ṛgveda 1


1,001.01  agnimīḻe purohitaṃ yajñasya devamṛtvijam |
1,001.01 hotāraṃ ratnadhātamam ||
1,001.02  agniḥ pūrvebhirṛṣibhirīḍyo nūtanairuta |
1,001.02 sa devāṃ eha vakṣati ||
1,001.03  agninā rayimaśnavatpoṣameva divedive |
1,001.03 yaśasaṃ vīravattamam ||
1,001.04  agne yaṃ yajñamadhvaraṃ viśvataḥ paribhūrasi |
1,001.04 sa iddeveṣu gacchati ||
1,001.05  agnirhotā kavikratuḥ satyaścitraśravastamaḥ |
1,001.05 devo devebhirā gamat ||
1,001.06  yadaṅga dāśuṣe tvamagne bhadraṃ kariṣyasi |
1,001.06 tavettatsatyamaṅgiraḥ ||
1,001.07  upa tvāgne divedive doṣāvastardhiyā vayam |
1,001.07 namo bharanta emasi ||
1,001.08  rājantamadhvarāṇāṃ gopāmṛtasya dīdivim |
1,001.08 vardhamānaṃ sve dame ||
1,001.09  sa naḥ piteva sūnave'gne sūpāyano bhava |
1,001.09 sacasvā naḥ svastaye ||

1,002.01  vāyavā yāhi darśateme somā araṅkṛtāḥ |
1,002.01 teṣāṃ pāhi śrudhī havam ||
1,002.02  vāya ukthebhirjarante tvāmacchā jaritāraḥ |
1,002.02 sutasomā aharvidaḥ ||
1,002.03  vāyo tava prapṛñcatī dhenā jigāti dāśuṣe |
1,002.03 urūcī somapītaye ||
1,002.04  indravāyū ime sutā upa prayobhirā gatam |
1,002.04 indavo vāmuśanti hi ||
1,002.05  vāyavindraśca cetathaḥ sutānāṃ vājinīvasū |
1,002.05 tāvā yātamupa dravat ||
1,002.06  vāyavindraśca sunvata ā yātamupa niṣkṛtam |
1,002.06 makṣvitthā dhiyā narā ||
1,002.07  mitraṃ huve pūtadakṣaṃ varuṇaṃ ca riśādasam |
1,002.07 dhiyaṃ ghṛtācīṃ sādhantā ||
1,002.08  ṛtena mitrāvaruṇāvṛtāvṛdhāvṛtaspṛśā |
1,002.08 kratuṃ bṛhantamāśāthe ||
1,002.09  kavī no mitrāvaruṇā tuvijātā urukṣayā |
1,002.09 dakṣaṃ dadhāte apasam ||

1,003.01  aśvinā yajvarīriṣo dravatpāṇī śubhaspatī |
1,003.01 purubhujā canasyatam ||
1,003.02  aśvinā purudaṃsasā narā śavīrayā dhiyā |
1,003.02 dhiṣṇyā vanataṃ giraḥ ||
1,003.03  dasrā yuvākavaḥ sutā nāsatyā vṛktabarhiṣaḥ |
1,003.03 ā yātaṃ rudravartanī ||
1,003.04  indrā yāhi citrabhāno sutā ime tvāyavaḥ |
1,003.04 aṇvībhistanā pūtāsaḥ ||
1,003.05  indrā yāhi dhiyeṣito viprajūtaḥ sutāvataḥ |
1,003.05 upa brahmāṇi vāghataḥ ||
1,003.06  indrā yāhi tūtujāna upa brahmāṇi harivaḥ |
1,003.06 sute dadhiṣva naścanaḥ ||
1,003.07  omāsaścarṣaṇīdhṛto viśve devāsa ā gata |
1,003.07 dāśvāṃso dāśuṣaḥ sutam ||
1,003.08  viśve devāso apturaḥ sutamā ganta tūrṇayaḥ |
1,003.08 usrā iva svasarāṇi ||
1,003.09  viśve devāso asridha ehimāyāso adruhaḥ |
1,003.09 medhaṃ juṣanta vahnayaḥ ||
1,003.10  pāvakā naḥ sarasvatī vājebhirvājinīvatī |
1,003.10 yajñaṃ vaṣṭu dhiyāvasuḥ ||
1,003.11  codayitrī sūnṛtānāṃ cetantī sumatīnām |
1,003.11 yajñaṃ dadhe sarasvatī ||
1,003.12  maho arṇaḥ sarasvatī pra cetayati ketunā |
1,003.12 dhiyo viśvā vi rājati ||

1,004.01  surūpakṛtnumūtaye sudughāmiva goduhe |
1,004.01 juhūmasi dyavidyavi ||
1,004.02  upa naḥ savanā gahi somasya somapāḥ piba |
1,004.02 godā idrevato madaḥ ||
1,004.03  athā te antamānāṃ vidyāma sumatīnām |
1,004.03 mā no ati khya ā gahi ||
1,004.04  parehi vigramastṛtamindraṃ pṛcchā vipaścitam |
1,004.04 yaste sakhibhya ā varam ||
1,004.05  uta bruvantu no nido niranyataścidārata |
1,004.05 dadhānā indra idduvaḥ ||
1,004.06  uta naḥ subhagāṃ arirvoceyurdasma kṛṣṭayaḥ |
1,004.06 syāmedindrasya śarmaṇi ||
1,004.07  emāśumāśave bhara yajñaśriyaṃ nṛmādanam |
1,004.07 patayanmandayatsakham ||
1,004.08  asya pītvā śatakrato ghano vṛtrāṇāmabhavaḥ |
1,004.08 prāvo vājeṣu vājinam ||
1,004.09  taṃ tvā vājeṣu vājinaṃ vājayāmaḥ śatakrato |
1,004.09 dhanānāmindra sātaye ||
1,004.10  yo rāyo'vanirmahānsupāraḥ sunvataḥ sakhā |
1,004.10 tasmā indrāya gāyata ||

1,005.01  ā tvetā ni ṣīdatendramabhi pra gāyata |
1,005.01 sakhāya stomavāhasaḥ ||
1,005.02  purūtamaṃ purūṇāmīśānaṃ vāryāṇām |
1,005.02 indraṃ some sacā sute ||
1,005.03  sa ghā no yoga ā bhuvatsa rāye sa purandhyām |
1,005.03 gamadvājebhirā sa naḥ ||
1,005.04  yasya saṃsthe na vṛṇvate harī samatsu śatravaḥ |
1,005.04 tasmā indrāya gāyata ||
1,005.05  sutapāvne sutā ime śucayo yanti vītaye |
1,005.05 somāso dadhyāśiraḥ ||
1,005.06  tvaṃ sutasya pītaye sadyo vṛddho ajāyathāḥ |
1,005.06 indra jyaiṣṭhyāya sukrato ||
1,005.07  ā tvā viśantvāśavaḥ somāsa indra girvaṇaḥ |
1,005.07 śaṃ te santu pracetase ||
1,005.08  tvāṃ stomā avīvṛdhantvāmukthā śatakrato |
1,005.08 tvāṃ vardhantu no giraḥ ||
1,005.09  akṣitotiḥ sanedimaṃ vājamindraḥ sahasriṇam |
1,005.09 yasminviśvāni pauṃsyā ||
1,005.10  mā no martā abhi druhantanūnāmindra girvaṇaḥ |
1,005.10 īśāno yavayā vadham ||

1,006.01  yuñjanti bradhnamaruṣaṃ carantaṃ pari tasthuṣaḥ |
1,006.01 rocante rocanā divi ||
1,006.02  yuñjantyasya kāmyā harī vipakṣasā rathe |
1,006.02 śoṇā dhṛṣṇū nṛvāhasā ||
1,006.03  ketuṃ kṛṇvannaketave peśo maryā apeśase |
1,006.03 samuṣadbhirajāyathāḥ ||
1,006.04  ādaha svadhāmanu punargarbhatvamerire |
1,006.04 dadhānā nāma yajñiyam ||
1,006.05  vīḻu cidārujatnubhirguhā cidindra vahnibhiḥ |
1,006.05 avinda usriyā anu ||
1,006.06  devayanto yathā matimacchā vidadvasuṃ giraḥ |
1,006.06 mahāmanūṣata śrutam ||
1,006.07  indreṇa saṃ hi dṛkṣase saṃjagmāno abibhyuṣā |
1,006.07 mandū samānavarcasā ||
1,006.08  anavadyairabhidyubhirmakhaḥ sahasvadarcati |
1,006.08 gaṇairindrasya kāmyaiḥ ||
1,006.09  ataḥ parijmannā gahi divo vā rocanādadhi |
1,006.09 samasminnṛñjate giraḥ ||
1,006.10  ito vā sātimīmahe divo vā pārthivādadhi |
1,006.10 indraṃ maho vā rajasaḥ ||

1,007.01  indramidgāthino bṛhadindramarkebhirarkiṇaḥ |
1,007.01 indraṃ vāṇīranūṣata ||
1,007.02  indra iddharyoḥ sacā sammiśla ā vacoyujā |
1,007.02 indro vajrī hiraṇyayaḥ ||
1,007.03  indro dīrghāya cakṣasa ā sūryaṃ rohayaddivi |
1,007.03 vi gobhiradrimairayat ||
1,007.04  indra vājeṣu no'va sahasrapradhaneṣu ca |
1,007.04 ugra ugrābhirūtibhiḥ ||
1,007.05  indraṃ vayaṃ mahādhana indramarbhe havāmahe |
1,007.05 yujaṃ vṛtreṣu vajriṇam ||
1,007.06  sa no vṛṣannamuṃ caruṃ satrādāvannapā vṛdhi |
1,007.06 asmabhyamapratiṣkutaḥ ||
1,007.07  tuñjetuñje ya uttare stomā indrasya vajriṇaḥ |
1,007.07 na vindhe asya suṣṭutim ||
1,007.08  vṛṣā yūtheva vaṃsagaḥ kṛṣṭīriyartyojasā |
1,007.08 īśāno apratiṣkutaḥ ||
1,007.09  ya ekaścarṣaṇīnāṃ vasūnāmirajyati |
1,007.09 indraḥ pañca kṣitīnām ||
1,007.10  indraṃ vo viśvataspari havāmahe janebhyaḥ |
1,007.10 asmākamastu kevalaḥ ||

1,008.01  endra sānasiṃ rayiṃ sajitvānaṃ sadāsaham |
1,008.01 varṣiṣṭhamūtaye bhara ||
1,008.02  ni yena muṣṭihatyayā ni vṛtrā ruṇadhāmahai |
1,008.02 tvotāso nyarvatā ||
1,008.03  indra tvotāsa ā vayaṃ vajraṃ ghanā dadīmahi |
1,008.03 jayema saṃ yudhi spṛdhaḥ ||
1,008.04  vayaṃ śūrebhirastṛbhirindra tvayā yujā vayam |
1,008.04 sāsahyāma pṛtanyataḥ ||
1,008.05  mahāṃ indraḥ paraśca nu mahitvamastu vajriṇe |
1,008.05 dyaurna prathinā śavaḥ ||
1,008.06  samohe vā ya āśata narastokasya sanitau |
1,008.06 viprāso vā dhiyāyavaḥ ||
1,008.07  yaḥ kukṣiḥ somapātamaḥ samudra iva pinvate |
1,008.07 urvīrāpo na kākudaḥ ||
1,008.08  evā hyasya sūnṛtā virapśī gomatī mahī |
1,008.08 pakvā śākhā na dāśuṣe ||
1,008.09  evā hi te vibhūtaya ūtaya indra māvate |
1,008.09 sadyaścitsanti dāśuṣe ||
1,008.10  evā hyasya kāmyā stoma ukthaṃ ca śaṃsyā |
1,008.10 indrāya somapītaye ||

1,009.01  indrehi matsyandhaso viśvebhiḥ somaparvabhiḥ |
1,009.01 mahāṃ abhiṣṭirojasā ||
1,009.02  emenaṃ sṛjatā sute mandimindrāya mandine |
1,009.02 cakriṃ viśvāni cakraye ||
1,009.03  matsvā suśipra mandibhi stomebhirviśvacarṣaṇe |
1,009.03 sacaiṣu savaneṣvā ||
1,009.04  asṛgramindra te giraḥ prati tvāmudahāsata |
1,009.04 ajoṣā vṛṣabhaṃ patim ||
1,009.05  saṃ codaya citramarvāgrādha indra vareṇyam |
1,009.05 asaditte vibhu prabhu ||
1,009.06  asmānsu tatra codayendra rāye rabhasvataḥ |
1,009.06 tuvidyumna yaśasvataḥ ||
1,009.07  saṃ gomadindra vājavadasme pṛthu śravo bṛhat |
1,009.07 viśvāyurdhehyakṣitam ||
1,009.08  asme dhehi śravo bṛhaddyumnaṃ sahasrasātamam |
1,009.08 indra tā rathinīriṣaḥ ||
1,009.09  vasorindraṃ vasupatiṃ gīrbhirgṛṇanta ṛgmiyam |
1,009.09 homa gantāramūtaye ||
1,009.10  sutesute nyokase bṛhadbṛhata edariḥ |
1,009.10 indrāya śūṣamarcati ||

1,010.01  gāyanti tvā gāyatriṇo'rcantyarkamarkiṇaḥ |
1,010.01 brahmāṇastvā śatakrata udvaṃśamiva yemire ||
1,010.02  yatsānoḥ sānumāruhadbhūryaspaṣṭa kartvam |
1,010.02 tadindro arthaṃ cetati yūthena vṛṣṇirejati ||
1,010.03  yukṣvā hi keśinā harī vṛṣaṇā kakṣyaprā |
1,010.03 athā na indra somapā girāmupaśrutiṃ cara ||
1,010.04  ehi stomāṃ abhi svarābhi gṛṇīhyā ruva |
1,010.04 brahma ca no vaso sacendra yajñaṃ ca vardhaya ||
1,010.05  ukthamindrāya śaṃsyaṃ vardhanaṃ puruniṣṣidhe |
1,010.05 śakro yathā suteṣu ṇo rāraṇatsakhyeṣu ca ||
1,010.06  tamitsakhitva īmahe taṃ rāye taṃ suvīrye |
1,010.06 sa śakra uta naḥ śakadindro vasu dayamānaḥ ||
1,010.07  suvivṛtaṃ sunirajamindra tvādātamidyaśaḥ |
1,010.07 gavāmapa vrajaṃ vṛdhi kṛṇuṣva rādho adrivaḥ ||
1,010.08  nahi tvā rodasī ubhe ṛghāyamāṇaminvataḥ |
1,010.08 jeṣaḥ svarvatīrapaḥ saṃ gā asmabhyaṃ dhūnuhi ||
1,010.09  āśrutkarṇa śrudhī havaṃ nū ciddadhiṣva me giraḥ |
1,010.09 indra stomamimaṃ mama kṛṣvā yujaścidantaram ||
1,010.10  vidmā hi tvā vṛṣantamaṃ vājeṣu havanaśrutam |
1,010.10 vṛṣantamasya hūmaha ūtiṃ sahasrasātamām ||
1,010.11  ā tū na indra kauśika mandasānaḥ sutaṃ piba |
1,010.11 navyamāyuḥ pra sū tira kṛdhī sahasrasāmṛṣim ||
1,010.12  pari tvā girvaṇo gira imā bhavantu viśvataḥ |
1,010.12 vṛddhāyumanu vṛddhayo juṣṭā bhavantu juṣṭayaḥ ||

1,011.01  indraṃ viśvā avīvṛdhansamudravyacasaṃ giraḥ |
1,011.01 rathītamaṃ rathīnāṃ vājānāṃ satpatiṃ patim ||
1,011.02  sakhye ta indra vājino mā bhema śavasaspate |
1,011.02 tvāmabhi pra ṇonumo jetāramaparājitam ||
1,011.03  pūrvīrindrasya rātayo na vi dasyantyūtayaḥ |
1,011.03 yadī vājasya gomata stotṛbhyo maṃhate magham ||
1,011.04  purāṃ bhinduryuvā kaviramitaujā ajāyata |
1,011.04 indro viśvasya karmaṇo dhartā vajrī puruṣṭutaḥ ||
1,011.05  tvaṃ valasya gomato'pāvaradrivo bilam |
1,011.05 tvāṃ devā abibhyuṣastujyamānāsa āviṣuḥ ||
1,011.06  tavāhaṃ śūra rātibhiḥ pratyāyaṃ sindhumāvadan |
1,011.06 upātiṣṭhanta girvaṇo viduṣṭe tasya kāravaḥ ||
1,011.07  māyābhirindra māyinaṃ tvaṃ śuṣṇamavātiraḥ |
1,011.07 viduṣṭe tasya medhirāsteṣāṃ śravāṃsyuttira ||
1,011.08  indramīśānamojasābhi stomā anūṣata |
1,011.08 sahasraṃ yasya rātaya uta vā santi bhūyasīḥ ||

1,012.01  agniṃ dūtaṃ vṛṇīmahe hotāraṃ viśvavedasam |
1,012.01 asya yajñasya sukratum ||
1,012.02  agnimagniṃ havīmabhiḥ sadā havanta viśpatim |
1,012.02 havyavāhaṃ purupriyam ||
1,012.03  agne devāṃ ihā vaha jajñāno vṛktabarhiṣe |
1,012.03 asi hotā na īḍyaḥ ||
1,012.04  tāṃ uśato vi bodhaya yadagne yāsi dūtyam |
1,012.04 devairā satsi barhiṣi ||
1,012.05  ghṛtāhavana dīdivaḥ prati ṣma riṣato daha |
1,012.05 agne tvaṃ rakṣasvinaḥ ||
1,012.06  agnināgniḥ samidhyate kavirgṛhapatiryuvā |
1,012.06 havyavāḍjuhvāsyaḥ ||
1,012.07  kavimagnimupa stuhi satyadharmāṇamadhvare |
1,012.07 devamamīvacātanam ||
1,012.08  yastvāmagne haviṣpatirdūtaṃ deva saparyati |
1,012.08 tasya sma prāvitā bhava ||
1,012.09  yo agniṃ devavītaye haviṣmāṃ āvivāsati |
1,012.09 tasmai pāvaka mṛḻaya ||
1,012.10  sa naḥ pāvaka dīdivo'gne devāṃ ihā vaha |
1,012.10 upa yajñaṃ haviśca naḥ ||
1,012.11  sa na stavāna ā bhara gāyatreṇa navīyasā |
1,012.11 rayiṃ vīravatīmiṣam ||
1,012.12  agne śukreṇa śociṣā viśvābhirdevahūtibhiḥ |
1,012.12 imaṃ stomaṃ juṣasva naḥ ||

1,013.01  susamiddho na ā vaha devāṃ agne haviṣmate |
1,013.01 hotaḥ pāvaka yakṣi ca ||
1,013.02  madhumantaṃ tanūnapādyajñaṃ deveṣu naḥ kave |
1,013.02 adyā kṛṇuhi vītaye ||
1,013.03  narāśaṃsamiha priyamasminyajña upa hvaye |
1,013.03 madhujihvaṃ haviṣkṛtam ||
1,013.04  agne sukhatame rathe devāṃ īḻita ā vaha |
1,013.04 asi hotā manurhitaḥ ||
1,013.05  stṛṇīta barhirānuṣagghṛtapṛṣṭhaṃ manīṣiṇaḥ |
1,013.05 yatrāmṛtasya cakṣaṇam ||
1,013.06  vi śrayantāmṛtāvṛdho dvāro devīrasaścataḥ |
1,013.06 adyā nūnaṃ ca yaṣṭave ||
1,013.07  naktoṣāsā supeśasāsminyajña upa hvaye |
1,013.07 idaṃ no barhirāsade ||
1,013.08  tā sujihvā upa hvaye hotārā daivyā kavī |
1,013.08 yajñaṃ no yakṣatāmimam ||
1,013.09  iḻā sarasvatī mahī tisro devīrmayobhuvaḥ |
1,013.09 barhiḥ sīdantvasridhaḥ ||
1,013.10  iha tvaṣṭāramagriyaṃ viśvarūpamupa hvaye |
1,013.10 asmākamastu kevalaḥ ||
1,013.11  ava sṛjā vanaspate deva devebhyo haviḥ |
1,013.11 pra dāturastu cetanam ||
1,013.12  svāhā yajñaṃ kṛṇotanendrāya yajvano gṛhe |
1,013.12 tatra devāṃ upa hvaye ||

1,014.01  aibhiragne duvo giro viśvebhiḥ somapītaye |
1,014.01 devebhiryāhi yakṣi ca ||
1,014.02  ā tvā kaṇvā ahūṣata gṛṇanti vipra te dhiyaḥ |
1,014.02 devebhiragna ā gahi ||
1,014.03  indravāyū bṛhaspatiṃ mitrāgniṃ pūṣaṇaṃ bhagam |
1,014.03 ādityānmārutaṃ gaṇam ||
1,014.04  pra vo bhriyanta indavo matsarā mādayiṣṇavaḥ |
1,014.04 drapsā madhvaścamūṣadaḥ ||
1,014.05  īḻate tvāmavasyavaḥ kaṇvāso vṛktabarhiṣaḥ |
1,014.05 haviṣmanto araṅkṛtaḥ ||
1,014.06  ghṛtapṛṣṭhā manoyujo ye tvā vahanti vahnayaḥ |
1,014.06 ā devānsomapītaye ||
1,014.07  tānyajatrāṃ ṛtāvṛdho'gne patnīvataskṛdhi |
1,014.07 madhvaḥ sujihva pāyaya ||
1,014.08  ye yajatrā ya īḍyāste te pibantu jihvayā |
1,014.08 madhoragne vaṣaṭkṛti ||
1,014.09  ākīṃ sūryasya rocanādviśvāndevāṃ uṣarbudhaḥ |
1,014.09 vipro hoteha vakṣati ||
1,014.10  viśvebhiḥ somyaṃ madhvagna indreṇa vāyunā |
1,014.10 pibā mitrasya dhāmabhiḥ ||
1,014.11  tvaṃ hotā manurhito'gne yajñeṣu sīdasi |
1,014.11 semaṃ no adhvaraṃ yaja ||
1,014.12  yukṣvā hyaruṣī rathe harito deva rohitaḥ |
1,014.12 tābhirdevāṃ ihā vaha ||

1,015.01  indra somaṃ piba ṛtunā tvā viśantvindavaḥ |
1,015.01 matsarāsastadokasaḥ ||
1,015.02  marutaḥ pibata ṛtunā potrādyajñaṃ punītana |
1,015.02 yūyaṃ hi ṣṭhā sudānavaḥ ||
1,015.03  abhi yajñaṃ gṛṇīhi no gnāvo neṣṭaḥ piba ṛtunā |
1,015.03 tvaṃ hi ratnadhā asi ||
1,015.04  agne devāṃ ihā vaha sādayā yoniṣu triṣu |
1,015.04 pari bhūṣa piba ṛtunā ||
1,015.05  brāhmaṇādindra rādhasaḥ pibā somamṛtūṃranu |
1,015.05 taveddhi sakhyamastṛtam ||
1,015.06  yuvaṃ dakṣaṃ dhṛtavrata mitrāvaruṇa dūḻabham |
1,015.06 ṛtunā yajñamāśāthe ||
1,015.07  draviṇodā draviṇaso grāvahastāso adhvare |
1,015.07 yajñeṣu devamīḻate ||
1,015.08  draviṇodā dadātu no vasūni yāni śṛṇvire |
1,015.08 deveṣu tā vanāmahe ||
1,015.09  draviṇodāḥ pipīṣati juhota pra ca tiṣṭhata |
1,015.09 neṣṭrādṛtubhiriṣyata ||
1,015.10  yattvā turīyamṛtubhirdraviṇodo yajāmahe |
1,015.10 adha smā no dadirbhava ||
1,015.11  aśvinā pibataṃ madhu dīdyagnī śucivratā |
1,015.11 ṛtunā yajñavāhasā ||
1,015.12  gārhapatyena santya ṛtunā yajñanīrasi |
1,015.12 devāndevayate yaja ||

1,016.01  ā tvā vahantu harayo vṛṣaṇaṃ somapītaye |
1,016.01 indra tvā sūracakṣasaḥ ||
1,016.02  imā dhānā ghṛtasnuvo harī ihopa vakṣataḥ |
1,016.02 indraṃ sukhatame rathe ||
1,016.03  indraṃ prātarhavāmaha indraṃ prayatyadhvare |
1,016.03 indraṃ somasya pītaye ||
1,016.04  upa naḥ sutamā gahi haribhirindra keśibhiḥ |
1,016.04 sute hi tvā havāmahe ||
1,016.05  semaṃ na stomamā gahyupedaṃ savanaṃ sutam |
1,016.05 gauro na tṛṣitaḥ piba ||
1,016.06  ime somāsa indavaḥ sutāso adhi barhiṣi |
1,016.06 tāṃ indra sahase piba ||
1,016.07  ayaṃ te stomo agriyo hṛdispṛgastu śantamaḥ |
1,016.07 athā somaṃ sutaṃ piba ||
1,016.08  viśvamitsavanaṃ sutamindro madāya gacchati |
1,016.08 vṛtrahā somapītaye ||
1,016.09  semaṃ naḥ kāmamā pṛṇa gobhiraśvaiḥ śatakrato |
1,016.09 stavāma tvā svādhyaḥ ||

1,017.01  indrāvaruṇayorahaṃ samrājorava ā vṛṇe |
1,017.01 tā no mṛḻāta īdṛśe ||
1,017.02  gantārā hi stho'vase havaṃ viprasya māvataḥ |
1,017.02 dhartārā carṣaṇīnām ||
1,017.03  anukāmaṃ tarpayethāmindrāvaruṇa rāya ā |
1,017.03 tā vāṃ nediṣṭhamīmahe ||
1,017.04  yuvāku hi śacīnāṃ yuvāku sumatīnām |
1,017.04 bhūyāma vājadāvnām ||
1,017.05  indraḥ sahasradāvnāṃ varuṇaḥ śaṃsyānām |
1,017.05 kraturbhavatyukthyaḥ ||
1,017.06  tayoridavasā vayaṃ sanema ni ca dhīmahi |
1,017.06 syāduta prarecanam ||
1,017.07  indrāvaruṇa vāmahaṃ huve citrāya rādhase |
1,017.07 asmānsu jigyuṣaskṛtam ||
1,017.08  indrāvaruṇa nū nu vāṃ siṣāsantīṣu dhīṣvā |
1,017.08 asmabhyaṃ śarma yacchatam ||
1,017.09  pra vāmaśnotu suṣṭutirindrāvaruṇa yāṃ huve |
1,017.09 yāmṛdhāthe sadhastutim ||

1,018.01  somānaṃ svaraṇaṃ kṛṇuhi brahmaṇaspate |
1,018.01 kakṣīvantaṃ ya auśijaḥ ||
1,018.02  yo revānyo amīvahā vasuvitpuṣṭivardhanaḥ |
1,018.02 sa naḥ siṣaktu yasturaḥ ||
1,018.03  mā naḥ śaṃso araruṣo dhūrtiḥ praṇaṅmartyasya |
1,018.03 rakṣā ṇo brahmaṇaspate ||
1,018.04  sa ghā vīro na riṣyati yamindro brahmaṇaspatiḥ |
1,018.04 somo hinoti martyam ||
1,018.05  tvaṃ taṃ brahmaṇaspate soma indraśca martyam |
1,018.05 dakṣiṇā pātvaṃhasaḥ ||
1,018.06  sadasaspatimadbhutaṃ priyamindrasya kāmyam |
1,018.06 saniṃ medhāmayāsiṣam ||
1,018.07  yasmādṛte na sidhyati yajño vipaścitaścana |
1,018.07 sa dhīnāṃ yogaminvati ||
1,018.08  ādṛdhnoti haviṣkṛtiṃ prāñcaṃ kṛṇotyadhvaram |
1,018.08 hotrā deveṣu gacchati ||
1,018.09  narāśaṃsaṃ sudhṛṣṭamamapaśyaṃ saprathastamam |
1,018.09 divo na sadmamakhasam ||

1,019.01  prati tyaṃ cārumadhvaraṃ gopīthāya pra hūyase |
1,019.01 marudbhiragna ā gahi ||
1,019.02  nahi devo na martyo mahastava kratuṃ paraḥ |
1,019.02 marudbhiragna ā gahi ||
1,019.03  ye maho rajaso vidurviśve devāso adruhaḥ |
1,019.03 marudbhiragna ā gahi ||
1,019.04  ya ugrā arkamānṛcuranādhṛṣṭāsa ojasā |
1,019.04 marudbhiragna ā gahi ||
1,019.05  ye śubhrā ghoravarpasaḥ sukṣatrāso riśādasaḥ |
1,019.05 marudbhiragna ā gahi ||
1,019.06  ye nākasyādhi rocane divi devāsa āsate |
1,019.06 marudbhiragna ā gahi ||
1,019.07  ya īṅkhayanti parvatāntiraḥ samudramarṇavam |
1,019.07 marudbhiragna ā gahi ||
1,019.08  ā ye tanvanti raśmibhistiraḥ samudramojasā |
1,019.08 marudbhiragna ā gahi ||
1,019.09  abhi tvā pūrvapītaye sṛjāmi somyaṃ madhu |
1,019.09 marudbhiragna ā gahi ||

1,020.01  ayaṃ devāya janmane stomo viprebhirāsayā |
1,020.01 akāri ratnadhātamaḥ ||
1,020.02  ya indrāya vacoyujā tatakṣurmanasā harī |
1,020.02 śamībhiryajñamāśata ||
1,020.03  takṣannāsatyābhyāṃ parijmānaṃ sukhaṃ ratham |
1,020.03 takṣandhenuṃ sabardughām ||
1,020.04  yuvānā pitarā punaḥ satyamantrā ṛjūyavaḥ |
1,020.04 ṛbhavo viṣṭyakrata ||
1,020.05  saṃ vo madāso agmatendreṇa ca marutvatā |
1,020.05 ādityebhiśca rājabhiḥ ||
1,020.06  uta tyaṃ camasaṃ navaṃ tvaṣṭurdevasya niṣkṛtam |
1,020.06 akarta caturaḥ punaḥ ||
1,020.07  te no ratnāni dhattana trirā sāptāni sunvate |
1,020.07 ekamekaṃ suśastibhiḥ ||
1,020.08  adhārayanta vahnayo'bhajanta sukṛtyayā |
1,020.08 bhāgaṃ deveṣu yajñiyam ||

1,021.01  ihendrāgnī upa hvaye tayoritstomamuśmasi |
1,021.01 tā somaṃ somapātamā ||
1,021.02  tā yajñeṣu pra śaṃsatendrāgnī śumbhatā naraḥ |
1,021.02 tā gāyatreṣu gāyata ||
1,021.03  tā mitrasya praśastaya indrāgnī tā havāmahe |
1,021.03 somapā somapītaye ||
1,021.04  ugrā santā havāmaha upedaṃ savanaṃ sutam |
1,021.04 indrāgnī eha gacchatām ||
1,021.05  tā mahāntā sadaspatī indrāgnī rakṣa ubjatam |
1,021.05 aprajāḥ santvatriṇaḥ ||
1,021.06  tena satyena jāgṛtamadhi pracetune pade |
1,021.06 indrāgnī śarma yacchatam ||

1,022.01  prātaryujā vi bodhayāśvināveha gacchatām |
1,022.01 asya somasya pītaye ||
1,022.02  yā surathā rathītamobhā devā divispṛśā |
1,022.02 aśvinā tā havāmahe ||
1,022.03  yā vāṃ kaśā madhumatyaśvinā sūnṛtāvatī |
1,022.03 tayā yajñaṃ mimikṣatam ||
1,022.04  nahi vāmasti dūrake yatrā rathena gacchathaḥ |
1,022.04 aśvinā somino gṛham ||
1,022.05  hiraṇyapāṇimūtaye savitāramupa hvaye |
1,022.05 sa cettā devatā padam ||
1,022.06  apāṃ napātamavase savitāramupa stuhi |
1,022.06 tasya vratānyuśmasi ||
1,022.07  vibhaktāraṃ havāmahe vasościtrasya rādhasaḥ |
1,022.07 savitāraṃ nṛcakṣasam ||
1,022.08  sakhāya ā ni ṣīdata savitā stomyo nu naḥ |
1,022.08 dātā rādhāṃsi śumbhati ||
1,022.09  agne patnīrihā vaha devānāmuśatīrupa |
1,022.09 tvaṣṭāraṃ somapītaye ||
1,022.10  ā gnā agna ihāvase hotrāṃ yaviṣṭha bhāratīm |
1,022.10 varūtrīṃ dhiṣaṇāṃ vaha ||
1,022.11  abhi no devīravasā mahaḥ śarmaṇā nṛpatnīḥ |
1,022.11 acchinnapatrāḥ sacantām ||
1,022.12  ihendrāṇīmupa hvaye varuṇānīṃ svastaye |
1,022.12 agnāyīṃ somapītaye ||
1,022.13  mahī dyauḥ pṛthivī ca na imaṃ yajñaṃ mimikṣatām |
1,022.13 pipṛtāṃ no bharīmabhiḥ ||
1,022.14  tayoridghṛtavatpayo viprā rihanti dhītibhiḥ |
1,022.14 gandharvasya dhruve pade ||
1,022.15  syonā pṛthivi bhavānṛkṣarā niveśanī |
1,022.15 yacchā naḥ śarma saprathaḥ ||
1,022.16  ato devā avantu no yato viṣṇurvicakrame |
1,022.16 pṛthivyāḥ sapta dhāmabhiḥ ||
1,022.17  idaṃ viṣṇurvi cakrame tredhā ni dadhe padam |
1,022.17 samūḻhamasya pāṃsure ||
1,022.18  trīṇi padā vi cakrame viṣṇurgopā adābhyaḥ |
1,022.18 ato dharmāṇi dhārayan ||
1,022.19  viṣṇoḥ karmāṇi paśyata yato vratāni paspaśe |
1,022.19 indrasya yujyaḥ sakhā ||
1,022.20  tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padaṃ sadā paśyanti sūrayaḥ |
1,022.20 divīva cakṣurātatam ||
1,022.21  tadviprāso vipanyavo jāgṛvāṃsaḥ samindhate |
1,022.21 viṣṇoryatparamaṃ padam ||

1,023.01  tīvrāḥ somāsa ā gahyāśīrvantaḥ sutā ime |
1,023.01 vāyo tānprasthitānpiba ||
1,023.02  ubhā devā divispṛśendravāyū havāmahe |
1,023.02 asya somasya pītaye ||
1,023.03  indravāyū manojuvā viprā havanta ūtaye |
1,023.03 sahasrākṣā dhiyaspatī ||
1,023.04  mitraṃ vayaṃ havāmahe varuṇaṃ somapītaye |
1,023.04 jajñānā pūtadakṣasā ||
1,023.05  ṛtena yāvṛtāvṛdhāvṛtasya jyotiṣaspatī |
1,023.05 tā mitrāvaruṇā huve ||
1,023.06  varuṇaḥ prāvitā bhuvanmitro viśvābhirūtibhiḥ |
1,023.06 karatāṃ naḥ surādhasaḥ ||
1,023.07  marutvantaṃ havāmaha indramā somapītaye |
1,023.07 sajūrgaṇena tṛmpatu ||
1,023.08  indrajyeṣṭhā marudgaṇā devāsaḥ pūṣarātayaḥ |
1,023.08 viśve mama śrutā havam ||
1,023.09  hata vṛtraṃ sudānava indreṇa sahasā yujā |
1,023.09 mā no duḥśaṃsa īśata ||
1,023.10  viśvāndevānhavāmahe marutaḥ somapītaye |
1,023.10 ugrā hi pṛśnimātaraḥ ||
1,023.11  jayatāmiva tanyaturmarutāmeti dhṛṣṇuyā |
1,023.11 yacchubhaṃ yāthanā naraḥ ||
1,023.12  haskārādvidyutasparyato jātā avantu naḥ |
1,023.12 maruto mṛḻayantu naḥ ||
1,023.13  ā pūṣañcitrabarhiṣamāghṛṇe dharuṇaṃ divaḥ |
1,023.13 ājā naṣṭaṃ yathā paśum ||
1,023.14  pūṣā rājānamāghṛṇirapagūḻhaṃ guhā hitam |
1,023.14 avindaccitrabarhiṣam ||
1,023.15  uto sa mahyamindubhiḥ ṣaḍyuktāṃ anuseṣidhat |
1,023.15 gobhiryavaṃ na carkṛṣat ||
1,023.16  ambayo yantyadhvabhirjāmayo adhvarīyatām |
1,023.16 pṛñcatīrmadhunā payaḥ ||
1,023.17  amūryā upa sūrye yābhirvā sūryaḥ saha |
1,023.17 tā no hinvantvadhvaram ||
1,023.18  apo devīrupa hvaye yatra gāvaḥ pibanti naḥ |
1,023.18 sindhubhyaḥ kartvaṃ haviḥ ||
1,023.19  apsvantaramṛtamapsu bheṣajamapāmuta praśastaye |
1,023.19 devā bhavata vājinaḥ ||
1,023.20  apsu me somo abravīdantarviśvāni bheṣajā |
1,023.20 agniṃ ca viśvaśambhuvamāpaśca viśvabheṣajīḥ ||
1,023.21  āpaḥ pṛṇīta bheṣajaṃ varūthaṃ tanve mama |
1,023.21 jyokca sūryaṃ dṛśe ||
1,023.22  idamāpaḥ pra vahata yatkiṃ ca duritaṃ mayi |
1,023.22 yadvāhamabhidudroha yadvā śepa utānṛtam ||
1,023.23  āpo adyānvacāriṣaṃ rasena samagasmahi |
1,023.23 payasvānagna ā gahi taṃ mā saṃ sṛja varcasā ||
1,023.24  saṃ māgne varcasā sṛja saṃ prajayā samāyuṣā |
1,023.24 vidyurme asya devā indro vidyātsaha ṛṣibhiḥ ||

1,024.01  kasya nūnaṃ katamasyāmṛtānāṃ manāmahe cāru devasya nāma |
1,024.01 ko no mahyā aditaye punardātpitaraṃ ca dṛśeyaṃ mātaraṃ ca ||
1,024.02  agnervayaṃ prathamasyāmṛtānāṃ manāmahe cāru devasya nāma |
1,024.02 sa no mahyā aditaye punardātpitaraṃ ca dṛśeyaṃ mātaraṃ ca ||
1,024.03  abhi tvā deva savitarīśānaṃ vāryāṇām |
1,024.03 sadāvanbhāgamīmahe ||
1,024.04  yaściddhi ta itthā bhagaḥ śaśamānaḥ purā nidaḥ |
1,024.04 adveṣo hastayordadhe ||
1,024.05  bhagabhaktasya te vayamudaśema tavāvasā |
1,024.05 mūrdhānaṃ rāya ārabhe ||
1,024.06  nahi te kṣatraṃ na saho na manyuṃ vayaścanāmī patayanta āpuḥ |
1,024.06 nemā āpo animiṣaṃ carantīrna ye vātasya praminantyabhvam ||
1,024.07  abudhne rājā varuṇo vanasyordhvaṃ stūpaṃ dadate pūtadakṣaḥ |
1,024.07 nīcīnā sthurupari budhna eṣāmasme antarnihitāḥ ketavaḥ syuḥ ||
1,024.08  uruṃ hi rājā varuṇaścakāra sūryāya panthāmanvetavā u |
1,024.08 apade pādā pratidhātave'karutāpavaktā hṛdayāvidhaścit ||
1,024.09  śataṃ te rājanbhiṣajaḥ sahasramurvī gabhīrā sumatiṣṭe astu |
1,024.09 bādhasva dūre nirṛtiṃ parācaiḥ kṛtaṃ cidenaḥ pra mumugdhyasmat ||
1,024.10  amī ya ṛkṣā nihitāsa uccā naktaṃ dadṛśre kuha ciddiveyuḥ |
1,024.10 adabdhāni varuṇasya vratāni vicākaśaccandramā naktameti ||
1,024.11  tattvā yāmi brahmaṇā vandamānastadā śāste yajamāno havirbhiḥ |
1,024.11 aheḻamāno varuṇeha bodhyuruśaṃsa mā na āyuḥ pra moṣīḥ ||
1,024.12  tadinnaktaṃ taddivā mahyamāhustadayaṃ keto hṛda ā vi caṣṭe |
1,024.12 śunaḥśepo yamahvadgṛbhītaḥ so asmānrājā varuṇo mumoktu ||
1,024.13  śunaḥśepo hyahvadgṛbhītastriṣvādityaṃ drupadeṣu baddhaḥ |
1,024.13 avainaṃ rājā varuṇaḥ sasṛjyādvidvāṃ adabdho vi mumoktu pāśān ||
1,024.14  ava te heḻo varuṇa namobhirava yajñebhirīmahe havirbhiḥ |
1,024.14 kṣayannasmabhyamasura pracetā rājannenāṃsi śiśrathaḥ kṛtāni ||
1,024.15  uduttamaṃ varuṇa pāśamasmadavādhamaṃ vi madhyamaṃ śrathāya |
1,024.15 athā vayamāditya vrate tavānāgaso aditaye syāma ||

1,025.01  yacciddhi te viśo yathā pra deva varuṇa vratam |
1,025.01 minīmasi dyavidyavi ||
1,025.02  mā no vadhāya hatnave jihīḻānasya rīradhaḥ |
1,025.02 mā hṛṇānasya manyave ||
1,025.03  vi mṛḻīkāya te mano rathīraśvaṃ na saṃditam |
1,025.03 gīrbhirvaruṇa sīmahi ||
1,025.04  parā hi me vimanyavaḥ patanti vasyaiṣṭaye |
1,025.04 vayo na vasatīrupa ||
1,025.05  kadā kṣatraśriyaṃ naramā varuṇaṃ karāmahe |
1,025.05 mṛḻīkāyorucakṣasam ||
1,025.06  taditsamānamāśāte venantā na pra yucchataḥ |
1,025.06 dhṛtavratāya dāśuṣe ||
1,025.07  vedā yo vīnāṃ padamantarikṣeṇa patatām |
1,025.07 veda nāvaḥ samudriyaḥ ||
1,025.08  veda māso dhṛtavrato dvādaśa prajāvataḥ |
1,025.08 vedā ya upajāyate ||
1,025.09  veda vātasya vartanimurorṛṣvasya bṛhataḥ |
1,025.09 vedā ye adhyāsate ||
1,025.10  ni ṣasāda dhṛtavrato varuṇaḥ pastyāsvā |
1,025.10 sāmrājyāya sukratuḥ ||
1,025.11  ato viśvānyadbhutā cikitvāṃ abhi paśyati |
1,025.11 kṛtāni yā ca kartvā ||
1,025.12  sa no viśvāhā sukraturādityaḥ supathā karat |
1,025.12 pra ṇa āyūṃṣi tāriṣat ||
1,025.13  bibhraddrāpiṃ hiraṇyayaṃ varuṇo vasta nirṇijam |
1,025.13 pari spaśo ni ṣedire ||
1,025.14  na yaṃ dipsanti dipsavo na druhvāṇo janānām |
1,025.14 na devamabhimātayaḥ ||
1,025.15  uta yo mānuṣeṣvā yaśaścakre asāmyā |
1,025.15 asmākamudareṣvā ||
1,025.16  parā me yanti dhītayo gāvo na gavyūtīranu |
1,025.16 icchantīrurucakṣasam ||
1,025.17  saṃ nu vocāvahai punaryato me madhvābhṛtam |
1,025.17 hoteva kṣadase priyam ||
1,025.18  darśaṃ nu viśvadarśataṃ darśaṃ rathamadhi kṣami |
1,025.18 etā juṣata me giraḥ ||
1,025.19  imaṃ me varuṇa śrudhī havamadyā ca mṛḻaya |
1,025.19 tvāmavasyurā cake ||
1,025.20  tvaṃ viśvasya medhira divaśca gmaśca rājasi |
1,025.20 sa yāmani prati śrudhi ||
1,025.21  uduttamaṃ mumugdhi no vi pāśaṃ madhyamaṃ cṛta |
1,025.21 avādhamāni jīvase ||

1,026.01  vasiṣvā hi miyedhya vastrāṇyūrjāṃ pate |
1,026.01 semaṃ no adhvaraṃ yaja ||
1,026.02  ni no hotā vareṇyaḥ sadā yaviṣṭha manmabhiḥ |
1,026.02 agne divitmatā vacaḥ ||
1,026.03  ā hi ṣmā sūnave pitāpiryajatyāpaye |
1,026.03 sakhā sakhye vareṇyaḥ ||
1,026.04  ā no barhī riśādaso varuṇo mitro aryamā |
1,026.04 sīdantu manuṣo yathā ||
1,026.05  pūrvya hotarasya no mandasva sakhyasya ca |
1,026.05 imā u ṣu śrudhī giraḥ ||
1,026.06  yacciddhi śaśvatā tanā devaṃdevaṃ yajāmahe |
1,026.06 tve iddhūyate haviḥ ||
1,026.07  priyo no astu viśpatirhotā mandro vareṇyaḥ |
1,026.07 priyāḥ svagnayo vayam ||
1,026.08  svagnayo hi vāryaṃ devāso dadhire ca naḥ |
1,026.08 svagnayo manāmahe ||
1,026.09  athā na ubhayeṣāmamṛta martyānām |
1,026.09 mithaḥ santu praśastayaḥ ||
1,026.10  viśvebhiragne agnibhirimaṃ yajñamidaṃ vacaḥ |
1,026.10 cano dhāḥ sahaso yaho ||

1,027.01  aśvaṃ na tvā vāravantaṃ vandadhyā agniṃ namobhiḥ |
1,027.01 samrājantamadhvarāṇām ||
1,027.02  sa ghā naḥ sūnuḥ śavasā pṛthupragāmā suśevaḥ |
1,027.02 mīḍhvāṃ asmākaṃ babhūyāt ||
1,027.03  sa no dūrāccāsācca ni martyādaghāyoḥ |
1,027.03 pāhi sadamidviśvāyuḥ ||
1,027.04  imamū ṣu tvamasmākaṃ saniṃ gāyatraṃ navyāṃsam |
1,027.04 agne deveṣu pra vocaḥ ||
1,027.05  ā no bhaja parameṣvā vājeṣu madhyameṣu |
1,027.05 śikṣā vasvo antamasya ||
1,027.06  vibhaktāsi citrabhāno sindhorūrmā upāka ā |
1,027.06 sadyo dāśuṣe kṣarasi ||
1,027.07  yamagne pṛtsu martyamavā vājeṣu yaṃ junāḥ |
1,027.07 sa yantā śaśvatīriṣaḥ ||
1,027.08  nakirasya sahantya paryetā kayasya cit |
1,027.08 vājo asti śravāyyaḥ ||
1,027.09  sa vājaṃ viśvacarṣaṇirarvadbhirastu tarutā |
1,027.09 viprebhirastu sanitā ||
1,027.10  jarābodha tadviviḍḍhi viśeviśe yajñiyāya |
1,027.10 stomaṃ rudrāya dṛśīkam ||
1,027.11  sa no mahāṃ animāno dhūmaketuḥ puruścandraḥ |
1,027.11 dhiye vājāya hinvatu ||
1,027.12  sa revāṃ iva viśpatirdaivyaḥ ketuḥ śṛṇotu naḥ |
1,027.12 ukthairagnirbṛhadbhānuḥ ||
1,027.13  namo mahadbhyo namo arbhakebhyo namo yuvabhyo nama āśinebhyaḥ |
1,027.13 yajāma devānyadi śaknavāma mā jyāyasaḥ śaṃsamā vṛkṣi devāḥ ||

1,028.01  yatra grāvā pṛthubudhna ūrdhvo bhavati sotave |
1,028.01 ulūkhalasutānāmavedvindra jalgulaḥ ||
1,028.02  yatra dvāviva jaghanādhiṣavaṇyā kṛtā |
1,028.02 ulūkhalasutānāmavedvindra jalgulaḥ ||
1,028.03  yatra nāryapacyavamupacyavaṃ ca śikṣate |
1,028.03 ulūkhalasutānāmavedvindra jalgulaḥ ||
1,028.04  yatra manthāṃ vibadhnate raśmīnyamitavā iva |
1,028.04 ulūkhalasutānāmavedvindra jalgulaḥ ||
1,028.05  yacciddhi tvaṃ gṛhegṛha ulūkhalaka yujyase |
1,028.05 iha dyumattamaṃ vada jayatāmiva dundubhiḥ ||
1,028.06  uta sma te vanaspate vāto vi vātyagramit |
1,028.06 atho indrāya pātave sunu somamulūkhala ||
1,028.07  āyajī vājasātamā tā hyuccā vijarbhṛtaḥ |
1,028.07 harī ivāndhāṃsi bapsatā ||
1,028.08  tā no adya vanaspatī ṛṣvāvṛṣvebhiḥ sotṛbhiḥ |
1,028.08 indrāya madhumatsutam ||
1,028.09  ucchiṣṭaṃ camvorbhara somaṃ pavitra ā sṛja |
1,028.09 ni dhehi goradhi tvaci ||

1,029.01  yacciddhi satya somapā anāśastā iva smasi |
1,029.01 ā tū na indra śaṃsaya goṣvaśveṣu śubhriṣu sahasreṣu tuvīmagha ||
1,029.02  śiprinvājānāṃ pate śacīvastava daṃsanā |
1,029.02 ā tū na indra śaṃsaya goṣvaśveṣu śubhriṣu sahasreṣu tuvīmagha ||
1,029.03  ni ṣvāpayā mithūdṛśā sastāmabudhyamāne |
1,029.03 ā tū na indra śaṃsaya goṣvaśveṣu śubhriṣu sahasreṣu tuvīmagha ||
1,029.04  sasantu tyā arātayo bodhantu śūra rātayaḥ |
1,029.04 ā tū na indra śaṃsaya goṣvaśveṣu śubhriṣu sahasreṣu tuvīmagha ||
1,029.05  samindra gardabhaṃ mṛṇa nuvantaṃ pāpayāmuyā |
1,029.05 ā tū na indra śaṃsaya goṣvaśveṣu śubhriṣu sahasreṣu tuvīmagha ||
1,029.06  patāti kuṇḍṛṇācyā dūraṃ vāto vanādadhi |
1,029.06 ā tū na indra śaṃsaya goṣvaśveṣu śubhriṣu sahasreṣu tuvīmagha ||
1,029.07  sarvaṃ parikrośaṃ jahi jambhayā kṛkadāśvam |
1,029.07 ā tū na indra śaṃsaya goṣvaśveṣu śubhriṣu sahasreṣu tuvīmagha ||

1,030.01  ā va indraṃ kriviṃ yathā vājayantaḥ śatakratum |
1,030.01 maṃhiṣṭhaṃ siñca indubhiḥ ||
1,030.02  śataṃ vā yaḥ śucīnāṃ sahasraṃ vā samāśirām |
1,030.02 edu nimnaṃ na rīyate ||
1,030.03  saṃ yanmadāya śuṣmiṇa enā hyasyodare |
1,030.03 samudro na vyaco dadhe ||
1,030.04  ayamu te samatasi kapota iva garbhadhim |
1,030.04 vacastaccinna ohase ||
1,030.05  stotraṃ rādhānāṃ pate girvāho vīra yasya te |
1,030.05 vibhūtirastu sūnṛtā ||
1,030.06  ūrdhvastiṣṭhā na ūtaye'sminvāje śatakrato |
1,030.06 samanyeṣu bravāvahai ||
1,030.07  yogeyoge tavastaraṃ vājevāje havāmahe |
1,030.07 sakhāya indramūtaye ||
1,030.08  ā ghā gamadyadi śravatsahasriṇībhirūtibhiḥ |
1,030.08 vājebhirupa no havam ||
1,030.09  anu pratnasyaukaso huve tuvipratiṃ naram |
1,030.09 yaṃ te pūrvaṃ pitā huve ||
1,030.10  taṃ tvā vayaṃ viśvavārā śāsmahe puruhūta |
1,030.10 sakhe vaso jaritṛbhyaḥ ||
1,030.11  asmākaṃ śipriṇīnāṃ somapāḥ somapāvnām |
1,030.11 sakhe vajrinsakhīnām ||
1,030.12  tathā tadastu somapāḥ sakhe vajrintathā kṛṇu |
1,030.12 yathā ta uśmasīṣṭaye ||
1,030.13  revatīrnaḥ sadhamāda indre santu tuvivājāḥ |
1,030.13 kṣumanto yābhirmadema ||
1,030.14  ā gha tvāvāntmanāpta stotṛbhyo dhṛṣṇaviyānaḥ |
1,030.14 ṛṇorakṣaṃ na cakryoḥ ||
1,030.15  ā yadduvaḥ śatakratavā kāmaṃ jaritṝṇām |
1,030.15 ṛṇorakṣaṃ na śacībhiḥ ||
1,030.16  śaśvadindraḥ popruthadbhirjigāya nānadadbhiḥ śāśvasadbhirdhanāni |
1,030.16 sa no hiraṇyarathaṃ daṃsanāvānsa naḥ sanitā sanaye sa no'dāt ||
1,030.17  āśvināvaśvāvatyeṣā yātaṃ śavīrayā |
1,030.17 gomaddasrā hiraṇyavat ||
1,030.18  samānayojano hi vāṃ ratho dasrāvamartyaḥ |
1,030.18 samudre aśvineyate ||
1,030.19  nyaghnyasya mūrdhani cakraṃ rathasya yemathuḥ |
1,030.19 pari dyāmanyadīyate ||
1,030.20  kasta uṣaḥ kadhapriye bhuje marto amartye |
1,030.20 kaṃ nakṣase vibhāvari ||
1,030.21  vayaṃ hi te amanmahyāntādā parākāt |
1,030.21 aśve na citre aruṣi ||
1,030.22  tvaṃ tyebhirā gahi vājebhirduhitardivaḥ |
1,030.22 asme rayiṃ ni dhāraya ||

1,031.01  tvamagne prathamo aṅgirā ṛṣirdevo devānāmabhavaḥ śivaḥ sakhā |
1,031.01 tava vrate kavayo vidmanāpaso'jāyanta maruto bhrājadṛṣṭayaḥ ||
1,031.02  tvamagne prathamo aṅgirastamaḥ kavirdevānāṃ pari bhūṣasi vratam |
1,031.02 vibhurviśvasmai bhuvanāya medhiro dvimātā śayuḥ katidhā cidāyave ||
1,031.03  tvamagne prathamo mātariśvana āvirbhava sukratūyā vivasvate |
1,031.03 arejetāṃ rodasī hotṛvūrye'saghnorbhāramayajo maho vaso ||
1,031.04  tvamagne manave dyāmavāśayaḥ purūravase sukṛte sukṛttaraḥ |
1,031.04 śvātreṇa yatpitrormucyase paryā tvā pūrvamanayannāparaṃ punaḥ ||
1,031.05  tvamagne vṛṣabhaḥ puṣṭivardhana udyatasruce bhavasi śravāyyaḥ |
1,031.05 ya āhutiṃ pari vedā vaṣaṭkṛtimekāyuragre viśa āvivāsasi ||
1,031.06  tvamagne vṛjinavartaniṃ naraṃ sakmanpiparṣi vidathe vicarṣaṇe |
1,031.06 yaḥ śūrasātā paritakmye dhane dabhrebhiścitsamṛtā haṃsi bhūyasaḥ ||
1,031.07  tvaṃ tamagne amṛtatva uttame martaṃ dadhāsi śravase divedive |
1,031.07 yastātṛṣāṇa ubhayāya janmane mayaḥ kṛṇoṣi praya ā ca sūraye ||
1,031.08  tvaṃ no agne sanaye dhanānāṃ yaśasaṃ kāruṃ kṛṇuhi stavānaḥ |
1,031.08 ṛdhyāma karmāpasā navena devairdyāvāpṛthivī prāvataṃ naḥ ||
1,031.09  tvaṃ no agne pitrorupastha ā devo deveṣvanavadya jāgṛviḥ |
1,031.09 tanūkṛdbodhi pramatiśca kārave tvaṃ kalyāṇa vasu viśvamopiṣe ||
1,031.10  tvamagne pramatistvaṃ pitāsi nastvaṃ vayaskṛttava jāmayo vayam |
1,031.10 saṃ tvā rāyaḥ śatinaḥ saṃ sahasriṇaḥ suvīraṃ yanti vratapāmadābhya ||
1,031.11  tvāmagne prathamamāyumāyave devā akṛṇvannahuṣasya viśpatim |
1,031.11 iḻāmakṛṇvanmanuṣasya śāsanīṃ pituryatputro mamakasya jāyate ||
1,031.12  tvaṃ no agne tava deva pāyubhirmaghono rakṣa tanvaśca vandya |
1,031.12 trātā tokasya tanaye gavāmasyanimeṣaṃ rakṣamāṇastava vrate ||
1,031.13  tvamagne yajyave pāyurantaro'niṣaṅgāya caturakṣa idhyase |
1,031.13 yo rātahavyo'vṛkāya dhāyase kīreścinmantraṃ manasā vanoṣi tam ||
1,031.14  tvamagna uruśaṃsāya vāghate spārhaṃ yadrekṇaḥ paramaṃ vanoṣi tat |
1,031.14 ādhrasya citpramatirucyase pitā pra pākaṃ śāssi pra diśo viduṣṭaraḥ ||
1,031.15  tvamagne prayatadakṣiṇaṃ naraṃ varmeva syūtaṃ pari pāsi viśvataḥ |
1,031.15 svādukṣadmā yo vasatau syonakṛjjīvayājaṃ yajate sopamā divaḥ ||
1,031.16  imāmagne śaraṇiṃ mīmṛṣo na imamadhvānaṃ yamagāma dūrāt |
1,031.16 āpiḥ pitā pramatiḥ somyānāṃ bhṛmirasyṛṣikṛnmartyānām ||
1,031.17  manuṣvadagne aṅgirasvadaṅgiro yayātivatsadane pūrvavacchuce |
1,031.17 accha yāhyā vahā daivyaṃ janamā sādaya barhiṣi yakṣi ca priyam ||
1,031.18  etenāgne brahmaṇā vāvṛdhasva śaktī vā yatte cakṛmā vidā vā |
1,031.18 uta pra ṇeṣyabhi vasyo asmānsaṃ naḥ sṛja sumatyā vājavatyā ||

1,032.01  indrasya nu vīryāṇi pra vocaṃ yāni cakāra prathamāni vajrī |
1,032.01 ahannahimanvapastatarda pra vakṣaṇā abhinatparvatānām ||
1,032.02  ahannahiṃ parvate śiśriyāṇaṃ tvaṣṭāsmai vajraṃ svaryaṃ tatakṣa |
1,032.02 vāśrā iva dhenavaḥ syandamānā añjaḥ samudramava jagmurāpaḥ ||
1,032.03  vṛṣāyamāṇo'vṛṇīta somaṃ trikadrukeṣvapibatsutasya |
1,032.03 ā sāyakaṃ maghavādatta vajramahannenaṃ prathamajāmahīnām ||
1,032.04  yadindrāhanprathamajāmahīnāmānmāyināmamināḥ prota māyāḥ |
1,032.04 ātsūryaṃ janayandyāmuṣāsaṃ tādītnā śatruṃ na kilā vivitse ||
1,032.05  ahanvṛtraṃ vṛtrataraṃ vyaṃsamindro vajreṇa mahatā vadhena |
1,032.05 skandhāṃsīva kuliśenā vivṛkṇāhiḥ śayata upapṛkpṛthivyāḥ ||
1,032.06  ayoddheva durmada ā hi juhve mahāvīraṃ tuvibādhamṛjīṣam |
1,032.06 nātārīdasya samṛtiṃ vadhānāṃ saṃ rujānāḥ pipiṣa indraśatruḥ ||
1,032.07  apādahasto apṛtanyadindramāsya vajramadhi sānau jaghāna |
1,032.07 vṛṣṇo vadhriḥ pratimānaṃ bubhūṣanpurutrā vṛtro aśayadvyastaḥ ||
1,032.08  nadaṃ na bhinnamamuyā śayānaṃ mano ruhāṇā ati yantyāpaḥ |
1,032.08 yāścidvṛtro mahinā paryatiṣṭhattāsāmahiḥ patsutaḥśīrbabhūva ||
1,032.09  nīcāvayā abhavadvṛtraputrendro asyā ava vadharjabhāra |
1,032.09 uttarā sūradharaḥ putra āsīddānuḥ śaye sahavatsā na dhenuḥ ||
1,032.10  atiṣṭhantīnāmaniveśanānāṃ kāṣṭhānāṃ madhye nihitaṃ śarīram |
1,032.10 vṛtrasya niṇyaṃ vi carantyāpo dīrghaṃ tama āśayadindraśatruḥ ||
1,032.11  dāsapatnīrahigopā atiṣṭhanniruddhā āpaḥ paṇineva gāvaḥ |
1,032.11 apāṃ bilamapihitaṃ yadāsīdvṛtraṃ jaghanvāṃ apa tadvavāra ||
1,032.12  aśvyo vāro abhavastadindra sṛke yattvā pratyahandeva ekaḥ |
1,032.12 ajayo gā ajayaḥ śūra somamavāsṛjaḥ sartave sapta sindhūn ||
1,032.13  nāsmai vidyunna tanyatuḥ siṣedha na yāṃ mihamakiraddhrāduniṃ ca |
1,032.13 indraśca yadyuyudhāte ahiścotāparībhyo maghavā vi jigye ||
1,032.14  aheryātāraṃ kamapaśya indra hṛdi yatte jaghnuṣo bhīragacchat |
1,032.14 nava ca yannavatiṃ ca sravantīḥ śyeno na bhīto ataro rajāṃsi ||
1,032.15  indro yāto'vasitasya rājā śamasya ca śṛṅgiṇo vajrabāhuḥ |
1,032.15 sedu rājā kṣayati carṣaṇīnāmarānna nemiḥ pari tā babhūva ||

1,033.01  etāyāmopa gavyanta indramasmākaṃ su pramatiṃ vāvṛdhāti |
1,033.01 anāmṛṇaḥ kuvidādasya rāyo gavāṃ ketaṃ paramāvarjate naḥ ||
1,033.02  upedahaṃ dhanadāmapratītaṃ juṣṭāṃ na śyeno vasatiṃ patāmi |
1,033.02 indraṃ namasyannupamebhirarkairya stotṛbhyo havyo asti yāman ||
1,033.03  ni sarvasena iṣudhīṃrasakta samaryo gā ajati yasya vaṣṭi |
1,033.03 coṣkūyamāṇa indra bhūri vāmaṃ mā paṇirbhūrasmadadhi pravṛddha ||
1,033.04  vadhīrhi dasyuṃ dhaninaṃ ghanenaṃ ekaścarannupaśākebhirindra |
1,033.04 dhanoradhi viṣuṇakte vyāyannayajvānaḥ sanakāḥ pretimīyuḥ ||
1,033.05  parā cicchīrṣā vavṛjusta indrāyajvāno yajvabhi spardhamānāḥ |
1,033.05 pra yaddivo hariva sthātarugra niravratāṃ adhamo rodasyoḥ ||
1,033.06  ayuyutsannanavadyasya senāmayātayanta kṣitayo navagvāḥ |
1,033.06 vṛṣāyudho na vadhrayo niraṣṭāḥ pravadbhirindrāccitayanta āyan ||
1,033.07  tvametānrudato jakṣataścāyodhayo rajasa indra pāre |
1,033.07 avādaho diva ā dasyumuccā pra sunvata stuvataḥ śaṃsamāvaḥ ||
1,033.08  cakrāṇāsaḥ parīṇahaṃ pṛthivyā hiraṇyena maṇinā śumbhamānāḥ |
1,033.08 na hinvānāsastitirusta indraṃ pari spaśo adadhātsūryeṇa ||
1,033.09  pari yadindra rodasī ubhe abubhojīrmahinā viśvataḥ sīm |
1,033.09 amanyamānāṃ abhi manyamānairnirbrahmabhiradhamo dasyumindra ||
1,033.10  na ye divaḥ pṛthivyā antamāpurna māyābhirdhanadāṃ paryabhūvan |
1,033.10 yujaṃ vajraṃ vṛṣabhaścakra indro nirjyotiṣā tamaso gā adukṣat ||
1,033.11  anu svadhāmakṣarannāpo asyāvardhata madhya ā nāvyānām |
1,033.11 sadhrīcīnena manasā tamindra ojiṣṭhena hanmanāhannabhi dyūn ||
1,033.12  nyāvidhyadilībiśasya dṛḻhā vi śṛṅgiṇamabhinacchuṣṇamindraḥ |
1,033.12 yāvattaro maghavanyāvadojo vajreṇa śatrumavadhīḥ pṛtanyum ||
1,033.13  abhi sidhmo ajigādasya śatrūnvi tigmena vṛṣabheṇā puro'bhet |
1,033.13 saṃ vajreṇāsṛjadvṛtramindraḥ pra svāṃ matimatiracchāśadānaḥ ||
1,033.14  āvaḥ kutsamindra yasmiñcākanprāvo yudhyantaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ daśadyum |
1,033.14 śaphacyuto reṇurnakṣata dyāmucchvaitreyo nṛṣāhyāya tasthau ||
1,033.15  āvaḥ śamaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ tugryāsu kṣetrajeṣe maghavañchvitryaṃ gām |
1,033.15 jyokcidatra tasthivāṃso akrañchatrūyatāmadharā vedanākaḥ ||

1,034.01  triścinno adyā bhavataṃ navedasā vibhurvāṃ yāma uta rātiraśvinā |
1,034.01 yuvorhi yantraṃ himyeva vāsaso'bhyāyaṃsenyā bhavataṃ manīṣibhiḥ ||
1,034.02  trayaḥ pavayo madhuvāhane rathe somasya venāmanu viśva idviduḥ |
1,034.02 traya skambhāsa skabhitāsa ārabhe trirnaktaṃ yāthastrirvaśvinā divā ||
1,034.03  samāne ahantriravadyagohanā triradya yajñaṃ madhunā mimikṣatam |
1,034.03 trirvājavatīriṣo aśvinā yuvaṃ doṣā asmabhyamuṣasaśca pinvatam ||
1,034.04  trirvartiryātaṃ triranuvrate jane triḥ suprāvye tredheva śikṣatam |
1,034.04 trirnāndyaṃ vahatamaśvinā yuvaṃ triḥ pṛkṣo asme akṣareva pinvatam ||
1,034.05  trirno rayiṃ vahatamaśvinā yuvaṃ trirdevatātā trirutāvataṃ dhiyaḥ |
1,034.05 triḥ saubhagatvaṃ triruta śravāṃsi nastriṣṭhaṃ vāṃ sūre duhitā ruhadratham ||
1,034.06  trirno aśvinā divyāni bheṣajā triḥ pārthivāni triru dattamadbhyaḥ |
1,034.06 omānaṃ śaṃyormamakāya sūnave tridhātu śarma vahataṃ śubhaspatī ||
1,034.07  trirno aśvinā yajatā divedive pari tridhātu pṛthivīmaśāyatam |
1,034.07 tisro nāsatyā rathyā parāvata ātmeva vātaḥ svasarāṇi gacchatam ||
1,034.08  triraśvinā sindhubhiḥ saptamātṛbhistraya āhāvāstredhā haviṣkṛtam |
1,034.08 tisraḥ pṛthivīrupari pravā divo nākaṃ rakṣethe dyubhiraktubhirhitam ||
1,034.09  kva trī cakrā trivṛto rathasya kva trayo vandhuro ye sanīḻāḥ |
1,034.09 kadā yogo vājino rāsabhasya yena yajñaṃ nāsatyopayāthaḥ ||
1,034.10  ā nāsatyā gacchataṃ hūyate havirmadhvaḥ pibataṃ madhupebhirāsabhiḥ |
1,034.10 yuvorhi pūrvaṃ savitoṣaso rathamṛtāya citraṃ ghṛtavantamiṣyati ||
1,034.11  ā nāsatyā tribhirekādaśairiha devebhiryātaṃ madhupeyamaśvinā |
1,034.11 prāyustāriṣṭaṃ nī rapāṃsi mṛkṣataṃ sedhataṃ dveṣo bhavataṃ sacābhuvā ||
1,034.12  ā no aśvinā trivṛtā rathenārvāñcaṃ rayiṃ vahataṃ suvīram |
1,034.12 śṛṇvantā vāmavase johavīmi vṛdhe ca no bhavataṃ vājasātau ||

1,035.01  hvayāmyagniṃ prathamaṃ svastaye hvayāmi mitrāvaruṇāvihāvase |
1,035.01 hvayāmi rātrīṃ jagato niveśanīṃ hvayāmi devaṃ savitāramūtaye ||
1,035.02  ā kṛṣṇena rajasā vartamāno niveśayannamṛtaṃ martyaṃ ca |
1,035.02 hiraṇyayena savitā rathenā devo yāti bhuvanāni paśyan ||
1,035.03  yāti devaḥ pravatā yātyudvatā yāti śubhrābhyāṃ yajato haribhyām |
1,035.03 ā devo yāti savitā parāvato'pa viśvā duritā bādhamānaḥ ||
1,035.04  abhīvṛtaṃ kṛśanairviśvarūpaṃ hiraṇyaśamyaṃ yajato bṛhantam |
1,035.04 āsthādrathaṃ savitā citrabhānuḥ kṛṣṇā rajāṃsi taviṣīṃ dadhānaḥ ||
1,035.05  vi janāñchyāvāḥ śitipādo akhyanrathaṃ hiraṇyapraugaṃ vahantaḥ |
1,035.05 śaśvadviśaḥ saviturdaivyasyopasthe viśvā bhuvanāni tasthuḥ ||
1,035.06  tisro dyāvaḥ saviturdvā upasthāṃ ekā yamasya bhuvane virāṣāṭ |
1,035.06 āṇiṃ na rathyamamṛtādhi tasthuriha bravītu ya u tacciketat ||
1,035.07  vi suparṇo antarikṣāṇyakhyadgabhīravepā asuraḥ sunīthaḥ |
1,035.07 kvedānīṃ sūryaḥ kaściketa katamāṃ dyāṃ raśmirasyā tatāna ||
1,035.08  aṣṭau vyakhyatkakubhaḥ pṛthivyāstrī dhanva yojanā sapta sindhūn |
1,035.08 hiraṇyākṣaḥ savitā deva āgāddadhadratnā dāśuṣe vāryāṇi ||
1,035.09  hiraṇyapāṇiḥ savitā vicarṣaṇirubhe dyāvāpṛthivī antarīyate |
1,035.09 apāmīvāṃ bādhate veti sūryamabhi kṛṣṇena rajasā dyāmṛṇoti ||
1,035.10  hiraṇyahasto asuraḥ sunīthaḥ sumṛḻīkaḥ svavāṃ yātvarvāṅ |
1,035.10 apasedhanrakṣaso yātudhānānasthāddevaḥ pratidoṣaṃ gṛṇānaḥ ||
1,035.11  ye te panthāḥ savitaḥ pūrvyāso'reṇavaḥ sukṛtā antarikṣe |
1,035.11 tebhirno adya pathibhiḥ sugebhī rakṣā ca no adhi ca brūhi deva ||

1,036.01  pra vo yahvaṃ purūṇāṃ viśāṃ devayatīnām |
1,036.01 agniṃ sūktebhirvacobhirīmahe yaṃ sīmidanya īḻate ||
1,036.02  janāso agniṃ dadhire sahovṛdhaṃ haviṣmanto vidhema te |
1,036.02 sa tvaṃ no adya sumanā ihāvitā bhavā vājeṣu santya ||
1,036.03  pra tvā dūtaṃ vṛṇīmahe hotāraṃ viśvavedasam |
1,036.03 mahaste sato vi carantyarcayo divi spṛśanti bhānavaḥ ||
1,036.04  devāsastvā varuṇo mitro aryamā saṃ dūtaṃ pratnamindhate |
1,036.04 viśvaṃ so agne jayati tvayā dhanaṃ yaste dadāśa martyaḥ ||
1,036.05  mandro hotā gṛhapatiragne dūto viśāmasi |
1,036.05 tve viśvā saṃgatāni vratā dhruvā yāni devā akṛṇvata ||
1,036.06  tve idagne subhage yaviṣṭhya viśvamā hūyate haviḥ |
1,036.06 sa tvaṃ no adya sumanā utāparaṃ yakṣi devānsuvīryā ||
1,036.07  taṃ ghemitthā namasvina upa svarājamāsate |
1,036.07 hotrābhiragniṃ manuṣaḥ samindhate titirvāṃso ati sridhaḥ ||
1,036.08  ghnanto vṛtramataranrodasī apa uru kṣayāya cakrire |
1,036.08 bhuvatkaṇve vṛṣā dyumnyāhutaḥ krandadaśvo gaviṣṭiṣu ||
1,036.09  saṃ sīdasva mahāṃ asi śocasva devavītamaḥ |
1,036.09 vi dhūmamagne aruṣaṃ miyedhya sṛja praśasta darśatam ||
1,036.10  yaṃ tvā devāso manave dadhuriha yajiṣṭhaṃ havyavāhana |
1,036.10 yaṃ kaṇvo medhyātithirdhanaspṛtaṃ yaṃ vṛṣā yamupastutaḥ ||
1,036.11  yamagniṃ medhyātithiḥ kaṇva īdha ṛtādadhi |
1,036.11 tasya preṣo dīdiyustamimā ṛcastamagniṃ vardhayāmasi ||
1,036.12  rāyaspūrdhi svadhāvo'sti hi te'gne deveṣvāpyam |
1,036.12 tvaṃ vājasya śrutyasya rājasi sa no mṛḻa mahāṃ asi ||
1,036.13  ūrdhva ū ṣu ṇa ūtaye tiṣṭhā devo na savitā |
1,036.13 ūrdhvo vājasya sanitā yadañjibhirvāghadbhirvihvayāmahe ||
1,036.14  ūrdhvo naḥ pāhyaṃhaso ni ketunā viśvaṃ samatriṇaṃ daha |
1,036.14 kṛdhī na ūrdhvāñcarathāya jīvase vidā deveṣu no duvaḥ ||
1,036.15  pāhi no agne rakṣasaḥ pāhi dhūrterarāvṇaḥ |
1,036.15 pāhi rīṣata uta vā jighāṃsato bṛhadbhāno yaviṣṭhya ||
1,036.16  ghaneva viṣvagvi jahyarāvṇastapurjambha yo asmadhruk |
1,036.16 yo martyaḥ śiśīte atyaktubhirmā naḥ sa ripurīśata ||
1,036.17  agnirvavne suvīryamagniḥ kaṇvāya saubhagam |
1,036.17 agniḥ prāvanmitrota medhyātithimagniḥ sātā upastutam ||
1,036.18  agninā turvaśaṃ yaduṃ parāvata ugrādevaṃ havāmahe |
1,036.18 agnirnayannavavāstvaṃ bṛhadrathaṃ turvītiṃ dasyave sahaḥ ||
1,036.19  ni tvāmagne manurdadhe jyotirjanāya śaśvate |
1,036.19 dīdetha kaṇva ṛtajāta ukṣito yaṃ namasyanti kṛṣṭayaḥ ||
1,036.20  tveṣāso agneramavanto arcayo bhīmāso na pratītaye |
1,036.20 rakṣasvinaḥ sadamidyātumāvato viśvaṃ samatriṇaṃ daha ||

1,037.01  krīḻaṃ vaḥ śardho mārutamanarvāṇaṃ ratheśubham |
1,037.01 kaṇvā abhi pra gāyata ||
1,037.02  ye pṛṣatībhirṛṣṭibhiḥ sākaṃ vāśībhirañjibhiḥ |
1,037.02 ajāyanta svabhānavaḥ ||
1,037.03  iheva śṛṇva eṣāṃ kaśā hasteṣu yadvadān |
1,037.03 ni yāmañcitramṛñjate ||
1,037.04  pra vaḥ śardhāya ghṛṣvaye tveṣadyumnāya śuṣmiṇe |
1,037.04 devattaṃ brahma gāyata ||
1,037.05  pra śaṃsā goṣvaghnyaṃ krīḻaṃ yacchardho mārutam |
1,037.05 jambhe rasasya vāvṛdhe ||
1,037.06  ko vo varṣiṣṭha ā naro divaśca gmaśca dhūtayaḥ |
1,037.06 yatsīmantaṃ na dhūnutha ||
1,037.07  ni vo yāmāya mānuṣo dadhra ugrāya manyave |
1,037.07 jihīta parvato giriḥ ||
1,037.08  yeṣāmajmeṣu pṛthivī jujurvāṃ iva viśpatiḥ |
1,037.08 bhiyā yāmeṣu rejate ||
1,037.09  sthiraṃ hi jānameṣāṃ vayo māturniretave |
1,037.09 yatsīmanu dvitā śavaḥ ||
1,037.10  udu tye sūnavo giraḥ kāṣṭhā ajmeṣvatnata |
1,037.10 vāśrā abhijñu yātave ||
1,037.11  tyaṃ cidghā dīrghaṃ pṛthuṃ miho napātamamṛdhram |
1,037.11 pra cyāvayanti yāmabhiḥ ||
1,037.12  maruto yaddha vo balaṃ janāṃ acucyavītana |
1,037.12 girīṃracucyavītana ||
1,037.13  yaddha yānti marutaḥ saṃ ha bruvate'dhvannā |
1,037.13 śṛṇoti kaścideṣām ||
1,037.14  pra yāta śībhamāśubhiḥ santi kaṇveṣu vo duvaḥ |
1,037.14 tatro ṣu mādayādhvai ||
1,037.15  asti hi ṣmā madāya vaḥ smasi ṣmā vayameṣām |
1,037.15 viśvaṃ cidāyurjīvase ||

1,038.01  kaddha nūnaṃ kadhapriyaḥ pitā putraṃ na hastayoḥ |
1,038.01 dadhidhve vṛktabarhiṣaḥ ||
1,038.02  kva nūnaṃ kadvo arthaṃ gantā divo na pṛthivyāḥ |
1,038.02 kva vo gāvo na raṇyanti ||
1,038.03  kva vaḥ sumnā navyāṃsi marutaḥ kva suvitā |
1,038.03 kvo viśvāni saubhagā ||
1,038.04  yadyūyaṃ pṛśnimātaro martāsaḥ syātana |
1,038.04 stotā vo amṛtaḥ syāt ||
1,038.05  mā vo mṛgo na yavase jaritā bhūdajoṣyaḥ |
1,038.05 pathā yamasya gādupa ||
1,038.06  mo ṣu ṇaḥ parāparā nirṛtirdurhaṇā vadhīt |
1,038.06 padīṣṭa tṛṣṇayā saha ||
1,038.07  satyaṃ tveṣā amavanto dhanvañcidā rudriyāsaḥ |
1,038.07 mihaṃ kṛṇvantyavātām ||
1,038.08  vāśreva vidyunmimāti vatsaṃ na mātā siṣakti |
1,038.08 yadeṣāṃ vṛṣṭirasarji ||
1,038.09  divā cittamaḥ kṛṇvanti parjanyenodavāhena |
1,038.09 yatpṛthivīṃ vyundanti ||
1,038.10  adha svanānmarutāṃ viśvamā sadma pārthivam |
1,038.10 arejanta pra mānuṣāḥ ||
1,038.11  maruto vīḻupāṇibhiścitrā rodhasvatīranu |
1,038.11 yātemakhidrayāmabhiḥ ||
1,038.12  sthirā vaḥ santu nemayo rathā aśvāsa eṣām |
1,038.12 susaṃskṛtā abhīśavaḥ ||
1,038.13  acchā vadā tanā girā jarāyai brahmaṇaspatim |
1,038.13 agniṃ mitraṃ na darśatam ||
1,038.14  mimīhi ślokamāsye parjanya iva tatanaḥ |
1,038.14 gāya gāyatramukthyam ||
1,038.15  vandasva mārutaṃ gaṇaṃ tveṣaṃ panasyumarkiṇam |
1,038.15 asme vṛddhā asanniha ||

1,039.01  pra yaditthā parāvataḥ śocirna mānamasyatha |
1,039.01 kasya kratvā marutaḥ kasya varpasā kaṃ yātha kaṃ ha dhūtayaḥ ||
1,039.02  sthirā vaḥ santvāyudhā parāṇude vīḻū uta pratiṣkabhe |
1,039.02 yuṣmākamastu taviṣī panīyasī mā martyasya māyinaḥ ||
1,039.03  parā ha yatsthiraṃ hatha naro vartayathā guru |
1,039.03 vi yāthana vaninaḥ pṛthivyā vyāśāḥ parvatānām ||
1,039.04  nahi vaḥ śatrurvivide adhi dyavi na bhūmyāṃ riśādasaḥ |
1,039.04 yuṣmākamastu taviṣī tanā yujā rudrāso nū cidādhṛṣe ||
1,039.05  pra vepayanti parvatānvi viñcanti vanaspatīn |
1,039.05 pro ārata maruto durmadā iva devāsaḥ sarvayā viśā ||
1,039.06  upo ratheṣu pṛṣatīrayugdhvaṃ praṣṭirvahati rohitaḥ |
1,039.06 ā vo yāmāya pṛthivī cidaśrodabībhayanta mānuṣāḥ ||
1,039.07  ā vo makṣū tanāya kaṃ rudrā avo vṛṇīmahe |
1,039.07 gantā nūnaṃ no'vasā yathā puretthā kaṇvāya bibhyuṣe ||
1,039.08  yuṣmeṣito maruto martyeṣita ā yo no abhva īṣate |
1,039.08 vi taṃ yuyota śavasā vyojasā vi yuṣmākābhirūtibhiḥ ||
1,039.09  asāmi hi prayajyavaḥ kaṇvaṃ dada pracetasaḥ |
1,039.09 asāmibhirmaruta ā na ūtibhirgantā vṛṣṭiṃ na vidyutaḥ ||
1,039.10  asāmyojo bibhṛthā sudānavo'sāmi dhūtayaḥ śavaḥ |
1,039.10 ṛṣidviṣe marutaḥ parimanyava iṣuṃ na sṛjata dviṣam ||

1,040.01  uttiṣṭha brahmaṇaspate devayantastvemahe |
1,040.01 upa pra yantu marutaḥ sudānava indra prāśūrbhavā sacā ||
1,040.02  tvāmiddhi sahasasputra martya upabrūte dhane hite |
1,040.02 suvīryaṃ maruta ā svaśvyaṃ dadhīta yo va ācake ||
1,040.03  praitu brahmaṇaspatiḥ pra devyetu sūnṛtā |
1,040.03 acchā vīraṃ naryaṃ paṅktirādhasaṃ devā yajñaṃ nayantu naḥ ||
1,040.04  yo vāghate dadāti sūnaraṃ vasu sa dhatte akṣiti śravaḥ |
1,040.04 tasmā iḻāṃ suvīrāmā yajāmahe supratūrtimanehasam ||
1,040.05  pra nūnaṃ brahmaṇaspatirmantraṃ vadatyukthyam |
1,040.05 yasminnindro varuṇo mitro aryamā devā okāṃsi cakrire ||
1,040.06  tamidvocemā vidatheṣu śambhuvaṃ mantraṃ devā anehasam |
1,040.06 imāṃ ca vācaṃ pratiharyathā naro viśvedvāmā vo aśnavat ||
1,040.07  ko devayantamaśnavajjanaṃ ko vṛktabarhiṣam |
1,040.07 prapra dāśvānpastyābhirasthitāntarvāvatkṣayaṃ dadhe ||
1,040.08  upa kṣatraṃ pṛñcīta hanti rājabhirbhaye citsukṣitiṃ dadhe |
1,040.08 nāsya vartā na tarutā mahādhane nārbhe asti vajriṇaḥ ||

1,041.01  yaṃ rakṣanti pracetaso varuṇo mitro aryamā |
1,041.01 nū citsa dabhyate janaḥ ||
1,041.02  yaṃ bāhuteva piprati pānti martyaṃ riṣaḥ |
1,041.02 ariṣṭaḥ sarva edhate ||
1,041.03  vi durgā vi dviṣaḥ puro ghnanti rājāna eṣām |
1,041.03 nayanti duritā tiraḥ ||
1,041.04  sugaḥ panthā anṛkṣara ādityāsa ṛtaṃ yate |
1,041.04 nātrāvakhādo asti vaḥ ||
1,041.05  yaṃ yajñaṃ nayathā nara ādityā ṛjunā pathā |
1,041.05 pra vaḥ sa dhītaye naśat ||
1,041.06  sa ratnaṃ martyo vasu viśvaṃ tokamuta tmanā |
1,041.06 acchā gacchatyastṛtaḥ ||
1,041.07  kathā rādhāma sakhāya stomaṃ mitrasyāryamṇaḥ |
1,041.07 mahi psaro varuṇasya ||
1,041.08  mā vo ghnantaṃ mā śapantaṃ prati voce devayantam |
1,041.08 sumnairidva ā vivāse ||
1,041.09  caturaściddadamānādbibhīyādā nidhātoḥ |
1,041.09 na duruktāya spṛhayet ||

1,042.01  saṃ pūṣannadhvanastira vyaṃho vimuco napāt |
1,042.01 sakṣvā deva pra ṇaspuraḥ ||
1,042.02  yo naḥ pūṣannagho vṛko duḥśeva ādideśati |
1,042.02 apa sma taṃ patho jahi ||
1,042.03  apa tyaṃ paripanthinaṃ muṣīvāṇaṃ huraścitam |
1,042.03 dūramadhi sruteraja ||
1,042.04  tvaṃ tasya dvayāvino'ghaśaṃsasya kasya cit |
1,042.04 padābhi tiṣṭha tapuṣim ||
1,042.05  ā tatte dasra mantumaḥ pūṣannavo vṛṇīmahe |
1,042.05 yena pitṝnacodayaḥ ||
1,042.06  adhā no viśvasaubhaga hiraṇyavāśīmattama |
1,042.06 dhanāni suṣaṇā kṛdhi ||
1,042.07  ati naḥ saścato naya sugā naḥ supathā kṛṇu |
1,042.07 pūṣanniha kratuṃ vidaḥ ||
1,042.08  abhi sūyavasaṃ naya na navajvāro adhvane |
1,042.08 pūṣanniha kratuṃ vidaḥ ||
1,042.09  śagdhi pūrdhi pra yaṃsi ca śiśīhi prāsyudaram |
1,042.09 pūṣanniha kratuṃ vidaḥ ||
1,042.10  na pūṣaṇaṃ methāmasi sūktairabhi gṛṇīmasi |
1,042.10 vasūni dasmamīmahe ||

1,043.01  kadrudrāya pracetase mīḻhuṣṭamāya tavyase |
1,043.01 vocema śantamaṃ hṛde ||
1,043.02  yathā no aditiḥ karatpaśve nṛbhyo yathā gave |
1,043.02 yathā tokāya rudriyam ||
1,043.03  yathā no mitro varuṇo yathā rudraściketati |
1,043.03 yathā viśve sajoṣasaḥ ||
1,043.04  gāthapatiṃ medhapatiṃ rudraṃ jalāṣabheṣajam |
1,043.04 tacchaṃyoḥ sumnamīmahe ||
1,043.05  yaḥ śukra iva sūryo hiraṇyamiva rocate |
1,043.05 śreṣṭho devānāṃ vasuḥ ||
1,043.06  śaṃ naḥ karatyarvate sugaṃ meṣāya meṣye |
1,043.06 nṛbhyo nāribhyo gave ||
1,043.07  asme soma śriyamadhi ni dhehi śatasya nṛṇām |
1,043.07 mahi śravastuvinṛmṇam ||
1,043.08  mā naḥ somaparibādho mārātayo juhuranta |
1,043.08 ā na indo vāje bhaja ||
1,043.09  yāste prajā amṛtasya parasmindhāmannṛtasya |
1,043.09 mūrdhā nābhā soma vena ābhūṣantīḥ soma vedaḥ ||

1,044.01  agne vivasvaduṣasaścitraṃ rādho amartya |
1,044.01 ā dāśuṣe jātavedo vahā tvamadyā devāṃ uṣarbudhaḥ ||
1,044.02  juṣṭo hi dūto asi havyavāhano'gne rathīradhvarāṇām |
1,044.02 sajūraśvibhyāmuṣasā suvīryamasme dhehi śravo bṛhat ||
1,044.03  adyā dūtaṃ vṛṇīmahe vasumagniṃ purupriyam |
1,044.03 dhūmaketuṃ bhāṛjīkaṃ vyuṣṭiṣu yajñānāmadhvaraśriyam ||
1,044.04  śreṣṭhaṃ yaviṣṭhamatithiṃ svāhutaṃ juṣṭaṃ janāya dāśuṣe |
1,044.04 devāṃ acchā yātave jātavedasamagnimīḻe vyuṣṭiṣu ||
1,044.05  staviṣyāmi tvāmahaṃ viśvasyāmṛta bhojana |
1,044.05 agne trātāramamṛtaṃ miyedhya yajiṣṭhaṃ havyavāhana ||
1,044.06  suśaṃso bodhi gṛṇate yaviṣṭhya madhujihvaḥ svāhutaḥ |
1,044.06 praskaṇvasya pratirannāyurjīvase namasyā daivyaṃ janam ||
1,044.07  hotāraṃ viśvavedasaṃ saṃ hi tvā viśa indhate |
1,044.07 sa ā vaha puruhūta pracetaso'gne devāṃ iha dravat ||
1,044.08  savitāramuṣasamaśvinā bhagamagniṃ vyuṣṭiṣu kṣapaḥ |
1,044.08 kaṇvāsastvā sutasomāsa indhate havyavāhaṃ svadhvara ||
1,044.09  patirhyadhvarāṇāmagne dūto viśāmasi |
1,044.09 uṣarbudha ā vaha somapītaye devāṃ adya svardṛśaḥ ||
1,044.10  agne pūrvā anūṣaso vibhāvaso dīdetha viśvadarśataḥ |
1,044.10 asi grāmeṣvavitā purohito'si yajñeṣu mānuṣaḥ ||
1,044.11  ni tvā yajñasya sādhanamagne hotāramṛtvijam |
1,044.11 manuṣvaddeva dhīmahi pracetasaṃ jīraṃ dūtamamartyam ||
1,044.12  yaddevānāṃ mitramahaḥ purohito'ntaro yāsi dūtyam |
1,044.12 sindhoriva prasvanitāsa ūrmayo'gnerbhrājante arcayaḥ ||
1,044.13  śrudhi śrutkarṇa vahnibhirdevairagne sayāvabhiḥ |
1,044.13 ā sīdantu barhiṣi mitro aryamā prātaryāvāṇo adhvaram ||
1,044.14  śṛṇvantu stomaṃ marutaḥ sudānavo'gnijihvā ṛtāvṛdhaḥ |
1,044.14 pibatu somaṃ varuṇo dhṛtavrato'śvibhyāmuṣasā sajūḥ ||

1,045.01  tvamagne vasūṃriha rudrāṃ ādityāṃ uta |
1,045.01 yajā svadhvaraṃ janaṃ manujātaṃ ghṛtapruṣam ||
1,045.02  śruṣṭīvāno hi dāśuṣe devā agne vicetasaḥ |
1,045.02 tānrohidaśva girvaṇastrayastriṃśatamā vaha ||
1,045.03  priyamedhavadatrivajjātavedo virūpavat |
1,045.03 aṅgirasvanmahivrata praskaṇvasya śrudhī havam ||
1,045.04  mahikerava ūtaye priyamedhā ahūṣata |
1,045.04 rājantamadhvarāṇāmagniṃ śukreṇa śociṣā ||
1,045.05  ghṛtāhavana santyemā u ṣu śrudhī giraḥ |
1,045.05 yābhiḥ kaṇvasya sūnavo havante'vase tvā ||
1,045.06  tvāṃ citraśravastama havante vikṣu jantavaḥ |
1,045.06 śociṣkeśaṃ purupriyāgne havyāya voḻhave ||
1,045.07  ni tvā hotāramṛtvijaṃ dadhire vasuvittamam |
1,045.07 śrutkarṇaṃ saprathastamaṃ viprā agne diviṣṭiṣu ||
1,045.08  ā tvā viprā acucyavuḥ sutasomā abhi prayaḥ |
1,045.08 bṛhadbhā bibhrato haviragne martāya dāśuṣe ||
1,045.09  prātaryāvṇaḥ sahaskṛta somapeyāya santya |
1,045.09 ihādya daivyaṃ janaṃ barhirā sādayā vaso ||
1,045.10  arvāñcaṃ daivyaṃ janamagne yakṣva sahūtibhiḥ |
1,045.10 ayaṃ somaḥ sudānavastaṃ pāta tiroahnyam ||

1,046.01  eṣo uṣā apūrvyā vyucchati priyā divaḥ |
1,046.01 stuṣe vāmaśvinā bṛhat ||
1,046.02  yā dasrā sindhumātarā manotarā rayīṇām |
1,046.02 dhiyā devā vasuvidā ||
1,046.03  vacyante vāṃ kakuhāso jūrṇāyāmadhi viṣṭapi |
1,046.03 yadvāṃ ratho vibhiṣpatāt ||
1,046.04  haviṣā jāro apāṃ piparti papurirnarā |
1,046.04 pitā kuṭasya carṣaṇiḥ ||
1,046.05  ādāro vāṃ matīnāṃ nāsatyā matavacasā |
1,046.05 pātaṃ somasya dhṛṣṇuyā ||
1,046.06  yā naḥ pīparadaśvinā jyotiṣmatī tamastiraḥ |
1,046.06 tāmasme rāsāthāmiṣam ||
1,046.07  ā no nāvā matīnāṃ yātaṃ pārāya gantave |
1,046.07 yuñjāthāmaśvinā ratham ||
1,046.08  aritraṃ vāṃ divaspṛthu tīrthe sindhūnāṃ rathaḥ |
1,046.08 dhiyā yuyujra indavaḥ ||
1,046.09  divaskaṇvāsa indavo vasu sindhūnāṃ pade |
1,046.09 svaṃ vavriṃ kuha dhitsathaḥ ||
1,046.10  abhūdu bhā u aṃśave hiraṇyaṃ prati sūryaḥ |
1,046.10 vyakhyajjihvayāsitaḥ ||
1,046.11  abhūdu pārametave panthā ṛtasya sādhuyā |
1,046.11 adarśi vi srutirdivaḥ ||
1,046.12  tattadidaśvinoravo jaritā prati bhūṣati |
1,046.12 made somasya pipratoḥ ||
1,046.13  vāvasānā vivasvati somasya pītyā girā |
1,046.13 manuṣvacchambhū ā gatam ||
1,046.14  yuvoruṣā anu śriyaṃ parijmanorupācarat |
1,046.14 ṛtā vanatho aktubhiḥ ||
1,046.15  ubhā pibatamaśvinobhā naḥ śarma yacchatam |
1,046.15 avidriyābhirūtibhiḥ ||

1,047.01  ayaṃ vāṃ madhumattamaḥ sutaḥ soma ṛtāvṛdhā |
1,047.01 tamaśvinā pibataṃ tiroahnyaṃ dhattaṃ ratnāni dāśuṣe ||
1,047.02  trivandhureṇa trivṛtā supeśasā rathenā yātamaśvinā |
1,047.02 kaṇvāso vāṃ brahma kṛṇvantyadhvare teṣāṃ su śṛṇutaṃ havam ||
1,047.03  aśvinā madhumattamaṃ pātaṃ somamṛtāvṛdhā |
1,047.03 athādya dasrā vasu bibhratā rathe dāśvāṃsamupa gacchatam ||
1,047.04  triṣadhasthe barhiṣi viśvavedasā madhvā yajñaṃ mimikṣatam |
1,047.04 kaṇvāso vāṃ sutasomā abhidyavo yuvāṃ havante aśvinā ||
1,047.05  yābhiḥ kaṇvamabhiṣṭibhiḥ prāvataṃ yuvamaśvinā |
1,047.05 tābhiḥ ṣvasmāṃ avataṃ śubhaspatī pātaṃ somamṛtāvṛdhā ||
1,047.06  sudāse dasrā vasu bibhratā rathe pṛkṣo vahatamaśvinā |
1,047.06 rayiṃ samudrāduta vā divasparyasme dhattaṃ puruspṛham ||
1,047.07  yannāsatyā parāvati yadvā stho adhi turvaśe |
1,047.07 ato rathena suvṛtā na ā gataṃ sākaṃ sūryasya raśmibhiḥ ||
1,047.08  arvāñcā vāṃ saptayo'dhvaraśriyo vahantu savanedupa |
1,047.08 iṣaṃ pṛñcantā sukṛte sudānava ā barhiḥ sīdataṃ narā ||
1,047.09  tena nāsatyā gataṃ rathena sūryatvacā |
1,047.09 yena śaśvadūhathurdāśuṣe vasu madhvaḥ somasya pītaye ||
1,047.10  ukthebhirarvāgavase purūvasū arkaiśca ni hvayāmahe |
1,047.10 śaśvatkaṇvānāṃ sadasi priye hi kaṃ somaṃ papathuraśvinā ||

1,048.01  saha vāmena na uṣo vyucchā duhitardivaḥ |
1,048.01 saha dyumnena bṛhatā vibhāvari rāyā devi dāsvatī ||
1,048.02  aśvāvatīrgomatīrviśvasuvido bhūri cyavanta vastave |
1,048.02 udīraya prati mā sūnṛtā uṣaścoda rādho maghonām ||
1,048.03  uvāsoṣā ucchācca nu devī jīrā rathānām |
1,048.03 ye asyā ācaraṇeṣu dadhrire samudre na śravasyavaḥ ||
1,048.04  uṣo ye te pra yāmeṣu yuñjate mano dānāya sūrayaḥ |
1,048.04 atrāha tatkaṇva eṣāṃ kaṇvatamo nāma gṛṇāti nṛṇām ||
1,048.05  ā ghā yoṣeva sūnaryuṣā yāti prabhuñjatī |
1,048.05 jarayantī vṛjanaṃ padvadīyata utpātayati pakṣiṇaḥ ||
1,048.06  vi yā sṛjati samanaṃ vyarthinaḥ padaṃ na vetyodatī |
1,048.06 vayo nakiṣṭe paptivāṃsa āsate vyuṣṭau vājinīvati ||
1,048.07  eṣāyukta parāvataḥ sūryasyodayanādadhi |
1,048.07 śataṃ rathebhiḥ subhagoṣā iyaṃ vi yātyabhi mānuṣān ||
1,048.08  viśvamasyā nānāma cakṣase jagajjyotiṣkṛṇoti sūnarī |
1,048.08 apa dveṣo maghonī duhitā diva uṣā ucchadapa sridhaḥ ||
1,048.09  uṣa ā bhāhi bhānunā candreṇa duhitardivaḥ |
1,048.09 āvahantī bhūryasmabhyaṃ saubhagaṃ vyucchantī diviṣṭiṣu ||
1,048.10  viśvasya hi prāṇanaṃ jīvanaṃ tve vi yaducchasi sūnari |
1,048.10 sā no rathena bṛhatā vibhāvari śrudhi citrāmaghe havam ||
1,048.11  uṣo vājaṃ hi vaṃsva yaścitro mānuṣe jane |
1,048.11 tenā vaha sukṛto adhvarāṃ upa ye tvā gṛṇanti vahnayaḥ ||
1,048.12  viśvāndevāṃ ā vaha somapītaye'ntarikṣāduṣastvam |
1,048.12 sāsmāsu dhā gomadaśvāvadukthyamuṣo vājaṃ suvīryam ||
1,048.13  yasyā ruśanto arcayaḥ prati bhadrā adṛkṣata |
1,048.13 sā no rayiṃ viśvavāraṃ supeśasamuṣā dadātu sugmyam ||
1,048.14  ye ciddhi tvāmṛṣayaḥ pūrva ūtaye juhūre'vase mahi |
1,048.14 sā na stomāṃ abhi gṛṇīhi rādhasoṣaḥ śukreṇa śociṣā ||
1,048.15  uṣo yadadya bhānunā vi dvārāvṛṇavo divaḥ |
1,048.15 pra no yacchatādavṛkaṃ pṛthu cchardiḥ pra devi gomatīriṣaḥ ||
1,048.16  saṃ no rāyā bṛhatā viśvapeśasā mimikṣvā samiḻābhirā |
1,048.16 saṃ dyumnena viśvaturoṣo mahi saṃ vājairvājinīvati ||

1,049.01  uṣo bhadrebhirā gahi divaścidrocanādadhi |
1,049.01 vahantvaruṇapsava upa tvā somino gṛham ||
1,049.02  supeśasaṃ sukhaṃ rathaṃ yamadhyasthā uṣastvam |
1,049.02 tenā suśravasaṃ janaṃ prāvādya duhitardivaḥ ||
1,049.03  vayaścitte patatriṇo dvipaccatuṣpadarjuni |
1,049.03 uṣaḥ prārannṛtūṃranu divo antebhyaspari ||
1,049.04  vyucchantī hi raśmibhirviśvamābhāsi rocanam |
1,049.04 tāṃ tvāmuṣarvasūyavo gīrbhiḥ kaṇvā ahūṣata ||

1,050.01  udu tyaṃ jātavedasaṃ devaṃ vahanti ketavaḥ |
1,050.01 dṛśe viśvāya sūryam ||
1,050.02  apa tye tāyavo yathā nakṣatrā yantyaktubhiḥ |
1,050.02 sūrāya viśvacakṣase ||
1,050.03  adṛśramasya ketavo vi raśmayo janāṃ anu |
1,050.03 bhrājanto agnayo yathā ||
1,050.04  taraṇirviśvadarśato jyotiṣkṛdasi sūrya |
1,050.04 viśvamā bhāsi rocanam ||
1,050.05  pratyaṅdevānāṃ viśaḥ pratyaṅṅudeṣi mānuṣān |
1,050.05 pratyaṅviśvaṃ svardṛśe ||
1,050.06  yenā pāvaka cakṣasā bhuraṇyantaṃ janāṃ anu |
1,050.06 tvaṃ varuṇa paśyasi ||
1,050.07  vi dyāmeṣi rajaspṛthvahā mimāno aktubhiḥ |
1,050.07 paśyañjanmāni sūrya ||
1,050.08  sapta tvā harito rathe vahanti deva sūrya |
1,050.08 śociṣkeśaṃ vicakṣaṇa ||
1,050.09  ayukta sapta śundhyuvaḥ sūro rathasya naptyaḥ |
1,050.09 tābhiryāti svayuktibhiḥ ||
1,050.10  udvayaṃ tamasaspari jyotiṣpaśyanta uttaram |
1,050.10 devaṃ devatrā sūryamaganma jyotiruttamam ||
1,050.11  udyannadya mitramaha ārohannuttarāṃ divam |
1,050.11 hṛdrogaṃ mama sūrya harimāṇaṃ ca nāśaya ||
1,050.12  śukeṣu me harimāṇaṃ ropaṇākāsu dadhmasi |
1,050.12 atho hāridraveṣu me harimāṇaṃ ni dadhmasi ||
1,050.13  udagādayamādityo viśvena sahasā saha |
1,050.13 dviṣantaṃ mahyaṃ randhayanmo ahaṃ dviṣate radham ||

1,051.01  abhi tyaṃ meṣaṃ puruhūtamṛgmiyamindraṃ gīrbhirmadatā vasvo arṇavam |
1,051.01 yasya dyāvo na vicaranti mānuṣā bhuje maṃhiṣṭhamabhi vipramarcata ||
1,051.02  abhīmavanvansvabhiṣṭimūtayo'ntarikṣaprāṃ taviṣībhirāvṛtam |
1,051.02 indraṃ dakṣāsa ṛbhavo madacyutaṃ śatakratuṃ javanī sūnṛtāruhat ||
1,051.03  tvaṃ gotramaṅgirobhyo'vṛṇorapotātraye śatadureṣu gātuvit |
1,051.03 sasena cidvimadāyāvaho vasvājāvadriṃ vāvasānasya nartayan ||
1,051.04  tvamapāmapidhānāvṛṇorapādhārayaḥ parvate dānumadvasu |
1,051.04 vṛtraṃ yadindra śavasāvadhīrahimāditsūryaṃ divyārohayo dṛśe ||
1,051.05  tvaṃ māyābhirapa māyino'dhamaḥ svadhābhirye adhi śuptāvajuhvata |
1,051.05 tvaṃ piprornṛmaṇaḥ prārujaḥ puraḥ pra ṛjiśvānaṃ dasyuhatyeṣvāvitha ||
1,051.06  tvaṃ kutsaṃ śuṣṇahatyeṣvāvithārandhayo'tithigvāya śambaram |
1,051.06 mahāntaṃ cidarbudaṃ ni kramīḥ padā sanādeva dasyuhatyāya jajñiṣe ||
1,051.07  tve viśvā taviṣī sadhryagghitā tava rādhaḥ somapīthāya harṣate |
1,051.07 tava vajraścikite bāhvorhito vṛścā śatrorava viśvāni vṛṣṇyā ||
1,051.08  vi jānīhyāryānye ca dasyavo barhiṣmate randhayā śāsadavratān |
1,051.08 śākī bhava yajamānasya coditā viśvettā te sadhamādeṣu cākana ||
1,051.09  anuvratāya randhayannapavratānābhūbhirindraḥ śnathayannanābhuvaḥ |
1,051.09 vṛddhasya cidvardhato dyāminakṣata stavāno vamro vi jaghāna saṃdihaḥ ||
1,051.10  takṣadyatta uśanā sahasā saho vi rodasī majmanā bādhate śavaḥ |
1,051.10 ā tvā vātasya nṛmaṇo manoyuja ā pūryamāṇamavahannabhi śravaḥ ||
1,051.11  mandiṣṭa yaduśane kāvye sacāṃ indro vaṅkū vaṅkutarādhi tiṣṭhati |
1,051.11 ugro yayiṃ nirapaḥ srotasāsṛjadvi śuṣṇasya dṛṃhitā airayatpuraḥ ||
1,051.12  ā smā rathaṃ vṛṣapāṇeṣu tiṣṭhasi śāryātasya prabhṛtā yeṣu mandase |
1,051.12 indra yathā sutasomeṣu cākano'narvāṇaṃ ślokamā rohase divi ||
1,051.13  adadā arbhāṃ mahate vacasyave kakṣīvate vṛcayāmindra sunvate |
1,051.13 menābhavo vṛṣaṇaśvasya sukrato viśvettā te savaneṣu pravācyā ||
1,051.14  indro aśrāyi sudhyo nireke pajreṣu stomo duryo na yūpaḥ |
1,051.14 aśvayurgavyū rathayurvasūyurindra idrāyaḥ kṣayati prayantā ||
1,051.15  idaṃ namo vṛṣabhāya svarāje satyaśuṣmāya tavase'vāci |
1,051.15 asminnindra vṛjane sarvavīrāḥ smatsūribhistava śarmansyāma ||

1,052.01  tyaṃ su meṣaṃ mahayā svarvidaṃ śataṃ yasya subhvaḥ sākamīrate |
1,052.01 atyaṃ na vājaṃ havanasyadaṃ rathamendraṃ vavṛtyāmavase suvṛktibhiḥ ||
1,052.02  sa parvato na dharuṇeṣvacyutaḥ sahasramūtistaviṣīṣu vāvṛdhe |
1,052.02 indro yadvṛtramavadhīnnadīvṛtamubjannarṇāṃsi jarhṛṣāṇo andhasā ||
1,052.03  sa hi dvaro dvariṣu vavra ūdhani candrabudhno madavṛddho manīṣibhiḥ |
1,052.03 indraṃ tamahve svapasyayā dhiyā maṃhiṣṭharātiṃ sa hi paprirandhasaḥ ||
1,052.04  ā yaṃ pṛṇanti divi sadmabarhiṣaḥ samudraṃ na subhvaḥ svā abhiṣṭayaḥ |
1,052.04 taṃ vṛtrahatye anu tasthurūtayaḥ śuṣmā indramavātā ahrutapsavaḥ ||
1,052.05  abhi svavṛṣṭiṃ made asya yudhyato raghvīriva pravaṇe sasrurūtayaḥ |
1,052.05 indro yadvajrī dhṛṣamāṇo andhasā bhinadvalasya paridhīṃriva tritaḥ ||
1,052.06  parīṃ ghṛṇā carati titviṣe śavo'po vṛtvī rajaso budhnamāśayat |
1,052.06 vṛtrasya yatpravaṇe durgṛbhiśvano nijaghantha hanvorindra tanyatum ||
1,052.07  hradaṃ na hi tvā nyṛṣantyūrmayo brahmāṇīndra tava yāni vardhanā |
1,052.07 tvaṣṭā citte yujyaṃ vāvṛdhe śavastatakṣa vajramabhibhūtyojasam ||
1,052.08  jaghanvāṃ u haribhiḥ sambhṛtakratavindra vṛtraṃ manuṣe gātuyannapaḥ |
1,052.08 ayacchathā bāhvorvajramāyasamadhārayo divyā sūryaṃ dṛśe ||
1,052.09  bṛhatsvaścandramamavadyadukthyamakṛṇvata bhiyasā rohaṇaṃ divaḥ |
1,052.09 yanmānuṣapradhanā indramūtayaḥ svarnṛṣāco maruto'madannanu ||
1,052.10  dyauścidasyāmavāṃ aheḥ svanādayoyavīdbhiyasā vajra indra te |
1,052.10 vṛtrasya yadbadbadhānasya rodasī made sutasya śavasābhinacchiraḥ ||
1,052.11  yadinnvindra pṛthivī daśabhujirahāni viśvā tatananta kṛṣṭayaḥ |
1,052.11 atrāha te maghavanviśrutaṃ saho dyāmanu śavasā barhaṇā bhuvat ||
1,052.12  tvamasya pāre rajaso vyomanaḥ svabhūtyojā avase dhṛṣanmanaḥ |
1,052.12 cakṛṣe bhūmiṃ pratimānamojaso'paḥ svaḥ paribhūreṣyā divam ||
1,052.13  tvaṃ bhuvaḥ pratimānaṃ pṛthivyā ṛṣvavīrasya bṛhataḥ patirbhūḥ |
1,052.13 viśvamāprā antarikṣaṃ mahitvā satyamaddhā nakiranyastvāvān ||
1,052.14  na yasya dyāvāpṛthivī anu vyaco na sindhavo rajaso antamānaśuḥ |
1,052.14 nota svavṛṣṭiṃ made asya yudhyata eko anyaccakṛṣe viśvamānuṣak ||
1,052.15  ārcannatra marutaḥ sasminnājau viśve devāso amadannanu tvā |
1,052.15 vṛtrasya yadbhṛṣṭimatā vadhena ni tvamindra pratyānaṃ jaghantha ||

1,053.01  nyū ṣu vācaṃ pra mahe bharāmahe gira indrāya sadane vivasvataḥ |
1,053.01 nū ciddhi ratnaṃ sasatāmivāvidanna duṣṭutirdraviṇodeṣu śasyate ||
1,053.02  duro aśvasya dura indra gorasi duro yavasya vasuna inaspatiḥ |
1,053.02 śikṣānaraḥ pradivo akāmakarśanaḥ sakhā sakhibhyastamidaṃ gṛṇīmasi ||
1,053.03  śacīva indra purukṛddyumattama tavedidamabhitaścekite vasu |
1,053.03 ataḥ saṃgṛbhyābhibhūta ā bhara mā tvāyato jarituḥ kāmamūnayīḥ ||
1,053.04  ebhirdyubhiḥ sumanā ebhirindubhirnirundhāno amatiṃ gobhiraśvinā |
1,053.04 indreṇa dasyuṃ darayanta indubhiryutadveṣasaḥ samiṣā rabhemahi ||
1,053.05  samindra rāyā samiṣā rabhemahi saṃ vājebhiḥ puruścandrairabhidyubhiḥ |
1,053.05 saṃ devyā pramatyā vīraśuṣmayā goagrayāśvāvatyā rabhemahi ||
1,053.06  te tvā madā amadantāni vṛṣṇyā te somāso vṛtrahatyeṣu satpate |
1,053.06 yatkārave daśa vṛtrāṇyaprati barhiṣmate ni sahasrāṇi barhayaḥ ||
1,053.07  yudhā yudhamupa ghedeṣi dhṛṣṇuyā purā puraṃ samidaṃ haṃsyojasā |
1,053.07 namyā yadindra sakhyā parāvati nibarhayo namuciṃ nāma māyinam ||
1,053.08  tvaṃ karañjamuta parṇayaṃ vadhīstejiṣṭhayātithigvasya vartanī |
1,053.08 tvaṃ śatā vaṅgṛdasyābhinatpuro'nānudaḥ pariṣūtā ṛjiśvanā ||
1,053.09  tvametāñjanarājño dvirdaśābandhunā suśravasopajagmuṣaḥ |
1,053.09 ṣaṣṭiṃ sahasrā navatiṃ nava śruto ni cakreṇa rathyā duṣpadāvṛṇak ||
1,053.10  tvamāvitha suśravasaṃ tavotibhistava trāmabhirindra tūrvayāṇam |
1,053.10 tvamasmai kutsamatithigvamāyuṃ mahe rājñe yūne arandhanāyaḥ ||
1,053.11  ya udṛcīndra devagopāḥ sakhāyaste śivatamā asāma |
1,053.11 tvāṃ stoṣāma tvayā suvīrā drāghīya āyuḥ prataraṃ dadhānāḥ ||

1,054.01  mā no asminmaghavanpṛtsvaṃhasi nahi te antaḥ śavasaḥ parīṇaśe |
1,054.01 akrandayo nadyo roruvadvanā kathā na kṣoṇīrbhiyasā samārata ||
1,054.02  arcā śakrāya śākine śacīvate śṛṇvantamindraṃ mahayannabhi ṣṭuhi |
1,054.02 yo dhṛṣṇunā śavasā rodasī ubhe vṛṣā vṛṣatvā vṛṣabho nyṛñjate ||
1,054.03  arcā dive bṛhate śūṣyaṃ vacaḥ svakṣatraṃ yasya dhṛṣato dhṛṣanmanaḥ |
1,054.03 bṛhacchravā asuro barhaṇā kṛtaḥ puro haribhyāṃ vṛṣabho ratho hi ṣaḥ ||
1,054.04  tvaṃ divo bṛhataḥ sānu kopayo'va tmanā dhṛṣatā śambaraṃ bhinat |
1,054.04 yanmāyino vrandino mandinā dhṛṣacchitāṃ gabhastimaśaniṃ pṛtanyasi ||
1,054.05  ni yadvṛṇakṣi śvasanasya mūrdhani śuṣṇasya cidvrandino roruvadvanā |
1,054.05 prācīnena manasā barhaṇāvatā yadadyā citkṛṇavaḥ kastvā pari ||
1,054.06  tvamāvitha naryaṃ turvaśaṃ yaduṃ tvaṃ turvītiṃ vayyaṃ śatakrato |
1,054.06 tvaṃ rathametaśaṃ kṛtvye dhane tvaṃ puro navatiṃ dambhayo nava ||
1,054.07  sa ghā rājā satpatiḥ śūśuvajjano rātahavyaḥ prati yaḥ śāsaminvati |
1,054.07 ukthā vā yo abhigṛṇāti rādhasā dānurasmā uparā pinvate divaḥ ||
1,054.08  asamaṃ kṣatramasamā manīṣā pra somapā apasā santu neme |
1,054.08 ye ta indra daduṣo vardhayanti mahi kṣatraṃ sthaviraṃ vṛṣṇyaṃ ca ||
1,054.09  tubhyedete bahulā adridugdhāścamūṣadaścamasā indrapānāḥ |
1,054.09 vyaśnuhi tarpayā kāmameṣāmathā mano vasudeyāya kṛṣva ||
1,054.10  apāmatiṣṭhaddharuṇahvaraṃ tamo'ntarvṛtrasya jaṭhareṣu parvataḥ |
1,054.10 abhīmindro nadyo vavriṇā hitā viśvā anuṣṭhāḥ pravaṇeṣu jighnate ||
1,054.11  sa śevṛdhamadhi dhā dyumnamasme mahi kṣatraṃ janāṣāḻ indra tavyam |
1,054.11 rakṣā ca no maghonaḥ pāhi sūrīnrāye ca naḥ svapatyā iṣe dhāḥ ||

1,055.01  divaścidasya varimā vi papratha indraṃ na mahnā pṛthivī cana prati |
1,055.01 bhīmastuviṣmāñcarṣaṇibhya ātapaḥ śiśīte vajraṃ tejase na vaṃsagaḥ ||
1,055.02  so arṇavo na nadyaḥ samudriyaḥ prati gṛbhṇāti viśritā varīmabhiḥ |
1,055.02 indraḥ somasya pītaye vṛṣāyate sanātsa yudhma ojasā panasyate ||
1,055.03  tvaṃ tamindra parvataṃ na bhojase maho nṛmṇasya dharmaṇāmirajyasi |
1,055.03 pra vīryeṇa devatāti cekite viśvasmā ugraḥ karmaṇe purohitaḥ ||
1,055.04  sa idvane namasyubhirvacasyate cāru janeṣu prabruvāṇa indriyam |
1,055.04 vṛṣā chandurbhavati haryato vṛṣā kṣemeṇa dhenāṃ maghavā yadinvati ||
1,055.05  sa inmahāni samithāni majmanā kṛṇoti yudhma ojasā janebhyaḥ |
1,055.05 adhā cana śraddadhati tviṣīmata indrāya vajraṃ nighanighnate vadham ||
1,055.06  sa hi śravasyuḥ sadanāni kṛtrimā kṣmayā vṛdhāna ojasā vināśayan |
1,055.06 jyotīṃṣi kṛṇvannavṛkāṇi yajyave'va sukratuḥ sartavā apaḥ sṛjat ||
1,055.07  dānāya manaḥ somapāvannastu te'rvāñcā harī vandanaśrudā kṛdhi |
1,055.07 yamiṣṭhāsaḥ sārathayo ya indra te na tvā ketā ā dabhnuvanti bhūrṇayaḥ ||
1,055.08  aprakṣitaṃ vasu bibharṣi hastayoraṣāḻhaṃ sahastanvi śruto dadhe |
1,055.08 āvṛtāso'vatāso na kartṛbhistanūṣu te kratava indra bhūrayaḥ ||

1,056.01  eṣa pra pūrvīrava tasya camriṣo'tyo na yoṣāmudayaṃsta bhurvaṇiḥ |
1,056.01 dakṣaṃ mahe pāyayate hiraṇyayaṃ rathamāvṛtyā hariyogamṛbhvasam ||
1,056.02  taṃ gūrtayo nemanniṣaḥ parīṇasaḥ samudraṃ na saṃcaraṇe saniṣyavaḥ |
1,056.02 patiṃ dakṣasya vidathasya nū saho giriṃ na venā adhi roha tejasā ||
1,056.03  sa turvaṇirmahāṃ areṇu pauṃsye girerbhṛṣṭirna bhrājate tujā śavaḥ |
1,056.03 yena śuṣṇaṃ māyinamāyaso made dudhra ābhūṣu rāmayanni dāmani ||
1,056.04  devī yadi taviṣī tvāvṛdhotaya indraṃ siṣaktyuṣasaṃ na sūryaḥ |
1,056.04 yo dhṛṣṇunā śavasā bādhate tama iyarti reṇuṃ bṛhadarhariṣvaṇiḥ ||
1,056.05  vi yattiro dharuṇamacyutaṃ rajo'tiṣṭhipo diva ātāsu barhaṇā |
1,056.05 svarmīḻhe yanmada indra harṣyāhanvṛtraṃ nirapāmaubjo arṇavam ||
1,056.06  tvaṃ divo dharuṇaṃ dhiṣa ojasā pṛthivyā indra sadaneṣu māhinaḥ |
1,056.06 tvaṃ sutasya made ariṇā apo vi vṛtrasya samayā pāṣyārujaḥ ||

1,057.01  pra maṃhiṣṭhāya bṛhate bṛhadraye satyaśuṣmāya tavase matiṃ bhare |
1,057.01 apāmiva pravaṇe yasya durdharaṃ rādho viśvāyu śavase apāvṛtam ||
1,057.02  adha te viśvamanu hāsadiṣṭaya āpo nimneva savanā haviṣmataḥ |
1,057.02 yatparvate na samaśīta haryata indrasya vajraḥ śnathitā hiraṇyayaḥ ||
1,057.03  asmai bhīmāya namasā samadhvara uṣo na śubhra ā bharā panīyase |
1,057.03 yasya dhāma śravase nāmendriyaṃ jyotirakāri harito nāyase ||
1,057.04  ime ta indra te vayaṃ puruṣṭuta ye tvārabhya carāmasi prabhūvaso |
1,057.04 nahi tvadanyo girvaṇo giraḥ saghatkṣoṇīriva prati no harya tadvacaḥ ||
1,057.05  bhūri ta indra vīryaṃ tava smasyasya stoturmaghavankāmamā pṛṇa |
1,057.05 anu te dyaurbṛhatī vīryaṃ mama iyaṃ ca te pṛthivī nema ojase ||
1,057.06  tvaṃ tamindra parvataṃ mahāmuruṃ vajreṇa vajrinparvaśaścakartitha |
1,057.06 avāsṛjo nivṛtāḥ sartavā apaḥ satrā viśvaṃ dadhiṣe kevalaṃ sahaḥ ||

1,058.01  nū citsahojā amṛto ni tundate hotā yaddūto abhavadvivasvataḥ |
1,058.01 vi sādhiṣṭhebhiḥ pathibhī rajo mama ā devatātā haviṣā vivāsati ||
1,058.02  ā svamadma yuvamāno ajarastṛṣvaviṣyannataseṣu tiṣṭhati |
1,058.02 atyo na pṛṣṭhaṃ pruṣitasya rocate divo na sānu stanayannacikradat ||
1,058.03  krāṇā rudrebhirvasubhiḥ purohito hotā niṣatto rayiṣāḻ amartyaḥ |
1,058.03 ratho na vikṣvṛñjasāna āyuṣu vyānuṣagvāryā deva ṛṇvati ||
1,058.04  vi vātajūto ataseṣu tiṣṭhate vṛthā juhūbhiḥ sṛṇyā tuviṣvaṇiḥ |
1,058.04 tṛṣu yadagne vanino vṛṣāyase kṛṣṇaṃ ta ema ruśadūrme ajara ||
1,058.05  tapurjambho vana ā vātacodito yūthe na sāhvāṃ ava vāti vaṃsagaḥ |
1,058.05 abhivrajannakṣitaṃ pājasā raja sthātuścarathaṃ bhayate patatriṇaḥ ||
1,058.06  dadhuṣṭvā bhṛgavo mānuṣeṣvā rayiṃ na cāruṃ suhavaṃ janebhyaḥ |
1,058.06 hotāramagne atithiṃ vareṇyaṃ mitraṃ na śevaṃ divyāya janmane ||
1,058.07  hotāraṃ sapta juhvo yajiṣṭhaṃ yaṃ vāghato vṛṇate adhvareṣu |
1,058.07 agniṃ viśveṣāmaratiṃ vasūnāṃ saparyāmi prayasā yāmi ratnam ||
1,058.08  acchidrā sūno sahaso no adya stotṛbhyo mitramahaḥ śarma yaccha |
1,058.08 agne gṛṇantamaṃhasa uruṣyorjo napātpūrbhirāyasībhiḥ ||
1,058.09  bhavā varūthaṃ gṛṇate vibhāvo bhavā maghavanmaghavadbhyaḥ śarma |
1,058.09 uruṣyāgne aṃhaso gṛṇantaṃ prātarmakṣū dhiyāvasurjagamyāt ||

1,059.01  vayā idagne agnayaste anye tve viśve amṛtā mādayante |
1,059.01 vaiśvānara nābhirasi kṣitīnāṃ sthūṇeva janāṃ upamidyayantha ||
1,059.02  mūrdhā divo nābhiragniḥ pṛthivyā athābhavadaratī rodasyoḥ |
1,059.02 taṃ tvā devāso'janayanta devaṃ vaiśvānara jyotiridāryāya ||
1,059.03  ā sūrye na raśmayo dhruvāso vaiśvānare dadhire'gnā vasūni |
1,059.03 yā parvateṣvoṣadhīṣvapsu yā mānuṣeṣvasi tasya rājā ||
1,059.04  bṛhatī iva sūnave rodasī giro hotā manuṣyo na dakṣaḥ |
1,059.04 svarvate satyaśuṣmāya pūrvīrvaiśvānarāya nṛtamāya yahvīḥ ||
1,059.05  divaścitte bṛhato jātavedo vaiśvānara pra ririce mahitvam |
1,059.05 rājā kṛṣṭīnāmasi mānuṣīṇāṃ yudhā devebhyo varivaścakartha ||
1,059.06  pra nū mahitvaṃ vṛṣabhasya vocaṃ yaṃ pūravo vṛtrahaṇaṃ sacante |
1,059.06 vaiśvānaro dasyumagnirjaghanvāṃ adhūnotkāṣṭhā ava śambaraṃ bhet ||
1,059.07  vaiśvānaro mahimnā viśvakṛṣṭirbharadvājeṣu yajato vibhāvā |
1,059.07 śātavaneye śatinībhiragniḥ puruṇīthe jarate sūnṛtāvān ||

1,060.01  vahniṃ yaśasaṃ vidathasya ketuṃ suprāvyaṃ dūtaṃ sadyoartham |
1,060.01 dvijanmānaṃ rayimiva praśastaṃ rātiṃ bharadbhṛgave mātariśvā ||
1,060.02  asya śāsurubhayāsaḥ sacante haviṣmanta uśijo ye ca martāḥ |
1,060.02 divaścitpūrvo nyasādi hotāpṛcchyo viśpatirvikṣu vedhāḥ ||
1,060.03  taṃ navyasī hṛda ā jāyamānamasmatsukīrtirmadhujihvamaśyāḥ |
1,060.03 yamṛtvijo vṛjane mānuṣāsaḥ prayasvanta āyavo jījananta ||
1,060.04  uśikpāvako vasurmānuṣeṣu vareṇyo hotādhāyi vikṣu |
1,060.04 damūnā gṛhapatirdama āṃ agnirbhuvadrayipatī rayīṇām ||
1,060.05  taṃ tvā vayaṃ patimagne rayīṇāṃ pra śaṃsāmo matibhirgotamāsaḥ |
1,060.05 āśuṃ na vājambharaṃ marjayantaḥ prātarmakṣū dhiyāvasurjagamyāt ||

1,061.01  asmā idu pra tavase turāya prayo na harmi stomaṃ māhināya |
1,061.01 ṛcīṣamāyādhrigava ohamindrāya brahmāṇi rātatamā ||
1,061.02  asmā idu praya iva pra yaṃsi bharāmyāṅgūṣaṃ bādhe suvṛkti |
1,061.02 indrāya hṛdā manasā manīṣā pratnāya patye dhiyo marjayanta ||
1,061.03  asmā idu tyamupamaṃ svarṣāṃ bharāmyāṅgūṣamāsyena |
1,061.03 maṃhiṣṭhamacchoktibhirmatīnāṃ suvṛktibhiḥ sūriṃ vāvṛdhadhyai ||
1,061.04  asmā idu stomaṃ saṃ hinomi rathaṃ na taṣṭeva tatsināya |
1,061.04 giraśca girvāhase suvṛktīndrāya viśvaminvaṃ medhirāya ||
1,061.05  asmā idu saptimiva śravasyendrāyārkaṃ juhvā samañje |
1,061.05 vīraṃ dānaukasaṃ vandadhyai purāṃ gūrtaśravasaṃ darmāṇam ||
1,061.06  asmā idu tvaṣṭā takṣadvajraṃ svapastamaṃ svaryaṃ raṇāya |
1,061.06 vṛtrasya cidvidadyena marma tujannīśānastujatā kiyedhāḥ ||
1,061.07  asyedu mātuḥ savaneṣu sadyo mahaḥ pituṃ papivāñcārvannā |
1,061.07 muṣāyadviṣṇuḥ pacataṃ sahīyānvidhyadvarāhaṃ tiro adrimastā ||
1,061.08  asmā idu gnāściddevapatnīrindrāyārkamahihatya ūvuḥ |
1,061.08 pari dyāvāpṛthivī jabhra urvī nāsya te mahimānaṃ pari ṣṭaḥ ||
1,061.09  asyedeva pra ririce mahitvaṃ divaspṛthivyāḥ paryantarikṣāt |
1,061.09 svarāḻ indro dama ā viśvagūrtaḥ svariramatro vavakṣe raṇāya ||
1,061.10  asyedeva śavasā śuṣantaṃ vi vṛścadvajreṇa vṛtramindraḥ |
1,061.10 gā na vrāṇā avanīramuñcadabhi śravo dāvane sacetāḥ ||
1,061.11  asyedu tveṣasā ranta sindhavaḥ pari yadvajreṇa sīmayacchat |
1,061.11 īśānakṛddāśuṣe daśasyanturvītaye gādhaṃ turvaṇiḥ kaḥ ||
1,061.12  asmā idu pra bharā tūtujāno vṛtrāya vajramīśānaḥ kiyedhāḥ |
1,061.12 gorna parva vi radā tiraśceṣyannarṇāṃsyapāṃ caradhyai ||
1,061.13  asyedu pra brūhi pūrvyāṇi turasya karmāṇi navya ukthaiḥ |
1,061.13 yudhe yadiṣṇāna āyudhānyṛghāyamāṇo niriṇāti śatrūn ||
1,061.14  asyedu bhiyā girayaśca dṛḻhā dyāvā ca bhūmā januṣastujete |
1,061.14 upo venasya joguvāna oṇiṃ sadyo bhuvadvīryāya nodhāḥ ||
1,061.15  asmā idu tyadanu dāyyeṣāmeko yadvavne bhūrerīśānaḥ |
1,061.15 praitaśaṃ sūrye paspṛdhānaṃ sauvaśvye suṣvimāvadindraḥ ||
1,061.16  evā te hāriyojanā suvṛktīndra brahmāṇi gotamāso akran |
1,061.16 aiṣu viśvapeśasaṃ dhiyaṃ dhāḥ prātarmakṣū dhiyāvasurjagamyāt ||

1,062.01  pra manmahe śavasānāya śūṣamāṅgūṣaṃ girvaṇase aṅgirasvat |
1,062.01 suvṛktibhi stuvata ṛgmiyāyārcāmārkaṃ nare viśrutāya ||
1,062.02  pra vo mahe mahi namo bharadhvamāṅgūṣyaṃ śavasānāya sāma |
1,062.02 yenā naḥ pūrve pitaraḥ padajñā arcanto aṅgiraso gā avindan ||
1,062.03  indrasyāṅgirasāṃ ceṣṭau vidatsaramā tanayāya dhāsim |
1,062.03 bṛhaspatirbhinadadriṃ vidadgāḥ samusriyābhirvāvaśanta naraḥ ||
1,062.04  sa suṣṭubhā sa stubhā sapta vipraiḥ svareṇādriṃ svaryo navagvaiḥ |
1,062.04 saraṇyubhiḥ phaligamindra śakra valaṃ raveṇa darayo daśagvaiḥ ||
1,062.05  gṛṇāno aṅgirobhirdasma vi varuṣasā sūryeṇa gobhirandhaḥ |
1,062.05 vi bhūmyā aprathaya indra sānu divo raja uparamastabhāyaḥ ||
1,062.06  tadu prayakṣatamamasya karma dasmasya cārutamamasti daṃsaḥ |
1,062.06 upahvare yaduparā apinvanmadhvarṇaso nadyaścatasraḥ ||
1,062.07  dvitā vi vavre sanajā sanīḻe ayāsya stavamānebhirarkaiḥ |
1,062.07 bhago na mene parame vyomannadhārayadrodasī sudaṃsāḥ ||
1,062.08  sanāddivaṃ pari bhūmā virūpe punarbhuvā yuvatī svebhirevaiḥ |
1,062.08 kṛṣṇebhiraktoṣā ruśadbhirvapurbhirā carato anyānyā ||
1,062.09  sanemi sakhyaṃ svapasyamānaḥ sūnurdādhāra śavasā sudaṃsāḥ |
1,062.09 āmāsu ciddadhiṣe pakvamantaḥ payaḥ kṛṣṇāsu ruśadrohiṇīṣu ||
1,062.10  sanātsanīḻā avanīravātā vratā rakṣante amṛtāḥ sahobhiḥ |
1,062.10 purū sahasrā janayo na patnīrduvasyanti svasāro ahrayāṇam ||
1,062.11  sanāyuvo namasā navyo arkairvasūyavo matayo dasma dadruḥ |
1,062.11 patiṃ na patnīruśatīruśantaṃ spṛśanti tvā śavasāvanmanīṣāḥ ||
1,062.12  sanādeva tava rāyo gabhastau na kṣīyante nopa dasyanti dasma |
1,062.12 dyumāṃ asi kratumāṃ indra dhīraḥ śikṣā śacīvastava naḥ śacībhiḥ ||
1,062.13  sanāyate gotama indra navyamatakṣadbrahma hariyojanāya |
1,062.13 sunīthāya naḥ śavasāna nodhāḥ prātarmakṣū dhiyāvasurjagamyāt ||

1,063.01  tvaṃ mahāṃ indra yo ha śuṣmairdyāvā jajñānaḥ pṛthivī ame dhāḥ |
1,063.01 yaddha te viśvā girayaścidabhvā bhiyā dṛḻhāsaḥ kiraṇā naijan ||
1,063.02  ā yaddharī indra vivratā verā te vajraṃ jaritā bāhvordhāt |
1,063.02 yenāviharyatakrato amitrānpura iṣṇāsi puruhūta pūrvīḥ ||
1,063.03  tvaṃ satya indra dhṛṣṇuretāntvamṛbhukṣā naryastvaṃ ṣāṭ |
1,063.03 tvaṃ śuṣṇaṃ vṛjane pṛkṣa āṇau yūne kutsāya dyumate sacāhan ||
1,063.04  tvaṃ ha tyadindra codīḥ sakhā vṛtraṃ yadvajrinvṛṣakarmannubhnāḥ |
1,063.04 yaddha śūra vṛṣamaṇaḥ parācairvi dasyūṃryonāvakṛto vṛthāṣāṭ ||
1,063.05  tvaṃ ha tyadindrāriṣaṇyandṛḻhasya cinmartānāmajuṣṭau |
1,063.05 vyasmadā kāṣṭhā arvate varghaneva vajriñchnathihyamitrān ||
1,063.06  tvāṃ ha tyadindrārṇasātau svarmīḻhe nara ājā havante |
1,063.06 tava svadhāva iyamā samarya ūtirvājeṣvatasāyyā bhūt ||
1,063.07  tvaṃ ha tyadindra sapta yudhyanpuro vajrinpurukutsāya dardaḥ |
1,063.07 barhirna yatsudāse vṛthā vargaṃho rājanvarivaḥ pūrave kaḥ ||
1,063.08  tvaṃ tyāṃ na indra deva citrāmiṣamāpo na pīpayaḥ parijman |
1,063.08 yayā śūra pratyasmabhyaṃ yaṃsi tmanamūrjaṃ na viśvadha kṣaradhyai ||
