1,063.09  akāri ta indra gotamebhirbrahmāṇyoktā namasā haribhyām |
1,063.09 supeśasaṃ vājamā bharā naḥ prātarmakṣū dhiyāvasurjagamyāt ||

1,064.01  vṛṣṇe śardhāya sumakhāya vedhase nodhaḥ suvṛktiṃ pra bharā marudbhyaḥ |
1,064.01 apo na dhīro manasā suhastyo giraḥ samañje vidatheṣvābhuvaḥ ||
1,064.02  te jajñire diva ṛṣvāsa ukṣaṇo rudrasya maryā asurā arepasaḥ |
1,064.02 pāvakāsaḥ śucayaḥ sūryā iva satvāno na drapsino ghoravarpasaḥ ||
1,064.03  yuvāno rudrā ajarā abhogghano vavakṣuradhrigāvaḥ parvatā iva |
1,064.03 dṛḻhā cidviśvā bhuvanāni pārthivā pra cyāvayanti divyāni majmanā ||
1,064.04  citrairañjibhirvapuṣe vyañjate vakṣassu rukmāṃ adhi yetire śubhe |
1,064.04 aṃseṣveṣāṃ ni mimṛkṣurṛṣṭayaḥ sākaṃ jajñire svadhayā divo naraḥ ||
1,064.05  īśānakṛto dhunayo riśādaso vātānvidyutastaviṣībhirakrata |
1,064.05 duhantyūdhardivyāni dhūtayo bhūmiṃ pinvanti payasā parijrayaḥ ||
1,064.06  pinvantyapo marutaḥ sudānavaḥ payo ghṛtavadvidatheṣvābhuvaḥ |
1,064.06 atyaṃ na mihe vi nayanti vājinamutsaṃ duhanti stanayantamakṣitam ||
1,064.07  mahiṣāso māyinaścitrabhānavo girayo na svatavaso raghuṣyadaḥ |
1,064.07 mṛgā iva hastinaḥ khādathā vanā yadāruṇīṣu taviṣīrayugdhvam ||
1,064.08  siṃhā iva nānadati pracetasaḥ piśā iva supiśo viśvavedasaḥ |
1,064.08 kṣapo jinvantaḥ pṛṣatībhirṛṣṭibhiḥ samitsabādhaḥ śavasāhimanyavaḥ ||
1,064.09  rodasī ā vadatā gaṇaśriyo nṛṣācaḥ śūrāḥ śavasāhimanyavaḥ |
1,064.09 ā vandhureṣvamatirna darśatā vidyunna tasthau maruto ratheṣu vaḥ ||
1,064.10  viśvavedaso rayibhiḥ samokasaḥ sammiślāsastaviṣībhirvirapśinaḥ |
1,064.10 astāra iṣuṃ dadhire gabhastyoranantaśuṣmā vṛṣakhādayo naraḥ ||
1,064.11  hiraṇyayebhiḥ pavibhiḥ payovṛdha ujjighnanta āpathyo na parvatān |
1,064.11 makhā ayāsaḥ svasṛto dhruvacyuto dudhrakṛto maruto bhrājadṛṣṭayaḥ ||
1,064.12  ghṛṣuṃ pāvakaṃ vaninaṃ vicarṣaṇiṃ rudrasya sūnuṃ havasā gṛṇīmasi |
1,064.12 rajasturaṃ tavasaṃ mārutaṃ gaṇamṛjīṣiṇaṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ saścata śriye ||
1,064.13  pra nū sa martaḥ śavasā janāṃ ati tasthau va ūtī maruto yamāvata |
1,064.13 arvadbhirvājaṃ bharate dhanā nṛbhirāpṛcchyaṃ kratumā kṣeti puṣyati ||
1,064.14  carkṛtyaṃ marutaḥ pṛtsu duṣṭaraṃ dyumantaṃ śuṣmaṃ maghavatsu dhattana |
1,064.14 dhanaspṛtamukthyaṃ viśvacarṣaṇiṃ tokaṃ puṣyema tanayaṃ śataṃ himāḥ ||
1,064.15  nū ṣṭhiraṃ maruto vīravantamṛtīṣāhaṃ rayimasmāsu dhatta |
1,064.15 sahasriṇaṃ śatinaṃ śūśuvāṃsaṃ prātarmakṣū dhiyāvasurjagamyāt ||

1,065.01 paśvā na tāyuṃ guhā catantaṃ namo yujānaṃ namo vahantam ||
1,065.02 sajoṣā dhīrāḥ padairanu gmannupa tvā sīdanviśve yajatrāḥ ||
1,065.03 ṛtasya devā anu vratā gurbhuvatpariṣṭirdyaurna bhūma ||
1,065.04 vardhantīmāpaḥ panvā suśiśvimṛtasya yonā garbhe sujātam ||
1,065.05 puṣṭirna raṇvā kṣitirna pṛthvī girirna bhujma kṣodo na śambhu ||
1,065.06 atyo nājmansargaprataktaḥ sindhurna kṣodaḥ ka īṃ varāte ||
1,065.07 jāmiḥ sindhūnāṃ bhrāteva svasrāmibhyānna rājā vanānyatti ||
1,065.08 yadvātajūto vanā vyasthādagnirha dāti romā pṛthivyāḥ ||
1,065.09 śvasityapsu haṃso na sīdankratvā cetiṣṭho viśāmuṣarbhut ||
1,065.10 somo na vedhā ṛtaprajātaḥ paśurna śiśvā vibhurdūrebhāḥ ||

1,066.01 rayirna citrā sūro na saṃdṛgāyurna prāṇo nityo na sūnuḥ ||
1,066.02 takvā na bhūrṇirvanā siṣakti payo na dhenuḥ śucirvibhāvā ||
1,066.03 dādhāra kṣemamoko na raṇvo yavo na pakvo jetā janānām ||
1,066.04 ṛṣirna stubhvā vikṣu praśasto vājī na prīto vayo dadhāti ||
1,066.05 durokaśociḥ kraturna nityo jāyeva yonāvaraṃ viśvasmai ||
1,066.06 citro yadabhrāṭchveto na vikṣu ratho na rukmī tveṣaḥ samatsu ||
1,066.07 seneva sṛṣṭāmaṃ dadhātyasturna didyuttveṣapratīkā ||
1,066.08 yamo ha jāto yamo janitvaṃ jāraḥ kanīnāṃ patirjanīnām ||
1,066.09 taṃ vaścarāthā vayaṃ vasatyāstaṃ na gāvo nakṣanta iddham ||
1,066.10 sindhurna kṣodaḥ pra nīcīrainonnavanta gāvaḥ svardṛśīke ||

1,067.01 vaneṣu jāyurmarteṣu mitro vṛṇīte śruṣṭiṃ rājevājuryam ||
1,067.02 kṣemo na sādhuḥ kraturna bhadro bhuvatsvādhīrhotā havyavāṭ ||
1,067.03 haste dadhāno nṛmṇā viśvānyame devāndhādguhā niṣīdan ||
1,067.04 vidantīmatra naro dhiyandhā hṛdā yattaṣṭānmantrāṃ aśaṃsan ||
1,067.05 ajo na kṣāṃ dādhāra pṛthivīṃ tastambha dyāṃ mantrebhiḥ satyaiḥ ||
1,067.06 priyā padāni paśvo ni pāhi viśvāyuragne guhā guhaṃ gāḥ ||
1,067.07 ya īṃ ciketa guhā bhavantamā yaḥ sasāda dhārāmṛtasya ||
1,067.08 vi ye cṛtantyṛtā sapanta ādidvasūni pra vavācāsmai ||
1,067.09 vi yo vīrutsu rodhanmahitvota prajā uta prasūṣvantaḥ ||
1,067.10 cittirapāṃ dame viśvāyuḥ sadmeva dhīrāḥ sammāya cakruḥ ||

1,068.01 śrīṇannupa sthāddivaṃ bhuraṇyu sthātuścarathamaktūnvyūrṇot ||
1,068.02 pari yadeṣāmeko viśveṣāṃ bhuvaddevo devānāṃ mahitvā ||
1,068.03 āditte viśve kratuṃ juṣanta śuṣkādyaddeva jīvo janiṣṭhāḥ ||
1,068.04 bhajanta viśve devatvaṃ nāma ṛtaṃ sapanto amṛtamevaiḥ ||
1,068.05 ṛtasya preṣā ṛtasya dhītirviśvāyurviśve apāṃsi cakruḥ ||
1,068.06 yastubhyaṃ dāśādyo vā te śikṣāttasmai cikitvānrayiṃ dayasva ||
1,068.07 hotā niṣatto manorapatye sa cinnvāsāṃ patī rayīṇām ||
1,068.08 icchanta reto mithastanūṣu saṃ jānata svairdakṣairamūrāḥ ||
1,068.09 piturna putrāḥ kratuṃ juṣanta śroṣanye asya śāsaṃ turāsaḥ ||
1,068.10 vi rāya aurṇodduraḥ purukṣuḥ pipeśa nākaṃ stṛbhirdamūnāḥ ||

1,069.01 śukraḥ śuśukvāṃ uṣo na jāraḥ paprā samīcī divo na jyotiḥ ||
1,069.02 pari prajātaḥ kratvā babhūtha bhuvo devānāṃ pitā putraḥ san ||
1,069.03 vedhā adṛpto agnirvijānannūdharna gonāṃ svādmā pitūnām ||
1,069.04 jane na śeva āhūryaḥ sanmadhye niṣatto raṇvo duroṇe ||
1,069.05 putro na jāto raṇvo duroṇe vājī na prīto viśo vi tārīt ||
1,069.06 viśo yadahve nṛbhiḥ sanīḻā agnirdevatvā viśvānyaśyāḥ ||
1,069.07 nakiṣṭa etā vratā minanti nṛbhyo yadebhyaḥ śruṣṭiṃ cakartha ||
1,069.08 tattu te daṃso yadahansamānairnṛbhiryadyukto vive rapāṃsi ||
1,069.09 uṣo na jāro vibhāvosraḥ saṃjñātarūpaściketadasmai ||
1,069.10 tmanā vahanto duro vyṛṇvannavanta viśve svardṛśīke ||

1,070.01 vanema pūrvīraryo manīṣā agniḥ suśoko viśvānyaśyāḥ ||
1,070.02 ā daivyāni vratā cikitvānā mānuṣasya janasya janma ||
1,070.03 garbho yo apāṃ garbho vanānāṃ garbhaśca sthātāṃ garbhaścarathām ||
1,070.04 adrau cidasmā antarduroṇe viśāṃ na viśvo amṛtaḥ svādhīḥ ||
1,070.05 sa hi kṣapāvāṃ agnī rayīṇāṃ dāśadyo asmā araṃ sūktaiḥ ||
1,070.06 etā cikitvo bhūmā ni pāhi devānāṃ janma martāṃśca vidvān ||
1,070.07 vardhānyaṃ pūrvīḥ kṣapo virūpā sthātuśca rathamṛtapravītam ||
1,070.08 arādhi hotā svarniṣattaḥ kṛṇvanviśvānyapāṃsi satyā ||
1,070.09 goṣu praśastiṃ vaneṣu dhiṣe bharanta viśve baliṃ svarṇaḥ ||
1,070.10 vi tvā naraḥ purutrā saparyanpiturna jivrervi vedo bharanta ||
1,070.11 sādhurna gṛdhnurasteva śūro yāteva bhīmastveṣaḥ samatsu ||

1,071.01  upa pra jinvannuśatīruśantaṃ patiṃ na nityaṃ janayaḥ sanīḻāḥ |
1,071.01 svasāraḥ śyāvīmaruṣīmajuṣrañcitramucchantīmuṣasaṃ na gāvaḥ ||
1,071.02  vīḻu ciddṛḻhā pitaro na ukthairadriṃ rujannaṅgiraso raveṇa |
1,071.02 cakrurdivo bṛhato gātumasme ahaḥ svarvividuḥ ketumusrāḥ ||
1,071.03  dadhannṛtaṃ dhanayannasya dhītimādidaryo didhiṣvo vibhṛtrāḥ |
1,071.03 atṛṣyantīrapaso yantyacchā devāñjanma prayasā vardhayantīḥ ||
1,071.04  mathīdyadīṃ vibhṛto mātariśvā gṛhegṛhe śyeto jenyo bhūt |
1,071.04 ādīṃ rājñe na sahīyase sacā sannā dūtyaṃ bhṛgavāṇo vivāya ||
1,071.05  mahe yatpitra īṃ rasaṃ dive karava tsaratpṛśanyaścikitvān |
1,071.05 sṛjadastā dhṛṣatā didyumasmai svāyāṃ devo duhitari tviṣiṃ dhāt ||
1,071.06  sva ā yastubhyaṃ dama ā vibhāti namo vā dāśāduśato anu dyūn |
1,071.06 vardho agne vayo asya dvibarhā yāsadrāyā sarathaṃ yaṃ junāsi ||
1,071.07  agniṃ viśvā abhi pṛkṣaḥ sacante samudraṃ na sravataḥ sapta yahvīḥ |
1,071.07 na jāmibhirvi cikite vayo no vidā deveṣu pramatiṃ cikitvān ||
1,071.08  ā yadiṣe nṛpatiṃ teja ānaṭchuci reto niṣiktaṃ dyaurabhīke |
1,071.08 agniḥ śardhamanavadyaṃ yuvānaṃ svādhyaṃ janayatsūdayacca ||
1,071.09  mano na yo'dhvanaḥ sadya etyekaḥ satrā sūro vasva īśe |
1,071.09 rājānā mitrāvaruṇā supāṇī goṣu priyamamṛtaṃ rakṣamāṇā ||
1,071.10  mā no agne sakhyā pitryāṇi pra marṣiṣṭhā abhi viduṣkaviḥ san |
1,071.10 nabho na rūpaṃ jarimā mināti purā tasyā abhiśasteradhīhi ||

1,072.01  ni kāvyā vedhasaḥ śaśvataskarhaste dadhāno naryā purūṇi |
1,072.01 agnirbhuvadrayipatī rayīṇāṃ satrā cakrāṇo amṛtāni viśvā ||
1,072.02  asme vatsaṃ pari ṣantaṃ na vindannicchanto viśve amṛtā amūrāḥ |
1,072.02 śramayuvaḥ padavyo dhiyandhāstasthuḥ pade parame cārvagneḥ ||
1,072.03  tisro yadagne śaradastvāmicchuciṃ ghṛtena śucayaḥ saparyān |
1,072.03 nāmāni ciddadhire yajñiyānyasūdayanta tanvaḥ sujātāḥ ||
1,072.04  ā rodasī bṛhatī vevidānāḥ pra rudriyā jabhrire yajñiyāsaḥ |
1,072.04 vidanmarto nemadhitā cikitvānagniṃ pade parame tasthivāṃsam ||
1,072.05  saṃjānānā upa sīdannabhijñu patnīvanto namasyaṃ namasyan |
1,072.05 ririkvāṃsastanvaḥ kṛṇvata svāḥ sakhā sakhyurnimiṣi rakṣamāṇāḥ ||
1,072.06  triḥ sapta yadguhyāni tve itpadāvidannihitā yajñiyāsaḥ |
1,072.06 tebhī rakṣante amṛtaṃ sajoṣāḥ paśūñca sthātṝñcarathaṃ ca pāhi ||
1,072.07  vidvāṃ agne vayunāni kṣitīnāṃ vyānuṣakchurudho jīvase dhāḥ |
1,072.07 antarvidvāṃ adhvano devayānānatandro dūto abhavo havirvāṭ ||
1,072.08  svādhyo diva ā sapta yahvī rāyo duro vyṛtajñā ajānan |
1,072.08 vidadgavyaṃ saramā dṛḻhamūrvaṃ yenā nu kaṃ mānuṣī bhojate viṭ ||
1,072.09  ā ye viśvā svapatyāni tasthuḥ kṛṇvānāso amṛtatvāya gātum |
1,072.09 mahnā mahadbhiḥ pṛthivī vi tasthe mātā putrairaditirdhāyase veḥ ||
1,072.10  adhi śriyaṃ ni dadhuścārumasmindivo yadakṣī amṛtā akṛṇvan |
1,072.10 adha kṣaranti sindhavo na sṛṣṭāḥ pra nīcīragne aruṣīrajānan ||

1,073.01  rayirna yaḥ pitṛvitto vayodhāḥ supraṇītiścikituṣo na śāsuḥ |
1,073.01 syonaśīratithirna prīṇāno hoteva sadma vidhato vi tārīt ||
1,073.02  devo na yaḥ savitā satyamanmā kratvā nipāti vṛjanāni viśvā |
1,073.02 purupraśasto amatirna satya ātmeva śevo didhiṣāyyo bhūt ||
1,073.03  devo na yaḥ pṛthivīṃ viśvadhāyā upakṣeti hitamitro na rājā |
1,073.03 puraḥsadaḥ śarmasado na vīrā anavadyā patijuṣṭeva nārī ||
1,073.04  taṃ tvā naro dama ā nityamiddhamagne sacanta kṣitiṣu dhruvāsu |
1,073.04 adhi dyumnaṃ ni dadhurbhūryasminbhavā viśvāyurdharuṇo rayīṇām ||
1,073.05  vi pṛkṣo agne maghavāno aśyurvi sūrayo dadato viśvamāyuḥ |
1,073.05 sanema vājaṃ samitheṣvaryo bhāgaṃ deveṣu śravase dadhānāḥ ||
1,073.06  ṛtasya hi dhenavo vāvaśānāḥ smadūdhnīḥ pīpayanta dyubhaktāḥ |
1,073.06 parāvataḥ sumatiṃ bhikṣamāṇā vi sindhavaḥ samayā sasruradrim ||
1,073.07  tve agne sumatiṃ bhikṣamāṇā divi śravo dadhire yajñiyāsaḥ |
1,073.07 naktā ca cakruruṣasā virūpe kṛṣṇaṃ ca varṇamaruṇaṃ ca saṃ dhuḥ ||
1,073.08  yānrāye martānsuṣūdo agne te syāma maghavāno vayaṃ ca |
1,073.08 chāyeva viśvaṃ bhuvanaṃ sisakṣyāpaprivānrodasī antarikṣam ||
1,073.09  arvadbhiragne arvato nṛbhirnṝnvīrairvīrānvanuyāmā tvotāḥ |
1,073.09 īśānāsaḥ pitṛvittasya rāyo vi sūrayaḥ śatahimā no aśyuḥ ||
1,073.10  etā te agna ucathāni vedho juṣṭāni santu manase hṛde ca |
1,073.10 śakema rāyaḥ sudhuro yamaṃ te'dhi śravo devabhaktaṃ dadhānāḥ ||

1,074.01  upaprayanto adhvaraṃ mantraṃ vocemāgnaye |
1,074.01 āre asme ca śṛṇvate ||
1,074.02  yaḥ snīhitīṣu pūrvyaḥ saṃjagmānāsu kṛṣṭiṣu |
1,074.02 arakṣaddāśuṣe gayam ||
1,074.03  uta bruvantu jantava udagnirvṛtrahājani |
1,074.03 dhanañjayo raṇeraṇe ||
1,074.04  yasya dūto asi kṣaye veṣi havyāni vītaye |
1,074.04 dasmatkṛṇoṣyadhvaram ||
1,074.05  tamitsuhavyamaṅgiraḥ sudevaṃ sahaso yaho |
1,074.05 janā āhuḥ subarhiṣam ||
1,074.06  ā ca vahāsi tāṃ iha devāṃ upa praśastaye |
1,074.06 havyā suścandra vītaye ||
1,074.07  na yorupabdiraśvyaḥ śṛṇve rathasya kaccana |
1,074.07 yadagne yāsi dūtyam ||
1,074.08  tvoto vājyahrayo'bhi pūrvasmādaparaḥ |
1,074.08 pra dāśvāṃ agne asthāt ||
1,074.09  uta dyumatsuvīryaṃ bṛhadagne vivāsasi |
1,074.09 devebhyo deva dāśuṣe ||

1,075.01  juṣasva saprathastamaṃ vaco devapsarastamam |
1,075.01 havyā juhvāna āsani ||
1,075.02  athā te aṅgirastamāgne vedhastama priyam |
1,075.02 vocema brahma sānasi ||
1,075.03  kaste jāmirjanānāmagne ko dāśvadhvaraḥ |
1,075.03 ko ha kasminnasi śritaḥ ||
1,075.04  tvaṃ jāmirjanānāmagne mitro asi priyaḥ |
1,075.04 sakhā sakhibhya īḍyaḥ ||
1,075.05  yajā no mitrāvaruṇā yajā devāṃ ṛtaṃ bṛhat |
1,075.05 agne yakṣi svaṃ damam ||

1,076.01  kā ta upetirmanaso varāya bhuvadagne śantamā kā manīṣā |
1,076.01 ko vā yajñaiḥ pari dakṣaṃ ta āpa kena vā te manasā dāśema ||
1,076.02  ehyagna iha hotā ni ṣīdādabdhaḥ su puraetā bhavā naḥ |
1,076.02 avatāṃ tvā rodasī viśvaminve yajā mahe saumanasāya devān ||
1,076.03  pra su viśvānrakṣaso dhakṣyagne bhavā yajñānāmabhiśastipāvā |
1,076.03 athā vaha somapatiṃ haribhyāmātithyamasmai cakṛmā sudāvne ||
1,076.04  prajāvatā vacasā vahnirāsā ca huve ni ca satsīha devaiḥ |
1,076.04 veṣi hotramuta potraṃ yajatra bodhi prayantarjanitarvasūnām ||
1,076.05  yathā viprasya manuṣo havirbhirdevāṃ ayajaḥ kavibhiḥ kaviḥ san |
1,076.05 evā hotaḥ satyatara tvamadyāgne mandrayā juhvā yajasva ||

1,077.01  kathā dāśemāgnaye kāsmai devajuṣṭocyate bhāmine gīḥ |
1,077.01 yo martyeṣvamṛta ṛtāvā hotā yajiṣṭha itkṛṇoti devān ||
1,077.02  yo adhvareṣu śantama ṛtāvā hotā tamū namobhirā kṛṇudhvam |
1,077.02 agniryadvermartāya devānsa cā bodhāti manasā yajāti ||
1,077.03  sa hi kratuḥ sa maryaḥ sa sādhurmitro na bhūdadbhutasya rathīḥ |
1,077.03 taṃ medheṣu prathamaṃ devayantīrviśa upa bruvate dasmamārīḥ ||
1,077.04  sa no nṛṇāṃ nṛtamo riśādā agnirgiro'vasā vetu dhītim |
1,077.04 tanā ca ye maghavānaḥ śaviṣṭhā vājaprasūtā iṣayanta manma ||
1,077.05  evāgnirgotamebhirṛtāvā viprebhirastoṣṭa jātavedāḥ |
1,077.05 sa eṣu dyumnaṃ pīpayatsa vājaṃ sa puṣṭiṃ yāti joṣamā cikitvān ||

1,078.01  abhi tvā gotamā girā jātavedo vicarṣaṇe |
1,078.01 dyumnairabhi pra ṇonumaḥ ||
1,078.02  tamu tvā gotamo girā rāyaskāmo duvasyati |
1,078.02 dyumnairabhi pra ṇonumaḥ ||
1,078.03  tamu tvā vājasātamamaṅgirasvaddhavāmahe |
1,078.03 dyumnairabhi pra ṇonumaḥ ||
1,078.04  tamu tvā vṛtrahantamaṃ yo dasyūṃravadhūnuṣe |
1,078.04 dyumnairabhi pra ṇonumaḥ ||
1,078.05  avocāma rahūgaṇā agnaye madhumadvacaḥ |
1,078.05 dyumnairabhi pra ṇonumaḥ ||

1,079.01  hiraṇyakeśo rajaso visāre'hirdhunirvāta iva dhrajīmān |
1,079.01 śucibhrājā uṣaso navedā yaśasvatīrapasyuvo na satyāḥ ||
1,079.02  ā te suparṇā aminantaṃ evaiḥ kṛṣṇo nonāva vṛṣabho yadīdam |
1,079.02 śivābhirna smayamānābhirāgātpatanti miha stanayantyabhrā ||
1,079.03  yadīmṛtasya payasā piyāno nayannṛtasya pathibhī rajiṣṭhaiḥ |
1,079.03 aryamā mitro varuṇaḥ parijmā tvacaṃ pṛñcantyuparasya yonau ||
1,079.04  agne vājasya gomata īśānaḥ sahaso yaho |
1,079.04 asme dhehi jātavedo mahi śravaḥ ||
1,079.05  sa idhāno vasuṣkaviragnirīḻenyo girā |
1,079.05 revadasmabhyaṃ purvaṇīka dīdihi ||
1,079.06  kṣapo rājannuta tmanāgne vastorutoṣasaḥ |
1,079.06 sa tigmajambha rakṣaso daha prati ||
1,079.07  avā no agna ūtibhirgāyatrasya prabharmaṇi |
1,079.07 viśvāsu dhīṣu vandya ||
1,079.08  ā no agne rayiṃ bhara satrāsāhaṃ vareṇyam |
1,079.08 viśvāsu pṛtsu duṣṭaram ||
1,079.09  ā no agne sucetunā rayiṃ viśvāyupoṣasam |
1,079.09 mārḍīkaṃ dhehi jīvase ||
1,079.10  pra pūtāstigmaśociṣe vāco gotamāgnaye |
1,079.10 bharasva sumnayurgiraḥ ||
1,079.11  yo no agne'bhidāsatyanti dūre padīṣṭa saḥ |
1,079.11 asmākamidvṛdhe bhava ||
1,079.12  sahasrākṣo vicarṣaṇiragnī rakṣāṃsi sedhati |
1,079.12 hotā gṛṇīta ukthyaḥ ||

1,080.01  itthā hi soma inmade brahmā cakāra vardhanam |
1,080.01 śaviṣṭha vajrinnojasā pṛthivyā niḥ śaśā ahimarcannanu svarājyam ||
1,080.02  sa tvāmadadvṛṣā madaḥ somaḥ śyenābhṛtaḥ sutaḥ |
1,080.02 yenā vṛtraṃ niradbhyo jaghantha vajrinnojasārcannanu svarājyam ||
1,080.03  prehyabhīhi dhṛṣṇuhi na te vajro ni yaṃsate |
1,080.03 indra nṛmṇaṃ hi te śavo hano vṛtraṃ jayā apo'rcannanu svarājyam ||
1,080.04  nirindra bhūmyā adhi vṛtraṃ jaghantha nirdivaḥ |
1,080.04 sṛjā marutvatīrava jīvadhanyā imā apo'rcannanu svarājyam ||
1,080.05  indro vṛtrasya dodhataḥ sānuṃ vajreṇa hīḻitaḥ |
1,080.05 abhikramyāva jighnate'paḥ sarmāya codayannarcannanu svarājyam ||
1,080.06  adhi sānau ni jighnate vajreṇa śataparvaṇā |
1,080.06 mandāna indro andhasaḥ sakhibhyo gātumicchatyarcannanu svarājyam ||
1,080.07  indra tubhyamidadrivo'nuttaṃ vajrinvīryam |
1,080.07 yaddha tyaṃ māyinaṃ mṛgaṃ tamu tvaṃ māyayāvadhīrarcannanu svarājyam ||
1,080.08  vi te vajrāso asthirannavatiṃ nāvyā anu |
1,080.08 mahatta indra vīryaṃ bāhvoste balaṃ hitamarcannanu svarājyam ||
1,080.09  sahasraṃ sākamarcata pari ṣṭobhata viṃśatiḥ |
1,080.09 śatainamanvanonavurindrāya brahmodyatamarcannanu svarājyam ||
1,080.10  indro vṛtrasya taviṣīṃ nirahansahasā sahaḥ |
1,080.10 mahattadasya pauṃsyaṃ vṛtraṃ jaghanvāṃ asṛjadarcannanu svarājyam ||
1,080.11  ime cittava manyave vepete bhiyasā mahī |
1,080.11 yadindra vajrinnojasā vṛtraṃ marutvāṃ avadhīrarcannanu svarājyam ||
1,080.12  na vepasā na tanyatendraṃ vṛtro vi bībhayat |
1,080.12 abhyenaṃ vajra āyasaḥ sahasrabhṛṣṭirāyatārcannanu svarājyam ||
1,080.13  yadvṛtraṃ tava cāśaniṃ vajreṇa samayodhayaḥ |
1,080.13 ahimindra jighāṃsato divi te badbadhe śavo'rcannanu svarājyam ||
1,080.14  abhiṣṭane te adrivo yatsthā jagacca rejate |
1,080.14 tvaṣṭā cittava manyava indra vevijyate bhiyārcannanu svarājyam ||
1,080.15  nahi nu yādadhīmasīndraṃ ko vīryā paraḥ |
1,080.15 tasminnṛmṇamuta kratuṃ devā ojāṃsi saṃ dadhurarcannanu svarājyam ||
1,080.16  yāmatharvā manuṣpitā dadhyaṅdhiyamatnata |
1,080.16 tasminbrahmāṇi pūrvathendra ukthā samagmatārcannanu svarājyam ||

1,081.01  indro madāya vāvṛdhe śavase vṛtrahā nṛbhiḥ |
1,081.01 taminmahatsvājiṣūtemarbhe havāmahe sa vājeṣu pra no'viṣat ||
1,081.02  asi hi vīra senyo'si bhūri parādadiḥ |
1,081.02 asi dabhrasya cidvṛdho yajamānāya śikṣasi sunvate bhūri te vasu ||
1,081.03  yadudīrata ājayo dhṛṣṇave dhīyate dhanā |
1,081.03 yukṣvā madacyutā harī kaṃ hanaḥ kaṃ vasau dadho'smāṃ indra vasau dadhaḥ ||
1,081.04  kratvā mahāṃ anuṣvadhaṃ bhīma ā vāvṛdhe śavaḥ |
1,081.04 śriya ṛṣva upākayorni śiprī harivāndadhe hastayorvajramāyasam ||
1,081.05  ā paprau pārthivaṃ rajo badbadhe rocanā divi |
1,081.05 na tvāvāṃ indra kaścana na jāto na janiṣyate'ti viśvaṃ vavakṣitha ||
1,081.06  yo aryo martabhojanaṃ parādadāti dāśuṣe |
1,081.06 indro asmabhyaṃ śikṣatu vi bhajā bhūri te vasu bhakṣīya tava rādhasaḥ ||
1,081.07  mademade hi no dadiryūthā gavāmṛjukratuḥ |
1,081.07 saṃ gṛbhāya purū śatobhayāhastyā vasu śiśīhi rāya ā bhara ||
1,081.08  mādayasva sute sacā śavase śūra rādhase |
1,081.08 vidmā hi tvā purūvasumupa kāmānsasṛjmahe'thā no'vitā bhava ||
1,081.09  ete ta indra jantavo viśvaṃ puṣyanti vāryam |
1,081.09 antarhi khyo janānāmaryo vedo adāśuṣāṃ teṣāṃ no veda ā bhara ||

1,082.01  upo ṣu śṛṇuhī giro maghavanmātathā iva |
1,082.01 yadā naḥ sūnṛtāvataḥ kara ādarthayāsa idyojā nvindra te harī ||
1,082.02  akṣannamīmadanta hyava priyā adhūṣata |
1,082.02 astoṣata svabhānavo viprā naviṣṭhayā matī yojā nvindra te harī ||
1,082.03  susaṃdṛśaṃ tvā vayaṃ maghavanvandiṣīmahi |
1,082.03 pra nūnaṃ pūrṇavandhura stuto yāhi vaśāṃ anu yojā nvindra te harī ||
1,082.04  sa ghā taṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ rathamadhi tiṣṭhāti govidam |
1,082.04 yaḥ pātraṃ hāriyojanaṃ pūrṇamindra ciketati yojā nvindra te harī ||
1,082.05  yuktaste astu dakṣiṇa uta savyaḥ śatakrato |
1,082.05 tena jāyāmupa priyāṃ mandāno yāhyandhaso yojā nvindra te harī ||
1,082.06  yunajmi te brahmaṇā keśinā harī upa pra yāhi dadhiṣe gabhastyoḥ |
1,082.06 uttvā sutāso rabhasā amandiṣuḥ pūṣaṇvānvajrinsamu patnyāmadaḥ ||

1,083.01  aśvāvati prathamo goṣu gacchati suprāvīrindra martyastavotibhiḥ |
1,083.01 tamitpṛṇakṣi vasunā bhavīyasā sindhumāpo yathābhito vicetasaḥ ||
1,083.02  āpo na devīrupa yanti hotriyamavaḥ paśyanti vitataṃ yathā rajaḥ |
1,083.02 prācairdevāsaḥ pra ṇayanti devayuṃ brahmapriyaṃ joṣayante varā iva ||
1,083.03  adhi dvayoradadhā ukthyaṃ vaco yatasrucā mithunā yā saparyataḥ |
1,083.03 asaṃyatto vrate te kṣeti puṣyati bhadrā śaktiryajamānāya sunvate ||
1,083.04  ādaṅgirāḥ prathamaṃ dadhire vaya iddhāgnayaḥ śamyā ye sukṛtyayā |
1,083.04 sarvaṃ paṇeḥ samavindanta bhojanamaśvāvantaṃ gomantamā paśuṃ naraḥ ||
1,083.05  yajñairatharvā prathamaḥ pathastate tataḥ sūryo vratapā vena ājani |
1,083.05 ā gā ājaduśanā kāvyaḥ sacā yamasya jātamamṛtaṃ yajāmahe ||
1,083.06  barhirvā yatsvapatyāya vṛjyate'rko vā ślokamāghoṣate divi |
1,083.06 grāvā yatra vadati kārurukthyastasyedindro abhipitveṣu raṇyati ||

1,084.01  asāvi soma indra te śaviṣṭha dhṛṣṇavā gahi |
1,084.01 ā tvā pṛṇaktvindriyaṃ rajaḥ sūryo na raśmibhiḥ ||
1,084.02  indramiddharī vahato'pratidhṛṣṭaśavasam |
1,084.02 ṛṣīṇāṃ ca stutīrupa yajñaṃ ca mānuṣāṇām ||
1,084.03  ā tiṣṭha vṛtrahanrathaṃ yuktā te brahmaṇā harī |
1,084.03 arvācīnaṃ su te mano grāvā kṛṇotu vagnunā ||
1,084.04  imamindra sutaṃ piba jyeṣṭhamamartyaṃ madam |
1,084.04 śukrasya tvābhyakṣarandhārā ṛtasya sādane ||
1,084.05  indrāya nūnamarcatokthāni ca bravītana |
1,084.05 sutā amatsurindavo jyeṣṭhaṃ namasyatā sahaḥ ||
1,084.06  nakiṣṭvadrathītaro harī yadindra yacchase |
1,084.06 nakiṣṭvānu majmanā nakiḥ svaśva ānaśe ||
1,084.07  ya eka idvidayate vasu martāya dāśuṣe |
1,084.07 īśāno apratiṣkuta indro aṅga ||
1,084.08  kadā martamarādhasaṃ padā kṣumpamiva sphurat |
1,084.08 kadā naḥ śuśravadgira indro aṅga ||
1,084.09  yaściddhi tvā bahubhya ā sutāvāṃ āvivāsati |
1,084.09 ugraṃ tatpatyate śava indro aṅga ||
1,084.10  svādoritthā viṣūvato madhvaḥ pibanti gauryaḥ |
1,084.10 yā indreṇa sayāvarīrvṛṣṇā madanti śobhase vasvīranu svarājyam ||
1,084.11  tā asya pṛśanāyuvaḥ somaṃ śrīṇanti pṛśnayaḥ |
1,084.11 priyā indrasya dhenavo vajraṃ hinvanti sāyakaṃ vasvīranu svarājyam ||
1,084.12  tā asya namasā sahaḥ saparyanti pracetasaḥ |
1,084.12 vratānyasya saścire purūṇi pūrvacittaye vasvīranu svarājyam ||
1,084.13  indro dadhīco asthabhirvṛtrāṇyapratiṣkutaḥ |
1,084.13 jaghāna navatīrnava ||
1,084.14  icchannaśvasya yacchiraḥ parvateṣvapaśritam |
1,084.14 tadvidaccharyaṇāvati ||
1,084.15  atrāha goramanvata nāma tvaṣṭurapīcyam |
1,084.15 itthā candramaso gṛhe ||
1,084.16  ko adya yuṅkte dhuri gā ṛtasya śimīvato bhāmino durhṛṇāyūn |
1,084.16 āsanniṣūnhṛtsvaso mayobhūnya eṣāṃ bhṛtyāmṛṇadhatsa jīvāt ||
1,084.17  ka īṣate tujyate ko bibhāya ko maṃsate santamindraṃ ko anti |
1,084.17 kastokāya ka ibhāyota rāye'dhi bravattanve ko janāya ||
1,084.18  ko agnimīṭṭe haviṣā ghṛtena srucā yajātā ṛtubhirdhruvebhiḥ |
1,084.18 kasmai devā ā vahānāśu homa ko maṃsate vītihotraḥ sudevaḥ ||
1,084.19  tvamaṅga pra śaṃsiṣo devaḥ śaviṣṭha martyam |
1,084.19 na tvadanyo maghavannasti marḍitendra bravīmi te vacaḥ ||
1,084.20  mā te rādhāṃsi mā ta ūtayo vaso'smānkadā canā dabhan |
1,084.20 viśvā ca na upamimīhi mānuṣa vasūni carṣaṇibhya ā ||

1,085.01  pra ye śumbhante janayo na saptayo yāmanrudrasya sūnavaḥ sudaṃsasaḥ |
1,085.01 rodasī hi marutaścakrire vṛdhe madanti vīrā vidatheṣu ghṛṣvayaḥ ||
1,085.02  ta ukṣitāso mahimānamāśata divi rudrāso adhi cakrire sadaḥ |
1,085.02 arcanto arkaṃ janayanta indriyamadhi śriyo dadhire pṛśnimātaraḥ ||
1,085.03  gomātaro yacchubhayante añjibhistanūṣu śubhrā dadhire virukmataḥ |
1,085.03 bādhante viśvamabhimātinamapa vartmānyeṣāmanu rīyate ghṛtam ||
1,085.04  vi ye bhrājante sumakhāsa ṛṣṭibhiḥ pracyāvayanto acyutā cidojasā |
1,085.04 manojuvo yanmaruto ratheṣvā vṛṣavrātāsaḥ pṛṣatīrayugdhvam ||
1,085.05  pra yadratheṣu pṛṣatīrayugdhvaṃ vāje adriṃ maruto raṃhayantaḥ |
1,085.05 utāruṣasya vi ṣyanti dhārāścarmevodabhirvyundanti bhūma ||
1,085.06  ā vo vahantu saptayo raghuṣyado raghupatvānaḥ pra jigāta bāhubhiḥ |
1,085.06 sīdatā barhiruru vaḥ sadaskṛtaṃ mādayadhvaṃ maruto madhvo andhasaḥ ||
1,085.07  te'vardhanta svatavaso mahitvanā nākaṃ tasthururu cakrire sadaḥ |
1,085.07 viṣṇuryaddhāvadvṛṣaṇaṃ madacyutaṃ vayo na sīdannadhi barhiṣi priye ||
1,085.08  śūrā ivedyuyudhayo na jagmayaḥ śravasyavo na pṛtanāsu yetire |
1,085.08 bhayante viśvā bhuvanā marudbhyo rājāna iva tveṣasaṃdṛśo naraḥ ||
1,085.09  tvaṣṭā yadvajraṃ sukṛtaṃ hiraṇyayaṃ sahasrabhṛṣṭiṃ svapā avartayat |
1,085.09 dhatta indro naryapāṃsi kartave'hanvṛtraṃ nirapāmaubjadarṇavam ||
1,085.10  ūrdhvaṃ nunudre'vataṃ ta ojasā dādṛhāṇaṃ cidbibhidurvi parvatam |
1,085.10 dhamanto vāṇaṃ marutaḥ sudānavo made somasya raṇyāni cakrire ||
1,085.11  jihmaṃ nunudre'vataṃ tayā diśāsiñcannutsaṃ gotamāya tṛṣṇaje |
1,085.11 ā gacchantīmavasā citrabhānavaḥ kāmaṃ viprasya tarpayanta dhāmabhiḥ ||
1,085.12  yā vaḥ śarma śaśamānāya santi tridhātūni dāśuṣe yacchatādhi |
1,085.12 asmabhyaṃ tāni maruto vi yanta rayiṃ no dhatta vṛṣaṇaḥ suvīram ||

1,086.01  maruto yasya hi kṣaye pāthā divo vimahasaḥ |
1,086.01 sa sugopātamo janaḥ ||
1,086.02  yajñairvā yajñavāhaso viprasya vā matīnām |
1,086.02 marutaḥ śṛṇutā havam ||
1,086.03  uta vā yasya vājino'nu vipramatakṣata |
1,086.03 sa gantā gomati vraje ||
1,086.04  asya vīrasya barhiṣi sutaḥ somo diviṣṭiṣu |
1,086.04 ukthaṃ madaśca śasyate ||
1,086.05  asya śroṣantvā bhuvo viśvā yaścarṣaṇīrabhi |
1,086.05 sūraṃ citsasruṣīriṣaḥ ||
1,086.06  pūrvībhirhi dadāśima śaradbhirmaruto vayam |
1,086.06 avobhiścarṣaṇīnām ||
1,086.07  subhagaḥ sa prayajyavo maruto astu martyaḥ |
1,086.07 yasya prayāṃsi parṣatha ||
1,086.08  śaśamānasya vā naraḥ svedasya satyaśavasaḥ |
1,086.08 vidā kāmasya venataḥ ||
1,086.09  yūyaṃ tatsatyaśavasa āviṣkarta mahitvanā |
1,086.09 vidhyatā vidyutā rakṣaḥ ||
1,086.10  gūhatā guhyaṃ tamo vi yāta viśvamatriṇam |
1,086.10 jyotiṣkartā yaduśmasi ||

1,087.01  pratvakṣasaḥ pratavaso virapśino'nānatā avithurā ṛjīṣiṇaḥ |
1,087.01 juṣṭatamāso nṛtamāso añjibhirvyānajre ke cidusrā iva stṛbhiḥ ||
1,087.02  upahvareṣu yadacidhvaṃ yayiṃ vaya iva marutaḥ kena citpathā |
1,087.02 ścotanti kośā upa vo ratheṣvā ghṛtamukṣatā madhuvarṇamarcate ||
1,087.03  praiṣāmajmeṣu vithureva rejate bhūmiryāmeṣu yaddha yuñjate śubhe |
1,087.03 te krīḻayo dhunayo bhrājadṛṣṭayaḥ svayaṃ mahitvaṃ panayanta dhūtayaḥ ||
1,087.04  sa hi svasṛtpṛṣadaśvo yuvā gaṇo'yā īśānastaviṣībhirāvṛtaḥ |
1,087.04 asi satya ṛṇayāvānedyo'syā dhiyaḥ prāvitāthā vṛṣā gaṇaḥ ||
1,087.05  pituḥ pratnasya janmanā vadāmasi somasya jihvā pra jigāti cakṣasā |
1,087.05 yadīmindraṃ śamyṛkvāṇa āśatādinnāmāni yajñiyāni dadhire ||
1,087.06  śriyase kaṃ bhānubhiḥ saṃ mimikṣire te raśmibhista ṛkvabhiḥ sukhādayaḥ |
1,087.06 te vāśīmanta iṣmiṇo abhīravo vidre priyasya mārutasya dhāmnaḥ ||

1,088.01  ā vidyunmadbhirmarutaḥ svarkai rathebhiryāta ṛṣṭimadbhiraśvaparṇaiḥ |
1,088.01 ā varṣiṣṭhayā na iṣā vayo na paptatā sumāyāḥ ||
1,088.02  te'ruṇebhirvaramā piśaṅgaiḥ śubhe kaṃ yānti rathatūrbhiraśvaiḥ |
1,088.02 rukmo na citraḥ svadhitīvānpavyā rathasya jaṅghananta bhūma ||
1,088.03  śriye kaṃ vo adhi tanūṣu vāśīrmedhā vanā na kṛṇavanta ūrdhvā |
1,088.03 yuṣmabhyaṃ kaṃ marutaḥ sujātāstuvidyumnāso dhanayante adrim ||
1,088.04  ahāni gṛdhrāḥ paryā va āgurimāṃ dhiyaṃ vārkāryāṃ ca devīm |
1,088.04 brahma kṛṇvanto gotamāso arkairūrdhvaṃ nunudra utsadhiṃ pibadhyai ||
1,088.05  etattyanna yojanamaceti sasvarha yanmaruto gotamo vaḥ |
1,088.05 paśyanhiraṇyacakrānayodaṃṣṭrānvidhāvato varāhūn ||
1,088.06  eṣā syā vo maruto'nubhartrī prati ṣṭobhati vāghato na vāṇī |
1,088.06 astobhayadvṛthāsāmanu svadhāṃ gabhastyoḥ ||

1,089.01  ā no bhadrāḥ kratavo yantu viśvato'dabdhāso aparītāsa udbhidaḥ |
1,089.01 devā no yathā sadamidvṛdhe asannaprāyuvo rakṣitāro divedive ||
1,089.02  devānāṃ bhadrā sumatirṛjūyatāṃ devānāṃ rātirabhi no ni vartatām |
1,089.02 devānāṃ sakhyamupa sedimā vayaṃ devā na āyuḥ pra tirantu jīvase ||
1,089.03  tānpūrvayā nividā hūmahe vayaṃ bhagaṃ mitramaditiṃ dakṣamasridham |
1,089.03 aryamaṇaṃ varuṇaṃ somamaśvinā sarasvatī naḥ subhagā mayaskarat ||
1,089.04  tanno vāto mayobhu vātu bheṣajaṃ tanmātā pṛthivī tatpitā dyauḥ |
1,089.04 tadgrāvāṇaḥ somasuto mayobhuvastadaśvinā śṛṇutaṃ dhiṣṇyā yuvam ||
1,089.05  tamīśānaṃ jagatastasthuṣaspatiṃ dhiyañjinvamavase hūmahe vayam |
1,089.05 pūṣā no yathā vedasāmasadvṛdhe rakṣitā pāyuradabdhaḥ svastaye ||
1,089.06  svasti na indro vṛddhaśravāḥ svasti naḥ pūṣā viśvavedāḥ |
1,089.06 svasti nastārkṣyo ariṣṭanemiḥ svasti no bṛhaspatirdadhātu ||
1,089.07  pṛṣadaśvā marutaḥ pṛśnimātaraḥ śubhaṃyāvāno vidatheṣu jagmayaḥ |
1,089.07 agnijihvā manavaḥ sūracakṣaso viśve no devā avasā gamanniha ||
1,089.08  bhadraṃ karṇebhiḥ śṛṇuyāma devā bhadraṃ paśyemākṣabhiryajatrāḥ |
1,089.08 sthirairaṅgaistuṣṭuvāṃsastanūbhirvyaśema devahitaṃ yadāyuḥ ||
1,089.09  śataminnu śarado anti devā yatrā naścakrā jarasaṃ tanūnām |
1,089.09 putrāso yatra pitaro bhavanti mā no madhyā rīriṣatāyurgantoḥ ||
1,089.10  aditirdyauraditirantarikṣamaditirmātā sa pitā sa putraḥ |
1,089.10 viśve devā aditiḥ pañca janā aditirjātamaditirjanitvam ||

1,090.01  ṛjunītī no varuṇo mitro nayatu vidvān |
1,090.01 aryamā devaiḥ sajoṣāḥ ||
1,090.02  te hi vasvo vasavānāste apramūrā mahobhiḥ |
1,090.02 vratā rakṣante viśvāhā ||
1,090.03  te asmabhyaṃ śarma yaṃsannamṛtā martyebhyaḥ |
1,090.03 bādhamānā apa dviṣaḥ ||
1,090.04  vi naḥ pathaḥ suvitāya ciyantvindro marutaḥ |
1,090.04 pūṣā bhago vandyāsaḥ ||
1,090.05  uta no dhiyo goagrāḥ pūṣanviṣṇavevayāvaḥ |
1,090.05 kartā naḥ svastimataḥ ||
1,090.06  madhu vātā ṛtāyate madhu kṣaranti sindhavaḥ |
1,090.06 mādhvīrnaḥ santvoṣadhīḥ ||
1,090.07  madhu naktamutoṣaso madhumatpārthivaṃ rajaḥ |
1,090.07 madhu dyaurastu naḥ pitā ||
1,090.08  madhumānno vanaspatirmadhumāṃ astu sūryaḥ |
1,090.08 mādhvīrgāvo bhavantu naḥ ||
1,090.09  śaṃ no mitraḥ śaṃ varuṇaḥ śaṃ no bhavatvaryamā |
1,090.09 śaṃ na indro bṛhaspatiḥ śaṃ no viṣṇururukramaḥ ||

1,091.01  tvaṃ soma pra cikito manīṣā tvaṃ rajiṣṭhamanu neṣi panthām |
1,091.01 tava praṇītī pitaro na indo deveṣu ratnamabhajanta dhīrāḥ ||
1,091.02  tvaṃ soma kratubhiḥ sukraturbhūstvaṃ dakṣaiḥ sudakṣo viśvavedāḥ |
1,091.02 tvaṃ vṛṣā vṛṣatvebhirmahitvā dyumnebhirdyumnyabhavo nṛcakṣāḥ ||
1,091.03  rājño nu te varuṇasya vratāni bṛhadgabhīraṃ tava soma dhāma |
1,091.03 śuciṣṭvamasi priyo na mitro dakṣāyyo aryamevāsi soma ||
1,091.04  yā te dhāmāni divi yā pṛthivyāṃ yā parvateṣvoṣadhīṣvapsu |
1,091.04 tebhirno viśvaiḥ sumanā aheḻanrājansoma prati havyā gṛbhāya ||
1,091.05  tvaṃ somāsi satpatistvaṃ rājota vṛtrahā |
1,091.05 tvaṃ bhadro asi kratuḥ ||
1,091.06  tvaṃ ca soma no vaśo jīvātuṃ na marāmahe |
1,091.06 priyastotro vanaspatiḥ ||
1,091.07  tvaṃ soma mahe bhagaṃ tvaṃ yūna ṛtāyate |
1,091.07 dakṣaṃ dadhāsi jīvase ||
1,091.08  tvaṃ naḥ soma viśvato rakṣā rājannaghāyataḥ |
1,091.08 na riṣyettvāvataḥ sakhā ||
1,091.09  soma yāste mayobhuva ūtayaḥ santi dāśuṣe |
1,091.09 tābhirno'vitā bhava ||
1,091.10  imaṃ yajñamidaṃ vaco jujuṣāṇa upāgahi |
1,091.10 soma tvaṃ no vṛdhe bhava ||
1,091.11  soma gīrbhiṣṭvā vayaṃ vardhayāmo vacovidaḥ |
1,091.11 sumṛḻīko na ā viśa ||
1,091.12  gayasphāno amīvahā vasuvitpuṣṭivardhanaḥ |
1,091.12 sumitraḥ soma no bhava ||
1,091.13  soma rārandhi no hṛdi gāvo na yavaseṣvā |
1,091.13 marya iva sva okye ||
1,091.14  yaḥ soma sakhye tava rāraṇaddeva martyaḥ |
1,091.14 taṃ dakṣaḥ sacate kaviḥ ||
1,091.15  uruṣyā ṇo abhiśasteḥ soma ni pāhyaṃhasaḥ |
1,091.15 sakhā suśeva edhi naḥ ||
1,091.16  ā pyāyasva sametu te viśvataḥ soma vṛṣṇyam |
1,091.16 bhavā vājasya saṃgathe ||
1,091.17  ā pyāyasva madintama soma viśvebhiraṃśubhiḥ |
1,091.17 bhavā naḥ suśravastamaḥ sakhā vṛdhe ||
1,091.18  saṃ te payāṃsi samu yantu vājāḥ saṃ vṛṣṇyānyabhimātiṣāhaḥ |
1,091.18 āpyāyamāno amṛtāya soma divi śravāṃsyuttamāni dhiṣva ||
1,091.19  yā te dhāmāni haviṣā yajanti tā te viśvā paribhūrastu yajñam |
1,091.19 gayasphānaḥ prataraṇaḥ suvīro'vīrahā pra carā soma duryān ||
1,091.20  somo dhenuṃ somo arvantamāśuṃ somo vīraṃ karmaṇyaṃ dadāti |
1,091.20 sādanyaṃ vidathyaṃ sabheyaṃ pitṛśravaṇaṃ yo dadāśadasmai ||
1,091.21  aṣāḻhaṃ yutsu pṛtanāsu papriṃ svarṣāmapsāṃ vṛjanasya gopām |
1,091.21 bhareṣujāṃ sukṣitiṃ suśravasaṃ jayantaṃ tvāmanu madema soma ||
1,091.22  tvamimā oṣadhīḥ soma viśvāstvamapo ajanayastvaṃ gāḥ |
1,091.22 tvamā tatanthorvantarikṣaṃ tvaṃ jyotiṣā vi tamo vavartha ||
1,091.23  devena no manasā deva soma rāyo bhāgaṃ sahasāvannabhi yudhya |
1,091.23 mā tvā tanadīśiṣe vīryasyobhayebhyaḥ pra cikitsā gaviṣṭau ||

1,092.01  etā u tyā uṣasaḥ ketumakrata pūrve ardhe rajaso bhānumañjate |
1,092.01 niṣkṛṇvānā āyudhānīva dhṛṣṇavaḥ prati gāvo'ruṣīryanti mātaraḥ ||
1,092.02  udapaptannaruṇā bhānavo vṛthā svāyujo aruṣīrgā ayukṣata |
1,092.02 akrannuṣāso vayunāni pūrvathā ruśantaṃ bhānumaruṣīraśiśrayuḥ ||
1,092.03  arcanti nārīrapaso na viṣṭibhiḥ samānena yojanenā parāvataḥ |
1,092.03 iṣaṃ vahantīḥ sukṛte sudānave viśvedaha yajamānāya sunvate ||
1,092.04  adhi peśāṃsi vapate nṛtūrivāporṇute vakṣa usreva barjaham |
1,092.04 jyotirviśvasmai bhuvanāya kṛṇvatī gāvo na vrajaṃ vyuṣā āvartamaḥ ||
1,092.05  pratyarcī ruśadasyā adarśi vi tiṣṭhate bādhate kṛṣṇamabhvam |
1,092.05 svaruṃ na peśo vidatheṣvañjañcitraṃ divo duhitā bhānumaśret ||
1,092.06  atāriṣma tamasaspāramasyoṣā ucchantī vayunā kṛṇoti |
1,092.06 śriye chando na smayate vibhātī supratīkā saumanasāyājīgaḥ ||
1,092.07  bhāsvatī netrī sūnṛtānāṃ diva stave duhitā gotamebhiḥ |
1,092.07 prajāvato nṛvato aśvabudhyānuṣo goagrāṃ upa māsi vājān ||
1,092.08  uṣastamaśyāṃ yaśasaṃ suvīraṃ dāsapravargaṃ rayimaśvabudhyam |
1,092.08 sudaṃsasā śravasā yā vibhāsi vājaprasūtā subhage bṛhantam ||
1,092.09  viśvāni devī bhuvanābhicakṣyā pratīcī cakṣururviyā vi bhāti |
1,092.09 viśvaṃ jīvaṃ carase bodhayantī viśvasya vācamavidanmanāyoḥ ||
1,092.10  punaḥpunarjāyamānā purāṇī samānaṃ varṇamabhi śumbhamānā |
1,092.10 śvaghnīva kṛtnurvija āminānā martasya devī jarayantyāyuḥ ||
1,092.11  vyūrṇvatī divo antāṃ abodhyapa svasāraṃ sanutaryuyoti |
1,092.11 praminatī manuṣyā yugāni yoṣā jārasya cakṣasā vi bhāti ||
1,092.12  paśūnna citrā subhagā prathānā sindhurna kṣoda urviyā vyaśvait |
1,092.12 aminatī daivyāni vratāni sūryasya ceti raśmibhirdṛśānā ||
1,092.13  uṣastaccitramā bharāsmabhyaṃ vājinīvati |
1,092.13 yena tokaṃ ca tanayaṃ ca dhāmahe ||
1,092.14  uṣo adyeha gomatyaśvāvati vibhāvari |
1,092.14 revadasme vyuccha sūnṛtāvati ||
1,092.15  yukṣvā hi vājinīvatyaśvāṃ adyāruṇāṃ uṣaḥ |
1,092.15 athā no viśvā saubhagānyā vaha ||
1,092.16  aśvinā vartirasmadā gomaddasrā hiraṇyavat |
1,092.16 arvāgrathaṃ samanasā ni yacchatam ||
1,092.17  yāvitthā ślokamā divo jyotirjanāya cakrathuḥ |
1,092.17 ā na ūrjaṃ vahatamaśvinā yuvam ||
1,092.18  eha devā mayobhuvā dasrā hiraṇyavartanī |
1,092.18 uṣarbudho vahantu somapītaye ||

1,093.01  agnīṣomāvimaṃ su me śṛṇutaṃ vṛṣaṇā havam |
1,093.01 prati sūktāni haryataṃ bhavataṃ dāśuṣe mayaḥ ||
1,093.02  agnīṣomā yo adya vāmidaṃ vacaḥ saparyati |
1,093.02 tasmai dhattaṃ suvīryaṃ gavāṃ poṣaṃ svaśvyam ||
1,093.03  agnīṣomā ya āhutiṃ yo vāṃ dāśāddhaviṣkṛtim |
1,093.03 sa prajayā suvīryaṃ viśvamāyurvyaśnavat ||
1,093.04  agnīṣomā ceti tadvīryaṃ vāṃ yadamuṣṇītamavasaṃ paṇiṃ gāḥ |
1,093.04 avātirataṃ bṛsayasya śeṣo'vindataṃ jyotirekaṃ bahubhyaḥ ||
1,093.05  yuvametāni divi rocanānyagniśca soma sakratū adhattam |
1,093.05 yuvaṃ sindhūṃrabhiśasteravadyādagnīṣomāvamuñcataṃ gṛbhītān ||
1,093.06  ānyaṃ divo mātariśvā jabhārāmathnādanyaṃ pari śyeno adreḥ |
1,093.06 agnīṣomā brahmaṇā vāvṛdhānoruṃ yajñāya cakrathuru lokam ||
1,093.07  agnīṣomā haviṣaḥ prasthitasya vītaṃ haryataṃ vṛṣaṇā juṣethām |
1,093.07 suśarmāṇā svavasā hi bhūtamathā dhattaṃ yajamānāya śaṃ yoḥ ||
1,093.08  yo agnīṣomā haviṣā saparyāddevadrīcā manasā yo ghṛtena |
1,093.08 tasya vrataṃ rakṣataṃ pātamaṃhaso viśe janāya mahi śarma yacchatam ||
1,093.09  agnīṣomā savedasā sahūtī vanataṃ giraḥ |
1,093.09 saṃ devatrā babhūvathuḥ ||
1,093.10  agnīṣomāvanena vāṃ yo vāṃ ghṛtena dāśati |
1,093.10 tasmai dīdayataṃ bṛhat ||
1,093.11  agnīṣomāvimāni no yuvaṃ havyā jujoṣatam |
1,093.11 ā yātamupa naḥ sacā ||
1,093.12  agnīṣomā pipṛtamarvato na ā pyāyantāmusriyā havyasūdaḥ |
1,093.12 asme balāni maghavatsu dhattaṃ kṛṇutaṃ no adhvaraṃ śruṣṭimantam ||

1,094.01  imaṃ stomamarhate jātavedase rathamiva saṃ mahemā manīṣayā |
1,094.01 bhadrā hi naḥ pramatirasya saṃsadyagne sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava ||
1,094.02  yasmai tvamāyajase sa sādhatyanarvā kṣeti dadhate suvīryam |
1,094.02 sa tūtāva nainamaśnotyaṃhatiragne sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava ||
1,094.03  śakema tvā samidhaṃ sādhayā dhiyastve devā haviradantyāhutam |
1,094.03 tvamādityāṃ ā vaha tānhyuśmasyagne sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava ||
1,094.04  bharāmedhmaṃ kṛṇavāmā havīṃṣi te citayantaḥ parvaṇāparvaṇā vayam |
1,094.04 jīvātave prataraṃ sādhayā dhiyo'gne sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava ||
1,094.05  viśāṃ gopā asya caranti jantavo dvipacca yaduta catuṣpadaktubhiḥ |
1,094.05 citraḥ praketa uṣaso mahāṃ asyagne sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava ||
1,094.06  tvamadhvaryuruta hotāsi pūrvyaḥ praśāstā potā januṣā purohitaḥ |
1,094.06 viśvā vidvāṃ ārtvijyā dhīra puṣyasyagne sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava ||
1,094.07  yo viśvataḥ supratīkaḥ sadṛṅṅasi dūre citsantaḻidivāti rocase |
1,094.07 rātryāścidandho ati deva paśyasyagne sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava ||
1,094.08  pūrvo devā bhavatu sunvato ratho'smākaṃ śaṃso abhyastu dūḍhyaḥ |
1,094.08 tadā jānītota puṣyatā vaco'gne sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava ||
1,094.09  vadhairduḥśaṃsāṃ apa dūḍhyo jahi dūre vā ye anti vā ke cidatriṇaḥ |
1,094.09 athā yajñāya gṛṇate sugaṃ kṛdhyagne sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava ||
1,094.10  yadayukthā aruṣā rohitā rathe vātajūtā vṛṣabhasyeva te ravaḥ |
1,094.10 ādinvasi vanino dhūmaketunāgne sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava ||
1,094.11  adha svanāduta bibhyuḥ patatriṇo drapsā yatte yavasādo vyasthiran |
1,094.11 sugaṃ tatte tāvakebhyo rathebhyo'gne sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava ||
1,094.12  ayaṃ mitrasya varuṇasya dhāyase'vayātāṃ marutāṃ heḻo adbhutaḥ |
1,094.12 mṛḻā su no bhūtveṣāṃ manaḥ punaragne sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava ||
1,094.13  devo devānāmasi mitro adbhuto vasurvasūnāmasi cāruradhvare |
1,094.13 śarmansyāma tava saprathastame'gne sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava ||
1,094.14  tatte bhadraṃ yatsamiddhaḥ sve dame somāhuto jarase mṛḻayattamaḥ |
1,094.14 dadhāsi ratnaṃ draviṇaṃ ca dāśuṣe'gne sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava ||
1,094.15  yasmai tvaṃ sudraviṇo dadāśo'nāgāstvamadite sarvatātā |
1,094.15 yaṃ bhadreṇa śavasā codayāsi prajāvatā rādhasā te syāma ||
1,094.16  sa tvamagne saubhagatvasya vidvānasmākamāyuḥ pra tireha deva |
1,094.16 tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||

1,095.01  dve virūpe carataḥ svarthe anyānyā vatsamupa dhāpayete |
1,095.01 hariranyasyāṃ bhavati svadhāvāñchukro anyasyāṃ dadṛśe suvarcāḥ ||
1,095.02  daśemaṃ tvaṣṭurjanayanta garbhamatandrāso yuvatayo vibhṛtram |
1,095.02 tigmānīkaṃ svayaśasaṃ janeṣu virocamānaṃ pari ṣīṃ nayanti ||
1,095.03  trīṇi jānā pari bhūṣantyasya samudra ekaṃ divyekamapsu |
1,095.03 pūrvāmanu pra diśaṃ pārthivānāmṛtūnpraśāsadvi dadhāvanuṣṭhu ||
1,095.04  ka imaṃ vo niṇyamā ciketa vatso mātṝrjanayata svadhābhiḥ |
1,095.04 bahvīnāṃ garbho apasāmupasthānmahānkavirniścarati svadhāvān ||
1,095.05  āviṣṭyo vardhate cārurāsu jihmānāmūrdhvaḥ svayaśā upasthe |
1,095.05 ubhe tvaṣṭurbibhyaturjāyamānātpratīcī siṃhaṃ prati joṣayete ||
1,095.06  ubhe bhadre joṣayete na mene gāvo na vāśrā upa tasthurevaiḥ |
1,095.06 sa dakṣāṇāṃ dakṣapatirbabhūvāñjanti yaṃ dakṣiṇato havirbhiḥ ||
1,095.07  udyaṃyamīti saviteva bāhū ubhe sicau yatate bhīma ṛñjan |
1,095.07 ucchukramatkamajate simasmānnavā mātṛbhyo vasanā jahāti ||
1,095.08  tveṣaṃ rūpaṃ kṛṇuta uttaraṃ yatsampṛñcānaḥ sadane gobhiradbhiḥ |
1,095.08 kavirbudhnaṃ pari marmṛjyate dhīḥ sā devatātā samitirbabhūva ||
1,095.09  uru te jrayaḥ paryeti budhnaṃ virocamānaṃ mahiṣasya dhāma |
1,095.09 viśvebhiragne svayaśobhiriddho'dabdhebhiḥ pāyubhiḥ pāhyasmān ||
1,095.10  dhanvansrotaḥ kṛṇute gātumūrmiṃ śukrairūrmibhirabhi nakṣati kṣām |
1,095.10 viśvā sanāni jaṭhareṣu dhatte'ntarnavāsu carati prasūṣu ||
1,095.11  evā no agne samidhā vṛdhāno revatpāvaka śravase vi bhāhi |
1,095.11 tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||

1,096.01  sa pratnathā sahasā jāyamānaḥ sadyaḥ kāvyāni baḻ adhatta viśvā |
1,096.01 āpaśca mitraṃ dhiṣaṇā ca sādhandevā agniṃ dhārayandraviṇodām ||
1,096.02  sa pūrvayā nividā kavyatāyorimāḥ prajā ajanayanmanūnām |
1,096.02 vivasvatā cakṣasā dyāmapaśca devā agniṃ dhārayandraviṇodām ||
1,096.03  tamīḻata prathamaṃ yajñasādhaṃ viśa ārīrāhutamṛñjasānam |
1,096.03 ūrjaḥ putraṃ bharataṃ sṛpradānuṃ devā agniṃ dhārayandraviṇodām ||
1,096.04  sa mātariśvā puruvārapuṣṭirvidadgātuṃ tanayāya svarvit |
1,096.04 viśāṃ gopā janitā rodasyordevā agniṃ dhārayandraviṇodām ||
1,096.05  naktoṣāsā varṇamāmemyāne dhāpayete śiśumekaṃ samīcī |
1,096.05 dyāvākṣāmā rukmo antarvi bhāti devā agniṃ dhārayandraviṇodām ||
1,096.06  rāyo budhnaḥ saṃgamano vasūnāṃ yajñasya keturmanmasādhano veḥ |
1,096.06 amṛtatvaṃ rakṣamāṇāsa enaṃ devā agniṃ dhārayandraviṇodām ||
1,096.07  nū ca purā ca sadanaṃ rayīṇāṃ jātasya ca jāyamānasya ca kṣām |
1,096.07 sataśca gopāṃ bhavataśca bhūrerdevā agniṃ dhārayandraviṇodām ||
1,096.08  draviṇodā draviṇasasturasya draviṇodāḥ sanarasya pra yaṃsat |
1,096.08 draviṇodā vīravatīmiṣaṃ no draviṇodā rāsate dīrghamāyuḥ ||
1,096.09  evā no agne samidhā vṛdhāno revatpāvaka śravase vi bhāhi |
1,096.09 tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||

1,097.01  apa naḥ śośucadaghamagne śuśugdhyā rayim |
1,097.01 apa naḥ śośucadagham ||
1,097.02  sukṣetriyā sugātuyā vasūyā ca yajāmahe |
1,097.02 apa naḥ śośucadagham ||
1,097.03  pra yadbhandiṣṭha eṣāṃ prāsmākāsaśca sūrayaḥ |
1,097.03 apa naḥ śośucadagham ||
1,097.04  pra yatte agne sūrayo jāyemahi pra te vayam |
1,097.04 apa naḥ śośucadagham ||
1,097.05  pra yadagneḥ sahasvato viśvato yanti bhānavaḥ |
1,097.05 apa naḥ śośucadagham ||
1,097.06  tvaṃ hi viśvatomukha viśvataḥ paribhūrasi |
1,097.06 apa naḥ śośucadagham ||
1,097.07  dviṣo no viśvatomukhāti nāveva pāraya |
1,097.07 apa naḥ śośucadagham ||
1,097.08  sa naḥ sindhumiva nāvayāti parṣā svastaye |
1,097.08 apa naḥ śośucadagham ||

1,098.01  vaiśvānarasya sumatau syāma rājā hi kaṃ bhuvanānāmabhiśrīḥ |
1,098.01 ito jāto viśvamidaṃ vi caṣṭe vaiśvānaro yatate sūryeṇa ||
1,098.02  pṛṣṭo divi pṛṣṭo agniḥ pṛthivyāṃ pṛṣṭo viśvā oṣadhīrā viveśa |
1,098.02 vaiśvānaraḥ sahasā pṛṣṭo agniḥ sa no divā sa riṣaḥ pātu naktam ||
1,098.03  vaiśvānara tava tatsatyamastvasmānrāyo maghavānaḥ sacantām |
1,098.03 tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||

1,099.01  jātavedase sunavāma somamarātīyato ni dahāti vedaḥ |
1,099.01 sa naḥ parṣadati durgāṇi viśvā nāveva sindhuṃ duritātyagniḥ ||

1,100.01  sa yo vṛṣā vṛṣṇyebhiḥ samokā maho divaḥ pṛthivyāśca samrāṭ |
1,100.01 satīnasatvā havyo bhareṣu marutvānno bhavatvindra ūtī ||
1,100.02  yasyānāptaḥ sūryasyeva yāmo bharebhare vṛtrahā śuṣmo asti |
1,100.02 vṛṣantamaḥ sakhibhiḥ svebhirevairmarutvānno bhavatvindra ūtī ||
1,100.03  divo na yasya retaso dughānāḥ panthāso yanti śavasāparītāḥ |
1,100.03 taraddveṣāḥ sāsahiḥ pauṃsyebhirmarutvānno bhavatvindra ūtī ||
1,100.04  so aṅgirobhiraṅgirastamo bhūdvṛṣā vṛṣabhiḥ sakhibhiḥ sakhā san |
1,100.04 ṛgmibhirṛgmī gātubhirjyeṣṭho marutvānno bhavatvindra ūtī ||
1,100.05  sa sūnubhirna rudrebhirṛbhvā nṛṣāhye sāsahvāṃ amitrān |
1,100.05 sanīḻebhiḥ śravasyāni tūrvanmarutvānno bhavatvindra ūtī ||
1,100.06  sa manyumīḥ samadanasya kartāsmākebhirnṛbhiḥ sūryaṃ sanat |
1,100.06 asminnahansatpatiḥ puruhūto marutvānno bhavatvindra ūtī ||
1,100.07  tamūtayo raṇayañchūrasātau taṃ kṣemasya kṣitayaḥ kṛṇvata trām |
1,100.07 sa viśvasya karuṇasyeśa eko marutvānno bhavatvindra ūtī ||
1,100.08  tamapsanta śavasa utsaveṣu naro naramavase taṃ dhanāya |
1,100.08 so andhe cittamasi jyotirvidanmarutvānno bhavatvindra ūtī ||
1,100.09  sa savyena yamati vrādhataścitsa dakṣiṇe saṃgṛbhītā kṛtāni |
1,100.09 sa kīriṇā citsanitā dhanāni marutvānno bhavatvindra ūtī ||
1,100.10  sa grāmebhiḥ sanitā sa rathebhirvide viśvābhiḥ kṛṣṭibhirnvadya |
1,100.10 sa pauṃsyebhirabhibhūraśastīrmarutvānno bhavatvindra ūtī ||
1,100.11  sa jāmibhiryatsamajāti mīḻhe'jāmibhirvā puruhūta evaiḥ |
1,100.11 apāṃ tokasya tanayasya jeṣe marutvānno bhavatvindra ūtī ||
1,100.12  sa vajrabhṛddasyuhā bhīma ugraḥ sahasracetāḥ śatanītha ṛbhvā |
1,100.12 camrīṣo na śavasā pāñcajanyo marutvānno bhavatvindra ūtī ||
1,100.13  tasya vajraḥ krandati smatsvarṣā divo na tveṣo ravathaḥ śimīvān |
1,100.13 taṃ sacante sanayastaṃ dhanāni marutvānno bhavatvindra ūtī ||
1,100.14  yasyājasraṃ śavasā mānamukthaṃ paribhujadrodasī viśvataḥ sīm |
1,100.14 sa pāriṣatkratubhirmandasāno marutvānno bhavatvindra ūtī ||
1,100.15  na yasya devā devatā na martā āpaścana śavaso antamāpuḥ |
1,100.15 sa prarikvā tvakṣasā kṣmo divaśca marutvānno bhavatvindra ūtī ||
1,100.16  rohicchyāvā sumadaṃśurlalāmīrdyukṣā rāya ṛjrāśvasya |
1,100.16 vṛṣaṇvantaṃ bibhratī dhūrṣu rathaṃ mandrā ciketa nāhuṣīṣu vikṣu ||
1,100.17  etattyatta indra vṛṣṇa ukthaṃ vārṣāgirā abhi gṛṇanti rādhaḥ |
1,100.17 ṛjrāśvaḥ praṣṭibhirambarīṣaḥ sahadevo bhayamānaḥ surādhāḥ ||
1,100.18  dasyūñchimyūṃśca puruhūta evairhatvā pṛthivyāṃ śarvā ni barhīt |
1,100.18 sanatkṣetraṃ sakhibhiḥ śvitnyebhiḥ sanatsūryaṃ sanadapaḥ suvajraḥ ||
1,100.19  viśvāhendro adhivaktā no astvaparihvṛtāḥ sanuyāma vājam |
1,100.19 tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||

1,101.01  pra mandine pitumadarcatā vaco yaḥ kṛṣṇagarbhā nirahannṛjiśvanā |
1,101.01 avasyavo vṛṣaṇaṃ vajradakṣiṇaṃ marutvantaṃ sakhyāya havāmahe ||
1,101.02  yo vyaṃsaṃ jāhṛṣāṇena manyunā yaḥ śambaraṃ yo ahanpiprumavratam |
1,101.02 indro yaḥ śuṣṇamaśuṣaṃ nyāvṛṇaṅmarutvantaṃ sakhyāya havāmahe ||
1,101.03  yasya dyāvāpṛthivī pauṃsyaṃ mahadyasya vrate varuṇo yasya sūryaḥ |
1,101.03 yasyendrasya sindhavaḥ saścati vrataṃ marutvantaṃ sakhyāya havāmahe ||
1,101.04  yo aśvānāṃ yo gavāṃ gopatirvaśī ya āritaḥ karmaṇikarmaṇi sthiraḥ |
1,101.04 vīḻościdindro yo asunvato vadho marutvantaṃ sakhyāya havāmahe ||
1,101.05  yo viśvasya jagataḥ prāṇataspatiryo brahmaṇe prathamo gā avindat |
1,101.05 indro yo dasyūṃradharāṃ avātiranmarutvantaṃ sakhyāya havāmahe ||
1,101.06  yaḥ śūrebhirhavyo yaśca bhīrubhiryo dhāvadbhirhūyate yaśca jigyubhiḥ |
1,101.06 indraṃ yaṃ viśvā bhuvanābhi saṃdadhurmarutvantaṃ sakhyāya havāmahe ||
1,101.07  rudrāṇāmeti pradiśā vicakṣaṇo rudrebhiryoṣā tanute pṛthu jrayaḥ |
1,101.07 indraṃ manīṣā abhyarcati śrutaṃ marutvantaṃ sakhyāya havāmahe ||
1,101.08  yadvā marutvaḥ parame sadhasthe yadvāvame vṛjane mādayāse |
1,101.08 ata ā yāhyadhvaraṃ no acchā tvāyā haviścakṛmā satyarādhaḥ ||
1,101.09  tvāyendra somaṃ suṣumā sudakṣa tvāyā haviścakṛmā brahmavāhaḥ |
1,101.09 adhā niyutvaḥ sagaṇo marudbhirasminyajñe barhiṣi mādayasva ||
1,101.10  mādayasva haribhirye ta indra vi ṣyasva śipre vi sṛjasva dhene |
1,101.10 ā tvā suśipra harayo vahantūśanhavyāni prati no juṣasva ||
1,101.11  marutstotrasya vṛjanasya gopā vayamindreṇa sanuyāma vājam |
1,101.11 tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||

1,102.01  imāṃ te dhiyaṃ pra bhare maho mahīmasya stotre dhiṣaṇā yatta ānaje |
1,102.01 tamutsave ca prasave ca sāsahimindraṃ devāsaḥ śavasāmadannanu ||
1,102.02  asya śravo nadyaḥ sapta bibhrati dyāvākṣāmā pṛthivī darśataṃ vapuḥ |
1,102.02 asme sūryācandramasābhicakṣe śraddhe kamindra carato vitarturam ||
1,102.03  taṃ smā rathaṃ maghavanprāva sātaye jaitraṃ yaṃ te anumadāma saṃgame |
1,102.03 ājā na indra manasā puruṣṭuta tvāyadbhyo maghavañcharma yaccha naḥ ||
1,102.04  vayaṃ jayema tvayā yujā vṛtamasmākamaṃśamudavā bharebhare |
1,102.04 asmabhyamindra varivaḥ sugaṃ kṛdhi pra śatrūṇāṃ maghavanvṛṣṇyā ruja ||
1,102.05  nānā hi tvā havamānā janā ime dhanānāṃ dhartaravasā vipanyavaḥ |
1,102.05 asmākaṃ smā rathamā tiṣṭha sātaye jaitraṃ hīndra nibhṛtaṃ manastava ||
1,102.06  gojitā bāhū amitakratuḥ simaḥ karmankarmañchatamūtiḥ khajaṅkaraḥ |
1,102.06 akalpa indraḥ pratimānamojasāthā janā vi hvayante siṣāsavaḥ ||
1,102.07  utte śatānmaghavannucca bhūyasa utsahasrādririce kṛṣṭiṣu śravaḥ |
1,102.07 amātraṃ tvā dhiṣaṇā titviṣe mahyadhā vṛtrāṇi jighnase purandara ||
1,102.08  triviṣṭidhātu pratimānamojasastisro bhūmīrnṛpate trīṇi rocanā |
1,102.08 atīdaṃ viśvaṃ bhuvanaṃ vavakṣithāśatrurindra januṣā sanādasi ||
1,102.09  tvāṃ deveṣu prathamaṃ havāmahe tvaṃ babhūtha pṛtanāsu sāsahiḥ |
1,102.09 semaṃ naḥ kārumupamanyumudbhidamindraḥ kṛṇotu prasave rathaṃ puraḥ ||
1,102.10  tvaṃ jigetha na dhanā rurodhithārbheṣvājā maghavanmahatsu ca |
1,102.10 tvāmugramavase saṃ śiśīmasyathā na indra havaneṣu codaya ||
1,102.11  viśvāhendro adhivaktā no astvaparihvṛtāḥ sanuyāma vājam |
1,102.11 tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||

1,103.01  tatta indriyaṃ paramaṃ parācairadhārayanta kavayaḥ puredam |
1,103.01 kṣamedamanyaddivyanyadasya samī pṛcyate samaneva ketuḥ ||
1,103.02  sa dhārayatpṛthivīṃ paprathacca vajreṇa hatvā nirapaḥ sasarja |
1,103.02 ahannahimabhinadrauhiṇaṃ vyahanvyaṃsaṃ maghavā śacībhiḥ ||
1,103.03  sa jātūbharmā śraddadhāna ojaḥ puro vibhindannacaradvi dāsīḥ |
1,103.03 vidvānvajrindasyave hetimasyāryaṃ saho vardhayā dyumnamindra ||
1,103.04  tadūcuṣe mānuṣemā yugāni kīrtenyaṃ maghavā nāma bibhrat |
1,103.04 upaprayandasyuhatyāya vajrī yaddha sūnuḥ śravase nāma dadhe ||
1,103.05  tadasyedaṃ paśyatā bhūri puṣṭaṃ śradindrasya dhattana vīryāya |
1,103.05 sa gā avindatso avindadaśvānsa oṣadhīḥ so apaḥ sa vanāni ||
1,103.06  bhūrikarmaṇe vṛṣabhāya vṛṣṇe satyaśuṣmāya sunavāma somam |
1,103.06 ya ādṛtyā paripanthīva śūro'yajvano vibhajanneti vedaḥ ||
1,103.07  tadindra preva vīryaṃ cakartha yatsasantaṃ vajreṇābodhayo'him |
1,103.07 anu tvā patnīrhṛṣitaṃ vayaśca viśve devāso amadannanu tvā ||
1,103.08  śuṣṇaṃ pipruṃ kuyavaṃ vṛtramindra yadāvadhīrvi puraḥ śambarasya |
1,103.08 tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||

1,104.01  yoniṣṭa indra niṣade akāri tamā ni ṣīda svāno nārvā |
1,104.01 vimucyā vayo'vasāyāśvāndoṣā vastorvahīyasaḥ prapitve ||
1,104.02  o tye nara indramūtaye gurnū cittānsadyo adhvano jagamyāt |
1,104.02 devāso manyuṃ dāsasya ścamnante na ā vakṣansuvitāya varṇam ||
1,104.03  ava tmanā bharate ketavedā ava tmanā bharate phenamudan |
1,104.03 kṣīreṇa snātaḥ kuyavasya yoṣe hate te syātāṃ pravaṇe śiphāyāḥ ||
1,104.04  yuyopa nābhiruparasyāyoḥ pra pūrvābhistirate rāṣṭi śūraḥ |
1,104.04 añjasī kuliśī vīrapatnī payo hinvānā udabhirbharante ||
1,104.05  prati yatsyā nīthādarśi dasyoroko nācchā sadanaṃ jānatī gāt |
1,104.05 adha smā no maghavañcarkṛtādinmā no magheva niṣṣapī parā dāḥ ||
1,104.06  sa tvaṃ na indra sūrye so apsvanāgāstva ā bhaja jīvaśaṃse |
1,104.06 māntarāṃ bhujamā rīriṣo naḥ śraddhitaṃ te mahata indriyāya ||
1,104.07  adhā manye śratte asmā adhāyi vṛṣā codasva mahate dhanāya |
1,104.07 mā no akṛte puruhūta yonāvindra kṣudhyadbhyo vaya āsutiṃ dāḥ ||
1,104.08  mā no vadhīrindra mā parā dā mā naḥ priyā bhojanāni pra moṣīḥ |
1,104.08 āṇḍā mā no maghavañchakra nirbhenmā naḥ pātrā bhetsahajānuṣāṇi ||
1,104.09  arvāṅehi somakāmaṃ tvāhurayaṃ sutastasya pibā madāya |
1,104.09 uruvyacā jaṭhara ā vṛṣasva piteva naḥ śṛṇuhi hūyamānaḥ ||

1,105.01  candramā apsvantarā suparṇo dhāvate divi |
1,105.01 na vo hiraṇyanemayaḥ padaṃ vindanti vidyuto vittaṃ me asya rodasī ||
1,105.02  arthamidvā u arthina ā jāyā yuvate patim |
1,105.02 tuñjāte vṛṣṇyaṃ payaḥ paridāya rasaṃ duhe vittaṃ me asya rodasī ||
1,105.03  mo ṣu devā adaḥ svarava pādi divaspari |
1,105.03 mā somyasya śambhuvaḥ śūne bhūma kadā cana vittaṃ me asya rodasī ||
1,105.04  yajñaṃ pṛcchāmyavamaṃ sa taddūto vi vocati |
1,105.04 kva ṛtaṃ pūrvyaṃ gataṃ kastadbibharti nūtano vittaṃ me asya rodasī ||
1,105.05  amī ye devā sthana triṣvā rocane divaḥ |
1,105.05 kadva ṛtaṃ kadanṛtaṃ kva pratnā va āhutirvittaṃ me asya rodasī ||
1,105.06  kadva ṛtasya dharṇasi kadvaruṇasya cakṣaṇam |
1,105.06 kadaryamṇo mahaspathāti krāmema dūḍhyo vittaṃ me asya rodasī ||
1,105.07  ahaṃ so asmi yaḥ purā sute vadāmi kāni cit |
1,105.07 taṃ mā vyantyādhyo vṛko na tṛṣṇajaṃ mṛgaṃ vittaṃ me asya rodasī ||
1,105.08  saṃ mā tapantyabhitaḥ sapatnīriva parśavaḥ |
1,105.08 mūṣo na śiśnā vyadanti mādhya stotāraṃ te śatakrato vittaṃ me asya rodasī ||
1,105.09  amī ye sapta raśmayastatrā me nābhirātatā |
1,105.09 tritastadvedāptyaḥ sa jāmitvāya rebhati vittaṃ me asya rodasī ||
1,105.10  amī ye pañcokṣaṇo madhye tasthurmaho divaḥ |
1,105.10 devatrā nu pravācyaṃ sadhrīcīnā ni vāvṛturvittaṃ me asya rodasī ||
1,105.11  suparṇā eta āsate madhya ārodhane divaḥ |
1,105.11 te sedhanti patho vṛkaṃ tarantaṃ yahvatīrapo vittaṃ me asya rodasī ||
1,105.12  navyaṃ tadukthyaṃ hitaṃ devāsaḥ supravācanam |
1,105.12 ṛtamarṣanti sindhavaḥ satyaṃ tātāna sūryo vittaṃ me asya rodasī ||
1,105.13  agne tava tyadukthyaṃ deveṣvastyāpyam |
1,105.13 sa naḥ satto manuṣvadā devānyakṣi viduṣṭaro vittaṃ me asya rodasī ||
1,105.14  satto hotā manuṣvadā devāṃ acchā viduṣṭaraḥ |
1,105.14 agnirhavyā suṣūdati devo deveṣu medhiro vittaṃ me asya rodasī ||
1,105.15  brahmā kṛṇoti varuṇo gātuvidaṃ tamīmahe |
1,105.15 vyūrṇoti hṛdā matiṃ navyo jāyatāmṛtaṃ vittaṃ me asya rodasī ||
1,105.16  asau yaḥ panthā ādityo divi pravācyaṃ kṛtaḥ |
1,105.16 na sa devā atikrame taṃ martāso na paśyatha vittaṃ me asya rodasī ||
1,105.17  tritaḥ kūpe'vahito devānhavata ūtaye |
1,105.17 tacchuśrāva bṛhaspatiḥ kṛṇvannaṃhūraṇāduru vittaṃ me asya rodasī ||
1,105.18  aruṇo mā sakṛdvṛkaḥ pathā yantaṃ dadarśa hi |
1,105.18 ujjihīte nicāyyā taṣṭeva pṛṣṭyāmayī vittaṃ me asya rodasī ||
1,105.19  enāṅgūṣeṇa vayamindravanto'bhi ṣyāma vṛjane sarvavīrāḥ |
1,105.19 tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||

1,106.01  indraṃ mitraṃ varuṇamagnimūtaye mārutaṃ śardho aditiṃ havāmahe |
1,106.01 rathaṃ na durgādvasavaḥ sudānavo viśvasmānno aṃhaso niṣpipartana ||
1,106.02  ta ādityā ā gatā sarvatātaye bhūta devā vṛtratūryeṣu śambhuvaḥ |
1,106.02 rathaṃ na durgādvasavaḥ sudānavo viśvasmānno aṃhaso niṣpipartana ||
1,106.03  avantu naḥ pitaraḥ supravācanā uta devī devaputre ṛtāvṛdhā |
1,106.03 rathaṃ na durgādvasavaḥ sudānavo viśvasmānno aṃhaso niṣpipartana ||
1,106.04  narāśaṃsaṃ vājinaṃ vājayanniha kṣayadvīraṃ pūṣaṇaṃ sumnairīmahe |
1,106.04 rathaṃ na durgādvasavaḥ sudānavo viśvasmānno aṃhaso niṣpipartana ||
1,106.05  bṛhaspate sadaminnaḥ sugaṃ kṛdhi śaṃ yoryatte manurhitaṃ tadīmahe |
1,106.05 rathaṃ na durgādvasavaḥ sudānavo viśvasmānno aṃhaso niṣpipartana ||
1,106.06  indraṃ kutso vṛtrahaṇaṃ śacīpatiṃ kāṭe nibāḻha ṛṣirahvadūtaye |
1,106.06 rathaṃ na durgādvasavaḥ sudānavo viśvasmānno aṃhaso niṣpipartana ||
1,106.07  devairno devyaditirni pātu devastrātā trāyatāmaprayucchan |
1,106.07 tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||

1,107.01  yajño devānāṃ pratyeti sumnamādityāso bhavatā mṛḻayantaḥ |
1,107.01 ā vo'rvācī sumatirvavṛtyādaṃhościdyā varivovittarāsat ||
1,107.02  upa no devā avasā gamantvaṅgirasāṃ sāmabhi stūyamānāḥ |
1,107.02 indra indriyairmaruto marudbhirādityairno aditiḥ śarma yaṃsat ||
1,107.03  tanna indrastadvaruṇastadagnistadaryamā tatsavitā cano dhāt |
1,107.03 tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||

1,108.01  ya indrāgnī citratamo ratho vāmabhi viśvāni bhuvanāni caṣṭe |
1,108.01 tenā yātaṃ sarathaṃ tasthivāṃsāthā somasya pibataṃ sutasya ||
1,108.02  yāvadidaṃ bhuvanaṃ viśvamastyuruvyacā varimatā gabhīram |
1,108.02 tāvāṃ ayaṃ pātave somo astvaramindrāgnī manase yuvabhyām ||
1,108.03  cakrāthe hi sadhryaṅnāma bhadraṃ sadhrīcīnā vṛtrahaṇā uta sthaḥ |
1,108.03 tāvindrāgnī sadhryañcā niṣadyā vṛṣṇaḥ somasya vṛṣaṇā vṛṣethām ||
1,108.04  samiddheṣvagniṣvānajānā yatasrucā barhiru tistirāṇā |
1,108.04 tīvraiḥ somaiḥ pariṣiktebhirarvāgendrāgnī saumanasāya yātam ||
1,108.05  yānīndrāgnī cakrathurvīryāṇi yāni rūpāṇyuta vṛṣṇyāni |
1,108.05 yā vāṃ pratnāni sakhyā śivāni tebhiḥ somasya pibataṃ sutasya ||
1,108.06  yadabravaṃ prathamaṃ vāṃ vṛṇāno'yaṃ somo asurairno vihavyaḥ |
1,108.06 tāṃ satyāṃ śraddhāmabhyā hi yātamathā somasya pibataṃ sutasya ||
1,108.07  yadindrāgnī madathaḥ sve duroṇe yadbrahmaṇi rājani vā yajatrā |
1,108.07 ataḥ pari vṛṣaṇāvā hi yātamathā somasya pibataṃ sutasya ||
1,108.08  yadindrāgnī yaduṣu turvaśeṣu yaddruhyuṣvanuṣu pūruṣu sthaḥ |
1,108.08 ataḥ pari vṛṣaṇāvā hi yātamathā somasya pibataṃ sutasya ||
1,108.09  yadindrāgnī avamasyāṃ pṛthivyāṃ madhyamasyāṃ paramasyāmuta sthaḥ |
1,108.09 ataḥ pari vṛṣaṇāvā hi yātamathā somasya pibataṃ sutasya ||
1,108.10  yadindrāgnī paramasyāṃ pṛthivyāṃ madhyamasyāmavamasyāmuta sthaḥ |
1,108.10 ataḥ pari vṛṣaṇāvā hi yātamathā somasya pibataṃ sutasya ||
1,108.11  yadindrāgnī divi ṣṭho yatpṛthivyāṃ yatparvateṣvoṣadhīṣvapsu |
1,108.11 ataḥ pari vṛṣaṇāvā hi yātamathā somasya pibataṃ sutasya ||
1,108.12  yadindrāgnī uditā sūryasya madhye divaḥ svadhayā mādayethe |
1,108.12 ataḥ pari vṛṣaṇāvā hi yātamathā somasya pibataṃ sutasya ||
1,108.13  evendrāgnī papivāṃsā sutasya viśvāsmabhyaṃ saṃ jayataṃ dhanāni |
1,108.13 tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||

1,109.01  vi hyakhyaṃ manasā vasya icchannindrāgnī jñāsa uta vā sajātān |
1,109.01 nānyā yuvatpramatirasti mahyaṃ sa vāṃ dhiyaṃ vājayantīmatakṣam ||
1,109.02  aśravaṃ hi bhūridāvattarā vāṃ vijāmāturuta vā ghā syālāt |
1,109.02 athā somasya prayatī yuvabhyāmindrāgnī stomaṃ janayāmi navyam ||
1,109.03  mā cchedma raśmīṃriti nādhamānāḥ pitṝṇāṃ śaktīranuyacchamānāḥ |
1,109.03 indrāgnibhyāṃ kaṃ vṛṣaṇo madanti tā hyadrī dhiṣaṇāyā upasthe ||
1,109.04  yuvābhyāṃ devī dhiṣaṇā madāyendrāgnī somamuśatī sunoti |
1,109.04 tāvaśvinā bhadrahastā supāṇī ā dhāvataṃ madhunā pṛṅktamapsu ||
1,109.05  yuvāmindrāgnī vasuno vibhāge tavastamā śuśrava vṛtrahatye |
1,109.05 tāvāsadyā barhiṣi yajñe asminpra carṣaṇī mādayethāṃ sutasya ||
1,109.06  pra carṣaṇibhyaḥ pṛtanāhaveṣu pra pṛthivyā riricāthe divaśca |
1,109.06 pra sindhubhyaḥ pra giribhyo mahitvā prendrāgnī viśvā bhuvanātyanyā ||
1,109.07  ā bharataṃ śikṣataṃ vajrabāhū asmāṃ indrāgnī avataṃ śacībhiḥ |
1,109.07 ime nu te raśmayaḥ sūryasya yebhiḥ sapitvaṃ pitaro na āsan ||
1,109.08  purandarā śikṣataṃ vajrahastāsmāṃ indrāgnī avataṃ bhareṣu |
1,109.08 tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||

1,110.01  tataṃ me apastadu tāyate punaḥ svādiṣṭhā dhītirucathāya śasyate |
1,110.01 ayaṃ samudra iha viśvadevyaḥ svāhākṛtasya samu tṛpṇuta ṛbhavaḥ ||
1,110.02  ābhogayaṃ pra yadicchanta aitanāpākāḥ prāñco mama ke cidāpayaḥ |
1,110.02 saudhanvanāsaścaritasya bhūmanāgacchata saviturdāśuṣo gṛham ||
1,110.03  tatsavitā vo'mṛtatvamāsuvadagohyaṃ yacchravayanta aitana |
1,110.03 tyaṃ ciccamasamasurasya bhakṣaṇamekaṃ santamakṛṇutā caturvayam ||
1,110.04  viṣṭvī śamī taraṇitvena vāghato martāsaḥ santo amṛtatvamānaśuḥ |
1,110.04 saudhanvanā ṛbhavaḥ sūracakṣasaḥ saṃvatsare samapṛcyanta dhītibhiḥ ||
1,110.05  kṣetramiva vi mamustejanenaṃ ekaṃ pātramṛbhavo jehamānam |
1,110.05 upastutā upamaṃ nādhamānā amartyeṣu śrava icchamānāḥ ||
1,110.06  ā manīṣāmantarikṣasya nṛbhyaḥ sruceva ghṛtaṃ juhavāma vidmanā |
1,110.06 taraṇitvā ye piturasya saścira ṛbhavo vājamaruhandivo rajaḥ ||
1,110.07  ṛbhurna indraḥ śavasā navīyānṛbhurvājebhirvasubhirvasurdadiḥ |
1,110.07 yuṣmākaṃ devā avasāhani priye'bhi tiṣṭhema pṛtsutīrasunvatām ||
1,110.08  niścarmaṇa ṛbhavo gāmapiṃśata saṃ vatsenāsṛjatā mātaraṃ punaḥ |
1,110.08 saudhanvanāsaḥ svapasyayā naro jivrī yuvānā pitarākṛṇotana ||
1,110.09  vājebhirno vājasātāvaviḍḍhyṛbhumāṃ indra citramā darṣi rādhaḥ |
1,110.09 tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||

1,111.01  takṣanrathaṃ suvṛtaṃ vidmanāpasastakṣanharī indravāhā vṛṣaṇvasū |
1,111.01 takṣanpitṛbhyāmṛbhavo yuvadvayastakṣanvatsāya mātaraṃ sacābhuvam ||
1,111.02  ā no yajñāya takṣata ṛbhumadvayaḥ kratve dakṣāya suprajāvatīmiṣam |
1,111.02 yathā kṣayāma sarvavīrayā viśā tannaḥ śardhāya dhāsathā svindriyam ||
1,111.03  ā takṣata sātimasmabhyamṛbhavaḥ sātiṃ rathāya sātimarvate naraḥ |
1,111.03 sātiṃ no jaitrīṃ saṃ maheta viśvahā jāmimajāmiṃ pṛtanāsu sakṣaṇim ||
1,111.04  ṛbhukṣaṇamindramā huva ūtaya ṛbhūnvājānmarutaḥ somapītaye |
1,111.04 ubhā mitrāvaruṇā nūnamaśvinā te no hinvantu sātaye dhiye jiṣe ||
1,111.05  ṛbhurbharāya saṃ śiśātu sātiṃ samaryajidvājo asmāṃ aviṣṭu |
1,111.05 tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||

1,112.01  īḻe dyāvāpṛthivī pūrvacittaye'gniṃ gharmaṃ surucaṃ yāmanniṣṭaye |
1,112.01 yābhirbhare kāramaṃśāya jinvathastābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam ||
1,112.02  yuvordānāya subharā asaścato rathamā tasthurvacasaṃ na mantave |
1,112.02 yābhirdhiyo'vathaḥ karmanniṣṭaye tābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam ||
1,112.03  yuvaṃ tāsāṃ divyasya praśāsane viśāṃ kṣayatho amṛtasya majmanā |
1,112.03 yābhirdhenumasvaṃ pinvatho narā tābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam ||
1,112.04  yābhiḥ parijmā tanayasya majmanā dvimātā tūrṣu taraṇirvibhūṣati |
1,112.04 yābhistrimanturabhavadvicakṣaṇastābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam ||
1,112.05  yābhī rebhaṃ nivṛtaṃ sitamadbhya udvandanamairayataṃ svardṛśe |
1,112.05 yābhiḥ kaṇvaṃ pra siṣāsantamāvataṃ tābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam ||
1,112.06  yābhirantakaṃ jasamānamāraṇe bhujyuṃ yābhiravyathibhirjijinvathuḥ |
1,112.06 yābhiḥ karkandhuṃ vayyaṃ ca jinvathastābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam ||
1,112.07  yābhiḥ śucantiṃ dhanasāṃ suṣaṃsadaṃ taptaṃ gharmamomyāvantamatraye |
1,112.07 yābhiḥ pṛśniguṃ purukutsamāvataṃ tābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam ||
1,112.08  yābhiḥ śacībhirvṛṣaṇā parāvṛjaṃ prāndhaṃ śroṇaṃ cakṣasa etave kṛthaḥ |
1,112.08 yābhirvartikāṃ grasitāmamuñcataṃ tābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam ||
1,112.09  yābhiḥ sindhuṃ madhumantamasaścataṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ yābhirajarāvajinvatam |
1,112.09 yābhiḥ kutsaṃ śrutaryaṃ naryamāvataṃ tābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam ||
1,112.10  yābhirviśpalāṃ dhanasāmatharvyaṃ sahasramīḻha ājāvajinvatam |
1,112.10 yābhirvaśamaśvyaṃ preṇimāvataṃ tābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam ||
1,112.11  yābhiḥ sudānū auśijāya vaṇije dīrghaśravase madhu kośo akṣarat |
1,112.11 kakṣīvantaṃ stotāraṃ yābhirāvataṃ tābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam ||
1,112.12  yābhī rasāṃ kṣodasodnaḥ pipinvathuranaśvaṃ yābhī rathamāvataṃ jiṣe |
1,112.12 yābhistriśoka usriyā udājata tābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam ||
1,112.13  yābhiḥ sūryaṃ pariyāthaḥ parāvati mandhātāraṃ kṣaitrapatyeṣvāvatam |
1,112.13 yābhirvipraṃ pra bharadvājamāvataṃ tābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam ||
1,112.14  yābhirmahāmatithigvaṃ kaśojuvaṃ divodāsaṃ śambarahatya āvatam |
1,112.14 yābhiḥ pūrbhidye trasadasyumāvataṃ tābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam ||
1,112.15  yābhirvamraṃ vipipānamupastutaṃ kaliṃ yābhirvittajāniṃ duvasyathaḥ |
1,112.15 yābhirvyaśvamuta pṛthimāvataṃ tābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam ||
1,112.16  yābhirnarā śayave yābhiratraye yābhiḥ purā manave gātumīṣathuḥ |
1,112.16 yābhiḥ śārīrājataṃ syūmaraśmaye tābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam ||
1,112.17  yābhiḥ paṭharvā jaṭharasya majmanāgnirnādīdeccita iddho ajmannā |
1,112.17 yābhiḥ śaryātamavatho mahādhane tābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam ||
1,112.18  yābhiraṅgiro manasā niraṇyatho'graṃ gacchatho vivare goarṇasaḥ |
1,112.18 yābhirmanuṃ śūramiṣā samāvataṃ tābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam ||
1,112.19  yābhiḥ patnīrvimadāya nyūhathurā gha vā yābhiraruṇīraśikṣatam |
1,112.19 yābhiḥ sudāsa ūhathuḥ sudevyaṃ tābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam ||
1,112.20  yābhiḥ śantātī bhavatho dadāśuṣe bhujyuṃ yābhiravatho yābhiradhrigum |
1,112.20 omyāvatīṃ subharāmṛtastubhaṃ tābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam ||
1,112.21  yābhiḥ kṛśānumasane duvasyatho jave yābhiryūno arvantamāvatam |
1,112.21 madhu priyaṃ bharatho yatsaraḍbhyastābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam ||
1,112.22  yābhirnaraṃ goṣuyudhaṃ nṛṣāhye kṣetrasya sātā tanayasya jinvathaḥ |
1,112.22 yābhī rathāṃ avatho yābhirarvatastābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam ||
1,112.23  yābhiḥ kutsamārjuneyaṃ śatakratū pra turvītiṃ pra ca dabhītimāvatam |
1,112.23 yābhirdhvasantiṃ puruṣantimāvataṃ tābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam ||
1,112.24  apnasvatīmaśvinā vācamasme kṛtaṃ no dasrā vṛṣaṇā manīṣām |
1,112.24 adyūtye'vase ni hvaye vāṃ vṛdhe ca no bhavataṃ vājasātau ||
1,112.25  dyubhiraktubhiḥ pari pātamasmānariṣṭebhiraśvinā saubhagebhiḥ |
1,112.25 tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||

1,113.01  idaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ jyotiṣāṃ jyotirāgāccitraḥ praketo ajaniṣṭa vibhvā |
1,113.01 yathā prasūtā savituḥ savāyaṃ evā rātryuṣase yonimāraik ||
1,113.02  ruśadvatsā ruśatī śvetyāgādāraigu kṛṣṇā sadanānyasyāḥ |
1,113.02 samānabandhū amṛte anūcī dyāvā varṇaṃ carata āmināne ||
1,113.03  samāno adhvā svasroranantastamanyānyā carato devaśiṣṭe |
1,113.03 na methete na tasthatuḥ sumeke naktoṣāsā samanasā virūpe ||
1,113.04  bhāsvatī netrī sūnṛtānāmaceti citrā vi duro na āvaḥ |
1,113.04 prārpyā jagadvyu no rāyo akhyaduṣā ajīgarbhuvanāni viśvā ||
1,113.05  jihmaśye caritave maghonyābhogaya iṣṭaye rāya u tvam |
1,113.05 dabhraṃ paśyadbhya urviyā vicakṣa uṣā ajīgarbhuvanāni viśvā ||
1,113.06  kṣatrāya tvaṃ śravase tvaṃ mahīyā iṣṭaye tvamarthamiva tvamityai |
1,113.06 visadṛśā jīvitābhipracakṣa uṣā ajīgarbhuvanāni viśvā ||
1,113.07  eṣā divo duhitā pratyadarśi vyucchantī yuvatiḥ śukravāsāḥ |
1,113.07 viśvasyeśānā pārthivasya vasva uṣo adyeha subhage vyuccha ||
1,113.08  parāyatīnāmanveti pātha āyatīnāṃ prathamā śaśvatīnām |
1,113.08 vyucchantī jīvamudīrayantyuṣā mṛtaṃ kaṃ cana bodhayantī ||
1,113.09  uṣo yadagniṃ samidhe cakartha vi yadāvaścakṣasā sūryasya |
1,113.09 yanmānuṣānyakṣyamāṇāṃ ajīgastaddeveṣu cakṛṣe bhadramapnaḥ ||
1,113.10  kiyātyā yatsamayā bhavāti yā vyūṣuryāśca nūnaṃ vyucchān |
1,113.10 anu pūrvāḥ kṛpate vāvaśānā pradīdhyānā joṣamanyābhireti ||
1,113.11  īyuṣṭe ye pūrvatarāmapaśyanvyucchantīmuṣasaṃ martyāsaḥ |
1,113.11 asmābhirū nu praticakṣyābhūdo te yanti ye aparīṣu paśyān ||
1,113.12  yāvayaddveṣā ṛtapā ṛtejāḥ sumnāvarī sūnṛtā īrayantī |
1,113.12 sumaṅgalīrbibhratī devavītimihādyoṣaḥ śreṣṭhatamā vyuccha ||
1,113.13  śaśvatpuroṣā vyuvāsa devyatho adyedaṃ vyāvo maghonī |
1,113.13 atho vyucchāduttarāṃ anu dyūnajarāmṛtā carati svadhābhiḥ ||
1,113.14  vyañjibhirdiva ātāsvadyaudapa kṛṣṇāṃ nirṇijaṃ devyāvaḥ |
1,113.14 prabodhayantyaruṇebhiraśvairoṣā yāti suyujā rathena ||
1,113.15  āvahantī poṣyā vāryāṇi citraṃ ketuṃ kṛṇute cekitānā |
1,113.15 īyuṣīṇāmupamā śaśvatīnāṃ vibhātīnāṃ prathamoṣā vyaśvait ||
1,113.16  udīrdhvaṃ jīvo asurna āgādapa prāgāttama ā jyotireti |
1,113.16 āraikpanthāṃ yātave sūryāyāganma yatra pratiranta āyuḥ ||
1,113.17  syūmanā vāca udiyarti vahni stavāno rebha uṣaso vibhātīḥ |
1,113.17 adyā taduccha gṛṇate maghonyasme āyurni didīhi prajāvat ||
1,113.18  yā gomatīruṣasaḥ sarvavīrā vyucchanti dāśuṣe martyāya |
1,113.18 vāyoriva sūnṛtānāmudarke tā aśvadā aśnavatsomasutvā ||
1,113.19  mātā devānāmaditeranīkaṃ yajñasya keturbṛhatī vi bhāhi |
1,113.19 praśastikṛdbrahmaṇe no vyucchā no jane janaya viśvavāre ||
1,113.20  yaccitramapna uṣaso vahantījānāya śaśamānāya bhadram |
1,113.20 tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||

1,114.01  imā rudrāya tavase kapardine kṣayadvīrāya pra bharāmahe matīḥ |
1,114.01 yathā śamasaddvipade catuṣpade viśvaṃ puṣṭaṃ grāme asminnanāturam ||
1,114.02  mṛḻā no rudrota no mayaskṛdhi kṣayadvīrāya namasā vidhema te |
1,114.02 yacchaṃ ca yośca manurāyeje pitā tadaśyāma tava rudra praṇītiṣu ||
1,114.03  aśyāma te sumatiṃ devayajyayā kṣayadvīrasya tava rudra mīḍhvaḥ |
1,114.03 sumnāyannidviśo asmākamā carāriṣṭavīrā juhavāma te haviḥ ||
1,114.04  tveṣaṃ vayaṃ rudraṃ yajñasādhaṃ vaṅkuṃ kavimavase ni hvayāmahe |
1,114.04 āre asmaddaivyaṃ heḻo asyatu sumatimidvayamasyā vṛṇīmahe ||
1,114.05  divo varāhamaruṣaṃ kapardinaṃ tveṣaṃ rūpaṃ namasā ni hvayāmahe |
1,114.05 haste bibhradbheṣajā vāryāṇi śarma varma cchardirasmabhyaṃ yaṃsat ||
1,114.06  idaṃ pitre marutāmucyate vacaḥ svādoḥ svādīyo rudrāya vardhanam |
1,114.06 rāsvā ca no amṛta martabhojanaṃ tmane tokāya tanayāya mṛḻa ||
1,114.07  mā no mahāntamuta mā no arbhakaṃ mā na ukṣantamuta mā na ukṣitam |
1,114.07 mā no vadhīḥ pitaraṃ mota mātaraṃ mā naḥ priyāstanvo rudra rīriṣaḥ ||
1,114.08  mā nastoke tanaye mā na āyau mā no goṣu mā no aśveṣu rīriṣaḥ |
1,114.08 vīrānmā no rudra bhāmito vadhīrhaviṣmantaḥ sadamittvā havāmahe ||
1,114.09  upa te stomānpaśupā ivākaraṃ rāsvā pitarmarutāṃ sumnamasme |
1,114.09 bhadrā hi te sumatirmṛḻayattamāthā vayamava itte vṛṇīmahe ||
1,114.10  āre te goghnamuta pūruṣaghnaṃ kṣayadvīra sumnamasme te astu |
1,114.10 mṛḻā ca no adhi ca brūhi devādhā ca naḥ śarma yaccha dvibarhāḥ ||
1,114.11  avocāma namo asmā avasyavaḥ śṛṇotu no havaṃ rudro marutvān |
1,114.11 tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||

1,115.01  citraṃ devānāmudagādanīkaṃ cakṣurmitrasya varuṇasyāgneḥ |
1,115.01 āprā dyāvāpṛthivī antarikṣaṃ sūrya ātmā jagatastasthuṣaśca ||
1,115.02  sūryo devīmuṣasaṃ rocamānāṃ maryo na yoṣāmabhyeti paścāt |
1,115.02 yatrā naro devayanto yugāni vitanvate prati bhadrāya bhadram ||
1,115.03  bhadrā aśvā haritaḥ sūryasya citrā etagvā anumādyāsaḥ |
1,115.03 namasyanto diva ā pṛṣṭhamasthuḥ pari dyāvāpṛthivī yanti sadyaḥ ||
1,115.04  tatsūryasya devatvaṃ tanmahitvaṃ madhyā kartorvitataṃ saṃ jabhāra |
1,115.04 yadedayukta haritaḥ sadhasthādādrātrī vāsastanute simasmai ||
1,115.05  tanmitrasya varuṇasyābhicakṣe sūryo rūpaṃ kṛṇute dyorupasthe |
1,115.05 anantamanyadruśadasya pājaḥ kṛṣṇamanyaddharitaḥ saṃ bharanti ||
1,115.06  adyā devā uditā sūryasya niraṃhasaḥ pipṛtā niravadyāt |
1,115.06 tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||

1,116.01  nāsatyābhyāṃ barhiriva pra vṛñje stomāṃ iyarmyabhriyeva vātaḥ |
1,116.01 yāvarbhagāya vimadāya jāyāṃ senājuvā nyūhatū rathena ||
1,116.02  vīḻupatmabhirāśuhemabhirvā devānāṃ vā jūtibhiḥ śāśadānā |
1,116.02 tadrāsabho nāsatyā sahasramājā yamasya pradhane jigāya ||
1,116.03  tugro ha bhujyumaśvinodameghe rayiṃ na kaścinmamṛvāṃ avāhāḥ |
1,116.03 tamūhathurnaubhirātmanvatībhirantarikṣaprudbhirapodakābhiḥ ||
1,116.04  tisraḥ kṣapastrirahātivrajadbhirnāsatyā bhujyumūhathuḥ pataṅgaiḥ |
1,116.04 samudrasya dhanvannārdrasya pāre tribhī rathaiḥ śatapadbhiḥ ṣaḻaśvaiḥ ||
1,116.05  anārambhaṇe tadavīrayethāmanāsthāne agrabhaṇe samudre |
1,116.05 yadaśvinā ūhathurbhujyumastaṃ śatāritrāṃ nāvamātasthivāṃsam ||
1,116.06  yamaśvinā dadathuḥ śvetamaśvamaghāśvāya śaśvaditsvasti |
1,116.06 tadvāṃ dātraṃ mahi kīrtenyaṃ bhūtpaidvo vājī sadamiddhavyo aryaḥ ||
1,116.07  yuvaṃ narā stuvate pajriyāya kakṣīvate aradataṃ purandhim |
1,116.07 kārotarācchaphādaśvasya vṛṣṇaḥ śataṃ kumbhāṃ asiñcataṃ surāyāḥ ||
1,116.08  himenāgniṃ ghraṃsamavārayethāṃ pitumatīmūrjamasmā adhattam |
1,116.08 ṛbīse atrimaśvināvanītamunninyathuḥ sarvagaṇaṃ svasti ||
1,116.09  parāvataṃ nāsatyānudethāmuccābudhnaṃ cakrathurjihmabāram |
1,116.09 kṣarannāpo na pāyanāya rāye sahasrāya tṛṣyate gotamasya ||
1,116.10  jujuruṣo nāsatyota vavriṃ prāmuñcataṃ drāpimiva cyavānāt |
1,116.10 prātirataṃ jahitasyāyurdasrāditpatimakṛṇutaṃ kanīnām ||
1,116.11  tadvāṃ narā śaṃsyaṃ rādhyaṃ cābhiṣṭimannāsatyā varūtham |
1,116.11 yadvidvāṃsā nidhimivāpagūḻhamuddarśatādūpathurvandanāya ||
1,116.12  tadvāṃ narā sanaye daṃsa ugramāviṣkṛṇomi tanyaturna vṛṣṭim |
1,116.12 dadhyaṅha yanmadhvātharvaṇo vāmaśvasya śīrṣṇā pra yadīmuvāca ||
1,116.13  ajohavīnnāsatyā karā vāṃ mahe yāmanpurubhujā purandhiḥ |
1,116.13 śrutaṃ tacchāsuriva vadhrimatyā hiraṇyahastamaśvināvadattam ||
1,116.14  āsno vṛkasya vartikāmabhīke yuvaṃ narā nāsatyāmumuktam |
1,116.14 uto kaviṃ purubhujā yuvaṃ ha kṛpamāṇamakṛṇutaṃ vicakṣe ||
1,116.15  caritraṃ hi verivācchedi parṇamājā khelasya paritakmyāyām |
1,116.15 sadyo jaṅghāmāyasīṃ viśpalāyai dhane hite sartave pratyadhattam ||
1,116.16  śataṃ meṣānvṛkye cakṣadānamṛjrāśvaṃ taṃ pitāndhaṃ cakāra |
1,116.16 tasmā akṣī nāsatyā vicakṣa ādhattaṃ dasrā bhiṣajāvanarvan ||
1,116.17  ā vāṃ rathaṃ duhitā sūryasya kārṣmevātiṣṭhadarvatā jayantī |
1,116.17 viśve devā anvamanyanta hṛdbhiḥ samu śriyā nāsatyā sacethe ||
1,116.18  yadayātaṃ divodāsāya vartirbharadvājāyāśvinā hayantā |
1,116.18 revaduvāha sacano ratho vāṃ vṛṣabhaśca śiṃśumāraśca yuktā ||
1,116.19  rayiṃ sukṣatraṃ svapatyamāyuḥ suvīryaṃ nāsatyā vahantā |
1,116.19 ā jahnāvīṃ samanasopa vājaistrirahno bhāgaṃ dadhatīmayātam ||
1,116.20  pariviṣṭaṃ jāhuṣaṃ viśvataḥ sīṃ sugebhirnaktamūhathū rajobhiḥ |
1,116.20 vibhindunā nāsatyā rathena vi parvatāṃ ajarayū ayātam ||
1,116.21  ekasyā vastorāvataṃ raṇāya vaśamaśvinā sanaye sahasrā |
1,116.21 nirahataṃ ducchunā indravantā pṛthuśravaso vṛṣaṇāvarātīḥ ||
1,116.22  śarasya cidārcatkasyāvatādā nīcāduccā cakrathuḥ pātave vāḥ |
1,116.22 śayave cinnāsatyā śacībhirjasuraye staryaṃ pipyathurgām ||
1,116.23  avasyate stuvate kṛṣṇiyāya ṛjūyate nāsatyā śacībhiḥ |
1,116.23 paśuṃ na naṣṭamiva darśanāya viṣṇāpvaṃ dadathurviśvakāya ||
1,116.24  daśa rātrīraśivenā nava dyūnavanaddhaṃ śnathitamapsvantaḥ |
1,116.24 viprutaṃ rebhamudani pravṛktamunninyathuḥ somamiva sruveṇa ||
1,116.25  pra vāṃ daṃsāṃsyaśvināvavocamasya patiḥ syāṃ sugavaḥ suvīraḥ |
1,116.25 uta paśyannaśnuvandīrghamāyurastamivejjarimāṇaṃ jagamyām ||

1,117.01  madhvaḥ somasyāśvinā madāya pratno hotā vivāsate vām |
1,117.01 barhiṣmatī rātirviśritā gīriṣā yātaṃ nāsatyopa vājaiḥ ||
1,117.02  yo vāmaśvinā manaso javīyānrathaḥ svaśvo viśa ājigāti |
1,117.02 yena gacchathaḥ sukṛto duroṇaṃ tena narā vartirasmabhyaṃ yātam ||
1,117.03  ṛṣiṃ narāvaṃhasaḥ pāñcajanyamṛbīsādatriṃ muñcatho gaṇena |
1,117.03 minantā dasyoraśivasya māyā anupūrvaṃ vṛṣaṇā codayantā ||
1,117.04  aśvaṃ na gūḻhamaśvinā durevairṛṣiṃ narā vṛṣaṇā rebhamapsu |
1,117.04 saṃ taṃ riṇītho viprutaṃ daṃsobhirna vāṃ jūryanti pūrvyā kṛtāni ||
1,117.05  suṣupvāṃsaṃ na nirṛterupasthe sūryaṃ na dasrā tamasi kṣiyantam |
1,117.05 śubhe rukmaṃ na darśataṃ nikhātamudūpathuraśvinā vandanāya ||
1,117.06  tadvāṃ narā śaṃsyaṃ pajriyeṇa kakṣīvatā nāsatyā parijman |
1,117.06 śaphādaśvasya vājino janāya śataṃ kumbhāṃ asiñcataṃ madhūnām ||
1,117.07  yuvaṃ narā stuvate kṛṣṇiyāya viṣṇāpvaṃ dadathurviśvakāya |
1,117.07 ghoṣāyai citpitṛṣade duroṇe patiṃ jūryantyā aśvināvadattam ||
1,117.08  yuvaṃ śyāvāya ruśatīmadattaṃ mahaḥ kṣoṇasyāśvinā kaṇvāya |
1,117.08 pravācyaṃ tadvṛṣaṇā kṛtaṃ vāṃ yannārṣadāya śravo adhyadhattam ||
1,117.09  purū varpāṃsyaśvinā dadhānā ni pedava ūhathurāśumaśvam |
1,117.09 sahasrasāṃ vājinamapratītamahihanaṃ śravasyaṃ tarutram ||
1,117.10  etāni vāṃ śravasyā sudānū brahmāṅgūṣaṃ sadanaṃ rodasyoḥ |
1,117.10 yadvāṃ pajrāso aśvinā havante yātamiṣā ca viduṣe ca vājam ||
1,117.11  sūnormānenāśvinā gṛṇānā vājaṃ viprāya bhuraṇā radantā |
1,117.11 agastye brahmaṇā vāvṛdhānā saṃ viśpalāṃ nāsatyāriṇītam ||
1,117.12  kuha yāntā suṣṭutiṃ kāvyasya divo napātā vṛṣaṇā śayutrā |
1,117.12 hiraṇyasyeva kalaśaṃ nikhātamudūpathurdaśame aśvināhan ||
1,117.13  yuvaṃ cyavānamaśvinā jarantaṃ punaryuvānaṃ cakrathuḥ śacībhiḥ |
1,117.13 yuvo rathaṃ duhitā sūryasya saha śriyā nāsatyāvṛṇīta ||
1,117.14  yuvaṃ tugrāya pūrvyebhirevaiḥ punarmanyāvabhavataṃ yuvānā |
1,117.14 yuvaṃ bhujyumarṇaso niḥ samudrādvibhirūhathurṛjrebhiraśvaiḥ ||
1,117.15  ajohavīdaśvinā taugryo vāṃ proḻhaḥ samudramavyathirjaganvān |
1,117.15 niṣṭamūhathuḥ suyujā rathena manojavasā vṛṣaṇā svasti ||
1,117.16  ajohavīdaśvinā vartikā vāmāsno yatsīmamuñcataṃ vṛkasya |
1,117.16 vi jayuṣā yayathuḥ sānvadrerjātaṃ viṣvāco ahataṃ viṣeṇa ||
1,117.17  śataṃ meṣānvṛkye māmahānaṃ tamaḥ praṇītamaśivena pitrā |
1,117.17 ākṣī ṛjrāśve aśvināvadhattaṃ jyotirandhāya cakrathurvicakṣe ||
1,117.18  śunamandhāya bharamahvayatsā vṛkīraśvinā vṛṣaṇā nareti |
1,117.18 jāraḥ kanīna iva cakṣadāna ṛjrāśvaḥ śatamekaṃ ca meṣān ||
1,117.19  mahī vāmūtiraśvinā mayobhūruta srāmaṃ dhiṣṇyā saṃ riṇīthaḥ |
1,117.19 athā yuvāmidahvayatpurandhirāgacchataṃ sīṃ vṛṣaṇāvavobhiḥ ||
1,117.20  adhenuṃ dasrā staryaṃ viṣaktāmapinvataṃ śayave aśvinā gām |
1,117.20 yuvaṃ śacībhirvimadāya jāyāṃ nyūhathuḥ purumitrasya yoṣām ||
1,117.21  yavaṃ vṛkeṇāśvinā vapanteṣaṃ duhantā manuṣāya dasrā |
1,117.21 abhi dasyuṃ bakureṇā dhamantoru jyotiścakrathurāryāya ||
1,117.22  ātharvaṇāyāśvinā dadhīce'śvyaṃ śiraḥ pratyairayatam |
1,117.22 sa vāṃ madhu pra vocadṛtāyantvāṣṭraṃ yaddasrāvapikakṣyaṃ vām ||
1,117.23  sadā kavī sumatimā cake vāṃ viśvā dhiyo aśvinā prāvataṃ me |
1,117.23 asme rayiṃ nāsatyā bṛhantamapatyasācaṃ śrutyaṃ rarāthām ||
1,117.24  hiraṇyahastamaśvinā rarāṇā putraṃ narā vadhrimatyā adattam |
1,117.24 tridhā ha śyāvamaśvinā vikastamujjīvasa airayataṃ sudānū ||
1,117.25  etāni vāmaśvinā vīryāṇi pra pūrvyāṇyāyavo'vocan |
1,117.25 brahma kṛṇvanto vṛṣaṇā yuvabhyāṃ suvīrāso vidathamā vadema ||

1,118.01  ā vāṃ ratho aśvinā śyenapatvā sumṛḻīkaḥ svavāṃ yātvarvāṅ |
1,118.01 yo martyasya manaso javīyāntrivandhuro vṛṣaṇā vātaraṃhāḥ ||
1,118.02  trivandhureṇa trivṛtā rathena tricakreṇa suvṛtā yātamarvāk |
1,118.02 pinvataṃ gā jinvatamarvato no vardhayatamaśvinā vīramasme ||
1,118.03  pravadyāmanā suvṛtā rathena dasrāvimaṃ śṛṇutaṃ ślokamadreḥ |
1,118.03 kimaṅga vāṃ pratyavartiṃ gamiṣṭhāhurviprāso aśvinā purājāḥ ||
1,118.04  ā vāṃ śyenāso aśvinā vahantu rathe yuktāsa āśavaḥ pataṅgāḥ |
1,118.04 ye apturo divyāso na gṛdhrā abhi prayo nāsatyā vahanti ||
1,118.05  ā vāṃ rathaṃ yuvatistiṣṭhadatra juṣṭvī narā duhitā sūryasya |
1,118.05 pari vāmaśvā vapuṣaḥ pataṅgā vayo vahantvaruṣā abhīke ||
1,118.06  udvandanamairataṃ daṃsanābhirudrebhaṃ dasrā vṛṣaṇā śacībhiḥ |
1,118.06 niṣṭaugryaṃ pārayathaḥ samudrātpunaścyavānaṃ cakrathuryuvānam ||
1,118.07  yuvamatraye'vanītāya taptamūrjamomānamaśvināvadhattam |
1,118.07 yuvaṃ kaṇvāyāpiriptāya cakṣuḥ pratyadhattaṃ suṣṭutiṃ jujuṣāṇā ||
1,118.08  yuvaṃ dhenuṃ śayave nādhitāyāpinvatamaśvinā pūrvyāya |
1,118.08 amuñcataṃ vartikāmaṃhaso niḥ prati jaṅghāṃ viśpalāyā adhattam ||
1,118.09  yuvaṃ śvetaṃ pedava indrajūtamahihanamaśvinādattamaśvam |
1,118.09 johūtramaryo abhibhūtimugraṃ sahasrasāṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ vīḍvaṅgam ||
1,118.10  tā vāṃ narā svavase sujātā havāmahe aśvinā nādhamānāḥ |
1,118.10 ā na upa vasumatā rathena giro juṣāṇā suvitāya yātam ||
1,118.11  ā śyenasya javasā nūtanenāsme yātaṃ nāsatyā sajoṣāḥ |
1,118.11 have hi vāmaśvinā rātahavyaḥ śaśvattamāyā uṣaso vyuṣṭau ||

1,119.01  ā vāṃ rathaṃ purumāyaṃ manojuvaṃ jīrāśvaṃ yajñiyaṃ jīvase huve |
1,119.01 sahasraketuṃ vaninaṃ śatadvasuṃ śruṣṭīvānaṃ varivodhāmabhi prayaḥ ||
1,119.02  ūrdhvā dhītiḥ pratyasya prayāmanyadhāyi śasmansamayanta ā diśaḥ |
1,119.02 svadāmi gharmaṃ prati yantyūtaya ā vāmūrjānī rathamaśvināruhat ||
1,119.03  saṃ yanmithaḥ paspṛdhānāso agmata śubhe makhā amitā jāyavo raṇe |
1,119.03 yuvoraha pravaṇe cekite ratho yadaśvinā vahathaḥ sūrimā varam ||
1,119.04  yuvaṃ bhujyuṃ bhuramāṇaṃ vibhirgataṃ svayuktibhirnivahantā pitṛbhya ā |
1,119.04 yāsiṣṭaṃ vartirvṛṣaṇā vijenyaṃ divodāsāya mahi ceti vāmavaḥ ||
1,119.05  yuvoraśvinā vapuṣe yuvāyujaṃ rathaṃ vāṇī yematurasya śardhyam |
1,119.05 ā vāṃ patitvaṃ sakhyāya jagmuṣī yoṣāvṛṇīta jenyā yuvāṃ patī ||
1,119.06  yuvaṃ rebhaṃ pariṣūteruruṣyatho himena gharmaṃ paritaptamatraye |
1,119.06 yuvaṃ śayoravasaṃ pipyathurgavi pra dīrgheṇa vandanastāryāyuṣā ||
1,119.07  yuvaṃ vandanaṃ nirṛtaṃ jaraṇyayā rathaṃ na dasrā karaṇā saminvathaḥ |
1,119.07 kṣetrādā vipraṃ janatho vipanyayā pra vāmatra vidhate daṃsanā bhuvat ||
1,119.08  agacchataṃ kṛpamāṇaṃ parāvati pituḥ svasya tyajasā nibādhitam |
1,119.08 svarvatīrita ūtīryuvoraha citrā abhīke abhavannabhiṣṭayaḥ ||
1,119.09  uta syā vāṃ madhumanmakṣikārapanmade somasyauśijo huvanyati |
1,119.09 yuvaṃ dadhīco mana ā vivāsatho'thā śiraḥ prati vāmaśvyaṃ vadat ||
1,119.10  yuvaṃ pedave puruvāramaśvinā spṛdhāṃ śvetaṃ tarutāraṃ duvasyathaḥ |
1,119.10 śaryairabhidyuṃ pṛtanāsu duṣṭaraṃ carkṛtyamindramiva carṣaṇīsaham ||

1,120.01  kā rādhaddhotrāśvinā vāṃ ko vāṃ joṣa ubhayoḥ |
1,120.01 kathā vidhātyapracetāḥ ||
1,120.02  vidvāṃsāvidduraḥ pṛcchedavidvānitthāparo acetāḥ |
1,120.02 nū cinnu marte akrau ||
1,120.03  tā vidvāṃsā havāmahe vāṃ tā no vidvāṃsā manma vocetamadya |
1,120.03 prārcaddayamāno yuvākuḥ ||
1,120.04  vi pṛcchāmi pākyā na devānvaṣaṭkṛtasyādbhutasya dasrā |
1,120.04 pātaṃ ca sahyaso yuvaṃ ca rabhyaso naḥ ||
1,120.05  pra yā ghoṣe bhṛgavāṇe na śobhe yayā vācā yajati pajriyo vām |
1,120.05 praiṣayurna vidvān ||
1,120.06  śrutaṃ gāyatraṃ takavānasyāhaṃ ciddhi rirebhāśvinā vām |
1,120.06 ākṣī śubhaspatī dan ||
1,120.07  yuvaṃ hyāstaṃ maho ranyuvaṃ vā yanniratataṃsatam |
1,120.07 tā no vasū sugopā syātaṃ pātaṃ no vṛkādaghāyoḥ ||
1,120.08  mā kasmai dhātamabhyamitriṇe no mākutrā no gṛhebhyo dhenavo guḥ |
1,120.08 stanābhujo aśiśvīḥ ||
1,120.09  duhīyanmitradhitaye yuvāku rāye ca no mimītaṃ vājavatyai |
1,120.09 iṣe ca no mimītaṃ dhenumatyai ||
1,120.10  aśvinorasanaṃ rathamanaśvaṃ vājinīvatoḥ |
1,120.10 tenāhaṃ bhūri cākana ||
1,120.11  ayaṃ samaha mā tanūhyāte janāṃ anu |
1,120.11 somapeyaṃ sukho rathaḥ ||
1,120.12  adha svapnasya nirvide'bhuñjataśca revataḥ |
1,120.12 ubhā tā basri naśyataḥ ||

1,121.01  kaditthā nṝṃḥ pātraṃ devayatāṃ śravadgiro aṅgirasāṃ turaṇyan |
1,121.01 pra yadānaḍviśa ā harmyasyoru kraṃsate adhvare yajatraḥ ||
1,121.02  stambhīddha dyāṃ sa dharuṇaṃ pruṣāyadṛbhurvājāya draviṇaṃ naro goḥ |
1,121.02 anu svajāṃ mahiṣaścakṣata vrāṃ menāmaśvasya pari mātaraṃ goḥ ||
1,121.03  nakṣaddhavamaruṇīḥ pūrvyaṃ rāṭturo viśāmaṅgirasāmanu dyūn |
1,121.03 takṣadvajraṃ niyutaṃ tastambhaddyāṃ catuṣpade naryāya dvipāde ||
1,121.04  asya made svaryaṃ dā ṛtāyāpīvṛtamusriyāṇāmanīkam |
1,121.04 yaddha prasarge trikakuṃ nivartadapa druho mānuṣasya duro vaḥ ||
1,121.05  tubhyaṃ payo yatpitarāvanītāṃ rādhaḥ suretasturaṇe bhuraṇyū |
1,121.05 śuci yatte rekṇa āyajanta sabardughāyāḥ paya usriyāyāḥ ||
