1,121.06  adha pra jajñe taraṇirmamattu pra rocyasyā uṣaso na sūraḥ |
1,121.06 induryebhirāṣṭa sveduhavyaiḥ sruveṇa siñcañjaraṇābhi dhāma ||
1,121.07  svidhmā yadvanadhitirapasyātsūro adhvare pari rodhanā goḥ |
1,121.07 yaddha prabhāsi kṛtvyāṃ anu dyūnanarviśe paśviṣe turāya ||
1,121.08  aṣṭā maho diva ādo harī iha dyumnāsāhamabhi yodhāna utsam |
1,121.08 hariṃ yatte mandinaṃ dukṣanvṛdhe gorabhasamadribhirvātāpyam ||
1,121.09  tvamāyasaṃ prati vartayo gordivo aśmānamupanītamṛbhvā |
1,121.09 kutsāya yatra puruhūta vanvañchuṣṇamanantaiḥ pariyāsi vadhaiḥ ||
1,121.10  purā yatsūrastamaso apītestamadrivaḥ phaligaṃ hetimasya |
1,121.10 śuṣṇasya citparihitaṃ yadojo divaspari sugrathitaṃ tadādaḥ ||
1,121.11  anu tvā mahī pājasī acakre dyāvākṣāmā madatāmindra karman |
1,121.11 tvaṃ vṛtramāśayānaṃ sirāsu maho vajreṇa siṣvapo varāhum ||
1,121.12  tvamindra naryo yāṃ avo nṝntiṣṭhā vātasya suyujo vahiṣṭhān |
1,121.12 yaṃ te kāvya uśanā mandinaṃ dādvṛtrahaṇaṃ pāryaṃ tatakṣa vajram ||
1,121.13  tvaṃ sūro harito rāmayo nṝnbharaccakrametaśo nāyamindra |
1,121.13 prāsya pāraṃ navatiṃ nāvyānāmapi kartamavartayo'yajyūn ||
1,121.14  tvaṃ no asyā indra durhaṇāyāḥ pāhi vajrivo duritādabhīke |
1,121.14 pra no vājānrathyo aśvabudhyāniṣe yandhi śravase sūnṛtāyai ||
1,121.15  mā sā te asmatsumatirvi dasadvājapramahaḥ samiṣo varanta |
1,121.15 ā no bhaja maghavangoṣvaryo maṃhiṣṭhāste sadhamādaḥ syāma ||

1,122.01  pra vaḥ pāntaṃ raghumanyavo'ndho yajñaṃ rudrāya mīḻhuṣe bharadhvam |
1,122.01 divo astoṣyasurasya vīrairiṣudhyeva maruto rodasyoḥ ||
1,122.02  patnīva pūrvahūtiṃ vāvṛdhadhyā uṣāsānaktā purudhā vidāne |
1,122.02 starīrnātkaṃ vyutaṃ vasānā sūryasya śriyā sudṛśī hiraṇyaiḥ ||
1,122.03  mamattu naḥ parijmā vasarhā mamattu vāto apāṃ vṛṣaṇvān |
1,122.03 śiśītamindrāparvatā yuvaṃ nastanno viśve varivasyantu devāḥ ||
1,122.04  uta tyā me yaśasā śvetanāyai vyantā pāntauśijo huvadhyai |
1,122.04 pra vo napātamapāṃ kṛṇudhvaṃ pra mātarā rāspinasyāyoḥ ||
1,122.05  ā vo ruvaṇyumauśijo huvadhyai ghoṣeva śaṃsamarjunasya naṃśe |
1,122.05 pra vaḥ pūṣṇe dāvana āṃ acchā voceya vasutātimagneḥ ||
1,122.06  śrutaṃ me mitrāvaruṇā havemota śrutaṃ sadane viśvataḥ sīm |
1,122.06 śrotu naḥ śroturātiḥ suśrotuḥ sukṣetrā sindhuradbhiḥ ||
1,122.07  stuṣe sā vāṃ varuṇa mitra rātirgavāṃ śatā pṛkṣayāmeṣu pajre |
1,122.07 śrutarathe priyarathe dadhānāḥ sadyaḥ puṣṭiṃ nirundhānāso agman ||
1,122.08  asya stuṣe mahimaghasya rādhaḥ sacā sanema nahuṣaḥ suvīrāḥ |
1,122.08 jano yaḥ pajrebhyo vājinīvānaśvāvato rathino mahyaṃ sūriḥ ||
1,122.09  jano yo mitrāvaruṇāvabhidhrugapo na vāṃ sunotyakṣṇayādhruk |
1,122.09 svayaṃ sa yakṣmaṃ hṛdaye ni dhatta āpa yadīṃ hotrābhirṛtāvā ||
1,122.10  sa vrādhato nahuṣo daṃsujūtaḥ śardhastaro narāṃ gūrtaśravāḥ |
1,122.10 visṛṣṭarātiryāti bāḻhasṛtvā viśvāsu pṛtsu sadamicchūraḥ ||
1,122.11  adha gmantā nahuṣo havaṃ sūreḥ śrotā rājāno amṛtasya mandrāḥ |
1,122.11 nabhojuvo yanniravasya rādhaḥ praśastaye mahinā rathavate ||
1,122.12  etaṃ śardhaṃ dhāma yasya sūrerityavocandaśatayasya naṃśe |
1,122.12 dyumnāni yeṣu vasutātī rāranviśve sanvantu prabhṛtheṣu vājam ||
1,122.13  mandāmahe daśatayasya dhāserdviryatpañca bibhrato yantyannā |
1,122.13 kimiṣṭāśva iṣṭaraśmireta īśānāsastaruṣa ṛñjate nṝn ||
1,122.14  hiraṇyakarṇaṃ maṇigrīvamarṇastanno viśve varivasyantu devāḥ |
1,122.14 aryo giraḥ sadya ā jagmuṣīrosrāścākantūbhayeṣvasme ||
1,122.15  catvāro mā maśarśārasya śiśvastrayo rājña āyavasasya jiṣṇoḥ |
1,122.15 ratho vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā dīrghāpsāḥ syūmagabhastiḥ sūro nādyaut ||

1,123.01  pṛthū ratho dakṣiṇāyā ayojyainaṃ devāso amṛtāso asthuḥ |
1,123.01 kṛṣṇādudasthādaryā vihāyāścikitsantī mānuṣāya kṣayāya ||
1,123.02  pūrvā viśvasmādbhuvanādabodhi jayantī vājaṃ bṛhatī sanutrī |
1,123.02 uccā vyakhyadyuvatiḥ punarbhūroṣā aganprathamā pūrvahūtau ||
1,123.03  yadadya bhāgaṃ vibhajāsi nṛbhya uṣo devi martyatrā sujāte |
1,123.03 devo no atra savitā damūnā anāgaso vocati sūryāya ||
1,123.04  gṛhaṃgṛhamahanā yātyacchā divedive adhi nāmā dadhānā |
1,123.04 siṣāsantī dyotanā śaśvadāgādagramagramidbhajate vasūnām ||
1,123.05  bhagasya svasā varuṇasya jāmiruṣaḥ sūnṛte prathamā jarasva |
1,123.05 paścā sa daghyā yo aghasya dhātā jayema taṃ dakṣiṇayā rathena ||
1,123.06  udīratāṃ sūnṛtā utpurandhīrudagnayaḥ śuśucānāso asthuḥ |
1,123.06 spārhā vasūni tamasāpagūḻhāviṣkṛṇvantyuṣaso vibhātīḥ ||
1,123.07  apānyadetyabhyanyadeti viṣurūpe ahanī saṃ carete |
1,123.07 parikṣitostamo anyā guhākaradyauduṣāḥ śośucatā rathena ||
1,123.08  sadṛśīradya sadṛśīridu śvo dīrghaṃ sacante varuṇasya dhāma |
1,123.08 anavadyāstriṃśataṃ yojanānyekaikā kratuṃ pari yanti sadyaḥ ||
1,123.09  jānatyahnaḥ prathamasya nāma śukrā kṛṣṇādajaniṣṭa śvitīcī |
1,123.09 ṛtasya yoṣā na mināti dhāmāharaharniṣkṛtamācarantī ||
1,123.10  kanyeva tanvā śāśadānāṃ eṣi devi devamiyakṣamāṇam |
1,123.10 saṃsmayamānā yuvatiḥ purastādāvirvakṣāṃsi kṛṇuṣe vibhātī ||
1,123.11  susaṃkāśā mātṛmṛṣṭeva yoṣāvistanvaṃ kṛṇuṣe dṛśe kam |
1,123.11 bhadrā tvamuṣo vitaraṃ vyuccha na tatte anyā uṣaso naśanta ||
1,123.12  aśvāvatīrgomatīrviśvavārā yatamānā raśmibhiḥ sūryasya |
1,123.12 parā ca yanti punarā ca yanti bhadrā nāma vahamānā uṣāsaḥ ||
1,123.13  ṛtasya raśmimanuyacchamānā bhadrambhadraṃ kratumasmāsu dhehi |
1,123.13 uṣo no adya suhavā vyucchāsmāsu rāyo maghavatsu ca syuḥ ||

1,124.01  uṣā ucchantī samidhāne agnā udyansūrya urviyā jyotiraśret |
1,124.01 devo no atra savitā nvarthaṃ prāsāvīddvipatpra catuṣpadityai ||
1,124.02  aminatī daivyāni vratāni praminatī manuṣyā yugāni |
1,124.02 īyuṣīṇāmupamā śaśvatīnāmāyatīnāṃ prathamoṣā vyadyaut ||
1,124.03  eṣā divo duhitā pratyadarśi jyotirvasānā samanā purastāt |
1,124.03 ṛtasya panthāmanveti sādhu prajānatīva na diśo mināti ||
1,124.04  upo adarśi śundhyuvo na vakṣo nodhā ivāvirakṛta priyāṇi |
1,124.04 admasanna sasato bodhayantī śaśvattamāgātpunareyuṣīṇām ||
1,124.05  pūrve ardhe rajaso aptyasya gavāṃ janitryakṛta pra ketum |
1,124.05 vyu prathate vitaraṃ varīya obhā pṛṇantī pitrorupasthā ||
1,124.06  evedeṣā purutamā dṛśe kaṃ nājāmiṃ na pari vṛṇakti jāmim |
1,124.06 arepasā tanvā śāśadānā nārbhādīṣate na maho vibhātī ||
1,124.07  abhrāteva puṃsa eti pratīcī gartārugiva sanaye dhanānām |
1,124.07 jāyeva patya uśatī suvāsā uṣā hasreva ni riṇīte apsaḥ ||
1,124.08  svasā svasre jyāyasyai yonimāraigapaityasyāḥ praticakṣyeva |
1,124.08 vyucchantī raśmibhiḥ sūryasyāñjyaṅkte samanagā iva vrāḥ ||
1,124.09  āsāṃ pūrvāsāmahasu svasṝṇāmaparā pūrvāmabhyeti paścāt |
1,124.09 tāḥ pratnavannavyasīrnūnamasme revaducchantu sudinā uṣāsaḥ ||
1,124.10  pra bodhayoṣaḥ pṛṇato maghonyabudhyamānāḥ paṇayaḥ sasantu |
1,124.10 revaduccha maghavadbhyo maghoni revatstotre sūnṛte jārayantī ||
1,124.11  aveyamaśvaidyuvatiḥ purastādyuṅkte gavāmaruṇānāmanīkam |
1,124.11 vi nūnamucchādasati pra keturgṛhaṃgṛhamupa tiṣṭhāte agniḥ ||
1,124.12  utte vayaścidvasaterapaptannaraśca ye pitubhājo vyuṣṭau |
1,124.12 amā sate vahasi bhūri vāmamuṣo devi dāśuṣe martyāya ||
1,124.13  astoḍhvaṃ stomyā brahmaṇā me'vīvṛdhadhvamuśatīruṣāsaḥ |
1,124.13 yuṣmākaṃ devīravasā sanema sahasriṇaṃ ca śatinaṃ ca vājam ||

1,125.01  prātā ratnaṃ prātaritvā dadhāti taṃ cikitvānpratigṛhyā ni dhatte |
1,125.01 tena prajāṃ vardhayamāna āyū rāyaspoṣeṇa sacate suvīraḥ ||
1,125.02  sugurasatsuhiraṇyaḥ svaśvo bṛhadasmai vaya indro dadhāti |
1,125.02 yastvāyantaṃ vasunā prātaritvo mukṣījayeva padimutsināti ||
1,125.03  āyamadya sukṛtaṃ prātaricchanniṣṭeḥ putraṃ vasumatā rathena |
1,125.03 aṃśoḥ sutaṃ pāyaya matsarasya kṣayadvīraṃ vardhaya sūnṛtābhiḥ ||
1,125.04  upa kṣaranti sindhavo mayobhuva ījānaṃ ca yakṣyamāṇaṃ ca dhenavaḥ |
1,125.04 pṛṇantaṃ ca papuriṃ ca śravasyavo ghṛtasya dhārā upa yanti viśvataḥ ||
1,125.05  nākasya pṛṣṭhe adhi tiṣṭhati śrito yaḥ pṛṇāti sa ha deveṣu gacchati |
1,125.05 tasmā āpo ghṛtamarṣanti sindhavastasmā iyaṃ dakṣiṇā pinvate sadā ||
1,125.06  dakṣiṇāvatāmidimāni citrā dakṣiṇāvatāṃ divi sūryāsaḥ |
1,125.06 dakṣiṇāvanto amṛtaṃ bhajante dakṣiṇāvantaḥ pra tiranta āyuḥ ||
1,125.07  mā pṛṇanto duritamena āranmā jāriṣuḥ sūrayaḥ suvratāsaḥ |
1,125.07 anyasteṣāṃ paridhirastu kaścidapṛṇantamabhi saṃ yantu śokāḥ ||

1,126.01  amandānstomānpra bhare manīṣā sindhāvadhi kṣiyato bhāvyasya |
1,126.01 yo me sahasramamimīta savānatūrto rājā śrava icchamānaḥ ||
1,126.02  śataṃ rājño nādhamānasya niṣkāñchatamaśvānprayatānsadya ādam |
1,126.02 śataṃ kakṣīvāṃ asurasya gonāṃ divi śravo'jaramā tatāna ||
1,126.03  upa mā śyāvāḥ svanayena dattā vadhūmanto daśa rathāso asthuḥ |
1,126.03 ṣaṣṭiḥ sahasramanu gavyamāgātsanatkakṣīvāṃ abhipitve ahnām ||
1,126.04  catvāriṃśaddaśarathasya śoṇāḥ sahasrasyāgre śreṇiṃ nayanti |
1,126.04 madacyutaḥ kṛśanāvato atyānkakṣīvanta udamṛkṣanta pajrāḥ ||
1,126.05  pūrvāmanu prayatimā dade vastrīnyuktāṃ aṣṭāvaridhāyaso gāḥ |
1,126.05 subandhavo ye viśyā iva vrā anasvantaḥ śrava aiṣanta pajrāḥ ||
1,126.06  āgadhitā parigadhitā yā kaśīkeva jaṅgahe |
1,126.06 dadāti mahyaṃ yādurī yāśūnāṃ bhojyā śatā ||
1,126.07  upopa me parā mṛśa mā me dabhrāṇi manyathāḥ |
1,126.07 sarvāhamasmi romaśā gandhārīṇāmivāvikā ||

1,127.01  agniṃ hotāraṃ manye dāsvantaṃ vasuṃ sūnuṃ sahaso jātavedasaṃ vipraṃ na jātavedasam |
1,127.01 ya ūrdhvayā svadhvaro devo devācyā kṛpā |
1,127.01  ghṛtasya vibhrāṣṭimanu vaṣṭi śociṣājuhvānasya sarpiṣaḥ ||
1,127.02  yajiṣṭhaṃ tvā yajamānā huvema jyeṣṭhamaṅgirasāṃ vipra manmabhirviprebhiḥ śukra manmabhiḥ |
1,127.02 parijmānamiva dyāṃ hotāraṃ carṣaṇīnām |
1,127.02  śociṣkeśaṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ yamimā viśaḥ prāvantu jūtaye viśaḥ ||
1,127.03  sa hi purū cidojasā virukmatā dīdyāno bhavati druhantaraḥ paraśurna druhantaraḥ |
1,127.03 vīḻu cidyasya samṛtau śruvadvaneva yatsthiram |
1,127.03  niḥṣahamāṇo yamate nāyate dhanvāsahā nāyate ||
1,127.04  dṛḻhā cidasmā anu duryathā vide tejiṣṭhābhiraraṇibhirdāṣṭyavase'gnaye dāṣṭyavase |
1,127.04 pra yaḥ purūṇi gāhate takṣadvaneva śociṣā |
1,127.04  sthirā cidannā ni riṇātyojasā ni sthirāṇi cidojasā ||
1,127.05  tamasya pṛkṣamuparāsu dhīmahi naktaṃ yaḥ sudarśataro divātarādaprāyuṣe divātarāt |
1,127.05 ādasyāyurgrabhaṇavadvīḻu śarma na sūnave |
1,127.05  bhaktamabhaktamavo vyanto ajarā agnayo vyanto ajarāḥ ||
1,127.06  sa hi śardho na mārutaṃ tuviṣvaṇirapnasvatīṣūrvarāsviṣṭanirārtanāsviṣṭaniḥ |
1,127.06 ādaddhavyānyādadiryajñasya keturarhaṇā |
1,127.06  adha smāsya harṣato hṛṣīvato viśve juṣanta panthāṃ naraḥ śubhe na panthām ||
1,127.07  dvitā yadīṃ kīstāso abhidyavo namasyanta upavocanta bhṛgavo mathnanto dāśā bhṛgavaḥ |
1,127.07 agnirīśe vasūnāṃ śuciryo dharṇireṣām |
1,127.07  priyāṃ apidhīṃrvaniṣīṣṭa medhira ā vaniṣīṣṭa medhiraḥ ||
1,127.08  viśvāsāṃ tvā viśāṃ patiṃ havāmahe sarvāsāṃ samānaṃ dampatiṃ bhuje satyagirvāhasaṃ bhuje |
1,127.08 atithiṃ mānuṣāṇāṃ piturna yasyāsayā |
1,127.08  amī ca viśve amṛtāsa ā vayo havyā deveṣvā vayaḥ ||
1,127.09  tvamagne sahasā sahantamaḥ śuṣmintamo jāyase devatātaye rayirna devatātaye |
1,127.09 śuṣmintamo hi te mado dyumnintama uta kratuḥ |
1,127.09  adha smā te pari carantyajara śruṣṭīvāno nājara ||
1,127.10  pra vo mahe sahasā sahasvata uṣarbudhe paśuṣe nāgnaye stomo babhūtvagnaye |
1,127.10 prati yadīṃ haviṣmānviśvāsu kṣāsu joguve |
1,127.10  agre rebho na jarata ṛṣūṇāṃ jūrṇirhota ṛṣūṇām ||
1,127.11  sa no nediṣṭhaṃ dadṛśāna ā bharāgne devebhiḥ sacanāḥ sucetunā maho rāyaḥ sucetunā |
1,127.11 mahi śaviṣṭha naskṛdhi saṃcakṣe bhuje asyai |
1,127.11  mahi stotṛbhyo maghavansuvīryaṃ mathīrugro na śavasā ||

1,128.01  ayaṃ jāyata manuṣo dharīmaṇi hotā yajiṣṭha uśijāmanu vratamagniḥ svamanu vratam |
1,128.01 viśvaśruṣṭiḥ sakhīyate rayiriva śravasyate |
1,128.01  adabdho hotā ni ṣadadiḻaspade parivīta iḻaspade ||
1,128.02  taṃ yajñasādhamapi vātayāmasyṛtasya pathā namasā haviṣmatā devatātā haviṣmatā |
1,128.02 sa na ūrjāmupābhṛtyayā kṛpā na jūryati |
1,128.02  yaṃ mātariśvā manave parāvato devaṃ bhāḥ parāvataḥ ||
1,128.03  evena sadyaḥ paryeti pārthivaṃ muhurgī reto vṛṣabhaḥ kanikradaddadhadretaḥ kanikradat |
1,128.03 śataṃ cakṣāṇo akṣabhirdevo vaneṣu turvaṇiḥ |
1,128.03  sado dadhāna upareṣu sānuṣvagniḥ pareṣu sānuṣu ||
1,128.04  sa sukratuḥ purohito damedame'gniryajñasyādhvarasya cetati kratvā yajñasya cetati |
1,128.04 kratvā vedhā iṣūyate viśvā jātāni paspaśe |
1,128.04  yato ghṛtaśrīratithirajāyata vahnirvedhā ajāyata ||
1,128.05  kratvā yadasya taviṣīṣu pṛñcate'gneraveṇa marutāṃ na bhojyeṣirāya na bhojyā |
1,128.05 sa hi ṣmā dānaminvati vasūnāṃ ca majmanā |
1,128.05  sa nastrāsate duritādabhihrutaḥ śaṃsādaghādabhihrutaḥ ||
1,128.06  viśvo vihāyā aratirvasurdadhe haste dakṣiṇe taraṇirna śiśrathacchravasyayā na śiśrathat |
1,128.06 viśvasmā idiṣudhyate devatrā havyamohiṣe |
1,128.06  viśvasmā itsukṛte vāramṛṇvatyagnirdvārā vyṛṇvati ||
1,128.07  sa mānuṣe vṛjane śantamo hito'gniryajñeṣu jenyo na viśpatiḥ priyo yajñeṣu viśpatiḥ |
1,128.07 sa havyā mānuṣāṇāmiḻā kṛtāni patyate |
1,128.07  sa nastrāsate varuṇasya dhūrtermaho devasya dhūrteḥ ||
1,128.08  agniṃ hotāramīḻate vasudhitiṃ priyaṃ cetiṣṭhamaratiṃ nyerire havyavāhaṃ nyerire |
1,128.08 viśvāyuṃ viśvavedasaṃ hotāraṃ yajataṃ kavim |
1,128.08  devāso raṇvamavase vasūyavo gīrbhī raṇvaṃ vasūyavaḥ ||

1,129.01  yaṃ tvaṃ rathamindra medhasātaye'pākā santamiṣira praṇayasi prānavadya nayasi |
1,129.01 sadyaścittamabhiṣṭaye karo vaśaśca vājinam |
1,129.01  sāsmākamanavadya tūtujāna vedhasāmimāṃ vācaṃ na vedhasām ||
1,129.02  sa śrudhi yaḥ smā pṛtanāsu kāsu ciddakṣāyya indra bharahūtaye nṛbhirasi pratūrtaye nṛbhiḥ |
1,129.02 yaḥ śūraiḥ svaḥ sanitā yo viprairvājaṃ tarutā |
1,129.02  tamīśānāsa iradhanta vājinaṃ pṛkṣamatyaṃ na vājinam ||
1,129.03  dasmo hi ṣmā vṛṣaṇaṃ pinvasi tvacaṃ kaṃ cidyāvīrararuṃ śūra martyaṃ parivṛṇakṣi martyam |
1,129.03 indrota tubhyaṃ taddive tadrudrāya svayaśase |
1,129.03  mitrāya vocaṃ varuṇāya saprathaḥ sumṛḻīkāya saprathaḥ ||
1,129.04  asmākaṃ va indramuśmasīṣṭaye sakhāyaṃ viśvāyuṃ prāsahaṃ yujaṃ vājeṣu prāsahaṃ yujam |
1,129.04 asmākaṃ brahmotaye'vā pṛtsuṣu kāsu cit |
1,129.04  nahi tvā śatru starate stṛṇoṣi yaṃ viśvaṃ śatruṃ stṛṇoṣi yam ||
1,129.05  ni ṣū namātimatiṃ kayasya cittejiṣṭhābhiraraṇibhirnotibhirugrābhirugrotibhiḥ |
1,129.05 neṣi ṇo yathā purānenāḥ śūra manyase |
1,129.05  viśvāni pūrorapa parṣi vahnirāsā vahnirno accha ||
1,129.06  pra tadvoceyaṃ bhavyāyendave havyo na ya iṣavānmanma rejati rakṣohā manma rejati |
1,129.06 svayaṃ so asmadā nido vadhairajeta durmatim |
1,129.06  ava sravedaghaśaṃso'vataramava kṣudramiva sravet ||
1,129.07  vanema taddhotrayā citantyā vanema rayiṃ rayivaḥ suvīryaṃ raṇvaṃ santaṃ suvīryam |
1,129.07 durmanmānaṃ sumantubhiremiṣā pṛcīmahi |
1,129.07  ā satyābhirindraṃ dyumnahūtibhiryajatraṃ dyumnahūtibhiḥ ||
1,129.08  praprā vo asme svayaśobhirūtī parivarga indro durmatīnāṃ darīmandurmatīnām |
1,129.08 svayaṃ sā riṣayadhyai yā na upeṣe atraiḥ |
1,129.08  hatemasanna vakṣati kṣiptā jūrṇirna vakṣati ||
1,129.09  tvaṃ na indra rāyā parīṇasā yāhi pathāṃ anehasā puro yāhyarakṣasā |
1,129.09 sacasva naḥ parāka ā sacasvāstamīka ā |
1,129.09  pāhi no dūrādārādabhiṣṭibhiḥ sadā pāhyabhiṣṭibhiḥ ||
1,129.10  tvaṃ na indra rāyā tarūṣasograṃ cittvā mahimā sakṣadavase mahe mitraṃ nāvase |
1,129.10 ojiṣṭha trātaravitā rathaṃ kaṃ cidamartya |
1,129.10  anyamasmadririṣeḥ kaṃ cidadrivo ririkṣantaṃ cidadrivaḥ ||
1,129.11  pāhi na indra suṣṭuta sridho'vayātā sadamiddurmatīnāṃ devaḥ sandurmatīnām |
1,129.11 hantā pāpasya rakṣasastrātā viprasya māvataḥ |
1,129.11  adhā hi tvā janitā jījanadvaso rakṣohaṇaṃ tvā jījanadvaso ||

1,130.01  endra yāhyupa naḥ parāvato nāyamacchā vidathānīva satpatirastaṃ rājeva satpatiḥ |
1,130.01 havāmahe tvā vayaṃ prayasvantaḥ sute sacā |
1,130.01  putrāso na pitaraṃ vājasātaye maṃhiṣṭhaṃ vājasātaye ||
1,130.02  pibā somamindra suvānamadribhiḥ kośena siktamavataṃ na vaṃsagastātṛṣāṇo na vaṃsagaḥ |
1,130.02 madāya haryatāya te tuviṣṭamāya dhāyase |
1,130.02  ā tvā yacchantu harito na sūryamahā viśveva sūryam ||
1,130.03  avindaddivo nihitaṃ guhā nidhiṃ verna garbhaṃ parivītamaśmanyanante antaraśmani |
1,130.03 vrajaṃ vajrī gavāmiva siṣāsannaṅgirastamaḥ |
1,130.03  apāvṛṇodiṣa indraḥ parīvṛtā dvāra iṣaḥ parīvṛtāḥ ||
1,130.04  dādṛhāṇo vajramindro gabhastyoḥ kṣadmeva tigmamasanāya saṃ śyadahihatyāya saṃ śyat |
1,130.04 saṃvivyāna ojasā śavobhirindra majmanā |
1,130.04  taṣṭeva vṛkṣaṃ vanino ni vṛścasi paraśveva ni vṛścasi ||
1,130.05  tvaṃ vṛthā nadya indra sartave'cchā samudramasṛjo rathāṃ iva vājayato rathāṃ iva |
1,130.05 ita ūtīrayuñjata samānamarthamakṣitam |
1,130.05  dhenūriva manave viśvadohaso janāya viśvadohasaḥ ||
1,130.06  imāṃ te vācaṃ vasūyanta āyavo rathaṃ na dhīraḥ svapā atakṣiṣuḥ sumnāya tvāmatakṣiṣuḥ |
1,130.06 śumbhanto jenyaṃ yathā vājeṣu vipra vājinam |
1,130.06  atyamiva śavase sātaye dhanā viśvā dhanāni sātaye ||
1,130.07  bhinatpuro navatimindra pūrave divodāsāya mahi dāśuṣe nṛto vajreṇa dāśuṣe nṛto |
1,130.07 atithigvāya śambaraṃ girerugro avābharat |
1,130.07  maho dhanāni dayamāna ojasā viśvā dhanānyojasā ||
1,130.08  indraḥ samatsu yajamānamāryaṃ prāvadviśveṣu śatamūtirājiṣu svarmīḻheṣvājiṣu |
1,130.08 manave śāsadavratāntvacaṃ kṛṣṇāmarandhayat |
1,130.08  dakṣanna viśvaṃ tatṛṣāṇamoṣati nyarśasānamoṣati ||
1,130.09  sūraścakraṃ pra vṛhajjāta ojasā prapitve vācamaruṇo muṣāyatīśāna ā muṣāyati |
1,130.09 uśanā yatparāvato'jagannūtaye kave |
1,130.09  sumnāni viśvā manuṣeva turvaṇirahā viśveva turvaṇiḥ ||
1,130.10  sa no navyebhirvṛṣakarmannukthaiḥ purāṃ dartaḥ pāyubhiḥ pāhi śagmaiḥ |
1,130.10 divodāsebhirindra stavāno vāvṛdhīthā ahobhiriva dyauḥ ||

1,131.01  indrāya hi dyaurasuro anamnatendrāya mahī pṛthivī varīmabhirdyumnasātā varīmabhiḥ |
1,131.01 indraṃ viśve sajoṣaso devāso dadhire puraḥ |
1,131.01  indrāya viśvā savanāni mānuṣā rātāni santu mānuṣā ||
1,131.02  viśveṣu hi tvā savaneṣu tuñjate samānamekaṃ vṛṣamaṇyavaḥ pṛthaksvaḥ saniṣyavaḥ pṛthak |
1,131.02 taṃ tvā nāvaṃ na parṣaṇiṃ śūṣasya dhuri dhīmahi |
1,131.02  indraṃ na yajñaiścitayanta āyava stomebhirindramāyavaḥ ||
1,131.03  vi tvā tatasre mithunā avasyavo vrajasya sātā gavyasya niḥsṛjaḥ sakṣanta indra niḥsṛjaḥ |
1,131.03 yadgavyantā dvā janā svaryantā samūhasi |
1,131.03  āviṣkarikradvṛṣaṇaṃ sacābhuvaṃ vajramindra sacābhuvam ||
1,131.04  viduṣṭe asya vīryasya pūravaḥ puro yadindra śāradīravātiraḥ sāsahāno avātiraḥ |
1,131.04 śāsastamindra martyamayajyuṃ śavasaspate |
1,131.04  mahīmamuṣṇāḥ pṛthivīmimā apo mandasāna imā apaḥ ||
1,131.05  āditte asya vīryasya carkiranmadeṣu vṛṣannuśijo yadāvitha sakhīyato yadāvitha |
1,131.05 cakartha kāramebhyaḥ pṛtanāsu pravantave |
1,131.05  te anyāmanyāṃ nadyaṃ saniṣṇata śravasyantaḥ saniṣṇata ||
1,131.06  uto no asyā uṣaso juṣeta hyarkasya bodhi haviṣo havīmabhiḥ svarṣātā havīmabhiḥ |
1,131.06 yadindra hantave mṛdho vṛṣā vajriñciketasi |
1,131.06  ā me asya vedhaso navīyaso manma śrudhi navīyasaḥ ||
1,131.07  tvaṃ tamindra vāvṛdhāno asmayuramitrayantaṃ tuvijāta martyaṃ vajreṇa śūra martyam |
1,131.07 jahi yo no aghāyati śṛṇuṣva suśravastamaḥ |
1,131.07  riṣṭaṃ na yāmannapa bhūtu durmatirviśvāpa bhūtu durmatiḥ ||

1,132.01  tvayā vayaṃ maghavanpūrvye dhana indratvotāḥ sāsahyāma pṛtanyato vanuyāma vanuṣyataḥ |
1,132.01 nediṣṭhe asminnahanyadhi vocā nu sunvate |
1,132.01  asminyajñe vi cayemā bhare kṛtaṃ vājayanto bhare kṛtam ||
1,132.02  svarjeṣe bhara āprasya vakmanyuṣarbudhaḥ svasminnañjasi krāṇasya svasminnañjasi |
1,132.02 ahannindro yathā vide śīrṣṇāśīrṣṇopavācyaḥ |
1,132.02  asmatrā te sadhryaksantu rātayo bhadrā bhadrasya rātayaḥ ||
1,132.03  tattu prayaḥ pratnathā te śuśukvanaṃ yasminyajñe vāramakṛṇvata kṣayamṛtasya vārasi kṣayam |
1,132.03 vi tadvoceradha dvitāntaḥ paśyanti raśmibhiḥ |
1,132.03  sa ghā vide anvindro gaveṣaṇo bandhukṣidbhyo gaveṣaṇaḥ ||
1,132.04  nū itthā te pūrvathā ca pravācyaṃ yadaṅgirobhyo'vṛṇorapa vrajamindra śikṣannapa vrajam |
1,132.04 aibhyaḥ samānyā diśāsmabhyaṃ jeṣi yotsi ca |
1,132.04  sunvadbhyo randhayā kaṃ cidavrataṃ hṛṇāyantaṃ cidavratam ||
1,132.05  saṃ yajjanānkratubhiḥ śūra īkṣayaddhane hite taruṣanta śravasyavaḥ pra yakṣanta śravasyavaḥ |
1,132.05 tasmā āyuḥ prajāvadidbādhe arcantyojasā |
1,132.05  indra okyaṃ didhiṣanta dhītayo devāṃ acchā na dhītayaḥ ||
1,132.06  yuvaṃ tamindrāparvatā puroyudhā yo naḥ pṛtanyādapa taṃtamiddhataṃ vajreṇa taṃtamiddhatam |
1,132.06 dūre cattāya cchantsadgahanaṃ yadinakṣat |
1,132.06  asmākaṃ śatrūnpari śūra viśvato darmā darṣīṣṭa viśvataḥ ||

1,133.01  ubhe punāmi rodasī ṛtena druho dahāmi saṃ mahīranindrāḥ |
1,133.01 abhivlagya yatra hatā amitrā vailasthānaṃ pari tṛḻhā aśeran ||
1,133.02  abhivlagyā cidadrivaḥ śīrṣā yātumatīnām |
1,133.02 chindhi vaṭūriṇā padā mahāvaṭūriṇā padā ||
1,133.03  avāsāṃ maghavañjahi śardho yātumatīnām |
1,133.03 vailasthānake armake mahāvailasthe armake ||
1,133.04  yāsāṃ tisraḥ pañcāśato'bhivlaṅgairapāvapaḥ |
1,133.04 tatsu te manāyati takatsu te manāyati ||
1,133.05  piśaṅgabhṛṣṭimambhṛṇaṃ piśācimindra saṃ mṛṇa |
1,133.05 sarvaṃ rakṣo ni barhaya ||
1,133.06  avarmaha indra dādṛhi śrudhī naḥ śuśoca hi dyauḥ kṣā na bhīṣāṃ adrivo ghṛṇānna bhīṣāṃ adrivaḥ |
1,133.06 śuṣmintamo hi śuṣmibhirvadhairugrebhirīyase |
1,133.06  apūruṣaghno apratīta śūra satvabhistrisaptaiḥ śūra satvabhiḥ ||
1,133.07  vanoti hi sunvankṣayaṃ parīṇasaḥ sunvāno hi ṣmā yajatyava dviṣo devānāmava dviṣaḥ |
1,133.07 sunvāna itsiṣāsati sahasrā vājyavṛtaḥ |
1,133.07  sunvānāyendro dadātyābhuvaṃ rayiṃ dadātyābhuvam ||

1,134.01  ā tvā juvo rārahāṇā abhi prayo vāyo vahantviha pūrvapītaye somasya pūrvapītaye |
1,134.01 ūrdhvā te anu sūnṛtā manastiṣṭhatu jānatī |
1,134.01  niyutvatā rathenā yāhi dāvane vāyo makhasya dāvane ||
1,134.02  mandantu tvā mandino vāyavindavo'smatkrāṇāsaḥ sukṛtā abhidyavo gobhiḥ krāṇā abhidyavaḥ |
1,134.02 yaddha krāṇā iradhyai dakṣaṃ sacanta ūtayaḥ |
1,134.02  sadhrīcīnā niyuto dāvane dhiya upa bruvata īṃ dhiyaḥ ||
1,134.03  vāyuryuṅkte rohitā vāyuraruṇā vāyū rathe ajirā dhuri voḻhave vahiṣṭhā dhuri voḻhave |
1,134.03 pra bodhayā purandhiṃ jāra ā sasatīmiva |
1,134.03  pra cakṣaya rodasī vāsayoṣasaḥ śravase vāsayoṣasaḥ ||
1,134.04  tubhyamuṣāsaḥ śucayaḥ parāvati bhadrā vastrā tanvate daṃsu raśmiṣu citrā navyeṣu raśmiṣu |
1,134.04 tubhyaṃ dhenuḥ sabardughā viśvā vasūni dohate |
1,134.04  ajanayo maruto vakṣaṇābhyo diva ā vakṣaṇābhyaḥ ||
1,134.05  tubhyaṃ śukrāsaḥ śucayasturaṇyavo madeṣūgrā iṣaṇanta bhurvaṇyapāmiṣanta bhurvaṇi |
1,134.05 tvāṃ tsārī dasamāno bhagamīṭṭe takvavīye |
1,134.05  tvaṃ viśvasmādbhuvanātpāsi dharmaṇāsuryātpāsi dharmaṇā ||
1,134.06  tvaṃ no vāyaveṣāmapūrvyaḥ somānāṃ prathamaḥ pītimarhasi sutānāṃ pītimarhasi |
1,134.06 uto vihutmatīnāṃ viśāṃ vavarjuṣīṇām |
1,134.06  viśvā itte dhenavo duhra āśiraṃ ghṛtaṃ duhrata āśiram ||

1,135.01  stīrṇaṃ barhirupa no yāhi vītaye sahasreṇa niyutā niyutvate śatinībhirniyutvate |
1,135.01 tubhyaṃ hi pūrvapītaye devā devāya yemire |
1,135.01  pra te sutāso madhumanto asthiranmadāya kratve asthiran ||
1,135.02  tubhyāyaṃ somaḥ paripūto adribhi spārhā vasānaḥ pari kośamarṣati śukrā vasāno arṣati |
1,135.02 tavāyaṃ bhāga āyuṣu somo deveṣu hūyate |
1,135.02  vaha vāyo niyuto yāhyasmayurjuṣāṇo yāhyasmayuḥ ||
1,135.03  ā no niyudbhiḥ śatinībhiradhvaraṃ sahasriṇībhirupa yāhi vītaye vāyo havyāni vītaye |
1,135.03 tavāyaṃ bhāga ṛtviyaḥ saraśmiḥ sūrye sacā |
1,135.03  adhvaryubhirbharamāṇā ayaṃsata vāyo śukrā ayaṃsata ||
1,135.04  ā vāṃ ratho niyutvānvakṣadavase'bhi prayāṃsi sudhitāni vītaye vāyo havyāni vītaye |
1,135.04 pibataṃ madhvo andhasaḥ pūrvapeyaṃ hi vāṃ hitam |
1,135.04  vāyavā candreṇa rādhasā gatamindraśca rādhasā gatam ||
1,135.05  ā vāṃ dhiyo vavṛtyuradhvarāṃ upemaminduṃ marmṛjanta vājinamāśumatyaṃ na vājinam |
1,135.05 teṣāṃ pibatamasmayū ā no gantamihotyā |
1,135.05  indravāyū sutānāmadribhiryuvaṃ madāya vājadā yuvam ||
1,135.06  ime vāṃ somā apsvā sutā ihādhvaryubhirbharamāṇā ayaṃsata vāyo śukrā ayaṃsata |
1,135.06 ete vāmabhyasṛkṣata tiraḥ pavitramāśavaḥ |
1,135.06  yuvāyavo'ti romāṇyavyayā somāso atyavyayā ||
1,135.07  ati vāyo sasato yāhi śaśvato yatra grāvā vadati tatra gacchataṃ gṛhamindraśca gacchatam |
1,135.07 vi sūnṛtā dadṛśe rīyate ghṛtamā pūrṇayā niyutā yātho adhvaramindraśca yātho adhvaram ||
1,135.08  atrāha tadvahethe madhva āhutiṃ yamaśvatthamupatiṣṭhanta jāyavo'sme te santu jāyavaḥ |
1,135.08 sākaṃ gāvaḥ suvate pacyate yavo na te vāya upa dasyanti dhenavo nāpa dasyanti dhenavaḥ ||
1,135.09  ime ye te su vāyo bāhvojaso'ntarnadī te patayantyukṣaṇo mahi vrādhanta ukṣaṇaḥ |
1,135.09 dhanvañcidye anāśavo jīrāścidagiraukasaḥ |
1,135.09  sūryasyeva raśmayo durniyantavo hastayordurniyantavaḥ ||

1,136.01  pra su jyeṣṭhaṃ nicirābhyāṃ bṛhannamo havyaṃ matiṃ bharatā mṛḻayadbhyāṃ svādiṣṭhaṃ mṛḻayadbhyām |
1,136.01 tā samrājā ghṛtāsutī yajñeyajña upastutā |
1,136.01  athainoḥ kṣatraṃ na kutaścanādhṛṣe devatvaṃ nū cidādhṛṣe ||
1,136.02  adarśi gātururave varīyasī panthā ṛtasya samayaṃsta raśmibhiścakṣurbhagasya raśmibhiḥ |
1,136.02 dyukṣaṃ mitrasya sādanamaryamṇo varuṇasya ca |
1,136.02  athā dadhāte bṛhadukthyaṃ vaya upastutyaṃ bṛhadvayaḥ ||
1,136.03  jyotiṣmatīmaditiṃ dhārayatkṣitiṃ svarvatīmā sacete divedive jāgṛvāṃsā divedive |
1,136.03 jyotiṣmatkṣatramāśāte ādityā dānunaspatī |
1,136.03  mitrastayorvaruṇo yātayajjano'ryamā yātayajjanaḥ ||
1,136.04  ayaṃ mitrāya varuṇāya śantamaḥ somo bhūtvavapāneṣvābhago devo deveṣvābhagaḥ |
1,136.04 taṃ devāso juṣerata viśve adya sajoṣasaḥ |
1,136.04  tathā rājānā karatho yadīmaha ṛtāvānā yadīmahe ||
1,136.05  yo mitrāya varuṇāyāvidhajjano'narvāṇaṃ taṃ pari pāto aṃhaso dāśvāṃsaṃ martamaṃhasaḥ |
1,136.05 tamaryamābhi rakṣatyṛjūyantamanu vratam |
1,136.05  ukthairya enoḥ paribhūṣati vrataṃ stomairābhūṣati vratam ||
1,136.06  namo dive bṛhate rodasībhyāṃ mitrāya vocaṃ varuṇāya mīḻhuṣe sumṛḻīkāya mīḻhuṣe |
1,136.06 indramagnimupa stuhi dyukṣamaryamaṇaṃ bhagam |
1,136.06  jyogjīvantaḥ prajayā sacemahi somasyotī sacemahi ||
1,136.07  ūtī devānāṃ vayamindravanto maṃsīmahi svayaśaso marudbhiḥ |
1,136.07 agnirmitro varuṇaḥ śarma yaṃsantadaśyāma maghavāno vayaṃ ca ||

1,137.01  suṣumā yātamadribhirgośrītā matsarā ime somāso matsarā ime |
1,137.01 ā rājānā divispṛśāsmatrā gantamupa naḥ |
1,137.01  ime vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā gavāśiraḥ somāḥ śukrā gavāśiraḥ ||
1,137.02  ima ā yātamindavaḥ somāso dadhyāśiraḥ sutāso dadhyāśiraḥ |
1,137.02 uta vāmuṣaso budhi sākaṃ sūryasya raśmibhiḥ |
1,137.02  suto mitrāya varuṇāya pītaye cārurṛtāya pītaye ||
1,137.03  tāṃ vāṃ dhenuṃ na vāsarīmaṃśuṃ duhantyadribhiḥ somaṃ duhantyadribhiḥ |
1,137.03 asmatrā gantamupa no'rvāñcā somapītaye |
1,137.03  ayaṃ vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā nṛbhiḥ sutaḥ soma ā pītaye sutaḥ ||

1,138.01  prapra pūṣṇastuvijātasya śasyate mahitvamasya tavaso na tandate stotramasya na tandate |
1,138.01 arcāmi sumnayannahamantyūtiṃ mayobhuvam |
1,138.01  viśvasya yo mana āyuyuve makho deva āyuyuve makhaḥ ||
1,138.02  pra hi tvā pūṣannajiraṃ na yāmani stomebhiḥ kṛṇva ṛṇavo yathā mṛdha uṣṭro na pīparo mṛdhaḥ |
1,138.02 huve yattvā mayobhuvaṃ devaṃ sakhyāya martyaḥ |
1,138.02  asmākamāṅgūṣāndyumninaskṛdhi vājeṣu dyumninaskṛdhi ||
1,138.03  yasya te pūṣansakhye vipanyavaḥ kratvā citsanto'vasā bubhujrira iti kratvā bubhujrire |
1,138.03 tāmanu tvā navīyasīṃ niyutaṃ rāya īmahe |
1,138.03  aheḻamāna uruśaṃsa sarī bhava vājevāje sarī bhava ||
1,138.04  asyā ū ṣu ṇa upa sātaye bhuvo'heḻamāno rarivāṃ ajāśva śravasyatāmajāśva |
1,138.04 o ṣu tvā vavṛtīmahi stomebhirdasma sādhubhiḥ |
1,138.04  nahi tvā pūṣannatimanya āghṛṇe na te sakhyamapahnuve ||

1,139.01  astu śrauṣaṭpuro agnīṃ dhiyā dadha ā nu tacchardho divyaṃ vṛṇīmaha indravāyū vṛṇīmahe |
1,139.01 yaddha krāṇā vivasvati nābhā saṃdāyi navyasī |
1,139.01  adha pra sū na upa yantu dhītayo devāṃ acchā na dhītayaḥ ||
1,139.02  yaddha tyanmitrāvaruṇāvṛtādadhyādadāthe anṛtaṃ svena manyunā dakṣasya svena manyunā |
1,139.02 yuvoritthādhi sadmasvapaśyāma hiraṇyayam |
1,139.02  dhībhiścana manasā svebhirakṣabhiḥ somasya svebhirakṣabhiḥ ||
1,139.03  yuvāṃ stomebhirdevayanto aśvināśrāvayanta iva ślokamāyavo yuvāṃ havyābhyāyavaḥ |
1,139.03 yuvorviśvā adhi śriyaḥ pṛkṣaśca viśvavedasā |
1,139.03  pruṣāyante vāṃ pavayo hiraṇyaye rathe dasrā hiraṇyaye ||
1,139.04  aceti dasrā vyu nākamṛṇvatho yuñjate vāṃ rathayujo diviṣṭiṣvadhvasmāno diviṣṭiṣu |
1,139.04 adhi vāṃ sthāma vandhure rathe dasrā hiraṇyaye |
1,139.04  patheva yantāvanuśāsatā rajo'ñjasā śāsatā rajaḥ ||
1,139.05  śacībhirnaḥ śacīvasū divā naktaṃ daśasyatam |
1,139.05 mā vāṃ rātirupa dasatkadā canāsmadrātiḥ kadā cana ||
1,139.06  vṛṣannindra vṛṣapāṇāsa indava ime sutā adriṣutāsa udbhidastubhyaṃ sutāsa udbhidaḥ |
1,139.06 te tvā mandantu dāvane mahe citrāya rādhase |
1,139.06  gīrbhirgirvāha stavamāna ā gahi sumṛḻīko na ā gahi ||
1,139.07  o ṣū ṇo agne śṛṇuhi tvamīḻito devebhyo bravasi yajñiyebhyo rājabhyo yajñiyebhyaḥ |
1,139.07 yaddha tyāmaṅgirobhyo dhenuṃ devā adattana |
1,139.07  vi tāṃ duhre aryamā kartarī sacāṃ eṣa tāṃ veda me sacā ||
1,139.08  mo ṣu vo asmadabhi tāni pauṃsyā sanā bhūvandyumnāni mota jāriṣurasmatpurota jāriṣuḥ |
1,139.08 yadvaścitraṃ yugeyuge navyaṃ ghoṣādamartyam |
1,139.08  asmāsu tanmaruto yacca duṣṭaraṃ didhṛtā yacca duṣṭaram ||
1,139.09  dadhyaṅha me januṣaṃ pūrvo aṅgirāḥ priyamedhaḥ kaṇvo atrirmanurviduste me pūrve manurviduḥ |
1,139.09 teṣāṃ deveṣvāyatirasmākaṃ teṣu nābhayaḥ |
1,139.09  teṣāṃ padena mahyā name girendrāgnī ā name girā ||
1,139.10  hotā yakṣadvanino vanta vāryaṃ bṛhaspatiryajati vena ukṣabhiḥ puruvārebhirukṣabhiḥ |
1,139.10 jagṛbhmā dūraādiśaṃ ślokamadreradha tmanā |
1,139.10  adhārayadararindāni sukratuḥ purū sadmāni sukratuḥ ||
1,139.11  ye devāso divyekādaśa stha pṛthivyāmadhyekādaśa stha |
1,139.11 apsukṣito mahinaikādaśa stha te devāso yajñamimaṃ juṣadhvam ||

1,140.01  vediṣade priyadhāmāya sudyute dhāsimiva pra bharā yonimagnaye |
1,140.01 vastreṇeva vāsayā manmanā śuciṃ jyotīrathaṃ śukravarṇaṃ tamohanam ||
1,140.02  abhi dvijanmā trivṛdannamṛjyate saṃvatsare vāvṛdhe jagdhamī punaḥ |
1,140.02 anyasyāsā jihvayā jenyo vṛṣā nyanyena vanino mṛṣṭa vāraṇaḥ ||
1,140.03  kṛṣṇaprutau vevije asya sakṣitā ubhā tarete abhi mātarā śiśum |
1,140.03 prācājihvaṃ dhvasayantaṃ tṛṣucyutamā sācyaṃ kupayaṃ vardhanaṃ pituḥ ||
1,140.04  mumukṣvo manave mānavasyate raghudruvaḥ kṛṣṇasītāsa ū juvaḥ |
1,140.04 asamanā ajirāso raghuṣyado vātajūtā upa yujyanta āśavaḥ ||
1,140.05  ādasya te dhvasayanto vṛtherate kṛṣṇamabhvaṃ mahi varpaḥ karikrataḥ |
1,140.05 yatsīṃ mahīmavaniṃ prābhi marmṛśadabhiśvasanstanayanneti nānadat ||
1,140.06  bhūṣanna yo'dhi babhrūṣu namnate vṛṣeva patnīrabhyeti roruvat |
1,140.06 ojāyamānastanvaśca śumbhate bhīmo na śṛṅgā davidhāva durgṛbhiḥ ||
1,140.07  sa saṃstiro viṣṭiraḥ saṃ gṛbhāyati jānanneva jānatīrnitya ā śaye |
1,140.07 punarvardhante api yanti devyamanyadvarpaḥ pitroḥ kṛṇvate sacā ||
1,140.08  tamagruvaḥ keśinīḥ saṃ hi rebhira ūrdhvāstasthurmamruṣīḥ prāyave punaḥ |
1,140.08 tāsāṃ jarāṃ pramuñcanneti nānadadasuṃ paraṃ janayañjīvamastṛtam ||
1,140.09  adhīvāsaṃ pari mātū rihannaha tuvigrebhiḥ satvabhiryāti vi jrayaḥ |
1,140.09 vayo dadhatpadvate rerihatsadānu śyenī sacate vartanīraha ||
1,140.10  asmākamagne maghavatsu dīdihyadha śvasīvānvṛṣabho damūnāḥ |
1,140.10 avāsyā śiśumatīradīdervarmeva yutsu parijarbhurāṇaḥ ||
1,140.11  idamagne sudhitaṃ durdhitādadhi priyādu cinmanmanaḥ preyo astu te |
1,140.11 yatte śukraṃ tanvo rocate śuci tenāsmabhyaṃ vanase ratnamā tvam ||
1,140.12  rathāya nāvamuta no gṛhāya nityāritrāṃ padvatīṃ rāsyagne |
1,140.12 asmākaṃ vīrāṃ uta no maghono janāṃśca yā pārayāccharma yā ca ||
1,140.13  abhī no agna ukthamijjuguryā dyāvākṣāmā sindhavaśca svagūrtāḥ |
1,140.13 gavyaṃ yavyaṃ yanto dīrghāheṣaṃ varamaruṇyo varanta ||

1,141.01  baḻ itthā tadvapuṣe dhāyi darśataṃ devasya bhargaḥ sahaso yato jani |
1,141.01 yadīmupa hvarate sādhate matirṛtasya dhenā anayanta sasrutaḥ ||
1,141.02  pṛkṣo vapuḥ pitumānnitya ā śaye dvitīyamā saptaśivāsu mātṛṣu |
1,141.02 tṛtīyamasya vṛṣabhasya dohase daśapramatiṃ janayanta yoṣaṇaḥ ||
1,141.03  niryadīṃ budhnānmahiṣasya varpasa īśānāsaḥ śavasā kranta sūrayaḥ |
1,141.03 yadīmanu pradivo madhva ādhave guhā santaṃ mātariśvā mathāyati ||
1,141.04  pra yatpituḥ paramānnīyate paryā pṛkṣudho vīrudho daṃsu rohati |
1,141.04 ubhā yadasya januṣaṃ yadinvata ādidyaviṣṭho abhavadghṛṇā śuciḥ ||
1,141.05  ādinmātṝrāviśadyāsvā śucirahiṃsyamāna urviyā vi vāvṛdhe |
1,141.05 anu yatpūrvā aruhatsanājuvo ni navyasīṣvavarāsu dhāvate ||
1,141.06  ādiddhotāraṃ vṛṇate diviṣṭiṣu bhagamiva papṛcānāsa ṛñjate |
1,141.06 devānyatkratvā majmanā puruṣṭuto martaṃ śaṃsaṃ viśvadhā veti dhāyase ||
1,141.07  vi yadasthādyajato vātacodito hvāro na vakvā jaraṇā anākṛtaḥ |
1,141.07 tasya patmandakṣuṣaḥ kṛṣṇajaṃhasaḥ śucijanmano raja ā vyadhvanaḥ ||
1,141.08  ratho na yātaḥ śikvabhiḥ kṛto dyāmaṅgebhiraruṣebhirīyate |
1,141.08 ādasya te kṛṣṇāso dakṣi sūrayaḥ śūrasyeva tveṣathādīṣate vayaḥ ||
1,141.09  tvayā hyagne varuṇo dhṛtavrato mitraḥ śāśadre aryamā sudānavaḥ |
1,141.09 yatsīmanu kratunā viśvathā vibhurarānna nemiḥ paribhūrajāyathāḥ ||
1,141.10  tvamagne śaśamānāya sunvate ratnaṃ yaviṣṭha devatātiminvasi |
1,141.10 taṃ tvā nu navyaṃ sahaso yuvanvayaṃ bhagaṃ na kāre mahiratna dhīmahi ||
1,141.11  asme rayiṃ na svarthaṃ damūnasaṃ bhagaṃ dakṣaṃ na papṛcāsi dharṇasim |
1,141.11 raśmīṃriva yo yamati janmanī ubhe devānāṃ śaṃsamṛta ā ca sukratuḥ ||
1,141.12  uta naḥ sudyotmā jīrāśvo hotā mandraḥ śṛṇavaccandrarathaḥ |
1,141.12 sa no neṣanneṣatamairamūro'gnirvāmaṃ suvitaṃ vasyo accha ||
1,141.13  astāvyagniḥ śimīvadbhirarkaiḥ sāmrājyāya prataraṃ dadhānaḥ |
1,141.13 amī ca ye maghavāno vayaṃ ca mihaṃ na sūro ati niṣṭatanyuḥ ||

1,142.01  samiddho agna ā vaha devāṃ adya yatasruce |
1,142.01 tantuṃ tanuṣva pūrvyaṃ sutasomāya dāśuṣe ||
1,142.02  ghṛtavantamupa māsi madhumantaṃ tanūnapāt |
1,142.02 yajñaṃ viprasya māvataḥ śaśamānasya dāśuṣaḥ ||
1,142.03  śuciḥ pāvako adbhuto madhvā yajñaṃ mimikṣati |
1,142.03 narāśaṃsastrirā divo devo deveṣu yajñiyaḥ ||
1,142.04  īḻito agna ā vahendraṃ citramiha priyam |
1,142.04 iyaṃ hi tvā matirmamācchā sujihva vacyate ||
1,142.05  stṛṇānāso yatasruco barhiryajñe svadhvare |
1,142.05 vṛñje devavyacastamamindrāya śarma saprathaḥ ||
1,142.06  vi śrayantāmṛtāvṛdhaḥ prayai devebhyo mahīḥ |
1,142.06 pāvakāsaḥ puruspṛho dvāro devīrasaścataḥ ||
1,142.07  ā bhandamāne upāke naktoṣāsā supeśasā |
1,142.07 yahvī ṛtasya mātarā sīdatāṃ barhirā sumat ||
1,142.08  mandrajihvā jugurvaṇī hotārā daivyā kavī |
1,142.08 yajñaṃ no yakṣatāmimaṃ sidhramadya divispṛśam ||
1,142.09  śucirdeveṣvarpitā hotrā marutsu bhāratī |
1,142.09 iḻā sarasvatī mahī barhiḥ sīdantu yajñiyāḥ ||
1,142.10  tannasturīpamadbhutaṃ puru vāraṃ puru tmanā |
1,142.10 tvaṣṭā poṣāya vi ṣyatu rāye nābhā no asmayuḥ ||
1,142.11  avasṛjannupa tmanā devānyakṣi vanaspate |
1,142.11 agnirhavyā suṣūdati devo deveṣu medhiraḥ ||
1,142.12  pūṣaṇvate marutvate viśvadevāya vāyave |
1,142.12 svāhā gāyatravepase havyamindrāya kartana ||
1,142.13  svāhākṛtānyā gahyupa havyāni vītaye |
1,142.13 indrā gahi śrudhī havaṃ tvāṃ havante adhvare ||

1,143.01  pra tavyasīṃ navyasīṃ dhītimagnaye vāco matiṃ sahasaḥ sūnave bhare |
1,143.01 apāṃ napādyo vasubhiḥ saha priyo hotā pṛthivyāṃ nyasīdadṛtviyaḥ ||
1,143.02  sa jāyamānaḥ parame vyomanyāviragnirabhavanmātariśvane |
1,143.02 asya kratvā samidhānasya majmanā pra dyāvā śociḥ pṛthivī arocayat ||
1,143.03  asya tveṣā ajarā asya bhānavaḥ susaṃdṛśaḥ supratīkasya sudyutaḥ |
1,143.03 bhātvakṣaso atyakturna sindhavo'gne rejante asasanto ajarāḥ ||
1,143.04  yamerire bhṛgavo viśvavedasaṃ nābhā pṛthivyā bhuvanasya majmanā |
1,143.04 agniṃ taṃ gīrbhirhinuhi sva ā dame ya eko vasvo varuṇo na rājati ||
1,143.05  na yo varāya marutāmiva svanaḥ seneva sṛṣṭā divyā yathāśaniḥ |
1,143.05 agnirjambhaistigitairatti bharvati yodho na śatrūnsa vanā nyṛñjate ||
1,143.06  kuvinno agnirucathasya vīrasadvasuṣkuvidvasubhiḥ kāmamāvarat |
1,143.06 codaḥ kuvittutujyātsātaye dhiyaḥ śucipratīkaṃ tamayā dhiyā gṛṇe ||
1,143.07  ghṛtapratīkaṃ va ṛtasya dhūrṣadamagniṃ mitraṃ na samidhāna ṛñjate |
1,143.07 indhāno akro vidatheṣu dīdyacchukravarṇāmudu no yaṃsate dhiyam ||
1,143.08  aprayucchannaprayucchadbhiragne śivebhirnaḥ pāyubhiḥ pāhi śagmaiḥ |
1,143.08 adabdhebhiradṛpitebhiriṣṭe'nimiṣadbhiḥ pari pāhi no jāḥ ||

1,144.01  eti pra hotā vratamasya māyayordhvāṃ dadhānaḥ śucipeśasaṃ dhiyam |
1,144.01 abhi srucaḥ kramate dakṣiṇāvṛto yā asya dhāma prathamaṃ ha niṃsate ||
1,144.02  abhīmṛtasya dohanā anūṣata yonau devasya sadane parīvṛtāḥ |
1,144.02 apāmupasthe vibhṛto yadāvasadadha svadhā adhayadyābhirīyate ||
1,144.03  yuyūṣataḥ savayasā tadidvapuḥ samānamarthaṃ vitaritratā mithaḥ |
1,144.03 ādīṃ bhago na havyaḥ samasmadā voḻhurna raśmīnsamayaṃsta sārathiḥ ||
1,144.04  yamīṃ dvā savayasā saparyataḥ samāne yonā mithunā samokasā |
1,144.04 divā na naktaṃ palito yuvājani purū carannajaro mānuṣā yugā ||
1,144.05  tamīṃ hinvanti dhītayo daśa vriśo devaṃ martāsa ūtaye havāmahe |
1,144.05 dhanoradhi pravata ā sa ṛṇvatyabhivrajadbhirvayunā navādhita ||
1,144.06  tvaṃ hyagne divyasya rājasi tvaṃ pārthivasya paśupā iva tmanā |
1,144.06 enī ta ete bṛhatī abhiśriyā hiraṇyayī vakvarī barhirāśāte ||
1,144.07  agne juṣasva prati harya tadvaco mandra svadhāva ṛtajāta sukrato |
1,144.07 yo viśvataḥ pratyaṅṅasi darśato raṇvaḥ saṃdṛṣṭau pitumāṃ iva kṣayaḥ ||

1,145.01  taṃ pṛcchatā sa jagāmā sa veda sa cikitvāṃ īyate sā nvīyate |
1,145.01 tasminsanti praśiṣastasminniṣṭayaḥ sa vājasya śavasaḥ śuṣmiṇaspatiḥ ||
1,145.02  tamitpṛcchanti na simo vi pṛcchati sveneva dhīro manasā yadagrabhīt |
1,145.02 na mṛṣyate prathamaṃ nāparaṃ vaco'sya kratvā sacate apradṛpitaḥ ||
1,145.03  tamidgacchanti juhvastamarvatīrviśvānyekaḥ śṛṇavadvacāṃsi me |
1,145.03 purupraiṣastaturiryajñasādhano'cchidrotiḥ śiśurādatta saṃ rabhaḥ ||
1,145.04  upasthāyaṃ carati yatsamārata sadyo jātastatsāra yujyebhiḥ |
1,145.04 abhi śvāntaṃ mṛśate nāndye mude yadīṃ gacchantyuśatīrapiṣṭhitam ||
1,145.05  sa īṃ mṛgo apyo vanargurupa tvacyupamasyāṃ ni dhāyi |
1,145.05 vyabravīdvayunā martyebhyo'gnirvidvāṃ ṛtaciddhi satyaḥ ||

1,146.01  trimūrdhānaṃ saptaraśmiṃ gṛṇīṣe'nūnamagniṃ pitrorupasthe |
1,146.01 niṣattamasya carato dhruvasya viśvā divo rocanāpaprivāṃsam ||
1,146.02  ukṣā mahāṃ abhi vavakṣa ene ajarastasthāvitaūtirṛṣvaḥ |
1,146.02 urvyāḥ pado ni dadhāti sānau rihantyūdho aruṣāso asya ||
1,146.03  samānaṃ vatsamabhi saṃcarantī viṣvagdhenū vi carataḥ sumeke |
1,146.03 anapavṛjyāṃ adhvano mimāne viśvānketāṃ adhi maho dadhāne ||
1,146.04  dhīrāsaḥ padaṃ kavayo nayanti nānā hṛdā rakṣamāṇā ajuryam |
1,146.04 siṣāsantaḥ paryapaśyanta sindhumāvirebhyo abhavatsūryo nṝn ||
1,146.05  didṛkṣeṇyaḥ pari kāṣṭhāsu jenya īḻenyo maho arbhāya jīvase |
1,146.05 purutrā yadabhavatsūrahaibhyo garbhebhyo maghavā viśvadarśataḥ ||

1,147.01  kathā te agne śucayanta āyordadāśurvājebhirāśuṣāṇāḥ |
1,147.01 ubhe yattoke tanaye dadhānā ṛtasya sāmanraṇayanta devāḥ ||
1,147.02  bodhā me asya vacaso yaviṣṭha maṃhiṣṭhasya prabhṛtasya svadhāvaḥ |
1,147.02 pīyati tvo anu tvo gṛṇāti vandāruste tanvaṃ vande agne ||
1,147.03  ye pāyavo māmateyaṃ te agne paśyanto andhaṃ duritādarakṣan |
1,147.03 rarakṣa tānsukṛto viśvavedā dipsanta idripavo nāha debhuḥ ||
1,147.04  yo no agne ararivāṃ aghāyurarātīvā marcayati dvayena |
1,147.04 mantro guruḥ punarastu so asmā anu mṛkṣīṣṭa tanvaṃ duruktaiḥ ||
1,147.05  uta vā yaḥ sahasya pravidvānmarto martaṃ marcayati dvayena |
1,147.05 ataḥ pāhi stavamāna stuvantamagne mākirno duritāya dhāyīḥ ||

1,148.01  mathīdyadīṃ viṣṭo mātariśvā hotāraṃ viśvāpsuṃ viśvadevyam |
1,148.01 ni yaṃ dadhurmanuṣyāsu vikṣu svarṇa citraṃ vapuṣe vibhāvam ||
1,148.02  dadānaminna dadabhanta manmāgnirvarūthaṃ mama tasya cākan |
1,148.02 juṣanta viśvānyasya karmopastutiṃ bharamāṇasya kāroḥ ||
1,148.03  nitye cinnu yaṃ sadane jagṛbhre praśastibhirdadhire yajñiyāsaḥ |
1,148.03 pra sū nayanta gṛbhayanta iṣṭāvaśvāso na rathyo rārahāṇāḥ ||
1,148.04  purūṇi dasmo ni riṇāti jambhairādrocate vana ā vibhāvā |
1,148.04 ādasya vāto anu vāti śocirasturna śaryāmasanāmanu dyūn ||
1,148.05  na yaṃ ripavo na riṣaṇyavo garbhe santaṃ reṣaṇā reṣayanti |
1,148.05 andhā apaśyā na dabhannabhikhyā nityāsa īṃ pretāro arakṣan ||

1,149.01  mahaḥ sa rāya eṣate patirdannina inasya vasunaḥ pada ā |
1,149.01 upa dhrajantamadrayo vidhannit ||
1,149.02  sa yo vṛṣā narāṃ na rodasyoḥ śravobhirasti jīvapītasargaḥ |
1,149.02 pra yaḥ sasrāṇaḥ śiśrīta yonau ||
1,149.03  ā yaḥ puraṃ nārmiṇīmadīdedatyaḥ kavirnabhanyo nārvā |
1,149.03 sūro na rurukvāñchatātmā ||
1,149.04  abhi dvijanmā trī rocanāni viśvā rajāṃsi śuśucāno asthāt |
1,149.04 hotā yajiṣṭho apāṃ sadhasthe ||
1,149.05  ayaṃ sa hotā yo dvijanmā viśvā dadhe vāryāṇi śravasyā |
1,149.05 marto yo asmai sutuko dadāśa ||

1,150.01  puru tvā dāśvānvoce'riragne tava svidā |
1,150.01 todasyeva śaraṇa ā mahasya ||
1,150.02  vyaninasya dhaninaḥ prahoṣe cidararuṣaḥ |
1,150.02 kadā cana prajigato adevayoḥ ||
1,150.03  sa candro vipra martyo maho vrādhantamo divi |
1,150.03 praprette agne vanuṣaḥ syāma ||

1,151.01  mitraṃ na yaṃ śimyā goṣu gavyavaḥ svādhyo vidathe apsu jījanan |
1,151.01 arejetāṃ rodasī pājasā girā prati priyaṃ yajataṃ januṣāmavaḥ ||
1,151.02  yaddha tyadvāṃ purumīḻhasya sominaḥ pra mitrāso na dadhire svābhuvaḥ |
1,151.02 adha kratuṃ vidataṃ gātumarcata uta śrutaṃ vṛṣaṇā pastyāvataḥ ||
1,151.03  ā vāṃ bhūṣankṣitayo janma rodasyoḥ pravācyaṃ vṛṣaṇā dakṣase mahe |
1,151.03 yadīmṛtāya bharatho yadarvate pra hotrayā śimyā vītho adhvaram ||
1,151.04  pra sā kṣitirasura yā mahi priya ṛtāvānāvṛtamā ghoṣatho bṛhat |
1,151.04 yuvaṃ divo bṛhato dakṣamābhuvaṃ gāṃ na dhuryupa yuñjāthe apaḥ ||
1,151.05  mahī atra mahinā vāramṛṇvatho'reṇavastuja ā sadmandhenavaḥ |
1,151.05 svaranti tā uparatāti sūryamā nimruca uṣasastakvavīriva ||
1,151.06  ā vāmṛtāya keśinīranūṣata mitra yatra varuṇa gātumarcathaḥ |
1,151.06 ava tmanā sṛjataṃ pinvataṃ dhiyo yuvaṃ viprasya manmanāmirajyathaḥ ||
1,151.07  yo vāṃ yajñaiḥ śaśamāno ha dāśati kavirhotā yajati manmasādhanaḥ |
1,151.07 upāha taṃ gacchatho vītho adhvaramacchā giraḥ sumatiṃ gantamasmayū ||
1,151.08  yuvāṃ yajñaiḥ prathamā gobhirañjata ṛtāvānā manaso na prayuktiṣu |
1,151.08 bharanti vāṃ manmanā saṃyatā giro'dṛpyatā manasā revadāśāthe ||
1,151.09  revadvayo dadhāthe revadāśāthe narā māyābhiritaūti māhinam |
1,151.09 na vāṃ dyāvo'habhirnota sindhavo na devatvaṃ paṇayo nānaśurmagham ||

1,152.01  yuvaṃ vastrāṇi pīvasā vasāthe yuvoracchidrā mantavo ha sargāḥ |
1,152.01 avātiratamanṛtāni viśva ṛtena mitrāvaruṇā sacethe ||
1,152.02  etaccana tvo vi ciketadeṣāṃ satyo mantraḥ kaviśasta ṛghāvān |
1,152.02 triraśriṃ hanti caturaśrirugro devanido ha prathamā ajūryan ||
1,152.03  apādeti prathamā padvatīnāṃ kastadvāṃ mitrāvaruṇā ciketa |
1,152.03 garbho bhāraṃ bharatyā cidasya ṛtaṃ pipartyanṛtaṃ ni tārīt ||
1,152.04  prayantamitpari jāraṃ kanīnāṃ paśyāmasi nopanipadyamānam |
1,152.04 anavapṛgṇā vitatā vasānaṃ priyaṃ mitrasya varuṇasya dhāma ||
1,152.05  anaśvo jāto anabhīśurarvā kanikradatpatayadūrdhvasānuḥ |
1,152.05 acittaṃ brahma jujuṣuryuvānaḥ pra mitre dhāma varuṇe gṛṇantaḥ ||
1,152.06  ā dhenavo māmateyamavantīrbrahmapriyaṃ pīpayansasminnūdhan |
1,152.06 pitvo bhikṣeta vayunāni vidvānāsāvivāsannaditimuruṣyet ||
1,152.07  ā vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā havyajuṣṭiṃ namasā devāvavasā vavṛtyām |
1,152.07 asmākaṃ brahma pṛtanāsu sahyā asmākaṃ vṛṣṭirdivyā supārā ||

1,153.01  yajāmahe vāṃ mahaḥ sajoṣā havyebhirmitrāvaruṇā namobhiḥ |
1,153.01 ghṛtairghṛtasnū adha yadvāmasme adhvaryavo na dhītibhirbharanti ||
1,153.02  prastutirvāṃ dhāma na prayuktirayāmi mitrāvaruṇā suvṛktiḥ |
1,153.02 anakti yadvāṃ vidatheṣu hotā sumnaṃ vāṃ sūrirvṛṣaṇāviyakṣan ||
1,153.03  pīpāya dhenuraditirṛtāya janāya mitrāvaruṇā havirde |
1,153.03 hinoti yadvāṃ vidathe saparyansa rātahavyo mānuṣo na hotā ||
1,153.04  uta vāṃ vikṣu madyāsvandho gāva āpaśca pīpayanta devīḥ |
1,153.04 uto no asya pūrvyaḥ patirdanvītaṃ pātaṃ payasa usriyāyāḥ ||

1,154.01  viṣṇornu kaṃ vīryāṇi pra vocaṃ yaḥ pārthivāni vimame rajāṃsi |
1,154.01 yo askabhāyaduttaraṃ sadhasthaṃ vicakramāṇastredhorugāyaḥ ||
1,154.02  pra tadviṣṇu stavate vīryeṇa mṛgo na bhīmaḥ kucaro giriṣṭhāḥ |
1,154.02 yasyoruṣu triṣu vikramaṇeṣvadhikṣiyanti bhuvanāni viśvā ||
1,154.03  pra viṣṇave śūṣametu manma girikṣita urugāyāya vṛṣṇe |
1,154.03 ya idaṃ dīrghaṃ prayataṃ sadhasthameko vimame tribhiritpadebhiḥ ||
1,154.04  yasya trī pūrṇā madhunā padānyakṣīyamāṇā svadhayā madanti |
1,154.04 ya u tridhātu pṛthivīmuta dyāmeko dādhāra bhuvanāni viśvā ||
1,154.05  tadasya priyamabhi pātho aśyāṃ naro yatra devayavo madanti |
1,154.05 urukramasya sa hi bandhuritthā viṣṇoḥ pade parame madhva utsaḥ ||
1,154.06  tā vāṃ vāstūnyuśmasi gamadhyai yatra gāvo bhūriśṛṅgā ayāsaḥ |
1,154.06 atrāha tadurugāyasya vṛṣṇaḥ paramaṃ padamava bhāti bhūri ||

1,155.01  pra vaḥ pāntamandhaso dhiyāyate mahe śūrāya viṣṇave cārcata |
1,155.01 yā sānuni parvatānāmadābhyā mahastasthaturarvateva sādhunā ||
1,155.02  tveṣamitthā samaraṇaṃ śimīvatorindrāviṣṇū sutapā vāmuruṣyati |
1,155.02 yā martyāya pratidhīyamānamitkṛśānorasturasanāmuruṣyathaḥ ||
1,155.03  tā īṃ vardhanti mahyasya pauṃsyaṃ ni mātarā nayati retase bhuje |
1,155.03 dadhāti putro'varaṃ paraṃ piturnāma tṛtīyamadhi rocane divaḥ ||
1,155.04  tattadidasya pauṃsyaṃ gṛṇīmasīnasya trāturavṛkasya mīḻhuṣaḥ |
1,155.04 yaḥ pārthivāni tribhiridvigāmabhiruru kramiṣṭorugāyāya jīvase ||
1,155.05  dve idasya kramaṇe svardṛśo'bhikhyāya martyo bhuraṇyati |
1,155.05 tṛtīyamasya nakirā dadharṣati vayaścana patayantaḥ patatriṇaḥ ||
1,155.06  caturbhiḥ sākaṃ navatiṃ ca nāmabhiścakraṃ na vṛttaṃ vyatīṃravīvipat |
1,155.06 bṛhaccharīro vimimāna ṛkvabhiryuvākumāraḥ pratyetyāhavam ||

1,156.01  bhavā mitro na śevyo ghṛtāsutirvibhūtadyumna evayā u saprathāḥ |
1,156.01 adhā te viṣṇo viduṣā cidardhya stomo yajñaśca rādhyo haviṣmatā ||
1,156.02  yaḥ pūrvyāya vedhase navīyase sumajjānaye viṣṇave dadāśati |
1,156.02 yo jātamasya mahato mahi bravatsedu śravobhiryujyaṃ cidabhyasat ||
1,156.03  tamu stotāraḥ pūrvyaṃ yathā vida ṛtasya garbhaṃ januṣā pipartana |
1,156.03 āsya jānanto nāma cidvivaktana mahaste viṣṇo sumatiṃ bhajāmahe ||
1,156.04  tamasya rājā varuṇastamaśvinā kratuṃ sacanta mārutasya vedhasaḥ |
1,156.04 dādhāra dakṣamuttamamaharvidaṃ vrajaṃ ca viṣṇuḥ sakhivāṃ aporṇute ||
1,156.05  ā yo vivāya sacathāya daivya indrāya viṣṇuḥ sukṛte sukṛttaraḥ |
1,156.05 vedhā ajinvattriṣadhastha āryamṛtasya bhāge yajamānamābhajat ||

1,157.01  abodhyagnirjma udeti sūryo vyuṣāścandrā mahyāvo arciṣā |
1,157.01 āyukṣātāmaśvinā yātave rathaṃ prāsāvīddevaḥ savitā jagatpṛthak ||
1,157.02  yadyuñjāthe vṛṣaṇamaśvinā rathaṃ ghṛtena no madhunā kṣatramukṣatam |
1,157.02 asmākaṃ brahma pṛtanāsu jinvataṃ vayaṃ dhanā śūrasātā bhajemahi ||
1,157.03  arvāṅtricakro madhuvāhano ratho jīrāśvo aśvinoryātu suṣṭutaḥ |
1,157.03 trivandhuro maghavā viśvasaubhagaḥ śaṃ na ā vakṣaddvipade catuṣpade ||
1,157.04  ā na ūrjaṃ vahatamaśvinā yuvaṃ madhumatyā naḥ kaśayā mimikṣatam |
1,157.04 prāyustāriṣṭaṃ nī rapāṃsi mṛkṣataṃ sedhataṃ dveṣo bhavataṃ sacābhuvā ||
1,157.05  yuvaṃ ha garbhaṃ jagatīṣu dhattho yuvaṃ viśveṣu bhuvaneṣvantaḥ |
1,157.05 yuvamagniṃ ca vṛṣaṇāvapaśca vanaspatīṃraśvināvairayethām ||
1,157.06  yuvaṃ ha stho bhiṣajā bheṣajebhiratho ha stho rathyā rāthyebhiḥ |
1,157.06 atho ha kṣatramadhi dhattha ugrā yo vāṃ haviṣmānmanasā dadāśa ||

1,158.01  vasū rudrā purumantū vṛdhantā daśasyataṃ no vṛṣaṇāvabhiṣṭau |
1,158.01 dasrā ha yadrekṇa aucathyo vāṃ pra yatsasrāthe akavābhirūtī ||
1,158.02  ko vāṃ dāśatsumataye cidasyai vasū yaddhethe namasā pade goḥ |
1,158.02 jigṛtamasme revatīḥ purandhīḥ kāmapreṇeva manasā carantā ||
1,158.03  yukto ha yadvāṃ taugryāya perurvi madhye arṇaso dhāyi pajraḥ |
1,158.03 upa vāmavaḥ śaraṇaṃ gameyaṃ śūro nājma patayadbhirevaiḥ ||
1,158.04  upastutiraucathyamuruṣyenmā māmime patatriṇī vi dugdhām |
1,158.04 mā māmedho daśatayaścito dhākpra yadvāṃ baddhastmani khādati kṣām ||
1,158.05  na mā garannadyo mātṛtamā dāsā yadīṃ susamubdhamavādhuḥ |
1,158.05 śiro yadasya traitano vitakṣatsvayaṃ dāsa uro aṃsāvapi gdha ||
1,158.06  dīrghatamā māmateyo jujurvāndaśame yuge |
1,158.06 apāmarthaṃ yatīnāṃ brahmā bhavati sārathiḥ ||

1,159.01  pra dyāvā yajñaiḥ pṛthivī ṛtāvṛdhā mahī stuṣe vidatheṣu pracetasā |
1,159.01 devebhirye devaputre sudaṃsasetthā dhiyā vāryāṇi prabhūṣataḥ ||
1,159.02  uta manye pituradruho mano māturmahi svatavastaddhavīmabhiḥ |
1,159.02 suretasā pitarā bhūma cakratururu prajāyā amṛtaṃ varīmabhiḥ ||
1,159.03  te sūnavaḥ svapasaḥ sudaṃsaso mahī jajñurmātarā pūrvacittaye |
1,159.03 sthātuśca satyaṃ jagataśca dharmaṇi putrasya pāthaḥ padamadvayāvinaḥ ||
1,159.04  te māyino mamire supracetaso jāmī sayonī mithunā samokasā |
1,159.04 navyaṃnavyaṃ tantumā tanvate divi samudre antaḥ kavayaḥ sudītayaḥ ||
1,159.05  tadrādho adya saviturvareṇyaṃ vayaṃ devasya prasave manāmahe |
1,159.05 asmabhyaṃ dyāvāpṛthivī sucetunā rayiṃ dhattaṃ vasumantaṃ śatagvinam ||

1,160.01  te hi dyāvāpṛthivī viśvaśambhuva ṛtāvarī rajaso dhārayatkavī |
1,160.01 sujanmanī dhiṣaṇe antarīyate devo devī dharmaṇā sūryaḥ śuciḥ ||
1,160.02  uruvyacasā mahinī asaścatā pitā mātā ca bhuvanāni rakṣataḥ |
1,160.02 sudhṛṣṭame vapuṣye na rodasī pitā yatsīmabhi rūpairavāsayat ||
1,160.03  sa vahniḥ putraḥ pitroḥ pavitravānpunāti dhīro bhuvanāni māyayā |
1,160.03 dhenuṃ ca pṛśniṃ vṛṣabhaṃ suretasaṃ viśvāhā śukraṃ payo asya dukṣata ||
1,160.04  ayaṃ devānāmapasāmapastamo yo jajāna rodasī viśvaśambhuvā |
1,160.04 vi yo mame rajasī sukratūyayājarebhi skambhanebhiḥ samānṛce ||
1,160.05  te no gṛṇāne mahinī mahi śravaḥ kṣatraṃ dyāvāpṛthivī dhāsatho bṛhat |
1,160.05 yenābhi kṛṣṭīstatanāma viśvahā panāyyamojo asme saminvatam ||

1,161.01  kimu śreṣṭhaḥ kiṃ yaviṣṭho na ājagankimīyate dūtyaṃ kadyadūcima |
1,161.01 na nindima camasaṃ yo mahākulo'gne bhrātardruṇa idbhūtimūdima ||
1,161.02  ekaṃ camasaṃ caturaḥ kṛṇotana tadvo devā abruvantadva āgamam |
1,161.02 saudhanvanā yadyevā kariṣyatha sākaṃ devairyajñiyāso bhaviṣyatha ||
1,161.03  agniṃ dūtaṃ prati yadabravītanāśvaḥ kartvo ratha uteha kartvaḥ |
1,161.03 dhenuḥ kartvā yuvaśā kartvā dvā tāni bhrātaranu vaḥ kṛtvyemasi ||
1,161.04  cakṛvāṃsa ṛbhavastadapṛcchata kvedabhūdyaḥ sya dūto na ājagan |
1,161.04 yadāvākhyaccamasāñcaturaḥ kṛtānādittvaṣṭā gnāsvantarnyānaje ||
1,161.05  hanāmaināṃ iti tvaṣṭā yadabravīccamasaṃ ye devapānamanindiṣuḥ |
1,161.05 anyā nāmāni kṛṇvate sute sacāṃ anyairenānkanyā nāmabhi sparat ||
1,161.06  indro harī yuyuje aśvinā rathaṃ bṛhaspatirviśvarūpāmupājata |
1,161.06 ṛbhurvibhvā vājo devāṃ agacchata svapaso yajñiyaṃ bhāgamaitana ||
1,161.07  niścarmaṇo gāmariṇīta dhītibhiryā jarantā yuvaśā tākṛṇotana |
1,161.07 saudhanvanā aśvādaśvamatakṣata yuktvā rathamupa devāṃ ayātana ||
1,161.08  idamudakaṃ pibatetyabravītanedaṃ vā ghā pibatā muñjanejanam |
1,161.08 saudhanvanā yadi tanneva haryatha tṛtīye ghā savane mādayādhvai ||
1,161.09  āpo bhūyiṣṭhā ityeko abravīdagnirbhūyiṣṭha ityanyo abravīt |
1,161.09 vadharyantīṃ bahubhyaḥ praiko abravīdṛtā vadantaścamasāṃ apiṃśata ||
1,161.10  śroṇāmeka udakaṃ gāmavājati māṃsamekaḥ piṃśati sūnayābhṛtam |
1,161.10 ā nimrucaḥ śakṛdeko apābharatkiṃ svitputrebhyaḥ pitarā upāvatuḥ ||
1,161.11  udvatsvasmā akṛṇotanā tṛṇaṃ nivatsvapaḥ svapasyayā naraḥ |
1,161.11 agohyasya yadasastanā gṛhe tadadyedamṛbhavo nānu gacchatha ||
1,161.12  sammīlya yadbhuvanā paryasarpata kva svittātyā pitarā va āsatuḥ |
1,161.12 aśapata yaḥ karasnaṃ va ādade yaḥ prābravītpro tasmā abravītana ||
1,161.13  suṣupvāṃsa ṛbhavastadapṛcchatāgohya ka idaṃ no abūbudhat |
1,161.13 śvānaṃ basto bodhayitāramabravītsaṃvatsara idamadyā vyakhyata ||
1,161.14  divā yānti maruto bhūmyāgnirayaṃ vāto antarikṣeṇa yāti |
1,161.14 adbhiryāti varuṇaḥ samudrairyuṣmāṃ icchantaḥ śavaso napātaḥ ||

1,162.01  mā no mitro varuṇo aryamāyurindra ṛbhukṣā marutaḥ pari khyan |
1,162.01 yadvājino devajātasya sapteḥ pravakṣyāmo vidathe vīryāṇi ||
1,162.02  yannirṇijā rekṇasā prāvṛtasya rātiṃ gṛbhītāṃ mukhato nayanti |
1,162.02 suprāṅajo memyadviśvarūpa indrāpūṣṇoḥ priyamapyeti pāthaḥ ||
1,162.03  eṣa cchāgaḥ puro aśvena vājinā pūṣṇo bhāgo nīyate viśvadevyaḥ |
1,162.03 abhipriyaṃ yatpuroḻāśamarvatā tvaṣṭedenaṃ sauśravasāya jinvati ||
1,162.04  yaddhaviṣyamṛtuśo devayānaṃ trirmānuṣāḥ paryaśvaṃ nayanti |
1,162.04 atrā pūṣṇaḥ prathamo bhāga eti yajñaṃ devebhyaḥ prativedayannajaḥ ||
1,162.05  hotādhvaryurāvayā agnimindho grāvagrābha uta śaṃstā suvipraḥ |
1,162.05 tena yajñena svaraṅkṛtena sviṣṭena vakṣaṇā ā pṛṇadhvam ||
1,162.06  yūpavraskā uta ye yūpavāhāścaṣālaṃ ye aśvayūpāya takṣati |
1,162.06 ye cārvate pacanaṃ sambharantyuto teṣāmabhigūrtirna invatu ||
1,162.07  upa prāgātsumanme'dhāyi manma devānāmāśā upa vītapṛṣṭhaḥ |
1,162.07 anvenaṃ viprā ṛṣayo madanti devānāṃ puṣṭe cakṛmā subandhum ||
1,162.08  yadvājino dāma saṃdānamarvato yā śīrṣaṇyā raśanā rajjurasya |
1,162.08 yadvā ghāsya prabhṛtamāsye tṛṇaṃ sarvā tā te api deveṣvastu ||
1,162.09  yadaśvasya kraviṣo makṣikāśa yadvā svarau svadhitau riptamasti |
1,162.09 yaddhastayoḥ śamituryannakheṣu sarvā tā te api deveṣvastu ||
1,162.10  yadūvadhyamudarasyāpavāti ya āmasya kraviṣo gandho asti |
1,162.10 sukṛtā tacchamitāraḥ kṛṇvantūta medhaṃ śṛtapākaṃ pacantu ||
1,162.11  yatte gātrādagninā pacyamānādabhi śūlaṃ nihatasyāvadhāvati |
1,162.11 mā tadbhūmyāmā śriṣanmā tṛṇeṣu devebhyastaduśadbhyo rātamastu ||
1,162.12  ye vājinaṃ paripaśyanti pakvaṃ ya īmāhuḥ surabhirnirhareti |
1,162.12 ye cārvato māṃsabhikṣāmupāsata uto teṣāmabhigūrtirna invatu ||
1,162.13  yannīkṣaṇaṃ māṃspacanyā ukhāyā yā pātrāṇi yūṣṇa āsecanāni |
1,162.13 ūṣmaṇyāpidhānā carūṇāmaṅkāḥ sūnāḥ pari bhūṣantyaśvam ||
1,162.14  nikramaṇaṃ niṣadanaṃ vivartanaṃ yacca paḍbīśamarvataḥ |
1,162.14 yacca papau yacca ghāsiṃ jaghāsa sarvā tā te api deveṣvastu ||
1,162.15  mā tvāgnirdhvanayīddhūmagandhirmokhā bhrājantyabhi vikta jaghriḥ |
1,162.15 iṣṭaṃ vītamabhigūrtaṃ vaṣaṭkṛtaṃ taṃ devāsaḥ prati gṛbhṇantyaśvam ||
1,162.16  yadaśvāya vāsa upastṛṇantyadhīvāsaṃ yā hiraṇyānyasmai |
1,162.16 saṃdānamarvantaṃ paḍbīśaṃ priyā deveṣvā yāmayanti ||
1,162.17  yatte sāde mahasā śūkṛtasya pārṣṇyā vā kaśayā vā tutoda |
1,162.17 sruceva tā haviṣo adhvareṣu sarvā tā te brahmaṇā sūdayāmi ||
1,162.18  catustriṃśadvājino devabandhorvaṅkrīraśvasya svadhitiḥ sameti |
1,162.18 acchidrā gātrā vayunā kṛṇota paruṣparuranughuṣyā vi śasta ||
1,162.19  ekastvaṣṭuraśvasyā viśastā dvā yantārā bhavatastatha ṛtuḥ |
1,162.19 yā te gātrāṇāmṛtuthā kṛṇomi tātā piṇḍānāṃ pra juhomyagnau ||
1,162.20  mā tvā tapatpriya ātmāpiyantaṃ mā svadhitistanva ā tiṣṭhipatte |
1,162.20 mā te gṛdhnuraviśastātihāya chidrā gātrāṇyasinā mithū kaḥ ||
1,162.21  na vā u etanmriyase na riṣyasi devāṃ ideṣi pathibhiḥ sugebhiḥ |
1,162.21 harī te yuñjā pṛṣatī abhūtāmupāsthādvājī dhuri rāsabhasya ||
1,162.22  sugavyaṃ no vājī svaśvyaṃ puṃsaḥ putrāṃ uta viśvāpuṣaṃ rayim |
1,162.22 anāgāstvaṃ no aditiḥ kṛṇotu kṣatraṃ no aśvo vanatāṃ haviṣmān ||

1,163.01  yadakrandaḥ prathamaṃ jāyamāna udyansamudrāduta vā purīṣāt |
1,163.01 śyenasya pakṣā hariṇasya bāhū upastutyaṃ mahi jātaṃ te arvan ||
1,163.02  yamena dattaṃ trita enamāyunagindra eṇaṃ prathamo adhyatiṣṭhat |
1,163.02 gandharvo asya raśanāmagṛbhṇātsūrādaśvaṃ vasavo nirataṣṭa ||
1,163.03  asi yamo asyādityo arvannasi trito guhyena vratena |
1,163.03 asi somena samayā vipṛkta āhuste trīṇi divi bandhanāni ||
1,163.04  trīṇi ta āhurdivi bandhanāni trīṇyapsu trīṇyantaḥ samudre |
1,163.04 uteva me varuṇaśchantsyarvanyatrā ta āhuḥ paramaṃ janitram ||
1,163.05  imā te vājinnavamārjanānīmā śaphānāṃ saniturnidhānā |
1,163.05 atrā te bhadrā raśanā apaśyamṛtasya yā abhirakṣanti gopāḥ ||
1,163.06  ātmānaṃ te manasārādajānāmavo divā patayantaṃ pataṅgam |
1,163.06 śiro apaśyaṃ pathibhiḥ sugebhirareṇubhirjehamānaṃ patatri ||
1,163.07  atrā te rūpamuttamamapaśyaṃ jigīṣamāṇamiṣa ā pade goḥ |
1,163.07 yadā te marto anu bhogamānaḻ ādidgrasiṣṭha oṣadhīrajīgaḥ ||
1,163.08  anu tvā ratho anu maryo arvannanu gāvo'nu bhagaḥ kanīnām |
1,163.08 anu vrātāsastava sakhyamīyuranu devā mamire vīryaṃ te ||
1,163.09  hiraṇyaśṛṅgo'yo asya pādā manojavā avara indra āsīt |
1,163.09 devā idasya haviradyamāyanyo arvantaṃ prathamo adhyatiṣṭhat ||
1,163.10  īrmāntāsaḥ silikamadhyamāsaḥ saṃ śūraṇāso divyāso atyāḥ |
1,163.10 haṃsā iva śreṇiśo yatante yadākṣiṣurdivyamajmamaśvāḥ ||
1,163.11  tava śarīraṃ patayiṣṇvarvantava cittaṃ vāta iva dhrajīmān |
1,163.11 tava śṛṅgāṇi viṣṭhitā purutrāraṇyeṣu jarbhurāṇā caranti ||
1,163.12  upa prāgācchasanaṃ vājyarvā devadrīcā manasā dīdhyānaḥ |
1,163.12 ajaḥ puro nīyate nābhirasyānu paścātkavayo yanti rebhāḥ ||
1,163.13  upa prāgātparamaṃ yatsadhasthamarvāṃ acchā pitaraṃ mātaraṃ ca |
1,163.13 adyā devāñjuṣṭatamo hi gamyā athā śāste dāśuṣe vāryāṇi ||

1,164.01  asya vāmasya palitasya hotustasya bhrātā madhyamo astyaśnaḥ |
1,164.01 tṛtīyo bhrātā ghṛtapṛṣṭho asyātrāpaśyaṃ viśpatiṃ saptaputram ||
1,164.02  sapta yuñjanti rathamekacakrameko aśvo vahati saptanāmā |
1,164.02 trinābhi cakramajaramanarvaṃ yatremā viśvā bhuvanādhi tasthuḥ ||
1,164.03  imaṃ rathamadhi ye sapta tasthuḥ saptacakraṃ sapta vahantyaśvāḥ |
1,164.03 sapta svasāro abhi saṃ navante yatra gavāṃ nihitā sapta nāma ||
1,164.04  ko dadarśa prathamaṃ jāyamānamasthanvantaṃ yadanasthā bibharti |
1,164.04 bhūmyā asurasṛgātmā kva svitko vidvāṃsamupa gātpraṣṭumetat ||
1,164.05  pākaḥ pṛcchāmi manasāvijānandevānāmenā nihitā padāni |
1,164.05 vatse baṣkaye'dhi sapta tantūnvi tatnire kavaya otavā u ||
1,164.06  acikitvāñcikituṣaścidatra kavīnpṛcchāmi vidmane na vidvān |
1,164.06 vi yastastambha ṣaḻ imā rajāṃsyajasya rūpe kimapi svidekam ||
1,164.07  iha bravītu ya īmaṅga vedāsya vāmasya nihitaṃ padaṃ veḥ |
1,164.07 śīrṣṇaḥ kṣīraṃ duhrate gāvo asya vavriṃ vasānā udakaṃ padāpuḥ ||
1,164.08  mātā pitaramṛta ā babhāja dhītyagre manasā saṃ hi jagme |
1,164.08 sā bībhatsurgarbharasā nividdhā namasvanta idupavākamīyuḥ ||
1,164.09  yuktā mātāsīddhuri dakṣiṇāyā atiṣṭhadgarbho vṛjanīṣvantaḥ |
1,164.09 amīmedvatso anu gāmapaśyadviśvarūpyaṃ triṣu yojaneṣu ||
1,164.10  tisro mātṝstrīnpitṝnbibhradeka ūrdhvastasthau nemava glāpayanti |
1,164.10 mantrayante divo amuṣya pṛṣṭhe viśvavidaṃ vācamaviśvaminvām ||
1,164.11  dvādaśāraṃ nahi tajjarāya varvarti cakraṃ pari dyāmṛtasya |
1,164.11 ā putrā agne mithunāso atra sapta śatāni viṃśatiśca tasthuḥ ||
1,164.12  pañcapādaṃ pitaraṃ dvādaśākṛtiṃ diva āhuḥ pare ardhe purīṣiṇam |
1,164.12 atheme anya upare vicakṣaṇaṃ saptacakre ṣaḻara āhurarpitam ||
1,164.13  pañcāre cakre parivartamāne tasminnā tasthurbhuvanāni viśvā |
1,164.13 tasya nākṣastapyate bhūribhāraḥ sanādeva na śīryate sanābhiḥ ||
1,164.14  sanemi cakramajaraṃ vi vāvṛta uttānāyāṃ daśa yuktā vahanti |
1,164.14 sūryasya cakṣū rajasaityāvṛtaṃ tasminnārpitā bhuvanāni viśvā ||
1,164.15  sākañjānāṃ saptathamāhurekajaṃ ṣaḻ idyamā ṛṣayo devajā iti |
1,164.15 teṣāmiṣṭāni vihitāni dhāmaśa sthātre rejante vikṛtāni rūpaśaḥ ||
1,164.16  striyaḥ satīstāṃ u me puṃsa āhuḥ paśyadakṣaṇvānna vi cetadandhaḥ |
1,164.16 kaviryaḥ putraḥ sa īmā ciketa yastā vijānātsa pituṣpitāsat ||
1,164.17  avaḥ pareṇa para enāvareṇa padā vatsaṃ bibhratī gaurudasthāt |
1,164.17 sā kadrīcī kaṃ svidardhaṃ parāgātkva svitsūte nahi yūthe antaḥ ||
1,164.18  avaḥ pareṇa pitaraṃ yo asyānuveda para enāvareṇa |
1,164.18 kavīyamānaḥ ka iha pra vocaddevaṃ manaḥ kuto adhi prajātam ||
1,164.19  ye arvāñcastāṃ u parāca āhurye parāñcastāṃ u arvāca āhuḥ |
1,164.19 indraśca yā cakrathuḥ soma tāni dhurā na yuktā rajaso vahanti ||
1,164.20  dvā suparṇā sayujā sakhāyā samānaṃ vṛkṣaṃ pari ṣasvajāte |
1,164.20 tayoranyaḥ pippalaṃ svādvattyanaśnannanyo abhi cākaśīti ||
1,164.21  yatrā suparṇā amṛtasya bhāgamanimeṣaṃ vidathābhisvaranti |
1,164.21 ino viśvasya bhuvanasya gopāḥ sa mā dhīraḥ pākamatrā viveśa ||
1,164.22  yasminvṛkṣe madhvadaḥ suparṇā niviśante suvate cādhi viśve |
1,164.22 tasyedāhuḥ pippalaṃ svādvagre tannonnaśadyaḥ pitaraṃ na veda ||
1,164.23  yadgāyatre adhi gāyatramāhitaṃ traiṣṭubhādvā traiṣṭubhaṃ niratakṣata |
1,164.23 yadvā jagajjagatyāhitaṃ padaṃ ya ittadviduste amṛtatvamānaśuḥ ||
1,164.24  gāyatreṇa prati mimīte arkamarkeṇa sāma traiṣṭubhena vākam |
1,164.24 vākena vākaṃ dvipadā catuṣpadākṣareṇa mimate sapta vāṇīḥ ||
1,164.25  jagatā sindhuṃ divyastabhāyadrathantare sūryaṃ paryapaśyat |
1,164.25 gāyatrasya samidhastisra āhustato mahnā pra ririce mahitvā ||
1,164.26  upa hvaye sudughāṃ dhenumetāṃ suhasto godhuguta dohadenām |
1,164.26 śreṣṭhaṃ savaṃ savitā sāviṣanno'bhīddho gharmastadu ṣu pra vocam ||
1,164.27  hiṅkṛṇvatī vasupatnī vasūnāṃ vatsamicchantī manasābhyāgāt |
1,164.27 duhāmaśvibhyāṃ payo aghnyeyaṃ sā vardhatāṃ mahate saubhagāya ||
1,164.28  gauramīmedanu vatsaṃ miṣantaṃ mūrdhānaṃ hiṅṅakṛṇonmātavā u |
1,164.28 sṛkvāṇaṃ gharmamabhi vāvaśānā mimāti māyuṃ payate payobhiḥ ||
1,164.29  ayaṃ sa śiṅkte yena gaurabhīvṛtā mimāti māyuṃ dhvasanāvadhi śritā |
1,164.29 sā cittibhirni hi cakāra martyaṃ vidyudbhavantī prati vavrimauhata ||
1,164.30  anacchaye turagātu jīvamejaddhruvaṃ madhya ā pastyānām |
1,164.30 jīvo mṛtasya carati svadhābhiramartyo martyenā sayoniḥ ||
1,164.31  apaśyaṃ gopāmanipadyamānamā ca parā ca pathibhiścarantam |
1,164.31 sa sadhrīcīḥ sa viṣūcīrvasāna ā varīvarti bhuvaneṣvantaḥ ||
1,164.32  ya īṃ cakāra na so asya veda ya īṃ dadarśa hiruginnu tasmāt |
1,164.32 sa māturyonā parivīto antarbahuprajā nirṛtimā viveśa ||
1,164.33  dyaurme pitā janitā nābhiratra bandhurme mātā pṛthivī mahīyam |
1,164.33 uttānayoścamvoryonirantaratrā pitā duhiturgarbhamādhāt ||
1,164.34  pṛcchāmi tvā paramantaṃ pṛthivyāḥ pṛcchāmi yatra bhuvanasya nābhiḥ |
1,164.34 pṛcchāmi tvā vṛṣṇo aśvasya retaḥ pṛcchāmi vācaḥ paramaṃ vyoma ||
1,164.35  iyaṃ vediḥ paro antaḥ pṛthivyā ayaṃ yajño bhuvanasya nābhiḥ |
1,164.35 ayaṃ somo vṛṣṇo aśvasya reto brahmāyaṃ vācaḥ paramaṃ vyoma ||
1,164.36  saptārdhagarbhā bhuvanasya reto viṣṇostiṣṭhanti pradiśā vidharmaṇi |
1,164.36 te dhītibhirmanasā te vipaścitaḥ paribhuvaḥ pari bhavanti viśvataḥ ||
1,164.37  na vi jānāmi yadivedamasmi niṇyaḥ saṃnaddho manasā carāmi |
1,164.37 yadā māganprathamajā ṛtasyādidvāco aśnuve bhāgamasyāḥ ||
1,164.38  apāṅprāṅeti svadhayā gṛbhīto'martyo martyenā sayoniḥ |
1,164.38 tā śaśvantā viṣūcīnā viyantā nyanyaṃ cikyurna ni cikyuranyam ||
1,164.39  ṛco akṣare parame vyomanyasmindevā adhi viśve niṣeduḥ |
1,164.39 yastanna veda kimṛcā kariṣyati ya ittadvidusta ime samāsate ||
1,164.40  sūyavasādbhagavatī hi bhūyā atho vayaṃ bhagavantaḥ syāma |
1,164.40 addhi tṛṇamaghnye viśvadānīṃ piba śuddhamudakamācarantī ||
1,164.41  gaurīrmimāya salilāni takṣatyekapadī dvipadī sā catuṣpadī |
1,164.41 aṣṭāpadī navapadī babhūvuṣī sahasrākṣarā parame vyoman ||
1,164.42  tasyāḥ samudrā adhi vi kṣaranti tena jīvanti pradiśaścatasraḥ |
1,164.42 tataḥ kṣaratyakṣaraṃ tadviśvamupa jīvati ||
1,164.43  śakamayaṃ dhūmamārādapaśyaṃ viṣūvatā para enāvareṇa |
1,164.43 ukṣāṇaṃ pṛśnimapacanta vīrāstāni dharmāṇi prathamānyāsan ||
1,164.44  trayaḥ keśina ṛtuthā vi cakṣate saṃvatsare vapata eka eṣām |
1,164.44 viśvameko abhi caṣṭe śacībhirdhrājirekasya dadṛśe na rūpam ||
1,164.45  catvāri vākparimitā padāni tāni vidurbrāhmaṇā ye manīṣiṇaḥ |
1,164.45 guhā trīṇi nihitā neṅgayanti turīyaṃ vāco manuṣyā vadanti ||
1,164.46  indraṃ mitraṃ varuṇamagnimāhuratho divyaḥ sa suparṇo garutmān |
1,164.46 ekaṃ sadviprā bahudhā vadantyagniṃ yamaṃ mātariśvānamāhuḥ ||
1,164.47  kṛṣṇaṃ niyānaṃ harayaḥ suparṇā apo vasānā divamutpatanti |
1,164.47 ta āvavṛtransadanādṛtasyādidghṛtena pṛthivī vyudyate ||
1,164.48  dvādaśa pradhayaścakramekaṃ trīṇi nabhyāni ka u tacciketa |
1,164.48 tasminsākaṃ triśatā na śaṅkavo'rpitāḥ ṣaṣṭirna calācalāsaḥ ||
1,164.49  yaste stanaḥ śaśayo yo mayobhūryena viśvā puṣyasi vāryāṇi |
1,164.49 yo ratnadhā vasuvidyaḥ sudatraḥ sarasvati tamiha dhātave kaḥ ||
1,164.50  yajñena yajñamayajanta devāstāni dharmāṇi prathamānyāsan |
1,164.50 te ha nākaṃ mahimānaḥ sacanta yatra pūrve sādhyāḥ santi devāḥ ||
1,164.51  samānametadudakamuccaityava cāhabhiḥ |
1,164.51 bhūmiṃ parjanyā jinvanti divaṃ jinvantyagnayaḥ ||
1,164.52  divyaṃ suparṇaṃ vāyasaṃ bṛhantamapāṃ garbhaṃ darśatamoṣadhīnām |
1,164.52 abhīpato vṛṣṭibhistarpayantaṃ sarasvantamavase johavīmi ||

1,165.01  kayā śubhā savayasaḥ sanīḻāḥ samānyā marutaḥ saṃ mimikṣuḥ |
1,165.01 kayā matī kuta etāsa ete'rcanti śuṣmaṃ vṛṣaṇo vasūyā ||
1,165.02  kasya brahmāṇi jujuṣuryuvānaḥ ko adhvare maruta ā vavarta |
1,165.02 śyenāṃ iva dhrajato antarikṣe kena mahā manasā rīramāma ||
1,165.03  kutastvamindra māhinaḥ sanneko yāsi satpate kiṃ ta itthā |
1,165.03 saṃ pṛcchase samarāṇaḥ śubhānairvocestanno harivo yatte asme ||
1,165.04  brahmāṇi me matayaḥ śaṃ sutāsaḥ śuṣma iyarti prabhṛto me adriḥ |
1,165.04 ā śāsate prati haryantyukthemā harī vahatastā no accha ||
1,165.05  ato vayamantamebhiryujānāḥ svakṣatrebhistanvaḥ śumbhamānāḥ |
1,165.05 mahobhiretāṃ upa yujmahe nvindra svadhāmanu hi no babhūtha ||
1,165.06  kva syā vo marutaḥ svadhāsīdyanmāmekaṃ samadhattāhihatye |
1,165.06 ahaṃ hyugrastaviṣastuviṣmānviśvasya śatroranamaṃ vadhasnaiḥ ||
1,165.07  bhūri cakartha yujyebhirasme samānebhirvṛṣabha pauṃsyebhiḥ |
1,165.07 bhūrīṇi hi kṛṇavāmā śaviṣṭhendra kratvā maruto yadvaśāma ||
1,165.08  vadhīṃ vṛtraṃ maruta indriyeṇa svena bhāmena taviṣo babhūvān |
1,165.08 ahametā manave viśvaścandrāḥ sugā apaścakara vajrabāhuḥ ||
1,165.09  anuttamā te maghavannakirnu na tvāvāṃ asti devatā vidānaḥ |
1,165.09 na jāyamāno naśate na jāto yāni kariṣyā kṛṇuhi pravṛddha ||
1,165.10  ekasya cinme vibhvastvojo yā nu dadhṛṣvānkṛṇavai manīṣā |
1,165.10 ahaṃ hyugro maruto vidāno yāni cyavamindra idīśa eṣām ||
1,165.11  amandanmā maruta stomo atra yanme naraḥ śrutyaṃ brahma cakra |
1,165.11 indrāya vṛṣṇe sumakhāya mahyaṃ sakhye sakhāyastanve tanūbhiḥ ||
1,165.12  evedete prati mā rocamānā anedyaḥ śrava eṣo dadhānāḥ |
1,165.12 saṃcakṣyā marutaścandravarṇā acchānta me chadayāthā ca nūnam ||
1,165.13  ko nvatra maruto māmahe vaḥ pra yātana sakhīṃracchā sakhāyaḥ |
1,165.13 manmāni citrā apivātayanta eṣāṃ bhūta navedā ma ṛtānām ||
1,165.14  ā yadduvasyādduvase na kārurasmāñcakre mānyasya medhā |
1,165.14 o ṣu vartta maruto vipramacchemā brahmāṇi jaritā vo arcat ||
1,165.15  eṣa va stomo maruta iyaṃ gīrmāndāryasya mānyasya kāroḥ |
1,165.15 eṣā yāsīṣṭa tanve vayāṃ vidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum ||

1,166.01  tannu vocāma rabhasāya janmane pūrvaṃ mahitvaṃ vṛṣabhasya ketave |
1,166.01 aidheva yāmanmarutastuviṣvaṇo yudheva śakrāstaviṣāṇi kartana ||
1,166.02  nityaṃ na sūnuṃ madhu bibhrata upa krīḻanti krīḻā vidatheṣu ghṛṣvayaḥ |
1,166.02 nakṣanti rudrā avasā namasvinaṃ na mardhanti svatavaso haviṣkṛtam ||
1,166.03  yasmā ūmāso amṛtā arāsata rāyaspoṣaṃ ca haviṣā dadāśuṣe |
1,166.03 ukṣantyasmai maruto hitā iva purū rajāṃsi payasā mayobhuvaḥ ||
1,166.04  ā ye rajāṃsi taviṣībhiravyata pra va evāsaḥ svayatāso adhrajan |
1,166.04 bhayante viśvā bhuvanāni harmyā citro vo yāmaḥ prayatāsvṛṣṭiṣu ||
1,166.05  yattveṣayāmā nadayanta parvatāndivo vā pṛṣṭhaṃ naryā acucyavuḥ |
1,166.05 viśvo vo ajmanbhayate vanaspatī rathīyantīva pra jihīta oṣadhiḥ ||
1,166.06  yūyaṃ na ugrā marutaḥ sucetunāriṣṭagrāmāḥ sumatiṃ pipartana |
1,166.06 yatrā vo didyudradati krivirdatī riṇāti paśvaḥ sudhiteva barhaṇā ||
1,166.07  pra skambhadeṣṇā anavabhrarādhaso'lātṛṇāso vidatheṣu suṣṭutāḥ |
1,166.07 arcantyarkaṃ madirasya pītaye vidurvīrasya prathamāni pauṃsyā ||
1,166.08  śatabhujibhistamabhihruteraghātpūrbhī rakṣatā maruto yamāvata |
1,166.08 janaṃ yamugrāstavaso virapśinaḥ pāthanā śaṃsāttanayasya puṣṭiṣu ||
1,166.09  viśvāni bhadrā maruto ratheṣu vo mithaspṛdhyeva taviṣāṇyāhitā |
1,166.09 aṃseṣvā vaḥ prapatheṣu khādayo'kṣo vaścakrā samayā vi vāvṛte ||
1,166.10  bhūrīṇi bhadrā naryeṣu bāhuṣu vakṣassu rukmā rabhasāso añjayaḥ |
1,166.10 aṃseṣvetāḥ paviṣu kṣurā adhi vayo na pakṣānvyanu śriyo dhire ||
1,166.11  mahānto mahnā vibhvo vibhūtayo dūredṛśo ye divyā iva stṛbhiḥ |
1,166.11 mandrāḥ sujihvāḥ svaritāra āsabhiḥ sammiślā indre marutaḥ pariṣṭubhaḥ ||
1,166.12  tadvaḥ sujātā maruto mahitvanaṃ dīrghaṃ vo dātramaditeriva vratam |
1,166.12 indraścana tyajasā vi hruṇāti tajjanāya yasmai sukṛte arādhvam ||
1,166.13  tadvo jāmitvaṃ marutaḥ pare yuge purū yacchaṃsamamṛtāsa āvata |
1,166.13 ayā dhiyā manave śruṣṭimāvyā sākaṃ naro daṃsanairā cikitrire ||
1,166.14  yena dīrghaṃ marutaḥ śūśavāma yuṣmākena parīṇasā turāsaḥ |
1,166.14 ā yattatananvṛjane janāsa ebhiryajñebhistadabhīṣṭimaśyām ||
1,166.15  eṣa va stomo maruta iyaṃ gīrmāndāryasya mānyasya kāroḥ |
1,166.15 eṣā yāsīṣṭa tanve vayāṃ vidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum ||

1,167.01  sahasraṃ ta indrotayo naḥ sahasramiṣo harivo gūrtatamāḥ |
1,167.01 sahasraṃ rāyo mādayadhyai sahasriṇa upa no yantu vājāḥ ||
1,167.02  ā no'vobhirmaruto yāntvacchā jyeṣṭhebhirvā bṛhaddivaiḥ sumāyāḥ |
1,167.02 adha yadeṣāṃ niyutaḥ paramāḥ samudrasya ciddhanayanta pāre ||
1,167.03  mimyakṣa yeṣu sudhitā ghṛtācī hiraṇyanirṇiguparā na ṛṣṭiḥ |
1,167.03 guhā carantī manuṣo na yoṣā sabhāvatī vidathyeva saṃ vāk ||
1,167.04  parā śubhrā ayāso yavyā sādhāraṇyeva maruto mimikṣuḥ |
1,167.04 na rodasī apa nudanta ghorā juṣanta vṛdhaṃ sakhyāya devāḥ ||
1,167.05  joṣadyadīmasuryā sacadhyai viṣitastukā rodasī nṛmaṇāḥ |
1,167.05 ā sūryeva vidhato rathaṃ gāttveṣapratīkā nabhaso netyā ||
1,167.06  āsthāpayanta yuvatiṃ yuvānaḥ śubhe nimiślāṃ vidatheṣu pajrām |
1,167.06 arko yadvo maruto haviṣmāngāyadgāthaṃ sutasomo duvasyan ||
1,167.07  pra taṃ vivakmi vakmyo ya eṣāṃ marutāṃ mahimā satyo asti |
1,167.07 sacā yadīṃ vṛṣamaṇā ahaṃyu sthirā cijjanīrvahate subhāgāḥ ||
1,167.08  pānti mitrāvaruṇāvavadyāccayata īmaryamo apraśastān |
1,167.08 uta cyavante acyutā dhruvāṇi vāvṛdha īṃ maruto dātivāraḥ ||
1,167.09  nahī nu vo maruto antyasme ārāttāccicchavaso antamāpuḥ |
1,167.09 te dhṛṣṇunā śavasā śūśuvāṃso'rṇo na dveṣo dhṛṣatā pari ṣṭhuḥ ||
1,167.10  vayamadyendrasya preṣṭhā vayaṃ śvo vocemahi samarye |
1,167.10 vayaṃ purā mahi ca no anu dyūntanna ṛbhukṣā narāmanu ṣyāt ||
1,167.11  eṣa va stomo maruta iyaṃ gīrmāndāryasya mānyasya kāroḥ |
1,167.11 eṣā yāsīṣṭa tanve vayāṃ vidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum ||

1,168.01  yajñāyajñā vaḥ samanā tuturvaṇirdhiyaṃdhiyaṃ vo devayā u dadhidhve |
1,168.01 ā vo'rvācaḥ suvitāya rodasyormahe vavṛtyāmavase suvṛktibhiḥ ||
1,168.02  vavrāso na ye svajāḥ svatavasa iṣaṃ svarabhijāyanta dhūtayaḥ |
1,168.02 sahasriyāso apāṃ normaya āsā gāvo vandyāso nokṣaṇaḥ ||
1,168.03  somāso na ye sutāstṛptāṃśavo hṛtsu pītāso duvaso nāsate |
1,168.03 aiṣāmaṃseṣu rambhiṇīva rārabhe hasteṣu khādiśca kṛtiśca saṃ dadhe ||
1,168.04  ava svayuktā diva ā vṛthā yayuramartyāḥ kaśayā codata tmanā |
1,168.04 areṇavastuvijātā acucyavurdṛḻhāni cinmaruto bhrājadṛṣṭayaḥ ||
1,168.05  ko vo'ntarmaruta ṛṣṭividyuto rejati tmanā hanveva jihvayā |
1,168.05 dhanvacyuta iṣāṃ na yāmani purupraiṣā ahanyo naitaśaḥ ||
1,168.06  kva svidasya rajaso mahasparaṃ kvāvaraṃ maruto yasminnāyaya |
1,168.06 yaccyāvayatha vithureva saṃhitaṃ vyadriṇā patatha tveṣamarṇavam ||
1,168.07  sātirna vo'mavatī svarvatī tveṣā vipākā marutaḥ pipiṣvatī |
1,168.07 bhadrā vo rātiḥ pṛṇato na dakṣiṇā pṛthujrayī asuryeva jañjatī ||
1,168.08  prati ṣṭobhanti sindhavaḥ pavibhyo yadabhriyāṃ vācamudīrayanti |
1,168.08 ava smayanta vidyutaḥ pṛthivyāṃ yadī ghṛtaṃ marutaḥ pruṣṇuvanti ||
1,168.09  asūta pṛśnirmahate raṇāya tveṣamayāsāṃ marutāmanīkam |
1,168.09 te sapsarāso'janayantābhvamāditsvadhāmiṣirāṃ paryapaśyan ||
1,168.10  eṣa va stomo maruta iyaṃ gīrmāndāryasya mānyasya kāroḥ |
1,168.10 eṣā yāsīṣṭa tanve vayāṃ vidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum ||

1,169.01  mahaścittvamindra yata etānmahaścidasi tyajaso varūtā |
1,169.01 sa no vedho marutāṃ cikitvānsumnā vanuṣva tava hi preṣṭhā ||
1,169.02  ayujranta indra viśvakṛṣṭīrvidānāso niṣṣidho martyatrā |
1,169.02 marutāṃ pṛtsutirhāsamānā svarmīḻhasya pradhanasya sātau ||
1,169.03  amyaksā ta indra ṛṣṭirasme sanemyabhvaṃ maruto junanti |
1,169.03 agniściddhi ṣmātase śuśukvānāpo na dvīpaṃ dadhati prayāṃsi ||
1,169.04  tvaṃ tū na indra taṃ rayiṃ dā ojiṣṭhayā dakṣiṇayeva rātim |
1,169.04 stutaśca yāste cakananta vāyo stanaṃ na madhvaḥ pīpayanta vājaiḥ ||
1,169.05  tve rāya indra tośatamāḥ praṇetāraḥ kasya cidṛtāyoḥ |
1,169.05 te ṣu ṇo maruto mṛḻayantu ye smā purā gātūyantīva devāḥ ||
1,169.06  prati pra yāhīndra mīḻhuṣo nṝnmahaḥ pārthive sadane yatasva |
1,169.06 adha yadeṣāṃ pṛthubudhnāsa etāstīrthe nāryaḥ pauṃsyāni tasthuḥ ||
1,169.07  prati ghorāṇāmetānāmayāsāṃ marutāṃ śṛṇva āyatāmupabdiḥ |
1,169.07 ye martyaṃ pṛtanāyantamūmairṛṇāvānaṃ na patayanta sargaiḥ ||
1,169.08  tvaṃ mānebhya indra viśvajanyā radā marudbhiḥ śurudho goagrāḥ |
1,169.08 stavānebhi stavase deva devairvidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum ||

1,170.01  na nūnamasti no śvaḥ kastadveda yadadbhutam |
1,170.01 anyasya cittamabhi saṃcareṇyamutādhītaṃ vi naśyati ||
1,170.02  kiṃ na indra jighāṃsasi bhrātaro marutastava |
1,170.02 tebhiḥ kalpasva sādhuyā mā naḥ samaraṇe vadhīḥ ||
1,170.03  kiṃ no bhrātaragastya sakhā sannati manyase |
1,170.03 vidmā hi te yathā mano'smabhyaminna ditsasi ||
1,170.04  araṃ kṛṇvantu vediṃ samagnimindhatāṃ puraḥ |
1,170.04 tatrāmṛtasya cetanaṃ yajñaṃ te tanavāvahai ||
1,170.05  tvamīśiṣe vasupate vasūnāṃ tvaṃ mitrāṇāṃ mitrapate dheṣṭhaḥ |
1,170.05 indra tvaṃ marudbhiḥ saṃ vadasvādha prāśāna ṛtuthā havīṃṣi ||

1,171.01  prati va enā namasāhamemi sūktena bhikṣe sumatiṃ turāṇām |
1,171.01 rarāṇatā maruto vedyābhirni heḻo dhatta vi mucadhvamaśvān ||
1,171.02  eṣa va stomo maruto namasvānhṛdā taṣṭo manasā dhāyi devāḥ |
1,171.02 upemā yāta manasā juṣāṇā yūyaṃ hi ṣṭhā namasa idvṛdhāsaḥ ||
1,171.03  stutāso no maruto mṛḻayantūta stuto maghavā śambhaviṣṭhaḥ |
1,171.03 ūrdhvā naḥ santu komyā vanānyahāni viśvā maruto jigīṣā ||
1,171.04  asmādahaṃ taviṣādīṣamāṇa indrādbhiyā maruto rejamānaḥ |
1,171.04 yuṣmabhyaṃ havyā niśitānyāsantānyāre cakṛmā mṛḻatā naḥ ||
1,171.05  yena mānāsaścitayanta usrā vyuṣṭiṣu śavasā śaśvatīnām |
1,171.05 sa no marudbhirvṛṣabha śravo dhā ugra ugrebhi sthaviraḥ sahodāḥ ||
1,171.06  tvaṃ pāhīndra sahīyaso nṝnbhavā marudbhiravayātaheḻāḥ |
1,171.06 supraketebhiḥ sāsahirdadhāno vidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum ||

1,172.01  citro vo'stu yāmaścitra ūtī sudānavaḥ |
1,172.01 maruto ahibhānavaḥ ||
1,172.02  āre sā vaḥ sudānavo maruta ṛñjatī śaruḥ |
1,172.02 āre aśmā yamasyatha ||
1,172.03  tṛṇaskandasya nu viśaḥ pari vṛṅkta sudānavaḥ |
1,172.03 ūrdhvānnaḥ karta jīvase ||

1,173.01  gāyatsāma nabhanyaṃ yathā verarcāma tadvāvṛdhānaṃ svarvat |
1,173.01 gāvo dhenavo barhiṣyadabdhā ā yatsadmānaṃ divyaṃ vivāsān ||
1,173.02  arcadvṛṣā vṛṣabhiḥ sveduhavyairmṛgo nāśno ati yajjuguryāt |
1,173.02 pra mandayurmanāṃ gūrta hotā bharate maryo mithunā yajatraḥ ||
1,173.03  nakṣaddhotā pari sadma mitā yanbharadgarbhamā śaradaḥ pṛthivyāḥ |
1,173.03 krandadaśvo nayamāno ruvadgaurantardūto na rodasī caradvāk ||
1,173.04  tā karmāṣatarāsmai pra cyautnāni devayanto bharante |
1,173.04 jujoṣadindro dasmavarcā nāsatyeva sugmyo ratheṣṭhāḥ ||
1,173.05  tamu ṣṭuhīndraṃ yo ha satvā yaḥ śūro maghavā yo ratheṣṭhāḥ |
1,173.05 pratīcaścidyodhīyānvṛṣaṇvānvavavruṣaścittamaso vihantā ||
1,173.06  pra yaditthā mahinā nṛbhyo astyaraṃ rodasī kakṣye nāsmai |
1,173.06 saṃ vivya indro vṛjanaṃ na bhūmā bharti svadhāvāṃ opaśamiva dyām ||
1,173.07  samatsu tvā śūra satāmurāṇaṃ prapathintamaṃ paritaṃsayadhyai |
1,173.07 sajoṣasa indraṃ made kṣoṇīḥ sūriṃ cidye anumadanti vājaiḥ ||
1,173.08  evā hi te śaṃ savanā samudra āpo yatta āsu madanti devīḥ |
1,173.08 viśvā te anu joṣyā bhūdgauḥ sūrīṃścidyadi dhiṣā veṣi janān ||
1,173.09  asāma yathā suṣakhāya ena svabhiṣṭayo narāṃ na śaṃsaiḥ |
1,173.09 asadyathā na indro vandaneṣṭhāsturo na karma nayamāna ukthā ||
1,173.10  viṣpardhaso narāṃ na śaṃsairasmākāsadindro vajrahastaḥ |
1,173.10 mitrāyuvo na pūrpatiṃ suśiṣṭau madhyāyuva upa śikṣanti yajñaiḥ ||
1,173.11  yajño hi ṣmendraṃ kaścidṛndhañjuhurāṇaścinmanasā pariyan |
1,173.11 tīrthe nācchā tātṛṣāṇamoko dīrgho na sidhramā kṛṇotyadhvā ||
1,173.12  mo ṣū ṇa indrātra pṛtsu devairasti hi ṣmā te śuṣminnavayāḥ |
1,173.12 mahaścidyasya mīḻhuṣo yavyā haviṣmato maruto vandate gīḥ ||
1,173.13  eṣa stoma indra tubhyamasme etena gātuṃ harivo vido naḥ |
1,173.13 ā no vavṛtyāḥ suvitāya deva vidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum ||

1,174.01  tvaṃ rājendra ye ca devā rakṣā nṝnpāhyasura tvamasmān |
1,174.01 tvaṃ satpatirmaghavā nastarutrastvaṃ satyo vasavānaḥ sahodāḥ ||
1,174.02  dano viśa indra mṛdhravācaḥ sapta yatpuraḥ śarma śāradīrdart |
1,174.02 ṛṇorapo anavadyārṇā yūne vṛtraṃ purukutsāya randhīḥ ||
1,174.03  ajā vṛta indra śūrapatnīrdyāṃ ca yebhiḥ puruhūta nūnam |
1,174.03 rakṣo agnimaśuṣaṃ tūrvayāṇaṃ siṃho na dame apāṃsi vastoḥ ||
1,174.04  śeṣannu ta indra sasminyonau praśastaye pavīravasya mahnā |
1,174.04 sṛjadarṇāṃsyava yadyudhā gāstiṣṭhaddharī dhṛṣatā mṛṣṭa vājān ||
1,174.05  vaha kutsamindra yasmiñcākansyūmanyū ṛjrā vātasyāśvā |
1,174.05 pra sūraścakraṃ vṛhatādabhīke'bhi spṛdho yāsiṣadvajrabāhuḥ ||
1,174.06  jaghanvāṃ indra mitrerūñcodapravṛddho harivo adāśūn |
1,174.06 pra ye paśyannaryamaṇaṃ sacāyostvayā śūrtā vahamānā apatyam ||
1,174.07  rapatkavirindrārkasātau kṣāṃ dāsāyopabarhaṇīṃ kaḥ |
1,174.07 karattisro maghavā dānucitrā ni duryoṇe kuyavācaṃ mṛdhi śret ||
1,174.08  sanā tā ta indra navyā āguḥ saho nabho'viraṇāya pūrvīḥ |
1,174.08 bhinatpuro na bhido adevīrnanamo vadharadevasya pīyoḥ ||
1,174.09  tvaṃ dhunirindra dhunimatīrṛṇorapaḥ sīrā na sravantīḥ |
1,174.09 pra yatsamudramati śūra parṣi pārayā turvaśaṃ yaduṃ svasti ||
1,174.10  tvamasmākamindra viśvadha syā avṛkatamo narāṃ nṛpātā |
1,174.10 sa no viśvāsāṃ spṛdhāṃ sahodā vidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum ||

1,175.01  matsyapāyi te mahaḥ pātrasyeva harivo matsaro madaḥ |
1,175.01 vṛṣā te vṛṣṇa indurvājī sahasrasātamaḥ ||
1,175.02  ā naste gantu matsaro vṛṣā mado vareṇyaḥ |
1,175.02 sahāvāṃ indra sānasiḥ pṛtanāṣāḻ amartyaḥ ||
1,175.03  tvaṃ hi śūraḥ sanitā codayo manuṣo ratham |
1,175.03 sahāvāndasyumavratamoṣaḥ pātraṃ na śociṣā ||
1,175.04  muṣāya sūryaṃ kave cakramīśāna ojasā |
1,175.04 vaha śuṣṇāya vadhaṃ kutsaṃ vātasyāśvaiḥ ||
1,175.05  śuṣmintamo hi te mado dyumnintama uta kratuḥ |
1,175.05 vṛtraghnā varivovidā maṃsīṣṭhā aśvasātamaḥ ||
1,175.06  yathā pūrvebhyo jaritṛbhya indra maya ivāpo na tṛṣyate babhūtha |
1,175.06 tāmanu tvā nividaṃ johavīmi vidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum ||

1,176.01  matsi no vasyaiṣṭaya indramindo vṛṣā viśa |
1,176.01 ṛghāyamāṇa invasi śatrumanti na vindasi ||
1,176.02  tasminnā veśayā giro ya ekaścarṣaṇīnām |
1,176.02 anu svadhā yamupyate yavaṃ na carkṛṣadvṛṣā ||
1,176.03  yasya viśvāni hastayoḥ pañca kṣitīnāṃ vasu |
1,176.03 spāśayasva yo asmadhrugdivyevāśanirjahi ||
1,176.04  asunvantaṃ samaṃ jahi dūṇāśaṃ yo na te mayaḥ |
1,176.04 asmabhyamasya vedanaṃ daddhi sūriścidohate ||
1,176.05  āvo yasya dvibarhaso'rkeṣu sānuṣagasat |
1,176.05 ājāvindrasyendo prāvo vājeṣu vājinam ||
1,176.06  yathā pūrvebhyo jaritṛbhya indra maya ivāpo na tṛṣyate babhūtha |
1,176.06 tāmanu tvā nividaṃ johavīmi vidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum ||

1,177.01  ā carṣaṇiprā vṛṣabho janānāṃ rājā kṛṣṭīnāṃ puruhūta indraḥ |
1,177.01 stutaḥ śravasyannavasopa madrigyuktvā harī vṛṣaṇā yāhyarvāṅ ||
1,177.02  ye te vṛṣaṇo vṛṣabhāsa indra brahmayujo vṛṣarathāso atyāḥ |
1,177.02 tāṃ ā tiṣṭha tebhirā yāhyarvāṅhavāmahe tvā suta indra some ||
1,177.03  ā tiṣṭha rathaṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ vṛṣā te sutaḥ somaḥ pariṣiktā madhūni |
1,177.03 yuktvā vṛṣabhyāṃ vṛṣabha kṣitīnāṃ haribhyāṃ yāhi pravatopa madrik ||
1,177.04  ayaṃ yajño devayā ayaṃ miyedha imā brahmāṇyayamindra somaḥ |
1,177.04 stīrṇaṃ barhirā tu śakra pra yāhi pibā niṣadya vi mucā harī iha ||
1,177.05  o suṣṭuta indra yāhyarvāṅupa brahmāṇi mānyasya kāroḥ |
1,177.05 vidyāma vastoravasā gṛṇanto vidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum ||

1,178.01  yaddha syā ta indra śruṣṭirasti yayā babhūtha jaritṛbhya ūtī |
1,178.01 mā naḥ kāmaṃ mahayantamā dhagviśvā te aśyāṃ paryāpa āyoḥ ||
1,178.02  na ghā rājendra ā dabhanno yā nu svasārā kṛṇavanta yonau |
1,178.02 āpaścidasmai sutukā aveṣangamanna indraḥ sakhyā vayaśca ||
1,178.03  jetā nṛbhirindraḥ pṛtsu śūraḥ śrotā havaṃ nādhamānasya kāroḥ |
1,178.03 prabhartā rathaṃ dāśuṣa upāka udyantā giro yadi ca tmanā bhūt ||
1,178.04  evā nṛbhirindraḥ suśravasyā prakhādaḥ pṛkṣo abhi mitriṇo bhūt |
1,178.04 samarya iṣa stavate vivāci satrākaro yajamānasya śaṃsaḥ ||
1,178.05  tvayā vayaṃ maghavannindra śatrūnabhi ṣyāma mahato manyamānān |
1,178.05 tvaṃ trātā tvamu no vṛdhe bhūrvidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum ||

1,179.01  pūrvīrahaṃ śaradaḥ śaśramāṇā doṣā vastoruṣaso jarayantīḥ |
1,179.01 mināti śriyaṃ jarimā tanūnāmapyū nu patnīrvṛṣaṇo jagamyuḥ ||
1,179.02  ye ciddhi pūrva ṛtasāpa āsansākaṃ devebhiravadannṛtāni |
1,179.02 te cidavāsurnahyantamāpuḥ samū nu patnīrvṛṣabhirjagamyuḥ ||
1,179.03  na mṛṣā śrāntaṃ yadavanti devā viśvā itspṛdho abhyaśnavāva |
1,179.03 jayāvedatra śatanīthamājiṃ yatsamyañcā mithunāvabhyajāva ||
1,179.04  nadasya mā rudhataḥ kāma āgannita ājāto amutaḥ kutaścit |
1,179.04 lopāmudrā vṛṣaṇaṃ nī riṇāti dhīramadhīrā dhayati śvasantam ||
1,179.05  imaṃ nu somamantito hṛtsu pītamupa bruve |
