1,179.05 yatsīmāgaścakṛmā tatsu mṛḻatu pulukāmo hi martyaḥ ||
1,179.06  agastyaḥ khanamānaḥ khanitraiḥ prajāmapatyaṃ balamicchamānaḥ |
1,179.06 ubhau varṇāvṛṣirugraḥ pupoṣa satyā deveṣvāśiṣo jagāma ||

1,180.01  yuvo rajāṃsi suyamāso aśvā ratho yadvāṃ paryarṇāṃsi dīyat |
1,180.01 hiraṇyayā vāṃ pavayaḥ pruṣāyanmadhvaḥ pibantā uṣasaḥ sacethe ||
1,180.02  yuvamatyasyāva nakṣatho yadvipatmano naryasya prayajyoḥ |
1,180.02 svasā yadvāṃ viśvagūrtī bharāti vājāyeṭṭe madhupāviṣe ca ||
1,180.03  yuvaṃ paya usriyāyāmadhattaṃ pakvamāmāyāmava pūrvyaṃ goḥ |
1,180.03 antaryadvanino vāmṛtapsū hvāro na śuciryajate haviṣmān ||
1,180.04  yuvaṃ ha gharmaṃ madhumantamatraye'po na kṣodo'vṛṇītameṣe |
1,180.04 tadvāṃ narāvaśvinā paśvaiṣṭī rathyeva cakrā prati yanti madhvaḥ ||
1,180.05  ā vāṃ dānāya vavṛtīya dasrā goroheṇa taugryo na jivriḥ |
1,180.05 apaḥ kṣoṇī sacate māhinā vāṃ jūrṇo vāmakṣuraṃhaso yajatrā ||
1,180.06  ni yadyuvethe niyutaḥ sudānū upa svadhābhiḥ sṛjathaḥ purandhim |
1,180.06 preṣadveṣadvāto na sūrirā mahe dade suvrato na vājam ||
1,180.07  vayaṃ ciddhi vāṃ jaritāraḥ satyā vipanyāmahe vi paṇirhitāvān |
1,180.07 adhā ciddhi ṣmāśvināvanindyā pātho hi ṣmā vṛṣaṇāvantidevam ||
1,180.08  yuvāṃ ciddhi ṣmāśvināvanu dyūnvirudrasya prasravaṇasya sātau |
1,180.08 agastyo narāṃ nṛṣu praśastaḥ kārādhunīva citayatsahasraiḥ ||
1,180.09  pra yadvahethe mahinā rathasya pra syandrā yātho manuṣo na hotā |
1,180.09 dhattaṃ sūribhya uta vā svaśvyaṃ nāsatyā rayiṣācaḥ syāma ||
1,180.10  taṃ vāṃ rathaṃ vayamadyā huvema stomairaśvinā suvitāya navyam |
1,180.10 ariṣṭanemiṃ pari dyāmiyānaṃ vidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum ||

1,181.01  kadu preṣṭāviṣāṃ rayīṇāmadhvaryantā yadunninītho apām |
1,181.01 ayaṃ vāṃ yajño akṛta praśastiṃ vasudhitī avitārā janānām ||
1,181.02  ā vāmaśvāsaḥ śucayaḥ payaspā vātaraṃhaso divyāso atyāḥ |
1,181.02 manojuvo vṛṣaṇo vītapṛṣṭhā eha svarājo aśvinā vahantu ||
1,181.03  ā vāṃ ratho'vanirna pravatvānsṛpravandhuraḥ suvitāya gamyāḥ |
1,181.03 vṛṣṇa sthātārā manaso javīyānahampūrvo yajato dhiṣṇyā yaḥ ||
1,181.04  iheha jātā samavāvaśītāmarepasā tanvā nāmabhiḥ svaiḥ |
1,181.04 jiṣṇurvāmanyaḥ sumakhasya sūrirdivo anyaḥ subhagaḥ putra ūhe ||
1,181.05  pra vāṃ niceruḥ kakuho vaśāṃ anu piśaṅgarūpaḥ sadanāni gamyāḥ |
1,181.05 harī anyasya pīpayanta vājairmathrā rajāṃsyaśvinā vi ghoṣaiḥ ||
1,181.06  pra vāṃ śaradvānvṛṣabho na niṣṣāṭpūrvīriṣaścarati madhva iṣṇan |
1,181.06 evairanyasya pīpayanta vājairveṣantīrūrdhvā nadyo na āguḥ ||
1,181.07  asarji vāṃ sthavirā vedhasā gīrbāḻhe aśvinā tredhā kṣarantī |
1,181.07 upastutāvavataṃ nādhamānaṃ yāmannayāmañchṛṇutaṃ havaṃ me ||
1,181.08  uta syā vāṃ ruśato vapsaso gīstribarhiṣi sadasi pinvate nṝn |
1,181.08 vṛṣā vāṃ megho vṛṣaṇā pīpāya gorna seke manuṣo daśasyan ||
1,181.09  yuvāṃ pūṣevāśvinā purandhiragnimuṣāṃ na jarate haviṣmān |
1,181.09 huve yadvāṃ varivasyā gṛṇāno vidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum ||

1,182.01  abhūdidaṃ vayunamo ṣu bhūṣatā ratho vṛṣaṇvānmadatā manīṣiṇaḥ |
1,182.01 dhiyañjinvā dhiṣṇyā viśpalāvasū divo napātā sukṛte śucivratā ||
1,182.02  indratamā hi dhiṣṇyā maruttamā dasrā daṃsiṣṭhā rathyā rathītamā |
1,182.02 pūrṇaṃ rathaṃ vahethe madhva ācitaṃ tena dāśvāṃsamupa yātho aśvinā ||
1,182.03  kimatra dasrā kṛṇuthaḥ kimāsāthe jano yaḥ kaścidahavirmahīyate |
1,182.03 ati kramiṣṭaṃ jurataṃ paṇerasuṃ jyotirviprāya kṛṇutaṃ vacasyave ||
1,182.04  jambhayatamabhito rāyataḥ śuno hataṃ mṛdho vidathustānyaśvinā |
1,182.04 vācaṃvācaṃ jaritū ratninīṃ kṛtamubhā śaṃsaṃ nāsatyāvataṃ mama ||
1,182.05  yuvametaṃ cakrathuḥ sindhuṣu plavamātmanvantaṃ pakṣiṇaṃ taugryāya kam |
1,182.05 yena devatrā manasā nirūhathuḥ supaptanī petathuḥ kṣodaso mahaḥ ||
1,182.06  avaviddhaṃ taugryamapsvantaranārambhaṇe tamasi praviddham |
1,182.06 catasro nāvo jaṭhalasya juṣṭā udaśvibhyāmiṣitāḥ pārayanti ||
1,182.07  kaḥ svidvṛkṣo niṣṭhito madhye arṇaso yaṃ taugryo nādhitaḥ paryaṣasvajat |
1,182.07 parṇā mṛgasya patarorivārabha udaśvinā ūhathuḥ śromatāya kam ||
1,182.08  tadvāṃ narā nāsatyāvanu ṣyādyadvāṃ mānāsa ucathamavocan |
1,182.08 asmādadya sadasaḥ somyādā vidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum ||

1,183.01  taṃ yuñjāthāṃ manaso yo javīyāntrivandhuro vṛṣaṇā yastricakraḥ |
1,183.01 yenopayāthaḥ sukṛto duroṇaṃ tridhātunā patatho virna parṇaiḥ ||
1,183.02  suvṛdratho vartate yannabhi kṣāṃ yattiṣṭhathaḥ kratumantānu pṛkṣe |
1,183.02 vapurvapuṣyā sacatāmiyaṃ gīrdivo duhitroṣasā sacethe ||
1,183.03  ā tiṣṭhataṃ suvṛtaṃ yo ratho vāmanu vratāni vartate haviṣmān |
1,183.03 yena narā nāsatyeṣayadhyai vartiryāthastanayāya tmane ca ||
1,183.04  mā vāṃ vṛko mā vṛkīrā dadharṣīnmā pari varktamuta māti dhaktam |
1,183.04 ayaṃ vāṃ bhāgo nihita iyaṃ gīrdasrāvime vāṃ nidhayo madhūnām ||
1,183.05  yuvāṃ gotamaḥ purumīḻho atrirdasrā havate'vase haviṣmān |
1,183.05 diśaṃ na diṣṭāmṛjūyeva yantā me havaṃ nāsatyopa yātam ||
1,183.06  atāriṣma tamasaspāramasya prati vāṃ stomo aśvināvadhāyi |
1,183.06 eha yātaṃ pathibhirdevayānairvidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum ||

1,184.01  tā vāmadya tāvaparaṃ huvemocchantyāmuṣasi vahnirukthaiḥ |
1,184.01 nāsatyā kuha citsantāvaryo divo napātā sudāstarāya ||
1,184.02  asme ū ṣu vṛṣaṇā mādayethāmutpaṇīṃrhatamūrmyā madantā |
1,184.02 śrutaṃ me acchoktibhirmatīnāmeṣṭā narā nicetārā ca karṇaiḥ ||
1,184.03  śriye pūṣanniṣukṛteva devā nāsatyā vahatuṃ sūryāyāḥ |
1,184.03 vacyante vāṃ kakuhā apsu jātā yugā jūrṇeva varuṇasya bhūreḥ ||
1,184.04  asme sā vāṃ mādhvī rātirastu stomaṃ hinotaṃ mānyasya kāroḥ |
1,184.04 anu yadvāṃ śravasyā sudānū suvīryāya carṣaṇayo madanti ||
1,184.05  eṣa vāṃ stomo aśvināvakāri mānebhirmaghavānā suvṛkti |
1,184.05 yātaṃ vartistanayāya tmane cāgastye nāsatyā madantā ||
1,184.06  atāriṣma tamasaspāramasya prati vāṃ stomo aśvināvadhāyi |
1,184.06 eha yātaṃ pathibhirdevayānairvidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum ||

1,185.01  katarā pūrvā katarāparāyoḥ kathā jāte kavayaḥ ko vi veda |
1,185.01 viśvaṃ tmanā bibhṛto yaddha nāma vi vartete ahanī cakriyeva ||
1,185.02  bhūriṃ dve acarantī carantaṃ padvantaṃ garbhamapadī dadhāte |
1,185.02 nityaṃ na sūnuṃ pitrorupasthe dyāvā rakṣataṃ pṛthivī no abhvāt ||
1,185.03  aneho dātramaditeranarvaṃ huve svarvadavadhaṃ namasvat |
1,185.03 tadrodasī janayataṃ jaritre dyāvā rakṣataṃ pṛthivī no abhvāt ||
1,185.04  atapyamāne avasāvantī anu ṣyāma rodasī devaputre |
1,185.04 ubhe devānāmubhayebhirahnāṃ dyāvā rakṣataṃ pṛthivī no abhvāt ||
1,185.05  saṃgacchamāne yuvatī samante svasārā jāmī pitrorupasthe |
1,185.05 abhijighrantī bhuvanasya nābhiṃ dyāvā rakṣataṃ pṛthivī no abhvāt ||
1,185.06  urvī sadmanī bṛhatī ṛtena huve devānāmavasā janitrī |
1,185.06 dadhāte ye amṛtaṃ supratīke dyāvā rakṣataṃ pṛthivī no abhvāt ||
1,185.07  urvī pṛthvī bahule dūreante upa bruve namasā yajñe asmin |
1,185.07 dadhāte ye subhage supratūrtī dyāvā rakṣataṃ pṛthivī no abhvāt ||
1,185.08  devānvā yaccakṛmā kaccidāgaḥ sakhāyaṃ vā sadamijjāspatiṃ vā |
1,185.08 iyaṃ dhīrbhūyā avayānameṣāṃ dyāvā rakṣataṃ pṛthivī no abhvāt ||
1,185.09  ubhā śaṃsā naryā māmaviṣṭāmubhe māmūtī avasā sacetām |
1,185.09 bhūri cidaryaḥ sudāstarāyeṣā madanta iṣayema devāḥ ||
1,185.10  ṛtaṃ dive tadavocaṃ pṛthivyā abhiśrāvāya prathamaṃ sumedhāḥ |
1,185.10 pātāmavadyādduritādabhīke pitā mātā ca rakṣatāmavobhiḥ ||
1,185.11  idaṃ dyāvāpṛthivī satyamastu pitarmātaryadihopabruve vām |
1,185.11 bhūtaṃ devānāmavame avobhirvidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum ||

1,186.01  ā na iḻābhirvidathe suśasti viśvānaraḥ savitā deva etu |
1,186.01 api yathā yuvāno matsathā no viśvaṃ jagadabhipitve manīṣā ||
1,186.02  ā no viśva āskrā gamantu devā mitro aryamā varuṇaḥ sajoṣāḥ |
1,186.02 bhuvanyathā no viśve vṛdhāsaḥ karansuṣāhā vithuraṃ na śavaḥ ||
1,186.03  preṣṭhaṃ vo atithiṃ gṛṇīṣe'gniṃ śastibhisturvaṇiḥ sajoṣāḥ |
1,186.03 asadyathā no varuṇaḥ sukīrtiriṣaśca parṣadarigūrtaḥ sūriḥ ||
1,186.04  upa va eṣe namasā jigīṣoṣāsānaktā sudugheva dhenuḥ |
1,186.04 samāne ahanvimimāno arkaṃ viṣurūpe payasi sasminnūdhan ||
1,186.05  uta no'hirbudhnyo mayaskaḥ śiśuṃ na pipyuṣīva veti sindhuḥ |
1,186.05 yena napātamapāṃ junāma manojuvo vṛṣaṇo yaṃ vahanti ||
1,186.06  uta na īṃ tvaṣṭā gantvacchā smatsūribhirabhipitve sajoṣāḥ |
1,186.06 ā vṛtrahendraścarṣaṇiprāstuviṣṭamo narāṃ na iha gamyāḥ ||
1,186.07  uta na īṃ matayo'śvayogāḥ śiśuṃ na gāvastaruṇaṃ rihanti |
1,186.07 tamīṃ giro janayo na patnīḥ surabhiṣṭamaṃ narāṃ nasanta ||
1,186.08  uta na īṃ maruto vṛddhasenāḥ smadrodasī samanasaḥ sadantu |
1,186.08 pṛṣadaśvāso'vanayo na rathā riśādaso mitrayujo na devāḥ ||
1,186.09  pra nu yadeṣāṃ mahinā cikitre pra yuñjate prayujaste suvṛkti |
1,186.09 adha yadeṣāṃ sudine na śarurviśvameriṇaṃ pruṣāyanta senāḥ ||
1,186.10  pro aśvināvavase kṛṇudhvaṃ pra pūṣaṇaṃ svatavaso hi santi |
1,186.10 adveṣo viṣṇurvāta ṛbhukṣā acchā sumnāya vavṛtīya devān ||
1,186.11  iyaṃ sā vo asme dīdhitiryajatrā apiprāṇī ca sadanī ca bhūyāḥ |
1,186.11 ni yā deveṣu yatate vasūyurvidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum ||

1,187.01  pituṃ nu stoṣaṃ maho dharmāṇaṃ taviṣīm |
1,187.01 yasya trito vyojasā vṛtraṃ viparvamardayat ||
1,187.02  svādo pito madho pito vayaṃ tvā vavṛmahe |
1,187.02 asmākamavitā bhava ||
1,187.03  upa naḥ pitavā cara śivaḥ śivābhirūtibhiḥ |
1,187.03 mayobhuradviṣeṇyaḥ sakhā suśevo advayāḥ ||
1,187.04  tava tye pito rasā rajāṃsyanu viṣṭhitāḥ |
1,187.04 divi vātā iva śritāḥ ||
1,187.05  tava tye pito dadatastava svādiṣṭha te pito |
1,187.05 pra svādmāno rasānāṃ tuvigrīvā iverate ||
1,187.06  tve pito mahānāṃ devānāṃ mano hitam |
1,187.06 akāri cāru ketunā tavāhimavasāvadhīt ||
1,187.07  yadado pito ajaganvivasva parvatānām |
1,187.07 atrā cinno madho pito'raṃ bhakṣāya gamyāḥ ||
1,187.08  yadapāmoṣadhīnāṃ pariṃśamāriśāmahe |
1,187.08 vātāpe pīva idbhava ||
1,187.09  yatte soma gavāśiro yavāśiro bhajāmahe |
1,187.09 vātāpe pīva idbhava ||
1,187.10  karambha oṣadhe bhava pīvo vṛkka udārathiḥ |
1,187.10 vātāpe pīva idbhava ||
1,187.11  taṃ tvā vayaṃ pito vacobhirgāvo na havyā suṣūdima |
1,187.11 devebhyastvā sadhamādamasmabhyaṃ tvā sadhamādam ||

1,188.01  samiddho adya rājasi devo devaiḥ sahasrajit |
1,188.01 dūto havyā kavirvaha ||
1,188.02  tanūnapādṛtaṃ yate madhvā yajñaḥ samajyate |
1,188.02 dadhatsahasriṇīriṣaḥ ||
1,188.03  ājuhvāno na īḍyo devāṃ ā vakṣi yajñiyān |
1,188.03 agne sahasrasā asi ||
1,188.04  prācīnaṃ barhirojasā sahasravīramastṛṇan |
1,188.04 yatrādityā virājatha ||
1,188.05  virāṭsamrāḍvibhvīḥ prabhvīrbahvīśca bhūyasīśca yāḥ |
1,188.05 duro ghṛtānyakṣaran ||
1,188.06  surukme hi supeśasādhi śriyā virājataḥ |
1,188.06 uṣāsāveha sīdatām ||
1,188.07  prathamā hi suvācasā hotārā daivyā kavī |
1,188.07 yajñaṃ no yakṣatāmimam ||
1,188.08  bhāratīḻe sarasvati yā vaḥ sarvā upabruve |
1,188.08 tā naścodayata śriye ||
1,188.09  tvaṣṭā rūpāṇi hi prabhuḥ paśūnviśvānsamānaje |
1,188.09 teṣāṃ na sphātimā yaja ||
1,188.10  upa tmanyā vanaspate pātho devebhyaḥ sṛja |
1,188.10 agnirhavyāni siṣvadat ||
1,188.11  purogā agnirdevānāṃ gāyatreṇa samajyate |
1,188.11 svāhākṛtīṣu rocate ||

1,189.01  agne naya supathā rāye asmānviśvāni deva vayunāni vidvān |
1,189.01 yuyodhyasmajjuhurāṇameno bhūyiṣṭhāṃ te namauktiṃ vidhema ||
1,189.02  agne tvaṃ pārayā navyo asmānsvastibhirati durgāṇi viśvā |
1,189.02 pūśca pṛthvī bahulā na urvī bhavā tokāya tanayāya śaṃ yoḥ ||
1,189.03  agne tvamasmadyuyodhyamīvā anagnitrā abhyamanta kṛṣṭīḥ |
1,189.03 punarasmabhyaṃ suvitāya deva kṣāṃ viśvebhiramṛtebhiryajatra ||
1,189.04  pāhi no agne pāyubhirajasrairuta priye sadana ā śuśukvān |
1,189.04 mā te bhayaṃ jaritāraṃ yaviṣṭha nūnaṃ vidanmāparaṃ sahasvaḥ ||
1,189.05  mā no agne'va sṛjo aghāyāviṣyave ripave ducchunāyai |
1,189.05 mā datvate daśate mādate no mā rīṣate sahasāvanparā dāḥ ||
1,189.06  vi gha tvāvāṃ ṛtajāta yaṃsadgṛṇāno agne tanve varūtham |
1,189.06 viśvādririkṣoruta vā ninitsorabhihrutāmasi hi deva viṣpaṭ ||
1,189.07  tvaṃ tāṃ agna ubhayānvi vidvānveṣi prapitve manuṣo yajatra |
1,189.07 abhipitve manave śāsyo bhūrmarmṛjenya uśigbhirnākraḥ ||
1,189.08  avocāma nivacanānyasminmānasya sūnuḥ sahasāne agnau |
1,189.08 vayaṃ sahasramṛṣibhiḥ sanema vidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum ||

1,190.01  anarvāṇaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ mandrajihvaṃ bṛhaspatiṃ vardhayā navyamarkaiḥ |
1,190.01 gāthānyaḥ suruco yasya devā āśṛṇvanti navamānasya martāḥ ||
1,190.02  tamṛtviyā upa vācaḥ sacante sargo na yo devayatāmasarji |
1,190.02 bṛhaspatiḥ sa hyañjo varāṃsi vibhvābhavatsamṛte mātariśvā ||
1,190.03  upastutiṃ namasa udyatiṃ ca ślokaṃ yaṃsatsaviteva pra bāhū |
1,190.03 asya kratvāhanyo yo asti mṛgo na bhīmo arakṣasastuviṣmān ||
1,190.04  asya śloko divīyate pṛthivyāmatyo na yaṃsadyakṣabhṛdvicetāḥ |
1,190.04 mṛgāṇāṃ na hetayo yanti cemā bṛhaspaterahimāyāṃ abhi dyūn ||
1,190.05  ye tvā devosrikaṃ manyamānāḥ pāpā bhadramupajīvanti pajrāḥ |
1,190.05 na dūḍhye anu dadāsi vāmaṃ bṛhaspate cayasa itpiyārum ||
1,190.06  supraituḥ sūyavaso na panthā durniyantuḥ pariprīto na mitraḥ |
1,190.06 anarvāṇo abhi ye cakṣate no'pīvṛtā aporṇuvanto asthuḥ ||
1,190.07  saṃ yaṃ stubho'vanayo na yanti samudraṃ na sravato rodhacakrāḥ |
1,190.07 sa vidvāṃ ubhayaṃ caṣṭe antarbṛhaspatistara āpaśca gṛdhraḥ ||
1,190.08  evā mahastuvijātastuviṣmānbṛhaspatirvṛṣabho dhāyi devaḥ |
1,190.08 sa na stuto vīravaddhātu gomadvidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum ||

1,191.01  kaṅkato na kaṅkato'tho satīnakaṅkataḥ |
1,191.01 dvāviti pluṣī iti nyadṛṣṭā alipsata ||
1,191.02  adṛṣṭānhantyāyatyatho hanti parāyatī |
1,191.02 atho avaghnatī hantyatho pinaṣṭi piṃṣatī ||
1,191.03  śarāsaḥ kuśarāso darbhāsaḥ sairyā uta |
1,191.03 mauñjā adṛṣṭā vairiṇāḥ sarve sākaṃ nyalipsata ||
1,191.04  ni gāvo goṣṭhe asadanni mṛgāso avikṣata |
1,191.04 ni ketavo janānāṃ nyadṛṣṭā alipsata ||
1,191.05  eta u tye pratyadṛśranpradoṣaṃ taskarā iva |
1,191.05 adṛṣṭā viśvadṛṣṭāḥ pratibuddhā abhūtana ||
1,191.06  dyaurvaḥ pitā pṛthivī mātā somo bhrātāditiḥ svasā |
1,191.06 adṛṣṭā viśvadṛṣṭāstiṣṭhatelayatā su kam ||
1,191.07  ye aṃsyā ye aṅgyāḥ sūcīkā ye prakaṅkatāḥ |
1,191.07 adṛṣṭāḥ kiṃ caneha vaḥ sarve sākaṃ ni jasyata ||
1,191.08  utpurastātsūrya eti viśvadṛṣṭo adṛṣṭahā |
1,191.08 adṛṣṭānsarvāñjambhayansarvāśca yātudhānyaḥ ||
1,191.09  udapaptadasau sūryaḥ puru viśvāni jūrvan |
1,191.09 ādityaḥ parvatebhyo viśvadṛṣṭo adṛṣṭahā ||
1,191.10  sūrye viṣamā sajāmi dṛtiṃ surāvato gṛhe |
1,191.10 so cinnu na marāti no vayaṃ marāmāre asya yojanaṃ hariṣṭhā madhu tvā madhulā cakāra ||
1,191.11  iyattikā śakuntikā sakā jaghāsa te viṣam |
1,191.11 so cinnu na marāti no vayaṃ marāmāre asya yojanaṃ hariṣṭhā madhu tvā madhulā cakāra ||
1,191.12  triḥ sapta viṣpuliṅgakā viṣasya puṣyamakṣan |
1,191.12 tāścinnu na maranti no vayaṃ marāmāre asya yojanaṃ hariṣṭhā madhu tvā madhulā cakāra ||
1,191.13  navānāṃ navatīnāṃ viṣasya ropuṣīṇām |
1,191.13 sarvāsāmagrabhaṃ nāmāre asya yojanaṃ hariṣṭhā madhu tvā madhulā cakāra ||
1,191.14  triḥ sapta mayūryaḥ sapta svasāro agruvaḥ |
1,191.14 tāste viṣaṃ vi jabhrira udakaṃ kumbhinīriva ||
1,191.15  iyattakaḥ kuṣumbhakastakaṃ bhinadmyaśmanā |
1,191.15 tato viṣaṃ pra vāvṛte parācīranu saṃvataḥ ||
1,191.16  kuṣumbhakastadabravīdgireḥ pravartamānakaḥ |
1,191.16 vṛścikasyārasaṃ viṣamarasaṃ vṛścika te viṣam ||








ṛgveda 2




2,001.01  tvamagne dyubhistvamāśuśukṣaṇistvamadbhyastvamaśmanaspari |
2,001.01 tvaṃ vanebhyastvamoṣadhībhyastvaṃ nṛṇāṃ nṛpate jāyase śuciḥ ||
2,001.02  tavāgne hotraṃ tava potramṛtviyaṃ tava neṣṭraṃ tvamagnidṛtāyataḥ |
2,001.02 tava praśāstraṃ tvamadhvarīyasi brahmā cāsi gṛhapatiśca no dame ||
2,001.03  tvamagna indro vṛṣabhaḥ satāmasi tvaṃ viṣṇururugāyo namasyaḥ |
2,001.03 tvaṃ brahmā rayividbrahmaṇaspate tvaṃ vidhartaḥ sacase purandhyā ||
2,001.04  tvamagne rājā varuṇo dhṛtavratastvaṃ mitro bhavasi dasma īḍyaḥ |
2,001.04 tvamaryamā satpatiryasya sambhujaṃ tvamaṃśo vidathe deva bhājayuḥ ||
2,001.05  tvamagne tvaṣṭā vidhate suvīryaṃ tava gnāvo mitramahaḥ sajātyam |
2,001.05 tvamāśuhemā rariṣe svaśvyaṃ tvaṃ narāṃ śardho asi purūvasuḥ ||
2,001.06  tvamagne rudro asuro maho divastvaṃ śardho mārutaṃ pṛkṣa īśiṣe |
2,001.06 tvaṃ vātairaruṇairyāsi śaṅgayastvaṃ pūṣā vidhataḥ pāsi nu tmanā ||
2,001.07  tvamagne draviṇodā araṅkṛte tvaṃ devaḥ savitā ratnadhā asi |
2,001.07 tvaṃ bhago nṛpate vasva īśiṣe tvaṃ pāyurdame yaste'vidhat ||
2,001.08  tvāmagne dama ā viśpatiṃ viśastvāṃ rājānaṃ suvidatramṛñjate |
2,001.08 tvaṃ viśvāni svanīka patyase tvaṃ sahasrāṇi śatā daśa prati ||
2,001.09  tvāmagne pitaramiṣṭibhirnarastvāṃ bhrātrāya śamyā tanūrucam |
2,001.09 tvaṃ putro bhavasi yaste'vidhattvaṃ sakhā suśevaḥ pāsyādhṛṣaḥ ||
2,001.10  tvamagna ṛbhurāke namasyastvaṃ vājasya kṣumato rāya īśiṣe |
2,001.10 tvaṃ vi bhāsyanu dakṣi dāvane tvaṃ viśikṣurasi yajñamātaniḥ ||
2,001.11  tvamagne aditirdeva dāśuṣe tvaṃ hotrā bhāratī vardhase girā |
2,001.11 tvamiḻā śatahimāsi dakṣase tvaṃ vṛtrahā vasupate sarasvatī ||
2,001.12  tvamagne subhṛta uttamaṃ vayastava spārhe varṇa ā saṃdṛśi śriyaḥ |
2,001.12 tvaṃ vājaḥ prataraṇo bṛhannasi tvaṃ rayirbahulo viśvataspṛthuḥ ||
2,001.13  tvāmagna ādityāsa āsyaṃ tvāṃ jihvāṃ śucayaścakrire kave |
2,001.13 tvāṃ rātiṣāco adhvareṣu saścire tve devā haviradantyāhutam ||
2,001.14  tve agne viśve amṛtāso adruha āsā devā haviradantyāhutam |
2,001.14 tvayā martāsaḥ svadanta āsutiṃ tvaṃ garbho vīrudhāṃ jajñiṣe śuciḥ ||
2,001.15  tvaṃ tānsaṃ ca prati cāsi majmanāgne sujāta pra ca deva ricyase |
2,001.15 pṛkṣo yadatra mahinā vi te bhuvadanu dyāvāpṛthivī rodasī ubhe ||
2,001.16  ye stotṛbhyo goagrāmaśvapeśasamagne rātimupasṛjanti sūrayaḥ |
2,001.16 asmāñca tāṃśca pra hi neṣi vasya ā bṛhadvadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||

2,002.01  yajñena vardhata jātavedasamagniṃ yajadhvaṃ haviṣā tanā girā |
2,002.01 samidhānaṃ suprayasaṃ svarṇaraṃ dyukṣaṃ hotāraṃ vṛjaneṣu dhūrṣadam ||
2,002.02  abhi tvā naktīruṣaso vavāśire'gne vatsaṃ na svasareṣu dhenavaḥ |
2,002.02 diva ivedaratirmānuṣā yugā kṣapo bhāsi puruvāra saṃyataḥ ||
2,002.03  taṃ devā budhne rajasaḥ sudaṃsasaṃ divaspṛthivyoraratiṃ nyerire |
2,002.03 rathamiva vedyaṃ śukraśociṣamagniṃ mitraṃ na kṣitiṣu praśaṃsyam ||
2,002.04  tamukṣamāṇaṃ rajasi sva ā dame candramiva surucaṃ hvāra ā dadhuḥ |
2,002.04 pṛśnyāḥ pataraṃ citayantamakṣabhiḥ pātho na pāyuṃ janasī ubhe anu ||
2,002.05  sa hotā viśvaṃ pari bhūtvadhvaraṃ tamu havyairmanuṣa ṛñjate girā |
2,002.05 hiriśipro vṛdhasānāsu jarbhuraddyaurna stṛbhiścitayadrodasī anu ||
2,002.06  sa no revatsamidhānaḥ svastaye saṃdadasvānrayimasmāsu dīdihi |
2,002.06 ā naḥ kṛṇuṣva suvitāya rodasī agne havyā manuṣo deva vītaye ||
2,002.07  dā no agne bṛhato dāḥ sahasriṇo duro na vājaṃ śrutyā apā vṛdhi |
2,002.07 prācī dyāvāpṛthivī brahmaṇā kṛdhi svarṇa śukramuṣaso vi didyutaḥ ||
2,002.08  sa idhāna uṣaso rāmyā anu svarṇa dīdedaruṣeṇa bhānunā |
2,002.08 hotrābhiragnirmanuṣaḥ svadhvaro rājā viśāmatithiścārurāyave ||
2,002.09  evā no agne amṛteṣu pūrvya dhīṣpīpāya bṛhaddiveṣu mānuṣā |
2,002.09 duhānā dhenurvṛjaneṣu kārave tmanā śatinaṃ pururūpamiṣaṇi ||
2,002.10  vayamagne arvatā vā suvīryaṃ brahmaṇā vā citayemā janāṃ ati |
2,002.10 asmākaṃ dyumnamadhi pañca kṛṣṭiṣūccā svarṇa śuśucīta duṣṭaram ||
2,002.11  sa no bodhi sahasya praśaṃsyo yasminsujātā iṣayanta sūrayaḥ |
2,002.11 yamagne yajñamupayanti vājino nitye toke dīdivāṃsaṃ sve dame ||
2,002.12  ubhayāso jātavedaḥ syāma te stotāro agne sūrayaśca śarmaṇi |
2,002.12 vasvo rāyaḥ puruścandrasya bhūyasaḥ prajāvataḥ svapatyasya śagdhi naḥ ||
2,002.13  ye stotṛbhyo goagrāmaśvapeśasamagne rātimupasṛjanti sūrayaḥ |
2,002.13 asmāñca tāṃśca pra hi neṣi vasya ā bṛhadvadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||

2,003.01  samiddho agnirnihitaḥ pṛthivyāṃ pratyaṅviśvāni bhuvanānyasthāt |
2,003.01 hotā pāvakaḥ pradivaḥ sumedhā devo devānyajatvagnirarhan ||
2,003.02  narāśaṃsaḥ prati dhāmānyañjantisro divaḥ prati mahnā svarciḥ |
2,003.02 ghṛtapruṣā manasā havyamundanmūrdhanyajñasya samanaktu devān ||
2,003.03  īḻito agne manasā no arhandevānyakṣi mānuṣātpūrvo adya |
2,003.03 sa ā vaha marutāṃ śardho acyutamindraṃ naro barhiṣadaṃ yajadhvam ||
2,003.04  deva barhirvardhamānaṃ suvīraṃ stīrṇaṃ rāye subharaṃ vedyasyām |
2,003.04 ghṛtenāktaṃ vasavaḥ sīdatedaṃ viśve devā ādityā yajñiyāsaḥ ||
2,003.05  vi śrayantāmurviyā hūyamānā dvāro devīḥ suprāyaṇā namobhiḥ |
2,003.05 vyacasvatīrvi prathantāmajuryā varṇaṃ punānā yaśasaṃ suvīram ||
2,003.06  sādhvapāṃsi sanatā na ukṣite uṣāsānaktā vayyeva raṇvite |
2,003.06 tantuṃ tataṃ saṃvayantī samīcī yajñasya peśaḥ sudughe payasvatī ||
2,003.07  daivyā hotārā prathamā viduṣṭara ṛju yakṣataḥ samṛcā vapuṣṭarā |
2,003.07 devānyajantāvṛtuthā samañjato nābhā pṛthivyā adhi sānuṣu triṣu ||
2,003.08  sarasvatī sādhayantī dhiyaṃ na iḻā devī bhāratī viśvatūrtiḥ |
2,003.08 tisro devīḥ svadhayā barhiredamacchidraṃ pāntu śaraṇaṃ niṣadya ||
2,003.09  piśaṅgarūpaḥ subharo vayodhāḥ śruṣṭī vīro jāyate devakāmaḥ |
2,003.09 prajāṃ tvaṣṭā vi ṣyatu nābhimasme athā devānāmapyetu pāthaḥ ||
2,003.10  vanaspatiravasṛjannupa sthādagnirhaviḥ sūdayāti pra dhībhiḥ |
2,003.10 tridhā samaktaṃ nayatu prajānandevebhyo daivyaḥ śamitopa havyam ||
2,003.11  ghṛtaṃ mimikṣe ghṛtamasya yonirghṛte śrito ghṛtaṃ vasya dhāma |
2,003.11 anuṣvadhamā vaha mādayasva svāhākṛtaṃ vṛṣabha vakṣi havyam ||

2,004.01  huve vaḥ sudyotmānaṃ suvṛktiṃ viśāmagnimatithiṃ suprayasam |
2,004.01 mitra iva yo didhiṣāyyo bhūddeva ādeve jane jātavedāḥ ||
2,004.02  imaṃ vidhanto apāṃ sadhasthe dvitādadhurbhṛgavo vikṣvāyoḥ |
2,004.02 eṣa viśvānyabhyastu bhūmā devānāmagniraratirjīrāśvaḥ ||
2,004.03  agniṃ devāso mānuṣīṣu vikṣu priyaṃ dhuḥ kṣeṣyanto na mitram |
2,004.03 sa dīdayaduśatīrūrmyā ā dakṣāyyo yo dāsvate dama ā ||
2,004.04  asya raṇvā svasyeva puṣṭiḥ saṃdṛṣṭirasya hiyānasya dakṣoḥ |
2,004.04 vi yo bharibhradoṣadhīṣu jihvāmatyo na rathyo dodhavīti vārān ||
2,004.05  ā yanme abhvaṃ vanadaḥ panantośigbhyo nāmimīta varṇam |
2,004.05 sa citreṇa cikite raṃsu bhāsā jujurvāṃ yo muhurā yuvā bhūt ||
2,004.06  ā yo vanā tātṛṣāṇo na bhāti vārṇa pathā rathyeva svānīt |
2,004.06 kṛṣṇādhvā tapū raṇvaściketa dyauriva smayamāno nabhobhiḥ ||
2,004.07  sa yo vyasthādabhi dakṣadurvīṃ paśurnaiti svayuragopāḥ |
2,004.07 agniḥ śociṣmāṃ atasānyuṣṇankṛṣṇavyathirasvadayanna bhūma ||
2,004.08  nū te pūrvasyāvaso adhītau tṛtīye vidathe manma śaṃsi |
2,004.08 asme agne saṃyadvīraṃ bṛhantaṃ kṣumantaṃ vājaṃ svapatyaṃ rayiṃ dāḥ ||
2,004.09  tvayā yathā gṛtsamadāso agne guhā vanvanta uparāṃ abhi ṣyuḥ |
2,004.09 suvīrāso abhimātiṣāhaḥ smatsūribhyo gṛṇate tadvayo dhāḥ ||

2,005.01  hotājaniṣṭa cetanaḥ pitā pitṛbhya ūtaye |
2,005.01 prayakṣañjenyaṃ vasu śakema vājino yamam ||
2,005.02  ā yasminsapta raśmayastatā yajñasya netari |
2,005.02 manuṣvaddaivyamaṣṭamaṃ potā viśvaṃ tadinvati ||
2,005.03  dadhanve vā yadīmanu vocadbrahmāṇi veru tat |
2,005.03 pari viśvāni kāvyā nemiścakramivābhavat ||
2,005.04  sākaṃ hi śucinā śuciḥ praśāstā kratunājani |
2,005.04 vidvāṃ asya vratā dhruvā vayā ivānu rohate ||
2,005.05  tā asya varṇamāyuvo neṣṭuḥ sacanta dhenavaḥ |
2,005.05 kuvittisṛbhya ā varaṃ svasāro yā idaṃ yayuḥ ||
2,005.06  yadī māturupa svasā ghṛtaṃ bharantyasthita |
2,005.06 tāsāmadhvaryurāgatau yavo vṛṣṭīva modate ||
2,005.07  svaḥ svāya dhāyase kṛṇutāmṛtvigṛtvijam |
2,005.07 stomaṃ yajñaṃ cādaraṃ vanemā rarimā vayam ||
2,005.08  yathā vidvāṃ araṃ karadviśvebhyo yajatebhyaḥ |
2,005.08 ayamagne tve api yaṃ yajñaṃ cakṛmā vayam ||

2,006.01  imāṃ me agne samidhamimāmupasadaṃ vaneḥ |
2,006.01 imā u ṣu śrudhī giraḥ ||
2,006.02  ayā te agne vidhemorjo napādaśvamiṣṭe |
2,006.02 enā sūktena sujāta ||
2,006.03  taṃ tvā gīrbhirgirvaṇasaṃ draviṇasyuṃ draviṇodaḥ |
2,006.03 saparyema saparyavaḥ ||
2,006.04  sa bodhi sūrirmaghavā vasupate vasudāvan |
2,006.04 yuyodhyasmaddveṣāṃsi ||
2,006.05  sa no vṛṣṭiṃ divaspari sa no vājamanarvāṇam |
2,006.05 sa naḥ sahasriṇīriṣaḥ ||
2,006.06  īḻānāyāvasyave yaviṣṭha dūta no girā |
2,006.06 yajiṣṭha hotarā gahi ||
2,006.07  antarhyagna īyase vidvāñjanmobhayā kave |
2,006.07 dūto janyeva mitryaḥ ||
2,006.08  sa vidvāṃ ā ca piprayo yakṣi cikitva ānuṣak |
2,006.08 ā cāsminsatsi barhiṣi ||

2,007.01  śreṣṭhaṃ yaviṣṭha bhāratāgne dyumantamā bhara |
2,007.01 vaso puruspṛhaṃ rayim ||
2,007.02  mā no arātirīśata devasya martyasya ca |
2,007.02 parṣi tasyā uta dviṣaḥ ||
2,007.03  viśvā uta tvayā vayaṃ dhārā udanyā iva |
2,007.03 ati gāhemahi dviṣaḥ ||
2,007.04  śuciḥ pāvaka vandyo'gne bṛhadvi rocase |
2,007.04 tvaṃ ghṛtebhirāhutaḥ ||
2,007.05  tvaṃ no asi bhāratāgne vaśābhirukṣabhiḥ |
2,007.05 aṣṭāpadībhirāhutaḥ ||
2,007.06  drvannaḥ sarpirāsutiḥ pratno hotā vareṇyaḥ |
2,007.06 sahasasputro adbhutaḥ ||

2,008.01  vājayanniva nū rathānyogāṃ agnerupa stuhi |
2,008.01 yaśastamasya mīḻhuṣaḥ ||
2,008.02  yaḥ sunītho dadāśuṣe'juryo jarayannarim |
2,008.02 cārupratīka āhutaḥ ||
2,008.03  ya u śriyā dameṣvā doṣoṣasi praśasyate |
2,008.03 yasya vrataṃ na mīyate ||
2,008.04  ā yaḥ svarṇa bhānunā citro vibhātyarciṣā |
2,008.04 añjāno ajarairabhi ||
2,008.05  atrimanu svarājyamagnimukthāni vāvṛdhuḥ |
2,008.05 viśvā adhi śriyo dadhe ||
2,008.06  agnerindrasya somasya devānāmūtibhirvayam |
2,008.06 ariṣyantaḥ sacemahyabhi ṣyāma pṛtanyataḥ ||

2,009.01  ni hotā hotṛṣadane vidānastveṣo dīdivāṃ asadatsudakṣaḥ |
2,009.01 adabdhavratapramatirvasiṣṭhaḥ sahasrambharaḥ śucijihvo agniḥ ||
2,009.02  tvaṃ dūtastvamu naḥ paraspāstvaṃ vasya ā vṛṣabha praṇetā |
2,009.02 agne tokasya nastane tanūnāmaprayucchandīdyadbodhi gopāḥ ||
2,009.03  vidhema te parame janmannagne vidhema stomairavare sadhasthe |
2,009.03 yasmādyonerudārithā yaje taṃ pra tve havīṃṣi juhure samiddhe ||
2,009.04  agne yajasva haviṣā yajīyāñchruṣṭī deṣṇamabhi gṛṇīhi rādhaḥ |
2,009.04 tvaṃ hyasi rayipatī rayīṇāṃ tvaṃ śukrasya vacaso manotā ||
2,009.05  ubhayaṃ te na kṣīyate vasavyaṃ divedive jāyamānasya dasma |
2,009.05 kṛdhi kṣumantaṃ jaritāramagne kṛdhi patiṃ svapatyasya rāyaḥ ||
2,009.06  sainānīkena suvidatro asme yaṣṭā devāṃ āyajiṣṭhaḥ svasti |
2,009.06 adabdho gopā uta naḥ paraspā agne dyumaduta revaddidīhi ||

2,010.01  johūtro agniḥ prathamaḥ piteveḻaspade manuṣā yatsamiddhaḥ |
2,010.01 śriyaṃ vasāno amṛto vicetā marmṛjenyaḥ śravasyaḥ sa vājī ||
2,010.02  śrūyā agniścitrabhānurhavaṃ me viśvābhirgīrbhiramṛto vicetāḥ |
2,010.02 śyāvā rathaṃ vahato rohitā votāruṣāha cakre vibhṛtraḥ ||
2,010.03  uttānāyāmajanayansuṣūtaṃ bhuvadagniḥ purupeśāsu garbhaḥ |
2,010.03 śiriṇāyāṃ cidaktunā mahobhiraparīvṛto vasati pracetāḥ ||
2,010.04  jigharmyagniṃ haviṣā ghṛtena pratikṣiyantaṃ bhuvanāni viśvā |
2,010.04 pṛthuṃ tiraścā vayasā bṛhantaṃ vyaciṣṭhamannai rabhasaṃ dṛśānam ||
2,010.05  ā viśvataḥ pratyañcaṃ jigharmyarakṣasā manasā tajjuṣeta |
2,010.05 maryaśrī spṛhayadvarṇo agnirnābhimṛśe tanvā jarbhurāṇaḥ ||
2,010.06  jñeyā bhāgaṃ sahasāno vareṇa tvādūtāso manuvadvadema |
2,010.06 anūnamagniṃ juhvā vacasyā madhupṛcaṃ dhanasā johavīmi ||

2,011.01  śrudhī havamindra mā riṣaṇyaḥ syāma te dāvane vasūnām |
2,011.01 imā hi tvāmūrjo vardhayanti vasūyavaḥ sindhavo na kṣarantaḥ ||
2,011.02  sṛjo mahīrindra yā apinvaḥ pariṣṭhitā ahinā śūra pūrvīḥ |
2,011.02 amartyaṃ ciddāsaṃ manyamānamavābhinadukthairvāvṛdhānaḥ ||
2,011.03  uktheṣvinnu śūra yeṣu cākanstomeṣvindra rudriyeṣu ca |
2,011.03 tubhyedetā yāsu mandasānaḥ pra vāyave sisrate na śubhrāḥ ||
2,011.04  śubhraṃ nu te śuṣmaṃ vardhayantaḥ śubhraṃ vajraṃ bāhvordadhānāḥ |
2,011.04 śubhrastvamindra vāvṛdhāno asme dāsīrviśaḥ sūryeṇa sahyāḥ ||
2,011.05  guhā hitaṃ guhyaṃ gūḻhamapsvapīvṛtaṃ māyinaṃ kṣiyantam |
2,011.05 uto apo dyāṃ tastabhvāṃsamahannahiṃ śūra vīryeṇa ||
2,011.06  stavā nu ta indra pūrvyā mahānyuta stavāma nūtanā kṛtāni |
2,011.06 stavā vajraṃ bāhvoruśantaṃ stavā harī sūryasya ketū ||
2,011.07  harī nu ta indra vājayantā ghṛtaścutaṃ svāramasvārṣṭām |
2,011.07 vi samanā bhūmiraprathiṣṭāraṃsta parvataścitsariṣyan ||
2,011.08  ni parvataḥ sādyaprayucchansaṃ mātṛbhirvāvaśāno akrān |
2,011.08 dūre pāre vāṇīṃ vardhayanta indreṣitāṃ dhamaniṃ paprathanni ||
2,011.09  indro mahāṃ sindhumāśayānaṃ māyāvinaṃ vṛtramasphuranniḥ |
2,011.09 arejetāṃ rodasī bhiyāne kanikradato vṛṣṇo asya vajrāt ||
2,011.10  aroravīdvṛṣṇo asya vajro'mānuṣaṃ yanmānuṣo nijūrvāt |
2,011.10 ni māyino dānavasya māyā apādayatpapivānsutasya ||
2,011.11  pibāpibedindra śūra somaṃ mandantu tvā mandinaḥ sutāsaḥ |
2,011.11 pṛṇantaste kukṣī vardhayantvitthā sutaḥ paura indramāva ||
2,011.12  tve indrāpyabhūma viprā dhiyaṃ vanema ṛtayā sapantaḥ |
2,011.12 avasyavo dhīmahi praśastiṃ sadyaste rāyo dāvane syāma ||
2,011.13  syāma te ta indra ye ta ūtī avasyava ūrjaṃ vardhayantaḥ |
2,011.13 śuṣmintamaṃ yaṃ cākanāma devāsme rayiṃ rāsi vīravantam ||
2,011.14  rāsi kṣayaṃ rāsi mitramasme rāsi śardha indra mārutaṃ naḥ |
2,011.14 sajoṣaso ye ca mandasānāḥ pra vāyavaḥ pāntyagraṇītim ||
2,011.15  vyantvinnu yeṣu mandasānastṛpatsomaṃ pāhi drahyadindra |
2,011.15 asmānsu pṛtsvā tarutrāvardhayo dyāṃ bṛhadbhirarkaiḥ ||
2,011.16  bṛhanta innu ye te tarutrokthebhirvā sumnamāvivāsān |
2,011.16 stṛṇānāso barhiḥ pastyāvattvotā idindra vājamagman ||
2,011.17  ugreṣvinnu śūra mandasānastrikadrukeṣu pāhi somamindra |
2,011.17 pradodhuvacchmaśruṣu prīṇāno yāhi haribhyāṃ sutasya pītim ||
2,011.18  dhiṣvā śavaḥ śūra yena vṛtramavābhinaddānumaurṇavābham |
2,011.18 apāvṛṇorjyotirāryāya ni savyataḥ sādi dasyurindra ||
2,011.19  sanema ye ta ūtibhistaranto viśvā spṛdha āryeṇa dasyūn |
2,011.19 asmabhyaṃ tattvāṣṭraṃ viśvarūpamarandhayaḥ sākhyasya tritāya ||
2,011.20  asya suvānasya mandinastritasya nyarbudaṃ vāvṛdhāno astaḥ |
2,011.20 avartayatsūryo na cakraṃ bhinadvalamindro aṅgirasvān ||
2,011.21  nūnaṃ sā te prati varaṃ jaritre duhīyadindra dakṣiṇā maghonī |
2,011.21 śikṣā stotṛbhyo māti dhagbhago no bṛhadvadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||

2,012.01  yo jāta eva prathamo manasvāndevo devānkratunā paryabhūṣat |
2,012.01 yasya śuṣmādrodasī abhyasetāṃ nṛmṇasya mahnā sa janāsa indraḥ ||
2,012.02  yaḥ pṛthivīṃ vyathamānāmadṛṃhadyaḥ parvatānprakupitāṃ aramṇāt |
2,012.02 yo antarikṣaṃ vimame varīyo yo dyāmastabhnātsa janāsa indraḥ ||
2,012.03  yo hatvāhimariṇātsapta sindhūnyo gā udājadapadhā valasya |
2,012.03 yo aśmanorantaragniṃ jajāna saṃvṛksamatsu sa janāsa indraḥ ||
2,012.04  yenemā viśvā cyavanā kṛtāni yo dāsaṃ varṇamadharaṃ guhākaḥ |
2,012.04 śvaghnīva yo jigīvāṃllakṣamādadaryaḥ puṣṭāni sa janāsa indraḥ ||
2,012.05  yaṃ smā pṛcchanti kuha seti ghoramutemāhurnaiṣo astītyenam |
2,012.05 so aryaḥ puṣṭīrvija ivā mināti śradasmai dhatta sa janāsa indraḥ ||
2,012.06  yo radhrasya coditā yaḥ kṛśasya yo brahmaṇo nādhamānasya kīreḥ |
2,012.06 yuktagrāvṇo yo'vitā suśipraḥ sutasomasya sa janāsa indraḥ ||
2,012.07  yasyāśvāsaḥ pradiśi yasya gāvo yasya grāmā yasya viśve rathāsaḥ |
2,012.07 yaḥ sūryaṃ ya uṣasaṃ jajāna yo apāṃ netā sa janāsa indraḥ ||
2,012.08  yaṃ krandasī saṃyatī vihvayete pare'vara ubhayā amitrāḥ |
2,012.08 samānaṃ cidrathamātasthivāṃsā nānā havete sa janāsa indraḥ ||
2,012.09  yasmānna ṛte vijayante janāso yaṃ yudhyamānā avase havante |
2,012.09 yo viśvasya pratimānaṃ babhūva yo acyutacyutsa janāsa indraḥ ||
2,012.10  yaḥ śaśvato mahyeno dadhānānamanyamānāñcharvā jaghāna |
2,012.10 yaḥ śardhate nānudadāti śṛdhyāṃ yo dasyorhantā sa janāsa indraḥ ||
2,012.11  yaḥ śambaraṃ parvateṣu kṣiyantaṃ catvāriṃśyāṃ śaradyanvavindat |
2,012.11 ojāyamānaṃ yo ahiṃ jaghāna dānuṃ śayānaṃ sa janāsa indraḥ ||
2,012.12  yaḥ saptaraśmirvṛṣabhastuviṣmānavāsṛjatsartave sapta sindhūn |
2,012.12 yo rauhiṇamasphuradvajrabāhurdyāmārohantaṃ sa janāsa indraḥ ||
2,012.13  dyāvā cidasmai pṛthivī namete śuṣmāccidasya parvatā bhayante |
2,012.13 yaḥ somapā nicito vajrabāhuryo vajrahastaḥ sa janāsa indraḥ ||
2,012.14  yaḥ sunvantamavati yaḥ pacantaṃ yaḥ śaṃsantaṃ yaḥ śaśamānamūtī |
2,012.14 yasya brahma vardhanaṃ yasya somo yasyedaṃ rādhaḥ sa janāsa indraḥ ||
2,012.15  yaḥ sunvate pacate dudhra ā cidvājaṃ dardarṣi sa kilāsi satyaḥ |
2,012.15 vayaṃ ta indra viśvaha priyāsaḥ suvīrāso vidathamā vadema ||

2,013.01  ṛturjanitrī tasyā apaspari makṣū jāta āviśadyāsu vardhate |
2,013.01 tadāhanā abhavatpipyuṣī payo'ṃśoḥ pīyūṣaṃ prathamaṃ tadukthyam ||
2,013.02  sadhrīmā yanti pari bibhratīḥ payo viśvapsnyāya pra bharanta bhojanam |
2,013.02 samāno adhvā pravatāmanuṣyade yastākṛṇoḥ prathamaṃ sāsyukthyaḥ ||
2,013.03  anveko vadati yaddadāti tadrūpā minantadapā eka īyate |
2,013.03 viśvā ekasya vinudastitikṣate yastākṛṇoḥ prathamaṃ sāsyukthyaḥ ||
2,013.04  prajābhyaḥ puṣṭiṃ vibhajanta āsate rayimiva pṛṣṭhaṃ prabhavantamāyate |
2,013.04 asinvandaṃṣṭraiḥ pituratti bhojanaṃ yastākṛṇoḥ prathamaṃ sāsyukthyaḥ ||
2,013.05  adhākṛṇoḥ pṛthivīṃ saṃdṛśe dive yo dhautīnāmahihannāriṇakpathaḥ |
2,013.05 taṃ tvā stomebhirudabhirna vājinaṃ devaṃ devā ajanansāsyukthyaḥ ||
2,013.06  yo bhojanaṃ ca dayase ca vardhanamārdrādā śuṣkaṃ madhumaddudohitha |
2,013.06 sa śevadhiṃ ni dadhiṣe vivasvati viśvasyaika īśiṣe sāsyukthyaḥ ||
2,013.07  yaḥ puṣpiṇīśca prasvaśca dharmaṇādhi dāne vyavanīradhārayaḥ |
2,013.07 yaścāsamā ajano didyuto diva ururūrvāṃ abhitaḥ sāsyukthyaḥ ||
2,013.08  yo nārmaraṃ sahavasuṃ nihantave pṛkṣāya ca dāsaveśāya cāvahaḥ |
2,013.08 ūrjayantyā apariviṣṭamāsyamutaivādya purukṛtsāsyukthyaḥ ||
2,013.09  śataṃ vā yasya daśa sākamādya ekasya śruṣṭau yaddha codamāvitha |
2,013.09 arajjau dasyūnsamunabdabhītaye suprāvyo abhavaḥ sāsyukthyaḥ ||
2,013.10  viśvedanu rodhanā asya pauṃsyaṃ dadurasmai dadhire kṛtnave dhanam |
2,013.10 ṣaḻ astabhnā viṣṭiraḥ pañca saṃdṛśaḥ pari paro abhavaḥ sāsyukthyaḥ ||
2,013.11  supravācanaṃ tava vīra vīryaṃ yadekena kratunā vindase vasu |
2,013.11 jātūṣṭhirasya pra vayaḥ sahasvato yā cakartha sendra viśvāsyukthyaḥ ||
2,013.12  aramayaḥ sarapasastarāya kaṃ turvītaye ca vayyāya ca srutim |
2,013.12 nīcā santamudanayaḥ parāvṛjaṃ prāndhaṃ śroṇaṃ śravayansāsyukthyaḥ ||
2,013.13  asmabhyaṃ tadvaso dānāya rādhaḥ samarthayasva bahu te vasavyam |
2,013.13 indra yaccitraṃ śravasyā anu dyūnbṛhadvadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||

2,014.01  adhvaryavo bharatendrāya somamāmatrebhiḥ siñcatā madyamandhaḥ |
2,014.01 kāmī hi vīraḥ sadamasya pītiṃ juhota vṛṣṇe tadideṣa vaṣṭi ||
2,014.02  adhvaryavo yo apo vavrivāṃsaṃ vṛtraṃ jaghānāśanyeva vṛkṣam |
2,014.02 tasmā etaṃ bharata tadvaśāyaṃ eṣa indro arhati pītimasya ||
2,014.03  adhvaryavo yo dṛbhīkaṃ jaghāna yo gā udājadapa hi valaṃ vaḥ |
2,014.03 tasmā etamantarikṣe na vātamindraṃ somairorṇuta jūrna vastraiḥ ||
2,014.04  adhvaryavo ya uraṇaṃ jaghāna nava cakhvāṃsaṃ navatiṃ ca bāhūn |
2,014.04 yo arbudamava nīcā babādhe tamindraṃ somasya bhṛthe hinota ||
2,014.05  adhvaryavo yaḥ svaśnaṃ jaghāna yaḥ śuṣṇamaśuṣaṃ yo vyaṃsam |
2,014.05 yaḥ pipruṃ namuciṃ yo rudhikrāṃ tasmā indrāyāndhaso juhota ||
2,014.06  adhvaryavo yaḥ śataṃ śambarasya puro bibhedāśmaneva pūrvīḥ |
2,014.06 yo varcinaḥ śatamindraḥ sahasramapāvapadbharatā somamasmai ||
2,014.07  adhvaryavo yaḥ śatamā sahasraṃ bhūmyā upasthe'vapajjaghanvān |
2,014.07 kutsasyāyoratithigvasya vīrānnyāvṛṇagbharatā somamasmai ||
2,014.08  adhvaryavo yannaraḥ kāmayādhve śruṣṭī vahanto naśathā tadindre |
2,014.08 gabhastipūtaṃ bharata śrutāyendrāya somaṃ yajyavo juhota ||
2,014.09  adhvaryavaḥ kartanā śruṣṭimasmai vane nipūtaṃ vana unnayadhvam |
2,014.09 juṣāṇo hastyamabhi vāvaśe va indrāya somaṃ madiraṃ juhota ||
2,014.10  adhvaryavaḥ payasodharyathā goḥ somebhirīṃ pṛṇatā bhojamindram |
2,014.10 vedāhamasya nibhṛtaṃ ma etadditsantaṃ bhūyo yajataściketa ||
2,014.11  adhvaryavo yo divyasya vasvo yaḥ pārthivasya kṣamyasya rājā |
2,014.11 tamūrdaraṃ na pṛṇatā yavenendraṃ somebhistadapo vo astu ||
2,014.12  asmabhyaṃ tadvaso dānāya rādhaḥ samarthayasva bahu te vasavyam |
2,014.12 indra yaccitraṃ śravasyā anu dyūnbṛhadvadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||

2,015.01  pra ghā nvasya mahato mahāni satyā satyasya karaṇāni vocam |
2,015.01 trikadrukeṣvapibatsutasyāsya made ahimindro jaghāna ||
2,015.02  avaṃśe dyāmastabhāyadbṛhantamā rodasī apṛṇadantarikṣam |
2,015.02 sa dhārayatpṛthivīṃ paprathacca somasya tā mada indraścakāra ||
2,015.03  sadmeva prāco vi mimāya mānairvajreṇa khānyatṛṇannadīnām |
2,015.03 vṛthāsṛjatpathibhirdīrghayāthaiḥ somasya tā mada indraścakāra ||
2,015.04  sa pravoḻhṝnparigatyā dabhīterviśvamadhāgāyudhamiddhe agnau |
2,015.04 saṃ gobhiraśvairasṛjadrathebhiḥ somasya tā mada indraścakāra ||
2,015.05  sa īṃ mahīṃ dhunimetoraramṇātso asnātṝnapārayatsvasti |
2,015.05 ta utsnāya rayimabhi pra tasthuḥ somasya tā mada indraścakāra ||
2,015.06  sodañcaṃ sindhumariṇānmahitvā vajreṇāna uṣasaḥ saṃ pipeṣa |
2,015.06 ajavaso javinībhirvivṛścansomasya tā mada indraścakāra ||
2,015.07  sa vidvāṃ apagohaṃ kanīnāmāvirbhavannudatiṣṭhatparāvṛk |
2,015.07 prati śroṇa sthādvyanagacaṣṭa somasya tā mada indraścakāra ||
2,015.08  bhinadvalamaṅgirobhirgṛṇāno vi parvatasya dṛṃhitānyairat |
2,015.08 riṇagrodhāṃsi kṛtrimāṇyeṣāṃ somasya tā mada indraścakāra ||
2,015.09  svapnenābhyupyā cumuriṃ dhuniṃ ca jaghantha dasyuṃ pra dabhītimāvaḥ |
2,015.09 rambhī cidatra vivide hiraṇyaṃ somasya tā mada indraścakāra ||
2,015.10  nūnaṃ sā te prati varaṃ jaritre duhīyadindra dakṣiṇā maghonī |
2,015.10 śikṣā stotṛbhyo māti dhagbhago no bṛhadvadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||

2,016.01  pra vaḥ satāṃ jyeṣṭhatamāya suṣṭutimagnāviva samidhāne havirbhare |
2,016.01 indramajuryaṃ jarayantamukṣitaṃ sanādyuvānamavase havāmahe ||
2,016.02  yasmādindrādbṛhataḥ kiṃ canemṛte viśvānyasminsambhṛtādhi vīryā |
2,016.02 jaṭhare somaṃ tanvī saho maho haste vajraṃ bharati śīrṣaṇi kratum ||
2,016.03  na kṣoṇībhyāṃ paribhve ta indriyaṃ na samudraiḥ parvatairindra te rathaḥ |
2,016.03 na te vajramanvaśnoti kaścana yadāśubhiḥ patasi yojanā puru ||
2,016.04  viśve hyasmai yajatāya dhṛṣṇave kratuṃ bharanti vṛṣabhāya saścate |
2,016.04 vṛṣā yajasva haviṣā viduṣṭaraḥ pibendra somaṃ vṛṣabheṇa bhānunā ||
2,016.05  vṛṣṇaḥ kośaḥ pavate madhva ūrmirvṛṣabhānnāya vṛṣabhāya pātave |
2,016.05 vṛṣaṇādhvaryū vṛṣabhāso adrayo vṛṣaṇaṃ somaṃ vṛṣabhāya suṣvati ||
2,016.06  vṛṣā te vajra uta te vṛṣā ratho vṛṣaṇā harī vṛṣabhāṇyāyudhā |
2,016.06 vṛṣṇo madasya vṛṣabha tvamīśiṣa indra somasya vṛṣabhasya tṛpṇuhi ||
2,016.07  pra te nāvaṃ na samane vacasyuvaṃ brahmaṇā yāmi savaneṣu dādhṛṣiḥ |
2,016.07 kuvinno asya vacaso nibodhiṣadindramutsaṃ na vasunaḥ sicāmahe ||
2,016.08  purā sambādhādabhyā vavṛtsva no dhenurna vatsaṃ yavasasya pipyuṣī |
2,016.08 sakṛtsu te sumatibhiḥ śatakrato saṃ patnībhirna vṛṣaṇo nasīmahi ||
2,016.09  nūnaṃ sā te prati varaṃ jaritre duhīyadindra dakṣiṇā maghonī |
2,016.09 śikṣā stotṛbhyo māti dhagbhago no bṛhadvadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||

2,017.01  tadasmai navyamaṅgirasvadarcata śuṣmā yadasya pratnathodīrate |
2,017.01 viśvā yadgotrā sahasā parīvṛtā made somasya dṛṃhitānyairayat ||
2,017.02  sa bhūtu yo ha prathamāya dhāyasa ojo mimāno mahimānamātirat |
2,017.02 śūro yo yutsu tanvaṃ parivyata śīrṣaṇi dyāṃ mahinā pratyamuñcata ||
2,017.03  adhākṛṇoḥ prathamaṃ vīryaṃ mahadyadasyāgre brahmaṇā śuṣmamairayaḥ |
2,017.03 ratheṣṭhena haryaśvena vicyutāḥ pra jīrayaḥ sisrate sadhryakpṛthak ||
2,017.04  adhā yo viśvā bhuvanābhi majmaneśānakṛtpravayā abhyavardhata |
2,017.04 ādrodasī jyotiṣā vahnirātanotsīvyantamāṃsi dudhitā samavyayat ||
2,017.05  sa prācīnānparvatāndṛṃhadojasādharācīnamakṛṇodapāmapaḥ |
2,017.05 adhārayatpṛthivīṃ viśvadhāyasamastabhnānmāyayā dyāmavasrasaḥ ||
2,017.06  sāsmā araṃ bāhubhyāṃ yaṃ pitākṛṇodviśvasmādā januṣo vedasaspari |
2,017.06 yenā pṛthivyāṃ ni kriviṃ śayadhyai vajreṇa hatvyavṛṇaktuviṣvaṇiḥ ||
2,017.07  amājūriva pitroḥ sacā satī samānādā sadasastvāmiye bhagam |
2,017.07 kṛdhi praketamupa māsyā bhara daddhi bhāgaṃ tanvo yena māmahaḥ ||
2,017.08  bhojaṃ tvāmindra vayaṃ huvema dadiṣṭvamindrāpāṃsi vājān |
2,017.08 aviḍḍhīndra citrayā na ūtī kṛdhi vṛṣannindra vasyaso naḥ ||
2,017.09  nūnaṃ sā te prati varaṃ jaritre duhīyadindra dakṣiṇā maghonī |
2,017.09 śikṣā stotṛbhyo māti dhagbhago no bṛhadvadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||

2,018.01  prātā ratho navo yoji sasniścaturyugastrikaśaḥ saptaraśmiḥ |
2,018.01 daśāritro manuṣyaḥ svarṣāḥ sa iṣṭibhirmatibhī raṃhyo bhūt ||
2,018.02  sāsmā araṃ prathamaṃ sa dvitīyamuto tṛtīyaṃ manuṣaḥ sa hotā |
2,018.02 anyasyā garbhamanya ū jananta so anyebhiḥ sacate jenyo vṛṣā ||
2,018.03  harī nu kaṃ ratha indrasya yojamāyai sūktena vacasā navena |
2,018.03 mo ṣu tvāmatra bahavo hi viprā ni rīramanyajamānāso anye ||
2,018.04  ā dvābhyāṃ haribhyāmindra yāhyā caturbhirā ṣaḍbhirhūyamānaḥ |
2,018.04 āṣṭābhirdaśabhiḥ somapeyamayaṃ sutaḥ sumakha mā mṛdhaskaḥ ||
2,018.05  ā viṃśatyā triṃśatā yāhyarvāṅā catvāriṃśatā haribhiryujānaḥ |
2,018.05 ā pañcāśatā surathebhirindrā ṣaṣṭyā saptatyā somapeyam ||
2,018.06  āśītyā navatyā yāhyarvāṅā śatena haribhiruhyamānaḥ |
2,018.06 ayaṃ hi te śunahotreṣu soma indra tvāyā pariṣikto madāya ||
2,018.07  mama brahmendra yāhyacchā viśvā harī dhuri dhiṣvā rathasya |
2,018.07 purutrā hi vihavyo babhūthāsmiñchūra savane mādayasva ||
2,018.08  na ma indreṇa sakhyaṃ vi yoṣadasmabhyamasya dakṣiṇā duhīta |
2,018.08 upa jyeṣṭhe varūthe gabhastau prāyeprāye jigīvāṃsaḥ syāma ||
2,018.09  nūnaṃ sā te prati varaṃ jaritre duhīyadindra dakṣiṇā maghonī |
2,018.09 śikṣā stotṛbhyo māti dhagbhago no bṛhadvadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||

2,019.01  apāyyasyāndhaso madāya manīṣiṇaḥ suvānasya prayasaḥ |
2,019.01 yasminnindraḥ pradivi vāvṛdhāna oko dadhe brahmaṇyantaśca naraḥ ||
2,019.02  asya mandāno madhvo vajrahasto'himindro arṇovṛtaṃ vi vṛścat |
2,019.02 pra yadvayo na svasarāṇyacchā prayāṃsi ca nadīnāṃ cakramanta ||
2,019.03  sa māhina indro arṇo apāṃ prairayadahihācchā samudram |
2,019.03 ajanayatsūryaṃ vidadgā aktunāhnāṃ vayunāni sādhat ||
2,019.04  so apratīni manave purūṇīndro dāśaddāśuṣe hanti vṛtram |
2,019.04 sadyo yo nṛbhyo atasāyyo bhūtpaspṛdhānebhyaḥ sūryasya sātau ||
2,019.05  sa sunvata indraḥ sūryamā devo riṇaṅmartyāya stavān |
2,019.05 ā yadrayiṃ guhadavadyamasmai bharadaṃśaṃ naitaśo daśasyan ||
2,019.06  sa randhayatsadivaḥ sārathaye śuṣṇamaśuṣaṃ kuyavaṃ kutsāya |
2,019.06 divodāsāya navatiṃ ca navendraḥ puro vyairacchambarasya ||
2,019.07  evā ta indrocathamahema śravasyā na tmanā vājayantaḥ |
2,019.07 aśyāma tatsāptamāśuṣāṇā nanamo vadharadevasya pīyoḥ ||
2,019.08  evā te gṛtsamadāḥ śūra manmāvasyavo na vayunāni takṣuḥ |
2,019.08 brahmaṇyanta indra te navīya iṣamūrjaṃ sukṣitiṃ sumnamaśyuḥ ||
2,019.09  nūnaṃ sā te prati varaṃ jaritre duhīyadindra dakṣiṇā maghonī |
2,019.09 śikṣā stotṛbhyo māti dhagbhago no bṛhadvadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||

2,020.01  vayaṃ te vaya indra viddhi ṣu ṇaḥ pra bharāmahe vājayurna ratham |
2,020.01 vipanyavo dīdhyato manīṣā sumnamiyakṣantastvāvato nṝn ||
2,020.02  tvaṃ na indra tvābhirūtī tvāyato abhiṣṭipāsi janān |
2,020.02 tvamino dāśuṣo varūtetthādhīrabhi yo nakṣati tvā ||
2,020.03  sa no yuvendro johūtraḥ sakhā śivo narāmastu pātā |
2,020.03 yaḥ śaṃsantaṃ yaḥ śaśamānamūtī pacantaṃ ca stuvantaṃ ca praṇeṣat ||
2,020.04  tamu stuṣa indraṃ taṃ gṛṇīṣe yasminpurā vāvṛdhuḥ śāśaduśca |
2,020.04 sa vasvaḥ kāmaṃ pīparadiyāno brahmaṇyato nūtanasyāyoḥ ||
2,020.05  so aṅgirasāmucathā jujuṣvānbrahmā tūtodindro gātumiṣṇan |
2,020.05 muṣṇannuṣasaḥ sūryeṇa stavānaśnasya cicchiśnathatpūrvyāṇi ||
2,020.06  sa ha śruta indro nāma deva ūrdhvo bhuvanmanuṣe dasmatamaḥ |
2,020.06 ava priyamarśasānasya sāhvāñchiro bharaddāsasya svadhāvān ||
2,020.07  sa vṛtrahendraḥ kṛṣṇayonīḥ purandaro dāsīrairayadvi |
2,020.07 ajanayanmanave kṣāmapaśca satrā śaṃsaṃ yajamānasya tūtot ||
2,020.08  tasmai tavasyamanu dāyi satrendrāya devebhirarṇasātau |
2,020.08 prati yadasya vajraṃ bāhvordhurhatvī dasyūnpura āyasīrni tārīt ||
2,020.09  nūnaṃ sā te prati varaṃ jaritre duhīyadindra dakṣiṇā maghonī |
2,020.09 śikṣā stotṛbhyo māti dhagbhago no bṛhadvadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||

2,021.01  viśvajite dhanajite svarjite satrājite nṛjita urvarājite |
2,021.01 aśvajite gojite abjite bharendrāya somaṃ yajatāya haryatam ||
2,021.02  abhibhuve'bhibhaṅgāya vanvate'ṣāḻhāya sahamānāya vedhase |
2,021.02 tuvigraye vahnaye duṣṭarītave satrāsāhe nama indrāya vocata ||
2,021.03  satrāsāho janabhakṣo janaṃsahaścyavano yudhmo anu joṣamukṣitaḥ |
2,021.03 vṛtañcayaḥ sahurirvikṣvārita indrasya vocaṃ pra kṛtāni vīryā ||
2,021.04  anānudo vṛṣabho dodhato vadho gambhīra ṛṣvo asamaṣṭakāvyaḥ |
2,021.04 radhracodaḥ śnathano vīḻitaspṛthurindraḥ suyajña uṣasaḥ svarjanat ||
2,021.05  yajñena gātumapturo vividrire dhiyo hinvānā uśijo manīṣiṇaḥ |
2,021.05 abhisvarā niṣadā gā avasyava indre hinvānā draviṇānyāśata ||
2,021.06  indra śreṣṭhāni draviṇāni dhehi cittiṃ dakṣasya subhagatvamasme |
2,021.06 poṣaṃ rayīṇāmariṣṭiṃ tanūnāṃ svādmānaṃ vācaḥ sudinatvamahnām ||

2,022.01  trikadrukeṣu mahiṣo yavāśiraṃ tuviśuṣmastṛpatsomamapibadviṣṇunā sutaṃ yathāvaśat |
2,022.01  sa īṃ mamāda mahi karma kartave mahāmuruṃ sainaṃ saścaddevo devaṃ satyamindraṃ satya induḥ ||
2,022.02  adha tviṣīmāṃ abhyojasā kriviṃ yudhābhavadā rodasī apṛṇadasya majmanā pra vāvṛdhe |
2,022.02  adhattānyaṃ jaṭhare premaricyata sainaṃ saścaddevo devaṃ satyamindraṃ satya induḥ ||
2,022.03  sākaṃ jātaḥ kratunā sākamojasā vavakṣitha sākaṃ vṛddho vīryaiḥ sāsahirmṛdho vicarṣaṇiḥ |
2,022.03  dātā rādha stuvate kāmyaṃ vasu sainaṃ saścaddevo devaṃ satyamindraṃ satya induḥ ||
2,022.04  tava tyannaryaṃ nṛto'pa indra prathamaṃ pūrvyaṃ divi pravācyaṃ kṛtam |
2,022.04 yaddevasya śavasā prāriṇā asuṃ riṇannapaḥ |
2,022.04  bhuvadviśvamabhyādevamojasā vidādūrjaṃ śatakraturvidādiṣam ||

2,023.01  gaṇānāṃ tvā gaṇapatiṃ havāmahe kaviṃ kavīnāmupamaśravastamam |
2,023.01 jyeṣṭharājaṃ brahmaṇāṃ brahmaṇaspata ā naḥ śṛṇvannūtibhiḥ sīda sādanam ||
2,023.02  devāścitte asurya pracetaso bṛhaspate yajñiyaṃ bhāgamānaśuḥ |
2,023.02 usrā iva sūryo jyotiṣā maho viśveṣāmijjanitā brahmaṇāmasi ||
2,023.03  ā vibādhyā parirāpastamāṃsi ca jyotiṣmantaṃ rathamṛtasya tiṣṭhasi |
2,023.03 bṛhaspate bhīmamamitradambhanaṃ rakṣohaṇaṃ gotrabhidaṃ svarvidam ||
2,023.04  sunītibhirnayasi trāyase janaṃ yastubhyaṃ dāśānna tamaṃho aśnavat |
2,023.04 brahmadviṣastapano manyumīrasi bṛhaspate mahi tatte mahitvanam ||
2,023.05  na tamaṃho na duritaṃ kutaścana nārātayastitirurna dvayāvinaḥ |
2,023.05 viśvā idasmāddhvaraso vi bādhase yaṃ sugopā rakṣasi brahmaṇaspate ||
2,023.06  tvaṃ no gopāḥ pathikṛdvicakṣaṇastava vratāya matibhirjarāmahe |
2,023.06 bṛhaspate yo no abhi hvaro dadhe svā taṃ marmartu ducchunā harasvatī ||
2,023.07  uta vā yo no marcayādanāgaso'rātīvā martaḥ sānuko vṛkaḥ |
2,023.07 bṛhaspate apa taṃ vartayā pathaḥ sugaṃ no asyai devavītaye kṛdhi ||
2,023.08  trātāraṃ tvā tanūnāṃ havāmahe'vaspartaradhivaktāramasmayum |
2,023.08 bṛhaspate devanido ni barhaya mā durevā uttaraṃ sumnamunnaśan ||
2,023.09  tvayā vayaṃ suvṛdhā brahmaṇaspate spārhā vasu manuṣyā dadīmahi |
2,023.09 yā no dūre taḻito yā arātayo'bhi santi jambhayā tā anapnasaḥ ||
2,023.10  tvayā vayamuttamaṃ dhīmahe vayo bṛhaspate papriṇā sasninā yujā |
2,023.10 mā no duḥśaṃso abhidipsurīśata pra suśaṃsā matibhistāriṣīmahi ||
2,023.11  anānudo vṛṣabho jagmirāhavaṃ niṣṭaptā śatruṃ pṛtanāsu sāsahiḥ |
2,023.11 asi satya ṛṇayā brahmaṇaspata ugrasya ciddamitā vīḻuharṣiṇaḥ ||
2,023.12  adevena manasā yo riṣaṇyati śāsāmugro manyamāno jighāṃsati |
2,023.12 bṛhaspate mā praṇaktasya no vadho ni karma manyuṃ durevasya śardhataḥ ||
2,023.13  bhareṣu havyo namasopasadyo gantā vājeṣu sanitā dhanaṃdhanam |
2,023.13 viśvā idaryo abhidipsvo mṛdho bṛhaspatirvi vavarhā rathāṃ iva ||
2,023.14  tejiṣṭhayā tapanī rakṣasastapa ye tvā nide dadhire dṛṣṭavīryam |
2,023.14 āvistatkṛṣva yadasatta ukthyaṃ bṛhaspate vi parirāpo ardaya ||
2,023.15  bṛhaspate ati yadaryo arhāddyumadvibhāti kratumajjaneṣu |
2,023.15 yaddīdayacchavasa ṛtaprajāta tadasmāsu draviṇaṃ dhehi citram ||
2,023.16  mā na stenebhyo ye abhi druhaspade nirāmiṇo ripavo'nneṣu jāgṛdhuḥ |
2,023.16 ā devānāmohate vi vrayo hṛdi bṛhaspate na paraḥ sāmno viduḥ ||
2,023.17  viśvebhyo hi tvā bhuvanebhyaspari tvaṣṭājanatsāmnaḥsāmnaḥ kaviḥ |
2,023.17 sa ṛṇacidṛṇayā brahmaṇaspatirdruho hantā maha ṛtasya dhartari ||
2,023.18  tava śriye vyajihīta parvato gavāṃ gotramudasṛjo yadaṅgiraḥ |
2,023.18 indreṇa yujā tamasā parīvṛtaṃ bṛhaspate nirapāmaubjo arṇavam ||
2,023.19  brahmaṇaspate tvamasya yantā sūktasya bodhi tanayaṃ ca jinva |
2,023.19 viśvaṃ tadbhadraṃ yadavanti devā bṛhadvadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||

2,024.01  semāmaviḍḍhi prabhṛtiṃ ya īśiṣe'yā vidhema navayā mahā girā |
2,024.01 yathā no mīḍhvānstavate sakhā tava bṛhaspate sīṣadhaḥ sota no matim ||
2,024.02  yo nantvānyanamannyojasotādardarmanyunā śambarāṇi vi |
2,024.02 prācyāvayadacyutā brahmaṇaspatirā cāviśadvasumantaṃ vi parvatam ||
2,024.03  taddevānāṃ devatamāya kartvamaśrathnandṛḻhāvradanta vīḻitā |
2,024.03 udgā ājadabhinadbrahmaṇā valamagūhattamo vyacakṣayatsvaḥ ||
2,024.04  aśmāsyamavataṃ brahmaṇaspatirmadhudhāramabhi yamojasātṛṇat |
2,024.04 tameva viśve papire svardṛśo bahu sākaṃ sisicurutsamudriṇam ||
2,024.05  sanā tā kā cidbhuvanā bhavītvā mādbhiḥ śaradbhirduro varanta vaḥ |
2,024.05 ayatantā carato anyadanyadidyā cakāra vayunā brahmaṇaspatiḥ ||
2,024.06  abhinakṣanto abhi ye tamānaśurnidhiṃ paṇīnāṃ paramaṃ guhā hitam |
2,024.06 te vidvāṃsaḥ praticakṣyānṛtā punaryata u āyantadudīyurāviśam ||
2,024.07  ṛtāvānaḥ praticakṣyānṛtā punarāta ā tasthuḥ kavayo mahaspathaḥ |
2,024.07 te bāhubhyāṃ dhamitamagnimaśmani nakiḥ ṣo astyaraṇo jahurhi tam ||
2,024.08  ṛtajyena kṣipreṇa brahmaṇaspatiryatra vaṣṭi pra tadaśnoti dhanvanā |
2,024.08 tasya sādhvīriṣavo yābhirasyati nṛcakṣaso dṛśaye karṇayonayaḥ ||
2,024.09  sa saṃnayaḥ sa vinayaḥ purohitaḥ sa suṣṭutaḥ sa yudhi brahmaṇaspatiḥ |
2,024.09 cākṣmo yadvājaṃ bharate matī dhanāditsūryastapati tapyaturvṛthā ||
2,024.10  vibhu prabhu prathamaṃ mehanāvato bṛhaspateḥ suvidatrāṇi rādhyā |
2,024.10 imā sātāni venyasya vājino yena janā ubhaye bhuñjate viśaḥ ||
2,024.11  yo'vare vṛjane viśvathā vibhurmahāmu raṇvaḥ śavasā vavakṣitha |
2,024.11 sa devo devānprati paprathe pṛthu viśvedu tā paribhūrbrahmaṇaspatiḥ ||
2,024.12  viśvaṃ satyaṃ maghavānā yuvoridāpaścana pra minanti vrataṃ vām |
2,024.12 acchendrābrahmaṇaspatī havirno'nnaṃ yujeva vājinā jigātam ||
2,024.13  utāśiṣṭhā anu śṛṇvanti vahnayaḥ sabheyo vipro bharate matī dhanā |
2,024.13 vīḻudveṣā anu vaśa ṛṇamādadiḥ sa ha vājī samithe brahmaṇaspatiḥ ||
2,024.14  brahmaṇaspaterabhavadyathāvaśaṃ satyo manyurmahi karmā kariṣyataḥ |
2,024.14 yo gā udājatsa dive vi cābhajanmahīva rītiḥ śavasāsaratpṛthak ||
2,024.15  brahmaṇaspate suyamasya viśvahā rāyaḥ syāma rathyo vayasvataḥ |
2,024.15 vīreṣu vīrāṃ upa pṛṅdhi nastvaṃ yadīśāno brahmaṇā veṣi me havam ||
2,024.16  brahmaṇaspate tvamasya yantā sūktasya bodhi tanayaṃ ca jinva |
2,024.16 viśvaṃ tadbhadraṃ yadavanti devā bṛhadvadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||

2,025.01  indhāno agniṃ vanavadvanuṣyataḥ kṛtabrahmā śūśuvadrātahavya it |
2,025.01 jātena jātamati sa pra sarsṛte yaṃyaṃ yujaṃ kṛṇute brahmaṇaspatiḥ ||
2,025.02  vīrebhirvīrānvanavadvanuṣyato gobhī rayiṃ paprathadbodhati tmanā |
2,025.02 tokaṃ ca tasya tanayaṃ ca vardhate yaṃyaṃ yujaṃ kṛṇute brahmaṇaspatiḥ ||
2,025.03  sindhurna kṣodaḥ śimīvāṃ ṛghāyato vṛṣeva vadhrīṃrabhi vaṣṭyojasā |
2,025.03 agneriva prasitirnāha vartave yaṃyaṃ yujaṃ kṛṇute brahmaṇaspatiḥ ||
2,025.04  tasmā arṣanti divyā asaścataḥ sa satvabhiḥ prathamo goṣu gacchati |
2,025.04 anibhṛṣṭataviṣirhantyojasā yaṃyaṃ yujaṃ kṛṇute brahmaṇaspatiḥ ||
2,025.05  tasmā idviśve dhunayanta sindhavo'cchidrā śarma dadhire purūṇi |
2,025.05 devānāṃ sumne subhagaḥ sa edhate yaṃyaṃ yujaṃ kṛṇute brahmaṇaspatiḥ ||

2,026.01  ṛjuricchaṃso vanavadvanuṣyato devayannidadevayantamabhyasat |
2,026.01 suprāvīridvanavatpṛtsu duṣṭaraṃ yajvedayajyorvi bhajāti bhojanam ||
2,026.02  yajasva vīra pra vihi manāyato bhadraṃ manaḥ kṛṇuṣva vṛtratūrye |
2,026.02 haviṣkṛṇuṣva subhago yathāsasi brahmaṇaspaterava ā vṛṇīmahe ||
2,026.03  sa ijjanena sa viśā sa janmanā sa putrairvājaṃ bharate dhanā nṛbhiḥ |
2,026.03 devānāṃ yaḥ pitaramāvivāsati śraddhāmanā haviṣā brahmaṇaspatim ||
2,026.04  yo asmai havyairghṛtavadbhiravidhatpra taṃ prācā nayati brahmaṇaspatiḥ |
2,026.04 uruṣyatīmaṃhaso rakṣatī riṣo'ṃhościdasmā urucakriradbhutaḥ ||

2,027.01  imā gira ādityebhyo ghṛtasnūḥ sanādrājabhyo juhvā juhomi |
2,027.01 śṛṇotu mitro aryamā bhago nastuvijāto varuṇo dakṣo aṃśaḥ ||
2,027.02  imaṃ stomaṃ sakratavo me adya mitro aryamā varuṇo juṣanta |
2,027.02 ādityāsaḥ śucayo dhārapūtā avṛjinā anavadyā ariṣṭāḥ ||
2,027.03  ta ādityāsa uravo gabhīrā adabdhāso dipsanto bhūryakṣāḥ |
2,027.03 antaḥ paśyanti vṛjinota sādhu sarvaṃ rājabhyaḥ paramā cidanti ||
2,027.04  dhārayanta ādityāso jagatsthā devā viśvasya bhuvanasya gopāḥ |
2,027.04 dīrghādhiyo rakṣamāṇā asuryamṛtāvānaścayamānā ṛṇāni ||
2,027.05  vidyāmādityā avaso vo asya yadaryamanbhaya ā cinmayobhu |
2,027.05 yuṣmākaṃ mitrāvaruṇā praṇītau pari śvabhreva duritāni vṛjyām ||
2,027.06  sugo hi vo aryamanmitra panthā anṛkṣaro varuṇa sādhurasti |
2,027.06 tenādityā adhi vocatā no yacchatā no duṣparihantu śarma ||
2,027.07  pipartu no aditī rājaputrāti dveṣāṃsyaryamā sugebhiḥ |
2,027.07 bṛhanmitrasya varuṇasya śarmopa syāma puruvīrā ariṣṭāḥ ||
2,027.08  tisro bhūmīrdhārayantrīṃruta dyūntrīṇi vratā vidathe antareṣām |
2,027.08 ṛtenādityā mahi vo mahitvaṃ tadaryamanvaruṇa mitra cāru ||
2,027.09  trī rocanā divyā dhārayanta hiraṇyayāḥ śucayo dhārapūtāḥ |
2,027.09 asvapnajo animiṣā adabdhā uruśaṃsā ṛjave martyāya ||
2,027.10  tvaṃ viśveṣāṃ varuṇāsi rājā ye ca devā asura ye ca martāḥ |
2,027.10 śataṃ no rāsva śarado vicakṣe'śyāmāyūṃṣi sudhitāni pūrvā ||
2,027.11  na dakṣiṇā vi cikite na savyā na prācīnamādityā nota paścā |
2,027.11 pākyā cidvasavo dhīryā cidyuṣmānīto abhayaṃ jyotiraśyām ||
2,027.12  yo rājabhya ṛtanibhyo dadāśa yaṃ vardhayanti puṣṭayaśca nityāḥ |
2,027.12 sa revānyāti prathamo rathena vasudāvā vidatheṣu praśastaḥ ||
2,027.13  śucirapaḥ sūyavasā adabdha upa kṣeti vṛddhavayāḥ suvīraḥ |
2,027.13 nakiṣṭaṃ ghnantyantito na dūrādya ādityānāṃ bhavati praṇītau ||
2,027.14  adite mitra varuṇota mṛḻa yadvo vayaṃ cakṛmā kaccidāgaḥ |
2,027.14 urvaśyāmabhayaṃ jyotirindra mā no dīrghā abhi naśantamisrāḥ ||
2,027.15  ubhe asmai pīpayataḥ samīcī divo vṛṣṭiṃ subhago nāma puṣyan |
2,027.15 ubhā kṣayāvājayanyāti pṛtsūbhāvardhau bhavataḥ sādhū asmai ||
2,027.16  yā vo māyā abhidruhe yajatrāḥ pāśā ādityā ripave vicṛttāḥ |
2,027.16 aśvīva tāṃ ati yeṣaṃ rathenāriṣṭā urāvā śarmansyāma ||
2,027.17  māhaṃ maghono varuṇa priyasya bhūridāvna ā vidaṃ śūnamāpeḥ |
2,027.17 mā rāyo rājansuyamādava sthāṃ bṛhadvadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||

2,028.01  idaṃ kaverādityasya svarājo viśvāni sāntyabhyastu mahnā |
2,028.01 ati yo mandro yajathāya devaḥ sukīrtiṃ bhikṣe varuṇasya bhūreḥ ||
2,028.02  tava vrate subhagāsaḥ syāma svādhyo varuṇa tuṣṭuvāṃsaḥ |
2,028.02 upāyana uṣasāṃ gomatīnāmagnayo na jaramāṇā anu dyūn ||
2,028.03  tava syāma puruvīrasya śarmannuruśaṃsasya varuṇa praṇetaḥ |
2,028.03 yūyaṃ naḥ putrā aditeradabdhā abhi kṣamadhvaṃ yujyāya devāḥ ||
2,028.04  pra sīmādityo asṛjadvidhartāṃ ṛtaṃ sindhavo varuṇasya yanti |
2,028.04 na śrāmyanti na vi mucantyete vayo na paptū raghuyā parijman ||
2,028.05  vi macchrathāya raśanāmivāga ṛdhyāma te varuṇa khāmṛtasya |
2,028.05 mā tantuśchedi vayato dhiyaṃ me mā mātrā śāryapasaḥ pura ṛtoḥ ||
2,028.06  apo su myakṣa varuṇa bhiyasaṃ matsamrāḻ ṛtāvo'nu mā gṛbhāya |
2,028.06 dāmeva vatsādvi mumugdhyaṃho nahi tvadāre nimiṣaścaneśe ||
2,028.07  mā no vadhairvaruṇa ye ta iṣṭāvenaḥ kṛṇvantamasura bhrīṇanti |
2,028.07 mā jyotiṣaḥ pravasathāni ganma vi ṣū mṛdhaḥ śiśratho jīvase naḥ ||
2,028.08  namaḥ purā te varuṇota nūnamutāparaṃ tuvijāta bravāma |
2,028.08 tve hi kaṃ parvate na śritānyapracyutāni dūḻabha vratāni ||
2,028.09  para ṛṇā sāvīradha matkṛtāni māhaṃ rājannanyakṛtena bhojam |
2,028.09 avyuṣṭā innu bhūyasīruṣāsa ā no jīvānvaruṇa tāsu śādhi ||
2,028.10  yo me rājanyujyo vā sakhā vā svapne bhayaṃ bhīrave mahyamāha |
2,028.10 steno vā yo dipsati no vṛko vā tvaṃ tasmādvaruṇa pāhyasmān ||
2,028.11  māhaṃ maghono varuṇa priyasya bhūridāvna ā vidaṃ śūnamāpeḥ |
2,028.11 mā rāyo rājansuyamādava sthāṃ bṛhadvadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||

2,029.01  dhṛtavratā ādityā iṣirā āre matkarta rahasūrivāgaḥ |
2,029.01 śṛṇvato vo varuṇa mitra devā bhadrasya vidvāṃ avase huve vaḥ ||
2,029.02  yūyaṃ devāḥ pramatiryūyamojo yūyaṃ dveṣāṃsi sanutaryuyota |
2,029.02 abhikṣattāro abhi ca kṣamadhvamadyā ca no mṛḻayatāparaṃ ca ||
2,029.03  kimū nu vaḥ kṛṇavāmāpareṇa kiṃ sanena vasava āpyena |
2,029.03 yūyaṃ no mitrāvaruṇādite ca svastimindrāmaruto dadhāta ||
2,029.04  haye devā yūyamidāpaya stha te mṛḻata nādhamānāya mahyam |
2,029.04 mā vo ratho madhyamavāḻ ṛte bhūnmā yuṣmāvatsvāpiṣu śramiṣma ||
2,029.05  pra va eko mimaya bhūryāgo yanmā piteva kitavaṃ śaśāsa |
2,029.05 āre pāśā āre aghāni devā mā mādhi putre vimiva grabhīṣṭa ||
2,029.06  arvāñco adyā bhavatā yajatrā ā vo hārdi bhayamāno vyayeyam |
2,029.06 trādhvaṃ no devā nijuro vṛkasya trādhvaṃ kartādavapado yajatrāḥ ||
2,029.07  māhaṃ maghono varuṇa priyasya bhūridāvna ā vidaṃ śūnamāpeḥ |
2,029.07 mā rāyo rājansuyamādava sthāṃ bṛhadvadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||

2,030.01  ṛtaṃ devāya kṛṇvate savitra indrāyāhighne na ramanta āpaḥ |
2,030.01 aharaharyātyakturapāṃ kiyātyā prathamaḥ sarga āsām ||
2,030.02  yo vṛtrāya sinamatrābhariṣyatpra taṃ janitrī viduṣa uvāca |
2,030.02 patho radantīranu joṣamasmai divedive dhunayo yantyartham ||
2,030.03  ūrdhvo hyasthādadhyantarikṣe'dhā vṛtrāya pra vadhaṃ jabhāra |
2,030.03 mihaṃ vasāna upa hīmadudrottigmāyudho ajayacchatrumindraḥ ||
2,030.04  bṛhaspate tapuṣāśneva vidhya vṛkadvaraso asurasya vīrān |
2,030.04 yathā jaghantha dhṛṣatā purā cidevā jahi śatrumasmākamindra ||
2,030.05  ava kṣipa divo aśmānamuccā yena śatruṃ mandasāno nijūrvāḥ |
2,030.05 tokasya sātau tanayasya bhūrerasmāṃ ardhaṃ kṛṇutādindra gonām ||
2,030.06  pra hi kratuṃ vṛhatho yaṃ vanutho radhrasya stho yajamānasya codau |
2,030.06 indrāsomā yuvamasmāṃ aviṣṭamasminbhayasthe kṛṇutamu lokam ||
2,030.07  na mā tamanna śramannota tandranna vocāma mā sunoteti somam |
2,030.07 yo me pṛṇādyo dadadyo nibodhādyo mā sunvantamupa gobhirāyat ||
2,030.08  sarasvati tvamasmāṃ aviḍḍhi marutvatī dhṛṣatī jeṣi śatrūn |
2,030.08 tyaṃ cicchardhantaṃ taviṣīyamāṇamindro hanti vṛṣabhaṃ śaṇḍikānām ||
2,030.09  yo naḥ sanutya uta vā jighatnurabhikhyāya taṃ tigitena vidhya |
2,030.09 bṛhaspata āyudhairjeṣi śatrūndruhe rīṣantaṃ pari dhehi rājan ||
2,030.10  asmākebhiḥ satvabhiḥ śūra śūrairvīryā kṛdhi yāni te kartvāni |
2,030.10 jyogabhūvannanudhūpitāso hatvī teṣāmā bharā no vasūni ||
2,030.11  taṃ vaḥ śardhaṃ mārutaṃ sumnayurgiropa bruve namasā daivyaṃ janam |
2,030.11 yathā rayiṃ sarvavīraṃ naśāmahā apatyasācaṃ śrutyaṃ divedive ||

2,031.01  asmākaṃ mitrāvaruṇāvataṃ rathamādityai rudrairvasubhiḥ sacābhuvā |
2,031.01 pra yadvayo na paptanvasmanaspari śravasyavo hṛṣīvanto vanarṣadaḥ ||
2,031.02  adha smā na udavatā sajoṣaso rathaṃ devāso abhi vikṣu vājayum |
2,031.02 yadāśavaḥ padyābhistitrato rajaḥ pṛthivyāḥ sānau jaṅghananta pāṇibhiḥ ||
2,031.03  uta sya na indro viśvacarṣaṇirdivaḥ śardhena mārutena sukratuḥ |
2,031.03 anu nu sthātyavṛkābhirūtibhī rathaṃ mahe sanaye vājasātaye ||
2,031.04  uta sya devo bhuvanasya sakṣaṇistvaṣṭā gnābhiḥ sajoṣā jūjuvadratham |
2,031.04 iḻā bhago bṛhaddivota rodasī pūṣā purandhiraśvināvadhā patī ||
2,031.05  uta tye devī subhage mithūdṛśoṣāsānaktā jagatāmapījuvā |
2,031.05 stuṣe yadvāṃ pṛthivi navyasā vaca sthātuśca vayastrivayā upastire ||
2,031.06  uta vaḥ śaṃsamuśijāmiva śmasyahirbudhnyo'ja ekapāduta |
2,031.06 trita ṛbhukṣāḥ savitā cano dadhe'pāṃ napādāśuhemā dhiyā śami ||
2,031.07  etā vo vaśmyudyatā yajatrā atakṣannāyavo navyase sam |
2,031.07 śravasyavo vājaṃ cakānāḥ saptirna rathyo aha dhītimaśyāḥ ||

2,032.01  asya me dyāvāpṛthivī ṛtāyato bhūtamavitrī vacasaḥ siṣāsataḥ |
2,032.01 yayorāyuḥ prataraṃ te idaṃ pura upastute vasūyurvāṃ maho dadhe ||
2,032.02  mā no guhyā ripa āyorahandabhanmā na ābhyo rīradho ducchunābhyaḥ |
2,032.02 mā no vi yauḥ sakhyā viddhi tasya naḥ sumnāyatā manasā tattvemahe ||
2,032.03  aheḻatā manasā śruṣṭimā vaha duhānāṃ dhenuṃ pipyuṣīmasaścatam |
2,032.03 padyābhirāśuṃ vacasā ca vājinaṃ tvāṃ hinomi puruhūta viśvahā ||
2,032.04  rākāmahaṃ suhavāṃ suṣṭutī huve śṛṇotu naḥ subhagā bodhatu tmanā |
2,032.04 sīvyatvapaḥ sūcyācchidyamānayā dadātu vīraṃ śatadāyamukthyam ||
2,032.05  yāste rāke sumatayaḥ supeśaso yābhirdadāsi dāśuṣe vasūni |
2,032.05 tābhirno adya sumanā upāgahi sahasrapoṣaṃ subhage rarāṇā ||
2,032.06  sinīvāli pṛthuṣṭuke yā devānāmasi svasā |
2,032.06 juṣasva havyamāhutaṃ prajāṃ devi didiḍḍhi naḥ ||
2,032.07  yā subāhuḥ svaṅguriḥ suṣūmā bahusūvarī |
2,032.07 tasyai viśpatnyai haviḥ sinīvālyai juhotana ||
2,032.08  yā guṅgūryā sinīvālī yā rākā yā sarasvatī |
2,032.08 indrāṇīmahva ūtaye varuṇānīṃ svastaye ||

2,033.01  ā te pitarmarutāṃ sumnametu mā naḥ sūryasya saṃdṛśo yuyothāḥ |
2,033.01 abhi no vīro arvati kṣameta pra jāyemahi rudra prajābhiḥ ||
2,033.02  tvādattebhī rudra śantamebhiḥ śataṃ himā aśīya bheṣajebhiḥ |
2,033.02 vyasmaddveṣo vitaraṃ vyaṃho vyamīvāścātayasvā viṣūcīḥ ||
2,033.03  śreṣṭho jātasya rudra śriyāsi tavastamastavasāṃ vajrabāho |
2,033.03 parṣi ṇaḥ pāramaṃhasaḥ svasti viśvā abhītī rapaso yuyodhi ||
2,033.04  mā tvā rudra cukrudhāmā namobhirmā duṣṭutī vṛṣabha mā sahūtī |
2,033.04 unno vīrāṃ arpaya bheṣajebhirbhiṣaktamaṃ tvā bhiṣajāṃ śṛṇomi ||
2,033.05  havīmabhirhavate yo havirbhirava stomebhī rudraṃ diṣīya |
2,033.05 ṛdūdaraḥ suhavo mā no asyai babhruḥ suśipro rīradhanmanāyai ||
2,033.06  unmā mamanda vṛṣabho marutvāntvakṣīyasā vayasā nādhamānam |
2,033.06 ghṛṇīva cchāyāmarapā aśīyā vivāseyaṃ rudrasya sumnam ||
2,033.07  kva sya te rudra mṛḻayākurhasto yo asti bheṣajo jalāṣaḥ |
2,033.07 apabhartā rapaso daivyasyābhī nu mā vṛṣabha cakṣamīthāḥ ||
2,033.08  pra babhrave vṛṣabhāya śvitīce maho mahīṃ suṣṭutimīrayāmi |
2,033.08 namasyā kalmalīkinaṃ namobhirgṛṇīmasi tveṣaṃ rudrasya nāma ||
2,033.09  sthirebhiraṅgaiḥ pururūpa ugro babhruḥ śukrebhiḥ pipiśe hiraṇyaiḥ |
2,033.09 īśānādasya bhuvanasya bhūrerna vā u yoṣadrudrādasuryam ||
2,033.10  arhanbibharṣi sāyakāni dhanvārhanniṣkaṃ yajataṃ viśvarūpam |
2,033.10 arhannidaṃ dayase viśvamabhvaṃ na vā ojīyo rudra tvadasti ||
2,033.11  stuhi śrutaṃ gartasadaṃ yuvānaṃ mṛgaṃ na bhīmamupahatnumugram |
2,033.11 mṛḻā jaritre rudra stavāno'nyaṃ te asmanni vapantu senāḥ ||
2,033.12  kumāraścitpitaraṃ vandamānaṃ prati nānāma rudropayantam |
2,033.12 bhūrerdātāraṃ satpatiṃ gṛṇīṣe stutastvaṃ bheṣajā rāsyasme ||
2,033.13  yā vo bheṣajā marutaḥ śucīni yā śantamā vṛṣaṇo yā mayobhu |
2,033.13 yāni manuravṛṇītā pitā nastā śaṃ ca yośca rudrasya vaśmi ||
2,033.14  pari ṇo hetī rudrasya vṛjyāḥ pari tveṣasya durmatirmahī gāt |
2,033.14 ava sthirā maghavadbhyastanuṣva mīḍhvastokāya tanayāya mṛḻa ||
2,033.15  evā babhro vṛṣabha cekitāna yathā deva na hṛṇīṣe na haṃsi |
2,033.15 havanaśrunno rudreha bodhi bṛhadvadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||

2,034.01  dhārāvarā maruto dhṛṣṇvojaso mṛgā na bhīmāstaviṣībhirarcinaḥ |
2,034.01 agnayo na śuśucānā ṛjīṣiṇo bhṛmiṃ dhamanto apa gā avṛṇvata ||
2,034.02  dyāvo na stṛbhiścitayanta khādino vyabhriyā na dyutayanta vṛṣṭayaḥ |
2,034.02 rudro yadvo maruto rukmavakṣaso vṛṣājani pṛśnyāḥ śukra ūdhani ||
2,034.03  ukṣante aśvāṃ atyāṃ ivājiṣu nadasya karṇaisturayanta āśubhiḥ |
2,034.03 hiraṇyaśiprā maruto davidhvataḥ pṛkṣaṃ yātha pṛṣatībhiḥ samanyavaḥ ||
2,034.04  pṛkṣe tā viśvā bhuvanā vavakṣire mitrāya vā sadamā jīradānavaḥ |
2,034.04 pṛṣadaśvāso anavabhrarādhasa ṛjipyāso na vayuneṣu dhūrṣadaḥ ||
2,034.05  indhanvabhirdhenubhī rapśadūdhabhiradhvasmabhiḥ pathibhirbhrājadṛṣṭayaḥ |
2,034.05 ā haṃsāso na svasarāṇi gantana madhormadāya marutaḥ samanyavaḥ ||
2,034.06  ā no brahmāṇi marutaḥ samanyavo narāṃ na śaṃsaḥ savanāni gantana |
2,034.06 aśvāmiva pipyata dhenumūdhani kartā dhiyaṃ jaritre vājapeśasam ||
2,034.07  taṃ no dāta maruto vājinaṃ ratha āpānaṃ brahma citayaddivedive |
2,034.07 iṣaṃ stotṛbhyo vṛjaneṣu kārave saniṃ medhāmariṣṭaṃ duṣṭaraṃ sahaḥ ||
2,034.08  yadyuñjate maruto rukmavakṣaso'śvānratheṣu bhaga ā sudānavaḥ |
2,034.08 dhenurna śiśve svasareṣu pinvate janāya rātahaviṣe mahīmiṣam ||
2,034.09  yo no maruto vṛkatāti martyo ripurdadhe vasavo rakṣatā riṣaḥ |
2,034.09 vartayata tapuṣā cakriyābhi tamava rudrā aśaso hantanā vadhaḥ ||
2,034.10  citraṃ tadvo maruto yāma cekite pṛśnyā yadūdharapyāpayo duhuḥ |
2,034.10 yadvā nide navamānasya rudriyāstritaṃ jarāya juratāmadābhyāḥ ||
2,034.11  tānvo maho maruta evayāvno viṣṇoreṣasya prabhṛthe havāmahe |
2,034.11 hiraṇyavarṇānkakuhānyatasruco brahmaṇyantaḥ śaṃsyaṃ rādha īmahe ||
2,034.12  te daśagvāḥ prathamā yajñamūhire te no hinvantūṣaso vyuṣṭiṣu |
2,034.12 uṣā na rāmīraruṇairaporṇute maho jyotiṣā śucatā goarṇasā ||
2,034.13  te kṣoṇībhiraruṇebhirnāñjibhī rudrā ṛtasya sadaneṣu vāvṛdhuḥ |
2,034.13 nimeghamānā atyena pājasā suścandraṃ varṇaṃ dadhire supeśasam ||
2,034.14  tāṃ iyāno mahi varūthamūtaya upa ghedenā namasā gṛṇīmasi |
2,034.14 trito na yānpañca hotṝnabhiṣṭaya āvavartadavarāñcakriyāvase ||
2,034.15  yayā radhraṃ pārayathātyaṃho yayā nido muñcatha vanditāram |
2,034.15 arvācī sā maruto yā va ūtiro ṣu vāśreva sumatirjigātu ||

2,035.01  upemasṛkṣi vājayurvacasyāṃ cano dadhīta nādyo giro me |
2,035.01 apāṃ napādāśuhemā kuvitsa supeśasaskarati joṣiṣaddhi ||
2,035.02  imaṃ svasmai hṛda ā sutaṣṭaṃ mantraṃ vocema kuvidasya vedat |
2,035.02 apāṃ napādasuryasya mahnā viśvānyaryo bhuvanā jajāna ||
2,035.03  samanyā yantyupa yantyanyāḥ samānamūrvaṃ nadyaḥ pṛṇanti |
2,035.03 tamū śuciṃ śucayo dīdivāṃsamapāṃ napātaṃ pari tasthurāpaḥ ||
2,035.04  tamasmerā yuvatayo yuvānaṃ marmṛjyamānāḥ pari yantyāpaḥ |
2,035.04 sa śukrebhiḥ śikvabhī revadasme dīdāyānidhmo ghṛtanirṇigapsu ||
2,035.05  asmai tisro avyathyāya nārīrdevāya devīrdidhiṣantyannam |
2,035.05 kṛtā ivopa hi prasarsre apsu sa pīyūṣaṃ dhayati pūrvasūnām ||
2,035.06  aśvasyātra janimāsya ca svardruho riṣaḥ sampṛcaḥ pāhi sūrīn |
2,035.06 āmāsu pūrṣu paro apramṛṣyaṃ nārātayo vi naśannānṛtāni ||
2,035.07  sva ā dame sudughā yasya dhenuḥ svadhāṃ pīpāya subhvannamatti |
2,035.07 so apāṃ napādūrjayannapsvantarvasudeyāya vidhate vi bhāti ||
2,035.08  yo apsvā śucinā daivyena ṛtāvājasra urviyā vibhāti |
2,035.08 vayā idanyā bhuvanānyasya pra jāyante vīrudhaśca prajābhiḥ ||
2,035.09  apāṃ napādā hyasthādupasthaṃ jihmānāmūrdhvo vidyutaṃ vasānaḥ |
2,035.09 tasya jyeṣṭhaṃ mahimānaṃ vahantīrhiraṇyavarṇāḥ pari yanti yahvīḥ ||
2,035.10  hiraṇyarūpaḥ sa hiraṇyasaṃdṛgapāṃ napātsedu hiraṇyavarṇaḥ |
2,035.10 hiraṇyayātpari yonerniṣadyā hiraṇyadā dadatyannamasmai ||
2,035.11  tadasyānīkamuta cāru nāmāpīcyaṃ vardhate napturapām |
2,035.11 yamindhate yuvatayaḥ samitthā hiraṇyavarṇaṃ ghṛtamannamasya ||
2,035.12  asmai bahūnāmavamāya sakhye yajñairvidhema namasā havirbhiḥ |
2,035.12 saṃ sānu mārjmi didhiṣāmi bilmairdadhāmyannaiḥ pari vanda ṛgbhiḥ ||
2,035.13  sa īṃ vṛṣājanayattāsu garbhaṃ sa īṃ śiśurdhayati taṃ rihanti |
2,035.13 so apāṃ napādanabhimlātavarṇo'nyasyeveha tanvā viveṣa ||
2,035.14  asminpade parame tasthivāṃsamadhvasmabhirviśvahā dīdivāṃsam |
2,035.14 āpo naptre ghṛtamannaṃ vahantīḥ svayamatkaiḥ pari dīyanti yahvīḥ ||
2,035.15  ayāṃsamagne sukṣitiṃ janāyāyāṃsamu maghavadbhyaḥ suvṛktim |
2,035.15 viśvaṃ tadbhadraṃ yadavanti devā bṛhadvadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||

2,036.01  tubhyaṃ hinvāno vasiṣṭa gā apo'dhukṣansīmavibhiradribhirnaraḥ |
2,036.01 pibendra svāhā prahutaṃ vaṣaṭkṛtaṃ hotrādā somaṃ prathamo ya īśiṣe ||
2,036.02  yajñaiḥ sammiślāḥ pṛṣatībhirṛṣṭibhiryāmañchubhrāso añjiṣu priyā uta |
2,036.02 āsadyā barhirbharatasya sūnavaḥ potrādā somaṃ pibatā divo naraḥ ||
2,036.03  ameva naḥ suhavā ā hi gantana ni barhiṣi sadatanā raṇiṣṭana |
2,036.03 athā mandasva jujuṣāṇo andhasastvaṣṭardevebhirjanibhiḥ sumadgaṇaḥ ||
2,036.04  ā vakṣi devāṃ iha vipra yakṣi cośanhotarni ṣadā yoniṣu triṣu |
2,036.04 prati vīhi prasthitaṃ somyaṃ madhu pibāgnīdhrāttava bhāgasya tṛpṇuhi ||
2,036.05  eṣa sya te tanvo nṛmṇavardhanaḥ saha ojaḥ pradivi bāhvorhitaḥ |
2,036.05 tubhyaṃ suto maghavantubhyamābhṛtastvamasya brāhmaṇādā tṛpatpiba ||
2,036.06  juṣethāṃ yajñaṃ bodhataṃ havasya me satto hotā nividaḥ pūrvyā anu |
2,036.06 acchā rājānā nama etyāvṛtaṃ praśāstrādā pibataṃ somyaṃ madhu ||

2,037.01  mandasva hotrādanu joṣamandhaso'dhvaryavaḥ sa pūrṇāṃ vaṣṭyāsicam |
2,037.01 tasmā etaṃ bharata tadvaśo dadirhotrātsomaṃ draviṇodaḥ piba ṛtubhiḥ ||
2,037.02  yamu pūrvamahuve tamidaṃ huve sedu havyo dadiryo nāma patyate |
2,037.02 adhvaryubhiḥ prasthitaṃ somyaṃ madhu potrātsomaṃ draviṇodaḥ piba ṛtubhiḥ ||
2,037.03  medyantu te vahnayo yebhirīyase'riṣaṇyanvīḻayasvā vanaspate |
2,037.03 āyūyā dhṛṣṇo abhigūryā tvaṃ neṣṭrātsomaṃ draviṇodaḥ piba ṛtubhiḥ ||
2,037.04  apāddhotrāduta potrādamattota neṣṭrādajuṣata prayo hitam |
2,037.04 turīyaṃ pātramamṛktamamartyaṃ draviṇodāḥ pibatu drāviṇodasaḥ ||
2,037.05  arvāñcamadya yayyaṃ nṛvāhaṇaṃ rathaṃ yuñjāthāmiha vāṃ vimocanam |
2,037.05 pṛṅktaṃ havīṃṣi madhunā hi kaṃ gatamathā somaṃ pibataṃ vājinīvasū ||
2,037.06  joṣyagne samidhaṃ joṣyāhutiṃ joṣi brahma janyaṃ joṣi suṣṭutim |
2,037.06 viśvebhirviśvāṃ ṛtunā vaso maha uśandevāṃ uśataḥ pāyayā haviḥ ||

2,038.01  udu ṣya devaḥ savitā savāya śaśvattamaṃ tadapā vahnirasthāt |
2,038.01 nūnaṃ devebhyo vi hi dhāti ratnamathābhajadvītihotraṃ svastau ||
2,038.02  viśvasya hi śruṣṭaye deva ūrdhvaḥ pra bāhavā pṛthupāṇiḥ sisarti |
2,038.02 āpaścidasya vrata ā nimṛgrā ayaṃ cidvāto ramate parijman ||
2,038.03  āśubhiścidyānvi mucāti nūnamarīramadatamānaṃ cidetoḥ |
2,038.03 ahyarṣūṇāṃ cinnyayāṃ aviṣyāmanu vrataṃ saviturmokyāgāt ||
2,038.04  punaḥ samavyadvitataṃ vayantī madhyā kartornyadhācchakma dhīraḥ |
2,038.04 utsaṃhāyāsthādvyṛtūṃradardhararamatiḥ savitā deva āgāt ||
2,038.05  nānaukāṃsi duryo viśvamāyurvi tiṣṭhate prabhavaḥ śoko agneḥ |
2,038.05 jyeṣṭhaṃ mātā sūnave bhāgamādhādanvasya ketamiṣitaṃ savitrā ||
2,038.06  samāvavarti viṣṭhito jigīṣurviśveṣāṃ kāmaścaratāmamābhūt |
2,038.06 śaśvāṃ apo vikṛtaṃ hitvyāgādanu vrataṃ saviturdaivyasya ||
2,038.07  tvayā hitamapyamapsu bhāgaṃ dhanvānvā mṛgayaso vi tasthuḥ |
2,038.07 vanāni vibhyo nakirasya tāni vratā devasya saviturminanti ||
2,038.08  yādrādhyaṃ varuṇo yonimapyamaniśitaṃ nimiṣi jarbhurāṇaḥ |
2,038.08 viśvo mārtāṇḍo vrajamā paśurgātsthaśo janmāni savitā vyākaḥ ||
2,038.09  na yasyendro varuṇo na mitro vratamaryamā na minanti rudraḥ |
2,038.09 nārātayastamidaṃ svasti huve devaṃ savitāraṃ namobhiḥ ||
2,038.10  bhagaṃ dhiyaṃ vājayantaḥ purandhiṃ narāśaṃso gnāspatirno avyāḥ |
2,038.10 āye vāmasya saṃgathe rayīṇāṃ priyā devasya savituḥ syāma ||
2,038.11  asmabhyaṃ taddivo adbhyaḥ pṛthivyāstvayā dattaṃ kāmyaṃ rādha ā gāt |
2,038.11 śaṃ yatstotṛbhya āpaye bhavātyuruśaṃsāya savitarjaritre ||

2,039.01  grāvāṇeva tadidarthaṃ jarethe gṛdhreva vṛkṣaṃ nidhimantamaccha |
2,039.01 brahmāṇeva vidatha ukthaśāsā dūteva havyā janyā purutrā ||
2,039.02  prātaryāvāṇā rathyeva vīrājeva yamā varamā sacethe |
2,039.02 mene iva tanvā śumbhamāne dampatīva kratuvidā janeṣu ||
2,039.03  śṛṅgeva naḥ prathamā gantamarvākchaphāviva jarbhurāṇā tarobhiḥ |
2,039.03 cakravākeva prati vastorusrārvāñcā yātaṃ rathyeva śakrā ||
2,039.04  nāveva naḥ pārayataṃ yugeva nabhyeva na upadhīva pradhīva |
2,039.04 śvāneva no ariṣaṇyā tanūnāṃ khṛgaleva visrasaḥ pātamasmān ||
2,039.05  vātevājuryā nadyeva rītirakṣī iva cakṣuṣā yātamarvāk |
2,039.05 hastāviva tanve śambhaviṣṭhā pādeva no nayataṃ vasyo accha ||
2,039.06  oṣṭhāviva madhvāsne vadantā stanāviva pipyataṃ jīvase naḥ |
2,039.06 nāseva nastanvo rakṣitārā karṇāviva suśrutā bhūtamasme ||
2,039.07  hasteva śaktimabhi saṃdadī naḥ kṣāmeva naḥ samajataṃ rajāṃsi |
2,039.07 imā giro aśvinā yuṣmayantīḥ kṣṇotreṇeva svadhitiṃ saṃ śiśītam ||
2,039.08  etāni vāmaśvinā vardhanāni brahma stomaṃ gṛtsamadāso akran |
2,039.08 tāni narā jujuṣāṇopa yātaṃ bṛhadvadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||

2,040.01  somāpūṣaṇā jananā rayīṇāṃ jananā divo jananā pṛthivyāḥ |
2,040.01 jātau viśvasya bhuvanasya gopau devā akṛṇvannamṛtasya nābhim ||
2,040.02  imau devau jāyamānau juṣantemau tamāṃsi gūhatāmajuṣṭā |
2,040.02 ābhyāmindraḥ pakvamāmāsvantaḥ somāpūṣabhyāṃ janadusriyāsu ||
2,040.03  somāpūṣaṇā rajaso vimānaṃ saptacakraṃ rathamaviśvaminvam |
2,040.03 viṣūvṛtaṃ manasā yujyamānaṃ taṃ jinvatho vṛṣaṇā pañcaraśmim ||
2,040.04  divyanyaḥ sadanaṃ cakra uccā pṛthivyāmanyo adhyantarikṣe |
2,040.04 tāvasmabhyaṃ puruvāraṃ purukṣuṃ rāyaspoṣaṃ vi ṣyatāṃ nābhimasme ||
2,040.05  viśvānyanyo bhuvanā jajāna viśvamanyo abhicakṣāṇa eti |
2,040.05 somāpūṣaṇāvavataṃ dhiyaṃ me yuvābhyāṃ viśvāḥ pṛtanā jayema ||
2,040.06  dhiyaṃ pūṣā jinvatu viśvaminvo rayiṃ somo rayipatirdadhātu |
2,040.06 avatu devyaditiranarvā bṛhadvadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||

2,041.01  vāyo ye te sahasriṇo rathāsastebhirā gahi |
2,041.01 niyutvānsomapītaye ||
2,041.02  niyutvānvāyavā gahyayaṃ śukro ayāmi te |
2,041.02 gantāsi sunvato gṛham ||
2,041.03  śukrasyādya gavāśira indravāyū niyutvataḥ |
2,041.03 ā yātaṃ pibataṃ narā ||
2,041.04  ayaṃ vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā sutaḥ soma ṛtāvṛdhā |
2,041.04 mamediha śrutaṃ havam ||
2,041.05  rājānāvanabhidruhā dhruve sadasyuttame |
2,041.05 sahasrasthūṇa āsāte ||
2,041.06  tā samrājā ghṛtāsutī ādityā dānunaspatī |
2,041.06 sacete anavahvaram ||
2,041.07  gomadū ṣu nāsatyāśvāvadyātamaśvinā |
2,041.07 vartī rudrā nṛpāyyam ||
2,041.08  na yatparo nāntara ādadharṣadvṛṣaṇvasū |
2,041.08 duḥśaṃso martyo ripuḥ ||
2,041.09  tā na ā voḻhamaśvinā rayiṃ piśaṅgasaṃdṛśam |
2,041.09 dhiṣṇyā varivovidam ||
2,041.10  indro aṅga mahadbhayamabhī ṣadapa cucyavat |
2,041.10 sa hi sthiro vicarṣaṇiḥ ||
2,041.11  indraśca mṛḻayāti no na naḥ paścādaghaṃ naśat |
2,041.11 bhadraṃ bhavāti naḥ puraḥ ||
2,041.12  indra āśābhyaspari sarvābhyo abhayaṃ karat |
2,041.12 jetā śatrūnvicarṣaṇiḥ ||
2,041.13  viśve devāsa ā gata śṛṇutā ma imaṃ havam |
2,041.13 edaṃ barhirni ṣīdata ||
2,041.14  tīvro vo madhumāṃ ayaṃ śunahotreṣu matsaraḥ |
2,041.14 etaṃ pibata kāmyam ||
2,041.15  indrajyeṣṭhā marudgaṇā devāsaḥ pūṣarātayaḥ |
2,041.15 viśve mama śrutā havam ||
2,041.16  ambitame nadītame devitame sarasvati |
2,041.16 apraśastā iva smasi praśastimamba naskṛdhi ||
2,041.17  tve viśvā sarasvati śritāyūṃṣi devyām |
2,041.17 śunahotreṣu matsva prajāṃ devi didiḍḍhi naḥ ||
2,041.18  imā brahma sarasvati juṣasva vājinīvati |
2,041.18 yā te manma gṛtsamadā ṛtāvari priyā deveṣu juhvati ||
2,041.19  pretāṃ yajñasya śambhuvā yuvāmidā vṛṇīmahe |
2,041.19 agniṃ ca havyavāhanam ||
2,041.20  dyāvā naḥ pṛthivī imaṃ sidhramadya divispṛśam |
2,041.20 yajñaṃ deveṣu yacchatām ||
2,041.21  ā vāmupasthamadruhā devāḥ sīdantu yajñiyāḥ |
2,041.21 ihādya somapītaye ||

2,042.01  kanikradajjanuṣaṃ prabruvāṇa iyarti vācamariteva nāvam |
2,042.01 sumaṅgalaśca śakune bhavāsi mā tvā kā cidabhibhā viśvyā vidat ||
2,042.02  mā tvā śyena udvadhīnmā suparṇo mā tvā vidadiṣumānvīro astā |
2,042.02 pitryāmanu pradiśaṃ kanikradatsumaṅgalo bhadravādī vadeha ||
2,042.03  ava kranda dakṣiṇato gṛhāṇāṃ sumaṅgalo bhadravādī śakunte |
2,042.03 mā na stena īśata māghaśaṃso bṛhadvadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||

2,043.01  pradakṣiṇidabhi gṛṇanti kāravo vayo vadanta ṛtuthā śakuntayaḥ |
2,043.01 ubhe vācau vadati sāmagā iva gāyatraṃ ca traiṣṭubhaṃ cānu rājati ||
2,043.02  udgāteva śakune sāma gāyasi brahmaputra iva savaneṣu śaṃsasi |
2,043.02 vṛṣeva vājī śiśumatīrapītyā sarvato naḥ śakune bhadramā vada viśvato naḥ śakune puṇyamā vada ||
2,043.03  āvadaṃstvaṃ śakune bhadramā vada tūṣṇīmāsīnaḥ sumatiṃ cikiddhi naḥ |
2,043.03 yadutpatanvadasi karkariryathā bṛhadvadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||








ṛgveda 3




3,001.01  somasya mā tavasaṃ vakṣyagne vahniṃ cakartha vidathe yajadhyai |
3,001.01 devāṃ acchā dīdyadyuñje adriṃ śamāye agne tanvaṃ juṣasva ||
3,001.02  prāñcaṃ yajñaṃ cakṛma vardhatāṃ gīḥ samidbhiragniṃ namasā duvasyan |
3,001.02 divaḥ śaśāsurvidathā kavīnāṃ gṛtsāya cittavase gātumīṣuḥ ||
3,001.03  mayo dadhe medhiraḥ pūtadakṣo divaḥ subandhurjanuṣā pṛthivyāḥ |
3,001.03 avindannu darśatamapsvantardevāso agnimapasi svasṝṇām ||
3,001.04  avardhayansubhagaṃ sapta yahvīḥ śvetaṃ jajñānamaruṣaṃ mahitvā |
3,001.04 śiśuṃ na jātamabhyāruraśvā devāso agniṃ janimanvapuṣyan ||
3,001.05  śukrebhiraṅgai raja ātatanvānkratuṃ punānaḥ kavibhiḥ pavitraiḥ |
3,001.05 śocirvasānaḥ paryāyurapāṃ śriyo mimīte bṛhatīranūnāḥ ||
3,001.06  vavrājā sīmanadatīradabdhā divo yahvīravasānā anagnāḥ |
3,001.06 sanā atra yuvatayaḥ sayonīrekaṃ garbhaṃ dadhire sapta vāṇīḥ ||
3,001.07  stīrṇā asya saṃhato viśvarūpā ghṛtasya yonau sravathe madhūnām |
3,001.07 asthuratra dhenavaḥ pinvamānā mahī dasmasya mātarā samīcī ||
3,001.08  babhrāṇaḥ sūno sahaso vyadyauddadhānaḥ śukrā rabhasā vapūṃṣi |
3,001.08 ścotanti dhārā madhuno ghṛtasya vṛṣā yatra vāvṛdhe kāvyena ||
3,001.09  pituścidūdharjanuṣā viveda vyasya dhārā asṛjadvi dhenāḥ |
3,001.09 guhā carantaṃ sakhibhiḥ śivebhirdivo yahvībhirna guhā babhūva ||
3,001.10  pituśca garbhaṃ janituśca babhre pūrvīreko adhayatpīpyānāḥ |
3,001.10 vṛṣṇe sapatnī śucaye sabandhū ubhe asmai manuṣye ni pāhi ||
3,001.11  urau mahāṃ anibādhe vavardhāpo agniṃ yaśasaḥ saṃ hi pūrvīḥ |
3,001.11 ṛtasya yonāvaśayaddamūnā jāmīnāmagnirapasi svasṝṇām ||
3,001.12  akro na babhriḥ samithe mahīnāṃ didṛkṣeyaḥ sūnave bhāṛjīkaḥ |
3,001.12 udusriyā janitā yo jajānāpāṃ garbho nṛtamo yahvo agniḥ ||
3,001.13  apāṃ garbhaṃ darśatamoṣadhīnāṃ vanā jajāna subhagā virūpam |
3,001.13 devāsaścinmanasā saṃ hi jagmuḥ paniṣṭhaṃ jātaṃ tavasaṃ duvasyan ||
3,001.14  bṛhanta idbhānavo bhāṛjīkamagniṃ sacanta vidyuto na śukrāḥ |
3,001.14 guheva vṛddhaṃ sadasi sve antarapāra ūrve amṛtaṃ duhānāḥ ||
3,001.15  īḻe ca tvā yajamāno havirbhirīḻe sakhitvaṃ sumatiṃ nikāmaḥ |
3,001.15 devairavo mimīhi saṃ jaritre rakṣā ca no damyebhiranīkaiḥ ||
3,001.16  upakṣetārastava supraṇīte'gne viśvāni dhanyā dadhānāḥ |
3,001.16 suretasā śravasā tuñjamānā abhi ṣyāma pṛtanāyūṃradevān ||
3,001.17  ā devānāmabhavaḥ keturagne mandro viśvāni kāvyāni vidvān |
3,001.17 prati martāṃ avāsayo damūnā anu devānrathiro yāsi sādhan ||
3,001.18  ni duroṇe amṛto martyānāṃ rājā sasāda vidathāni sādhan |
3,001.18 ghṛtapratīka urviyā vyadyaudagnirviśvāni kāvyāni vidvān ||
3,001.19  ā no gahi sakhyebhiḥ śivebhirmahānmahībhirūtibhiḥ saraṇyan |
3,001.19 asme rayiṃ bahulaṃ saṃtarutraṃ suvācaṃ bhāgaṃ yaśasaṃ kṛdhī naḥ ||
3,001.20  etā te agne janimā sanāni pra pūrvyāya nūtanāni vocam |
3,001.20 mahānti vṛṣṇe savanā kṛtemā janmañjanmannihito jātavedāḥ ||
3,001.21  janmañjanmannihito jātavedā viśvāmitrebhiridhyate ajasraḥ |
3,001.21 tasya vayaṃ sumatau yajñiyasyāpi bhadre saumanase syāma ||
3,001.22  imaṃ yajñaṃ sahasāvantvaṃ no devatrā dhehi sukrato rarāṇaḥ |
3,001.22 pra yaṃsi hotarbṛhatīriṣo no'gne mahi draviṇamā yajasva ||
3,001.23  iḻāmagne purudaṃsaṃ saniṃ goḥ śaśvattamaṃ havamānāya sādha |
3,001.23 syānnaḥ sūnustanayo vijāvāgne sā te sumatirbhūtvasme ||

3,002.01  vaiśvānarāya dhiṣaṇāmṛtāvṛdhe ghṛtaṃ na pūtamagnaye janāmasi |
3,002.01 dvitā hotāraṃ manuṣaśca vāghato dhiyā rathaṃ na kuliśaḥ samṛṇvati ||
3,002.02  sa rocayajjanuṣā rodasī ubhe sa mātrorabhavatputra īḍyaḥ |
3,002.02 havyavāḻ agnirajaraścanohito dūḻabho viśāmatithirvibhāvasuḥ ||
3,002.03  kratvā dakṣasya taruṣo vidharmaṇi devāso agniṃ janayanta cittibhiḥ |
3,002.03 rurucānaṃ bhānunā jyotiṣā mahāmatyaṃ na vājaṃ saniṣyannupa bruve ||
3,002.04  ā mandrasya saniṣyanto vareṇyaṃ vṛṇīmahe ahrayaṃ vājamṛgmiyam |
3,002.04 rātiṃ bhṛgūṇāmuśijaṃ kavikratumagniṃ rājantaṃ divyena śociṣā ||
3,002.05  agniṃ sumnāya dadhire puro janā vājaśravasamiha vṛktabarhiṣaḥ |
3,002.05 yatasrucaḥ surucaṃ viśvadevyaṃ rudraṃ yajñānāṃ sādhadiṣṭimapasām ||
3,002.06  pāvakaśoce tava hi kṣayaṃ pari hotaryajñeṣu vṛktabarhiṣo naraḥ |
3,002.06 agne duva icchamānāsa āpyamupāsate draviṇaṃ dhehi tebhyaḥ ||
3,002.07  ā rodasī apṛṇadā svarmahajjātaṃ yadenamapaso adhārayan |
3,002.07 so adhvarāya pari ṇīyate kaviratyo na vājasātaye canohitaḥ ||
3,002.08  namasyata havyadātiṃ svadhvaraṃ duvasyata damyaṃ jātavedasam |
3,002.08 rathīrṛtasya bṛhato vicarṣaṇiragnirdevānāmabhavatpurohitaḥ ||
3,002.09  tisro yahvasya samidhaḥ parijmano'gnerapunannuśijo amṛtyavaḥ |
3,002.09 tāsāmekāmadadhurmartye bhujamu lokamu dve upa jāmimīyatuḥ ||
3,002.10  viśāṃ kaviṃ viśpatiṃ mānuṣīriṣaḥ saṃ sīmakṛṇvansvadhitiṃ na tejase |
3,002.10 sa udvato nivato yāti veviṣatsa garbhameṣu bhuvaneṣu dīdharat ||
3,002.11  sa jinvate jaṭhareṣu prajajñivānvṛṣā citreṣu nānadanna siṃhaḥ |
3,002.11 vaiśvānaraḥ pṛthupājā amartyo vasu ratnā dayamāno vi dāśuṣe ||
3,002.12  vaiśvānaraḥ pratnathā nākamāruhaddivaspṛṣṭhaṃ bhandamānaḥ sumanmabhiḥ |
3,002.12 sa pūrvavajjanayañjantave dhanaṃ samānamajmaṃ paryeti jāgṛviḥ ||
3,002.13  ṛtāvānaṃ yajñiyaṃ vipramukthyamā yaṃ dadhe mātariśvā divi kṣayam |
3,002.13 taṃ citrayāmaṃ harikeśamīmahe sudītimagniṃ suvitāya navyase ||
3,002.14  śuciṃ na yāmanniṣiraṃ svardṛśaṃ ketuṃ divo rocanasthāmuṣarbudham |
3,002.14 agniṃ mūrdhānaṃ divo apratiṣkutaṃ tamīmahe namasā vājinaṃ bṛhat ||
3,002.15  mandraṃ hotāraṃ śucimadvayāvinaṃ damūnasamukthyaṃ viśvacarṣaṇim |
3,002.15 rathaṃ na citraṃ vapuṣāya darśataṃ manurhitaṃ sadamidrāya īmahe ||

3,003.01  vaiśvānarāya pṛthupājase vipo ratnā vidhanta dharuṇeṣu gātave |
3,003.01 agnirhi devāṃ amṛto duvasyatyathā dharmāṇi sanatā na dūduṣat ||
3,003.02  antardūto rodasī dasma īyate hotā niṣatto manuṣaḥ purohitaḥ |
3,003.02 kṣayaṃ bṛhantaṃ pari bhūṣati dyubhirdevebhiragniriṣito dhiyāvasuḥ ||
