3,003.03  ketuṃ yajñānāṃ vidathasya sādhanaṃ viprāso agniṃ mahayanta cittibhiḥ |
3,003.03 apāṃsi yasminnadhi saṃdadhurgirastasminsumnāni yajamāna ā cake ||
3,003.04  pitā yajñānāmasuro vipaścitāṃ vimānamagnirvayunaṃ ca vāghatām |
3,003.04 ā viveśa rodasī bhūrivarpasā purupriyo bhandate dhāmabhiḥ kaviḥ ||
3,003.05  candramagniṃ candrarathaṃ harivrataṃ vaiśvānaramapsuṣadaṃ svarvidam |
3,003.05 vigāhaṃ tūrṇiṃ taviṣībhirāvṛtaṃ bhūrṇiṃ devāsa iha suśriyaṃ dadhuḥ ||
3,003.06  agnirdevebhirmanuṣaśca jantubhistanvāno yajñaṃ purupeśasaṃ dhiyā |
3,003.06 rathīrantarīyate sādhadiṣṭibhirjīro damūnā abhiśasticātanaḥ ||
3,003.07  agne jarasva svapatya āyunyūrjā pinvasva samiṣo didīhi naḥ |
3,003.07 vayāṃsi jinva bṛhataśca jāgṛva uśigdevānāmasi sukraturvipām ||
3,003.08  viśpatiṃ yahvamatithiṃ naraḥ sadā yantāraṃ dhīnāmuśijaṃ ca vāghatām |
3,003.08 adhvarāṇāṃ cetanaṃ jātavedasaṃ pra śaṃsanti namasā jūtibhirvṛdhe ||
3,003.09  vibhāvā devaḥ suraṇaḥ pari kṣitīragnirbabhūva śavasā sumadrathaḥ |
3,003.09 tasya vratāni bhūripoṣiṇo vayamupa bhūṣema dama ā suvṛktibhiḥ ||
3,003.10  vaiśvānara tava dhāmānyā cake yebhiḥ svarvidabhavo vicakṣaṇa |
3,003.10 jāta āpṛṇo bhuvanāni rodasī agne tā viśvā paribhūrasi tmanā ||
3,003.11  vaiśvānarasya daṃsanābhyo bṛhadariṇādekaḥ svapasyayā kaviḥ |
3,003.11 ubhā pitarā mahayannajāyatāgnirdyāvāpṛthivī bhūriretasā ||

3,004.01  samitsamitsumanā bodhyasme śucāśucā sumatiṃ rāsi vasvaḥ |
3,004.01 ā deva devānyajathāya vakṣi sakhā sakhīnsumanā yakṣyagne ||
3,004.02  yaṃ devāsastrirahannāyajante divedive varuṇo mitro agniḥ |
3,004.02 semaṃ yajñaṃ madhumantaṃ kṛdhī nastanūnapādghṛtayoniṃ vidhantam ||
3,004.03  pra dīdhitirviśvavārā jigāti hotāramiḻaḥ prathamaṃ yajadhyai |
3,004.03 acchā namobhirvṛṣabhaṃ vandadhyai sa devānyakṣadiṣito yajīyān ||
3,004.04  ūrdhvo vāṃ gāturadhvare akāryūrdhvā śocīṃṣi prasthitā rajāṃsi |
3,004.04 divo vā nābhā nyasādi hotā stṛṇīmahi devavyacā vi barhiḥ ||
3,004.05  sapta hotrāṇi manasā vṛṇānā invanto viśvaṃ prati yannṛtena |
3,004.05 nṛpeśaso vidatheṣu pra jātā abhīmaṃ yajñaṃ vi caranta pūrvīḥ ||
3,004.06  ā bhandamāne uṣasā upāke uta smayete tanvā virūpe |
3,004.06 yathā no mitro varuṇo jujoṣadindro marutvāṃ uta vā mahobhiḥ ||
3,004.07  daivyā hotārā prathamā nyṛñje sapta pṛkṣāsaḥ svadhayā madanti |
3,004.07 ṛtaṃ śaṃsanta ṛtamitta āhuranu vrataṃ vratapā dīdhyānāḥ ||
3,004.08  ā bhāratī bhāratībhiḥ sajoṣā iḻā devairmanuṣyebhiragniḥ |
3,004.08 sarasvatī sārasvatebhirarvāktisro devīrbarhiredaṃ sadantu ||
3,004.09  tannasturīpamadha poṣayitnu deva tvaṣṭarvi rarāṇaḥ syasva |
3,004.09 yato vīraḥ karmaṇyaḥ sudakṣo yuktagrāvā jāyate devakāmaḥ ||
3,004.10  vanaspate'va sṛjopa devānagnirhaviḥ śamitā sūdayāti |
3,004.10 sedu hotā satyataro yajāti yathā devānāṃ janimāni veda ||
3,004.11  ā yāhyagne samidhāno arvāṅindreṇa devaiḥ sarathaṃ turebhiḥ |
3,004.11 barhirna āstāmaditiḥ suputrā svāhā devā amṛtā mādayantām ||

3,005.01  pratyagniruṣasaścekitāno'bodhi vipraḥ padavīḥ kavīnām |
3,005.01 pṛthupājā devayadbhiḥ samiddho'pa dvārā tamaso vahnirāvaḥ ||
3,005.02  predvagnirvāvṛdhe stomebhirgīrbhi stotṝṇāṃ namasya ukthaiḥ |
3,005.02 pūrvīrṛtasya saṃdṛśaścakānaḥ saṃ dūto adyauduṣaso viroke ||
3,005.03  adhāyyagnirmānuṣīṣu vikṣvapāṃ garbho mitra ṛtena sādhan |
3,005.03 ā haryato yajataḥ sānvasthādabhūdu vipro havyo matīnām ||
3,005.04  mitro agnirbhavati yatsamiddho mitro hotā varuṇo jātavedāḥ |
3,005.04 mitro adhvaryuriṣiro damūnā mitraḥ sindhūnāmuta parvatānām ||
3,005.05  pāti priyaṃ ripo agraṃ padaṃ veḥ pāti yahvaścaraṇaṃ sūryasya |
3,005.05 pāti nābhā saptaśīrṣāṇamagniḥ pāti devānāmupamādamṛṣvaḥ ||
3,005.06  ṛbhuścakra īḍyaṃ cāru nāma viśvāni devo vayunāni vidvān |
3,005.06 sasasya carma ghṛtavatpadaṃ vestadidagnī rakṣatyaprayucchan ||
3,005.07  ā yonimagnirghṛtavantamasthātpṛthupragāṇamuśantamuśānaḥ |
3,005.07 dīdyānaḥ śucirṛṣvaḥ pāvakaḥ punaḥpunarmātarā navyasī kaḥ ||
3,005.08  sadyo jāta oṣadhībhirvavakṣe yadī vardhanti prasvo ghṛtena |
3,005.08 āpa iva pravatā śumbhamānā uruṣyadagniḥ pitrorupasthe ||
3,005.09  udu ṣṭutaḥ samidhā yahvo adyaudvarṣmandivo adhi nābhā pṛthivyāḥ |
3,005.09 mitro agnirīḍyo mātariśvā dūto vakṣadyajathāya devān ||
3,005.10  udastambhītsamidhā nākamṛṣvo'gnirbhavannuttamo rocanānām |
3,005.10 yadī bhṛgubhyaḥ pari mātariśvā guhā santaṃ havyavāhaṃ samīdhe ||
3,005.11  iḻāmagne purudaṃsaṃ saniṃ goḥ śaśvattamaṃ havamānāya sādha |
3,005.11 syānnaḥ sūnustanayo vijāvāgne sā te sumatirbhūtvasme ||

3,006.01  pra kāravo mananā vacyamānā devadrīcīṃ nayata devayantaḥ |
3,006.01 dakṣiṇāvāḍvājinī prācyeti havirbharantyagnaye ghṛtācī ||
3,006.02  ā rodasī apṛṇā jāyamāna uta pra rikthā adha nu prayajyo |
3,006.02 divaścidagne mahinā pṛthivyā vacyantāṃ te vahnayaḥ saptajihvāḥ ||
3,006.03  dyauśca tvā pṛthivī yajñiyāso ni hotāraṃ sādayante damāya |
3,006.03 yadī viśo mānuṣīrdevayantīḥ prayasvatīrīḻate śukramarciḥ ||
3,006.04  mahānsadhasthe dhruva ā niṣatto'ntardyāvā māhine haryamāṇaḥ |
3,006.04 āskre sapatnī ajare amṛkte sabardughe urugāyasya dhenū ||
3,006.05  vratā te agne mahato mahāni tava kratvā rodasī ā tatantha |
3,006.05 tvaṃ dūto abhavo jāyamānastvaṃ netā vṛṣabha carṣaṇīnām ||
3,006.06  ṛtasya vā keśinā yogyābhirghṛtasnuvā rohitā dhuri dhiṣva |
3,006.06 athā vaha devāndeva viśvānsvadhvarā kṛṇuhi jātavedaḥ ||
3,006.07  divaścidā te rucayanta rokā uṣo vibhātīranu bhāsi pūrvīḥ |
3,006.07 apo yadagna uśadhagvaneṣu hoturmandrasya panayanta devāḥ ||
3,006.08  urau vā ye antarikṣe madanti divo vā ye rocane santi devāḥ |
3,006.08 ūmā vā ye suhavāso yajatrā āyemire rathyo agne aśvāḥ ||
3,006.09  aibhiragne sarathaṃ yāhyarvāṅnānārathaṃ vā vibhavo hyaśvāḥ |
3,006.09 patnīvatastriṃśataṃ trīṃśca devānanuṣvadhamā vaha mādayasva ||
3,006.10  sa hotā yasya rodasī cidurvī yajñaṃyajñamabhi vṛdhe gṛṇītaḥ |
3,006.10 prācī adhvareva tasthatuḥ sumeke ṛtāvarī ṛtajātasya satye ||
3,006.11  iḻāmagne purudaṃsaṃ saniṃ goḥ śaśvattamaṃ havamānāya sādha |
3,006.11 syānnaḥ sūnustanayo vijāvāgne sā te sumatirbhūtvasme ||

3,007.01  pra ya āruḥ śitipṛṣṭhasya dhāserā mātarā viviśuḥ sapta vāṇīḥ |
3,007.01 parikṣitā pitarā saṃ carete pra sarsrāte dīrghamāyuḥ prayakṣe ||
3,007.02  divakṣaso dhenavo vṛṣṇo aśvā devīrā tasthau madhumadvahantīḥ |
3,007.02 ṛtasya tvā sadasi kṣemayantaṃ paryekā carati vartaniṃ gauḥ ||
3,007.03  ā sīmarohatsuyamā bhavantīḥ patiścikitvānrayividrayīṇām |
3,007.03 pra nīlapṛṣṭho atasasya dhāsestā avāsayatpurudhapratīkaḥ ||
3,007.04  mahi tvāṣṭramūrjayantīrajuryaṃ stabhūyamānaṃ vahato vahanti |
3,007.04 vyaṅgebhirdidyutānaḥ sadhastha ekāmiva rodasī ā viveśa ||
3,007.05  jānanti vṛṣṇo aruṣasya śevamuta bradhnasya śāsane raṇanti |
3,007.05 divorucaḥ suruco rocamānā iḻā yeṣāṃ gaṇyā māhinā gīḥ ||
3,007.06  uto pitṛbhyāṃ pravidānu ghoṣaṃ maho mahadbhyāmanayanta śūṣam |
3,007.06 ukṣā ha yatra pari dhānamaktoranu svaṃ dhāma jariturvavakṣa ||
3,007.07  adhvaryubhiḥ pañcabhiḥ sapta viprāḥ priyaṃ rakṣante nihitaṃ padaṃ veḥ |
3,007.07 prāñco madantyukṣaṇo ajuryā devā devānāmanu hi vratā guḥ ||
3,007.08  daivyā hotārā prathamā nyṛñje sapta pṛkṣāsaḥ svadhayā madanti |
3,007.08 ṛtaṃ śaṃsanta ṛtamitta āhuranu vrataṃ vratapā dīdhyānāḥ ||
3,007.09  vṛṣāyante mahe atyāya pūrvīrvṛṣṇe citrāya raśmayaḥ suyāmāḥ |
3,007.09 deva hotarmandrataraścikitvānmaho devānrodasī eha vakṣi ||
3,007.10  pṛkṣaprayajo draviṇaḥ suvācaḥ suketava uṣaso revadūṣuḥ |
3,007.10 uto cidagne mahinā pṛthivyāḥ kṛtaṃ cidenaḥ saṃ mahe daśasya ||
3,007.11  iḻāmagne purudaṃsaṃ saniṃ goḥ śaśvattamaṃ havamānāya sādha |
3,007.11 syānnaḥ sūnustanayo vijāvāgne sā te sumatirbhūtvasme ||

3,008.01  añjanti tvāmadhvare devayanto vanaspate madhunā daivyena |
3,008.01 yadūrdhvastiṣṭhā draviṇeha dhattādyadvā kṣayo māturasyā upasthe ||
3,008.02  samiddhasya śrayamāṇaḥ purastādbrahma vanvāno ajaraṃ suvīram |
3,008.02 āre asmadamatiṃ bādhamāna ucchrayasva mahate saubhagāya ||
3,008.03  ucchrayasva vanaspate varṣmanpṛthivyā adhi |
3,008.03 sumitī mīyamāno varco dhā yajñavāhase ||
3,008.04  yuvā suvāsāḥ parivīta āgātsa u śreyānbhavati jāyamānaḥ |
3,008.04 taṃ dhīrāsaḥ kavaya unnayanti svādhyo manasā devayantaḥ ||
3,008.05  jāto jāyate sudinatve ahnāṃ samarya ā vidathe vardhamānaḥ |
3,008.05 punanti dhīrā apaso manīṣā devayā vipra udiyarti vācam ||
3,008.06  yānvo naro devayanto nimimyurvanaspate svadhitirvā tatakṣa |
3,008.06 te devāsaḥ svaravastasthivāṃsaḥ prajāvadasme didhiṣantu ratnam ||
3,008.07  ye vṛkṇāso adhi kṣami nimitāso yatasrucaḥ |
3,008.07 te no vyantu vāryaṃ devatrā kṣetrasādhasaḥ ||
3,008.08  ādityā rudrā vasavaḥ sunīthā dyāvākṣāmā pṛthivī antarikṣam |
3,008.08 sajoṣaso yajñamavantu devā ūrdhvaṃ kṛṇvantvadhvarasya ketum ||
3,008.09  haṃsā iva śreṇiśo yatānāḥ śukrā vasānāḥ svaravo na āguḥ |
3,008.09 unnīyamānāḥ kavibhiḥ purastāddevā devānāmapi yanti pāthaḥ ||
3,008.10  śṛṅgāṇīvecchṛṅgiṇāṃ saṃ dadṛśre caṣālavantaḥ svaravaḥ pṛthivyām |
3,008.10 vāghadbhirvā vihave śroṣamāṇā asmāṃ avantu pṛtanājyeṣu ||
3,008.11  vanaspate śatavalśo vi roha sahasravalśā vi vayaṃ ruhema |
3,008.11 yaṃ tvāmayaṃ svadhitistejamānaḥ praṇināya mahate saubhagāya ||

3,009.01  sakhāyastvā vavṛmahe devaṃ martāsa ūtaye |
3,009.01 apāṃ napātaṃ subhagaṃ sudīditiṃ supratūrtimanehasam ||
3,009.02  kāyamāno vanā tvaṃ yanmātṝrajagannapaḥ |
3,009.02 na tatte agne pramṛṣe nivartanaṃ yaddūre sannihābhavaḥ ||
3,009.03  ati tṛṣṭaṃ vavakṣithāthaiva sumanā asi |
3,009.03 praprānye yanti paryanya āsate yeṣāṃ sakhye asi śritaḥ ||
3,009.04  īyivāṃsamati sridhaḥ śaśvatīrati saścataḥ |
3,009.04 anvīmavindannicirāso adruho'psu siṃhamiva śritam ||
3,009.05  sasṛvāṃsamiva tmanāgnimitthā tirohitam |
3,009.05 ainaṃ nayanmātariśvā parāvato devebhyo mathitaṃ pari ||
3,009.06  taṃ tvā martā agṛbhṇata devebhyo havyavāhana |
3,009.06 viśvānyadyajñāṃ abhipāsi mānuṣa tava kratvā yaviṣṭhya ||
3,009.07  tadbhadraṃ tava daṃsanā pākāya cicchadayati |
3,009.07 tvāṃ yadagne paśavaḥ samāsate samiddhamapiśarvare ||
3,009.08  ā juhotā svadhvaraṃ śīraṃ pāvakaśociṣam |
3,009.08 āśuṃ dūtamajiraṃ pratnamīḍyaṃ śruṣṭī devaṃ saparyata ||
3,009.09  trīṇi śatā trī sahasrāṇyagniṃ triṃśacca devā nava cāsaparyan |
3,009.09 aukṣanghṛtairastṛṇanbarhirasmā ādiddhotāraṃ nyasādayanta ||

3,010.01  tvāmagne manīṣiṇaḥ samrājaṃ carṣaṇīnām |
3,010.01 devaṃ martāsa indhate samadhvare ||
3,010.02  tvāṃ yajñeṣvṛtvijamagne hotāramīḻate |
3,010.02 gopā ṛtasya dīdihi sve dame ||
3,010.03  sa ghā yaste dadāśati samidhā jātavedase |
3,010.03 so agne dhatte suvīryaṃ sa puṣyati ||
3,010.04  sa keturadhvarāṇāmagnirdevebhirā gamat |
3,010.04 añjānaḥ sapta hotṛbhirhaviṣmate ||
3,010.05  pra hotre pūrvyaṃ vaco'gnaye bharatā bṛhat |
3,010.05 vipāṃ jyotīṃṣi bibhrate na vedhase ||
3,010.06  agniṃ vardhantu no giro yato jāyata ukthyaḥ |
3,010.06 mahe vājāya draviṇāya darśataḥ ||
3,010.07  agne yajiṣṭho adhvare devāndevayate yaja |
3,010.07 hotā mandro vi rājasyati sridhaḥ ||
3,010.08  sa naḥ pāvaka dīdihi dyumadasme suvīryam |
3,010.08 bhavā stotṛbhyo antamaḥ svastaye ||
3,010.09  taṃ tvā viprā vipanyavo jāgṛvāṃsaḥ samindhate |
3,010.09 havyavāhamamartyaṃ sahovṛdham ||

3,011.01  agnirhotā purohito'dhvarasya vicarṣaṇiḥ |
3,011.01 sa veda yajñamānuṣak ||
3,011.02  sa havyavāḻ amartya uśigdūtaścanohitaḥ |
3,011.02 agnirdhiyā samṛṇvati ||
3,011.03  agnirdhiyā sa cetati keturyajñasya pūrvyaḥ |
3,011.03 arthaṃ hyasya taraṇi ||
3,011.04  agniṃ sūnuṃ sanaśrutaṃ sahaso jātavedasam |
3,011.04 vahniṃ devā akṛṇvata ||
3,011.05  adābhyaḥ puraetā viśāmagnirmānuṣīṇām |
3,011.05 tūrṇī rathaḥ sadā navaḥ ||
3,011.06  sāhvānviśvā abhiyujaḥ kraturdevānāmamṛktaḥ |
3,011.06 agnistuviśravastamaḥ ||
3,011.07  abhi prayāṃsi vāhasā dāśvāṃ aśnoti martyaḥ |
3,011.07 kṣayaṃ pāvakaśociṣaḥ ||
3,011.08  pari viśvāni sudhitāgneraśyāma manmabhiḥ |
3,011.08 viprāso jātavedasaḥ ||
3,011.09  agne viśvāni vāryā vājeṣu saniṣāmahe |
3,011.09 tve devāsa erire ||

3,012.01  indrāgnī ā gataṃ sutaṃ gīrbhirnabho vareṇyam |
3,012.01 asya pātaṃ dhiyeṣitā ||
3,012.02  indrāgnī jarituḥ sacā yajño jigāti cetanaḥ |
3,012.02 ayā pātamimaṃ sutam ||
3,012.03  indramagniṃ kavicchadā yajñasya jūtyā vṛṇe |
3,012.03 tā somasyeha tṛmpatām ||
3,012.04  tośā vṛtrahaṇā huve sajitvānāparājitā |
3,012.04 indrāgnī vājasātamā ||
3,012.05  pra vāmarcantyukthino nīthāvido jaritāraḥ |
3,012.05 indrāgnī iṣa ā vṛṇe ||
3,012.06  indrāgnī navatiṃ puro dāsapatnīradhūnutam |
3,012.06 sākamekena karmaṇā ||
3,012.07  indrāgnī apasasparyupa pra yanti dhītayaḥ |
3,012.07 ṛtasya pathyā anu ||
3,012.08  indrāgnī taviṣāṇi vāṃ sadhasthāni prayāṃsi ca |
3,012.08 yuvoraptūryaṃ hitam ||
3,012.09  indrāgnī rocanā divaḥ pari vājeṣu bhūṣathaḥ |
3,012.09 tadvāṃ ceti pra vīryam ||

3,013.01  pra vo devāyāgnaye barhiṣṭhamarcāsmai |
3,013.01 gamaddevebhirā sa no yajiṣṭho barhirā sadat ||
3,013.02  ṛtāvā yasya rodasī dakṣaṃ sacanta ūtayaḥ |
3,013.02 haviṣmantastamīḻate taṃ saniṣyanto'vase ||
3,013.03  sa yantā vipra eṣāṃ sa yajñānāmathā hi ṣaḥ |
3,013.03 agniṃ taṃ vo duvasyata dātā yo vanitā magham ||
3,013.04  sa naḥ śarmāṇi vītaye'gniryacchatu śantamā |
3,013.04 yato naḥ pruṣṇavadvasu divi kṣitibhyo apsvā ||
3,013.05  dīdivāṃsamapūrvyaṃ vasvībhirasya dhītibhiḥ |
3,013.05 ṛkvāṇo agnimindhate hotāraṃ viśpatiṃ viśām ||
3,013.06  uta no brahmannaviṣa uktheṣu devahūtamaḥ |
3,013.06 śaṃ naḥ śocā marudvṛdho'gne sahasrasātamaḥ ||
3,013.07  nū no rāsva sahasravattokavatpuṣṭimadvasu |
3,013.07 dyumadagne suvīryaṃ varṣiṣṭhamanupakṣitam ||

3,014.01  ā hotā mandro vidathānyasthātsatyo yajvā kavitamaḥ sa vedhāḥ |
3,014.01 vidyudrathaḥ sahasasputro agniḥ śociṣkeśaḥ pṛthivyāṃ pājo aśret ||
3,014.02  ayāmi te namauktiṃ juṣasva ṛtāvastubhyaṃ cetate sahasvaḥ |
3,014.02 vidvāṃ ā vakṣi viduṣo ni ṣatsi madhya ā barhirūtaye yajatra ||
3,014.03  dravatāṃ ta uṣasā vājayantī agne vātasya pathyābhiraccha |
3,014.03 yatsīmañjanti pūrvyaṃ havirbhirā vandhureva tasthaturduroṇe ||
3,014.04  mitraśca tubhyaṃ varuṇaḥ sahasvo'gne viśve marutaḥ sumnamarcan |
3,014.04 yacchociṣā sahasasputra tiṣṭhā abhi kṣitīḥ prathayansūryo nṝn ||
3,014.05  vayaṃ te adya rarimā hi kāmamuttānahastā namasopasadya |
3,014.05 yajiṣṭhena manasā yakṣi devānasredhatā manmanā vipro agne ||
3,014.06  tvaddhi putra sahaso vi pūrvīrdevasya yantyūtayo vi vājāḥ |
3,014.06 tvaṃ dehi sahasriṇaṃ rayiṃ no'drogheṇa vacasā satyamagne ||
3,014.07  tubhyaṃ dakṣa kavikrato yānīmā deva martāso adhvare akarma |
3,014.07 tvaṃ viśvasya surathasya bodhi sarvaṃ tadagne amṛta svadeha ||

3,015.01  vi pājasā pṛthunā śośucāno bādhasva dviṣo rakṣaso amīvāḥ |
3,015.01 suśarmaṇo bṛhataḥ śarmaṇi syāmagnerahaṃ suhavasya praṇītau ||
3,015.02  tvaṃ no asyā uṣaso vyuṣṭau tvaṃ sūra udite bodhi gopāḥ |
3,015.02 janmeva nityaṃ tanayaṃ juṣasva stomaṃ me agne tanvā sujāta ||
3,015.03  tvaṃ nṛcakṣā vṛṣabhānu pūrvīḥ kṛṣṇāsvagne aruṣo vi bhāhi |
3,015.03 vaso neṣi ca parṣi cātyaṃhaḥ kṛdhī no rāya uśijo yaviṣṭha ||
3,015.04  aṣāḻho agne vṛṣabho didīhi puro viśvāḥ saubhagā saṃjigīvān |
3,015.04 yajñasya netā prathamasya pāyorjātavedo bṛhataḥ supraṇīte ||
3,015.05  acchidrā śarma jaritaḥ purūṇi devāṃ acchā dīdyānaḥ sumedhāḥ |
3,015.05 ratho na sasnirabhi vakṣi vājamagne tvaṃ rodasī naḥ sumeke ||
3,015.06  pra pīpaya vṛṣabha jinva vājānagne tvaṃ rodasī naḥ sudoghe |
3,015.06 devebhirdeva surucā rucāno mā no martasya durmatiḥ pari ṣṭhāt ||
3,015.07  iḻāmagne purudaṃsaṃ saniṃ goḥ śaśvattamaṃ havamānāya sādha |
3,015.07 syānnaḥ sūnustanayo vijāvāgne sā te sumatirbhūtvasme ||

3,016.01  ayamagniḥ suvīryasyeśe mahaḥ saubhagasya |
3,016.01 rāya īśe svapatyasya gomata īśe vṛtrahathānām ||
3,016.02  imaṃ naro marutaḥ saścatā vṛdhaṃ yasminrāyaḥ śevṛdhāsaḥ |
3,016.02 abhi ye santi pṛtanāsu dūḍhyo viśvāhā śatrumādabhuḥ ||
3,016.03  sa tvaṃ no rāyaḥ śiśīhi mīḍhvo agne suvīryasya |
3,016.03 tuvidyumna varṣiṣṭhasya prajāvato'namīvasya śuṣmiṇaḥ ||
3,016.04  cakriryo viśvā bhuvanābhi sāsahiścakrirdeveṣvā duvaḥ |
3,016.04 ā deveṣu yatata ā suvīrya ā śaṃsa uta nṛṇām ||
3,016.05  mā no agne'mataye māvīratāyai rīradhaḥ |
3,016.05 māgotāyai sahasasputra mā nide'pa dveṣāṃsyā kṛdhi ||
3,016.06  śagdhi vājasya subhaga prajāvato'gne bṛhato adhvare |
3,016.06 saṃ rāyā bhūyasā sṛja mayobhunā tuvidyumna yaśasvatā ||

3,017.01  samidhyamānaḥ prathamānu dharmā samaktubhirajyate viśvavāraḥ |
3,017.01 śociṣkeśo ghṛtanirṇikpāvakaḥ suyajño agniryajathāya devān ||
3,017.02  yathāyajo hotramagne pṛthivyā yathā divo jātavedaścikitvān |
3,017.02 evānena haviṣā yakṣi devānmanuṣvadyajñaṃ pra tiremamadya ||
3,017.03  trīṇyāyūṃṣi tava jātavedastisra ājānīruṣasaste agne |
3,017.03 tābhirdevānāmavo yakṣi vidvānathā bhava yajamānāya śaṃ yoḥ ||
3,017.04  agniṃ sudītiṃ sudṛśaṃ gṛṇanto namasyāmastveḍyaṃ jātavedaḥ |
3,017.04 tvāṃ dūtamaratiṃ havyavāhaṃ devā akṛṇvannamṛtasya nābhim ||
3,017.05  yastvaddhotā pūrvo agne yajīyāndvitā ca sattā svadhayā ca śambhuḥ |
3,017.05 tasyānu dharma pra yajā cikitvo'tha no dhā adhvaraṃ devavītau ||

3,018.01  bhavā no agne sumanā upetau sakheva sakhye pitareva sādhuḥ |
3,018.01 purudruho hi kṣitayo janānāṃ prati pratīcīrdahatādarātīḥ ||
3,018.02  tapo ṣvagne antarāṃ amitrāntapā śaṃsamararuṣaḥ parasya |
3,018.02 tapo vaso cikitāno acittānvi te tiṣṭhantāmajarā ayāsaḥ ||
3,018.03  idhmenāgna icchamāno ghṛtena juhomi havyaṃ tarase balāya |
3,018.03 yāvadīśe brahmaṇā vandamāna imāṃ dhiyaṃ śataseyāya devīm ||
3,018.04  ucchociṣā sahasasputra stuto bṛhadvayaḥ śaśamāneṣu dhehi |
3,018.04 revadagne viśvāmitreṣu śaṃ yormarmṛjmā te tanvaṃ bhūri kṛtvaḥ ||
3,018.05  kṛdhi ratnaṃ susanitardhanānāṃ sa ghedagne bhavasi yatsamiddhaḥ |
3,018.05 stoturduroṇe subhagasya revatsṛprā karasnā dadhiṣe vapūṃṣi ||

3,019.01  agniṃ hotāraṃ pra vṛṇe miyedhe gṛtsaṃ kaviṃ viśvavidamamūram |
3,019.01 sa no yakṣaddevatātā yajīyānrāye vājāya vanate maghāni ||
3,019.02  pra te agne haviṣmatīmiyarmyacchā sudyumnāṃ rātinīṃ ghṛtācīm |
3,019.02 pradakṣiṇiddevatātimurāṇaḥ saṃ rātibhirvasubhiryajñamaśret ||
3,019.03  sa tejīyasā manasā tvota uta śikṣa svapatyasya śikṣoḥ |
3,019.03 agne rāyo nṛtamasya prabhūtau bhūyāma te suṣṭutayaśca vasvaḥ ||
3,019.04  bhūrīṇi hi tve dadhire anīkāgne devasya yajyavo janāsaḥ |
3,019.04 sa ā vaha devatātiṃ yaviṣṭha śardho yadadya divyaṃ yajāsi ||
3,019.05  yattvā hotāramanajanmiyedhe niṣādayanto yajathāya devāḥ |
3,019.05 sa tvaṃ no agne'viteha bodhyadhi śravāṃsi dhehi nastanūṣu ||

3,020.01  agnimuṣasamaśvinā dadhikrāṃ vyuṣṭiṣu havate vahnirukthaiḥ |
3,020.01 sujyotiṣo naḥ śṛṇvantu devāḥ sajoṣaso adhvaraṃ vāvaśānāḥ ||
3,020.02  agne trī te vājinā trī ṣadhasthā tisraste jihvā ṛtajāta pūrvīḥ |
3,020.02 tisra u te tanvo devavātāstābhirnaḥ pāhi giro aprayucchan ||
3,020.03  agne bhūrīṇi tava jātavedo deva svadhāvo'mṛtasya nāma |
3,020.03 yāśca māyā māyināṃ viśvaminva tve pūrvīḥ saṃdadhuḥ pṛṣṭabandho ||
3,020.04  agnirnetā bhaga iva kṣitīnāṃ daivīnāṃ deva ṛtupā ṛtāvā |
3,020.04 sa vṛtrahā sanayo viśvavedāḥ parṣadviśvāti duritā gṛṇantam ||
3,020.05  dadhikrāmagnimuṣasaṃ ca devīṃ bṛhaspatiṃ savitāraṃ ca devam |
3,020.05 aśvinā mitrāvaruṇā bhagaṃ ca vasūnrudrāṃ ādityāṃ iha huve ||

3,021.01  imaṃ no yajñamamṛteṣu dhehīmā havyā jātavedo juṣasva |
3,021.01 stokānāmagne medaso ghṛtasya hotaḥ prāśāna prathamo niṣadya ||
3,021.02  ghṛtavantaḥ pāvaka te stokā ścotanti medasaḥ |
3,021.02 svadharmandevavītaye śreṣṭhaṃ no dhehi vāryam ||
3,021.03  tubhyaṃ stokā ghṛtaścuto'gne viprāya santya |
3,021.03 ṛṣiḥ śreṣṭhaḥ samidhyase yajñasya prāvitā bhava ||
3,021.04  tubhyaṃ ścotantyadhrigo śacīva stokāso agne medaso ghṛtasya |
3,021.04 kaviśasto bṛhatā bhānunāgā havyā juṣasva medhira ||
3,021.05  ojiṣṭhaṃ te madhyato meda udbhṛtaṃ pra te vayaṃ dadāmahe |
3,021.05 ścotanti te vaso stokā adhi tvaci prati tāndevaśo vihi ||

3,022.01  ayaṃ so agniryasminsomamindraḥ sutaṃ dadhe jaṭhare vāvaśānaḥ |
3,022.01 sahasriṇaṃ vājamatyaṃ na saptiṃ sasavānsanstūyase jātavedaḥ ||
3,022.02  agne yatte divi varcaḥ pṛthivyāṃ yadoṣadhīṣvapsvā yajatra |
3,022.02 yenāntarikṣamurvātatantha tveṣaḥ sa bhānurarṇavo nṛcakṣāḥ ||
3,022.03  agne divo arṇamacchā jigāsyacchā devāṃ ūciṣe dhiṣṇyā ye |
3,022.03 yā rocane parastātsūryasya yāścāvastādupatiṣṭhanta āpaḥ ||
3,022.04  purīṣyāso agnayaḥ prāvaṇebhiḥ sajoṣasaḥ |
3,022.04 juṣantāṃ yajñamadruho'namīvā iṣo mahīḥ ||
3,022.05  iḻāmagne purudaṃsaṃ saniṃ goḥ śaśvattamaṃ havamānāya sādha |
3,022.05 syānnaḥ sūnustanayo vijāvāgne sā te sumatirbhūtvasme ||

3,023.01  nirmathitaḥ sudhita ā sadhasthe yuvā kaviradhvarasya praṇetā |
3,023.01 jūryatsvagnirajaro vaneṣvatrā dadhe amṛtaṃ jātavedāḥ ||
3,023.02  amanthiṣṭāṃ bhāratā revadagniṃ devaśravā devavātaḥ sudakṣam |
3,023.02 agne vi paśya bṛhatābhi rāyeṣāṃ no netā bhavatādanu dyūn ||
3,023.03  daśa kṣipaḥ pūrvyaṃ sīmajījanansujātaṃ mātṛṣu priyam |
3,023.03 agniṃ stuhi daivavātaṃ devaśravo yo janānāmasadvaśī ||
3,023.04  ni tvā dadhe vara ā pṛthivyā iḻāyāspade sudinatve ahnām |
3,023.04 dṛṣadvatyāṃ mānuṣa āpayāyāṃ sarasvatyāṃ revadagne didīhi ||
3,023.05  iḻāmagne purudaṃsaṃ saniṃ goḥ śaśvattamaṃ havamānāya sādha |
3,023.05 syānnaḥ sūnustanayo vijāvāgne sā te sumatirbhūtvasme ||

3,024.01  agne sahasva pṛtanā abhimātīrapāsya |
3,024.01 duṣṭarastarannarātīrvarco dhā yajñavāhase ||
3,024.02  agna iḻā samidhyase vītihotro amartyaḥ |
3,024.02 juṣasva sū no adhvaram ||
3,024.03  agne dyumnena jāgṛve sahasaḥ sūnavāhuta |
3,024.03 edaṃ barhiḥ sado mama ||
3,024.04  agne viśvebhiragnibhirdevebhirmahayā giraḥ |
3,024.04 yajñeṣu ya u cāyavaḥ ||
3,024.05  agne dā dāśuṣe rayiṃ vīravantaṃ parīṇasam |
3,024.05 śiśīhi naḥ sūnumataḥ ||

3,025.01  agne divaḥ sūnurasi pracetāstanā pṛthivyā uta viśvavedāḥ |
3,025.01 ṛdhagdevāṃ iha yajā cikitvaḥ ||
3,025.02  agniḥ sanoti vīryāṇi vidvānsanoti vājamamṛtāya bhūṣan |
3,025.02 sa no devāṃ eha vahā purukṣo ||
3,025.03  agnirdyāvāpṛthivī viśvajanye ā bhāti devī amṛte amūraḥ |
3,025.03 kṣayanvājaiḥ puruścandro namobhiḥ ||
3,025.04  agna indraśca dāśuṣo duroṇe sutāvato yajñamihopa yātam |
3,025.04 amardhantā somapeyāya devā ||
3,025.05  agne apāṃ samidhyase duroṇe nityaḥ sūno sahaso jātavedaḥ |
3,025.05 sadhasthāni mahayamāna ūtī ||

3,026.01  vaiśvānaraṃ manasāgniṃ nicāyyā haviṣmanto anuṣatyaṃ svarvidam |
3,026.01 sudānuṃ devaṃ rathiraṃ vasūyavo gīrbhī raṇvaṃ kuśikāso havāmahe ||
3,026.02  taṃ śubhramagnimavase havāmahe vaiśvānaraṃ mātariśvānamukthyam |
3,026.02 bṛhaspatiṃ manuṣo devatātaye vipraṃ śrotāramatithiṃ raghuṣyadam ||
3,026.03  aśvo na krandañjanibhiḥ samidhyate vaiśvānaraḥ kuśikebhiryugeyuge |
3,026.03 sa no agniḥ suvīryaṃ svaśvyaṃ dadhātu ratnamamṛteṣu jāgṛviḥ ||
3,026.04  pra yantu vājāstaviṣībhiragnayaḥ śubhe sammiślāḥ pṛṣatīrayukṣata |
3,026.04 bṛhadukṣo maruto viśvavedasaḥ pra vepayanti parvatāṃ adābhyāḥ ||
3,026.05  agniśriyo maruto viśvakṛṣṭaya ā tveṣamugramava īmahe vayam |
3,026.05 te svānino rudriyā varṣanirṇijaḥ siṃhā na heṣakratavaḥ sudānavaḥ ||
3,026.06  vrātaṃvrātaṃ gaṇaṃgaṇaṃ suśastibhiragnerbhāmaṃ marutāmoja īmahe |
3,026.06 pṛṣadaśvāso anavabhrarādhaso gantāro yajñaṃ vidatheṣu dhīrāḥ ||
3,026.07  agnirasmi janmanā jātavedā ghṛtaṃ me cakṣuramṛtaṃ ma āsan |
3,026.07 arkastridhātū rajaso vimāno'jasro gharmo havirasmi nāma ||
3,026.08  tribhiḥ pavitrairapupoddhyarkaṃ hṛdā matiṃ jyotiranu prajānan |
3,026.08 varṣiṣṭhaṃ ratnamakṛta svadhābhirādiddyāvāpṛthivī paryapaśyat ||
3,026.09  śatadhāramutsamakṣīyamāṇaṃ vipaścitaṃ pitaraṃ vaktvānām |
3,026.09 meḻiṃ madantaṃ pitrorupasthe taṃ rodasī pipṛtaṃ satyavācam ||

3,027.01  pra vo vājā abhidyavo haviṣmanto ghṛtācyā |
3,027.01 devāñjigāti sumnayuḥ ||
3,027.02  īḻe agniṃ vipaścitaṃ girā yajñasya sādhanam |
3,027.02 śruṣṭīvānaṃ dhitāvānam ||
3,027.03  agne śakema te vayaṃ yamaṃ devasya vājinaḥ |
3,027.03 ati dveṣāṃsi tarema ||
3,027.04  samidhyamāno adhvare'gniḥ pāvaka īḍyaḥ |
3,027.04 śociṣkeśastamīmahe ||
3,027.05  pṛthupājā amartyo ghṛtanirṇiksvāhutaḥ |
3,027.05 agniryajñasya havyavāṭ ||
3,027.06  taṃ sabādho yatasruca itthā dhiyā yajñavantaḥ |
3,027.06 ā cakruragnimūtaye ||
3,027.07  hotā devo amartyaḥ purastādeti māyayā |
3,027.07 vidathāni pracodayan ||
3,027.08  vājī vājeṣu dhīyate'dhvareṣu pra ṇīyate |
3,027.08 vipro yajñasya sādhanaḥ ||
3,027.09  dhiyā cakre vareṇyo bhūtānāṃ garbhamā dadhe |
3,027.09 dakṣasya pitaraṃ tanā ||
3,027.10  ni tvā dadhe vareṇyaṃ dakṣasyeḻā sahaskṛta |
3,027.10 agne sudītimuśijam ||
3,027.11  agniṃ yanturamapturamṛtasya yoge vanuṣaḥ |
3,027.11 viprā vājaiḥ samindhate ||
3,027.12  ūrjo napātamadhvare dīdivāṃsamupa dyavi |
3,027.12 agnimīḻe kavikratum ||
3,027.13  īḻenyo namasyastirastamāṃsi darśataḥ |
3,027.13 samagniridhyate vṛṣā ||
3,027.14  vṛṣo agniḥ samidhyate'śvo na devavāhanaḥ |
3,027.14 taṃ haviṣmanta īḻate ||
3,027.15  vṛṣaṇaṃ tvā vayaṃ vṛṣanvṛṣaṇaḥ samidhīmahi |
3,027.15 agne dīdyataṃ bṛhat ||

3,028.01  agne juṣasva no haviḥ puroḻāśaṃ jātavedaḥ |
3,028.01 prātaḥsāve dhiyāvaso ||
3,028.02  puroḻā agne pacatastubhyaṃ vā ghā pariṣkṛtaḥ |
3,028.02 taṃ juṣasva yaviṣṭhya ||
3,028.03  agne vīhi puroḻāśamāhutaṃ tiroahnyam |
3,028.03 sahasaḥ sūnurasyadhvare hitaḥ ||
3,028.04  mādhyandine savane jātavedaḥ puroḻāśamiha kave juṣasva |
3,028.04 agne yahvasya tava bhāgadheyaṃ na pra minanti vidatheṣu dhīrāḥ ||
3,028.05  agne tṛtīye savane hi kāniṣaḥ puroḻāśaṃ sahasaḥ sūnavāhutam |
3,028.05 athā deveṣvadhvaraṃ vipanyayā dhā ratnavantamamṛteṣu jāgṛvim ||
3,028.06  agne vṛdhāna āhutiṃ puroḻāśaṃ jātavedaḥ |
3,028.06 juṣasva tiroahnyam ||

3,029.01  astīdamadhimanthanamasti prajananaṃ kṛtam |
3,029.01 etāṃ viśpatnīmā bharāgniṃ manthāma pūrvathā ||
3,029.02  araṇyornihito jātavedā garbha iva sudhito garbhiṇīṣu |
3,029.02 divediva īḍyo jāgṛvadbhirhaviṣmadbhirmanuṣyebhiragniḥ ||
3,029.03  uttānāyāmava bharā cikitvānsadyaḥ pravītā vṛṣaṇaṃ jajāna |
3,029.03 aruṣastūpo ruśadasya pāja iḻāyāsputro vayune'janiṣṭa ||
3,029.04  iḻāyāstvā pade vayaṃ nābhā pṛthivyā adhi |
3,029.04 jātavedo ni dhīmahyagne havyāya voḻhave ||
3,029.05  manthatā naraḥ kavimadvayantaṃ pracetasamamṛtaṃ supratīkam |
3,029.05 yajñasya ketuṃ prathamaṃ purastādagniṃ naro janayatā suśevam ||
3,029.06  yadī manthanti bāhubhirvi rocate'śvo na vājyaruṣo vaneṣvā |
3,029.06 citro na yāmannaśvinoranivṛtaḥ pari vṛṇaktyaśmanastṛṇā dahan ||
3,029.07  jāto agnī rocate cekitāno vājī vipraḥ kaviśastaḥ sudānuḥ |
3,029.07 yaṃ devāsa īḍyaṃ viśvavidaṃ havyavāhamadadhuradhvareṣu ||
3,029.08  sīda hotaḥ sva u loke cikitvānsādayā yajñaṃ sukṛtasya yonau |
3,029.08 devāvīrdevānhaviṣā yajāsyagne bṛhadyajamāne vayo dhāḥ ||
3,029.09  kṛṇota dhūmaṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ sakhāyo'sredhanta itana vājamaccha |
3,029.09 ayamagniḥ pṛtanāṣāṭsuvīro yena devāso asahanta dasyūn ||
3,029.10  ayaṃ te yonirṛtviyo yato jāto arocathāḥ |
3,029.10 taṃ jānannagna ā sīdāthā no vardhayā giraḥ ||
3,029.11  tanūnapāducyate garbha āsuro narāśaṃso bhavati yadvijāyate |
3,029.11 mātariśvā yadamimīta mātari vātasya sargo abhavatsarīmaṇi ||
3,029.12  sunirmathā nirmathitaḥ sunidhā nihitaḥ kaviḥ |
3,029.12 agne svadhvarā kṛṇu devāndevayate yaja ||
3,029.13  ajījanannamṛtaṃ martyāso'sremāṇaṃ taraṇiṃ vīḻujambham |
3,029.13 daśa svasāro agruvaḥ samīcīḥ pumāṃsaṃ jātamabhi saṃ rabhante ||
3,029.14  pra saptahotā sanakādarocata māturupasthe yadaśocadūdhani |
3,029.14 na ni miṣati suraṇo divedive yadasurasya jaṭharādajāyata ||
3,029.15  amitrāyudho marutāmiva prayāḥ prathamajā brahmaṇo viśvamidviduḥ |
3,029.15 dyumnavadbrahma kuśikāsa erira ekaeko dame agniṃ samīdhire ||
3,029.16  yadadya tvā prayati yajñe asminhotaścikitvo'vṛṇīmahīha |
3,029.16 dhruvamayā dhruvamutāśamiṣṭhāḥ prajānanvidvāṃ upa yāhi somam ||

3,030.01  icchanti tvā somyāsaḥ sakhāyaḥ sunvanti somaṃ dadhati prayāṃsi |
3,030.01 titikṣante abhiśastiṃ janānāmindra tvadā kaścana hi praketaḥ ||
3,030.02  na te dūre paramā cidrajāṃsyā tu pra yāhi harivo haribhyām |
3,030.02 sthirāya vṛṣṇe savanā kṛtemā yuktā grāvāṇaḥ samidhāne agnau ||
3,030.03  indraḥ suśipro maghavā tarutro mahāvrātastuvikūrmirṛghāvān |
3,030.03 yadugro dhā bādhito martyeṣu kva tyā te vṛṣabha vīryāṇi ||
3,030.04  tvaṃ hi ṣmā cyāvayannacyutānyeko vṛtrā carasi jighnamānaḥ |
3,030.04 tava dyāvāpṛthivī parvatāso'nu vratāya nimiteva tasthuḥ ||
3,030.05  utābhaye puruhūta śravobhireko dṛḻhamavado vṛtrahā san |
3,030.05 ime cidindra rodasī apāre yatsaṃgṛbhṇā maghavankāśiritte ||
3,030.06  pra sū ta indra pravatā haribhyāṃ pra te vajraḥ pramṛṇannetu śatrūn |
3,030.06 jahi pratīco anūcaḥ parāco viśvaṃ satyaṃ kṛṇuhi viṣṭamastu ||
3,030.07  yasmai dhāyuradadhā martyāyābhaktaṃ cidbhajate gehyaṃ saḥ |
3,030.07 bhadrā ta indra sumatirghṛtācī sahasradānā puruhūta rātiḥ ||
3,030.08  sahadānuṃ puruhūta kṣiyantamahastamindra saṃ piṇakkuṇārum |
3,030.08 abhi vṛtraṃ vardhamānaṃ piyārumapādamindra tavasā jaghantha ||
3,030.09  ni sāmanāmiṣirāmindra bhūmiṃ mahīmapārāṃ sadane sasattha |
3,030.09 astabhnāddyāṃ vṛṣabho antarikṣamarṣantvāpastvayeha prasūtāḥ ||
3,030.10  alātṛṇo vala indra vrajo goḥ purā hantorbhayamāno vyāra |
3,030.10 sugānpatho akṛṇonniraje gāḥ prāvanvāṇīḥ puruhūtaṃ dhamantīḥ ||
3,030.11  eko dve vasumatī samīcī indra ā paprau pṛthivīmuta dyām |
3,030.11 utāntarikṣādabhi naḥ samīka iṣo rathīḥ sayujaḥ śūra vājān ||
3,030.12  diśaḥ sūryo na mināti pradiṣṭā divedive haryaśvaprasūtāḥ |
3,030.12 saṃ yadānaḻ adhvana ādidaśvairvimocanaṃ kṛṇute tattvasya ||
3,030.13  didṛkṣanta uṣaso yāmannaktorvivasvatyā mahi citramanīkam |
3,030.13 viśve jānanti mahinā yadāgādindrasya karma sukṛtā purūṇi ||
3,030.14  mahi jyotirnihitaṃ vakṣaṇāsvāmā pakvaṃ carati bibhratī gauḥ |
3,030.14 viśvaṃ svādma sambhṛtamusriyāyāṃ yatsīmindro adadhādbhojanāya ||
3,030.15  indra dṛhya yāmakośā abhūvanyajñāya śikṣa gṛṇate sakhibhyaḥ |
3,030.15 durmāyavo durevā martyāso niṣaṅgiṇo ripavo hantvāsaḥ ||
3,030.16  saṃ ghoṣaḥ śṛṇve'vamairamitrairjahī nyeṣvaśaniṃ tapiṣṭhām |
3,030.16 vṛścemadhastādvi rujā sahasva jahi rakṣo maghavanrandhayasva ||
3,030.17  udvṛha rakṣaḥ sahamūlamindra vṛścā madhyaṃ pratyagraṃ śṛṇīhi |
3,030.17 ā kīvataḥ salalūkaṃ cakartha brahmadviṣe tapuṣiṃ hetimasya ||
3,030.18  svastaye vājibhiśca praṇetaḥ saṃ yanmahīriṣa āsatsi pūrvīḥ |
3,030.18 rāyo vantāro bṛhataḥ syāmāsme astu bhaga indra prajāvān ||
3,030.19  ā no bhara bhagamindra dyumantaṃ ni te deṣṇasya dhīmahi prareke |
3,030.19 ūrva iva paprathe kāmo asme tamā pṛṇa vasupate vasūnām ||
3,030.20  imaṃ kāmaṃ mandayā gobhiraśvaiścandravatā rādhasā paprathaśca |
3,030.20 svaryavo matibhistubhyaṃ viprā indrāya vāhaḥ kuśikāso akran ||
3,030.21  ā no gotrā dardṛhi gopate gāḥ samasmabhyaṃ sanayo yantu vājāḥ |
3,030.21 divakṣā asi vṛṣabha satyaśuṣmo'smabhyaṃ su maghavanbodhi godāḥ ||
3,030.22  śunaṃ huvema maghavānamindramasminbhare nṛtamaṃ vājasātau |
3,030.22 śṛṇvantamugramūtaye samatsu ghnantaṃ vṛtrāṇi saṃjitaṃ dhanānām ||

3,031.01  śāsadvahnirduhiturnaptyaṃ gādvidvāṃ ṛtasya dīdhitiṃ saparyan |
3,031.01 pitā yatra duhituḥ sekamṛñjansaṃ śagmyena manasā dadhanve ||
3,031.02  na jāmaye tānvo rikthamāraikcakāra garbhaṃ saniturnidhānam |
3,031.02 yadī mātaro janayanta vahnimanyaḥ kartā sukṛtoranya ṛndhan ||
3,031.03  agnirjajñe juhvā rejamāno mahasputrāṃ aruṣasya prayakṣe |
3,031.03 mahāngarbho mahyā jātameṣāṃ mahī pravṛddharyaśvasya yajñaiḥ ||
3,031.04  abhi jaitrīrasacanta spṛdhānaṃ mahi jyotistamaso nirajānan |
3,031.04 taṃ jānatīḥ pratyudāyannuṣāsaḥ patirgavāmabhavadeka indraḥ ||
3,031.05  vīḻau satīrabhi dhīrā atṛndanprācāhinvanmanasā sapta viprāḥ |
3,031.05 viśvāmavindanpathyāmṛtasya prajānannittā namasā viveśa ||
3,031.06  vidadyadī saramā rugṇamadrermahi pāthaḥ pūrvyaṃ sadhryakkaḥ |
3,031.06 agraṃ nayatsupadyakṣarāṇāmacchā ravaṃ prathamā jānatī gāt ||
3,031.07  agacchadu vipratamaḥ sakhīyannasūdayatsukṛte garbhamadriḥ |
3,031.07 sasāna maryo yuvabhirmakhasyannathābhavadaṅgirāḥ sadyo arcan ||
3,031.08  sataḥsataḥ pratimānaṃ purobhūrviśvā veda janimā hanti śuṣṇam |
3,031.08 pra ṇo divaḥ padavīrgavyurarcansakhā sakhīṃramuñcanniravadyāt ||
3,031.09  ni gavyatā manasā sedurarkaiḥ kṛṇvānāso amṛtatvāya gātum |
3,031.09 idaṃ cinnu sadanaṃ bhūryeṣāṃ yena māsāṃ asiṣāsannṛtena ||
3,031.10  sampaśyamānā amadannabhi svaṃ payaḥ pratnasya retaso dughānāḥ |
3,031.10 vi rodasī atapadghoṣa eṣāṃ jāte niṣṭhāmadadhurgoṣu vīrān ||
3,031.11  sa jātebhirvṛtrahā sedu havyairudusriyā asṛjadindro arkaiḥ |
3,031.11 urūcyasmai ghṛtavadbharantī madhu svādma duduhe jenyā gauḥ ||
3,031.12  pitre ciccakruḥ sadanaṃ samasmai mahi tviṣīmatsukṛto vi hi khyan |
3,031.12 viṣkabhnanta skambhanenā janitrī āsīnā ūrdhvaṃ rabhasaṃ vi minvan ||
3,031.13  mahī yadi dhiṣaṇā śiśnathe dhātsadyovṛdhaṃ vibhvaṃ rodasyoḥ |
3,031.13 giro yasminnanavadyāḥ samīcīrviśvā indrāya taviṣīranuttāḥ ||
3,031.14  mahyā te sakhyaṃ vaśmi śaktīrā vṛtraghne niyuto yanti pūrvīḥ |
3,031.14 mahi stotramava āganma sūrerasmākaṃ su maghavanbodhi gopāḥ ||
3,031.15  mahi kṣetraṃ puru ścandraṃ vividvānāditsakhibhyaścarathaṃ samairat |
3,031.15 indro nṛbhirajanaddīdyānaḥ sākaṃ sūryamuṣasaṃ gātumagnim ||
3,031.16  apaścideṣa vibhvo damūnāḥ pra sadhrīcīrasṛjadviśvaścandrāḥ |
3,031.16 madhvaḥ punānāḥ kavibhiḥ pavitrairdyubhirhinvantyaktubhirdhanutrīḥ ||
3,031.17  anu kṛṣṇe vasudhitī jihāte ubhe sūryasya maṃhanā yajatre |
3,031.17 pari yatte mahimānaṃ vṛjadhyai sakhāya indra kāmyā ṛjipyāḥ ||
3,031.18  patirbhava vṛtrahansūnṛtānāṃ girāṃ viśvāyurvṛṣabho vayodhāḥ |
3,031.18 ā no gahi sakhyebhiḥ śivebhirmahānmahībhirūtibhiḥ saraṇyan ||
3,031.19  tamaṅgirasvannamasā saparyannavyaṃ kṛṇomi sanyase purājām |
3,031.19 druho vi yāhi bahulā adevīḥ svaśca no maghavansātaye dhāḥ ||
3,031.20  mihaḥ pāvakāḥ pratatā abhūvansvasti naḥ pipṛhi pāramāsām |
3,031.20 indra tvaṃ rathiraḥ pāhi no riṣo makṣūmakṣū kṛṇuhi gojito naḥ ||
3,031.21  adediṣṭa vṛtrahā gopatirgā antaḥ kṛṣṇāṃ aruṣairdhāmabhirgāt |
3,031.21 pra sūnṛtā diśamāna ṛtena duraśca viśvā avṛṇodapa svāḥ ||
3,031.22  śunaṃ huvema maghavānamindramasminbhare nṛtamaṃ vājasātau |
3,031.22 śṛṇvantamugramūtaye samatsu ghnantaṃ vṛtrāṇi saṃjitaṃ dhanānām ||

3,032.01  indra somaṃ somapate pibemaṃ mādhyandinaṃ savanaṃ cāru yatte |
3,032.01 prapruthyā śipre maghavannṛjīṣinvimucyā harī iha mādayasva ||
3,032.02  gavāśiraṃ manthinamindra śukraṃ pibā somaṃ rarimā te madāya |
3,032.02 brahmakṛtā mārutenā gaṇena sajoṣā rudraistṛpadā vṛṣasva ||
3,032.03  ye te śuṣmaṃ ye taviṣīmavardhannarcanta indra marutasta ojaḥ |
3,032.03 mādhyandine savane vajrahasta pibā rudrebhiḥ sagaṇaḥ suśipra ||
3,032.04  ta innvasya madhumadvivipra indrasya śardho maruto ya āsan |
3,032.04 yebhirvṛtrasyeṣito vivedāmarmaṇo manyamānasya marma ||
3,032.05  manuṣvadindra savanaṃ juṣāṇaḥ pibā somaṃ śaśvate vīryāya |
3,032.05 sa ā vavṛtsva haryaśva yajñaiḥ saraṇyubhirapo arṇā sisarṣi ||
3,032.06  tvamapo yaddha vṛtraṃ jaghanvāṃ atyāṃ iva prāsṛjaḥ sartavājau |
3,032.06 śayānamindra caratā vadhena vavrivāṃsaṃ pari devīradevam ||
3,032.07  yajāma innamasā vṛddhamindraṃ bṛhantamṛṣvamajaraṃ yuvānam |
3,032.07 yasya priye mamaturyajñiyasya na rodasī mahimānaṃ mamāte ||
3,032.08  indrasya karma sukṛtā purūṇi vratāni devā na minanti viśve |
3,032.08 dādhāra yaḥ pṛthivīṃ dyāmutemāṃ jajāna sūryamuṣasaṃ sudaṃsāḥ ||
3,032.09  adrogha satyaṃ tava tanmahitvaṃ sadyo yajjāto apibo ha somam |
3,032.09 na dyāva indra tavasasta ojo nāhā na māsāḥ śarado varanta ||
3,032.10  tvaṃ sadyo apibo jāta indra madāya somaṃ parame vyoman |
3,032.10 yaddha dyāvāpṛthivī āviveśīrathābhavaḥ pūrvyaḥ kārudhāyāḥ ||
3,032.11  ahannahiṃ pariśayānamarṇa ojāyamānaṃ tuvijāta tavyān |
3,032.11 na te mahitvamanu bhūdadha dyauryadanyayā sphigyā kṣāmavasthāḥ ||
3,032.12  yajño hi ta indra vardhano bhūduta priyaḥ sutasomo miyedhaḥ |
3,032.12 yajñena yajñamava yajñiyaḥ sanyajñaste vajramahihatya āvat ||
3,032.13  yajñenendramavasā cakre arvāgainaṃ sumnāya navyase vavṛtyām |
3,032.13 ya stomebhirvāvṛdhe pūrvyebhiryo madhyamebhiruta nūtanebhiḥ ||
3,032.14  viveṣa yanmā dhiṣaṇā jajāna stavai purā pāryādindramahnaḥ |
3,032.14 aṃhaso yatra pīparadyathā no nāveva yāntamubhaye havante ||
3,032.15  āpūrṇo asya kalaśaḥ svāhā sekteva kośaṃ sisice pibadhyai |
3,032.15 samu priyā āvavṛtranmadāya pradakṣiṇidabhi somāsa indram ||
3,032.16  na tvā gabhīraḥ puruhūta sindhurnādrayaḥ pari ṣanto varanta |
3,032.16 itthā sakhibhya iṣito yadindrā dṛḻhaṃ cidarujo gavyamūrvam ||
3,032.17  śunaṃ huvema maghavānamindramasminbhare nṛtamaṃ vājasātau |
3,032.17 śṛṇvantamugramūtaye samatsu ghnantaṃ vṛtrāṇi saṃjitaṃ dhanānām ||

3,033.01  pra parvatānāmuśatī upasthādaśve iva viṣite hāsamāne |
3,033.01 gāveva śubhre mātarā rihāṇe vipāṭchutudrī payasā javete ||
3,033.02  indreṣite prasavaṃ bhikṣamāṇe acchā samudraṃ rathyeva yāthaḥ |
3,033.02 samārāṇe ūrmibhiḥ pinvamāne anyā vāmanyāmapyeti śubhre ||
3,033.03  acchā sindhuṃ mātṛtamāmayāsaṃ vipāśamurvīṃ subhagāmaganma |
3,033.03 vatsamiva mātarā saṃrihāṇe samānaṃ yonimanu saṃcarantī ||
3,033.04  enā vayaṃ payasā pinvamānā anu yoniṃ devakṛtaṃ carantīḥ |
3,033.04 na vartave prasavaḥ sargataktaḥ kiṃyurvipro nadyo johavīti ||
3,033.05  ramadhvaṃ me vacase somyāya ṛtāvarīrupa muhūrtamevaiḥ |
3,033.05 pra sindhumacchā bṛhatī manīṣāvasyurahve kuśikasya sūnuḥ ||
3,033.06  indro asmāṃ aradadvajrabāhurapāhanvṛtraṃ paridhiṃ nadīnām |
3,033.06 devo'nayatsavitā supāṇistasya vayaṃ prasave yāma urvīḥ ||
3,033.07  pravācyaṃ śaśvadhā vīryaṃ tadindrasya karma yadahiṃ vivṛścat |
3,033.07 vi vajreṇa pariṣado jaghānāyannāpo'yanamicchamānāḥ ||
3,033.08  etadvaco jaritarmāpi mṛṣṭhā ā yatte ghoṣānuttarā yugāni |
3,033.08 uktheṣu kāro prati no juṣasva mā no ni kaḥ puruṣatrā namaste ||
3,033.09  o ṣu svasāraḥ kārave śṛṇota yayau vo dūrādanasā rathena |
3,033.09 ni ṣū namadhvaṃ bhavatā supārā adhoakṣāḥ sindhavaḥ srotyābhiḥ ||
3,033.10  ā te kāro śṛṇavāmā vacāṃsi yayātha dūrādanasā rathena |
3,033.10 ni te naṃsai pīpyāneva yoṣā maryāyeva kanyā śaśvacai te ||
3,033.11  yadaṅga tvā bharatāḥ saṃtareyurgavyangrāma iṣita indrajūtaḥ |
3,033.11 arṣādaha prasavaḥ sargatakta ā vo vṛṇe sumatiṃ yajñiyānām ||
3,033.12  atāriṣurbharatā gavyavaḥ samabhakta vipraḥ sumatiṃ nadīnām |
3,033.12 pra pinvadhvamiṣayantīḥ surādhā ā vakṣaṇāḥ pṛṇadhvaṃ yāta śībham ||
3,033.13  udva ūrmiḥ śamyā hantvāpo yoktrāṇi muñcata |
3,033.13 māduṣkṛtau vyenasāghnyau śūnamāratām ||

3,034.01  indraḥ pūrbhidātiraddāsamarkairvidadvasurdayamāno vi śatrūn |
3,034.01 brahmajūtastanvā vāvṛdhāno bhūridātra āpṛṇadrodasī ubhe ||
3,034.02  makhasya te taviṣasya pra jūtimiyarmi vācamamṛtāya bhūṣan |
3,034.02 indra kṣitīnāmasi mānuṣīṇāṃ viśāṃ daivīnāmuta pūrvayāvā ||
3,034.03  indro vṛtramavṛṇocchardhanītiḥ pra māyināmaminādvarpaṇītiḥ |
3,034.03 ahanvyaṃsamuśadhagvaneṣvāvirdhenā akṛṇodrāmyāṇām ||
3,034.04  indraḥ svarṣā janayannahāni jigāyośigbhiḥ pṛtanā abhiṣṭiḥ |
3,034.04 prārocayanmanave ketumahnāmavindajjyotirbṛhate raṇāya ||
3,034.05  indrastujo barhaṇā ā viveśa nṛvaddadhāno naryā purūṇi |
3,034.05 acetayaddhiya imā jaritre premaṃ varṇamatiracchukramāsām ||
3,034.06  maho mahāni panayantyasyendrasya karma sukṛtā purūṇi |
3,034.06 vṛjanena vṛjinānsaṃ pipeṣa māyābhirdasyūṃrabhibhūtyojāḥ ||
3,034.07  yudhendro mahnā varivaścakāra devebhyaḥ satpatiścarṣaṇiprāḥ |
3,034.07 vivasvataḥ sadane asya tāni viprā ukthebhiḥ kavayo gṛṇanti ||
3,034.08  satrāsāhaṃ vareṇyaṃ sahodāṃ sasavāṃsaṃ svarapaśca devīḥ |
3,034.08 sasāna yaḥ pṛthivīṃ dyāmutemāmindraṃ madantyanu dhīraṇāsaḥ ||
3,034.09  sasānātyāṃ uta sūryaṃ sasānendraḥ sasāna purubhojasaṃ gām |
3,034.09 hiraṇyayamuta bhogaṃ sasāna hatvī dasyūnprāryaṃ varṇamāvat ||
3,034.10  indra oṣadhīrasanodahāni vanaspatīṃrasanodantarikṣam |
3,034.10 bibheda valaṃ nunude vivāco'thābhavaddamitābhikratūnām ||
3,034.11  śunaṃ huvema maghavānamindramasminbhare nṛtamaṃ vājasātau |
3,034.11 śṛṇvantamugramūtaye samatsu ghnantaṃ vṛtrāṇi saṃjitaṃ dhanānām ||

3,035.01  tiṣṭhā harī ratha ā yujyamānā yāhi vāyurna niyuto no accha |
3,035.01 pibāsyandho abhisṛṣṭo asme indra svāhā rarimā te madāya ||
3,035.02  upājirā puruhūtāya saptī harī rathasya dhūrṣvā yunajmi |
3,035.02 dravadyathā sambhṛtaṃ viśvataścidupemaṃ yajñamā vahāta indram ||
3,035.03  upo nayasva vṛṣaṇā tapuṣpotemava tvaṃ vṛṣabha svadhāvaḥ |
3,035.03 grasetāmaśvā vi muceha śoṇā divedive sadṛśīraddhi dhānāḥ ||
3,035.04  brahmaṇā te brahmayujā yunajmi harī sakhāyā sadhamāda āśū |
3,035.04 sthiraṃ rathaṃ sukhamindrādhitiṣṭhanprajānanvidvāṃ upa yāhi somam ||
3,035.05  mā te harī vṛṣaṇā vītapṛṣṭhā ni rīramanyajamānāso anye |
3,035.05 atyāyāhi śaśvato vayaṃ te'raṃ sutebhiḥ kṛṇavāma somaiḥ ||
3,035.06  tavāyaṃ somastvamehyarvāṅchaśvattamaṃ sumanā asya pāhi |
3,035.06 asminyajñe barhiṣyā niṣadyā dadhiṣvemaṃ jaṭhara indumindra ||
3,035.07  stīrṇaṃ te barhiḥ suta indra somaḥ kṛtā dhānā attave te haribhyām |
3,035.07 tadokase puruśākāya vṛṣṇe marutvate tubhyaṃ rātā havīṃṣi ||
3,035.08  imaṃ naraḥ parvatāstubhyamāpaḥ samindra gobhirmadhumantamakran |
3,035.08 tasyāgatyā sumanā ṛṣva pāhi prajānanvidvānpathyā anu svāḥ ||
3,035.09  yāṃ ābhajo maruta indra some ye tvāmavardhannabhavangaṇaste |
3,035.09 tebhiretaṃ sajoṣā vāvaśāno'gneḥ piba jihvayā somamindra ||
3,035.10  indra piba svadhayā citsutasyāgnervā pāhi jihvayā yajatra |
3,035.10 adhvaryorvā prayataṃ śakra hastāddhoturvā yajñaṃ haviṣo juṣasva ||
3,035.11  śunaṃ huvema maghavānamindramasminbhare nṛtamaṃ vājasātau |
3,035.11 śṛṇvantamugramūtaye samatsu ghnantaṃ vṛtrāṇi saṃjitaṃ dhanānām ||

3,036.01  imāmū ṣu prabhṛtiṃ sātaye dhāḥ śaśvacchaśvadūtibhiryādamānaḥ |
3,036.01 sutesute vāvṛdhe vardhanebhiryaḥ karmabhirmahadbhiḥ suśruto bhūt ||
3,036.02  indrāya somāḥ pradivo vidānā ṛbhuryebhirvṛṣaparvā vihāyāḥ |
3,036.02 prayamyamānānprati ṣū gṛbhāyendra piba vṛṣadhūtasya vṛṣṇaḥ ||
3,036.03  pibā vardhasva tava ghā sutāsa indra somāsaḥ prathamā uteme |
3,036.03 yathāpibaḥ pūrvyāṃ indra somāṃ evā pāhi panyo adyā navīyān ||
3,036.04  mahāṃ amatro vṛjane virapśyugraṃ śavaḥ patyate dhṛṣṇvojaḥ |
3,036.04 nāha vivyāca pṛthivī canainaṃ yatsomāso haryaśvamamandan ||
3,036.05  mahāṃ ugro vāvṛdhe vīryāya samācakre vṛṣabhaḥ kāvyena |
3,036.05 indro bhago vājadā asya gāvaḥ pra jāyante dakṣiṇā asya pūrvīḥ ||
3,036.06  pra yatsindhavaḥ prasavaṃ yathāyannāpaḥ samudraṃ rathyeva jagmuḥ |
3,036.06 ataścidindraḥ sadaso varīyānyadīṃ somaḥ pṛṇati dugdho aṃśuḥ ||
3,036.07  samudreṇa sindhavo yādamānā indrāya somaṃ suṣutaṃ bharantaḥ |
3,036.07 aṃśuṃ duhanti hastino bharitrairmadhvaḥ punanti dhārayā pavitraiḥ ||
3,036.08  hradā iva kukṣayaḥ somadhānāḥ samī vivyāca savanā purūṇi |
3,036.08 annā yadindraḥ prathamā vyāśa vṛtraṃ jaghanvāṃ avṛṇīta somam ||
3,036.09  ā tū bhara mākiretatpari ṣṭhādvidmā hi tvā vasupatiṃ vasūnām |
3,036.09 indra yatte māhinaṃ datramastyasmabhyaṃ taddharyaśva pra yandhi ||
3,036.10  asme pra yandhi maghavannṛjīṣinnindra rāyo viśvavārasya bhūreḥ |
3,036.10 asme śataṃ śarado jīvase dhā asme vīrāñchaśvata indra śiprin ||
3,036.11  śunaṃ huvema maghavānamindramasminbhare nṛtamaṃ vājasātau |
3,036.11 śṛṇvantamugramūtaye samatsu ghnantaṃ vṛtrāṇi saṃjitaṃ dhanānām ||

3,037.01  vārtrahatyāya śavase pṛtanāṣāhyāya ca |
3,037.01 indra tvā vartayāmasi ||
3,037.02  arvācīnaṃ su te mana uta cakṣuḥ śatakrato |
3,037.02 indra kṛṇvantu vāghataḥ ||
3,037.03  nāmāni te śatakrato viśvābhirgīrbhirīmahe |
3,037.03 indrābhimātiṣāhye ||
3,037.04  puruṣṭutasya dhāmabhiḥ śatena mahayāmasi |
3,037.04 indrasya carṣaṇīdhṛtaḥ ||
3,037.05  indraṃ vṛtrāya hantave puruhūtamupa bruve |
3,037.05 bhareṣu vājasātaye ||
3,037.06  vājeṣu sāsahirbhava tvāmīmahe śatakrato |
3,037.06 indra vṛtrāya hantave ||
3,037.07  dyumneṣu pṛtanājye pṛtsutūrṣu śravassu ca |
3,037.07 indra sākṣvābhimātiṣu ||
3,037.08  śuṣmintamaṃ na ūtaye dyumninaṃ pāhi jāgṛvim |
3,037.08 indra somaṃ śatakrato ||
3,037.09  indriyāṇi śatakrato yā te janeṣu pañcasu |
3,037.09 indra tāni ta ā vṛṇe ||
3,037.10  agannindra śravo bṛhaddyumnaṃ dadhiṣva duṣṭaram |
3,037.10 utte śuṣmaṃ tirāmasi ||
3,037.11  arvāvato na ā gahyatho śakra parāvataḥ |
3,037.11 u loko yaste adriva indreha tata ā gahi ||

3,038.01  abhi taṣṭeva dīdhayā manīṣāmatyo na vājī sudhuro jihānaḥ |
3,038.01 abhi priyāṇi marmṛśatparāṇi kavīṃricchāmi saṃdṛśe sumedhāḥ ||
3,038.02  inota pṛccha janimā kavīnāṃ manodhṛtaḥ sukṛtastakṣata dyām |
3,038.02 imā u te praṇyo vardhamānā manovātā adha nu dharmaṇi gman ||
3,038.03  ni ṣīmidatra guhyā dadhānā uta kṣatrāya rodasī samañjan |
3,038.03 saṃ mātrābhirmamire yemururvī antarmahī samṛte dhāyase dhuḥ ||
3,038.04  ātiṣṭhantaṃ pari viśve abhūṣañchriyo vasānaścarati svarociḥ |
3,038.04 mahattadvṛṣṇo asurasya nāmā viśvarūpo amṛtāni tasthau ||
3,038.05  asūta pūrvo vṛṣabho jyāyānimā asya śurudhaḥ santi pūrvīḥ |
3,038.05 divo napātā vidathasya dhībhiḥ kṣatraṃ rājānā pradivo dadhāthe ||
3,038.06  trīṇi rājānā vidathe purūṇi pari viśvāni bhūṣathaḥ sadāṃsi |
3,038.06 apaśyamatra manasā jaganvānvrate gandharvāṃ api vāyukeśān ||
3,038.07  tadinnvasya vṛṣabhasya dhenorā nāmabhirmamire sakmyaṃ goḥ |
3,038.07 anyadanyadasuryaṃ vasānā ni māyino mamire rūpamasmin ||
3,038.08  tadinnvasya saviturnakirme hiraṇyayīmamatiṃ yāmaśiśret |
3,038.08 ā suṣṭutī rodasī viśvaminve apīva yoṣā janimāni vavre ||
3,038.09  yuvaṃ pratnasya sādhatho maho yaddaivī svastiḥ pari ṇaḥ syātam |
3,038.09 gopājihvasya tasthuṣo virūpā viśve paśyanti māyinaḥ kṛtāni ||
3,038.10  śunaṃ huvema maghavānamindramasminbhare nṛtamaṃ vājasātau |
3,038.10 śṛṇvantamugramūtaye samatsu ghnantaṃ vṛtrāṇi saṃjitaṃ dhanānām ||

3,039.01  indraṃ matirhṛda ā vacyamānācchā patiṃ stomataṣṭā jigāti |
3,039.01 yā jāgṛvirvidathe śasyamānendra yatte jāyate viddhi tasya ||
3,039.02  divaścidā pūrvyā jāyamānā vi jāgṛvirvidathe śasyamānā |
3,039.02 bhadrā vastrāṇyarjunā vasānā seyamasme sanajā pitryā dhīḥ ||
3,039.03  yamā cidatra yamasūrasūta jihvāyā agraṃ patadā hyasthāt |
3,039.03 vapūṃṣi jātā mithunā sacete tamohanā tapuṣo budhna etā ||
3,039.04  nakireṣāṃ ninditā martyeṣu ye asmākaṃ pitaro goṣu yodhāḥ |
3,039.04 indra eṣāṃ dṛṃhitā māhināvānudgotrāṇi sasṛje daṃsanāvān ||
3,039.05  sakhā ha yatra sakhibhirnavagvairabhijñvā satvabhirgā anugman |
3,039.05 satyaṃ tadindro daśabhirdaśagvaiḥ sūryaṃ viveda tamasi kṣiyantam ||
3,039.06  indro madhu sambhṛtamusriyāyāṃ padvadviveda śaphavanname goḥ |
3,039.06 guhā hitaṃ guhyaṃ gūḻhamapsu haste dadhe dakṣiṇe dakṣiṇāvān ||
3,039.07  jyotirvṛṇīta tamaso vijānannāre syāma duritādabhīke |
3,039.07 imā giraḥ somapāḥ somavṛddha juṣasvendra purutamasya kāroḥ ||
3,039.08  jyotiryajñāya rodasī anu ṣyādāre syāma duritasya bhūreḥ |
3,039.08 bhūri ciddhi tujato martyasya supārāso vasavo barhaṇāvat ||
3,039.09  śunaṃ huvema maghavānamindramasminbhare nṛtamaṃ vājasātau |
3,039.09 śṛṇvantamugramūtaye samatsu ghnantaṃ vṛtrāṇi saṃjitaṃ dhanānām ||

3,040.01  indra tvā vṛṣabhaṃ vayaṃ sute some havāmahe |
3,040.01 sa pāhi madhvo andhasaḥ ||
3,040.02  indra kratuvidaṃ sutaṃ somaṃ harya puruṣṭuta |
3,040.02 pibā vṛṣasva tātṛpim ||
3,040.03  indra pra ṇo dhitāvānaṃ yajñaṃ viśvebhirdevebhiḥ |
3,040.03 tira stavāna viśpate ||
3,040.04  indra somāḥ sutā ime tava pra yanti satpate |
3,040.04 kṣayaṃ candrāsa indavaḥ ||
3,040.05  dadhiṣvā jaṭhare sutaṃ somamindra vareṇyam |
3,040.05 tava dyukṣāsa indavaḥ ||
3,040.06  girvaṇaḥ pāhi naḥ sutaṃ madhordhārābhirajyase |
3,040.06 indra tvādātamidyaśaḥ ||
3,040.07  abhi dyumnāni vanina indraṃ sacante akṣitā |
3,040.07 pītvī somasya vāvṛdhe ||
3,040.08  arvāvato na ā gahi parāvataśca vṛtrahan |
3,040.08 imā juṣasva no giraḥ ||
3,040.09  yadantarā parāvatamarvāvataṃ ca hūyase |
3,040.09 indreha tata ā gahi ||

3,041.01  ā tū na indra madryagghuvānaḥ somapītaye |
3,041.01 haribhyāṃ yāhyadrivaḥ ||
3,041.02  satto hotā na ṛtviyastistire barhirānuṣak |
3,041.02 ayujranprātaradrayaḥ ||
3,041.03  imā brahma brahmavāhaḥ kriyanta ā barhiḥ sīda |
3,041.03 vīhi śūra puroḻāśam ||
3,041.04  rārandhi savaneṣu ṇa eṣu stomeṣu vṛtrahan |
3,041.04 uktheṣvindra girvaṇaḥ ||
3,041.05  matayaḥ somapāmuruṃ rihanti śavasaspatim |
3,041.05 indraṃ vatsaṃ na mātaraḥ ||
3,041.06  sa mandasvā hyandhaso rādhase tanvā mahe |
3,041.06 na stotāraṃ nide karaḥ ||
3,041.07  vayamindra tvāyavo haviṣmanto jarāmahe |
3,041.07 uta tvamasmayurvaso ||
3,041.08  māre asmadvi mumuco haripriyārvāṅyāhi |
3,041.08 indra svadhāvo matsveha ||
3,041.09  arvāñcaṃ tvā sukhe rathe vahatāmindra keśinā |
3,041.09 ghṛtasnū barhirāsade ||

3,042.01  upa naḥ sutamā gahi somamindra gavāśiram |
3,042.01 haribhyāṃ yaste asmayuḥ ||
3,042.02  tamindra madamā gahi barhiṣṭhāṃ grāvabhiḥ sutam |
3,042.02 kuvinnvasya tṛpṇavaḥ ||
3,042.03  indramitthā giro mamācchāguriṣitā itaḥ |
3,042.03 āvṛte somapītaye ||
3,042.04  indraṃ somasya pītaye stomairiha havāmahe |
3,042.04 ukthebhiḥ kuvidāgamat ||
3,042.05  indra somāḥ sutā ime tāndadhiṣva śatakrato |
3,042.05 jaṭhare vājinīvaso ||
3,042.06  vidmā hi tvā dhanañjayaṃ vājeṣu dadhṛṣaṃ kave |
3,042.06 adhā te sumnamīmahe ||
3,042.07  imamindra gavāśiraṃ yavāśiraṃ ca naḥ piba |
3,042.07 āgatyā vṛṣabhiḥ sutam ||
3,042.08  tubhyedindra sva okye somaṃ codāmi pītaye |
3,042.08 eṣa rārantu te hṛdi ||
3,042.09  tvāṃ sutasya pītaye pratnamindra havāmahe |
3,042.09 kuśikāso avasyavaḥ ||

3,043.01  ā yāhyarvāṅupa vandhureṣṭhāstavedanu pradivaḥ somapeyam |
3,043.01 priyā sakhāyā vi mucopa barhistvāmime havyavāho havante ||
3,043.02  ā yāhi pūrvīrati carṣaṇīrāṃ arya āśiṣa upa no haribhyām |
3,043.02 imā hi tvā mataya stomataṣṭā indra havante sakhyaṃ juṣāṇāḥ ||
3,043.03  ā no yajñaṃ namovṛdhaṃ sajoṣā indra deva haribhiryāhi tūyam |
3,043.03 ahaṃ hi tvā matibhirjohavīmi ghṛtaprayāḥ sadhamāde madhūnām ||
3,043.04  ā ca tvāmetā vṛṣaṇā vahāto harī sakhāyā sudhurā svaṅgā |
3,043.04 dhānāvadindraḥ savanaṃ juṣāṇaḥ sakhā sakhyuḥ śṛṇavadvandanāni ||
3,043.05  kuvinmā gopāṃ karase janasya kuvidrājānaṃ maghavannṛjīṣin |
3,043.05 kuvinma ṛṣiṃ papivāṃsaṃ sutasya kuvinme vasvo amṛtasya śikṣāḥ ||
3,043.06  ā tvā bṛhanto harayo yujānā arvāgindra sadhamādo vahantu |
3,043.06 pra ye dvitā diva ṛñjantyātāḥ susammṛṣṭāso vṛṣabhasya mūrāḥ ||
3,043.07  indra piba vṛṣadhūtasya vṛṣṇa ā yaṃ te śyena uśate jabhāra |
3,043.07 yasya made cyāvayasi pra kṛṣṭīryasya made apa gotrā vavartha ||
3,043.08  śunaṃ huvema maghavānamindramasminbhare nṛtamaṃ vājasātau |
3,043.08 śṛṇvantamugramūtaye samatsu ghnantaṃ vṛtrāṇi saṃjitaṃ dhanānām ||

3,044.01  ayaṃ te astu haryataḥ soma ā haribhiḥ sutaḥ |
3,044.01 juṣāṇa indra haribhirna ā gahyā tiṣṭha haritaṃ ratham ||
3,044.02  haryannuṣasamarcayaḥ sūryaṃ haryannarocayaḥ |
3,044.02 vidvāṃścikitvānharyaśva vardhasa indra viśvā abhi śriyaḥ ||
3,044.03  dyāmindro haridhāyasaṃ pṛthivīṃ harivarpasam |
3,044.03 adhārayaddharitorbhūri bhojanaṃ yayorantarhariścarat ||
3,044.04  jajñāno harito vṛṣā viśvamā bhāti rocanam |
3,044.04 haryaśvo haritaṃ dhatta āyudhamā vajraṃ bāhvorharim ||
3,044.05  indro haryantamarjunaṃ vajraṃ śukrairabhīvṛtam |
3,044.05 apāvṛṇoddharibhiradribhiḥ sutamudgā haribhirājata ||

3,045.01  ā mandrairindra haribhiryāhi mayūraromabhiḥ |
3,045.01 mā tvā ke cinni yamanviṃ na pāśino'ti dhanveva tāṃ ihi ||
3,045.02  vṛtrakhādo valaṃrujaḥ purāṃ darmo apāmajaḥ |
3,045.02 sthātā rathasya haryorabhisvara indro dṛḻhā cidārujaḥ ||
3,045.03  gambhīrāṃ udadhīṃriva kratuṃ puṣyasi gā iva |
3,045.03 pra sugopā yavasaṃ dhenavo yathā hradaṃ kulyā ivāśata ||
3,045.04  ā nastujaṃ rayiṃ bharāṃśaṃ na pratijānate |
3,045.04 vṛkṣaṃ pakvaṃ phalamaṅkīva dhūnuhīndra sampāraṇaṃ vasu ||
3,045.05  svayurindra svarāḻ asi smaddiṣṭiḥ svayaśastaraḥ |
3,045.05 sa vāvṛdhāna ojasā puruṣṭuta bhavā naḥ suśravastamaḥ ||

3,046.01  yudhmasya te vṛṣabhasya svarāja ugrasya yūna sthavirasya ghṛṣveḥ |
3,046.01 ajūryato vajriṇo vīryāṇīndra śrutasya mahato mahāni ||
3,046.02  mahāṃ asi mahiṣa vṛṣṇyebhirdhanaspṛdugra sahamāno anyān |
3,046.02 eko viśvasya bhuvanasya rājā sa yodhayā ca kṣayayā ca janān ||
3,046.03  pra mātrābhī ririce rocamānaḥ pra devebhirviśvato apratītaḥ |
3,046.03 pra majmanā diva indraḥ pṛthivyāḥ prorormaho antarikṣādṛjīṣī ||
3,046.04  uruṃ gabhīraṃ januṣābhyugraṃ viśvavyacasamavataṃ matīnām |
3,046.04 indraṃ somāsaḥ pradivi sutāsaḥ samudraṃ na sravata ā viśanti ||
3,046.05  yaṃ somamindra pṛthivīdyāvā garbhaṃ na mātā bibhṛtastvāyā |
3,046.05 taṃ te hinvanti tamu te mṛjantyadhvaryavo vṛṣabha pātavā u ||

3,047.01  marutvāṃ indra vṛṣabho raṇāya pibā somamanuṣvadhaṃ madāya |
3,047.01 ā siñcasva jaṭhare madhva ūrmiṃ tvaṃ rājāsi pradivaḥ sutānām ||
3,047.02  sajoṣā indra sagaṇo marudbhiḥ somaṃ piba vṛtrahā śūra vidvān |
3,047.02 jahi śatrūṃrapa mṛdho nudasvāthābhayaṃ kṛṇuhi viśvato naḥ ||
3,047.03  uta ṛtubhirṛtupāḥ pāhi somamindra devebhiḥ sakhibhiḥ sutaṃ naḥ |
3,047.03 yāṃ ābhajo maruto ye tvānvahanvṛtramadadhustubhyamojaḥ ||
3,047.04  ye tvāhihatye maghavannavardhanye śāmbare harivo ye gaviṣṭau |
3,047.04 ye tvā nūnamanumadanti viprāḥ pibendra somaṃ sagaṇo marudbhiḥ ||
3,047.05  marutvantaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ vāvṛdhānamakavāriṃ divyaṃ śāsamindram |
3,047.05 viśvāsāhamavase nūtanāyograṃ sahodāmiha taṃ huvema ||

3,048.01  sadyo ha jāto vṛṣabhaḥ kanīnaḥ prabhartumāvadandhasaḥ sutasya |
3,048.01 sādhoḥ piba pratikāmaṃ yathā te rasāśiraḥ prathamaṃ somyasya ||
3,048.02  yajjāyathāstadaharasya kāme'ṃśoḥ pīyūṣamapibo giriṣṭhām |
3,048.02 taṃ te mātā pari yoṣā janitrī mahaḥ piturdama āsiñcadagre ||
3,048.03  upasthāya mātaramannamaiṭṭa tigmamapaśyadabhi somamūdhaḥ |
3,048.03 prayāvayannacaradgṛtso anyānmahāni cakre purudhapratīkaḥ ||
3,048.04  ugrasturāṣāḻ abhibhūtyojā yathāvaśaṃ tanvaṃ cakra eṣaḥ |
3,048.04 tvaṣṭāramindro januṣābhibhūyāmuṣyā somamapibaccamūṣu ||
3,048.05  śunaṃ huvema maghavānamindramasminbhare nṛtamaṃ vājasātau |
3,048.05 śṛṇvantamugramūtaye samatsu ghnantaṃ vṛtrāṇi saṃjitaṃ dhanānām ||

3,049.01  śaṃsā mahāmindraṃ yasminviśvā ā kṛṣṭayaḥ somapāḥ kāmamavyan |
3,049.01 yaṃ sukratuṃ dhiṣaṇe vibhvataṣṭaṃ ghanaṃ vṛtrāṇāṃ janayanta devāḥ ||
3,049.02  yaṃ nu nakiḥ pṛtanāsu svarājaṃ dvitā tarati nṛtamaṃ hariṣṭhām |
3,049.02 inatamaḥ satvabhiryo ha śūṣaiḥ pṛthujrayā aminādāyurdasyoḥ ||
3,049.03  sahāvā pṛtsu taraṇirnārvā vyānaśī rodasī mehanāvān |
3,049.03 bhago na kāre havyo matīnāṃ piteva cāruḥ suhavo vayodhāḥ ||
3,049.04  dhartā divo rajasaspṛṣṭa ūrdhvo ratho na vāyurvasubhirniyutvān |
3,049.04 kṣapāṃ vastā janitā sūryasya vibhaktā bhāgaṃ dhiṣaṇeva vājam ||
3,049.05  śunaṃ huvema maghavānamindramasminbhare nṛtamaṃ vājasātau |
3,049.05 śṛṇvantamugramūtaye samatsu ghnantaṃ vṛtrāṇi saṃjitaṃ dhanānām ||

3,050.01  indraḥ svāhā pibatu yasya soma āgatyā tumro vṛṣabho marutvān |
3,050.01 oruvyacāḥ pṛṇatāmebhirannairāsya havistanvaḥ kāmamṛdhyāḥ ||
3,050.02  ā te saparyū javase yunajmi yayoranu pradivaḥ śruṣṭimāvaḥ |
3,050.02 iha tvā dheyurharayaḥ suśipra pibā tvasya suṣutasya cāroḥ ||
3,050.03  gobhirmimikṣuṃ dadhire supāramindraṃ jyaiṣṭhyāya dhāyase gṛṇānāḥ |
3,050.03 mandānaḥ somaṃ papivāṃ ṛjīṣinsamasmabhyaṃ purudhā gā iṣaṇya ||
3,050.04  imaṃ kāmaṃ mandayā gobhiraśvaiścandravatā rādhasā paprathaśca |
3,050.04 svaryavo matibhistubhyaṃ viprā indrāya vāhaḥ kuśikāso akran ||
3,050.05  śunaṃ huvema maghavānamindramasminbhare nṛtamaṃ vājasātau |
3,050.05 śṛṇvantamugramūtaye samatsu ghnantaṃ vṛtrāṇi saṃjitaṃ dhanānām ||

3,051.01  carṣaṇīdhṛtaṃ maghavānamukthyamindraṃ giro bṛhatīrabhyanūṣata |
3,051.01 vāvṛdhānaṃ puruhūtaṃ suvṛktibhiramartyaṃ jaramāṇaṃ divedive ||
3,051.02  śatakratumarṇavaṃ śākinaṃ naraṃ giro ma indramupa yanti viśvataḥ |
3,051.02 vājasaniṃ pūrbhidaṃ tūrṇimapturaṃ dhāmasācamabhiṣācaṃ svarvidam ||
3,051.03  ākare vasorjaritā panasyate'nehasa stubha indro duvasyati |
3,051.03 vivasvataḥ sadana ā hi pipriye satrāsāhamabhimātihanaṃ stuhi ||
3,051.04  nṛṇāmu tvā nṛtamaṃ gīrbhirukthairabhi pra vīramarcatā sabādhaḥ |
3,051.04 saṃ sahase purumāyo jihīte namo asya pradiva eka īśe ||
3,051.05  pūrvīrasya niṣṣidho martyeṣu purū vasūni pṛthivī bibharti |
3,051.05 indrāya dyāva oṣadhīrutāpo rayiṃ rakṣanti jīrayo vanāni ||
3,051.06  tubhyaṃ brahmāṇi gira indra tubhyaṃ satrā dadhire harivo juṣasva |
3,051.06 bodhyāpiravaso nūtanasya sakhe vaso jaritṛbhyo vayo dhāḥ ||
3,051.07  indra marutva iha pāhi somaṃ yathā śāryāte apibaḥ sutasya |
3,051.07 tava praṇītī tava śūra śarmannā vivāsanti kavayaḥ suyajñāḥ ||
3,051.08  sa vāvaśāna iha pāhi somaṃ marudbhirindra sakhibhiḥ sutaṃ naḥ |
3,051.08 jātaṃ yattvā pari devā abhūṣanmahe bharāya puruhūta viśve ||
3,051.09  aptūrye maruta āpireṣo'mandannindramanu dātivārāḥ |
3,051.09 tebhiḥ sākaṃ pibatu vṛtrakhādaḥ sutaṃ somaṃ dāśuṣaḥ sve sadhasthe ||
3,051.10  idaṃ hyanvojasā sutaṃ rādhānāṃ pate |
3,051.10 pibā tvasya girvaṇaḥ ||
3,051.11  yaste anu svadhāmasatsute ni yaccha tanvam |
3,051.11 sa tvā mamattu somyam ||
3,051.12  pra te aśnotu kukṣyoḥ prendra brahmaṇā śiraḥ |
3,051.12 pra bāhū śūra rādhase ||

3,052.01  dhānāvantaṃ karambhiṇamapūpavantamukthinam |
3,052.01 indra prātarjuṣasva naḥ ||
3,052.02  puroḻāśaṃ pacatyaṃ juṣasvendrā gurasva ca |
3,052.02 tubhyaṃ havyāni sisrate ||
3,052.03  puroḻāśaṃ ca no ghaso joṣayāse giraśca naḥ |
3,052.03 vadhūyuriva yoṣaṇām ||
3,052.04  puroḻāśaṃ sanaśruta prātaḥsāve juṣasva naḥ |
3,052.04 indra kraturhi te bṛhan ||
3,052.05  mādhyandinasya savanasya dhānāḥ puroḻāśamindra kṛṣveha cārum |
3,052.05 pra yatstotā jaritā tūrṇyartho vṛṣāyamāṇa upa gīrbhirīṭṭe ||
3,052.06  tṛtīye dhānāḥ savane puruṣṭuta puroḻāśamāhutaṃ māmahasva naḥ |
3,052.06 ṛbhumantaṃ vājavantaṃ tvā kave prayasvanta upa śikṣema dhītibhiḥ ||
3,052.07  pūṣaṇvate te cakṛmā karambhaṃ harivate haryaśvāya dhānāḥ |
3,052.07 apūpamaddhi sagaṇo marudbhiḥ somaṃ piba vṛtrahā śūra vidvān ||
3,052.08  prati dhānā bharata tūyamasmai puroḻāśaṃ vīratamāya nṛṇām |
3,052.08 divedive sadṛśīrindra tubhyaṃ vardhantu tvā somapeyāya dhṛṣṇo ||

3,053.01  indrāparvatā bṛhatā rathena vāmīriṣa ā vahataṃ suvīrāḥ |
3,053.01 vītaṃ havyānyadhvareṣu devā vardhethāṃ gīrbhiriḻayā madantā ||
3,053.02  tiṣṭhā su kaṃ maghavanmā parā gāḥ somasya nu tvā suṣutasya yakṣi |
3,053.02 piturna putraḥ sicamā rabhe ta indra svādiṣṭhayā girā śacīvaḥ ||
3,053.03  śaṃsāvādhvaryo prati me gṛṇīhīndrāya vāhaḥ kṛṇavāva juṣṭam |
3,053.03 edaṃ barhiryajamānasya sīdāthā ca bhūdukthamindrāya śastam ||
3,053.04  jāyedastaṃ maghavansedu yonistadittvā yuktā harayo vahantu |
3,053.04 yadā kadā ca sunavāma somamagniṣṭvā dūto dhanvātyaccha ||
3,053.05  parā yāhi maghavannā ca yāhīndra bhrātarubhayatrā te artham |
3,053.05 yatrā rathasya bṛhato nidhānaṃ vimocanaṃ vājino rāsabhasya ||
3,053.06  apāḥ somamastamindra pra yāhi kalyāṇīrjāyā suraṇaṃ gṛhe te |
3,053.06 yatrā rathasya bṛhato nidhānaṃ vimocanaṃ vājino dakṣiṇāvat ||
3,053.07  ime bhojā aṅgiraso virūpā divasputrāso asurasya vīrāḥ |
3,053.07 viśvāmitrāya dadato maghāni sahasrasāve pra tiranta āyuḥ ||
3,053.08  rūpaṃrūpaṃ maghavā bobhavīti māyāḥ kṛṇvānastanvaṃ pari svām |
3,053.08 triryaddivaḥ pari muhūrtamāgātsvairmantrairanṛtupā ṛtāvā ||
3,053.09  mahāṃ ṛṣirdevajā devajūto'stabhnātsindhumarṇavaṃ nṛcakṣāḥ |
3,053.09 viśvāmitro yadavahatsudāsamapriyāyata kuśikebhirindraḥ ||
3,053.10  haṃsā iva kṛṇutha ślokamadribhirmadanto gīrbhiradhvare sute sacā |
3,053.10 devebhirviprā ṛṣayo nṛcakṣaso vi pibadhvaṃ kuśikāḥ somyaṃ madhu ||
3,053.11  upa preta kuśikāścetayadhvamaśvaṃ rāye pra muñcatā sudāsaḥ |
3,053.11 rājā vṛtraṃ jaṅghanatprāgapāgudagathā yajāte vara ā pṛthivyāḥ ||
3,053.12  ya ime rodasī ubhe ahamindramatuṣṭavam |
3,053.12 viśvāmitrasya rakṣati brahmedaṃ bhārataṃ janam ||
3,053.13  viśvāmitrā arāsata brahmendrāya vajriṇe |
3,053.13 karadinnaḥ surādhasaḥ ||
3,053.14  kiṃ te kṛṇvanti kīkaṭeṣu gāvo nāśiraṃ duhre na tapanti gharmam |
3,053.14 ā no bhara pramagandasya vedo naicāśākhaṃ maghavanrandhayā naḥ ||
3,053.15  sasarparīramatiṃ bādhamānā bṛhanmimāya jamadagnidattā |
3,053.15 ā sūryasya duhitā tatāna śravo deveṣvamṛtamajuryam ||
3,053.16  sasarparīrabharattūyamebhyo'dhi śravaḥ pāñcajanyāsu kṛṣṭiṣu |
3,053.16 sā pakṣyā navyamāyurdadhānā yāṃ me palastijamadagnayo daduḥ ||
3,053.17  sthirau gāvau bhavatāṃ vīḻurakṣo meṣā vi varhi mā yugaṃ vi śāri |
3,053.17 indraḥ pātalye dadatāṃ śarītorariṣṭaneme abhi naḥ sacasva ||
3,053.18  balaṃ dhehi tanūṣu no balamindrānaḻutsu naḥ |
3,053.18 balaṃ tokāya tanayāya jīvase tvaṃ hi baladā asi ||
3,053.19  abhi vyayasva khadirasya sāramojo dhehi spandane śiṃśapāyām |
3,053.19 akṣa vīḻo vīḻita vīḻayasva mā yāmādasmādava jīhipo naḥ ||
3,053.20  ayamasmānvanaspatirmā ca hā mā ca rīriṣat |
3,053.20 svastyā gṛhebhya āvasā ā vimocanāt ||
3,053.21  indrotibhirbahulābhirno adya yācchreṣṭhābhirmaghavañchūra jinva |
3,053.21 yo no dveṣṭyadharaḥ saspadīṣṭa yamu dviṣmastamu prāṇo jahātu ||
3,053.22  paraśuṃ cidvi tapati śimbalaṃ cidvi vṛścati |
3,053.22 ukhā cidindra yeṣantī prayastā phenamasyati ||
3,053.23  na sāyakasya cikite janāso lodhaṃ nayanti paśu manyamānāḥ |
3,053.23 nāvājinaṃ vājinā hāsayanti na gardabhaṃ puro aśvānnayanti ||
3,053.24  ima indra bharatasya putrā apapitvaṃ cikiturna prapitvam |
3,053.24 hinvantyaśvamaraṇaṃ na nityaṃ jyāvājaṃ pari ṇayantyājau ||

3,054.01  imaṃ mahe vidathyāya śūṣaṃ śaśvatkṛtva īḍyāya pra jabhruḥ |
3,054.01 śṛṇotu no damyebhiranīkaiḥ śṛṇotvagnirdivyairajasraḥ ||
3,054.02  mahi mahe dive arcā pṛthivyai kāmo ma icchañcarati prajānan |
3,054.02 yayorha stome vidatheṣu devāḥ saparyavo mādayante sacāyoḥ ||
3,054.03  yuvorṛtaṃ rodasī satyamastu mahe ṣu ṇaḥ suvitāya pra bhūtam |
3,054.03 idaṃ dive namo agne pṛthivyai saparyāmi prayasā yāmi ratnam ||
3,054.04  uto hi vāṃ pūrvyā āvividra ṛtāvarī rodasī satyavācaḥ |
3,054.04 naraścidvāṃ samithe śūrasātau vavandire pṛthivi vevidānāḥ ||
3,054.05  ko addhā veda ka iha pra vocaddevāṃ acchā pathyā kā sameti |
3,054.05 dadṛśra eṣāmavamā sadāṃsi pareṣu yā guhyeṣu vrateṣu ||
3,054.06  kavirnṛcakṣā abhi ṣīmacaṣṭa ṛtasya yonā vighṛte madantī |
3,054.06 nānā cakrāte sadanaṃ yathā veḥ samānena kratunā saṃvidāne ||
3,054.07  samānyā viyute dūreante dhruve pade tasthaturjāgarūke |
3,054.07 uta svasārā yuvatī bhavantī ādu bruvāte mithunāni nāma ||
3,054.08  viśvedete janimā saṃ vivikto maho devānbibhratī na vyathete |
3,054.08 ejaddhruvaṃ patyate viśvamekaṃ caratpatatri viṣuṇaṃ vi jātam ||
3,054.09  sanā purāṇamadhyemyārānmahaḥ piturjaniturjāmi tannaḥ |
3,054.09 devāso yatra panitāra evairurau pathi vyute tasthurantaḥ ||
3,054.10  imaṃ stomaṃ rodasī pra bravīmyṛdūdarāḥ śṛṇavannagnijihvāḥ |
3,054.10 mitraḥ samrājo varuṇo yuvāna ādityāsaḥ kavayaḥ paprathānāḥ ||
3,054.11  hiraṇyapāṇiḥ savitā sujihvastrirā divo vidathe patyamānaḥ |
3,054.11 deveṣu ca savitaḥ ślokamaśrerādasmabhyamā suva sarvatātim ||
3,054.12  sukṛtsupāṇiḥ svavāṃ ṛtāvā devastvaṣṭāvase tāni no dhāt |
3,054.12 pūṣaṇvanta ṛbhavo mādayadhvamūrdhvagrāvāṇo adhvaramataṣṭa ||
3,054.13  vidyudrathā maruta ṛṣṭimanto divo maryā ṛtajātā ayāsaḥ |
3,054.13 sarasvatī śṛṇavanyajñiyāso dhātā rayiṃ sahavīraṃ turāsaḥ ||
3,054.14  viṣṇuṃ stomāsaḥ purudasmamarkā bhagasyeva kāriṇo yāmani gman |
3,054.14 urukramaḥ kakuho yasya pūrvīrna mardhanti yuvatayo janitrīḥ ||
3,054.15  indro viśvairvīryaiḥ patyamāna ubhe ā paprau rodasī mahitvā |
3,054.15 purandaro vṛtrahā dhṛṣṇuṣeṇaḥ saṃgṛbhyā na ā bharā bhūri paśvaḥ ||
3,054.16  nāsatyā me pitarā bandhupṛcchā sajātyamaśvinoścāru nāma |
3,054.16 yuvaṃ hi stho rayidau no rayīṇāṃ dātraṃ rakṣethe akavairadabdhā ||
3,054.17  mahattadvaḥ kavayaścāru nāma yaddha devā bhavatha viśva indre |
3,054.17 sakha ṛbhubhiḥ puruhūta priyebhirimāṃ dhiyaṃ sātaye takṣatā naḥ ||
3,054.18  aryamā ṇo aditiryajñiyāso'dabdhāni varuṇasya vratāni |
3,054.18 yuyota no anapatyāni gantoḥ prajāvānnaḥ paśumāṃ astu gātuḥ ||
3,054.19  devānāṃ dūtaḥ purudha prasūto'nāgānno vocatu sarvatātā |
3,054.19 śṛṇotu naḥ pṛthivī dyaurutāpaḥ sūryo nakṣatrairurvantarikṣam ||
3,054.20  śṛṇvantu no vṛṣaṇaḥ parvatāso dhruvakṣemāsa iḻayā madantaḥ |
3,054.20 ādityairno aditiḥ śṛṇotu yacchantu no marutaḥ śarma bhadram ||
3,054.21  sadā sugaḥ pitumāṃ astu panthā madhvā devā oṣadhīḥ saṃ pipṛkta |
3,054.21 bhago me agne sakhye na mṛdhyā udrāyo aśyāṃ sadanaṃ purukṣoḥ ||
3,054.22  svadasva havyā samiṣo didīhyasmadryaksaṃ mimīhi śravāṃsi |
3,054.22 viśvāṃ agne pṛtsu tāñjeṣi śatrūnahā viśvā sumanā dīdihī naḥ ||

3,055.01  uṣasaḥ pūrvā adha yadvyūṣurmahadvi jajñe akṣaraṃ pade goḥ |
3,055.01 vratā devānāmupa nu prabhūṣanmahaddevānāmasuratvamekam ||
3,055.02  mo ṣū ṇo atra juhuranta devā mā pūrve agne pitaraḥ padajñāḥ |
3,055.02 purāṇyoḥ sadmanoḥ keturantarmahaddevānāmasuratvamekam ||
3,055.03  vi me purutrā patayanti kāmāḥ śamyacchā dīdye pūrvyāṇi |
3,055.03 samiddhe agnāvṛtamidvadema mahaddevānāmasuratvamekam ||
3,055.04  samāno rājā vibhṛtaḥ purutrā śaye śayāsu prayuto vanānu |
3,055.04 anyā vatsaṃ bharati kṣeti mātā mahaddevānāmasuratvamekam ||
3,055.05  ākṣitpūrvāsvaparā anūrutsadyo jātāsu taruṇīṣvantaḥ |
3,055.05 antarvatīḥ suvate apravītā mahaddevānāmasuratvamekam ||
3,055.06  śayuḥ parastādadha nu dvimātābandhanaścarati vatsa ekaḥ |
3,055.06 mitrasya tā varuṇasya vratāni mahaddevānāmasuratvamekam ||
3,055.07  dvimātā hotā vidatheṣu samrāḻ anvagraṃ carati kṣeti budhnaḥ |
3,055.07 pra raṇyāni raṇyavāco bharante mahaddevānāmasuratvamekam ||
3,055.08  śūrasyeva yudhyato antamasya pratīcīnaṃ dadṛśe viśvamāyat |
3,055.08 antarmatiścarati niṣṣidhaṃ gormahaddevānāmasuratvamekam ||
3,055.09  ni veveti palito dūta āsvantarmahāṃścarati rocanena |
3,055.09 vapūṃṣi bibhradabhi no vi caṣṭe mahaddevānāmasuratvamekam ||
3,055.10  viṣṇurgopāḥ paramaṃ pāti pāthaḥ priyā dhāmānyamṛtā dadhānaḥ |
3,055.10 agniṣṭā viśvā bhuvanāni veda mahaddevānāmasuratvamekam ||
3,055.11  nānā cakrāte yamyā vapūṃṣi tayoranyadrocate kṛṣṇamanyat |
3,055.11 śyāvī ca yadaruṣī ca svasārau mahaddevānāmasuratvamekam ||
3,055.12  mātā ca yatra duhitā ca dhenū sabardughe dhāpayete samīcī |
3,055.12 ṛtasya te sadasīḻe antarmahaddevānāmasuratvamekam ||
3,055.13  anyasyā vatsaṃ rihatī mimāya kayā bhuvā ni dadhe dhenurūdhaḥ |
3,055.13 ṛtasya sā payasāpinvateḻā mahaddevānāmasuratvamekam ||
3,055.14  padyā vaste pururūpā vapūṃṣyūrdhvā tasthau tryaviṃ rerihāṇā |
3,055.14 ṛtasya sadma vi carāmi vidvānmahaddevānāmasuratvamekam ||
3,055.15  pade iva nihite dasme antastayoranyadguhyamāviranyat |
3,055.15 sadhrīcīnā pathyā sā viṣūcī mahaddevānāmasuratvamekam ||
3,055.16  ā dhenavo dhunayantāmaśiśvīḥ sabardughāḥ śaśayā apradugdhāḥ |
3,055.16 navyānavyā yuvatayo bhavantīrmahaddevānāmasuratvamekam ||
3,055.17  yadanyāsu vṛṣabho roravīti so anyasminyūthe ni dadhāti retaḥ |
3,055.17 sa hi kṣapāvānsa bhagaḥ sa rājā mahaddevānāmasuratvamekam ||
3,055.18  vīrasya nu svaśvyaṃ janāsaḥ pra nu vocāma vidurasya devāḥ |
3,055.18 ṣoḻhā yuktāḥ pañcapañcā vahanti mahaddevānāmasuratvamekam ||
3,055.19  devastvaṣṭā savitā viśvarūpaḥ pupoṣa prajāḥ purudhā jajāna |
3,055.19 imā ca viśvā bhuvanānyasya mahaddevānāmasuratvamekam ||
3,055.20  mahī samairaccamvā samīcī ubhe te asya vasunā nyṛṣṭe |
3,055.20 śṛṇve vīro vindamāno vasūni mahaddevānāmasuratvamekam ||
3,055.21  imāṃ ca naḥ pṛthivīṃ viśvadhāyā upa kṣeti hitamitro na rājā |
3,055.21 puraḥsadaḥ śarmasado na vīrā mahaddevānāmasuratvamekam ||
3,055.22  niṣṣidhvarīsta oṣadhīrutāpo rayiṃ ta indra pṛthivī bibharti |
3,055.22 sakhāyaste vāmabhājaḥ syāma mahaddevānāmasuratvamekam ||

3,056.01  na tā minanti māyino na dhīrā vratā devānāṃ prathamā dhruvāṇi |
3,056.01 na rodasī adruhā vedyābhirna parvatā niname tasthivāṃsaḥ ||
3,056.02  ṣaḍbhārāṃ eko acaranbibhartyṛtaṃ varṣiṣṭhamupa gāva āguḥ |
3,056.02 tisro mahīruparāstasthuratyā guhā dve nihite darśyekā ||
3,056.03  tripājasyo vṛṣabho viśvarūpa uta tryudhā purudha prajāvān |
3,056.03 tryanīkaḥ patyate māhināvānsa retodhā vṛṣabhaḥ śaśvatīnām ||
3,056.04  abhīka āsāṃ padavīrabodhyādityānāmahve cāru nāma |
3,056.04 āpaścidasmā aramanta devīḥ pṛthagvrajantīḥ pari ṣīmavṛñjan ||
3,056.05  trī ṣadhasthā sindhavastriḥ kavīnāmuta trimātā vidatheṣu samrāṭ |
3,056.05 ṛtāvarīryoṣaṇāstisro apyāstrirā divo vidathe patyamānāḥ ||
3,056.06  trirā divaḥ savitarvāryāṇi divediva ā suva trirno ahnaḥ |
3,056.06 tridhātu rāya ā suvā vasūni bhaga trātardhiṣaṇe sātaye dhāḥ ||
3,056.07  trirā divaḥ savitā soṣavīti rājānā mitrāvaruṇā supāṇī |
3,056.07 āpaścidasya rodasī cidurvī ratnaṃ bhikṣanta savituḥ savāya ||
3,056.08  triruttamā dūṇaśā rocanāni trayo rājantyasurasya vīrāḥ |
3,056.08 ṛtāvāna iṣirā dūḻabhāsastrirā divo vidathe santu devāḥ ||

3,057.01  pra me vivikvāṃ avidanmanīṣāṃ dhenuṃ carantīṃ prayutāmagopām |
3,057.01 sadyaścidyā duduhe bhūri dhāserindrastadagniḥ panitāro asyāḥ ||
3,057.02  indraḥ su pūṣā vṛṣaṇā suhastā divo na prītāḥ śaśayaṃ duduhre |
3,057.02 viśve yadasyāṃ raṇayanta devāḥ pra vo'tra vasavaḥ sumnamaśyām ||
3,057.03  yā jāmayo vṛṣṇa icchanti śaktiṃ namasyantīrjānate garbhamasmin |
3,057.03 acchā putraṃ dhenavo vāvaśānā mahaścaranti bibhrataṃ vapūṃṣi ||
3,057.04  acchā vivakmi rodasī sumeke grāvṇo yujāno adhvare manīṣā |
3,057.04 imā u te manave bhūrivārā ūrdhvā bhavanti darśatā yajatrāḥ ||
3,057.05  yā te jihvā madhumatī sumedhā agne deveṣūcyata urūcī |
3,057.05 tayeha viśvāṃ avase yajatrānā sādaya pāyayā cā madhūni ||
3,057.06  yā te agne parvatasyeva dhārāsaścantī pīpayaddeva citrā |
3,057.06 tāmasmabhyaṃ pramatiṃ jātavedo vaso rāsva sumatiṃ viśvajanyām ||

3,058.01  dhenuḥ pratnasya kāmyaṃ duhānāntaḥ putraścarati dakṣiṇāyāḥ |
3,058.01 ā dyotaniṃ vahati śubhrayāmoṣasa stomo aśvināvajīgaḥ ||
3,058.02  suyugvahanti prati vāmṛtenordhvā bhavanti pitareva medhāḥ |
3,058.02 jarethāmasmadvi paṇermanīṣāṃ yuvoravaścakṛmā yātamarvāk ||
3,058.03  suyugbhiraśvaiḥ suvṛtā rathena dasrāvimaṃ śṛṇutaṃ ślokamadreḥ |
3,058.03 kimaṅga vāṃ pratyavartiṃ gamiṣṭhāhurviprāso aśvinā purājāḥ ||
3,058.04  ā manyethāmā gataṃ kaccidevairviśve janāso aśvinā havante |
3,058.04 imā hi vāṃ goṛjīkā madhūni pra mitrāso na dadurusro agre ||
3,058.05  tiraḥ purū cidaśvinā rajāṃsyāṅgūṣo vāṃ maghavānā janeṣu |
3,058.05 eha yātaṃ pathibhirdevayānairdasrāvime vāṃ nidhayo madhūnām ||
3,058.06  purāṇamokaḥ sakhyaṃ śivaṃ vāṃ yuvornarā draviṇaṃ jahnāvyām |
3,058.06 punaḥ kṛṇvānāḥ sakhyā śivāni madhvā madema saha nū samānāḥ ||
3,058.07  aśvinā vāyunā yuvaṃ sudakṣā niyudbhiṣca sajoṣasā yuvānā |
3,058.07 nāsatyā tiroahnyaṃ juṣāṇā somaṃ pibatamasridhā sudānū ||
3,058.08  aśvinā pari vāmiṣaḥ purūcīrīyurgīrbhiryatamānā amṛdhrāḥ |
3,058.08 ratho ha vāmṛtajā adrijūtaḥ pari dyāvāpṛthivī yāti sadyaḥ ||
3,058.09  aśvinā madhuṣuttamo yuvākuḥ somastaṃ pātamā gataṃ duroṇe |
3,058.09 ratho ha vāṃ bhūri varpaḥ karikratsutāvato niṣkṛtamāgamiṣṭhaḥ ||

3,059.01  mitro janānyātayati bruvāṇo mitro dādhāra pṛthivīmuta dyām |
3,059.01 mitraḥ kṛṣṭīranimiṣābhi caṣṭe mitrāya havyaṃ ghṛtavajjuhota ||
3,059.02  pra sa mitra marto astu prayasvānyasta āditya śikṣati vratena |
3,059.02 na hanyate na jīyate tvoto nainamaṃho aśnotyantito na dūrāt ||
3,059.03  anamīvāsa iḻayā madanto mitajñavo varimannā pṛthivyāḥ |
3,059.03 ādityasya vratamupakṣiyanto vayaṃ mitrasya sumatau syāma ||
3,059.04  ayaṃ mitro namasyaḥ suśevo rājā sukṣatro ajaniṣṭa vedhāḥ |
3,059.04 tasya vayaṃ sumatau yajñiyasyāpi bhadre saumanase syāma ||
3,059.05  mahāṃ ādityo namasopasadyo yātayajjano gṛṇate suśevaḥ |
3,059.05 tasmā etatpanyatamāya juṣṭamagnau mitrāya havirā juhota ||
3,059.06  mitrasya carṣaṇīdhṛto'vo devasya sānasi |
3,059.06 dyumnaṃ citraśravastamam ||
3,059.07  abhi yo mahinā divaṃ mitro babhūva saprathāḥ |
3,059.07 abhi śravobhiḥ pṛthivīm ||
3,059.08  mitrāya pañca yemire janā abhiṣṭiśavase |
3,059.08 sa devānviśvānbibharti ||
3,059.09  mitro deveṣvāyuṣu janāya vṛktabarhiṣe |
3,059.09 iṣa iṣṭavratā akaḥ ||

3,060.01  iheha vo manasā bandhutā nara uśijo jagmurabhi tāni vedasā |
3,060.01 yābhirmāyābhiḥ pratijūtivarpasaḥ saudhanvanā yajñiyaṃ bhāgamānaśa ||
3,060.02  yābhiḥ śacībhiścamasāṃ apiṃśata yayā dhiyā gāmariṇīta carmaṇaḥ |
3,060.02 yena harī manasā niratakṣata tena devatvamṛbhavaḥ samānaśa ||
3,060.03  indrasya sakhyamṛbhavaḥ samānaśurmanornapāto apaso dadhanvire |
3,060.03 saudhanvanāso amṛtatvamerire viṣṭvī śamībhiḥ sukṛtaḥ sukṛtyayā ||
3,060.04  indreṇa yātha sarathaṃ sute sacāṃ atho vaśānāṃ bhavathā saha śriyā |
3,060.04 na vaḥ pratimai sukṛtāni vāghataḥ saudhanvanā ṛbhavo vīryāṇi ca ||
3,060.05  indra ṛbhubhirvājavadbhiḥ samukṣitaṃ sutaṃ somamā vṛṣasvā gabhastyoḥ |
3,060.05 dhiyeṣito maghavandāśuṣo gṛhe saudhanvanebhiḥ saha matsvā nṛbhiḥ ||
3,060.06  indra ṛbhumānvājavānmatsveha no'sminsavane śacyā puruṣṭuta |
3,060.06 imāni tubhyaṃ svasarāṇi yemire vratā devānāṃ manuṣaśca dharmabhiḥ ||
3,060.07  indra ṛbhubhirvājibhirvājayanniha stomaṃ jariturupa yāhi yajñiyam |
3,060.07 śataṃ ketebhiriṣirebhirāyave sahasraṇītho adhvarasya homani ||

3,061.01  uṣo vājena vājini pracetā stomaṃ juṣasva gṛṇato maghoni |
3,061.01 purāṇī devi yuvatiḥ purandhiranu vrataṃ carasi viśvavāre ||
3,061.02  uṣo devyamartyā vi bhāhi candrarathā sūnṛtā īrayantī |
3,061.02 ā tvā vahantu suyamāso aśvā hiraṇyavarṇāṃ pṛthupājaso ye ||
3,061.03  uṣaḥ pratīcī bhuvanāni viśvordhvā tiṣṭhasyamṛtasya ketuḥ |
3,061.03 samānamarthaṃ caraṇīyamānā cakramiva navyasyā vavṛtsva ||
3,061.04  ava syūmeva cinvatī maghonyuṣā yāti svasarasya patnī |
3,061.04 svarjanantī subhagā sudaṃsā āntāddivaḥ papratha ā pṛthivyāḥ ||
3,061.05  acchā vo devīmuṣasaṃ vibhātīṃ pra vo bharadhvaṃ namasā suvṛktim |
3,061.05 ūrdhvaṃ madhudhā divi pājo aśretpra rocanā ruruce raṇvasaṃdṛk ||
3,061.06  ṛtāvarī divo arkairabodhyā revatī rodasī citramasthāt |
3,061.06 āyatīmagna uṣasaṃ vibhātīṃ vāmameṣi draviṇaṃ bhikṣamāṇaḥ ||
3,061.07  ṛtasya budhna uṣasāmiṣaṇyanvṛṣā mahī rodasī ā viveśa |
3,061.07 mahī mitrasya varuṇasya māyā candreva bhānuṃ vi dadhe purutrā ||

3,062.01  imā u vāṃ bhṛmayo manyamānā yuvāvate na tujyā abhūvan |
3,062.01 kva tyadindrāvaruṇā yaśo vāṃ yena smā sinaṃ bharathaḥ sakhibhyaḥ ||
3,062.02  ayamu vāṃ purutamo rayīyañchaśvattamamavase johavīti |
3,062.02 sajoṣāvindrāvaruṇā marudbhirdivā pṛthivyā śṛṇutaṃ havaṃ me ||
3,062.03  asme tadindrāvaruṇā vasu ṣyādasme rayirmarutaḥ sarvavīraḥ |
3,062.03 asmānvarūtrīḥ śaraṇairavantvasmānhotrā bhāratī dakṣiṇābhiḥ ||
3,062.04  bṛhaspate juṣasva no havyāni viśvadevya |
3,062.04 rāsva ratnāni dāśuṣe ||
3,062.05  śucimarkairbṛhaspatimadhvareṣu namasyata |
3,062.05 anāmyoja ā cake ||
3,062.06  vṛṣabhaṃ carṣaṇīnāṃ viśvarūpamadābhyam |
3,062.06 bṛhaspatiṃ vareṇyam ||
3,062.07  iyaṃ te pūṣannāghṛṇe suṣṭutirdeva navyasī |
3,062.07 asmābhistubhyaṃ śasyate ||
3,062.08  tāṃ juṣasva giraṃ mama vājayantīmavā dhiyam |
3,062.08 vadhūyuriva yoṣaṇām ||
3,062.09  yo viśvābhi vipaśyati bhuvanā saṃ ca paśyati |
3,062.09 sa naḥ pūṣāvitā bhuvat ||
3,062.10  tatsaviturvareṇyaṃ bhargo devasya dhīmahi |
3,062.10 dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt ||
3,062.11  devasya saviturvayaṃ vājayantaḥ purandhyā |
3,062.11 bhagasya rātimīmahe ||
3,062.12  devaṃ naraḥ savitāraṃ viprā yajñaiḥ suvṛktibhiḥ |
3,062.12 namasyanti dhiyeṣitāḥ ||
3,062.13  somo jigāti gātuviddevānāmeti niṣkṛtam |
3,062.13 ṛtasya yonimāsadam ||
3,062.14  somo asmabhyaṃ dvipade catuṣpade ca paśave |
3,062.14 anamīvā iṣaskarat ||
3,062.15  asmākamāyurvardhayannabhimātīḥ sahamānaḥ |
3,062.15 somaḥ sadhasthamāsadat ||
3,062.16  ā no mitrāvaruṇā ghṛtairgavyūtimukṣatam |
3,062.16 madhvā rajāṃsi sukratū ||
3,062.17  uruśaṃsā namovṛdhā mahnā dakṣasya rājathaḥ |
3,062.17 drāghiṣṭhābhiḥ śucivratā ||
3,062.18  gṛṇānā jamadagninā yonāvṛtasya sīdatam |
3,062.18 pātaṃ somamṛtāvṛdhā ||









ṛgveda 4




4,001.01  tvāṃ hyagne sadamitsamanyavo devāso devamaratiṃ nyerira iti kratvā nyerire |
4,001.01 amartyaṃ yajata martyeṣvā devamādevaṃ janata pracetasaṃ viśvamādevaṃ janata pracetasam ||
4,001.02  sa bhrātaraṃ varuṇamagna ā vavṛtsva devāṃ acchā sumatī yajñavanasaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ yajñavanasam |
4,001.02 ṛtāvānamādityaṃ carṣaṇīdhṛtaṃ rājānaṃ carṣaṇīdhṛtam ||
4,001.03  sakhe sakhāyamabhyā vavṛtsvāśuṃ na cakraṃ rathyeva raṃhyāsmabhyaṃ dasma raṃhyā |
4,001.03 agne mṛḻīkaṃ varuṇe sacā vido marutsu viśvabhānuṣu |
4,001.03 tokāya tuje śuśucāna śaṃ kṛdhyasmabhyaṃ dasma śaṃ kṛdhi ||
4,001.04  tvaṃ no agne varuṇasya vidvāndevasya heḻo'va yāsisīṣṭhāḥ |
4,001.04 yajiṣṭho vahnitamaḥ śośucāno viśvā dveṣāṃsi pra mumugdhyasmat ||
4,001.05  sa tvaṃ no agne'vamo bhavotī nediṣṭho asyā uṣaso vyuṣṭau |
4,001.05 ava yakṣva no varuṇaṃ rarāṇo vīhi mṛḻīkaṃ suhavo na edhi ||
4,001.06  asya śreṣṭhā subhagasya saṃdṛgdevasya citratamā martyeṣu |
4,001.06 śuci ghṛtaṃ na taptamaghnyāyā spārhā devasya maṃhaneva dhenoḥ ||
4,001.07  trirasya tā paramā santi satyā spārhā devasya janimānyagneḥ |
4,001.07 anante antaḥ parivīta āgācchuciḥ śukro aryo rorucānaḥ ||
4,001.08  sa dūto viśvedabhi vaṣṭi sadmā hotā hiraṇyaratho raṃsujihvaḥ |
4,001.08 rohidaśvo vapuṣyo vibhāvā sadā raṇvaḥ pitumatīva saṃsat ||
4,001.09  sa cetayanmanuṣo yajñabandhuḥ pra taṃ mahyā raśanayā nayanti |
4,001.09 sa kṣetyasya duryāsu sādhandevo martasya sadhanitvamāpa ||
4,001.10  sa tū no agnirnayatu prajānannacchā ratnaṃ devabhaktaṃ yadasya |
4,001.10 dhiyā yadviśve amṛtā akṛṇvandyauṣpitā janitā satyamukṣan ||
4,001.11  sa jāyata prathamaḥ pastyāsu maho budhne rajaso asya yonau |
4,001.11 apādaśīrṣā guhamāno antāyoyuvāno vṛṣabhasya nīḻe ||
4,001.12  pra śardha ārta prathamaṃ vipanyāṃ ṛtasya yonā vṛṣabhasya nīḻe |
4,001.12 spārho yuvā vapuṣyo vibhāvā sapta priyāso'janayanta vṛṣṇe ||
4,001.13  asmākamatra pitaro manuṣyā abhi pra sedurṛtamāśuṣāṇāḥ |
4,001.13 aśmavrajāḥ sudughā vavre antarudusrā ājannuṣaso huvānāḥ ||
4,001.14  te marmṛjata dadṛvāṃso adriṃ tadeṣāmanye abhito vi vocan |
4,001.14 paśvayantrāso abhi kāramarcanvidanta jyotiścakṛpanta dhībhiḥ ||
4,001.15  te gavyatā manasā dṛdhramubdhaṃ gā yemānaṃ pari ṣantamadrim |
4,001.15 dṛḻhaṃ naro vacasā daivyena vrajaṃ gomantamuśijo vi vavruḥ ||
4,001.16  te manvata prathamaṃ nāma dhenostriḥ sapta mātuḥ paramāṇi vindan |
4,001.16 tajjānatīrabhyanūṣata vrā āvirbhuvadaruṇīryaśasā goḥ ||
4,001.17  neśattamo dudhitaṃ rocata dyauruddevyā uṣaso bhānurarta |
4,001.17 ā sūryo bṛhatastiṣṭhadajrāṃ ṛju marteṣu vṛjinā ca paśyan ||
4,001.18  āditpaścā bubudhānā vyakhyannādidratnaṃ dhārayanta dyubhaktam |
4,001.18 viśve viśvāsu duryāsu devā mitra dhiye varuṇa satyamastu ||
4,001.19  acchā voceya śuśucānamagniṃ hotāraṃ viśvabharasaṃ yajiṣṭham |
4,001.19 śucyūdho atṛṇanna gavāmandho na pūtaṃ pariṣiktamaṃśoḥ ||
4,001.20  viśveṣāmaditiryajñiyānāṃ viśveṣāmatithirmānuṣāṇām |
4,001.20 agnirdevānāmava āvṛṇānaḥ sumṛḻīko bhavatu jātavedāḥ ||

4,002.01  yo martyeṣvamṛta ṛtāvā devo deveṣvaratirnidhāyi |
4,002.01 hotā yajiṣṭho mahnā śucadhyai havyairagnirmanuṣa īrayadhyai ||
4,002.02  iha tvaṃ sūno sahaso no adya jāto jātāṃ ubhayāṃ antaragne |
4,002.02 dūta īyase yuyujāna ṛṣva ṛjumuṣkānvṛṣaṇaḥ śukrāṃśca ||
4,002.03  atyā vṛdhasnū rohitā ghṛtasnū ṛtasya manye manasā javiṣṭhā |
4,002.03 antarīyase aruṣā yujāno yuṣmāṃśca devānviśa ā ca martān ||
4,002.04  aryamaṇaṃ varuṇaṃ mitrameṣāmindrāviṣṇū maruto aśvinota |
4,002.04 svaśvo agne surathaḥ surādhā edu vaha suhaviṣe janāya ||
4,002.05  gomāṃ agne'vimāṃ aśvī yajño nṛvatsakhā sadamidapramṛṣyaḥ |
4,002.05 iḻāvāṃ eṣo asura prajāvāndīrgho rayiḥ pṛthubudhnaḥ sabhāvān ||
4,002.06  yasta idhmaṃ jabharatsiṣvidāno mūrdhānaṃ vā tatapate tvāyā |
4,002.06 bhuvastasya svatavāṃḥ pāyuragne viśvasmātsīmaghāyata uruṣya ||
4,002.07  yaste bharādanniyate cidannaṃ niśiṣanmandramatithimudīrat |
4,002.07 ā devayurinadhate duroṇe tasminrayirdhruvo astu dāsvān ||
4,002.08  yastvā doṣā ya uṣasi praśaṃsātpriyaṃ vā tvā kṛṇavate haviṣmān |
4,002.08 aśvo na sve dama ā hemyāvāntamaṃhasaḥ pīparo dāśvāṃsam ||
4,002.09  yastubhyamagne amṛtāya dāśadduvastve kṛṇavate yatasruk |
4,002.09 na sa rāyā śaśamāno vi yoṣannainamaṃhaḥ pari varadaghāyoḥ ||
4,002.10  yasya tvamagne adhvaraṃ jujoṣo devo martasya sudhitaṃ rarāṇaḥ |
4,002.10 prītedasaddhotrā sā yaviṣṭhāsāma yasya vidhato vṛdhāsaḥ ||
4,002.11  cittimacittiṃ cinavadvi vidvānpṛṣṭheva vītā vṛjinā ca martān |
4,002.11 rāye ca naḥ svapatyāya deva ditiṃ ca rāsvāditimuruṣya ||
4,002.12  kaviṃ śaśāsuḥ kavayo'dabdhā nidhārayanto duryāsvāyoḥ |
4,002.12 atastvaṃ dṛśyāṃ agna etānpaḍbhiḥ paśyeradbhutāṃ arya evaiḥ ||
4,002.13  tvamagne vāghate supraṇītiḥ sutasomāya vidhate yaviṣṭha |
4,002.13 ratnaṃ bhara śaśamānāya ghṛṣve pṛthu ścandramavase carṣaṇiprāḥ ||
4,002.14  adhā ha yadvayamagne tvāyā paḍbhirhastebhiścakṛmā tanūbhiḥ |
4,002.14 rathaṃ na kranto apasā bhurijorṛtaṃ yemuḥ sudhya āśuṣāṇāḥ ||
4,002.15  adhā māturuṣasaḥ sapta viprā jāyemahi prathamā vedhaso nṝn |
4,002.15 divasputrā aṅgiraso bhavemādriṃ rujema dhaninaṃ śucantaḥ ||
4,002.16  adhā yathā naḥ pitaraḥ parāsaḥ pratnāso agna ṛtamāśuṣāṇāḥ |
4,002.16 śucīdayandīdhitimukthaśāsaḥ kṣāmā bhindanto aruṇīrapa vran ||
4,002.17  sukarmāṇaḥ suruco devayanto'yo na devā janimā dhamantaḥ |
4,002.17 śucanto agniṃ vavṛdhanta indramūrvaṃ gavyaṃ pariṣadanto agman ||
4,002.18  ā yūtheva kṣumati paśvo akhyaddevānāṃ yajjanimāntyugra |
4,002.18 martānāṃ cidurvaśīrakṛpranvṛdhe cidarya uparasyāyoḥ ||
4,002.19  akarma te svapaso abhūma ṛtamavasrannuṣaso vibhātīḥ |
4,002.19 anūnamagniṃ purudhā suścandraṃ devasya marmṛjataścāru cakṣuḥ ||
4,002.20  etā te agna ucathāni vedho'vocāma kavaye tā juṣasva |
4,002.20 ucchocasva kṛṇuhi vasyaso no maho rāyaḥ puruvāra pra yandhi ||

4,003.01  ā vo rājānamadhvarasya rudraṃ hotāraṃ satyayajaṃ rodasyoḥ |
4,003.01 agniṃ purā tanayitnoracittāddhiraṇyarūpamavase kṛṇudhvam ||
4,003.02  ayaṃ yoniścakṛmā yaṃ vayaṃ te jāyeva patya uśatī suvāsāḥ |
