4,003.02 arvācīnaḥ parivīto ni ṣīdemā u te svapāka pratīcīḥ ||
4,003.03  āśṛṇvate adṛpitāya manma nṛcakṣase sumṛḻīkāya vedhaḥ |
4,003.03 devāya śastimamṛtāya śaṃsa grāveva sotā madhuṣudyamīḻe ||
4,003.04  tvaṃ cinnaḥ śamyā agne asyā ṛtasya bodhyṛtacitsvādhīḥ |
4,003.04 kadā ta ukthā sadhamādyāni kadā bhavanti sakhyā gṛhe te ||
4,003.05  kathā ha tadvaruṇāya tvamagne kathā dive garhase kanna āgaḥ |
4,003.05 kathā mitrāya mīḻhuṣe pṛthivyai bravaḥ kadaryamṇe kadbhagāya ||
4,003.06  kaddhiṣṇyāsu vṛdhasāno agne kadvātāya pratavase śubhaṃye |
4,003.06 parijmane nāsatyāya kṣe bravaḥ kadagne rudrāya nṛghne ||
4,003.07  kathā mahe puṣṭimbharāya pūṣṇe kadrudrāya sumakhāya havirde |
4,003.07 kadviṣṇava urugāyāya reto bravaḥ kadagne śarave bṛhatyai ||
4,003.08  kathā śardhāya marutāmṛtāya kathā sūre bṛhate pṛcchyamānaḥ |
4,003.08 prati bravo'ditaye turāya sādhā divo jātavedaścikitvān ||
4,003.09  ṛtena ṛtaṃ niyatamīḻa ā gorāmā sacā madhumatpakvamagne |
4,003.09 kṛṣṇā satī ruśatā dhāsinaiṣā jāmaryeṇa payasā pīpāya ||
4,003.10  ṛtena hi ṣmā vṛṣabhaścidaktaḥ pumāṃ agniḥ payasā pṛṣṭhyena |
4,003.10 aspandamāno acaradvayodhā vṛṣā śukraṃ duduhe pṛśnirūdhaḥ ||
4,003.11  ṛtenādriṃ vyasanbhidantaḥ samaṅgiraso navanta gobhiḥ |
4,003.11 śunaṃ naraḥ pari ṣadannuṣāsamāviḥ svarabhavajjāte agnau ||
4,003.12  ṛtena devīramṛtā amṛktā arṇobhirāpo madhumadbhiragne |
4,003.12 vājī na sargeṣu prastubhānaḥ pra sadamitsravitave dadhanyuḥ ||
4,003.13  mā kasya yakṣaṃ sadamiddhuro gā mā veśasya praminato māpeḥ |
4,003.13 mā bhrāturagne anṛjorṛṇaṃ vermā sakhyurdakṣaṃ riporbhujema ||
4,003.14  rakṣā ṇo agne tava rakṣaṇebhī rārakṣāṇaḥ sumakha prīṇānaḥ |
4,003.14 prati ṣphura vi ruja vīḍvaṃho jahi rakṣo mahi cidvāvṛdhānam ||
4,003.15  ebhirbhava sumanā agne arkairimānspṛśa manmabhiḥ śūra vājān |
4,003.15 uta brahmāṇyaṅgiro juṣasva saṃ te śastirdevavātā jareta ||
4,003.16  etā viśvā viduṣe tubhyaṃ vedho nīthānyagne niṇyā vacāṃsi |
4,003.16 nivacanā kavaye kāvyānyaśaṃsiṣaṃ matibhirvipra ukthaiḥ ||

4,004.01  kṛṇuṣva pājaḥ prasitiṃ na pṛthvīṃ yāhi rājevāmavāṃ ibhena |
4,004.01 tṛṣvīmanu prasitiṃ drūṇāno'stāsi vidhya rakṣasastapiṣṭhaiḥ ||
4,004.02  tava bhramāsa āśuyā patantyanu spṛśa dhṛṣatā śośucānaḥ |
4,004.02 tapūṃṣyagne juhvā pataṅgānasaṃdito vi sṛja viṣvagulkāḥ ||
4,004.03  prati spaśo vi sṛja tūrṇitamo bhavā pāyurviśo asyā adabdhaḥ |
4,004.03 yo no dūre aghaśaṃso yo antyagne mākiṣṭe vyathirā dadharṣīt ||
4,004.04  udagne tiṣṭha pratyā tanuṣva nyamitrāṃ oṣatāttigmahete |
4,004.04 yo no arātiṃ samidhāna cakre nīcā taṃ dhakṣyatasaṃ na śuṣkam ||
4,004.05  ūrdhvo bhava prati vidhyādhyasmadāviṣkṛṇuṣva daivyānyagne |
4,004.05 ava sthirā tanuhi yātujūnāṃ jāmimajāmiṃ pra mṛṇīhi śatrūn ||
4,004.06  sa te jānāti sumatiṃ yaviṣṭha ya īvate brahmaṇe gātumairat |
4,004.06 viśvānyasmai sudināni rāyo dyumnānyaryo vi duro abhi dyaut ||
4,004.07  sedagne astu subhagaḥ sudānuryastvā nityena haviṣā ya ukthaiḥ |
4,004.07 piprīṣati sva āyuṣi duroṇe viśvedasmai sudinā sāsadiṣṭiḥ ||
4,004.08  arcāmi te sumatiṃ ghoṣyarvāksaṃ te vāvātā jaratāmiyaṃ gīḥ |
4,004.08 svaśvāstvā surathā marjayemāsme kṣatrāṇi dhārayeranu dyūn ||
4,004.09  iha tvā bhūryā caredupa tmandoṣāvastardīdivāṃsamanu dyūn |
4,004.09 krīḻantastvā sumanasaḥ sapemābhi dyumnā tasthivāṃso janānām ||
4,004.10  yastvā svaśvaḥ suhiraṇyo agna upayāti vasumatā rathena |
4,004.10 tasya trātā bhavasi tasya sakhā yasta ātithyamānuṣagjujoṣat ||
4,004.11  maho rujāmi bandhutā vacobhistanmā piturgotamādanviyāya |
4,004.11 tvaṃ no asya vacasaścikiddhi hotaryaviṣṭha sukrato damūnāḥ ||
4,004.12  asvapnajastaraṇayaḥ suśevā atandrāso'vṛkā aśramiṣṭhāḥ |
4,004.12 te pāyavaḥ sadhryañco niṣadyāgne tava naḥ pāntvamūra ||
4,004.13  ye pāyavo māmateyaṃ te agne paśyanto andhaṃ duritādarakṣan |
4,004.13 rarakṣa tānsukṛto viśvavedā dipsanta idripavo nāha debhuḥ ||
4,004.14  tvayā vayaṃ sadhanyastvotāstava praṇītyaśyāma vājān |
4,004.14 ubhā śaṃsā sūdaya satyatāte'nuṣṭhuyā kṛṇuhyahrayāṇa ||
4,004.15  ayā te agne samidhā vidhema prati stomaṃ śasyamānaṃ gṛbhāya |
4,004.15 dahāśaso rakṣasaḥ pāhyasmāndruho nido mitramaho avadyāt ||

4,005.01  vaiśvānarāya mīḻhuṣe sajoṣāḥ kathā dāśemāgnaye bṛhadbhāḥ |
4,005.01 anūnena bṛhatā vakṣathenopa stabhāyadupaminna rodhaḥ ||
4,005.02  mā nindata ya imāṃ mahyaṃ rātiṃ devo dadau martyāya svadhāvān |
4,005.02 pākāya gṛtso amṛto vicetā vaiśvānaro nṛtamo yahvo agniḥ ||
4,005.03  sāma dvibarhā mahi tigmabhṛṣṭiḥ sahasraretā vṛṣabhastuviṣmān |
4,005.03 padaṃ na gorapagūḻhaṃ vividvānagnirmahyaṃ predu vocanmanīṣām ||
4,005.04  pra tāṃ agnirbabhasattigmajambhastapiṣṭhena śociṣā yaḥ surādhāḥ |
4,005.04 pra ye minanti varuṇasya dhāma priyā mitrasya cetato dhruvāṇi ||
4,005.05  abhrātaro na yoṣaṇo vyantaḥ patiripo na janayo durevāḥ |
4,005.05 pāpāsaḥ santo anṛtā asatyā idaṃ padamajanatā gabhīram ||
4,005.06  idaṃ me agne kiyate pāvakāminate guruṃ bhāraṃ na manma |
4,005.06 bṛhaddadhātha dhṛṣatā gabhīraṃ yahvaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ prayasā saptadhātu ||
4,005.07  taminnveva samanā samānamabhi kratvā punatī dhītiraśyāḥ |
4,005.07 sasasya carmannadhi cāru pṛśneragre rupa ārupitaṃ jabāru ||
4,005.08  pravācyaṃ vacasaḥ kiṃ me asya guhā hitamupa niṇigvadanti |
4,005.08 yadusriyāṇāmapa vāriva vranpāti priyaṃ rupo agraṃ padaṃ veḥ ||
4,005.09  idamu tyanmahi mahāmanīkaṃ yadusriyā sacata pūrvyaṃ gauḥ |
4,005.09 ṛtasya pade adhi dīdyānaṃ guhā raghuṣyadraghuyadviveda ||
4,005.10  adha dyutānaḥ pitroḥ sacāsāmanuta guhyaṃ cāru pṛśneḥ |
4,005.10 mātuṣpade parame anti ṣadgorvṛṣṇaḥ śociṣaḥ prayatasya jihvā ||
4,005.11  ṛtaṃ voce namasā pṛcchyamānastavāśasā jātavedo yadīdam |
4,005.11 tvamasya kṣayasi yaddha viśvaṃ divi yadu draviṇaṃ yatpṛthivyām ||
4,005.12  kiṃ no asya draviṇaṃ kaddha ratnaṃ vi no voco jātavedaścikitvān |
4,005.12 guhādhvanaḥ paramaṃ yanno asya reku padaṃ na nidānā aganma ||
4,005.13  kā maryādā vayunā kaddha vāmamacchā gamema raghavo na vājam |
4,005.13 kadā no devīramṛtasya patnīḥ sūro varṇena tatanannuṣāsaḥ ||
4,005.14  anireṇa vacasā phalgvena pratītyena kṛdhunātṛpāsaḥ |
4,005.14 adhā te agne kimihā vadantyanāyudhāsa āsatā sacantām ||
4,005.15  asya śriye samidhānasya vṛṣṇo vasoranīkaṃ dama ā ruroca |
4,005.15 ruśadvasānaḥ sudṛśīkarūpaḥ kṣitirna rāyā puruvāro adyaut ||

4,006.01  ūrdhva ū ṣu ṇo adhvarasya hotaragne tiṣṭha devatātā yajīyān |
4,006.01 tvaṃ hi viśvamabhyasi manma pra vedhasaścittirasi manīṣām ||
4,006.02  amūro hotā nyasādi vikṣvagnirmandro vidatheṣu pracetāḥ |
4,006.02 ūrdhvaṃ bhānuṃ savitevāśrenmeteva dhūmaṃ stabhāyadupa dyām ||
4,006.03  yatā sujūrṇī rātinī ghṛtācī pradakṣiṇiddevatātimurāṇaḥ |
4,006.03 udu svarurnavajā nākraḥ paśvo anakti sudhitaḥ sumekaḥ ||
4,006.04  stīrṇe barhiṣi samidhāne agnā ūrdhvo adhvaryurjujuṣāṇo asthāt |
4,006.04 paryagniḥ paśupā na hotā triviṣṭyeti pradiva urāṇaḥ ||
4,006.05  pari tmanā mitadrureti hotāgnirmandro madhuvacā ṛtāvā |
4,006.05 dravantyasya vājino na śokā bhayante viśvā bhuvanā yadabhrāṭ ||
4,006.06  bhadrā te agne svanīka saṃdṛgghorasya sato viṣuṇasya cāruḥ |
4,006.06 na yatte śocistamasā varanta na dhvasmānastanvī repa ā dhuḥ ||
4,006.07  na yasya sāturjanitoravāri na mātarāpitarā nū cidiṣṭau |
4,006.07 adhā mitro na sudhitaḥ pāvako'gnirdīdāya mānuṣīṣu vikṣu ||
4,006.08  dviryaṃ pañca jījanansaṃvasānāḥ svasāro agniṃ mānuṣīṣu vikṣu |
4,006.08 uṣarbudhamatharyo na dantaṃ śukraṃ svāsaṃ paraśuṃ na tigmam ||
4,006.09  tava tye agne harito ghṛtasnā rohitāsa ṛjvañcaḥ svañcaḥ |
4,006.09 aruṣāso vṛṣaṇa ṛjumuṣkā ā devatātimahvanta dasmāḥ ||
4,006.10  ye ha tye te sahamānā ayāsastveṣāso agne arcayaścaranti |
4,006.10 śyenāso na duvasanāso arthaṃ tuviṣvaṇaso mārutaṃ na śardhaḥ ||
4,006.11  akāri brahma samidhāna tubhyaṃ śaṃsātyukthaṃ yajate vyū dhāḥ |
4,006.11 hotāramagniṃ manuṣo ni ṣedurnamasyanta uśijaḥ śaṃsamāyoḥ ||

4,007.01  ayamiha prathamo dhāyi dhātṛbhirhotā yajiṣṭho adhvareṣvīḍyaḥ |
4,007.01 yamapnavāno bhṛgavo virurucurvaneṣu citraṃ vibhvaṃ viśeviśe ||
4,007.02  agne kadā ta ānuṣagbhuvaddevasya cetanam |
4,007.02 adhā hi tvā jagṛbhrire martāso vikṣvīḍyam ||
4,007.03  ṛtāvānaṃ vicetasaṃ paśyanto dyāmiva stṛbhiḥ |
4,007.03 viśveṣāmadhvarāṇāṃ haskartāraṃ damedame ||
4,007.04  āśuṃ dūtaṃ vivasvato viśvā yaścarṣaṇīrabhi |
4,007.04 ā jabhruḥ ketumāyavo bhṛgavāṇaṃ viśeviśe ||
4,007.05  tamīṃ hotāramānuṣakcikitvāṃsaṃ ni ṣedire |
4,007.05 raṇvaṃ pāvakaśociṣaṃ yajiṣṭhaṃ sapta dhāmabhiḥ ||
4,007.06  taṃ śaśvatīṣu mātṛṣu vana ā vītamaśritam |
4,007.06 citraṃ santaṃ guhā hitaṃ suvedaṃ kūcidarthinam ||
4,007.07  sasasya yadviyutā sasminnūdhannṛtasya dhāmanraṇayanta devāḥ |
4,007.07 mahāṃ agnirnamasā rātahavyo veradhvarāya sadamidṛtāvā ||
4,007.08  veradhvarasya dūtyāni vidvānubhe antā rodasī saṃcikitvān |
4,007.08 dūta īyase pradiva urāṇo viduṣṭaro diva ārodhanāni ||
4,007.09  kṛṣṇaṃ ta ema ruśataḥ puro bhāścariṣṇvarcirvapuṣāmidekam |
4,007.09 yadapravītā dadhate ha garbhaṃ sadyaścijjāto bhavasīdu dūtaḥ ||
4,007.10  sadyo jātasya dadṛśānamojo yadasya vāto anuvāti śociḥ |
4,007.10 vṛṇakti tigmāmataseṣu jihvāṃ sthirā cidannā dayate vi jambhaiḥ ||
4,007.11  tṛṣu yadannā tṛṣuṇā vavakṣa tṛṣuṃ dūtaṃ kṛṇute yahvo agniḥ |
4,007.11 vātasya meḻiṃ sacate nijūrvannāśuṃ na vājayate hinve arvā ||

4,008.01  dūtaṃ vo viśvavedasaṃ havyavāhamamartyam |
4,008.01 yajiṣṭhamṛñjase girā ||
4,008.02  sa hi vedā vasudhitiṃ mahāṃ ārodhanaṃ divaḥ |
4,008.02 sa devāṃ eha vakṣati ||
4,008.03  sa veda deva ānamaṃ devāṃ ṛtāyate dame |
4,008.03 dāti priyāṇi cidvasu ||
4,008.04  sa hotā sedu dūtyaṃ cikitvāṃ antarīyate |
4,008.04 vidvāṃ ārodhanaṃ divaḥ ||
4,008.05  te syāma ye agnaye dadāśurhavyadātibhiḥ |
4,008.05 ya īṃ puṣyanta indhate ||
4,008.06  te rāyā te suvīryaiḥ sasavāṃso vi śṛṇvire |
4,008.06 ye agnā dadhire duvaḥ ||
4,008.07  asme rāyo divedive saṃ carantu puruspṛhaḥ |
4,008.07 asme vājāsa īratām ||
4,008.08  sa vipraścarṣaṇīnāṃ śavasā mānuṣāṇām |
4,008.08 ati kṣipreva vidhyati ||

4,009.01  agne mṛḻa mahāṃ asi ya īmā devayuṃ janam |
4,009.01 iyetha barhirāsadam ||
4,009.02  sa mānuṣīṣu dūḻabho vikṣu prāvīramartyaḥ |
4,009.02 dūto viśveṣāṃ bhuvat ||
4,009.03  sa sadma pari ṇīyate hotā mandro diviṣṭiṣu |
4,009.03 uta potā ni ṣīdati ||
4,009.04  uta gnā agniradhvara uto gṛhapatirdame |
4,009.04 uta brahmā ni ṣīdati ||
4,009.05  veṣi hyadhvarīyatāmupavaktā janānām |
4,009.05 havyā ca mānuṣāṇām ||
4,009.06  veṣīdvasya dūtyaṃ yasya jujoṣo adhvaram |
4,009.06 havyaṃ martasya voḻhave ||
4,009.07  asmākaṃ joṣyadhvaramasmākaṃ yajñamaṅgiraḥ |
4,009.07 asmākaṃ śṛṇudhī havam ||
4,009.08  pari te dūḻabho ratho'smāṃ aśnotu viśvataḥ |
4,009.08 yena rakṣasi dāśuṣaḥ ||

4,010.01  agne tamadyāśvaṃ na stomaiḥ kratuṃ na bhadraṃ hṛdispṛśam |
4,010.01 ṛdhyāmā ta ohaiḥ ||
4,010.02  adhā hyagne kratorbhadrasya dakṣasya sādhoḥ |
4,010.02 rathīrṛtasya bṛhato babhūtha ||
4,010.03  ebhirno arkairbhavā no arvāṅsvarṇa jyotiḥ |
4,010.03 agne viśvebhiḥ sumanā anīkaiḥ ||
4,010.04  ābhiṣṭe adya gīrbhirgṛṇanto'gne dāśema |
4,010.04 pra te divo na stanayanti śuṣmāḥ ||
4,010.05  tava svādiṣṭhāgne saṃdṛṣṭiridā cidahna idā cidaktoḥ |
4,010.05 śriye rukmo na rocata upāke ||
4,010.06  ghṛtaṃ na pūtaṃ tanūrarepāḥ śuci hiraṇyam |
4,010.06 tatte rukmo na rocata svadhāvaḥ ||
4,010.07  kṛtaṃ ciddhi ṣmā sanemi dveṣo'gna inoṣi martāt |
4,010.07 itthā yajamānādṛtāvaḥ ||
4,010.08  śivā naḥ sakhyā santu bhrātrāgne deveṣu yuṣme |
4,010.08 sā no nābhiḥ sadane sasminnūdhan ||

4,011.01  bhadraṃ te agne sahasinnanīkamupāka ā rocate sūryasya |
4,011.01 ruśaddṛśe dadṛśe naktayā cidarūkṣitaṃ dṛśa ā rūpe annam ||
4,011.02  vi ṣāhyagne gṛṇate manīṣāṃ khaṃ vepasā tuvijāta stavānaḥ |
4,011.02 viśvebhiryadvāvanaḥ śukra devaistanno rāsva sumaho bhūri manma ||
4,011.03  tvadagne kāvyā tvanmanīṣāstvadukthā jāyante rādhyāni |
4,011.03 tvadeti draviṇaṃ vīrapeśā itthādhiye dāśuṣe martyāya ||
4,011.04  tvadvājī vājambharo vihāyā abhiṣṭikṛjjāyate satyaśuṣmaḥ |
4,011.04 tvadrayirdevajūto mayobhustvadāśurjūjuvāṃ agne arvā ||
4,011.05  tvāmagne prathamaṃ devayanto devaṃ martā amṛta mandrajihvam |
4,011.05 dveṣoyutamā vivāsanti dhībhirdamūnasaṃ gṛhapatimamūram ||
4,011.06  āre asmadamatimāre aṃha āre viśvāṃ durmatiṃ yannipāsi |
4,011.06 doṣā śivaḥ sahasaḥ sūno agne yaṃ deva ā citsacase svasti ||

4,012.01  yastvāmagna inadhate yatasruktriste annaṃ kṛṇavatsasminnahan |
4,012.01 sa su dyumnairabhyastu prasakṣattava kratvā jātavedaścikitvān ||
4,012.02  idhmaṃ yaste jabharacchaśramāṇo maho agne anīkamā saparyan |
4,012.02 sa idhānaḥ prati doṣāmuṣāsaṃ puṣyanrayiṃ sacate ghnannamitrān ||
4,012.03  agnirīśe bṛhataḥ kṣatriyasyāgnirvājasya paramasya rāyaḥ |
4,012.03 dadhāti ratnaṃ vidhate yaviṣṭho vyānuṣaṅmartyāya svadhāvān ||
4,012.04  yacciddhi te puruṣatrā yaviṣṭhācittibhiścakṛmā kaccidāgaḥ |
4,012.04 kṛdhī ṣvasmāṃ aditeranāgānvyenāṃsi śiśratho viṣvagagne ||
4,012.05  mahaścidagna enaso abhīka ūrvāddevānāmuta martyānām |
4,012.05 mā te sakhāyaḥ sadamidriṣāma yacchā tokāya tanayāya śaṃ yoḥ ||
4,012.06  yathā ha tyadvasavo gauryaṃ citpadi ṣitāmamuñcatā yajatrāḥ |
4,012.06 evo ṣvasmanmuñcatā vyaṃhaḥ pra tāryagne prataraṃ na āyuḥ ||

4,013.01  pratyagniruṣasāmagramakhyadvibhātīnāṃ sumanā ratnadheyam |
4,013.01 yātamaśvinā sukṛto duroṇamutsūryo jyotiṣā deva eti ||
4,013.02  ūrdhvaṃ bhānuṃ savitā devo aśreddrapsaṃ davidhvadgaviṣo na satvā |
4,013.02 anu vrataṃ varuṇo yanti mitro yatsūryaṃ divyārohayanti ||
4,013.03  yaṃ sīmakṛṇvantamase vipṛce dhruvakṣemā anavasyanto artham |
4,013.03 taṃ sūryaṃ haritaḥ sapta yahvī spaśaṃ viśvasya jagato vahanti ||
4,013.04  vahiṣṭhebhirviharanyāsi tantumavavyayannasitaṃ deva vasma |
4,013.04 davidhvato raśmayaḥ sūryasya carmevāvādhustamo apsvantaḥ ||
4,013.05  anāyato anibaddhaḥ kathāyaṃ nyaṅṅuttāno'va padyate na |
4,013.05 kayā yāti svadhayā ko dadarśa diva skambhaḥ samṛtaḥ pāti nākam ||

4,014.01  pratyagniruṣaso jātavedā akhyaddevo rocamānā mahobhiḥ |
4,014.01 ā nāsatyorugāyā rathenemaṃ yajñamupa no yātamaccha ||
4,014.02  ūrdhvaṃ ketuṃ savitā devo aśrejjyotirviśvasmai bhuvanāya kṛṇvan |
4,014.02 āprā dyāvāpṛthivī antarikṣaṃ vi sūryo raśmibhiścekitānaḥ ||
4,014.03  āvahantyaruṇīrjyotiṣāgānmahī citrā raśmibhiścekitānā |
4,014.03 prabodhayantī suvitāya devyuṣā īyate suyujā rathena ||
4,014.04  ā vāṃ vahiṣṭhā iha te vahantu rathā aśvāsa uṣaso vyuṣṭau |
4,014.04 ime hi vāṃ madhupeyāya somā asminyajñe vṛṣaṇā mādayethām ||
4,014.05  anāyato anibaddhaḥ kathāyaṃ nyaṅṅuttāno'va padyate na |
4,014.05 kayā yāti svadhayā ko dadarśa diva skambhaḥ samṛtaḥ pāti nākam ||

4,015.01  agnirhotā no adhvare vājī sanpari ṇīyate |
4,015.01 devo deveṣu yajñiyaḥ ||
4,015.02  pari triviṣṭyadhvaraṃ yātyagnī rathīriva |
4,015.02 ā deveṣu prayo dadhat ||
4,015.03  pari vājapatiḥ kaviragnirhavyānyakramīt |
4,015.03 dadhadratnāni dāśuṣe ||
4,015.04  ayaṃ yaḥ sṛñjaye puro daivavāte samidhyate |
4,015.04 dyumāṃ amitradambhanaḥ ||
4,015.05  asya ghā vīra īvato'gnerīśīta martyaḥ |
4,015.05 tigmajambhasya mīḻhuṣaḥ ||
4,015.06  tamarvantaṃ na sānasimaruṣaṃ na divaḥ śiśum |
4,015.06 marmṛjyante divedive ||
4,015.07  bodhadyanmā haribhyāṃ kumāraḥ sāhadevyaḥ |
4,015.07 acchā na hūta udaram ||
4,015.08  uta tyā yajatā harī kumārātsāhadevyāt |
4,015.08 prayatā sadya ā dade ||
4,015.09  eṣa vāṃ devāvaśvinā kumāraḥ sāhadevyaḥ |
4,015.09 dīrghāyurastu somakaḥ ||
4,015.10  taṃ yuvaṃ devāvaśvinā kumāraṃ sāhadevyam |
4,015.10 dīrghāyuṣaṃ kṛṇotana ||

4,016.01  ā satyo yātu maghavāṃ ṛjīṣī dravantvasya haraya upa naḥ |
4,016.01 tasmā idandhaḥ suṣumā sudakṣamihābhipitvaṃ karate gṛṇānaḥ ||
4,016.02  ava sya śūrādhvano nānte'sminno adya savane mandadhyai |
4,016.02 śaṃsātyukthamuśaneva vedhāścikituṣe asuryāya manma ||
4,016.03  kavirna niṇyaṃ vidathāni sādhanvṛṣā yatsekaṃ vipipāno arcāt |
4,016.03 diva itthā jījanatsapta kārūnahnā ciccakrurvayunā gṛṇantaḥ ||
4,016.04  svaryadvedi sudṛśīkamarkairmahi jyotī rurucuryaddha vastoḥ |
4,016.04 andhā tamāṃsi dudhitā vicakṣe nṛbhyaścakāra nṛtamo abhiṣṭau ||
4,016.05  vavakṣa indro amitamṛjīṣyubhe ā paprau rodasī mahitvā |
4,016.05 ataścidasya mahimā vi recyabhi yo viśvā bhuvanā babhūva ||
4,016.06  viśvāni śakro naryāṇi vidvānapo rireca sakhibhirnikāmaiḥ |
4,016.06 aśmānaṃ cidye bibhidurvacobhirvrajaṃ gomantamuśijo vi vavruḥ ||
4,016.07  apo vṛtraṃ vavrivāṃsaṃ parāhanprāvatte vajraṃ pṛthivī sacetāḥ |
4,016.07 prārṇāṃsi samudriyāṇyainoḥ patirbhavañchavasā śūra dhṛṣṇo ||
4,016.08  apo yadadriṃ puruhūta dardarāvirbhuvatsaramā pūrvyaṃ te |
4,016.08 sa no netā vājamā darṣi bhūriṃ gotrā rujannaṅgirobhirgṛṇānaḥ ||
4,016.09  acchā kaviṃ nṛmaṇo gā abhiṣṭau svarṣātā maghavannādhamānam |
4,016.09 ūtibhistamiṣaṇo dyumnahūtau ni māyāvānabrahmā dasyurarta ||
4,016.10  ā dasyughnā manasā yāhyastaṃ bhuvatte kutsaḥ sakhye nikāmaḥ |
4,016.10 sve yonau ni ṣadataṃ sarūpā vi vāṃ cikitsadṛtaciddha nārī ||
4,016.11  yāsi kutsena sarathamavasyustodo vātasya haryorīśānaḥ |
4,016.11 ṛjrā vājaṃ na gadhyaṃ yuyūṣankaviryadahanpāryāya bhūṣāt ||
4,016.12  kutsāya śuṣṇamaśuṣaṃ ni barhīḥ prapitve ahnaḥ kuyavaṃ sahasrā |
4,016.12 sadyo dasyūnpra mṛṇa kutsyena pra sūraścakraṃ vṛhatādabhīke ||
4,016.13  tvaṃ pipruṃ mṛgayaṃ śūśuvāṃsamṛjiśvane vaidathināya randhīḥ |
4,016.13 pañcāśatkṛṣṇā ni vapaḥ sahasrātkaṃ na puro jarimā vi dardaḥ ||
4,016.14  sūra upāke tanvaṃ dadhāno vi yatte cetyamṛtasya varpaḥ |
4,016.14 mṛgo na hastī taviṣīmuṣāṇaḥ siṃho na bhīma āyudhāni bibhrat ||
4,016.15  indraṃ kāmā vasūyanto agmansvarmīḻhe na savane cakānāḥ |
4,016.15 śravasyavaḥ śaśamānāsa ukthairoko na raṇvā sudṛśīva puṣṭiḥ ||
4,016.16  tamidva indraṃ suhavaṃ huvema yastā cakāra naryā purūṇi |
4,016.16 yo māvate jaritre gadhyaṃ cinmakṣū vājaṃ bharati spārharādhāḥ ||
4,016.17  tigmā yadantaraśaniḥ patāti kasmiñcicchūra muhuke janānām |
4,016.17 ghorā yadarya samṛtirbhavātyadha smā nastanvo bodhi gopāḥ ||
4,016.18  bhuvo'vitā vāmadevasya dhīnāṃ bhuvaḥ sakhāvṛko vājasātau |
4,016.18 tvāmanu pramatimā jaganmoruśaṃso jaritre viśvadha syāḥ ||
4,016.19  ebhirnṛbhirindra tvāyubhiṣṭvā maghavadbhirmaghavanviśva ājau |
4,016.19 dyāvo na dyumnairabhi santo aryaḥ kṣapo madema śaradaśca pūrvīḥ ||
4,016.20  evedindrāya vṛṣabhāya vṛṣṇe brahmākarma bhṛgavo na ratham |
4,016.20 nū cidyathā naḥ sakhyā viyoṣadasanna ugro'vitā tanūpāḥ ||
4,016.21  nū ṣṭuta indra nū gṛṇāna iṣaṃ jaritre nadyo na pīpeḥ |
4,016.21 akāri te harivo brahma navyaṃ dhiyā syāma rathyaḥ sadāsāḥ ||

4,017.01  tvaṃ mahāṃ indra tubhyaṃ ha kṣā anu kṣatraṃ maṃhanā manyata dyauḥ |
4,017.01 tvaṃ vṛtraṃ śavasā jaghanvānsṛjaḥ sindhūṃrahinā jagrasānān ||
4,017.02  tava tviṣo janimanrejata dyau rejadbhūmirbhiyasā svasya manyoḥ |
4,017.02 ṛghāyanta subhvaḥ parvatāsa ārdandhanvāni sarayanta āpaḥ ||
4,017.03  bhinadgiriṃ śavasā vajramiṣṇannāviṣkṛṇvānaḥ sahasāna ojaḥ |
4,017.03 vadhīdvṛtraṃ vajreṇa mandasānaḥ sarannāpo javasā hatavṛṣṇīḥ ||
4,017.04  suvīraste janitā manyata dyaurindrasya kartā svapastamo bhūt |
4,017.04 ya īṃ jajāna svaryaṃ suvajramanapacyutaṃ sadaso na bhūma ||
4,017.05  ya eka iccyāvayati pra bhūmā rājā kṛṣṭīnāṃ puruhūta indraḥ |
4,017.05 satyamenamanu viśve madanti rātiṃ devasya gṛṇato maghonaḥ ||
4,017.06  satrā somā abhavannasya viśve satrā madāso bṛhato madiṣṭhāḥ |
4,017.06 satrābhavo vasupatirvasūnāṃ datre viśvā adhithā indra kṛṣṭīḥ ||
4,017.07  tvamadha prathamaṃ jāyamāno'me viśvā adhithā indra kṛṣṭīḥ |
4,017.07 tvaṃ prati pravata āśayānamahiṃ vajreṇa maghavanvi vṛścaḥ ||
4,017.08  satrāhaṇaṃ dādhṛṣiṃ tumramindraṃ mahāmapāraṃ vṛṣabhaṃ suvajram |
4,017.08 hantā yo vṛtraṃ sanitota vājaṃ dātā maghāni maghavā surādhāḥ ||
4,017.09  ayaṃ vṛtaścātayate samīcīrya ājiṣu maghavā śṛṇva ekaḥ |
4,017.09 ayaṃ vājaṃ bharati yaṃ sanotyasya priyāsaḥ sakhye syāma ||
4,017.10  ayaṃ śṛṇve adha jayannuta ghnannayamuta pra kṛṇute yudhā gāḥ |
4,017.10 yadā satyaṃ kṛṇute manyumindro viśvaṃ dṛḻhaṃ bhayata ejadasmāt ||
4,017.11  samindro gā ajayatsaṃ hiraṇyā samaśviyā maghavā yo ha pūrvīḥ |
4,017.11 ebhirnṛbhirnṛtamo asya śākai rāyo vibhaktā sambharaśca vasvaḥ ||
4,017.12  kiyatsvidindro adhyeti mātuḥ kiyatpiturjanituryo jajāna |
4,017.12 yo asya śuṣmaṃ muhukairiyarti vāto na jūta stanayadbhirabhraiḥ ||
4,017.13  kṣiyantaṃ tvamakṣiyantaṃ kṛṇotīyarti reṇuṃ maghavā samoham |
4,017.13 vibhañjanuraśanimāṃ iva dyauruta stotāraṃ maghavā vasau dhāt ||
4,017.14  ayaṃ cakramiṣaṇatsūryasya nyetaśaṃ rīramatsasṛmāṇam |
4,017.14 ā kṛṣṇa īṃ juhurāṇo jigharti tvaco budhne rajaso asya yonau ||
4,017.15  asiknyāṃ yajamāno na hotā ||
4,017.16  gavyanta indraṃ sakhyāya viprā aśvāyanto vṛṣaṇaṃ vājayantaḥ |
4,017.16 janīyanto janidāmakṣitotimā cyāvayāmo'vate na kośam ||
4,017.17  trātā no bodhi dadṛśāna āpirabhikhyātā marḍitā somyānām |
4,017.17 sakhā pitā pitṛtamaḥ pitṝṇāṃ kartemu lokamuśate vayodhāḥ ||
4,017.18  sakhīyatāmavitā bodhi sakhā gṛṇāna indra stuvate vayo dhāḥ |
4,017.18 vayaṃ hyā te cakṛmā sabādha ābhiḥ śamībhirmahayanta indra ||
4,017.19  stuta indro maghavā yaddha vṛtrā bhūrīṇyeko apratīni hanti |
4,017.19 asya priyo jaritā yasya śarmannakirdevā vārayante na martāḥ ||
4,017.20  evā na indro maghavā virapśī karatsatyā carṣaṇīdhṛdanarvā |
4,017.20 tvaṃ rājā januṣāṃ dhehyasme adhi śravo māhinaṃ yajjaritre ||
4,017.21  nū ṣṭuta indra nū gṛṇāna iṣaṃ jaritre nadyo na pīpeḥ |
4,017.21 akāri te harivo brahma navyaṃ dhiyā syāma rathyaḥ sadāsāḥ ||

4,018.01  ayaṃ panthā anuvittaḥ purāṇo yato devā udajāyanta viśve |
4,018.01 ataścidā janiṣīṣṭa pravṛddho mā mātaramamuyā pattave kaḥ ||
4,018.02  nāhamato nirayā durgahaitattiraścatā pārśvānnirgamāṇi |
4,018.02 bahūni me akṛtā kartvāni yudhyai tvena saṃ tvena pṛcchai ||
4,018.03  parāyatīṃ mātaramanvacaṣṭa na nānu gānyanu nū gamāni |
4,018.03 tvaṣṭurgṛhe apibatsomamindraḥ śatadhanyaṃ camvoḥ sutasya ||
4,018.04  kiṃ sa ṛdhakkṛṇavadyaṃ sahasraṃ māso jabhāra śaradaśca pūrvīḥ |
4,018.04 nahī nvasya pratimānamastyantarjāteṣūta ye janitvāḥ ||
4,018.05  avadyamiva manyamānā guhākarindraṃ mātā vīryeṇā nyṛṣṭam |
4,018.05 athodasthātsvayamatkaṃ vasāna ā rodasī apṛṇājjāyamānaḥ ||
4,018.06  etā arṣantyalalābhavantīrṛtāvarīriva saṃkrośamānāḥ |
4,018.06 etā vi pṛccha kimidaṃ bhananti kamāpo adriṃ paridhiṃ rujanti ||
4,018.07  kimu ṣvidasmai nivido bhanantendrasyāvadyaṃ didhiṣanta āpaḥ |
4,018.07 mamaitānputro mahatā vadhena vṛtraṃ jaghanvāṃ asṛjadvi sindhūn ||
4,018.08  mamaccana tvā yuvatiḥ parāsa mamaccana tvā kuṣavā jagāra |
4,018.08 mamaccidāpaḥ śiśave mamṛḍyurmamaccidindraḥ sahasodatiṣṭhat ||
4,018.09  mamaccana te maghavanvyaṃso nivividhvāṃ apa hanū jaghāna |
4,018.09 adhā nividdha uttaro babhūvāñchiro dāsasya saṃ piṇagvadhena ||
4,018.10  gṛṣṭiḥ sasūva sthaviraṃ tavāgāmanādhṛṣyaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ tumramindram |
4,018.10 arīḻhaṃ vatsaṃ carathāya mātā svayaṃ gātuṃ tanva icchamānam ||
4,018.11  uta mātā mahiṣamanvavenadamī tvā jahati putra devāḥ |
4,018.11 athābravīdvṛtramindro haniṣyansakhe viṣṇo vitaraṃ vi kramasva ||
4,018.12  kaste mātaraṃ vidhavāmacakracchayuṃ kastvāmajighāṃsaccarantam |
4,018.12 kaste devo adhi mārḍīka āsīdyatprākṣiṇāḥ pitaraṃ pādagṛhya ||
4,018.13  avartyā śuna āntrāṇi pece na deveṣu vivide marḍitāram |
4,018.13 apaśyaṃ jāyāmamahīyamānāmadhā me śyeno madhvā jabhāra ||

4,019.01  evā tvāmindra vajrinnatra viśve devāsaḥ suhavāsa ūmāḥ |
4,019.01 mahāmubhe rodasī vṛddhamṛṣvaṃ nirekamidvṛṇate vṛtrahatye ||
4,019.02  avāsṛjanta jivrayo na devā bhuvaḥ samrāḻ indra satyayoniḥ |
4,019.02 ahannahiṃ pariśayānamarṇaḥ pra vartanīrarado viśvadhenāḥ ||
4,019.03  atṛpṇuvantaṃ viyatamabudhyamabudhyamānaṃ suṣupāṇamindra |
4,019.03 sapta prati pravata āśayānamahiṃ vajreṇa vi riṇā aparvan ||
4,019.04  akṣodayacchavasā kṣāma budhnaṃ vārṇa vātastaviṣībhirindraḥ |
4,019.04 dṛḻhānyaubhnāduśamāna ojo'vābhinatkakubhaḥ parvatānām ||
4,019.05  abhi pra dadrurjanayo na garbhaṃ rathā iva pra yayuḥ sākamadrayaḥ |
4,019.05 atarpayo visṛta ubja ūrmīntvaṃ vṛtāṃ ariṇā indra sindhūn ||
4,019.06  tvaṃ mahīmavaniṃ viśvadhenāṃ turvītaye vayyāya kṣarantīm |
4,019.06 aramayo namasaijadarṇaḥ sutaraṇāṃ akṛṇorindra sindhūn ||
4,019.07  prāgruvo nabhanvo na vakvā dhvasrā apinvadyuvatīrṛtajñāḥ |
4,019.07 dhanvānyajrāṃ apṛṇaktṛṣāṇāṃ adhogindra staryo daṃsupatnīḥ ||
4,019.08  pūrvīruṣasaḥ śaradaśca gūrtā vṛtraṃ jaghanvāṃ asṛjadvi sindhūn |
4,019.08 pariṣṭhitā atṛṇadbadbadhānāḥ sīrā indraḥ sravitave pṛthivyā ||
4,019.09  vamrībhiḥ putramagruvo adānaṃ niveśanāddhariva ā jabhartha |
4,019.09 vyandho akhyadahimādadāno nirbhūdukhacchitsamaranta parva ||
4,019.10  pra te pūrvāṇi karaṇāni viprāvidvāṃ āha viduṣe karāṃsi |
4,019.10 yathāyathā vṛṣṇyāni svagūrtāpāṃsi rājannaryāviveṣīḥ ||
4,019.11  nū ṣṭuta indra nū gṛṇāna iṣaṃ jaritre nadyo na pīpeḥ |
4,019.11 akāri te harivo brahma navyaṃ dhiyā syāma rathyaḥ sadāsāḥ ||

4,020.01  ā na indro dūrādā na āsādabhiṣṭikṛdavase yāsadugraḥ |
4,020.01 ojiṣṭhebhirnṛpatirvajrabāhuḥ saṃge samatsu turvaṇiḥ pṛtanyūn ||
4,020.02  ā na indro haribhiryātvacchārvācīno'vase rādhase ca |
4,020.02 tiṣṭhāti vajrī maghavā virapśīmaṃ yajñamanu no vājasātau ||
4,020.03  imaṃ yajñaṃ tvamasmākamindra puro dadhatsaniṣyasi kratuṃ naḥ |
4,020.03 śvaghnīva vajrinsanaye dhanānāṃ tvayā vayamarya ājiṃ jayema ||
4,020.04  uśannu ṣu ṇaḥ sumanā upāke somasya nu suṣutasya svadhāvaḥ |
4,020.04 pā indra pratibhṛtasya madhvaḥ samandhasā mamadaḥ pṛṣṭhyena ||
4,020.05  vi yo rarapśa ṛṣibhirnavebhirvṛkṣo na pakvaḥ sṛṇyo na jetā |
4,020.05 maryo na yoṣāmabhi manyamāno'cchā vivakmi puruhūtamindram ||
4,020.06  girirna yaḥ svatavāṃ ṛṣva indraḥ sanādeva sahase jāta ugraḥ |
4,020.06 ādartā vajraṃ sthaviraṃ na bhīma udneva kośaṃ vasunā nyṛṣṭam ||
4,020.07  na yasya vartā januṣā nvasti na rādhasa āmarītā maghasya |
4,020.07 udvāvṛṣāṇastaviṣīva ugrāsmabhyaṃ daddhi puruhūta rāyaḥ ||
4,020.08  īkṣe rāyaḥ kṣayasya carṣaṇīnāmuta vrajamapavartāsi gonām |
4,020.08 śikṣānaraḥ samitheṣu prahāvānvasvo rāśimabhinetāsi bhūrim ||
4,020.09  kayā tacchṛṇve śacyā śaciṣṭho yayā kṛṇoti muhu kā cidṛṣvaḥ |
4,020.09 puru dāśuṣe vicayiṣṭho aṃho'thā dadhāti draviṇaṃ jaritre ||
4,020.10  mā no mardhīrā bharā daddhi tannaḥ pra dāśuṣe dātave bhūri yatte |
4,020.10 navye deṣṇe śaste asminta ukthe pra bravāma vayamindra stuvantaḥ ||
4,020.11  nū ṣṭuta indra nū gṛṇāna iṣaṃ jaritre nadyo na pīpeḥ |
4,020.11 akāri te harivo brahma navyaṃ dhiyā syāma rathyaḥ sadāsāḥ ||

4,021.01  ā yātvindro'vasa upa na iha stutaḥ sadhamādastu śūraḥ |
4,021.01 vāvṛdhānastaviṣīryasya pūrvīrdyaurna kṣatramabhibhūti puṣyāt ||
4,021.02  tasyediha stavatha vṛṣṇyāni tuvidyumnasya tuvirādhaso nṝn |
4,021.02 yasya kraturvidathyo na samrāṭsāhvāntarutro abhyasti kṛṣṭīḥ ||
4,021.03  ā yātvindro diva ā pṛthivyā makṣū samudrāduta vā purīṣāt |
4,021.03 svarṇarādavase no marutvānparāvato vā sadanādṛtasya ||
4,021.04  sthūrasya rāyo bṛhato ya īśe tamu ṣṭavāma vidatheṣvindram |
4,021.04 yo vāyunā jayati gomatīṣu pra dhṛṣṇuyā nayati vasyo accha ||
4,021.05  upa yo namo namasi stabhāyanniyarti vācaṃ janayanyajadhyai |
4,021.05 ṛñjasānaḥ puruvāra ukthairendraṃ kṛṇvīta sadaneṣu hotā ||
4,021.06  dhiṣā yadi dhiṣaṇyantaḥ saraṇyānsadanto adrimauśijasya gohe |
4,021.06 ā duroṣāḥ pāstyasya hotā yo no mahānsaṃvaraṇeṣu vahniḥ ||
4,021.07  satrā yadīṃ bhārvarasya vṛṣṇaḥ siṣakti śuṣma stuvate bharāya |
4,021.07 guhā yadīmauśijasya gohe pra yaddhiye prāyase madāya ||
4,021.08  vi yadvarāṃsi parvatasya vṛṇve payobhirjinve apāṃ javāṃsi |
4,021.08 vidadgaurasya gavayasya gohe yadī vājāya sudhyo vahanti ||
4,021.09  bhadrā te hastā sukṛtota pāṇī prayantārā stuvate rādha indra |
4,021.09 kā te niṣattiḥ kimu no mamatsi kiṃ nodudu harṣase dātavā u ||
4,021.10  evā vasva indraḥ satyaḥ samrāḍḍhantā vṛtraṃ varivaḥ pūrave kaḥ |
4,021.10 puruṣṭuta kratvā naḥ śagdhi rāyo bhakṣīya te'vaso daivyasya ||
4,021.11  nū ṣṭuta indra nū gṛṇāna iṣaṃ jaritre nadyo na pīpeḥ |
4,021.11 akāri te harivo brahma navyaṃ dhiyā syāma rathyaḥ sadāsāḥ ||

4,022.01  yanna indro jujuṣe yacca vaṣṭi tanno mahānkarati śuṣmyā cit |
4,022.01 brahma stomaṃ maghavā somamukthā yo aśmānaṃ śavasā bibhradeti ||
4,022.02  vṛṣā vṛṣandhiṃ caturaśrimasyannugro bāhubhyāṃ nṛtamaḥ śacīvān |
4,022.02 śriye paruṣṇīmuṣamāṇa ūrṇāṃ yasyāḥ parvāṇi sakhyāya vivye ||
4,022.03  yo devo devatamo jāyamāno maho vājebhirmahadbhiśca śuṣmaiḥ |
4,022.03 dadhāno vajraṃ bāhvoruśantaṃ dyāmamena rejayatpra bhūma ||
4,022.04  viśvā rodhāṃsi pravataśca pūrvīrdyaurṛṣvājjanimanrejata kṣāḥ |
4,022.04 ā mātarā bharati śuṣmyā gornṛvatparijmannonuvanta vātāḥ ||
4,022.05  tā tū ta indra mahato mahāni viśveṣvitsavaneṣu pravācyā |
4,022.05 yacchūra dhṛṣṇo dhṛṣatā dadhṛṣvānahiṃ vajreṇa śavasāviveṣīḥ ||
4,022.06  tā tū te satyā tuvinṛmṇa viśvā pra dhenavaḥ sisrate vṛṣṇa ūdhnaḥ |
4,022.06 adhā ha tvadvṛṣamaṇo bhiyānāḥ pra sindhavo javasā cakramanta ||
4,022.07  atrāha te harivastā u devīravobhirindra stavanta svasāraḥ |
4,022.07 yatsīmanu pra muco badbadhānā dīrghāmanu prasitiṃ syandayadhyai ||
4,022.08  pipīḻe aṃśurmadyo na sindhurā tvā śamī śaśamānasya śaktiḥ |
4,022.08 asmadryakchuśucānasya yamyā āśurna raśmiṃ tuvyojasaṃ goḥ ||
4,022.09  asme varṣiṣṭhā kṛṇuhi jyeṣṭhā nṛmṇāni satrā sahure sahāṃsi |
4,022.09 asmabhyaṃ vṛtrā suhanāni randhi jahi vadharvanuṣo martyasya ||
4,022.10  asmākamitsu śṛṇuhi tvamindrāsmabhyaṃ citrāṃ upa māhi vājān |
4,022.10 asmabhyaṃ viśvā iṣaṇaḥ purandhīrasmākaṃ su maghavanbodhi godāḥ ||
4,022.11  nū ṣṭuta indra nū gṛṇāna iṣaṃ jaritre nadyo na pīpeḥ |
4,022.11 akāri te harivo brahma navyaṃ dhiyā syāma rathyaḥ sadāsāḥ ||

4,023.01  kathā mahāmavṛdhatkasya hoturyajñaṃ juṣāṇo abhi somamūdhaḥ |
4,023.01 pibannuśāno juṣamāṇo andho vavakṣa ṛṣvaḥ śucate dhanāya ||
4,023.02  ko asya vīraḥ sadhamādamāpa samānaṃśa sumatibhiḥ ko asya |
4,023.02 kadasya citraṃ cikite kadūtī vṛdhe bhuvacchaśamānasya yajyoḥ ||
4,023.03  kathā śṛṇoti hūyamānamindraḥ kathā śṛṇvannavasāmasya veda |
4,023.03 kā asya pūrvīrupamātayo ha kathainamāhuḥ papuriṃ jaritre ||
4,023.04  kathā sabādhaḥ śaśamāno asya naśadabhi draviṇaṃ dīdhyānaḥ |
4,023.04 devo bhuvannavedā ma ṛtānāṃ namo jagṛbhvāṃ abhi yajjujoṣat ||
4,023.05  kathā kadasyā uṣaso vyuṣṭau devo martasya sakhyaṃ jujoṣa |
4,023.05 kathā kadasya sakhyaṃ sakhibhyo ye asminkāmaṃ suyujaṃ tatasre ||
4,023.06  kimādamatraṃ sakhyaṃ sakhibhyaḥ kadā nu te bhrātraṃ pra bravāma |
4,023.06 śriye sudṛśo vapurasya sargāḥ svarṇa citratamamiṣa ā goḥ ||
4,023.07  druhaṃ jighāṃsandhvarasamanindrāṃ tetikte tigmā tujase anīkā |
4,023.07 ṛṇā cidyatra ṛṇayā na ugro dūre ajñātā uṣaso babādhe ||
4,023.08  ṛtasya hi śurudhaḥ santi pūrvīrṛtasya dhītirvṛjināni hanti |
4,023.08 ṛtasya śloko badhirā tatarda karṇā budhānaḥ śucamāna āyoḥ ||
4,023.09  ṛtasya dṛḻhā dharuṇāni santi purūṇi candrā vapuṣe vapūṃṣi |
4,023.09 ṛtena dīrghamiṣaṇanta pṛkṣa ṛtena gāva ṛtamā viveśuḥ ||
4,023.10  ṛtaṃ yemāna ṛtamidvanotyṛtasya śuṣmasturayā u gavyuḥ |
4,023.10 ṛtāya pṛthvī bahule gabhīre ṛtāya dhenū parame duhāte ||
4,023.11  nū ṣṭuta indra nū gṛṇāna iṣaṃ jaritre nadyo na pīpeḥ |
4,023.11 akāri te harivo brahma navyaṃ dhiyā syāma rathyaḥ sadāsāḥ ||

4,024.01  kā suṣṭutiḥ śavasaḥ sūnumindramarvācīnaṃ rādhasa ā vavartat |
4,024.01 dadirhi vīro gṛṇate vasūni sa gopatirniṣṣidhāṃ no janāsaḥ ||
4,024.02  sa vṛtrahatye havyaḥ sa īḍyaḥ sa suṣṭuta indraḥ satyarādhāḥ |
4,024.02 sa yāmannā maghavā martyāya brahmaṇyate suṣvaye varivo dhāt ||
4,024.03  taminnaro vi hvayante samīke ririkvāṃsastanvaḥ kṛṇvata trām |
4,024.03 mitho yattyāgamubhayāso agmannarastokasya tanayasya sātau ||
4,024.04  kratūyanti kṣitayo yoga ugrāśuṣāṇāso mitho arṇasātau |
4,024.04 saṃ yadviśo'vavṛtranta yudhmā ādinnema indrayante abhīke ||
4,024.05  ādiddha nema indriyaṃ yajanta āditpaktiḥ puroḻāśaṃ riricyāt |
4,024.05 āditsomo vi papṛcyādasuṣvīnādijjujoṣa vṛṣabhaṃ yajadhyai ||
4,024.06  kṛṇotyasmai varivo ya itthendrāya somamuśate sunoti |
4,024.06 sadhrīcīnena manasāvivenantamitsakhāyaṃ kṛṇute samatsu ||
4,024.07  ya indrāya sunavatsomamadya pacātpaktīruta bhṛjjāti dhānāḥ |
4,024.07 prati manāyorucathāni haryantasmindadhadvṛṣaṇaṃ śuṣmamindraḥ ||
4,024.08  yadā samaryaṃ vyacedṛghāvā dīrghaṃ yadājimabhyakhyadaryaḥ |
4,024.08 acikradadvṛṣaṇaṃ patnyacchā duroṇa ā niśitaṃ somasudbhiḥ ||
4,024.09  bhūyasā vasnamacaratkanīyo'vikrīto akāniṣaṃ punaryan |
4,024.09 sa bhūyasā kanīyo nārirecīddīnā dakṣā vi duhanti pra vāṇam ||
4,024.10  ka imaṃ daśabhirmamendraṃ krīṇāti dhenubhiḥ |
4,024.10 yadā vṛtrāṇi jaṅghanadathainaṃ me punardadat ||
4,024.11  nū ṣṭuta indra nū gṛṇāna iṣaṃ jaritre nadyo na pīpeḥ |
4,024.11 akāri te harivo brahma navyaṃ dhiyā syāma rathyaḥ sadāsāḥ ||

4,025.01  ko adya naryo devakāma uśannindrasya sakhyaṃ jujoṣa |
4,025.01 ko vā mahe'vase pāryāya samiddhe agnau sutasoma īṭṭe ||
4,025.02  ko nānāma vacasā somyāya manāyurvā bhavati vasta usrāḥ |
4,025.02 ka indrasya yujyaṃ kaḥ sakhitvaṃ ko bhrātraṃ vaṣṭi kavaye ka ūtī ||
4,025.03  ko devānāmavo adyā vṛṇīte ka ādityāṃ aditiṃ jyotirīṭṭe |
4,025.03 kasyāśvināvindro agniḥ sutasyāṃśoḥ pibanti manasāvivenam ||
4,025.04  tasmā agnirbhārataḥ śarma yaṃsajjyokpaśyātsūryamuccarantam |
4,025.04 ya indrāya sunavāmetyāha nare naryāya nṛtamāya nṛṇām ||
4,025.05  na taṃ jinanti bahavo na dabhrā urvasmā aditiḥ śarma yaṃsat |
4,025.05 priyaḥ sukṛtpriya indre manāyuḥ priyaḥ suprāvīḥ priyo asya somī ||
4,025.06  suprāvyaḥ prāśuṣāḻ eṣa vīraḥ suṣveḥ paktiṃ kṛṇute kevalendraḥ |
4,025.06 nāsuṣverāpirna sakhā na jāmirduṣprāvyo'vahantedavācaḥ ||
4,025.07  na revatā paṇinā sakhyamindro'sunvatā sutapāḥ saṃ gṛṇīte |
4,025.07 āsya vedaḥ khidati hanti nagnaṃ vi suṣvaye paktaye kevalo bhūt ||
4,025.08  indraṃ pare'vare madhyamāsa indraṃ yānto'vasitāsa indram |
4,025.08 indraṃ kṣiyanta uta yudhyamānā indraṃ naro vājayanto havante ||

4,026.01  ahaṃ manurabhavaṃ sūryaścāhaṃ kakṣīvāṃ ṛṣirasmi vipraḥ |
4,026.01 ahaṃ kutsamārjuneyaṃ nyṛñje'haṃ kaviruśanā paśyatā mā ||
4,026.02  ahaṃ bhūmimadadāmāryāyāhaṃ vṛṣṭiṃ dāśuṣe martyāya |
4,026.02 ahamapo anayaṃ vāvaśānā mama devāso anu ketamāyan ||
4,026.03  ahaṃ puro mandasāno vyairaṃ nava sākaṃ navatīḥ śambarasya |
4,026.03 śatatamaṃ veśyaṃ sarvatātā divodāsamatithigvaṃ yadāvam ||
4,026.04  pra su ṣa vibhyo maruto virastu pra śyenaḥ śyenebhya āśupatvā |
4,026.04 acakrayā yatsvadhayā suparṇo havyaṃ bharanmanave devajuṣṭam ||
4,026.05  bharadyadi virato vevijānaḥ pathoruṇā manojavā asarji |
4,026.05 tūyaṃ yayau madhunā somyenota śravo vivide śyeno atra ||
4,026.06  ṛjīpī śyeno dadamāno aṃśuṃ parāvataḥ śakuno mandraṃ madam |
4,026.06 somaṃ bharaddādṛhāṇo devāvāndivo amuṣmāduttarādādāya ||
4,026.07  ādāya śyeno abharatsomaṃ sahasraṃ savāṃ ayutaṃ ca sākam |
4,026.07 atrā purandhirajahādarātīrmade somasya mūrā amūraḥ ||

4,027.01  garbhe nu sannanveṣāmavedamahaṃ devānāṃ janimāni viśvā |
4,027.01 śataṃ mā pura āyasīrarakṣannadha śyeno javasā niradīyam ||
4,027.02  na ghā sa māmapa joṣaṃ jabhārābhīmāsa tvakṣasā vīryeṇa |
4,027.02 īrmā purandhirajahādarātīruta vātāṃ ataracchūśuvānaḥ ||
4,027.03  ava yacchyeno asvanīdadha dyorvi yadyadi vāta ūhuḥ purandhim |
4,027.03 sṛjadyadasmā ava ha kṣipajjyāṃ kṛśānurastā manasā bhuraṇyan ||
4,027.04  ṛjipya īmindrāvato na bhujyuṃ śyeno jabhāra bṛhato adhi ṣṇoḥ |
4,027.04 antaḥ patatpatatryasya parṇamadha yāmani prasitasya tadveḥ ||
4,027.05  adha śvetaṃ kalaśaṃ gobhiraktamāpipyānaṃ maghavā śukramandhaḥ |
4,027.05 adhvaryubhiḥ prayataṃ madhvo agramindro madāya prati dhatpibadhyai śūro madāya prati dhatpibadhyai ||

4,028.01  tvā yujā tava tatsoma sakhya indro apo manave sasrutaskaḥ |
4,028.01 ahannahimariṇātsapta sindhūnapāvṛṇodapihiteva khāni ||
4,028.02  tvā yujā ni khidatsūryasyendraścakraṃ sahasā sadya indo |
4,028.02 adhi ṣṇunā bṛhatā vartamānaṃ maho druho apa viśvāyu dhāyi ||
4,028.03  ahannindro adahadagnirindo purā dasyūnmadhyandinādabhīke |
4,028.03 durge duroṇe kratvā na yātāṃ purū sahasrā śarvā ni barhīt ||
4,028.04  viśvasmātsīmadhamāṃ indra dasyūnviśo dāsīrakṛṇorapraśastāḥ |
4,028.04 abādhethāmamṛṇataṃ ni śatrūnavindethāmapacitiṃ vadhatraiḥ ||
4,028.05  evā satyaṃ maghavānā yuvaṃ tadindraśca somorvamaśvyaṃ goḥ |
4,028.05 ādardṛtamapihitānyaśnā riricathuḥ kṣāścittatṛdānā ||

4,029.01  ā na stuta upa vājebhirūtī indra yāhi haribhirmandasānaḥ |
4,029.01 tiraścidaryaḥ savanā purūṇyāṅgūṣebhirgṛṇānaḥ satyarādhāḥ ||
4,029.02  ā hi ṣmā yāti naryaścikitvānhūyamānaḥ sotṛbhirupa yajñam |
4,029.02 svaśvo yo abhīrurmanyamānaḥ suṣvāṇebhirmadati saṃ ha vīraiḥ ||
4,029.03  śrāvayedasya karṇā vājayadhyai juṣṭāmanu pra diśaṃ mandayadhyai |
4,029.03 udvāvṛṣāṇo rādhase tuviṣmānkaranna indraḥ sutīrthābhayaṃ ca ||
4,029.04  acchā yo gantā nādhamānamūtī itthā vipraṃ havamānaṃ gṛṇantam |
4,029.04 upa tmani dadhāno dhuryāśūnsahasrāṇi śatāni vajrabāhuḥ ||
4,029.05  tvotāso maghavannindra viprā vayaṃ te syāma sūrayo gṛṇantaḥ |
4,029.05 bhejānāso bṛhaddivasya rāya ākāyyasya dāvane purukṣoḥ ||

4,030.01  nakirindra tvaduttaro na jyāyāṃ asti vṛtrahan |
4,030.01 nakirevā yathā tvam ||
4,030.02  satrā te anu kṛṣṭayo viśvā cakreva vāvṛtuḥ |
4,030.02 satrā mahāṃ asi śrutaḥ ||
4,030.03  viśve canedanā tvā devāsa indra yuyudhuḥ |
4,030.03 yadahā naktamātiraḥ ||
4,030.04  yatrota bādhitebhyaścakraṃ kutsāya yudhyate |
4,030.04 muṣāya indra sūryam ||
4,030.05  yatra devāṃ ṛghāyato viśvāṃ ayudhya eka it |
4,030.05 tvamindra vanūṃrahan ||
4,030.06  yatrota martyāya kamariṇā indra sūryam |
4,030.06 prāvaḥ śacībhiretaśam ||
4,030.07  kimādutāsi vṛtrahanmaghavanmanyumattamaḥ |
4,030.07 atrāha dānumātiraḥ ||
4,030.08  etadgheduta vīryamindra cakartha pauṃsyam |
4,030.08 striyaṃ yaddurhaṇāyuvaṃ vadhīrduhitaraṃ divaḥ ||
4,030.09  divaścidghā duhitaraṃ mahānmahīyamānām |
4,030.09 uṣāsamindra saṃ piṇak ||
4,030.10  apoṣā anasaḥ saratsampiṣṭādaha bibhyuṣī |
4,030.10 ni yatsīṃ śiśnathadvṛṣā ||
4,030.11  etadasyā anaḥ śaye susampiṣṭaṃ vipāśyā |
4,030.11 sasāra sīṃ parāvataḥ ||
4,030.12  uta sindhuṃ vibālyaṃ vitasthānāmadhi kṣami |
4,030.12 pari ṣṭhā indra māyayā ||
4,030.13  uta śuṣṇasya dhṛṣṇuyā pra mṛkṣo abhi vedanam |
4,030.13 puro yadasya sampiṇak ||
4,030.14  uta dāsaṃ kaulitaraṃ bṛhataḥ parvatādadhi |
4,030.14 avāhannindra śambaram ||
4,030.15  uta dāsasya varcinaḥ sahasrāṇi śatāvadhīḥ |
4,030.15 adhi pañca pradhīṃriva ||
4,030.16  uta tyaṃ putramagruvaḥ parāvṛktaṃ śatakratuḥ |
4,030.16 uktheṣvindra ābhajat ||
4,030.17  uta tyā turvaśāyadū asnātārā śacīpatiḥ |
4,030.17 indro vidvāṃ apārayat ||
4,030.18  uta tyā sadya āryā sarayorindra pārataḥ |
4,030.18 arṇācitrarathāvadhīḥ ||
4,030.19  anu dvā jahitā nayo'ndhaṃ śroṇaṃ ca vṛtrahan |
4,030.19 na tatte sumnamaṣṭave ||
4,030.20  śatamaśmanmayīnāṃ purāmindro vyāsyat |
4,030.20 divodāsāya dāśuṣe ||
4,030.21  asvāpayaddabhītaye sahasrā triṃśataṃ hathaiḥ |
4,030.21 dāsānāmindro māyayā ||
4,030.22  sa ghedutāsi vṛtrahansamāna indra gopatiḥ |
4,030.22 yastā viśvāni cicyuṣe ||
4,030.23  uta nūnaṃ yadindriyaṃ kariṣyā indra pauṃsyam |
4,030.23 adyā nakiṣṭadā minat ||
4,030.24  vāmaṃvāmaṃ ta ādure devo dadātvaryamā |
4,030.24 vāmaṃ pūṣā vāmaṃ bhago vāmaṃ devaḥ karūḻatī ||

4,031.01  kayā naścitra ā bhuvadūtī sadāvṛdhaḥ sakhā |
4,031.01 kayā śaciṣṭhayā vṛtā ||
4,031.02  kastvā satyo madānāṃ maṃhiṣṭho matsadandhasaḥ |
4,031.02 dṛḻhā cidāruje vasu ||
4,031.03  abhī ṣu ṇaḥ sakhīnāmavitā jaritṝṇām |
4,031.03 śataṃ bhavāsyūtibhiḥ ||
4,031.04  abhī na ā vavṛtsva cakraṃ na vṛttamarvataḥ |
4,031.04 niyudbhiścarṣaṇīnām ||
4,031.05  pravatā hi kratūnāmā hā padeva gacchasi |
4,031.05 abhakṣi sūrye sacā ||
4,031.06  saṃ yatta indra manyavaḥ saṃ cakrāṇi dadhanvire |
4,031.06 adha tve adha sūrye ||
4,031.07  uta smā hi tvāmāhurinmaghavānaṃ śacīpate |
4,031.07 dātāramavidīdhayum ||
4,031.08  uta smā sadya itpari śaśamānāya sunvate |
4,031.08 purū cinmaṃhase vasu ||
4,031.09  nahi ṣmā te śataṃ cana rādho varanta āmuraḥ |
4,031.09 na cyautnāni kariṣyataḥ ||
4,031.10  asmāṃ avantu te śatamasmānsahasramūtayaḥ |
4,031.10 asmānviśvā abhiṣṭayaḥ ||
4,031.11  asmāṃ ihā vṛṇīṣva sakhyāya svastaye |
4,031.11 maho rāye divitmate ||
4,031.12  asmāṃ aviḍḍhi viśvahendra rāyā parīṇasā |
4,031.12 asmānviśvābhirūtibhiḥ ||
4,031.13  asmabhyaṃ tāṃ apā vṛdhi vrajāṃ asteva gomataḥ |
4,031.13 navābhirindrotibhiḥ ||
4,031.14  asmākaṃ dhṛṣṇuyā ratho dyumāṃ indrānapacyutaḥ |
4,031.14 gavyuraśvayurīyate ||
4,031.15  asmākamuttamaṃ kṛdhi śravo deveṣu sūrya |
4,031.15 varṣiṣṭhaṃ dyāmivopari ||

4,032.01  ā tū na indra vṛtrahannasmākamardhamā gahi |
4,032.01 mahānmahībhirūtibhiḥ ||
4,032.02  bhṛmiścidghāsi tūtujirā citra citriṇīṣvā |
4,032.02 citraṃ kṛṇoṣyūtaye ||
4,032.03  dabhrebhiścicchaśīyāṃsaṃ haṃsi vrādhantamojasā |
4,032.03 sakhibhirye tve sacā ||
4,032.04  vayamindra tve sacā vayaṃ tvābhi nonumaḥ |
4,032.04 asmāṃsmāṃ idudava ||
4,032.05  sa naścitrābhiradrivo'navadyābhirūtibhiḥ |
4,032.05 anādhṛṣṭābhirā gahi ||
4,032.06  bhūyāmo ṣu tvāvataḥ sakhāya indra gomataḥ |
4,032.06 yujo vājāya ghṛṣvaye ||
4,032.07  tvaṃ hyeka īśiṣa indra vājasya gomataḥ |
4,032.07 sa no yandhi mahīmiṣam ||
4,032.08  na tvā varante anyathā yadditsasi stuto magham |
4,032.08 stotṛbhya indra girvaṇaḥ ||
4,032.09  abhi tvā gotamā girānūṣata pra dāvane |
4,032.09 indra vājāya ghṛṣvaye ||
4,032.10  pra te vocāma vīryā yā mandasāna ārujaḥ |
4,032.10 puro dāsīrabhītya ||
4,032.11  tā te gṛṇanti vedhaso yāni cakartha pauṃsyā |
4,032.11 suteṣvindra girvaṇaḥ ||
4,032.12  avīvṛdhanta gotamā indra tve stomavāhasaḥ |
4,032.12 aiṣu dhā vīravadyaśaḥ ||
4,032.13  yacciddhi śaśvatāmasīndra sādhāraṇastvam |
4,032.13 taṃ tvā vayaṃ havāmahe ||
4,032.14  arvācīno vaso bhavāsme su matsvāndhasaḥ |
4,032.14 somānāmindra somapāḥ ||
4,032.15  asmākaṃ tvā matīnāmā stoma indra yacchatu |
4,032.15 arvāgā vartayā harī ||
4,032.16  puroḻāśaṃ ca no ghaso joṣayāse giraśca naḥ |
4,032.16 vadhūyuriva yoṣaṇām ||
4,032.17  sahasraṃ vyatīnāṃ yuktānāmindramīmahe |
4,032.17 śataṃ somasya khāryaḥ ||
4,032.18  sahasrā te śatā vayaṃ gavāmā cyāvayāmasi |
4,032.18 asmatrā rādha etu te ||
4,032.19  daśa te kalaśānāṃ hiraṇyānāmadhīmahi |
4,032.19 bhūridā asi vṛtrahan ||
4,032.20  bhūridā bhūri dehi no mā dabhraṃ bhūryā bhara |
4,032.20 bhūri ghedindra ditsasi ||
4,032.21  bhūridā hyasi śrutaḥ purutrā śūra vṛtrahan |
4,032.21 ā no bhajasva rādhasi ||
4,032.22  pra te babhrū vicakṣaṇa śaṃsāmi goṣaṇo napāt |
4,032.22 mābhyāṃ gā anu śiśrathaḥ ||
4,032.23  kanīnakeva vidradhe nave drupade arbhake |
4,032.23 babhrū yāmeṣu śobhete ||
4,032.24  araṃ ma usrayāmṇe'ramanusrayāmṇe |
4,032.24 babhrū yāmeṣvasridhā ||

4,033.01  pra ṛbhubhyo dūtamiva vācamiṣya upastire śvaitarīṃ dhenumīḻe |
4,033.01 ye vātajūtāstaraṇibhirevaiḥ pari dyāṃ sadyo apaso babhūvuḥ ||
4,033.02  yadāramakrannṛbhavaḥ pitṛbhyāṃ pariviṣṭī veṣaṇā daṃsanābhiḥ |
4,033.02 ādiddevānāmupa sakhyamāyandhīrāsaḥ puṣṭimavahanmanāyai ||
4,033.03  punarye cakruḥ pitarā yuvānā sanā yūpeva jaraṇā śayānā |
4,033.03 te vājo vibhvāṃ ṛbhurindravanto madhupsaraso no'vantu yajñam ||
4,033.04  yatsaṃvatsamṛbhavo gāmarakṣanyatsaṃvatsamṛbhavo mā apiṃśan |
4,033.04 yatsaṃvatsamabharanbhāso asyāstābhiḥ śamībhiramṛtatvamāśuḥ ||
4,033.05  jyeṣṭha āha camasā dvā kareti kanīyāntrīnkṛṇavāmetyāha |
4,033.05 kaniṣṭha āha caturaskareti tvaṣṭa ṛbhavastatpanayadvaco vaḥ ||
4,033.06  satyamūcurnara evā hi cakruranu svadhāmṛbhavo jagmuretām |
4,033.06 vibhrājamānāṃścamasāṃ ahevāvenattvaṣṭā caturo dadṛśvān ||
4,033.07  dvādaśa dyūnyadagohyasyātithye raṇannṛbhavaḥ sasantaḥ |
4,033.07 sukṣetrākṛṇvannanayanta sindhūndhanvātiṣṭhannoṣadhīrnimnamāpaḥ ||
4,033.08  rathaṃ ye cakruḥ suvṛtaṃ nareṣṭhāṃ ye dhenuṃ viśvajuvaṃ viśvarūpām |
4,033.08 ta ā takṣantvṛbhavo rayiṃ naḥ svavasaḥ svapasaḥ suhastāḥ ||
4,033.09  apo hyeṣāmajuṣanta devā abhi kratvā manasā dīdhyānāḥ |
4,033.09 vājo devānāmabhavatsukarmendrasya ṛbhukṣā varuṇasya vibhvā ||
4,033.10  ye harī medhayokthā madanta indrāya cakruḥ suyujā ye aśvā |
4,033.10 te rāyaspoṣaṃ draviṇānyasme dhatta ṛbhavaḥ kṣemayanto na mitram ||
4,033.11  idāhnaḥ pītimuta vo madaṃ dhurna ṛte śrāntasya sakhyāya devāḥ |
4,033.11 te nūnamasme ṛbhavo vasūni tṛtīye asminsavane dadhāta ||

4,034.01  ṛbhurvibhvā vāja indro no acchemaṃ yajñaṃ ratnadheyopa yāta |
4,034.01 idā hi vo dhiṣaṇā devyahnāmadhātpītiṃ saṃ madā agmatā vaḥ ||
4,034.02  vidānāso janmano vājaratnā uta ṛtubhirṛbhavo mādayadhvam |
4,034.02 saṃ vo madā agmata saṃ purandhiḥ suvīrāmasme rayimerayadhvam ||
4,034.03  ayaṃ vo yajña ṛbhavo'kāri yamā manuṣvatpradivo dadhidhve |
4,034.03 pra vo'cchā jujuṣāṇāso asthurabhūta viśve agriyota vājāḥ ||
4,034.04  abhūdu vo vidhate ratnadheyamidā naro dāśuṣe martyāya |
4,034.04 pibata vājā ṛbhavo dade vo mahi tṛtīyaṃ savanaṃ madāya ||
4,034.05  ā vājā yātopa na ṛbhukṣā maho naro draviṇaso gṛṇānāḥ |
4,034.05 ā vaḥ pītayo'bhipitve ahnāmimā astaṃ navasva iva gman ||
4,034.06  ā napātaḥ śavaso yātanopemaṃ yajñaṃ namasā hūyamānāḥ |
4,034.06 sajoṣasaḥ sūrayo yasya ca stha madhvaḥ pāta ratnadhā indravantaḥ ||
4,034.07  sajoṣā indra varuṇena somaṃ sajoṣāḥ pāhi girvaṇo marudbhiḥ |
4,034.07 agrepābhirṛtupābhiḥ sajoṣā gnāspatnībhī ratnadhābhiḥ sajoṣāḥ ||
4,034.08  sajoṣasa ādityairmādayadhvaṃ sajoṣasa ṛbhavaḥ parvatebhiḥ |
4,034.08 sajoṣaso daivyenā savitrā sajoṣasaḥ sindhubhī ratnadhebhiḥ ||
4,034.09  ye aśvinā ye pitarā ya ūtī dhenuṃ tatakṣurṛbhavo ye aśvā |
4,034.09 ye aṃsatrā ya ṛdhagrodasī ye vibhvo naraḥ svapatyāni cakruḥ ||
4,034.10  ye gomantaṃ vājavantaṃ suvīraṃ rayiṃ dhattha vasumantaṃ purukṣum |
4,034.10 te agrepā ṛbhavo mandasānā asme dhatta ye ca rātiṃ gṛṇanti ||
4,034.11  nāpābhūta na vo'tītṛṣāmāniḥśastā ṛbhavo yajñe asmin |
4,034.11 samindreṇa madatha saṃ marudbhiḥ saṃ rājabhī ratnadheyāya devāḥ ||

4,035.01  ihopa yāta śavaso napātaḥ saudhanvanā ṛbhavo māpa bhūta |
4,035.01 asminhi vaḥ savane ratnadheyaṃ gamantvindramanu vo madāsaḥ ||
4,035.02  āgannṛbhūṇāmiha ratnadheyamabhūtsomasya suṣutasya pītiḥ |
4,035.02 sukṛtyayā yatsvapasyayā caṃ ekaṃ vicakra camasaṃ caturdhā ||
4,035.03  vyakṛṇota camasaṃ caturdhā sakhe vi śikṣetyabravīta |
4,035.03 athaita vājā amṛtasya panthāṃ gaṇaṃ devānāmṛbhavaḥ suhastāḥ ||
4,035.04  kimmayaḥ sviccamasa eṣa āsa yaṃ kāvyena caturo vicakra |
4,035.04 athā sunudhvaṃ savanaṃ madāya pāta ṛbhavo madhunaḥ somyasya ||
4,035.05  śacyākarta pitarā yuvānā śacyākarta camasaṃ devapānam |
4,035.05 śacyā harī dhanutarāvataṣṭendravāhāvṛbhavo vājaratnāḥ ||
4,035.06  yo vaḥ sunotyabhipitve ahnāṃ tīvraṃ vājāsaḥ savanaṃ madāya |
4,035.06 tasmai rayimṛbhavaḥ sarvavīramā takṣata vṛṣaṇo mandasānāḥ ||
4,035.07  prātaḥ sutamapibo haryaśva mādhyandinaṃ savanaṃ kevalaṃ te |
4,035.07 samṛbhubhiḥ pibasva ratnadhebhiḥ sakhīṃryāṃ indra cakṛṣe sukṛtyā ||
4,035.08  ye devāso abhavatā sukṛtyā śyenā ivedadhi divi niṣeda |
4,035.08 te ratnaṃ dhāta śavaso napātaḥ saudhanvanā abhavatāmṛtāsaḥ ||
4,035.09  yattṛtīyaṃ savanaṃ ratnadheyamakṛṇudhvaṃ svapasyā suhastāḥ |
4,035.09 tadṛbhavaḥ pariṣiktaṃ va etatsaṃ madebhirindriyebhiḥ pibadhvam ||

4,036.01  anaśvo jāto anabhīśurukthyo rathastricakraḥ pari vartate rajaḥ |
4,036.01 mahattadvo devyasya pravācanaṃ dyāmṛbhavaḥ pṛthivīṃ yacca puṣyatha ||
4,036.02  rathaṃ ye cakruḥ suvṛtaṃ sucetaso'vihvarantaṃ manasaspari dhyayā |
4,036.02 tāṃ ū nvasya savanasya pītaya ā vo vājā ṛbhavo vedayāmasi ||
4,036.03  tadvo vājā ṛbhavaḥ supravācanaṃ deveṣu vibhvo abhavanmahitvanam |
4,036.03 jivrī yatsantā pitarā sanājurā punaryuvānā carathāya takṣatha ||
4,036.04  ekaṃ vi cakra camasaṃ caturvayaṃ niścarmaṇo gāmariṇīta dhītibhiḥ |
4,036.04 athā deveṣvamṛtatvamānaśa śruṣṭī vājā ṛbhavastadva ukthyam ||
4,036.05  ṛbhuto rayiḥ prathamaśravastamo vājaśrutāso yamajījanannaraḥ |
4,036.05 vibhvataṣṭo vidatheṣu pravācyo yaṃ devāso'vathā sa vicarṣaṇiḥ ||
4,036.06  sa vājyarvā sa ṛṣirvacasyayā sa śūro astā pṛtanāsu duṣṭaraḥ |
4,036.06 sa rāyaspoṣaṃ sa suvīryaṃ dadhe yaṃ vājo vibhvāṃ ṛbhavo yamāviṣuḥ ||
4,036.07  śreṣṭhaṃ vaḥ peśo adhi dhāyi darśataṃ stomo vājā ṛbhavastaṃ jujuṣṭana |
4,036.07 dhīrāso hi ṣṭhā kavayo vipaścitastānva enā brahmaṇā vedayāmasi ||
4,036.08  yūyamasmabhyaṃ dhiṣaṇābhyaspari vidvāṃso viśvā naryāṇi bhojanā |
4,036.08 dyumantaṃ vājaṃ vṛṣaśuṣmamuttamamā no rayimṛbhavastakṣatā vayaḥ ||
4,036.09  iha prajāmiha rayiṃ rarāṇā iha śravo vīravattakṣatā naḥ |
4,036.09 yena vayaṃ citayemātyanyāntaṃ vājaṃ citramṛbhavo dadā naḥ ||

4,037.01  upa no vājā adhvaramṛbhukṣā devā yāta pathibhirdevayānaiḥ |
4,037.01 yathā yajñaṃ manuṣo vikṣvāsu dadhidhve raṇvāḥ sudineṣvahnām ||
4,037.02  te vo hṛde manase santu yajñā juṣṭāso adya ghṛtanirṇijo guḥ |
4,037.02 pra vaḥ sutāso harayanta pūrṇāḥ kratve dakṣāya harṣayanta pītāḥ ||
4,037.03  tryudāyaṃ devahitaṃ yathā va stomo vājā ṛbhukṣaṇo dade vaḥ |
4,037.03 juhve manuṣvaduparāsu vikṣu yuṣme sacā bṛhaddiveṣu somam ||
4,037.04  pīvoaśvāḥ śucadrathā hi bhūtāyaḥśiprā vājinaḥ suniṣkāḥ |
4,037.04 indrasya sūno śavaso napāto'nu vaścetyagriyaṃ madāya ||
4,037.05  ṛbhumṛbhukṣaṇo rayiṃ vāje vājintamaṃ yujam |
4,037.05 indrasvantaṃ havāmahe sadāsātamamaśvinam ||
4,037.06  sedṛbhavo yamavatha yūyamindraśca martyam |
4,037.06 sa dhībhirastu sanitā medhasātā so arvatā ||
4,037.07  vi no vājā ṛbhukṣaṇaḥ pathaścitana yaṣṭave |
4,037.07 asmabhyaṃ sūraya stutā viśvā āśāstarīṣaṇi ||
4,037.08  taṃ no vājā ṛbhukṣaṇa indra nāsatyā rayim |
4,037.08 samaśvaṃ carṣaṇibhya ā puru śasta maghattaye ||

4,038.01  uto hi vāṃ dātrā santi pūrvā yā pūrubhyastrasadasyurnitośe |
4,038.01 kṣetrāsāṃ dadathururvarāsāṃ ghanaṃ dasyubhyo abhibhūtimugram ||
4,038.02  uta vājinaṃ puruniṣṣidhvānaṃ dadhikrāmu dadathurviśvakṛṣṭim |
4,038.02 ṛjipyaṃ śyenaṃ pruṣitapsumāśuṃ carkṛtyamaryo nṛpatiṃ na śūram ||
4,038.03  yaṃ sīmanu pravateva dravantaṃ viśvaḥ pūrurmadati harṣamāṇaḥ |
4,038.03 paḍbhirgṛdhyantaṃ medhayuṃ na śūraṃ rathaturaṃ vātamiva dhrajantam ||
4,038.04  yaḥ smārundhāno gadhyā samatsu sanutaraścarati goṣu gacchan |
4,038.04 āvirṛjīko vidathā nicikyattiro aratiṃ paryāpa āyoḥ ||
4,038.05  uta smainaṃ vastramathiṃ na tāyumanu krośanti kṣitayo bhareṣu |
4,038.05 nīcāyamānaṃ jasuriṃ na śyenaṃ śravaścācchā paśumacca yūtham ||
4,038.06  uta smāsu prathamaḥ sariṣyanni veveti śreṇibhī rathānām |
4,038.06 srajaṃ kṛṇvāno janyo na śubhvā reṇuṃ rerihatkiraṇaṃ dadaśvān ||
4,038.07  uta sya vājī sahurirṛtāvā śuśrūṣamāṇastanvā samarye |
4,038.07 turaṃ yatīṣu turayannṛjipyo'dhi bhruvoḥ kirate reṇumṛñjan ||
4,038.08  uta smāsya tanyatoriva dyorṛghāyato abhiyujo bhayante |
4,038.08 yadā sahasramabhi ṣīmayodhīddurvartuḥ smā bhavati bhīma ṛñjan ||
4,038.09  uta smāsya panayanti janā jūtiṃ kṛṣṭipro abhibhūtimāśoḥ |
4,038.09 utainamāhuḥ samithe viyantaḥ parā dadhikrā asaratsahasraiḥ ||
4,038.10  ā dadhikrāḥ śavasā pañca kṛṣṭīḥ sūrya iva jyotiṣāpastatāna |
4,038.10 sahasrasāḥ śatasā vājyarvā pṛṇaktu madhvā samimā vacāṃsi ||

4,039.01  āśuṃ dadhikrāṃ tamu nu ṣṭavāma divaspṛthivyā uta carkirāma |
4,039.01 ucchantīrmāmuṣasaḥ sūdayantvati viśvāni duritāni parṣan ||
4,039.02  mahaścarkarmyarvataḥ kratuprā dadhikrāvṇaḥ puruvārasya vṛṣṇaḥ |
4,039.02 yaṃ pūrubhyo dīdivāṃsaṃ nāgniṃ dadathurmitrāvaruṇā taturim ||
4,039.03  yo aśvasya dadhikrāvṇo akārītsamiddhe agnā uṣaso vyuṣṭau |
4,039.03 anāgasaṃ tamaditiḥ kṛṇotu sa mitreṇa varuṇenā sajoṣāḥ ||
4,039.04  dadhikrāvṇa iṣa ūrjo maho yadamanmahi marutāṃ nāma bhadram |
4,039.04 svastaye varuṇaṃ mitramagniṃ havāmaha indraṃ vajrabāhum ||
4,039.05  indramivedubhaye vi hvayanta udīrāṇā yajñamupaprayantaḥ |
4,039.05 dadhikrāmu sūdanaṃ martyāya dadathurmitrāvaruṇā no aśvam ||
4,039.06  dadhikrāvṇo akāriṣaṃ jiṣṇoraśvasya vājinaḥ |
4,039.06 surabhi no mukhā karatpra ṇa āyūṃṣi tāriṣat ||

4,040.01  dadhikrāvṇa idu nu carkirāma viśvā inmāmuṣasaḥ sūdayantu |
4,040.01 apāmagneruṣasaḥ sūryasya bṛhaspaterāṅgirasasya jiṣṇoḥ ||
4,040.02  satvā bhariṣo gaviṣo duvanyasacchravasyādiṣa uṣasasturaṇyasat |
4,040.02 satyo dravo dravaraḥ pataṅgaro dadhikrāveṣamūrjaṃ svarjanat ||
4,040.03  uta smāsya dravatasturaṇyataḥ parṇaṃ na veranu vāti pragardhinaḥ |
4,040.03 śyenasyeva dhrajato aṅkasaṃ pari dadhikrāvṇaḥ sahorjā taritrataḥ ||
4,040.04  uta sya vājī kṣipaṇiṃ turaṇyati grīvāyāṃ baddho apikakṣa āsani |
4,040.04 kratuṃ dadhikrā anu saṃtavītvatpathāmaṅkāṃsyanvāpanīphaṇat ||
4,040.05  haṃsaḥ śuciṣadvasurantarikṣasaddhotā vediṣadatithirduroṇasat |
4,040.05 nṛṣadvarasadṛtasadvyomasadabjā gojā ṛtajā adrijā ṛtam ||

4,041.01  indrā ko vāṃ varuṇā sumnamāpa stomo haviṣmāṃ amṛto na hotā |
4,041.01 yo vāṃ hṛdi kratumāṃ asmaduktaḥ pasparśadindrāvaruṇā namasvān ||
4,041.02  indrā ha yo varuṇā cakra āpī devau martaḥ sakhyāya prayasvān |
4,041.02 sa hanti vṛtrā samitheṣu śatrūnavobhirvā mahadbhiḥ sa pra śṛṇve ||
4,041.03  indrā ha ratnaṃ varuṇā dheṣṭhetthā nṛbhyaḥ śaśamānebhyastā |
4,041.03 yadī sakhāyā sakhyāya somaiḥ sutebhiḥ suprayasā mādayaite ||
4,041.04  indrā yuvaṃ varuṇā didyumasminnojiṣṭhamugrā ni vadhiṣṭaṃ vajram |
4,041.04 yo no durevo vṛkatirdabhītistasminmimāthāmabhibhūtyojaḥ ||
4,041.05  indrā yuvaṃ varuṇā bhūtamasyā dhiyaḥ pretārā vṛṣabheva dhenoḥ |
4,041.05 sā no duhīyadyavaseva gatvī sahasradhārā payasā mahī gauḥ ||
4,041.06  toke hite tanaya urvarāsu sūro dṛśīke vṛṣaṇaśca pauṃsye |
4,041.06 indrā no atra varuṇā syātāmavobhirdasmā paritakmyāyām ||
4,041.07  yuvāmiddhyavase pūrvyāya pari prabhūtī gaviṣaḥ svāpī |
4,041.07 vṛṇīmahe sakhyāya priyāya śūrā maṃhiṣṭhā pitareva śambhū ||
4,041.08  tā vāṃ dhiyo'vase vājayantīrājiṃ na jagmuryuvayūḥ sudānū |
4,041.08 śriye na gāva upa somamasthurindraṃ giro varuṇaṃ me manīṣāḥ ||
4,041.09  imā indraṃ varuṇaṃ me manīṣā agmannupa draviṇamicchamānāḥ |
4,041.09 upemasthurjoṣṭāra iva vasvo raghvīriva śravaso bhikṣamāṇāḥ ||
4,041.10  aśvyasya tmanā rathyasya puṣṭernityasya rāyaḥ patayaḥ syāma |
4,041.10 tā cakrāṇā ūtibhirnavyasībhirasmatrā rāyo niyutaḥ sacantām ||
4,041.11  ā no bṛhantā bṛhatībhirūtī indra yātaṃ varuṇa vājasātau |
4,041.11 yaddidyavaḥ pṛtanāsu prakrīḻāntasya vāṃ syāma sanitāra ājeḥ ||

4,042.01  mama dvitā rāṣṭraṃ kṣatriyasya viśvāyorviśve amṛtā yathā naḥ |
4,042.01 kratuṃ sacante varuṇasya devā rājāmi kṛṣṭerupamasya vavreḥ ||
4,042.02  ahaṃ rājā varuṇo mahyaṃ tānyasuryāṇi prathamā dhārayanta |
4,042.02 kratuṃ sacante varuṇasya devā rājāmi kṛṣṭerupamasya vavreḥ ||
4,042.03  ahamindro varuṇaste mahitvorvī gabhīre rajasī sumeke |
4,042.03 tvaṣṭeva viśvā bhuvanāni vidvānsamairayaṃ rodasī dhārayaṃ ca ||
4,042.04  ahamapo apinvamukṣamāṇā dhārayaṃ divaṃ sadana ṛtasya |
4,042.04 ṛtena putro aditerṛtāvota tridhātu prathayadvi bhūma ||
4,042.05  māṃ naraḥ svaśvā vājayanto māṃ vṛtāḥ samaraṇe havante |
4,042.05 kṛṇomyājiṃ maghavāhamindra iyarmi reṇumabhibhūtyojāḥ ||
4,042.06  ahaṃ tā viśvā cakaraṃ nakirmā daivyaṃ saho varate apratītam |
4,042.06 yanmā somāso mamadanyadukthobhe bhayete rajasī apāre ||
4,042.07  viduṣṭe viśvā bhuvanāni tasya tā pra bravīṣi varuṇāya vedhaḥ |
4,042.07 tvaṃ vṛtrāṇi śṛṇviṣe jaghanvāntvaṃ vṛtāṃ ariṇā indra sindhūn ||
4,042.08  asmākamatra pitarasta āsansapta ṛṣayo daurgahe badhyamāne |
4,042.08 ta āyajanta trasadasyumasyā indraṃ na vṛtraturamardhadevam ||
4,042.09  purukutsānī hi vāmadāśaddhavyebhirindrāvaruṇā namobhiḥ |
4,042.09 athā rājānaṃ trasadasyumasyā vṛtrahaṇaṃ dadathurardhadevam ||
4,042.10  rāyā vayaṃ sasavāṃso madema havyena devā yavasena gāvaḥ |
4,042.10 tāṃ dhenumindrāvaruṇā yuvaṃ no viśvāhā dhattamanapasphurantīm ||

4,043.01  ka u śravatkatamo yajñiyānāṃ vandāru devaḥ katamo juṣāte |
4,043.01 kasyemāṃ devīmamṛteṣu preṣṭhāṃ hṛdi śreṣāma suṣṭutiṃ suhavyām ||
4,043.02  ko mṛḻāti katama āgamiṣṭho devānāmu katamaḥ śambhaviṣṭhaḥ |
4,043.02 rathaṃ kamāhurdravadaśvamāśuṃ yaṃ sūryasya duhitāvṛṇīta ||
4,043.03  makṣū hi ṣmā gacchatha īvato dyūnindro na śaktiṃ paritakmyāyām |
4,043.03 diva ājātā divyā suparṇā kayā śacīnāṃ bhavathaḥ śaciṣṭhā ||
4,043.04  kā vāṃ bhūdupamātiḥ kayā na āśvinā gamatho hūyamānā |
4,043.04 ko vāṃ mahaścittyajaso abhīka uruṣyataṃ mādhvī dasrā na ūtī ||
4,043.05  uru vāṃ rathaḥ pari nakṣati dyāmā yatsamudrādabhi vartate vām |
4,043.05 madhvā mādhvī madhu vāṃ pruṣāyanyatsīṃ vāṃ pṛkṣo bhurajanta pakvāḥ ||
4,043.06  sindhurha vāṃ rasayā siñcadaśvānghṛṇā vayo'ruṣāsaḥ pari gman |
4,043.06 tadū ṣu vāmajiraṃ ceti yānaṃ yena patī bhavathaḥ sūryāyāḥ ||
4,043.07  iheha yadvāṃ samanā papṛkṣe seyamasme sumatirvājaratnā |
4,043.07 uruṣyataṃ jaritāraṃ yuvaṃ ha śritaḥ kāmo nāsatyā yuvadrik ||

4,044.01  taṃ vāṃ rathaṃ vayamadyā huvema pṛthujrayamaśvinā saṃgatiṃ goḥ |
4,044.01 yaḥ sūryāṃ vahati vandhurāyurgirvāhasaṃ purutamaṃ vasūyum ||
4,044.02  yuvaṃ śriyamaśvinā devatā tāṃ divo napātā vanathaḥ śacībhiḥ |
4,044.02 yuvorvapurabhi pṛkṣaḥ sacante vahanti yatkakuhāso rathe vām ||
4,044.03  ko vāmadyā karate rātahavya ūtaye vā sutapeyāya vārkaiḥ |
4,044.03 ṛtasya vā vanuṣe pūrvyāya namo yemāno aśvinā vavartat ||
4,044.04  hiraṇyayena purubhū rathenemaṃ yajñaṃ nāsatyopa yātam |
4,044.04 pibātha inmadhunaḥ somyasya dadhatho ratnaṃ vidhate janāya ||
4,044.05  ā no yātaṃ divo acchā pṛthivyā hiraṇyayena suvṛtā rathena |
4,044.05 mā vāmanye ni yamandevayantaḥ saṃ yaddade nābhiḥ pūrvyā vām ||
4,044.06  nū no rayiṃ puruvīraṃ bṛhantaṃ dasrā mimāthāmubhayeṣvasme |
4,044.06 naro yadvāmaśvinā stomamāvansadhastutimājamīḻhāso agman ||
4,044.07  iheha yadvāṃ samanā papṛkṣe seyamasme sumatirvājaratnā |
4,044.07 uruṣyataṃ jaritāraṃ yuvaṃ ha śritaḥ kāmo nāsatyā yuvadrik ||

4,045.01  eṣa sya bhānurudiyarti yujyate rathaḥ parijmā divo asya sānavi |
4,045.01 pṛkṣāso asminmithunā adhi trayo dṛtisturīyo madhuno vi rapśate ||
4,045.02  udvāṃ pṛkṣāso madhumanta īrate rathā aśvāsa uṣaso vyuṣṭiṣu |
4,045.02 aporṇuvantastama ā parīvṛtaṃ svarṇa śukraṃ tanvanta ā rajaḥ ||
4,045.03  madhvaḥ pibataṃ madhupebhirāsabhiruta priyaṃ madhune yuñjāthāṃ ratham |
4,045.03 ā vartaniṃ madhunā jinvathaspatho dṛtiṃ vahethe madhumantamaśvinā ||
4,045.04  haṃsāso ye vāṃ madhumanto asridho hiraṇyaparṇā uhuva uṣarbudhaḥ |
4,045.04 udapruto mandino mandinispṛśo madhvo na makṣaḥ savanāni gacchathaḥ ||
4,045.05  svadhvarāso madhumanto agnaya usrā jarante prati vastoraśvinā |
4,045.05 yanniktahastastaraṇirvicakṣaṇaḥ somaṃ suṣāva madhumantamadribhiḥ ||
4,045.06  ākenipāso ahabhirdavidhvataḥ svarṇa śukraṃ tanvanta ā rajaḥ |
4,045.06 sūraścidaśvānyuyujāna īyate viśvāṃ anu svadhayā cetathaspathaḥ ||
4,045.07  pra vāmavocamaśvinā dhiyandhā rathaḥ svaśvo ajaro yo asti |
4,045.07 yena sadyaḥ pari rajāṃsi yātho haviṣmantaṃ taraṇiṃ bhojamaccha ||

4,046.01  agraṃ pibā madhūnāṃ sutaṃ vāyo diviṣṭiṣu |
4,046.01 tvaṃ hi pūrvapā asi ||
4,046.02  śatenā no abhiṣṭibhirniyutvāṃ indrasārathiḥ |
4,046.02 vāyo sutasya tṛmpatam ||
4,046.03  ā vāṃ sahasraṃ haraya indravāyū abhi prayaḥ |
4,046.03 vahantu somapītaye ||
4,046.04  rathaṃ hiraṇyavandhuramindravāyū svadhvaram |
4,046.04 ā hi sthātho divispṛśam ||
4,046.05  rathena pṛthupājasā dāśvāṃsamupa gacchatam |
4,046.05 indravāyū ihā gatam ||
4,046.06  indravāyū ayaṃ sutastaṃ devebhiḥ sajoṣasā |
4,046.06 pibataṃ dāśuṣo gṛhe ||
4,046.07  iha prayāṇamastu vāmindravāyū vimocanam |
4,046.07 iha vāṃ somapītaye ||

4,047.01  vāyo śukro ayāmi te madhvo agraṃ diviṣṭiṣu |
4,047.01 ā yāhi somapītaye spārho deva niyutvatā ||
4,047.02  indraśca vāyaveṣāṃ somānāṃ pītimarhathaḥ |
4,047.02 yuvāṃ hi yantīndavo nimnamāpo na sadhryak ||
4,047.03  vāyavindraśca śuṣmiṇā sarathaṃ śavasaspatī |
4,047.03 niyutvantā na ūtaya ā yātaṃ somapītaye ||
4,047.04  yā vāṃ santi puruspṛho niyuto dāśuṣe narā |
4,047.04 asme tā yajñavāhasendravāyū ni yacchatam ||

4,048.01  vihi hotrā avītā vipo na rāyo aryaḥ |
4,048.01 vāyavā candreṇa rathena yāhi sutasya pītaye ||
4,048.02  niryuvāṇo aśastīrniyutvāṃ indrasārathiḥ |
4,048.02 vāyavā candreṇa rathena yāhi sutasya pītaye ||
4,048.03  anu kṛṣṇe vasudhitī yemāte viśvapeśasā |
4,048.03 vāyavā candreṇa rathena yāhi sutasya pītaye ||
4,048.04  vahantu tvā manoyujo yuktāso navatirnava |
4,048.04 vāyavā candreṇa rathena yāhi sutasya pītaye ||
4,048.05  vāyo śataṃ harīṇāṃ yuvasva poṣyāṇām |
4,048.05 uta vā te sahasriṇo ratha ā yātu pājasā ||

4,049.01  idaṃ vāmāsye haviḥ priyamindrābṛhaspatī |
4,049.01 ukthaṃ madaśca śasyate ||
4,049.02  ayaṃ vāṃ pari ṣicyate soma indrābṛhaspatī |
4,049.02 cārurmadāya pītaye ||
4,049.03  ā na indrābṛhaspatī gṛhamindraśca gacchatam |
4,049.03 somapā somapītaye ||
4,049.04  asme indrābṛhaspatī rayiṃ dhattaṃ śatagvinam |
4,049.04 aśvāvantaṃ sahasriṇam ||
4,049.05  indrābṛhaspatī vayaṃ sute gīrbhirhavāmahe |
4,049.05 asya somasya pītaye ||
4,049.06  somamindrābṛhaspatī pibataṃ dāśuṣo gṛhe |
4,049.06 mādayethāṃ tadokasā ||

4,050.01  yastastambha sahasā vi jmo antānbṛhaspatistriṣadhastho raveṇa |
4,050.01 taṃ pratnāsa ṛṣayo dīdhyānāḥ puro viprā dadhire mandrajihvam ||
4,050.02  dhunetayaḥ supraketaṃ madanto bṛhaspate abhi ye nastatasre |
4,050.02 pṛṣantaṃ sṛpramadabdhamūrvaṃ bṛhaspate rakṣatādasya yonim ||
4,050.03  bṛhaspate yā paramā parāvadata ā ta ṛtaspṛśo ni ṣeduḥ |
4,050.03 tubhyaṃ khātā avatā adridugdhā madhva ścotantyabhito virapśam ||
4,050.04  bṛhaspatiḥ prathamaṃ jāyamāno maho jyotiṣaḥ parame vyoman |
4,050.04 saptāsyastuvijāto raveṇa vi saptaraśmiradhamattamāṃsi ||
4,050.05  sa suṣṭubhā sa ṛkvatā gaṇena valaṃ ruroja phaligaṃ raveṇa |
4,050.05 bṛhaspatirusriyā havyasūdaḥ kanikradadvāvaśatīrudājat ||
4,050.06  evā pitre viśvadevāya vṛṣṇe yajñairvidhema namasā havirbhiḥ |
4,050.06 bṛhaspate suprajā vīravanto vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām ||
4,050.07  sa idrājā pratijanyāni viśvā śuṣmeṇa tasthāvabhi vīryeṇa |
4,050.07 bṛhaspatiṃ yaḥ subhṛtaṃ bibharti valgūyati vandate pūrvabhājam ||
4,050.08  sa itkṣeti sudhita okasi sve tasmā iḻā pinvate viśvadānīm |
4,050.08 tasmai viśaḥ svayamevā namante yasminbrahmā rājani pūrva eti ||
4,050.09  apratīto jayati saṃ dhanāni pratijanyānyuta yā sajanyā |
4,050.09 avasyave yo varivaḥ kṛṇoti brahmaṇe rājā tamavanti devāḥ ||
4,050.10  indraśca somaṃ pibataṃ bṛhaspate'sminyajñe mandasānā vṛṣaṇvasū |
4,050.10 ā vāṃ viśantvindavaḥ svābhuvo'sme rayiṃ sarvavīraṃ ni yacchatam ||
4,050.11  bṛhaspata indra vardhataṃ naḥ sacā sā vāṃ sumatirbhūtvasme |
4,050.11 aviṣṭaṃ dhiyo jigṛtaṃ purandhīrjajastamaryo vanuṣāmarātīḥ ||

4,051.01  idamu tyatpurutamaṃ purastājjyotistamaso vayunāvadasthāt |
4,051.01 nūnaṃ divo duhitaro vibhātīrgātuṃ kṛṇavannuṣaso janāya ||
4,051.02  asthuru citrā uṣasaḥ purastānmitā iva svaravo'dhvareṣu |
4,051.02 vyū vrajasya tamaso dvārocchantīravrañchucayaḥ pāvakāḥ ||
4,051.03  ucchantīradya citayanta bhojānrādhodeyāyoṣaso maghonīḥ |
4,051.03 acitre antaḥ paṇayaḥ sasantvabudhyamānāstamaso vimadhye ||
4,051.04  kuvitsa devīḥ sanayo navo vā yāmo babhūyāduṣaso vo adya |
4,051.04 yenā navagve aṅgire daśagve saptāsye revatī revadūṣa ||
4,051.05  yūyaṃ hi devīrṛtayugbhiraśvaiḥ pariprayātha bhuvanāni sadyaḥ |
4,051.05 prabodhayantīruṣasaḥ sasantaṃ dvipāccatuṣpāccarathāya jīvam ||
4,051.06  kva svidāsāṃ katamā purāṇī yayā vidhānā vidadhurṛbhūṇām |
4,051.06 śubhaṃ yacchubhrā uṣasaścaranti na vi jñāyante sadṛśīrajuryāḥ ||
4,051.07  tā ghā tā bhadrā uṣasaḥ purāsurabhiṣṭidyumnā ṛtajātasatyāḥ |
4,051.07 yāsvījānaḥ śaśamāna ukthai stuvañchaṃsandraviṇaṃ sadya āpa ||
4,051.08  tā ā caranti samanā purastātsamānataḥ samanā paprathānāḥ |
4,051.08 ṛtasya devīḥ sadaso budhānā gavāṃ na sargā uṣaso jarante ||
4,051.09  tā innveva samanā samānīramītavarṇā uṣasaścaranti |
4,051.09 gūhantīrabhvamasitaṃ ruśadbhiḥ śukrāstanūbhiḥ śucayo rucānāḥ ||
4,051.10  rayiṃ divo duhitaro vibhātīḥ prajāvantaṃ yacchatāsmāsu devīḥ |
4,051.10 syonādā vaḥ pratibudhyamānāḥ suvīryasya patayaḥ syāma ||
4,051.11  tadvo divo duhitaro vibhātīrupa bruva uṣaso yajñaketuḥ |
4,051.11 vayaṃ syāma yaśaso janeṣu taddyauśca dhattāṃ pṛthivī ca devī ||

4,052.01  prati ṣyā sūnarī janī vyucchantī pari svasuḥ |
4,052.01 divo adarśi duhitā ||
4,052.02  aśveva citrāruṣī mātā gavāmṛtāvarī |
4,052.02 sakhābhūdaśvinoruṣāḥ ||
4,052.03  uta sakhāsyaśvinoruta mātā gavāmasi |
4,052.03 utoṣo vasva īśiṣe ||
4,052.04  yāvayaddveṣasaṃ tvā cikitvitsūnṛtāvari |
4,052.04 prati stomairabhutsmahi ||
4,052.05  prati bhadrā adṛkṣata gavāṃ sargā na raśmayaḥ |
4,052.05 oṣā aprā uru jrayaḥ ||
4,052.06  āpapruṣī vibhāvari vyāvarjyotiṣā tamaḥ |
4,052.06 uṣo anu svadhāmava ||
4,052.07  ā dyāṃ tanoṣi raśmibhirāntarikṣamuru priyam |
4,052.07 uṣaḥ śukreṇa śociṣā ||

4,053.01  taddevasya saviturvāryaṃ mahadvṛṇīmahe asurasya pracetasaḥ |
4,053.01 chardiryena dāśuṣe yacchati tmanā tanno mahāṃ udayāndevo aktubhiḥ ||
4,053.02  divo dhartā bhuvanasya prajāpatiḥ piśaṅgaṃ drāpiṃ prati muñcate kaviḥ |
4,053.02 vicakṣaṇaḥ prathayannāpṛṇannurvajījanatsavitā sumnamukthyam ||
4,053.03  āprā rajāṃsi divyāni pārthivā ślokaṃ devaḥ kṛṇute svāya dharmaṇe |
4,053.03 pra bāhū asrāksavitā savīmani niveśayanprasuvannaktubhirjagat ||
4,053.04  adābhyo bhuvanāni pracākaśadvratāni devaḥ savitābhi rakṣate |
4,053.04 prāsrāgbāhū bhuvanasya prajābhyo dhṛtavrato maho ajmasya rājati ||
4,053.05  trirantarikṣaṃ savitā mahitvanā trī rajāṃsi paribhustrīṇi rocanā |
4,053.05 tisro divaḥ pṛthivīstisra invati tribhirvratairabhi no rakṣati tmanā ||
4,053.06  bṛhatsumnaḥ prasavītā niveśano jagata sthāturubhayasya yo vaśī |
4,053.06 sa no devaḥ savitā śarma yacchatvasme kṣayāya trivarūthamaṃhasaḥ ||
4,053.07  āgandeva ṛtubhirvardhatu kṣayaṃ dadhātu naḥ savitā suprajāmiṣam |
4,053.07 sa naḥ kṣapābhirahabhiśca jinvatu prajāvantaṃ rayimasme saminvatu ||

4,054.01  abhūddevaḥ savitā vandyo nu na idānīmahna upavācyo nṛbhiḥ |
4,054.01 vi yo ratnā bhajati mānavebhyaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ no atra draviṇaṃ yathā dadhat ||
4,054.02  devebhyo hi prathamaṃ yajñiyebhyo'mṛtatvaṃ suvasi bhāgamuttamam |
4,054.02 ādiddāmānaṃ savitarvyūrṇuṣe'nūcīnā jīvitā mānuṣebhyaḥ ||
4,054.03  acittī yaccakṛmā daivye jane dīnairdakṣaiḥ prabhūtī pūruṣatvatā |
4,054.03 deveṣu ca savitarmānuṣeṣu ca tvaṃ no atra suvatādanāgasaḥ ||
4,054.04  na pramiye saviturdaivyasya tadyathā viśvaṃ bhuvanaṃ dhārayiṣyati |
4,054.04 yatpṛthivyā varimannā svaṅgurirvarṣmandivaḥ suvati satyamasya tat ||
4,054.05  indrajyeṣṭhānbṛhadbhyaḥ parvatebhyaḥ kṣayāṃ ebhyaḥ suvasi pastyāvataḥ |
4,054.05 yathāyathā patayanto viyemira evaiva tasthuḥ savitaḥ savāya te ||
4,054.06  ye te trirahansavitaḥ savāso divedive saubhagamāsuvanti |
4,054.06 indro dyāvāpṛthivī sindhuradbhirādityairno aditiḥ śarma yaṃsat ||

4,055.01  ko vastrātā vasavaḥ ko varūtā dyāvābhūmī adite trāsīthāṃ naḥ |
4,055.01 sahīyaso varuṇa mitra martātko vo'dhvare varivo dhāti devāḥ ||
4,055.02  pra ye dhāmāni pūrvyāṇyarcānvi yaducchānviyotāro amūrāḥ |
4,055.02 vidhātāro vi te dadhurajasrā ṛtadhītayo rurucanta dasmāḥ ||
4,055.03  pra pastyāmaditiṃ sindhumarkaiḥ svastimīḻe sakhyāya devīm |
4,055.03 ubhe yathā no ahanī nipāta uṣāsānaktā karatāmadabdhe ||
4,055.04  vyaryamā varuṇaśceti panthāmiṣaspatiḥ suvitaṃ gātumagniḥ |
4,055.04 indrāviṣṇū nṛvadu ṣu stavānā śarma no yantamamavadvarūtham ||
4,055.05  ā parvatasya marutāmavāṃsi devasya trāturavri bhagasya |
4,055.05 pātpatirjanyādaṃhaso no mitro mitriyāduta na uruṣyet ||
4,055.06  nū rodasī ahinā budhnyena stuvīta devī apyebhiriṣṭaiḥ |
4,055.06 samudraṃ na saṃcaraṇe saniṣyavo gharmasvaraso nadyo apa vran ||
4,055.07  devairno devyaditirni pātu devastrātā trāyatāmaprayucchan |
4,055.07 nahi mitrasya varuṇasya dhāsimarhāmasi pramiyaṃ sānvagneḥ ||
4,055.08  agnirīśe vasavyasyāgnirmahaḥ saubhagasya |
4,055.08 tānyasmabhyaṃ rāsate ||
4,055.09  uṣo maghonyā vaha sūnṛte vāryā puru |
4,055.09 asmabhyaṃ vājinīvati ||
4,055.10  tatsu naḥ savitā bhago varuṇo mitro aryamā |
4,055.10 indro no rādhasā gamat ||

4,056.01  mahī dyāvāpṛthivī iha jyeṣṭhe rucā bhavatāṃ śucayadbhirarkaiḥ |
4,056.01 yatsīṃ variṣṭhe bṛhatī viminvanruvaddhokṣā paprathānebhirevaiḥ ||
4,056.02  devī devebhiryajate yajatrairaminatī tasthaturukṣamāṇe |
4,056.02 ṛtāvarī adruhā devaputre yajñasya netrī śucayadbhirarkaiḥ ||
4,056.03  sa itsvapā bhuvaneṣvāsa ya ime dyāvāpṛthivī jajāna |
4,056.03 urvī gabhīre rajasī sumeke avaṃśe dhīraḥ śacyā samairat ||
4,056.04  nū rodasī bṛhadbhirno varūthaiḥ patnīvadbhiriṣayantī sajoṣāḥ |
4,056.04 urūcī viśve yajate ni pātaṃ dhiyā syāma rathyaḥ sadāsāḥ ||
4,056.05  pra vāṃ mahi dyavī abhyupastutiṃ bharāmahe |
4,056.05 śucī upa praśastaye ||
4,056.06  punāne tanvā mithaḥ svena dakṣeṇa rājathaḥ |
4,056.06 ūhyāthe sanādṛtam ||
4,056.07  mahī mitrasya sādhathastarantī pipratī ṛtam |
4,056.07 pari yajñaṃ ni ṣedathuḥ ||

4,057.01  kṣetrasya patinā vayaṃ hiteneva jayāmasi |
4,057.01 gāmaśvaṃ poṣayitnvā sa no mṛḻātīdṛśe ||
4,057.02  kṣetrasya pate madhumantamūrmiṃ dhenuriva payo asmāsu dhukṣva |
4,057.02 madhuścutaṃ ghṛtamiva supūtamṛtasya naḥ patayo mṛḻayantu ||
4,057.03  madhumatīroṣadhīrdyāva āpo madhumanno bhavatvantarikṣam |
4,057.03 kṣetrasya patirmadhumānno astvariṣyanto anvenaṃ carema ||
4,057.04  śunaṃ vāhāḥ śunaṃ naraḥ śunaṃ kṛṣatu lāṅgalam |
4,057.04 śunaṃ varatrā badhyantāṃ śunamaṣṭrāmudiṅgaya ||
4,057.05  śunāsīrāvimāṃ vācaṃ juṣethāṃ yaddivi cakrathuḥ payaḥ |
4,057.05 tenemāmupa siñcatam ||
4,057.06  arvācī subhage bhava sīte vandāmahe tvā |
4,057.06 yathā naḥ subhagāsasi yathā naḥ suphalāsasi ||
4,057.07  indraḥ sītāṃ ni gṛhṇātu tāṃ pūṣānu yacchatu |
4,057.07 sā naḥ payasvatī duhāmuttarāmuttarāṃ samām ||
4,057.08  śunaṃ naḥ phālā vi kṛṣantu bhūmiṃ śunaṃ kīnāśā abhi yantu vāhaiḥ |
4,057.08 śunaṃ parjanyo madhunā payobhiḥ śunāsīrā śunamasmāsu dhattam ||

4,058.01  samudrādūrmirmadhumāṃ udāradupāṃśunā samamṛtatvamānaṭ |
4,058.01 ghṛtasya nāma guhyaṃ yadasti jihvā devānāmamṛtasya nābhiḥ ||
4,058.02  vayaṃ nāma pra bravāmā ghṛtasyāsminyajñe dhārayāmā namobhiḥ |
4,058.02 upa brahmā śṛṇavacchasyamānaṃ catuḥśṛṅgo'vamīdgaura etat ||
4,058.03  catvāri śṛṅgā trayo asya pādā dve śīrṣe sapta hastāso asya |
4,058.03 tridhā baddho vṛṣabho roravīti maho devo martyāṃ ā viveśa ||
4,058.04  tridhā hitaṃ paṇibhirguhyamānaṃ gavi devāso ghṛtamanvavindan |
4,058.04 indra ekaṃ sūrya ekaṃ jajāna venādekaṃ svadhayā niṣṭatakṣuḥ ||
4,058.05  etā arṣanti hṛdyātsamudrācchatavrajā ripuṇā nāvacakṣe |
4,058.05 ghṛtasya dhārā abhi cākaśīmi hiraṇyayo vetaso madhya āsām ||
4,058.06  samyaksravanti sarito na dhenā antarhṛdā manasā pūyamānāḥ |
4,058.06 ete arṣantyūrmayo ghṛtasya mṛgā iva kṣipaṇorīṣamāṇāḥ ||
4,058.07  sindhoriva prādhvane śūghanāso vātapramiyaḥ patayanti yahvāḥ |
4,058.07 ghṛtasya dhārā aruṣo na vājī kāṣṭhā bhindannūrmibhiḥ pinvamānaḥ ||
4,058.08  abhi pravanta samaneva yoṣāḥ kalyāṇyaḥ smayamānāso agnim |
4,058.08 ghṛtasya dhārāḥ samidho nasanta tā juṣāṇo haryati jātavedāḥ ||
4,058.09  kanyā iva vahatumetavā u añjyañjānā abhi cākaśīmi |
4,058.09 yatra somaḥ sūyate yatra yajño ghṛtasya dhārā abhi tatpavante ||
4,058.10  abhyarṣata suṣṭutiṃ gavyamājimasmāsu bhadrā draviṇāni dhatta |
4,058.10 imaṃ yajñaṃ nayata devatā no ghṛtasya dhārā madhumatpavante ||
4,058.11  dhāmante viśvaṃ bhuvanamadhi śritamantaḥ samudre hṛdyantarāyuṣi |
4,058.11 apāmanīke samithe ya ābhṛtastamaśyāma madhumantaṃ ta ūrmim ||









ṛgveda 5






5,001.01  abodhyagniḥ samidhā janānāṃ prati dhenumivāyatīmuṣāsam |
5,001.01 yahvā iva pra vayāmujjihānāḥ pra bhānavaḥ sisrate nākamaccha ||
5,001.02  abodhi hotā yajathāya devānūrdhvo agniḥ sumanāḥ prātarasthāt |
5,001.02 samiddhasya ruśadadarśi pājo mahāndevastamaso niramoci ||
5,001.03  yadīṃ gaṇasya raśanāmajīgaḥ śuciraṅkte śucibhirgobhiragniḥ |
5,001.03 āddakṣiṇā yujyate vājayantyuttānāmūrdhvo adhayajjuhūbhiḥ ||
5,001.04  agnimacchā devayatāṃ manāṃsi cakṣūṃṣīva sūrye saṃ caranti |
5,001.04 yadīṃ suvāte uṣasā virūpe śveto vājī jāyate agre ahnām ||
5,001.05  janiṣṭa hi jenyo agre ahnāṃ hito hiteṣvaruṣo vaneṣu |
5,001.05 damedame sapta ratnā dadhāno'gnirhotā ni ṣasādā yajīyān ||
5,001.06  agnirhotā nyasīdadyajīyānupasthe mātuḥ surabhā u loke |
5,001.06 yuvā kaviḥ puruniṣṭha ṛtāvā dhartā kṛṣṭīnāmuta madhya iddhaḥ ||
5,001.07  pra ṇu tyaṃ vipramadhvareṣu sādhumagniṃ hotāramīḻate namobhiḥ |
5,001.07 ā yastatāna rodasī ṛtena nityaṃ mṛjanti vājinaṃ ghṛtena ||
5,001.08  mārjālyo mṛjyate sve damūnāḥ kavipraśasto atithiḥ śivo naḥ |
5,001.08 sahasraśṛṅgo vṛṣabhastadojā viśvāṃ agne sahasā prāsyanyān ||
5,001.09  pra sadyo agne atyeṣyanyānāviryasmai cārutamo babhūtha |
5,001.09 īḻenyo vapuṣyo vibhāvā priyo viśāmatithirmānuṣīṇām ||
5,001.10  tubhyaṃ bharanti kṣitayo yaviṣṭha balimagne antita ota dūrāt |
5,001.10 ā bhandiṣṭhasya sumatiṃ cikiddhi bṛhatte agne mahi śarma bhadram ||
5,001.11  ādya rathaṃ bhānumo bhānumantamagne tiṣṭha yajatebhiḥ samantam |
5,001.11 vidvānpathīnāmurvantarikṣameha devānhaviradyāya vakṣi ||
5,001.12  avocāma kavaye medhyāya vaco vandāru vṛṣabhāya vṛṣṇe |
5,001.12 gaviṣṭhiro namasā stomamagnau divīva rukmamuruvyañcamaśret ||

5,002.01  kumāraṃ mātā yuvatiḥ samubdhaṃ guhā bibharti na dadāti pitre |
5,002.01 anīkamasya na minajjanāsaḥ puraḥ paśyanti nihitamaratau ||
5,002.02  kametaṃ tvaṃ yuvate kumāraṃ peṣī bibharṣi mahiṣī jajāna |
5,002.02 pūrvīrhi garbhaḥ śarado vavardhāpaśyaṃ jātaṃ yadasūta mātā ||
5,002.03  hiraṇyadantaṃ śucivarṇamārātkṣetrādapaśyamāyudhā mimānam |
5,002.03 dadāno asmā amṛtaṃ vipṛkvatkiṃ māmanindrāḥ kṛṇavannanukthāḥ ||
5,002.04  kṣetrādapaśyaṃ sanutaścarantaṃ sumadyūthaṃ na puru śobhamānam |
5,002.04 na tā agṛbhrannajaniṣṭa hi ṣaḥ paliknīridyuvatayo bhavanti ||
5,002.05  ke me maryakaṃ vi yavanta gobhirna yeṣāṃ gopā araṇaścidāsa |
5,002.05 ya īṃ jagṛbhurava te sṛjantvājāti paśva upa naścikitvān ||
5,002.06  vasāṃ rājānaṃ vasatiṃ janānāmarātayo ni dadhurmartyeṣu |
5,002.06 brahmāṇyatrerava taṃ sṛjantu ninditāro nindyāso bhavantu ||
5,002.07  śunaścicchepaṃ niditaṃ sahasrādyūpādamuñco aśamiṣṭa hi ṣaḥ |
5,002.07 evāsmadagne vi mumugdhi pāśānhotaścikitva iha tū niṣadya ||
5,002.08  hṛṇīyamāno apa hi madaiyeḥ pra me devānāṃ vratapā uvāca |
5,002.08 indro vidvāṃ anu hi tvā cacakṣa tenāhamagne anuśiṣṭa āgām ||
5,002.09  vi jyotiṣā bṛhatā bhātyagnirāvirviśvāni kṛṇute mahitvā |
5,002.09 prādevīrmāyāḥ sahate durevāḥ śiśīte śṛṅge rakṣase vinikṣe ||
5,002.10  uta svānāso divi ṣantvagnestigmāyudhā rakṣase hantavā u |
5,002.10 made cidasya pra rujanti bhāmā na varante paribādho adevīḥ ||
5,002.11  etaṃ te stomaṃ tuvijāta vipro rathaṃ na dhīraḥ svapā atakṣam |
5,002.11 yadīdagne prati tvaṃ deva haryāḥ svarvatīrapa enā jayema ||
5,002.12  tuvigrīvo vṛṣabho vāvṛdhāno'śatrvaryaḥ samajāti vedaḥ |
5,002.12 itīmamagnimamṛtā avocanbarhiṣmate manave śarma yaṃsaddhaviṣmate manave śarma yaṃsat ||

5,003.01  tvamagne varuṇo jāyase yattvaṃ mitro bhavasi yatsamiddhaḥ |
5,003.01 tve viśve sahasasputra devāstvamindro dāśuṣe martyāya ||
5,003.02  tvamaryamā bhavasi yatkanīnāṃ nāma svadhāvanguhyaṃ bibharṣi |
5,003.02 añjanti mitraṃ sudhitaṃ na gobhiryaddampatī samanasā kṛṇoṣi ||
5,003.03  tava śriye maruto marjayanta rudra yatte janima cāru citram |
5,003.03 padaṃ yadviṣṇorupamaṃ nidhāyi tena pāsi guhyaṃ nāma gonām ||
5,003.04  tava śriyā sudṛśo deva devāḥ purū dadhānā amṛtaṃ sapanta |
5,003.04 hotāramagniṃ manuṣo ni ṣedurdaśasyanta uśijaḥ śaṃsamāyoḥ ||
5,003.05  na tvaddhotā pūrvo agne yajīyānna kāvyaiḥ paro asti svadhāvaḥ |
5,003.05 viśaśca yasyā atithirbhavāsi sa yajñena vanavaddeva martān ||
5,003.06  vayamagne vanuyāma tvotā vasūyavo haviṣā budhyamānāḥ |
5,003.06 vayaṃ samarye vidatheṣvahnāṃ vayaṃ rāyā sahasasputra martān ||
5,003.07  yo na āgo abhyeno bharātyadhīdaghamaghaśaṃse dadhāta |
5,003.07 jahī cikitvo abhiśastimetāmagne yo no marcayati dvayena ||
5,003.08  tvāmasyā vyuṣi deva pūrve dūtaṃ kṛṇvānā ayajanta havyaiḥ |
5,003.08 saṃsthe yadagna īyase rayīṇāṃ devo martairvasubhiridhyamānaḥ ||
5,003.09  ava spṛdhi pitaraṃ yodhi vidvānputro yaste sahasaḥ sūna ūhe |
5,003.09 kadā cikitvo abhi cakṣase no'gne kadāṃ ṛtacidyātayāse ||
5,003.10  bhūri nāma vandamāno dadhāti pitā vaso yadi tajjoṣayāse |
5,003.10 kuviddevasya sahasā cakānaḥ sumnamagnirvanate vāvṛdhānaḥ ||
5,003.11  tvamaṅga jaritāraṃ yaviṣṭha viśvānyagne duritāti parṣi |
5,003.11 stenā adṛśranripavo janāso'jñātaketā vṛjinā abhūvan ||
5,003.12  ime yāmāsastvadrigabhūvanvasave vā tadidāgo avāci |
5,003.12 nāhāyamagnirabhiśastaye no na rīṣate vāvṛdhānaḥ parā dāt ||

5,004.01  tvāmagne vasupatiṃ vasūnāmabhi pra mande adhvareṣu rājan |
5,004.01 tvayā vājaṃ vājayanto jayemābhi ṣyāma pṛtsutīrmartyānām ||
5,004.02  havyavāḻ agnirajaraḥ pitā no vibhurvibhāvā sudṛśīko asme |
5,004.02 sugārhapatyāḥ samiṣo didīhyasmadryaksaṃ mimīhi śravāṃsi ||
5,004.03  viśāṃ kaviṃ viśpatiṃ mānuṣīṇāṃ śuciṃ pāvakaṃ ghṛtapṛṣṭhamagnim |
5,004.03 ni hotāraṃ viśvavidaṃ dadhidhve sa deveṣu vanate vāryāṇi ||
5,004.04  juṣasvāgna iḻayā sajoṣā yatamāno raśmibhiḥ sūryasya |
5,004.04 juṣasva naḥ samidhaṃ jātaveda ā ca devānhaviradyāya vakṣi ||
5,004.05  juṣṭo damūnā atithirduroṇa imaṃ no yajñamupa yāhi vidvān |
5,004.05 viśvā agne abhiyujo vihatyā śatrūyatāmā bharā bhojanāni ||
5,004.06  vadhena dasyuṃ pra hi cātayasva vayaḥ kṛṇvānastanve svāyai |
5,004.06 piparṣi yatsahasasputra devāntso agne pāhi nṛtama vāje asmān ||
5,004.07  vayaṃ te agna ukthairvidhema vayaṃ havyaiḥ pāvaka bhadraśoce |
5,004.07 asme rayiṃ viśvavāraṃ saminvāsme viśvāni draviṇāni dhehi ||
5,004.08  asmākamagne adhvaraṃ juṣasva sahasaḥ sūno triṣadhastha havyam |
5,004.08 vayaṃ deveṣu sukṛtaḥ syāma śarmaṇā nastrivarūthena pāhi ||
5,004.09  viśvāni no durgahā jātavedaḥ sindhuṃ na nāvā duritāti parṣi |
5,004.09 agne atrivannamasā gṛṇāno'smākaṃ bodhyavitā tanūnām ||
5,004.10  yastvā hṛdā kīriṇā manyamāno'martyaṃ martyo johavīmi |
5,004.10 jātavedo yaśo asmāsu dhehi prajābhiragne amṛtatvamaśyām ||
5,004.11  yasmai tvaṃ sukṛte jātaveda u lokamagne kṛṇavaḥ syonam |
5,004.11 aśvinaṃ sa putriṇaṃ vīravantaṃ gomantaṃ rayiṃ naśate svasti ||

5,005.01  susamiddhāya śociṣe ghṛtaṃ tīvraṃ juhotana |
5,005.01 agnaye jātavedase ||
5,005.02  narāśaṃsaḥ suṣūdatīmaṃ yajñamadābhyaḥ |
5,005.02 kavirhi madhuhastyaḥ ||
5,005.03  īḻito agna ā vahendraṃ citramiha priyam |
5,005.03 sukhai rathebhirūtaye ||
5,005.04  ūrṇamradā vi prathasvābhyarkā anūṣata |
5,005.04 bhavā naḥ śubhra sātaye ||
5,005.05  devīrdvāro vi śrayadhvaṃ suprāyaṇā na ūtaye |
5,005.05 prapra yajñaṃ pṛṇītana ||
5,005.06  supratīke vayovṛdhā yahvī ṛtasya mātarā |
5,005.06 doṣāmuṣāsamīmahe ||
5,005.07  vātasya patmannīḻitā daivyā hotārā manuṣaḥ |
5,005.07 imaṃ no yajñamā gatam ||
5,005.08  iḻā sarasvatī mahī tisro devīrmayobhuvaḥ |
5,005.08 barhiḥ sīdantvasridhaḥ ||
5,005.09  śivastvaṣṭarihā gahi vibhuḥ poṣa uta tmanā |
5,005.09 yajñeyajñe na udava ||
5,005.10  yatra vettha vanaspate devānāṃ guhyā nāmāni |
5,005.10 tatra havyāni gāmaya ||
5,005.11  svāhāgnaye varuṇāya svāhendrāya marudbhyaḥ |
5,005.11 svāhā devebhyo haviḥ ||

5,006.01  agniṃ taṃ manye yo vasurastaṃ yaṃ yanti dhenavaḥ |
5,006.01 astamarvanta āśavo'staṃ nityāso vājina iṣaṃ stotṛbhya ā bhara ||
5,006.02  so agniryo vasurgṛṇe saṃ yamāyanti dhenavaḥ |
5,006.02 samarvanto raghudruvaḥ saṃ sujātāsaḥ sūraya iṣaṃ stotṛbhya ā bhara ||
5,006.03  agnirhi vājinaṃ viśe dadāti viśvacarṣaṇiḥ |
5,006.03 agnī rāye svābhuvaṃ sa prīto yāti vāryamiṣaṃ stotṛbhya ā bhara ||
5,006.04  ā te agna idhīmahi dyumantaṃ devājaram |
5,006.04 yaddha syā te panīyasī samiddīdayati dyavīṣaṃ stotṛbhya ā bhara ||
5,006.05  ā te agna ṛcā haviḥ śukrasya śociṣaspate |
5,006.05 suścandra dasma viśpate havyavāṭtubhyaṃ hūyata iṣaṃ stotṛbhya ā bhara ||
5,006.06  pro tye agnayo'gniṣu viśvaṃ puṣyanti vāryam |
5,006.06 te hinvire ta invire ta iṣaṇyantyānuṣagiṣaṃ stotṛbhya ā bhara ||
5,006.07  tava tye agne arcayo mahi vrādhanta vājinaḥ |
5,006.07 ye patvabhiḥ śaphānāṃ vrajā bhuranta gonāmiṣaṃ stotṛbhya ā bhara ||
5,006.08  navā no agna ā bhara stotṛbhyaḥ sukṣitīriṣaḥ |
5,006.08 te syāma ya ānṛcustvādūtāso damedama iṣaṃ stotṛbhya ā bhara ||
5,006.09  ubhe suścandra sarpiṣo darvī śrīṇīṣa āsani |
5,006.09 uto na utpupūryā uktheṣu śavasaspata iṣaṃ stotṛbhya ā bhara ||
5,006.10  evāṃ agnimajuryamurgīrbhiryajñebhirānuṣak |
5,006.10 dadhadasme suvīryamuta tyadāśvaśvyamiṣaṃ stotṛbhya ā bhara ||

5,007.01  sakhāyaḥ saṃ vaḥ samyañcamiṣaṃ stomaṃ cāgnaye |
5,007.01 varṣiṣṭhāya kṣitīnāmūrjo naptre sahasvate ||
5,007.02  kutrā cidyasya samṛtau raṇvā naro nṛṣadane |
5,007.02 arhantaścidyamindhate saṃjanayanti jantavaḥ ||
5,007.03  saṃ yadiṣo vanāmahe saṃ havyā mānuṣāṇām |
5,007.03 uta dyumnasya śavasa ṛtasya raśmimā dade ||
5,007.04  sa smā kṛṇoti ketumā naktaṃ ciddūra ā sate |
5,007.04 pāvako yadvanaspatīnpra smā minātyajaraḥ ||
5,007.05  ava sma yasya veṣaṇe svedaṃ pathiṣu juhvati |
5,007.05 abhīmaha svajenyaṃ bhūmā pṛṣṭheva ruruhuḥ ||
5,007.06  yaṃ martyaḥ puruspṛhaṃ vidadviśvasya dhāyase |
5,007.06 pra svādanaṃ pitūnāmastatātiṃ cidāyave ||
5,007.07  sa hi ṣmā dhanvākṣitaṃ dātā na dātyā paśuḥ |
5,007.07 hiriśmaśruḥ śucidannṛbhuranibhṛṣṭataviṣiḥ ||
5,007.08  śuciḥ ṣma yasmā atrivatpra svadhitīva rīyate |
5,007.08 suṣūrasūta mātā krāṇā yadānaśe bhagam ||
5,007.09  ā yaste sarpirāsute'gne śamasti dhāyase |
5,007.09 aiṣu dyumnamuta śrava ā cittaṃ martyeṣu dhāḥ ||
5,007.10  iti cinmanyumadhrijastvādātamā paśuṃ dade |
5,007.10 ādagne apṛṇato'triḥ sāsahyāddasyūniṣaḥ sāsahyānnṝn ||

5,008.01  tvāmagna ṛtāyavaḥ samīdhire pratnaṃ pratnāsa ūtaye sahaskṛta |
5,008.01 puruścandraṃ yajataṃ viśvadhāyasaṃ damūnasaṃ gṛhapatiṃ vareṇyam ||
5,008.02  tvāmagne atithiṃ pūrvyaṃ viśaḥ śociṣkeśaṃ gṛhapatiṃ ni ṣedire |
5,008.02 bṛhatketuṃ pururūpaṃ dhanaspṛtaṃ suśarmāṇaṃ svavasaṃ jaradviṣam ||
5,008.03  tvāmagne mānuṣīrīḻate viśo hotrāvidaṃ viviciṃ ratnadhātamam |
5,008.03 guhā santaṃ subhaga viśvadarśataṃ tuviṣvaṇasaṃ suyajaṃ ghṛtaśriyam ||
