5,008.04  tvāmagne dharṇasiṃ viśvadhā vayaṃ gīrbhirgṛṇanto namasopa sedima |
5,008.04 sa no juṣasva samidhāno aṅgiro devo martasya yaśasā sudītibhiḥ ||
5,008.05  tvamagne pururūpo viśeviśe vayo dadhāsi pratnathā puruṣṭuta |
5,008.05 purūṇyannā sahasā vi rājasi tviṣiḥ sā te titviṣāṇasya nādhṛṣe ||
5,008.06  tvāmagne samidhānaṃ yaviṣṭhya devā dūtaṃ cakrire havyavāhanam |
5,008.06 urujrayasaṃ ghṛtayonimāhutaṃ tveṣaṃ cakṣurdadhire codayanmati ||
5,008.07  tvāmagne pradiva āhutaṃ ghṛtaiḥ sumnāyavaḥ suṣamidhā samīdhire |
5,008.07 sa vāvṛdhāna oṣadhībhirukṣito'bhi jrayāṃsi pārthivā vi tiṣṭhase ||

5,009.01  tvāmagne haviṣmanto devaṃ martāsa īḻate |
5,009.01 manye tvā jātavedasaṃ sa havyā vakṣyānuṣak ||
5,009.02  agnirhotā dāsvataḥ kṣayasya vṛktabarhiṣaḥ |
5,009.02 saṃ yajñāsaścaranti yaṃ saṃ vājāsaḥ śravasyavaḥ ||
5,009.03  uta sma yaṃ śiśuṃ yathā navaṃ janiṣṭāraṇī |
5,009.03 dhartāraṃ mānuṣīṇāṃ viśāmagniṃ svadhvaram ||
5,009.04  uta sma durgṛbhīyase putro na hvāryāṇām |
5,009.04 purū yo dagdhāsi vanāgne paśurna yavase ||
5,009.05  adha sma yasyārcayaḥ samyaksaṃyanti dhūminaḥ |
5,009.05 yadīmaha trito divyupa dhmāteva dhamati śiśīte dhmātarī yathā ||
5,009.06  tavāhamagna ūtibhirmitrasya ca praśastibhiḥ |
5,009.06 dveṣoyuto na duritā turyāma martyānām ||
5,009.07  taṃ no agne abhī naro rayiṃ sahasva ā bhara |
5,009.07 sa kṣepayatsa poṣayadbhuvadvājasya sātaya utaidhi pṛtsu no vṛdhe ||

5,010.01  agna ojiṣṭhamā bhara dyumnamasmabhyamadhrigo |
5,010.01 pra no rāyā parīṇasā ratsi vājāya panthām ||
5,010.02  tvaṃ no agne adbhuta kratvā dakṣasya maṃhanā |
5,010.02 tve asuryamāruhatkrāṇā mitro na yajñiyaḥ ||
5,010.03  tvaṃ no agna eṣāṃ gayaṃ puṣṭiṃ ca vardhaya |
5,010.03 ye stomebhiḥ pra sūrayo naro maghānyānaśuḥ ||
5,010.04  ye agne candra te giraḥ śumbhantyaśvarādhasaḥ |
5,010.04 śuṣmebhiḥ śuṣmiṇo naro divaścidyeṣāṃ bṛhatsukīrtirbodhati tmanā ||
5,010.05  tava tye agne arcayo bhrājanto yanti dhṛṣṇuyā |
5,010.05 parijmāno na vidyutaḥ svāno ratho na vājayuḥ ||
5,010.06  nū no agna ūtaye sabādhasaśca rātaye |
5,010.06 asmākāsaśca sūrayo viśvā āśāstarīṣaṇi ||
5,010.07  tvaṃ no agne aṅgira stuta stavāna ā bhara |
5,010.07 hotarvibhvāsahaṃ rayiṃ stotṛbhya stavase ca na utaidhi pṛtsu no vṛdhe ||

5,011.01  janasya gopā ajaniṣṭa jāgṛviragniḥ sudakṣaḥ suvitāya navyase |
5,011.01 ghṛtapratīko bṛhatā divispṛśā dyumadvi bhāti bharatebhyaḥ śuciḥ ||
5,011.02  yajñasya ketuṃ prathamaṃ purohitamagniṃ narastriṣadhasthe samīdhire |
5,011.02 indreṇa devaiḥ sarathaṃ sa barhiṣi sīdanni hotā yajathāya sukratuḥ ||
5,011.03  asammṛṣṭo jāyase mātroḥ śucirmandraḥ kavirudatiṣṭho vivasvataḥ |
5,011.03 ghṛtena tvāvardhayannagna āhuta dhūmaste keturabhavaddivi śritaḥ ||
5,011.04  agnirno yajñamupa vetu sādhuyāgniṃ naro vi bharante gṛhegṛhe |
5,011.04 agnirdūto abhavaddhavyavāhano'gniṃ vṛṇānā vṛṇate kavikratum ||
5,011.05  tubhyedamagne madhumattamaṃ vacastubhyaṃ manīṣā iyamastu śaṃ hṛde |
5,011.05 tvāṃ giraḥ sindhumivāvanīrmahīrā pṛṇanti śavasā vardhayanti ca ||
5,011.06  tvāmagne aṅgiraso guhā hitamanvavindañchiśriyāṇaṃ vanevane |
5,011.06 sa jāyase mathyamānaḥ saho mahattvāmāhuḥ sahasasputramaṅgiraḥ ||

5,012.01  prāgnaye bṛhate yajñiyāya ṛtasya vṛṣṇe asurāya manma |
5,012.01 ghṛtaṃ na yajña āsye supūtaṃ giraṃ bhare vṛṣabhāya pratīcīm ||
5,012.02  ṛtaṃ cikitva ṛtamiccikiddhyṛtasya dhārā anu tṛndhi pūrvīḥ |
5,012.02 nāhaṃ yātuṃ sahasā na dvayena ṛtaṃ sapāmyaruṣasya vṛṣṇaḥ ||
5,012.03  kayā no agna ṛtayannṛtena bhuvo navedā ucathasya navyaḥ |
5,012.03 vedā me deva ṛtupā ṛtūnāṃ nāhaṃ patiṃ saniturasya rāyaḥ ||
5,012.04  ke te agne ripave bandhanāsaḥ ke pāyavaḥ saniṣanta dyumantaḥ |
5,012.04 ke dhāsimagne anṛtasya pānti ka āsato vacasaḥ santi gopāḥ ||
5,012.05  sakhāyaste viṣuṇā agna ete śivāsaḥ santo aśivā abhūvan |
5,012.05 adhūrṣata svayamete vacobhirṛjūyate vṛjināni bruvantaḥ ||
5,012.06  yaste agne namasā yajñamīṭṭa ṛtaṃ sa pātyaruṣasya vṛṣṇaḥ |
5,012.06 tasya kṣayaḥ pṛthurā sādhuretu prasarsrāṇasya nahuṣasya śeṣaḥ ||

5,013.01  arcantastvā havāmahe'rcantaḥ samidhīmahi |
5,013.01 agne arcanta ūtaye ||
5,013.02  agne stomaṃ manāmahe sidhramadya divispṛśaḥ |
5,013.02 devasya draviṇasyavaḥ ||
5,013.03  agnirjuṣata no giro hotā yo mānuṣeṣvā |
5,013.03 sa yakṣaddaivyaṃ janam ||
5,013.04  tvamagne saprathā asi juṣṭo hotā vareṇyaḥ |
5,013.04 tvayā yajñaṃ vi tanvate ||
5,013.05  tvāmagne vājasātamaṃ viprā vardhanti suṣṭutam |
5,013.05 sa no rāsva suvīryam ||
5,013.06  agne nemirarāṃ iva devāṃstvaṃ paribhūrasi |
5,013.06 ā rādhaścitramṛñjase ||

5,014.01  agniṃ stomena bodhaya samidhāno amartyam |
5,014.01 havyā deveṣu no dadhat ||
5,014.02  tamadhvareṣvīḻate devaṃ martā amartyam |
5,014.02 yajiṣṭhaṃ mānuṣe jane ||
5,014.03  taṃ hi śaśvanta īḻate srucā devaṃ ghṛtaścutā |
5,014.03 agniṃ havyāya voḻhave ||
5,014.04  agnirjāto arocata ghnandasyūñjyotiṣā tamaḥ |
5,014.04 avindadgā apaḥ svaḥ ||
5,014.05  agnimīḻenyaṃ kaviṃ ghṛtapṛṣṭhaṃ saparyata |
5,014.05 vetu me śṛṇavaddhavam ||
5,014.06  agniṃ ghṛtena vāvṛdhu stomebhirviśvacarṣaṇim |
5,014.06 svādhībhirvacasyubhiḥ ||

5,015.01  pra vedhase kavaye vedyāya giraṃ bhare yaśase pūrvyāya |
5,015.01 ghṛtaprasatto asuraḥ suśevo rāyo dhartā dharuṇo vasvo agniḥ ||
5,015.02  ṛtena ṛtaṃ dharuṇaṃ dhārayanta yajñasya śāke parame vyoman |
5,015.02 divo dharmandharuṇe seduṣo nṝñjātairajātāṃ abhi ye nanakṣuḥ ||
5,015.03  aṅhoyuvastanvastanvate vi vayo mahadduṣṭaraṃ pūrvyāya |
5,015.03 sa saṃvato navajātastuturyātsiṅhaṃ na kruddhamabhitaḥ pari ṣṭhuḥ ||
5,015.04  māteva yadbharase paprathāno janaṃjanaṃ dhāyase cakṣase ca |
5,015.04 vayovayo jarase yaddadhānaḥ pari tmanā viṣurūpo jigāsi ||
5,015.05  vājo nu te śavasaspātvantamuruṃ doghaṃ dharuṇaṃ deva rāyaḥ |
5,015.05 padaṃ na tāyurguhā dadhāno maho rāye citayannatrimaspaḥ ||

5,016.01  bṛhadvayo hi bhānave'rcā devāyāgnaye |
5,016.01 yaṃ mitraṃ na praśastibhirmartāso dadhire puraḥ ||
5,016.02  sa hi dyubhirjanānāṃ hotā dakṣasya bāhvoḥ |
5,016.02 vi havyamagnirānuṣagbhago na vāramṛṇvati ||
5,016.03  asya stome maghonaḥ sakhye vṛddhaśociṣaḥ |
5,016.03 viśvā yasmintuviṣvaṇi samarye śuṣmamādadhuḥ ||
5,016.04  adhā hyagna eṣāṃ suvīryasya maṃhanā |
5,016.04 tamidyahvaṃ na rodasī pari śravo babhūvatuḥ ||
5,016.05  nū na ehi vāryamagne gṛṇāna ā bhara |
5,016.05 ye vayaṃ ye ca sūrayaḥ svasti dhāmahe sacotaidhi pṛtsu no vṛdhe ||

5,017.01  ā yajñairdeva martya itthā tavyāṃsamūtaye |
5,017.01 agniṃ kṛte svadhvare pūrurīḻītāvase ||
5,017.02  asya hi svayaśastara āsā vidharmanmanyase |
5,017.02 taṃ nākaṃ citraśociṣaṃ mandraṃ paro manīṣayā ||
5,017.03  asya vāsā u arciṣā ya āyukta tujā girā |
5,017.03 divo na yasya retasā bṛhacchocantyarcayaḥ ||
5,017.04  asya kratvā vicetaso dasmasya vasu ratha ā |
5,017.04 adhā viśvāsu havyo'gnirvikṣu pra śasyate ||
5,017.05  nū na iddhi vāryamāsā sacanta sūrayaḥ |
5,017.05 ūrjo napādabhiṣṭaye pāhi śagdhi svastaya utaidhi pṛtsu no vṛdhe ||

5,018.01  prātaragniḥ purupriyo viśa stavetātithiḥ |
5,018.01 viśvāni yo amartyo havyā marteṣu raṇyati ||
5,018.02  dvitāya mṛktavāhase svasya dakṣasya maṃhanā |
5,018.02 induṃ sa dhatta ānuṣakstotā citte amartya ||
5,018.03  taṃ vo dīrghāyuśociṣaṃ girā huve maghonām |
5,018.03 ariṣṭo yeṣāṃ ratho vyaśvadāvannīyate ||
5,018.04  citrā vā yeṣu dīdhitirāsannukthā pānti ye |
5,018.04 stīrṇaṃ barhiḥ svarṇare śravāṃsi dadhire pari ||
5,018.05  ye me pañcāśataṃ daduraśvānāṃ sadhastuti |
5,018.05 dyumadagne mahi śravo bṛhatkṛdhi maghonāṃ nṛvadamṛta nṛṇām ||

5,019.01  abhyavasthāḥ pra jāyante pra vavrervavriściketa |
5,019.01 upasthe māturvi caṣṭe ||
5,019.02  juhure vi citayanto'nimiṣaṃ nṛmṇaṃ pānti |
5,019.02 ā dṛḻhāṃ puraṃ viviśuḥ ||
5,019.03  ā śvaitreyasya jantavo dyumadvardhanta kṛṣṭayaḥ |
5,019.03 niṣkagrīvo bṛhaduktha enā madhvā na vājayuḥ ||
5,019.04  priyaṃ dugdhaṃ na kāmyamajāmi jāmyoḥ sacā |
5,019.04 gharmo na vājajaṭharo'dabdhaḥ śaśvato dabhaḥ ||
5,019.05  krīḻanno raśma ā bhuvaḥ saṃ bhasmanā vāyunā vevidānaḥ |
5,019.05 tā asya sandhṛṣajo na tigmāḥ susaṃśitā vakṣyo vakṣaṇesthāḥ ||

5,020.01  yamagne vājasātama tvaṃ cinmanyase rayim |
5,020.01 taṃ no gīrbhiḥ śravāyyaṃ devatrā panayā yujam ||
5,020.02  ye agne nerayanti te vṛddhā ugrasya śavasaḥ |
5,020.02 apa dveṣo apa hvaro'nyavratasya saścire ||
5,020.03  hotāraṃ tvā vṛṇīmahe'gne dakṣasya sādhanam |
5,020.03 yajñeṣu pūrvyaṃ girā prayasvanto havāmahe ||
5,020.04  itthā yathā ta ūtaye sahasāvandivedive |
5,020.04 rāya ṛtāya sukrato gobhiḥ ṣyāma sadhamādo vīraiḥ syāma sadhamādaḥ ||

5,021.01  manuṣvattvā ni dhīmahi manuṣvatsamidhīmahi |
5,021.01 agne manuṣvadaṅgiro devāndevayate yaja ||
5,021.02  tvaṃ hi mānuṣe jane'gne suprīta idhyase |
5,021.02 srucastvā yantyānuṣaksujāta sarpirāsute ||
5,021.03  tvāṃ viśve sajoṣaso devāso dūtamakrata |
5,021.03 saparyantastvā kave yajñeṣu devamīḻate ||
5,021.04  devaṃ vo devayajyayāgnimīḻīta martyaḥ |
5,021.04 samiddhaḥ śukra dīdihyṛtasya yonimāsadaḥ sasasya yonimāsadaḥ ||

5,022.01  pra viśvasāmannatrivadarcā pāvakaśociṣe |
5,022.01 yo adhvareṣvīḍyo hotā mandratamo viśi ||
5,022.02  nyagniṃ jātavedasaṃ dadhātā devamṛtvijam |
5,022.02 pra yajña etvānuṣagadyā devavyacastamaḥ ||
5,022.03  cikitvinmanasaṃ tvā devaṃ martāsa ūtaye |
5,022.03 vareṇyasya te'vasa iyānāso amanmahi ||
5,022.04  agne cikiddhyasya na idaṃ vacaḥ sahasya |
5,022.04 taṃ tvā suśipra dampate stomairvardhantyatrayo gīrbhiḥ śumbhantyatrayaḥ ||

5,023.01  agne sahantamā bhara dyumnasya prāsahā rayim |
5,023.01 viśvā yaścarṣaṇīrabhyāsā vājeṣu sāsahat ||
5,023.02  tamagne pṛtanāṣahaṃ rayiṃ sahasva ā bhara |
5,023.02 tvaṃ hi satyo adbhuto dātā vājasya gomataḥ ||
5,023.03  viśve hi tvā sajoṣaso janāso vṛktabarhiṣaḥ |
5,023.03 hotāraṃ sadmasu priyaṃ vyanti vāryā puru ||
5,023.04  sa hi ṣmā viśvacarṣaṇirabhimāti saho dadhe |
5,023.04 agna eṣu kṣayeṣvā revannaḥ śukra dīdihi dyumatpāvaka dīdihi ||

5,024.01  agne tvaṃ no antama uta trātā śivo bhavā varūthyaḥ ||
5,024.02  vasuragnirvasuśravā acchā nakṣi dyumattamaṃ rayiṃ dāḥ ||
5,024.03  sa no bodhi śrudhī havamuruṣyā ṇo aghāyataḥ samasmāt ||
5,024.04  taṃ tvā śociṣṭha dīdivaḥ sumnāya nūnamīmahe sakhibhyaḥ ||

5,025.01  acchā vo agnimavase devaṃ gāsi sa no vasuḥ |
5,025.01 rāsatputra ṛṣūṇāmṛtāvā parṣati dviṣaḥ ||
5,025.02  sa hi satyo yaṃ pūrve ciddevāsaścidyamīdhire |
5,025.02 hotāraṃ mandrajihvamitsudītibhirvibhāvasum ||
5,025.03  sa no dhītī variṣṭhayā śreṣṭhayā ca sumatyā |
5,025.03 agne rāyo didīhi naḥ suvṛktibhirvareṇya ||
5,025.04  agnirdeveṣu rājatyagnirmarteṣvāviśan |
5,025.04 agnirno havyavāhano'gniṃ dhībhiḥ saparyata ||
5,025.05  agnistuviśravastamaṃ tuvibrahmāṇamuttamam |
5,025.05 atūrtaṃ śrāvayatpatiṃ putraṃ dadāti dāśuṣe ||
5,025.06  agnirdadāti satpatiṃ sāsāha yo yudhā nṛbhiḥ |
5,025.06 agniratyaṃ raghuṣyadaṃ jetāramaparājitam ||
5,025.07  yadvāhiṣṭhaṃ tadagnaye bṛhadarca vibhāvaso |
5,025.07 mahiṣīva tvadrayistvadvājā udīrate ||
5,025.08  tava dyumanto arcayo grāvevocyate bṛhat |
5,025.08 uto te tanyaturyathā svāno arta tmanā divaḥ ||
5,025.09  evāṃ agniṃ vasūyavaḥ sahasānaṃ vavandima |
5,025.09 sa no viśvā ati dviṣaḥ parṣannāveva sukratuḥ ||

5,026.01  agne pāvaka rociṣā mandrayā deva jihvayā |
5,026.01 ā devānvakṣi yakṣi ca ||
5,026.02  taṃ tvā ghṛtasnavīmahe citrabhāno svardṛśam |
5,026.02 devāṃ ā vītaye vaha ||
5,026.03  vītihotraṃ tvā kave dyumantaṃ samidhīmahi |
5,026.03 agne bṛhantamadhvare ||
5,026.04  agne viśvebhirā gahi devebhirhavyadātaye |
5,026.04 hotāraṃ tvā vṛṇīmahe ||
5,026.05  yajamānāya sunvata āgne suvīryaṃ vaha |
5,026.05 devairā satsi barhiṣi ||
5,026.06  samidhānaḥ sahasrajidagne dharmāṇi puṣyasi |
5,026.06 devānāṃ dūta ukthyaḥ ||
5,026.07  nyagniṃ jātavedasaṃ hotravāhaṃ yaviṣṭhyam |
5,026.07 dadhātā devamṛtvijam ||
5,026.08  pra yajña etvānuṣagadyā devavyacastamaḥ |
5,026.08 stṛṇīta barhirāsade ||
5,026.09  edaṃ maruto aśvinā mitraḥ sīdantu varuṇaḥ |
5,026.09 devāsaḥ sarvayā viśā ||

5,027.01  anasvantā satpatirmāmahe me gāvā cetiṣṭho asuro maghonaḥ |
5,027.01 traivṛṣṇo agne daśabhiḥ sahasrairvaiśvānara tryaruṇaściketa ||
5,027.02  yo me śatā ca viṃśatiṃ ca gonāṃ harī ca yuktā sudhurā dadāti |
5,027.02 vaiśvānara suṣṭuto vāvṛdhāno'gne yaccha tryaruṇāya śarma ||
5,027.03  evā te agne sumatiṃ cakāno naviṣṭhāya navamaṃ trasadasyuḥ |
5,027.03 yo me girastuvijātasya pūrvīryuktenābhi tryaruṇo gṛṇāti ||
5,027.04  yo ma iti pravocatyaśvamedhāya sūraye |
5,027.04 dadadṛcā saniṃ yate dadanmedhāmṛtāyate ||
5,027.05  yasya mā paruṣāḥ śatamuddharṣayantyukṣaṇaḥ |
5,027.05 aśvamedhasya dānāḥ somā iva tryāśiraḥ ||
5,027.06  indrāgnī śatadāvnyaśvamedhe suvīryam |
5,027.06 kṣatraṃ dhārayataṃ bṛhaddivi sūryamivājaram ||

5,028.01  samiddho agnirdivi śociraśretpratyaṅṅuṣasamurviyā vi bhāti |
5,028.01 eti prācī viśvavārā namobhirdevāṃ īḻānā haviṣā ghṛtācī ||
5,028.02  samidhyamāno amṛtasya rājasi haviṣkṛṇvantaṃ sacase svastaye |
5,028.02 viśvaṃ sa dhatte draviṇaṃ yaminvasyātithyamagne ni ca dhatta itpuraḥ ||
5,028.03  agne śardha mahate saubhagāya tava dyumnānyuttamāni santu |
5,028.03 saṃ jāspatyaṃ suyamamā kṛṇuṣva śatrūyatāmabhi tiṣṭhā mahāṃsi ||
5,028.04  samiddhasya pramahaso'gne vande tava śriyam |
5,028.04 vṛṣabho dyumnavāṃ asi samadhvareṣvidhyase ||
5,028.05  samiddho agna āhuta devānyakṣi svadhvara |
5,028.05 tvaṃ hi havyavāḻ asi ||
5,028.06  ā juhotā duvasyatāgniṃ prayatyadhvare |
5,028.06 vṛṇīdhvaṃ havyavāhanam ||

5,029.01  tryaryamā manuṣo devatātā trī rocanā divyā dhārayanta |
5,029.01 arcanti tvā marutaḥ pūtadakṣāstvameṣāmṛṣirindrāsi dhīraḥ ||
5,029.02  anu yadīṃ maruto mandasānamārcannindraṃ papivāṃsaṃ sutasya |
5,029.02 ādatta vajramabhi yadahiṃ hannapo yahvīrasṛjatsartavā u ||
5,029.03  uta brahmāṇo maruto me asyendraḥ somasya suṣutasya peyāḥ |
5,029.03 taddhi havyaṃ manuṣe gā avindadahannahiṃ papivāṃ indro asya ||
5,029.04  ādrodasī vitaraṃ vi ṣkabhāyatsaṃvivyānaścidbhiyase mṛgaṃ kaḥ |
5,029.04 jigartimindro apajargurāṇaḥ prati śvasantamava dānavaṃ han ||
5,029.05  adha kratvā maghavantubhyaṃ devā anu viśve adaduḥ somapeyam |
5,029.05 yatsūryasya haritaḥ patantīḥ puraḥ satīruparā etaśe kaḥ ||
5,029.06  nava yadasya navatiṃ ca bhogānsākaṃ vajreṇa maghavā vivṛścat |
5,029.06 arcantīndraṃ marutaḥ sadhasthe traiṣṭubhena vacasā bādhata dyām ||
5,029.07  sakhā sakhye apacattūyamagnirasya kratvā mahiṣā trī śatāni |
5,029.07 trī sākamindro manuṣaḥ sarāṃsi sutaṃ pibadvṛtrahatyāya somam ||
5,029.08  trī yacchatā mahiṣāṇāmagho māstrī sarāṃsi maghavā somyāpāḥ |
5,029.08 kāraṃ na viśve ahvanta devā bharamindrāya yadahiṃ jaghāna ||
5,029.09  uśanā yatsahasyairayātaṃ gṛhamindra jūjuvānebhiraśvaiḥ |
5,029.09 vanvāno atra sarathaṃ yayātha kutsena devairavanorha śuṣṇam ||
5,029.10  prānyaccakramavṛhaḥ sūryasya kutsāyānyadvarivo yātave'kaḥ |
5,029.10 anāso dasyūṃramṛṇo vadhena ni duryoṇa āvṛṇaṅmṛdhravācaḥ ||
5,029.11  stomāsastvā gaurivīteravardhannarandhayo vaidathināya piprum |
5,029.11 ā tvāmṛjiśvā sakhyāya cakre pacanpaktīrapibaḥ somamasya ||
5,029.12  navagvāsaḥ sutasomāsa indraṃ daśagvāso abhyarcantyarkaiḥ |
5,029.12 gavyaṃ cidūrvamapidhānavantaṃ taṃ cinnaraḥ śaśamānā apa vran ||
5,029.13  katho nu te pari carāṇi vidvānvīryā maghavanyā cakartha |
5,029.13 yā co nu navyā kṛṇavaḥ śaviṣṭha predu tā te vidatheṣu bravāma ||
5,029.14  etā viśvā cakṛvāṃ indra bhūryaparīto januṣā vīryeṇa |
5,029.14 yā cinnu vajrinkṛṇavo dadhṛṣvānna te vartā taviṣyā asti tasyāḥ ||
5,029.15  indra brahma kriyamāṇā juṣasva yā te śaviṣṭha navyā akarma |
5,029.15 vastreva bhadrā sukṛtā vasūyū rathaṃ na dhīraḥ svapā atakṣam ||

5,030.01  kva sya vīraḥ ko apaśyadindraṃ sukharathamīyamānaṃ haribhyām |
5,030.01 yo rāyā vajrī sutasomamicchantadoko gantā puruhūta ūtī ||
5,030.02  avācacakṣaṃ padamasya sasvarugraṃ nidhāturanvāyamicchan |
5,030.02 apṛcchamanyāṃ uta te ma āhurindraṃ naro bubudhānā aśema ||
5,030.03  pra nu vayaṃ sute yā te kṛtānīndra bravāma yāni no jujoṣaḥ |
5,030.03 vedadavidvāñchṛṇavacca vidvānvahate'yaṃ maghavā sarvasenaḥ ||
5,030.04  sthiraṃ manaścakṛṣe jāta indra veṣīdeko yudhaye bhūyasaścit |
5,030.04 aśmānaṃ cicchavasā didyuto vi vido gavāmūrvamusriyāṇām ||
5,030.05  paro yattvaṃ parama ājaniṣṭhāḥ parāvati śrutyaṃ nāma bibhrat |
5,030.05 ataścidindrādabhayanta devā viśvā apo ajayaddāsapatnīḥ ||
5,030.06  tubhyedete marutaḥ suśevā arcantyarkaṃ sunvantyandhaḥ |
5,030.06 ahimohānamapa āśayānaṃ pra māyābhirmāyinaṃ sakṣadindraḥ ||
5,030.07  vi ṣū mṛdho januṣā dānaminvannahangavā maghavansaṃcakānaḥ |
5,030.07 atrā dāsasya namuceḥ śiro yadavartayo manave gātumicchan ||
5,030.08  yujaṃ hi māmakṛthā ādidindra śiro dāsasya namucermathāyan |
5,030.08 aśmānaṃ citsvaryaṃ vartamānaṃ pra cakriyeva rodasī marudbhyaḥ ||
5,030.09  striyo hi dāsa āyudhāni cakre kiṃ mā karannabalā asya senāḥ |
5,030.09 antarhyakhyadubhe asya dhene athopa praidyudhaye dasyumindraḥ ||
5,030.10  samatra gāvo'bhito'navanteheha vatsairviyutā yadāsan |
5,030.10 saṃ tā indro asṛjadasya śākairyadīṃ somāsaḥ suṣutā amandan ||
5,030.11  yadīṃ somā babhrudhūtā amandannaroravīdvṛṣabhaḥ sādaneṣu |
5,030.11 purandaraḥ papivāṃ indro asya punargavāmadadādusriyāṇām ||
5,030.12  bhadramidaṃ ruśamā agne akrangavāṃ catvāri dadataḥ sahasrā |
5,030.12 ṛṇañcayasya prayatā maghāni pratyagrabhīṣma nṛtamasya nṛṇām ||
5,030.13  supeśasaṃ māva sṛjantyastaṃ gavāṃ sahasrai ruśamāso agne |
5,030.13 tīvrā indramamamanduḥ sutāso'ktorvyuṣṭau paritakmyāyāḥ ||
5,030.14  aucchatsā rātrī paritakmyā yāṃ ṛṇañcaye rājani ruśamānām |
5,030.14 atyo na vājī raghurajyamāno babhruścatvāryasanatsahasrā ||
5,030.15  catuḥsahasraṃ gavyasya paśvaḥ pratyagrabhīṣma ruśameṣvagne |
5,030.15 gharmaścittaptaḥ pravṛje ya āsīdayasmayastaṃ vādāma viprāḥ ||

5,031.01  indro rathāya pravataṃ kṛṇoti yamadhyasthānmaghavā vājayantam |
5,031.01 yūtheva paśvo vyunoti gopā ariṣṭo yāti prathamaḥ siṣāsan ||
5,031.02  ā pra drava harivo mā vi venaḥ piśaṅgarāte abhi naḥ sacasva |
5,031.02 nahi tvadindra vasyo anyadastyamenāṃścijjanivataścakartha ||
5,031.03  udyatsahaḥ sahasa ājaniṣṭa dediṣṭa indra indriyāṇi viśvā |
5,031.03 prācodayatsudughā vavre antarvi jyotiṣā saṃvavṛtvattamo'vaḥ ||
5,031.04  anavaste rathamaśvāya takṣantvaṣṭā vajraṃ puruhūta dyumantam |
5,031.04 brahmāṇa indraṃ mahayanto arkairavardhayannahaye hantavā u ||
5,031.05  vṛṣṇe yatte vṛṣaṇo arkamarcānindra grāvāṇo aditiḥ sajoṣāḥ |
5,031.05 anaśvāso ye pavayo'rathā indreṣitā abhyavartanta dasyūn ||
5,031.06  pra te pūrvāṇi karaṇāni vocaṃ pra nūtanā maghavanyā cakartha |
5,031.06 śaktīvo yadvibharā rodasī ubhe jayannapo manave dānucitrāḥ ||
5,031.07  tadinnu te karaṇaṃ dasma viprāhiṃ yadghnannojo atrāmimīthāḥ |
5,031.07 śuṣṇasya citpari māyā agṛbhṇāḥ prapitvaṃ yannapa dasyūṃrasedhaḥ ||
5,031.08  tvamapo yadave turvaśāyāramayaḥ sudughāḥ pāra indra |
5,031.08 ugramayātamavaho ha kutsaṃ saṃ ha yadvāmuśanāranta devāḥ ||
5,031.09  indrākutsā vahamānā rathenā vāmatyā api karṇe vahantu |
5,031.09 niḥ ṣīmadbhyo dhamatho niḥ ṣadhasthānmaghono hṛdo varathastamāṃsi ||
5,031.10  vātasya yuktānsuyujaścidaśvānkaviścideṣo ajagannavasyuḥ |
5,031.10 viśve te atra marutaḥ sakhāya indra brahmāṇi taviṣīmavardhan ||
5,031.11  sūraścidrathaṃ paritakmyāyāṃ pūrvaṃ karaduparaṃ jūjuvāṃsam |
5,031.11 bharaccakrametaśaḥ saṃ riṇāti puro dadhatsaniṣyati kratuṃ naḥ ||
5,031.12  āyaṃ janā abhicakṣe jagāmendraḥ sakhāyaṃ sutasomamicchan |
5,031.12 vadangrāvāva vediṃ bhriyāte yasya jīramadhvaryavaścaranti ||
5,031.13  ye cākananta cākananta nū te martā amṛta mo te aṃha āran |
5,031.13 vāvandhi yajyūṃruta teṣu dhehyojo janeṣu yeṣu te syāma ||

5,032.01  adardarutsamasṛjo vi khāni tvamarṇavānbadbadhānāṃ aramṇāḥ |
5,032.01 mahāntamindra parvataṃ vi yadvaḥ sṛjo vi dhārā ava dānavaṃ han ||
5,032.02  tvamutsāṃ ṛtubhirbadbadhānāṃ araṃha ūdhaḥ parvatasya vajrin |
5,032.02 ahiṃ cidugra prayutaṃ śayānaṃ jaghanvāṃ indra taviṣīmadhatthāḥ ||
5,032.03  tyasya cinmahato nirmṛgasya vadharjaghāna taviṣībhirindraḥ |
5,032.03 ya eka idapratirmanyamāna ādasmādanyo ajaniṣṭa tavyān ||
5,032.04  tyaṃ cideṣāṃ svadhayā madantaṃ miho napātaṃ suvṛdhaṃ tamogām |
5,032.04 vṛṣaprabharmā dānavasya bhāmaṃ vajreṇa vajrī ni jaghāna śuṣṇam ||
5,032.05  tyaṃ cidasya kratubhirniṣattamamarmaṇo vidadidasya marma |
5,032.05 yadīṃ sukṣatra prabhṛtā madasya yuyutsantaṃ tamasi harmye dhāḥ ||
5,032.06  tyaṃ ciditthā katpayaṃ śayānamasūrye tamasi vāvṛdhānam |
5,032.06 taṃ cinmandāno vṛṣabhaḥ sutasyoccairindro apagūryā jaghāna ||
5,032.07  udyadindro mahate dānavāya vadharyamiṣṭa saho apratītam |
5,032.07 yadīṃ vajrasya prabhṛtau dadābha viśvasya jantoradhamaṃ cakāra ||
5,032.08  tyaṃ cidarṇaṃ madhupaṃ śayānamasinvaṃ vavraṃ mahyādadugraḥ |
5,032.08 apādamatraṃ mahatā vadhena ni duryoṇa āvṛṇaṅmṛdhravācam ||
5,032.09  ko asya śuṣmaṃ taviṣīṃ varāta eko dhanā bharate apratītaḥ |
5,032.09 ime cidasya jrayaso nu devī indrasyaujaso bhiyasā jihāte ||
5,032.10  nyasmai devī svadhitirjihīta indrāya gāturuśatīva yeme |
5,032.10 saṃ yadojo yuvate viśvamābhiranu svadhāvne kṣitayo namanta ||
5,032.11  ekaṃ nu tvā satpatiṃ pāñcajanyaṃ jātaṃ śṛṇomi yaśasaṃ janeṣu |
5,032.11 taṃ me jagṛbhra āśaso naviṣṭhaṃ doṣā vastorhavamānāsa indram ||
5,032.12  evā hi tvāmṛtuthā yātayantaṃ maghā viprebhyo dadataṃ śṛṇomi |
5,032.12 kiṃ te brahmāṇo gṛhate sakhāyo ye tvāyā nidadhuḥ kāmamindra ||

5,033.01  mahi mahe tavase dīdhye nṝnindrāyetthā tavase atavyān |
5,033.01 yo asmai sumatiṃ vājasātau stuto jane samaryaściketa ||
5,033.02  sa tvaṃ na indra dhiyasāno arkairharīṇāṃ vṛṣanyoktramaśreḥ |
5,033.02 yā itthā maghavannanu joṣaṃ vakṣo abhi prāryaḥ sakṣi janān ||
5,033.03  na te ta indrābhyasmadṛṣvāyuktāso abrahmatā yadasan |
5,033.03 tiṣṭhā rathamadhi taṃ vajrahastā raśmiṃ deva yamase svaśvaḥ ||
5,033.04  purū yatta indra santyukthā gave cakarthorvarāsu yudhyan |
5,033.04 tatakṣe sūryāya cidokasi sve vṛṣā samatsu dāsasya nāma cit ||
5,033.05  vayaṃ te ta indra ye ca naraḥ śardho jajñānā yātāśca rathāḥ |
5,033.05 āsmāñjagamyādahiśuṣma satvā bhago na havyaḥ prabhṛtheṣu cāruḥ ||
5,033.06  papṛkṣeṇyamindra tve hyojo nṛmṇāni ca nṛtamāno amartaḥ |
5,033.06 sa na enīṃ vasavāno rayiṃ dāḥ prārya stuṣe tuvimaghasya dānam ||
5,033.07  evā na indrotibhirava pāhi gṛṇataḥ śūra kārūn |
5,033.07 uta tvacaṃ dadato vājasātau piprīhi madhvaḥ suṣutasya cāroḥ ||
5,033.08  uta tye mā paurukutsyasya sūrestrasadasyorhiraṇino rarāṇāḥ |
5,033.08 vahantu mā daśa śyetāso asya gairikṣitasya kratubhirnu saśce ||
5,033.09  uta tye mā mārutāśvasya śoṇāḥ kratvāmaghāso vidathasya rātau |
5,033.09 sahasrā me cyavatāno dadāna ānūkamaryo vapuṣe nārcat ||
5,033.10  uta tye mā dhvanyasya juṣṭā lakṣmaṇyasya suruco yatānāḥ |
5,033.10 mahnā rāyaḥ saṃvaraṇasya ṛṣervrajaṃ na gāvaḥ prayatā api gman ||

5,034.01  ajātaśatrumajarā svarvatyanu svadhāmitā dasmamīyate |
5,034.01 sunotana pacata brahmavāhase puruṣṭutāya prataraṃ dadhātana ||
5,034.02  ā yaḥ somena jaṭharamapipratāmandata maghavā madhvo andhasaḥ |
5,034.02 yadīṃ mṛgāya hantave mahāvadhaḥ sahasrabhṛṣṭimuśanā vadhaṃ yamat ||
5,034.03  yo asmai ghraṃsa uta vā ya ūdhani somaṃ sunoti bhavati dyumāṃ aha |
5,034.03 apāpa śakrastatanuṣṭimūhati tanūśubhraṃ maghavā yaḥ kavāsakhaḥ ||
5,034.04  yasyāvadhītpitaraṃ yasya mātaraṃ yasya śakro bhrātaraṃ nāta īṣate |
5,034.04 vetīdvasya prayatā yataṅkaro na kilbiṣādīṣate vasva ākaraḥ ||
5,034.05  na pañcabhirdaśabhirvaṣṭyārabhaṃ nāsunvatā sacate puṣyatā cana |
5,034.05 jināti vedamuyā hanti vā dhunirā devayuṃ bhajati gomati vraje ||
5,034.06  vitvakṣaṇaḥ samṛtau cakramāsajo'sunvato viṣuṇaḥ sunvato vṛdhaḥ |
5,034.06 indro viśvasya damitā vibhīṣaṇo yathāvaśaṃ nayati dāsamāryaḥ ||
5,034.07  samīṃ paṇerajati bhojanaṃ muṣe vi dāśuṣe bhajati sūnaraṃ vasu |
5,034.07 durge cana dhriyate viśva ā puru jano yo asya taviṣīmacukrudhat ||
5,034.08  saṃ yajjanau sudhanau viśvaśardhasāvavedindro maghavā goṣu śubhriṣu |
5,034.08 yujaṃ hyanyamakṛta pravepanyudīṃ gavyaṃ sṛjate satvabhirdhuniḥ ||
5,034.09  sahasrasāmāgniveśiṃ gṛṇīṣe śatrimagna upamāṃ ketumaryaḥ |
5,034.09 tasmā āpaḥ saṃyataḥ pīpayanta tasminkṣatramamavattveṣamastu ||

5,035.01  yaste sādhiṣṭho'vasa indra kratuṣṭamā bhara |
5,035.01 asmabhyaṃ carṣaṇīsahaṃ sasniṃ vājeṣu duṣṭaram ||
5,035.02  yadindra te catasro yacchūra santi tisraḥ |
5,035.02 yadvā pañca kṣitīnāmavastatsu na ā bhara ||
5,035.03  ā te'vo vareṇyaṃ vṛṣantamasya hūmahe |
5,035.03 vṛṣajūtirhi jajñiṣa ābhūbhirindra turvaṇiḥ ||
5,035.04  vṛṣā hyasi rādhase jajñiṣe vṛṣṇi te śavaḥ |
5,035.04 svakṣatraṃ te dhṛṣanmanaḥ satrāhamindra pauṃsyam ||
5,035.05  tvaṃ tamindra martyamamitrayantamadrivaḥ |
5,035.05 sarvarathā śatakrato ni yāhi śavasaspate ||
5,035.06  tvāmidvṛtrahantama janāso vṛktabarhiṣaḥ |
5,035.06 ugraṃ pūrvīṣu pūrvyaṃ havante vājasātaye ||
5,035.07  asmākamindra duṣṭaraṃ puroyāvānamājiṣu |
5,035.07 sayāvānaṃ dhanedhane vājayantamavā ratham ||
5,035.08  asmākamindrehi no rathamavā purandhyā |
5,035.08 vayaṃ śaviṣṭha vāryaṃ divi śravo dadhīmahi divi stomaṃ manāmahe ||

5,036.01  sa ā gamadindro yo vasūnāṃ ciketaddātuṃ dāmano rayīṇām |
5,036.01 dhanvacaro na vaṃsagastṛṣāṇaścakamānaḥ pibatu dugdhamaṃśum ||
5,036.02  ā te hanū harivaḥ śūra śipre ruhatsomo na parvatasya pṛṣṭhe |
5,036.02 anu tvā rājannarvato na hinvangīrbhirmadema puruhūta viśve ||
5,036.03  cakraṃ na vṛttaṃ puruhūta vepate mano bhiyā me amateridadrivaḥ |
5,036.03 rathādadhi tvā jaritā sadāvṛdha kuvinnu stoṣanmaghavanpurūvasuḥ ||
5,036.04  eṣa grāveva jaritā ta indreyarti vācaṃ bṛhadāśuṣāṇaḥ |
5,036.04 pra savyena maghavanyaṃsi rāyaḥ pra dakṣiṇiddharivo mā vi venaḥ ||
5,036.05  vṛṣā tvā vṛṣaṇaṃ vardhatu dyaurvṛṣā vṛṣabhyāṃ vahase haribhyām |
5,036.05 sa no vṛṣā vṛṣarathaḥ suśipra vṛṣakrato vṛṣā vajrinbhare dhāḥ ||
5,036.06  yo rohitau vājinau vājinīvāntribhiḥ śataiḥ sacamānāvadiṣṭa |
5,036.06 yūne samasmai kṣitayo namantāṃ śrutarathāya maruto duvoyā ||

5,037.01  saṃ bhānunā yatate sūryasyājuhvāno ghṛtapṛṣṭhaḥ svañcāḥ |
5,037.01 tasmā amṛdhrā uṣaso vyucchānya indrāya sunavāmetyāha ||
5,037.02  samiddhāgnirvanavatstīrṇabarhiryuktagrāvā sutasomo jarāte |
5,037.02 grāvāṇo yasyeṣiraṃ vadantyayadadhvaryurhaviṣāva sindhum ||
5,037.03  vadhūriyaṃ patimicchantyeti ya īṃ vahāte mahiṣīmiṣirām |
5,037.03 āsya śravasyādratha ā ca ghoṣātpurū sahasrā pari vartayāte ||
5,037.04  na sa rājā vyathate yasminnindrastīvraṃ somaṃ pibati gosakhāyam |
5,037.04 ā satvanairajati hanti vṛtraṃ kṣeti kṣitīḥ subhago nāma puṣyan ||
5,037.05  puṣyātkṣeme abhi yoge bhavātyubhe vṛtau saṃyatī saṃ jayāti |
5,037.05 priyaḥ sūrye priyo agnā bhavāti ya indrāya sutasomo dadāśat ||

5,038.01  uroṣṭa indra rādhaso vibhvī rātiḥ śatakrato |
5,038.01 adhā no viśvacarṣaṇe dyumnā sukṣatra maṃhaya ||
5,038.02  yadīmindra śravāyyamiṣaṃ śaviṣṭha dadhiṣe |
5,038.02 paprathe dīrghaśruttamaṃ hiraṇyavarṇa duṣṭaram ||
5,038.03  śuṣmāso ye te adrivo mehanā ketasāpaḥ |
5,038.03 ubhā devāvabhiṣṭaye divaśca gmaśca rājathaḥ ||
5,038.04  uto no asya kasya ciddakṣasya tava vṛtrahan |
5,038.04 asmabhyaṃ nṛmṇamā bharāsmabhyaṃ nṛmaṇasyase ||
5,038.05  nū ta ābhirabhiṣṭibhistava śarmañchatakrato |
5,038.05 indra syāma sugopāḥ śūra syāma sugopāḥ ||

5,039.01  yadindra citra mehanāsti tvādātamadrivaḥ |
5,039.01 rādhastanno vidadvasa ubhayāhastyā bhara ||
5,039.02  yanmanyase vareṇyamindra dyukṣaṃ tadā bhara |
5,039.02 vidyāma tasya te vayamakūpārasya dāvane ||
5,039.03  yatte ditsu prarādhyaṃ mano asti śrutaṃ bṛhat |
5,039.03 tena dṛḻhā cidadriva ā vājaṃ darṣi sātaye ||
5,039.04  maṃhiṣṭhaṃ vo maghonāṃ rājānaṃ carṣaṇīnām |
5,039.04 indramupa praśastaye pūrvībhirjujuṣe giraḥ ||
5,039.05  asmā itkāvyaṃ vaca ukthamindrāya śaṃsyam |
5,039.05 tasmā u brahmavāhase giro vardhantyatrayo giraḥ śumbhantyatrayaḥ ||

5,040.01  ā yāhyadribhiḥ sutaṃ somaṃ somapate piba |
5,040.01 vṛṣannindra vṛṣabhirvṛtrahantama ||
5,040.02  vṛṣā grāvā vṛṣā mado vṛṣā somo ayaṃ sutaḥ |
5,040.02 vṛṣannindra vṛṣabhirvṛtrahantama ||
5,040.03  vṛṣā tvā vṛṣaṇaṃ huve vajriñcitrābhirūtibhiḥ |
5,040.03 vṛṣannindra vṛṣabhirvṛtrahantama ||
5,040.04  ṛjīṣī vajrī vṛṣabhasturāṣāṭchuṣmī rājā vṛtrahā somapāvā |
5,040.04 yuktvā haribhyāmupa yāsadarvāṅmādhyandine savane matsadindraḥ ||
5,040.05  yattvā sūrya svarbhānustamasāvidhyadāsuraḥ |
5,040.05 akṣetravidyathā mugdho bhuvanānyadīdhayuḥ ||
5,040.06  svarbhānoradha yadindra māyā avo divo vartamānā avāhan |
5,040.06 gūḻhaṃ sūryaṃ tamasāpavratena turīyeṇa brahmaṇāvindadatriḥ ||
5,040.07  mā māmimaṃ tava santamatra irasyā drugdho bhiyasā ni gārīt |
5,040.07 tvaṃ mitro asi satyarādhāstau mehāvataṃ varuṇaśca rājā ||
5,040.08  grāvṇo brahmā yuyujānaḥ saparyankīriṇā devānnamasopaśikṣan |
5,040.08 atriḥ sūryasya divi cakṣurādhātsvarbhānorapa māyā aghukṣat ||
5,040.09  yaṃ vai sūryaṃ svarbhānustamasāvidhyadāsuraḥ |
5,040.09 atrayastamanvavindannahyanye aśaknuvan ||

5,041.01  ko nu vāṃ mitrāvaruṇāvṛtāyandivo vā mahaḥ pārthivasya vā de |
5,041.01 ṛtasya vā sadasi trāsīthāṃ no yajñāyate vā paśuṣo na vājān ||
5,041.02  te no mitro varuṇo aryamāyurindra ṛbhukṣā maruto juṣanta |
5,041.02 namobhirvā ye dadhate suvṛktiṃ stomaṃ rudrāya mīḻhuṣe sajoṣāḥ ||
5,041.03  ā vāṃ yeṣṭhāśvinā huvadhyai vātasya patmanrathyasya puṣṭau |
5,041.03 uta vā divo asurāya manma prāndhāṃsīva yajyave bharadhvam ||
5,041.04  pra sakṣaṇo divyaḥ kaṇvahotā trito divaḥ sajoṣā vāto agniḥ |
5,041.04 pūṣā bhagaḥ prabhṛthe viśvabhojā ājiṃ na jagmurāśvaśvatamāḥ ||
5,041.05  pra vo rayiṃ yuktāśvaṃ bharadhvaṃ rāya eṣe'vase dadhīta dhīḥ |
5,041.05 suśeva evairauśijasya hotā ye va evā marutasturāṇām ||
5,041.06  pra vo vāyuṃ rathayujaṃ kṛṇudhvaṃ pra devaṃ vipraṃ panitāramarkaiḥ |
5,041.06 iṣudhyava ṛtasāpaḥ purandhīrvasvīrno atra patnīrā dhiye dhuḥ ||
5,041.07  upa va eṣe vandyebhiḥ śūṣaiḥ pra yahvī divaścitayadbhirarkaiḥ |
5,041.07 uṣāsānaktā viduṣīva viśvamā hā vahato martyāya yajñam ||
5,041.08  abhi vo arce poṣyāvato nṝnvāstoṣpatiṃ tvaṣṭāraṃ rarāṇaḥ |
5,041.08 dhanyā sajoṣā dhiṣaṇā namobhirvanaspatīṃroṣadhī rāya eṣe ||
5,041.09  tuje nastane parvatāḥ santu svaitavo ye vasavo na vīrāḥ |
5,041.09 panita āptyo yajataḥ sadā no vardhānnaḥ śaṃsaṃ naryo abhiṣṭau ||
5,041.10  vṛṣṇo astoṣi bhūmyasya garbhaṃ trito napātamapāṃ suvṛkti |
5,041.10 gṛṇīte agniretarī na śūṣaiḥ śociṣkeśo ni riṇāti vanā ||
5,041.11  kathā mahe rudriyāya bravāma kadrāye cikituṣe bhagāya |
5,041.11 āpa oṣadhīruta no'vantu dyaurvanā girayo vṛkṣakeśāḥ ||
5,041.12  śṛṇotu na ūrjāṃ patirgiraḥ sa nabhastarīyāṃ iṣiraḥ parijmā |
5,041.12 śṛṇvantvāpaḥ puro na śubhrāḥ pari sruco babṛhāṇasyādreḥ ||
5,041.13  vidā cinnu mahānto ye va evā bravāma dasmā vāryaṃ dadhānāḥ |
5,041.13 vayaścana subhva āva yanti kṣubhā martamanuyataṃ vadhasnaiḥ ||
5,041.14  ā daivyāni pārthivāni janmāpaścācchā sumakhāya vocam |
5,041.14 vardhantāṃ dyāvo giraścandrāgrā udā vardhantāmabhiṣātā arṇāḥ ||
5,041.15  padepade me jarimā ni dhāyi varūtrī vā śakrā yā pāyubhiśca |
5,041.15 siṣaktu mātā mahī rasā naḥ smatsūribhirṛjuhasta ṛjuvaniḥ ||
5,041.16  kathā dāśema namasā sudānūnevayā maruto acchoktau praśravaso maruto acchoktau |
5,041.16 mā no'hirbudhnyo riṣe dhādasmākaṃ bhūdupamātivaniḥ ||
5,041.17  iti cinnu prajāyai paśumatyai devāso vanate martyo va ā devāso vanate martyo vaḥ |
5,041.17 atrā śivāṃ tanvo dhāsimasyā jarāṃ cinme nirṛtirjagrasīta ||
5,041.18  tāṃ vo devāḥ sumatimūrjayantīmiṣamaśyāma vasavaḥ śasā goḥ |
5,041.18 sā naḥ sudānurmṛḻayantī devī prati dravantī suvitāya gamyāḥ ||
5,041.19  abhi na iḻā yūthasya mātā smannadībhirurvaśī vā gṛṇātu |
5,041.19 urvaśī vā bṛhaddivā gṛṇānābhyūrṇvānā prabhṛthasyāyoḥ ||
5,041.20  siṣaktu na ūrjavyasya puṣṭeḥ ||

5,042.01  pra śantamā varuṇaṃ dīdhitī gīrmitraṃ bhagamaditiṃ nūnamaśyāḥ |
5,042.01 pṛṣadyoniḥ pañcahotā śṛṇotvatūrtapanthā asuro mayobhuḥ ||
5,042.02  prati me stomamaditirjagṛbhyātsūnuṃ na mātā hṛdyaṃ suśevam |
5,042.02 brahma priyaṃ devahitaṃ yadastyahaṃ mitre varuṇe yanmayobhu ||
5,042.03  udīraya kavitamaṃ kavīnāmunattainamabhi madhvā ghṛtena |
5,042.03 sa no vasūni prayatā hitāni candrāṇi devaḥ savitā suvāti ||
5,042.04  samindra ṇo manasā neṣi gobhiḥ saṃ sūribhirharivaḥ saṃ svasti |
5,042.04 saṃ brahmaṇā devahitaṃ yadasti saṃ devānāṃ sumatyā yajñiyānām ||
5,042.05  devo bhagaḥ savitā rāyo aṃśa indro vṛtrasya saṃjito dhanānām |
5,042.05 ṛbhukṣā vāja uta vā purandhiravantu no amṛtāsasturāsaḥ ||
5,042.06  marutvato apratītasya jiṣṇorajūryataḥ pra bravāmā kṛtāni |
5,042.06 na te pūrve maghavannāparāso na vīryaṃ nūtanaḥ kaścanāpa ||
5,042.07  upa stuhi prathamaṃ ratnadheyaṃ bṛhaspatiṃ sanitāraṃ dhanānām |
5,042.07 yaḥ śaṃsate stuvate śambhaviṣṭhaḥ purūvasurāgamajjohuvānam ||
5,042.08  tavotibhiḥ sacamānā ariṣṭā bṛhaspate maghavānaḥ suvīrāḥ |
5,042.08 ye aśvadā uta vā santi godā ye vastradāḥ subhagāsteṣu rāyaḥ ||
5,042.09  visarmāṇaṃ kṛṇuhi vittameṣāṃ ye bhuñjate apṛṇanto na ukthaiḥ |
5,042.09 apavratānprasave vāvṛdhānānbrahmadviṣaḥ sūryādyāvayasva ||
5,042.10  ya ohate rakṣaso devavītāvacakrebhistaṃ maruto ni yāta |
5,042.10 yo vaḥ śamīṃ śaśamānasya nindāttucchyānkāmānkarate siṣvidānaḥ ||
5,042.11  tamu ṣṭuhi yaḥ sviṣuḥ sudhanvā yo viśvasya kṣayati bheṣajasya |
5,042.11 yakṣvā mahe saumanasāya rudraṃ namobhirdevamasuraṃ duvasya ||
5,042.12  damūnaso apaso ye suhastā vṛṣṇaḥ patnīrnadyo vibhvataṣṭāḥ |
5,042.12 sarasvatī bṛhaddivota rākā daśasyantīrvarivasyantu śubhrāḥ ||
5,042.13  pra sū mahe suśaraṇāya medhāṃ giraṃ bhare navyasīṃ jāyamānām |
5,042.13 ya āhanā duhiturvakṣaṇāsu rūpā mināno akṛṇodidaṃ naḥ ||
5,042.14  pra suṣṭuti stanayantaṃ ruvantamiḻaspatiṃ jaritarnūnamaśyāḥ |
5,042.14 yo abdimāṃ udanimāṃ iyarti pra vidyutā rodasī ukṣamāṇaḥ ||
5,042.15  eṣa stomo mārutaṃ śardho acchā rudrasya sūnūṃryuvanyūṃrudaśyāḥ |
5,042.15 kāmo rāye havate mā svastyupa stuhi pṛṣadaśvāṃ ayāsaḥ ||
5,042.16  praiṣa stomaḥ pṛthivīmantarikṣaṃ vanaspatīṃroṣadhī rāye aśyāḥ |
5,042.16 devodevaḥ suhavo bhūtu mahyaṃ mā no mātā pṛthivī durmatau dhāt ||
5,042.17  urau devā anibādhe syāma ||
5,042.18  samaśvinoravasā nūtanena mayobhuvā supraṇītī gamema |
5,042.18 ā no rayiṃ vahatamota vīrānā viśvānyamṛtā saubhagāni ||

5,043.01  ā dhenavaḥ payasā tūrṇyarthā amardhantīrupa no yantu madhvā |
5,043.01 maho rāye bṛhatīḥ sapta vipro mayobhuvo jaritā johavīti ||
5,043.02  ā suṣṭutī namasā vartayadhyai dyāvā vājāya pṛthivī amṛdhre |
5,043.02 pitā mātā madhuvacāḥ suhastā bharebhare no yaśasāvaviṣṭām ||
5,043.03  adhvaryavaścakṛvāṃso madhūni pra vāyave bharata cāru śukram |
5,043.03 hoteva naḥ prathamaḥ pāhyasya deva madhvo rarimā te madāya ||
5,043.04  daśa kṣipo yuñjate bāhū adriṃ somasya yā śamitārā suhastā |
5,043.04 madhvo rasaṃ sugabhastirgiriṣṭhāṃ caniścadadduduhe śukramaṃśuḥ ||
5,043.05  asāvi te jujuṣāṇāya somaḥ kratve dakṣāya bṛhate madāya |
5,043.05 harī rathe sudhurā yoge arvāgindra priyā kṛṇuhi hūyamānaḥ ||
5,043.06  ā no mahīmaramatiṃ sajoṣā gnāṃ devīṃ namasā rātahavyām |
5,043.06 madhormadāya bṛhatīmṛtajñāmāgne vaha pathibhirdevayānaiḥ ||
5,043.07  añjanti yaṃ prathayanto na viprā vapāvantaṃ nāgninā tapantaḥ |
5,043.07 piturna putra upasi preṣṭha ā gharmo agnimṛtayannasādi ||
5,043.08  acchā mahī bṛhatī śantamā gīrdūto na gantvaśvinā huvadhyai |
5,043.08 mayobhuvā sarathā yātamarvāggantaṃ nidhiṃ dhuramāṇirna nābhim ||
5,043.09  pra tavyaso namauktiṃ turasyāhaṃ pūṣṇa uta vāyoradikṣi |
5,043.09 yā rādhasā coditārā matīnāṃ yā vājasya draviṇodā uta tman ||
5,043.10  ā nāmabhirmaruto vakṣi viśvānā rūpebhirjātavedo huvānaḥ |
5,043.10 yajñaṃ giro jarituḥ suṣṭutiṃ ca viśve ganta maruto viśva ūtī ||
5,043.11  ā no divo bṛhataḥ parvatādā sarasvatī yajatā gantu yajñam |
5,043.11 havaṃ devī jujuṣāṇā ghṛtācī śagmāṃ no vācamuśatī śṛṇotu ||
5,043.12  ā vedhasaṃ nīlapṛṣṭhaṃ bṛhantaṃ bṛhaspatiṃ sadane sādayadhvam |
5,043.12 sādadyoniṃ dama ā dīdivāṃsaṃ hiraṇyavarṇamaruṣaṃ sapema ||
5,043.13  ā dharṇasirbṛhaddivo rarāṇo viśvebhirgantvomabhirhuvānaḥ |
5,043.13 gnā vasāna oṣadhīramṛdhrastridhātuśṛṅgo vṛṣabho vayodhāḥ ||
5,043.14  mātuṣpade parame śukra āyorvipanyavo rāspirāso agman |
5,043.14 suśevyaṃ namasā rātahavyāḥ śiśuṃ mṛjantyāyavo na vāse ||
5,043.15  bṛhadvayo bṛhate tubhyamagne dhiyājuro mithunāsaḥ sacanta |
5,043.15 devodevaḥ suhavo bhūtu mahyaṃ mā no mātā pṛthivī durmatau dhāt ||
5,043.16  urau devā anibādhe syāma ||
5,043.17  samaśvinoravasā nūtanena mayobhuvā supraṇītī gamema |
5,043.17 ā no rayiṃ vahatamota vīrānā viśvānyamṛtā saubhagāni ||

5,044.01  taṃ pratnathā pūrvathā viśvathemathā jyeṣṭhatātiṃ barhiṣadaṃ svarvidam |
5,044.01 pratīcīnaṃ vṛjanaṃ dohase girāśuṃ jayantamanu yāsu vardhase ||
5,044.02  śriye sudṛśīruparasya yāḥ svarvirocamānaḥ kakubhāmacodate |
5,044.02 sugopā asi na dabhāya sukrato paro māyābhirṛta āsa nāma te ||
5,044.03  atyaṃ haviḥ sacate sacca dhātu cāriṣṭagātuḥ sa hotā sahobhariḥ |
5,044.03 prasarsrāṇo anu barhirvṛṣā śiśurmadhye yuvājaro visruhā hitaḥ ||
5,044.04  pra va ete suyujo yāmanniṣṭaye nīcīramuṣmai yamya ṛtāvṛdhaḥ |
5,044.04 suyantubhiḥ sarvaśāsairabhīśubhiḥ krivirnāmāni pravaṇe muṣāyati ||
5,044.05  saṃjarbhurāṇastarubhiḥ sutegṛbhaṃ vayākinaṃ cittagarbhāsu susvaruḥ |
5,044.05 dhāravākeṣvṛjugātha śobhase vardhasva patnīrabhi jīvo adhvare ||
5,044.06  yādṛgeva dadṛśe tādṛgucyate saṃ chāyayā dadhire sidhrayāpsvā |
5,044.06 mahīmasmabhyamuruṣāmuru jrayo bṛhatsuvīramanapacyutaṃ sahaḥ ||
5,044.07  vetyagrurjanivānvā ati spṛdhaḥ samaryatā manasā sūryaḥ kaviḥ |
5,044.07 ghraṃsaṃ rakṣantaṃ pari viśvato gayamasmākaṃ śarma vanavatsvāvasuḥ ||
5,044.08  jyāyāṃsamasya yatunasya ketuna ṛṣisvaraṃ carati yāsu nāma te |
5,044.08 yādṛśmindhāyi tamapasyayā vidadya u svayaṃ vahate so araṃ karat ||
5,044.09  samudramāsāmava tasthe agrimā na riṣyati savanaṃ yasminnāyatā |
5,044.09 atrā na hārdi kravaṇasya rejate yatrā matirvidyate pūtabandhanī ||
5,044.10  sa hi kṣatrasya manasasya cittibhirevāvadasya yajatasya sadhreḥ |
5,044.10 avatsārasya spṛṇavāma raṇvabhiḥ śaviṣṭhaṃ vājaṃ viduṣā cidardhyam ||
5,044.11  śyena āsāmaditiḥ kakṣyo mado viśvavārasya yajatasya māyinaḥ |
5,044.11 samanyamanyamarthayantyetave vidurviṣāṇaṃ paripānamanti te ||
5,044.12  sadāpṛṇo yajato vi dviṣo vadhīdbāhuvṛktaḥ śrutavittaryo vaḥ sacā |
5,044.12 ubhā sa varā pratyeti bhāti ca yadīṃ gaṇaṃ bhajate suprayāvabhiḥ ||
5,044.13  sutambharo yajamānasya satpatirviśvāsāmūdhaḥ sa dhiyāmudañcanaḥ |
5,044.13 bharaddhenū rasavacchiśriye payo'nubruvāṇo adhyeti na svapan ||
5,044.14  yo jāgāra tamṛcaḥ kāmayante yo jāgāra tamu sāmāni yanti |
5,044.14 yo jāgāra tamayaṃ soma āha tavāhamasmi sakhye nyokāḥ ||
5,044.15  agnirjāgāra tamṛcaḥ kāmayante'gnirjāgāra tamu sāmāni yanti |
5,044.15 agnirjāgāra tamayaṃ soma āha tavāhamasmi sakhye nyokāḥ ||

5,045.01  vidā divo viṣyannadrimukthairāyatyā uṣaso arcino guḥ |
5,045.01 apāvṛta vrajinīrutsvargādvi duro mānuṣīrdeva āvaḥ ||
5,045.02  vi sūryo amatiṃ na śriyaṃ sādorvādgavāṃ mātā jānatī gāt |
5,045.02 dhanvarṇaso nadyaḥ khādoarṇā sthūṇeva sumitā dṛṃhata dyauḥ ||
5,045.03  asmā ukthāya parvatasya garbho mahīnāṃ januṣe pūrvyāya |
5,045.03 vi parvato jihīta sādhata dyaurāvivāsanto dasayanta bhūma ||
5,045.04  sūktebhirvo vacobhirdevajuṣṭairindrā nvagnī avase huvadhyai |
5,045.04 ukthebhirhi ṣmā kavayaḥ suyajñā āvivāsanto maruto yajanti ||
5,045.05  eto nvadya sudhyo bhavāma pra ducchunā minavāmā varīyaḥ |
5,045.05 āre dveṣāṃsi sanutardadhāmāyāma prāñco yajamānamaccha ||
5,045.06  etā dhiyaṃ kṛṇavāmā sakhāyo'pa yā mātāṃ ṛṇuta vrajaṃ goḥ |
5,045.06 yayā manurviśiśipraṃ jigāya yayā vaṇigvaṅkurāpā purīṣam ||
5,045.07  anūnodatra hastayato adrirārcanyena daśa māso navagvāḥ |
5,045.07 ṛtaṃ yatī saramā gā avindadviśvāni satyāṅgirāścakāra ||
5,045.08  viśve asyā vyuṣi māhināyāḥ saṃ yadgobhiraṅgiraso navanta |
5,045.08 utsa āsāṃ parame sadhastha ṛtasya pathā saramā vidadgāḥ ||
5,045.09  ā sūryo yātu saptāśvaḥ kṣetraṃ yadasyorviyā dīrghayāthe |
5,045.09 raghuḥ śyenaḥ patayadandho acchā yuvā kavirdīdayadgoṣu gacchan ||
5,045.10  ā sūryo aruhacchukramarṇo'yukta yaddharito vītapṛṣṭhāḥ |
5,045.10 udnā na nāvamanayanta dhīrā āśṛṇvatīrāpo arvāgatiṣṭhan ||
5,045.11  dhiyaṃ vo apsu dadhiṣe svarṣāṃ yayātarandaśa māso navagvāḥ |
5,045.11 ayā dhiyā syāma devagopā ayā dhiyā tuturyāmātyaṃhaḥ ||

5,046.01  hayo na vidvāṃ ayuji svayaṃ dhuri tāṃ vahāmi prataraṇīmavasyuvam |
5,046.01 nāsyā vaśmi vimucaṃ nāvṛtaṃ punarvidvānpathaḥ puraeta ṛju neṣati ||
5,046.02  agna indra varuṇa mitra devāḥ śardhaḥ pra yanta mārutota viṣṇo |
5,046.02 ubhā nāsatyā rudro adha gnāḥ pūṣā bhagaḥ sarasvatī juṣanta ||
5,046.03  indrāgnī mitrāvaruṇāditiṃ svaḥ pṛthivīṃ dyāṃ marutaḥ parvatāṃ apaḥ |
5,046.03 huve viṣṇuṃ pūṣaṇaṃ brahmaṇaspatiṃ bhagaṃ nu śaṃsaṃ savitāramūtaye ||
5,046.04  uta no viṣṇuruta vāto asridho draviṇodā uta somo mayaskarat |
5,046.04 uta ṛbhava uta rāye no aśvinota tvaṣṭota vibhvānu maṃsate ||
5,046.05  uta tyanno mārutaṃ śardha ā gamaddivikṣayaṃ yajataṃ barhirāsade |
5,046.05 bṛhaspatiḥ śarma pūṣota no yamadvarūthyaṃ varuṇo mitro aryamā ||
5,046.06  uta tye naḥ parvatāsaḥ suśastayaḥ sudītayo nadyastrāmaṇe bhuvan |
5,046.06 bhago vibhaktā śavasāvasā gamaduruvyacā aditiḥ śrotu me havam ||
5,046.07  devānāṃ patnīruśatīravantu naḥ prāvantu nastujaye vājasātaye |
5,046.07 yāḥ pārthivāso yā apāmapi vrate tā no devīḥ suhavāḥ śarma yacchata ||
5,046.08  uta gnā vyantu devapatnīrindrāṇyagnāyyaśvinī rāṭ |
5,046.08 ā rodasī varuṇānī śṛṇotu vyantu devīrya ṛturjanīnām ||

5,047.01  prayuñjatī diva eti bruvāṇā mahī mātā duhiturbodhayantī |
5,047.01 āvivāsantī yuvatirmanīṣā pitṛbhya ā sadane johuvānā ||
5,047.02  ajirāsastadapa īyamānā ātasthivāṃso amṛtasya nābhim |
5,047.02 anantāsa uravo viśvataḥ sīṃ pari dyāvāpṛthivī yanti panthāḥ ||
5,047.03  ukṣā samudro aruṣaḥ suparṇaḥ pūrvasya yoniṃ piturā viveśa |
5,047.03 madhye divo nihitaḥ pṛśniraśmā vi cakrame rajasaspātyantau ||
5,047.04  catvāra īṃ bibhrati kṣemayanto daśa garbhaṃ carase dhāpayante |
5,047.04 tridhātavaḥ paramā asya gāvo divaścaranti pari sadyo antān ||
5,047.05  idaṃ vapurnivacanaṃ janāsaścaranti yannadyastasthurāpaḥ |
5,047.05 dve yadīṃ bibhṛto māturanye iheha jāte yamyā sabandhū ||
5,047.06  vi tanvate dhiyo asmā apāṃsi vastrā putrāya mātaro vayanti |
5,047.06 upaprakṣe vṛṣaṇo modamānā divaspathā vadhvo yantyaccha ||
5,047.07  tadastu mitrāvaruṇā tadagne śaṃ yorasmabhyamidamastu śastam |
5,047.07 aśīmahi gādhamuta pratiṣṭhāṃ namo dive bṛhate sādanāya ||

5,048.01  kadu priyāya dhāmne manāmahe svakṣatrāya svayaśase mahe vayam |
5,048.01 āmenyasya rajaso yadabhra āṃ apo vṛṇānā vitanoti māyinī ||
5,048.02  tā atnata vayunaṃ vīravakṣaṇaṃ samānyā vṛtayā viśvamā rajaḥ |
5,048.02 apo apācīraparā apejate pra pūrvābhistirate devayurjanaḥ ||
5,048.03  ā grāvabhirahanyebhiraktubhirvariṣṭhaṃ vajramā jigharti māyini |
5,048.03 śataṃ vā yasya pracaransve dame saṃvartayanto vi ca vartayannahā ||
5,048.04  tāmasya rītiṃ paraśoriva pratyanīkamakhyaṃ bhuje asya varpasaḥ |
5,048.04 sacā yadi pitumantamiva kṣayaṃ ratnaṃ dadhāti bharahūtaye viśe ||
5,048.05  sa jihvayā caturanīka ṛñjate cāru vasāno varuṇo yatannarim |
5,048.05 na tasya vidma puruṣatvatā vayaṃ yato bhagaḥ savitā dāti vāryam ||

5,049.01  devaṃ vo adya savitārameṣe bhagaṃ ca ratnaṃ vibhajantamāyoḥ |
5,049.01 ā vāṃ narā purubhujā vavṛtyāṃ divedive cidaśvinā sakhīyan ||
5,049.02  prati prayāṇamasurasya vidvānsūktairdevaṃ savitāraṃ duvasya |
5,049.02 upa bruvīta namasā vijānañjyeṣṭhaṃ ca ratnaṃ vibhajantamāyoḥ ||
5,049.03  adatrayā dayate vāryāṇi pūṣā bhago aditirvasta usraḥ |
5,049.03 indro viṣṇurvaruṇo mitro agnirahāni bhadrā janayanta dasmāḥ ||
5,049.04  tanno anarvā savitā varūthaṃ tatsindhava iṣayanto anu gman |
5,049.04 upa yadvoce adhvarasya hotā rāyaḥ syāma patayo vājaratnāḥ ||
5,049.05  pra ye vasubhya īvadā namo durye mitre varuṇe sūktavācaḥ |
5,049.05 avaitvabhvaṃ kṛṇutā varīyo divaspṛthivyoravasā madema ||

5,050.01  viśvo devasya neturmarto vurīta sakhyam |
5,050.01 viśvo rāya iṣudhyati dyumnaṃ vṛṇīta puṣyase ||
5,050.02  te te deva netarye cemāṃ anuśase |
5,050.02 te rāyā te hyāpṛce sacemahi sacathyaiḥ ||
5,050.03  ato na ā nṝnatithīnataḥ patnīrdaśasyata |
5,050.03 āre viśvaṃ patheṣṭhāṃ dviṣo yuyotu yūyuviḥ ||
5,050.04  yatra vahnirabhihito dudravaddroṇyaḥ paśuḥ |
5,050.04 nṛmaṇā vīrapastyo'rṇā dhīreva sanitā ||
5,050.05  eṣa te deva netā rathaspatiḥ śaṃ rayiḥ |
5,050.05 śaṃ rāye śaṃ svastaya iṣastuto manāmahe devastuto manāmahe ||

5,051.01  agne sutasya pītaye viśvairūmebhirā gahi |
5,051.01 devebhirhavyadātaye ||
5,051.02  ṛtadhītaya ā gata satyadharmāṇo adhvaram |
5,051.02 agneḥ pibata jihvayā ||
5,051.03  viprebhirvipra santya prātaryāvabhirā gahi |
5,051.03 devebhiḥ somapītaye ||
5,051.04  ayaṃ somaścamū suto'matre pari ṣicyate |
5,051.04 priya indrāya vāyave ||
5,051.05  vāyavā yāhi vītaye juṣāṇo havyadātaye |
5,051.05 pibā sutasyāndhaso abhi prayaḥ ||
5,051.06  indraśca vāyaveṣāṃ sutānāṃ pītimarhathaḥ |
5,051.06 tāñjuṣethāmarepasāvabhi prayaḥ ||
5,051.07  sutā indrāya vāyave somāso dadhyāśiraḥ |
5,051.07 nimnaṃ na yanti sindhavo'bhi prayaḥ ||
5,051.08  sajūrviśvebhirdevebhiraśvibhyāmuṣasā sajūḥ |
5,051.08 ā yāhyagne atrivatsute raṇa ||
5,051.09  sajūrmitrāvaruṇābhyāṃ sajūḥ somena viṣṇunā |
5,051.09 ā yāhyagne atrivatsute raṇa ||
5,051.10  sajūrādityairvasubhiḥ sajūrindreṇa vāyunā |
5,051.10 ā yāhyagne atrivatsute raṇa ||
5,051.11  svasti no mimītāmaśvinā bhagaḥ svasti devyaditiranarvaṇaḥ |
5,051.11 svasti pūṣā asuro dadhātu naḥ svasti dyāvāpṛthivī sucetunā ||
5,051.12  svastaye vāyumupa bravāmahai somaṃ svasti bhuvanasya yaspatiḥ |
5,051.12 bṛhaspatiṃ sarvagaṇaṃ svastaye svastaya ādityāso bhavantu naḥ ||
5,051.13  viśve devā no adyā svastaye vaiśvānaro vasuragniḥ svastaye |
5,051.13 devā avantvṛbhavaḥ svastaye svasti no rudraḥ pātvaṃhasaḥ ||
5,051.14  svasti mitrāvaruṇā svasti pathye revati |
5,051.14 svasti na indraścāgniśca svasti no adite kṛdhi ||
5,051.15  svasti panthāmanu carema sūryācandramasāviva |
5,051.15 punardadatāghnatā jānatā saṃ gamemahi ||

5,052.01  pra śyāvāśva dhṛṣṇuyārcā marudbhirṛkvabhiḥ |
5,052.01 ye adroghamanuṣvadhaṃ śravo madanti yajñiyāḥ ||
5,052.02  te hi sthirasya śavasaḥ sakhāyaḥ santi dhṛṣṇuyā |
5,052.02 te yāmannā dhṛṣadvinastmanā pānti śaśvataḥ ||
5,052.03  te syandrāso nokṣaṇo'ti ṣkandanti śarvarīḥ |
5,052.03 marutāmadhā maho divi kṣamā ca manmahe ||
5,052.04  marutsu vo dadhīmahi stomaṃ yajñaṃ ca dhṛṣṇuyā |
5,052.04 viśve ye mānuṣā yugā pānti martyaṃ riṣaḥ ||
5,052.05  arhanto ye sudānavo naro asāmiśavasaḥ |
5,052.05 pra yajñaṃ yajñiyebhyo divo arcā marudbhyaḥ ||
5,052.06  ā rukmairā yudhā nara ṛṣvā ṛṣṭīrasṛkṣata |
5,052.06 anvenāṃ aha vidyuto maruto jajjhatīriva bhānurarta tmanā divaḥ ||
5,052.07  ye vāvṛdhanta pārthivā ya urāvantarikṣa ā |
5,052.07 vṛjane vā nadīnāṃ sadhasthe vā maho divaḥ ||
5,052.08  śardho mārutamucchaṃsa satyaśavasamṛbhvasam |
5,052.08 uta sma te śubhe naraḥ pra syandrā yujata tmanā ||
5,052.09  uta sma te paruṣṇyāmūrṇā vasata śundhyavaḥ |
5,052.09 uta pavyā rathānāmadriṃ bhindantyojasā ||
5,052.10  āpathayo vipathayo'ntaspathā anupathāḥ |
5,052.10 etebhirmahyaṃ nāmabhiryajñaṃ viṣṭāra ohate ||
5,052.11  adhā naro nyohate'dhā niyuta ohate |
5,052.11 adhā pārāvatā iti citrā rūpāṇi darśyā ||
5,052.12  chandastubhaḥ kubhanyava utsamā kīriṇo nṛtuḥ |
5,052.12 te me ke cinna tāyava ūmā āsandṛśi tviṣe ||
5,052.13  ya ṛṣvā ṛṣṭividyutaḥ kavayaḥ santi vedhasaḥ |
5,052.13 tamṛṣe mārutaṃ gaṇaṃ namasyā ramayā girā ||
5,052.14  accha ṛṣe mārutaṃ gaṇaṃ dānā mitraṃ na yoṣaṇā |
5,052.14 divo vā dhṛṣṇava ojasā stutā dhībhiriṣaṇyata ||
5,052.15  nū manvāna eṣāṃ devāṃ acchā na vakṣaṇā |
5,052.15 dānā saceta sūribhiryāmaśrutebhirañjibhiḥ ||
5,052.16  pra ye me bandhveṣe gāṃ vocanta sūrayaḥ pṛśniṃ vocanta mātaram |
5,052.16 adhā pitaramiṣmiṇaṃ rudraṃ vocanta śikvasaḥ ||
5,052.17  sapta me sapta śākina ekamekā śatā daduḥ |
5,052.17 yamunāyāmadhi śrutamudrādho gavyaṃ mṛje ni rādho aśvyaṃ mṛje ||

5,053.01  ko veda jānameṣāṃ ko vā purā sumneṣvāsa marutām |
5,053.01 yadyuyujre kilāsyaḥ ||
5,053.02  aitānratheṣu tasthuṣaḥ kaḥ śuśrāva kathā yayuḥ |
5,053.02 kasmai sasruḥ sudāse anvāpaya iḻābhirvṛṣṭayaḥ saha ||
5,053.03  te ma āhurya āyayurupa dyubhirvibhirmade |
5,053.03 naro maryā arepasa imānpaśyanniti ṣṭuhi ||
5,053.04  ye añjiṣu ye vāśīṣu svabhānavaḥ srakṣu rukmeṣu khādiṣu |
5,053.04 śrāyā ratheṣu dhanvasu ||
5,053.05  yuṣmākaṃ smā rathāṃ anu mude dadhe maruto jīradānavaḥ |
5,053.05 vṛṣṭī dyāvo yatīriva ||
5,053.06  ā yaṃ naraḥ sudānavo dadāśuṣe divaḥ kośamacucyavuḥ |
5,053.06 vi parjanyaṃ sṛjanti rodasī anu dhanvanā yanti vṛṣṭayaḥ ||
5,053.07  tatṛdānāḥ sindhavaḥ kṣodasā rajaḥ pra sasrurdhenavo yathā |
5,053.07 syannā aśvā ivādhvano vimocane vi yadvartanta enyaḥ ||
5,053.08  ā yāta maruto diva āntarikṣādamāduta |
5,053.08 māva sthāta parāvataḥ ||
5,053.09  mā vo rasānitabhā kubhā krumurmā vaḥ sindhurni rīramat |
5,053.09 mā vaḥ pari ṣṭhātsarayuḥ purīṣiṇyasme itsumnamastu vaḥ ||
5,053.10  taṃ vaḥ śardhaṃ rathānāṃ tveṣaṃ gaṇaṃ mārutaṃ navyasīnām |
5,053.10 anu pra yanti vṛṣṭayaḥ ||
5,053.11  śardhaṃśardhaṃ va eṣāṃ vrātaṃvrātaṃ gaṇaṃgaṇaṃ suśastibhiḥ |
5,053.11 anu krāmema dhītibhiḥ ||
5,053.12  kasmā adya sujātāya rātahavyāya pra yayuḥ |
5,053.12 enā yāmena marutaḥ ||
5,053.13  yena tokāya tanayāya dhānyaṃ bījaṃ vahadhve akṣitam |
5,053.13 asmabhyaṃ taddhattana yadva īmahe rādho viśvāyu saubhagam ||
5,053.14  atīyāma nidastiraḥ svastibhirhitvāvadyamarātīḥ |
5,053.14 vṛṣṭvī śaṃ yorāpa usri bheṣajaṃ syāma marutaḥ saha ||
5,053.15  sudevaḥ samahāsati suvīro naro marutaḥ sa martyaḥ |
5,053.15 yaṃ trāyadhve syāma te ||
5,053.16  stuhi bhojānstuvato asya yāmani raṇangāvo na yavase |
5,053.16 yataḥ pūrvāṃ iva sakhīṃranu hvaya girā gṛṇīhi kāminaḥ ||

5,054.01  pra śardhāya mārutāya svabhānava imāṃ vācamanajā parvatacyute |
5,054.01 gharmastubhe diva ā pṛṣṭhayajvane dyumnaśravase mahi nṛmṇamarcata ||
5,054.02  pra vo marutastaviṣā udanyavo vayovṛdho aśvayujaḥ parijrayaḥ |
5,054.02 saṃ vidyutā dadhati vāśati tritaḥ svarantyāpo'vanā parijrayaḥ ||
5,054.03  vidyunmahaso naro aśmadidyavo vātatviṣo marutaḥ parvatacyutaḥ |
5,054.03 abdayā cinmuhurā hrādunīvṛta stanayadamā rabhasā udojasaḥ ||
5,054.04  vyaktūnrudrā vyahāni śikvaso vyantarikṣaṃ vi rajāṃsi dhūtayaḥ |
5,054.04 vi yadajrāṃ ajatha nāva īṃ yathā vi durgāṇi maruto nāha riṣyatha ||
5,054.05  tadvīryaṃ vo maruto mahitvanaṃ dīrghaṃ tatāna sūryo na yojanam |
5,054.05 etā na yāme agṛbhītaśociṣo'naśvadāṃ yannyayātanā girim ||
5,054.06  abhrāji śardho maruto yadarṇasaṃ moṣathā vṛkṣaṃ kapaneva vedhasaḥ |
5,054.06 adha smā no aramatiṃ sajoṣasaścakṣuriva yantamanu neṣathā sugam ||
5,054.07  na sa jīyate maruto na hanyate na sredhati na vyathate na riṣyati |
5,054.07 nāsya rāya upa dasyanti notaya ṛṣiṃ vā yaṃ rājānaṃ vā suṣūdatha ||
5,054.08  niyutvanto grāmajito yathā naro'ryamaṇo na marutaḥ kabandhinaḥ |
5,054.08 pinvantyutsaṃ yadināso asvaranvyundanti pṛthivīṃ madhvo andhasā ||
5,054.09  pravatvatīyaṃ pṛthivī marudbhyaḥ pravatvatī dyaurbhavati prayadbhyaḥ |
5,054.09 pravatvatīḥ pathyā antarikṣyāḥ pravatvantaḥ parvatā jīradānavaḥ ||
5,054.10  yanmarutaḥ sabharasaḥ svarṇaraḥ sūrya udite madathā divo naraḥ |
5,054.10 na vo'śvāḥ śrathayantāha sisrataḥ sadyo asyādhvanaḥ pāramaśnutha ||
5,054.11  aṃseṣu va ṛṣṭayaḥ patsu khādayo vakṣassu rukmā maruto rathe śubhaḥ |
5,054.11 agnibhrājaso vidyuto gabhastyoḥ śiprāḥ śīrṣasu vitatā hiraṇyayīḥ ||
5,054.12  taṃ nākamaryo agṛbhītaśociṣaṃ ruśatpippalaṃ maruto vi dhūnutha |
5,054.12 samacyanta vṛjanātitviṣanta yatsvaranti ghoṣaṃ vitatamṛtāyavaḥ ||
5,054.13  yuṣmādattasya maruto vicetaso rāyaḥ syāma rathyo vayasvataḥ |
5,054.13 na yo yucchati tiṣyo yathā divo'sme rāranta marutaḥ sahasriṇam ||
5,054.14  yūyaṃ rayiṃ maruta spārhavīraṃ yūyamṛṣimavatha sāmavipram |
5,054.14 yūyamarvantaṃ bharatāya vājaṃ yūyaṃ dhattha rājānaṃ śruṣṭimantam ||
5,054.15  tadvo yāmi draviṇaṃ sadyaūtayo yenā svarṇa tatanāma nṝṃrabhi |
5,054.15 idaṃ su me maruto haryatā vaco yasya tarema tarasā śataṃ himāḥ ||

5,055.01  prayajyavo maruto bhrājadṛṣṭayo bṛhadvayo dadhire rukmavakṣasaḥ |
5,055.01 īyante aśvaiḥ suyamebhirāśubhiḥ śubhaṃ yātāmanu rathā avṛtsata ||
5,055.02  svayaṃ dadhidhve taviṣīṃ yathā vida bṛhanmahānta urviyā vi rājatha |
5,055.02 utāntarikṣaṃ mamire vyojasā śubhaṃ yātāmanu rathā avṛtsata ||
5,055.03  sākaṃ jātāḥ subhvaḥ sākamukṣitāḥ śriye cidā prataraṃ vāvṛdhurnaraḥ |
5,055.03 virokiṇaḥ sūryasyeva raśmayaḥ śubhaṃ yātāmanu rathā avṛtsata ||
5,055.04  ābhūṣeṇyaṃ vo maruto mahitvanaṃ didṛkṣeṇyaṃ sūryasyeva cakṣaṇam |
5,055.04 uto asmāṃ amṛtatve dadhātana śubhaṃ yātāmanu rathā avṛtsata ||
5,055.05  udīrayathā marutaḥ samudrato yūyaṃ vṛṣṭiṃ varṣayathā purīṣiṇaḥ |
5,055.05 na vo dasrā upa dasyanti dhenavaḥ śubhaṃ yātāmanu rathā avṛtsata ||
5,055.06  yadaśvāndhūrṣu pṛṣatīrayugdhvaṃ hiraṇyayānpratyatkāṃ amugdhvam |
5,055.06 viśvā itspṛdho maruto vyasyatha śubhaṃ yātāmanu rathā avṛtsata ||
5,055.07  na parvatā na nadyo varanta vo yatrācidhvaṃ maruto gacchathedu tat |
5,055.07 uta dyāvāpṛthivī yāthanā pari śubhaṃ yātāmanu rathā avṛtsata ||
5,055.08  yatpūrvyaṃ maruto yacca nūtanaṃ yadudyate vasavo yacca śasyate |
5,055.08 viśvasya tasya bhavathā navedasaḥ śubhaṃ yātāmanu rathā avṛtsata ||
5,055.09  mṛḻata no maruto mā vadhiṣṭanāsmabhyaṃ śarma bahulaṃ vi yantana |
5,055.09 adhi stotrasya sakhyasya gātana śubhaṃ yātāmanu rathā avṛtsata ||
5,055.10  yūyamasmānnayata vasyo acchā niraṃhatibhyo maruto gṛṇānāḥ |
5,055.10 juṣadhvaṃ no havyadātiṃ yajatrā vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām ||

5,056.01  agne śardhantamā gaṇaṃ piṣṭaṃ rukmebhirañjibhiḥ |
5,056.01 viśo adya marutāmava hvaye divaścidrocanādadhi ||
5,056.02  yathā cinmanyase hṛdā tadinme jagmurāśasaḥ |
5,056.02 ye te nediṣṭhaṃ havanānyāgamantānvardha bhīmasaṃdṛśaḥ ||
5,056.03  mīḻhuṣmatīva pṛthivī parāhatā madantyetyasmadā |
5,056.03 ṛkṣo na vo marutaḥ śimīvāṃ amo dudhro gauriva bhīmayuḥ ||
5,056.04  ni ye riṇantyojasā vṛthā gāvo na durdhuraḥ |
5,056.04 aśmānaṃ citsvaryaṃ parvataṃ giriṃ pra cyāvayanti yāmabhiḥ ||
5,056.05  uttiṣṭha nūnameṣāṃ stomaiḥ samukṣitānām |
5,056.05 marutāṃ purutamamapūrvyaṃ gavāṃ sargamiva hvaye ||
5,056.06  yuṅgdhvaṃ hyaruṣī rathe yuṅgdhvaṃ ratheṣu rohitaḥ |
5,056.06 yuṅgdhvaṃ harī ajirā dhuri voḻhave vahiṣṭhā dhuri voḻhave ||
5,056.07  uta sya vājyaruṣastuviṣvaṇiriha sma dhāyi darśataḥ |
5,056.07 mā vo yāmeṣu marutaściraṃ karatpra taṃ ratheṣu codata ||
5,056.08  rathaṃ nu mārutaṃ vayaṃ śravasyumā huvāmahe |
5,056.08 ā yasmintasthau suraṇāni bibhratī sacā marutsu rodasī ||
5,056.09  taṃ vaḥ śardhaṃ ratheśubhaṃ tveṣaṃ panasyumā huve |
5,056.09 yasminsujātā subhagā mahīyate sacā marutsu mīḻhuṣī ||

5,057.01  ā rudrāsa indravantaḥ sajoṣaso hiraṇyarathāḥ suvitāya gantana |
5,057.01 iyaṃ vo asmatprati haryate matistṛṣṇaje na diva utsā udanyave ||
5,057.02  vāśīmanta ṛṣṭimanto manīṣiṇaḥ sudhanvāna iṣumanto niṣaṅgiṇaḥ |
5,057.02 svaśvā stha surathāḥ pṛśnimātaraḥ svāyudhā maruto yāthanā śubham ||
5,057.03  dhūnutha dyāṃ parvatāndāśuṣe vasu ni vo vanā jihate yāmano bhiyā |
5,057.03 kopayatha pṛthivīṃ pṛśnimātaraḥ śubhe yadugrāḥ pṛṣatīrayugdhvam ||
5,057.04  vātatviṣo maruto varṣanirṇijo yamā iva susadṛśaḥ supeśasaḥ |
5,057.04 piśaṅgāśvā aruṇāśvā arepasaḥ pratvakṣaso mahinā dyaurivoravaḥ ||
5,057.05  purudrapsā añjimantaḥ sudānavastveṣasaṃdṛśo anavabhrarādhasaḥ |
5,057.05 sujātāso januṣā rukmavakṣaso divo arkā amṛtaṃ nāma bhejire ||
5,057.06  ṛṣṭayo vo maruto aṃsayoradhi saha ojo bāhvorvo balaṃ hitam |
5,057.06 nṛmṇā śīrṣasvāyudhā ratheṣu vo viśvā vaḥ śrīradhi tanūṣu pipiśe ||
5,057.07  gomadaśvāvadrathavatsuvīraṃ candravadrādho maruto dadā naḥ |
5,057.07 praśastiṃ naḥ kṛṇuta rudriyāso bhakṣīya vo'vaso daivyasya ||
5,057.08  haye naro maruto mṛḻatā nastuvīmaghāso amṛtā ṛtajñāḥ |
5,057.08 satyaśrutaḥ kavayo yuvāno bṛhadgirayo bṛhadukṣamāṇāḥ ||

5,058.01  tamu nūnaṃ taviṣīmantameṣāṃ stuṣe gaṇaṃ mārutaṃ navyasīnām |
5,058.01 ya āśvaśvā amavadvahanta uteśire amṛtasya svarājaḥ ||
5,058.02  tveṣaṃ gaṇaṃ tavasaṃ khādihastaṃ dhunivrataṃ māyinaṃ dātivāram |
5,058.02 mayobhuvo ye amitā mahitvā vandasva vipra tuvirādhaso nṝn ||
5,058.03  ā vo yantūdavāhāso adya vṛṣṭiṃ ye viśve maruto junanti |
5,058.03 ayaṃ yo agnirmarutaḥ samiddha etaṃ juṣadhvaṃ kavayo yuvānaḥ ||
5,058.04  yūyaṃ rājānamiryaṃ janāya vibhvataṣṭaṃ janayathā yajatrāḥ |
5,058.04 yuṣmadeti muṣṭihā bāhujūto yuṣmatsadaśvo marutaḥ suvīraḥ ||
5,058.05  arā ivedacaramā aheva prapra jāyante akavā mahobhiḥ |
5,058.05 pṛśneḥ putrā upamāso rabhiṣṭhāḥ svayā matyā marutaḥ saṃ mimikṣuḥ ||
5,058.06  yatprāyāsiṣṭa pṛṣatībhiraśvairvīḻupavibhirmaruto rathebhiḥ |
5,058.06 kṣodanta āpo riṇate vanānyavosriyo vṛṣabhaḥ krandatu dyauḥ ||
5,058.07  prathiṣṭa yāmanpṛthivī cideṣāṃ bharteva garbhaṃ svamicchavo dhuḥ |
5,058.07 vātānhyaśvāndhuryāyuyujre varṣaṃ svedaṃ cakrire rudriyāsaḥ ||
5,058.08  haye naro maruto mṛḻatā nastuvīmaghāso amṛtā ṛtajñāḥ |
5,058.08 satyaśrutaḥ kavayo yuvāno bṛhadgirayo bṛhadukṣamāṇāḥ ||

5,059.01  pra va spaḻ akransuvitāya dāvane'rcā dive pra pṛthivyā ṛtaṃ bhare |
5,059.01 ukṣante aśvāntaruṣanta ā rajo'nu svaṃ bhānuṃ śrathayante arṇavaiḥ ||
5,059.02  amādeṣāṃ bhiyasā bhūmirejati naurna pūrṇā kṣarati vyathiryatī |
5,059.02 dūredṛśo ye citayanta emabhirantarmahe vidathe yetire naraḥ ||
5,059.03  gavāmiva śriyase śṛṅgamuttamaṃ sūryo na cakṣū rajaso visarjane |
5,059.03 atyā iva subhvaścārava sthana maryā iva śriyase cetathā naraḥ ||
5,059.04  ko vo mahānti mahatāmudaśnavatkaskāvyā marutaḥ ko ha pauṃsyā |
5,059.04 yūyaṃ ha bhūmiṃ kiraṇaṃ na rejatha pra yadbharadhve suvitāya dāvane ||
5,059.05  aśvā ivedaruṣāsaḥ sabandhavaḥ śūrā iva prayudhaḥ prota yuyudhuḥ |
5,059.05 maryā iva suvṛdho vāvṛdhurnaraḥ sūryasya cakṣuḥ pra minanti vṛṣṭibhiḥ ||
5,059.06  te ajyeṣṭhā akaniṣṭhāsa udbhido'madhyamāso mahasā vi vāvṛdhuḥ |
5,059.06 sujātāso januṣā pṛśnimātaro divo maryā ā no acchā jigātana ||
5,059.07  vayo na ye śreṇīḥ papturojasāntāndivo bṛhataḥ sānunaspari |
5,059.07 aśvāsa eṣāmubhaye yathā viduḥ pra parvatasya nabhanūṃracucyavuḥ ||
5,059.08  mimātu dyauraditirvītaye naḥ saṃ dānucitrā uṣaso yatantām |
5,059.08 ācucyavurdivyaṃ kośameta ṛṣe rudrasya maruto gṛṇānāḥ ||

5,060.01  īḻe agniṃ svavasaṃ namobhiriha prasatto vi cayatkṛtaṃ naḥ |
5,060.01 rathairiva pra bhare vājayadbhiḥ pradakṣiṇinmarutāṃ stomamṛdhyām ||
5,060.02  ā ye tasthuḥ pṛṣatīṣu śrutāsu sukheṣu rudrā maruto ratheṣu |
5,060.02 vanā cidugrā jihate ni vo bhiyā pṛthivī cidrejate parvataścit ||
5,060.03  parvataścinmahi vṛddho bibhāya divaścitsānu rejata svane vaḥ |
5,060.03 yatkrīḻatha maruta ṛṣṭimanta āpa iva sadhryañco dhavadhve ||
5,060.04  varā ivedraivatāso hiraṇyairabhi svadhābhistanvaḥ pipiśre |
5,060.04 śriye śreyāṃsastavaso ratheṣu satrā mahāṃsi cakrire tanūṣu ||
5,060.05  ajyeṣṭhāso akaniṣṭhāsa ete saṃ bhrātaro vāvṛdhuḥ saubhagāya |
5,060.05 yuvā pitā svapā rudra eṣāṃ sudughā pṛśniḥ sudinā marudbhyaḥ ||
5,060.06  yaduttame maruto madhyame vā yadvāvame subhagāso divi ṣṭha |
5,060.06 ato no rudrā uta vā nvasyāgne vittāddhaviṣo yadyajāma ||
5,060.07  agniśca yanmaruto viśvavedaso divo vahadhva uttarādadhi ṣṇubhiḥ |
5,060.07 te mandasānā dhunayo riśādaso vāmaṃ dhatta yajamānāya sunvate ||
5,060.08  agne marudbhiḥ śubhayadbhirṛkvabhiḥ somaṃ piba mandasāno gaṇaśribhiḥ |
5,060.08 pāvakebhirviśvaminvebhirāyubhirvaiśvānara pradivā ketunā sajūḥ ||

5,061.01  ke ṣṭhā naraḥ śreṣṭhatamā ya ekaeka āyaya |
5,061.01 paramasyāḥ parāvataḥ ||
5,061.02  kva vo'śvāḥ kvābhīśavaḥ kathaṃ śeka kathā yaya |
5,061.02 pṛṣṭhe sado nasoryamaḥ ||
5,061.03  jaghane coda eṣāṃ vi sakthāni naro yamuḥ |
5,061.03 putrakṛthe na janayaḥ ||
5,061.04  parā vīrāsa etana maryāso bhadrajānayaḥ |
5,061.04 agnitapo yathāsatha ||
5,061.05  sanatsāśvyaṃ paśumuta gavyaṃ śatāvayam |
5,061.05 śyāvāśvastutāya yā dorvīrāyopabarbṛhat ||
5,061.06  uta tvā strī śaśīyasī puṃso bhavati vasyasī |
5,061.06 adevatrādarādhasaḥ ||
5,061.07  vi yā jānāti jasuriṃ vi tṛṣyantaṃ vi kāminam |
5,061.07 devatrā kṛṇute manaḥ ||
5,061.08  uta ghā nemo astutaḥ pumāṃ iti bruve paṇiḥ |
5,061.08 sa vairadeya itsamaḥ ||
5,061.09  uta me'rapadyuvatirmamanduṣī prati śyāvāya vartanim |
5,061.09 vi rohitā purumīḻhāya yematurviprāya dīrghayaśase ||
5,061.10  yo me dhenūnāṃ śataṃ vaidadaśviryathā dadat |
5,061.10 taranta iva maṃhanā ||
5,061.11  ya īṃ vahanta āśubhiḥ pibanto madiraṃ madhu |
5,061.11 atra śravāṃsi dadhire ||
5,061.12  yeṣāṃ śriyādhi rodasī vibhrājante ratheṣvā |
5,061.12 divi rukma ivopari ||
5,061.13  yuvā sa māruto gaṇastveṣaratho anedyaḥ |
5,061.13 śubhaṃyāvāpratiṣkutaḥ ||
5,061.14  ko veda nūnameṣāṃ yatrā madanti dhūtayaḥ |
5,061.14 ṛtajātā arepasaḥ ||
5,061.15  yūyaṃ martaṃ vipanyavaḥ praṇetāra itthā dhiyā |
5,061.15 śrotāro yāmahūtiṣu ||
5,061.16  te no vasūni kāmyā puruścandrā riśādasaḥ |
5,061.16 ā yajñiyāso vavṛttana ||
5,061.17  etaṃ me stomamūrmye dārbhyāya parā vaha |
5,061.17 giro devi rathīriva ||
5,061.18  uta me vocatāditi sutasome rathavītau |
5,061.18 na kāmo apa veti me ||
5,061.19  eṣa kṣeti rathavītirmaghavā gomatīranu |
5,061.19 parvateṣvapaśritaḥ ||

5,062.01  ṛtena ṛtamapihitaṃ dhruvaṃ vāṃ sūryasya yatra vimucantyaśvān |
5,062.01 daśa śatā saha tasthustadekaṃ devānāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vapuṣāmapaśyam ||
5,062.02  tatsu vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā mahitvamīrmā tasthuṣīrahabhirduduhre |
5,062.02 viśvāḥ pinvathaḥ svasarasya dhenā anu vāmekaḥ pavirā vavarta ||
5,062.03  adhārayataṃ pṛthivīmuta dyāṃ mitrarājānā varuṇā mahobhiḥ |
5,062.03 vardhayatamoṣadhīḥ pinvataṃ gā ava vṛṣṭiṃ sṛjataṃ jīradānū ||
5,062.04  ā vāmaśvāsaḥ suyujo vahantu yataraśmaya upa yantvarvāk |
5,062.04 ghṛtasya nirṇiganu vartate vāmupa sindhavaḥ pradivi kṣaranti ||
5,062.05  anu śrutāmamatiṃ vardhadurvīṃ barhiriva yajuṣā rakṣamāṇā |
5,062.05 namasvantā dhṛtadakṣādhi garte mitrāsāthe varuṇeḻāsvantaḥ ||
5,062.06  akravihastā sukṛte paraspā yaṃ trāsāthe varuṇeḻāsvantaḥ |
5,062.06 rājānā kṣatramahṛṇīyamānā sahasrasthūṇaṃ bibhṛthaḥ saha dvau ||
5,062.07  hiraṇyanirṇigayo asya sthūṇā vi bhrājate divyaśvājanīva |
5,062.07 bhadre kṣetre nimitā tilvile vā sanema madhvo adhigartyasya ||
5,062.08  hiraṇyarūpamuṣaso vyuṣṭāvayasthūṇamuditā sūryasya |
5,062.08 ā rohatho varuṇa mitra gartamataścakṣāthe aditiṃ ditiṃ ca ||
5,062.09  yadbaṃhiṣṭhaṃ nātividhe sudānū acchidraṃ śarma bhuvanasya gopā |
5,062.09 tena no mitrāvaruṇāvaviṣṭaṃ siṣāsanto jigīvāṃsaḥ syāma ||

5,063.01  ṛtasya gopāvadhi tiṣṭhatho rathaṃ satyadharmāṇā parame vyomani |
5,063.01 yamatra mitrāvaruṇāvatho yuvaṃ tasmai vṛṣṭirmadhumatpinvate divaḥ ||
5,063.02  samrājāvasya bhuvanasya rājatho mitrāvaruṇā vidathe svardṛśā |
5,063.02 vṛṣṭiṃ vāṃ rādho amṛtatvamīmahe dyāvāpṛthivī vi caranti tanyavaḥ ||
5,063.03  samrājā ugrā vṛṣabhā divaspatī pṛthivyā mitrāvaruṇā vicarṣaṇī |
5,063.03 citrebhirabhrairupa tiṣṭhatho ravaṃ dyāṃ varṣayatho asurasya māyayā ||
5,063.04  māyā vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā divi śritā sūryo jyotiścarati citramāyudham |
5,063.04 tamabhreṇa vṛṣṭyā gūhatho divi parjanya drapsā madhumanta īrate ||
5,063.05  rathaṃ yuñjate marutaḥ śubhe sukhaṃ śūro na mitrāvaruṇā gaviṣṭiṣu |
5,063.05 rajāṃsi citrā vi caranti tanyavo divaḥ samrājā payasā na ukṣatam ||
5,063.06  vācaṃ su mitrāvaruṇāvirāvatīṃ parjanyaścitrāṃ vadati tviṣīmatīm |
5,063.06 abhrā vasata marutaḥ su māyayā dyāṃ varṣayatamaruṇāmarepasam ||
5,063.07  dharmaṇā mitrāvaruṇā vipaścitā vratā rakṣethe asurasya māyayā |
5,063.07 ṛtena viśvaṃ bhuvanaṃ vi rājathaḥ sūryamā dhattho divi citryaṃ ratham ||

5,064.01  varuṇaṃ vo riśādasamṛcā mitraṃ havāmahe |
5,064.01 pari vrajeva bāhvorjaganvāṃsā svarṇaram ||
5,064.02  tā bāhavā sucetunā pra yantamasmā arcate |
5,064.02 śevaṃ hi jāryaṃ vāṃ viśvāsu kṣāsu joguve ||
5,064.03  yannūnamaśyāṃ gatiṃ mitrasya yāyāṃ pathā |
5,064.03 asya priyasya śarmaṇyahiṃsānasya saścire ||
5,064.04  yuvābhyāṃ mitrāvaruṇopamaṃ dheyāmṛcā |
5,064.04 yaddha kṣaye maghonāṃ stotṝṇāṃ ca spūrdhase ||
5,064.05  ā no mitra sudītibhirvaruṇaśca sadhastha ā |
5,064.05 sve kṣaye maghonāṃ sakhīnāṃ ca vṛdhase ||
5,064.06  yuvaṃ no yeṣu varuṇa kṣatraṃ bṛhacca bibhṛthaḥ |
5,064.06 uru ṇo vājasātaye kṛtaṃ rāye svastaye ||
5,064.07  ucchantyāṃ me yajatā devakṣatre ruśadgavi |
5,064.07 sutaṃ somaṃ na hastibhirā paḍbhirdhāvataṃ narā bibhratāvarcanānasam ||

5,065.01  yaściketa sa sukraturdevatrā sa bravītu naḥ |
5,065.01 varuṇo yasya darśato mitro vā vanate giraḥ ||
5,065.02  tā hi śreṣṭhavarcasā rājānā dīrghaśruttamā |
5,065.02 tā satpatī ṛtāvṛdha ṛtāvānā janejane ||
5,065.03  tā vāmiyāno'vase pūrvā upa bruve sacā |
5,065.03 svaśvāsaḥ su cetunā vājāṃ abhi pra dāvane ||
5,065.04  mitro aṃhościdāduru kṣayāya gātuṃ vanate |
5,065.04 mitrasya hi pratūrvataḥ sumatirasti vidhataḥ ||
5,065.05  vayaṃ mitrasyāvasi syāma saprathastame |
5,065.05 anehasastvotayaḥ satrā varuṇaśeṣasaḥ ||
5,065.06  yuvaṃ mitremaṃ janaṃ yatathaḥ saṃ ca nayathaḥ |
5,065.06 mā maghonaḥ pari khyataṃ mo asmākamṛṣīṇāṃ gopīthe na uruṣyatam ||

5,066.01  ā cikitāna sukratū devau marta riśādasā |
5,066.01 varuṇāya ṛtapeśase dadhīta prayase mahe ||
5,066.02  tā hi kṣatramavihrutaṃ samyagasuryamāśāte |
5,066.02 adha vrateva mānuṣaṃ svarṇa dhāyi darśatam ||
5,066.03  tā vāmeṣe rathānāmurvīṃ gavyūtimeṣām |
5,066.03 rātahavyasya suṣṭutiṃ dadhṛkstomairmanāmahe ||
5,066.04  adhā hi kāvyā yuvaṃ dakṣasya pūrbhiradbhutā |
5,066.04 ni ketunā janānāṃ cikethe pūtadakṣasā ||
5,066.05  tadṛtaṃ pṛthivi bṛhacchravaeṣa ṛṣīṇām |
5,066.05 jrayasānāvaraṃ pṛthvati kṣaranti yāmabhiḥ ||
5,066.06  ā yadvāmīyacakṣasā mitra vayaṃ ca sūrayaḥ |
5,066.06 vyaciṣṭhe bahupāyye yatemahi svarājye ||

5,067.01  baḻ itthā deva niṣkṛtamādityā yajataṃ bṛhat |
5,067.01 varuṇa mitrāryamanvarṣiṣṭhaṃ kṣatramāśāthe ||
5,067.02  ā yadyoniṃ hiraṇyayaṃ varuṇa mitra sadathaḥ |
5,067.02 dhartārā carṣaṇīnāṃ yantaṃ sumnaṃ riśādasā ||
5,067.03  viśve hi viśvavedaso varuṇo mitro aryamā |
5,067.03 vratā padeva saścire pānti martyaṃ riṣaḥ ||
5,067.04  te hi satyā ṛtaspṛśa ṛtāvāno janejane |
5,067.04 sunīthāsaḥ sudānavo'ṃhościdurucakrayaḥ ||
5,067.05  ko nu vāṃ mitrāstuto varuṇo vā tanūnām |
5,067.05 tatsu vāmeṣate matiratribhya eṣate matiḥ ||

5,068.01  pra vo mitrāya gāyata varuṇāya vipā girā |
5,068.01 mahikṣatrāvṛtaṃ bṛhat ||
5,068.02  samrājā yā ghṛtayonī mitraścobhā varuṇaśca |
5,068.02 devā deveṣu praśastā ||
5,068.03  tā naḥ śaktaṃ pārthivasya maho rāyo divyasya |
5,068.03 mahi vāṃ kṣatraṃ deveṣu ||
5,068.04  ṛtamṛtena sapanteṣiraṃ dakṣamāśāte |
5,068.04 adruhā devau vardhete ||
5,068.05  vṛṣṭidyāvā rītyāpeṣaspatī dānumatyāḥ |
5,068.05 bṛhantaṃ gartamāśāte ||

5,069.01  trī rocanā varuṇa trīṃruta dyūntrīṇi mitra dhārayatho rajāṃsi |
5,069.01 vāvṛdhānāvamatiṃ kṣatriyasyānu vrataṃ rakṣamāṇāvajuryam ||
5,069.02  irāvatīrvaruṇa dhenavo vāṃ madhumadvāṃ sindhavo mitra duhre |
5,069.02 trayastasthurvṛṣabhāsastisṛṇāṃ dhiṣaṇānāṃ retodhā vi dyumantaḥ ||
5,069.03  prātardevīmaditiṃ johavīmi madhyandina uditā sūryasya |
5,069.03 rāye mitrāvaruṇā sarvatāteḻe tokāya tanayāya śaṃ yoḥ ||
5,069.04  yā dhartārā rajaso rocanasyotādityā divyā pārthivasya |
5,069.04 na vāṃ devā amṛtā ā minanti vratāni mitrāvaruṇā dhruvāṇi ||

5,070.01  purūruṇā ciddhyastyavo nūnaṃ vāṃ varuṇa |
5,070.01 mitra vaṃsi vāṃ sumatim ||
5,070.02  tā vāṃ samyagadruhvāṇeṣamaśyāma dhāyase |
5,070.02 vayaṃ te rudrā syāma ||
5,070.03  pātaṃ no rudrā pāyubhiruta trāyethāṃ sutrātrā |
5,070.03 turyāma dasyūntanūbhiḥ ||
5,070.04  mā kasyādbhutakratū yakṣaṃ bhujemā tanūbhiḥ |
5,070.04 mā śeṣasā mā tanasā ||

5,071.01  ā no gantaṃ riśādasā varuṇa mitra barhaṇā |
5,071.01 upemaṃ cārumadhvaram ||
5,071.02  viśvasya hi pracetasā varuṇa mitra rājathaḥ |
5,071.02 īśānā pipyataṃ dhiyaḥ ||
5,071.03  upa naḥ sutamā gataṃ varuṇa mitra dāśuṣaḥ |
5,071.03 asya somasya pītaye ||

5,072.01  ā mitre varuṇe vayaṃ gīrbhirjuhumo atrivat |
5,072.01 ni barhiṣi sadataṃ somapītaye ||
5,072.02  vratena stho dhruvakṣemā dharmaṇā yātayajjanā |
5,072.02 ni barhiṣi sadataṃ somapītaye ||
5,072.03  mitraśca no varuṇaśca juṣetāṃ yajñamiṣṭaye |
5,072.03 ni barhiṣi sadatāṃ somapītaye ||

5,073.01  yadadya sthaḥ parāvati yadarvāvatyaśvinā |
5,073.01 yadvā purū purubhujā yadantarikṣa ā gatam ||
5,073.02  iha tyā purubhūtamā purū daṃsāṃsi bibhratā |
5,073.02 varasyā yāmyadhrigū huve tuviṣṭamā bhuje ||
5,073.03  īrmānyadvapuṣe vapuścakraṃ rathasya yemathuḥ |
5,073.03 paryanyā nāhuṣā yugā mahnā rajāṃsi dīyathaḥ ||
5,073.04  tadū ṣu vāmenā kṛtaṃ viśvā yadvāmanu ṣṭave |
5,073.04 nānā jātāvarepasā samasme bandhumeyathuḥ ||
5,073.05  ā yadvāṃ sūryā rathaṃ tiṣṭhadraghuṣyadaṃ sadā |
5,073.05 pari vāmaruṣā vayo ghṛṇā varanta ātapaḥ ||
5,073.06  yuvoratriściketati narā sumnena cetasā |
5,073.06 gharmaṃ yadvāmarepasaṃ nāsatyāsnā bhuraṇyati ||
5,073.07  ugro vāṃ kakuho yayiḥ śṛṇve yāmeṣu saṃtaniḥ |
5,073.07 yadvāṃ daṃsobhiraśvinātrirnarāvavartati ||
5,073.08  madhva ū ṣu madhūyuvā rudrā siṣakti pipyuṣī |
5,073.08 yatsamudrāti parṣathaḥ pakvāḥ pṛkṣo bharanta vām ||
5,073.09  satyamidvā u aśvinā yuvāmāhurmayobhuvā |
5,073.09 tā yāmanyāmahūtamā yāmannā mṛḻayattamā ||
5,073.10  imā brahmāṇi vardhanāśvibhyāṃ santu śantamā |
5,073.10 yā takṣāma rathāṃ ivāvocāma bṛhannamaḥ ||
5,074.01  kūṣṭho devāvaśvinādyā divo manāvasū |
5,074.01 tacchravatho vṛṣaṇvasū atrirvāmā vivāsati ||
5,074.02  kuha tyā kuha nu śrutā divi devā nāsatyā |
5,074.02 kasminnā yatatho jane ko vāṃ nadīnāṃ sacā ||
5,074.03  kaṃ yāthaḥ kaṃ ha gacchathaḥ kamacchā yuñjāthe ratham |
5,074.03 kasya brahmāṇi raṇyatho vayaṃ vāmuśmasīṣṭaye ||
5,074.04  pauraṃ ciddhyudaprutaṃ paura paurāya jinvathaḥ |
5,074.04 yadīṃ gṛbhītatātaye siṃhamiva druhaspade ||
5,074.05  pra cyavānājjujuruṣo vavrimatkaṃ na muñcathaḥ |
5,074.05 yuvā yadī kṛthaḥ punarā kāmamṛṇve vadhvaḥ ||
5,074.06  asti hi vāmiha stotā smasi vāṃ saṃdṛśi śriye |
5,074.06 nū śrutaṃ ma ā gatamavobhirvājinīvasū ||
5,074.07  ko vāmadya purūṇāmā vavne martyānām |
5,074.07 ko vipro vipravāhasā ko yajñairvājinīvasū ||
5,074.08  ā vāṃ ratho rathānāṃ yeṣṭho yātvaśvinā |
5,074.08 purū cidasmayustira āṅgūṣo martyeṣvā ||
5,074.09  śamū ṣu vāṃ madhūyuvāsmākamastu carkṛtiḥ |
5,074.09 arvācīnā vicetasā vibhiḥ śyeneva dīyatam ||
5,074.10  aśvinā yaddha karhi cicchuśrūyātamimaṃ havam |
5,074.10 vasvīrū ṣu vāṃ bhujaḥ pṛñcanti su vāṃ pṛcaḥ ||

5,075.01  prati priyatamaṃ rathaṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ vasuvāhanam |
5,075.01 stotā vāmaśvināvṛṣi stomena prati bhūṣati mādhvī mama śrutaṃ havam ||
5,075.02  atyāyātamaśvinā tiro viśvā ahaṃ sanā |
5,075.02 dasrā hiraṇyavartanī suṣumnā sindhuvāhasā mādhvī mama śrutaṃ havam ||
5,075.03  ā no ratnāni bibhratāvaśvinā gacchataṃ yuvam |
5,075.03 rudrā hiraṇyavartanī juṣāṇā vājinīvasū mādhvī mama śrutaṃ havam ||
5,075.04  suṣṭubho vāṃ vṛṣaṇvasū rathe vāṇīcyāhitā |
5,075.04 uta vāṃ kakuho mṛgaḥ pṛkṣaḥ kṛṇoti vāpuṣo mādhvī mama śrutaṃ havam ||
5,075.05  bodhinmanasā rathyeṣirā havanaśrutā |
5,075.05 vibhiścyavānamaśvinā ni yātho advayāvinaṃ mādhvī mama śrutaṃ havam ||
5,075.06  ā vāṃ narā manoyujo'śvāsaḥ pruṣitapsavaḥ |
5,075.06 vayo vahantu pītaye saha sumnebhiraśvinā mādhvī mama śrutaṃ havam ||
5,075.07  aśvināveha gacchataṃ nāsatyā mā vi venatam |
5,075.07 tiraścidaryayā pari vartiryātamadābhyā mādhvī mama śrutaṃ havam ||
5,075.08  asminyajñe adābhyā jaritāraṃ śubhaspatī |
5,075.08 avasyumaśvinā yuvaṃ gṛṇantamupa bhūṣatho mādhvī mama śrutaṃ havam ||
5,075.09  abhūduṣā ruśatpaśurāgniradhāyyṛtviyaḥ |
5,075.09 ayoji vāṃ vṛṣaṇvasū ratho dasrāvamartyo mādhvī mama śrutaṃ havam ||

5,076.01  ā bhātyagniruṣasāmanīkamudviprāṇāṃ devayā vāco asthuḥ |
5,076.01 arvāñcā nūnaṃ rathyeha yātaṃ pīpivāṃsamaśvinā gharmamaccha ||
5,076.02  na saṃskṛtaṃ pra mimīto gamiṣṭhānti nūnamaśvinopastuteha |
5,076.02 divābhipitve'vasāgamiṣṭhā pratyavartiṃ dāśuṣe śambhaviṣṭhā ||
5,076.03  utā yātaṃ saṃgave prātarahno madhyandina uditā sūryasya |
5,076.03 divā naktamavasā śantamena nedānīṃ pītiraśvinā tatāna ||
5,076.04  idaṃ hi vāṃ pradivi sthānamoka ime gṛhā aśvinedaṃ duroṇam |
5,076.04 ā no divo bṛhataḥ parvatādādbhyo yātamiṣamūrjaṃ vahantā ||
5,076.05  samaśvinoravasā nūtanena mayobhuvā supraṇītī gamema |
5,076.05 ā no rayiṃ vahatamota vīrānā viśvānyamṛtā saubhagāni ||

5,077.01  prātaryāvāṇā prathamā yajadhvaṃ purā gṛdhrādararuṣaḥ pibātaḥ |
5,077.01 prātarhi yajñamaśvinā dadhāte pra śaṃsanti kavayaḥ pūrvabhājaḥ ||
5,077.02  prātaryajadhvamaśvinā hinota na sāyamasti devayā ajuṣṭam |
5,077.02 utānyo asmadyajate vi cāvaḥ pūrvaḥpūrvo yajamāno vanīyān ||
5,077.03  hiraṇyatvaṅmadhuvarṇo ghṛtasnuḥ pṛkṣo vahannā ratho vartate vām |
5,077.03 manojavā aśvinā vātaraṃhā yenātiyātho duritāni viśvā ||
5,077.04  yo bhūyiṣṭhaṃ nāsatyābhyāṃ viveṣa caniṣṭhaṃ pitvo rarate vibhāge |
5,077.04 sa tokamasya pīparacchamībhiranūrdhvabhāsaḥ sadamittuturyāt ||
5,077.05  samaśvinoravasā nūtanena mayobhuvā supraṇītī gamema |
5,077.05 ā no rayiṃ vahatamota vīrānā viśvānyamṛtā saubhagāni ||

5,078.01  aśvināveha gacchataṃ nāsatyā mā vi venatam |
5,078.01 haṃsāviva patatamā sutāṃ upa ||
5,078.02  aśvinā hariṇāviva gaurāvivānu yavasam |
5,078.02 haṃsāviva patatamā sutāṃ upa ||
5,078.03  aśvinā vājinīvasū juṣethāṃ yajñamiṣṭaye |
5,078.03 haṃsāviva patatamā sutāṃ upa ||
5,078.04  atriryadvāmavarohannṛbīsamajohavīnnādhamāneva yoṣā |
5,078.04 śyenasya cijjavasā nūtanenāgacchatamaśvinā śantamena ||
5,078.05  vi jihīṣva vanaspate yoniḥ sūṣyantyā iva |
5,078.05 śrutaṃ me aśvinā havaṃ saptavadhriṃ ca muñcatam ||
5,078.06  bhītāya nādhamānāya ṛṣaye saptavadhraye |
5,078.06 māyābhiraśvinā yuvaṃ vṛkṣaṃ saṃ ca vi cācathaḥ ||
5,078.07  yathā vātaḥ puṣkariṇīṃ samiṅgayati sarvataḥ |
5,078.07 evā te garbha ejatu niraitu daśamāsyaḥ ||
5,078.08  yathā vāto yathā vanaṃ yathā samudra ejati |
5,078.08 evā tvaṃ daśamāsya sahāvehi jarāyuṇā ||
5,078.09  daśa māsāñchaśayānaḥ kumāro adhi mātari |
5,078.09 niraitu jīvo akṣato jīvo jīvantyā adhi ||

5,079.01  mahe no adya bodhayoṣo rāye divitmatī |
5,079.01 yathā cinno abodhayaḥ satyaśravasi vāyye sujāte aśvasūnṛte ||
5,079.02  yā sunīthe śaucadrathe vyauccho duhitardivaḥ |
5,079.02 sā vyuccha sahīyasi satyaśravasi vāyye sujāte aśvasūnṛte ||
5,079.03  sā no adyābharadvasurvyucchā duhitardivaḥ |
5,079.03 yo vyaucchaḥ sahīyasi satyaśravasi vāyye sujāte aśvasūnṛte ||
5,079.04  abhi ye tvā vibhāvari stomairgṛṇanti vahnayaḥ |
5,079.04 maghairmaghoni suśriyo dāmanvantaḥ surātayaḥ sujāte aśvasūnṛte ||
5,079.05  yacciddhi te gaṇā ime chadayanti maghattaye |
5,079.05 pari cidvaṣṭayo dadhurdadato rādho ahrayaṃ sujāte aśvasūnṛte ||
5,079.06  aiṣu dhā vīravadyaśa uṣo maghoni sūriṣu |
5,079.06 ye no rādhāṃsyahrayā maghavāno arāsata sujāte aśvasūnṛte ||
5,079.07  tebhyo dyumnaṃ bṛhadyaśa uṣo maghonyā vaha |
5,079.07 ye no rādhāṃsyaśvyā gavyā bhajanta sūrayaḥ sujāte aśvasūnṛte ||
5,079.08  uta no gomatīriṣa ā vahā duhitardivaḥ |
5,079.08 sākaṃ sūryasya raśmibhiḥ śukraiḥ śocadbhirarcibhiḥ sujāte aśvasūnṛte ||
5,079.09  vyucchā duhitardivo mā ciraṃ tanuthā apaḥ |
5,079.09 nettvā stenaṃ yathā ripuṃ tapāti sūro arciṣā sujāte aśvasūnṛte ||
5,079.10  etāvadveduṣastvaṃ bhūyo vā dātumarhasi |
5,079.10 yā stotṛbhyo vibhāvaryucchantī na pramīyase sujāte aśvasūnṛte ||

5,080.01  dyutadyāmānaṃ bṛhatīmṛtena ṛtāvarīmaruṇapsuṃ vibhātīm |
5,080.01 devīmuṣasaṃ svarāvahantīṃ prati viprāso matibhirjarante ||
5,080.02  eṣā janaṃ darśatā bodhayantī sugānpathaḥ kṛṇvatī yātyagre |
5,080.02 bṛhadrathā bṛhatī viśvaminvoṣā jyotiryacchatyagre ahnām ||
5,080.03  eṣā gobhiraruṇebhiryujānāsredhantī rayimaprāyu cakre |
5,080.03 patho radantī suvitāya devī puruṣṭutā viśvavārā vi bhāti ||
5,080.04  eṣā vyenī bhavati dvibarhā āviṣkṛṇvānā tanvaṃ purastāt |
5,080.04 ṛtasya panthāmanveti sādhu prajānatīva na diśo mināti ||
5,080.05  eṣā śubhrā na tanvo vidānordhveva snātī dṛśaye no asthāt |
5,080.05 apa dveṣo bādhamānā tamāṃsyuṣā divo duhitā jyotiṣāgāt ||
5,080.06  eṣā pratīcī duhitā divo nṝnyoṣeva bhadrā ni riṇīte apsaḥ |
5,080.06 vyūrṇvatī dāśuṣe vāryāṇi punarjyotiryuvatiḥ pūrvathākaḥ ||

5,081.01  yuñjate mana uta yuñjate dhiyo viprā viprasya bṛhato vipaścitaḥ |
5,081.01 vi hotrā dadhe vayunāvideka inmahī devasya savituḥ pariṣṭutiḥ ||
5,081.02  viśvā rūpāṇi prati muñcate kaviḥ prāsāvīdbhadraṃ dvipade catuṣpade |
5,081.02 vi nākamakhyatsavitā vareṇyo'nu prayāṇamuṣaso vi rājati ||
5,081.03  yasya prayāṇamanvanya idyayurdevā devasya mahimānamojasā |
5,081.03 yaḥ pārthivāni vimame sa etaśo rajāṃsi devaḥ savitā mahitvanā ||
5,081.04  uta yāsi savitastrīṇi rocanota sūryasya raśmibhiḥ samucyasi |
5,081.04 uta rātrīmubhayataḥ parīyasa uta mitro bhavasi deva dharmabhiḥ ||
5,081.05  uteśiṣe prasavasya tvameka iduta pūṣā bhavasi deva yāmabhiḥ |
5,081.05 utedaṃ viśvaṃ bhuvanaṃ vi rājasi śyāvāśvaste savita stomamānaśe ||

5,082.01  tatsaviturvṛṇīmahe vayaṃ devasya bhojanam |
5,082.01 śreṣṭhaṃ sarvadhātamaṃ turaṃ bhagasya dhīmahi ||
5,082.02  asya hi svayaśastaraṃ savituḥ kaccana priyam |
5,082.02 na minanti svarājyam ||
5,082.03  sa hi ratnāni dāśuṣe suvāti savitā bhagaḥ |
5,082.03 taṃ bhāgaṃ citramīmahe ||
5,082.04  adyā no deva savitaḥ prajāvatsāvīḥ saubhagam |
5,082.04 parā duṣṣvapnyaṃ suva ||
5,082.05  viśvāni deva savitarduritāni parā suva |
5,082.05 yadbhadraṃ tanna ā suva ||
5,082.06  anāgaso aditaye devasya savituḥ save |
5,082.06 viśvā vāmāni dhīmahi ||
5,082.07  ā viśvadevaṃ satpatiṃ sūktairadyā vṛṇīmahe |
5,082.07 satyasavaṃ savitāram ||
5,082.08  ya ime ubhe ahanī pura etyaprayucchan |
5,082.08 svādhīrdevaḥ savitā ||
5,082.09  ya imā viśvā jātānyāśrāvayati ślokena |
5,082.09 pra ca suvāti savitā ||

5,083.01  acchā vada tavasaṃ gīrbhirābhi stuhi parjanyaṃ namasā vivāsa |
5,083.01 kanikradadvṛṣabho jīradānū reto dadhātyoṣadhīṣu garbham ||
5,083.02  vi vṛkṣānhantyuta hanti rakṣaso viśvaṃ bibhāya bhuvanaṃ mahāvadhāt |
5,083.02 utānāgā īṣate vṛṣṇyāvato yatparjanya stanayanhanti duṣkṛtaḥ ||
5,083.03  rathīva kaśayāśvāṃ abhikṣipannāvirdūtānkṛṇute varṣyāṃ aha |
5,083.03 dūrātsiṃhasya stanathā udīrate yatparjanyaḥ kṛṇute varṣyaṃ nabhaḥ ||
5,083.04  pra vātā vānti patayanti vidyuta udoṣadhīrjihate pinvate svaḥ |
5,083.04 irā viśvasmai bhuvanāya jāyate yatparjanyaḥ pṛthivīṃ retasāvati ||
5,083.05  yasya vrate pṛthivī nannamīti yasya vrate śaphavajjarbhurīti |
5,083.05 yasya vrata oṣadhīrviśvarūpāḥ sa naḥ parjanya mahi śarma yaccha ||
5,083.06  divo no vṛṣṭiṃ maruto rarīdhvaṃ pra pinvata vṛṣṇo aśvasya dhārāḥ |
5,083.06 arvāṅetena stanayitnunehyapo niṣiñcannasuraḥ pitā naḥ ||
5,083.07  abhi kranda stanaya garbhamā dhā udanvatā pari dīyā rathena |
5,083.07 dṛtiṃ su karṣa viṣitaṃ nyañcaṃ samā bhavantūdvato nipādāḥ ||
5,083.08  mahāntaṃ kośamudacā ni ṣiñca syandantāṃ kulyā viṣitāḥ purastāt |
5,083.08 ghṛtena dyāvāpṛthivī vyundhi suprapāṇaṃ bhavatvaghnyābhyaḥ ||
5,083.09  yatparjanya kanikradatstanayanhaṃsi duṣkṛtaḥ |
5,083.09 pratīdaṃ viśvaṃ modate yatkiṃ ca pṛthivyāmadhi ||
5,083.10  avarṣīrvarṣamudu ṣū gṛbhāyākardhanvānyatyetavā u |
5,083.10 ajījana oṣadhīrbhojanāya kamuta prajābhyo'vido manīṣām ||

5,084.01  baḻ itthā parvatānāṃ khidraṃ bibharṣi pṛthivi |
5,084.01 pra yā bhūmiṃ pravatvati mahnā jinoṣi mahini ||
5,084.02  stomāsastvā vicāriṇi prati ṣṭobhantyaktubhiḥ |
5,084.02 pra yā vājaṃ na heṣantaṃ perumasyasyarjuni ||
5,084.03  dṛḻhā cidyā vanaspatīnkṣmayā dardharṣyojasā |
5,084.03 yatte abhrasya vidyuto divo varṣanti vṛṣṭayaḥ ||

5,085.01  pra samrāje bṛhadarcā gabhīraṃ brahma priyaṃ varuṇāya śrutāya |
5,085.01 vi yo jaghāna śamiteva carmopastire pṛthivīṃ sūryāya ||
5,085.02  vaneṣu vyantarikṣaṃ tatāna vājamarvatsu paya usriyāsu |
5,085.02 hṛtsu kratuṃ varuṇo apsvagniṃ divi sūryamadadhātsomamadrau ||
5,085.03  nīcīnabāraṃ varuṇaḥ kavandhaṃ pra sasarja rodasī antarikṣam |
5,085.03 tena viśvasya bhuvanasya rājā yavaṃ na vṛṣṭirvyunatti bhūma ||
5,085.04  unatti bhūmiṃ pṛthivīmuta dyāṃ yadā dugdhaṃ varuṇo vaṣṭyādit |
5,085.04 samabhreṇa vasata parvatāsastaviṣīyantaḥ śrathayanta vīrāḥ ||
5,085.05  imāmū ṣvāsurasya śrutasya mahīṃ māyāṃ varuṇasya pra vocam |
5,085.05 māneneva tasthivāṃ antarikṣe vi yo mame pṛthivīṃ sūryeṇa ||
5,085.06  imāmū nu kavitamasya māyāṃ mahīṃ devasya nakirā dadharṣa |
5,085.06 ekaṃ yadudnā na pṛṇantyenīrāsiñcantīravanayaḥ samudram ||
5,085.07  aryamyaṃ varuṇa mitryaṃ vā sakhāyaṃ vā sadamidbhrātaraṃ vā |
5,085.07 veśaṃ vā nityaṃ varuṇāraṇaṃ vā yatsīmāgaścakṛmā śiśrathastat ||
5,085.08  kitavāso yadriripurna dīvi yadvā ghā satyamuta yanna vidma |
5,085.08 sarvā tā vi ṣya śithireva devādhā te syāma varuṇa priyāsaḥ ||

5,086.01  indrāgnī yamavatha ubhā vājeṣu martyam |
5,086.01 dṛḻhā citsa pra bhedati dyumnā vāṇīriva tritaḥ ||
5,086.02  yā pṛtanāsu duṣṭarā yā vājeṣu śravāyyā |
5,086.02 yā pañca carṣaṇīrabhīndrāgnī tā havāmahe ||
5,086.03  tayoridamavacchavastigmā didyunmaghonoḥ |
5,086.03 prati druṇā gabhastyorgavāṃ vṛtraghna eṣate ||
5,086.04  tā vāmeṣe rathānāmindrāgnī havāmahe |
5,086.04 patī turasya rādhaso vidvāṃsā girvaṇastamā ||
5,086.05  tā vṛdhantāvanu dyūnmartāya devāvadabhā |
5,086.05 arhantā citpuro dadhe'ṃśeva devāvarvate ||
5,086.06  evendrāgnibhyāmahāvi havyaṃ śūṣyaṃ ghṛtaṃ na pūtamadribhiḥ |
5,086.06 tā sūriṣu śravo bṛhadrayiṃ gṛṇatsu didhṛtamiṣaṃ gṛṇatsu didhṛtam ||

5,087.01  pra vo mahe matayo yantu viṣṇave marutvate girijā evayāmarut |
5,087.01 pra śardhāya prayajyave sukhādaye tavase bhandadiṣṭaye dhunivratāya śavase ||
5,087.02  pra ye jātā mahinā ye ca nu svayaṃ pra vidmanā bruvata evayāmarut |
