5,087.02 kratvā tadvo maruto nādhṛṣe śavo dānā mahnā tadeṣāmadhṛṣṭāso nādrayaḥ ||
5,087.03  pra ye divo bṛhataḥ śṛṇvire girā suśukvānaḥ subhva evayāmarut |
5,087.03 na yeṣāmirī sadhastha īṣṭa āṃ agnayo na svavidyutaḥ pra syandrāso dhunīnām ||
5,087.04  sa cakrame mahato nirurukramaḥ samānasmātsadasa evayāmarut |
5,087.04 yadāyukta tmanā svādadhi ṣṇubhirviṣpardhaso vimahaso jigāti śevṛdho nṛbhiḥ ||
5,087.05  svano na vo'mavānrejayadvṛṣā tveṣo yayistaviṣa evayāmarut |
5,087.05 yenā sahanta ṛñjata svarociṣa sthāraśmāno hiraṇyayāḥ svāyudhāsa iṣmiṇaḥ ||
5,087.06  apāro vo mahimā vṛddhaśavasastveṣaṃ śavo'vatvevayāmarut |
5,087.06 sthātāro hi prasitau saṃdṛśi sthana te na uruṣyatā nidaḥ śuśukvāṃso nāgnayaḥ ||
5,087.07  te rudrāsaḥ sumakhā agnayo yathā tuvidyumnā avantvevayāmarut |
5,087.07 dīrghaṃ pṛthu paprathe sadma pārthivaṃ yeṣāmajmeṣvā mahaḥ śardhāṃsyadbhutainasām ||
5,087.08  adveṣo no maruto gātumetana śrotā havaṃ jariturevayāmarut |
5,087.08 viṣṇormahaḥ samanyavo yuyotana smadrathyo na daṃsanāpa dveṣāṃsi sanutaḥ ||
5,087.09  gantā no yajñaṃ yajñiyāḥ suśami śrotā havamarakṣa evayāmarut |
5,087.09 jyeṣṭhāso na parvatāso vyomani yūyaṃ tasya pracetasaḥ syāta durdhartavo nidaḥ ||









ṛgveda 6



6,001.01  tvaṃ hyagne prathamo manotāsyā dhiyo abhavo dasma hotā |
6,001.01 tvaṃ sīṃ vṛṣannakṛṇorduṣṭarītu saho viśvasmai sahase sahadhyai ||
6,001.02  adhā hotā nyasīdo yajīyāniḻaspada iṣayannīḍyaḥ san |
6,001.02 taṃ tvā naraḥ prathamaṃ devayanto maho rāye citayanto anu gman ||
6,001.03  vṛteva yantaṃ bahubhirvasavyaistve rayiṃ jāgṛvāṃso anu gman |
6,001.03 ruśantamagniṃ darśataṃ bṛhantaṃ vapāvantaṃ viśvahā dīdivāṃsam ||
6,001.04  padaṃ devasya namasā vyantaḥ śravasyavaḥ śrava āpannamṛktam |
6,001.04 nāmāni ciddadhire yajñiyāni bhadrāyāṃ te raṇayanta saṃdṛṣṭau ||
6,001.05  tvāṃ vardhanti kṣitayaḥ pṛthivyāṃ tvāṃ rāya ubhayāso janānām |
6,001.05 tvaṃ trātā taraṇe cetyo bhūḥ pitā mātā sadaminmānuṣāṇām ||
6,001.06  saparyeṇyaḥ sa priyo vikṣvagnirhotā mandro ni ṣasādā yajīyān |
6,001.06 taṃ tvā vayaṃ dama ā dīdivāṃsamupa jñubādho namasā sadema ||
6,001.07  taṃ tvā vayaṃ sudhyo navyamagne sumnāyava īmahe devayantaḥ |
6,001.07 tvaṃ viśo anayo dīdyāno divo agne bṛhatā rocanena ||
6,001.08  viśāṃ kaviṃ viśpatiṃ śaśvatīnāṃ nitośanaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ carṣaṇīnām |
6,001.08 pretīṣaṇimiṣayantaṃ pāvakaṃ rājantamagniṃ yajataṃ rayīṇām ||
6,001.09  so agna īje śaśame ca marto yasta ānaṭsamidhā havyadātim |
6,001.09 ya āhutiṃ pari vedā namobhirviśvetsa vāmā dadhate tvotaḥ ||
6,001.10  asmā u te mahi mahe vidhema namobhiragne samidhota havyaiḥ |
6,001.10 vedī sūno sahaso gīrbhirukthairā te bhadrāyāṃ sumatau yatema ||
6,001.11  ā yastatantha rodasī vi bhāsā śravobhiśca śravasyastarutraḥ |
6,001.11 bṛhadbhirvājai sthavirebhirasme revadbhiragne vitaraṃ vi bhāhi ||
6,001.12  nṛvadvaso sadamiddhehyasme bhūri tokāya tanayāya paśvaḥ |
6,001.12 pūrvīriṣo bṛhatīrāreaghā asme bhadrā sauśravasāni santu ||
6,001.13  purūṇyagne purudhā tvāyā vasūni rājanvasutā te aśyām |
6,001.13 purūṇi hi tve puruvāra santyagne vasu vidhate rājani tve ||

6,002.01  tvaṃ hi kṣaitavadyaśo'gne mitro na patyase |
6,002.01 tvaṃ vicarṣaṇe śravo vaso puṣṭiṃ na puṣyasi ||
6,002.02  tvāṃ hi ṣmā carṣaṇayo yajñebhirgīrbhirīḻate |
6,002.02 tvāṃ vājī yātyavṛko rajastūrviśvacarṣaṇiḥ ||
6,002.03  sajoṣastvā divo naro yajñasya ketumindhate |
6,002.03 yaddha sya mānuṣo janaḥ sumnāyurjuhve adhvare ||
6,002.04  ṛdhadyaste sudānave dhiyā martaḥ śaśamate |
6,002.04 ūtī ṣa bṛhato divo dviṣo aṃho na tarati ||
6,002.05  samidhā yasta āhutiṃ niśitiṃ martyo naśat |
6,002.05 vayāvantaṃ sa puṣyati kṣayamagne śatāyuṣam ||
6,002.06  tveṣaste dhūma ṛṇvati divi ṣañchukra ātataḥ |
6,002.06 sūro na hi dyutā tvaṃ kṛpā pāvaka rocase ||
6,002.07  adhā hi vikṣvīḍyo'si priyo no atithiḥ |
6,002.07 raṇvaḥ purīva jūryaḥ sūnurna trayayāyyaḥ ||
6,002.08  kratvā hi droṇe ajyase'gne vājī na kṛtvyaḥ |
6,002.08 parijmeva svadhā gayo'tyo na hvāryaḥ śiśuḥ ||
6,002.09  tvaṃ tyā cidacyutāgne paśurna yavase |
6,002.09 dhāmā ha yatte ajara vanā vṛścanti śikvasaḥ ||
6,002.10  veṣi hyadhvarīyatāmagne hotā dame viśām |
6,002.10 samṛdho viśpate kṛṇu juṣasva havyamaṅgiraḥ ||
6,002.11  acchā no mitramaho deva devānagne vocaḥ sumatiṃ rodasyoḥ |
6,002.11 vīhi svastiṃ sukṣitiṃ divo nṝndviṣo aṃhāṃsi duritā tarema tā tarema tavāvasā tarema ||

6,003.01  agne sa kṣeṣadṛtapā ṛtejā uru jyotirnaśate devayuṣṭe |
6,003.01 yaṃ tvaṃ mitreṇa varuṇaḥ sajoṣā deva pāsi tyajasā martamaṃhaḥ ||
6,003.02  īje yajñebhiḥ śaśame śamībhirṛdhadvārāyāgnaye dadāśa |
6,003.02 evā cana taṃ yaśasāmajuṣṭirnāṃho martaṃ naśate na pradṛptiḥ ||
6,003.03  sūro na yasya dṛśatirarepā bhīmā yadeti śucatasta ā dhīḥ |
6,003.03 heṣasvataḥ śurudho nāyamaktoḥ kutrā cidraṇvo vasatirvanejāḥ ||
6,003.04  tigmaṃ cidema mahi varpo asya bhasadaśvo na yamasāna āsā |
6,003.04 vijehamānaḥ paraśurna jihvāṃ dravirna drāvayati dāru dhakṣat ||
6,003.05  sa idasteva prati dhādasiṣyañchiśīta tejo'yaso na dhārām |
6,003.05 citradhrajatiraratiryo aktorverna druṣadvā raghupatmajaṃhāḥ ||
6,003.06  sa īṃ rebho na prati vasta usrāḥ śociṣā rārapīti mitramahāḥ |
6,003.06 naktaṃ ya īmaruṣo yo divā nṝnamartyo aruṣo yo divā nṝn ||
6,003.07  divo na yasya vidhato navīnodvṛṣā rukṣa oṣadhīṣu nūnot |
6,003.07 ghṛṇā na yo dhrajasā patmanā yannā rodasī vasunā daṃ supatnī ||
6,003.08  dhāyobhirvā yo yujyebhirarkairvidyunna davidyotsvebhiḥ śuṣmaiḥ |
6,003.08 śardho vā yo marutāṃ tatakṣa ṛbhurna tveṣo rabhasāno adyaut ||

6,004.01  yathā hotarmanuṣo devatātā yajñebhiḥ sūno sahaso yajāsi |
6,004.01 evā no adya samanā samānānuśannagna uśato yakṣi devān ||
6,004.02  sa no vibhāvā cakṣaṇirna vastoragnirvandāru vedyaścano dhāt |
6,004.02 viśvāyuryo amṛto martyeṣūṣarbhudbhūdatithirjātavedāḥ ||
6,004.03  dyāvo na yasya panayantyabhvaṃ bhāsāṃsi vaste sūryo na śukraḥ |
6,004.03 vi ya inotyajaraḥ pāvako'śnasya cicchiśnathatpūrvyāṇi ||
6,004.04  vadmā hi sūno asyadmasadvā cakre agnirjanuṣājmānnam |
6,004.04 sa tvaṃ na ūrjasana ūrjaṃ dhā rājeva jeravṛke kṣeṣyantaḥ ||
6,004.05  nitikti yo vāraṇamannamatti vāyurna rāṣṭryatyetyaktūn |
6,004.05 turyāma yasta ādiśāmarātīratyo na hrutaḥ patataḥ parihrut ||
6,004.06  ā sūryo na bhānumadbhirarkairagne tatantha rodasī vi bhāsā |
6,004.06 citro nayatpari tamāṃsyaktaḥ śociṣā patmannauśijo na dīyan ||
6,004.07  tvāṃ hi mandratamamarkaśokairvavṛmahe mahi naḥ śroṣyagne |
6,004.07 indraṃ na tvā śavasā devatā vāyuṃ pṛṇanti rādhasā nṛtamāḥ ||
6,004.08  nū no agne'vṛkebhiḥ svasti veṣi rāyaḥ pathibhiḥ parṣyaṃhaḥ |
6,004.08 tā sūribhyo gṛṇate rāsi sumnaṃ madema śatahimāḥ suvīrāḥ ||

6,005.01  huve vaḥ sūnuṃ sahaso yuvānamadroghavācaṃ matibhiryaviṣṭham |
6,005.01 ya invati draviṇāni pracetā viśvavārāṇi puruvāro adhruk ||
6,005.02  tve vasūni purvaṇīka hotardoṣā vastorerire yajñiyāsaḥ |
6,005.02 kṣāmeva viśvā bhuvanāni yasminsaṃ saubhagāni dadhire pāvake ||
6,005.03  tvaṃ vikṣu pradivaḥ sīda āsu kratvā rathīrabhavo vāryāṇām |
6,005.03 ata inoṣi vidhate cikitvo vyānuṣagjātavedo vasūni ||
6,005.04  yo naḥ sanutyo abhidāsadagne yo antaro mitramaho vanuṣyāt |
6,005.04 tamajarebhirvṛṣabhistava svaistapā tapiṣṭha tapasā tapasvān ||
6,005.05  yaste yajñena samidhā ya ukthairarkebhiḥ sūno sahaso dadāśat |
6,005.05 sa martyeṣvamṛta pracetā rāyā dyumnena śravasā vi bhāti ||
6,005.06  sa tatkṛdhīṣitastūyamagne spṛdho bādhasva sahasā sahasvān |
6,005.06 yacchasyase dyubhirakto vacobhistajjuṣasva jariturghoṣi manma ||
6,005.07  aśyāma taṃ kāmamagne tavotī aśyāma rayiṃ rayivaḥ suvīram |
6,005.07 aśyāma vājamabhi vājayanto'śyāma dyumnamajarājaraṃ te ||

6,006.01  pra navyasā sahasaḥ sūnumacchā yajñena gātumava icchamānaḥ |
6,006.01 vṛścadvanaṃ kṛṣṇayāmaṃ ruśantaṃ vītī hotāraṃ divyaṃ jigāti ||
6,006.02  sa śvitānastanyatū rocanasthā ajarebhirnānadadbhiryaviṣṭhaḥ |
6,006.02 yaḥ pāvakaḥ purutamaḥ purūṇi pṛthūnyagniranuyāti bharvan ||
6,006.03  vi te viṣvagvātajūtāso agne bhāmāsaḥ śuce śucayaścaranti |
6,006.03 tuvimrakṣāso divyā navagvā vanā vananti dhṛṣatā rujantaḥ ||
6,006.04  ye te śukrāsaḥ śucayaḥ śuciṣmaḥ kṣāṃ vapanti viṣitāso aśvāḥ |
6,006.04 adha bhramasta urviyā vi bhāti yātayamāno adhi sānu pṛśneḥ ||
6,006.05  adha jihvā pāpatīti pra vṛṣṇo goṣuyudho nāśaniḥ sṛjānā |
6,006.05 śūrasyeva prasitiḥ kṣātiragnerdurvarturbhīmo dayate vanāni ||
6,006.06  ā bhānunā pārthivāni jrayāṃsi mahastodasya dhṛṣatā tatantha |
6,006.06 sa bādhasvāpa bhayā sahobhi spṛdho vanuṣyanvanuṣo ni jūrva ||
6,006.07  sa citra citraṃ citayantamasme citrakṣatra citratamaṃ vayodhām |
6,006.07 candraṃ rayiṃ puruvīraṃ bṛhantaṃ candra candrābhirgṛṇate yuvasva ||

6,007.01  mūrdhānaṃ divo aratiṃ pṛthivyā vaiśvānaramṛta ā jātamagnim |
6,007.01 kaviṃ samrājamatithiṃ janānāmāsannā pātraṃ janayanta devāḥ ||
6,007.02  nābhiṃ yajñānāṃ sadanaṃ rayīṇāṃ mahāmāhāvamabhi saṃ navanta |
6,007.02 vaiśvānaraṃ rathyamadhvarāṇāṃ yajñasya ketuṃ janayanta devāḥ ||
6,007.03  tvadvipro jāyate vājyagne tvadvīrāso abhimātiṣāhaḥ |
6,007.03 vaiśvānara tvamasmāsu dhehi vasūni rājanspṛhayāyyāṇi ||
6,007.04  tvāṃ viśve amṛta jāyamānaṃ śiśuṃ na devā abhi saṃ navante |
6,007.04 tava kratubhiramṛtatvamāyanvaiśvānara yatpitroradīdeḥ ||
6,007.05  vaiśvānara tava tāni vratāni mahānyagne nakirā dadharṣa |
6,007.05 yajjāyamānaḥ pitrorupasthe'vindaḥ ketuṃ vayuneṣvahnām ||
6,007.06  vaiśvānarasya vimitāni cakṣasā sānūni divo amṛtasya ketunā |
6,007.06 tasyedu viśvā bhuvanādhi mūrdhani vayā iva ruruhuḥ sapta visruhaḥ ||
6,007.07  vi yo rajāṃsyamimīta sukraturvaiśvānaro vi divo rocanā kaviḥ |
6,007.07 pari yo viśvā bhuvanāni paprathe'dabdho gopā amṛtasya rakṣitā ||

6,008.01  pṛkṣasya vṛṣṇo aruṣasya nū sahaḥ pra nu vocaṃ vidathā jātavedasaḥ |
6,008.01 vaiśvānarāya matirnavyasī śuciḥ soma iva pavate cāruragnaye ||
6,008.02  sa jāyamānaḥ parame vyomani vratānyagnirvratapā arakṣata |
6,008.02 vyantarikṣamamimīta sukraturvaiśvānaro mahinā nākamaspṛśat ||
6,008.03  vyastabhnādrodasī mitro adbhuto'ntarvāvadakṛṇojjyotiṣā tamaḥ |
6,008.03 vi carmaṇīva dhiṣaṇe avartayadvaiśvānaro viśvamadhatta vṛṣṇyam ||
6,008.04  apāmupasthe mahiṣā agṛbhṇata viśo rājānamupa tasthurṛgmiyam |
6,008.04 ā dūto agnimabharadvivasvato vaiśvānaraṃ mātariśvā parāvataḥ ||
6,008.05  yugeyuge vidathyaṃ gṛṇadbhyo'gne rayiṃ yaśasaṃ dhehi navyasīm |
6,008.05 pavyeva rājannaghaśaṃsamajara nīcā ni vṛśca vaninaṃ na tejasā ||
6,008.06  asmākamagne maghavatsu dhārayānāmi kṣatramajaraṃ suvīryam |
6,008.06 vayaṃ jayema śatinaṃ sahasriṇaṃ vaiśvānara vājamagne tavotibhiḥ ||
6,008.07  adabdhebhistava gopābhiriṣṭe'smākaṃ pāhi triṣadhastha sūrīn |
6,008.07 rakṣā ca no daduṣāṃ śardho agne vaiśvānara pra ca tārī stavānaḥ ||

6,009.01  ahaśca kṛṣṇamahararjunaṃ ca vi vartete rajasī vedyābhiḥ |
6,009.01 vaiśvānaro jāyamāno na rājāvātirajjyotiṣāgnistamāṃsi ||
6,009.02  nāhaṃ tantuṃ na vi jānāmyotuṃ na yaṃ vayanti samare'tamānāḥ |
6,009.02 kasya svitputra iha vaktvāni paro vadātyavareṇa pitrā ||
6,009.03  sa ittantuṃ sa vi jānātyotuṃ sa vaktvānyṛtuthā vadāti |
6,009.03 ya īṃ ciketadamṛtasya gopā avaścaranparo anyena paśyan ||
6,009.04  ayaṃ hotā prathamaḥ paśyatemamidaṃ jyotiramṛtaṃ martyeṣu |
6,009.04 ayaṃ sa jajñe dhruva ā niṣatto'martyastanvā vardhamānaḥ ||
6,009.05  dhruvaṃ jyotirnihitaṃ dṛśaye kaṃ mano javiṣṭhaṃ patayatsvantaḥ |
6,009.05 viśve devāḥ samanasaḥ saketā ekaṃ kratumabhi vi yanti sādhu ||
6,009.06  vi me karṇā patayato vi cakṣurvīdaṃ jyotirhṛdaya āhitaṃ yat |
6,009.06 vi me manaścarati dūraādhīḥ kiṃ svidvakṣyāmi kimu nū maniṣye ||
6,009.07  viśve devā anamasyanbhiyānāstvāmagne tamasi tasthivāṃsam |
6,009.07 vaiśvānaro'vatūtaye no'martyo'vatūtaye naḥ ||

6,010.01  puro vo mandraṃ divyaṃ suvṛktiṃ prayati yajñe agnimadhvare dadhidhvam |
6,010.01 pura ukthebhiḥ sa hi no vibhāvā svadhvarā karati jātavedāḥ ||
6,010.02  tamu dyumaḥ purvaṇīka hotaragne agnibhirmanuṣa idhānaḥ |
6,010.02 stomaṃ yamasmai mamateva śūṣaṃ ghṛtaṃ na śuci matayaḥ pavante ||
6,010.03  pīpāya sa śravasā martyeṣu yo agnaye dadāśa vipra ukthaiḥ |
6,010.03 citrābhistamūtibhiścitraśocirvrajasya sātā gomato dadhāti ||
6,010.04  ā yaḥ paprau jāyamāna urvī dūredṛśā bhāsā kṛṣṇādhvā |
6,010.04 adha bahu cittama ūrmyāyāstiraḥ śociṣā dadṛśe pāvakaḥ ||
6,010.05  nū naścitraṃ puruvājābhirūtī agne rayiṃ maghavadbhyaśca dhehi |
6,010.05 ye rādhasā śravasā cātyanyānsuvīryebhiścābhi santi janān ||
6,010.06  imaṃ yajñaṃ cano dhā agna uśanyaṃ ta āsāno juhute haviṣmān |
6,010.06 bharadvājeṣu dadhiṣe suvṛktimavīrvājasya gadhyasya sātau ||
6,010.07  vi dveṣāṃsīnuhi vardhayeḻāṃ madema śatahimāḥ suvīrāḥ ||

6,011.01  yajasva hotariṣito yajīyānagne bādho marutāṃ na prayukti |
6,011.01 ā no mitrāvaruṇā nāsatyā dyāvā hotrāya pṛthivī vavṛtyāḥ ||
6,011.02  tvaṃ hotā mandratamo no adhrugantardevo vidathā martyeṣu |
6,011.02 pāvakayā juhvā vahnirāsāgne yajasva tanvaṃ tava svām ||
6,011.03  dhanyā ciddhi tve dhiṣaṇā vaṣṭi pra devāñjanma gṛṇate yajadhyai |
6,011.03 vepiṣṭho aṅgirasāṃ yaddha vipro madhu cchando bhanati rebha iṣṭau ||
6,011.04  adidyutatsvapāko vibhāvāgne yajasva rodasī urūcī |
6,011.04 āyuṃ na yaṃ namasā rātahavyā añjanti suprayasaṃ pañca janāḥ ||
6,011.05  vṛñje ha yannamasā barhiragnāvayāmi srugghṛtavatī suvṛktiḥ |
6,011.05 amyakṣi sadma sadane pṛthivyā aśrāyi yajñaḥ sūrye na cakṣuḥ ||
6,011.06  daśasyā naḥ purvaṇīka hotardevebhiragne agnibhiridhānaḥ |
6,011.06 rāyaḥ sūno sahaso vāvasānā ati srasema vṛjanaṃ nāṃhaḥ ||

6,012.01  madhye hotā duroṇe barhiṣo rāḻ agnistodasya rodasī yajadhyai |
6,012.01 ayaṃ sa sūnuḥ sahasa ṛtāvā dūrātsūryo na śociṣā tatāna ||
6,012.02  ā yasmintve svapāke yajatra yakṣadrājansarvatāteva nu dyauḥ |
6,012.02 triṣadhasthastataruṣo na jaṃho havyā maghāni mānuṣā yajadhyai ||
6,012.03  tejiṣṭhā yasyāratirvanerāṭtodo adhvanna vṛdhasāno adyaut |
6,012.03 adrogho na dravitā cetati tmannamartyo'vartra oṣadhīṣu ||
6,012.04  sāsmākebhiretarī na śūṣairagni ṣṭave dama ā jātavedāḥ |
6,012.04 drvanno vanvankratvā nārvosraḥ piteva jārayāyi yajñaiḥ ||
6,012.05  adha smāsya panayanti bhāso vṛthā yattakṣadanuyāti pṛthvīm |
6,012.05 sadyo yaḥ syandro viṣito dhavīyānṛṇo na tāyurati dhanvā rāṭ ||
6,012.06  sa tvaṃ no arvannidāyā viśvebhiragne agnibhiridhānaḥ |
6,012.06 veṣi rāyo vi yāsi ducchunā madema śatahimāḥ suvīrāḥ ||

6,013.01  tvadviśvā subhaga saubhagānyagne vi yanti vanino na vayāḥ |
6,013.01 śruṣṭī rayirvājo vṛtratūrye divo vṛṣṭirīḍyo rītirapām ||
6,013.02  tvaṃ bhago na ā hi ratnamiṣe parijmeva kṣayasi dasmavarcāḥ |
6,013.02 agne mitro na bṛhata ṛtasyāsi kṣattā vāmasya deva bhūreḥ ||
6,013.03  sa satpatiḥ śavasā hanti vṛtramagne vipro vi paṇerbharti vājam |
6,013.03 yaṃ tvaṃ praceta ṛtajāta rāyā sajoṣā naptrāpāṃ hinoṣi ||
6,013.04  yaste sūno sahaso gīrbhirukthairyajñairmarto niśitiṃ vedyānaṭ |
6,013.04 viśvaṃ sa deva prati vāramagne dhatte dhānyaṃ patyate vasavyaiḥ ||
6,013.05  tā nṛbhya ā sauśravasā suvīrāgne sūno sahasaḥ puṣyase dhāḥ |
6,013.05 kṛṇoṣi yacchavasā bhūri paśvo vayo vṛkāyāraye jasuraye ||
6,013.06  vadmā sūno sahaso no vihāyā agne tokaṃ tanayaṃ vāji no dāḥ |
6,013.06 viśvābhirgīrbhirabhi pūrtimaśyāṃ madema śatahimāḥ suvīrāḥ ||

6,014.01  agnā yo martyo duvo dhiyaṃ jujoṣa dhītibhiḥ |
6,014.01 bhasannu ṣa pra pūrvya iṣaṃ vurītāvase ||
6,014.02  agniriddhi pracetā agnirvedhastama ṛṣiḥ |
6,014.02 agniṃ hotāramīḻate yajñeṣu manuṣo viśaḥ ||
6,014.03  nānā hyagne'vase spardhante rāyo aryaḥ |
6,014.03 tūrvanto dasyumāyavo vrataiḥ sīkṣanto avratam ||
6,014.04  agnirapsāmṛtīṣahaṃ vīraṃ dadāti satpatim |
6,014.04 yasya trasanti śavasaḥ saṃcakṣi śatravo bhiyā ||
6,014.05  agnirhi vidmanā nido devo martamuruṣyati |
6,014.05 sahāvā yasyāvṛto rayirvājeṣvavṛtaḥ ||
6,014.06  acchā no mitramaho deva devānagne vocaḥ sumatiṃ rodasyoḥ |
6,014.06 vīhi svastiṃ sukṣitiṃ divo nṝndviṣo aṃhāṃsi duritā tarema tā tarema tavāvasā tarema ||

6,015.01  imamū ṣu vo atithimuṣarbudhaṃ viśvāsāṃ viśāṃ patimṛñjase girā |
6,015.01 vetīddivo januṣā kaccidā śucirjyokcidatti garbho yadacyutam ||
6,015.02  mitraṃ na yaṃ sudhitaṃ bhṛgavo dadhurvanaspatāvīḍyamūrdhvaśociṣam |
6,015.02 sa tvaṃ suprīto vītahavye adbhuta praśastibhirmahayase divedive ||
6,015.03  sa tvaṃ dakṣasyāvṛko vṛdho bhūraryaḥ parasyāntarasya taruṣaḥ |
6,015.03 rāyaḥ sūno sahaso martyeṣvā chardiryaccha vītahavyāya sapratho bharadvājāya saprathaḥ ||
6,015.04  dyutānaṃ vo atithiṃ svarṇaramagniṃ hotāraṃ manuṣaḥ svadhvaram |
6,015.04 vipraṃ na dyukṣavacasaṃ suvṛktibhirhavyavāhamaratiṃ devamṛñjase ||
6,015.05  pāvakayā yaścitayantyā kṛpā kṣāmanruruca uṣaso na bhānunā |
6,015.05 tūrvanna yāmannetaśasya nū raṇa ā yo ghṛṇe na tatṛṣāṇo ajaraḥ ||
6,015.06  agnimagniṃ vaḥ samidhā duvasyata priyampriyaṃ vo atithiṃ gṛṇīṣaṇi |
6,015.06 upa vo gīrbhiramṛtaṃ vivāsata devo deveṣu vanate hi vāryaṃ devo deveṣu vanate hi no duvaḥ ||
6,015.07  samiddhamagniṃ samidhā girā gṛṇe śuciṃ pāvakaṃ puro adhvare dhruvam |
6,015.07 vipraṃ hotāraṃ puruvāramadruhaṃ kaviṃ sumnairīmahe jātavedasam ||
6,015.08  tvāṃ dūtamagne amṛtaṃ yugeyuge havyavāhaṃ dadhire pāyumīḍyam |
6,015.08 devāsaśca martāsaśca jāgṛviṃ vibhuṃ viśpatiṃ namasā ni ṣedire ||
6,015.09  vibhūṣannagna ubhayāṃ anu vratā dūto devānāṃ rajasī samīyase |
6,015.09 yatte dhītiṃ sumatimāvṛṇīmahe'dha smā nastrivarūthaḥ śivo bhava ||
6,015.10  taṃ supratīkaṃ sudṛśaṃ svañcamavidvāṃso viduṣṭaraṃ sapema |
6,015.10 sa yakṣadviśvā vayunāni vidvānpra havyamagniramṛteṣu vocat ||
6,015.11  tamagne pāsyuta taṃ piparṣi yasta ānaṭkavaye śūra dhītim |
6,015.11 yajñasya vā niśitiṃ voditiṃ vā tamitpṛṇakṣi śavasota rāyā ||
6,015.12  tvamagne vanuṣyato ni pāhi tvamu naḥ sahasāvannavadyāt |
6,015.12 saṃ tvā dhvasmanvadabhyetu pāthaḥ saṃ rayi spṛhayāyyaḥ sahasrī ||
6,015.13  agnirhotā gṛhapatiḥ sa rājā viśvā veda janimā jātavedāḥ |
6,015.13 devānāmuta yo martyānāṃ yajiṣṭhaḥ sa pra yajatāmṛtāvā ||
6,015.14  agne yadadya viśo adhvarasya hotaḥ pāvakaśoce veṣṭvaṃ hi yajvā |
6,015.14 ṛtā yajāsi mahinā vi yadbhūrhavyā vaha yaviṣṭha yā te adya ||
6,015.15  abhi prayāṃsi sudhitāni hi khyo ni tvā dadhīta rodasī yajadhyai |
6,015.15 avā no maghavanvājasātāvagne viśvāni duritā tarema tā tarema tavāvasā tarema ||
6,015.16  agne viśvebhiḥ svanīka devairūrṇāvantaṃ prathamaḥ sīda yonim |
6,015.16 kulāyinaṃ ghṛtavantaṃ savitre yajñaṃ naya yajamānāya sādhu ||
6,015.17  imamu tyamatharvavadagniṃ manthanti vedhasaḥ |
6,015.17 yamaṅkūyantamānayannamūraṃ śyāvyābhyaḥ ||
6,015.18  janiṣvā devavītaye sarvatātā svastaye |
6,015.18 ā devānvakṣyamṛtāṃ ṛtāvṛdho yajñaṃ deveṣu pispṛśaḥ ||
6,015.19  vayamu tvā gṛhapate janānāmagne akarma samidhā bṛhantam |
6,015.19 asthūri no gārhapatyāni santu tigmena nastejasā saṃ śiśādhi ||

6,016.01  tvamagne yajñānāṃ hotā viśveṣāṃ hitaḥ |
6,016.01 devebhirmānuṣe jane ||
6,016.02  sa no mandrābhiradhvare jihvābhiryajā mahaḥ |
6,016.02 ā devānvakṣi yakṣi ca ||
6,016.03  vetthā hi vedho adhvanaḥ pathaśca devāñjasā |
6,016.03 agne yajñeṣu sukrato ||
6,016.04  tvāmīḻe adha dvitā bharato vājibhiḥ śunam |
6,016.04 īje yajñeṣu yajñiyam ||
6,016.05  tvamimā vāryā puru divodāsāya sunvate |
6,016.05 bharadvājāya dāśuṣe ||
6,016.06  tvaṃ dūto amartya ā vahā daivyaṃ janam |
6,016.06 śṛṇvanviprasya suṣṭutim ||
6,016.07  tvāmagne svādhyo martāso devavītaye |
6,016.07 yajñeṣu devamīḻate ||
6,016.08  tava pra yakṣi saṃdṛśamuta kratuṃ sudānavaḥ |
6,016.08 viśve juṣanta kāminaḥ ||
6,016.09  tvaṃ hotā manurhito vahnirāsā viduṣṭaraḥ |
6,016.09 agne yakṣi divo viśaḥ ||
6,016.10  agna ā yāhi vītaye gṛṇāno havyadātaye |
6,016.10 ni hotā satsi barhiṣi ||
6,016.11  taṃ tvā samidbhiraṅgiro ghṛtena vardhayāmasi |
6,016.11 bṛhacchocā yaviṣṭhya ||
6,016.12  sa naḥ pṛthu śravāyyamacchā deva vivāsasi |
6,016.12 bṛhadagne suvīryam ||
6,016.13  tvāmagne puṣkarādadhyatharvā niramanthata |
6,016.13 mūrdhno viśvasya vāghataḥ ||
6,016.14  tamu tvā dadhyaṅṅṛṣiḥ putra īdhe atharvaṇaḥ |
6,016.14 vṛtrahaṇaṃ purandaram ||
6,016.15  tamu tvā pāthyo vṛṣā samīdhe dasyuhantamam |
6,016.15 dhanañjayaṃ raṇeraṇe ||
6,016.16  ehyū ṣu bravāṇi te'gna itthetarā giraḥ |
6,016.16 ebhirvardhāsa indubhiḥ ||
6,016.17  yatra kva ca te mano dakṣaṃ dadhasa uttaram |
6,016.17 tatrā sadaḥ kṛṇavase ||
6,016.18  nahi te pūrtamakṣipadbhuvannemānāṃ vaso |
6,016.18 athā duvo vanavase ||
6,016.19  āgniragāmi bhārato vṛtrahā purucetanaḥ |
6,016.19 divodāsasya satpatiḥ ||
6,016.20  sa hi viśvāti pārthivā rayiṃ dāśanmahitvanā |
6,016.20 vanvannavāto astṛtaḥ ||
6,016.21  sa pratnavannavīyasāgne dyumnena saṃyatā |
6,016.21 bṛhattatantha bhānunā ||
6,016.22  pra vaḥ sakhāyo agnaye stomaṃ yajñaṃ ca dhṛṣṇuyā |
6,016.22 arca gāya ca vedhase ||
6,016.23  sa hi yo mānuṣā yugā sīdaddhotā kavikratuḥ |
6,016.23 dūtaśca havyavāhanaḥ ||
6,016.24  tā rājānā śucivratādityānmārutaṃ gaṇam |
6,016.24 vaso yakṣīha rodasī ||
6,016.25  vasvī te agne saṃdṛṣṭiriṣayate martyāya |
6,016.25 ūrjo napādamṛtasya ||
6,016.26  kratvā dā astu śreṣṭho'dya tvā vanvansurekṇāḥ |
6,016.26 marta ānāśa suvṛktim ||
6,016.27  te te agne tvotā iṣayanto viśvamāyuḥ |
6,016.27 taranto aryo arātīrvanvanto aryo arātīḥ ||
6,016.28  agnistigmena śociṣā yāsadviśvaṃ nyatriṇam |
6,016.28 agnirno vanate rayim ||
6,016.29  suvīraṃ rayimā bhara jātavedo vicarṣaṇe |
6,016.29 jahi rakṣāṃsi sukrato ||
6,016.30  tvaṃ naḥ pāhyaṃhaso jātavedo aghāyataḥ |
6,016.30 rakṣā ṇo brahmaṇaskave ||
6,016.31  yo no agne dureva ā marto vadhāya dāśati |
6,016.31 tasmānnaḥ pāhyaṃhasaḥ ||
6,016.32  tvaṃ taṃ deva jihvayā pari bādhasva duṣkṛtam |
6,016.32 marto yo no jighāṃsati ||
6,016.33  bharadvājāya saprathaḥ śarma yaccha sahantya |
6,016.33 agne vareṇyaṃ vasu ||
6,016.34  agnirvṛtrāṇi jaṅghanaddraviṇasyurvipanyayā |
6,016.34 samiddhaḥ śukra āhutaḥ ||
6,016.35  garbhe mātuḥ pituṣpitā vididyutāno akṣare |
6,016.35 sīdannṛtasya yonimā ||
6,016.36  brahma prajāvadā bhara jātavedo vicarṣaṇe |
6,016.36 agne yaddīdayaddivi ||
6,016.37  upa tvā raṇvasaṃdṛśaṃ prayasvantaḥ sahaskṛta |
6,016.37 agne sasṛjmahe giraḥ ||
6,016.38  upa cchāyāmiva ghṛṇeraganma śarma te vayam |
6,016.38 agne hiraṇyasaṃdṛśaḥ ||
6,016.39  ya ugra iva śaryahā tigmaśṛṅgo na vaṃsagaḥ |
6,016.39 agne puro rurojitha ||
6,016.40  ā yaṃ haste na khādinaṃ śiśuṃ jātaṃ na bibhrati |
6,016.40 viśāmagniṃ svadhvaram ||
6,016.41  pra devaṃ devavītaye bharatā vasuvittamam |
6,016.41 ā sve yonau ni ṣīdatu ||
6,016.42  ā jātaṃ jātavedasi priyaṃ śiśītātithim |
6,016.42 syona ā gṛhapatim ||
6,016.43  agne yukṣvā hi ye tavāśvāso deva sādhavaḥ |
6,016.43 araṃ vahanti manyave ||
6,016.44  acchā no yāhyā vahābhi prayāṃsi vītaye |
6,016.44 ā devānsomapītaye ||
6,016.45  udagne bhārata dyumadajasreṇa davidyutat |
6,016.45 śocā vi bhāhyajara ||
6,016.46  vītī yo devaṃ marto duvasyedagnimīḻītādhvare haviṣmān |
6,016.46 hotāraṃ satyayajaṃ rodasyoruttānahasto namasā vivāset ||
6,016.47  ā te agna ṛcā havirhṛdā taṣṭaṃ bharāmasi |
6,016.47 te te bhavantūkṣaṇa ṛṣabhāso vaśā uta ||
6,016.48  agniṃ devāso agriyamindhate vṛtrahantamam |
6,016.48 yenā vasūnyābhṛtā tṛḻhā rakṣāṃsi vājinā ||

6,017.01  pibā somamabhi yamugra tarda ūrvaṃ gavyaṃ mahi gṛṇāna indra |
6,017.01 vi yo dhṛṣṇo vadhiṣo vajrahasta viśvā vṛtramamitriyā śavobhiḥ ||
6,017.02  sa īṃ pāhi ya ṛjīṣī tarutro yaḥ śipravānvṛṣabho yo matīnām |
6,017.02 yo gotrabhidvajrabhṛdyo hariṣṭhāḥ sa indra citrāṃ abhi tṛndhi vājān ||
6,017.03  evā pāhi pratnathā mandatu tvā śrudhi brahma vāvṛdhasvota gīrbhiḥ |
6,017.03 āviḥ sūryaṃ kṛṇuhi pīpihīṣo jahi śatrūṃrabhi gā indra tṛndhi ||
6,017.04  te tvā madā bṛhadindra svadhāva ime pītā ukṣayanta dyumantam |
6,017.04 mahāmanūnaṃ tavasaṃ vibhūtiṃ matsarāso jarhṛṣanta prasāham ||
6,017.05  yebhiḥ sūryamuṣasaṃ mandasāno'vāsayo'pa dṛḻhāni dardrat |
6,017.05 mahāmadriṃ pari gā indra santaṃ nutthā acyutaṃ sadasaspari svāt ||
6,017.06  tava kratvā tava taddaṃsanābhirāmāsu pakvaṃ śacyā ni dīdhaḥ |
6,017.06 aurṇordura usriyābhyo vi dṛḻhodūrvādgā asṛjo aṅgirasvān ||
6,017.07  paprātha kṣāṃ mahi daṃso vyurvīmupa dyāmṛṣvo bṛhadindra stabhāyaḥ |
6,017.07 adhārayo rodasī devaputre pratne mātarā yahvī ṛtasya ||
6,017.08  adha tvā viśve pura indra devā ekaṃ tavasaṃ dadhire bharāya |
6,017.08 adevo yadabhyauhiṣṭa devānsvarṣātā vṛṇata indramatra ||
6,017.09  adha dyauścitte apa sā nu vajrāddvitānamadbhiyasā svasya manyoḥ |
6,017.09 ahiṃ yadindro abhyohasānaṃ ni cidviśvāyuḥ śayathe jaghāna ||
6,017.10  adha tvaṣṭā te maha ugra vajraṃ sahasrabhṛṣṭiṃ vavṛtacchatāśrim |
6,017.10 nikāmamaramaṇasaṃ yena navantamahiṃ saṃ piṇagṛjīṣin ||
6,017.11  vardhānyaṃ viśve marutaḥ sajoṣāḥ pacacchataṃ mahiṣāṃ indra tubhyam |
6,017.11 pūṣā viṣṇustrīṇi sarāṃsi dhāvanvṛtrahaṇaṃ madiramaṃśumasmai ||
6,017.12  ā kṣodo mahi vṛtaṃ nadīnāṃ pariṣṭhitamasṛja ūrmimapām |
6,017.12 tāsāmanu pravata indra panthāṃ prārdayo nīcīrapasaḥ samudram ||
6,017.13  evā tā viśvā cakṛvāṃsamindraṃ mahāmugramajuryaṃ sahodām |
6,017.13 suvīraṃ tvā svāyudhaṃ suvajramā brahma navyamavase vavṛtyāt ||
6,017.14  sa no vājāya śravasa iṣe ca rāye dhehi dyumata indra viprān |
6,017.14 bharadvāje nṛvata indra sūrīndivi ca smaidhi pārye na indra ||
6,017.15  ayā vājaṃ devahitaṃ sanema madema śatahimāḥ suvīrāḥ ||

6,018.01  tamu ṣṭuhi yo abhibhūtyojā vanvannavātaḥ puruhūta indraḥ |
6,018.01 aṣāḻhamugraṃ sahamānamābhirgīrbhirvardha vṛṣabhaṃ carṣaṇīnām ||
6,018.02  sa yudhmaḥ satvā khajakṛtsamadvā tuvimrakṣo nadanumāṃ ṛjīṣī |
6,018.02 bṛhadreṇuścyavano mānuṣīṇāmekaḥ kṛṣṭīnāmabhavatsahāvā ||
6,018.03  tvaṃ ha nu tyadadamāyo dasyūṃrekaḥ kṛṣṭīravanorāryāya |
6,018.03 asti svinnu vīryaṃ tatta indra na svidasti tadṛtuthā vi vocaḥ ||
6,018.04  sadiddhi te tuvijātasya manye sahaḥ sahiṣṭha turatasturasya |
6,018.04 ugramugrasya tavasastavīyo'radhrasya radhraturo babhūva ||
6,018.05  tannaḥ pratnaṃ sakhyamastu yuṣme itthā vadadbhirvalamaṅgirobhiḥ |
6,018.05 hannacyutacyuddasmeṣayantamṛṇoḥ puro vi duro asya viśvāḥ ||
6,018.06  sa hi dhībhirhavyo astyugra īśānakṛnmahati vṛtratūrye |
6,018.06 sa tokasātā tanaye sa vajrī vitantasāyyo abhavatsamatsu ||
6,018.07  sa majmanā janima mānuṣāṇāmamartyena nāmnāti pra sarsre |
6,018.07 sa dyumnena sa śavasota rāyā sa vīryeṇa nṛtamaḥ samokāḥ ||
6,018.08  sa yo na muhe na mithū jano bhūtsumantunāmā cumuriṃ dhuniṃ ca |
6,018.08 vṛṇakpipruṃ śambaraṃ śuṣṇamindraḥ purāṃ cyautnāya śayathāya nū cit ||
6,018.09  udāvatā tvakṣasā panyasā ca vṛtrahatyāya rathamindra tiṣṭha |
6,018.09 dhiṣva vajraṃ hasta ā dakṣiṇatrābhi pra manda purudatra māyāḥ ||
6,018.10  agnirna śuṣkaṃ vanamindra hetī rakṣo ni dhakṣyaśanirna bhīmā |
6,018.10 gambhīraya ṛṣvayā yo rurojādhvānayadduritā dambhayacca ||
6,018.11  ā sahasraṃ pathibhirindra rāyā tuvidyumna tuvivājebhirarvāk |
6,018.11 yāhi sūno sahaso yasya nū cidadeva īśe puruhūta yotoḥ ||
6,018.12  pra tuvidyumnasya sthavirasya ghṛṣverdivo rarapśe mahimā pṛthivyāḥ |
6,018.12 nāsya śatrurna pratimānamasti na pratiṣṭhiḥ purumāyasya sahyoḥ ||
6,018.13  pra tatte adyā karaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ bhūtkutsaṃ yadāyumatithigvamasmai |
6,018.13 purū sahasrā ni śiśā abhi kṣāmuttūrvayāṇaṃ dhṛṣatā ninetha ||
6,018.14  anu tvāhighne adha deva devā madanviśve kavitamaṃ kavīnām |
6,018.14 karo yatra varivo bādhitāya dive janāya tanve gṛṇānaḥ ||
6,018.15  anu dyāvāpṛthivī tatta ojo'martyā jihata indra devāḥ |
6,018.15 kṛṣvā kṛtno akṛtaṃ yatte astyukthaṃ navīyo janayasva yajñaiḥ ||

6,019.01  mahāṃ indro nṛvadā carṣaṇiprā uta dvibarhā aminaḥ sahobhiḥ |
6,019.01 asmadryagvāvṛdhe vīryāyoruḥ pṛthuḥ sukṛtaḥ kartṛbhirbhūt ||
6,019.02  indrameva dhiṣaṇā sātaye dhādbṛhantamṛṣvamajaraṃ yuvānam |
6,019.02 aṣāḻhena śavasā śūśuvāṃsaṃ sadyaścidyo vāvṛdhe asāmi ||
6,019.03  pṛthū karasnā bahulā gabhastī asmadryaksaṃ mimīhi śravāṃsi |
6,019.03 yūtheva paśvaḥ paśupā damūnā asmāṃ indrābhyā vavṛtsvājau ||
6,019.04  taṃ va indraṃ catinamasya śākairiha nūnaṃ vājayanto huvema |
6,019.04 yathā citpūrve jaritāra āsuranedyā anavadyā ariṣṭāḥ ||
6,019.05  dhṛtavrato dhanadāḥ somavṛddhaḥ sa hi vāmasya vasunaḥ purukṣuḥ |
6,019.05 saṃ jagmire pathyā rāyo asminsamudre na sindhavo yādamānāḥ ||
6,019.06  śaviṣṭhaṃ na ā bhara śūra śava ojiṣṭhamojo abhibhūta ugram |
6,019.06 viśvā dyumnā vṛṣṇyā mānuṣāṇāmasmabhyaṃ dā harivo mādayadhyai ||
6,019.07  yaste madaḥ pṛtanāṣāḻ amṛdhra indra taṃ na ā bhara śūśuvāṃsam |
6,019.07 yena tokasya tanayasya sātau maṃsīmahi jigīvāṃsastvotāḥ ||
6,019.08  ā no bhara vṛṣaṇaṃ śuṣmamindra dhanaspṛtaṃ śūśuvāṃsaṃ sudakṣam |
6,019.08 yena vaṃsāma pṛtanāsu śatrūntavotibhiruta jāmīṃrajāmīn ||
6,019.09  ā te śuṣmo vṛṣabha etu paścādottarādadharādā purastāt |
6,019.09 ā viśvato abhi sametvarvāṅindra dyumnaṃ svarvaddhehyasme ||
6,019.10  nṛvatta indra nṛtamābhirūtī vaṃsīmahi vāmaṃ śromatebhiḥ |
6,019.10 īkṣe hi vasva ubhayasya rājandhā ratnaṃ mahi sthūraṃ bṛhantam ||
6,019.11  marutvantaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ vāvṛdhānamakavāriṃ divyaṃ śāsamindram |
6,019.11 viśvāsāhamavase nūtanāyograṃ sahodāmiha taṃ huvema ||
6,019.12  janaṃ vajrinmahi cinmanyamānamebhyo nṛbhyo randhayā yeṣvasmi |
6,019.12 adhā hi tvā pṛthivyāṃ śūrasātau havāmahe tanaye goṣvapsu ||
6,019.13  vayaṃ ta ebhiḥ puruhūta sakhyaiḥ śatroḥśatroruttara itsyāma |
6,019.13 ghnanto vṛtrāṇyubhayāni śūra rāyā madema bṛhatā tvotāḥ ||

6,020.01  dyaurna ya indrābhi bhūmāryastasthau rayiḥ śavasā pṛtsu janān |
6,020.01 taṃ naḥ sahasrabharamurvarāsāṃ daddhi sūno sahaso vṛtraturam ||
6,020.02  divo na tubhyamanvindra satrāsuryaṃ devebhirdhāyi viśvam |
6,020.02 ahiṃ yadvṛtramapo vavrivāṃsaṃ hannṛjīṣinviṣṇunā sacānaḥ ||
6,020.03  tūrvannojīyāntavasastavīyānkṛtabrahmendro vṛddhamahāḥ |
6,020.03 rājābhavanmadhunaḥ somyasya viśvāsāṃ yatpurāṃ dartnumāvat ||
6,020.04  śatairapadranpaṇaya indrātra daśoṇaye kavaye'rkasātau |
6,020.04 vadhaiḥ śuṣṇasyāśuṣasya māyāḥ pitvo nārirecītkiṃ cana pra ||
6,020.05  maho druho apa viśvāyu dhāyi vajrasya yatpatane pādi śuṣṇaḥ |
6,020.05 uru ṣa sarathaṃ sārathaye karindraḥ kutsāya sūryasya sātau ||
6,020.06  pra śyeno na madiramaṃśumasmai śiro dāsasya namucermathāyan |
6,020.06 prāvannamīṃ sāpyaṃ sasantaṃ pṛṇagrāyā samiṣā saṃ svasti ||
6,020.07  vi piprorahimāyasya dṛḻhāḥ puro vajriñchavasā na dardaḥ |
6,020.07 sudāmantadrekṇo apramṛṣyamṛjiśvane dātraṃ dāśuṣe dāḥ ||
6,020.08  sa vetasuṃ daśamāyaṃ daśoṇiṃ tūtujimindraḥ svabhiṣṭisumnaḥ |
6,020.08 ā tugraṃ śaśvadibhaṃ dyotanāya māturna sīmupa sṛjā iyadhyai ||
6,020.09  sa īṃ spṛdho vanate apratīto bibhradvajraṃ vṛtrahaṇaṃ gabhastau |
6,020.09 tiṣṭhaddharī adhyasteva garte vacoyujā vahata indramṛṣvam ||
6,020.10  sanema te'vasā navya indra pra pūrava stavanta enā yajñaiḥ |
6,020.10 sapta yatpuraḥ śarma śāradīrdarddhandāsīḥ purukutsāya śikṣan ||
6,020.11  tvaṃ vṛdha indra pūrvyo bhūrvarivasyannuśane kāvyāya |
6,020.11 parā navavāstvamanudeyaṃ mahe pitre dadātha svaṃ napātam ||
6,020.12  tvaṃ dhunirindra dhunimatīrṛṇorapaḥ sīrā na sravantīḥ |
6,020.12 pra yatsamudramati śūra parṣi pārayā turvaśaṃ yaduṃ svasti ||
6,020.13  tava ha tyadindra viśvamājau sasto dhunīcumurī yā ha siṣvap |
6,020.13 dīdayadittubhyaṃ somebhiḥ sunvandabhītiridhmabhṛtiḥ pakthyarkaiḥ ||

6,021.01  imā u tvā purutamasya kārorhavyaṃ vīra havyā havante |
6,021.01 dhiyo ratheṣṭhāmajaraṃ navīyo rayirvibhūtirīyate vacasyā ||
6,021.02  tamu stuṣa indraṃ yo vidāno girvāhasaṃ gīrbhiryajñavṛddham |
6,021.02 yasya divamati mahnā pṛthivyāḥ purumāyasya ririce mahitvam ||
6,021.03  sa ittamo'vayunaṃ tatanvatsūryeṇa vayunavaccakāra |
6,021.03 kadā te martā amṛtasya dhāmeyakṣanto na minanti svadhāvaḥ ||
6,021.04  yastā cakāra sa kuha svidindraḥ kamā janaṃ carati kāsu vikṣu |
6,021.04 kaste yajño manase śaṃ varāya ko arka indra katamaḥ sa hotā ||
6,021.05  idā hi te veviṣataḥ purājāḥ pratnāsa āsuḥ purukṛtsakhāyaḥ |
6,021.05 ye madhyamāsa uta nūtanāsa utāvamasya puruhūta bodhi ||
6,021.06  taṃ pṛcchanto'varāsaḥ parāṇi pratnā ta indra śrutyānu yemuḥ |
6,021.06 arcāmasi vīra brahmavāho yādeva vidma tāttvā mahāntam ||
6,021.07  abhi tvā pājo rakṣaso vi tasthe mahi jajñānamabhi tatsu tiṣṭha |
6,021.07 tava pratnena yujyena sakhyā vajreṇa dhṛṣṇo apa tā nudasva ||
6,021.08  sa tu śrudhīndra nūtanasya brahmaṇyato vīra kārudhāyaḥ |
6,021.08 tvaṃ hyāpiḥ pradivi pitṝṇāṃ śaśvadbabhūtha suhava eṣṭau ||
6,021.09  protaye varuṇaṃ mitramindraṃ marutaḥ kṛṣvāvase no adya |
6,021.09 pra pūṣaṇaṃ viṣṇumagniṃ purandhiṃ savitāramoṣadhīḥ parvatāṃśca ||
6,021.10  ima u tvā puruśāka prayajyo jaritāro abhyarcantyarkaiḥ |
6,021.10 śrudhī havamā huvato huvāno na tvāvāṃ anyo amṛta tvadasti ||
6,021.11  nū ma ā vācamupa yāhi vidvānviśvebhiḥ sūno sahaso yajatraiḥ |
6,021.11 ye agnijihvā ṛtasāpa āsurye manuṃ cakruruparaṃ dasāya ||
6,021.12  sa no bodhi puraetā sugeṣūta durgeṣu pathikṛdvidānaḥ |
6,021.12 ye aśramāsa uravo vahiṣṭhāstebhirna indrābhi vakṣi vājam ||

6,022.01  ya eka iddhavyaścarṣaṇīnāmindraṃ taṃ gīrbhirabhyarca ābhiḥ |
6,022.01 yaḥ patyate vṛṣabho vṛṣṇyāvānsatyaḥ satvā purumāyaḥ sahasvān ||
6,022.02  tamu naḥ pūrve pitaro navagvāḥ sapta viprāso abhi vājayantaḥ |
6,022.02 nakṣaddābhaṃ taturiṃ parvateṣṭhāmadroghavācaṃ matibhiḥ śaviṣṭham ||
6,022.03  tamīmaha indramasya rāyaḥ puruvīrasya nṛvataḥ purukṣoḥ |
6,022.03 yo askṛdhoyurajaraḥ svarvāntamā bhara harivo mādayadhyai ||
6,022.04  tanno vi voco yadi te purā cijjaritāra ānaśuḥ sumnamindra |
6,022.04 kaste bhāgaḥ kiṃ vayo dudhra khidvaḥ puruhūta purūvaso'suraghnaḥ ||
6,022.05  taṃ pṛcchantī vajrahastaṃ ratheṣṭhāmindraṃ vepī vakvarī yasya nū gīḥ |
6,022.05 tuvigrābhaṃ tuvikūrmiṃ rabhodāṃ gātumiṣe nakṣate tumramaccha ||
6,022.06  ayā ha tyaṃ māyayā vāvṛdhānaṃ manojuvā svatavaḥ parvatena |
6,022.06 acyutā cidvīḻitā svojo rujo vi dṛḻhā dhṛṣatā virapśin ||
6,022.07  taṃ vo dhiyā navyasyā śaviṣṭhaṃ pratnaṃ pratnavatparitaṃsayadhyai |
6,022.07 sa no vakṣadanimānaḥ suvahmendro viśvānyati durgahāṇi ||
6,022.08  ā janāya druhvaṇe pārthivāni divyāni dīpayo'ntarikṣā |
6,022.08 tapā vṛṣanviśvataḥ śociṣā tānbrahmadviṣe śocaya kṣāmapaśca ||
6,022.09  bhuvo janasya divyasya rājā pārthivasya jagatastveṣasaṃdṛk |
6,022.09 dhiṣva vajraṃ dakṣiṇa indra haste viśvā ajurya dayase vi māyāḥ ||
6,022.10  ā saṃyatamindra ṇaḥ svastiṃ śatrutūryāya bṛhatīmamṛdhrām |
6,022.10 yayā dāsānyāryāṇi vṛtrā karo vajrinsutukā nāhuṣāṇi ||
6,022.11  sa no niyudbhiḥ puruhūta vedho viśvavārābhirā gahi prayajyo |
6,022.11 na yā adevo varate na deva ābhiryāhi tūyamā madryadrik ||

6,023.01  suta ittvaṃ nimiśla indra some stome brahmaṇi śasyamāna ukthe |
6,023.01 yadvā yuktābhyāṃ maghavanharibhyāṃ bibhradvajraṃ bāhvorindra yāsi ||
6,023.02  yadvā divi pārye suṣvimindra vṛtrahatye'vasi śūrasātau |
6,023.02 yadvā dakṣasya bibhyuṣo abibhyadarandhayaḥ śardhata indra dasyūn ||
6,023.03  pātā sutamindro astu somaṃ praṇenīrugro jaritāramūtī |
6,023.03 kartā vīrāya suṣvaya u lokaṃ dātā vasu stuvate kīraye cit ||
6,023.04  ganteyānti savanā haribhyāṃ babhrirvajraṃ papiḥ somaṃ dadirgāḥ |
6,023.04 kartā vīraṃ naryaṃ sarvavīraṃ śrotā havaṃ gṛṇata stomavāhāḥ ||
6,023.05  asmai vayaṃ yadvāvāna tadviviṣma indrāya yo naḥ pradivo apaskaḥ |
6,023.05 sute some stumasi śaṃsadukthendrāya brahma vardhanaṃ yathāsat ||
6,023.06  brahmāṇi hi cakṛṣe vardhanāni tāvatta indra matibhirviviṣmaḥ |
6,023.06 sute some sutapāḥ śantamāni rāṇḍyā kriyāsma vakṣaṇāni yajñaiḥ ||
6,023.07  sa no bodhi puroḻāśaṃ rarāṇaḥ pibā tu somaṃ goṛjīkamindra |
6,023.07 edaṃ barhiryajamānasya sīdoruṃ kṛdhi tvāyata u lokam ||
6,023.08  sa mandasvā hyanu joṣamugra pra tvā yajñāsa ime aśnuvantu |
6,023.08 preme havāsaḥ puruhūtamasme ā tveyaṃ dhīravasa indra yamyāḥ ||
6,023.09  taṃ vaḥ sakhāyaḥ saṃ yathā suteṣu somebhirīṃ pṛṇatā bhojamindram |
6,023.09 kuvittasmā asati no bharāya na suṣvimindro'vase mṛdhāti ||
6,023.10  evedindraḥ sute astāvi some bharadvājeṣu kṣayadinmaghonaḥ |
6,023.10 asadyathā jaritra uta sūririndro rāyo viśvavārasya dātā ||

6,024.01  vṛṣā mada indre śloka ukthā sacā someṣu sutapā ṛjīṣī |
6,024.01 arcatryo maghavā nṛbhya ukthairdyukṣo rājā girāmakṣitotiḥ ||
6,024.02  taturirvīro naryo vicetāḥ śrotā havaṃ gṛṇata urvyūtiḥ |
6,024.02 vasuḥ śaṃso narāṃ kārudhāyā vājī stuto vidathe dāti vājam ||
6,024.03  akṣo na cakryoḥ śūra bṛhanpra te mahnā ririce rodasyoḥ |
6,024.03 vṛkṣasya nu te puruhūta vayā vyūtayo ruruhurindra pūrvīḥ ||
6,024.04  śacīvataste puruśāka śākā gavāmiva srutayaḥ saṃcaraṇīḥ |
6,024.04 vatsānāṃ na tantayasta indra dāmanvanto adāmānaḥ sudāman ||
6,024.05  anyadadya karvaramanyadu śvo'sacca sanmuhurācakririndraḥ |
6,024.05 mitro no atra varuṇaśca pūṣāryo vaśasya paryetāsti ||
6,024.06  vi tvadāpo na parvatasya pṛṣṭhādukthebhirindrānayanta yajñaiḥ |
6,024.06 taṃ tvābhiḥ suṣṭutibhirvājayanta ājiṃ na jagmurgirvāho aśvāḥ ||
6,024.07  na yaṃ jaranti śarado na māsā na dyāva indramavakarśayanti |
6,024.07 vṛddhasya cidvardhatāmasya tanū stomebhirukthaiśca śasyamānā ||
6,024.08  na vīḻave namate na sthirāya na śardhate dasyujūtāya stavān |
6,024.08 ajrā indrasya girayaścidṛṣvā gambhīre cidbhavati gādhamasmai ||
6,024.09  gambhīreṇa na uruṇāmatrinpreṣo yandhi sutapāvanvājān |
6,024.09 sthā ū ṣu ūrdhva ūtī ariṣaṇyannaktorvyuṣṭau paritakmyāyām ||
6,024.10  sacasva nāyamavase abhīka ito vā tamindra pāhi riṣaḥ |
6,024.10 amā cainamaraṇye pāhi riṣo madema śatahimāḥ suvīrāḥ ||

6,025.01  yā ta ūtiravamā yā paramā yā madhyamendra śuṣminnasti |
6,025.01 tābhirū ṣu vṛtrahatye'vīrna ebhiśca vājairmahānna ugra ||
6,025.02  ābhi spṛdho mithatīrariṣaṇyannamitrasya vyathayā manyumindra |
6,025.02 ābhirviśvā abhiyujo viṣūcīrāryāya viśo'va tārīrdāsīḥ ||
6,025.03  indra jāmaya uta ye'jāmayo'rvācīnāso vanuṣo yuyujre |
6,025.03 tvameṣāṃ vithurā śavāṃsi jahi vṛṣṇyāni kṛṇuhī parācaḥ ||
6,025.04  śūro vā śūraṃ vanate śarīraistanūrucā taruṣi yatkṛṇvaite |
6,025.04 toke vā goṣu tanaye yadapsu vi krandasī urvarāsu bravaite ||
6,025.05  nahi tvā śūro na turo na dhṛṣṇurna tvā yodho manyamāno yuyodha |
6,025.05 indra nakiṣṭvā pratyastyeṣāṃ viśvā jātānyabhyasi tāni ||
6,025.06  sa patyata ubhayornṛmṇamayoryadī vedhasaḥ samithe havante |
6,025.06 vṛtre vā maho nṛvati kṣaye vā vyacasvantā yadi vitantasaite ||
6,025.07  adha smā te carṣaṇayo yadejānindra trātota bhavā varūtā |
6,025.07 asmākāso ye nṛtamāso arya indra sūrayo dadhire puro naḥ ||
6,025.08  anu te dāyi maha indriyāya satrā te viśvamanu vṛtrahatye |
6,025.08 anu kṣatramanu saho yajatrendra devebhiranu te nṛṣahye ||
6,025.09  evā na spṛdhaḥ samajā samatsvindra rārandhi mithatīradevīḥ |
6,025.09 vidyāma vastoravasā gṛṇanto bharadvājā uta ta indra nūnam ||

6,026.01  śrudhī na indra hvayāmasi tvā maho vājasya sātau vāvṛṣāṇāḥ |
6,026.01 saṃ yadviśo'yanta śūrasātā ugraṃ no'vaḥ pārye ahandāḥ ||
6,026.02  tvāṃ vājī havate vājineyo maho vājasya gadhyasya sātau |
6,026.02 tvāṃ vṛtreṣvindra satpatiṃ tarutraṃ tvāṃ caṣṭe muṣṭihā goṣu yudhyan ||
6,026.03  tvaṃ kaviṃ codayo'rkasātau tvaṃ kutsāya śuṣṇaṃ dāśuṣe vark |
6,026.03 tvaṃ śiro amarmaṇaḥ parāhannatithigvāya śaṃsyaṃ kariṣyan ||
6,026.04  tvaṃ rathaṃ pra bharo yodhamṛṣvamāvo yudhyantaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ daśadyum |
6,026.04 tvaṃ tugraṃ vetasave sacāhantvaṃ tujiṃ gṛṇantamindra tūtoḥ ||
6,026.05  tvaṃ tadukthamindra barhaṇā kaḥ pra yacchatā sahasrā śūra darṣi |
6,026.05 ava girerdāsaṃ śambaraṃ hanprāvo divodāsaṃ citrābhirūtī ||
6,026.06  tvaṃ śraddhābhirmandasānaḥ somairdabhītaye cumurimindra siṣvap |
6,026.06 tvaṃ rajiṃ piṭhīnase daśasyanṣaṣṭiṃ sahasrā śacyā sacāhan ||
6,026.07  ahaṃ cana tatsūribhirānaśyāṃ tava jyāya indra sumnamojaḥ |
6,026.07 tvayā yatstavante sadhavīra vīrāstrivarūthena nahuṣā śaviṣṭha ||
6,026.08  vayaṃ te asyāmindra dyumnahūtau sakhāyaḥ syāma mahina preṣṭhāḥ |
6,026.08 prātardaniḥ kṣatraśrīrastu śreṣṭho ghane vṛtrāṇāṃ sanaye dhanānām ||

6,027.01  kimasya made kiṃ vasya pītāvindraḥ kimasya sakhye cakāra |
6,027.01 raṇā vā ye niṣadi kiṃ te asya purā vividre kimu nūtanāsaḥ ||
6,027.02  sadasya made sadvasya pītāvindraḥ sadasya sakhye cakāra |
6,027.02 raṇā vā ye niṣadi satte asya purā vividre sadu nūtanāsaḥ ||
6,027.03  nahi nu te mahimanaḥ samasya na maghavanmaghavattvasya vidma |
6,027.03 na rādhasorādhaso nūtanasyendra nakirdadṛśa indriyaṃ te ||
6,027.04  etattyatta indriyamaceti yenāvadhīrvaraśikhasya śeṣaḥ |
6,027.04 vajrasya yatte nihatasya śuṣmātsvanāccidindra paramo dadāra ||
6,027.05  vadhīdindro varaśikhasya śeṣo'bhyāvartine cāyamānāya śikṣan |
6,027.05 vṛcīvato yaddhariyūpīyāyāṃ hanpūrve ardhe bhiyasāparo dart ||
6,027.06  triṃśacchataṃ varmiṇa indra sākaṃ yavyāvatyāṃ puruhūta śravasyā |
6,027.06 vṛcīvantaḥ śarave patyamānāḥ pātrā bhindānā nyarthānyāyan ||
6,027.07  yasya gāvāvaruṣā sūyavasyū antarū ṣu carato rerihāṇā |
6,027.07 sa sṛñjayāya turvaśaṃ parādādvṛcīvato daivavātāya śikṣan ||
6,027.08  dvayāṃ agne rathino viṃśatiṃ gā vadhūmato maghavā mahyaṃ samrāṭ |
6,027.08 abhyāvartī cāyamāno dadāti dūṇāśeyaṃ dakṣiṇā pārthavānām ||

6,028.01  ā gāvo agmannuta bhadramakransīdantu goṣṭhe raṇayantvasme |
6,028.01 prajāvatīḥ pururūpā iha syurindrāya pūrvīruṣaso duhānāḥ ||
6,028.02  indro yajvane pṛṇate ca śikṣatyupeddadāti na svaṃ muṣāyati |
6,028.02 bhūyobhūyo rayimidasya vardhayannabhinne khilye ni dadhāti devayum ||
6,028.03  na tā naśanti na dabhāti taskaro nāsāmāmitro vyathirā dadharṣati |
6,028.03 devāṃśca yābhiryajate dadāti ca jyogittābhiḥ sacate gopatiḥ saha ||
6,028.04  na tā arvā reṇukakāṭo aśnute na saṃskṛtatramupa yanti tā abhi |
6,028.04 urugāyamabhayaṃ tasya tā anu gāvo martasya vi caranti yajvanaḥ ||
6,028.05  gāvo bhago gāva indro me acchāngāvaḥ somasya prathamasya bhakṣaḥ |
6,028.05 imā yā gāvaḥ sa janāsa indra icchāmīddhṛdā manasā cidindram ||
6,028.06  yūyaṃ gāvo medayathā kṛśaṃ cidaśrīraṃ citkṛṇuthā supratīkam |
6,028.06 bhadraṃ gṛhaṃ kṛṇutha bhadravāco bṛhadvo vaya ucyate sabhāsu ||
6,028.07  prajāvatīḥ sūyavasaṃ riśantīḥ śuddhā apaḥ suprapāṇe pibantīḥ |
6,028.07 mā va stena īśata māghaśaṃsaḥ pari vo hetī rudrasya vṛjyāḥ ||
6,028.08  upedamupaparcanamāsu goṣūpa pṛcyatām |
6,028.08 upa ṛṣabhasya retasyupendra tava vīrye ||

6,029.01  indraṃ vo naraḥ sakhyāya sepurmaho yantaḥ sumataye cakānāḥ |
6,029.01 maho hi dātā vajrahasto asti mahāmu raṇvamavase yajadhvam ||
6,029.02  ā yasminhaste naryā mimikṣurā rathe hiraṇyaye ratheṣṭhāḥ |
6,029.02 ā raśmayo gabhastyo sthūrayorādhvannaśvāso vṛṣaṇo yujānāḥ ||
6,029.03  śriye te pādā duva ā mimikṣurdhṛṣṇurvajrī śavasā dakṣiṇāvān |
6,029.03 vasāno atkaṃ surabhiṃ dṛśe kaṃ svarṇa nṛtaviṣiro babhūtha ||
6,029.04  sa soma āmiślatamaḥ suto bhūdyasminpaktiḥ pacyate santi dhānāḥ |
6,029.04 indraṃ nara stuvanto brahmakārā ukthā śaṃsanto devavātatamāḥ ||
6,029.05  na te antaḥ śavaso dhāyyasya vi tu bābadhe rodasī mahitvā |
6,029.05 ā tā sūriḥ pṛṇati tūtujāno yūthevāpsu samījamāna ūtī ||
6,029.06  evedindraḥ suhava ṛṣvo astūtī anūtī hiriśipraḥ satvā |
6,029.06 evā hi jāto asamātyojāḥ purū ca vṛtrā hanati ni dasyūn ||

6,030.01  bhūya idvāvṛdhe vīryāyaṃ eko ajuryo dayate vasūni |
6,030.01 pra ririce diva indraḥ pṛthivyā ardhamidasya prati rodasī ubhe ||
6,030.02  adhā manye bṛhadasuryamasya yāni dādhāra nakirā mināti |
6,030.02 divedive sūryo darśato bhūdvi sadmānyurviyā sukraturdhāt ||
6,030.03  adyā cinnū cittadapo nadīnāṃ yadābhyo arado gātumindra |
6,030.03 ni parvatā admasado na sedustvayā dṛḻhāni sukrato rajāṃsi ||
6,030.04  satyamittanna tvāvāṃ anyo astīndra devo na martyo jyāyān |
6,030.04 ahannahiṃ pariśayānamarṇo'vāsṛjo apo acchā samudram ||
6,030.05  tvamapo vi duro viṣūcīrindra dṛḻhamarujaḥ parvatasya |
6,030.05 rājābhavo jagataścarṣaṇīnāṃ sākaṃ sūryaṃ janayandyāmuṣāsam ||

6,031.01  abhūreko rayipate rayīṇāmā hastayoradhithā indra kṛṣṭīḥ |
6,031.01 vi toke apsu tanaye ca sūre'vocanta carṣaṇayo vivācaḥ ||
6,031.02  tvadbhiyendra pārthivāni viśvācyutā ciccyāvayante rajāṃsi |
6,031.02 dyāvākṣāmā parvatāso vanāni viśvaṃ dṛḻhaṃ bhayate ajmannā te ||
6,031.03  tvaṃ kutsenābhi śuṣṇamindrāśuṣaṃ yudhya kuyavaṃ gaviṣṭau |
6,031.03 daśa prapitve adha sūryasya muṣāyaścakramavive rapāṃsi ||
6,031.04  tvaṃ śatānyava śambarasya puro jaghanthāpratīni dasyoḥ |
6,031.04 aśikṣo yatra śacyā śacīvo divodāsāya sunvate sutakre bharadvājāya gṛṇate vasūni ||
6,031.05  sa satyasatvanmahate raṇāya rathamā tiṣṭha tuvinṛmṇa bhīmam |
6,031.05 yāhi prapathinnavasopa madrikpra ca śruta śrāvaya carṣaṇibhyaḥ ||

6,032.01  apūrvyā purutamānyasmai mahe vīrāya tavase turāya |
6,032.01 virapśine vajriṇe śantamāni vacāṃsyāsā sthavirāya takṣam ||
6,032.02  sa mātarā sūryeṇā kavīnāmavāsayadrujadadriṃ gṛṇānaḥ |
6,032.02 svādhībhirṛkvabhirvāvaśāna udusriyāṇāmasṛjannidānam ||
6,032.03  sa vahnibhirṛkvabhirgoṣu śaśvanmitajñubhiḥ purukṛtvā jigāya |
6,032.03 puraḥ purohā sakhibhiḥ sakhīyandṛḻhā ruroja kavibhiḥ kaviḥ san ||
6,032.04  sa nīvyābhirjaritāramacchā maho vājebhirmahadbhiśca śuṣmaiḥ |
6,032.04 puruvīrābhirvṛṣabha kṣitīnāmā girvaṇaḥ suvitāya pra yāhi ||
6,032.05  sa sargeṇa śavasā takto atyairapa indro dakṣiṇatasturāṣāṭ |
6,032.05 itthā sṛjānā anapāvṛdarthaṃ divedive viviṣurapramṛṣyam ||

6,033.01  ya ojiṣṭha indra taṃ su no dā mado vṛṣansvabhiṣṭirdāsvān |
6,033.01 sauvaśvyaṃ yo vanavatsvaśvo vṛtrā samatsu sāsahadamitrān ||
6,033.02  tvāṃ hīndrāvase vivāco havante carṣaṇayaḥ śūrasātau |
6,033.02 tvaṃ viprebhirvi paṇīṃraśāyastvota itsanitā vājamarvā ||
6,033.03  tvaṃ tāṃ indrobhayāṃ amitrāndāsā vṛtrāṇyāryā ca śūra |
6,033.03 vadhīrvaneva sudhitebhiratkairā pṛtsu darṣi nṛṇāṃ nṛtama ||
6,033.04  sa tvaṃ na indrākavābhirūtī sakhā viśvāyuravitā vṛdhe bhūḥ |
6,033.04 svarṣātā yaddhvayāmasi tvā yudhyanto nemadhitā pṛtsu śūra ||
6,033.05  nūnaṃ na indrāparāya ca syā bhavā mṛḻīka uta no abhiṣṭau |
6,033.05 itthā gṛṇanto mahinasya śarmandivi ṣyāma pārye goṣatamāḥ ||

6,034.01  saṃ ca tve jagmurgira indra pūrvīrvi ca tvadyanti vibhvo manīṣāḥ |
6,034.01 purā nūnaṃ ca stutaya ṛṣīṇāṃ paspṛdhra indre adhyukthārkā ||
6,034.02  puruhūto yaḥ purugūrta ṛbhvāṃ ekaḥ purupraśasto asti yajñaiḥ |
6,034.02 ratho na mahe śavase yujāno'smābhirindro anumādyo bhūt ||
6,034.03  na yaṃ hiṃsanti dhītayo na vāṇīrindraṃ nakṣantīdabhi vardhayantīḥ |
6,034.03 yadi stotāraḥ śataṃ yatsahasraṃ gṛṇanti girvaṇasaṃ śaṃ tadasmai ||
6,034.04  asmā etaddivyarceva māsā mimikṣa indre nyayāmi somaḥ |
6,034.04 janaṃ na dhanvannabhi saṃ yadāpaḥ satrā vāvṛdhurhavanāni yajñaiḥ ||
6,034.05  asmā etanmahyāṅgūṣamasmā indrāya stotraṃ matibhiravāci |
6,034.05 asadyathā mahati vṛtratūrya indro viśvāyuravitā vṛdhaśca ||

6,035.01  kadā bhuvanrathakṣayāṇi brahma kadā stotre sahasrapoṣyaṃ dāḥ |
6,035.01 kadā stomaṃ vāsayo'sya rāyā kadā dhiyaḥ karasi vājaratnāḥ ||
6,035.02  karhi svittadindra yannṛbhirnṝnvīrairvīrānnīḻayāse jayājīn |
6,035.02 tridhātu gā adhi jayāsi goṣvindra dyumnaṃ svarvaddhehyasme ||
6,035.03  karhi svittadindra yajjaritre viśvapsu brahma kṛṇavaḥ śaviṣṭha |
6,035.03 kadā dhiyo na niyuto yuvāse kadā gomaghā havanāni gacchāḥ ||
6,035.04  sa gomaghā jaritre aśvaścandrā vājaśravaso adhi dhehi pṛkṣaḥ |
6,035.04 pīpihīṣaḥ sudughāmindra dhenuṃ bharadvājeṣu suruco rurucyāḥ ||
6,035.05  tamā nūnaṃ vṛjanamanyathā cicchūro yacchakra vi duro gṛṇīṣe |
6,035.05 mā niraraṃ śukradughasya dhenorāṅgirasānbrahmaṇā vipra jinva ||

6,036.01  satrā madāsastava viśvajanyāḥ satrā rāyo'dha ye pārthivāsaḥ |
6,036.01 satrā vājānāmabhavo vibhaktā yaddeveṣu dhārayathā asuryam ||
6,036.02  anu pra yeje jana ojo asya satrā dadhire anu vīryāya |
6,036.02 syūmagṛbhe dudhaye'rvate ca kratuṃ vṛñjantyapi vṛtrahatye ||
6,036.03  taṃ sadhrīcīrūtayo vṛṣṇyāni pauṃsyāni niyutaḥ saścurindram |
6,036.03 samudraṃ na sindhava ukthaśuṣmā uruvyacasaṃ gira ā viśanti ||
6,036.04  sa rāyaskhāmupa sṛjā gṛṇānaḥ puruścandrasya tvamindra vasvaḥ |
6,036.04 patirbabhūthāsamo janānāmeko viśvasya bhuvanasya rājā ||
6,036.05  sa tu śrudhi śrutyā yo duvoyurdyaurna bhūmābhi rāyo aryaḥ |
6,036.05 aso yathā naḥ śavasā cakāno yugeyuge vayasā cekitānaḥ ||

6,037.01  arvāgrathaṃ viśvavāraṃ ta ugrendra yuktāso harayo vahantu |
6,037.01 kīriściddhi tvā havate svarvānṛdhīmahi sadhamādaste adya ||
6,037.02  pro droṇe harayaḥ karmāgmanpunānāsa ṛjyanto abhūvan |
6,037.02 indro no asya pūrvyaḥ papīyāddyukṣo madasya somyasya rājā ||
6,037.03  āsasrāṇāsaḥ śavasānamacchendraṃ sucakre rathyāso aśvāḥ |
6,037.03 abhi śrava ṛjyanto vaheyurnū cinnu vāyoramṛtaṃ vi dasyet ||
6,037.04  variṣṭho asya dakṣiṇāmiyartīndro maghonāṃ tuvikūrmitamaḥ |
6,037.04 yayā vajrivaḥ pariyāsyaṃho maghā ca dhṛṣṇo dayase vi sūrīn ||
6,037.05  indro vājasya sthavirasya dātendro gīrbhirvardhatāṃ vṛddhamahāḥ |
6,037.05 indro vṛtraṃ haniṣṭho astu satvā tā sūriḥ pṛṇati tūtujānaḥ ||

6,038.01  apādita udu naścitratamo mahīṃ bharṣaddyumatīmindrahūtim |
6,038.01 panyasīṃ dhītiṃ daivyasya yāmañjanasya rātiṃ vanate sudānuḥ ||
6,038.02  dūrāccidā vasato asya karṇā ghoṣādindrasya tanyati bruvāṇaḥ |
6,038.02 eyamenaṃ devahūtirvavṛtyānmadryagindramiyamṛcyamānā ||
6,038.03  taṃ vo dhiyā paramayā purājāmajaramindramabhyanūṣyarkaiḥ |
6,038.03 brahmā ca giro dadhire samasminmahāṃśca stomo adhi vardhadindre ||
6,038.04  vardhādyaṃ yajña uta soma indraṃ vardhādbrahma gira ukthā ca manma |
6,038.04 vardhāhainamuṣaso yāmannaktorvardhānmāsāḥ śarado dyāva indram ||
6,038.05  evā jajñānaṃ sahase asāmi vāvṛdhānaṃ rādhase ca śrutāya |
6,038.05 mahāmugramavase vipra nūnamā vivāsema vṛtratūryeṣu ||

6,039.01  mandrasya kaverdivyasya vahnervipramanmano vacanasya madhvaḥ |
6,039.01 apā nastasya sacanasya deveṣo yuvasva gṛṇate goagrāḥ ||
6,039.02  ayamuśānaḥ paryadrimusrā ṛtadhītibhirṛtayugyujānaḥ |
6,039.02 rujadarugṇaṃ vi valasya sānuṃ paṇīṃrvacobhirabhi yodhadindraḥ ||
6,039.03  ayaṃ dyotayadadyuto vyaktūndoṣā vastoḥ śarada indurindra |
6,039.03 imaṃ ketumadadhurnū cidahnāṃ śucijanmana uṣasaścakāra ||
6,039.04  ayaṃ rocayadaruco rucāno'yaṃ vāsayadvyṛtena pūrvīḥ |
6,039.04 ayamīyata ṛtayugbhiraśvaiḥ svarvidā nābhinā carṣaṇiprāḥ ||
6,039.05  nū gṛṇāno gṛṇate pratna rājanniṣaḥ pinva vasudeyāya pūrvīḥ |
6,039.05 apa oṣadhīraviṣā vanāni gā arvato nṝnṛcase rirīhi ||

6,040.01  indra piba tubhyaṃ suto madāyāva sya harī vi mucā sakhāyā |
6,040.01 uta pra gāya gaṇa ā niṣadyāthā yajñāya gṛṇate vayo dhāḥ ||
6,040.02  asya piba yasya jajñāna indra madāya kratve apibo virapśin |
6,040.02 tamu te gāvo nara āpo adririnduṃ samahyanpītaye samasmai ||
6,040.03  samiddhe agnau suta indra soma ā tvā vahantu harayo vahiṣṭhāḥ |
6,040.03 tvāyatā manasā johavīmīndrā yāhi suvitāya mahe naḥ ||
6,040.04  ā yāhi śaśvaduśatā yayāthendra mahā manasā somapeyam |
6,040.04 upa brahmāṇi śṛṇava imā no'thā te yajñastanve vayo dhāt ||
6,040.05  yadindra divi pārye yadṛdhagyadvā sve sadane yatra vāsi |
6,040.05 ato no yajñamavase niyutvānsajoṣāḥ pāhi girvaṇo marudbhiḥ ||

6,041.01  aheḻamāna upa yāhi yajñaṃ tubhyaṃ pavanta indavaḥ sutāsaḥ |
6,041.01 gāvo na vajrinsvamoko acchendrā gahi prathamo yajñiyānām ||
6,041.02  yā te kākutsukṛtā yā variṣṭhā yayā śaśvatpibasi madhva ūrmim |
6,041.02 tayā pāhi pra te adhvaryurasthātsaṃ te vajro vartatāmindra gavyuḥ ||
6,041.03  eṣa drapso vṛṣabho viśvarūpa indrāya vṛṣṇe samakāri somaḥ |
6,041.03 etaṃ piba hariva sthātarugra yasyeśiṣe pradivi yaste annam ||
6,041.04  sutaḥ somo asutādindra vasyānayaṃ śreyāñcikituṣe raṇāya |
6,041.04 etaṃ titirva upa yāhi yajñaṃ tena viśvāstaviṣīrā pṛṇasva ||
6,041.05  hvayāmasi tvendra yāhyarvāṅaraṃ te somastanve bhavāti |
6,041.05 śatakrato mādayasvā suteṣu prāsmāṃ ava pṛtanāsu pra vikṣu ||

6,042.01  pratyasmai pipīṣate viśvāni viduṣe bhara |
6,042.01 araṅgamāya jagmaye'paścāddaghvane nare ||
6,042.02  emenaṃ pratyetana somebhiḥ somapātamam |
6,042.02 amatrebhirṛjīṣiṇamindraṃ sutebhirindubhiḥ ||
6,042.03  yadī sutebhirindubhiḥ somebhiḥ pratibhūṣatha |
6,042.03 vedā viśvasya medhiro dhṛṣattaṃtamideṣate ||
6,042.04  asmāasmā idandhaso'dhvaryo pra bharā sutam |
6,042.04 kuvitsamasya jenyasya śardhato'bhiśasteravasparat ||

6,043.01  yasya tyacchambaraṃ made divodāsāya randhayaḥ |
6,043.01 ayaṃ sa soma indra te sutaḥ piba ||
6,043.02  yasya tīvrasutaṃ madaṃ madhyamantaṃ ca rakṣase |
6,043.02 ayaṃ sa soma indra te sutaḥ piba ||
6,043.03  yasya gā antaraśmano made dṛḻhā avāsṛjaḥ |
6,043.03 ayaṃ sa soma indra te sutaḥ piba ||
6,043.04  yasya mandāno andhaso māghonaṃ dadhiṣe śavaḥ |
6,043.04 ayaṃ sa soma indra te sutaḥ piba ||

6,044.01  yo rayivo rayintamo yo dyumnairdyumnavattamaḥ |
6,044.01 somaḥ sutaḥ sa indra te'sti svadhāpate madaḥ ||
6,044.02  yaḥ śagmastuviśagma te rāyo dāmā matīnām |
6,044.02 somaḥ sutaḥ sa indra te'sti svadhāpate madaḥ ||
6,044.03  yena vṛddho na śavasā turo na svābhirūtibhiḥ |
6,044.03 somaḥ sutaḥ sa indra te'sti svadhāpate madaḥ ||
6,044.04  tyamu vo aprahaṇaṃ gṛṇīṣe śavasaspatim |
6,044.04 indraṃ viśvāsāhaṃ naraṃ maṃhiṣṭhaṃ viśvacarṣaṇim ||
6,044.05  yaṃ vardhayantīdgiraḥ patiṃ turasya rādhasaḥ |
6,044.05 taminnvasya rodasī devī śuṣmaṃ saparyataḥ ||
6,044.06  tadva ukthasya barhaṇendrāyopastṛṇīṣaṇi |
6,044.06 vipo na yasyotayo vi yadrohanti sakṣitaḥ ||
6,044.07  avidaddakṣaṃ mitro navīyānpapāno devebhyo vasyo acait |
6,044.07 sasavānstaulābhirdhautarībhiruruṣyā pāyurabhavatsakhibhyaḥ ||
6,044.08  ṛtasya pathi vedhā apāyi śriye manāṃsi devāso akran |
6,044.08 dadhāno nāma maho vacobhirvapurdṛśaye venyo vyāvaḥ ||
6,044.09  dyumattamaṃ dakṣaṃ dhehyasme sedhā janānāṃ pūrvīrarātīḥ |
6,044.09 varṣīyo vayaḥ kṛṇuhi śacībhirdhanasya sātāvasmāṃ aviḍḍhi ||
6,044.10  indra tubhyaminmaghavannabhūma vayaṃ dātre harivo mā vi venaḥ |
6,044.10 nakirāpirdadṛśe martyatrā kimaṅga radhracodanaṃ tvāhuḥ ||
6,044.11  mā jasvane vṛṣabha no rarīthā mā te revataḥ sakhye riṣāma |
6,044.11 pūrvīṣṭa indra niṣṣidho janeṣu jahyasuṣvīnpra vṛhāpṛṇataḥ ||
6,044.12  udabhrāṇīva stanayanniyartīndro rādhāṃsyaśvyāni gavyā |
6,044.12 tvamasi pradivaḥ kārudhāyā mā tvādāmāna ā dabhanmaghonaḥ ||
6,044.13  adhvaryo vīra pra mahe sutānāmindrāya bhara sa hyasya rājā |
6,044.13 yaḥ pūrvyābhiruta nūtanābhirgīrbhirvāvṛdhe gṛṇatāmṛṣīṇām ||
6,044.14  asya made puru varpāṃsi vidvānindro vṛtrāṇyapratī jaghāna |
6,044.14 tamu pra hoṣi madhumantamasmai somaṃ vīrāya śipriṇe pibadhyai ||
6,044.15  pātā sutamindro astu somaṃ hantā vṛtraṃ vajreṇa mandasānaḥ |
6,044.15 gantā yajñaṃ parāvataścidacchā vasurdhīnāmavitā kārudhāyāḥ ||
6,044.16  idaṃ tyatpātramindrapānamindrasya priyamamṛtamapāyi |
6,044.16 matsadyathā saumanasāya devaṃ vyasmaddveṣo yuyavadvyaṃhaḥ ||
6,044.17  enā mandāno jahi śūra śatrūñjāmimajāmiṃ maghavannamitrān |
6,044.17 abhiṣeṇāṃ abhyādediśānānparāca indra pra mṛṇā jahī ca ||
6,044.18  āsu ṣmā ṇo maghavannindra pṛtsvasmabhyaṃ mahi varivaḥ sugaṃ kaḥ |
6,044.18 apāṃ tokasya tanayasya jeṣa indra sūrīnkṛṇuhi smā no ardham ||
6,044.19  ā tvā harayo vṛṣaṇo yujānā vṛṣarathāso vṛṣaraśmayo'tyāḥ |
6,044.19 asmatrāñco vṛṣaṇo vajravāho vṛṣṇe madāya suyujo vahantu ||
6,044.20  ā te vṛṣanvṛṣaṇo droṇamasthurghṛtapruṣo normayo madantaḥ |
6,044.20 indra pra tubhyaṃ vṛṣabhiḥ sutānāṃ vṛṣṇe bharanti vṛṣabhāya somam ||
6,044.21  vṛṣāsi divo vṛṣabhaḥ pṛthivyā vṛṣā sindhūnāṃ vṛṣabha stiyānām |
6,044.21 vṛṣṇe ta indurvṛṣabha pīpāya svādū raso madhupeyo varāya ||
6,044.22  ayaṃ devaḥ sahasā jāyamāna indreṇa yujā paṇimastabhāyat |
6,044.22 ayaṃ svasya piturāyudhānīnduramuṣṇādaśivasya māyāḥ ||
6,044.23  ayamakṛṇoduṣasaḥ supatnīrayaṃ sūrye adadhājjyotirantaḥ |
6,044.23 ayaṃ tridhātu divi rocaneṣu triteṣu vindadamṛtaṃ nigūḻham ||
6,044.24  ayaṃ dyāvāpṛthivī vi ṣkabhāyadayaṃ rathamayunaksaptaraśmim |
6,044.24 ayaṃ goṣu śacyā pakvamantaḥ somo dādhāra daśayantramutsam ||

6,045.01  ya ānayatparāvataḥ sunītī turvaśaṃ yadum |
6,045.01 indraḥ sa no yuvā sakhā ||
6,045.02  avipre cidvayo dadhadanāśunā cidarvatā |
6,045.02 indro jetā hitaṃ dhanam ||
6,045.03  mahīrasya praṇītayaḥ pūrvīruta praśastayaḥ |
6,045.03 nāsya kṣīyanta ūtayaḥ ||
6,045.04  sakhāyo brahmavāhase'rcata pra ca gāyata |
6,045.04 sa hi naḥ pramatirmahī ||
6,045.05  tvamekasya vṛtrahannavitā dvayorasi |
6,045.05 utedṛśe yathā vayam ||
6,045.06  nayasīdvati dviṣaḥ kṛṇoṣyukthaśaṃsinaḥ |
6,045.06 nṛbhiḥ suvīra ucyase ||
6,045.07  brahmāṇaṃ brahmavāhasaṃ gīrbhiḥ sakhāyamṛgmiyam |
6,045.07 gāṃ na dohase huve ||
6,045.08  yasya viśvāni hastayorūcurvasūni ni dvitā |
6,045.08 vīrasya pṛtanāṣahaḥ ||
6,045.09  vi dṛḻhāni cidadrivo janānāṃ śacīpate |
6,045.09 vṛha māyā anānata ||
6,045.10  tamu tvā satya somapā indra vājānāṃ pate |
6,045.10 ahūmahi śravasyavaḥ ||
6,045.11  tamu tvā yaḥ purāsitha yo vā nūnaṃ hite dhane |
6,045.11 havyaḥ sa śrudhī havam ||
6,045.12  dhībhirarvadbhirarvato vājāṃ indra śravāyyān |
6,045.12 tvayā jeṣma hitaṃ dhanam ||
6,045.13  abhūru vīra girvaṇo mahāṃ indra dhane hite |
6,045.13 bhare vitantasāyyaḥ ||
6,045.14  yā ta ūtiramitrahanmakṣūjavastamāsati |
6,045.14 tayā no hinuhī ratham ||
6,045.15  sa rathena rathītamo'smākenābhiyugvanā |
6,045.15 jeṣi jiṣṇo hitaṃ dhanam ||
6,045.16  ya eka ittamu ṣṭuhi kṛṣṭīnāṃ vicarṣaṇiḥ |
6,045.16 patirjajñe vṛṣakratuḥ ||
6,045.17  yo gṛṇatāmidāsithāpirūtī śivaḥ sakhā |
6,045.17 sa tvaṃ na indra mṛḻaya ||
6,045.18  dhiṣva vajraṃ gabhastyo rakṣohatyāya vajrivaḥ |
6,045.18 sāsahīṣṭhā abhi spṛdhaḥ ||
6,045.19  pratnaṃ rayīṇāṃ yujaṃ sakhāyaṃ kīricodanam |
6,045.19 brahmavāhastamaṃ huve ||
6,045.20  sa hi viśvāni pārthivāṃ eko vasūni patyate |
6,045.20 girvaṇastamo adhriguḥ ||
6,045.21  sa no niyudbhirā pṛṇa kāmaṃ vājebhiraśvibhiḥ |
6,045.21 gomadbhirgopate dhṛṣat ||
6,045.22  tadvo gāya sute sacā puruhūtāya satvane |
6,045.22 śaṃ yadgave na śākine ||
6,045.23  na ghā vasurni yamate dānaṃ vājasya gomataḥ |
6,045.23 yatsīmupa śravadgiraḥ ||
6,045.24  kuvitsasya pra hi vrajaṃ gomantaṃ dasyuhā gamat |
6,045.24 śacībhirapa no varat ||
6,045.25  imā u tvā śatakrato'bhi pra ṇonuvurgiraḥ |
6,045.25 indra vatsaṃ na mātaraḥ ||
6,045.26  dūṇāśaṃ sakhyaṃ tava gaurasi vīra gavyate |
6,045.26 aśvo aśvāyate bhava ||
6,045.27  sa mandasvā hyandhaso rādhase tanvā mahe |
6,045.27 na stotāraṃ nide karaḥ ||
6,045.28  imā u tvā sutesute nakṣante girvaṇo giraḥ |
6,045.28 vatsaṃ gāvo na dhenavaḥ ||
6,045.29  purūtamaṃ purūṇāṃ stotṝṇāṃ vivāci |
6,045.29 vājebhirvājayatām ||
6,045.30  asmākamindra bhūtu te stomo vāhiṣṭho antamaḥ |
6,045.30 asmānrāye mahe hinu ||
6,045.31  adhi bṛbuḥ paṇīnāṃ varṣiṣṭhe mūrdhannasthāt |
6,045.31 uruḥ kakṣo na gāṅgyaḥ ||
6,045.32  yasya vāyoriva dravadbhadrā rātiḥ sahasriṇī |
6,045.32 sadyo dānāya maṃhate ||
6,045.33  tatsu no viśve arya ā sadā gṛṇanti kāravaḥ |
6,045.33 bṛbuṃ sahasradātamaṃ sūriṃ sahasrasātamam ||

6,046.01  tvāmiddhi havāmahe sātā vājasya kāravaḥ |
6,046.01 tvāṃ vṛtreṣvindra satpatiṃ narastvāṃ kāṣṭhāsvarvataḥ ||
6,046.02  sa tvaṃ naścitra vajrahasta dhṛṣṇuyā maha stavāno adrivaḥ |
6,046.02 gāmaśvaṃ rathyamindra saṃ kira satrā vājaṃ na jigyuṣe ||
6,046.03  yaḥ satrāhā vicarṣaṇirindraṃ taṃ hūmahe vayam |
6,046.03 sahasramuṣka tuvinṛmṇa satpate bhavā samatsu no vṛdhe ||
6,046.04  bādhase janānvṛṣabheva manyunā ghṛṣau mīḻha ṛcīṣama |
6,046.04 asmākaṃ bodhyavitā mahādhane tanūṣvapsu sūrye ||
6,046.05  indra jyeṣṭhaṃ na ā bharaṃ ojiṣṭhaṃ papuri śravaḥ |
6,046.05 yeneme citra vajrahasta rodasī obhe suśipra prāḥ ||
6,046.06  tvāmugramavase carṣaṇīsahaṃ rājandeveṣu hūmahe |
6,046.06 viśvā su no vithurā pibdanā vaso'mitrānsuṣahānkṛdhi ||
6,046.07  yadindra nāhuṣīṣvāṃ ojo nṛmṇaṃ ca kṛṣṭiṣu |
6,046.07 yadvā pañca kṣitīnāṃ dyumnamā bhara satrā viśvāni pauṃsyā ||
6,046.08  yadvā tṛkṣau maghavandruhyāvā jane yatpūrau kacca vṛṣṇyam |
6,046.08 asmabhyaṃ tadrirīhi saṃ nṛṣāhye'mitrānpṛtsu turvaṇe ||
6,046.09  indra tridhātu śaraṇaṃ trivarūthaṃ svastimat |
6,046.09 chardiryaccha maghavadbhyaśca mahyaṃ ca yāvayā didyumebhyaḥ ||
6,046.10  ye gavyatā manasā śatrumādabhurabhipraghnanti dhṛṣṇuyā |
6,046.10 adha smā no maghavannindra girvaṇastanūpā antamo bhava ||
6,046.11  adha smā no vṛdhe bhavendra nāyamavā yudhi |
6,046.11 yadantarikṣe patayanti parṇino didyavastigmamūrdhānaḥ ||
6,046.12  yatra śūrāsastanvo vitanvate priyā śarma pitṝṇām |
6,046.12 adha smā yaccha tanve tane ca chardiracittaṃ yāvaya dveṣaḥ ||
6,046.13  yadindra sarge arvataścodayāse mahādhane |
6,046.13 asamane adhvani vṛjine pathi śyenāṃ iva śravasyataḥ ||
6,046.14  sindhūṃriva pravaṇa āśuyā yato yadi klośamanu ṣvaṇi |
6,046.14 ā ye vayo na varvṛtatyāmiṣi gṛbhītā bāhvorgavi ||

6,047.01  svāduṣkilāyaṃ madhumāṃ utāyaṃ tīvraḥ kilāyaṃ rasavāṃ utāyam |
6,047.01 uto nvasya papivāṃsamindraṃ na kaścana sahata āhaveṣu ||
6,047.02  ayaṃ svāduriha madiṣṭha āsa yasyendro vṛtrahatye mamāda |
6,047.02 purūṇi yaścyautnā śambarasya vi navatiṃ nava ca dehyo han ||
6,047.03  ayaṃ me pīta udiyarti vācamayaṃ manīṣāmuśatīmajīgaḥ |
6,047.03 ayaṃ ṣaḻ urvīramimīta dhīro na yābhyo bhuvanaṃ kaccanāre ||
6,047.04  ayaṃ sa yo varimāṇaṃ pṛthivyā varṣmāṇaṃ divo akṛṇodayaṃ saḥ |
6,047.04 ayaṃ pīyūṣaṃ tisṛṣu pravatsu somo dādhārorvantarikṣam ||
6,047.05  ayaṃ vidaccitradṛśīkamarṇaḥ śukrasadmanāmuṣasāmanīke |
6,047.05 ayaṃ mahānmahatā skambhanenoddyāmastabhnādvṛṣabho marutvān ||
6,047.06  dhṛṣatpiba kalaśe somamindra vṛtrahā śūra samare vasūnām |
6,047.06 mādhyandine savana ā vṛṣasva rayisthāno rayimasmāsu dhehi ||
6,047.07  indra pra ṇaḥ puraeteva paśya pra no naya prataraṃ vasyo accha |
6,047.07 bhavā supāro atipārayo no bhavā sunītiruta vāmanītiḥ ||
6,047.08  uruṃ no lokamanu neṣi vidvānsvarvajjyotirabhayaṃ svasti |
6,047.08 ṛṣvā ta indra sthavirasya bāhū upa stheyāma śaraṇā bṛhantā ||
6,047.09  variṣṭhe na indra vandhure dhā vahiṣṭhayoḥ śatāvannaśvayorā |
6,047.09 iṣamā vakṣīṣāṃ varṣiṣṭhāṃ mā nastārīnmaghavanrāyo aryaḥ ||
6,047.10  indra mṛḻa mahyaṃ jīvātumiccha codaya dhiyamayaso na dhārām |
6,047.10 yatkiṃ cāhaṃ tvāyuridaṃ vadāmi tajjuṣasva kṛdhi mā devavantam ||
6,047.11  trātāramindramavitāramindraṃ havehave suhavaṃ śūramindram |
6,047.11 hvayāmi śakraṃ puruhūtamindraṃ svasti no maghavā dhātvindraḥ ||
6,047.12  indraḥ sutrāmā svavāṃ avobhiḥ sumṛḻīko bhavatu viśvavedāḥ |
6,047.12 bādhatāṃ dveṣo abhayaṃ kṛṇotu suvīryasya patayaḥ syāma ||
6,047.13  tasya vayaṃ sumatau yajñiyasyāpi bhadre saumanase syāma |
6,047.13 sa sutrāmā svavāṃ indro asme ārācciddveṣaḥ sanutaryuyotu ||
6,047.14  ava tve indra pravato normirgiro brahmāṇi niyuto dhavante |
6,047.14 urū na rādhaḥ savanā purūṇyapo gā vajrinyuvase samindūn ||
6,047.15  ka īṃ stavatkaḥ pṛṇātko yajāte yadugraminmaghavā viśvahāvet |
6,047.15 pādāviva praharannanyamanyaṃ kṛṇoti pūrvamaparaṃ śacībhiḥ ||
6,047.16  śṛṇve vīra ugramugraṃ damāyannanyamanyamatinenīyamānaḥ |
6,047.16 edhamānadviḻ ubhayasya rājā coṣkūyate viśa indro manuṣyān ||
6,047.17  parā pūrveṣāṃ sakhyā vṛṇakti vitarturāṇo aparebhireti |
6,047.17 anānubhūtīravadhūnvānaḥ pūrvīrindraḥ śaradastartarīti ||
6,047.18  rūpaṃrūpaṃ pratirūpo babhūva tadasya rūpaṃ praticakṣaṇāya |
6,047.18 indro māyābhiḥ pururūpa īyate yuktā hyasya harayaḥ śatā daśa ||
6,047.19  yujāno haritā rathe bhūri tvaṣṭeha rājati |
6,047.19 ko viśvāhā dviṣataḥ pakṣa āsata utāsīneṣu sūriṣu ||
6,047.20  agavyūti kṣetramāganma devā urvī satī bhūmiraṃhūraṇābhūt |
6,047.20 bṛhaspate pra cikitsā gaviṣṭāvitthā sate jaritra indra panthām ||
6,047.21  divedive sadṛśīranyamardhaṃ kṛṣṇā asedhadapa sadmano jāḥ |
6,047.21 ahandāsā vṛṣabho vasnayantodavraje varcinaṃ śambaraṃ ca ||
6,047.22  prastoka innu rādhasasta indra daśa kośayīrdaśa vājino'dāt |
6,047.22 divodāsādatithigvasya rādhaḥ śāmbaraṃ vasu pratyagrabhīṣma ||
6,047.23  daśāśvāndaśa kośāndaśa vastrādhibhojanā |
6,047.23 daśo hiraṇyapiṇḍāndivodāsādasāniṣam ||
6,047.24  daśa rathānpraṣṭimataḥ śataṃ gā atharvabhyaḥ |
6,047.24 aśvathaḥ pāyave'dāt ||
6,047.25  mahi rādho viśvajanyaṃ dadhānānbharadvājānsārñjayo abhyayaṣṭa ||
6,047.26  vanaspate vīḍvaṅgo hi bhūyā asmatsakhā prataraṇaḥ suvīraḥ |
6,047.26 gobhiḥ saṃnaddho asi vīḻayasvāsthātā te jayatu jetvāni ||
6,047.27  divaspṛthivyāḥ paryoja udbhṛtaṃ vanaspatibhyaḥ paryābhṛtaṃ sahaḥ |
6,047.27 apāmojmānaṃ pari gobhirāvṛtamindrasya vajraṃ haviṣā rathaṃ yaja ||
6,047.28  indrasya vajro marutāmanīkaṃ mitrasya garbho varuṇasya nābhiḥ |
6,047.28 semāṃ no havyadātiṃ juṣāṇo deva ratha prati havyā gṛbhāya ||
6,047.29  upa śvāsaya pṛthivīmuta dyāṃ purutrā te manutāṃ viṣṭhitaṃ jagat |
6,047.29 sa dundubhe sajūrindreṇa devairdūrāddavīyo apa sedha śatrūn ||
6,047.30  ā krandaya balamojo na ā dhā ni ṣṭanihi duritā bādhamānaḥ |
6,047.30 apa protha dundubhe ducchunā ita indrasya muṣṭirasi vīḻayasva ||
6,047.31  āmūraja pratyāvartayemāḥ ketumaddundubhirvāvadīti |
6,047.31 samaśvaparṇāścaranti no naro'smākamindra rathino jayantu ||

6,048.01  yajñāyajñā vo agnaye girāgirā ca dakṣase |
6,048.01 prapra vayamamṛtaṃ jātavedasaṃ priyaṃ mitraṃ na śaṃsiṣam ||
6,048.02  ūrjo napātaṃ sa hināyamasmayurdāśema havyadātaye |
6,048.02 bhuvadvājeṣvavitā bhuvadvṛdha uta trātā tanūnām ||
6,048.03  vṛṣā hyagne ajaro mahānvibhāsyarciṣā |
6,048.03 ajasreṇa śociṣā śośucacchuce sudītibhiḥ su dīdihi ||
6,048.04  maho devānyajasi yakṣyānuṣaktava kratvota daṃsanā |
6,048.04 arvācaḥ sīṃ kṛṇuhyagne'vase rāsva vājota vaṃsva ||
6,048.05  yamāpo adrayo vanā garbhamṛtasya piprati |
6,048.05 sahasā yo mathito jāyate nṛbhiḥ pṛthivyā adhi sānavi ||
6,048.06  ā yaḥ paprau bhānunā rodasī ubhe dhūmena dhāvate divi |
6,048.06 tirastamo dadṛśa ūrmyāsvā śyāvāsvaruṣo vṛṣā śyāvā aruṣo vṛṣā ||
6,048.07  bṛhadbhiragne arcibhiḥ śukreṇa deva śociṣā |
6,048.07 bharadvāje samidhāno yaviṣṭhya revannaḥ śukra dīdihi dyumatpāvaka dīdihi ||
6,048.08  viśvāsāṃ gṛhapatirviśāmasi tvamagne mānuṣīṇām |
6,048.08 śataṃ pūrbhiryaviṣṭha pāhyaṃhasaḥ sameddhāraṃ śataṃ himā stotṛbhyo ye ca dadati ||
6,048.09  tvaṃ naścitra ūtyā vaso rādhāṃsi codaya |
6,048.09 asya rāyastvamagne rathīrasi vidā gādhaṃ tuce tu naḥ ||
6,048.10  parṣi tokaṃ tanayaṃ partṛbhiṣṭvamadabdhairaprayutvabhiḥ |
6,048.10 agne heḻāṃsi daivyā yuyodhi no'devāni hvarāṃsi ca ||
6,048.11  ā sakhāyaḥ sabardughāṃ dhenumajadhvamupa navyasā vacaḥ |
6,048.11 sṛjadhvamanapasphurām ||
6,048.12  yā śardhāya mārutāya svabhānave śravo'mṛtyu dhukṣata |
6,048.12 yā mṛḻīke marutāṃ turāṇāṃ yā sumnairevayāvarī ||
6,048.13  bharadvājāyāva dhukṣata dvitā |
6,048.13 dhenuṃ ca viśvadohasamiṣaṃ ca viśvabhojasam ||
6,048.14  taṃ va indraṃ na sukratuṃ varuṇamiva māyinam |
6,048.14 aryamaṇaṃ na mandraṃ sṛprabhojasaṃ viṣṇuṃ na stuṣa ādiśe ||
6,048.15  tveṣaṃ śardho na mārutaṃ tuviṣvaṇyanarvāṇaṃ pūṣaṇaṃ saṃ yathā śatā |
6,048.15 saṃ sahasrā kāriṣaccarṣaṇibhya āṃ āvirgūḻhā vasū karatsuvedā no vasū karat ||
6,048.16  ā mā pūṣannupa drava śaṃsiṣaṃ nu te apikarṇa āghṛṇe |
6,048.16 aghā aryo arātayaḥ ||
6,048.17  mā kākambīramudvṛho vanaspatimaśastīrvi hi nīnaśaḥ |
6,048.17 mota sūro aha evā cana grīvā ādadhate veḥ ||
6,048.18  dṛteriva te'vṛkamastu sakhyam |
6,048.18 acchidrasya dadhanvataḥ supūrṇasya dadhanvataḥ ||
6,048.19  paro hi martyairasi samo devairuta śriyā |
6,048.19 abhi khyaḥ pūṣanpṛtanāsu nastvamavā nūnaṃ yathā purā ||
6,048.20  vāmī vāmasya dhūtayaḥ praṇītirastu sūnṛtā |
6,048.20 devasya vā maruto martyasya vejānasya prayajyavaḥ ||
6,048.21  sadyaścidyasya carkṛtiḥ pari dyāṃ devo naiti sūryaḥ |
6,048.21 tveṣaṃ śavo dadhire nāma yajñiyaṃ maruto vṛtrahaṃ śavo jyeṣṭhaṃ vṛtrahaṃ śavaḥ ||
6,048.22  sakṛddha dyaurajāyata sakṛdbhūmirajāyata |
6,048.22 pṛśnyā dugdhaṃ sakṛtpayastadanyo nānu jāyate ||

6,049.01  stuṣe janaṃ suvrataṃ navyasībhirgīrbhirmitrāvaruṇā sumnayantā |
6,049.01 ta ā gamantu ta iha śruvantu sukṣatrāso varuṇo mitro agniḥ ||
6,049.02  viśoviśa īḍyamadhvareṣvadṛptakratumaratiṃ yuvatyoḥ |
6,049.02 divaḥ śiśuṃ sahasaḥ sūnumagniṃ yajñasya ketumaruṣaṃ yajadhyai ||
6,049.03  aruṣasya duhitarā virūpe stṛbhiranyā pipiśe sūro anyā |
6,049.03 mithasturā vicarantī pāvake manma śrutaṃ nakṣata ṛcyamāne ||
6,049.04  pra vāyumacchā bṛhatī manīṣā bṛhadrayiṃ viśvavāraṃ rathaprām |
6,049.04 dyutadyāmā niyutaḥ patyamānaḥ kaviḥ kavimiyakṣasi prayajyo ||
6,049.05  sa me vapuśchadayadaśvinoryo ratho virukmānmanasā yujānaḥ |
6,049.05 yena narā nāsatyeṣayadhyai vartiryāthastanayāya tmane ca ||
6,049.06  parjanyavātā vṛṣabhā pṛthivyāḥ purīṣāṇi jinvatamapyāni |
6,049.06 satyaśrutaḥ kavayo yasya gīrbhirjagata sthātarjagadā kṛṇudhvam ||
6,049.07  pāvīravī kanyā citrāyuḥ sarasvatī vīrapatnī dhiyaṃ dhāt |
6,049.07 gnābhiracchidraṃ śaraṇaṃ sajoṣā durādharṣaṃ gṛṇate śarma yaṃsat ||
6,049.08  pathaspathaḥ paripatiṃ vacasyā kāmena kṛto abhyānaḻ arkam |
6,049.08 sa no rāsacchurudhaścandrāgrā dhiyaṃdhiyaṃ sīṣadhāti pra pūṣā ||
6,049.09  prathamabhājaṃ yaśasaṃ vayodhāṃ supāṇiṃ devaṃ sugabhastimṛbhvam |
6,049.09 hotā yakṣadyajataṃ pastyānāmagnistvaṣṭāraṃ suhavaṃ vibhāvā ||
6,049.10  bhuvanasya pitaraṃ gīrbhirābhī rudraṃ divā vardhayā rudramaktau |
6,049.10 bṛhantamṛṣvamajaraṃ suṣumnamṛdhagghuvema kavineṣitāsaḥ ||
6,049.11  ā yuvānaḥ kavayo yajñiyāso maruto ganta gṛṇato varasyām |
6,049.11 acitraṃ ciddhi jinvathā vṛdhanta itthā nakṣanto naro aṅgirasvat ||
6,049.12  pra vīrāya pra tavase turāyājā yūtheva paśurakṣirastam |
6,049.12 sa pispṛśati tanvi śrutasya stṛbhirna nākaṃ vacanasya vipaḥ ||
6,049.13  yo rajāṃsi vimame pārthivāni triścidviṣṇurmanave bādhitāya |
6,049.13 tasya te śarmannupadadyamāne rāyā madema tanvā tanā ca ||
6,049.14  tanno'hirbudhnyo adbhirarkaistatparvatastatsavitā cano dhāt |
6,049.14 tadoṣadhībhirabhi rātiṣāco bhagaḥ purandhirjinvatu pra rāye ||
6,049.15  nu no rayiṃ rathyaṃ carṣaṇiprāṃ puruvīraṃ maha ṛtasya gopām |
6,049.15 kṣayaṃ dātājaraṃ yena janānspṛdho adevīrabhi ca kramāma viśa ādevīrabhyaśnavāma ||

6,050.01  huve vo devīmaditiṃ namobhirmṛḻīkāya varuṇaṃ mitramagnim |
6,050.01 abhikṣadāmaryamaṇaṃ suśevaṃ trātṝndevānsavitāraṃ bhagaṃ ca ||
6,050.02  sujyotiṣaḥ sūrya dakṣapitṝnanāgāstve sumaho vīhi devān |
6,050.02 dvijanmāno ya ṛtasāpaḥ satyāḥ svarvanto yajatā agnijihvāḥ ||
6,050.03  uta dyāvāpṛthivī kṣatramuru bṛhadrodasī śaraṇaṃ suṣumne |
6,050.03 mahaskaratho varivo yathā no'sme kṣayāya dhiṣaṇe anehaḥ ||
6,050.04  ā no rudrasya sūnavo namantāmadyā hūtāso vasavo'dhṛṣṭāḥ |
6,050.04 yadīmarbhe mahati vā hitāso bādhe maruto ahvāma devān ||
6,050.05  mimyakṣa yeṣu rodasī nu devī siṣakti pūṣā abhyardhayajvā |
6,050.05 śrutvā havaṃ maruto yaddha yātha bhūmā rejante adhvani pravikte ||
6,050.06  abhi tyaṃ vīraṃ girvaṇasamarcendraṃ brahmaṇā jaritarnavena |
6,050.06 śravadiddhavamupa ca stavāno rāsadvājāṃ upa maho gṛṇānaḥ ||
6,050.07  omānamāpo mānuṣīramṛktaṃ dhāta tokāya tanayāya śaṃ yoḥ |
6,050.07 yūyaṃ hi ṣṭhā bhiṣajo mātṛtamā viśvasya sthāturjagato janitrīḥ ||
6,050.08  ā no devaḥ savitā trāyamāṇo hiraṇyapāṇiryajato jagamyāt |
6,050.08 yo datravāṃ uṣaso na pratīkaṃ vyūrṇute dāśuṣe vāryāṇi ||
6,050.09  uta tvaṃ sūno sahaso no adyā devāṃ asminnadhvare vavṛtyāḥ |
6,050.09 syāmahaṃ te sadamidrātau tava syāmagne'vasā suvīraḥ ||
6,050.10  uta tyā me havamā jagmyātaṃ nāsatyā dhībhiryuvamaṅga viprā |
6,050.10 atriṃ na mahastamaso'mumuktaṃ tūrvataṃ narā duritādabhīke ||
6,050.11  te no rāyo dyumato vājavato dātāro bhūta nṛvataḥ purukṣoḥ |
6,050.11 daśasyanto divyāḥ pārthivāso gojātā apyā mṛḻatā ca devāḥ ||
6,050.12  te no rudraḥ sarasvatī sajoṣā mīḻhuṣmanto viṣṇurmṛḻantu vāyuḥ |
6,050.12 ṛbhukṣā vājo daivyo vidhātā parjanyāvātā pipyatāmiṣaṃ naḥ ||
6,050.13  uta sya devaḥ savitā bhago no'pāṃ napādavatu dānu papriḥ |
6,050.13 tvaṣṭā devebhirjanibhiḥ sajoṣā dyaurdevebhiḥ pṛthivī samudraiḥ ||
6,050.14  uta no'hirbudhnyaḥ śṛṇotvaja ekapātpṛthivī samudraḥ |
6,050.14 viśve devā ṛtāvṛdho huvānā stutā mantrāḥ kaviśastā avantu ||
6,050.15  evā napāto mama tasya dhībhirbharadvājā abhyarcantyarkaiḥ |
6,050.15 gnā hutāso vasavo'dhṛṣṭā viśve stutāso bhūtā yajatrāḥ ||

6,051.01  udu tyaccakṣurmahi mitrayorāṃ eti priyaṃ varuṇayoradabdham |
6,051.01 ṛtasya śuci darśatamanīkaṃ rukmo na diva uditā vyadyaut ||
6,051.02  veda yastrīṇi vidathānyeṣāṃ devānāṃ janma sanutarā ca vipraḥ |
6,051.02 ṛju marteṣu vṛjinā ca paśyannabhi caṣṭe sūro arya evān ||
6,051.03  stuṣa u vo maha ṛtasya gopānaditiṃ mitraṃ varuṇaṃ sujātān |
6,051.03 aryamaṇaṃ bhagamadabdhadhītīnacchā voce sadhanyaḥ pāvakān ||
6,051.04  riśādasaḥ satpatīṃradabdhānmaho rājñaḥ suvasanasya dātṝn |
6,051.04 yūnaḥ sukṣatrānkṣayato divo nṝnādityānyāmyaditiṃ duvoyu ||
6,051.05  dyauṣpitaḥ pṛthivi mātaradhrugagne bhrātarvasavo mṛḻatā naḥ |
6,051.05 viśva ādityā adite sajoṣā asmabhyaṃ śarma bahulaṃ vi yanta ||
6,051.06  mā no vṛkāya vṛkye samasmā aghāyate rīradhatā yajatrāḥ |
6,051.06 yūyaṃ hi ṣṭhā rathyo nastanūnāṃ yūyaṃ dakṣasya vacaso babhūva ||
6,051.07  mā va eno anyakṛtaṃ bhujema mā tatkarma vasavo yaccayadhve |
6,051.07 viśvasya hi kṣayatha viśvadevāḥ svayaṃ ripustanvaṃ rīriṣīṣṭa ||
6,051.08  nama idugraṃ nama ā vivāse namo dādhāra pṛthivīmuta dyām |
6,051.08 namo devebhyo nama īśa eṣāṃ kṛtaṃ cideno namasā vivāse ||
6,051.09  ṛtasya vo rathyaḥ pūtadakṣānṛtasya pastyasado adabdhān |
6,051.09 tāṃ ā namobhirurucakṣaso nṝnviśvānva ā name maho yajatrāḥ ||
6,051.10  te hi śreṣṭhavarcasasta u nastiro viśvāni duritā nayanti |
6,051.10 sukṣatrāso varuṇo mitro agnirṛtadhītayo vakmarājasatyāḥ ||
6,051.11  te na indraḥ pṛthivī kṣāma vardhanpūṣā bhago aditiḥ pañca janāḥ |
6,051.11 suśarmāṇaḥ svavasaḥ sunīthā bhavantu naḥ sutrātrāsaḥ sugopāḥ ||
6,051.12  nū sadmānaṃ divyaṃ naṃśi devā bhāradvājaḥ sumatiṃ yāti hotā |
6,051.12 āsānebhiryajamāno miyedhairdevānāṃ janma vasūyurvavanda ||
6,051.13  apa tyaṃ vṛjinaṃ ripuṃ stenamagne durādhyam |
6,051.13 daviṣṭhamasya satpate kṛdhī sugam ||
6,051.14  grāvāṇaḥ soma no hi kaṃ sakhitvanāya vāvaśuḥ |
6,051.14 jahī nyatriṇaṃ paṇiṃ vṛko hi ṣaḥ ||
6,051.15  yūyaṃ hi ṣṭhā sudānava indrajyeṣṭhā abhidyavaḥ |
6,051.15 kartā no adhvannā sugaṃ gopā amā ||
6,051.16  api panthāmaganmahi svastigāmanehasam |
6,051.16 yena viśvāḥ pari dviṣo vṛṇakti vindate vasu ||

6,052.01  na taddivā na pṛthivyānu manye na yajñena nota śamībhirābhiḥ |
6,052.01 ubjantu taṃ subhvaḥ parvatāso ni hīyatāmatiyājasya yaṣṭā ||
6,052.02  ati vā yo maruto manyate no brahma vā yaḥ kriyamāṇaṃ ninitsāt |
6,052.02 tapūṃṣi tasmai vṛjināni santu brahmadviṣamabhi taṃ śocatu dyauḥ ||
6,052.03  kimaṅga tvā brahmaṇaḥ soma gopāṃ kimaṅga tvāhurabhiśastipāṃ naḥ |
6,052.03 kimaṅga naḥ paśyasi nidyamānānbrahmadviṣe tapuṣiṃ hetimasya ||
6,052.04  avantu māmuṣaso jāyamānā avantu mā sindhavaḥ pinvamānāḥ |
6,052.04 avantu mā parvatāso dhruvāso'vantu mā pitaro devahūtau ||
6,052.05  viśvadānīṃ sumanasaḥ syāma paśyema nu sūryamuccarantam |
6,052.05 tathā karadvasupatirvasūnāṃ devāṃ ohāno'vasāgamiṣṭhaḥ ||
6,052.06  indro nediṣṭhamavasāgamiṣṭhaḥ sarasvatī sindhubhiḥ pinvamānā |
6,052.06 parjanyo na oṣadhībhirmayobhuragniḥ suśaṃsaḥ suhavaḥ piteva ||
6,052.07  viśve devāsa ā gata śṛṇutā ma imaṃ havam |
6,052.07 edaṃ barhirni ṣīdata ||
6,052.08  yo vo devā ghṛtasnunā havyena pratibhūṣati |
6,052.08 taṃ viśva upa gacchatha ||
6,052.09  upa naḥ sūnavo giraḥ śṛṇvantvamṛtasya ye |
6,052.09 sumṛḻīkā bhavantu naḥ ||
6,052.10  viśve devā ṛtāvṛdha ṛtubhirhavanaśrutaḥ |
6,052.10 juṣantāṃ yujyaṃ payaḥ ||
6,052.11  stotramindro marudgaṇastvaṣṭṛmānmitro aryamā |
6,052.11 imā havyā juṣanta naḥ ||
6,052.12  imaṃ no agne adhvaraṃ hotarvayunaśo yaja |
6,052.12 cikitvāndaivyaṃ janam ||
6,052.13  viśve devāḥ śṛṇutemaṃ havaṃ me ye antarikṣe ya upa dyavi ṣṭha |
6,052.13 ye agnijihvā uta vā yajatrā āsadyāsminbarhiṣi mādayadhvam ||
6,052.14  viśve devā mama śṛṇvantu yajñiyā ubhe rodasī apāṃ napācca manma |
6,052.14 mā vo vacāṃsi paricakṣyāṇi vocaṃ sumneṣvidvo antamā madema ||
6,052.15  ye ke ca jmā mahino ahimāyā divo jajñire apāṃ sadhasthe |
6,052.15 te asmabhyamiṣaye viśvamāyuḥ kṣapa usrā varivasyantu devāḥ ||
6,052.16  agnīparjanyāvavataṃ dhiyaṃ me'sminhave suhavā suṣṭutiṃ naḥ |
6,052.16 iḻāmanyo janayadgarbhamanyaḥ prajāvatīriṣa ā dhattamasme ||
6,052.17  stīrṇe barhiṣi samidhāne agnau sūktena mahā namasā vivāse |
6,052.17 asminno adya vidathe yajatrā viśve devā haviṣi mādayadhvam ||

6,053.01  vayamu tvā pathaspate rathaṃ na vājasātaye |
6,053.01 dhiye pūṣannayujmahi ||
6,053.02  abhi no naryaṃ vasu vīraṃ prayatadakṣiṇam |
6,053.02 vāmaṃ gṛhapatiṃ naya ||
6,053.03  aditsantaṃ cidāghṛṇe pūṣandānāya codaya |
6,053.03 paṇeścidvi mradā manaḥ ||
6,053.04  vi patho vājasātaye cinuhi vi mṛdho jahi |
6,053.04 sādhantāmugra no dhiyaḥ ||
6,053.05  pari tṛndhi paṇīnāmārayā hṛdayā kave |
6,053.05 athemasmabhyaṃ randhaya ||
6,053.06  vi pūṣannārayā tuda paṇericcha hṛdi priyam |
6,053.06 athemasmabhyaṃ randhaya ||
6,053.07  ā rikha kikirā kṛṇu paṇīnāṃ hṛdayā kave |
6,053.07 athemasmabhyaṃ randhaya ||
6,053.08  yāṃ pūṣanbrahmacodanīmārāṃ bibharṣyāghṛṇe |
6,053.08 tayā samasya hṛdayamā rikha kikirā kṛṇu ||
6,053.09  yā te aṣṭrā goopaśāghṛṇe paśusādhanī |
6,053.09 tasyāste sumnamīmahe ||
6,053.10  uta no goṣaṇiṃ dhiyamaśvasāṃ vājasāmuta |
6,053.10 nṛvatkṛṇuhi vītaye ||

6,054.01  saṃ pūṣanviduṣā naya yo añjasānuśāsati |
6,054.01 ya evedamiti bravat ||
6,054.02  samu pūṣṇā gamemahi yo gṛhāṃ abhiśāsati |
6,054.02 ima eveti ca bravat ||
6,054.03  pūṣṇaścakraṃ na riṣyati na kośo'va padyate |
6,054.03 no asya vyathate paviḥ ||
6,054.04  yo asmai haviṣāvidhanna taṃ pūṣāpi mṛṣyate |
6,054.04 prathamo vindate vasu ||
6,054.05  pūṣā gā anvetu naḥ pūṣā rakṣatvarvataḥ |
6,054.05 pūṣā vājaṃ sanotu naḥ ||
6,054.06  pūṣannanu pra gā ihi yajamānasya sunvataḥ |
6,054.06 asmākaṃ stuvatāmuta ||
6,054.07  mākirneśanmākīṃ riṣanmākīṃ saṃ śāri kevaṭe |
6,054.07 athāriṣṭābhirā gahi ||
6,054.08  śṛṇvantaṃ pūṣaṇaṃ vayamiryamanaṣṭavedasam |
6,054.08 īśānaṃ rāya īmahe ||
6,054.09  pūṣantava vrate vayaṃ na riṣyema kadā cana |
6,054.09 stotārasta iha smasi ||
6,054.10  pari pūṣā parastāddhastaṃ dadhātu dakṣiṇam |
6,054.10 punarno naṣṭamājatu ||

6,055.01  ehi vāṃ vimuco napādāghṛṇe saṃ sacāvahai |
6,055.01 rathīrṛtasya no bhava ||
6,055.02  rathītamaṃ kapardinamīśānaṃ rādhaso mahaḥ |
6,055.02 rāyaḥ sakhāyamīmahe ||
6,055.03  rāyo dhārāsyāghṛṇe vaso rāśirajāśva |
6,055.03 dhīvatodhīvataḥ sakhā ||
6,055.04  pūṣaṇaṃ nvajāśvamupa stoṣāma vājinam |
6,055.04 svasuryo jāra ucyate ||
6,055.05  māturdidhiṣumabravaṃ svasurjāraḥ śṛṇotu naḥ |
6,055.05 bhrātendrasya sakhā mama ||
6,055.06  ājāsaḥ pūṣaṇaṃ rathe niśṛmbhāste janaśriyam |
6,055.06 devaṃ vahantu bibhrataḥ ||

6,056.01  ya enamādideśati karambhāditi pūṣaṇam |
6,056.01 na tena deva ādiśe ||
6,056.02  uta ghā sa rathītamaḥ sakhyā satpatiryujā |
6,056.02 indro vṛtrāṇi jighnate ||
6,056.03  utādaḥ paruṣe gavi sūraścakraṃ hiraṇyayam |
6,056.03 nyairayadrathītamaḥ ||
6,056.04  yadadya tvā puruṣṭuta bravāma dasra mantumaḥ |
6,056.04 tatsu no manma sādhaya ||
6,056.05  imaṃ ca no gaveṣaṇaṃ sātaye sīṣadho gaṇam |
6,056.05 ārātpūṣannasi śrutaḥ ||
6,056.06  ā te svastimīmaha āreaghāmupāvasum |
6,056.06 adyā ca sarvatātaye śvaśca sarvatātaye ||

6,057.01  indrā nu pūṣaṇā vayaṃ sakhyāya svastaye |
6,057.01 huvema vājasātaye ||
6,057.02  somamanya upāsadatpātave camvoḥ sutam |
6,057.02 karambhamanya icchati ||
6,057.03  ajā anyasya vahnayo harī anyasya sambhṛtā |
6,057.03 tābhyāṃ vṛtrāṇi jighnate ||
6,057.04  yadindro anayadrito mahīrapo vṛṣantamaḥ |
6,057.04 tatra pūṣābhavatsacā ||
6,057.05  tāṃ pūṣṇaḥ sumatiṃ vayaṃ vṛkṣasya pra vayāmiva |
6,057.05 indrasya cā rabhāmahe ||
6,057.06  utpūṣaṇaṃ yuvāmahe'bhīśūṃriva sārathiḥ |
6,057.06 mahyā indraṃ svastaye ||

6,058.01  śukraṃ te anyadyajataṃ te anyadviṣurūpe ahanī dyaurivāsi |
6,058.01 viśvā hi māyā avasi svadhāvo bhadrā te pūṣanniha rātirastu ||
6,058.02  ajāśvaḥ paśupā vājapastyo dhiyañjinvo bhuvane viśve arpitaḥ |
6,058.02 aṣṭrāṃ pūṣā śithirāmudvarīvṛjatsaṃcakṣāṇo bhuvanā deva īyate ||
6,058.03  yāste pūṣannāvo antaḥ samudre hiraṇyayīrantarikṣe caranti |
6,058.03 tābhiryāsi dūtyāṃ sūryasya kāmena kṛta śrava icchamānaḥ ||
6,058.04  pūṣā subandhurdiva ā pṛthivyā iḻaspatirmaghavā dasmavarcāḥ |
6,058.04 yaṃ devāso adaduḥ sūryāyai kāmena kṛtaṃ tavasaṃ svañcam ||

6,059.01  pra nu vocā suteṣu vāṃ vīryā yāni cakrathuḥ |
6,059.01 hatāso vāṃ pitaro devaśatrava indrāgnī jīvatho yuvam ||
6,059.02  baḻ itthā mahimā vāmindrāgnī paniṣṭha ā |
6,059.02 samāno vāṃ janitā bhrātarā yuvaṃ yamāvihehamātarā ||
6,059.03  okivāṃsā sute sacāṃ aśvā saptī ivādane |
6,059.03 indrā nvagnī avaseha vajriṇā vayaṃ devā havāmahe ||
6,059.04  ya indrāgnī suteṣu vāṃ stavatteṣvṛtāvṛdhā |
6,059.04 joṣavākaṃ vadataḥ pajrahoṣiṇā na devā bhasathaścana ||
6,059.05  indrāgnī ko asya vāṃ devau martaściketati |
6,059.05 viṣūco aśvānyuyujāna īyata ekaḥ samāna ā rathe ||
6,059.06  indrāgnī apādiyaṃ pūrvāgātpadvatībhyaḥ |
6,059.06 hitvī śiro jihvayā vāvadaccarattriṃśatpadā nyakramīt ||
6,059.07  indrāgnī ā hi tanvate naro dhanvāni bāhvoḥ |
6,059.07 mā no asminmahādhane parā varktaṃ gaviṣṭiṣu ||
6,059.08  indrāgnī tapanti māghā aryo arātayaḥ |
6,059.08 apa dveṣāṃsyā kṛtaṃ yuyutaṃ sūryādadhi ||
6,059.09  indrāgnī yuvorapi vasu divyāni pārthivā |
6,059.09 ā na iha pra yacchataṃ rayiṃ viśvāyupoṣasam ||
6,059.10  indrāgnī ukthavāhasā stomebhirhavanaśrutā |
6,059.10 viśvābhirgīrbhirā gatamasya somasya pītaye ||

6,060.01  śnathadvṛtramuta sanoti vājamindrā yo agnī sahurī saparyāt |
6,060.01 irajyantā vasavyasya bhūreḥ sahastamā sahasā vājayantā ||
6,060.02  tā yodhiṣṭamabhi gā indra nūnamapaḥ svaruṣaso agna ūḻhāḥ |
6,060.02 diśaḥ svaruṣasa indra citrā apo gā agne yuvase niyutvān ||
6,060.03  ā vṛtrahaṇā vṛtrahabhiḥ śuṣmairindra yātaṃ namobhiragne arvāk |
6,060.03 yuvaṃ rādhobhirakavebhirindrāgne asme bhavatamuttamebhiḥ ||
6,060.04  tā huve yayoridaṃ papne viśvaṃ purā kṛtam |
6,060.04 indrāgnī na mardhataḥ ||
6,060.05  ugrā vighaninā mṛdha indrāgnī havāmahe |
6,060.05 tā no mṛḻāta īdṛśe ||
6,060.06  hato vṛtrāṇyāryā hato dāsāni satpatī |
