6,060.06 hato viśvā apa dviṣaḥ ||
6,060.07  indrāgnī yuvāmime'bhi stomā anūṣata |
6,060.07 pibataṃ śambhuvā sutam ||
6,060.08  yā vāṃ santi puruspṛho niyuto dāśuṣe narā |
6,060.08 indrāgnī tābhirā gatam ||
6,060.09  tābhirā gacchataṃ naropedaṃ savanaṃ sutam |
6,060.09 indrāgnī somapītaye ||
6,060.10  tamīḻiṣva yo arciṣā vanā viśvā pariṣvajat |
6,060.10 kṛṣṇā kṛṇoti jihvayā ||
6,060.11  ya iddha āvivāsati sumnamindrasya martyaḥ |
6,060.11 dyumnāya sutarā apaḥ ||
6,060.12  tā no vājavatīriṣa āśūnpipṛtamarvataḥ |
6,060.12 indramagniṃ ca voḻhave ||
6,060.13  ubhā vāmindrāgnī āhuvadhyā ubhā rādhasaḥ saha mādayadhyai |
6,060.13 ubhā dātārāviṣāṃ rayīṇāmubhā vājasya sātaye huve vām ||
6,060.14  ā no gavyebhiraśvyairvasavyairupa gacchatam |
6,060.14 sakhāyau devau sakhyāya śambhuvendrāgnī tā havāmahe ||
6,060.15  indrāgnī śṛṇutaṃ havaṃ yajamānasya sunvataḥ |
6,060.15 vītaṃ havyānyā gataṃ pibataṃ somyaṃ madhu ||

6,061.01  iyamadadādrabhasamṛṇacyutaṃ divodāsaṃ vadhryaśvāya dāśuṣe |
6,061.01 yā śaśvantamācakhādāvasaṃ paṇiṃ tā te dātrāṇi taviṣā sarasvati ||
6,061.02  iyaṃ śuṣmebhirbisakhā ivārujatsānu girīṇāṃ taviṣebhirūrmibhiḥ |
6,061.02 pārāvataghnīmavase suvṛktibhiḥ sarasvatīmā vivāsema dhītibhiḥ ||
6,061.03  sarasvati devanido ni barhaya prajāṃ viśvasya bṛsayasya māyinaḥ |
6,061.03 uta kṣitibhyo'vanīravindo viṣamebhyo asravo vājinīvati ||
6,061.04  pra ṇo devī sarasvatī vājebhirvājinīvatī |
6,061.04 dhīnāmavitryavatu ||
6,061.05  yastvā devi sarasvatyupabrūte dhane hite |
6,061.05 indraṃ na vṛtratūrye ||
6,061.06  tvaṃ devi sarasvatyavā vājeṣu vājini |
6,061.06 radā pūṣeva naḥ sanim ||
6,061.07  uta syā naḥ sarasvatī ghorā hiraṇyavartaniḥ |
6,061.07 vṛtraghnī vaṣṭi suṣṭutim ||
6,061.08  yasyā ananto ahrutastveṣaścariṣṇurarṇavaḥ |
6,061.08 amaścarati roruvat ||
6,061.09  sā no viśvā ati dviṣaḥ svasṝranyā ṛtāvarī |
6,061.09 atannaheva sūryaḥ ||
6,061.10  uta naḥ priyā priyāsu saptasvasā sujuṣṭā |
6,061.10 sarasvatī stomyā bhūt ||
6,061.11  āpapruṣī pārthivānyuru rajo antarikṣam |
6,061.11 sarasvatī nidaspātu ||
6,061.12  triṣadhasthā saptadhātuḥ pañca jātā vardhayantī |
6,061.12 vājevāje havyā bhūt ||
6,061.13  pra yā mahimnā mahināsu cekite dyumnebhiranyā apasāmapastamā |
6,061.13 ratha iva bṛhatī vibhvane kṛtopastutyā cikituṣā sarasvatī ||
6,061.14  sarasvatyabhi no neṣi vasyo māpa spharīḥ payasā mā na ā dhak |
6,061.14 juṣasva naḥ sakhyā veśyā ca mā tvatkṣetrāṇyaraṇāni ganma ||

6,062.01  stuṣe narā divo asya prasantāśvinā huve jaramāṇo arkaiḥ |
6,062.01 yā sadya usrā vyuṣi jmo antānyuyūṣataḥ paryurū varāṃsi ||
6,062.02  tā yajñamā śucibhiścakramāṇā rathasya bhānuṃ rurucū rajobhiḥ |
6,062.02 purū varāṃsyamitā mimānāpo dhanvānyati yātho ajrān ||
6,062.03  tā ha tyadvartiryadaradhramugretthā dhiya ūhathuḥ śaśvadaśvaiḥ |
6,062.03 manojavebhiriṣiraiḥ śayadhyai pari vyathirdāśuṣo martyasya ||
6,062.04  tā navyaso jaramāṇasya manmopa bhūṣato yuyujānasaptī |
6,062.04 śubhaṃ pṛkṣamiṣamūrjaṃ vahantā hotā yakṣatpratno adhrugyuvānā ||
6,062.05  tā valgū dasrā puruśākatamā pratnā navyasā vacasā vivāse |
6,062.05 yā śaṃsate stuvate śambhaviṣṭhā babhūvaturgṛṇate citrarātī ||
6,062.06  tā bhujyuṃ vibhiradbhyaḥ samudrāttugrasya sūnumūhathū rajobhiḥ |
6,062.06 areṇubhiryojanebhirbhujantā patatribhirarṇaso nirupasthāt ||
6,062.07  vi jayuṣā rathyā yātamadriṃ śrutaṃ havaṃ vṛṣaṇā vadhrimatyāḥ |
6,062.07 daśasyantā śayave pipyathurgāmiti cyavānā sumatiṃ bhuraṇyū ||
6,062.08  yadrodasī pradivo asti bhūmā heḻo devānāmuta martyatrā |
6,062.08 tadādityā vasavo rudriyāso rakṣoyuje tapuraghaṃ dadhāta ||
6,062.09  ya īṃ rājānāvṛtuthā vidadhadrajaso mitro varuṇaściketat |
6,062.09 gambhīrāya rakṣase hetimasya droghāya cidvacasa ānavāya ||
6,062.10  antaraiścakraistanayāya vartirdyumatā yātaṃ nṛvatā rathena |
6,062.10 sanutyena tyajasā martyasya vanuṣyatāmapi śīrṣā vavṛktam ||
6,062.11  ā paramābhiruta madhyamābhirniyudbhiryātamavamābhirarvāk |
6,062.11 dṛḻhasya cidgomato vi vrajasya duro vartaṃ gṛṇate citrarātī ||

6,063.01  kva tyā valgū puruhūtādya dūto na stomo'vidannamasvān |
6,063.01 ā yo arvāṅnāsatyā vavarta preṣṭhā hyasatho asya manman ||
6,063.02  araṃ me gantaṃ havanāyāsmai gṛṇānā yathā pibātho andhaḥ |
6,063.02 pari ha tyadvartiryātho riṣo na yatparo nāntarastuturyāt ||
6,063.03  akāri vāmandhaso varīmannastāri barhiḥ suprāyaṇatamam |
6,063.03 uttānahasto yuvayurvavandā vāṃ nakṣanto adraya āñjan ||
6,063.04  ūrdhvo vāmagniradhvareṣvasthātpra rātireti jūrṇinī ghṛtācī |
6,063.04 pra hotā gūrtamanā urāṇo'yukta yo nāsatyā havīman ||
6,063.05  adhi śriye duhitā sūryasya rathaṃ tasthau purubhujā śatotim |
6,063.05 pra māyābhirmāyinā bhūtamatra narā nṛtū janimanyajñiyānām ||
6,063.06  yuvaṃ śrībhirdarśatābhirābhiḥ śubhe puṣṭimūhathuḥ sūryāyāḥ |
6,063.06 pra vāṃ vayo vapuṣe'nu paptannakṣadvāṇī suṣṭutā dhiṣṇyā vām ||
6,063.07  ā vāṃ vayo'śvāso vahiṣṭhā abhi prayo nāsatyā vahantu |
6,063.07 pra vāṃ ratho manojavā asarjīṣaḥ pṛkṣa iṣidho anu pūrvīḥ ||
6,063.08  puru hi vāṃ purubhujā deṣṇaṃ dhenuṃ na iṣaṃ pinvatamasakrām |
6,063.08 stutaśca vāṃ mādhvī suṣṭutiśca rasāśca ye vāmanu rātimagman ||
6,063.09  uta ma ṛjre purayasya raghvī sumīḻhe śataṃ peruke ca pakvā |
6,063.09 śāṇḍo dāddhiraṇinaḥ smaddiṣṭīndaśa vaśāso abhiṣāca ṛṣvān ||
6,063.10  saṃ vāṃ śatā nāsatyā sahasrāśvānāṃ purupanthā gire dāt |
6,063.10 bharadvājāya vīra nū gire dāddhatā rakṣāṃsi purudaṃsasā syuḥ ||
6,063.11  ā vāṃ sumne varimansūribhiḥ ṣyām ||

6,064.01  udu śriya uṣaso rocamānā asthurapāṃ normayo ruśantaḥ |
6,064.01 kṛṇoti viśvā supathā sugānyabhūdu vasvī dakṣiṇā maghonī ||
6,064.02  bhadrā dadṛkṣa urviyā vi bhāsyutte śocirbhānavo dyāmapaptan |
6,064.02 āvirvakṣaḥ kṛṇuṣe śumbhamānoṣo devi rocamānā mahobhiḥ ||
6,064.03  vahanti sīmaruṇāso ruśanto gāvaḥ subhagāmurviyā prathānām |
6,064.03 apejate śūro asteva śatrūnbādhate tamo ajiro na voḻhā ||
6,064.04  sugota te supathā parvateṣvavāte apastarasi svabhāno |
6,064.04 sā na ā vaha pṛthuyāmannṛṣve rayiṃ divo duhitariṣayadhyai ||
6,064.05  sā vaha yokṣabhiravātoṣo varaṃ vahasi joṣamanu |
6,064.05 tvaṃ divo duhitaryā ha devī pūrvahūtau maṃhanā darśatā bhūḥ ||
6,064.06  utte vayaścidvasaterapaptannaraśca ye pitubhājo vyuṣṭau |
6,064.06 amā sate vahasi bhūri vāmamuṣo devi dāśuṣe martyāya ||

6,065.01  eṣā syā no duhitā divojāḥ kṣitīrucchantī mānuṣīrajīgaḥ |
6,065.01 yā bhānunā ruśatā rāmyāsvajñāyi tirastamasaścidaktūn ||
6,065.02  vi tadyayuraruṇayugbhiraśvaiścitraṃ bhāntyuṣasaścandrarathāḥ |
6,065.02 agraṃ yajñasya bṛhato nayantīrvi tā bādhante tama ūrmyāyāḥ ||
6,065.03  śravo vājamiṣamūrjaṃ vahantīrni dāśuṣa uṣaso martyāya |
6,065.03 maghonīrvīravatpatyamānā avo dhāta vidhate ratnamadya ||
6,065.04  idā hi vo vidhate ratnamastīdā vīrāya dāśuṣa uṣāsaḥ |
6,065.04 idā viprāya jarate yadukthā ni ṣma māvate vahathā purā cit ||
6,065.05  idā hi ta uṣo adrisāno gotrā gavāmaṅgiraso gṛṇanti |
6,065.05 vyarkeṇa bibhidurbrahmaṇā ca satyā nṛṇāmabhavaddevahūtiḥ ||
6,065.06  ucchā divo duhitaḥ pratnavanno bharadvājavadvidhate maghoni |
6,065.06 suvīraṃ rayiṃ gṛṇate rirīhyurugāyamadhi dhehi śravo naḥ ||

6,066.01  vapurnu taccikituṣe cidastu samānaṃ nāma dhenu patyamānam |
6,066.01 marteṣvanyaddohase pīpāya sakṛcchukraṃ duduhe pṛśnirūdhaḥ ||
6,066.02  ye agnayo na śośucannidhānā dviryattrirmaruto vāvṛdhanta |
6,066.02 areṇavo hiraṇyayāsa eṣāṃ sākaṃ nṛmṇaiḥ pauṃsyebhiśca bhūvan ||
6,066.03  rudrasya ye mīḻhuṣaḥ santi putrā yāṃśco nu dādhṛvirbharadhyai |
6,066.03 vide hi mātā maho mahī ṣā setpṛśniḥ subhve garbhamādhāt ||
6,066.04  na ya īṣante januṣo'yā nvantaḥ santo'vadyāni punānāḥ |
6,066.04 niryadduhre śucayo'nu joṣamanu śriyā tanvamukṣamāṇāḥ ||
6,066.05  makṣū na yeṣu dohase cidayā ā nāma dhṛṣṇu mārutaṃ dadhānāḥ |
6,066.05 na ye staunā ayāso mahnā nū citsudānurava yāsadugrān ||
6,066.06  ta idugrāḥ śavasā dhṛṣṇuṣeṇā ubhe yujanta rodasī sumeke |
6,066.06 adha smaiṣu rodasī svaśocirāmavatsu tasthau na rokaḥ ||
6,066.07  aneno vo maruto yāmo astvanaśvaścidyamajatyarathīḥ |
6,066.07 anavaso anabhīśū rajastūrvi rodasī pathyā yāti sādhan ||
6,066.08  nāsya vartā na tarutā nvasti maruto yamavatha vājasātau |
6,066.08 toke vā goṣu tanaye yamapsu sa vrajaṃ dartā pārye adha dyoḥ ||
6,066.09  pra citramarkaṃ gṛṇate turāya mārutāya svatavase bharadhvam |
6,066.09 ye sahāṃsi sahasā sahante rejate agne pṛthivī makhebhyaḥ ||
6,066.10  tviṣīmanto adhvarasyeva didyuttṛṣucyavaso juhvo nāgneḥ |
6,066.10 arcatrayo dhunayo na vīrā bhrājajjanmāno maruto adhṛṣṭāḥ ||
6,066.11  taṃ vṛdhantaṃ mārutaṃ bhrājadṛṣṭiṃ rudrasya sūnuṃ havasā vivāse |
6,066.11 divaḥ śardhāya śucayo manīṣā girayo nāpa ugrā aspṛdhran ||

6,067.01  viśveṣāṃ vaḥ satāṃ jyeṣṭhatamā gīrbhirmitrāvaruṇā vāvṛdhadhyai |
6,067.01 saṃ yā raśmeva yamaturyamiṣṭhā dvā janāṃ asamā bāhubhiḥ svaiḥ ||
6,067.02  iyaṃ madvāṃ pra stṛṇīte manīṣopa priyā namasā barhiraccha |
6,067.02 yantaṃ no mitrāvaruṇāvadhṛṣṭaṃ chardiryadvāṃ varūthyaṃ sudānū ||
6,067.03  ā yātaṃ mitrāvaruṇā suśastyupa priyā namasā hūyamānā |
6,067.03 saṃ yāvapnastho apaseva janāñchrudhīyataścidyatatho mahitvā ||
6,067.04  aśvā na yā vājinā pūtabandhū ṛtā yadgarbhamaditirbharadhyai |
6,067.04 pra yā mahi mahāntā jāyamānā ghorā martāya ripave ni dīdhaḥ ||
6,067.05  viśve yadvāṃ maṃhanā mandamānāḥ kṣatraṃ devāso adadhuḥ sajoṣāḥ |
6,067.05 pari yadbhūtho rodasī cidurvī santi spaśo adabdhāso amūrāḥ ||
6,067.06  tā hi kṣatraṃ dhārayethe anu dyūndṛṃhethe sānumupamādiva dyoḥ |
6,067.06 dṛḻho nakṣatra uta viśvadevo bhūmimātāndyāṃ dhāsināyoḥ ||
6,067.07  tā vigraṃ dhaithe jaṭharaṃ pṛṇadhyā ā yatsadma sabhṛtayaḥ pṛṇanti |
6,067.07 na mṛṣyante yuvatayo'vātā vi yatpayo viśvajinvā bharante ||
6,067.08  tā jihvayā sadamedaṃ sumedhā ā yadvāṃ satyo aratirṛte bhūt |
6,067.08 tadvāṃ mahitvaṃ ghṛtānnāvastu yuvaṃ dāśuṣe vi cayiṣṭamaṃhaḥ ||
6,067.09  pra yadvāṃ mitrāvaruṇā spūrdhanpriyā dhāma yuvadhitā minanti |
6,067.09 na ye devāsa ohasā na martā ayajñasāco apyo na putrāḥ ||
6,067.10  vi yadvācaṃ kīstāso bharante śaṃsanti ke cinnivido manānāḥ |
6,067.10 ādvāṃ bravāma satyānyukthā nakirdevebhiryatatho mahitvā ||
6,067.11  avoritthā vāṃ chardiṣo abhiṣṭau yuvormitrāvaruṇāvaskṛdhoyu |
6,067.11 anu yadgāva sphurānṛjipyaṃ dhṛṣṇuṃ yadraṇe vṛṣaṇaṃ yunajan ||

6,068.01  śruṣṭī vāṃ yajña udyataḥ sajoṣā manuṣvadvṛktabarhiṣo yajadhyai |
6,068.01 ā ya indrāvaruṇāviṣe adya mahe sumnāya maha āvavartat ||
6,068.02  tā hi śreṣṭhā devatātā tujā śūrāṇāṃ śaviṣṭhā tā hi bhūtam |
6,068.02 maghonāṃ maṃhiṣṭhā tuviśuṣma ṛtena vṛtraturā sarvasenā ||
6,068.03  tā gṛṇīhi namasyebhiḥ śūṣaiḥ sumnebhirindrāvaruṇā cakānā |
6,068.03 vajreṇānyaḥ śavasā hanti vṛtraṃ siṣaktyanyo vṛjaneṣu vipraḥ ||
6,068.04  gnāśca yannaraśca vāvṛdhanta viśve devāso narāṃ svagūrtāḥ |
6,068.04 praibhya indrāvaruṇā mahitvā dyauśca pṛthivi bhūtamurvī ||
6,068.05  sa itsudānuḥ svavāṃ ṛtāvendrā yo vāṃ varuṇa dāśati tman |
6,068.05 iṣā sa dviṣastareddāsvānvaṃsadrayiṃ rayivataśca janān ||
6,068.06  yaṃ yuvaṃ dāśvadhvarāya devā rayiṃ dhattho vasumantaṃ purukṣum |
6,068.06 asme sa indrāvaruṇāvapi ṣyātpra yo bhanakti vanuṣāmaśastīḥ ||
6,068.07  uta naḥ sutrātro devagopāḥ sūribhya indrāvaruṇā rayiḥ ṣyāt |
6,068.07 yeṣāṃ śuṣmaḥ pṛtanāsu sāhvānpra sadyo dyumnā tirate taturiḥ ||
6,068.08  nū na indrāvaruṇā gṛṇānā pṛṅktaṃ rayiṃ sauśravasāya devā |
6,068.08 itthā gṛṇanto mahinasya śardho'po na nāvā duritā tarema ||
6,068.09  pra samrāje bṛhate manma nu priyamarca devāya varuṇāya saprathaḥ |
6,068.09 ayaṃ ya urvī mahinā mahivrataḥ kratvā vibhātyajaro na śociṣā ||
6,068.10  indrāvaruṇā sutapāvimaṃ sutaṃ somaṃ pibataṃ madyaṃ dhṛtavratā |
6,068.10 yuvo ratho adhvaraṃ devavītaye prati svasaramupa yāti pītaye ||
6,068.11  indrāvaruṇā madhumattamasya vṛṣṇaḥ somasya vṛṣaṇā vṛṣethām |
6,068.11 idaṃ vāmandhaḥ pariṣiktamasme āsadyāsminbarhiṣi mādayethām ||

6,069.01  saṃ vāṃ karmaṇā samiṣā hinomīndrāviṣṇū apasaspāre asya |
6,069.01 juṣethāṃ yajñaṃ draviṇaṃ ca dhattamariṣṭairnaḥ pathibhiḥ pārayantā ||
6,069.02  yā viśvāsāṃ janitārā matīnāmindrāviṣṇū kalaśā somadhānā |
6,069.02 pra vāṃ giraḥ śasyamānā avantu pra stomāso gīyamānāso arkaiḥ ||
6,069.03  indrāviṣṇū madapatī madānāmā somaṃ yātaṃ draviṇo dadhānā |
6,069.03 saṃ vāmañjantvaktubhirmatīnāṃ saṃ stomāsaḥ śasyamānāsa ukthaiḥ ||
6,069.04  ā vāmaśvāso abhimātiṣāha indrāviṣṇū sadhamādo vahantu |
6,069.04 juṣethāṃ viśvā havanā matīnāmupa brahmāṇi śṛṇutaṃ giro me ||
6,069.05  indrāviṣṇū tatpanayāyyaṃ vāṃ somasya mada uru cakramāthe |
6,069.05 akṛṇutamantarikṣaṃ varīyo'prathataṃ jīvase no rajāṃsi ||
6,069.06  indrāviṣṇū haviṣā vāvṛdhānāgrādvānā namasā rātahavyā |
6,069.06 ghṛtāsutī draviṇaṃ dhattamasme samudra sthaḥ kalaśaḥ somadhānaḥ ||
6,069.07  indrāviṣṇū pibataṃ madhvo asya somasya dasrā jaṭharaṃ pṛṇethām |
6,069.07 ā vāmandhāṃsi madirāṇyagmannupa brahmāṇi śṛṇutaṃ havaṃ me ||
6,069.08  ubhā jigyathurna parā jayethe na parā jigye kataraścanainoḥ |
6,069.08 indraśca viṣṇo yadapaspṛdhethāṃ tredhā sahasraṃ vi tadairayethām ||

6,070.01  ghṛtavatī bhuvanānāmabhiśriyorvī pṛthvī madhudughe supeśasā |
6,070.01 dyāvāpṛthivī varuṇasya dharmaṇā viṣkabhite ajare bhūriretasā ||
6,070.02  asaścantī bhūridhāre payasvatī ghṛtaṃ duhāte sukṛte śucivrate |
6,070.02 rājantī asya bhuvanasya rodasī asme retaḥ siñcataṃ yanmanurhitam ||
6,070.03  yo vāmṛjave kramaṇāya rodasī marto dadāśa dhiṣaṇe sa sādhati |
6,070.03 pra prajābhirjāyate dharmaṇaspari yuvoḥ siktā viṣurūpāṇi savratā ||
6,070.04  ghṛtena dyāvāpṛthivī abhīvṛte ghṛtaśriyā ghṛtapṛcā ghṛtāvṛdhā |
6,070.04 urvī pṛthvī hotṛvūrye purohite te idviprā īḻate sumnamiṣṭaye ||
6,070.05  madhu no dyāvāpṛthivī mimikṣatāṃ madhuścutā madhudughe madhuvrate |
6,070.05 dadhāne yajñaṃ draviṇaṃ ca devatā mahi śravo vājamasme suvīryam ||
6,070.06  ūrjaṃ no dyauśca pṛthivī ca pinvatāṃ pitā mātā viśvavidā sudaṃsasā |
6,070.06 saṃrarāṇe rodasī viśvaśambhuvā saniṃ vājaṃ rayimasme saminvatām ||

6,071.01  udu ṣya devaḥ savitā hiraṇyayā bāhū ayaṃsta savanāya sukratuḥ |
6,071.01 ghṛtena pāṇī abhi pruṣṇute makho yuvā sudakṣo rajaso vidharmaṇi ||
6,071.02  devasya vayaṃ savituḥ savīmani śreṣṭhe syāma vasunaśca dāvane |
6,071.02 yo viśvasya dvipado yaścatuṣpado niveśane prasave cāsi bhūmanaḥ ||
6,071.03  adabdhebhiḥ savitaḥ pāyubhiṣṭvaṃ śivebhiradya pari pāhi no gayam |
6,071.03 hiraṇyajihvaḥ suvitāya navyase rakṣā mākirno aghaśaṃsa īśata ||
6,071.04  udu ṣya devaḥ savitā damūnā hiraṇyapāṇiḥ pratidoṣamasthāt |
6,071.04 ayohanuryajato mandrajihva ā dāśuṣe suvati bhūri vāmam ||
6,071.05  udū ayāṃ upavakteva bāhū hiraṇyayā savitā supratīkā |
6,071.05 divo rohāṃsyaruhatpṛthivyā arīramatpatayatkaccidabhvam ||
6,071.06  vāmamadya savitarvāmamu śvo divedive vāmamasmabhyaṃ sāvīḥ |
6,071.06 vāmasya hi kṣayasya deva bhūrerayā dhiyā vāmabhājaḥ syāma ||

6,072.01  indrāsomā mahi tadvāṃ mahitvaṃ yuvaṃ mahāni prathamāni cakrathuḥ |
6,072.01 yuvaṃ sūryaṃ vividathuryuvaṃ svarviśvā tamāṃsyahataṃ nidaśca ||
6,072.02  indrāsomā vāsayatha uṣāsamutsūryaṃ nayatho jyotiṣā saha |
6,072.02 upa dyāṃ skambhathu skambhanenāprathataṃ pṛthivīṃ mātaraṃ vi ||
6,072.03  indrāsomāvahimapaḥ pariṣṭhāṃ hatho vṛtramanu vāṃ dyauramanyata |
6,072.03 prārṇāṃsyairayataṃ nadīnāmā samudrāṇi paprathuḥ purūṇi ||
6,072.04  indrāsomā pakvamāmāsvantarni gavāmiddadhathurvakṣaṇāsu |
6,072.04 jagṛbhathuranapinaddhamāsu ruśaccitrāsu jagatīṣvantaḥ ||
6,072.05  indrāsomā yuvamaṅga tarutramapatyasācaṃ śrutyaṃ rarāthe |
6,072.05 yuvaṃ śuṣmaṃ naryaṃ carṣaṇibhyaḥ saṃ vivyathuḥ pṛtanāṣāhamugrā ||

6,073.01  yo adribhitprathamajā ṛtāvā bṛhaspatirāṅgiraso haviṣmān |
6,073.01 dvibarhajmā prāgharmasatpitā na ā rodasī vṛṣabho roravīti ||
6,073.02  janāya cidya īvata u lokaṃ bṛhaspatirdevahūtau cakāra |
6,073.02 ghnanvṛtrāṇi vi puro dardarīti jayañchatrūṃramitrānpṛtsu sāhan ||
6,073.03  bṛhaspatiḥ samajayadvasūni maho vrajāngomato deva eṣaḥ |
6,073.03 apaḥ siṣāsansvarapratīto bṛhaspatirhantyamitramarkaiḥ ||

6,074.01  somārudrā dhārayethāmasuryaṃ pra vāmiṣṭayo'ramaśnuvantu |
6,074.01 damedame sapta ratnā dadhānā śaṃ no bhūtaṃ dvipade śaṃ catuṣpade ||
6,074.02  somārudrā vi vṛhataṃ viṣūcīmamīvā yā no gayamāviveśa |
6,074.02 āre bādhethāṃ nirṛtiṃ parācairasme bhadrā sauśravasāni santu ||
6,074.03  somārudrā yuvametānyasme viśvā tanūṣu bheṣajāni dhattam |
6,074.03 ava syataṃ muñcataṃ yanno asti tanūṣu baddhaṃ kṛtameno asmat ||
6,074.04  tigmāyudhau tigmahetī suśevau somārudrāviha su mṛḻataṃ naḥ |
6,074.04 pra no muñcataṃ varuṇasya pāśādgopāyataṃ naḥ sumanasyamānā ||

6,075.01  jīmūtasyeva bhavati pratīkaṃ yadvarmī yāti samadāmupasthe |
6,075.01 anāviddhayā tanvā jaya tvaṃ sa tvā varmaṇo mahimā pipartu ||
6,075.02  dhanvanā gā dhanvanājiṃ jayema dhanvanā tīvrāḥ samado jayema |
6,075.02 dhanuḥ śatrorapakāmaṃ kṛṇoti dhanvanā sarvāḥ pradiśo jayema ||
6,075.03  vakṣyantīvedā ganīganti karṇaṃ priyaṃ sakhāyaṃ pariṣasvajānā |
6,075.03 yoṣeva śiṅkte vitatādhi dhanvañjyā iyaṃ samane pārayantī ||
6,075.04  te ācarantī samaneva yoṣā māteva putraṃ bibhṛtāmupasthe |
6,075.04 apa śatrūnvidhyatāṃ saṃvidāne ārtnī ime viṣphurantī amitrān ||
6,075.05  bahvīnāṃ pitā bahurasya putraściścā kṛṇoti samanāvagatya |
6,075.05 iṣudhiḥ saṅkāḥ pṛtanāśca sarvāḥ pṛṣṭhe ninaddho jayati prasūtaḥ ||
6,075.06  rathe tiṣṭhannayati vājinaḥ puro yatrayatra kāmayate suṣārathiḥ |
6,075.06 abhīśūnāṃ mahimānaṃ panāyata manaḥ paścādanu yacchanti raśmayaḥ ||
6,075.07  tīvrānghoṣānkṛṇvate vṛṣapāṇayo'śvā rathebhiḥ saha vājayantaḥ |
6,075.07 avakrāmantaḥ prapadairamitrānkṣiṇanti śatrūṃranapavyayantaḥ ||
6,075.08  rathavāhanaṃ havirasya nāma yatrāyudhaṃ nihitamasya varma |
6,075.08 tatrā rathamupa śagmaṃ sadema viśvāhā vayaṃ sumanasyamānāḥ ||
6,075.09  svāduṣaṃsadaḥ pitaro vayodhāḥ kṛcchreśritaḥ śaktīvanto gabhīrāḥ |
6,075.09 citrasenā iṣubalā amṛdhrāḥ satovīrā uravo vrātasāhāḥ ||
6,075.10  brāhmaṇāsaḥ pitaraḥ somyāsaḥ śive no dyāvāpṛthivī anehasā |
6,075.10 pūṣā naḥ pātu duritādṛtāvṛdho rakṣā mākirno aghaśaṃsa īśata ||
6,075.11  suparṇaṃ vaste mṛgo asyā danto gobhiḥ saṃnaddhā patati prasūtā |
6,075.11 yatrā naraḥ saṃ ca vi ca dravanti tatrāsmabhyamiṣavaḥ śarma yaṃsan ||
6,075.12  ṛjīte pari vṛṅdhi no'śmā bhavatu nastanūḥ |
6,075.12 somo adhi bravītu no'ditiḥ śarma yacchatu ||
6,075.13  ā jaṅghanti sānveṣāṃ jaghanāṃ upa jighnate |
6,075.13 aśvājani pracetaso'śvānsamatsu codaya ||
6,075.14  ahiriva bhogaiḥ paryeti bāhuṃ jyāyā hetiṃ paribādhamānaḥ |
6,075.14 hastaghno viśvā vayunāni vidvānpumānpumāṃsaṃ pari pātu viśvataḥ ||
6,075.15  ālāktā yā ruruśīrṣṇyatho yasyā ayo mukham |
6,075.15 idaṃ parjanyaretasa iṣvai devyai bṛhannamaḥ ||
6,075.16  avasṛṣṭā parā pata śaravye brahmasaṃśite |
6,075.16 gacchāmitrānpra padyasva māmīṣāṃ kaṃ canocchiṣaḥ ||
6,075.17  yatra bāṇāḥ sampatanti kumārā viśikhā iva |
6,075.17 tatrā no brahmaṇaspatiraditiḥ śarma yacchatu viśvāhā śarma yacchatu ||
6,075.18  marmāṇi te varmaṇā chādayāmi somastvā rājāmṛtenānu vastām |
6,075.18 urorvarīyo varuṇaste kṛṇotu jayantaṃ tvānu devā madantu ||
6,075.19  yo naḥ svo araṇo yaśca niṣṭyo jighāṃsati |
6,075.19 devāstaṃ sarve dhūrvantu brahma varma mamāntaram ||








ṛgveda 7



7,001.01  agniṃ naro dīdhitibhiraraṇyorhastacyutī janayanta praśastam |
7,001.01 dūredṛśaṃ gṛhapatimatharyum ||
7,001.02  tamagnimaste vasavo nyṛṇvansupraticakṣamavase kutaścit |
7,001.02 dakṣāyyo yo dama āsa nityaḥ ||
7,001.03  preddho agne dīdihi puro no'jasrayā sūrmyā yaviṣṭha |
7,001.03 tvāṃ śaśvanta upa yanti vājāḥ ||
7,001.04  pra te agnayo'gnibhyo varaṃ niḥ suvīrāsaḥ śośucanta dyumantaḥ |
7,001.04 yatrā naraḥ samāsate sujātāḥ ||
7,001.05  dā no agne dhiyā rayiṃ suvīraṃ svapatyaṃ sahasya praśastam |
7,001.05 na yaṃ yāvā tarati yātumāvān ||
7,001.06  upa yameti yuvatiḥ sudakṣaṃ doṣā vastorhaviṣmatī ghṛtācī |
7,001.06 upa svainamaramatirvasūyuḥ ||
7,001.07  viśvā agne'pa dahārātīryebhistapobhiradaho jarūtham |
7,001.07 pra nisvaraṃ cātayasvāmīvām ||
7,001.08  ā yaste agna idhate anīkaṃ vasiṣṭha śukra dīdivaḥ pāvaka |
7,001.08 uto na ebhi stavathairiha syāḥ ||
7,001.09  vi ye te agne bhejire anīkaṃ martā naraḥ pitryāsaḥ purutrā |
7,001.09 uto na ebhiḥ sumanā iha syāḥ ||
7,001.10  ime naro vṛtrahatyeṣu śūrā viśvā adevīrabhi santu māyāḥ |
7,001.10 ye me dhiyaṃ panayanta praśastām ||
7,001.11  mā śūne agne ni ṣadāma nṛṇāṃ māśeṣaso'vīratā pari tvā |
7,001.11 prajāvatīṣu duryāsu durya ||
7,001.12  yamaśvī nityamupayāti yajñaṃ prajāvantaṃ svapatyaṃ kṣayaṃ naḥ |
7,001.12 svajanmanā śeṣasā vāvṛdhānam ||
7,001.13  pāhi no agne rakṣaso ajuṣṭātpāhi dhūrterararuṣo aghāyoḥ |
7,001.13 tvā yujā pṛtanāyūṃrabhi ṣyām ||
7,001.14  sedagniragnīṃratyastvanyānyatra vājī tanayo vīḻupāṇiḥ |
7,001.14 sahasrapāthā akṣarā sameti ||
7,001.15  sedagniryo vanuṣyato nipāti sameddhāramaṃhasa uruṣyāt |
7,001.15 sujātāsaḥ pari caranti vīrāḥ ||
7,001.16  ayaṃ so agnirāhutaḥ purutrā yamīśānaḥ samidindhe haviṣmān |
7,001.16 pari yametyadhvareṣu hotā ||
7,001.17  tve agna āhavanāni bhūrīśānāsa ā juhuyāma nityā |
7,001.17 ubhā kṛṇvanto vahatū miyedhe ||
7,001.18  imo agne vītatamāni havyājasro vakṣi devatātimaccha |
7,001.18 prati na īṃ surabhīṇi vyantu ||
7,001.19  mā no agne'vīrate parā dā durvāsase'mataye mā no asyai |
7,001.19 mā naḥ kṣudhe mā rakṣasa ṛtāvo mā no dame mā vana ā juhūrthāḥ ||
7,001.20  nū me brahmāṇyagna ucchaśādhi tvaṃ deva maghavadbhyaḥ suṣūdaḥ |
7,001.20 rātau syāmobhayāsa ā te yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
7,001.21  tvamagne suhavo raṇvasaṃdṛksudītī sūno sahaso didīhi |
7,001.21 mā tve sacā tanaye nitya ā dhaṅmā vīro asmannaryo vi dāsīt ||
7,001.22  mā no agne durbhṛtaye sacaiṣu deveddheṣvagniṣu pra vocaḥ |
7,001.22 mā te asmāndurmatayo bhṛmācciddevasya sūno sahaso naśanta ||
7,001.23  sa marto agne svanīka revānamartye ya ājuhoti havyam |
7,001.23 sa devatā vasuvaniṃ dadhāti yaṃ sūrirarthī pṛcchamāna eti ||
7,001.24  maho no agne suvitasya vidvānrayiṃ sūribhya ā vahā bṛhantam |
7,001.24 yena vayaṃ sahasāvanmademāvikṣitāsa āyuṣā suvīrāḥ ||
7,001.25  nū me brahmāṇyagna ucchaśādhi tvaṃ deva maghavadbhyaḥ suṣūdaḥ |
7,001.25 rātau syāmobhayāsa ā te yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,002.01  juṣasva naḥ samidhamagne adya śocā bṛhadyajataṃ dhūmamṛṇvan |
7,002.01 upa spṛśa divyaṃ sānu stūpaiḥ saṃ raśmibhistatanaḥ sūryasya ||
7,002.02  narāśaṃsasya mahimānameṣāmupa stoṣāma yajatasya yajñaiḥ |
7,002.02 ye sukratavaḥ śucayo dhiyandhāḥ svadanti devā ubhayāni havyā ||
7,002.03  īḻenyaṃ vo asuraṃ sudakṣamantardūtaṃ rodasī satyavācam |
7,002.03 manuṣvadagniṃ manunā samiddhaṃ samadhvarāya sadaminmahema ||
7,002.04  saparyavo bharamāṇā abhijñu pra vṛñjate namasā barhiragnau |
7,002.04 ājuhvānā ghṛtapṛṣṭhaṃ pṛṣadvadadhvaryavo haviṣā marjayadhvam ||
7,002.05  svādhyo vi duro devayanto'śiśrayū rathayurdevatātā |
7,002.05 pūrvī śiśuṃ na mātarā rihāṇe samagruvo na samaneṣvañjan ||
7,002.06  uta yoṣaṇe divye mahī na uṣāsānaktā sudugheva dhenuḥ |
7,002.06 barhiṣadā puruhūte maghonī ā yajñiye suvitāya śrayetām ||
7,002.07  viprā yajñeṣu mānuṣeṣu kārū manye vāṃ jātavedasā yajadhyai |
7,002.07 ūrdhvaṃ no adhvaraṃ kṛtaṃ haveṣu tā deveṣu vanatho vāryāṇi ||
7,002.08  ā bhāratī bhāratībhiḥ sajoṣā iḻā devairmanuṣyebhiragniḥ |
7,002.08 sarasvatī sārasvatebhirarvāktisro devīrbarhiredaṃ sadantu ||
7,002.09  tannasturīpamadha poṣayitnu deva tvaṣṭarvi rarāṇaḥ syasva |
7,002.09 yato vīraḥ karmaṇyaḥ sudakṣo yuktagrāvā jāyate devakāmaḥ ||
7,002.10  vanaspate'va sṛjopa devānagnirhaviḥ śamitā sūdayāti |
7,002.10 sedu hotā satyataro yajāti yathā devānāṃ janimāni veda ||
7,002.11  ā yāhyagne samidhāno arvāṅindreṇa devaiḥ sarathaṃ turebhiḥ |
7,002.11 barhirna āstāmaditiḥ suputrā svāhā devā amṛtā mādayantām ||

7,003.01  agniṃ vo devamagnibhiḥ sajoṣā yajiṣṭhaṃ dūtamadhvare kṛṇudhvam |
7,003.01 yo martyeṣu nidhruvirṛtāvā tapurmūrdhā ghṛtānnaḥ pāvakaḥ ||
7,003.02  prothadaśvo na yavase'viṣyanyadā mahaḥ saṃvaraṇādvyasthāt |
7,003.02 ādasya vāto anu vāti śociradha sma te vrajanaṃ kṛṣṇamasti ||
7,003.03  udyasya te navajātasya vṛṣṇo'gne carantyajarā idhānāḥ |
7,003.03 acchā dyāmaruṣo dhūma eti saṃ dūto agna īyase hi devān ||
7,003.04  vi yasya te pṛthivyāṃ pājo aśrettṛṣu yadannā samavṛkta jambhaiḥ |
7,003.04 seneva sṛṣṭā prasitiṣṭa eti yavaṃ na dasma juhvā vivekṣi ||
7,003.05  tamiddoṣā tamuṣasi yaviṣṭhamagnimatyaṃ na marjayanta naraḥ |
7,003.05 niśiśānā atithimasya yonau dīdāya śocirāhutasya vṛṣṇaḥ ||
7,003.06  susaṃdṛkte svanīka pratīkaṃ vi yadrukmo na rocasa upāke |
7,003.06 divo na te tanyatureti śuṣmaścitro na sūraḥ prati cakṣi bhānum ||
7,003.07  yathā vaḥ svāhāgnaye dāśema parīḻābhirghṛtavadbhiśca havyaiḥ |
7,003.07 tebhirno agne amitairmahobhiḥ śataṃ pūrbhirāyasībhirni pāhi ||
7,003.08  yā vā te santi dāśuṣe adhṛṣṭā giro vā yābhirnṛvatīruruṣyāḥ |
7,003.08 tābhirnaḥ sūno sahaso ni pāhi smatsūrīñjaritṝñjātavedaḥ ||
7,003.09  niryatpūteva svadhitiḥ śucirgātsvayā kṛpā tanvā rocamānaḥ |
7,003.09 ā yo mātroruśenyo janiṣṭa devayajyāya sukratuḥ pāvakaḥ ||
7,003.10  etā no agne saubhagā didīhyapi kratuṃ sucetasaṃ vatema |
7,003.10 viśvā stotṛbhyo gṛṇate ca santu yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,004.01  pra vaḥ śukrāya bhānave bharadhvaṃ havyaṃ matiṃ cāgnaye supūtam |
7,004.01 yo daivyāni mānuṣā janūṃṣyantarviśvāni vidmanā jigāti ||
7,004.02  sa gṛtso agnistaruṇaścidastu yato yaviṣṭho ajaniṣṭa mātuḥ |
7,004.02 saṃ yo vanā yuvate śucidanbhūri cidannā samidatti sadyaḥ ||
7,004.03  asya devasya saṃsadyanīke yaṃ martāsaḥ śyetaṃ jagṛbhre |
7,004.03 ni yo gṛbhaṃ pauruṣeyīmuvoca durokamagnirāyave śuśoca ||
7,004.04  ayaṃ kavirakaviṣu pracetā marteṣvagniramṛto ni dhāyi |
7,004.04 sa mā no atra juhuraḥ sahasvaḥ sadā tve sumanasaḥ syāma ||
7,004.05  ā yo yoniṃ devakṛtaṃ sasāda kratvā hyagniramṛtāṃ atārīt |
7,004.05 tamoṣadhīśca vaninaśca garbhaṃ bhūmiśca viśvadhāyasaṃ bibharti ||
7,004.06  īśe hyagniramṛtasya bhūrerīśe rāyaḥ suvīryasya dātoḥ |
7,004.06 mā tvā vayaṃ sahasāvannavīrā māpsavaḥ pari ṣadāma māduvaḥ ||
7,004.07  pariṣadyaṃ hyaraṇasya rekṇo nityasya rāyaḥ patayaḥ syāma |
7,004.07 na śeṣo agne anyajātamastyacetānasya mā patho vi dukṣaḥ ||
7,004.08  nahi grabhāyāraṇaḥ suśevo'nyodaryo manasā mantavā u |
7,004.08 adhā cidokaḥ punaritsa etyā no vājyabhīṣāḻ etu navyaḥ ||
7,004.09  tvamagne vanuṣyato ni pāhi tvamu naḥ sahasāvannavadyāt |
7,004.09 saṃ tvā dhvasmanvadabhyetu pāthaḥ saṃ rayi spṛhayāyyaḥ sahasrī ||
7,004.10  etā no agne saubhagā didīhyapi kratuṃ sucetasaṃ vatema |
7,004.10 viśvā stotṛbhyo gṛṇate ca santu yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,005.01  prāgnaye tavase bharadhvaṃ giraṃ divo arataye pṛthivyāḥ |
7,005.01 yo viśveṣāmamṛtānāmupasthe vaiśvānaro vāvṛdhe jāgṛvadbhiḥ ||
7,005.02  pṛṣṭo divi dhāyyagniḥ pṛthivyāṃ netā sindhūnāṃ vṛṣabha stiyānām |
7,005.02 sa mānuṣīrabhi viśo vi bhāti vaiśvānaro vāvṛdhāno vareṇa ||
7,005.03  tvadbhiyā viśa āyannasiknīrasamanā jahatīrbhojanāni |
7,005.03 vaiśvānara pūrave śośucānaḥ puro yadagne darayannadīdeḥ ||
7,005.04  tava tridhātu pṛthivī uta dyaurvaiśvānara vratamagne sacanta |
7,005.04 tvaṃ bhāsā rodasī ā tatanthājasreṇa śociṣā śośucānaḥ ||
7,005.05  tvāmagne harito vāvaśānā giraḥ sacante dhunayo ghṛtācīḥ |
7,005.05 patiṃ kṛṣṭīnāṃ rathyaṃ rayīṇāṃ vaiśvānaramuṣasāṃ ketumahnām ||
7,005.06  tve asuryaṃ vasavo nyṛṇvankratuṃ hi te mitramaho juṣanta |
7,005.06 tvaṃ dasyūṃrokaso agna āja uru jyotirjanayannāryāya ||
7,005.07  sa jāyamānaḥ parame vyomanvāyurna pāthaḥ pari pāsi sadyaḥ |
7,005.07 tvaṃ bhuvanā janayannabhi krannapatyāya jātavedo daśasyan ||
7,005.08  tāmagne asme iṣamerayasva vaiśvānara dyumatīṃ jātavedaḥ |
7,005.08 yayā rādhaḥ pinvasi viśvavāra pṛthu śravo dāśuṣe martyāya ||
7,005.09  taṃ no agne maghavadbhyaḥ purukṣuṃ rayiṃ ni vājaṃ śrutyaṃ yuvasva |
7,005.09 vaiśvānara mahi naḥ śarma yaccha rudrebhiragne vasubhiḥ sajoṣāḥ ||

7,006.01  pra samrājo asurasya praśastiṃ puṃsaḥ kṛṣṭīnāmanumādyasya |
7,006.01 indrasyeva pra tavasaskṛtāni vande dāruṃ vandamāno vivakmi ||
7,006.02  kaviṃ ketuṃ dhāsiṃ bhānumadrerhinvanti śaṃ rājyaṃ rodasyoḥ |
7,006.02 purandarasya gīrbhirā vivāse'gnervratāni pūrvyā mahāni ||
7,006.03  nyakratūngrathino mṛdhravācaḥ paṇīṃraśraddhāṃ avṛdhāṃ ayajñān |
7,006.03 prapra tāndasyūṃragnirvivāya pūrvaścakārāparāṃ ayajyūn ||
7,006.04  yo apācīne tamasi madantīḥ prācīścakāra nṛtamaḥ śacībhiḥ |
7,006.04 tamīśānaṃ vasvo agniṃ gṛṇīṣe'nānataṃ damayantaṃ pṛtanyūn ||
7,006.05  yo dehyo anamayadvadhasnairyo aryapatnīruṣasaścakāra |
7,006.05 sa nirudhyā nahuṣo yahvo agnirviśaścakre balihṛtaḥ sahobhiḥ ||
7,006.06  yasya śarmannupa viśve janāsa evaistasthuḥ sumatiṃ bhikṣamāṇāḥ |
7,006.06 vaiśvānaro varamā rodasyorāgniḥ sasāda pitrorupastham ||
7,006.07  ā devo dade budhnyā vasūni vaiśvānara uditā sūryasya |
7,006.07 ā samudrādavarādā parasmādāgnirdade diva ā pṛthivyāḥ ||

7,007.01  pra vo devaṃ citsahasānamagnimaśvaṃ na vājinaṃ hiṣe namobhiḥ |
7,007.01 bhavā no dūto adhvarasya vidvāntmanā deveṣu vivide mitadruḥ ||
7,007.02  ā yāhyagne pathyā anu svā mandro devānāṃ sakhyaṃ juṣāṇaḥ |
7,007.02 ā sānu śuṣmairnadayanpṛthivyā jambhebhirviśvamuśadhagvanāni ||
7,007.03  prācīno yajñaḥ sudhitaṃ hi barhiḥ prīṇīte agnirīḻito na hotā |
7,007.03 ā mātarā viśvavāre huvāno yato yaviṣṭha jajñiṣe suśevaḥ ||
7,007.04  sadyo adhvare rathiraṃ jananta mānuṣāso vicetaso ya eṣām |
7,007.04 viśāmadhāyi viśpatirduroṇe'gnirmandro madhuvacā ṛtāvā ||
7,007.05  asādi vṛto vahnirājaganvānagnirbrahmā nṛṣadane vidhartā |
7,007.05 dyauśca yaṃ pṛthivī vāvṛdhāte ā yaṃ hotā yajati viśvavāram ||
7,007.06  ete dyumnebhirviśvamātiranta mantraṃ ye vāraṃ naryā atakṣan |
7,007.06 pra ye viśastiranta śroṣamāṇā ā ye me asya dīdhayannṛtasya ||
7,007.07  nū tvāmagna īmahe vasiṣṭhā īśānaṃ sūno sahaso vasūnām |
7,007.07 iṣaṃ stotṛbhyo maghavadbhya ānaḍyūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,008.01  indhe rājā samaryo namobhiryasya pratīkamāhutaṃ ghṛtena |
7,008.01 naro havyebhirīḻate sabādha āgniragra uṣasāmaśoci ||
7,008.02  ayamu ṣya sumahāṃ avedi hotā mandro manuṣo yahvo agniḥ |
7,008.02 vi bhā akaḥ sasṛjānaḥ pṛthivyāṃ kṛṣṇapaviroṣadhībhirvavakṣe ||
7,008.03  kayā no agne vi vasaḥ suvṛktiṃ kāmu svadhāmṛṇavaḥ śasyamānaḥ |
7,008.03 kadā bhavema patayaḥ sudatra rāyo vantāro duṣṭarasya sādhoḥ ||
7,008.04  praprāyamagnirbharatasya śṛṇve vi yatsūryo na rocate bṛhadbhāḥ |
7,008.04 abhi yaḥ pūruṃ pṛtanāsu tasthau dyutāno daivyo atithiḥ śuśoca ||
7,008.05  asannittve āhavanāni bhūri bhuvo viśvebhiḥ sumanā anīkaiḥ |
7,008.05 stutaścidagne śṛṇviṣe gṛṇānaḥ svayaṃ vardhasva tanvaṃ sujāta ||
7,008.06  idaṃ vacaḥ śatasāḥ saṃsahasramudagnaye janiṣīṣṭa dvibarhāḥ |
7,008.06 śaṃ yatstotṛbhya āpaye bhavāti dyumadamīvacātanaṃ rakṣohā ||
7,008.07  nū tvāmagna īmahe vasiṣṭhā īśānaṃ sūno sahaso vasūnām |
7,008.07 iṣaṃ stotṛbhyo maghavadbhya ānaḍyūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,009.01  abodhi jāra uṣasāmupasthāddhotā mandraḥ kavitamaḥ pāvakaḥ |
7,009.01 dadhāti ketumubhayasya jantorhavyā deveṣu draviṇaṃ sukṛtsu ||
7,009.02  sa sukraturyo vi duraḥ paṇīnāṃ punāno arkaṃ purubhojasaṃ naḥ |
7,009.02 hotā mandro viśāṃ damūnāstirastamo dadṛśe rāmyāṇām ||
7,009.03  amūraḥ kaviraditirvivasvānsusaṃsanmitro atithiḥ śivo naḥ |
7,009.03 citrabhānuruṣasāṃ bhātyagre'pāṃ garbhaḥ prasva ā viveśa ||
7,009.04  īḻenyo vo manuṣo yugeṣu samanagā aśucajjātavedāḥ |
7,009.04 susaṃdṛśā bhānunā yo vibhāti prati gāvaḥ samidhānaṃ budhanta ||
7,009.05  agne yāhi dūtyaṃ mā riṣaṇyo devāṃ acchā brahmakṛtā gaṇena |
7,009.05 sarasvatīṃ maruto aśvināpo yakṣi devānratnadheyāya viśvān ||
7,009.06  tvāmagne samidhāno vasiṣṭho jarūthaṃ hanyakṣi rāye purandhim |
7,009.06 puruṇīthā jātavedo jarasva yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,010.01  uṣo na jāraḥ pṛthu pājo aśreddavidyutaddīdyacchośucānaḥ |
7,010.01 vṛṣā hariḥ śucirā bhāti bhāsā dhiyo hinvāna uśatīrajīgaḥ ||
7,010.02  svarṇa vastoruṣasāmaroci yajñaṃ tanvānā uśijo na manma |
7,010.02 agnirjanmāni deva ā vi vidvāndravaddūto devayāvā vaniṣṭhaḥ ||
7,010.03  acchā giro matayo devayantīragniṃ yanti draviṇaṃ bhikṣamāṇāḥ |
7,010.03 susaṃdṛśaṃ supratīkaṃ svañcaṃ havyavāhamaratiṃ mānuṣāṇām ||
7,010.04  indraṃ no agne vasubhiḥ sajoṣā rudraṃ rudrebhirā vahā bṛhantam |
7,010.04 ādityebhiraditiṃ viśvajanyāṃ bṛhaspatimṛkvabhirviśvavāram ||
7,010.05  mandraṃ hotāramuśijo yaviṣṭhamagniṃ viśa īḻate adhvareṣu |
7,010.05 sa hi kṣapāvāṃ abhavadrayīṇāmatandro dūto yajathāya devān ||

7,011.01  mahāṃ asyadhvarasya praketo na ṛte tvadamṛtā mādayante |
7,011.01 ā viśvebhiḥ sarathaṃ yāhi devairnyagne hotā prathamaḥ sadeha ||
7,011.02  tvāmīḻate ajiraṃ dūtyāya haviṣmantaḥ sadaminmānuṣāsaḥ |
7,011.02 yasya devairāsado barhiragne'hānyasmai sudinā bhavanti ||
7,011.03  triścidaktoḥ pra cikiturvasūni tve antardāśuṣe martyāya |
7,011.03 manuṣvadagna iha yakṣi devānbhavā no dūto abhiśastipāvā ||
7,011.04  agnirīśe bṛhato adhvarasyāgnirviśvasya haviṣaḥ kṛtasya |
7,011.04 kratuṃ hyasya vasavo juṣantāthā devā dadhire havyavāham ||
7,011.05  āgne vaha haviradyāya devānindrajyeṣṭhāsa iha mādayantām |
7,011.05 imaṃ yajñaṃ divi deveṣu dhehi yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,012.01  aganma mahā namasā yaviṣṭhaṃ yo dīdāya samiddhaḥ sve duroṇe |
7,012.01 citrabhānuṃ rodasī antarurvī svāhutaṃ viśvataḥ pratyañcam ||
7,012.02  sa mahnā viśvā duritāni sāhvānagni ṣṭave dama ā jātavedāḥ |
7,012.02 sa no rakṣiṣadduritādavadyādasmāngṛṇata uta no maghonaḥ ||
7,012.03  tvaṃ varuṇa uta mitro agne tvāṃ vardhanti matibhirvasiṣṭhāḥ |
7,012.03 tve vasu suṣaṇanāni santu yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,013.01  prāgnaye viśvaśuce dhiyandhe'suraghne manma dhītiṃ bharadhvam |
7,013.01 bhare havirna barhiṣi prīṇāno vaiśvānarāya yataye matīnām ||
7,013.02  tvamagne śociṣā śośucāna ā rodasī apṛṇā jāyamānaḥ |
7,013.02 tvaṃ devāṃ abhiśasteramuñco vaiśvānara jātavedo mahitvā ||
7,013.03  jāto yadagne bhuvanā vyakhyaḥ paśūnna gopā iryaḥ parijmā |
7,013.03 vaiśvānara brahmaṇe vinda gātuṃ yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,014.01  samidhā jātavedase devāya devahūtibhiḥ |
7,014.01 havirbhiḥ śukraśociṣe namasvino vayaṃ dāśemāgnaye ||
7,014.02  vayaṃ te agne samidhā vidhema vayaṃ dāśema suṣṭutī yajatra |
7,014.02 vayaṃ ghṛtenādhvarasya hotarvayaṃ deva haviṣā bhadraśoce ||
7,014.03  ā no devebhirupa devahūtimagne yāhi vaṣaṭkṛtiṃ juṣāṇaḥ |
7,014.03 tubhyaṃ devāya dāśataḥ syāma yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,015.01  upasadyāya mīḻhuṣa āsye juhutā haviḥ |
7,015.01 yo no nediṣṭhamāpyam ||
7,015.02  yaḥ pañca carṣaṇīrabhi niṣasāda damedame |
7,015.02 kavirgṛhapatiryuvā ||
7,015.03  sa no vedo amātyamagnī rakṣatu viśvataḥ |
7,015.03 utāsmānpātvaṃhasaḥ ||
7,015.04  navaṃ nu stomamagnaye divaḥ śyenāya jījanam |
7,015.04 vasvaḥ kuvidvanāti naḥ ||
7,015.05  spārhā yasya śriyo dṛśe rayirvīravato yathā |
7,015.05 agre yajñasya śocataḥ ||
7,015.06  semāṃ vetu vaṣaṭkṛtimagnirjuṣata no giraḥ |
7,015.06 yajiṣṭho havyavāhanaḥ ||
7,015.07  ni tvā nakṣya viśpate dyumantaṃ deva dhīmahi |
7,015.07 suvīramagna āhuta ||
7,015.08  kṣapa usraśca dīdihi svagnayastvayā vayam |
7,015.08 suvīrastvamasmayuḥ ||
7,015.09  upa tvā sātaye naro viprāso yanti dhītibhiḥ |
7,015.09 upākṣarā sahasriṇī ||
7,015.10  agnī rakṣāṃsi sedhati śukraśociramartyaḥ |
7,015.10 śuciḥ pāvaka īḍyaḥ ||
7,015.11  sa no rādhāṃsyā bhareśānaḥ sahaso yaho |
7,015.11 bhagaśca dātu vāryam ||
7,015.12  tvamagne vīravadyaśo devaśca savitā bhagaḥ |
7,015.12 ditiśca dāti vāryam ||
7,015.13  agne rakṣā ṇo aṃhasaḥ prati ṣma deva rīṣataḥ |
7,015.13 tapiṣṭhairajaro daha ||
7,015.14  adhā mahī na āyasyanādhṛṣṭo nṛpītaye |
7,015.14 pūrbhavā śatabhujiḥ ||
7,015.15  tvaṃ naḥ pāhyaṃhaso doṣāvastaraghāyataḥ |
7,015.15 divā naktamadābhya ||

7,016.01  enā vo agniṃ namasorjo napātamā huve |
7,016.01 priyaṃ cetiṣṭhamaratiṃ svadhvaraṃ viśvasya dūtamamṛtam ||
7,016.02  sa yojate aruṣā viśvabhojasā sa dudravatsvāhutaḥ |
7,016.02 subrahmā yajñaḥ suśamī vasūnāṃ devaṃ rādho janānām ||
7,016.03  udasya śocirasthādājuhvānasya mīḻhuṣaḥ |
7,016.03 uddhūmāso aruṣāso divispṛśaḥ samagnimindhate naraḥ ||
7,016.04  taṃ tvā dūtaṃ kṛṇmahe yaśastamaṃ devāṃ ā vītaye vaha |
7,016.04 viśvā sūno sahaso martabhojanā rāsva tadyattvemahe ||
7,016.05  tvamagne gṛhapatistvaṃ hotā no adhvare |
7,016.05 tvaṃ potā viśvavāra pracetā yakṣi veṣi ca vāryam ||
7,016.06  kṛdhi ratnaṃ yajamānāya sukrato tvaṃ hi ratnadhā asi |
7,016.06 ā na ṛte śiśīhi viśvamṛtvijaṃ suśaṃso yaśca dakṣate ||
7,016.07  tve agne svāhuta priyāsaḥ santu sūrayaḥ |
7,016.07 yantāro ye maghavāno janānāmūrvāndayanta gonām ||
7,016.08  yeṣāmiḻā ghṛtahastā duroṇa āṃ api prātā niṣīdati |
7,016.08 tāṃstrāyasva sahasya druho nido yacchā naḥ śarma dīrghaśrut ||
7,016.09  sa mandrayā ca jihvayā vahnirāsā viduṣṭaraḥ |
7,016.09 agne rayiṃ maghavadbhyo na ā vaha havyadātiṃ ca sūdaya ||
7,016.10  ye rādhāṃsi dadatyaśvyā maghā kāmena śravaso mahaḥ |
7,016.10 tāṃ aṃhasaḥ pipṛhi partṛbhiṣṭvaṃ śataṃ pūrbhiryaviṣṭhya ||
7,016.11  devo vo draviṇodāḥ pūrṇāṃ vivaṣṭyāsicam |
7,016.11 udvā siñcadhvamupa vā pṛṇadhvamādidvo deva ohate ||
7,016.12  taṃ hotāramadhvarasya pracetasaṃ vahniṃ devā akṛṇvata |
7,016.12 dadhāti ratnaṃ vidhate suvīryamagnirjanāya dāśuṣe ||

7,017.01 agne bhava suṣamidhā samiddha uta barhirurviyā vi stṛṇītām ||
7,017.02 uta dvāra uśatīrvi śrayantāmuta devāṃ uśata ā vaheha ||
7,017.03 agne vīhi haviṣā yakṣi devānsvadhvarā kṛṇuhi jātavedaḥ ||
7,017.04 svadhvarā karati jātavedā yakṣaddevāṃ amṛtānpiprayacca ||
7,017.05 vaṃsva viśvā vāryāṇi pracetaḥ satyā bhavantvāśiṣo no adya ||
7,017.06 tvāmu te dadhire havyavāhaṃ devāso agna ūrja ā napātam ||
7,017.07 te te devāya dāśataḥ syāma maho no ratnā vi dadha iyānaḥ ||

7,018.01  tve ha yatpitaraścinna indra viśvā vāmā jaritāro asanvan |
7,018.01 tve gāvaḥ sudughāstve hyaśvāstvaṃ vasu devayate vaniṣṭhaḥ ||
7,018.02  rājeva hi janibhiḥ kṣeṣyevāva dyubhirabhi viduṣkaviḥ san |
7,018.02 piśā giro maghavangobhiraśvaistvāyataḥ śiśīhi rāye asmān ||
7,018.03  imā u tvā paspṛdhānāso atra mandrā giro devayantīrupa sthuḥ |
7,018.03 arvācī te pathyā rāya etu syāma te sumatāvindra śarman ||
7,018.04  dhenuṃ na tvā sūyavase dudukṣannupa brahmāṇi sasṛje vasiṣṭhaḥ |
7,018.04 tvāminme gopatiṃ viśva āhā na indraḥ sumatiṃ gantvaccha ||
7,018.05  arṇāṃsi citpaprathānā sudāsa indro gādhānyakṛṇotsupārā |
7,018.05 śardhantaṃ śimyumucathasya navyaḥ śāpaṃ sindhūnāmakṛṇodaśastīḥ ||
7,018.06  puroḻā itturvaśo yakṣurāsīdrāye matsyāso niśitā apīva |
7,018.06 śruṣṭiṃ cakrurbhṛgavo druhyavaśca sakhā sakhāyamataradviṣūcoḥ ||
7,018.07  ā pakthāso bhalānaso bhanantālināso viṣāṇinaḥ śivāsaḥ |
7,018.07 ā yo'nayatsadhamā āryasya gavyā tṛtsubhyo ajaganyudhā nṝn ||
7,018.08  durādhyo aditiṃ srevayanto'cetaso vi jagṛbhre paruṣṇīm |
7,018.08 mahnāvivyakpṛthivīṃ patyamānaḥ paśuṣkaviraśayaccāyamānaḥ ||
7,018.09  īyurarthaṃ na nyarthaṃ paruṣṇīmāśuścanedabhipitvaṃ jagāma |
7,018.09 sudāsa indraḥ sutukāṃ amitrānarandhayanmānuṣe vadhrivācaḥ ||
7,018.10  īyurgāvo na yavasādagopā yathākṛtamabhi mitraṃ citāsaḥ |
7,018.10 pṛśnigāvaḥ pṛśninipreṣitāsaḥ śruṣṭiṃ cakrurniyuto rantayaśca ||
7,018.11  ekaṃ ca yo viṃśatiṃ ca śravasyā vaikarṇayorjanānrājā nyastaḥ |
7,018.11 dasmo na sadmanni śiśāti barhiḥ śūraḥ sargamakṛṇodindra eṣām ||
7,018.12  adha śrutaṃ kavaṣaṃ vṛddhamapsvanu druhyuṃ ni vṛṇagvajrabāhuḥ |
7,018.12 vṛṇānā atra sakhyāya sakhyaṃ tvāyanto ye amadannanu tvā ||
7,018.13  vi sadyo viśvā dṛṃhitānyeṣāmindraḥ puraḥ sahasā sapta dardaḥ |
7,018.13 vyānavasya tṛtsave gayaṃ bhāgjeṣma pūruṃ vidathe mṛdhravācam ||
7,018.14  ni gavyavo'navo druhyavaśca ṣaṣṭiḥ śatā suṣupuḥ ṣaṭsahasrā |
7,018.14 ṣaṣṭirvīrāso adhi ṣaḍduvoyu viśvedindrasya vīryā kṛtāni ||
7,018.15  indreṇaite tṛtsavo veviṣāṇā āpo na sṛṣṭā adhavanta nīcīḥ |
7,018.15 durmitrāsaḥ prakalavinmimānā jahurviśvāni bhojanā sudāse ||
7,018.16  ardhaṃ vīrasya śṛtapāmanindraṃ parā śardhantaṃ nunude abhi kṣām |
7,018.16 indro manyuṃ manyumyo mimāya bheje patho vartaniṃ patyamānaḥ ||
7,018.17  ādhreṇa cittadvekaṃ cakāra siṃhyaṃ citpetvenā jaghāna |
7,018.17 ava sraktīrveśyāvṛścadindraḥ prāyacchadviśvā bhojanā sudāse ||
7,018.18  śaśvanto hi śatravo rāradhuṣṭe bhedasya cicchardhato vinda randhim |
7,018.18 martāṃ ena stuvato yaḥ kṛṇoti tigmaṃ tasminni jahi vajramindra ||
7,018.19  āvadindraṃ yamunā tṛtsavaśca prātra bhedaṃ sarvatātā muṣāyat |
7,018.19 ajāsaśca śigravo yakṣavaśca baliṃ śīrṣāṇi jabhruraśvyāni ||
7,018.20  na ta indra sumatayo na rāyaḥ saṃcakṣe pūrvā uṣaso na nūtnāḥ |
7,018.20 devakaṃ cinmānyamānaṃ jaghanthāva tmanā bṛhataḥ śambaraṃ bhet ||
7,018.21  pra ye gṛhādamamadustvāyā parāśaraḥ śatayāturvasiṣṭhaḥ |
7,018.21 na te bhojasya sakhyaṃ mṛṣantādhā sūribhyaḥ sudinā vyucchān ||
7,018.22  dve napturdevavataḥ śate gordvā rathā vadhūmantā sudāsaḥ |
7,018.22 arhannagne paijavanasya dānaṃ hoteva sadma paryemi rebhan ||
7,018.23  catvāro mā paijavanasya dānāḥ smaddiṣṭayaḥ kṛśanino nireke |
7,018.23 ṛjrāso mā pṛthiviṣṭhāḥ sudāsastokaṃ tokāya śravase vahanti ||
7,018.24  yasya śravo rodasī antarurvī śīrṣṇeśīrṣṇe vibabhājā vibhaktā |
7,018.24 saptedindraṃ na sravato gṛṇanti ni yudhyāmadhimaśiśādabhīke ||
7,018.25  imaṃ naro marutaḥ saścatānu divodāsaṃ na pitaraṃ sudāsaḥ |
7,018.25 aviṣṭanā paijavanasya ketaṃ dūṇāśaṃ kṣatramajaraṃ duvoyu ||

7,019.01  yastigmaśṛṅgo vṛṣabho na bhīma ekaḥ kṛṣṭīścyāvayati pra viśvāḥ |
7,019.01 yaḥ śaśvato adāśuṣo gayasya prayantāsi suṣvitarāya vedaḥ ||
7,019.02  tvaṃ ha tyadindra kutsamāvaḥ śuśrūṣamāṇastanvā samarye |
7,019.02 dāsaṃ yacchuṣṇaṃ kuyavaṃ nyasmā arandhaya ārjuneyāya śikṣan ||
7,019.03  tvaṃ dhṛṣṇo dhṛṣatā vītahavyaṃ prāvo viśvābhirūtibhiḥ sudāsam |
7,019.03 pra paurukutsiṃ trasadasyumāvaḥ kṣetrasātā vṛtrahatyeṣu pūrum ||
7,019.04  tvaṃ nṛbhirnṛmaṇo devavītau bhūrīṇi vṛtrā haryaśva haṃsi |
7,019.04 tvaṃ ni dasyuṃ cumuriṃ dhuniṃ cāsvāpayo dabhītaye suhantu ||
7,019.05  tava cyautnāni vajrahasta tāni nava yatpuro navatiṃ ca sadyaḥ |
7,019.05 niveśane śatatamāviveṣīrahañca vṛtraṃ namucimutāhan ||
7,019.06  sanā tā ta indra bhojanāni rātahavyāya dāśuṣe sudāse |
7,019.06 vṛṣṇe te harī vṛṣaṇā yunajmi vyantu brahmāṇi puruśāka vājam ||
7,019.07  mā te asyāṃ sahasāvanpariṣṭāvaghāya bhūma harivaḥ parādai |
7,019.07 trāyasva no'vṛkebhirvarūthaistava priyāsaḥ sūriṣu syāma ||
7,019.08  priyāsa itte maghavannabhiṣṭau naro madema śaraṇe sakhāyaḥ |
7,019.08 ni turvaśaṃ ni yādvaṃ śiśīhyatithigvāya śaṃsyaṃ kariṣyan ||
7,019.09  sadyaścinnu te maghavannabhiṣṭau naraḥ śaṃsantyukthaśāsa ukthā |
7,019.09 ye te havebhirvi paṇīṃradāśannasmānvṛṇīṣva yujyāya tasmai ||
7,019.10  ete stomā narāṃ nṛtama tubhyamasmadryañco dadato maghāni |
7,019.10 teṣāmindra vṛtrahatye śivo bhūḥ sakhā ca śūro'vitā ca nṛṇām ||
7,019.11  nū indra śūra stavamāna ūtī brahmajūtastanvā vāvṛdhasva |
7,019.11 upa no vājānmimīhyupa stīnyūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,020.01  ugro jajñe vīryāya svadhāvāñcakrirapo naryo yatkariṣyan |
7,020.01 jagmiryuvā nṛṣadanamavobhistrātā na indra enaso mahaścit ||
7,020.02  hantā vṛtramindraḥ śūśuvānaḥ prāvīnnu vīro jaritāramūtī |
7,020.02 kartā sudāse aha vā u lokaṃ dātā vasu muhurā dāśuṣe bhūt ||
7,020.03  yudhmo anarvā khajakṛtsamadvā śūraḥ satrāṣāḍjanuṣemaṣāḻhaḥ |
7,020.03 vyāsa indraḥ pṛtanāḥ svojā adhā viśvaṃ śatrūyantaṃ jaghāna ||
7,020.04  ubhe cidindra rodasī mahitvā paprātha taviṣībhistuviṣmaḥ |
7,020.04 ni vajramindro harivānmimikṣansamandhasā madeṣu vā uvoca ||
7,020.05  vṛṣā jajāna vṛṣaṇaṃ raṇāya tamu cinnārī naryaṃ sasūva |
7,020.05 pra yaḥ senānīradha nṛbhyo astīnaḥ satvā gaveṣaṇaḥ sa dhṛṣṇuḥ ||
7,020.06  nū citsa bhreṣate jano na reṣanmano yo asya ghoramāvivāsāt |
7,020.06 yajñairya indre dadhate duvāṃsi kṣayatsa rāya ṛtapā ṛtejāḥ ||
7,020.07  yadindra pūrvo aparāya śikṣannayajjyāyānkanīyaso deṣṇam |
7,020.07 amṛta itparyāsīta dūramā citra citryaṃ bharā rayiṃ naḥ ||
7,020.08  yasta indra priyo jano dadāśadasannireke adrivaḥ sakhā te |
7,020.08 vayaṃ te asyāṃ sumatau caniṣṭhāḥ syāma varūthe aghnato nṛpītau ||
7,020.09  eṣa stomo acikradadvṛṣā ta uta stāmurmaghavannakrapiṣṭa |
7,020.09 rāyaskāmo jaritāraṃ ta āgantvamaṅga śakra vasva ā śako naḥ ||
7,020.10  sa na indra tvayatāyā iṣe dhāstmanā ca ye maghavāno junanti |
7,020.10 vasvī ṣu te jaritre astu śaktiryūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,021.01  asāvi devaṃ goṛjīkamandho nyasminnindro januṣemuvoca |
7,021.01 bodhāmasi tvā haryaśva yajñairbodhā na stomamandhaso madeṣu ||
7,021.02  pra yanti yajñaṃ vipayanti barhiḥ somamādo vidathe dudhravācaḥ |
7,021.02 nyu bhriyante yaśaso gṛbhādā dūraupabdo vṛṣaṇo nṛṣācaḥ ||
7,021.03  tvamindra sravitavā apaskaḥ pariṣṭhitā ahinā śūra pūrvīḥ |
7,021.03 tvadvāvakre rathyo na dhenā rejante viśvā kṛtrimāṇi bhīṣā ||
7,021.04  bhīmo viveṣāyudhebhireṣāmapāṃsi viśvā naryāṇi vidvān |
7,021.04 indraḥ puro jarhṛṣāṇo vi dūdhodvi vajrahasto mahinā jaghāna ||
7,021.05  na yātava indra jūjuvurno na vandanā śaviṣṭha vedyābhiḥ |
7,021.05 sa śardhadaryo viṣuṇasya jantormā śiśnadevā api gurṛtaṃ naḥ ||
7,021.06  abhi kratvendra bhūradha jmanna te vivyaṅmahimānaṃ rajāṃsi |
7,021.06 svenā hi vṛtraṃ śavasā jaghantha na śatrurantaṃ vividadyudhā te ||
7,021.07  devāścitte asuryāya pūrve'nu kṣatrāya mamire sahāṃsi |
7,021.07 indro maghāni dayate viṣahyendraṃ vājasya johuvanta sātau ||
7,021.08  kīriściddhi tvāmavase juhāveśānamindra saubhagasya bhūreḥ |
7,021.08 avo babhūtha śatamūte asme abhikṣattustvāvato varūtā ||
7,021.09  sakhāyasta indra viśvaha syāma namovṛdhāso mahinā tarutra |
7,021.09 vanvantu smā te'vasā samīke'bhītimaryo vanuṣāṃ śavāṃsi ||
7,021.10  sa na indra tvayatāyā iṣe dhāstmanā ca ye maghavāno junanti |
7,021.10 vasvī ṣu te jaritre astu śaktiryūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,022.01  pibā somamindra mandatu tvā yaṃ te suṣāva haryaśvādriḥ |
7,022.01 soturbāhubhyāṃ suyato nārvā ||
7,022.02  yaste mado yujyaścārurasti yena vṛtrāṇi haryaśva haṃsi |
7,022.02 sa tvāmindra prabhūvaso mamattu ||
7,022.03  bodhā su me maghavanvācamemāṃ yāṃ te vasiṣṭho arcati praśastim |
7,022.03 imā brahma sadhamāde juṣasva ||
7,022.04  śrudhī havaṃ vipipānasyādrerbodhā viprasyārcato manīṣām |
7,022.04 kṛṣvā duvāṃsyantamā sacemā ||
7,022.05  na te giro api mṛṣye turasya na suṣṭutimasuryasya vidvān |
7,022.05 sadā te nāma svayaśo vivakmi ||
7,022.06  bhūri hi te savanā mānuṣeṣu bhūri manīṣī havate tvāmit |
7,022.06 māre asmanmaghavañjyokkaḥ ||
7,022.07  tubhyedimā savanā śūra viśvā tubhyaṃ brahmāṇi vardhanā kṛṇomi |
7,022.07 tvaṃ nṛbhirhavyo viśvadhāsi ||
7,022.08  nū cinnu te manyamānasya dasmodaśnuvanti mahimānamugra |
7,022.08 na vīryamindra te na rādhaḥ ||
7,022.09  ye ca pūrva ṛṣayo ye ca nūtnā indra brahmāṇi janayanta viprāḥ |
7,022.09 asme te santu sakhyā śivāni yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,023.01  udu brahmāṇyairata śravasyendraṃ samarye mahayā vasiṣṭha |
7,023.01 ā yo viśvāni śavasā tatānopaśrotā ma īvato vacāṃsi ||
7,023.02  ayāmi ghoṣa indra devajāmirirajyanta yacchurudho vivāci |
7,023.02 nahi svamāyuścikite janeṣu tānīdaṃhāṃsyati parṣyasmān ||
7,023.03  yuje rathaṃ gaveṣaṇaṃ haribhyāmupa brahmāṇi jujuṣāṇamasthuḥ |
7,023.03 vi bādhiṣṭa sya rodasī mahitvendro vṛtrāṇyapratī jaghanvān ||
7,023.04  āpaścitpipyu staryo na gāvo nakṣannṛtaṃ jaritārasta indra |
7,023.04 yāhi vāyurna niyuto no acchā tvaṃ hi dhībhirdayase vi vājān ||
7,023.05  te tvā madā indra mādayantu śuṣmiṇaṃ tuvirādhasaṃ jaritre |
7,023.05 eko devatrā dayase hi martānasmiñchūra savane mādayasva ||
7,023.06  evedindraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ vajrabāhuṃ vasiṣṭhāso abhyarcantyarkaiḥ |
7,023.06 sa na stuto vīravaddhātu gomadyūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,024.01  yoniṣṭa indra sadane akāri tamā nṛbhiḥ puruhūta pra yāhi |
7,024.01 aso yathā no'vitā vṛdhe ca dado vasūni mamadaśca somaiḥ ||
7,024.02  gṛbhītaṃ te mana indra dvibarhāḥ sutaḥ somaḥ pariṣiktā madhūni |
7,024.02 visṛṣṭadhenā bharate suvṛktiriyamindraṃ johuvatī manīṣā ||
7,024.03  ā no diva ā pṛthivyā ṛjīṣinnidaṃ barhiḥ somapeyāya yāhi |
7,024.03 vahantu tvā harayo madryañcamāṅgūṣamacchā tavasaṃ madāya ||
7,024.04  ā no viśvābhirūtibhiḥ sajoṣā brahma juṣāṇo haryaśva yāhi |
7,024.04 varīvṛjatsthavirebhiḥ suśiprāsme dadhadvṛṣaṇaṃ śuṣmamindra ||
7,024.05  eṣa stomo maha ugrāya vāhe dhurīvātyo na vājayannadhāyi |
7,024.05 indra tvāyamarka īṭṭe vasūnāṃ divīva dyāmadhi naḥ śromataṃ dhāḥ ||
7,024.06  evā na indra vāryasya pūrdhi pra te mahīṃ sumatiṃ vevidāma |
7,024.06 iṣaṃ pinva maghavadbhyaḥ suvīrāṃ yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,025.01  ā te maha indrotyugra samanyavo yatsamaranta senāḥ |
7,025.01 patāti didyunnaryasya bāhvormā te mano viṣvadryagvi cārīt ||
7,025.02  ni durga indra śnathihyamitrāṃ abhi ye no martāso amanti |
7,025.02 āre taṃ śaṃsaṃ kṛṇuhi ninitsorā no bhara sambharaṇaṃ vasūnām ||
7,025.03  śataṃ te śiprinnūtayaḥ sudāse sahasraṃ śaṃsā uta rātirastu |
7,025.03 jahi vadharvanuṣo martyasyāsme dyumnamadhi ratnaṃ ca dhehi ||
7,025.04  tvāvato hīndra kratve asmi tvāvato'vituḥ śūra rātau |
7,025.04 viśvedahāni taviṣīva ugraṃ okaḥ kṛṇuṣva harivo na mardhīḥ ||
7,025.05  kutsā ete haryaśvāya śūṣamindre saho devajūtamiyānāḥ |
7,025.05 satrā kṛdhi suhanā śūra vṛtrā vayaṃ tarutrāḥ sanuyāma vājam ||
7,025.06  evā na indra vāryasya pūrdhi pra te mahīṃ sumatiṃ vevidāma |
7,025.06 iṣaṃ pinva maghavadbhyaḥ suvīrāṃ yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,026.01  na soma indramasuto mamāda nābrahmāṇo maghavānaṃ sutāsaḥ |
7,026.01 tasmā ukthaṃ janaye yajjujoṣannṛvannavīyaḥ śṛṇavadyathā naḥ ||
7,026.02  ukthaukthe soma indraṃ mamāda nīthenīthe maghavānaṃ sutāsaḥ |
7,026.02 yadīṃ sabādhaḥ pitaraṃ na putrāḥ samānadakṣā avase havante ||
7,026.03  cakāra tā kṛṇavannūnamanyā yāni bruvanti vedhasaḥ suteṣu |
7,026.03 janīriva patirekaḥ samāno ni māmṛje pura indraḥ su sarvāḥ ||
7,026.04  evā tamāhuruta śṛṇva indra eko vibhaktā taraṇirmaghānām |
7,026.04 mithastura ūtayo yasya pūrvīrasme bhadrāṇi saścata priyāṇi ||
7,026.05  evā vasiṣṭha indramūtaye nṝnkṛṣṭīnāṃ vṛṣabhaṃ sute gṛṇāti |
7,026.05 sahasriṇa upa no māhi vājānyūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,027.01  indraṃ naro nemadhitā havante yatpāryā yunajate dhiyastāḥ |
7,027.01 śūro nṛṣātā śavasaścakāna ā gomati vraje bhajā tvaṃ naḥ ||
7,027.02  ya indra śuṣmo maghavante asti śikṣā sakhibhyaḥ puruhūta nṛbhyaḥ |
7,027.02 tvaṃ hi dṛḻhā maghavanvicetā apā vṛdhi parivṛtaṃ na rādhaḥ ||
7,027.03  indro rājā jagataścarṣaṇīnāmadhi kṣami viṣurūpaṃ yadasti |
7,027.03 tato dadāti dāśuṣe vasūni codadrādha upastutaścidarvāk ||
7,027.04  nū cinna indro maghavā sahūtī dāno vājaṃ ni yamate na ūtī |
7,027.04 anūnā yasya dakṣiṇā pīpāya vāmaṃ nṛbhyo abhivītā sakhibhyaḥ ||
7,027.05  nū indra rāye varivaskṛdhī na ā te mano vavṛtyāma maghāya |
7,027.05 gomadaśvāvadrathavadvyanto yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,028.01  brahmā ṇa indropa yāhi vidvānarvāñcaste harayaḥ santu yuktāḥ |
7,028.01 viśve ciddhi tvā vihavanta martā asmākamicchṛṇuhi viśvaminva ||
7,028.02  havaṃ ta indra mahimā vyānaḍbrahma yatpāsi śavasinnṛṣīṇām |
7,028.02 ā yadvajraṃ dadhiṣe hasta ugra ghoraḥ sankratvā janiṣṭhā aṣāḻhaḥ ||
7,028.03  tava praṇītīndra johuvānānsaṃ yannṝnna rodasī ninetha |
7,028.03 mahe kṣatrāya śavase hi jajñe'tūtujiṃ cittūtujiraśiśnat ||
7,028.04  ebhirna indrāhabhirdaśasya durmitrāso hi kṣitayaḥ pavante |
7,028.04 prati yaccaṣṭe anṛtamanenā ava dvitā varuṇo māyī naḥ sāt ||
7,028.05  vocemedindraṃ maghavānamenaṃ maho rāyo rādhaso yaddadannaḥ |
7,028.05 yo arcato brahmakṛtimaviṣṭho yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,029.01  ayaṃ soma indra tubhyaṃ sunva ā tu pra yāhi harivastadokāḥ |
7,029.01 pibā tvasya suṣutasya cārordado maghāni maghavanniyānaḥ ||
7,029.02  brahmanvīra brahmakṛtiṃ juṣāṇo'rvācīno haribhiryāhi tūyam |
7,029.02 asminnū ṣu savane mādayasvopa brahmāṇi śṛṇava imā naḥ ||
7,029.03  kā te astyaraṅkṛtiḥ sūktaiḥ kadā nūnaṃ te maghavandāśema |
7,029.03 viśvā matīrā tatane tvāyādhā ma indra śṛṇavo havemā ||
7,029.04  uto ghā te puruṣyā idāsanyeṣāṃ pūrveṣāmaśṛṇorṛṣīṇām |
7,029.04 adhāhaṃ tvā maghavañjohavīmi tvaṃ na indrāsi pramatiḥ piteva ||
7,029.05  vocemedindraṃ maghavānamenaṃ maho rāyo rādhaso yaddadannaḥ |
7,029.05 yo arcato brahmakṛtimaviṣṭho yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,030.01  ā no deva śavasā yāhi śuṣminbhavā vṛdha indra rāyo asya |
7,030.01 mahe nṛmṇāya nṛpate suvajra mahi kṣatrāya pauṃsyāya śūra ||
7,030.02  havanta u tvā havyaṃ vivāci tanūṣu śūrāḥ sūryasya sātau |
7,030.02 tvaṃ viśveṣu senyo janeṣu tvaṃ vṛtrāṇi randhayā suhantu ||
7,030.03  ahā yadindra sudinā vyucchāndadho yatketumupamaṃ samatsu |
7,030.03 nyagniḥ sīdadasuro na hotā huvāno atra subhagāya devān ||
7,030.04  vayaṃ te ta indra ye ca deva stavanta śūra dadato maghāni |
7,030.04 yacchā sūribhya upamaṃ varūthaṃ svābhuvo jaraṇāmaśnavanta ||
7,030.05  vocemedindraṃ maghavānamenaṃ maho rāyo rādhaso yaddadannaḥ |
7,030.05 yo arcato brahmakṛtimaviṣṭho yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,031.01  pra va indrāya mādanaṃ haryaśvāya gāyata |
7,031.01 sakhāyaḥ somapāvne ||
7,031.02  śaṃsedukthaṃ sudānava uta dyukṣaṃ yathā naraḥ |
7,031.02 cakṛmā satyarādhase ||
7,031.03  tvaṃ na indra vājayustvaṃ gavyuḥ śatakrato |
7,031.03 tvaṃ hiraṇyayurvaso ||
7,031.04  vayamindra tvāyavo'bhi pra ṇonumo vṛṣan |
7,031.04 viddhī tvasya no vaso ||
7,031.05  mā no nide ca vaktave'ryo randhīrarāvṇe |
7,031.05 tve api kraturmama ||
7,031.06  tvaṃ varmāsi saprathaḥ puroyodhaśca vṛtrahan |
7,031.06 tvayā prati bruve yujā ||
7,031.07  mahāṃ utāsi yasya te'nu svadhāvarī sahaḥ |
7,031.07 mamnāte indra rodasī ||
7,031.08  taṃ tvā marutvatī pari bhuvadvāṇī sayāvarī |
7,031.08 nakṣamāṇā saha dyubhiḥ ||
7,031.09  ūrdhvāsastvānvindavo bhuvandasmamupa dyavi |
7,031.09 saṃ te namanta kṛṣṭayaḥ ||
7,031.10  pra vo mahe mahivṛdhe bharadhvaṃ pracetase pra sumatiṃ kṛṇudhvam |
7,031.10 viśaḥ pūrvīḥ pra carā carṣaṇiprāḥ ||
7,031.11  uruvyacase mahine suvṛktimindrāya brahma janayanta viprāḥ |
7,031.11 tasya vratāni na minanti dhīrāḥ ||
7,031.12  indraṃ vāṇīranuttamanyumeva satrā rājānaṃ dadhire sahadhyai |
7,031.12 haryaśvāya barhayā samāpīn ||

7,032.01  mo ṣu tvā vāghataścanāre asmanni rīraman |
7,032.01 ārāttāccitsadhamādaṃ na ā gahīha vā sannupa śrudhi ||
7,032.02  ime hi te brahmakṛtaḥ sute sacā madhau na makṣa āsate |
7,032.02 indre kāmaṃ jaritāro vasūyavo rathe na pādamā dadhuḥ ||
7,032.03 rāyaskāmo vajrahastaṃ sudakṣiṇaṃ putro na pitaraṃ huve ||
7,032.04  ima indrāya sunvire somāso dadhyāśiraḥ |
7,032.04 tāṃ ā madāya vajrahasta pītaye haribhyāṃ yāhyoka ā ||
7,032.05  śravacchrutkarṇa īyate vasūnāṃ nū cinno mardhiṣadgiraḥ |
7,032.05 sadyaścidyaḥ sahasrāṇi śatā dadannakirditsantamā minat ||
7,032.06  sa vīro apratiṣkuta indreṇa śūśuve nṛbhiḥ |
7,032.06 yaste gabhīrā savanāni vṛtrahansunotyā ca dhāvati ||
7,032.07  bhavā varūthaṃ maghavanmaghonāṃ yatsamajāsi śardhataḥ |
7,032.07 vi tvāhatasya vedanaṃ bhajemahyā dūṇāśo bharā gayam ||
7,032.08  sunotā somapāvne somamindrāya vajriṇe |
7,032.08 pacatā paktīravase kṛṇudhvamitpṛṇannitpṛṇate mayaḥ ||
7,032.09  mā sredhata somino dakṣatā mahe kṛṇudhvaṃ rāya ātuje |
7,032.09 taraṇirijjayati kṣeti puṣyati na devāsaḥ kavatnave ||
7,032.10  nakiḥ sudāso rathaṃ paryāsa na rīramat |
7,032.10 indro yasyāvitā yasya maruto gamatsa gomati vraje ||
7,032.11  gamadvājaṃ vājayannindra martyo yasya tvamavitā bhuvaḥ |
7,032.11 asmākaṃ bodhyavitā rathānāmasmākaṃ śūra nṛṇām ||
7,032.12  udinnvasya ricyate'ṃśo dhanaṃ na jigyuṣaḥ |
7,032.12 ya indro harivānna dabhanti taṃ ripo dakṣaṃ dadhāti somini ||
7,032.13  mantramakharvaṃ sudhitaṃ supeśasaṃ dadhāta yajñiyeṣvā |
7,032.13 pūrvīścana prasitayastaranti taṃ ya indre karmaṇā bhuvat ||
7,032.14  kastamindra tvāvasumā martyo dadharṣati |
7,032.14 śraddhā itte maghavanpārye divi vājī vājaṃ siṣāsati ||
7,032.15  maghonaḥ sma vṛtrahatyeṣu codaya ye dadati priyā vasu |
7,032.15 tava praṇītī haryaśva sūribhirviśvā tarema duritā ||
7,032.16  tavedindrāvamaṃ vasu tvaṃ puṣyasi madhyamam |
7,032.16 satrā viśvasya paramasya rājasi nakiṣṭvā goṣu vṛṇvate ||
7,032.17  tvaṃ viśvasya dhanadā asi śruto ya īṃ bhavantyājayaḥ |
7,032.17 tavāyaṃ viśvaḥ puruhūta pārthivo'vasyurnāma bhikṣate ||
7,032.18  yadindra yāvatastvametāvadahamīśīya |
7,032.18 stotāramiddidhiṣeya radāvaso na pāpatvāya rāsīya ||
7,032.19  śikṣeyaminmahayate divedive rāya ā kuhacidvide |
7,032.19 nahi tvadanyanmaghavanna āpyaṃ vasyo asti pitā cana ||
7,032.20  taraṇiritsiṣāsati vājaṃ purandhyā yujā |
7,032.20 ā va indraṃ puruhūtaṃ name girā nemiṃ taṣṭeva sudrvam ||
7,032.21  na duṣṭutī martyo vindate vasu na sredhantaṃ rayirnaśat |
7,032.21 suśaktirinmaghavantubhyaṃ māvate deṣṇaṃ yatpārye divi ||
7,032.22  abhi tvā śūra nonumo'dugdhā iva dhenavaḥ |
7,032.22 īśānamasya jagataḥ svardṛśamīśānamindra tasthuṣaḥ ||
7,032.23  na tvāvāṃ anyo divyo na pārthivo na jāto na janiṣyate |
7,032.23 aśvāyanto maghavannindra vājino gavyantastvā havāmahe ||
7,032.24  abhī ṣatastadā bharendra jyāyaḥ kanīyasaḥ |
7,032.24 purūvasurhi maghavansanādasi bharebhare ca havyaḥ ||
7,032.25  parā ṇudasva maghavannamitrānsuvedā no vasū kṛdhi |
7,032.25 asmākaṃ bodhyavitā mahādhane bhavā vṛdhaḥ sakhīnām ||
7,032.26  indra kratuṃ na ā bhara pitā putrebhyo yathā |
7,032.26 śikṣā ṇo asminpuruhūta yāmani jīvā jyotiraśīmahi ||
7,032.27  mā no ajñātā vṛjanā durādhyo māśivāso ava kramuḥ |
7,032.27 tvayā vayaṃ pravataḥ śaśvatīrapo'ti śūra tarāmasi ||

7,033.01  śvityañco mā dakṣiṇataskapardā dhiyañjinvāso abhi hi pramanduḥ |
7,033.01 uttiṣṭhanvoce pari barhiṣo nṝnna me dūrādavitave vasiṣṭhāḥ ||
7,033.02  dūrādindramanayannā sutena tiro vaiśantamati pāntamugram |
7,033.02 pāśadyumnasya vāyatasya somātsutādindro'vṛṇītā vasiṣṭhān ||
7,033.03  evennu kaṃ sindhumebhistatārevennu kaṃ bhedamebhirjaghāna |
7,033.03 evennu kaṃ dāśarājñe sudāsaṃ prāvadindro brahmaṇā vo vasiṣṭhāḥ ||
7,033.04  juṣṭī naro brahmaṇā vaḥ pitṝṇāmakṣamavyayaṃ na kilā riṣātha |
7,033.04 yacchakvarīṣu bṛhatā raveṇendre śuṣmamadadhātā vasiṣṭhāḥ ||
7,033.05  uddyāmivettṛṣṇajo nāthitāso'dīdhayurdāśarājñe vṛtāsaḥ |
7,033.05 vasiṣṭhasya stuvata indro aśroduruṃ tṛtsubhyo akṛṇodu lokam ||
7,033.06  daṇḍā ivedgoajanāsa āsanparicchinnā bharatā arbhakāsaḥ |
7,033.06 abhavacca puraetā vasiṣṭha ādittṛtsūnāṃ viśo aprathanta ||
7,033.07  trayaḥ kṛṇvanti bhuvaneṣu retastisraḥ prajā āryā jyotiragrāḥ |
7,033.07 trayo gharmāsa uṣasaṃ sacante sarvāṃ ittāṃ anu vidurvasiṣṭhāḥ ||
7,033.08  sūryasyeva vakṣatho jyotireṣāṃ samudrasyeva mahimā gabhīraḥ |
7,033.08 vātasyeva prajavo nānyena stomo vasiṣṭhā anvetave vaḥ ||
7,033.09  ta inniṇyaṃ hṛdayasya praketaiḥ sahasravalśamabhi saṃ caranti |
7,033.09 yamena tataṃ paridhiṃ vayanto'psarasa upa sedurvasiṣṭhāḥ ||
7,033.10  vidyuto jyotiḥ pari saṃjihānaṃ mitrāvaruṇā yadapaśyatāṃ tvā |
7,033.10 tatte janmotaikaṃ vasiṣṭhāgastyo yattvā viśa ājabhāra ||
7,033.11  utāsi maitrāvaruṇo vasiṣṭhorvaśyā brahmanmanaso'dhi jātaḥ |
7,033.11 drapsaṃ skannaṃ brahmaṇā daivyena viśve devāḥ puṣkare tvādadanta ||
7,033.12  sa praketa ubhayasya pravidvānsahasradāna uta vā sadānaḥ |
7,033.12 yamena tataṃ paridhiṃ vayiṣyannapsarasaḥ pari jajñe vasiṣṭhaḥ ||
7,033.13  satre ha jātāviṣitā namobhiḥ kumbhe retaḥ siṣicatuḥ samānam |
7,033.13 tato ha māna udiyāya madhyāttato jātamṛṣimāhurvasiṣṭham ||
7,033.14  ukthabhṛtaṃ sāmabhṛtaṃ bibharti grāvāṇaṃ bibhratpra vadātyagre |
7,033.14 upainamādhvaṃ sumanasyamānā ā vo gacchāti pratṛdo vasiṣṭhaḥ ||

7,034.01 pra śukraitu devī manīṣā asmatsutaṣṭo ratho na vājī ||
7,034.02 viduḥ pṛthivyā divo janitraṃ śṛṇvantyāpo adha kṣarantīḥ ||
7,034.03 āpaścidasmai pinvanta pṛthvīrvṛtreṣu śūrā maṃsanta ugrāḥ ||
7,034.04 ā dhūrṣvasmai dadhātāśvānindro na vajrī hiraṇyabāhuḥ ||
7,034.05 abhi pra sthātāheva yajñaṃ yāteva patmantmanā hinota ||
7,034.06 tmanā samatsu hinota yajñaṃ dadhāta ketuṃ janāya vīram ||
7,034.07 udasya śuṣmādbhānurnārta bibharti bhāraṃ pṛthivī na bhūma ||
7,034.08 hvayāmi devāṃ ayāturagne sādhannṛtena dhiyaṃ dadhāmi ||
7,034.09 abhi vo devīṃ dhiyaṃ dadhidhvaṃ pra vo devatrā vācaṃ kṛṇudhvam ||
7,034.10 ā caṣṭa āsāṃ pātho nadīnāṃ varuṇa ugraḥ sahasracakṣāḥ ||
7,034.11 rājā rāṣṭrānāṃ peśo nadīnāmanuttamasmai kṣatraṃ viśvāyu ||
7,034.12 aviṣṭo asmānviśvāsu vikṣvadyuṃ kṛṇota śaṃsaṃ ninitsoḥ ||
7,034.13 vyetu didyuddviṣāmaśevā yuyota viṣvagrapastanūnām ||
7,034.14 avīnno agnirhavyānnamobhiḥ preṣṭho asmā adhāyi stomaḥ ||
7,034.15 sajūrdevebhirapāṃ napātaṃ sakhāyaṃ kṛdhvaṃ śivo no astu ||
7,034.16 abjāmukthairahiṃ gṛṇīṣe budhne nadīnāṃ rajassu ṣīdan ||
7,034.17 mā no'hirbudhnyo riṣe dhānmā yajño asya sridhadṛtāyoḥ ||
7,034.18 uta na eṣu nṛṣu śravo dhuḥ pra rāye yantu śardhanto aryaḥ ||
7,034.19 tapanti śatruṃ svarṇa bhūmā mahāsenāso amebhireṣām ||
7,034.20 ā yannaḥ patnīrgamantyacchā tvaṣṭā supāṇirdadhātu vīrān ||
7,034.21 prati na stomaṃ tvaṣṭā juṣeta syādasme aramatirvasūyuḥ ||
7,034.22  tā no rāsanrātiṣāco vasūnyā rodasī varuṇānī śṛṇotu |
7,034.22 varūtrībhiḥ suśaraṇo no astu tvaṣṭā sudatro vi dadhātu rāyaḥ ||
7,034.23  tanno rāyaḥ parvatāstanna āpastadrātiṣāca oṣadhīruta dyauḥ |
7,034.23 vanaspatibhiḥ pṛthivī sajoṣā ubhe rodasī pari pāsato naḥ ||
7,034.24  anu tadurvī rodasī jihātāmanu dyukṣo varuṇa indrasakhā |
7,034.24 anu viśve maruto ye sahāso rāyaḥ syāma dharuṇaṃ dhiyadhyai ||
7,034.25  tanna indro varuṇo mitro agnirāpa oṣadhīrvanino juṣanta |
7,034.25 śarmansyāma marutāmupasthe yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,035.01  śaṃ na indrāgnī bhavatāmavobhiḥ śaṃ na indrāvaruṇā rātahavyā |
7,035.01 śamindrāsomā suvitāya śaṃ yoḥ śaṃ na indrāpūṣaṇā vājasātau ||
7,035.02  śaṃ no bhagaḥ śamu naḥ śaṃso astu śaṃ naḥ purandhiḥ śamu santu rāyaḥ |
7,035.02 śaṃ naḥ satyasya suyamasya śaṃsaḥ śaṃ no aryamā purujāto astu ||
7,035.03  śaṃ no dhātā śamu dhartā no astu śaṃ na urūcī bhavatu svadhābhiḥ |
7,035.03 śaṃ rodasī bṛhatī śaṃ no adriḥ śaṃ no devānāṃ suhavāni santu ||
7,035.04  śaṃ no agnirjyotiranīko astu śaṃ no mitrāvaruṇāvaśvinā śam |
7,035.04 śaṃ naḥ sukṛtāṃ sukṛtāni santu śaṃ na iṣiro abhi vātu vātaḥ ||
7,035.05  śaṃ no dyāvāpṛthivī pūrvahūtau śamantarikṣaṃ dṛśaye no astu |
7,035.05 śaṃ na oṣadhīrvanino bhavantu śaṃ no rajasaspatirastu jiṣṇuḥ ||
7,035.06  śaṃ na indro vasubhirdevo astu śamādityebhirvaruṇaḥ suśaṃsaḥ |
7,035.06 śaṃ no rudro rudrebhirjalāṣaḥ śaṃ nastvaṣṭā gnābhiriha śṛṇotu ||
7,035.07  śaṃ naḥ somo bhavatu brahma śaṃ naḥ śaṃ no grāvāṇaḥ śamu santu yajñāḥ |
7,035.07 śaṃ naḥ svarūṇāṃ mitayo bhavantu śaṃ naḥ prasvaḥ śaṃ vastu vediḥ ||
7,035.08  śaṃ naḥ sūrya urucakṣā udetu śaṃ naścatasraḥ pradiśo bhavantu |
7,035.08 śaṃ naḥ parvatā dhruvayo bhavantu śaṃ naḥ sindhavaḥ śamu santvāpaḥ ||
7,035.09  śaṃ no aditirbhavatu vratebhiḥ śaṃ no bhavantu marutaḥ svarkāḥ |
7,035.09 śaṃ no viṣṇuḥ śamu pūṣā no astu śaṃ no bhavitraṃ śaṃ vastu vāyuḥ ||
7,035.10  śaṃ no devaḥ savitā trāyamāṇaḥ śaṃ no bhavantūṣaso vibhātīḥ |
7,035.10 śaṃ naḥ parjanyo bhavatu prajābhyaḥ śaṃ naḥ kṣetrasya patirastu śambhuḥ ||
7,035.11  śaṃ no devā viśvadevā bhavantu śaṃ sarasvatī saha dhībhirastu |
7,035.11 śamabhiṣācaḥ śamu rātiṣācaḥ śaṃ no divyāḥ pārthivāḥ śaṃ no apyāḥ ||
7,035.12  śaṃ naḥ satyasya patayo bhavantu śaṃ no arvantaḥ śamu santu gāvaḥ |
7,035.12 śaṃ na ṛbhavaḥ sukṛtaḥ suhastāḥ śaṃ no bhavantu pitaro haveṣu ||
7,035.13  śaṃ no aja ekapāddevo astu śaṃ no'hirbudhnyaḥ śaṃ samudraḥ |
7,035.13 śaṃ no apāṃ napātperurastu śaṃ naḥ pṛśnirbhavatu devagopā ||
7,035.14  ādityā rudrā vasavo juṣantedaṃ brahma kriyamāṇaṃ navīyaḥ |
7,035.14 śṛṇvantu no divyāḥ pārthivāso gojātā uta ye yajñiyāsaḥ ||
7,035.15  ye devānāṃ yajñiyā yajñiyānāṃ manoryajatrā amṛtā ṛtajñāḥ |
7,035.15 te no rāsantāmurugāyamadya yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,036.01  pra brahmaitu sadanādṛtasya vi raśmibhiḥ sasṛje sūryo gāḥ |
7,036.01 vi sānunā pṛthivī sasra urvī pṛthu pratīkamadhyedhe agniḥ ||
7,036.02  imāṃ vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā suvṛktimiṣaṃ na kṛṇve asurā navīyaḥ |
7,036.02 ino vāmanyaḥ padavīradabdho janaṃ ca mitro yatati bruvāṇaḥ ||
7,036.03  ā vātasya dhrajato ranta ityā apīpayanta dhenavo na sūdāḥ |
7,036.03 maho divaḥ sadane jāyamāno'cikradadvṛṣabhaḥ sasminnūdhan ||
7,036.04  girā ya etā yunajaddharī ta indra priyā surathā śūra dhāyū |
7,036.04 pra yo manyuṃ ririkṣato minātyā sukratumaryamaṇaṃ vavṛtyām ||
7,036.05  yajante asya sakhyaṃ vayaśca namasvinaḥ sva ṛtasya dhāman |
7,036.05 vi pṛkṣo bābadhe nṛbhi stavāna idaṃ namo rudrāya preṣṭham ||
7,036.06  ā yatsākaṃ yaśaso vāvaśānāḥ sarasvatī saptathī sindhumātā |
7,036.06 yāḥ suṣvayanta sudughāḥ sudhārā abhi svena payasā pīpyānāḥ ||
7,036.07  uta tye no maruto mandasānā dhiyaṃ tokaṃ ca vājino'vantu |
7,036.07 mā naḥ pari khyadakṣarā carantyavīvṛdhanyujyaṃ te rayiṃ naḥ ||
7,036.08  pra vo mahīmaramatiṃ kṛṇudhvaṃ pra pūṣaṇaṃ vidathyaṃ na vīram |
7,036.08 bhagaṃ dhiyo'vitāraṃ no asyāḥ sātau vājaṃ rātiṣācaṃ purandhim ||
7,036.09  acchāyaṃ vo marutaḥ śloka etvacchā viṣṇuṃ niṣiktapāmavobhiḥ |
7,036.09 uta prajāyai gṛṇate vayo dhuryūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,037.01  ā vo vāhiṣṭho vahatu stavadhyai ratho vājā ṛbhukṣaṇo amṛktaḥ |
7,037.01 abhi tripṛṣṭhaiḥ savaneṣu somairmade suśiprā mahabhiḥ pṛṇadhvam ||
7,037.02  yūyaṃ ha ratnaṃ maghavatsu dhattha svardṛśa ṛbhukṣaṇo amṛktam |
7,037.02 saṃ yajñeṣu svadhāvantaḥ pibadhvaṃ vi no rādhāṃsi matibhirdayadhvam ||
7,037.03  uvocitha hi maghavandeṣṇaṃ maho arbhasya vasuno vibhāge |
7,037.03 ubhā te pūrṇā vasunā gabhastī na sūnṛtā ni yamate vasavyā ||
7,037.04  tvamindra svayaśā ṛbhukṣā vājo na sādhurastameṣyṛkvā |
7,037.04 vayaṃ nu te dāśvāṃsaḥ syāma brahma kṛṇvanto harivo vasiṣṭhāḥ ||
7,037.05  sanitāsi pravato dāśuṣe cidyābhirviveṣo haryaśva dhībhiḥ |
7,037.05 vavanmā nu te yujyābhirūtī kadā na indra rāya ā daśasyeḥ ||
7,037.06  vāsayasīva vedhasastvaṃ naḥ kadā na indra vacaso bubodhaḥ |
7,037.06 astaṃ tātyā dhiyā rayiṃ suvīraṃ pṛkṣo no arvā nyuhīta vājī ||
7,037.07  abhi yaṃ devī nirṛtiścidīśe nakṣanta indraṃ śaradaḥ supṛkṣaḥ |
7,037.07 upa tribandhurjaradaṣṭimetyasvaveśaṃ yaṃ kṛṇavanta martāḥ ||
7,037.08  ā no rādhāṃsi savita stavadhyā ā rāyo yantu parvatasya rātau |
7,037.08 sadā no divyaḥ pāyuḥ siṣaktu yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,038.01  udu ṣya devaḥ savitā yayāma hiraṇyayīmamatiṃ yāmaśiśret |
7,038.01 nūnaṃ bhago havyo mānuṣebhirvi yo ratnā purūvasurdadhāti ||
7,038.02  udu tiṣṭha savitaḥ śrudhyasya hiraṇyapāṇe prabhṛtāvṛtasya |
7,038.02 vyurvīṃ pṛthvīmamatiṃ sṛjāna ā nṛbhyo martabhojanaṃ suvānaḥ ||
7,038.03  api ṣṭutaḥ savitā devo astu yamā cidviśve vasavo gṛṇanti |
7,038.03 sa na stomānnamasyaścano dhādviśvebhiḥ pātu pāyubhirni sūrīn ||
7,038.04  abhi yaṃ devyaditirgṛṇāti savaṃ devasya saviturjuṣāṇā |
7,038.04 abhi samrājo varuṇo gṛṇantyabhi mitrāso aryamā sajoṣāḥ ||
7,038.05  abhi ye mitho vanuṣaḥ sapante rātiṃ divo rātiṣācaḥ pṛthivyāḥ |
7,038.05 ahirbudhnya uta naḥ śṛṇotu varūtryekadhenubhirni pātu ||
7,038.06  anu tanno jāspatirmaṃsīṣṭa ratnaṃ devasya savituriyānaḥ |
7,038.06 bhagamugro'vase johavīti bhagamanugro adha yāti ratnam ||
7,038.07  śaṃ no bhavantu vājino haveṣu devatātā mitadravaḥ svarkāḥ |
7,038.07 jambhayanto'hiṃ vṛkaṃ rakṣāṃsi sanemyasmadyuyavannamīvāḥ ||
7,038.08  vājevāje'vata vājino no dhaneṣu viprā amṛtā ṛtajñāḥ |
7,038.08 asya madhvaḥ pibata mādayadhvaṃ tṛptā yāta pathibhirdevayānaiḥ ||

7,039.01  ūrdhvo agniḥ sumatiṃ vasvo aśretpratīcī jūrṇirdevatātimeti |
7,039.01 bhejāte adrī rathyeva panthāmṛtaṃ hotā na iṣito yajāti ||
7,039.02  pra vāvṛje suprayā barhireṣāmā viśpatīva bīriṭa iyāte |
7,039.02 viśāmaktoruṣasaḥ pūrvahūtau vāyuḥ pūṣā svastaye niyutvān ||
7,039.03  jmayā atra vasavo ranta devā urāvantarikṣe marjayanta śubhrāḥ |
7,039.03 arvākpatha urujrayaḥ kṛṇudhvaṃ śrotā dūtasya jagmuṣo no asya ||
7,039.04  te hi yajñeṣu yajñiyāsa ūmāḥ sadhasthaṃ viśve abhi santi devāḥ |
7,039.04 tāṃ adhvara uśato yakṣyagne śruṣṭī bhagaṃ nāsatyā purandhim ||
7,039.05  āgne giro diva ā pṛthivyā mitraṃ vaha varuṇamindramagnim |
7,039.05 āryamaṇamaditiṃ viṣṇumeṣāṃ sarasvatī maruto mādayantām ||
7,039.06  rare havyaṃ matibhiryajñiyānāṃ nakṣatkāmaṃ martyānāmasinvan |
7,039.06 dhātā rayimavidasyaṃ sadāsāṃ sakṣīmahi yujyebhirnu devaiḥ ||
7,039.07  nū rodasī abhiṣṭute vasiṣṭhairṛtāvāno varuṇo mitro agniḥ |
7,039.07 yacchantu candrā upamaṃ no arkaṃ yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,040.01  o śruṣṭirvidathyā sametu prati stomaṃ dadhīmahi turāṇām |
7,040.01 yadadya devaḥ savitā suvāti syāmāsya ratnino vibhāge ||
7,040.02  mitrastanno varuṇo rodasī ca dyubhaktamindro aryamā dadātu |
7,040.02 dideṣṭu devyaditī rekṇo vāyuśca yanniyuvaite bhagaśca ||
7,040.03  sedugro astu marutaḥ sa śuṣmī yaṃ martyaṃ pṛṣadaśvā avātha |
7,040.03 utemagniḥ sarasvatī junanti na tasya rāyaḥ paryetāsti ||
7,040.04  ayaṃ hi netā varuṇa ṛtasya mitro rājāno aryamāpo dhuḥ |
7,040.04 suhavā devyaditiranarvā te no aṃho ati parṣannariṣṭān ||
7,040.05  asya devasya mīḻhuṣo vayā viṣṇoreṣasya prabhṛthe havirbhiḥ |
7,040.05 vide hi rudro rudriyaṃ mahitvaṃ yāsiṣṭaṃ vartiraśvināvirāvat ||
7,040.06  mātra pūṣannāghṛṇa irasyo varūtrī yadrātiṣācaśca rāsan |
7,040.06 mayobhuvo no arvanto ni pāntu vṛṣṭiṃ parijmā vāto dadātu ||
7,040.07  nū rodasī abhiṣṭute vasiṣṭhairṛtāvāno varuṇo mitro agniḥ |
7,040.07 yacchantu candrā upamaṃ no arkaṃ yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,041.01  prātaragniṃ prātarindraṃ havāmahe prātarmitrāvaruṇā prātaraśvinā |
7,041.01 prātarbhagaṃ pūṣaṇaṃ brahmaṇaspatiṃ prātaḥ somamuta rudraṃ huvema ||
7,041.02  prātarjitaṃ bhagamugraṃ huvema vayaṃ putramaditeryo vidhartā |
7,041.02 ādhraścidyaṃ manyamānasturaścidrājā cidyaṃ bhagaṃ bhakṣītyāha ||
7,041.03  bhaga praṇetarbhaga satyarādho bhagemāṃ dhiyamudavā dadannaḥ |
7,041.03 bhaga pra ṇo janaya gobhiraśvairbhaga pra nṛbhirnṛvantaḥ syāma ||
7,041.04  utedānīṃ bhagavantaḥ syāmota prapitva uta madhye ahnām |
7,041.04 utoditā maghavansūryasya vayaṃ devānāṃ sumatau syāma ||
7,041.05  bhaga eva bhagavāṃ astu devāstena vayaṃ bhagavantaḥ syāma |
7,041.05 taṃ tvā bhaga sarva ijjohavīti sa no bhaga puraetā bhaveha ||
7,041.06  samadhvarāyoṣaso namanta dadhikrāveva śucaye padāya |
7,041.06 arvācīnaṃ vasuvidaṃ bhagaṃ no rathamivāśvā vājina ā vahantu ||
7,041.07  aśvāvatīrgomatīrna uṣāso vīravatīḥ sadamucchantu bhadrāḥ |
7,041.07 ghṛtaṃ duhānā viśvataḥ prapītā yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,042.01  pra brahmāṇo aṅgiraso nakṣanta pra krandanurnabhanyasya vetu |
7,042.01 pra dhenava udapruto navanta yujyātāmadrī adhvarasya peśaḥ ||
7,042.02  sugaste agne sanavitto adhvā yukṣvā sute harito rohitaśca |
7,042.02 ye vā sadmannaruṣā vīravāho huve devānāṃ janimāni sattaḥ ||
7,042.03  samu vo yajñaṃ mahayannamobhiḥ pra hotā mandro ririca upāke |
7,042.03 yajasva su purvaṇīka devānā yajñiyāmaramatiṃ vavṛtyāḥ ||
7,042.04  yadā vīrasya revato duroṇe syonaśīratithirāciketat |
7,042.04 suprīto agniḥ sudhito dama ā sa viśe dāti vāryamiyatyai ||
7,042.05  imaṃ no agne adhvaraṃ juṣasva marutsvindre yaśasaṃ kṛdhī naḥ |
7,042.05 ā naktā barhiḥ sadatāmuṣāsośantā mitrāvaruṇā yajeha ||
7,042.06  evāgniṃ sahasyaṃ vasiṣṭho rāyaskāmo viśvapsnyasya staut |
7,042.06 iṣaṃ rayiṃ paprathadvājamasme yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,043.01  pra vo yajñeṣu devayanto arcandyāvā namobhiḥ pṛthivī iṣadhyai |
7,043.01 yeṣāṃ brahmāṇyasamāni viprā viṣvagviyanti vanino na śākhāḥ ||
7,043.02  pra yajña etu hetvo na saptirudyacchadhvaṃ samanaso ghṛtācīḥ |
7,043.02 stṛṇīta barhiradhvarāya sādhūrdhvā śocīṃṣi devayūnyasthuḥ ||
7,043.03  ā putrāso na mātaraṃ vibhṛtrāḥ sānau devāso barhiṣaḥ sadantu |
7,043.03 ā viśvācī vidathyāmanaktvagne mā no devatātā mṛdhaskaḥ ||
7,043.04  te sīṣapanta joṣamā yajatrā ṛtasya dhārāḥ sudughā duhānāḥ |
7,043.04 jyeṣṭhaṃ vo adya maha ā vasūnāmā gantana samanaso yati ṣṭha ||
7,043.05  evā no agne vikṣvā daśasya tvayā vayaṃ sahasāvannāskrāḥ |
7,043.05 rāyā yujā sadhamādo ariṣṭā yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,044.01  dadhikrāṃ vaḥ prathamamaśvinoṣasamagniṃ samiddhaṃ bhagamūtaye huve |
7,044.01 indraṃ viṣṇuṃ pūṣaṇaṃ brahmaṇaspatimādityāndyāvāpṛthivī apaḥ svaḥ ||
7,044.02  dadhikrāmu namasā bodhayanta udīrāṇā yajñamupaprayantaḥ |
7,044.02 iḻāṃ devīṃ barhiṣi sādayanto'śvinā viprā suhavā huvema ||
7,044.03  dadhikrāvāṇaṃ bubudhāno agnimupa bruva uṣasaṃ sūryaṃ gām |
7,044.03 bradhnaṃ māṃścatorvaruṇasya babhruṃ te viśvāsmadduritā yāvayantu ||
7,044.04  dadhikrāvā prathamo vājyarvāgre rathānāṃ bhavati prajānan |
7,044.04 saṃvidāna uṣasā sūryeṇādityebhirvasubhiraṅgirobhiḥ ||
7,044.05  ā no dadhikrāḥ pathyāmanaktvṛtasya panthāmanvetavā u |
7,044.05 śṛṇotu no daivyaṃ śardho agniḥ śṛṇvantu viśve mahiṣā amūrāḥ ||

7,045.01  ā devo yātu savitā suratno'ntarikṣaprā vahamāno aśvaiḥ |
7,045.01 haste dadhāno naryā purūṇi niveśayañca prasuvañca bhūma ||
7,045.02  udasya bāhū śithirā bṛhantā hiraṇyayā divo antāṃ anaṣṭām |
7,045.02 nūnaṃ so asya mahimā paniṣṭa sūraścidasmā anu dādapasyām ||
7,045.03  sa ghā no devaḥ savitā sahāvā sāviṣadvasupatirvasūni |
7,045.03 viśrayamāṇo amatimurūcīṃ martabhojanamadha rāsate naḥ ||
7,045.04  imā giraḥ savitāraṃ sujihvaṃ pūrṇagabhastimīḻate supāṇim |
7,045.04 citraṃ vayo bṛhadasme dadhātu yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,046.01  imā rudrāya sthiradhanvane giraḥ kṣipreṣave devāya svadhāvne |
7,046.01 aṣāḻhāya sahamānāya vedhase tigmāyudhāya bharatā śṛṇotu naḥ ||
7,046.02  sa hi kṣayeṇa kṣamyasya janmanaḥ sāmrājyena divyasya cetati |
7,046.02 avannavantīrupa no duraścarānamīvo rudra jāsu no bhava ||
7,046.03  yā te didyudavasṛṣṭā divaspari kṣmayā carati pari sā vṛṇaktu naḥ |
7,046.03 sahasraṃ te svapivāta bheṣajā mā nastokeṣu tanayeṣu rīriṣaḥ ||
7,046.04  mā no vadhī rudra mā parā dā mā te bhūma prasitau hīḻitasya |
7,046.04 ā no bhaja barhiṣi jīvaśaṃse yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,047.01  āpo yaṃ vaḥ prathamaṃ devayanta indrapānamūrmimakṛṇvateḻaḥ |
7,047.01 taṃ vo vayaṃ śucimaripramadya ghṛtapruṣaṃ madhumantaṃ vanema ||
7,047.02  tamūrmimāpo madhumattamaṃ vo'pāṃ napādavatvāśuhemā |
7,047.02 yasminnindro vasubhirmādayāte tamaśyāma devayanto vo adya ||
7,047.03  śatapavitrāḥ svadhayā madantīrdevīrdevānāmapi yanti pāthaḥ |
7,047.03 tā indrasya na minanti vratāni sindhubhyo havyaṃ ghṛtavajjuhota ||
7,047.04  yāḥ sūryo raśmibhirātatāna yābhya indro aradadgātumūrmim |
7,047.04 te sindhavo varivo dhātanā no yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,048.01  ṛbhukṣaṇo vājā mādayadhvamasme naro maghavānaḥ sutasya |
7,048.01 ā vo'rvācaḥ kratavo na yātāṃ vibhvo rathaṃ naryaṃ vartayantu ||
7,048.02  ṛbhurṛbhubhirabhi vaḥ syāma vibhvo vibhubhiḥ śavasā śavāṃsi |
7,048.02 vājo asmāṃ avatu vājasātāvindreṇa yujā taruṣema vṛtram ||
7,048.03  te ciddhi pūrvīrabhi santi śāsā viśvāṃ arya uparatāti vanvan |
7,048.03 indro vibhvāṃ ṛbhukṣā vājo aryaḥ śatrormithatyā kṛṇavanvi nṛmṇam ||
7,048.04  nū devāso varivaḥ kartanā no bhūta no viśve'vase sajoṣāḥ |
7,048.04 samasme iṣaṃ vasavo dadīranyūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,049.01  samudrajyeṣṭhāḥ salilasya madhyātpunānā yantyaniviśamānāḥ |
7,049.01 indro yā vajrī vṛṣabho rarāda tā āpo devīriha māmavantu ||
7,049.02  yā āpo divyā uta vā sravanti khanitrimā uta vā yāḥ svayañjāḥ |
7,049.02 samudrārthā yāḥ śucayaḥ pāvakāstā āpo devīriha māmavantu ||
7,049.03  yāsāṃ rājā varuṇo yāti madhye satyānṛte avapaśyañjanānām |
7,049.03 madhuścutaḥ śucayo yāḥ pāvakāstā āpo devīriha māmavantu ||
7,049.04  yāsu rājā varuṇo yāsu somo viśve devā yāsūrjaṃ madanti |
7,049.04 vaiśvānaro yāsvagniḥ praviṣṭastā āpo devīriha māmavantu ||

7,050.01  ā māṃ mitrāvaruṇeha rakṣataṃ kulāyayadviśvayanmā na ā gan |
7,050.01 ajakāvaṃ durdṛśīkaṃ tiro dadhe mā māṃ padyena rapasā vidattsaruḥ ||
7,050.02  yadvijāmanparuṣi vandanaṃ bhuvadaṣṭhīvantau pari kulphau ca dehat |
7,050.02 agniṣṭacchocannapa bādhatāmito mā māṃ padyena rapasā vidattsaruḥ ||
7,050.03  yacchalmalau bhavati yannadīṣu yadoṣadhībhyaḥ pari jāyate viṣam |
7,050.03 viśve devā niritastatsuvantu mā māṃ padyena rapasā vidattsaruḥ ||
7,050.04  yāḥ pravato nivata udvata udanvatīranudakāśca yāḥ |
7,050.04 tā asmabhyaṃ payasā pinvamānāḥ śivā devīraśipadā bhavantu sarvā nadyo aśimidā bhavantu ||

7,051.01  ādityānāmavasā nūtanena sakṣīmahi śarmaṇā śantamena |
7,051.01 anāgāstve adititve turāsa imaṃ yajñaṃ dadhatu śroṣamāṇāḥ ||
7,051.02  ādityāso aditirmādayantāṃ mitro aryamā varuṇo rajiṣṭhāḥ |
7,051.02 asmākaṃ santu bhuvanasya gopāḥ pibantu somamavase no adya ||
7,051.03  ādityā viśve marutaśca viśve devāśca viśva ṛbhavaśca viśve |
7,051.03 indro agniraśvinā tuṣṭuvānā yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,052.01  ādityāso aditayaḥ syāma pūrdevatrā vasavo martyatrā |
7,052.01 sanema mitrāvaruṇā sananto bhavema dyāvāpṛthivī bhavantaḥ ||
7,052.02  mitrastanno varuṇo māmahanta śarma tokāya tanayāya gopāḥ |
7,052.02 mā vo bhujemānyajātameno mā tatkarma vasavo yaccayadhve ||
7,052.03  turaṇyavo'ṅgiraso nakṣanta ratnaṃ devasya savituriyānāḥ |
7,052.03 pitā ca tanno mahānyajatro viśve devāḥ samanaso juṣanta ||

7,053.01  pra dyāvā yajñaiḥ pṛthivī namobhiḥ sabādha īḻe bṛhatī yajatre |
7,053.01 te ciddhi pūrve kavayo gṛṇantaḥ puro mahī dadhire devaputre ||
7,053.02  pra pūrvaje pitarā navyasībhirgīrbhiḥ kṛṇudhvaṃ sadane ṛtasya |
7,053.02 ā no dyāvāpṛthivī daivyena janena yātaṃ mahi vāṃ varūtham ||
7,053.03  uto hi vāṃ ratnadheyāni santi purūṇi dyāvāpṛthivī sudāse |
7,053.03 asme dhattaṃ yadasadaskṛdhoyu yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,054.01  vāstoṣpate prati jānīhyasmānsvāveśo anamīvo bhavā naḥ |
7,054.01 yattvemahe prati tanno juṣasva śaṃ no bhava dvipade śaṃ catuṣpade ||
7,054.02  vāstoṣpate prataraṇo na edhi gayasphāno gobhiraśvebhirindo |
7,054.02 ajarāsaste sakhye syāma piteva putrānprati no juṣasva ||
7,054.03  vāstoṣpate śagmayā saṃsadā te sakṣīmahi raṇvayā gātumatyā |
7,054.03 pāhi kṣema uta yoge varaṃ no yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,055.01  amīvahā vāstoṣpate viśvā rūpāṇyāviśan |
7,055.01 sakhā suśeva edhi naḥ ||
7,055.02  yadarjuna sārameya dataḥ piśaṅga yacchase |
7,055.02 vīva bhrājanta ṛṣṭaya upa srakveṣu bapsato ni ṣu svapa ||
7,055.03  stenaṃ rāya sārameya taskaraṃ vā punaḥsara |
7,055.03 stotṝnindrasya rāyasi kimasmānducchunāyase ni ṣu svapa ||
7,055.04  tvaṃ sūkarasya dardṛhi tava dardartu sūkaraḥ |
7,055.04 stotṝnindrasya rāyasi kimasmānducchunāyase ni ṣu svapa ||
7,055.05  sastu mātā sastu pitā sastu śvā sastu viśpatiḥ |
7,055.05 sasantu sarve jñātayaḥ sastvayamabhito janaḥ ||
7,055.06  ya āste yaśca carati yaśca paśyati no janaḥ |
7,055.06 teṣāṃ saṃ hanmo akṣāṇi yathedaṃ harmyaṃ tathā ||
7,055.07  sahasraśṛṅgo vṛṣabho yaḥ samudrādudācarat |
7,055.07 tenā sahasyenā vayaṃ ni janānsvāpayāmasi ||
7,055.08  proṣṭheśayā vahyeśayā nārīryāstalpaśīvarīḥ |
7,055.08 striyo yāḥ puṇyagandhāstāḥ sarvāḥ svāpayāmasi ||

7,056.01  ka īṃ vyaktā naraḥ sanīḻā rudrasya maryā adha svaśvāḥ ||
7,056.02  nakirhyeṣāṃ janūṃṣi veda te aṅga vidre mitho janitram ||
7,056.03  abhi svapūbhirmitho vapanta vātasvanasaḥ śyenā aspṛdhran ||
7,056.04  etāni dhīro niṇyā ciketa pṛśniryadūdho mahī jabhāra ||
7,056.05  sā viṭsuvīrā marudbhirastu sanātsahantī puṣyantī nṛmṇam ||
7,056.06  yāmaṃ yeṣṭhāḥ śubhā śobhiṣṭhāḥ śriyā sammiślā ojobhirugrāḥ ||
7,056.07  ugraṃ va oja sthirā śavāṃsyadhā marudbhirgaṇastuviṣmān ||
7,056.08  śubhro vaḥ śuṣmaḥ krudhmī manāṃsi dhunirmuniriva śardhasya dhṛṣṇoḥ ||
7,056.09  sanemyasmadyuyota didyuṃ mā vo durmatiriha praṇaṅnaḥ ||
7,056.10  priyā vo nāma huve turāṇāmā yattṛpanmaruto vāvaśānāḥ ||
7,056.11  svāyudhāsa iṣmiṇaḥ suniṣkā uta svayaṃ tanvaḥ śumbhamānāḥ ||
7,056.12  śucī vo havyā marutaḥ śucīnāṃ śuciṃ hinomyadhvaraṃ śucibhyaḥ |
7,056.12 ṛtena satyamṛtasāpa āyañchucijanmānaḥ śucayaḥ pāvakāḥ ||
7,056.13  aṃseṣvā marutaḥ khādayo vo vakṣassu rukmā upaśiśriyāṇāḥ |
7,056.13 vi vidyuto na vṛṣṭibhī rucānā anu svadhāmāyudhairyacchamānāḥ ||
7,056.14  pra budhnyā va īrate mahāṃsi pra nāmāni prayajyavastiradhvam |
7,056.14 sahasriyaṃ damyaṃ bhāgametaṃ gṛhamedhīyaṃ maruto juṣadhvam ||
7,056.15  yadi stutasya maruto adhīthetthā viprasya vājino havīman |
7,056.15 makṣū rāyaḥ suvīryasya dāta nū cidyamanya ādabhadarāvā ||
7,056.16  atyāso na ye marutaḥ svañco yakṣadṛśo na śubhayanta maryāḥ |
7,056.16 te harmyeṣṭhāḥ śiśavo na śubhrā vatsāso na prakrīḻinaḥ payodhāḥ ||
7,056.17  daśasyanto no maruto mṛḻantu varivasyanto rodasī sumeke |
7,056.17 āre gohā nṛhā vadho vo astu sumnebhirasme vasavo namadhvam ||
7,056.18  ā vo hotā johavīti sattaḥ satrācīṃ rātiṃ maruto gṛṇānaḥ |
7,056.18 ya īvato vṛṣaṇo asti gopāḥ so advayāvī havate va ukthaiḥ ||
7,056.19  ime turaṃ maruto rāmayantīme sahaḥ sahasa ā namanti |
7,056.19 ime śaṃsaṃ vanuṣyato ni pānti guru dveṣo araruṣe dadhanti ||
7,056.20  ime radhraṃ cinmaruto junanti bhṛmiṃ cidyathā vasavo juṣanta |
7,056.20 apa bādhadhvaṃ vṛṣaṇastamāṃsi dhatta viśvaṃ tanayaṃ tokamasme ||
7,056.21  mā vo dātrānmaruto nirarāma mā paścāddaghma rathyo vibhāge |
7,056.21 ā na spārhe bhajatanā vasavye yadīṃ sujātaṃ vṛṣaṇo vo asti ||
7,056.22  saṃ yaddhananta manyubhirjanāsaḥ śūrā yahvīṣvoṣadhīṣu vikṣu |
7,056.22 adha smā no maruto rudriyāsastrātāro bhūta pṛtanāsvaryaḥ ||
7,056.23  bhūri cakra marutaḥ pitryāṇyukthāni yā vaḥ śasyante purā cit |
7,056.23 marudbhirugraḥ pṛtanāsu sāḻhā marudbhiritsanitā vājamarvā ||
7,056.24  asme vīro marutaḥ śuṣmyastu janānāṃ yo asuro vidhartā |
7,056.24 apo yena sukṣitaye taremādha svamoko abhi vaḥ syāma ||
7,056.25  tanna indro varuṇo mitro agnirāpa oṣadhīrvanino juṣanta |
7,056.25 śarmansyāma marutāmupasthe yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,057.01  madhvo vo nāma mārutaṃ yajatrāḥ pra yajñeṣu śavasā madanti |
