7,057.01 ye rejayanti rodasī cidurvī pinvantyutsaṃ yadayāsurugrāḥ ||
7,057.02  nicetāro hi maruto gṛṇantaṃ praṇetāro yajamānasya manma |
7,057.02 asmākamadya vidatheṣu barhirā vītaye sadata pipriyāṇāḥ ||
7,057.03  naitāvadanye maruto yatheme bhrājante rukmairāyudhaistanūbhiḥ |
7,057.03 ā rodasī viśvapiśaḥ piśānāḥ samānamañjyañjate śubhe kam ||
7,057.04  ṛdhaksā vo maruto didyudastu yadva āgaḥ puruṣatā karāma |
7,057.04 mā vastasyāmapi bhūmā yajatrā asme vo astu sumatiścaniṣṭhā ||
7,057.05  kṛte cidatra maruto raṇantānavadyāsaḥ śucayaḥ pāvakāḥ |
7,057.05 pra ṇo'vata sumatibhiryajatrāḥ pra vājebhistirata puṣyase naḥ ||
7,057.06  uta stutāso maruto vyantu viśvebhirnāmabhirnaro havīṃṣi |
7,057.06 dadāta no amṛtasya prajāyai jigṛta rāyaḥ sūnṛtā maghāni ||
7,057.07  ā stutāso maruto viśva ūtī acchā sūrīnsarvatātā jigāta |
7,057.07 ye nastmanā śatino vardhayanti yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,058.01  pra sākamukṣe arcatā gaṇāya yo daivyasya dhāmnastuviṣmān |
7,058.01 uta kṣodanti rodasī mahitvā nakṣante nākaṃ nirṛteravaṃśāt ||
7,058.02  janūścidvo marutastveṣyeṇa bhīmāsastuvimanyavo'yāsaḥ |
7,058.02 pra ye mahobhirojasota santi viśvo vo yāmanbhayate svardṛk ||
7,058.03  bṛhadvayo maghavadbhyo dadhāta jujoṣanninmarutaḥ suṣṭutiṃ naḥ |
7,058.03 gato nādhvā vi tirāti jantuṃ pra ṇa spārhābhirūtibhistireta ||
7,058.04  yuṣmoto vipro marutaḥ śatasvī yuṣmoto arvā sahuriḥ sahasrī |
7,058.04 yuṣmotaḥ samrāḻ uta hanti vṛtraṃ pra tadvo astu dhūtayo deṣṇam ||
7,058.05  tāṃ ā rudrasya mīḻhuṣo vivāse kuvinnaṃsante marutaḥ punarnaḥ |
7,058.05 yatsasvartā jihīḻire yadāvirava tadena īmahe turāṇām ||
7,058.06  pra sā vāci suṣṭutirmaghonāmidaṃ sūktaṃ maruto juṣanta |
7,058.06 ārācciddveṣo vṛṣaṇo yuyota yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,059.01  yaṃ trāyadhva idamidaṃ devāso yaṃ ca nayatha |
7,059.01 tasmā agne varuṇa mitrāryamanmarutaḥ śarma yacchata ||
7,059.02  yuṣmākaṃ devā avasāhani priya ījānastarati dviṣaḥ |
7,059.02 pra sa kṣayaṃ tirate vi mahīriṣo yo vo varāya dāśati ||
7,059.03  nahi vaścaramaṃ cana vasiṣṭhaḥ parimaṃsate |
7,059.03 asmākamadya marutaḥ sute sacā viśve pibata kāminaḥ ||
7,059.04  nahi va ūtiḥ pṛtanāsu mardhati yasmā arādhvaṃ naraḥ |
7,059.04 abhi va āvartsumatirnavīyasī tūyaṃ yāta pipīṣavaḥ ||
7,059.05  o ṣu ghṛṣvirādhaso yātanāndhāṃsi pītaye |
7,059.05 imā vo havyā maruto rare hi kaṃ mo ṣvanyatra gantana ||
7,059.06  ā ca no barhiḥ sadatāvitā ca na spārhāṇi dātave vasu |
7,059.06 asredhanto marutaḥ somye madhau svāheha mādayādhvai ||
7,059.07  sasvaściddhi tanvaḥ śumbhamānā ā haṃsāso nīlapṛṣṭhā apaptan |
7,059.07 viśvaṃ śardho abhito mā ni ṣeda naro na raṇvāḥ savane madantaḥ ||
7,059.08  yo no maruto abhi durhṛṇāyustiraścittāni vasavo jighāṃsati |
7,059.08 druhaḥ pāśānprati sa mucīṣṭa tapiṣṭhena hanmanā hantanā tam ||
7,059.09  sāṃtapanā idaṃ havirmarutastajjujuṣṭana |
7,059.09 yuṣmākotī riśādasaḥ ||
7,059.10  gṛhamedhāsa ā gata maruto māpa bhūtana |
7,059.10 yuṣmākotī sudānavaḥ ||
7,059.11  iheha vaḥ svatavasaḥ kavayaḥ sūryatvacaḥ |
7,059.11 yajñaṃ maruta ā vṛṇe ||
7,059.12  tryambakaṃ yajāmahe sugandhiṃ puṣṭivardhanam |
7,059.12 urvārukamiva bandhanānmṛtyormukṣīya māmṛtāt ||

7,060.01  yadadya sūrya bravo'nāgā udyanmitrāya varuṇāya satyam |
7,060.01 vayaṃ devatrādite syāma tava priyāso aryamangṛṇantaḥ ||
7,060.02  eṣa sya mitrāvaruṇā nṛcakṣā ubhe udeti sūryo abhi jman |
7,060.02 viśvasya sthāturjagataśca gopā ṛju marteṣu vṛjinā ca paśyan ||
7,060.03  ayukta sapta haritaḥ sadhasthādyā īṃ vahanti sūryaṃ ghṛtācīḥ |
7,060.03 dhāmāni mitrāvaruṇā yuvākuḥ saṃ yo yūtheva janimāni caṣṭe ||
7,060.04  udvāṃ pṛkṣāso madhumanto asthurā sūryo aruhacchukramarṇaḥ |
7,060.04 yasmā ādityā adhvano radanti mitro aryamā varuṇaḥ sajoṣāḥ ||
7,060.05  ime cetāro anṛtasya bhūrermitro aryamā varuṇo hi santi |
7,060.05 ima ṛtasya vāvṛdhurduroṇe śagmāsaḥ putrā aditeradabdhāḥ ||
7,060.06  ime mitro varuṇo dūḻabhāso'cetasaṃ ciccitayanti dakṣaiḥ |
7,060.06 api kratuṃ sucetasaṃ vatantastiraścidaṃhaḥ supathā nayanti ||
7,060.07  ime divo animiṣā pṛthivyāścikitvāṃso acetasaṃ nayanti |
7,060.07 pravrāje cinnadyo gādhamasti pāraṃ no asya viṣpitasya parṣan ||
7,060.08  yadgopāvadaditiḥ śarma bhadraṃ mitro yacchanti varuṇaḥ sudāse |
7,060.08 tasminnā tokaṃ tanayaṃ dadhānā mā karma devaheḻanaṃ turāsaḥ ||
7,060.09  ava vediṃ hotrābhiryajeta ripaḥ kāścidvaruṇadhrutaḥ saḥ |
7,060.09 pari dveṣobhiraryamā vṛṇaktūruṃ sudāse vṛṣaṇā u lokam ||
7,060.10  sasvaściddhi samṛtistveṣyeṣāmapīcyena sahasā sahante |
7,060.10 yuṣmadbhiyā vṛṣaṇo rejamānā dakṣasya cinmahinā mṛḻatā naḥ ||
7,060.11  yo brahmaṇe sumatimāyajāte vājasya sātau paramasya rāyaḥ |
7,060.11 sīkṣanta manyuṃ maghavāno arya uru kṣayāya cakrire sudhātu ||
7,060.12  iyaṃ deva purohitiryuvabhyāṃ yajñeṣu mitrāvaruṇāvakāri |
7,060.12 viśvāni durgā pipṛtaṃ tiro no yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,061.01  udvāṃ cakṣurvaruṇa supratīkaṃ devayoreti sūryastatanvān |
7,061.01 abhi yo viśvā bhuvanāni caṣṭe sa manyuṃ martyeṣvā ciketa ||
7,061.02  pra vāṃ sa mitrāvaruṇāvṛtāvā vipro manmāni dīrghaśrudiyarti |
7,061.02 yasya brahmāṇi sukratū avātha ā yatkratvā na śaradaḥ pṛṇaithe ||
7,061.03  prorormitrāvaruṇā pṛthivyāḥ pra diva ṛṣvādbṛhataḥ sudānū |
7,061.03 spaśo dadhāthe oṣadhīṣu vikṣvṛdhagyato animiṣaṃ rakṣamāṇā ||
7,061.04  śaṃsā mitrasya varuṇasya dhāma śuṣmo rodasī badbadhe mahitvā |
7,061.04 ayanmāsā ayajvanāmavīrāḥ pra yajñamanmā vṛjanaṃ tirāte ||
7,061.05  amūrā viśvā vṛṣaṇāvimā vāṃ na yāsu citraṃ dadṛśe na yakṣam |
7,061.05 druhaḥ sacante anṛtā janānāṃ na vāṃ niṇyānyacite abhūvan ||
7,061.06  samu vāṃ yajñaṃ mahayaṃ namobhirhuve vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā sabādhaḥ |
7,061.06 pra vāṃ manmānyṛcase navāni kṛtāni brahma jujuṣannimāni ||
7,061.07  iyaṃ deva purohitiryuvabhyāṃ yajñeṣu mitrāvaruṇāvakāri |
7,061.07 viśvāni durgā pipṛtaṃ tiro no yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,062.01  utsūryo bṛhadarcīṃṣyaśretpuru viśvā janima mānuṣāṇām |
7,062.01 samo divā dadṛśe rocamānaḥ kratvā kṛtaḥ sukṛtaḥ kartṛbhirbhūt ||
7,062.02  sa sūrya prati puro na udgā ebhi stomebhiretaśebhirevaiḥ |
7,062.02 pra no mitrāya varuṇāya voco'nāgaso aryamṇe agnaye ca ||
7,062.03  vi naḥ sahasraṃ śurudho radantvṛtāvāno varuṇo mitro agniḥ |
7,062.03 yacchantu candrā upamaṃ no arkamā naḥ kāmaṃ pūpurantu stavānāḥ ||
7,062.04  dyāvābhūmī adite trāsīthāṃ no ye vāṃ jajñuḥ sujanimāna ṛṣve |
7,062.04 mā heḻe bhūma varuṇasya vāyormā mitrasya priyatamasya nṛṇām ||
7,062.05  pra bāhavā sisṛtaṃ jīvase na ā no gavyūtimukṣataṃ ghṛtena |
7,062.05 ā no jane śravayataṃ yuvānā śrutaṃ me mitrāvaruṇā havemā ||
7,062.06  nū mitro varuṇo aryamā nastmane tokāya varivo dadhantu |
7,062.06 sugā no viśvā supathāni santu yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,063.01  udveti subhago viśvacakṣāḥ sādhāraṇaḥ sūryo mānuṣāṇām |
7,063.01 cakṣurmitrasya varuṇasya devaścarmeva yaḥ samavivyaktamāṃsi ||
7,063.02  udveti prasavītā janānāṃ mahānketurarṇavaḥ sūryasya |
7,063.02 samānaṃ cakraṃ paryāvivṛtsanyadetaśo vahati dhūrṣu yuktaḥ ||
7,063.03  vibhrājamāna uṣasāmupasthādrebhairudetyanumadyamānaḥ |
7,063.03 eṣa me devaḥ savitā cacchanda yaḥ samānaṃ na pramināti dhāma ||
7,063.04  divo rukma urucakṣā udeti dūrearthastaraṇirbhrājamānaḥ |
7,063.04 nūnaṃ janāḥ sūryeṇa prasūtā ayannarthāni kṛṇavannapāṃsi ||
7,063.05  yatrā cakruramṛtā gātumasmai śyeno na dīyannanveti pāthaḥ |
7,063.05 prati vāṃ sūra udite vidhema namobhirmitrāvaruṇota havyaiḥ ||
7,063.06  nū mitro varuṇo aryamā nastmane tokāya varivo dadhantu |
7,063.06 sugā no viśvā supathāni santu yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,064.01  divi kṣayantā rajasaḥ pṛthivyāṃ pra vāṃ ghṛtasya nirṇijo dadīran |
7,064.01 havyaṃ no mitro aryamā sujāto rājā sukṣatro varuṇo juṣanta ||
7,064.02  ā rājānā maha ṛtasya gopā sindhupatī kṣatriyā yātamarvāk |
7,064.02 iḻāṃ no mitrāvaruṇota vṛṣṭimava diva invataṃ jīradānū ||
7,064.03  mitrastanno varuṇo devo aryaḥ pra sādhiṣṭhebhiḥ pathibhirnayantu |
7,064.03 bravadyathā na ādariḥ sudāsa iṣā madema saha devagopāḥ ||
7,064.04  yo vāṃ gartaṃ manasā takṣadetamūrdhvāṃ dhītiṃ kṛṇavaddhārayacca |
7,064.04 ukṣethāṃ mitrāvaruṇā ghṛtena tā rājānā sukṣitīstarpayethām ||
7,064.05  eṣa stomo varuṇa mitra tubhyaṃ somaḥ śukro na vāyave'yāmi |
7,064.05 aviṣṭaṃ dhiyo jigṛtaṃ purandhīryūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,065.01  prati vāṃ sūra udite sūktairmitraṃ huve varuṇaṃ pūtadakṣam |
7,065.01 yayorasuryamakṣitaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ viśvasya yāmannācitā jigatnu ||
7,065.02  tā hi devānāmasurā tāvaryā tā naḥ kṣitīḥ karatamūrjayantīḥ |
7,065.02 aśyāma mitrāvaruṇā vayaṃ vāṃ dyāvā ca yatra pīpayannahā ca ||
7,065.03  tā bhūripāśāvanṛtasya setū duratyetū ripave martyāya |
7,065.03 ṛtasya mitrāvaruṇā pathā vāmapo na nāvā duritā tarema ||
7,065.04  ā no mitrāvaruṇā havyajuṣṭiṃ ghṛtairgavyūtimukṣatamiḻābhiḥ |
7,065.04 prati vāmatra varamā janāya pṛṇītamudno divyasya cāroḥ ||
7,065.05  eṣa stomo varuṇa mitra tubhyaṃ somaḥ śukro na vāyave'yāmi |
7,065.05 aviṣṭaṃ dhiyo jigṛtaṃ purandhīryūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,066.01  pra mitrayorvaruṇayo stomo na etu śūṣyaḥ |
7,066.01 namasvāntuvijātayoḥ ||
7,066.02  yā dhārayanta devāḥ sudakṣā dakṣapitarā |
7,066.02 asuryāya pramahasā ||
7,066.03  tā na stipā tanūpā varuṇa jaritṝṇām |
7,066.03 mitra sādhayataṃ dhiyaḥ ||
7,066.04  yadadya sūra udite'nāgā mitro aryamā |
7,066.04 suvāti savitā bhagaḥ ||
7,066.05  suprāvīrastu sa kṣayaḥ pra nu yāmansudānavaḥ |
7,066.05 ye no aṃho'tipiprati ||
7,066.06  uta svarājo aditiradabdhasya vratasya ye |
7,066.06 maho rājāna īśate ||
7,066.07  prati vāṃ sūra udite mitraṃ gṛṇīṣe varuṇam |
7,066.07 aryamaṇaṃ riśādasam ||
7,066.08  rāyā hiraṇyayā matiriyamavṛkāya śavase |
7,066.08 iyaṃ viprā medhasātaye ||
7,066.09  te syāma deva varuṇa te mitra sūribhiḥ saha |
7,066.09 iṣaṃ svaśca dhīmahi ||
7,066.10  bahavaḥ sūracakṣaso'gnijihvā ṛtāvṛdhaḥ |
7,066.10 trīṇi ye yemurvidathāni dhītibhirviśvāni paribhūtibhiḥ ||
7,066.11  vi ye dadhuḥ śaradaṃ māsamādaharyajñamaktuṃ cādṛcam |
7,066.11 anāpyaṃ varuṇo mitro aryamā kṣatraṃ rājāna āśata ||
7,066.12  tadvo adya manāmahe sūktaiḥ sūra udite |
7,066.12 yadohate varuṇo mitro aryamā yūyamṛtasya rathyaḥ ||
7,066.13  ṛtāvāna ṛtajātā ṛtāvṛdho ghorāso anṛtadviṣaḥ |
7,066.13 teṣāṃ vaḥ sumne succhardiṣṭame naraḥ syāma ye ca sūrayaḥ ||
7,066.14  udu tyaddarśataṃ vapurdiva eti pratihvare |
7,066.14 yadīmāśurvahati deva etaśo viśvasmai cakṣase aram ||
7,066.15  śīrṣṇaḥśīrṣṇo jagatastasthuṣaspatiṃ samayā viśvamā rajaḥ |
7,066.15 sapta svasāraḥ suvitāya sūryaṃ vahanti harito rathe ||
7,066.16  taccakṣurdevahitaṃ śukramuccarat |
7,066.16 paśyema śaradaḥ śataṃ jīvema śaradaḥ śatam ||
7,066.17  kāvyebhiradābhyā yātaṃ varuṇa dyumat |
7,066.17 mitraśca somapītaye ||
7,066.18  divo dhāmabhirvaruṇa mitraścā yātamadruhā |
7,066.18 pibataṃ somamātujī ||
7,066.19  ā yātaṃ mitrāvaruṇā juṣāṇāvāhutiṃ narā |
7,066.19 pātaṃ somamṛtāvṛdhā ||

7,067.01  prati vāṃ rathaṃ nṛpatī jaradhyai haviṣmatā manasā yajñiyena |
7,067.01 yo vāṃ dūto na dhiṣṇyāvajīgaracchā sūnurna pitarā vivakmi ||
7,067.02  aśocyagniḥ samidhāno asme upo adṛśrantamasaścidantāḥ |
7,067.02 aceti keturuṣasaḥ purastācchriye divo duhiturjāyamānaḥ ||
7,067.03  abhi vāṃ nūnamaśvinā suhotā stomaiḥ siṣakti nāsatyā vivakvān |
7,067.03 pūrvībhiryātaṃ pathyābhirarvāksvarvidā vasumatā rathena ||
7,067.04  avorvāṃ nūnamaśvinā yuvākurhuve yadvāṃ sute mādhvī vasūyuḥ |
7,067.04 ā vāṃ vahantu sthavirāso aśvāḥ pibātho asme suṣutā madhūni ||
7,067.05  prācīmu devāśvinā dhiyaṃ me'mṛdhrāṃ sātaye kṛtaṃ vasūyum |
7,067.05 viśvā aviṣṭaṃ vāja ā purandhīstā naḥ śaktaṃ śacīpatī śacībhiḥ ||
7,067.06  aviṣṭaṃ dhīṣvaśvinā na āsu prajāvadreto ahrayaṃ no astu |
7,067.06 ā vāṃ toke tanaye tūtujānāḥ suratnāso devavītiṃ gamema ||
7,067.07  eṣa sya vāṃ pūrvagatveva sakhye nidhirhito mādhvī rāto asme |
7,067.07 aheḻatā manasā yātamarvāgaśnantā havyaṃ mānuṣīṣu vikṣu ||
7,067.08  ekasminyoge bhuraṇā samāne pari vāṃ sapta sravato ratho gāt |
7,067.08 na vāyanti subhvo devayuktā ye vāṃ dhūrṣu taraṇayo vahanti ||
7,067.09  asaścatā maghavadbhyo hi bhūtaṃ ye rāyā maghadeyaṃ junanti |
7,067.09 pra ye bandhuṃ sūnṛtābhistirante gavyā pṛñcanto aśvyā maghāni ||
7,067.10  nū me havamā śṛṇutaṃ yuvānā yāsiṣṭaṃ vartiraśvināvirāvat |
7,067.10 dhattaṃ ratnāni jarataṃ ca sūrīnyūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,068.01  ā śubhrā yātamaśvinā svaśvā giro dasrā jujuṣāṇā yuvākoḥ |
7,068.01 havyāni ca pratibhṛtā vītaṃ naḥ ||
7,068.02  pra vāmandhāṃsi madyānyasthuraraṃ gantaṃ haviṣo vītaye me |
7,068.02 tiro aryo havanāni śrutaṃ naḥ ||
7,068.03  pra vāṃ ratho manojavā iyarti tiro rajāṃsyaśvinā śatotiḥ |
7,068.03 asmabhyaṃ sūryāvasū iyānaḥ ||
7,068.04  ayaṃ ha yadvāṃ devayā u adrirūrdhvo vivakti somasudyuvabhyām |
7,068.04 ā valgū vipro vavṛtīta havyaiḥ ||
7,068.05  citraṃ ha yadvāṃ bhojanaṃ nvasti nyatraye mahiṣvantaṃ yuyotam |
7,068.05 yo vāmomānaṃ dadhate priyaḥ san ||
7,068.06  uta tyadvāṃ jurate aśvinā bhūccyavānāya pratītyaṃ havirde |
7,068.06 adhi yadvarpa itaūti dhatthaḥ ||
7,068.07  uta tyaṃ bhujyumaśvinā sakhāyo madhye jahurdurevāsaḥ samudre |
7,068.07 nirīṃ parṣadarāvā yo yuvākuḥ ||
7,068.08  vṛkāya cijjasamānāya śaktamuta śrutaṃ śayave hūyamānā |
7,068.08 yāvaghnyāmapinvatamapo na staryaṃ cicchaktyaśvinā śacībhiḥ ||
7,068.09  eṣa sya kārurjarate sūktairagre budhāna uṣasāṃ sumanmā |
7,068.09 iṣā taṃ vardhadaghnyā payobhiryūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,069.01  ā vāṃ ratho rodasī badbadhāno hiraṇyayo vṛṣabhiryātvaśvaiḥ |
7,069.01 ghṛtavartaniḥ pavibhī rucāna iṣāṃ voḻhā nṛpatirvājinīvān ||
7,069.02  sa paprathāno abhi pañca bhūmā trivandhuro manasā yātu yuktaḥ |
7,069.02 viśo yena gacchatho devayantīḥ kutrā cidyāmamaśvinā dadhānā ||
7,069.03  svaśvā yaśasā yātamarvāgdasrā nidhiṃ madhumantaṃ pibāthaḥ |
7,069.03 vi vāṃ ratho vadhvā yādamāno'ntāndivo bādhate vartanibhyām ||
7,069.04  yuvoḥ śriyaṃ pari yoṣāvṛṇīta sūro duhitā paritakmyāyām |
7,069.04 yaddevayantamavathaḥ śacībhiḥ pari ghraṃsamomanā vāṃ vayo gāt ||
7,069.05  yo ha sya vāṃ rathirā vasta usrā ratho yujānaḥ pariyāti vartiḥ |
7,069.05 tena naḥ śaṃ yoruṣaso vyuṣṭau nyaśvinā vahataṃ yajñe asmin ||
7,069.06  narā gaureva vidyutaṃ tṛṣāṇāsmākamadya savanopa yātam |
7,069.06 purutrā hi vāṃ matibhirhavante mā vāmanye ni yamandevayantaḥ ||
7,069.07  yuvaṃ bhujyumavaviddhaṃ samudra udūhathurarṇaso asridhānaiḥ |
7,069.07 patatribhiraśramairavyathibhirdaṃsanābhiraśvinā pārayantā ||
7,069.08  nū me havamā śṛṇutaṃ yuvānā yāsiṣṭaṃ vartiraśvināvirāvat |
7,069.08 dhattaṃ ratnāni jarataṃ ca sūrīnyūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,070.01  ā viśvavārāśvinā gataṃ naḥ pra tatsthānamavāci vāṃ pṛthivyām |
7,070.01 aśvo na vājī śunapṛṣṭho asthādā yatsedathurdhruvase na yonim ||
7,070.02  siṣakti sā vāṃ sumatiścaniṣṭhātāpi gharmo manuṣo duroṇe |
7,070.02 yo vāṃ samudrānsaritaḥ pipartyetagvā cinna suyujā yujānaḥ ||
7,070.03  yāni sthānānyaśvinā dadhāthe divo yahvīṣvoṣadhīṣu vikṣu |
7,070.03 ni parvatasya mūrdhani sadanteṣaṃ janāya dāśuṣe vahantā ||
7,070.04  caniṣṭaṃ devā oṣadhīṣvapsu yadyogyā aśnavaithe ṛṣīṇām |
7,070.04 purūṇi ratnā dadhatau nyasme anu pūrvāṇi cakhyathuryugāni ||
7,070.05  śuśruvāṃsā cidaśvinā purūṇyabhi brahmāṇi cakṣāthe ṛṣīṇām |
7,070.05 prati pra yātaṃ varamā janāyāsme vāmastu sumatiścaniṣṭhā ||
7,070.06  yo vāṃ yajño nāsatyā haviṣmānkṛtabrahmā samaryo bhavāti |
7,070.06 upa pra yātaṃ varamā vasiṣṭhamimā brahmāṇyṛcyante yuvabhyām ||
7,070.07  iyaṃ manīṣā iyamaśvinā gīrimāṃ suvṛktiṃ vṛṣaṇā juṣethām |
7,070.07 imā brahmāṇi yuvayūnyagmanyūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,071.01  apa svasuruṣaso nagjihīte riṇakti kṛṣṇīraruṣāya panthām |
7,071.01 aśvāmaghā gomaghā vāṃ huvema divā naktaṃ śarumasmadyuyotam ||
7,071.02  upāyātaṃ dāśuṣe martyāya rathena vāmamaśvinā vahantā |
7,071.02 yuyutamasmadanirāmamīvāṃ divā naktaṃ mādhvī trāsīthāṃ naḥ ||
7,071.03  ā vāṃ rathamavamasyāṃ vyuṣṭau sumnāyavo vṛṣaṇo vartayantu |
7,071.03 syūmagabhastimṛtayugbhiraśvairāśvinā vasumantaṃ vahethām ||
7,071.04  yo vāṃ ratho nṛpatī asti voḻhā trivandhuro vasumāṃ usrayāmā |
7,071.04 ā na enā nāsatyopa yātamabhi yadvāṃ viśvapsnyo jigāti ||
7,071.05  yuvaṃ cyavānaṃ jaraso'mumuktaṃ ni pedava ūhathurāśumaśvam |
7,071.05 niraṃhasastamasa spartamatriṃ ni jāhuṣaṃ śithire dhātamantaḥ ||
7,071.06  iyaṃ manīṣā iyamaśvinā gīrimāṃ suvṛktiṃ vṛṣaṇā juṣethām |
7,071.06 imā brahmāṇi yuvayūnyagmanyūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,072.01  ā gomatā nāsatyā rathenāśvāvatā puruścandreṇa yātam |
7,072.01 abhi vāṃ viśvā niyutaḥ sacante spārhayā śriyā tanvā śubhānā ||
7,072.02  ā no devebhirupa yātamarvāksajoṣasā nāsatyā rathena |
7,072.02 yuvorhi naḥ sakhyā pitryāṇi samāno bandhuruta tasya vittam ||
7,072.03  udu stomāso aśvinorabudhrañjāmi brahmāṇyuṣasaśca devīḥ |
7,072.03 āvivāsanrodasī dhiṣṇyeme acchā vipro nāsatyā vivakti ||
7,072.04  vi ceducchantyaśvinā uṣāsaḥ pra vāṃ brahmāṇi kāravo bharante |
7,072.04 ūrdhvaṃ bhānuṃ savitā devo aśredbṛhadagnayaḥ samidhā jarante ||
7,072.05  ā paścātānnāsatyā purastādāśvinā yātamadharādudaktāt |
7,072.05 ā viśvataḥ pāñcajanyena rāyā yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,073.01  atāriṣma tamasaspāramasya prati stomaṃ devayanto dadhānāḥ |
7,073.01 purudaṃsā purutamā purājāmartyā havate aśvinā gīḥ ||
7,073.02  nyu priyo manuṣaḥ sādi hotā nāsatyā yo yajate vandate ca |
7,073.02 aśnītaṃ madhvo aśvinā upāka ā vāṃ voce vidatheṣu prayasvān ||
7,073.03  ahema yajñaṃ pathāmurāṇā imāṃ suvṛktiṃ vṛṣaṇā juṣethām |
7,073.03 śruṣṭīveva preṣito vāmabodhi prati stomairjaramāṇo vasiṣṭhaḥ ||
7,073.04  upa tyā vahnī gamato viśaṃ no rakṣohaṇā sambhṛtā vīḻupāṇī |
7,073.04 samandhāṃsyagmata matsarāṇi mā no mardhiṣṭamā gataṃ śivena ||
7,073.05  ā paścātānnāsatyā purastādāśvinā yātamadharādudaktāt |
7,073.05 ā viśvataḥ pāñcajanyena rāyā yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,074.01  imā u vāṃ diviṣṭaya usrā havante aśvinā |
7,074.01 ayaṃ vāmahve'vase śacīvasū viśaṃviśaṃ hi gacchathaḥ ||
7,074.02  yuvaṃ citraṃ dadathurbhojanaṃ narā codethāṃ sūnṛtāvate |
7,074.02 arvāgrathaṃ samanasā ni yacchataṃ pibataṃ somyaṃ madhu ||
7,074.03  ā yātamupa bhūṣataṃ madhvaḥ pibatamaśvinā |
7,074.03 dugdhaṃ payo vṛṣaṇā jenyāvasū mā no mardhiṣṭamā gatam ||
7,074.04  aśvāso ye vāmupa dāśuṣo gṛhaṃ yuvāṃ dīyanti bibhrataḥ |
7,074.04 makṣūyubhirnarā hayebhiraśvinā devā yātamasmayū ||
7,074.05  adhā ha yanto aśvinā pṛkṣaḥ sacanta sūrayaḥ |
7,074.05 tā yaṃsato maghavadbhyo dhruvaṃ yaśaśchardirasmabhyaṃ nāsatyā ||
7,074.06  pra ye yayuravṛkāso rathā iva nṛpātāro janānām |
7,074.06 uta svena śavasā śūśuvurnara uta kṣiyanti sukṣitim ||

7,075.01  vyuṣā āvo divijā ṛtenāviṣkṛṇvānā mahimānamāgāt |
7,075.01 apa druhastama āvarajuṣṭamaṅgirastamā pathyā ajīgaḥ ||
7,075.02  mahe no adya suvitāya bodhyuṣo mahe saubhagāya pra yandhi |
7,075.02 citraṃ rayiṃ yaśasaṃ dhehyasme devi marteṣu mānuṣi śravasyum ||
7,075.03  ete tye bhānavo darśatāyāścitrā uṣaso amṛtāsa āguḥ |
7,075.03 janayanto daivyāni vratānyāpṛṇanto antarikṣā vyasthuḥ ||
7,075.04  eṣā syā yujānā parākātpañca kṣitīḥ pari sadyo jigāti |
7,075.04 abhipaśyantī vayunā janānāṃ divo duhitā bhuvanasya patnī ||
7,075.05  vājinīvatī sūryasya yoṣā citrāmaghā rāya īśe vasūnām |
7,075.05 ṛṣiṣṭutā jarayantī maghonyuṣā ucchati vahnibhirgṛṇānā ||
7,075.06  prati dyutānāmaruṣāso aśvāścitrā adṛśrannuṣasaṃ vahantaḥ |
7,075.06 yāti śubhrā viśvapiśā rathena dadhāti ratnaṃ vidhate janāya ||
7,075.07  satyā satyebhirmahatī mahadbhirdevī devebhiryajatā yajatraiḥ |
7,075.07 rujaddṛḻhāni dadadusriyāṇāṃ prati gāva uṣasaṃ vāvaśanta ||
7,075.08  nū no gomadvīravaddhehi ratnamuṣo aśvāvatpurubhojo asme |
7,075.08 mā no barhiḥ puruṣatā nide karyūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,076.01  udu jyotiramṛtaṃ viśvajanyaṃ viśvānaraḥ savitā devo aśret |
7,076.01 kratvā devānāmajaniṣṭa cakṣurāvirakarbhuvanaṃ viśvamuṣāḥ ||
7,076.02  pra me panthā devayānā adṛśrannamardhanto vasubhiriṣkṛtāsaḥ |
7,076.02 abhūdu keturuṣasaḥ purastātpratīcyāgādadhi harmyebhyaḥ ||
7,076.03  tānīdahāni bahulānyāsanyā prācīnamuditā sūryasya |
7,076.03 yataḥ pari jāra ivācarantyuṣo dadṛkṣe na punaryatīva ||
7,076.04  ta iddevānāṃ sadhamāda āsannṛtāvānaḥ kavayaḥ pūrvyāsaḥ |
7,076.04 gūḻhaṃ jyotiḥ pitaro anvavindansatyamantrā ajanayannuṣāsam ||
7,076.05  samāna ūrve adhi saṃgatāsaḥ saṃ jānate na yatante mithaste |
7,076.05 te devānāṃ na minanti vratānyamardhanto vasubhiryādamānāḥ ||
7,076.06  prati tvā stomairīḻate vasiṣṭhā uṣarbudhaḥ subhage tuṣṭuvāṃsaḥ |
7,076.06 gavāṃ netrī vājapatnī na ucchoṣaḥ sujāte prathamā jarasva ||
7,076.07  eṣā netrī rādhasaḥ sūnṛtānāmuṣā ucchantī ribhyate vasiṣṭhaiḥ |
7,076.07 dīrghaśrutaṃ rayimasme dadhānā yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,077.01  upo ruruce yuvatirna yoṣā viśvaṃ jīvaṃ prasuvantī carāyai |
7,077.01 abhūdagniḥ samidhe mānuṣāṇāmakarjyotirbādhamānā tamāṃsi ||
7,077.02  viśvaṃ pratīcī saprathā udasthādruśadvāso bibhratī śukramaśvait |
7,077.02 hiraṇyavarṇā sudṛśīkasaṃdṛggavāṃ mātā netryahnāmaroci ||
7,077.03  devānāṃ cakṣuḥ subhagā vahantī śvetaṃ nayantī sudṛśīkamaśvam |
7,077.03 uṣā adarśi raśmibhirvyaktā citrāmaghā viśvamanu prabhūtā ||
7,077.04  antivāmā dūre amitramucchorvīṃ gavyūtimabhayaṃ kṛdhī naḥ |
7,077.04 yāvaya dveṣa ā bharā vasūni codaya rādho gṛṇate maghoni ||
7,077.05  asme śreṣṭhebhirbhānubhirvi bhāhyuṣo devi pratirantī na āyuḥ |
7,077.05 iṣaṃ ca no dadhatī viśvavāre gomadaśvāvadrathavacca rādhaḥ ||
7,077.06  yāṃ tvā divo duhitarvardhayantyuṣaḥ sujāte matibhirvasiṣṭhāḥ |
7,077.06 sāsmāsu dhā rayimṛṣvaṃ bṛhantaṃ yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,078.01  prati ketavaḥ prathamā adṛśrannūrdhvā asyā añjayo vi śrayante |
7,078.01 uṣo arvācā bṛhatā rathena jyotiṣmatā vāmamasmabhyaṃ vakṣi ||
7,078.02  prati ṣīmagnirjarate samiddhaḥ prati viprāso matibhirgṛṇantaḥ |
7,078.02 uṣā yāti jyotiṣā bādhamānā viśvā tamāṃsi duritāpa devī ||
7,078.03  etā u tyāḥ pratyadṛśranpurastājjyotiryacchantīruṣaso vibhātīḥ |
7,078.03 ajījanansūryaṃ yajñamagnimapācīnaṃ tamo agādajuṣṭam ||
7,078.04  aceti divo duhitā maghonī viśve paśyantyuṣasaṃ vibhātīm |
7,078.04 āsthādrathaṃ svadhayā yujyamānamā yamaśvāsaḥ suyujo vahanti ||
7,078.05  prati tvādya sumanaso budhantāsmākāso maghavāno vayaṃ ca |
7,078.05 tilvilāyadhvamuṣaso vibhātīryūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,079.01  vyuṣā āvaḥ pathyā janānāṃ pañca kṣitīrmānuṣīrbodhayantī |
7,079.01 susaṃdṛgbhirukṣabhirbhānumaśredvi sūryo rodasī cakṣasāvaḥ ||
7,079.02  vyañjate divo anteṣvaktūnviśo na yuktā uṣaso yatante |
7,079.02 saṃ te gāvastama ā vartayanti jyotiryacchanti saviteva bāhū ||
7,079.03  abhūduṣā indratamā maghonyajījanatsuvitāya śravāṃsi |
7,079.03 vi divo devī duhitā dadhātyaṅgirastamā sukṛte vasūni ||
7,079.04  tāvaduṣo rādho asmabhyaṃ rāsva yāvatstotṛbhyo arado gṛṇānā |
7,079.04 yāṃ tvā jajñurvṛṣabhasyā raveṇa vi dṛḻhasya duro adreraurṇoḥ ||
7,079.05  devaṃdevaṃ rādhase codayantyasmadryaksūnṛtā īrayantī |
7,079.05 vyucchantī naḥ sanaye dhiyo dhā yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,080.01  prati stomebhiruṣasaṃ vasiṣṭhā gīrbhirviprāsaḥ prathamā abudhran |
7,080.01 vivartayantīṃ rajasī samante āviṣkṛṇvatīṃ bhuvanāni viśvā ||
7,080.02  eṣā syā navyamāyurdadhānā gūḍhvī tamo jyotiṣoṣā abodhi |
7,080.02 agra eti yuvatirahrayāṇā prācikitatsūryaṃ yajñamagnim ||
7,080.03  aśvāvatīrgomatīrna uṣāso vīravatīḥ sadamucchantu bhadrāḥ |
7,080.03 ghṛtaṃ duhānā viśvataḥ prapītā yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,081.01  pratyu adarśyāyatyucchantī duhitā divaḥ |
7,081.01 apo mahi vyayati cakṣase tamo jyotiṣkṛṇoti sūnarī ||
7,081.02  udusriyāḥ sṛjate sūryaḥ sacāṃ udyannakṣatramarcivat |
7,081.02 taveduṣo vyuṣi sūryasya ca saṃ bhaktena gamemahi ||
7,081.03  prati tvā duhitardiva uṣo jīrā abhutsmahi |
7,081.03 yā vahasi puru spārhaṃ vananvati ratnaṃ na dāśuṣe mayaḥ ||
7,081.04  ucchantī yā kṛṇoṣi maṃhanā mahi prakhyai devi svardṛśe |
7,081.04 tasyāste ratnabhāja īmahe vayaṃ syāma māturna sūnavaḥ ||
7,081.05  taccitraṃ rādha ā bharoṣo yaddīrghaśruttamam |
7,081.05 yatte divo duhitarmartabhojanaṃ tadrāsva bhunajāmahai ||
7,081.06  śravaḥ sūribhyo amṛtaṃ vasutvanaṃ vājāṃ asmabhyaṃ gomataḥ |
7,081.06 codayitrī maghonaḥ sūnṛtāvatyuṣā ucchadapa sridhaḥ ||

7,082.01  indrāvaruṇā yuvamadhvarāya no viśe janāya mahi śarma yacchatam |
7,082.01 dīrghaprayajyumati yo vanuṣyati vayaṃ jayema pṛtanāsu dūḍhyaḥ ||
7,082.02  samrāḻ anyaḥ svarāḻ anya ucyate vāṃ mahāntāvindrāvaruṇā mahāvasū |
7,082.02 viśve devāsaḥ parame vyomani saṃ vāmojo vṛṣaṇā saṃ balaṃ dadhuḥ ||
7,082.03  anvapāṃ khānyatṛntamojasā sūryamairayataṃ divi prabhum |
7,082.03 indrāvaruṇā made asya māyino'pinvatamapitaḥ pinvataṃ dhiyaḥ ||
7,082.04  yuvāmidyutsu pṛtanāsu vahnayo yuvāṃ kṣemasya prasave mitajñavaḥ |
7,082.04 īśānā vasva ubhayasya kārava indrāvaruṇā suhavā havāmahe ||
7,082.05  indrāvaruṇā yadimāni cakrathurviśvā jātāni bhuvanasya majmanā |
7,082.05 kṣemeṇa mitro varuṇaṃ duvasyati marudbhirugraḥ śubhamanya īyate ||
7,082.06  mahe śulkāya varuṇasya nu tviṣa ojo mimāte dhruvamasya yatsvam |
7,082.06 ajāmimanyaḥ śnathayantamātiraddabhrebhiranyaḥ pra vṛṇoti bhūyasaḥ ||
7,082.07  na tamaṃho na duritāni martyamindrāvaruṇā na tapaḥ kutaścana |
7,082.07 yasya devā gacchatho vītho adhvaraṃ na taṃ martasya naśate parihvṛtiḥ ||
7,082.08  arvāṅnarā daivyenāvasā gataṃ śṛṇutaṃ havaṃ yadi me jujoṣathaḥ |
7,082.08 yuvorhi sakhyamuta vā yadāpyaṃ mārḍīkamindrāvaruṇā ni yacchatam ||
7,082.09  asmākamindrāvaruṇā bharebhare puroyodhā bhavataṃ kṛṣṭyojasā |
7,082.09 yadvāṃ havanta ubhaye adha spṛdhi narastokasya tanayasya sātiṣu ||
7,082.10  asme indro varuṇo mitro aryamā dyumnaṃ yacchantu mahi śarma saprathaḥ |
7,082.10 avadhraṃ jyotiraditerṛtāvṛdho devasya ślokaṃ saviturmanāmahe ||

7,083.01  yuvāṃ narā paśyamānāsa āpyaṃ prācā gavyantaḥ pṛthuparśavo yayuḥ |
7,083.01 dāsā ca vṛtrā hatamāryāṇi ca sudāsamindrāvaruṇāvasāvatam ||
7,083.02  yatrā naraḥ samayante kṛtadhvajo yasminnājā bhavati kiṃ cana priyam |
7,083.02 yatrā bhayante bhuvanā svardṛśastatrā na indrāvaruṇādhi vocatam ||
7,083.03  saṃ bhūmyā antā dhvasirā adṛkṣatendrāvaruṇā divi ghoṣa āruhat |
7,083.03 asthurjanānāmupa māmarātayo'rvāgavasā havanaśrutā gatam ||
7,083.04  indrāvaruṇā vadhanābhiraprati bhedaṃ vanvantā pra sudāsamāvatam |
7,083.04 brahmāṇyeṣāṃ śṛṇutaṃ havīmani satyā tṛtsūnāmabhavatpurohitiḥ ||
7,083.05  indrāvaruṇāvabhyā tapanti māghānyaryo vanuṣāmarātayaḥ |
7,083.05 yuvaṃ hi vasva ubhayasya rājatho'dha smā no'vataṃ pārye divi ||
7,083.06  yuvāṃ havanta ubhayāsa ājiṣvindraṃ ca vasvo varuṇaṃ ca sātaye |
7,083.06 yatra rājabhirdaśabhirnibādhitaṃ pra sudāsamāvataṃ tṛtsubhiḥ saha ||
7,083.07  daśa rājānaḥ samitā ayajyavaḥ sudāsamindrāvaruṇā na yuyudhuḥ |
7,083.07 satyā nṛṇāmadmasadāmupastutirdevā eṣāmabhavandevahūtiṣu ||
7,083.08  dāśarājñe pariyattāya viśvataḥ sudāsa indrāvaruṇāvaśikṣatam |
7,083.08 śvityañco yatra namasā kapardino dhiyā dhīvanto asapanta tṛtsavaḥ ||
7,083.09  vṛtrāṇyanyaḥ samitheṣu jighnate vratānyanyo abhi rakṣate sadā |
7,083.09 havāmahe vāṃ vṛṣaṇā suvṛktibhirasme indrāvaruṇā śarma yacchatam ||
7,083.10  asme indro varuṇo mitro aryamā dyumnaṃ yacchantu mahi śarma saprathaḥ |
7,083.10 avadhraṃ jyotiraditerṛtāvṛdho devasya ślokaṃ saviturmanāmahe ||

7,084.01  ā vāṃ rājānāvadhvare vavṛtyāṃ havyebhirindrāvaruṇā namobhiḥ |
7,084.01 pra vāṃ ghṛtācī bāhvordadhānā pari tmanā viṣurūpā jigāti ||
7,084.02  yuvo rāṣṭraṃ bṛhadinvati dyauryau setṛbhirarajjubhiḥ sinīthaḥ |
7,084.02 pari no heḻo varuṇasya vṛjyā uruṃ na indraḥ kṛṇavadu lokam ||
7,084.03  kṛtaṃ no yajñaṃ vidatheṣu cāruṃ kṛtaṃ brahmāṇi sūriṣu praśastā |
7,084.03 upo rayirdevajūto na etu pra ṇa spārhābhirūtibhistiretam ||
7,084.04  asme indrāvaruṇā viśvavāraṃ rayiṃ dhattaṃ vasumantaṃ purukṣum |
7,084.04 pra ya ādityo anṛtā minātyamitā śūro dayate vasūni ||
7,084.05  iyamindraṃ varuṇamaṣṭa me gīḥ prāvattoke tanaye tūtujānā |
7,084.05 suratnāso devavītiṃ gamema yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,085.01  punīṣe vāmarakṣasaṃ manīṣāṃ somamindrāya varuṇāya juhvat |
7,085.01 ghṛtapratīkāmuṣasaṃ na devīṃ tā no yāmannuruṣyatāmabhīke ||
7,085.02  spardhante vā u devahūye atra yeṣu dhvajeṣu didyavaḥ patanti |
7,085.02 yuvaṃ tāṃ indrāvaruṇāvamitrānhataṃ parācaḥ śarvā viṣūcaḥ ||
7,085.03  āpaściddhi svayaśasaḥ sadassu devīrindraṃ varuṇaṃ devatā dhuḥ |
7,085.03 kṛṣṭīranyo dhārayati praviktā vṛtrāṇyanyo apratīni hanti ||
7,085.04  sa sukraturṛtacidastu hotā ya āditya śavasā vāṃ namasvān |
7,085.04 āvavartadavase vāṃ haviṣmānasaditsa suvitāya prayasvān ||
7,085.05  iyamindraṃ varuṇamaṣṭa me gīḥ prāvattoke tanaye tūtujānā |
7,085.05 suratnāso devavītiṃ gamema yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,086.01  dhīrā tvasya mahinā janūṃṣi vi yastastambha rodasī cidurvī |
7,086.01 pra nākamṛṣvaṃ nunude bṛhantaṃ dvitā nakṣatraṃ paprathacca bhūma ||
7,086.02  uta svayā tanvā saṃ vade tatkadā nvantarvaruṇe bhuvāni |
7,086.02 kiṃ me havyamahṛṇāno juṣeta kadā mṛḻīkaṃ sumanā abhi khyam ||
7,086.03  pṛcche tadeno varuṇa didṛkṣūpo emi cikituṣo vipṛccham |
7,086.03 samānaminme kavayaścidāhurayaṃ ha tubhyaṃ varuṇo hṛṇīte ||
7,086.04  kimāga āsa varuṇa jyeṣṭhaṃ yatstotāraṃ jighāṃsasi sakhāyam |
7,086.04 pra tanme voco dūḻabha svadhāvo'va tvānenā namasā tura iyām ||
7,086.05  ava drugdhāni pitryā sṛjā no'va yā vayaṃ cakṛmā tanūbhiḥ |
7,086.05 ava rājanpaśutṛpaṃ na tāyuṃ sṛjā vatsaṃ na dāmno vasiṣṭham ||
7,086.06  na sa svo dakṣo varuṇa dhrutiḥ sā surā manyurvibhīdako acittiḥ |
7,086.06 asti jyāyānkanīyasa upāre svapnaścanedanṛtasya prayotā ||
7,086.07  araṃ dāso na mīḻhuṣe karāṇyahaṃ devāya bhūrṇaye'nāgāḥ |
7,086.07 acetayadacito devo aryo gṛtsaṃ rāye kavitaro junāti ||
7,086.08  ayaṃ su tubhyaṃ varuṇa svadhāvo hṛdi stoma upaśritaścidastu |
7,086.08 śaṃ naḥ kṣeme śamu yoge no astu yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,087.01  radatpatho varuṇaḥ sūryāya prārṇāṃsi samudriyā nadīnām |
7,087.01 sargo na sṛṣṭo arvatīrṛtāyañcakāra mahīravanīrahabhyaḥ ||
7,087.02  ātmā te vāto raja ā navīnotpaśurna bhūrṇiryavase sasavān |
7,087.02 antarmahī bṛhatī rodasīme viśvā te dhāma varuṇa priyāṇi ||
7,087.03  pari spaśo varuṇasya smadiṣṭā ubhe paśyanti rodasī sumeke |
7,087.03 ṛtāvānaḥ kavayo yajñadhīrāḥ pracetaso ya iṣayanta manma ||
7,087.04  uvāca me varuṇo medhirāya triḥ sapta nāmāghnyā bibharti |
7,087.04 vidvānpadasya guhyā na vocadyugāya vipra uparāya śikṣan ||
7,087.05  tisro dyāvo nihitā antarasmintisro bhūmīruparāḥ ṣaḍvidhānāḥ |
7,087.05 gṛtso rājā varuṇaścakra etaṃ divi preṅkhaṃ hiraṇyayaṃ śubhe kam ||
7,087.06  ava sindhuṃ varuṇo dyauriva sthāddrapso na śveto mṛgastuviṣmān |
7,087.06 gambhīraśaṃso rajaso vimānaḥ supārakṣatraḥ sato asya rājā ||
7,087.07  yo mṛḻayāti cakruṣe cidāgo vayaṃ syāma varuṇe anāgāḥ |
7,087.07 anu vratānyaditerṛdhanto yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,088.01  pra śundhyuvaṃ varuṇāya preṣṭhāṃ matiṃ vasiṣṭha mīḻhuṣe bharasva |
7,088.01 ya īmarvāñcaṃ karate yajatraṃ sahasrāmaghaṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ bṛhantam ||
7,088.02  adhā nvasya saṃdṛśaṃ jaganvānagneranīkaṃ varuṇasya maṃsi |
7,088.02 svaryadaśmannadhipā u andho'bhi mā vapurdṛśaye ninīyāt ||
7,088.03  ā yadruhāva varuṇaśca nāvaṃ pra yatsamudramīrayāva madhyam |
7,088.03 adhi yadapāṃ snubhiścarāva pra preṅkha īṅkhayāvahai śubhe kam ||
7,088.04  vasiṣṭhaṃ ha varuṇo nāvyādhādṛṣiṃ cakāra svapā mahobhiḥ |
7,088.04 stotāraṃ vipraḥ sudinatve ahnāṃ yānnu dyāvastatananyāduṣāsaḥ ||
7,088.05  kva tyāni nau sakhyā babhūvuḥ sacāvahe yadavṛkaṃ purā cit |
7,088.05 bṛhantaṃ mānaṃ varuṇa svadhāvaḥ sahasradvāraṃ jagamā gṛhaṃ te ||
7,088.06  ya āpirnityo varuṇa priyaḥ santvāmāgāṃsi kṛṇavatsakhā te |
7,088.06 mā ta enasvanto yakṣinbhujema yandhi ṣmā vipra stuvate varūtham ||
7,088.07  dhruvāsu tvāsu kṣitiṣu kṣiyanto vyasmatpāśaṃ varuṇo mumocat |
7,088.07 avo vanvānā aditerupasthādyūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,089.01  mo ṣu varuṇa mṛnmayaṃ gṛhaṃ rājannahaṃ gamam |
7,089.01 mṛḻā sukṣatra mṛḻaya ||
7,089.02  yademi prasphuranniva dṛtirna dhmāto adrivaḥ |
7,089.02 mṛḻā sukṣatra mṛḻaya ||
7,089.03  kratvaḥ samaha dīnatā pratīpaṃ jagamā śuce |
7,089.03 mṛḻā sukṣatra mṛḻaya ||
7,089.04  apāṃ madhye tasthivāṃsaṃ tṛṣṇāvidajjaritāram |
7,089.04 mṛḻā sukṣatra mṛḻaya ||
7,089.05  yatkiṃ cedaṃ varuṇa daivye jane'bhidrohaṃ manuṣyāścarāmasi |
7,089.05 acittī yattava dharmā yuyopima mā nastasmādenaso deva rīriṣaḥ ||

7,090.01  pra vīrayā śucayo dadrire vāmadhvaryubhirmadhumantaḥ sutāsaḥ |
7,090.01 vaha vāyo niyuto yāhyacchā pibā sutasyāndhaso madāya ||
7,090.02  īśānāya prahutiṃ yasta ānaṭchuciṃ somaṃ śucipāstubhyaṃ vāyo |
7,090.02 kṛṇoṣi taṃ martyeṣu praśastaṃ jātojāto jāyate vājyasya ||
7,090.03  rāye nu yaṃ jajñatū rodasīme rāye devī dhiṣaṇā dhāti devam |
7,090.03 adha vāyuṃ niyutaḥ saścata svā uta śvetaṃ vasudhitiṃ nireke ||
7,090.04  ucchannuṣasaḥ sudinā ariprā uru jyotirvividurdīdhyānāḥ |
7,090.04 gavyaṃ cidūrvamuśijo vi vavrusteṣāmanu pradivaḥ sasrurāpaḥ ||
7,090.05  te satyena manasā dīdhyānāḥ svena yuktāsaḥ kratunā vahanti |
7,090.05 indravāyū vīravāhaṃ rathaṃ vāmīśānayorabhi pṛkṣaḥ sacante ||
7,090.06  īśānāso ye dadhate svarṇo gobhiraśvebhirvasubhirhiraṇyaiḥ |
7,090.06 indravāyū sūrayo viśvamāyurarvadbhirvīraiḥ pṛtanāsu sahyuḥ ||
7,090.07  arvanto na śravaso bhikṣamāṇā indravāyū suṣṭutibhirvasiṣṭhāḥ |
7,090.07 vājayantaḥ svavase huvema yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,091.01  kuvidaṅga namasā ye vṛdhāsaḥ purā devā anavadyāsa āsan |
7,091.01 te vāyave manave bādhitāyāvāsayannuṣasaṃ sūryeṇa ||
7,091.02  uśantā dūtā na dabhāya gopā māsaśca pāthaḥ śaradaśca pūrvīḥ |
7,091.02 indravāyū suṣṭutirvāmiyānā mārḍīkamīṭṭe suvitaṃ ca navyam ||
7,091.03  pīvoannāṃ rayivṛdhaḥ sumedhāḥ śvetaḥ siṣakti niyutāmabhiśrīḥ |
7,091.03 te vāyave samanaso vi tasthurviśvennaraḥ svapatyāni cakruḥ ||
7,091.04  yāvattarastanvo yāvadojo yāvannaraścakṣasā dīdhyānāḥ |
7,091.04 śuciṃ somaṃ śucipā pātamasme indravāyū sadataṃ barhiredam ||
7,091.05  niyuvānā niyuta spārhavīrā indravāyū sarathaṃ yātamarvāk |
7,091.05 idaṃ hi vāṃ prabhṛtaṃ madhvo agramadha prīṇānā vi mumuktamasme ||
7,091.06  yā vāṃ śataṃ niyuto yāḥ sahasramindravāyū viśvavārāḥ sacante |
7,091.06 ābhiryātaṃ suvidatrābhirarvākpātaṃ narā pratibhṛtasya madhvaḥ ||
7,091.07  arvanto na śravaso bhikṣamāṇā indravāyū suṣṭutibhirvasiṣṭhāḥ |
7,091.07 vājayantaḥ svavase huvema yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,092.01  ā vāyo bhūṣa śucipā upa naḥ sahasraṃ te niyuto viśvavāra |
7,092.01 upo te andho madyamayāmi yasya deva dadhiṣe pūrvapeyam ||
7,092.02  pra sotā jīro adhvareṣvasthātsomamindrāya vāyave pibadhyai |
7,092.02 pra yadvāṃ madhvo agriyaṃ bharantyadhvaryavo devayantaḥ śacībhiḥ ||
7,092.03  pra yābhiryāsi dāśvāṃsamacchā niyudbhirvāyaviṣṭaye duroṇe |
7,092.03 ni no rayiṃ subhojasaṃ yuvasva ni vīraṃ gavyamaśvyaṃ ca rādhaḥ ||
7,092.04  ye vāyava indramādanāsa ādevāso nitośanāso aryaḥ |
7,092.04 ghnanto vṛtrāṇi sūribhiḥ ṣyāma sāsahvāṃso yudhā nṛbhiramitrān ||
7,092.05  ā no niyudbhiḥ śatinībhiradhvaraṃ sahasriṇībhirupa yāhi yajñam |
7,092.05 vāyo asminsavane mādayasva yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,093.01  śuciṃ nu stomaṃ navajātamadyendrāgnī vṛtrahaṇā juṣethām |
7,093.01 ubhā hi vāṃ suhavā johavīmi tā vājaṃ sadya uśate dheṣṭhā ||
7,093.02  tā sānasī śavasānā hi bhūtaṃ sākaṃvṛdhā śavasā śūśuvāṃsā |
7,093.02 kṣayantau rāyo yavasasya bhūreḥ pṛṅktaṃ vājasya sthavirasya ghṛṣveḥ ||
7,093.03  upo ha yadvidathaṃ vājino gurdhībhirviprāḥ pramatimicchamānāḥ |
7,093.03 arvanto na kāṣṭhāṃ nakṣamāṇā indrāgnī johuvato naraste ||
7,093.04  gīrbhirvipraḥ pramatimicchamāna īṭṭe rayiṃ yaśasaṃ pūrvabhājam |
7,093.04 indrāgnī vṛtrahaṇā suvajrā pra no navyebhistirataṃ deṣṇaiḥ ||
7,093.05  saṃ yanmahī mithatī spardhamāne tanūrucā śūrasātā yataite |
7,093.05 adevayuṃ vidathe devayubhiḥ satrā hataṃ somasutā janena ||
7,093.06  imāmu ṣu somasutimupa na endrāgnī saumanasāya yātam |
7,093.06 nū ciddhi parimamnāthe asmānā vāṃ śaśvadbhirvavṛtīya vājaiḥ ||
7,093.07  so agna enā namasā samiddho'cchā mitraṃ varuṇamindraṃ voceḥ |
7,093.07 yatsīmāgaścakṛmā tatsu mṛḻa tadaryamāditiḥ śiśrathantu ||
7,093.08  etā agna āśuṣāṇāsa iṣṭīryuvoḥ sacābhyaśyāma vājān |
7,093.08 mendro no viṣṇurmarutaḥ pari khyanyūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,094.01  iyaṃ vāmasya manmana indrāgnī pūrvyastutiḥ |
7,094.01 abhrādvṛṣṭirivājani ||
7,094.02  śṛṇutaṃ jariturhavamindrāgnī vanataṃ giraḥ |
7,094.02 īśānā pipyataṃ dhiyaḥ ||
7,094.03  mā pāpatvāya no narendrāgnī mābhiśastaye |
7,094.03 mā no rīradhataṃ nide ||
7,094.04  indre agnā namo bṛhatsuvṛktimerayāmahe |
7,094.04 dhiyā dhenā avasyavaḥ ||
7,094.05  tā hi śaśvanta īḻata itthā viprāsa ūtaye |
7,094.05 sabādho vājasātaye ||
7,094.06  tā vāṃ gīrbhirvipanyavaḥ prayasvanto havāmahe |
7,094.06 medhasātā saniṣyavaḥ ||
7,094.07  indrāgnī avasā gatamasmabhyaṃ carṣaṇīsahā |
7,094.07 mā no duḥśaṃsa īśata ||
7,094.08  mā kasya no araruṣo dhūrtiḥ praṇaṅmartyasya |
7,094.08 indrāgnī śarma yacchatam ||
7,094.09  gomaddhiraṇyavadvasu yadvāmaśvāvadīmahe |
7,094.09 indrāgnī tadvanemahi ||
7,094.10  yatsoma ā sute nara indrāgnī ajohavuḥ |
7,094.10 saptīvantā saparyavaḥ ||
7,094.11  ukthebhirvṛtrahantamā yā mandānā cidā girā |
7,094.11 āṅgūṣairāvivāsataḥ ||
7,094.12  tāvidduḥśaṃsaṃ martyaṃ durvidvāṃsaṃ rakṣasvinam |
7,094.12 ābhogaṃ hanmanā hatamudadhiṃ hanmanā hatam ||

7,095.01  pra kṣodasā dhāyasā sasra eṣā sarasvatī dharuṇamāyasī pūḥ |
7,095.01 prabābadhānā rathyeva yāti viśvā apo mahinā sindhuranyāḥ ||
7,095.02  ekācetatsarasvatī nadīnāṃ śuciryatī giribhya ā samudrāt |
7,095.02 rāyaścetantī bhuvanasya bhūrerghṛtaṃ payo duduhe nāhuṣāya ||
7,095.03  sa vāvṛdhe naryo yoṣaṇāsu vṛṣā śiśurvṛṣabho yajñiyāsu |
7,095.03 sa vājinaṃ maghavadbhyo dadhāti vi sātaye tanvaṃ māmṛjīta ||
7,095.04  uta syā naḥ sarasvatī juṣāṇopa śravatsubhagā yajṇe asmin |
7,095.04 mitajñubhirnamasyairiyānā rāyā yujā ciduttarā sakhibhyaḥ ||
7,095.05  imā juhvānā yuṣmadā namobhiḥ prati stomaṃ sarasvati juṣasva |
7,095.05 tava śarmanpriyatame dadhānā upa stheyāma śaraṇaṃ na vṛkṣam ||
7,095.06  ayamu te sarasvati vasiṣṭho dvārāvṛtasya subhage vyāvaḥ |
7,095.06 vardha śubhre stuvate rāsi vājānyūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,096.01  bṛhadu gāyiṣe vaco'suryā nadīnām |
7,096.01 sarasvatīminmahayā suvṛktibhi stomairvasiṣṭha rodasī ||
7,096.02  ubhe yatte mahinā śubhre andhasī adhikṣiyanti pūravaḥ |
7,096.02 sā no bodhyavitrī marutsakhā coda rādho maghonām ||
7,096.03  bhadramidbhadrā kṛṇavatsarasvatyakavārī cetati vājinīvatī |
7,096.03 gṛṇānā jamadagnivatstuvānā ca vasiṣṭhavat ||
7,096.04  janīyanto nvagravaḥ putrīyantaḥ sudānavaḥ |
7,096.04 sarasvantaṃ havāmahe ||
7,096.05  ye te sarasva ūrmayo madhumanto ghṛtaścutaḥ |
7,096.05 tebhirno'vitā bhava ||
7,096.06  pīpivāṃsaṃ sarasvata stanaṃ yo viśvadarśataḥ |
7,096.06 bhakṣīmahi prajāmiṣam ||

7,097.01  yajñe divo nṛṣadane pṛthivyā naro yatra devayavo madanti |
7,097.01 indrāya yatra savanāni sunve gamanmadāya prathamaṃ vayaśca ||
7,097.02  ā daivyā vṛṇīmahe'vāṃsi bṛhaspatirno maha ā sakhāyaḥ |
7,097.02 yathā bhavema mīḻhuṣe anāgā yo no dātā parāvataḥ piteva ||
7,097.03  tamu jyeṣṭhaṃ namasā havirbhiḥ suśevaṃ brahmaṇaspatiṃ gṛṇīṣe |
7,097.03 indraṃ śloko mahi daivyaḥ siṣaktu yo brahmaṇo devakṛtasya rājā ||
7,097.04  sa ā no yoniṃ sadatu preṣṭho bṛhaspatirviśvavāro yo asti |
7,097.04 kāmo rāyaḥ suvīryasya taṃ dātparṣanno ati saścato ariṣṭān ||
7,097.05  tamā no arkamamṛtāya juṣṭamime dhāsuramṛtāsaḥ purājāḥ |
7,097.05 śucikrandaṃ yajataṃ pastyānāṃ bṛhaspatimanarvāṇaṃ huvema ||
7,097.06  taṃ śagmāso aruṣāso aśvā bṛhaspatiṃ sahavāho vahanti |
7,097.06 sahaścidyasya nīlavatsadhasthaṃ nabho na rūpamaruṣaṃ vasānāḥ ||
7,097.07  sa hi śuciḥ śatapatraḥ sa śundhyurhiraṇyavāśīriṣiraḥ svarṣāḥ |
7,097.07 bṛhaspatiḥ sa svāveśa ṛṣvaḥ purū sakhibhya āsutiṃ kariṣṭhaḥ ||
7,097.08  devī devasya rodasī janitrī bṛhaspatiṃ vāvṛdhaturmahitvā |
7,097.08 dakṣāyyāya dakṣatā sakhāyaḥ karadbrahmaṇe sutarā sugādhā ||
7,097.09  iyaṃ vāṃ brahmaṇaspate suvṛktirbrahmendrāya vajriṇe akāri |
7,097.09 aviṣṭaṃ dhiyo jigṛtaṃ purandhīrjajastamaryo vanuṣāmarātīḥ ||
7,097.10  bṛhaspate yuvamindraśca vasvo divyasyeśāthe uta pārthivasya |
7,097.10 dhattaṃ rayiṃ stuvate kīraye cidyūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,098.01  adhvaryavo'ruṇaṃ dugdhamaṃśuṃ juhotana vṛṣabhāya kṣitīnām |
7,098.01 gaurādvedīyāṃ avapānamindro viśvāhedyāti sutasomamicchan ||
7,098.02  yaddadhiṣe pradivi cārvannaṃ divedive pītimidasya vakṣi |
7,098.02 uta hṛdota manasā juṣāṇa uśannindra prasthitānpāhi somān ||
7,098.03  jajñānaḥ somaṃ sahase papātha pra te mātā mahimānamuvāca |
7,098.03 endra paprāthorvantarikṣaṃ yudhā devebhyo varivaścakartha ||
7,098.04  yadyodhayā mahato manyamānānsākṣāma tānbāhubhiḥ śāśadānān |
7,098.04 yadvā nṛbhirvṛta indrābhiyudhyāstaṃ tvayājiṃ sauśravasaṃ jayema ||
7,098.05  prendrasya vocaṃ prathamā kṛtāni pra nūtanā maghavā yā cakāra |
7,098.05 yadedadevīrasahiṣṭa māyā athābhavatkevalaḥ somo asya ||
7,098.06  tavedaṃ viśvamabhitaḥ paśavyaṃ yatpaśyasi cakṣasā sūryasya |
7,098.06 gavāmasi gopatireka indra bhakṣīmahi te prayatasya vasvaḥ ||
7,098.07  bṛhaspate yuvamindraśca vasvo divyasyeśāthe uta pārthivasya |
7,098.07 dhattaṃ rayiṃ stuvate kīraye cidyūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,099.01  paro mātrayā tanvā vṛdhāna na te mahitvamanvaśnuvanti |
7,099.01 ubhe te vidma rajasī pṛthivyā viṣṇo deva tvaṃ paramasya vitse ||
7,099.02  na te viṣṇo jāyamāno na jāto deva mahimnaḥ paramantamāpa |
7,099.02 udastabhnā nākamṛṣvaṃ bṛhantaṃ dādhartha prācīṃ kakubhaṃ pṛthivyāḥ ||
7,099.03  irāvatī dhenumatī hi bhūtaṃ sūyavasinī manuṣe daśasyā |
7,099.03 vyastabhnā rodasī viṣṇavete dādhartha pṛthivīmabhito mayūkhaiḥ ||
7,099.04  uruṃ yajñāya cakrathuru lokaṃ janayantā sūryamuṣāsamagnim |
7,099.04 dāsasya cidvṛṣaśiprasya māyā jaghnathurnarā pṛtanājyeṣu ||
7,099.05  indrāviṣṇū dṛṃhitāḥ śambarasya nava puro navatiṃ ca śnathiṣṭam |
7,099.05 śataṃ varcinaḥ sahasraṃ ca sākaṃ hatho apratyasurasya vīrān ||
7,099.06  iyaṃ manīṣā bṛhatī bṛhantorukramā tavasā vardhayantī |
7,099.06 rare vāṃ stomaṃ vidatheṣu viṣṇo pinvatamiṣo vṛjaneṣvindra ||
7,099.07  vaṣaṭte viṣṇavāsa ā kṛṇomi tanme juṣasva śipiviṣṭa havyam |
7,099.07 vardhantu tvā suṣṭutayo giro me yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,100.01  nū marto dayate saniṣyanyo viṣṇava urugāyāya dāśat |
7,100.01 pra yaḥ satrācā manasā yajāta etāvantaṃ naryamāvivāsāt ||
7,100.02  tvaṃ viṣṇo sumatiṃ viśvajanyāmaprayutāmevayāvo matiṃ dāḥ |
7,100.02 parco yathā naḥ suvitasya bhūreraśvāvataḥ puruścandrasya rāyaḥ ||
7,100.03  trirdevaḥ pṛthivīmeṣa etāṃ vi cakrame śatarcasaṃ mahitvā |
7,100.03 pra viṣṇurastu tavasastavīyāntveṣaṃ hyasya sthavirasya nāma ||
7,100.04  vi cakrame pṛthivīmeṣa etāṃ kṣetrāya viṣṇurmanuṣe daśasyan |
7,100.04 dhruvāso asya kīrayo janāsa urukṣitiṃ sujanimā cakāra ||
7,100.05  pra tatte adya śipiviṣṭa nāmāryaḥ śaṃsāmi vayunāni vidvān |
7,100.05 taṃ tvā gṛṇāmi tavasamatavyānkṣayantamasya rajasaḥ parāke ||
7,100.06  kimitte viṣṇo paricakṣyaṃ bhūtpra yadvavakṣe śipiviṣṭo asmi |
7,100.06 mā varpo asmadapa gūha etadyadanyarūpaḥ samithe babhūtha ||
7,100.07  vaṣaṭte viṣṇavāsa ā kṛṇomi tanme juṣasva śipiviṣṭa havyam |
7,100.07 vardhantu tvā suṣṭutayo giro me yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,101.01  tisro vācaḥ pra vada jyotiragrā yā etadduhre madhudoghamūdhaḥ |
7,101.01 sa vatsaṃ kṛṇvangarbhamoṣadhīnāṃ sadyo jāto vṛṣabho roravīti ||
7,101.02  yo vardhana oṣadhīnāṃ yo apāṃ yo viśvasya jagato deva īśe |
7,101.02 sa tridhātu śaraṇaṃ śarma yaṃsattrivartu jyotiḥ svabhiṣṭyasme ||
7,101.03  starīru tvadbhavati sūta u tvadyathāvaśaṃ tanvaṃ cakra eṣaḥ |
7,101.03 pituḥ payaḥ prati gṛbhṇāti mātā tena pitā vardhate tena putraḥ ||
7,101.04  yasminviśvāni bhuvanāni tasthustisro dyāvastredhā sasrurāpaḥ |
7,101.04 trayaḥ kośāsa upasecanāso madhva ścotantyabhito virapśam ||
7,101.05  idaṃ vacaḥ parjanyāya svarāje hṛdo astvantaraṃ tajjujoṣat |
7,101.05 mayobhuvo vṛṣṭayaḥ santvasme supippalā oṣadhīrdevagopāḥ ||
7,101.06  sa retodhā vṛṣabhaḥ śaśvatīnāṃ tasminnātmā jagatastasthuṣaśca |
7,101.06 tanma ṛtaṃ pātu śataśāradāya yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

7,102.01  parjanyāya pra gāyata divasputrāya mīḻhuṣe |
7,102.01 sa no yavasamicchatu ||
7,102.02  yo garbhamoṣadhīnāṃ gavāṃ kṛṇotyarvatām |
7,102.02 parjanyaḥ puruṣīṇām ||
7,102.03  tasmā idāsye havirjuhotā madhumattamam |
7,102.03 iḻāṃ naḥ saṃyataṃ karat ||

7,103.01  saṃvatsaraṃ śaśayānā brāhmaṇā vratacāriṇaḥ |
7,103.01 vācaṃ parjanyajinvitāṃ pra maṇḍūkā avādiṣuḥ ||
7,103.02  divyā āpo abhi yadenamāyandṛtiṃ na śuṣkaṃ sarasī śayānam |
7,103.02 gavāmaha na māyurvatsinīnāṃ maṇḍūkānāṃ vagnuratrā sameti ||
7,103.03  yadīmenāṃ uśato abhyavarṣīttṛṣyāvataḥ prāvṛṣyāgatāyām |
7,103.03 akhkhalīkṛtyā pitaraṃ na putro anyo anyamupa vadantameti ||
7,103.04  anyo anyamanu gṛbhṇātyenorapāṃ prasarge yadamandiṣātām |
7,103.04 maṇḍūko yadabhivṛṣṭaḥ kaniṣkanpṛśniḥ sampṛṅkte haritena vācam ||
7,103.05  yadeṣāmanyo anyasya vācaṃ śāktasyeva vadati śikṣamāṇaḥ |
7,103.05 sarvaṃ tadeṣāṃ samṛdheva parva yatsuvāco vadathanādhyapsu ||
7,103.06  gomāyureko ajamāyurekaḥ pṛśnireko harita eka eṣām |
7,103.06 samānaṃ nāma bibhrato virūpāḥ purutrā vācaṃ pipiśurvadantaḥ ||
7,103.07  brāhmaṇāso atirātre na some saro na pūrṇamabhito vadantaḥ |
7,103.07 saṃvatsarasya tadahaḥ pari ṣṭha yanmaṇḍūkāḥ prāvṛṣīṇaṃ babhūva ||
7,103.08  brāhmaṇāsaḥ somino vācamakrata brahma kṛṇvantaḥ parivatsarīṇam |
7,103.08 adhvaryavo gharmiṇaḥ siṣvidānā āvirbhavanti guhyā na ke cit ||
7,103.09  devahitiṃ jugupurdvādaśasya ṛtuṃ naro na pra minantyete |
7,103.09 saṃvatsare prāvṛṣyāgatāyāṃ taptā gharmā aśnuvate visargam ||
7,103.10  gomāyuradādajamāyuradātpṛśniradāddharito no vasūni |
7,103.10 gavāṃ maṇḍūkā dadataḥ śatāni sahasrasāve pra tiranta āyuḥ ||

7,104.01  indrāsomā tapataṃ rakṣa ubjataṃ nyarpayataṃ vṛṣaṇā tamovṛdhaḥ |
7,104.01 parā śṛṇītamacito nyoṣataṃ hataṃ nudethāṃ ni śiśītamatriṇaḥ ||
7,104.02  indrāsomā samaghaśaṃsamabhyaghaṃ tapuryayastu caruragnivāṃ iva |
7,104.02 brahmadviṣe kravyāde ghoracakṣase dveṣo dhattamanavāyaṃ kimīdine ||
7,104.03  indrāsomā duṣkṛto vavre antaranārambhaṇe tamasi pra vidhyatam |
7,104.03 yathā nātaḥ punarekaścanodayattadvāmastu sahase manyumacchavaḥ ||
7,104.04  indrāsomā vartayataṃ divo vadhaṃ saṃ pṛthivyā aghaśaṃsāya tarhaṇam |
7,104.04 uttakṣataṃ svaryaṃ parvatebhyo yena rakṣo vāvṛdhānaṃ nijūrvathaḥ ||
7,104.05  indrāsomā vartayataṃ divasparyagnitaptebhiryuvamaśmahanmabhiḥ |
7,104.05 tapurvadhebhirajarebhiratriṇo ni parśāne vidhyataṃ yantu nisvaram ||
7,104.06  indrāsomā pari vāṃ bhūtu viśvata iyaṃ matiḥ kakṣyāśveva vājinā |
7,104.06 yāṃ vāṃ hotrāṃ parihinomi medhayemā brahmāṇi nṛpatīva jinvatam ||
7,104.07  prati smarethāṃ tujayadbhirevairhataṃ druho rakṣaso bhaṅgurāvataḥ |
7,104.07 indrāsomā duṣkṛte mā sugaṃ bhūdyo naḥ kadā cidabhidāsati druhā ||
7,104.08  yo mā pākena manasā carantamabhicaṣṭe anṛtebhirvacobhiḥ |
7,104.08 āpa iva kāśinā saṃgṛbhītā asannastvāsata indra vaktā ||
7,104.09  ye pākaśaṃsaṃ viharanta evairye vā bhadraṃ dūṣayanti svadhābhiḥ |
7,104.09 ahaye vā tānpradadātu soma ā vā dadhātu nirṛterupasthe ||
7,104.10  yo no rasaṃ dipsati pitvo agne yo aśvānāṃ yo gavāṃ yastanūnām |
7,104.10 ripu stena steyakṛddabhrametu ni ṣa hīyatāṃ tanvā tanā ca ||
7,104.11  paraḥ so astu tanvā tanā ca tisraḥ pṛthivīradho astu viśvāḥ |
7,104.11 prati śuṣyatu yaśo asya devā yo no divā dipsati yaśca naktam ||
7,104.12  suvijñānaṃ cikituṣe janāya saccāsacca vacasī paspṛdhāte |
7,104.12 tayoryatsatyaṃ yataradṛjīyastaditsomo'vati hantyāsat ||
7,104.13  na vā u somo vṛjinaṃ hinoti na kṣatriyaṃ mithuyā dhārayantam |
7,104.13 hanti rakṣo hantyāsadvadantamubhāvindrasya prasitau śayāte ||
7,104.14  yadi vāhamanṛtadeva āsa moghaṃ vā devāṃ apyūhe agne |
7,104.14 kimasmabhyaṃ jātavedo hṛṇīṣe droghavācaste nirṛthaṃ sacantām ||
7,104.15  adyā murīya yadi yātudhāno asmi yadi vāyustatapa pūruṣasya |
7,104.15 adhā sa vīrairdaśabhirvi yūyā yo mā moghaṃ yātudhānetyāha ||
7,104.16  yo māyātuṃ yātudhānetyāha yo vā rakṣāḥ śucirasmītyāha |
7,104.16 indrastaṃ hantu mahatā vadhena viśvasya jantoradhamaspadīṣṭa ||
7,104.17  pra yā jigāti khargaleva naktamapa druhā tanvaṃ gūhamānā |
7,104.17 vavrāṃ anantāṃ ava sā padīṣṭa grāvāṇo ghnantu rakṣasa upabdaiḥ ||
7,104.18  vi tiṣṭhadhvaṃ maruto vikṣvicchata gṛbhāyata rakṣasaḥ saṃ pinaṣṭana |
7,104.18 vayo ye bhūtvī patayanti naktabhirye vā ripo dadhire deve adhvare ||
7,104.19  pra vartaya divo aśmānamindra somaśitaṃ maghavansaṃ śiśādhi |
7,104.19 prāktādapāktādadharādudaktādabhi jahi rakṣasaḥ parvatena ||
7,104.20  eta u tye patayanti śvayātava indraṃ dipsanti dipsavo'dābhyam |
7,104.20 śiśīte śakraḥ piśunebhyo vadhaṃ nūnaṃ sṛjadaśaniṃ yātumadbhyaḥ ||
7,104.21  indro yātūnāmabhavatparāśaro havirmathīnāmabhyāvivāsatām |
7,104.21 abhīdu śakraḥ paraśuryathā vanaṃ pātreva bhindansata eti rakṣasaḥ ||
7,104.22  ulūkayātuṃ śuśulūkayātuṃ jahi śvayātumuta kokayātum |
7,104.22 suparṇayātumuta gṛdhrayātuṃ dṛṣadeva pra mṛṇa rakṣa indra ||
7,104.23  mā no rakṣo abhi naḍyātumāvatāmapocchatu mithunā yā kimīdinā |
7,104.23 pṛthivī naḥ pārthivātpātvaṃhaso'ntarikṣaṃ divyātpātvasmān ||
7,104.24  indra jahi pumāṃsaṃ yātudhānamuta striyaṃ māyayā śāśadānām |
7,104.24 vigrīvāso mūradevā ṛdantu mā te dṛśansūryamuccarantam ||
7,104.25  prati cakṣva vi cakṣvendraśca soma jāgṛtam |
7,104.25 rakṣobhyo vadhamasyatamaśaniṃ yātumadbhyaḥ ||







ṛgveda 8



8,001.01  mā cidanyadvi śaṃsata sakhāyo mā riṣaṇyata |
8,001.01 indramitstotā vṛṣaṇaṃ sacā sute muhurukthā ca śaṃsata ||
8,001.02  avakrakṣiṇaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ yathājuraṃ gāṃ na carṣaṇīsaham |
8,001.02 vidveṣaṇaṃ saṃvananobhayaṅkaraṃ maṃhiṣṭhamubhayāvinam ||
8,001.03  yacciddhi tvā janā ime nānā havanta ūtaye |
8,001.03 asmākaṃ brahmedamindra bhūtu te'hā viśvā ca vardhanam ||
8,001.04  vi tartūryante maghavanvipaścito'ryo vipo janānām |
8,001.04 upa kramasva pururūpamā bhara vājaṃ nediṣṭhamūtaye ||
8,001.05  mahe cana tvāmadrivaḥ parā śulkāya deyām |
8,001.05 na sahasrāya nāyutāya vajrivo na śatāya śatāmagha ||
8,001.06  vasyāṃ indrāsi me pituruta bhrāturabhuñjataḥ |
8,001.06 mātā ca me chadayathaḥ samā vaso vasutvanāya rādhase ||
8,001.07  kveyatha kvedasi purutrā ciddhi te manaḥ |
8,001.07 alarṣi yudhma khajakṛtpurandara pra gāyatrā agāsiṣuḥ ||
8,001.08  prāsmai gāyatramarcata vāvāturyaḥ purandaraḥ |
8,001.08 yābhiḥ kāṇvasyopa barhirāsadaṃ yāsadvajrī bhinatpuraḥ ||
8,001.09  ye te santi daśagvinaḥ śatino ye sahasriṇaḥ |
8,001.09 aśvāso ye te vṛṣaṇo raghudruvastebhirnastūyamā gahi ||
8,001.10  ā tvadya sabardughāṃ huve gāyatravepasam |
8,001.10 indraṃ dhenuṃ sudughāmanyāmiṣamurudhārāmaraṅkṛtam ||
8,001.11  yattudatsūra etaśaṃ vaṅkū vātasya parṇinā |
8,001.11 vahatkutsamārjuneyaṃ śatakratuḥ tsaradgandharvamastṛtam ||
8,001.12  ya ṛte cidabhiśriṣaḥ purā jatrubhya ātṛdaḥ |
8,001.12 saṃdhātā saṃdhiṃ maghavā purūvasuriṣkartā vihrutaṃ punaḥ ||
8,001.13  mā bhūma niṣṭyā ivendra tvadaraṇā iva |
8,001.13 vanāni na prajahitānyadrivo duroṣāso amanmahi ||
8,001.14  amanmahīdanāśavo'nugrāsaśca vṛtrahan |
8,001.14 sakṛtsu te mahatā śūra rādhasā anu stomaṃ mudīmahi ||
8,001.15  yadi stomaṃ mama śravadasmākamindramindavaḥ |
8,001.15 tiraḥ pavitraṃ sasṛvāṃsa āśavo mandantu tugryāvṛdhaḥ ||
8,001.16  ā tvadya sadhastutiṃ vāvātuḥ sakhyurā gahi |
8,001.16 upastutirmaghonāṃ pra tvāvatvadhā te vaśmi suṣṭutim ||
8,001.17  sotā hi somamadribhiremenamapsu dhāvata |
8,001.17 gavyā vastreva vāsayanta innaro nirdhukṣanvakṣaṇābhyaḥ ||
8,001.18  adha jmo adha vā divo bṛhato rocanādadhi |
8,001.18 ayā vardhasva tanvā girā mamā jātā sukrato pṛṇa ||
8,001.19  indrāya su madintamaṃ somaṃ sotā vareṇyam |
8,001.19 śakra eṇaṃ pīpayadviśvayā dhiyā hinvānaṃ na vājayum ||
8,001.20  mā tvā somasya galdayā sadā yācannahaṃ girā |
8,001.20 bhūrṇiṃ mṛgaṃ na savaneṣu cukrudhaṃ ka īśānaṃ na yāciṣat ||
8,001.21  madeneṣitaṃ madamugramugreṇa śavasā |
8,001.21 viśveṣāṃ tarutāraṃ madacyutaṃ made hi ṣmā dadāti naḥ ||
8,001.22  śevāre vāryā puru devo martāya dāśuṣe |
8,001.22 sa sunvate ca stuvate ca rāsate viśvagūrto ariṣṭutaḥ ||
8,001.23  endra yāhi matsva citreṇa deva rādhasā |
8,001.23 saro na prāsyudaraṃ sapītibhirā somebhiruru sphiram ||
8,001.24  ā tvā sahasramā śataṃ yuktā rathe hiraṇyaye |
8,001.24 brahmayujo haraya indra keśino vahantu somapītaye ||
8,001.25  ā tvā rathe hiraṇyaye harī mayūraśepyā |
8,001.25 śitipṛṣṭhā vahatāṃ madhvo andhaso vivakṣaṇasya pītaye ||
8,001.26  pibā tvasya girvaṇaḥ sutasya pūrvapā iva |
8,001.26 pariṣkṛtasya rasina iyamāsutiścārurmadāya patyate ||
8,001.27  ya eko asti daṃsanā mahāṃ ugro abhi vrataiḥ |
8,001.27 gamatsa śiprī na sa yoṣadā gamaddhavaṃ na pari varjati ||
8,001.28  tvaṃ puraṃ cariṣṇvaṃ vadhaiḥ śuṣṇasya saṃ piṇak |
8,001.28 tvaṃ bhā anu caro adha dvitā yadindra havyo bhuvaḥ ||
8,001.29  mama tvā sūra udite mama madhyandine divaḥ |
8,001.29 mama prapitve apiśarvare vasavā stomāso avṛtsata ||
8,001.30  stuhi stuhīdete ghā te maṃhiṣṭhāso maghonām |
8,001.30 ninditāśvaḥ prapathī paramajyā maghasya medhyātithe ||
8,001.31  ā yadaśvānvananvataḥ śraddhayāhaṃ rathe ruham |
8,001.31 uta vāmasya vasunaściketati yo asti yādvaḥ paśuḥ ||
8,001.32  ya ṛjrā mahyaṃ māmahe saha tvacā hiraṇyayā |
8,001.32 eṣa viśvānyabhyastu saubhagāsaṅgasya svanadrathaḥ ||
8,001.33  adha plāyogirati dāsadanyānāsaṅgo agne daśabhiḥ sahasraiḥ |
8,001.33 adhokṣaṇo daśa mahyaṃ ruśanto naḻā iva saraso niratiṣṭhan ||
8,001.34  anvasya sthūraṃ dadṛśe purastādanastha ūruravarambamāṇaḥ |
8,001.34 śaśvatī nāryabhicakṣyāha subhadramarya bhojanaṃ bibharṣi ||

8,002.01  idaṃ vaso sutamandhaḥ pibā supūrṇamudaram |
8,002.01 anābhayinrarimā te ||
8,002.02  nṛbhirdhūtaḥ suto aśnairavyo vāraiḥ paripūtaḥ |
8,002.02 aśvo na nikto nadīṣu ||
8,002.03  taṃ te yavaṃ yathā gobhiḥ svādumakarma śrīṇantaḥ |
8,002.03 indra tvāsminsadhamāde ||
8,002.04  indra itsomapā eka indraḥ sutapā viśvāyuḥ |
8,002.04 antardevānmartyāṃśca ||
8,002.05  na yaṃ śukro na durāśīrna tṛprā uruvyacasam |
8,002.05 apaspṛṇvate suhārdam ||
8,002.06  gobhiryadīmanye asmanmṛgaṃ na vrā mṛgayante |
8,002.06 abhitsaranti dhenubhiḥ ||
8,002.07  traya indrasya somāḥ sutāsaḥ santu devasya |
8,002.07 sve kṣaye sutapāvnaḥ ||
8,002.08  trayaḥ kośāsa ścotanti tisraścamvaḥ supūrṇāḥ |
8,002.08 samāne adhi bhārman ||
8,002.09  śucirasi puruniṣṭhāḥ kṣīrairmadhyata āśīrtaḥ |
8,002.09 dadhnā mandiṣṭhaḥ śūrasya ||
8,002.10  ime ta indra somāstīvrā asme sutāsaḥ |
8,002.10 śukrā āśiraṃ yācante ||
8,002.11  tāṃ āśiraṃ puroḻāśamindremaṃ somaṃ śrīṇīhi |
8,002.11 revantaṃ hi tvā śṛṇomi ||
8,002.12  hṛtsu pītāso yudhyante durmadāso na surāyām |
8,002.12 ūdharna nagnā jarante ||
8,002.13  revāṃ idrevata stotā syāttvāvato maghonaḥ |
8,002.13 predu harivaḥ śrutasya ||
8,002.14  ukthaṃ cana śasyamānamagorarirā ciketa |
8,002.14 na gāyatraṃ gīyamānam ||
8,002.15  mā na indra pīyatnave mā śardhate parā dāḥ |
8,002.15 śikṣā śacīvaḥ śacībhiḥ ||
8,002.16  vayamu tvā tadidarthā indra tvāyantaḥ sakhāyaḥ |
8,002.16 kaṇvā ukthebhirjarante ||
8,002.17  na ghemanyadā papana vajrinnapaso naviṣṭau |
8,002.17 tavedu stomaṃ ciketa ||
8,002.18  icchanti devāḥ sunvantaṃ na svapnāya spṛhayanti |
8,002.18 yanti pramādamatandrāḥ ||
8,002.19  o ṣu pra yāhi vājebhirmā hṛṇīthā abhyasmān |
8,002.19 mahāṃ iva yuvajāniḥ ||
8,002.20  mo ṣvadya durhaṇāvānsāyaṃ karadāre asmat |
8,002.20 aśrīra iva jāmātā ||
8,002.21  vidmā hyasya vīrasya bhūridāvarīṃ sumatim |
8,002.21 triṣu jātasya manāṃsi ||
8,002.22  ā tū ṣiñca kaṇvamantaṃ na ghā vidma śavasānāt |
8,002.22 yaśastaraṃ śatamūteḥ ||
8,002.23  jyeṣṭhena sotarindrāya somaṃ vīrāya śakrāya |
8,002.23 bharā pibannaryāya ||
8,002.24  yo vediṣṭho avyathiṣvaśvāvantaṃ jaritṛbhyaḥ |
8,002.24 vājaṃ stotṛbhyo gomantam ||
8,002.25  panyampanyamitsotāra ā dhāvata madyāya |
8,002.25 somaṃ vīrāya śūrāya ||
8,002.26  pātā vṛtrahā sutamā ghā gamannāre asmat |
8,002.26 ni yamate śatamūtiḥ ||
8,002.27  eha harī brahmayujā śagmā vakṣataḥ sakhāyam |
8,002.27 gīrbhiḥ śrutaṃ girvaṇasam ||
8,002.28  svādavaḥ somā ā yāhi śrītāḥ somā ā yāhi |
8,002.28 śiprinnṛṣīvaḥ śacīvo nāyamacchā sadhamādam ||
8,002.29  stutaśca yāstvā vardhanti mahe rādhase nṛmṇāya |
8,002.29 indra kāriṇaṃ vṛdhantaḥ ||
8,002.30  giraśca yāste girvāha ukthā ca tubhyaṃ tāni |
8,002.30 satrā dadhire śavāṃsi ||
8,002.31  evedeṣa tuvikūrmirvājāṃ eko vajrahastaḥ |
8,002.31 sanādamṛkto dayate ||
8,002.32  hantā vṛtraṃ dakṣiṇenendraḥ purū puruhūtaḥ |
8,002.32 mahānmahībhiḥ śacībhiḥ ||
8,002.33  yasminviśvāścarṣaṇaya uta cyautnā jrayāṃsi ca |
8,002.33 anu ghenmandī maghonaḥ ||
8,002.34  eṣa etāni cakārendro viśvā yo'ti śṛṇve |
8,002.34 vājadāvā maghonām ||
8,002.35  prabhartā rathaṃ gavyantamapākāccidyamavati |
8,002.35 ino vasu sa hi voḻhā ||
8,002.36  sanitā vipro arvadbhirhantā vṛtraṃ nṛbhiḥ śūraḥ |
8,002.36 satyo'vitā vidhantam ||
8,002.37  yajadhvainaṃ priyamedhā indraṃ satrācā manasā |
8,002.37 yo bhūtsomaiḥ satyamadvā ||
8,002.38  gāthaśravasaṃ satpatiṃ śravaskāmaṃ purutmānam |
8,002.38 kaṇvāso gāta vājinam ||
8,002.39  ya ṛte cidgāspadebhyo dātsakhā nṛbhyaḥ śacīvān |
8,002.39 ye asminkāmamaśriyan ||
8,002.40  itthā dhīvantamadrivaḥ kāṇvaṃ medhyātithim |
8,002.40 meṣo bhūto'bhi yannayaḥ ||
8,002.41  śikṣā vibhindo asmai catvāryayutā dadat |
8,002.41 aṣṭā paraḥ sahasrā ||
8,002.42  uta su tye payovṛdhā mākī raṇasya naptyā |
8,002.42 janitvanāya māmahe ||

8,003.01  pibā sutasya rasino matsvā na indra gomataḥ |
8,003.01 āpirno bodhi sadhamādyo vṛdhe'smāṃ avantu te dhiyaḥ ||
8,003.02  bhūyāma te sumatau vājino vayaṃ mā na starabhimātaye |
8,003.02 asmāñcitrābhiravatādabhiṣṭibhirā naḥ sumneṣu yāmaya ||
8,003.03  imā u tvā purūvaso giro vardhantu yā mama |
8,003.03 pāvakavarṇāḥ śucayo vipaścito'bhi stomairanūṣata ||
8,003.04  ayaṃ sahasramṛṣibhiḥ sahaskṛtaḥ samudra iva paprathe |
8,003.04 satyaḥ so asya mahimā gṛṇe śavo yajñeṣu viprarājye ||
8,003.05  indramiddevatātaya indraṃ prayatyadhvare |
8,003.05 indraṃ samīke vanino havāmaha indraṃ dhanasya sātaye ||
8,003.06  indro mahnā rodasī paprathacchava indraḥ sūryamarocayat |
8,003.06 indre ha viśvā bhuvanāni yemira indre suvānāsa indavaḥ ||
8,003.07  abhi tvā pūrvapītaya indra stomebhirāyavaḥ |
8,003.07 samīcīnāsa ṛbhavaḥ samasvaranrudrā gṛṇanta pūrvyam ||
8,003.08  asyedindro vāvṛdhe vṛṣṇyaṃ śavo made sutasya viṣṇavi |
8,003.08 adyā tamasya mahimānamāyavo'nu ṣṭuvanti pūrvathā ||
8,003.09  tattvā yāmi suvīryaṃ tadbrahma pūrvacittaye |
8,003.09 yenā yatibhyo bhṛgave dhane hite yena praskaṇvamāvitha ||
8,003.10  yenā samudramasṛjo mahīrapastadindra vṛṣṇi te śavaḥ |
8,003.10 sadyaḥ so asya mahimā na saṃnaśe yaṃ kṣoṇīranucakrade ||
8,003.11  śagdhī na indra yattvā rayiṃ yāmi suvīryam |
8,003.11 śagdhi vājāya prathamaṃ siṣāsate śagdhi stomāya pūrvya ||
8,003.12  śagdhī no asya yaddha pauramāvitha dhiya indra siṣāsataḥ |
8,003.12 śagdhi yathā ruśamaṃ śyāvakaṃ kṛpamindra prāvaḥ svarṇaram ||
8,003.13  kannavyo atasīnāṃ turo gṛṇīta martyaḥ |
8,003.13 nahī nvasya mahimānamindriyaṃ svargṛṇanta ānaśuḥ ||
8,003.14  kadu stuvanta ṛtayanta devata ṛṣiḥ ko vipra ohate |
8,003.14 kadā havaṃ maghavannindra sunvataḥ kadu stuvata ā gamaḥ ||
8,003.15  udu tye madhumattamā gira stomāsa īrate |
8,003.15 satrājito dhanasā akṣitotayo vājayanto rathā iva ||
8,003.16  kaṇvā iva bhṛgavaḥ sūryā iva viśvamiddhītamānaśuḥ |
8,003.16 indraṃ stomebhirmahayanta āyavaḥ priyamedhāso asvaran ||
8,003.17  yukṣvā hi vṛtrahantama harī indra parāvataḥ |
8,003.17 arvācīno maghavansomapītaya ugra ṛṣvebhirā gahi ||
8,003.18  ime hi te kāravo vāvaśurdhiyā viprāso medhasātaye |
8,003.18 sa tvaṃ no maghavannindra girvaṇo veno na śṛṇudhī havam ||
8,003.19  nirindra bṛhatībhyo vṛtraṃ dhanubhyo asphuraḥ |
8,003.19 nirarbudasya mṛgayasya māyino niḥ parvatasya gā ājaḥ ||
8,003.20  niragnayo rurucurniru sūryo niḥ soma indriyo rasaḥ |
8,003.20 nirantarikṣādadhamo mahāmahiṃ kṛṣe tadindra pauṃsyam ||
8,003.21  yaṃ me durindro marutaḥ pākasthāmā kaurayāṇaḥ |
8,003.21 viśveṣāṃ tmanā śobhiṣṭhamupeva divi dhāvamānam ||
8,003.22  rohitaṃ me pākasthāmā sudhuraṃ kakṣyaprām |
8,003.22 adādrāyo vibodhanam ||
8,003.23  yasmā anye daśa prati dhuraṃ vahanti vahnayaḥ |
8,003.23 astaṃ vayo na tugryam ||
8,003.24  ātmā pitustanūrvāsa ojodā abhyañjanam |
8,003.24 turīyamidrohitasya pākasthāmānaṃ bhojaṃ dātāramabravam ||

8,004.01  yadindra prāgapāgudaṅnyagvā hūyase nṛbhiḥ |
8,004.01 simā purū nṛṣūto asyānave'si praśardha turvaśe ||
8,004.02  yadvā rume ruśame śyāvake kṛpa indra mādayase sacā |
8,004.02 kaṇvāsastvā brahmabhi stomavāhasa indrā yacchantyā gahi ||
8,004.03  yathā gauro apā kṛtaṃ tṛṣyannetyaveriṇam |
8,004.03 āpitve naḥ prapitve tūyamā gahi kaṇveṣu su sacā piba ||
8,004.04  mandantu tvā maghavannindrendavo rādhodeyāya sunvate |
8,004.04 āmuṣyā somamapibaścamū sutaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ taddadhiṣe sahaḥ ||
8,004.05  pra cakre sahasā saho babhañja manyumojasā |
8,004.05 viśve ta indra pṛtanāyavo yaho ni vṛkṣā iva yemire ||
8,004.06  sahasreṇeva sacate yavīyudhā yasta ānaḻ upastutim |
8,004.06 putraṃ prāvargaṃ kṛṇute suvīrye dāśnoti namauktibhiḥ ||
8,004.07  mā bhema mā śramiṣmograsya sakhye tava |
8,004.07 mahatte vṛṣṇo abhicakṣyaṃ kṛtaṃ paśyema turvaśaṃ yadum ||
8,004.08  savyāmanu sphigyaṃ vāvase vṛṣā na dāno asya roṣati |
8,004.08 madhvā sampṛktāḥ sāragheṇa dhenavastūyamehi dravā piba ||
8,004.09  aśvī rathī surūpa idgomāṃ idindra te sakhā |
8,004.09 śvātrabhājā vayasā sacate sadā candro yāti sabhāmupa ||
8,004.10  ṛśyo na tṛṣyannavapānamā gahi pibā somaṃ vaśāṃ anu |
8,004.10 nimeghamāno maghavandivediva ojiṣṭhaṃ dadhiṣe sahaḥ ||
8,004.11  adhvaryo drāvayā tvaṃ somamindraḥ pipāsati |
8,004.11 upa nūnaṃ yuyuje vṛṣaṇā harī ā ca jagāma vṛtrahā ||
8,004.12  svayaṃ citsa manyate dāśurirjano yatrā somasya tṛmpasi |
8,004.12 idaṃ te annaṃ yujyaṃ samukṣitaṃ tasyehi pra dravā piba ||
8,004.13  ratheṣṭhāyādhvaryavaḥ somamindrāya sotana |
8,004.13 adhi bradhnasyādrayo vi cakṣate sunvanto dāśvadhvaram ||
8,004.14  upa bradhnaṃ vāvātā vṛṣaṇā harī indramapasu vakṣataḥ |
8,004.14 arvāñcaṃ tvā saptayo'dhvaraśriyo vahantu savanedupa ||
8,004.15  pra pūṣaṇaṃ vṛṇīmahe yujyāya purūvasum |
8,004.15 sa śakra śikṣa puruhūta no dhiyā tuje rāye vimocana ||
8,004.16  saṃ naḥ śiśīhi bhurijoriva kṣuraṃ rāsva rāyo vimocana |
8,004.16 tve tannaḥ suvedamusriyaṃ vasu yaṃ tvaṃ hinoṣi martyam ||
8,004.17  vemi tvā pūṣannṛñjase vemi stotava āghṛṇe |
8,004.17 na tasya vemyaraṇaṃ hi tadvaso stuṣe pajrāya sāmne ||
8,004.18  parā gāvo yavasaṃ kaccidāghṛṇe nityaṃ rekṇo amartya |
8,004.18 asmākaṃ pūṣannavitā śivo bhava maṃhiṣṭho vājasātaye ||
8,004.19  sthūraṃ rādhaḥ śatāśvaṃ kuruṅgasya diviṣṭiṣu |
8,004.19 rājñastveṣasya subhagasya rātiṣu turvaśeṣvamanmahi ||
8,004.20  dhībhiḥ sātāni kāṇvasya vājinaḥ priyamedhairabhidyubhiḥ |
8,004.20 ṣaṣṭiṃ sahasrānu nirmajāmaje niryūthāni gavāmṛṣiḥ ||
8,004.21  vṛkṣāścinme abhipitve arāraṇuḥ |
8,004.21 gāṃ bhajanta mehanāśvaṃ bhajanta mehanā ||

8,005.01  dūrādiheva yatsatyaruṇapsuraśiśvitat |
8,005.01 vi bhānuṃ viśvadhātanat ||
8,005.02  nṛvaddasrā manoyujā rathena pṛthupājasā |
8,005.02 sacethe aśvinoṣasam ||
8,005.03  yuvābhyāṃ vājinīvasū prati stomā adṛkṣata |
8,005.03 vācaṃ dūto yathohiṣe ||
8,005.04  purupriyā ṇa ūtaye purumandrā purūvasū |
8,005.04 stuṣe kaṇvāso aśvinā ||
8,005.05  maṃhiṣṭhā vājasātameṣayantā śubhaspatī |
8,005.05 gantārā dāśuṣo gṛham ||
8,005.06  tā sudevāya dāśuṣe sumedhāmavitāriṇīm |
8,005.06 ghṛtairgavyūtimukṣatam ||
8,005.07  ā na stomamupa dravattūyaṃ śyenebhirāśubhiḥ |
8,005.07 yātamaśvebhiraśvinā ||
8,005.08  yebhistisraḥ parāvato divo viśvāni rocanā |
8,005.08 trīṃraktūnparidīyathaḥ ||
8,005.09  uta no gomatīriṣa uta sātīraharvidā |
8,005.09 vi pathaḥ sātaye sitam ||
8,005.10  ā no gomantamaśvinā suvīraṃ surathaṃ rayim |
8,005.10 voḻhamaśvāvatīriṣaḥ ||
8,005.11  vāvṛdhānā śubhaspatī dasrā hiraṇyavartanī |
8,005.11 pibataṃ somyaṃ madhu ||
8,005.12  asmabhyaṃ vājinīvasū maghavadbhyaśca saprathaḥ |
8,005.12 chardiryantamadābhyam ||
8,005.13  ni ṣu brahma janānāṃ yāviṣṭaṃ tūyamā gatam |
8,005.13 mo ṣvanyāṃ upāratam ||
8,005.14  asya pibatamaśvinā yuvaṃ madasya cāruṇaḥ |
8,005.14 madhvo rātasya dhiṣṇyā ||
8,005.15  asme ā vahataṃ rayiṃ śatavantaṃ sahasriṇam |
8,005.15 purukṣuṃ viśvadhāyasam ||
8,005.16  purutrā ciddhi vāṃ narā vihvayante manīṣiṇaḥ |
8,005.16 vāghadbhiraśvinā gatam ||
8,005.17  janāso vṛktabarhiṣo haviṣmanto araṅkṛtaḥ |
8,005.17 yuvāṃ havante aśvinā ||
8,005.18  asmākamadya vāmayaṃ stomo vāhiṣṭho antamaḥ |
8,005.18 yuvābhyāṃ bhūtvaśvinā ||
8,005.19  yo ha vāṃ madhuno dṛtirāhito rathacarṣaṇe |
8,005.19 tataḥ pibatamaśvinā ||
8,005.20  tena no vājinīvasū paśve tokāya śaṃ gave |
8,005.20 vahataṃ pīvarīriṣaḥ ||
8,005.21  uta no divyā iṣa uta sindhūṃraharvidā |
8,005.21 apa dvāreva varṣathaḥ ||
8,005.22  kadā vāṃ taugryo vidhatsamudre jahito narā |
8,005.22 yadvāṃ ratho vibhiṣpatāt ||
8,005.23  yuvaṃ kaṇvāya nāsatyā ṛpiriptāya harmye |
8,005.23 śaśvadūtīrdaśasyathaḥ ||
8,005.24  tābhirā yātamūtibhirnavyasībhiḥ suśastibhiḥ |
8,005.24 yadvāṃ vṛṣaṇvasū huve ||
8,005.25  yathā citkaṇvamāvataṃ priyamedhamupastutam |
8,005.25 atriṃ śiñjāramaśvinā ||
8,005.26  yathota kṛtvye dhane'ṃśuṃ goṣvagastyam |
8,005.26 yathā vājeṣu sobharim ||
8,005.27  etāvadvāṃ vṛṣaṇvasū ato vā bhūyo aśvinā |
8,005.27 gṛṇantaḥ sumnamīmahe ||
8,005.28  rathaṃ hiraṇyavandhuraṃ hiraṇyābhīśumaśvinā |
8,005.28 ā hi sthātho divispṛśam ||
8,005.29  hiraṇyayī vāṃ rabhirīṣā akṣo hiraṇyayaḥ |
8,005.29 ubhā cakrā hiraṇyayā ||
8,005.30  tena no vājinīvasū parāvataścidā gatam |
8,005.30 upemāṃ suṣṭutiṃ mama ||
8,005.31  ā vahethe parākātpūrvīraśnantāvaśvinā |
8,005.31 iṣo dāsīramartyā ||
8,005.32  ā no dyumnairā śravobhirā rāyā yātamaśvinā |
8,005.32 puruścandrā nāsatyā ||
8,005.33  eha vāṃ pruṣitapsavo vayo vahantu parṇinaḥ |
8,005.33 acchā svadhvaraṃ janam ||
8,005.34  rathaṃ vāmanugāyasaṃ ya iṣā vartate saha |
8,005.34 na cakramabhi bādhate ||
8,005.35  hiraṇyayena rathena dravatpāṇibhiraśvaiḥ |
8,005.35 dhījavanā nāsatyā ||
8,005.36  yuvaṃ mṛgaṃ jāgṛvāṃsaṃ svadatho vā vṛṣaṇvasū |
8,005.36 tā naḥ pṛṅktamiṣā rayim ||
8,005.37  tā me aśvinā sanīnāṃ vidyātaṃ navānām |
8,005.37 yathā ciccaidyaḥ kaśuḥ śatamuṣṭrānāṃ dadatsahasrā daśa gonām ||
8,005.38  yo me hiraṇyasaṃdṛśo daśa rājño amaṃhata |
8,005.38 adhaspadā iccaidyasya kṛṣṭayaścarmamnā abhito janāḥ ||
8,005.39  mākirenā pathā gādyeneme yanti cedayaḥ |
8,005.39 anyo netsūrirohate bhūridāvattaro janaḥ ||

8,006.01  mahāṃ indro ya ojasā parjanyo vṛṣṭimāṃ iva |
8,006.01 stomairvatsasya vāvṛdhe ||
8,006.02  prajāmṛtasya piprataḥ pra yadbharanta vahnayaḥ |
8,006.02 viprā ṛtasya vāhasā ||
8,006.03  kaṇvā indraṃ yadakrata stomairyajñasya sādhanam |
8,006.03 jāmi bruvata āyudham ||
8,006.04  samasya manyave viśo viśvā namanta kṛṣṭayaḥ |
8,006.04 samudrāyeva sindhavaḥ ||
8,006.05  ojastadasya titviṣa ubhe yatsamavartayat |
8,006.05 indraścarmeva rodasī ||
8,006.06  vi cidvṛtrasya dodhato vajreṇa śataparvaṇā |
8,006.06 śiro bibheda vṛṣṇinā ||
8,006.07  imā abhi pra ṇonumo vipāmagreṣu dhītayaḥ |
8,006.07 agneḥ śocirna didyutaḥ ||
8,006.08  guhā satīrupa tmanā pra yacchocanta dhītayaḥ |
8,006.08 kaṇvā ṛtasya dhārayā ||
8,006.09  pra tamindra naśīmahi rayiṃ gomantamaśvinam |
8,006.09 pra brahma pūrvacittaye ||
8,006.10  ahamiddhi pituṣpari medhāmṛtasya jagrabha |
8,006.10 ahaṃ sūrya ivājani ||
8,006.11  ahaṃ pratnena manmanā giraḥ śumbhāmi kaṇvavat |
8,006.11 yenendraḥ śuṣmamiddadhe ||
8,006.12  ye tvāmindra na tuṣṭuvurṛṣayo ye ca tuṣṭuvuḥ |
8,006.12 mamedvardhasva suṣṭutaḥ ||
8,006.13  yadasya manyuradhvanīdvi vṛtraṃ parvaśo rujan |
8,006.13 apaḥ samudramairayat ||
8,006.14  ni śuṣṇa indra dharṇasiṃ vajraṃ jaghantha dasyavi |
8,006.14 vṛṣā hyugra śṛṇviṣe ||
8,006.15  na dyāva indramojasā nāntarikṣāṇi vajriṇam |
8,006.15 na vivyacanta bhūmayaḥ ||
8,006.16  yasta indra mahīrapa stabhūyamāna āśayat |
8,006.16 ni taṃ padyāsu śiśnathaḥ ||
8,006.17  ya ime rodasī mahī samīcī samajagrabhīt |
8,006.17 tamobhirindra taṃ guhaḥ ||
8,006.18  ya indra yatayastvā bhṛgavo ye ca tuṣṭuvuḥ |
8,006.18 mamedugra śrudhī havam ||
8,006.19  imāsta indra pṛśnayo ghṛtaṃ duhata āśiram |
8,006.19 enāmṛtasya pipyuṣīḥ ||
8,006.20  yā indra prasvastvāsā garbhamacakriran |
8,006.20 pari dharmeva sūryam ||
8,006.21  tvāmicchavasaspate kaṇvā ukthena vāvṛdhuḥ |
8,006.21 tvāṃ sutāsa indavaḥ ||
8,006.22  tavedindra praṇītiṣūta praśastiradrivaḥ |
8,006.22 yajño vitantasāyyaḥ ||
8,006.23  ā na indra mahīmiṣaṃ puraṃ na darṣi gomatīm |
8,006.23 uta prajāṃ suvīryam ||
8,006.24  uta tyadāśvaśvyaṃ yadindra nāhuṣīṣvā |
8,006.24 agre vikṣu pradīdayat ||
8,006.25  abhi vrajaṃ na tatniṣe sūra upākacakṣasam |
8,006.25 yadindra mṛḻayāsi naḥ ||
8,006.26  yadaṅga taviṣīyasa indra prarājasi kṣitīḥ |
8,006.26 mahāṃ apāra ojasā ||
8,006.27  taṃ tvā haviṣmatīrviśa upa bruvata ūtaye |
8,006.27 urujrayasamindubhiḥ ||
8,006.28  upahvare girīṇāṃ saṃgathe ca nadīnām |
8,006.28 dhiyā vipro ajāyata ||
8,006.29  ataḥ samudramudvataścikitvāṃ ava paśyati |
8,006.29 yato vipāna ejati ||
8,006.30  āditpratnasya retaso jyotiṣpaśyanti vāsaram |
8,006.30 paro yadidhyate divā ||
8,006.31  kaṇvāsa indra te matiṃ viśve vardhanti pauṃsyam |
8,006.31 uto śaviṣṭha vṛṣṇyam ||
8,006.32  imāṃ ma indra suṣṭutiṃ juṣasva pra su māmava |
8,006.32 uta pra vardhayā matim ||
8,006.33  uta brahmaṇyā vayaṃ tubhyaṃ pravṛddha vajrivaḥ |
8,006.33 viprā atakṣma jīvase ||
8,006.34  abhi kaṇvā anūṣatāpo na pravatā yatīḥ |
8,006.34 indraṃ vananvatī matiḥ ||
8,006.35  indramukthāni vāvṛdhuḥ samudramiva sindhavaḥ |
8,006.35 anuttamanyumajaram ||
8,006.36  ā no yāhi parāvato haribhyāṃ haryatābhyām |
8,006.36 imamindra sutaṃ piba ||
8,006.37  tvāmidvṛtrahantama janāso vṛktabarhiṣaḥ |
8,006.37 havante vājasātaye ||
8,006.38  anu tvā rodasī ubhe cakraṃ na vartyetaśam |
8,006.38 anu suvānāsa indavaḥ ||
8,006.39  mandasvā su svarṇara utendra śaryaṇāvati |
8,006.39 matsvā vivasvato matī ||
8,006.40  vāvṛdhāna upa dyavi vṛṣā vajryaroravīt |
8,006.40 vṛtrahā somapātamaḥ ||
8,006.41  ṛṣirhi pūrvajā asyeka īśāna ojasā |
8,006.41 indra coṣkūyase vasu ||
8,006.42  asmākaṃ tvā sutāṃ upa vītapṛṣṭhā abhi prayaḥ |
8,006.42 śataṃ vahantu harayaḥ ||
8,006.43  imāṃ su pūrvyāṃ dhiyaṃ madhorghṛtasya pipyuṣīm |
8,006.43 kaṇvā ukthena vāvṛdhuḥ ||
8,006.44  indramidvimahīnāṃ medhe vṛṇīta martyaḥ |
8,006.44 indraṃ saniṣyurūtaye ||
8,006.45  arvāñcaṃ tvā puruṣṭuta priyamedhastutā harī |
8,006.45 somapeyāya vakṣataḥ ||
8,006.46  śatamahaṃ tirindire sahasraṃ parśāvā dade |
8,006.46 rādhāṃsi yādvānām ||
8,006.47  trīṇi śatānyarvatāṃ sahasrā daśa gonām |
8,006.47 daduṣpajrāya sāmne ||
8,006.48  udānaṭkakuho divamuṣṭrāñcaturyujo dadat |
8,006.48 śravasā yādvaṃ janam ||

8,007.01  pra yadvastriṣṭubhamiṣaṃ maruto vipro akṣarat |
8,007.01 vi parvateṣu rājatha ||
8,007.02  yadaṅga taviṣīyavo yāmaṃ śubhrā acidhvam |
8,007.02 ni parvatā ahāsata ||
8,007.03  udīrayanta vāyubhirvāśrāsaḥ pṛśnimātaraḥ |
8,007.03 dhukṣanta pipyuṣīmiṣam ||
8,007.04  vapanti maruto mihaṃ pra vepayanti parvatān |
8,007.04 yadyāmaṃ yānti vāyubhiḥ ||
8,007.05  ni yadyāmāya vo girirni sindhavo vidharmaṇe |
8,007.05 mahe śuṣmāya yemire ||
8,007.06  yuṣmāṃ u naktamūtaye yuṣmāndivā havāmahe |
8,007.06 yuṣmānprayatyadhvare ||
8,007.07  udu tye aruṇapsavaścitrā yāmebhirīrate |
8,007.07 vāśrā adhi ṣṇunā divaḥ ||
8,007.08  sṛjanti raśmimojasā panthāṃ sūryāya yātave |
8,007.08 te bhānubhirvi tasthire ||
8,007.09  imāṃ me maruto giramimaṃ stomamṛbhukṣaṇaḥ |
8,007.09 imaṃ me vanatā havam ||
8,007.10  trīṇi sarāṃsi pṛśnayo duduhre vajriṇe madhu |
8,007.10 utsaṃ kavandhamudriṇam ||
8,007.11  maruto yaddha vo divaḥ sumnāyanto havāmahe |
8,007.11 ā tū na upa gantana ||
8,007.12  yūyaṃ hi ṣṭhā sudānavo rudrā ṛbhukṣaṇo dame |
8,007.12 uta pracetaso made ||
8,007.13  ā no rayiṃ madacyutaṃ purukṣuṃ viśvadhāyasam |
8,007.13 iyartā maruto divaḥ ||
8,007.14  adhīva yadgirīṇāṃ yāmaṃ śubhrā acidhvam |
8,007.14 suvānairmandadhva indubhiḥ ||
8,007.15  etāvataścideṣāṃ sumnaṃ bhikṣeta martyaḥ |
8,007.15 adābhyasya manmabhiḥ ||
8,007.16  ye drapsā iva rodasī dhamantyanu vṛṣṭibhiḥ |
8,007.16 utsaṃ duhanto akṣitam ||
8,007.17  udu svānebhirīrata udrathairudu vāyubhiḥ |
8,007.17 utstomaiḥ pṛśnimātaraḥ ||
8,007.18  yenāva turvaśaṃ yaduṃ yena kaṇvaṃ dhanaspṛtam |
8,007.18 rāye su tasya dhīmahi ||
8,007.19  imā u vaḥ sudānavo ghṛtaṃ na pipyuṣīriṣaḥ |
8,007.19 vardhānkāṇvasya manmabhiḥ ||
8,007.20  kva nūnaṃ sudānavo madathā vṛktabarhiṣaḥ |
8,007.20 brahmā ko vaḥ saparyati ||
8,007.21  nahi ṣma yaddha vaḥ purā stomebhirvṛktabarhiṣaḥ |
8,007.21 śardhāṃ ṛtasya jinvatha ||
8,007.22  samu tye mahatīrapaḥ saṃ kṣoṇī samu sūryam |
8,007.22 saṃ vajraṃ parvaśo dadhuḥ ||
8,007.23  vi vṛtraṃ parvaśo yayurvi parvatāṃ arājinaḥ |
8,007.23 cakrāṇā vṛṣṇi pauṃsyam ||
8,007.24  anu tritasya yudhyataḥ śuṣmamāvannuta kratum |
8,007.24 anvindraṃ vṛtratūrye ||
8,007.25  vidyuddhastā abhidyavaḥ śiprāḥ śīrṣanhiraṇyayīḥ |
8,007.25 śubhrā vyañjata śriye ||
8,007.26  uśanā yatparāvata ukṣṇo randhramayātana |
8,007.26 dyaurna cakradadbhiyā ||
8,007.27  ā no makhasya dāvane'śvairhiraṇyapāṇibhiḥ |
8,007.27 devāsa upa gantana ||
8,007.28  yadeṣāṃ pṛṣatī rathe praṣṭirvahati rohitaḥ |
8,007.28 yānti śubhrā riṇannapaḥ ||
8,007.29  suṣome śaryaṇāvatyārjīke pastyāvati |
8,007.29 yayurnicakrayā naraḥ ||
8,007.30  kadā gacchātha maruta itthā vipraṃ havamānam |
8,007.30 mārḍīkebhirnādhamānam ||
8,007.31  kaddha nūnaṃ kadhapriyo yadindramajahātana |
8,007.31 ko vaḥ sakhitva ohate ||
8,007.32  saho ṣu ṇo vajrahastaiḥ kaṇvāso agniṃ marudbhiḥ |
8,007.32 stuṣe hiraṇyavāśībhiḥ ||
8,007.33  o ṣu vṛṣṇaḥ prayajyūnā navyase suvitāya |
8,007.33 vavṛtyāṃ citravājān ||
8,007.34  girayaścinni jihate parśānāso manyamānāḥ |
8,007.34 parvatāścinni yemire ||
8,007.35  ākṣṇayāvāno vahantyantarikṣeṇa patataḥ |
8,007.35 dhātāra stuvate vayaḥ ||
8,007.36  agnirhi jāni pūrvyaśchando na sūro arciṣā |
8,007.36 te bhānubhirvi tasthire ||

8,008.01  ā no viśvābhirūtibhiraśvinā gacchataṃ yuvam |
8,008.01 dasrā hiraṇyavartanī pibataṃ somyaṃ madhu ||
8,008.02  ā nūnaṃ yātamaśvinā rathena sūryatvacā |
8,008.02 bhujī hiraṇyapeśasā kavī gambhīracetasā ||
8,008.03  ā yātaṃ nahuṣasparyāntarikṣātsuvṛktibhiḥ |
8,008.03 pibātho aśvinā madhu kaṇvānāṃ savane sutam ||
8,008.04  ā no yātaṃ divasparyāntarikṣādadhapriyā |
8,008.04 putraḥ kaṇvasya vāmiha suṣāva somyaṃ madhu ||
8,008.05  ā no yātamupaśrutyaśvinā somapītaye |
8,008.05 svāhā stomasya vardhanā pra kavī dhītibhirnarā ||
8,008.06  yacciddhi vāṃ pura ṛṣayo juhūre'vase narā |
8,008.06 ā yātamaśvinā gatamupemāṃ suṣṭutiṃ mama ||
8,008.07  divaścidrocanādadhyā no gantaṃ svarvidā |
8,008.07 dhībhirvatsapracetasā stomebhirhavanaśrutā ||
8,008.08  kimanye paryāsate'smatstomebhiraśvinā |
8,008.08 putraḥ kaṇvasya vāmṛṣirgīrbhirvatso avīvṛdhat ||
8,008.09  ā vāṃ vipra ihāvase'hvatstomebhiraśvinā |
8,008.09 ariprā vṛtrahantamā tā no bhūtaṃ mayobhuvā ||
8,008.10  ā yadvāṃ yoṣaṇā rathamatiṣṭhadvājinīvasū |
8,008.10 viśvānyaśvinā yuvaṃ pra dhītānyagacchatam ||
8,008.11  ataḥ sahasranirṇijā rathenā yātamaśvinā |
8,008.11 vatso vāṃ madhumadvaco'śaṃsītkāvyaḥ kaviḥ ||
8,008.12  purumandrā purūvasū manotarā rayīṇām |
8,008.12 stomaṃ me aśvināvimamabhi vahnī anūṣātām ||
8,008.13  ā no viśvānyaśvinā dhattaṃ rādhāṃsyahrayā |
8,008.13 kṛtaṃ na ṛtviyāvato mā no rīradhataṃ nide ||
8,008.14  yannāsatyā parāvati yadvā stho adhyambare |
8,008.14 ataḥ sahasranirṇijā rathenā yātamaśvinā ||
8,008.15  yo vāṃ nāsatyāvṛṣirgīrbhirvatso avīvṛdhat |
8,008.15 tasmai sahasranirṇijamiṣaṃ dhattaṃ ghṛtaścutam ||
8,008.16  prāsmā ūrjaṃ ghṛtaścutamaśvinā yacchataṃ yuvam |
8,008.16 yo vāṃ sumnāya tuṣṭavadvasūyāddānunaspatī ||
8,008.17  ā no gantaṃ riśādasemaṃ stomaṃ purubhujā |
8,008.17 kṛtaṃ naḥ suśriyo naremā dātamabhiṣṭaye ||
8,008.18  ā vāṃ viśvābhirūtibhiḥ priyamedhā ahūṣata |
8,008.18 rājantāvadhvarāṇāmaśvinā yāmahūtiṣu ||
8,008.19  ā no gantaṃ mayobhuvāśvinā śambhuvā yuvam |
8,008.19 yo vāṃ vipanyū dhītibhirgīrbhirvatso avīvṛdhat ||
8,008.20  yābhiḥ kaṇvaṃ medhātithiṃ yābhirvaśaṃ daśavrajam |
8,008.20 yābhirgośaryamāvataṃ tābhirno'vataṃ narā ||
8,008.21  yābhirnarā trasadasyumāvataṃ kṛtvye dhane |
8,008.21 tābhiḥ ṣvasmāṃ aśvinā prāvataṃ vājasātaye ||
8,008.22  pra vāṃ stomāḥ suvṛktayo giro vardhantvaśvinā |
8,008.22 purutrā vṛtrahantamā tā no bhūtaṃ puruspṛhā ||
8,008.23  trīṇi padānyaśvinorāviḥ sānti guhā paraḥ |
8,008.23 kavī ṛtasya patmabhirarvāgjīvebhyaspari ||

8,009.01  ā nūnamaśvinā yuvaṃ vatsasya gantamavase |
8,009.01 prāsmai yacchatamavṛkaṃ pṛthu cchardiryuyutaṃ yā arātayaḥ ||
8,009.02  yadantarikṣe yaddivi yatpañca mānuṣāṃ anu |
8,009.02 nṛmṇaṃ taddhattamaśvinā ||
8,009.03  ye vāṃ daṃsāṃsyaśvinā viprāsaḥ parimāmṛśuḥ |
8,009.03 evetkāṇvasya bodhatam ||
8,009.04  ayaṃ vāṃ gharmo aśvinā stomena pari ṣicyate |
8,009.04 ayaṃ somo madhumānvājinīvasū yena vṛtraṃ ciketathaḥ ||
8,009.05  yadapsu yadvanaspatau yadoṣadhīṣu purudaṃsasā kṛtam |
8,009.05 tena māviṣṭamaśvinā ||
8,009.06  yannāsatyā bhuraṇyatho yadvā deva bhiṣajyathaḥ |
8,009.06 ayaṃ vāṃ vatso matibhirna vindhate haviṣmantaṃ hi gacchathaḥ ||
8,009.07  ā nūnamaśvinorṛṣi stomaṃ ciketa vāmayā |
8,009.07 ā somaṃ madhumattamaṃ gharmaṃ siñcādatharvaṇi ||
8,009.08  ā nūnaṃ raghuvartaniṃ rathaṃ tiṣṭhātho aśvinā |
8,009.08 ā vāṃ stomā ime mama nabho na cucyavīrata ||
8,009.09  yadadya vāṃ nāsatyokthairācucyuvīmahi |
8,009.09 yadvā vāṇībhiraśvinevetkāṇvasya bodhatam ||
8,009.10  yadvāṃ kakṣīvāṃ uta yadvyaśva ṛṣiryadvāṃ dīrghatamā juhāva |
8,009.10 pṛthī yadvāṃ vainyaḥ sādaneṣvevedato aśvinā cetayethām ||
8,009.11  yātaṃ chardiṣpā uta naḥ paraspā bhūtaṃ jagatpā uta nastanūpā |
8,009.11 vartistokāya tanayāya yātam ||
8,009.12  yadindreṇa sarathaṃ yātho aśvinā yadvā vāyunā bhavathaḥ samokasā |
8,009.12 yadādityebhirṛbhubhiḥ sajoṣasā yadvā viṣṇorvikramaṇeṣu tiṣṭhathaḥ ||
8,009.13  yadadyāśvināvahaṃ huveya vājasātaye |
8,009.13 yatpṛtsu turvaṇe sahastacchreṣṭhamaśvinoravaḥ ||
8,009.14  ā nūnaṃ yātamaśvinemā havyāni vāṃ hitā |
8,009.14 ime somāso adhi turvaśe yadāvime kaṇveṣu vāmatha ||
8,009.15  yannāsatyā parāke arvāke asti bheṣajam |
8,009.15 tena nūnaṃ vimadāya pracetasā chardirvatsāya yacchatam ||
8,009.16  abhutsyu pra devyā sākaṃ vācāhamaśvinoḥ |
8,009.16 vyāvardevyā matiṃ vi rātiṃ martyebhyaḥ ||
8,009.17  pra bodhayoṣo aśvinā pra devi sūnṛte mahi |
8,009.17 pra yajñahotarānuṣakpra madāya śravo bṛhat ||
8,009.18  yaduṣo yāsi bhānunā saṃ sūryeṇa rocase |
8,009.18 ā hāyamaśvino ratho vartiryāti nṛpāyyam ||
8,009.19  yadāpītāso aṃśavo gāvo na duhra ūdhabhiḥ |
8,009.19 yadvā vāṇīranūṣata pra devayanto aśvinā ||
8,009.20  pra dyumnāya pra śavase pra nṛṣāhyāya śarmaṇe |
8,009.20 pra dakṣāya pracetasā ||
8,009.21  yannūnaṃ dhībhiraśvinā pituryonā niṣīdathaḥ |
8,009.21 yadvā sumnebhirukthyā ||

8,010.01  yatstho dīrghaprasadmani yadvādo rocane divaḥ |
8,010.01 yadvā samudre adhyākṛte gṛhe'ta ā yātamaśvinā ||
8,010.02  yadvā yajñaṃ manave sammimikṣathurevetkāṇvasya bodhatam |
8,010.02 bṛhaspatiṃ viśvāndevāṃ ahaṃ huva indrāviṣṇū aśvināvāśuheṣasā ||
8,010.03  tyā nvaśvinā huve sudaṃsasā gṛbhe kṛtā |
8,010.03 yayorasti pra ṇaḥ sakhyaṃ deveṣvadhyāpyam ||
8,010.04  yayoradhi pra yajñā asūre santi sūrayaḥ |
8,010.04 tā yajñasyādhvarasya pracetasā svadhābhiryā pibataḥ somyaṃ madhu ||
8,010.05  yadadyāśvināvapāgyatprākstho vājinīvasū |
8,010.05 yaddruhyavyanavi turvaśe yadau huve vāmatha mā gatam ||
8,010.06  yadantarikṣe patathaḥ purubhujā yadveme rodasī anu |
8,010.06 yadvā svadhābhiradhitiṣṭhatho rathamata ā yātamaśvinā ||

8,011.01  tvamagne vratapā asi deva ā martyeṣvā |
8,011.01 tvaṃ yajñeṣvīḍyaḥ ||
8,011.02  tvamasi praśasyo vidatheṣu sahantya |
8,011.02 agne rathīradhvarāṇām ||
8,011.03  sa tvamasmadapa dviṣo yuyodhi jātavedaḥ |
8,011.03 adevīragne arātīḥ ||
8,011.04  anti citsantamaha yajñaṃ martasya ripoḥ |
8,011.04 nopa veṣi jātavedaḥ ||
8,011.05  martā amartyasya te bhūri nāma manāmahe |
8,011.05 viprāso jātavedasaḥ ||
8,011.06  vipraṃ viprāso'vase devaṃ martāsa ūtaye |
8,011.06 agniṃ gīrbhirhavāmahe ||
8,011.07  ā te vatso mano yamatparamāccitsadhasthāt |
8,011.07 agne tvāṅkāmayā girā ||
8,011.08  purutrā hi sadṛṅṅasi viśo viśvā anu prabhuḥ |
8,011.08 samatsu tvā havāmahe ||
8,011.09  samatsvagnimavase vājayanto havāmahe |
8,011.09 vājeṣu citrarādhasam ||
8,011.10  pratno hi kamīḍyo adhvareṣu sanācca hotā navyaśca satsi |
8,011.10 svāṃ cāgne tanvaṃ piprayasvāsmabhyaṃ ca saubhagamā yajasva ||

8,012.01  ya indra somapātamo madaḥ śaviṣṭha cetati |
8,012.01 yenā haṃsi nyatriṇaṃ tamīmahe ||
8,012.02  yenā daśagvamadhriguṃ vepayantaṃ svarṇaram |
8,012.02 yenā samudramāvithā tamīmahe ||
8,012.03  yena sindhuṃ mahīrapo rathāṃ iva pracodayaḥ |
8,012.03 panthāmṛtasya yātave tamīmahe ||
8,012.04  imaṃ stomamabhiṣṭaye ghṛtaṃ na pūtamadrivaḥ |
8,012.04 yenā nu sadya ojasā vavakṣitha ||
8,012.05  imaṃ juṣasva girvaṇaḥ samudra iva pinvate |
8,012.05 indra viśvābhirūtibhirvavakṣitha ||
8,012.06  yo no devaḥ parāvataḥ sakhitvanāya māmahe |
8,012.06 divo na vṛṣṭiṃ prathayanvavakṣitha ||
8,012.07  vavakṣurasya ketavo uta vajro gabhastyoḥ |
8,012.07 yatsūryo na rodasī avardhayat ||
8,012.08  yadi pravṛddha satpate sahasraṃ mahiṣāṃ aghaḥ |
8,012.08 āditta indriyaṃ mahi pra vāvṛdhe ||
8,012.09  indraḥ sūryasya raśmibhirnyarśasānamoṣati |
