8,012.09 agnirvaneva sāsahiḥ pra vāvṛdhe ||
8,012.10  iyaṃ ta ṛtviyāvatī dhītireti navīyasī |
8,012.10 saparyantī purupriyā mimīta it ||
8,012.11  garbho yajñasya devayuḥ kratuṃ punīta ānuṣak |
8,012.11 stomairindrasya vāvṛdhe mimīta it ||
8,012.12  sanirmitrasya papratha indraḥ somasya pītaye |
8,012.12 prācī vāśīva sunvate mimīta it ||
8,012.13  yaṃ viprā ukthavāhaso'bhipramandurāyavaḥ |
8,012.13 ghṛtaṃ na pipya āsanyṛtasya yat ||
8,012.14  uta svarāje aditi stomamindrāya jījanat |
8,012.14 purupraśastamūtaya ṛtasya yat ||
8,012.15  abhi vahnaya ūtaye'nūṣata praśastaye |
8,012.15 na deva vivratā harī ṛtasya yat ||
8,012.16  yatsomamindra viṣṇavi yadvā gha trita āptye |
8,012.16 yadvā marutsu mandase samindubhiḥ ||
8,012.17  yadvā śakra parāvati samudre adhi mandase |
8,012.17 asmākamitsute raṇā samindubhiḥ ||
8,012.18  yadvāsi sunvato vṛdho yajamānasya satpate |
8,012.18 ukthe vā yasya raṇyasi samindubhiḥ ||
8,012.19  devaṃdevaṃ vo'vasa indramindraṃ gṛṇīṣaṇi |
8,012.19 adhā yajñāya turvaṇe vyānaśuḥ ||
8,012.20  yajñebhiryajñavāhasaṃ somebhiḥ somapātamam |
8,012.20 hotrābhirindraṃ vāvṛdhurvyānaśuḥ ||
8,012.21  mahīrasya praṇītayaḥ pūrvīruta praśastayaḥ |
8,012.21 viśvā vasūni dāśuṣe vyānaśuḥ ||
8,012.22  indraṃ vṛtrāya hantave devāso dadhire puraḥ |
8,012.22 indraṃ vāṇīranūṣatā samojase ||
8,012.23  mahāntaṃ mahinā vayaṃ stomebhirhavanaśrutam |
8,012.23 arkairabhi pra ṇonumaḥ samojase ||
8,012.24  na yaṃ vivikto rodasī nāntarikṣāṇi vajriṇam |
8,012.24 amādidasya titviṣe samojasaḥ ||
8,012.25  yadindra pṛtanājye devāstvā dadhire puraḥ |
8,012.25 āditte haryatā harī vavakṣatuḥ ||
8,012.26  yadā vṛtraṃ nadīvṛtaṃ śavasā vajrinnavadhīḥ |
8,012.26 āditte haryatā harī vavakṣatuḥ ||
8,012.27  yadā te viṣṇurojasā trīṇi padā vicakrame |
8,012.27 āditte haryatā harī vavakṣatuḥ ||
8,012.28  yadā te haryatā harī vāvṛdhāte divedive |
8,012.28 āditte viśvā bhuvanāni yemire ||
8,012.29  yadā te mārutīrviśastubhyamindra niyemire |
8,012.29 āditte viśvā bhuvanāni yemire ||
8,012.30  yadā sūryamamuṃ divi śukraṃ jyotiradhārayaḥ |
8,012.30 āditte viśvā bhuvanāni yemire ||
8,012.31  imāṃ ta indra suṣṭutiṃ vipra iyarti dhītibhiḥ |
8,012.31 jāmiṃ padeva pipratīṃ prādhvare ||
8,012.32  yadasya dhāmani priye samīcīnāso asvaran |
8,012.32 nābhā yajñasya dohanā prādhvare ||
8,012.33  suvīryaṃ svaśvyaṃ sugavyamindra daddhi naḥ |
8,012.33 hoteva pūrvacittaye prādhvare ||

8,013.01  indraḥ suteṣu someṣu kratuṃ punīta ukthyam |
8,013.01 vide vṛdhasya dakṣaso mahānhi ṣaḥ ||
8,013.02  sa prathame vyomani devānāṃ sadane vṛdhaḥ |
8,013.02 supāraḥ suśravastamaḥ samapsujit ||
8,013.03  tamahve vājasātaya indraṃ bharāya śuṣmiṇam |
8,013.03 bhavā naḥ sumne antamaḥ sakhā vṛdhe ||
8,013.04  iyaṃ ta indra girvaṇo rātiḥ kṣarati sunvataḥ |
8,013.04 mandāno asya barhiṣo vi rājasi ||
8,013.05  nūnaṃ tadindra daddhi no yattvā sunvanta īmahe |
8,013.05 rayiṃ naścitramā bharā svarvidam ||
8,013.06  stotā yatte vicarṣaṇiratipraśardhayadgiraḥ |
8,013.06 vayā ivānu rohate juṣanta yat ||
8,013.07  pratnavajjanayā giraḥ śṛṇudhī jariturhavam |
8,013.07 mademade vavakṣithā sukṛtvane ||
8,013.08  krīḻantyasya sūnṛtā āpo na pravatā yatīḥ |
8,013.08 ayā dhiyā ya ucyate patirdivaḥ ||
8,013.09  uto patirya ucyate kṛṣṭīnāmeka idvaśī |
8,013.09 namovṛdhairavasyubhiḥ sute raṇa ||
8,013.10  stuhi śrutaṃ vipaścitaṃ harī yasya prasakṣiṇā |
8,013.10 gantārā dāśuṣo gṛhaṃ namasvinaḥ ||
8,013.11  tūtujāno mahemate'śvebhiḥ pruṣitapsubhiḥ |
8,013.11 ā yāhi yajñamāśubhiḥ śamiddhi te ||
8,013.12  indra śaviṣṭha satpate rayiṃ gṛṇatsu dhāraya |
8,013.12 śravaḥ sūribhyo amṛtaṃ vasutvanam ||
8,013.13  have tvā sūra udite have madhyandine divaḥ |
8,013.13 juṣāṇa indra saptibhirna ā gahi ||
8,013.14  ā tū gahi pra tu drava matsvā sutasya gomataḥ |
8,013.14 tantuṃ tanuṣva pūrvyaṃ yathā vide ||
8,013.15  yacchakrāsi parāvati yadarvāvati vṛtrahan |
8,013.15 yadvā samudre andhaso'vitedasi ||
8,013.16  indraṃ vardhantu no gira indraṃ sutāsa indavaḥ |
8,013.16 indre haviṣmatīrviśo arāṇiṣuḥ ||
8,013.17  tamidviprā avasyavaḥ pravatvatībhirūtibhiḥ |
8,013.17 indraṃ kṣoṇīravardhayanvayā iva ||
8,013.18  trikadrukeṣu cetanaṃ devāso yajñamatnata |
8,013.18 tamidvardhantu no giraḥ sadāvṛdham ||
8,013.19  stotā yatte anuvrata ukthānyṛtuthā dadhe |
8,013.19 śuciḥ pāvaka ucyate so adbhutaḥ ||
8,013.20  tadidrudrasya cetati yahvaṃ pratneṣu dhāmasu |
8,013.20 mano yatrā vi taddadhurvicetasaḥ ||
8,013.21  yadi me sakhyamāvara imasya pāhyandhasaḥ |
8,013.21 yena viśvā ati dviṣo atārima ||
8,013.22  kadā ta indra girvaṇa stotā bhavāti śantamaḥ |
8,013.22 kadā no gavye aśvye vasau dadhaḥ ||
8,013.23  uta te suṣṭutā harī vṛṣaṇā vahato ratham |
8,013.23 ajuryasya madintamaṃ yamīmahe ||
8,013.24  tamīmahe puruṣṭutaṃ yahvaṃ pratnābhirūtibhiḥ |
8,013.24 ni barhiṣi priye sadadadha dvitā ||
8,013.25  vardhasvā su puruṣṭuta ṛṣiṣṭutābhirūtibhiḥ |
8,013.25 dhukṣasva pipyuṣīmiṣamavā ca naḥ ||
8,013.26  indra tvamavitedasītthā stuvato adrivaḥ |
8,013.26 ṛtādiyarmi te dhiyaṃ manoyujam ||
8,013.27  iha tyā sadhamādyā yujānaḥ somapītaye |
8,013.27 harī indra pratadvasū abhi svara ||
8,013.28  abhi svarantu ye tava rudrāsaḥ sakṣata śriyam |
8,013.28 uto marutvatīrviśo abhi prayaḥ ||
8,013.29  imā asya pratūrtayaḥ padaṃ juṣanta yaddivi |
8,013.29 nābhā yajñasya saṃ dadhuryathā vide ||
8,013.30  ayaṃ dīrghāya cakṣase prāci prayatyadhvare |
8,013.30 mimīte yajñamānuṣagvicakṣya ||
8,013.31  vṛṣāyamindra te ratha uto te vṛṣaṇā harī |
8,013.31 vṛṣā tvaṃ śatakrato vṛṣā havaḥ ||
8,013.32  vṛṣā grāvā vṛṣā mado vṛṣā somo ayaṃ sutaḥ |
8,013.32 vṛṣā yajño yaminvasi vṛṣā havaḥ ||
8,013.33  vṛṣā tvā vṛṣaṇaṃ huve vajriñcitrābhirūtibhiḥ |
8,013.33 vāvantha hi pratiṣṭutiṃ vṛṣā havaḥ ||

8,014.01  yadindrāhaṃ yathā tvamīśīya vasva eka it |
8,014.01 stotā me goṣakhā syāt ||
8,014.02  śikṣeyamasmai ditseyaṃ śacīpate manīṣiṇe |
8,014.02 yadahaṃ gopatiḥ syām ||
8,014.03  dhenuṣṭa indra sūnṛtā yajamānāya sunvate |
8,014.03 gāmaśvaṃ pipyuṣī duhe ||
8,014.04  na te vartāsti rādhasa indra devo na martyaḥ |
8,014.04 yadditsasi stuto magham ||
8,014.05  yajña indramavardhayadyadbhūmiṃ vyavartayat |
8,014.05 cakrāṇa opaśaṃ divi ||
8,014.06  vāvṛdhānasya te vayaṃ viśvā dhanāni jigyuṣaḥ |
8,014.06 ūtimindrā vṛṇīmahe ||
8,014.07  vyantarikṣamatiranmade somasya rocanā |
8,014.07 indro yadabhinadvalam ||
8,014.08  udgā ājadaṅgirobhya āviṣkṛṇvanguhā satīḥ |
8,014.08 arvāñcaṃ nunude valam ||
8,014.09  indreṇa rocanā divo dṛḻhāni dṛṃhitāni ca |
8,014.09 sthirāṇi na parāṇude ||
8,014.10  apāmūrmirmadanniva stoma indrājirāyate |
8,014.10 vi te madā arājiṣuḥ ||
8,014.11  tvaṃ hi stomavardhana indrāsyukthavardhanaḥ |
8,014.11 stotṝṇāmuta bhadrakṛt ||
8,014.12  indramitkeśinā harī somapeyāya vakṣataḥ |
8,014.12 upa yajñaṃ surādhasam ||
8,014.13  apāṃ phenena namuceḥ śira indrodavartayaḥ |
8,014.13 viśvā yadajaya spṛdhaḥ ||
8,014.14  māyābhirutsisṛpsata indra dyāmārurukṣataḥ |
8,014.14 ava dasyūṃradhūnuthāḥ ||
8,014.15  asunvāmindra saṃsadaṃ viṣūcīṃ vyanāśayaḥ |
8,014.15 somapā uttaro bhavan ||

8,015.01  taṃ vabhi pra gāyata puruhūtaṃ puruṣṭutam |
8,015.01 indraṃ gīrbhistaviṣamā vivāsata ||
8,015.02  yasya dvibarhaso bṛhatsaho dādhāra rodasī |
8,015.02 girīṃrajrāṃ apaḥ svarvṛṣatvanā ||
8,015.03  sa rājasi puruṣṭutaṃ eko vṛtrāṇi jighnase |
8,015.03 indra jaitrā śravasyā ca yantave ||
8,015.04  taṃ te madaṃ gṛṇīmasi vṛṣaṇaṃ pṛtsu sāsahim |
8,015.04 u lokakṛtnumadrivo hariśriyam ||
8,015.05  yena jyotīṃṣyāyave manave ca viveditha |
8,015.05 mandāno asya barhiṣo vi rājasi ||
8,015.06  tadadyā citta ukthino'nu ṣṭuvanti pūrvathā |
8,015.06 vṛṣapatnīrapo jayā divedive ||
8,015.07  tava tyadindriyaṃ bṛhattava śuṣmamuta kratum |
8,015.07 vajraṃ śiśāti dhiṣaṇā vareṇyam ||
8,015.08  tava dyaurindra pauṃsyaṃ pṛthivī vardhati śravaḥ |
8,015.08 tvāmāpaḥ parvatāsaśca hinvire ||
8,015.09  tvāṃ viṣṇurbṛhankṣayo mitro gṛṇāti varuṇaḥ |
8,015.09 tvāṃ śardho madatyanu mārutam ||
8,015.10  tvaṃ vṛṣā janānāṃ maṃhiṣṭha indra jajñiṣe |
8,015.10 satrā viśvā svapatyāni dadhiṣe ||
8,015.11  satrā tvaṃ puruṣṭutaṃ eko vṛtrāṇi tośase |
8,015.11 nānya indrātkaraṇaṃ bhūya invati ||
8,015.12  yadindra manmaśastvā nānā havanta ūtaye |
8,015.12 asmākebhirnṛbhiratrā svarjaya ||
8,015.13  araṃ kṣayāya no mahe viśvā rūpāṇyāviśan |
8,015.13 indraṃ jaitrāya harṣayā śacīpatim ||

8,016.01  pra samrājaṃ carṣaṇīnāmindraṃ stotā navyaṃ gīrbhiḥ |
8,016.01 naraṃ nṛṣāhaṃ maṃhiṣṭham ||
8,016.02  yasminnukthāni raṇyanti viśvāni ca śravasyā |
8,016.02 apāmavo na samudre ||
8,016.03  taṃ suṣṭutyā vivāse jyeṣṭharājaṃ bhare kṛtnum |
8,016.03 maho vājinaṃ sanibhyaḥ ||
8,016.04  yasyānūnā gabhīrā madā uravastarutrāḥ |
8,016.04 harṣumantaḥ śūrasātau ||
8,016.05  tamiddhaneṣu hiteṣvadhivākāya havante |
8,016.05 yeṣāmindraste jayanti ||
8,016.06  tamiccyautnairāryanti taṃ kṛtebhiścarṣaṇayaḥ |
8,016.06 eṣa indro varivaskṛt ||
8,016.07  indro brahmendra ṛṣirindraḥ purū puruhūtaḥ |
8,016.07 mahānmahībhiḥ śacībhiḥ ||
8,016.08  sa stomyaḥ sa havyaḥ satyaḥ satvā tuvikūrmiḥ |
8,016.08 ekaścitsannabhibhūtiḥ ||
8,016.09  tamarkebhistaṃ sāmabhistaṃ gāyatraiścarṣaṇayaḥ |
8,016.09 indraṃ vardhanti kṣitayaḥ ||
8,016.10  praṇetāraṃ vasyo acchā kartāraṃ jyotiḥ samatsu |
8,016.10 sāsahvāṃsaṃ yudhāmitrān ||
8,016.11  sa naḥ papriḥ pārayāti svasti nāvā puruhūtaḥ |
8,016.11 indro viśvā ati dviṣaḥ ||
8,016.12  sa tvaṃ na indra vājebhirdaśasyā ca gātuyā ca |
8,016.12 acchā ca naḥ sumnaṃ neṣi ||

8,017.01  ā yāhi suṣumā hi ta indra somaṃ pibā imam |
8,017.01 edaṃ barhiḥ sado mama ||
8,017.02  ā tvā brahmayujā harī vahatāmindra keśinā |
8,017.02 upa brahmāṇi naḥ śṛṇu ||
8,017.03  brahmāṇastvā vayaṃ yujā somapāmindra sominaḥ |
8,017.03 sutāvanto havāmahe ||
8,017.04  ā no yāhi sutāvato'smākaṃ suṣṭutīrupa |
8,017.04 pibā su śiprinnandhasaḥ ||
8,017.05  ā te siñcāmi kukṣyoranu gātrā vi dhāvatu |
8,017.05 gṛbhāya jihvayā madhu ||
8,017.06  svāduṣṭe astu saṃsude madhumāntanve tava |
8,017.06 somaḥ śamastu te hṛde ||
8,017.07  ayamu tvā vicarṣaṇe janīrivābhi saṃvṛtaḥ |
8,017.07 pra soma indra sarpatu ||
8,017.08  tuvigrīvo vapodaraḥ subāhurandhaso made |
8,017.08 indro vṛtrāṇi jighnate ||
8,017.09  indra prehi purastvaṃ viśvasyeśāna ojasā |
8,017.09 vṛtrāṇi vṛtrahañjahi ||
8,017.10  dīrghaste astvaṅkuśo yenā vasu prayacchasi |
8,017.10 yajamānāya sunvate ||
8,017.11  ayaṃ ta indra somo nipūto adhi barhiṣi |
8,017.11 ehīmasya dravā piba ||
8,017.12  śācigo śācipūjanāyaṃ raṇāya te sutaḥ |
8,017.12 ākhaṇḍala pra hūyase ||
8,017.13  yaste śṛṅgavṛṣo napātpraṇapātkuṇḍapāyyaḥ |
8,017.13 nyasmindadhra ā manaḥ ||
8,017.14  vāstoṣpate dhruvā sthūṇāṃsatraṃ somyānām |
8,017.14 drapso bhettā purāṃ śaśvatīnāmindro munīnāṃ sakhā ||
8,017.15  pṛdākusānuryajato gaveṣaṇa ekaḥ sannabhi bhūyasaḥ |
8,017.15 bhūrṇimaśvaṃ nayattujā puro gṛbhendraṃ somasya pītaye ||

8,018.01  idaṃ ha nūnameṣāṃ sumnaṃ bhikṣeta martyaḥ |
8,018.01 ādityānāmapūrvyaṃ savīmani ||
8,018.02  anarvāṇo hyeṣāṃ panthā ādityānām |
8,018.02 adabdhāḥ santi pāyavaḥ sugevṛdhaḥ ||
8,018.03  tatsu naḥ savitā bhago varuṇo mitro aryamā |
8,018.03 śarma yacchantu sapratho yadīmahe ||
8,018.04  devebhirdevyadite'riṣṭabharmannā gahi |
8,018.04 smatsūribhiḥ purupriye suśarmabhiḥ ||
8,018.05  te hi putrāso aditervidurdveṣāṃsi yotave |
8,018.05 aṃhościdurucakrayo'nehasaḥ ||
8,018.06  aditirno divā paśumaditirnaktamadvayāḥ |
8,018.06 aditiḥ pātvaṃhasaḥ sadāvṛdhā ||
8,018.07  uta syā no divā matiraditirūtyā gamat |
8,018.07 sā śantāti mayaskaradapa sridhaḥ ||
8,018.08  uta tyā daivyā bhiṣajā śaṃ naḥ karato aśvinā |
8,018.08 yuyuyātāmito rapo apa sridhaḥ ||
8,018.09  śamagniragnibhiḥ karacchaṃ nastapatu sūryaḥ |
8,018.09 śaṃ vāto vātvarapā apa sridhaḥ ||
8,018.10  apāmīvāmapa sridhamapa sedhata durmatim |
8,018.10 ādityāso yuyotanā no aṃhasaḥ ||
8,018.11  yuyotā śarumasmadāṃ ādityāsa utāmatim |
8,018.11 ṛdhagdveṣaḥ kṛṇuta viśvavedasaḥ ||
8,018.12  tatsu naḥ śarma yacchatādityā yanmumocati |
8,018.12 enasvantaṃ cidenasaḥ sudānavaḥ ||
8,018.13  yo naḥ kaścidririkṣati rakṣastvena martyaḥ |
8,018.13 svaiḥ ṣa evai ririṣīṣṭa yurjanaḥ ||
8,018.14  samittamaghamaśnavadduḥśaṃsaṃ martyaṃ ripum |
8,018.14 yo asmatrā durhaṇāvāṃ upa dvayuḥ ||
8,018.15  pākatrā sthana devā hṛtsu jānītha martyam |
8,018.15 upa dvayuṃ cādvayuṃ ca vasavaḥ ||
8,018.16  ā śarma parvatānāmotāpāṃ vṛṇīmahe |
8,018.16 dyāvākṣāmāre asmadrapaskṛtam ||
8,018.17  te no bhadreṇa śarmaṇā yuṣmākaṃ nāvā vasavaḥ |
8,018.17 ati viśvāni duritā pipartana ||
8,018.18  tuce tanāya tatsu no drāghīya āyurjīvase |
8,018.18 ādityāsaḥ sumahasaḥ kṛṇotana ||
8,018.19  yajño hīḻo vo antara ādityā asti mṛḻata |
8,018.19 yuṣme idvo api ṣmasi sajātye ||
8,018.20  bṛhadvarūthaṃ marutāṃ devaṃ trātāramaśvinā |
8,018.20 mitramīmahe varuṇaṃ svastaye ||
8,018.21  aneho mitrāryamannṛvadvaruṇa śaṃsyam |
8,018.21 trivarūthaṃ maruto yanta naśchardiḥ ||
8,018.22  ye ciddhi mṛtyubandhava ādityā manavaḥ smasi |
8,018.22 pra sū na āyurjīvase tiretana ||

8,019.01  taṃ gūrdhayā svarṇaraṃ devāso devamaratiṃ dadhanvire |
8,019.01 devatrā havyamohire ||
8,019.02  vibhūtarātiṃ vipra citraśociṣamagnimīḻiṣva yanturam |
8,019.02 asya medhasya somyasya sobhare premadhvarāya pūrvyam ||
8,019.03  yajiṣṭhaṃ tvā vavṛmahe devaṃ devatrā hotāramamartyam |
8,019.03 asya yajñasya sukratum ||
8,019.04  ūrjo napātaṃ subhagaṃ sudīditimagniṃ śreṣṭhaśociṣam |
8,019.04 sa no mitrasya varuṇasya so apāmā sumnaṃ yakṣate divi ||
8,019.05  yaḥ samidhā ya āhutī yo vedena dadāśa marto agnaye |
8,019.05 yo namasā svadhvaraḥ ||
8,019.06  tasyedarvanto raṃhayanta āśavastasya dyumnitamaṃ yaśaḥ |
8,019.06 na tamaṃho devakṛtaṃ kutaścana na martyakṛtaṃ naśat ||
8,019.07  svagnayo vo agnibhiḥ syāma sūno sahasa ūrjāṃ pate |
8,019.07 suvīrastvamasmayuḥ ||
8,019.08  praśaṃsamāno atithirna mitriyo'gnī ratho na vedyaḥ |
8,019.08 tve kṣemāso api santi sādhavastvaṃ rājā rayīṇām ||
8,019.09  so addhā dāśvadhvaro'gne martaḥ subhaga sa praśaṃsyaḥ |
8,019.09 sa dhībhirastu sanitā ||
8,019.10  yasya tvamūrdhvo adhvarāya tiṣṭhasi kṣayadvīraḥ sa sādhate |
8,019.10 so arvadbhiḥ sanitā sa vipanyubhiḥ sa śūraiḥ sanitā kṛtam ||
8,019.11  yasyāgnirvapurgṛhe stomaṃ cano dadhīta viśvavāryaḥ |
8,019.11 havyā vā veviṣadviṣaḥ ||
8,019.12  viprasya vā stuvataḥ sahaso yaho makṣūtamasya rātiṣu |
8,019.12 avodevamuparimartyaṃ kṛdhi vaso vividuṣo vacaḥ ||
8,019.13  yo agniṃ havyadātibhirnamobhirvā sudakṣamāvivāsati |
8,019.13 girā vājiraśociṣam ||
8,019.14  samidhā yo niśitī dāśadaditiṃ dhāmabhirasya martyaḥ |
8,019.14 viśvetsa dhībhiḥ subhago janāṃ ati dyumnairudna iva tāriṣat ||
8,019.15  tadagne dyumnamā bhara yatsāsahatsadane kaṃ cidatriṇam |
8,019.15 manyuṃ janasya dūḍhyaḥ ||
8,019.16  yena caṣṭe varuṇo mitro aryamā yena nāsatyā bhagaḥ |
8,019.16 vayaṃ tatte śavasā gātuvittamā indratvotā vidhemahi ||
8,019.17  te ghedagne svādhyo ye tvā vipra nidadhire nṛcakṣasam |
8,019.17 viprāso deva sukratum ||
8,019.18  ta idvediṃ subhaga ta āhutiṃ te sotuṃ cakrire divi |
8,019.18 ta idvājebhirjigyurmahaddhanaṃ ye tve kāmaṃ nyerire ||
8,019.19  bhadro no agnirāhuto bhadrā rātiḥ subhaga bhadro adhvaraḥ |
8,019.19 bhadrā uta praśastayaḥ ||
8,019.20  bhadraṃ manaḥ kṛṇuṣva vṛtratūrye yenā samatsu sāsahaḥ |
8,019.20 ava sthirā tanuhi bhūri śardhatāṃ vanemā te abhiṣṭibhiḥ ||
8,019.21  īḻe girā manurhitaṃ yaṃ devā dūtamaratiṃ nyerire |
8,019.21 yajiṣṭhaṃ havyavāhanam ||
8,019.22  tigmajambhāya taruṇāya rājate prayo gāyasyagnaye |
8,019.22 yaḥ piṃśate sūnṛtābhiḥ suvīryamagnirghṛtebhirāhutaḥ ||
8,019.23  yadī ghṛtebhirāhuto vāśīmagnirbharata uccāva ca |
8,019.23 asura iva nirṇijam ||
8,019.24  yo havyānyairayatā manurhito deva āsā sugandhinā |
8,019.24 vivāsate vāryāṇi svadhvaro hotā devo amartyaḥ ||
8,019.25  yadagne martyastvaṃ syāmahaṃ mitramaho amartyaḥ |
8,019.25 sahasaḥ sūnavāhuta ||
8,019.26  na tvā rāsīyābhiśastaye vaso na pāpatvāya santya |
8,019.26 na me stotāmatīvā na durhitaḥ syādagne na pāpayā ||
8,019.27  piturna putraḥ subhṛto duroṇa ā devāṃ etu pra ṇo haviḥ ||
8,019.28  tavāhamagna ūtibhirnediṣṭhābhiḥ saceya joṣamā vaso |
8,019.28 sadā devasya martyaḥ ||
8,019.29  tava kratvā saneyaṃ tava rātibhiragne tava praśastibhiḥ |
8,019.29 tvāmidāhuḥ pramatiṃ vaso mamāgne harṣasva dātave ||
8,019.30  pra so agne tavotibhiḥ suvīrābhistirate vājabharmabhiḥ |
8,019.30 yasya tvaṃ sakhyamāvaraḥ ||
8,019.31  tava drapso nīlavānvāśa ṛtviya indhānaḥ siṣṇavā dade |
8,019.31 tvaṃ mahīnāmuṣasāmasi priyaḥ kṣapo vastuṣu rājasi ||
8,019.32  tamāganma sobharayaḥ sahasramuṣkaṃ svabhiṣṭimavase |
8,019.32 samrājaṃ trāsadasyavam ||
8,019.33  yasya te agne anye agnaya upakṣito vayā iva |
8,019.33 vipo na dyumnā ni yuve janānāṃ tava kṣatrāṇi vardhayan ||
8,019.34  yamādityāso adruhaḥ pāraṃ nayatha martyam |
8,019.34 maghonāṃ viśveṣāṃ sudānavaḥ ||
8,019.35  yūyaṃ rājānaḥ kaṃ ciccarṣaṇīsahaḥ kṣayantaṃ mānuṣāṃ anu |
8,019.35 vayaṃ te vo varuṇa mitrāryamansyāmedṛtasya rathyaḥ ||
8,019.36  adānme paurukutsyaḥ pañcāśataṃ trasadasyurvadhūnām |
8,019.36 maṃhiṣṭho aryaḥ satpatiḥ ||
8,019.37  uta me prayiyorvayiyoḥ suvāstvā adhi tugvani |
8,019.37 tisṝṇāṃ saptatīnāṃ śyāvaḥ praṇetā bhuvadvasurdiyānāṃ patiḥ ||

8,020.01  ā gantā mā riṣaṇyata prasthāvāno māpa sthātā samanyavaḥ |
8,020.01 sthirā cinnamayiṣṇavaḥ ||
8,020.02  vīḻupavibhirmaruta ṛbhukṣaṇa ā rudrāsaḥ sudītibhiḥ |
8,020.02 iṣā no adyā gatā puruspṛho yajñamā sobharīyavaḥ ||
8,020.03  vidmā hi rudriyāṇāṃ śuṣmamugraṃ marutāṃ śimīvatām |
8,020.03 viṣṇoreṣasya mīḻhuṣām ||
8,020.04  vi dvīpāni pāpatantiṣṭhadducchunobhe yujanta rodasī |
8,020.04 pra dhanvānyairata śubhrakhādayo yadejatha svabhānavaḥ ||
8,020.05  acyutā cidvo ajmannā nānadati parvatāso vanaspatiḥ |
8,020.05 bhūmiryāmeṣu rejate ||
8,020.06  amāya vo maruto yātave dyaurjihīta uttarā bṛhat |
8,020.06 yatrā naro dediśate tanūṣvā tvakṣāṃsi bāhvojasaḥ ||
8,020.07  svadhāmanu śriyaṃ naro mahi tveṣā amavanto vṛṣapsavaḥ |
8,020.07 vahante ahrutapsavaḥ ||
8,020.08  gobhirvāṇo ajyate sobharīṇāṃ rathe kośe hiraṇyaye |
8,020.08 gobandhavaḥ sujātāsa iṣe bhuje mahānto na sparase nu ||
8,020.09  prati vo vṛṣadañjayo vṛṣṇe śardhāya mārutāya bharadhvam |
8,020.09 havyā vṛṣaprayāvṇe ||
8,020.10  vṛṣaṇaśvena maruto vṛṣapsunā rathena vṛṣanābhinā |
8,020.10 ā śyenāso na pakṣiṇo vṛthā naro havyā no vītaye gata ||
8,020.11  samānamañjyeṣāṃ vi bhrājante rukmāso adhi bāhuṣu |
8,020.11 davidyutatyṛṣṭayaḥ ||
8,020.12  ta ugrāso vṛṣaṇa ugrabāhavo nakiṣṭanūṣu yetire |
8,020.12 sthirā dhanvānyāyudhā ratheṣu vo'nīkeṣvadhi śriyaḥ ||
8,020.13  yeṣāmarṇo na sapratho nāma tveṣaṃ śaśvatāmekamidbhuje |
8,020.13 vayo na pitryaṃ sahaḥ ||
8,020.14  tānvandasva marutastāṃ upa stuhi teṣāṃ hi dhunīnām |
8,020.14 arāṇāṃ na caramastadeṣāṃ dānā mahnā tadeṣām ||
8,020.15  subhagaḥ sa va ūtiṣvāsa pūrvāsu maruto vyuṣṭiṣu |
8,020.15 yo vā nūnamutāsati ||
8,020.16  yasya vā yūyaṃ prati vājino nara ā havyā vītaye gatha |
8,020.16 abhi ṣa dyumnairuta vājasātibhiḥ sumnā vo dhūtayo naśat ||
8,020.17  yathā rudrasya sūnavo divo vaśantyasurasya vedhasaḥ |
8,020.17 yuvānastathedasat ||
8,020.18  ye cārhanti marutaḥ sudānavaḥ smanmīḻhuṣaścaranti ye |
8,020.18 ataścidā na upa vasyasā hṛdā yuvāna ā vavṛdhvam ||
8,020.19  yūna ū ṣu naviṣṭhayā vṛṣṇaḥ pāvakāṃ abhi sobhare girā |
8,020.19 gāya gā iva carkṛṣat ||
8,020.20  sāhā ye santi muṣṭiheva havyo viśvāsu pṛtsu hotṛṣu |
8,020.20 vṛṣṇaścandrānna suśravastamāngirā vandasva maruto aha ||
8,020.21  gāvaścidghā samanyavaḥ sajātyena marutaḥ sabandhavaḥ |
8,020.21 rihate kakubho mithaḥ ||
8,020.22  martaścidvo nṛtavo rukmavakṣasa upa bhrātṛtvamāyati |
8,020.22 adhi no gāta marutaḥ sadā hi va āpitvamasti nidhruvi ||
8,020.23  maruto mārutasya na ā bheṣajasya vahatā sudānavaḥ |
8,020.23 yūyaṃ sakhāyaḥ saptayaḥ ||
8,020.24  yābhiḥ sindhumavatha yābhistūrvatha yābhirdaśasyathā krivim |
8,020.24 mayo no bhūtotibhirmayobhuvaḥ śivābhirasacadviṣaḥ ||
8,020.25  yatsindhau yadasiknyāṃ yatsamudreṣu marutaḥ subarhiṣaḥ |
8,020.25 yatparvateṣu bheṣajam ||
8,020.26  viśvaṃ paśyanto bibhṛthā tanūṣvā tenā no adhi vocata |
8,020.26 kṣamā rapo maruta āturasya na iṣkartā vihrutaṃ punaḥ ||

8,021.01  vayamu tvāmapūrvya sthūraṃ na kaccidbharanto'vasyavaḥ |
8,021.01 vāje citraṃ havāmahe ||
8,021.02  upa tvā karmannūtaye sa no yuvograścakrāma yo dhṛṣat |
8,021.02 tvāmiddhyavitāraṃ vavṛmahe sakhāya indra sānasim ||
8,021.03  ā yāhīma indavo'śvapate gopata urvarāpate |
8,021.03 somaṃ somapate piba ||
8,021.04  vayaṃ hi tvā bandhumantamabandhavo viprāsa indra yemima |
8,021.04 yā te dhāmāni vṛṣabha tebhirā gahi viśvebhiḥ somapītaye ||
8,021.05  sīdantaste vayo yathā gośrīte madhau madire vivakṣaṇe |
8,021.05 abhi tvāmindra nonumaḥ ||
8,021.06  acchā ca tvainā namasā vadāmasi kiṃ muhuścidvi dīdhayaḥ |
8,021.06 santi kāmāso harivo dadiṣṭvaṃ smo vayaṃ santi no dhiyaḥ ||
8,021.07  nūtnā idindra te vayamūtī abhūma nahi nū te adrivaḥ |
8,021.07 vidmā purā parīṇasaḥ ||
8,021.08  vidmā sakhitvamuta śūra bhojyamā te tā vajrinnīmahe |
8,021.08 uto samasminnā śiśīhi no vaso vāje suśipra gomati ||
8,021.09  yo na idamidaṃ purā pra vasya ānināya tamu va stuṣe |
8,021.09 sakhāya indramūtaye ||
8,021.10  haryaśvaṃ satpatiṃ carṣaṇīsahaṃ sa hi ṣmā yo amandata |
8,021.10 ā tu naḥ sa vayati gavyamaśvyaṃ stotṛbhyo maghavā śatam ||
8,021.11  tvayā ha svidyujā vayaṃ prati śvasantaṃ vṛṣabha bruvīmahi |
8,021.11 saṃsthe janasya gomataḥ ||
8,021.12  jayema kāre puruhūta kāriṇo'bhi tiṣṭhema dūḍhyaḥ |
8,021.12 nṛbhirvṛtraṃ hanyāma śūśuyāma cāverindra pra ṇo dhiyaḥ ||
8,021.13  abhrātṛvyo anā tvamanāpirindra januṣā sanādasi |
8,021.13 yudhedāpitvamicchase ||
8,021.14  nakī revantaṃ sakhyāya vindase pīyanti te surāśvaḥ |
8,021.14 yadā kṛṇoṣi nadanuṃ samūhasyāditpiteva hūyase ||
8,021.15  mā te amājuro yathā mūrāsa indra sakhye tvāvataḥ |
8,021.15 ni ṣadāma sacā sute ||
8,021.16  mā te godatra nirarāma rādhasa indra mā te gṛhāmahi |
8,021.16 dṛḻhā cidaryaḥ pra mṛśābhyā bhara na te dāmāna ādabhe ||
8,021.17  indro vā ghediyanmaghaṃ sarasvatī vā subhagā dadirvasu |
8,021.17 tvaṃ vā citra dāśuṣe ||
8,021.18  citra idrājā rājakā idanyake yake sarasvatīmanu |
8,021.18 parjanya iva tatanaddhi vṛṣṭyā sahasramayutā dadat ||

8,022.01  o tyamahva ā rathamadyā daṃsiṣṭhamūtaye |
8,022.01 yamaśvinā suhavā rudravartanī ā sūryāyai tasthathuḥ ||
8,022.02  pūrvāyuṣaṃ suhavaṃ puruspṛhaṃ bhujyuṃ vājeṣu pūrvyam |
8,022.02 sacanāvantaṃ sumatibhiḥ sobhare vidveṣasamanehasam ||
8,022.03  iha tyā purubhūtamā devā namobhiraśvinā |
8,022.03 arvācīnā svavase karāmahe gantārā dāśuṣo gṛham ||
8,022.04  yuvo rathasya pari cakramīyata īrmānyadvāmiṣaṇyati |
8,022.04 asmāṃ acchā sumatirvāṃ śubhaspatī ā dhenuriva dhāvatu ||
8,022.05  ratho yo vāṃ trivandhuro hiraṇyābhīśuraśvinā |
8,022.05 pari dyāvāpṛthivī bhūṣati śrutastena nāsatyā gatam ||
8,022.06  daśasyantā manave pūrvyaṃ divi yavaṃ vṛkeṇa karṣathaḥ |
8,022.06 tā vāmadya sumatibhiḥ śubhaspatī aśvinā pra stuvīmahi ||
8,022.07  upa no vājinīvasū yātamṛtasya pathibhiḥ |
8,022.07 yebhistṛkṣiṃ vṛṣaṇā trāsadasyavaṃ mahe kṣatrāya jinvathaḥ ||
8,022.08  ayaṃ vāmadribhiḥ sutaḥ somo narā vṛṣaṇvasū |
8,022.08 ā yātaṃ somapītaye pibataṃ dāśuṣo gṛhe ||
8,022.09  ā hi ruhatamaśvinā rathe kośe hiraṇyaye vṛṣaṇvasū |
8,022.09 yuñjāthāṃ pīvarīriṣaḥ ||
8,022.10  yābhiḥ pakthamavatho yābhiradhriguṃ yābhirbabhruṃ vijoṣasam |
8,022.10 tābhirno makṣū tūyamaśvinā gataṃ bhiṣajyataṃ yadāturam ||
8,022.11  yadadhrigāvo adhrigū idā cidahno aśvinā havāmahe |
8,022.11 vayaṃ gīrbhirvipanyavaḥ ||
8,022.12  tābhirā yātaṃ vṛṣaṇopa me havaṃ viśvapsuṃ viśvavāryam |
8,022.12 iṣā maṃhiṣṭhā purubhūtamā narā yābhiḥ kriviṃ vāvṛdhustābhirā gatam ||
8,022.13  tāvidā cidahānāṃ tāvaśvinā vandamāna upa bruve |
8,022.13 tā u namobhirīmahe ||
8,022.14  tāviddoṣā tā uṣasi śubhaspatī tā yāmanrudravartanī |
8,022.14 mā no martāya ripave vājinīvasū paro rudrāvati khyatam ||
8,022.15  ā sugmyāya sugmyaṃ prātā rathenāśvinā vā sakṣaṇī |
8,022.15 huve piteva sobharī ||
8,022.16  manojavasā vṛṣaṇā madacyutā makṣuṅgamābhirūtibhiḥ |
8,022.16 ārāttāccidbhūtamasme avase pūrvībhiḥ purubhojasā ||
8,022.17  ā no aśvāvadaśvinā vartiryāsiṣṭaṃ madhupātamā narā |
8,022.17 gomaddasrā hiraṇyavat ||
8,022.18  suprāvargaṃ suvīryaṃ suṣṭhu vāryamanādhṛṣṭaṃ rakṣasvinā |
8,022.18 asminnā vāmāyāne vājinīvasū viśvā vāmāni dhīmahi ||

8,023.01  īḻiṣvā hi pratīvyaṃ yajasva jātavedasam |
8,023.01 cariṣṇudhūmamagṛbhītaśociṣam ||
8,023.02  dāmānaṃ viśvacarṣaṇe'gniṃ viśvamano girā |
8,023.02 uta stuṣe viṣpardhaso rathānām ||
8,023.03  yeṣāmābādha ṛgmiya iṣaḥ pṛkṣaśca nigrabhe |
8,023.03 upavidā vahnirvindate vasu ||
8,023.04  udasya śocirasthāddīdiyuṣo vyajaram |
8,023.04 tapurjambhasya sudyuto gaṇaśriyaḥ ||
8,023.05  udu tiṣṭha svadhvara stavāno devyā kṛpā |
8,023.05 abhikhyā bhāsā bṛhatā śuśukvaniḥ ||
8,023.06  agne yāhi suśastibhirhavyā juhvāna ānuṣak |
8,023.06 yathā dūto babhūtha havyavāhanaḥ ||
8,023.07  agniṃ vaḥ pūrvyaṃ huve hotāraṃ carṣaṇīnām |
8,023.07 tamayā vācā gṛṇe tamu va stuṣe ||
8,023.08  yajñebhiradbhutakratuṃ yaṃ kṛpā sūdayanta it |
8,023.08 mitraṃ na jane sudhitamṛtāvani ||
8,023.09  ṛtāvānamṛtāyavo yajñasya sādhanaṃ girā |
8,023.09 upo enaṃ jujuṣurnamasaspade ||
8,023.10  acchā no aṅgirastamaṃ yajñāso yantu saṃyataḥ |
8,023.10 hotā yo asti vikṣvā yaśastamaḥ ||
8,023.11  agne tava tye ajarendhānāso bṛhadbhāḥ |
8,023.11 aśvā iva vṛṣaṇastaviṣīyavaḥ ||
8,023.12  sa tvaṃ na ūrjāṃ pate rayiṃ rāsva suvīryam |
8,023.12 prāva nastoke tanaye samatsvā ||
8,023.13  yadvā u viśpatiḥ śitaḥ suprīto manuṣo viśi |
8,023.13 viśvedagniḥ prati rakṣāṃsi sedhati ||
8,023.14  śruṣṭyagne navasya me stomasya vīra viśpate |
8,023.14 ni māyinastapuṣā rakṣaso daha ||
8,023.15  na tasya māyayā cana ripurīśīta martyaḥ |
8,023.15 yo agnaye dadāśa havyadātibhiḥ ||
8,023.16  vyaśvastvā vasuvidamukṣaṇyuraprīṇādṛṣiḥ |
8,023.16 maho rāye tamu tvā samidhīmahi ||
8,023.17  uśanā kāvyastvā ni hotāramasādayat |
8,023.17 āyajiṃ tvā manave jātavedasam ||
8,023.18  viśve hi tvā sajoṣaso devāso dūtamakrata |
8,023.18 śruṣṭī deva prathamo yajñiyo bhuvaḥ ||
8,023.19  imaṃ ghā vīro amṛtaṃ dūtaṃ kṛṇvīta martyaḥ |
8,023.19 pāvakaṃ kṛṣṇavartaniṃ vihāyasam ||
8,023.20  taṃ huvema yatasrucaḥ subhāsaṃ śukraśociṣam |
8,023.20 viśāmagnimajaraṃ pratnamīḍyam ||
8,023.21  yo asmai havyadātibhirāhutiṃ marto'vidhat |
8,023.21 bhūri poṣaṃ sa dhatte vīravadyaśaḥ ||
8,023.22  prathamaṃ jātavedasamagniṃ yajñeṣu pūrvyam |
8,023.22 prati srugeti namasā haviṣmatī ||
8,023.23  ābhirvidhemāgnaye jyeṣṭhābhirvyaśvavat |
8,023.23 maṃhiṣṭhābhirmatibhiḥ śukraśociṣe ||
8,023.24  nūnamarca vihāyase stomebhi sthūrayūpavat |
8,023.24 ṛṣe vaiyaśva damyāyāgnaye ||
8,023.25  atithiṃ mānuṣāṇāṃ sūnuṃ vanaspatīnām |
8,023.25 viprā agnimavase pratnamīḻate ||
8,023.26  maho viśvāṃ abhi ṣato'bhi havyāni mānuṣā |
8,023.26 agne ni ṣatsi namasādhi barhiṣi ||
8,023.27  vaṃsvā no vāryā puru vaṃsva rāyaḥ puruspṛhaḥ |
8,023.27 suvīryasya prajāvato yaśasvataḥ ||
8,023.28  tvaṃ varo suṣāmṇe'gne janāya codaya |
8,023.28 sadā vaso rātiṃ yaviṣṭha śaśvate ||
8,023.29  tvaṃ hi supratūrasi tvaṃ no gomatīriṣaḥ |
8,023.29 maho rāyaḥ sātimagne apā vṛdhi ||
8,023.30  agne tvaṃ yaśā asyā mitrāvaruṇā vaha |
8,023.30 ṛtāvānā samrājā pūtadakṣasā ||

8,024.01  sakhāya ā śiṣāmahi brahmendrāya vajriṇe |
8,024.01 stuṣa ū ṣu vo nṛtamāya dhṛṣṇave ||
8,024.02  śavasā hyasi śruto vṛtrahatyena vṛtrahā |
8,024.02 maghairmaghono ati śūra dāśasi ||
8,024.03  sa na stavāna ā bhara rayiṃ citraśravastamam |
8,024.03 nireke cidyo harivo vasurdadiḥ ||
8,024.04  ā nirekamuta priyamindra darṣi janānām |
8,024.04 dhṛṣatā dhṛṣṇo stavamāna ā bhara ||
8,024.05  na te savyaṃ na dakṣiṇaṃ hastaṃ varanta āmuraḥ |
8,024.05 na paribādho harivo gaviṣṭiṣu ||
8,024.06  ā tvā gobhiriva vrajaṃ gīrbhirṛṇomyadrivaḥ |
8,024.06 ā smā kāmaṃ jariturā manaḥ pṛṇa ||
8,024.07  viśvāni viśvamanaso dhiyā no vṛtrahantama |
8,024.07 ugra praṇetaradhi ṣū vaso gahi ||
8,024.08  vayaṃ te asya vṛtrahanvidyāma śūra navyasaḥ |
8,024.08 vaso spārhasya puruhūta rādhasaḥ ||
8,024.09  indra yathā hyasti te'parītaṃ nṛto śavaḥ |
8,024.09 amṛktā rātiḥ puruhūta dāśuṣe ||
8,024.10  ā vṛṣasva mahāmaha mahe nṛtama rādhase |
8,024.10 dṛḻhaściddṛhya maghavanmaghattaye ||
8,024.11  nū anyatrā cidadrivastvanno jagmurāśasaḥ |
8,024.11 maghavañchagdhi tava tanna ūtibhiḥ ||
8,024.12  nahyaṅga nṛto tvadanyaṃ vindāmi rādhase |
8,024.12 rāye dyumnāya śavase ca girvaṇaḥ ||
8,024.13  endumindrāya siñcata pibāti somyaṃ madhu |
8,024.13 pra rādhasā codayāte mahitvanā ||
8,024.14  upo harīṇāṃ patiṃ dakṣaṃ pṛñcantamabravam |
8,024.14 nūnaṃ śrudhi stuvato aśvyasya ||
8,024.15  nahyaṅga purā cana jajñe vīratarastvat |
8,024.15 nakī rāyā naivathā na bhandanā ||
8,024.16  edu madhvo madintaraṃ siñca vādhvaryo andhasaḥ |
8,024.16 evā hi vīra stavate sadāvṛdhaḥ ||
8,024.17  indra sthātarharīṇāṃ nakiṣṭe pūrvyastutim |
8,024.17 udānaṃśa śavasā na bhandanā ||
8,024.18  taṃ vo vājānāṃ patimahūmahi śravasyavaḥ |
8,024.18 aprāyubhiryajñebhirvāvṛdhenyam ||
8,024.19  eto nvindraṃ stavāma sakhāya stomyaṃ naram |
8,024.19 kṛṣṭīryo viśvā abhyastyeka it ||
8,024.20  agorudhāya gaviṣe dyukṣāya dasmyaṃ vacaḥ |
8,024.20 ghṛtātsvādīyo madhunaśca vocata ||
8,024.21  yasyāmitāni vīryā na rādhaḥ paryetave |
8,024.21 jyotirna viśvamabhyasti dakṣiṇā ||
8,024.22  stuhīndraṃ vyaśvavadanūrmiṃ vājinaṃ yamam |
8,024.22 aryo gayaṃ maṃhamānaṃ vi dāśuṣe ||
8,024.23  evā nūnamupa stuhi vaiyaśva daśamaṃ navam |
8,024.23 suvidvāṃsaṃ carkṛtyaṃ caraṇīnām ||
8,024.24  vetthā hi nirṛtīnāṃ vajrahasta parivṛjam |
8,024.24 aharahaḥ śundhyuḥ paripadāmiva ||
8,024.25  tadindrāva ā bhara yenā daṃsiṣṭha kṛtvane |
8,024.25 dvitā kutsāya śiśnatho ni codaya ||
8,024.26  tamu tvā nūnamīmahe navyaṃ daṃsiṣṭha sanyase |
8,024.26 sa tvaṃ no viśvā abhimātīḥ sakṣaṇiḥ ||
8,024.27  ya ṛkṣādaṃhaso mucadyo vāryātsapta sindhuṣu |
8,024.27 vadhardāsasya tuvinṛmṇa nīnamaḥ ||
8,024.28  yathā varo suṣāmṇe sanibhya āvaho rayim |
8,024.28 vyaśvebhyaḥ subhage vājinīvati ||
8,024.29  ā nāryasya dakṣiṇā vyaśvāṃ etu sominaḥ |
8,024.29 sthūraṃ ca rādhaḥ śatavatsahasravat ||
8,024.30  yattvā pṛcchādījānaḥ kuhayā kuhayākṛte |
8,024.30 eṣo apaśrito valo gomatīmava tiṣṭhati ||

8,025.01  tā vāṃ viśvasya gopā devā deveṣu yajñiyā |
8,025.01 ṛtāvānā yajase pūtadakṣasā ||
8,025.02  mitrā tanā na rathyā varuṇo yaśca sukratuḥ |
8,025.02 sanātsujātā tanayā dhṛtavratā ||
8,025.03  tā mātā viśvavedasāsuryāya pramahasā |
8,025.03 mahī jajānāditirṛtāvarī ||
8,025.04  mahāntā mitrāvaruṇā samrājā devāvasurā |
8,025.04 ṛtāvānāvṛtamā ghoṣato bṛhat ||
8,025.05  napātā śavaso mahaḥ sūnū dakṣasya sukratū |
8,025.05 sṛpradānū iṣo vāstvadhi kṣitaḥ ||
8,025.06  saṃ yā dānūni yemathurdivyāḥ pārthivīriṣaḥ |
8,025.06 nabhasvatīrā vāṃ carantu vṛṣṭayaḥ ||
8,025.07  adhi yā bṛhato divo'bhi yūtheva paśyataḥ |
8,025.07 ṛtāvānā samrājā namase hitā ||
8,025.08  ṛtāvānā ni ṣedatuḥ sāmrājyāya sukratū |
8,025.08 dhṛtavratā kṣatriyā kṣatramāśatuḥ ||
8,025.09  akṣṇaścidgātuvittarānulbaṇena cakṣasā |
8,025.09 ni cinmiṣantā nicirā ni cikyatuḥ ||
8,025.10  uta no devyaditiruruṣyatāṃ nāsatyā |
8,025.10 uruṣyantu maruto vṛddhaśavasaḥ ||
8,025.11  te no nāvamuruṣyata divā naktaṃ sudānavaḥ |
8,025.11 ariṣyanto ni pāyubhiḥ sacemahi ||
8,025.12  aghnate viṣṇave vayamariṣyantaḥ sudānave |
8,025.12 śrudhi svayāvansindho pūrvacittaye ||
8,025.13  tadvāryaṃ vṛṇīmahe variṣṭhaṃ gopayatyam |
8,025.13 mitro yatpānti varuṇo yadaryamā ||
8,025.14  uta naḥ sindhurapāṃ tanmarutastadaśvinā |
8,025.14 indro viṣṇurmīḍhvāṃsaḥ sajoṣasaḥ ||
8,025.15  te hi ṣmā vanuṣo naro'bhimātiṃ kayasya cit |
8,025.15 tigmaṃ na kṣodaḥ pratighnanti bhūrṇayaḥ ||
8,025.16  ayameka itthā purūru caṣṭe vi viśpatiḥ |
8,025.16 tasya vratānyanu vaścarāmasi ||
8,025.17  anu pūrvāṇyokyā sāmrājyasya saścima |
8,025.17 mitrasya vratā varuṇasya dīrghaśrut ||
8,025.18  pari yo raśminā divo'ntānmame pṛthivyāḥ |
8,025.18 ubhe ā paprau rodasī mahitvā ||
8,025.19  udu ṣya śaraṇe divo jyotirayaṃsta sūryaḥ |
8,025.19 agnirna śukraḥ samidhāna āhutaḥ ||
8,025.20  vaco dīrghaprasadmanīśe vājasya gomataḥ |
8,025.20 īśe hi pitvo'viṣasya dāvane ||
8,025.21  tatsūryaṃ rodasī ubhe doṣā vastorupa bruve |
8,025.21 bhojeṣvasmāṃ abhyuccarā sadā ||
8,025.22  ṛjramukṣaṇyāyane rajataṃ harayāṇe |
8,025.22 rathaṃ yuktamasanāma suṣāmaṇi ||
8,025.23  tā me aśvyānāṃ harīṇāṃ nitośanā |
8,025.23 uto nu kṛtvyānāṃ nṛvāhasā ||
8,025.24  smadabhīśū kaśāvantā viprā naviṣṭhayā matī |
8,025.24 maho vājināvarvantā sacāsanam ||

8,026.01  yuvoru ṣū rathaṃ huve sadhastutyāya sūriṣu |
8,026.01 atūrtadakṣā vṛṣaṇā vṛṣaṇvasū ||
8,026.02  yuvaṃ varo suṣāmṇe mahe tane nāsatyā |
8,026.02 avobhiryātho vṛṣaṇā vṛṣaṇvasū ||
8,026.03  tā vāmadya havāmahe havyebhirvājinīvasū |
8,026.03 pūrvīriṣa iṣayantāvati kṣapaḥ ||
8,026.04  ā vāṃ vāhiṣṭho aśvinā ratho yātu śruto narā |
8,026.04 upa stomānturasya darśathaḥ śriye ||
8,026.05  juhurāṇā cidaśvinā manyethāṃ vṛṣaṇvasū |
8,026.05 yuvaṃ hi rudrā parṣatho ati dviṣaḥ ||
8,026.06  dasrā hi viśvamānuṣaṅmakṣūbhiḥ paridīyathaḥ |
8,026.06 dhiyañjinvā madhuvarṇā śubhaspatī ||
8,026.07  upa no yātamaśvinā rāyā viśvapuṣā saha |
8,026.07 maghavānā suvīrāvanapacyutā ||
8,026.08  ā me asya pratīvyamindranāsatyā gatam |
8,026.08 devā devebhiradya sacanastamā ||
8,026.09  vayaṃ hi vāṃ havāmaha ukṣaṇyanto vyaśvavat |
8,026.09 sumatibhirupa viprāvihā gatam ||
8,026.10  aśvinā svṛṣe stuhi kuvitte śravato havam |
8,026.10 nedīyasaḥ kūḻayātaḥ paṇīṃruta ||
8,026.11  vaiyaśvasya śrutaṃ naroto me asya vedathaḥ |
8,026.11 sajoṣasā varuṇo mitro aryamā ||
8,026.12  yuvādattasya dhiṣṇyā yuvānītasya sūribhiḥ |
8,026.12 aharaharvṛṣaṇa mahyaṃ śikṣatam ||
8,026.13  yo vāṃ yajñebhirāvṛto'dhivastrā vadhūriva |
8,026.13 saparyantā śubhe cakrāte aśvinā ||
8,026.14  yo vāmuruvyacastamaṃ ciketati nṛpāyyam |
8,026.14 vartiraśvinā pari yātamasmayū ||
8,026.15  asmabhyaṃ su vṛṣaṇvasū yātaṃ vartirnṛpāyyam |
8,026.15 viṣudruheva yajñamūhathurgirā ||
8,026.16  vāhiṣṭho vāṃ havānāṃ stomo dūto huvannarā |
8,026.16 yuvābhyāṃ bhūtvaśvinā ||
8,026.17  yadado divo arṇava iṣo vā madatho gṛhe |
8,026.17 śrutaminme amartyā ||
8,026.18  uta syā śvetayāvarī vāhiṣṭhā vāṃ nadīnām |
8,026.18 sindhurhiraṇyavartaniḥ ||
8,026.19  smadetayā sukīrtyāśvinā śvetayā dhiyā |
8,026.19 vahethe śubhrayāvānā ||
8,026.20  yukṣvā hi tvaṃ rathāsahā yuvasva poṣyā vaso |
8,026.20 ānno vāyo madhu pibāsmākaṃ savanā gahi ||
8,026.21  tava vāyavṛtaspate tvaṣṭurjāmātaradbhuta |
8,026.21 avāṃsyā vṛṇīmahe ||
8,026.22  tvaṣṭurjāmātaraṃ vayamīśānaṃ rāya īmahe |
8,026.22 sutāvanto vāyuṃ dyumnā janāsaḥ ||
8,026.23  vāyo yāhi śivā divo vahasvā su svaśvyam |
8,026.23 vahasva mahaḥ pṛthupakṣasā rathe ||
8,026.24  tvāṃ hi supsarastamaṃ nṛṣadaneṣu hūmahe |
8,026.24 grāvāṇaṃ nāśvapṛṣṭhaṃ maṃhanā ||
8,026.25  sa tvaṃ no deva manasā vāyo mandāno agriyaḥ |
8,026.25 kṛdhi vājāṃ apo dhiyaḥ ||

8,027.01  agnirukthe purohito grāvāṇo barhiradhvare |
8,027.01 ṛcā yāmi maruto brahmaṇaspatiṃ devāṃ avo vareṇyam ||
8,027.02  ā paśuṃ gāsi pṛthivīṃ vanaspatīnuṣāsā naktamoṣadhīḥ |
8,027.02 viśve ca no vasavo viśvavedaso dhīnāṃ bhūta prāvitāraḥ ||
8,027.03  pra sū na etvadhvaro'gnā deveṣu pūrvyaḥ |
8,027.03 ādityeṣu pra varuṇe dhṛtavrate marutsu viśvabhānuṣu ||
8,027.04  viśve hi ṣmā manave viśvavedaso bhuvanvṛdhe riśādasaḥ |
8,027.04 ariṣṭebhiḥ pāyubhirviśvavedaso yantā no'vṛkaṃ chardiḥ ||
8,027.05  ā no adya samanaso gantā viśve sajoṣasaḥ |
8,027.05 ṛcā girā maruto devyadite sadane pastye mahi ||
8,027.06  abhi priyā maruto yā vo aśvyā havyā mitra prayāthana |
8,027.06 ā barhirindro varuṇasturā nara ādityāsaḥ sadantu naḥ ||
8,027.07  vayaṃ vo vṛktabarhiṣo hitaprayasa ānuṣak |
8,027.07 sutasomāso varuṇa havāmahe manuṣvadiddhāgnayaḥ ||
8,027.08  ā pra yāta maruto viṣṇo aśvinā pūṣanmākīnayā dhiyā |
8,027.08 indra ā yātu prathamaḥ saniṣyubhirvṛṣā yo vṛtrahā gṛṇe ||
8,027.09  vi no devāso adruho'cchidraṃ śarma yacchata |
8,027.09 na yaddūrādvasavo nū cidantito varūthamādadharṣati ||
8,027.10  asti hi vaḥ sajātyaṃ riśādaso devāso astyāpyam |
8,027.10 pra ṇaḥ pūrvasmai suvitāya vocata makṣū sumnāya navyase ||
8,027.11  idā hi va upastutimidā vāmasya bhaktaye |
8,027.11 upa vo viśvavedaso namasyurāṃ asṛkṣyanyāmiva ||
8,027.12  udu ṣya vaḥ savitā supraṇītayo'sthādūrdhvo vareṇyaḥ |
8,027.12 ni dvipādaścatuṣpādo arthino'viśranpatayiṣṇavaḥ ||
8,027.13  devaṃdevaṃ vo'vase devaṃdevamabhiṣṭaye |
8,027.13 devaṃdevaṃ huvema vājasātaye gṛṇanto devyā dhiyā ||
8,027.14  devāso hi ṣmā manave samanyavo viśve sākaṃ sarātayaḥ |
8,027.14 te no adya te aparaṃ tuce tu no bhavantu varivovidaḥ ||
8,027.15  pra vaḥ śaṃsāmyadruhaḥ saṃstha upastutīnām |
8,027.15 na taṃ dhūrtirvaruṇa mitra martyaṃ yo vo dhāmabhyo'vidhat ||
8,027.16  pra sa kṣayaṃ tirate vi mahīriṣo yo vo varāya dāśati |
8,027.16 pra prajābhirjāyate dharmaṇasparyariṣṭaḥ sarva edhate ||
8,027.17  ṛte sa vindate yudhaḥ sugebhiryātyadhvanaḥ |
8,027.17 aryamā mitro varuṇaḥ sarātayo yaṃ trāyante sajoṣasaḥ ||
8,027.18  ajre cidasmai kṛṇuthā nyañcanaṃ durge cidā susaraṇam |
8,027.18 eṣā cidasmādaśaniḥ paro nu sāsredhantī vi naśyatu ||
8,027.19  yadadya sūrya udyati priyakṣatrā ṛtaṃ dadha |
8,027.19 yannimruci prabudhi viśvavedaso yadvā madhyandine divaḥ ||
8,027.20  yadvābhipitve asurā ṛtaṃ yate chardiryema vi dāśuṣe |
8,027.20 vayaṃ tadvo vasavo viśvavedasa upa stheyāma madhya ā ||
8,027.21  yadadya sūra udite yanmadhyandina ātuci |
8,027.21 vāmaṃ dhattha manave viśvavedaso juhvānāya pracetase ||
8,027.22  vayaṃ tadvaḥ samrāja ā vṛṇīmahe putro na bahupāyyam |
8,027.22 aśyāma tadādityā juhvato haviryena vasyo'naśāmahai ||

8,028.01  ye triṃśati trayasparo devāso barhirāsadan |
8,028.01 vidannaha dvitāsanan ||
8,028.02  varuṇo mitro aryamā smadrātiṣāco agnayaḥ |
8,028.02 patnīvanto vaṣaṭkṛtāḥ ||
8,028.03  te no gopā apācyāsta udakta itthā nyak |
8,028.03 purastātsarvayā viśā ||
8,028.04  yathā vaśanti devāstathedasattadeṣāṃ nakirā minat |
8,028.04 arāvā cana martyaḥ ||
8,028.05  saptānāṃ sapta ṛṣṭayaḥ sapta dyumnānyeṣām |
8,028.05 sapto adhi śriyo dhire ||

8,029.01  babhrureko viṣuṇaḥ sūnaro yuvāñjyaṅkte hiraṇyayam ||
8,029.02  yonimeka ā sasāda dyotano'ntardeveṣu medhiraḥ ||
8,029.03  vāśīmeko bibharti hasta āyasīmantardeveṣu nidhruviḥ ||
8,029.04  vajrameko bibharti hasta āhitaṃ tena vṛtrāṇi jighnate ||
8,029.05  tigmameko bibharti hasta āyudhaṃ śucirugro jalāṣabheṣajaḥ ||
8,029.06  patha ekaḥ pīpāya taskaro yathāṃ eṣa veda nidhīnām ||
8,029.07  trīṇyeka urugāyo vi cakrame yatra devāso madanti ||
8,029.08  vibhirdvā carata ekayā saha pra pravāseva vasataḥ ||
8,029.09  sado dvā cakrāte upamā divi samrājā sarpirāsutī ||
8,029.10  arcanta eke mahi sāma manvata tena sūryamarocayan ||

8,030.01  nahi vo astyarbhako devāso na kumārakaḥ |
8,030.01 viśve satomahānta it ||
8,030.02  iti stutāso asathā riśādaso ye stha trayaśca triṃśacca |
8,030.02 manordevā yajñiyāsaḥ ||
8,030.03  te nastrādhvaṃ te'vata ta u no adhi vocata |
8,030.03 mā naḥ pathaḥ pitryānmānavādadhi dūraṃ naiṣṭa parāvataḥ ||
8,030.04  ye devāsa iha sthana viśve vaiśvānarā uta |
8,030.04 asmabhyaṃ śarma sapratho gave'śvāya yacchata ||

8,031.01  yo yajāti yajāta itsunavacca pacāti ca |
8,031.01 brahmedindrasya cākanat ||
8,031.02  puroḻāśaṃ yo asmai somaṃ rarata āśiram |
8,031.02 pādittaṃ śakro aṃhasaḥ ||
8,031.03  tasya dyumāṃ asadratho devajūtaḥ sa śūśuvat |
8,031.03 viśvā vanvannamitriyā ||
8,031.04  asya prajāvatī gṛhe'saścantī divedive |
8,031.04 iḻā dhenumatī duhe ||
8,031.05  yā dampatī samanasā sunuta ā ca dhāvataḥ |
8,031.05 devāso nityayāśirā ||
8,031.06  prati prāśavyāṃ itaḥ samyañcā barhirāśāte |
8,031.06 na tā vājeṣu vāyataḥ ||
8,031.07  na devānāmapi hnutaḥ sumatiṃ na jugukṣataḥ |
8,031.07 śravo bṛhadvivāsataḥ ||
8,031.08  putriṇā tā kumāriṇā viśvamāyurvyaśnutaḥ |
8,031.08 ubhā hiraṇyapeśasā ||
8,031.09  vītihotrā kṛtadvasū daśasyantāmṛtāya kam |
8,031.09 samūdho romaśaṃ hato deveṣu kṛṇuto duvaḥ ||
8,031.10  ā śarma parvatānāṃ vṛṇīmahe nadīnām |
8,031.10 ā viṣṇoḥ sacābhuvaḥ ||
8,031.11  aitu pūṣā rayirbhagaḥ svasti sarvadhātamaḥ |
8,031.11 ururadhvā svastaye ||
8,031.12  aramatiranarvaṇo viśvo devasya manasā |
8,031.12 ādityānāmaneha it ||
8,031.13  yathā no mitro aryamā varuṇaḥ santi gopāḥ |
8,031.13 sugā ṛtasya panthāḥ ||
8,031.14  agniṃ vaḥ pūrvyaṃ girā devamīḻe vasūnām |
8,031.14 saparyantaḥ purupriyaṃ mitraṃ na kṣetrasādhasam ||
8,031.15  makṣū devavato rathaḥ śūro vā pṛtsu kāsu cit |
8,031.15 devānāṃ ya inmano yajamāna iyakṣatyabhīdayajvano bhuvat ||
8,031.16  na yajamāna riṣyasi na sunvāna na devayo |
8,031.16 devānāṃ ya inmano yajamāna iyakṣatyabhīdayajvano bhuvat ||
8,031.17  nakiṣṭaṃ karmaṇā naśanna pra yoṣanna yoṣati |
8,031.17 devānāṃ ya inmano yajamāna iyakṣatyabhīdayajvano bhuvat ||
8,031.18  asadatra suvīryamuta tyadāśvaśvyam |
8,031.18 devānāṃ ya inmano yajamāna iyakṣatyabhīdayajvano bhuvat ||

8,032.01  pra kṛtānyṛjīṣiṇaḥ kaṇvā indrasya gāthayā |
8,032.01 made somasya vocata ||
8,032.02  yaḥ sṛbindamanarśaniṃ pipruṃ dāsamahīśuvam |
8,032.02 vadhīdugro riṇannapaḥ ||
8,032.03  nyarbudasya viṣṭapaṃ varṣmāṇaṃ bṛhatastira |
8,032.03 kṛṣe tadindra pauṃsyam ||
8,032.04  prati śrutāya vo dhṛṣattūrṇāśaṃ na gireradhi |
8,032.04 huve suśipramūtaye ||
8,032.05  sa goraśvasya vi vrajaṃ mandānaḥ somyebhyaḥ |
8,032.05 puraṃ na śūra darṣasi ||
8,032.06  yadi me rāraṇaḥ suta ukthe vā dadhase canaḥ |
8,032.06 ārādupa svadhā gahi ||
8,032.07  vayaṃ ghā te api ṣmasi stotāra indra girvaṇaḥ |
8,032.07 tvaṃ no jinva somapāḥ ||
8,032.08  uta naḥ pitumā bhara saṃrarāṇo avikṣitam |
8,032.08 maghavanbhūri te vasu ||
8,032.09  uta no gomataskṛdhi hiraṇyavato aśvinaḥ |
8,032.09 iḻābhiḥ saṃ rabhemahi ||
8,032.10  bṛbadukthaṃ havāmahe sṛprakarasnamūtaye |
8,032.10 sādhu kṛṇvantamavase ||
8,032.11  yaḥ saṃsthe cicchatakraturādīṃ kṛṇoti vṛtrahā |
8,032.11 jaritṛbhyaḥ purūvasuḥ ||
8,032.12  sa naḥ śakraścidā śakaddānavāṃ antarābharaḥ |
8,032.12 indro viśvābhirūtibhiḥ ||
8,032.13  yo rāyo'vanirmahānsupāraḥ sunvataḥ sakhā |
8,032.13 tamindramabhi gāyata ||
8,032.14  āyantāraṃ mahi sthiraṃ pṛtanāsu śravojitam |
8,032.14 bhūrerīśānamojasā ||
8,032.15  nakirasya śacīnāṃ niyantā sūnṛtānām |
8,032.15 nakirvaktā na dāditi ||
8,032.16  na nūnaṃ brahmaṇāmṛṇaṃ prāśūnāmasti sunvatām |
8,032.16 na somo apratā pape ||
8,032.17  panya idupa gāyata panya ukthāni śaṃsata |
8,032.17 brahmā kṛṇota panya it ||
8,032.18  panya ā dardiracchatā sahasrā vājyavṛtaḥ |
8,032.18 indro yo yajvano vṛdhaḥ ||
8,032.19  vi ṣū cara svadhā anu kṛṣṭīnāmanvāhuvaḥ |
8,032.19 indra piba sutānām ||
8,032.20  piba svadhainavānāmuta yastugrye sacā |
8,032.20 utāyamindra yastava ||
8,032.21  atīhi manyuṣāviṇaṃ suṣuvāṃsamupāraṇe |
8,032.21 imaṃ rātaṃ sutaṃ piba ||
8,032.22  ihi tisraḥ parāvata ihi pañca janāṃ ati |
8,032.22 dhenā indrāvacākaśat ||
8,032.23  sūryo raśmiṃ yathā sṛjā tvā yacchantu me giraḥ |
8,032.23 nimnamāpo na sadhryak ||
8,032.24  adhvaryavā tu hi ṣiñca somaṃ vīrāya śipriṇe |
8,032.24 bharā sutasya pītaye ||
8,032.25  ya udnaḥ phaligaṃ bhinannyaksindhūṃravāsṛjat |
8,032.25 yo goṣu pakvaṃ dhārayat ||
8,032.26  ahanvṛtramṛcīṣama aurṇavābhamahīśuvam |
8,032.26 himenāvidhyadarbudam ||
8,032.27  pra va ugrāya niṣṭure'ṣāḻhāya prasakṣiṇe |
8,032.27 devattaṃ brahma gāyata ||
8,032.28  yo viśvānyabhi vratā somasya made andhasaḥ |
8,032.28 indro deveṣu cetati ||
8,032.29  iha tyā sadhamādyā harī hiraṇyakeśyā |
8,032.29 voḻhāmabhi prayo hitam ||
8,032.30  arvāñcaṃ tvā puruṣṭuta priyamedhastutā harī |
8,032.30 somapeyāya vakṣataḥ ||

8,033.01  vayaṃ gha tvā sutāvanta āpo na vṛktabarhiṣaḥ |
8,033.01 pavitrasya prasravaṇeṣu vṛtrahanpari stotāra āsate ||
8,033.02  svaranti tvā sute naro vaso nireka ukthinaḥ |
8,033.02 kadā sutaṃ tṛṣāṇa oka ā gama indra svabdīva vaṃsagaḥ ||
8,033.03  kaṇvebhirdhṛṣṇavā dhṛṣadvājaṃ darṣi sahasriṇam |
8,033.03 piśaṅgarūpaṃ maghavanvicarṣaṇe makṣū gomantamīmahe ||
8,033.04  pāhi gāyāndhaso mada indrāya medhyātithe |
8,033.04 yaḥ sammiślo haryoryaḥ sute sacā vajrī ratho hiraṇyayaḥ ||
8,033.05  yaḥ suṣavyaḥ sudakṣiṇa ino yaḥ sukraturgṛṇe |
8,033.05 ya ākaraḥ sahasrā yaḥ śatāmagha indro yaḥ pūrbhidāritaḥ ||
8,033.06  yo dhṛṣito yo'vṛto yo asti śmaśruṣu śritaḥ |
8,033.06 vibhūtadyumnaścyavanaḥ puruṣṭutaḥ kratvā gauriva śākinaḥ ||
8,033.07  ka īṃ veda sute sacā pibantaṃ kadvayo dadhe |
8,033.07 ayaṃ yaḥ puro vibhinattyojasā mandānaḥ śipryandhasaḥ ||
8,033.08  dānā mṛgo na vāraṇaḥ purutrā carathaṃ dadhe |
8,033.08 nakiṣṭvā ni yamadā sute gamo mahāṃścarasyojasā ||
8,033.09  ya ugraḥ sannaniṣṭṛta sthiro raṇāya saṃskṛtaḥ |
8,033.09 yadi stoturmaghavā śṛṇavaddhavaṃ nendro yoṣatyā gamat ||
8,033.10  satyamitthā vṛṣedasi vṛṣajūtirno'vṛtaḥ |
8,033.10 vṛṣā hyugra śṛṇviṣe parāvati vṛṣo arvāvati śrutaḥ ||
8,033.11  vṛṣaṇaste abhīśavo vṛṣā kaśā hiraṇyayī |
8,033.11 vṛṣā ratho maghavanvṛṣaṇā harī vṛṣā tvaṃ śatakrato ||
8,033.12  vṛṣā sotā sunotu te vṛṣannṛjīpinnā bhara |
8,033.12 vṛṣā dadhanve vṛṣaṇaṃ nadīṣvā tubhyaṃ sthātarharīṇām ||
8,033.13  endra yāhi pītaye madhu śaviṣṭha somyam |
8,033.13 nāyamacchā maghavā śṛṇavadgiro brahmokthā ca sukratuḥ ||
8,033.14  vahantu tvā ratheṣṭhāmā harayo rathayujaḥ |
8,033.14 tiraścidaryaṃ savanāni vṛtrahannanyeṣāṃ yā śatakrato ||
8,033.15  asmākamadyāntamaṃ stomaṃ dhiṣva mahāmaha |
8,033.15 asmākaṃ te savanā santu śantamā madāya dyukṣa somapāḥ ||
8,033.16  nahi ṣastava no mama śāstre anyasya raṇyati |
8,033.16 yo asmānvīra ānayat ||
8,033.17  indraścidghā tadabravītstriyā aśāsyaṃ manaḥ |
8,033.17 uto aha kratuṃ raghum ||
8,033.18  saptī cidghā madacyutā mithunā vahato ratham |
8,033.18 eveddhūrvṛṣṇa uttarā ||
8,033.19  adhaḥ paśyasva mopari saṃtarāṃ pādakau hara |
8,033.19 mā te kaśaplakau dṛśanstrī hi brahmā babhūvitha ||

8,034.01  endra yāhi haribhirupa kaṇvasya suṣṭutim |
8,034.01 divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso ||
8,034.02  ā tvā grāvā vadanniha somī ghoṣeṇa yacchatu |
8,034.02 divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso ||
8,034.03  atrā vi nemireṣāmurāṃ na dhūnute vṛkaḥ |
8,034.03 divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso ||
8,034.04  ā tvā kaṇvā ihāvase havante vājasātaye |
8,034.04 divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso ||
8,034.05  dadhāmi te sutānāṃ vṛṣṇe na pūrvapāyyam |
8,034.05 divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso ||
8,034.06  smatpurandhirna ā gahi viśvatodhīrna ūtaye |
8,034.06 divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso ||
8,034.07  ā no yāhi mahemate sahasrote śatāmagha |

8,034.10 divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso ||
8,034.11  ā no yāhyupaśrutyuktheṣu raṇayā iha |
8,034.11 divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso ||
8,034.12  sarūpairā su no gahi sambhṛtaiḥ sambhṛtāśvaḥ |
8,034.12 divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso ||
8,034.13  ā yāhi parvatebhyaḥ samudrasyādhi viṣṭapaḥ |
8,034.13 divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso ||
8,034.14  ā no gavyānyaśvyā sahasrā śūra dardṛhi |
8,034.14 divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso ||
8,034.15  ā naḥ sahasraśo bharāyutāni śatāni ca |

8,034.16  ā yadindraśca dadvahe sahasraṃ vasurociṣaḥ |
8,034.16 ojiṣṭhamaśvyaṃ paśum ||
8,034.17  ya ṛjrā vātaraṃhaso'ruṣāso raghuṣyadaḥ |
8,034.17 bhrājante sūryā iva ||
8,034.18  pārāvatasya rātiṣu dravaccakreṣvāśuṣu |
8,034.18 tiṣṭhaṃ vanasya madhya ā ||

8,035.01  agninendreṇa varuṇena viṣṇunādityai rudrairvasubhiḥ sacābhuvā |
8,035.01 sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa ca somaṃ pibatamaśvinā ||
8,035.02  viśvābhirdhībhirbhuvanena vājinā divā pṛthivyādribhiḥ sacābhuvā |
8,035.02 sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa ca somaṃ pibatamaśvinā ||
8,035.03  viśvairdevaistribhirekādaśairihādbhirmarudbhirbhṛgubhiḥ sacābhuvā |
8,035.03 sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa ca somaṃ pibatamaśvinā ||
8,035.04  juṣethāṃ yajñaṃ bodhataṃ havasya me viśveha devau savanāva gacchatam |
8,035.04 sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa ceṣaṃ no voḻhamaśvinā ||
8,035.05  stomaṃ juṣethāṃ yuvaśeva kanyanāṃ viśveha devau savanāva gacchatam |
8,035.05 sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa ceṣaṃ no voḻhamaśvinā ||
8,035.06  giro juṣethāmadhvaraṃ juṣethāṃ viśveha devau savanāva gacchatam |
8,035.06 sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa ceṣaṃ no voḻhamaśvinā ||
8,035.07  hāridraveva patatho vanedupa somaṃ sutaṃ mahiṣevāva gacchathaḥ |
8,035.07 sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa ca trirvartiryātamaśvinā ||
8,035.08  haṃsāviva patatho adhvagāviva somaṃ sutaṃ mahiṣevāva gacchathaḥ |
8,035.08 sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa ca trirvartiryātamaśvinā ||
8,035.09  śyenāviva patatho havyadātaye somaṃ sutaṃ mahiṣevāva gacchathaḥ |
8,035.09 sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa ca trirvartiryātamaśvinā ||
8,035.10  pibataṃ ca tṛpṇutaṃ cā ca gacchataṃ prajāṃ ca dhattaṃ draviṇaṃ ca dhattam |
8,035.10 sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa corjaṃ no dhattamaśvinā ||
8,035.11  jayataṃ ca pra stutaṃ ca pra cāvataṃ prajāṃ ca dhattaṃ draviṇaṃ ca dhattam |
8,035.11 sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa corjaṃ no dhattamaśvinā ||
8,035.12  hataṃ ca śatrūnyatataṃ ca mitriṇaḥ prajāṃ ca dhattaṃ draviṇaṃ ca dhattam |
8,035.12 sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa corjaṃ no dhattamaśvinā ||
8,035.13  mitrāvaruṇavantā uta dharmavantā marutvantā jariturgacchatho havam |
8,035.13 sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa cādityairyātamaśvinā ||
8,035.14  aṅgirasvantā uta viṣṇuvantā marutvantā jariturgacchatho havam |
8,035.14 sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa cādityairyātamaśvinā ||
8,035.15  ṛbhumantā vṛṣaṇā vājavantā marutvantā jariturgacchatho havam |
8,035.15 sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa cādityairyātamaśvinā ||
8,035.16  brahma jinvatamuta jinvataṃ dhiyo hataṃ rakṣāṃsi sedhatamamīvāḥ |
8,035.16 sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa ca somaṃ sunvato aśvinā ||
8,035.17  kṣatraṃ jinvatamuta jinvataṃ nṝnhataṃ rakṣāṃsi sedhatamamīvāḥ |
8,035.17 sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa ca somaṃ sunvato aśvinā ||
8,035.18  dhenūrjinvatamuta jinvataṃ viśo hataṃ rakṣāṃsi sedhatamamīvāḥ |
8,035.18 sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa ca somaṃ sunvato aśvinā ||
8,035.19  atreriva śṛṇutaṃ pūrvyastutiṃ śyāvāśvasya sunvato madacyutā |
8,035.19 sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa cāśvinā tiroahnyam ||
8,035.20  sargāṃ iva sṛjataṃ suṣṭutīrupa śyāvāśvasya sunvato madacyutā |
8,035.20 sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa cāśvinā tiroahnyam ||
8,035.21  raśmīṃriva yacchatamadhvarāṃ upa śyāvāśvasya sunvato madacyutā |
8,035.21 sajoṣasā uṣasā sūryeṇa cāśvinā tiroahnyam ||
8,035.22  arvāgrathaṃ ni yacchataṃ pibataṃ somyaṃ madhu |
8,035.22 ā yātamaśvinā gatamavasyurvāmahaṃ huve dhattaṃ ratnāni dāśuṣe ||
8,035.23  namovāke prasthite adhvare narā vivakṣaṇasya pītaye |
8,035.23 ā yātamaśvinā gatamavasyurvāmahaṃ huve dhattaṃ ratnāni dāśuṣe ||
8,035.24  svāhākṛtasya tṛmpataṃ sutasya devāvandhasaḥ |
8,035.24 ā yātamaśvinā gatamavasyurvāmahaṃ huve dhattaṃ ratnāni dāśuṣe ||

8,036.01  avitāsi sunvato vṛktabarhiṣaḥ pibā somaṃ madāya kaṃ śatakrato |
8,036.01 yaṃ te bhāgamadhārayanviśvāḥ sehānaḥ pṛtanā uru jrayaḥ samapsujinmarutvāṃ indra satpate ||
8,036.02  prāva stotāraṃ maghavannava tvāṃ pibā somaṃ madāya kaṃ śatakrato |
8,036.02 yaṃ te bhāgamadhārayanviśvāḥ sehānaḥ pṛtanā uru jrayaḥ samapsujinmarutvāṃ indra satpate ||
8,036.03  ūrjā devāṃ avasyojasā tvāṃ pibā somaṃ madāya kaṃ śatakrato |
8,036.03 yaṃ te bhāgamadhārayanviśvāḥ sehānaḥ pṛtanā uru jrayaḥ samapsujinmarutvāṃ indra satpate ||
8,036.04  janitā divo janitā pṛthivyāḥ pibā somaṃ madāya kaṃ śatakrato |
8,036.04 yaṃ te bhāgamadhārayanviśvāḥ sehānaḥ pṛtanā uru jrayaḥ samapsujinmarutvāṃ indra satpate ||
8,036.05  janitāśvānāṃ janitā gavāmasi pibā somaṃ madāya kaṃ śatakrato |
8,036.05 yaṃ te bhāgamadhārayanviśvāḥ sehānaḥ pṛtanā uru jrayaḥ samapsujinmarutvāṃ indra satpate ||
8,036.06  atrīṇāṃ stomamadrivo mahaskṛdhi pibā somaṃ madāya kaṃ śatakrato |
8,036.06 yaṃ te bhāgamadhārayanviśvāḥ sehānaḥ pṛtanā uru jrayaḥ samapsujinmarutvāṃ indra satpate ||
8,036.07  śyāvāśvasya sunvatastathā śṛṇu yathāśṛṇoratreḥ karmāṇi kṛṇvataḥ |
8,036.07 pra trasadasyumāvitha tvameka innṛṣāhya indra brahmāṇi vardhayan ||

8,037.01  predaṃ brahma vṛtratūryeṣvāvitha pra sunvataḥ śacīpata indra viśvābhirūtibhiḥ |
8,037.01 mādhyandinasya savanasya vṛtrahannanedya pibā somasya vajrivaḥ ||
8,037.02  sehāna ugra pṛtanā abhi druhaḥ śacīpata indra viśvābhirūtibhiḥ |
8,037.02 mādhyandinasya savanasya vṛtrahannanedya pibā somasya vajrivaḥ ||
8,037.03  ekarāḻ asya bhuvanasya rājasi śacīpata indra viśvābhirūtibhiḥ |
8,037.03 mādhyandinasya savanasya vṛtrahannanedya pibā somasya vajrivaḥ ||
8,037.04  sasthāvānā yavayasi tvameka icchacīpata indra viśvābhirūtibhiḥ |
8,037.04 mādhyandinasya savanasya vṛtrahannanedya pibā somasya vajrivaḥ ||
8,037.05  kṣemasya ca prayujaśca tvamīśiṣe śacīpata indra viśvābhirūtibhiḥ |
8,037.05 mādhyandinasya savanasya vṛtrahannanedya pibā somasya vajrivaḥ ||
8,037.06  kṣatrāya tvamavasi na tvamāvitha śacīpata indra viśvābhirūtibhiḥ |
8,037.06 mādhyandinasya savanasya vṛtrahannanedya pibā somasya vajrivaḥ ||
8,037.07  śyāvāśvasya rebhatastathā śṛṇu yathāśṛṇoratreḥ karmāṇi kṛṇvataḥ |
8,037.07 pra trasadasyumāvitha tvameka innṛṣāhya indra kṣatrāṇi vardhayan ||

8,038.01  yajñasya hi stha ṛtvijā sasnī vājeṣu karmasu |
8,038.01 indrāgnī tasya bodhatam ||
8,038.02  tośāsā rathayāvānā vṛtrahaṇāparājitā |
8,038.02 indrāgnī tasya bodhatam ||
8,038.03  idaṃ vāṃ madiraṃ madhvadhukṣannadribhirnaraḥ |
8,038.03 indrāgnī tasya bodhatam ||
8,038.04  juṣethāṃ yajñamiṣṭaye sutaṃ somaṃ sadhastutī |
8,038.04 indrāgnī ā gataṃ narā ||
8,038.05  imā juṣethāṃ savanā yebhirhavyānyūhathuḥ |
8,038.05 indrāgnī ā gataṃ narā ||
8,038.06  imāṃ gāyatravartaniṃ juṣethāṃ suṣṭutiṃ mama |
8,038.06 indrāgnī ā gataṃ narā ||
8,038.07  prātaryāvabhirā gataṃ devebhirjenyāvasū |
8,038.07 indrāgnī somapītaye ||
8,038.08  śyāvāśvasya sunvato'trīṇāṃ śṛṇutaṃ havam |
8,038.08 indrāgnī somapītaye ||
8,038.09  evā vāmahva ūtaye yathāhuvanta medhirāḥ |
8,038.09 indrāgnī somapītaye ||
8,038.10  āhaṃ sarasvatīvatorindrāgnyoravo vṛṇe |
8,038.10 yābhyāṃ gāyatramṛcyate ||

8,039.01  agnimastoṣyṛgmiyamagnimīḻā yajadhyai |
8,039.01 agnirdevāṃ anaktu na ubhe hi vidathe kavirantaścarati dūtyaṃ nabhantāmanyake same ||
8,039.02  nyagne navyasā vacastanūṣu śaṃsameṣām |
8,039.02 nyarātī rarāvṇāṃ viśvā aryo arātīrito yucchantvāmuro nabhantāmanyake same ||
8,039.03  agne manmāni tubhyaṃ kaṃ ghṛtaṃ na juhva āsani |
8,039.03 sa deveṣu pra cikiddhi tvaṃ hyasi pūrvyaḥ śivo dūto vivasvato nabhantāmanyake same ||
8,039.04  tattadagnirvayo dadhe yathāyathā kṛpaṇyati |
8,039.04 ūrjāhutirvasūnāṃ śaṃ ca yośca mayo dadhe viśvasyai devahūtyai nabhantāmanyake same ||
8,039.05  sa ciketa sahīyasāgniścitreṇa karmaṇā |
8,039.05 sa hotā śaśvatīnāṃ dakṣiṇābhirabhīvṛta inoti ca pratīvyaṃ nabhantāmanyake same ||
8,039.06  agnirjātā devānāmagnirveda martānāmapīcyam |
8,039.06 agniḥ sa draviṇodā agnirdvārā vyūrṇute svāhuto navīyasā nabhantāmanyake same ||
8,039.07  agnirdeveṣu saṃvasuḥ sa vikṣu yajñiyāsvā |
8,039.07 sa mudā kāvyā puru viśvaṃ bhūmeva puṣyati devo deveṣu yajñiyo nabhantāmanyake same ||
8,039.08  yo agniḥ saptamānuṣaḥ śrito viśveṣu sindhuṣu |
8,039.08 tamāganma tripastyaṃ mandhāturdasyuhantamamagniṃ yajñeṣu pūrvyaṃ nabhantāmanyake same ||
8,039.09  agnistrīṇi tridhātūnyā kṣeti vidathā kaviḥ |
8,039.09 sa trīṃrekādaśāṃ iha yakṣacca piprayacca no vipro dūtaḥ pariṣkṛto nabhantāmanyake same ||
8,039.10  tvaṃ no agna āyuṣu tvaṃ deveṣu pūrvya vasva eka irajyasi |
8,039.10 tvāmāpaḥ parisrutaḥ pari yanti svasetavo nabhantāmanyake same ||

8,040.01  indrāgnī yuvaṃ su naḥ sahantā dāsatho rayim |
8,040.01 yena dṛḻhā samatsvā vīḻu citsāhiṣīmahyagnirvaneva vāta innabhantāmanyake same ||
8,040.02  nahi vāṃ vavrayāmahe'thendramidyajāmahe śaviṣṭhaṃ nṛṇāṃ naram |
8,040.02 sa naḥ kadā cidarvatā gamadā vājasātaye gamadā medhasātaye nabhantāmanyake same ||
8,040.03  tā hi madhyaṃ bharāṇāmindrāgnī adhikṣitaḥ |
8,040.03 tā u kavitvanā kavī pṛcchyamānā sakhīyate saṃ dhītamaśnutaṃ narā nabhantāmanyake same ||
8,040.04  abhyarca nabhākavadindrāgnī yajasā girā |
8,040.04 yayorviśvamidaṃ jagadiyaṃ dyauḥ pṛthivī mahyupasthe bibhṛto vasu nabhantāmanyake same ||
8,040.05  pra brahmāṇi nabhākavadindrāgnibhyāmirajyata |
8,040.05 yā saptabudhnamarṇavaṃ jihmabāramaporṇuta indra īśāna ojasā nabhantāmanyake same ||
8,040.06  api vṛśca purāṇavadvratateriva guṣpitamojo dāsasya dambhaya |
8,040.06 vayaṃ tadasya sambhṛtaṃ vasvindreṇa vi bhajemahi nabhantāmanyake same ||
8,040.07  yadindrāgnī janā ime vihvayante tanā girā |
8,040.07 asmākebhirnṛbhirvayaṃ sāsahyāma pṛtanyato vanuyāma vanuṣyato nabhantāmanyake same ||
8,040.08  yā nu śvetāvavo diva uccarāta upa dyubhiḥ |
8,040.08 indrāgnyoranu vratamuhānā yanti sindhavo yānsīṃ bandhādamuñcatāṃ nabhantāmanyake same ||
8,040.09  pūrvīṣṭa indropamātayaḥ pūrvīruta praśastayaḥ sūno hinvasya harivaḥ |
8,040.09 vasvo vīrasyāpṛco yā nu sādhanta no dhiyo nabhantāmanyake same ||
8,040.10  taṃ śiśītā suvṛktibhistveṣaṃ satvānamṛgmiyam |
8,040.10 uto nu cidya ojasā śuṣṇasyāṇḍāni bhedati jeṣatsvarvatīrapo nabhantāmanyake same ||
8,040.11  taṃ śiśītā svadhvaraṃ satyaṃ satvānamṛtviyam |
8,040.11 uto nu cidya ohata āṇḍā śuṣṇasya bhedatyajaiḥ svarvatīrapo nabhantāmanyake same ||
8,040.12  evendrāgnibhyāṃ pitṛvannavīyo mandhātṛvadaṅgirasvadavāci |
8,040.12 tridhātunā śarmaṇā pātamasmānvayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām ||

8,041.01  asmā ū ṣu prabhūtaye varuṇāya marudbhyo'rcā viduṣṭarebhyaḥ |
8,041.01 yo dhītā mānuṣāṇāṃ paśvo gā iva rakṣati nabhantāmanyake same ||
8,041.02  tamū ṣu samanā girā pitṝṇāṃ ca manmabhiḥ |
8,041.02 nābhākasya praśastibhiryaḥ sindhūnāmupodaye saptasvasā sa madhyamo nabhantāmanyake same ||
8,041.03  sa kṣapaḥ pari ṣasvaje nyusro māyayā dadhe sa viśvaṃ pari darśataḥ |
8,041.03 tasya venīranu vratamuṣastisro avardhayannabhantāmanyake same ||
8,041.04  yaḥ kakubho nidhārayaḥ pṛthivyāmadhi darśataḥ |
8,041.04 sa mātā pūrvyaṃ padaṃ tadvaruṇasya saptyaṃ sa hi gopā iveryo nabhantāmanyake same ||
8,041.05  yo dhartā bhuvanānāṃ ya usrāṇāmapīcyā veda nāmāni guhyā |
8,041.05 sa kaviḥ kāvyā puru rūpaṃ dyauriva puṣyati nabhantāmanyake same ||
8,041.06  yasminviśvāni kāvyā cakre nābhiriva śritā |
8,041.06 tritaṃ jūtī saparyata vraje gāvo na saṃyuje yuje aśvāṃ ayukṣata nabhantāmanyake same ||
8,041.07  ya āsvatka āśaye viśvā jātānyeṣām |
8,041.07 pari dhāmāni marmṛśadvaruṇasya puro gaye viśve devā anu vrataṃ nabhantāmanyake same ||
8,041.08  sa samudro apīcyasturo dyāmiva rohati ni yadāsu yajurdadhe |
8,041.08 sa māyā arcinā padāstṛṇānnākamāruhannabhantāmanyake same ||
8,041.09  yasya śvetā vicakṣaṇā tisro bhūmīradhikṣitaḥ |
8,041.09 triruttarāṇi papraturvaruṇasya dhruvaṃ sadaḥ sa saptānāmirajyati nabhantāmanyake same ||
8,041.10  yaḥ śvetāṃ adhinirṇijaścakre kṛṣṇāṃ anu vratā |
8,041.10 sa dhāma pūrvyaṃ mame ya skambhena vi rodasī ajo na dyāmadhārayannabhantāmanyake same ||

8,042.01  astabhnāddyāmasuro viśvavedā amimīta varimāṇaṃ pṛthivyāḥ |
8,042.01 āsīdadviśvā bhuvanāni samrāḍviśvettāni varuṇasya vratāni ||
8,042.02  evā vandasva varuṇaṃ bṛhantaṃ namasyā dhīramamṛtasya gopām |
8,042.02 sa naḥ śarma trivarūthaṃ vi yaṃsatpātaṃ no dyāvāpṛthivī upasthe ||
8,042.03  imāṃ dhiyaṃ śikṣamāṇasya deva kratuṃ dakṣaṃ varuṇa saṃ śiśādhi |
8,042.03 yayāti viśvā duritā tarema sutarmāṇamadhi nāvaṃ ruhema ||
8,042.04  ā vāṃ grāvāṇo aśvinā dhībhirviprā acucyavuḥ |
8,042.04 nāsatyā somapītaye nabhantāmanyake same ||
8,042.05  yathā vāmatriraśvinā gīrbhirvipro ajohavīt |
8,042.05 nāsatyā somapītaye nabhantāmanyake same ||
8,042.06  evā vāmahva ūtaye yathāhuvanta medhirāḥ |
8,042.06 nāsatyā somapītaye nabhantāmanyake same ||

8,043.01  ime viprasya vedhaso'gnerastṛtayajvanaḥ |
8,043.01 gira stomāsa īrate ||
8,043.02  asmai te pratiharyate jātavedo vicarṣaṇe |
8,043.02 agne janāmi suṣṭutim ||
8,043.03  ārokā iva ghedaha tigmā agne tava tviṣaḥ |
8,043.03 dadbhirvanāni bapsati ||
8,043.04  harayo dhūmaketavo vātajūtā upa dyavi |
8,043.04 yatante vṛthagagnayaḥ ||
8,043.05  ete tye vṛthagagnaya iddhāsaḥ samadṛkṣata |
8,043.05 uṣasāmiva ketavaḥ ||
8,043.06  kṛṣṇā rajāṃsi patsutaḥ prayāṇe jātavedasaḥ |
8,043.06 agniryadrodhati kṣami ||
8,043.07  dhāsiṃ kṛṇvāna oṣadhīrbapsadagnirna vāyati |
8,043.07 punaryantaruṇīrapi ||
8,043.08  jihvābhiraha nannamadarciṣā jañjaṇābhavan |
8,043.08 agnirvaneṣu rocate ||
8,043.09  apsvagne sadhiṣṭava sauṣadhīranu rudhyase |
8,043.09 garbhe sañjāyase punaḥ ||
8,043.10  udagne tava tadghṛtādarcī rocata āhutam |
8,043.10 niṃsānaṃ juhvo mukhe ||
8,043.11  ukṣānnāya vaśānnāya somapṛṣṭhāya vedhase |
8,043.11 stomairvidhemāgnaye ||
8,043.12  uta tvā namasā vayaṃ hotarvareṇyakrato |
8,043.12 agne samidbhirīmahe ||
8,043.13  uta tvā bhṛguvacchuce manuṣvadagna āhuta |
8,043.13 aṅgirasvaddhavāmahe ||
8,043.14  tvaṃ hyagne agninā vipro vipreṇa sansatā |
8,043.14 sakhā sakhyā samidhyase ||
8,043.15  sa tvaṃ viprāya dāśuṣe rayiṃ dehi sahasriṇam |
8,043.15 agne vīravatīmiṣam ||
8,043.16  agne bhrātaḥ sahaskṛta rohidaśva śucivrata |
8,043.16 imaṃ stomaṃ juṣasva me ||
8,043.17  uta tvāgne mama stuto vāśrāya pratiharyate |
8,043.17 goṣṭhaṃ gāva ivāśata ||
8,043.18  tubhyaṃ tā aṅgirastama viśvāḥ sukṣitayaḥ pṛthak |
8,043.18 agne kāmāya yemire ||
8,043.19  agniṃ dhībhirmanīṣiṇo medhirāso vipaścitaḥ |
8,043.19 admasadyāya hinvire ||
8,043.20  taṃ tvāmajmeṣu vājinaṃ tanvānā agne adhvaram |
8,043.20 vahniṃ hotāramīḻate ||
8,043.21  purutrā hi sadṛṅṅasi viśo viśvā anu prabhuḥ |
8,043.21 samatsu tvā havāmahe ||
8,043.22  tamīḻiṣva ya āhuto'gnirvibhrājate ghṛtaiḥ |
8,043.22 imaṃ naḥ śṛṇavaddhavam ||
8,043.23  taṃ tvā vayaṃ havāmahe śṛṇvantaṃ jātavedasam |
8,043.23 agne ghnantamapa dviṣaḥ ||
8,043.24  viśāṃ rājānamadbhutamadhyakṣaṃ dharmaṇāmimam |
8,043.24 agnimīḻe sa u śravat ||
8,043.25  agniṃ viśvāyuvepasaṃ maryaṃ na vājinaṃ hitam |
8,043.25 saptiṃ na vājayāmasi ||
8,043.26  ghnanmṛdhrāṇyapa dviṣo dahanrakṣāṃsi viśvahā |
8,043.26 agne tigmena dīdihi ||
8,043.27  yaṃ tvā janāsa indhate manuṣvadaṅgirastama |
8,043.27 agne sa bodhi me vacaḥ ||
8,043.28  yadagne divijā asyapsujā vā sahaskṛta |
8,043.28 taṃ tvā gīrbhirhavāmahe ||
8,043.29  tubhyaṃ ghette janā ime viśvāḥ sukṣitayaḥ pṛthak |
8,043.29 dhāsiṃ hinvantyattave ||
8,043.30  te ghedagne svādhyo'hā viśvā nṛcakṣasaḥ |
8,043.30 tarantaḥ syāma durgahā ||
8,043.31  agniṃ mandraṃ purupriyaṃ śīraṃ pāvakaśociṣam |
8,043.31 hṛdbhirmandrebhirīmahe ||
8,043.32  sa tvamagne vibhāvasuḥ sṛjansūryo na raśmibhiḥ |
8,043.32 śardhantamāṃsi jighnase ||
8,043.33  tatte sahasva īmahe dātraṃ yannopadasyati |
8,043.33 tvadagne vāryaṃ vasu ||

8,044.01  samidhāgniṃ duvasyata ghṛtairbodhayatātithim |
8,044.01 āsminhavyā juhotana ||
8,044.02  agne stomaṃ juṣasva me vardhasvānena manmanā |
8,044.02 prati sūktāni harya naḥ ||
8,044.03  agniṃ dūtaṃ puro dadhe havyavāhamupa bruve |
8,044.03 devāṃ ā sādayādiha ||
8,044.04  utte bṛhanto arcayaḥ samidhānasya dīdivaḥ |
8,044.04 agne śukrāsa īrate ||
8,044.05  upa tvā juhvo mama ghṛtācīryantu haryata |
8,044.05 agne havyā juṣasva naḥ ||
8,044.06  mandraṃ hotāramṛtvijaṃ citrabhānuṃ vibhāvasum |
8,044.06 agnimīḻe sa u śravat ||
8,044.07  pratnaṃ hotāramīḍyaṃ juṣṭamagniṃ kavikratum |
8,044.07 adhvarāṇāmabhiśriyam ||
8,044.08  juṣāṇo aṅgirastamemā havyānyānuṣak |
8,044.08 agne yajñaṃ naya ṛtuthā ||
8,044.09  samidhāna u santya śukraśoca ihā vaha |
8,044.09 cikitvāndaivyaṃ janam ||
8,044.10  vipraṃ hotāramadruhaṃ dhūmaketuṃ vibhāvasum |
8,044.10 yajñānāṃ ketumīmahe ||
8,044.11  agne ni pāhi nastvaṃ prati ṣma deva rīṣataḥ |
8,044.11 bhindhi dveṣaḥ sahaskṛta ||
8,044.12  agniḥ pratnena manmanā śumbhānastanvaṃ svām |
8,044.12 kavirvipreṇa vāvṛdhe ||
8,044.13  ūrjo napātamā huve'gniṃ pāvakaśociṣam |
8,044.13 asminyajñe svadhvare ||
8,044.14  sa no mitramahastvamagne śukreṇa śociṣā |
8,044.14 devairā satsi barhiṣi ||
8,044.15  yo agniṃ tanvo dame devaṃ martaḥ saparyati |
8,044.15 tasmā iddīdayadvasu ||
8,044.16  agnirmūrdhā divaḥ kakutpatiḥ pṛthivyā ayam |
8,044.16 apāṃ retāṃsi jinvati ||
8,044.17  udagne śucayastava śukrā bhrājanta īrate |
8,044.17 tava jyotīṃṣyarcayaḥ ||
8,044.18  īśiṣe vāryasya hi dātrasyāgne svarpatiḥ |
8,044.18 stotā syāṃ tava śarmaṇi ||
8,044.19  tvāmagne manīṣiṇastvāṃ hinvanti cittibhiḥ |
8,044.19 tvāṃ vardhantu no giraḥ ||
8,044.20  adabdhasya svadhāvato dūtasya rebhataḥ sadā |
8,044.20 agneḥ sakhyaṃ vṛṇīmahe ||
8,044.21  agniḥ śucivratatamaḥ śucirvipraḥ śuciḥ kaviḥ |
8,044.21 śucī rocata āhutaḥ ||
8,044.22  uta tvā dhītayo mama giro vardhantu viśvahā |
8,044.22 agne sakhyasya bodhi naḥ ||
8,044.23  yadagne syāmahaṃ tvaṃ tvaṃ vā ghā syā aham |
8,044.23 syuṣṭe satyā ihāśiṣaḥ ||
8,044.24  vasurvasupatirhi kamasyagne vibhāvasuḥ |
8,044.24 syāma te sumatāvapi ||
8,044.25  agne dhṛtavratāya te samudrāyeva sindhavaḥ |
8,044.25 giro vāśrāsa īrate ||
8,044.26  yuvānaṃ viśpatiṃ kaviṃ viśvādaṃ puruvepasam |
8,044.26 agniṃ śumbhāmi manmabhiḥ ||
8,044.27  yajñānāṃ rathye vayaṃ tigmajambhāya vīḻave |
8,044.27 stomairiṣemāgnaye ||
8,044.28  ayamagne tve api jaritā bhūtu santya |
8,044.28 tasmai pāvaka mṛḻaya ||
8,044.29  dhīro hyasyadmasadvipro na jāgṛviḥ sadā |
8,044.29 agne dīdayasi dyavi ||
8,044.30  purāgne duritebhyaḥ purā mṛdhrebhyaḥ kave |
8,044.30 pra ṇa āyurvaso tira ||

8,045.01  ā ghā ye agnimindhate stṛṇanti barhirānuṣak |
8,045.01 yeṣāmindro yuvā sakhā ||
8,045.02  bṛhannididhma eṣāṃ bhūri śastaṃ pṛthuḥ svaruḥ |
8,045.02 yeṣāmindro yuvā sakhā ||
8,045.03  ayuddha idyudhā vṛtaṃ śūra ājati satvabhiḥ |
8,045.03 yeṣāmindro yuvā sakhā ||
8,045.04  ā bundaṃ vṛtrahā dade jātaḥ pṛcchadvi mātaram |
8,045.04 ka ugrāḥ ke ha śṛṇvire ||
8,045.05  prati tvā śavasī vadadgirāvapso na yodhiṣat |
8,045.05 yaste śatrutvamācake ||
8,045.06  uta tvaṃ maghavañchṛṇu yaste vaṣṭi vavakṣi tat |
8,045.06 yadvīḻayāsi vīḻu tat ||
8,045.07  yadājiṃ yātyājikṛdindraḥ svaśvayurupa |
8,045.07 rathītamo rathīnām ||
8,045.08  vi ṣu viśvā abhiyujo vajrinviṣvagyathā vṛha |
8,045.08 bhavā naḥ suśravastamaḥ ||
8,045.09  asmākaṃ su rathaṃ pura indraḥ kṛṇotu sātaye |
8,045.09 na yaṃ dhūrvanti dhūrtayaḥ ||
8,045.10  vṛjyāma te pari dviṣo'raṃ te śakra dāvane |
8,045.10 gamemedindra gomataḥ ||
8,045.11  śanaiścidyanto adrivo'śvāvantaḥ śatagvinaḥ |
8,045.11 vivakṣaṇā anehasaḥ ||
8,045.12  ūrdhvā hi te divedive sahasrā sūnṛtā śatā |
8,045.12 jaritṛbhyo vimaṃhate ||
8,045.13  vidmā hi tvā dhanañjayamindra dṛḻhā cidārujam |
8,045.13 ādāriṇaṃ yathā gayam ||
8,045.14  kakuhaṃ cittvā kave mandantu dhṛṣṇavindavaḥ |
8,045.14 ā tvā paṇiṃ yadīmahe ||
8,045.15  yaste revāṃ adāśuriḥ pramamarṣa maghattaye |
8,045.15 tasya no veda ā bhara ||
8,045.16  ima u tvā vi cakṣate sakhāya indra sominaḥ |
8,045.16 puṣṭāvanto yathā paśum ||
8,045.17  uta tvābadhiraṃ vayaṃ śrutkarṇaṃ santamūtaye |
8,045.17 dūrādiha havāmahe ||
8,045.18  yacchuśrūyā imaṃ havaṃ durmarṣaṃ cakriyā uta |
8,045.18 bhaverāpirno antamaḥ ||
8,045.19  yacciddhi te api vyathirjaganvāṃso amanmahi |
8,045.19 godā idindra bodhi naḥ ||
8,045.20  ā tvā rambhaṃ na jivrayo rarabhmā śavasaspate |
8,045.20 uśmasi tvā sadhastha ā ||
8,045.21  stotramindrāya gāyata purunṛmṇāya satvane |
8,045.21 nakiryaṃ vṛṇvate yudhi ||
8,045.22  abhi tvā vṛṣabhā sute sutaṃ sṛjāmi pītaye |
8,045.22 tṛmpā vyaśnuhī madam ||
8,045.23  mā tvā mūrā aviṣyavo mopahasvāna ā dabhan |
8,045.23 mākīṃ brahmadviṣo vanaḥ ||
8,045.24  iha tvā goparīṇasā mahe mandantu rādhase |
8,045.24 saro gauro yathā piba ||
8,045.25  yā vṛtrahā parāvati sanā navā ca cucyuve |
8,045.25 tā saṃsatsu pra vocata ||
8,045.26  apibatkadruvaḥ sutamindraḥ sahasrabāhve |
8,045.26 atrādediṣṭa pauṃsyam ||
8,045.27  satyaṃ tatturvaśe yadau vidāno ahnavāyyam |
8,045.27 vyānaṭturvaṇe śami ||
8,045.28  taraṇiṃ vo janānāṃ tradaṃ vājasya gomataḥ |
8,045.28 samānamu pra śaṃsiṣam ||
8,045.29  ṛbhukṣaṇaṃ na vartava uktheṣu tugryāvṛdham |
8,045.29 indraṃ some sacā sute ||
8,045.30  yaḥ kṛntadidvi yonyaṃ triśokāya giriṃ pṛthum |
8,045.30 gobhyo gātuṃ niretave ||
8,045.31  yaddadhiṣe manasyasi mandānaḥ prediyakṣasi |
8,045.31 mā tatkarindra mṛḻaya ||
8,045.32  dabhraṃ ciddhi tvāvataḥ kṛtaṃ śṛṇve adhi kṣami |
8,045.32 jigātvindra te manaḥ ||
8,045.33  tavedu tāḥ sukīrtayo'sannuta praśastayaḥ |
8,045.33 yadindra mṛḻayāsi naḥ ||
8,045.34  mā na ekasminnāgasi mā dvayoruta triṣu |
8,045.34 vadhīrmā śūra bhūriṣu ||
8,045.35  bibhayā hi tvāvata ugrādabhiprabhaṅgiṇaḥ |
8,045.35 dasmādahamṛtīṣahaḥ ||
8,045.36  mā sakhyuḥ śūnamā vide mā putrasya prabhūvaso |
8,045.36 āvṛtvadbhūtu te manaḥ ||
8,045.37  ko nu maryā amithitaḥ sakhā sakhāyamabravīt |
8,045.37 jahā ko asmadīṣate ||
8,045.38  evāre vṛṣabhā sute'sinvanbhūryāvayaḥ |
8,045.38 śvaghnīva nivatā caran ||
8,045.39  ā ta etā vacoyujā harī gṛbhṇe sumadrathā |
8,045.39 yadīṃ brahmabhya iddadaḥ ||
8,045.40  bhindhi viśvā apa dviṣaḥ pari bādho jahī mṛdhaḥ |
8,045.40 vasu spārhaṃ tadā bhara ||
8,045.41  yadvīḻāvindra yatsthire yatparśāne parābhṛtam |
8,045.41 vasu spārhaṃ tadā bhara ||
8,045.42  yasya te viśvamānuṣo bhūrerdattasya vedati |
8,045.42 vasu spārhaṃ tadā bhara ||

8,046.01  tvāvataḥ purūvaso vayamindra praṇetaḥ |
8,046.01 smasi sthātarharīṇām ||
8,046.02  tvāṃ hi satyamadrivo vidma dātāramiṣām |
8,046.02 vidma dātāraṃ rayīṇām ||
8,046.03  ā yasya te mahimānaṃ śatamūte śatakrato |
8,046.03 gīrbhirgṛṇanti kāravaḥ ||
8,046.04  sunītho ghā sa martyo yaṃ maruto yamaryamā |
8,046.04 mitraḥ pāntyadruhaḥ ||
8,046.05  dadhāno gomadaśvavatsuvīryamādityajūta edhate |
8,046.05 sadā rāyā puruspṛhā ||
8,046.06  tamindraṃ dānamīmahe śavasānamabhīrvam |
8,046.06 īśānaṃ rāya īmahe ||
8,046.07  tasminhi santyūtayo viśvā abhīravaḥ sacā |
8,046.07 tamā vahantu saptayaḥ purūvasuṃ madāya harayaḥ sutam ||
8,046.08  yaste mado vareṇyo ya indra vṛtrahantamaḥ |
8,046.08 ya ādadiḥ svarnṛbhiryaḥ pṛtanāsu duṣṭaraḥ ||
8,046.09  yo duṣṭaro viśvavāra śravāyyo vājeṣvasti tarutā |
8,046.09 sa naḥ śaviṣṭha savanā vaso gahi gamema gomati vraje ||
8,046.10  gavyo ṣu ṇo yathā purāśvayota rathayā |
8,046.10 varivasya mahāmaha ||
8,046.11  nahi te śūra rādhaso'ntaṃ vindāmi satrā |
8,046.11 daśasyā no maghavannū cidadrivo dhiyo vājebhirāvitha ||
8,046.12  ya ṛṣvaḥ śrāvayatsakhā viśvetsa veda janimā puruṣṭutaḥ |
8,046.12 taṃ viśve mānuṣā yugendraṃ havante taviṣaṃ yatasrucaḥ ||
8,046.13  sa no vājeṣvavitā purūvasuḥ purasthātā maghavā vṛtrahā bhuvat ||
8,046.14  abhi vo vīramandhaso madeṣu gāya girā mahā vicetasam |
8,046.14 indraṃ nāma śrutyaṃ śākinaṃ vaco yathā ||
8,046.15  dadī rekṇastanve dadirvasu dadirvājeṣu puruhūta vājinam |
8,046.15 nūnamatha ||
8,046.16  viśveṣāmirajyantaṃ vasūnāṃ sāsahvāṃsaṃ cidasya varpasaḥ |
8,046.16 kṛpayato nūnamatyatha ||
8,046.17  mahaḥ su vo aramiṣe stavāmahe mīḻhuṣe araṅgamāya jagmaye |
8,046.17 yajñebhirgīrbhirviśvamanuṣāṃ marutāmiyakṣasi gāye tvā namasā girā ||
8,046.18  ye pātayante ajmabhirgirīṇāṃ snubhireṣām |
8,046.18 yajñaṃ mahiṣvaṇīnāṃ sumnaṃ tuviṣvaṇīnāṃ prādhvare ||
8,046.19  prabhaṅgaṃ durmatīnāmindra śaviṣṭhā bhara |
8,046.19 rayimasmabhyaṃ yujyaṃ codayanmate jyeṣṭhaṃ codayanmate ||
8,046.20  sanitaḥ susanitarugra citra cetiṣṭha sūnṛta |
8,046.20 prāsahā samrāṭsahuriṃ sahantaṃ bhujyuṃ vājeṣu pūrvyam ||
8,046.21  ā sa etu ya īvadāṃ adevaḥ pūrtamādade |
8,046.21 yathā cidvaśo aśvyaḥ pṛthuśravasi kānīte'syā vyuṣyādade ||
8,046.22  ṣaṣṭiṃ sahasrāśvyasyāyutāsanamuṣṭrānāṃ viṃśatiṃ śatā |
8,046.22 daśa śyāvīnāṃ śatā daśa tryaruṣīṇāṃ daśa gavāṃ sahasrā ||
8,046.23  daśa śyāvā ṛdhadrayo vītavārāsa āśavaḥ |
8,046.23 mathrā nemiṃ ni vāvṛtuḥ ||
8,046.24  dānāsaḥ pṛthuśravasaḥ kānītasya surādhasaḥ |
8,046.24 rathaṃ hiraṇyayaṃ dadanmaṃhiṣṭhaḥ sūrirabhūdvarṣiṣṭhamakṛta śravaḥ ||
8,046.25  ā no vāyo mahe tane yāhi makhāya pājase |
8,046.25 vayaṃ hi te cakṛmā bhūri dāvane sadyaścinmahi dāvane ||
8,046.26  yo aśvebhirvahate vasta usrāstriḥ sapta saptatīnām |
8,046.26 ebhiḥ somebhiḥ somasudbhiḥ somapā dānāya śukrapūtapāḥ ||
8,046.27  yo ma imaṃ cidu tmanāmandaccitraṃ dāvane |
8,046.27 araṭve akṣe nahuṣe sukṛtvani sukṛttarāya sukratuḥ ||
8,046.28  ucathye vapuṣi yaḥ svarāḻ uta vāyo ghṛtasnāḥ |
8,046.28 aśveṣitaṃ rajeṣitaṃ śuneṣitaṃ prājma tadidaṃ nu tat ||
8,046.29  adha priyamiṣirāya ṣaṣṭiṃ sahasrāsanam |
8,046.29 aśvānāminna vṛṣṇām ||
8,046.30  gāvo na yūthamupa yanti vadhraya upa mā yanti vadhrayaḥ ||
8,046.31  adha yaccārathe gaṇe śatamuṣṭrāṃ acikradat |
8,046.31 adha śvitneṣu viṃśatiṃ śatā ||
8,046.32  śataṃ dāse balbūthe viprastarukṣa ā dade |
8,046.32 te te vāyavime janā madantīndragopā madanti devagopāḥ ||
8,046.33  adha syā yoṣaṇā mahī pratīcī vaśamaśvyam |
8,046.33 adhirukmā vi nīyate ||

8,047.01  mahi vo mahatāmavo varuṇa mitra dāśuṣe |
8,047.01 yamādityā abhi druho rakṣathā nemaghaṃ naśadanehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ ||
8,047.02  vidā devā aghānāmādityāso apākṛtim |
8,047.02 pakṣā vayo yathopari vyasme śarma yacchatānehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ ||
8,047.03  vyasme adhi śarma tatpakṣā vayo na yantana |
8,047.03 viśvāni viśvavedaso varūthyā manāmahe'nehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ ||
8,047.04  yasmā arāsata kṣayaṃ jīvātuṃ ca pracetasaḥ |
8,047.04 manorviśvasya ghedima ādityā rāya īśate'nehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ ||
8,047.05  pari ṇo vṛṇajannaghā durgāṇi rathyo yathā |
8,047.05 syāmedindrasya śarmaṇyādityānāmutāvasyanehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ ||
8,047.06  parihvṛtedanā jano yuṣmādattasya vāyati |
8,047.06 devā adabhramāśa vo yamādityā ahetanānehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ ||
8,047.07  na taṃ tigmaṃ cana tyajo na drāsadabhi taṃ guru |
8,047.07 yasmā u śarma sapratha ādityāso arādhvamanehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ ||
8,047.08  yuṣme devā api ṣmasi yudhyanta iva varmasu |
8,047.08 yūyaṃ maho na enaso yūyamarbhāduruṣyatānehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ ||
8,047.09  aditirna uruṣyatvaditiḥ śarma yacchatu |
8,047.09 mātā mitrasya revato'ryamṇo varuṇasya cānehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ ||
8,047.10  yaddevāḥ śarma śaraṇaṃ yadbhadraṃ yadanāturam |
8,047.10 tridhātu yadvarūthyaṃ tadasmāsu vi yantanānehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ ||
8,047.11  ādityā ava hi khyatādhi kūlādiva spaśaḥ |
8,047.11 sutīrthamarvato yathānu no neṣathā sugamanehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ ||
8,047.12  neha bhadraṃ rakṣasvine nāvayai nopayā uta |
8,047.12 gave ca bhadraṃ dhenave vīrāya ca śravasyate'nehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ ||
8,047.13  yadāviryadapīcyaṃ devāso asti duṣkṛtam |
8,047.13 trite tadviśvamāptya āre asmaddadhātanānehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ ||
8,047.14  yacca goṣu duṣṣvapnyaṃ yaccāsme duhitardivaḥ |
8,047.14 tritāya tadvibhāvaryāptyāya parā vahānehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ ||
8,047.15  niṣkaṃ vā ghā kṛṇavate srajaṃ vā duhitardivaḥ |
8,047.15 trite duṣṣvapnyaṃ sarvamāptye pari dadmasyanehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ ||
8,047.16  tadannāya tadapase taṃ bhāgamupaseduṣe |
8,047.16 tritāya ca dvitāya coṣo duṣṣvapnyaṃ vahānehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ ||
8,047.17  yathā kalāṃ yathā śaphaṃ yatha ṛṇaṃ saṃnayāmasi |
8,047.17 evā duṣṣvapnyaṃ sarvamāptye saṃ nayāmasyanehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ ||
8,047.18  ajaiṣmādyāsanāma cābhūmānāgaso vayam |
8,047.18 uṣo yasmādduṣṣvapnyādabhaiṣmāpa taducchatvanehaso va ūtayaḥ suūtayo va ūtayaḥ ||

8,048.01  svādorabhakṣi vayasaḥ sumedhāḥ svādhyo varivovittarasya |
8,048.01 viśve yaṃ devā uta martyāso madhu bruvanto abhi saṃcaranti ||
8,048.02  antaśca prāgā aditirbhavāsyavayātā haraso daivyasya |
8,048.02 indavindrasya sakhyaṃ juṣāṇaḥ śrauṣṭīva dhuramanu rāya ṛdhyāḥ ||
8,048.03  apāma somamamṛtā abhūmāganma jyotiravidāma devān |
8,048.03 kiṃ nūnamasmānkṛṇavadarātiḥ kimu dhūrtiramṛta martyasya ||
8,048.04  śaṃ no bhava hṛda ā pīta indo piteva soma sūnave suśevaḥ |
8,048.04 sakheva sakhya uruśaṃsa dhīraḥ pra ṇa āyurjīvase soma tārīḥ ||
8,048.05  ime mā pītā yaśasa uruṣyavo rathaṃ na gāvaḥ samanāha parvasu |
8,048.05 te mā rakṣantu visrasaścaritrāduta mā srāmādyavayantvindavaḥ ||
8,048.06  agniṃ na mā mathitaṃ saṃ didīpaḥ pra cakṣaya kṛṇuhi vasyaso naḥ |
8,048.06 athā hi te mada ā soma manye revāṃ iva pra carā puṣṭimaccha ||
8,048.07  iṣireṇa te manasā sutasya bhakṣīmahi pitryasyeva rāyaḥ |
8,048.07 soma rājanpra ṇa āyūṃṣi tārīrahānīva sūryo vāsarāṇi ||
8,048.08  soma rājanmṛḻayā naḥ svasti tava smasi vratyāstasya viddhi |
8,048.08 alarti dakṣa uta manyurindo mā no aryo anukāmaṃ parā dāḥ ||
8,048.09  tvaṃ hi nastanvaḥ soma gopā gātregātre niṣasatthā nṛcakṣāḥ |
8,048.09 yatte vayaṃ pramināma vratāni sa no mṛḻa suṣakhā deva vasyaḥ ||
8,048.10  ṛdūdareṇa sakhyā saceya yo mā na riṣyeddharyaśva pītaḥ |
8,048.10 ayaṃ yaḥ somo nyadhāyyasme tasmā indraṃ pratiramemyāyuḥ ||
8,048.11  apa tyā asthuranirā amīvā niratrasantamiṣīcīrabhaiṣuḥ |
8,048.11 ā somo asmāṃ aruhadvihāyā aganma yatra pratiranta āyuḥ ||
8,048.12  yo na induḥ pitaro hṛtsu pīto'martyo martyāṃ āviveśa |
8,048.12 tasmai somāya haviṣā vidhema mṛḻīke asya sumatau syāma ||
8,048.13  tvaṃ soma pitṛbhiḥ saṃvidāno'nu dyāvāpṛthivī ā tatantha |
8,048.13 tasmai ta indo haviṣā vidhema vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām ||
8,048.14  trātāro devā adhi vocatā no mā no nidrā īśata mota jalpiḥ |
8,048.14 vayaṃ somasya viśvaha priyāsaḥ suvīrāso vidathamā vadema ||
8,048.15  tvaṃ naḥ soma viśvato vayodhāstvaṃ svarvidā viśā nṛcakṣāḥ |
8,048.15 tvaṃ na inda ūtibhiḥ sajoṣāḥ pāhi paścātāduta vā purastāt ||

8,049.01  abhi pra vaḥ surādhasamindramarca yathā vide |
8,049.01 yo jaritṛbhyo maghavā purūvasuḥ sahasreṇeva śikṣati ||
8,049.02  śatānīkeva pra jigāti dhṛṣṇuyā hanti vṛtrāṇi dāśuṣe |
8,049.02 gireriva pra rasā asya pinvire datrāṇi purubhojasaḥ ||
8,049.03  ā tvā sutāsa indavo madā ya indra girvaṇaḥ |
8,049.03 āpo na vajrinnanvokyaṃ saraḥ pṛṇanti śūra rādhase ||
8,049.04  anehasaṃ prataraṇaṃ vivakṣaṇaṃ madhvaḥ svādiṣṭhamīṃ piba |
8,049.04 ā yathā mandasānaḥ kirāsi naḥ pra kṣudreva tmanā dhṛṣat ||
8,049.05  ā na stomamupa dravaddhiyāno aśvo na sotṛbhiḥ |
8,049.05 yaṃ te svadhāvansvadayanti dhenava indra kaṇveṣu rātayaḥ ||
8,049.06  ugraṃ na vīraṃ namasopa sedima vibhūtimakṣitāvasum |
8,049.06 udrīva vajrinnavato na siñcate kṣarantīndra dhītayaḥ ||
8,049.07  yaddha nūnaṃ yadvā yajñe yadvā pṛthivyāmadhi |
8,049.07 ato no yajñamāśubhirmahemata ugra ugrebhirā gahi ||
8,049.08  ajirāso harayo ye ta āśavo vātā iva prasakṣiṇaḥ |
8,049.08 yebhirapatyaṃ manuṣaḥ parīyase yebhirviśvaṃ svardṛśe ||
8,049.09  etāvatasta īmaha indra sumnasya gomataḥ |
8,049.09 yathā prāvo maghavanmedhyātithiṃ yathā nīpātithiṃ dhane ||
8,049.10  yathā kaṇve maghavantrasadasyavi yathā pakthe daśavraje |
8,049.10 yathā gośarye asanorṛjiśvanīndra gomaddhiraṇyavat ||

8,050.01  pra su śrutaṃ surādhasamarcā śakramabhiṣṭaye |
8,050.01 yaḥ sunvate stuvate kāmyaṃ vasu sahasreṇeva maṃhate ||
8,050.02  śatānīkā hetayo asya duṣṭarā indrasya samiṣo mahīḥ |
8,050.02 girirna bhujmā maghavatsu pinvate yadīṃ sutā amandiṣuḥ ||
8,050.03  yadīṃ sutāsa indavo'bhi priyamamandiṣuḥ |
8,050.03 āpo na dhāyi savanaṃ ma ā vaso dughā ivopa dāśuṣe ||
8,050.04  anehasaṃ vo havamānamūtaye madhvaḥ kṣaranti dhītayaḥ |
8,050.04 ā tvā vaso havamānāsa indava upa stotreṣu dadhire ||
8,050.05  ā naḥ some svadhvara iyāno atyo na tośate |
8,050.05 yaṃ te svadāvansvadanti gūrtayaḥ paure chandayase havam ||
8,050.06  pra vīramugraṃ viviciṃ dhanaspṛtaṃ vibhūtiṃ rādhaso mahaḥ |
8,050.06 udrīva vajrinnavato vasutvanā sadā pīpetha dāśuṣe ||
8,050.07  yaddha nūnaṃ parāvati yadvā pṛthivyāṃ divi |
8,050.07 yujāna indra haribhirmahemata ṛṣva ṛṣvebhirā gahi ||
8,050.08  rathirāso harayo ye te asridha ojo vātasya piprati |
8,050.08 yebhirni dasyuṃ manuṣo nighoṣayo yebhiḥ svaḥ parīyase ||
8,050.09  etāvataste vaso vidyāma śūra navyasaḥ |
8,050.09 yathā prāva etaśaṃ kṛtvye dhane yathā vaśaṃ daśavraje ||
8,050.10  yathā kaṇve maghavanmedhe adhvare dīrghanīthe damūnasi |
8,050.10 yathā gośarye asiṣāso adrivo mayi gotraṃ hariśriyam ||

8,051.01  yathā manau sāṃvaraṇau somamindrāpibaḥ sutam |
8,051.01 nīpātithau maghavanmedhyātithau puṣṭigau śruṣṭigau sacā ||
8,051.02  pārṣadvāṇaḥ praskaṇvaṃ samasādayacchayānaṃ jivrimuddhitam |
8,051.02 sahasrāṇyasiṣāsadgavāmṛṣistvoto dasyave vṛkaḥ ||
8,051.03  ya ukthebhirna vindhate cikidya ṛṣicodanaḥ |
8,051.03 indraṃ tamacchā vada navyasyā matyariṣyantaṃ na bhojase ||
8,051.04  yasmā arkaṃ saptaśīrṣāṇamānṛcustridhātumuttame pade |
8,051.04 sa tvimā viśvā bhuvanāni cikradadādijjaniṣṭa pauṃsyam ||
8,051.05  yo no dātā vasūnāmindraṃ taṃ hūmahe vayam |
8,051.05 vidmā hyasya sumatiṃ navīyasīṃ gamema gomati vraje ||
8,051.06  yasmai tvaṃ vaso dānāya śikṣasi sa rāyaspoṣamaśnute |
8,051.06 taṃ tvā vayaṃ maghavannindra girvaṇaḥ sutāvanto havāmahe ||
8,051.07  kadā cana starīrasi nendra saścasi dāśuṣe |
8,051.07 upopennu maghavanbhūya innu te dānaṃ devasya pṛcyate ||
8,051.08  pra yo nanakṣe abhyojasā kriviṃ vadhaiḥ śuṣṇaṃ nighoṣayan |
8,051.08 yadedastambhītprathayannamūṃ divamādijjaniṣṭa pārthivaḥ ||
8,051.09  yasyāyaṃ viśva āryo dāsaḥ śevadhipā ariḥ |
8,051.09 tiraścidarye ruśame parīravi tubhyetso ajyate rayiḥ ||
8,051.10  turaṇyavo madhumantaṃ ghṛtaścutaṃ viprāso arkamānṛcuḥ |
8,051.10 asme rayiḥ paprathe vṛṣṇyaṃ śavo'sme suvānāsa indavaḥ ||

8,052.01  yathā manau vivasvati somaṃ śakrāpibaḥ sutam |
8,052.01 yathā trite chanda indra jujoṣasyāyau mādayase sacā ||
8,052.02  pṛṣadhre medhye mātariśvanīndra suvāne amandathāḥ |
8,052.02 yathā somaṃ daśaśipre daśoṇye syūmaraśmāvṛjūnasi ||
8,052.03  ya ukthā kevalā dadhe yaḥ somaṃ dhṛṣitāpibat |
8,052.03 yasmai viṣṇustrīṇi padā vicakrama upa mitrasya dharmabhiḥ ||
