8,052.04  yasya tvamindra stomeṣu cākano vāje vājiñchatakrato |
8,052.04 taṃ tvā vayaṃ sudughāmiva goduho juhūmasi śravasyavaḥ ||
8,052.05  yo no dātā sa naḥ pitā mahāṃ ugra īśānakṛt |
8,052.05 ayāmannugro maghavā purūvasurgoraśvasya pra dātu naḥ ||
8,052.06  yasmai tvaṃ vaso dānāya maṃhase sa rāyaspoṣaminvati |
8,052.06 vasūyavo vasupatiṃ śatakratuṃ stomairindraṃ havāmahe ||
8,052.07  kadā cana pra yucchasyubhe ni pāsi janmanī |
8,052.07 turīyāditya havanaṃ ta indriyamā tasthāvamṛtaṃ divi ||
8,052.08  yasmai tvaṃ maghavannindra girvaṇaḥ śikṣo śikṣasi dāśuṣe |
8,052.08 asmākaṃ gira uta suṣṭutiṃ vaso kaṇvavacchṛṇudhī havam ||
8,052.09  astāvi manma pūrvyaṃ brahmendrāya vocata |
8,052.09 pūrvīrṛtasya bṛhatīranūṣata stoturmedhā asṛkṣata ||
8,052.10  samindro rāyo bṛhatīradhūnuta saṃ kṣoṇī samu sūryam |
8,052.10 saṃ śukrāsaḥ śucayaḥ saṃ gavāśiraḥ somā indramamandiṣuḥ ||

8,053.01  upamaṃ tvā maghonāṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ ca vṛṣabhāṇām |
8,053.01 pūrbhittamaṃ maghavannindra govidamīśānaṃ rāya īmahe ||
8,053.02  ya āyuṃ kutsamatithigvamardayo vāvṛdhāno divedive |
8,053.02 taṃ tvā vayaṃ haryaśvaṃ śatakratuṃ vājayanto havāmahe ||
8,053.03  ā no viśveṣāṃ rasaṃ madhvaḥ siñcantvadrayaḥ |
8,053.03 ye parāvati sunvire janeṣvā ye arvāvatīndavaḥ ||
8,053.04  viśvā dveṣāṃsi jahi cāva cā kṛdhi viśve sanvantvā vasu |
8,053.04 śīṣṭeṣu citte madirāso aṃśavo yatrā somasya tṛmpasi ||
8,053.05  indra nedīya edihi mitamedhābhirūtibhiḥ |
8,053.05 ā śantama śantamābhirabhiṣṭibhirā svāpe svāpibhiḥ ||
8,053.06  ājituraṃ satpatiṃ viśvacarṣaṇiṃ kṛdhi prajāsvābhagam |
8,053.06 pra sū tirā śacībhirye ta ukthinaḥ kratuṃ punata ānuṣak ||
8,053.07  yaste sādhiṣṭho'vase te syāma bhareṣu te |
8,053.07 vayaṃ hotrābhiruta devahūtibhiḥ sasavāṃso manāmahe ||
8,053.08  ahaṃ hi te harivo brahma vājayurājiṃ yāmi sadotibhiḥ |
8,053.08 tvāmideva tamame samaśvayurgavyuragre mathīnām ||

8,054.01  etatta indra vīryaṃ gīrbhirgṛṇanti kāravaḥ |
8,054.01 te stobhanta ūrjamāvanghṛtaścutaṃ paurāso nakṣandhītibhiḥ ||
8,054.02  nakṣanta indramavase sukṛtyayā yeṣāṃ suteṣu mandase |
8,054.02 yathā saṃvarte amado yathā kṛśa evāsme indra matsva ||
8,054.03  ā no viśve sajoṣaso devāso gantanopa naḥ |
8,054.03 vasavo rudrā avase na ā gamañchṛṇvantu maruto havam ||
8,054.04  pūṣā viṣṇurhavanaṃ me sarasvatyavantu sapta sindhavaḥ |
8,054.04 āpo vātaḥ parvatāso vanaspatiḥ śṛṇotu pṛthivī havam ||
8,054.05  yadindra rādho asti te māghonaṃ maghavattama |
8,054.05 tena no bodhi sadhamādyo vṛdhe bhago dānāya vṛtrahan ||
8,054.06  ājipate nṛpate tvamiddhi no vāja ā vakṣi sukrato |
8,054.06 vītī hotrābhiruta devavītibhiḥ sasavāṃso vi śṛṇvire ||
8,054.07  santi hyarya āśiṣa indra āyurjanānām |
8,054.07 asmānnakṣasva maghavannupāvase dhukṣasva pipyuṣīmiṣam ||
8,054.08  vayaṃ ta indra stomebhirvidhema tvamasmākaṃ śatakrato |
8,054.08 mahi sthūraṃ śaśayaṃ rādho ahrayaṃ praskaṇvāya ni tośaya ||

8,055.01  bhūrīdindrasya vīryaṃ vyakhyamabhyāyati |
8,055.01 rādhaste dasyave vṛka ||
8,055.02  śataṃ śvetāsa ukṣaṇo divi tāro na rocante |
8,055.02 mahnā divaṃ na tastabhuḥ ||
8,055.03  śataṃ veṇūñchataṃ śunaḥ śataṃ carmāṇi mlātāni |
8,055.03 śataṃ me balbajastukā aruṣīṇāṃ catuḥśatam ||
8,055.04  sudevā stha kāṇvāyanā vayovayo vicarantaḥ |
8,055.04 aśvāso na caṅkramata ||
8,055.05  āditsāptasya carkirannānūnasya mahi śravaḥ |
8,055.05 śyāvīratidhvasanpathaścakṣuṣā cana saṃnaśe ||

8,056.01  prati te dasyave vṛka rādho adarśyahrayam |
8,056.01 dyaurna prathinā śavaḥ ||
8,056.02  daśa mahyaṃ pautakrataḥ sahasrā dasyave vṛkaḥ |
8,056.02 nityādrāyo amaṃhata ||
8,056.03  śataṃ me gardabhānāṃ śatamūrṇāvatīnām |
8,056.03 śataṃ dāsāṃ ati srajaḥ ||
8,056.04  tatro api prāṇīyata pūtakratāyai vyaktā |
8,056.04 aśvānāminna yūthyām ||
8,056.05  acetyagniścikiturhavyavāṭsa sumadrathaḥ |
8,056.05 agniḥ śukreṇa śociṣā bṛhatsūro arocata divi sūryo arocata ||
8,057.01  yuvaṃ devā kratunā pūrvyeṇa yuktā rathena taviṣaṃ yajatrā |
8,057.01 āgacchataṃ nāsatyā śacībhiridaṃ tṛtīyaṃ savanaṃ pibāthaḥ ||
8,057.02  yuvāṃ devāstraya ekādaśāsaḥ satyāḥ satyasya dadṛśe purastāt |
8,057.02 asmākaṃ yajñaṃ savanaṃ juṣāṇā pātaṃ somamaśvinā dīdyagnī ||
8,057.03  panāyyaṃ tadaśvinā kṛtaṃ vāṃ vṛṣabho divo rajasaḥ pṛthivyāḥ |
8,057.03 sahasraṃ śaṃsā uta ye gaviṣṭau sarvāṃ ittāṃ upa yātā pibadhyai ||
8,057.04  ayaṃ vāṃ bhāgo nihito yajatremā giro nāsatyopa yātam |
8,057.04 pibataṃ somaṃ madhumantamasme pra dāśvāṃsamavataṃ śacībhiḥ ||

8,058.01  yamṛtvijo bahudhā kalpayantaḥ sacetaso yajñamimaṃ vahanti |
8,058.01 yo anūcāno brāhmaṇo yukta āsītkā svittatra yajamānasya saṃvit ||
8,058.02  eka evāgnirbahudhā samiddha ekaḥ sūryo viśvamanu prabhūtaḥ |
8,058.02 ekaivoṣāḥ sarvamidaṃ vi bhātyekaṃ vā idaṃ vi babhūva sarvam ||
8,058.03  jyotiṣmantaṃ ketumantaṃ tricakraṃ sukhaṃ rathaṃ suṣadaṃ bhūrivāram |
8,058.03 citrāmaghā yasya yoge'dhijajñe taṃ vāṃ huve ati riktaṃ pibadhyai ||

8,059.01  imāni vāṃ bhāgadheyāni sisrata indrāvaruṇā pra mahe suteṣu vām |
8,059.01 yajñeyajñe ha savanā bhuraṇyatho yatsunvate yajamānāya śikṣathaḥ ||
8,059.02  niṣṣidhvarīroṣadhīrāpa āstāmindrāvaruṇā mahimānamāśata |
8,059.02 yā sisratū rajasaḥ pāre adhvano yayoḥ śatrurnakirādeva ohate ||
8,059.03  satyaṃ tadindrāvaruṇā kṛśasya vāṃ madhva ūrmiṃ duhate sapta vāṇīḥ |
8,059.03 tābhirdāśvāṃsamavataṃ śubhaspatī yo vāmadabdho abhi pāti cittibhiḥ ||
8,059.04  ghṛtapruṣaḥ saumyā jīradānavaḥ sapta svasāraḥ sadana ṛtasya |
8,059.04 yā ha vāmindrāvaruṇā ghṛtaścutastābhirdhattaṃ yajamānāya śikṣatam ||
8,059.05  avocāma mahate saubhagāya satyaṃ tveṣābhyāṃ mahimānamindriyam |
8,059.05 asmānsvindrāvaruṇā ghṛtaścutastribhiḥ sāptebhiravataṃ śubhaspatī ||
8,059.06  indrāvaruṇā yadṛṣibhyo manīṣāṃ vāco matiṃ śrutamadattamagre |
8,059.06 yāni sthānānyasṛjanta dhīrā yajñaṃ tanvānāstapasābhyapaśyam ||
8,059.07  indrāvaruṇā saumanasamadṛptaṃ rāyaspoṣaṃ yajamāneṣu dhattam |
8,059.07 prajāṃ puṣṭiṃ bhūtimasmāsu dhattaṃ dīrghāyutvāya pra tirataṃ na āyuḥ ||

8,060.01  agna ā yāhyagnibhirhotāraṃ tvā vṛṇīmahe |
8,060.01 ā tvāmanaktu prayatā haviṣmatī yajiṣṭhaṃ barhirāsade ||
8,060.02  acchā hi tvā sahasaḥ sūno aṅgiraḥ srucaścarantyadhvare |
8,060.02 ūrjo napātaṃ ghṛtakeśamīmahe'gniṃ yajñeṣu pūrvyam ||
8,060.03  agne kavirvedhā asi hotā pāvaka yakṣyaḥ |
8,060.03 mandro yajiṣṭho adhvareṣvīḍyo viprebhiḥ śukra manmabhiḥ ||
8,060.04  adroghamā vahośato yaviṣṭhya devāṃ ajasra vītaye |
8,060.04 abhi prayāṃsi sudhitā vaso gahi mandasva dhītibhirhitaḥ ||
8,060.05  tvamitsaprathā asyagne trātarṛtaskaviḥ |
8,060.05 tvāṃ viprāsaḥ samidhāna dīdiva ā vivāsanti vedhasaḥ ||
8,060.06  śocā śociṣṭha dīdihi viśe mayo rāsva stotre mahāṃ asi |
8,060.06 devānāṃ śarmanmama santu sūrayaḥ śatrūṣāhaḥ svagnayaḥ ||
8,060.07  yathā cidvṛddhamatasamagne saṃjūrvasi kṣami |
8,060.07 evā daha mitramaho yo asmadhrugdurmanmā kaśca venati ||
8,060.08  mā no martāya ripave rakṣasvine māghaśaṃsāya rīradhaḥ |
8,060.08 asredhadbhistaraṇibhiryaviṣṭhya śivebhiḥ pāhi pāyubhiḥ ||
8,060.09  pāhi no agna ekayā pāhyuta dvitīyayā |
8,060.09 pāhi gīrbhistisṛbhirūrjāṃ pate pāhi catasṛbhirvaso ||
8,060.10  pāhi viśvasmādrakṣaso arāvṇaḥ pra sma vājeṣu no'va |
8,060.10 tvāmiddhi nediṣṭhaṃ devatātaya āpiṃ nakṣāmahe vṛdhe ||
8,060.11  ā no agne vayovṛdhaṃ rayiṃ pāvaka śaṃsyam |
8,060.11 rāsvā ca na upamāte puruspṛhaṃ sunītī svayaśastaram ||
8,060.12  yena vaṃsāma pṛtanāsu śardhatastaranto arya ādiśaḥ |
8,060.12 sa tvaṃ no vardha prayasā śacīvaso jinvā dhiyo vasuvidaḥ ||
8,060.13  śiśāno vṛṣabho yathāgniḥ śṛṅge davidhvat |
8,060.13 tigmā asya hanavo na pratidhṛṣe sujambhaḥ sahaso yahuḥ ||
8,060.14  nahi te agne vṛṣabha pratidhṛṣe jambhāso yadvitiṣṭhase |
8,060.14 sa tvaṃ no hotaḥ suhutaṃ haviṣkṛdhi vaṃsvā no vāryā puru ||
8,060.15  śeṣe vaneṣu mātroḥ saṃ tvā martāsa indhate |
8,060.15 atandro havyā vahasi haviṣkṛta ādiddeveṣu rājasi ||
8,060.16  sapta hotārastamidīḻate tvāgne sutyajamahrayam |
8,060.16 bhinatsyadriṃ tapasā vi śociṣā prāgne tiṣṭha janāṃ ati ||
8,060.17  agnimagniṃ vo adhriguṃ huvema vṛktabarhiṣaḥ |
8,060.17 agniṃ hitaprayasaḥ śaśvatīṣvā hotāraṃ carṣaṇīnām ||
8,060.18  ketena śarmansacate suṣāmaṇyagne tubhyaṃ cikitvanā |
8,060.18 iṣaṇyayā naḥ pururūpamā bhara vājaṃ nediṣṭhamūtaye ||
8,060.19  agne jaritarviśpatistepāno deva rakṣasaḥ |
8,060.19 aproṣivāngṛhapatirmahāṃ asi divaspāyurduroṇayuḥ ||
8,060.20  mā no rakṣa ā veśīdāghṛṇīvaso mā yāturyātumāvatām |
8,060.20 parogavyūtyanirāmapa kṣudhamagne sedha rakṣasvinaḥ ||

8,061.01  ubhayaṃ śṛṇavacca na indro arvāgidaṃ vacaḥ |
8,061.01 satrācyā maghavā somapītaye dhiyā śaviṣṭha ā gamat ||
8,061.02  taṃ hi svarājaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ tamojase dhiṣaṇe niṣṭatakṣatuḥ |
8,061.02 utopamānāṃ prathamo ni ṣīdasi somakāmaṃ hi te manaḥ ||
8,061.03  ā vṛṣasva purūvaso sutasyendrāndhasaḥ |
8,061.03 vidmā hi tvā harivaḥ pṛtsu sāsahimadhṛṣṭaṃ ciddadhṛṣvaṇim ||
8,061.04  aprāmisatya maghavantathedasadindra kratvā yathā vaśaḥ |
8,061.04 sanema vājaṃ tava śiprinnavasā makṣū cidyanto adrivaḥ ||
8,061.05  śagdhyū ṣu śacīpata indra viśvābhirūtibhiḥ |
8,061.05 bhagaṃ na hi tvā yaśasaṃ vasuvidamanu śūra carāmasi ||
8,061.06  pauro aśvasya purukṛdgavāmasyutso deva hiraṇyayaḥ |
8,061.06 nakirhi dānaṃ parimardhiṣattve yadyadyāmi tadā bhara ||
8,061.07  tvaṃ hyehi cerave vidā bhagaṃ vasuttaye |
8,061.07 udvāvṛṣasva maghavangaviṣṭaya udindrāśvamiṣṭaye ||
8,061.08  tvaṃ purū sahasrāṇi śatāni ca yūthā dānāya maṃhase |
8,061.08 ā purandaraṃ cakṛma vipravacasa indraṃ gāyanto'vase ||
8,061.09  avipro vā yadavidhadvipro vendra te vacaḥ |
8,061.09 sa pra mamandattvāyā śatakrato prācāmanyo ahaṃsana ||
8,061.10  ugrabāhurmrakṣakṛtvā purandaro yadi me śṛṇavaddhavam |
8,061.10 vasūyavo vasupatiṃ śatakratuṃ stomairindraṃ havāmahe ||
8,061.11  na pāpāso manāmahe nārāyāso na jaḻhavaḥ |
8,061.11 yadinnvindraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ sacā sute sakhāyaṃ kṛṇavāmahai ||
8,061.12  ugraṃ yuyujma pṛtanāsu sāsahimṛṇakātimadābhyam |
8,061.12 vedā bhṛmaṃ citsanitā rathītamo vājinaṃ yamidū naśat ||
8,061.13  yata indra bhayāmahe tato no abhayaṃ kṛdhi |
8,061.13 maghavañchagdhi tava tanna ūtibhirvi dviṣo vi mṛdho jahi ||
8,061.14  tvaṃ hi rādhaspate rādhaso mahaḥ kṣayasyāsi vidhataḥ |
8,061.14 taṃ tvā vayaṃ maghavannindra girvaṇaḥ sutāvanto havāmahe ||
8,061.15  indra spaḻ uta vṛtrahā paraspā no vareṇyaḥ |
8,061.15 sa no rakṣiṣaccaramaṃ sa madhyamaṃ sa paścātpātu naḥ puraḥ ||
8,061.16  tvaṃ naḥ paścādadharāduttarātpura indra ni pāhi viśvataḥ |
8,061.16 āre asmatkṛṇuhi daivyaṃ bhayamāre hetīradevīḥ ||
8,061.17  adyādyā śvaḥśva indra trāsva pare ca naḥ |
8,061.17 viśvā ca no jaritṝnsatpate ahā divā naktaṃ ca rakṣiṣaḥ ||
8,061.18  prabhaṅgī śūro maghavā tuvīmaghaḥ sammiślo viryāya kam |
8,061.18 ubhā te bāhū vṛṣaṇā śatakrato ni yā vajraṃ mimikṣatuḥ ||

8,062.01  pro asmā upastutiṃ bharatā yajjujoṣati |
8,062.01 ukthairindrasya māhinaṃ vayo vardhanti somino bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ ||
8,062.02  ayujo asamo nṛbhirekaḥ kṛṣṭīrayāsyaḥ |
8,062.02 pūrvīrati pra vāvṛdhe viśvā jātānyojasā bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ ||
8,062.03  ahitena cidarvatā jīradānuḥ siṣāsati |
8,062.03 pravācyamindra tattava vīryāṇi kariṣyato bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ ||
8,062.04  ā yāhi kṛṇavāma ta indra brahmāṇi vardhanā |
8,062.04 yebhiḥ śaviṣṭha cākano bhadramiha śravasyate bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ ||
8,062.05  dhṛṣataściddhṛṣanmanaḥ kṛṇoṣīndra yattvam |
8,062.05 tīvraiḥ somaiḥ saparyato namobhiḥ pratibhūṣato bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ ||
8,062.06  ava caṣṭa ṛcīṣamo'vatāṃ iva mānuṣaḥ |
8,062.06 juṣṭvī dakṣasya sominaḥ sakhāyaṃ kṛṇute yujaṃ bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ ||
8,062.07  viśve ta indra vīryaṃ devā anu kratuṃ daduḥ |
8,062.07 bhuvo viśvasya gopatiḥ puruṣṭuta bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ ||
8,062.08  gṛṇe tadindra te śava upamaṃ devatātaye |
8,062.08 yaddhaṃsi vṛtramojasā śacīpate bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ ||
8,062.09  samaneva vapuṣyataḥ kṛṇavanmānuṣā yugā |
8,062.09 vide tadindraścetanamadha śruto bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ ||
8,062.10  ujjātamindra te śava uttvāmuttava kratum |
8,062.10 bhūrigo bhūri vāvṛdhurmaghavantava śarmaṇi bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ ||
8,062.11  ahaṃ ca tvaṃ ca vṛtrahansaṃ yujyāva sanibhya ā |
8,062.11 arātīvā cidadrivo'nu nau śūra maṃsate bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ ||
8,062.12  satyamidvā u taṃ vayamindraṃ stavāma nānṛtam |
8,062.12 mahāṃ asunvato vadho bhūri jyotīṃṣi sunvato bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ ||

8,063.01  sa pūrvyo mahānāṃ venaḥ kratubhirānaje |
8,063.01 yasya dvārā manuṣpitā deveṣu dhiya ānaje ||
8,063.02  divo mānaṃ notsadansomapṛṣṭhāso adrayaḥ |
8,063.02 ukthā brahma ca śaṃsyā ||
8,063.03  sa vidvāṃ aṅgirobhya indro gā avṛṇodapa |
8,063.03 stuṣe tadasya pauṃsyam ||
8,063.04  sa pratnathā kavivṛdha indro vākasya vakṣaṇiḥ |
8,063.04 śivo arkasya homanyasmatrā gantvavase ||
8,063.05  ādū nu te anu kratuṃ svāhā varasya yajyavaḥ |
8,063.05 śvātramarkā anūṣatendra gotrasya dāvane ||
8,063.06  indre viśvāni vīryā kṛtāni kartvāni ca |
8,063.06 yamarkā adhvaraṃ viduḥ ||
8,063.07  yatpāñcajanyayā viśendre ghoṣā asṛkṣata |
8,063.07 astṛṇādbarhaṇā vipo'ryo mānasya sa kṣayaḥ ||
8,063.08  iyamu te anuṣṭutiścakṛṣe tāni pauṃsyā |
8,063.08 prāvaścakrasya vartanim ||
8,063.09  asya vṛṣṇo vyodana uru kramiṣṭa jīvase |
8,063.09 yavaṃ na paśva ā dade ||
8,063.10  taddadhānā avasyavo yuṣmābhirdakṣapitaraḥ |
8,063.10 syāma marutvato vṛdhe ||
8,063.11  baḻ ṛtviyāya dhāmna ṛkvabhiḥ śūra nonumaḥ |
8,063.11 jeṣāmendra tvayā yujā ||
8,063.12  asme rudrā mehanā parvatāso vṛtrahatye bharahūtau sajoṣāḥ |
8,063.12 yaḥ śaṃsate stuvate dhāyi pajra indrajyeṣṭhā asmāṃ avantu devāḥ ||

8,064.01  uttvā mandantu stomāḥ kṛṇuṣva rādho adrivaḥ |
8,064.01 ava brahmadviṣo jahi ||
8,064.02  padā paṇīṃrarādhaso ni bādhasva mahāṃ asi |
8,064.02 nahi tvā kaścana prati ||
8,064.03  tvamīśiṣe sutānāmindra tvamasutānām |
8,064.03 tvaṃ rājā janānām ||
8,064.04  ehi prehi kṣayo divyāghoṣañcarṣaṇīnām |
8,064.04 obhe pṛṇāsi rodasī ||
8,064.05  tyaṃ citparvataṃ giriṃ śatavantaṃ sahasriṇam |
8,064.05 vi stotṛbhyo rurojitha ||
8,064.06  vayamu tvā divā sute vayaṃ naktaṃ havāmahe |
8,064.06 asmākaṃ kāmamā pṛṇa ||
8,064.07  kva sya vṛṣabho yuvā tuvigrīvo anānataḥ |
8,064.07 brahmā kastaṃ saparyati ||
8,064.08  kasya svitsavanaṃ vṛṣā jujuṣvāṃ ava gacchati |
8,064.08 indraṃ ka u svidā cake ||
8,064.09  kaṃ te dānā asakṣata vṛtrahankaṃ suvīryā |
8,064.09 ukthe ka u svidantamaḥ ||
8,064.10  ayaṃ te mānuṣe jane somaḥ pūruṣu sūyate |
8,064.10 tasyehi pra dravā piba ||
8,064.11  ayaṃ te śaryaṇāvati suṣomāyāmadhi priyaḥ |
8,064.11 ārjīkīye madintamaḥ ||
8,064.12  tamadya rādhase mahe cāruṃ madāya ghṛṣvaye |
8,064.12 ehīmindra dravā piba ||

8,065.01  yadindra prāgapāgudaṅnyagvā hūyase nṛbhiḥ |
8,065.01 ā yāhi tūyamāśubhiḥ ||
8,065.02  yadvā prasravaṇe divo mādayāse svarṇare |
8,065.02 yadvā samudre andhasaḥ ||
8,065.03  ā tvā gīrbhirmahāmuruṃ huve gāmiva bhojase |
8,065.03 indra somasya pītaye ||
8,065.04  ā ta indra mahimānaṃ harayo deva te mahaḥ |
8,065.04 rathe vahantu bibhrataḥ ||
8,065.05  indra gṛṇīṣa u stuṣe mahāṃ ugra īśānakṛt |
8,065.05 ehi naḥ sutaṃ piba ||
8,065.06  sutāvantastvā vayaṃ prayasvanto havāmahe |
8,065.06 idaṃ no barhirāsade ||
8,065.07  yacciddhi śaśvatāmasīndra sādhāraṇastvam |
8,065.07 taṃ tvā vayaṃ havāmahe ||
8,065.08  idaṃ te somyaṃ madhvadhukṣannadribhirnaraḥ |
8,065.08 juṣāṇa indra tatpiba ||
8,065.09  viśvāṃ aryo vipaścito'ti khyastūyamā gahi |
8,065.09 asme dhehi śravo bṛhat ||
8,065.10  dātā me pṛṣatīnāṃ rājā hiraṇyavīnām |
8,065.10 mā devā maghavā riṣat ||
8,065.11  sahasre pṛṣatīnāmadhi ścandraṃ bṛhatpṛthu |
8,065.11 śukraṃ hiraṇyamā dade ||
8,065.12  napāto durgahasya me sahasreṇa surādhasaḥ |
8,065.12 śravo deveṣvakrata ||

8,066.01  tarobhirvo vidadvasumindraṃ sabādha ūtaye |
8,066.01 bṛhadgāyantaḥ sutasome adhvare huve bharaṃ na kāriṇam ||
8,066.02  na yaṃ dudhrā varante na sthirā muro made suśipramandhasaḥ |
8,066.02 ya ādṛtyā śaśamānāya sunvate dātā jaritra ukthyam ||
8,066.03  yaḥ śakro mṛkṣo aśvyo yo vā kījo hiraṇyayaḥ |
8,066.03 sa ūrvasya rejayatyapāvṛtimindro gavyasya vṛtrahā ||
8,066.04  nikhātaṃ cidyaḥ purusambhṛtaṃ vasūdidvapati dāśuṣe |
8,066.04 vajrī suśipro haryaśva itkaradindraḥ kratvā yathā vaśat ||
8,066.05  yadvāvantha puruṣṭuta purā cicchūra nṛṇām |
8,066.05 vayaṃ tatta indra saṃ bharāmasi yajñamukthaṃ turaṃ vacaḥ ||
8,066.06  sacā someṣu puruhūta vajrivo madāya dyukṣa somapāḥ |
8,066.06 tvamiddhi brahmakṛte kāmyaṃ vasu deṣṭhaḥ sunvate bhuvaḥ ||
8,066.07  vayamenamidā hyo'pīpemeha vajriṇam |
8,066.07 tasmā u adya samanā sutaṃ bharā nūnaṃ bhūṣata śrute ||
8,066.08  vṛkaścidasya vāraṇa urāmathirā vayuneṣu bhūṣati |
8,066.08 semaṃ na stomaṃ jujuṣāṇa ā gahīndra pra citrayā dhiyā ||
8,066.09  kadū nvasyākṛtamindrasyāsti pauṃsyam |
8,066.09 keno nu kaṃ śromatena na śuśruve januṣaḥ pari vṛtrahā ||
8,066.10  kadū mahīradhṛṣṭā asya taviṣīḥ kadu vṛtraghno astṛtam |
8,066.10 indro viśvānbekanāṭāṃ ahardṛśa uta kratvā paṇīṃrabhi ||
8,066.11  vayaṃ ghā te apūrvyendra brahmāṇi vṛtrahan |
8,066.11 purūtamāsaḥ puruhūta vajrivo bhṛtiṃ na pra bharāmasi ||
8,066.12  pūrvīściddhi tve tuvikūrminnāśaso havanta indrotayaḥ |
8,066.12 tiraścidaryaḥ savanā vaso gahi śaviṣṭha śrudhi me havam ||
8,066.13  vayaṃ ghā te tve idvindra viprā api ṣmasi |
8,066.13 nahi tvadanyaḥ puruhūta kaścana maghavannasti marḍitā ||
8,066.14  tvaṃ no asyā amateruta kṣudho'bhiśasterava spṛdhi |
8,066.14 tvaṃ na ūtī tava citrayā dhiyā śikṣā śaciṣṭha gātuvit ||
8,066.15  soma idvaḥ suto astu kalayo mā bibhītana |
8,066.15 apedeṣa dhvasmāyati svayaṃ ghaiṣo apāyati ||

8,067.01  tyānnu kṣatriyāṃ ava ādityānyāciṣāmahe |
8,067.01 sumṛḻīkāṃ abhiṣṭaye ||
8,067.02  mitro no atyaṃhatiṃ varuṇaḥ parṣadaryamā |
8,067.02 ādityāso yathā viduḥ ||
8,067.03  teṣāṃ hi citramukthyaṃ varūthamasti dāśuṣe |
8,067.03 ādityānāmaraṅkṛte ||
8,067.04  mahi vo mahatāmavo varuṇa mitrāryaman |
8,067.04 avāṃsyā vṛṇīmahe ||
8,067.05  jīvānno abhi dhetanādityāsaḥ purā hathāt |
8,067.05 kaddha stha havanaśrutaḥ ||
8,067.06  yadvaḥ śrāntāya sunvate varūthamasti yacchardiḥ |
8,067.06 tenā no adhi vocata ||
8,067.07  asti devā aṃhorurvasti ratnamanāgasaḥ |
8,067.07 ādityā adbhutainasaḥ ||
8,067.08  mā naḥ setuḥ siṣedayaṃ mahe vṛṇaktu naspari |
8,067.08 indra iddhi śruto vaśī ||
8,067.09  mā no mṛcā ripūṇāṃ vṛjinānāmaviṣyavaḥ |
8,067.09 devā abhi pra mṛkṣata ||
8,067.10  uta tvāmadite mahyahaṃ devyupa bruve |
8,067.10 sumṛḻīkāmabhiṣṭaye ||
8,067.11  parṣi dīne gabhīra āṃ ugraputre jighāṃsataḥ |
8,067.11 mākistokasya no riṣat ||
8,067.12  aneho na uruvraja urūci vi prasartave |
8,067.12 kṛdhi tokāya jīvase ||
8,067.13  ye mūrdhānaḥ kṣitīnāmadabdhāsaḥ svayaśasaḥ |
8,067.13 vratā rakṣante adruhaḥ ||
8,067.14  te na āsno vṛkāṇāmādityāso mumocata |
8,067.14 stenaṃ baddhamivādite ||
8,067.15  apo ṣu ṇa iyaṃ śarurādityā apa durmatiḥ |
8,067.15 asmadetvajaghnuṣī ||
8,067.16  śaśvaddhi vaḥ sudānava ādityā ūtibhirvayam |
8,067.16 purā nūnaṃ bubhujmahe ||
8,067.17  śaśvantaṃ hi pracetasaḥ pratiyantaṃ cidenasaḥ |
8,067.17 devāḥ kṛṇutha jīvase ||
8,067.18  tatsu no navyaṃ sanyasa ādityā yanmumocati |
8,067.18 bandhādbaddhamivādite ||
8,067.19  nāsmākamasti tattara ādityāso atiṣkade |
8,067.19 yūyamasmabhyaṃ mṛḻata ||
8,067.20  mā no hetirvivasvata ādityāḥ kṛtrimā śaruḥ |
8,067.20 purā nu jaraso vadhīt ||
8,067.21  vi ṣu dveṣo vyaṃhatimādityāso vi saṃhitam |
8,067.21 viṣvagvi vṛhatā rapaḥ ||

8,068.01  ā tvā rathaṃ yathotaye sumnāya vartayāmasi |
8,068.01 tuvikūrmimṛtīṣahamindra śaviṣṭha satpate ||
8,068.02  tuviśuṣma tuvikrato śacīvo viśvayā mate |
8,068.02 ā paprātha mahitvanā ||
8,068.03  yasya te mahinā mahaḥ pari jmāyantamīyatuḥ |
8,068.03 hastā vajraṃ hiraṇyayam ||
8,068.04  viśvānarasya vaspatimanānatasya śavasaḥ |
8,068.04 evaiśca carṣaṇīnāmūtī huve rathānām ||
8,068.05  abhiṣṭaye sadāvṛdhaṃ svarmīḻheṣu yaṃ naraḥ |
8,068.05 nānā havanta ūtaye ||
8,068.06  paromātramṛcīṣamamindramugraṃ surādhasam |
8,068.06 īśānaṃ cidvasūnām ||
8,068.07  taṃtamidrādhase maha indraṃ codāmi pītaye |
8,068.07 yaḥ pūrvyāmanuṣṭutimīśe kṛṣṭīnāṃ nṛtuḥ ||
8,068.08  na yasya te śavasāna sakhyamānaṃśa martyaḥ |
8,068.08 nakiḥ śavāṃsi te naśat ||
8,068.09  tvotāsastvā yujāpsu sūrye mahaddhanam |
8,068.09 jayema pṛtsu vajrivaḥ ||
8,068.10  taṃ tvā yajñebhirīmahe taṃ gīrbhirgirvaṇastama |
8,068.10 indra yathā cidāvitha vājeṣu purumāyyam ||
8,068.11  yasya te svādu sakhyaṃ svādvī praṇītiradrivaḥ |
8,068.11 yajño vitantasāyyaḥ ||
8,068.12  uru ṇastanve tana uru kṣayāya naskṛdhi |
8,068.12 uru ṇo yandhi jīvase ||
8,068.13  uruṃ nṛbhya uruṃ gava uruṃ rathāya panthām |
8,068.13 devavītiṃ manāmahe ||
8,068.14  upa mā ṣaḍdvādvā naraḥ somasya harṣyā |
8,068.14 tiṣṭhanti svādurātayaḥ ||
8,068.15  ṛjrāvindrota ā dade harī ṛkṣasya sūnavi |
8,068.15 āśvamedhasya rohitā ||
8,068.16  surathāṃ ātithigve svabhīśūṃrārkṣe |
8,068.16 āśvamedhe supeśasaḥ ||
8,068.17  ṣaḻ aśvāṃ ātithigva indrote vadhūmataḥ |
8,068.17 sacā pūtakratau sanam ||
8,068.18  aiṣu cetadvṛṣaṇvatyantarṛjreṣvaruṣī |
8,068.18 svabhīśuḥ kaśāvatī ||
8,068.19  na yuṣme vājabandhavo ninitsuścana martyaḥ |
8,068.19 avadyamadhi dīdharat ||

8,069.01  prapra vastriṣṭubhamiṣaṃ mandadvīrāyendave |
8,069.01 dhiyā vo medhasātaye purandhyā vivāsati ||
8,069.02  nadaṃ va odatīnāṃ nadaṃ yoyuvatīnām |
8,069.02 patiṃ vo aghnyānāṃ dhenūnāmiṣudhyasi ||
8,069.03  tā asya sūdadohasaḥ somaṃ śrīṇanti pṛśnayaḥ |
8,069.03 janmandevānāṃ viśastriṣvā rocane divaḥ ||
8,069.04  abhi pra gopatiṃ girendramarca yathā vide |
8,069.04 sūnuṃ satyasya satpatim ||
8,069.05  ā harayaḥ sasṛjrire'ruṣīradhi barhiṣi |
8,069.05 yatrābhi saṃnavāmahe ||
8,069.06  indrāya gāva āśiraṃ duduhre vajriṇe madhu |
8,069.06 yatsīmupahvare vidat ||
8,069.07  udyadbradhnasya viṣṭapaṃ gṛhamindraśca ganvahi |
8,069.07 madhvaḥ pītvā sacevahi triḥ sapta sakhyuḥ pade ||
8,069.08  arcata prārcata priyamedhāso arcata |
8,069.08 arcantu putrakā uta puraṃ na dhṛṣṇvarcata ||
8,069.09  ava svarāti gargaro godhā pari saniṣvaṇat |
8,069.09 piṅgā pari caniṣkadadindrāya brahmodyatam ||
8,069.10  ā yatpatantyenyaḥ sudughā anapasphuraḥ |
8,069.10 apasphuraṃ gṛbhāyata somamindrāya pātave ||
8,069.11  apādindro apādagnirviśve devā amatsata |
8,069.11 varuṇa idiha kṣayattamāpo abhyanūṣata vatsaṃ saṃśiśvarīriva ||
8,069.12  sudevo asi varuṇa yasya te sapta sindhavaḥ |
8,069.12 anukṣaranti kākudaṃ sūrmyaṃ suṣirāmiva ||
8,069.13  yo vyatīṃraphāṇayatsuyuktāṃ upa dāśuṣe |
8,069.13 takvo netā tadidvapurupamā yo amucyata ||
8,069.14  atīdu śakra ohata indro viśvā ati dviṣaḥ |
8,069.14 bhinatkanīna odanaṃ pacyamānaṃ paro girā ||
8,069.15  arbhako na kumārako'dhi tiṣṭhannavaṃ ratham |
8,069.15 sa pakṣanmahiṣaṃ mṛgaṃ pitre mātre vibhukratum ||
8,069.16  ā tū suśipra dampate rathaṃ tiṣṭhā hiraṇyayam |
8,069.16 adha dyukṣaṃ sacevahi sahasrapādamaruṣaṃ svastigāmanehasam ||
8,069.17  taṃ ghemitthā namasvina upa svarājamāsate |
8,069.17 arthaṃ cidasya sudhitaṃ yadetava āvartayanti dāvane ||
8,069.18  anu pratnasyaukasaḥ priyamedhāsa eṣām |
8,069.18 pūrvāmanu prayatiṃ vṛktabarhiṣo hitaprayasa āśata ||

8,070.01  yo rājā carṣaṇīnāṃ yātā rathebhiradhriguḥ |
8,070.01 viśvāsāṃ tarutā pṛtanānāṃ jyeṣṭho yo vṛtrahā gṛṇe ||
8,070.02  indraṃ taṃ śumbha puruhanmannavase yasya dvitā vidhartari |
8,070.02 hastāya vajraḥ prati dhāyi darśato maho dive na sūryaḥ ||
8,070.03  nakiṣṭaṃ karmaṇā naśadyaścakāra sadāvṛdham |
8,070.03 indraṃ na yajñairviśvagūrtamṛbhvasamadhṛṣṭaṃ dhṛṣṇvojasam ||
8,070.04  aṣāḻhamugraṃ pṛtanāsu sāsahiṃ yasminmahīrurujrayaḥ |
8,070.04 saṃ dhenavo jāyamāne anonavurdyāvaḥ kṣāmo anonavuḥ ||
8,070.05  yaddyāva indra te śataṃ śataṃ bhūmīruta syuḥ |
8,070.05 na tvā vajrinsahasraṃ sūryā anu na jātamaṣṭa rodasī ||
8,070.06  ā paprātha mahinā vṛṣṇyā vṛṣanviśvā śaviṣṭha śavasā |
8,070.06 asmāṃ ava maghavangomati vraje vajriñcitrābhirūtibhiḥ ||
8,070.07  na sīmadeva āpadiṣaṃ dīrghāyo martyaḥ |
8,070.07 etagvā cidya etaśā yuyojate harī indro yuyojate ||
8,070.08  taṃ vo maho mahāyyamindraṃ dānāya sakṣaṇim |
8,070.08 yo gādheṣu ya āraṇeṣu havyo vājeṣvasti havyaḥ ||
8,070.09  udū ṣu ṇo vaso mahe mṛśasva śūra rādhase |
8,070.09 udū ṣu mahyai maghavanmaghattaya udindra śravase mahe ||
8,070.10  tvaṃ na indra ṛtayustvānido ni tṛmpasi |
8,070.10 madhye vasiṣva tuvinṛmṇorvorni dāsaṃ śiśnatho hathaiḥ ||
8,070.11  anyavratamamānuṣamayajvānamadevayum |
8,070.11 ava svaḥ sakhā dudhuvīta parvataḥ sughnāya dasyuṃ parvataḥ ||
8,070.12  tvaṃ na indrāsāṃ haste śaviṣṭha dāvane |
8,070.12 dhānānāṃ na saṃ gṛbhāyāsmayurdviḥ saṃ gṛbhāyāsmayuḥ ||
8,070.13  sakhāyaḥ kratumicchata kathā rādhāma śarasya |
8,070.13 upastutiṃ bhojaḥ sūriryo ahrayaḥ ||
8,070.14  bhūribhiḥ samaha ṛṣibhirbarhiṣmadbhi staviṣyase |
8,070.14 yaditthamekamekamicchara vatsānparādadaḥ ||
8,070.15  karṇagṛhyā maghavā śauradevyo vatsaṃ nastribhya ānayat |
8,070.15 ajāṃ sūrirna dhātave ||

8,071.01  tvaṃ no agne mahobhiḥ pāhi viśvasyā arāteḥ |
8,071.01 uta dviṣo martyasya ||
8,071.02  nahi manyuḥ pauruṣeya īśe hi vaḥ priyajāta |
8,071.02 tvamidasi kṣapāvān ||
8,071.03  sa no viśvebhirdevebhirūrjo napādbhadraśoce |
8,071.03 rayiṃ dehi viśvavāram ||
8,071.04  na tamagne arātayo martaṃ yuvanta rāyaḥ |
8,071.04 yaṃ trāyase dāśvāṃsam ||
8,071.05  yaṃ tvaṃ vipra medhasātāvagne hinoṣi dhanāya |
8,071.05 sa tavotī goṣu gantā ||
8,071.06  tvaṃ rayiṃ puruvīramagne dāśuṣe martāya |
8,071.06 pra ṇo naya vasyo accha ||
8,071.07  uruṣyā ṇo mā parā dā aghāyate jātavedaḥ |
8,071.07 durādhye martāya ||
8,071.08  agne mākiṣṭe devasya rātimadevo yuyota |
8,071.08 tvamīśiṣe vasūnām ||
8,071.09  sa no vasva upa māsyūrjo napānmāhinasya |
8,071.09 sakhe vaso jaritṛbhyaḥ ||
8,071.10  acchā naḥ śīraśociṣaṃ giro yantu darśatam |
8,071.10 acchā yajñāso namasā purūvasuṃ purupraśastamūtaye ||
8,071.11  agniṃ sūnuṃ sahaso jātavedasaṃ dānāya vāryāṇām |
8,071.11 dvitā yo bhūdamṛto martyeṣvā hotā mandratamo viśi ||
8,071.12  agniṃ vo devayajyayāgniṃ prayatyadhvare |
8,071.12 agniṃ dhīṣu prathamamagnimarvatyagniṃ kṣaitrāya sādhase ||
8,071.13  agniriṣāṃ sakhye dadātu na īśe yo vāryāṇām |
8,071.13 agniṃ toke tanaye śaśvadīmahe vasuṃ santaṃ tanūpām ||
8,071.14  agnimīḻiṣvāvase gāthābhiḥ śīraśociṣam |
8,071.14 agniṃ rāye purumīḻha śrutaṃ naro'gniṃ sudītaye chardiḥ ||
8,071.15  agniṃ dveṣo yotavai no gṛṇīmasyagniṃ śaṃ yośca dātave |
8,071.15 viśvāsu vikṣvaviteva havyo bhuvadvasturṛṣūṇām ||

8,072.01  haviṣkṛṇudhvamā gamadadhvaryurvanate punaḥ |
8,072.01 vidvāṃ asya praśāsanam ||
8,072.02  ni tigmamabhyaṃśuṃ sīdaddhotā manāvadhi |
8,072.02 juṣāṇo asya sakhyam ||
8,072.03  antaricchanti taṃ jane rudraṃ paro manīṣayā |
8,072.03 gṛbhṇanti jihvayā sasam ||
8,072.04  jāmyatītape dhanurvayodhā aruhadvanam |
8,072.04 dṛṣadaṃ jihvayāvadhīt ||
8,072.05  caranvatso ruśanniha nidātāraṃ na vindate |
8,072.05 veti stotava ambyam ||
8,072.06  uto nvasya yanmahadaśvāvadyojanaṃ bṛhad |
8,072.06 dāmā rathasya dadṛśe ||
8,072.07  duhanti saptaikāmupa dvā pañca sṛjataḥ |
8,072.07 tīrthe sindhoradhi svare ||
8,072.08  ā daśabhirvivasvata indraḥ kośamacucyavīt |
8,072.08 khedayā trivṛtā divaḥ ||
8,072.09  pari tridhāturadhvaraṃ jūrṇireti navīyasī |
8,072.09 madhvā hotāro añjate ||
8,072.10  siñcanti namasāvatamuccācakraṃ parijmānam |
8,072.10 nīcīnabāramakṣitam ||
8,072.11  abhyāramidadrayo niṣiktaṃ puṣkare madhu |
8,072.11 avatasya visarjane ||
8,072.12  gāva upāvatāvataṃ mahī yajñasya rapsudā |
8,072.12 ubhā karṇā hiraṇyayā ||
8,072.13  ā sute siñcata śriyaṃ rodasyorabhiśriyam |
8,072.13 rasā dadhīta vṛṣabham ||
8,072.14  te jānata svamokyaṃ saṃ vatsāso na mātṛbhiḥ |
8,072.14 mitho nasanta jāmibhiḥ ||
8,072.15  upa srakveṣu bapsataḥ kṛṇvate dharuṇaṃ divi |
8,072.15 indre agnā namaḥ svaḥ ||
8,072.16  adhukṣatpipyuṣīmiṣamūrjaṃ saptapadīmariḥ |
8,072.16 sūryasya sapta raśmibhiḥ ||
8,072.17  somasya mitrāvaruṇoditā sūra ā dade |
8,072.17 tadāturasya bheṣajam ||
8,072.18  uto nvasya yatpadaṃ haryatasya nidhānyam |
8,072.18 pari dyāṃ jihvayātanat ||

8,073.01  udīrāthāmṛtāyate yuñjāthāmaśvinā ratham |
8,073.01 anti ṣadbhūtu vāmavaḥ ||
8,073.02  nimiṣaścijjavīyasā rathenā yātamaśvinā |
8,073.02 anti ṣadbhūtu vāmavaḥ ||
8,073.03  upa stṛṇītamatraye himena gharmamaśvinā |
8,073.03 anti ṣadbhūtu vāmavaḥ ||
8,073.04  kuha sthaḥ kuha jagmathuḥ kuha śyeneva petathuḥ |
8,073.04 anti ṣadbhūtu vāmavaḥ ||
8,073.05  yadadya karhi karhi cicchuśrūyātamimaṃ havam |
8,073.05 anti ṣadbhūtu vāmavaḥ ||
8,073.06  aśvinā yāmahūtamā nediṣṭhaṃ yāmyāpyam |
8,073.06 anti ṣadbhūtu vāmavaḥ ||
8,073.07  avantamatraye gṛhaṃ kṛṇutaṃ yuvamaśvinā |
8,073.07 anti ṣadbhūtu vāmavaḥ ||
8,073.08  varethe agnimātapo vadate valgvatraye |
8,073.08 anti ṣadbhūtu vāmavaḥ ||
8,073.09  pra saptavadhrirāśasā dhārāmagneraśāyata |
8,073.09 anti ṣadbhūtu vāmavaḥ ||
8,073.10  ihā gataṃ vṛṣaṇvasū śṛṇutaṃ ma imaṃ havam |
8,073.10 anti ṣadbhūtu vāmavaḥ ||
8,073.11  kimidaṃ vāṃ purāṇavajjaratoriva śasyate |
8,073.11 anti ṣadbhūtu vāmavaḥ ||
8,073.12  samānaṃ vāṃ sajātyaṃ samāno bandhuraśvinā |
8,073.12 anti ṣadbhūtu vāmavaḥ ||
8,073.13  yo vāṃ rajāṃsyaśvinā ratho viyāti rodasī |
8,073.13 anti ṣadbhūtu vāmavaḥ ||
8,073.14  ā no gavyebhiraśvyaiḥ sahasrairupa gacchatam |
8,073.14 anti ṣadbhūtu vāmavaḥ ||
8,073.15  mā no gavyebhiraśvyaiḥ sahasrebhirati khyatam |
8,073.15 anti ṣadbhūtu vāmavaḥ ||
8,073.16  aruṇapsuruṣā abhūdakarjyotirṛtāvarī |
8,073.16 anti ṣadbhūtu vāmavaḥ ||
8,073.17  aśvinā su vicākaśadvṛkṣaṃ paraśumāṃ iva |
8,073.17 anti ṣadbhūtu vāmavaḥ ||
8,073.18  puraṃ na dhṛṣṇavā ruja kṛṣṇayā bādhito viśā |
8,073.18 anti ṣadbhūtu vāmavaḥ ||

8,074.01  viśoviśo vo atithiṃ vājayantaḥ purupriyam |
8,074.01 agniṃ vo duryaṃ vaca stuṣe śūṣasya manmabhiḥ ||
8,074.02  yaṃ janāso haviṣmanto mitraṃ na sarpirāsutim |
8,074.02 praśaṃsanti praśastibhiḥ ||
8,074.03  panyāṃsaṃ jātavedasaṃ yo devatātyudyatā |
8,074.03 havyānyairayaddivi ||
8,074.04  āganma vṛtrahantamaṃ jyeṣṭhamagnimānavam |
8,074.04 yasya śrutarvā bṛhannārkṣo anīka edhate ||
8,074.05  amṛtaṃ jātavedasaṃ tirastamāṃsi darśatam |
8,074.05 ghṛtāhavanamīḍyam ||
8,074.06  sabādho yaṃ janā ime'gniṃ havyebhirīḻate |
8,074.06 juhvānāso yatasrucaḥ ||
8,074.07  iyaṃ te navyasī matiragne adhāyyasmadā |
8,074.07 mandra sujāta sukrato'mūra dasmātithe ||
8,074.08  sā te agne śantamā caniṣṭhā bhavatu priyā |
8,074.08 tayā vardhasva suṣṭutaḥ ||
8,074.09  sā dyumnairdyumninī bṛhadupopa śravasi śravaḥ |
8,074.09 dadhīta vṛtratūrye ||
8,074.10  aśvamidgāṃ rathaprāṃ tveṣamindraṃ na satpatim |
8,074.10 yasya śravāṃsi tūrvatha panyampanyaṃ ca kṛṣṭayaḥ ||
8,074.11  yaṃ tvā gopavano girā caniṣṭhadagne aṅgiraḥ |
8,074.11 sa pāvaka śrudhī havam ||
8,074.12  yaṃ tvā janāsa īḻate sabādho vājasātaye |
8,074.12 sa bodhi vṛtratūrye ||
8,074.13  ahaṃ huvāna ārkṣe śrutarvaṇi madacyuti |
8,074.13 śardhāṃsīva stukāvināṃ mṛkṣā śīrṣā caturṇām ||
8,074.14  māṃ catvāra āśavaḥ śaviṣṭhasya dravitnavaḥ |
8,074.14 surathāso abhi prayo vakṣanvayo na tugryam ||
8,074.15  satyamittvā mahenadi paruṣṇyava dediśam |
8,074.15 nemāpo aśvadātaraḥ śaviṣṭhādasti martyaḥ ||

8,075.01  yukṣvā hi devahūtamāṃ aśvāṃ agne rathīriva |
8,075.01 ni hotā pūrvyaḥ sadaḥ ||
8,075.02  uta no deva devāṃ acchā voco viduṣṭaraḥ |
8,075.02 śradviśvā vāryā kṛdhi ||
8,075.03  tvaṃ ha yadyaviṣṭhya sahasaḥ sūnavāhuta |
8,075.03 ṛtāvā yajñiyo bhuvaḥ ||
8,075.04  ayamagniḥ sahasriṇo vājasya śatinaspatiḥ |
8,075.04 mūrdhā kavī rayīṇām ||
8,075.05  taṃ nemimṛbhavo yathā namasva sahūtibhiḥ |
8,075.05 nedīyo yajñamaṅgiraḥ ||
8,075.06  tasmai nūnamabhidyave vācā virūpa nityayā |
8,075.06 vṛṣṇe codasva suṣṭutim ||
8,075.07  kamu ṣvidasya senayāgnerapākacakṣasaḥ |
8,075.07 paṇiṃ goṣu starāmahe ||
8,075.08  mā no devānāṃ viśaḥ prasnātīrivosrāḥ |
8,075.08 kṛśaṃ na hāsuraghnyāḥ ||
8,075.09  mā naḥ samasya dūḍhyaḥ paridveṣaso aṃhatiḥ |
8,075.09 ūrmirna nāvamā vadhīt ||
8,075.10  namaste agna ojase gṛṇanti deva kṛṣṭayaḥ |
8,075.10 amairamitramardaya ||
8,075.11  kuvitsu no gaviṣṭaye'gne saṃveṣiṣo rayim |
8,075.11 urukṛduru ṇaskṛdhi ||
8,075.12  mā no asminmahādhane parā vargbhārabhṛdyathā |
8,075.12 saṃvargaṃ saṃ rayiṃ jaya ||
8,075.13  anyamasmadbhiyā iyamagne siṣaktu ducchunā |
8,075.13 vardhā no amavacchavaḥ ||
8,075.14  yasyājuṣannamasvinaḥ śamīmadurmakhasya vā |
8,075.14 taṃ ghedagnirvṛdhāvati ||
8,075.15  parasyā adhi saṃvato'varāṃ abhyā tara |
8,075.15 yatrāhamasmi tāṃ ava ||
8,075.16  vidmā hi te purā vayamagne pituryathāvasaḥ |
8,075.16 adhā te sumnamīmahe ||

8,076.01  imaṃ nu māyinaṃ huva indramīśānamojasā |
8,076.01 marutvantaṃ na vṛñjase ||
8,076.02  ayamindro marutsakhā vi vṛtrasyābhinacchiraḥ |
8,076.02 vajreṇa śataparvaṇā ||
8,076.03  vāvṛdhāno marutsakhendro vi vṛtramairayat |
8,076.03 sṛjansamudriyā apaḥ ||
8,076.04  ayaṃ ha yena vā idaṃ svarmarutvatā jitam |
8,076.04 indreṇa somapītaye ||
8,076.05  marutvantamṛjīṣiṇamojasvantaṃ virapśinam |
8,076.05 indraṃ gīrbhirhavāmahe ||
8,076.06  indraṃ pratnena manmanā marutvantaṃ havāmahe |
8,076.06 asya somasya pītaye ||
8,076.07  marutvāṃ indra mīḍhvaḥ pibā somaṃ śatakrato |
8,076.07 asminyajñe puruṣṭuta ||
8,076.08  tubhyedindra marutvate sutāḥ somāso adrivaḥ |
8,076.08 hṛdā hūyanta ukthinaḥ ||
8,076.09  pibedindra marutsakhā sutaṃ somaṃ diviṣṭiṣu |
8,076.09 vajraṃ śiśāna ojasā ||
8,076.10  uttiṣṭhannojasā saha pītvī śipre avepayaḥ |
8,076.10 somamindra camū sutam ||
8,076.11  anu tvā rodasī ubhe krakṣamāṇamakṛpetām |
8,076.11 indra yaddasyuhābhavaḥ ||
8,076.12  vācamaṣṭāpadīmahaṃ navasraktimṛtaspṛśam |
8,076.12 indrātpari tanvaṃ mame ||

8,077.01  jajñāno nu śatakraturvi pṛcchaditi mātaram |
8,077.01 ka ugrāḥ ke ha śṛṇvire ||
8,077.02  ādīṃ śavasyabravīdaurṇavābhamahīśuvam |
8,077.02 te putra santu niṣṭuraḥ ||
8,077.03  samittānvṛtrahākhidatkhe arāṃ iva khedayā |
8,077.03 pravṛddho dasyuhābhavat ||
8,077.04  ekayā pratidhāpibatsākaṃ sarāṃsi triṃśatam |
8,077.04 indraḥ somasya kāṇukā ||
8,077.05  abhi gandharvamatṛṇadabudhneṣu rajassvā |
8,077.05 indro brahmabhya idvṛdhe ||
8,077.06  nirāvidhyadgiribhya ā dhārayatpakvamodanam |
8,077.06 indro bundaṃ svātatam ||
8,077.07  śatabradhna iṣustava sahasraparṇa eka it |
8,077.07 yamindra cakṛṣe yujam ||
8,077.08  tena stotṛbhya ā bhara nṛbhyo nāribhyo attave |
8,077.08 sadyo jāta ṛbhuṣṭhira ||
8,077.09  etā cyautnāni te kṛtā varṣiṣṭhāni parīṇasā |
8,077.09 hṛdā vīḍvadhārayaḥ ||
8,077.10  viśvettā viṣṇurābharadurukramastveṣitaḥ |
8,077.10 śataṃ mahiṣānkṣīrapākamodanaṃ varāhamindra emuṣam ||
8,077.11  tuvikṣaṃ te sukṛtaṃ sūmayaṃ dhanuḥ sādhurbundo hiraṇyayaḥ |
8,077.11 ubhā te bāhū raṇyā susaṃskṛta ṛdūpe cidṛdūvṛdhā ||

8,078.01  puroḻāśaṃ no andhasa indra sahasramā bhara |
8,078.01 śatā ca śūra gonām ||
8,078.02  ā no bhara vyañjanaṃ gāmaśvamabhyañjanam |
8,078.02 sacā manā hiraṇyayā ||
8,078.03  uta naḥ karṇaśobhanā purūṇi dhṛṣṇavā bhara |
8,078.03 tvaṃ hi śṛṇviṣe vaso ||
8,078.04  nakīṃ vṛdhīka indra te na suṣā na sudā uta |
8,078.04 nānyastvacchūra vāghataḥ ||
8,078.05  nakīmindro nikartave na śakraḥ pariśaktave |
8,078.05 viśvaṃ śṛṇoti paśyati ||
8,078.06  sa manyuṃ martyānāmadabdho ni cikīṣate |
8,078.06 purā nidaścikīṣate ||
8,078.07  kratva itpūrṇamudaraṃ turasyāsti vidhataḥ |
8,078.07 vṛtraghnaḥ somapāvnaḥ ||
8,078.08  tve vasūni saṃgatā viśvā ca soma saubhagā |
8,078.08 sudātvaparihvṛtā ||
8,078.09  tvāmidyavayurmama kāmo gavyurhiraṇyayuḥ |
8,078.09 tvāmaśvayureṣate ||
8,078.10  tavedindrāhamāśasā haste dātraṃ canā dade |
8,078.10 dinasya vā maghavansambhṛtasya vā pūrdhi yavasya kāśinā ||

8,079.01  ayaṃ kṛtnuragṛbhīto viśvajidudbhiditsomaḥ |
8,079.01 ṛṣirvipraḥ kāvyena ||
8,079.02  abhyūrṇoti yannagnaṃ bhiṣakti viśvaṃ yatturam |
8,079.02 premandhaḥ khyanniḥ śroṇo bhūt ||
8,079.03  tvaṃ soma tanūkṛdbhyo dveṣobhyo'nyakṛtebhyaḥ |
8,079.03 uru yantāsi varūtham ||
8,079.04  tvaṃ cittī tava dakṣairdiva ā pṛthivyā ṛjīṣin |
8,079.04 yāvīraghasya ciddveṣaḥ ||
8,079.05  arthino yanti cedarthaṃ gacchāniddaduṣo rātim |
8,079.05 vavṛjyustṛṣyataḥ kāmam ||
8,079.06  vidadyatpūrvyaṃ naṣṭamudīmṛtāyumīrayat |
8,079.06 premāyustārīdatīrṇam ||
8,079.07  suśevo no mṛḻayākuradṛptakraturavātaḥ |
8,079.07 bhavā naḥ soma śaṃ hṛde ||
8,079.08  mā naḥ soma saṃ vīvijo mā vi bībhiṣathā rājan |
8,079.08 mā no hārdi tviṣā vadhīḥ ||
8,079.09  ava yatsve sadhasthe devānāṃ durmatīrīkṣe |
8,079.09 rājannapa dviṣaḥ sedha mīḍhvo apa sridhaḥ sedha ||

8,080.01  nahyanyaṃ baḻākaraṃ marḍitāraṃ śatakrato |
8,080.01 tvaṃ na indra mṛḻaya ||
8,080.02  yo naḥ śaśvatpurāvithāmṛdhro vājasātaye |
8,080.02 sa tvaṃ na indra mṛḻaya ||
8,080.03  kimaṅga radhracodanaḥ sunvānasyāvitedasi |
8,080.03 kuvitsvindra ṇaḥ śakaḥ ||
8,080.04  indra pra ṇo rathamava paścāccitsantamadrivaḥ |
8,080.04 purastādenaṃ me kṛdhi ||
8,080.05  hanto nu kimāsase prathamaṃ no rathaṃ kṛdhi |
8,080.05 upamaṃ vājayu śravaḥ ||
8,080.06  avā no vājayuṃ rathaṃ sukaraṃ te kimitpari |
8,080.06 asmānsu jigyuṣaskṛdhi ||
8,080.07  indra dṛhyasva pūrasi bhadrā ta eti niṣkṛtam |
8,080.07 iyaṃ dhīrṛtviyāvatī ||
8,080.08  mā sīmavadya ā bhāgurvī kāṣṭhā hitaṃ dhanam |
8,080.08 apāvṛktā aratnayaḥ ||
8,080.09  turīyaṃ nāma yajñiyaṃ yadā karastaduśmasi |
8,080.09 āditpatirna ohase ||
8,080.10  avīvṛdhadvo amṛtā amandīdekadyūrdevā uta yāśca devīḥ |
8,080.10 tasmā u rādhaḥ kṛṇuta praśastaṃ prātarmakṣū dhiyāvasurjagamyāt ||

8,081.01  ā tū na indra kṣumantaṃ citraṃ grābhaṃ saṃ gṛbhāya |
8,081.01 mahāhastī dakṣiṇena ||
8,081.02  vidmā hi tvā tuvikūrmiṃ tuvideṣṇaṃ tuvīmagham |
8,081.02 tuvimātramavobhiḥ ||
8,081.03  nahi tvā śūra devā na martāso ditsantam |
8,081.03 bhīmaṃ na gāṃ vārayante ||
8,081.04  eto nvindraṃ stavāmeśānaṃ vasvaḥ svarājam |
8,081.04 na rādhasā mardhiṣannaḥ ||
8,081.05  pra stoṣadupa gāsiṣacchravatsāma gīyamānam |
8,081.05 abhi rādhasā jugurat ||
8,081.06  ā no bhara dakṣiṇenābhi savyena pra mṛśa |
8,081.06 indra mā no vasornirbhāk ||
8,081.07  upa kramasvā bhara dhṛṣatā dhṛṣṇo janānām |
8,081.07 adāśūṣṭarasya vedaḥ ||
8,081.08  indra ya u nu te asti vājo viprebhiḥ sanitvaḥ |
8,081.08 asmābhiḥ su taṃ sanuhi ||
8,081.09  sadyojuvaste vājā asmabhyaṃ viśvaścandrāḥ |
8,081.09 vaśaiśca makṣū jarante ||

8,082.01  ā pra drava parāvato'rvāvataśca vṛtrahan |
8,082.01 madhvaḥ prati prabharmaṇi ||
8,082.02  tīvrāḥ somāsa ā gahi sutāso mādayiṣṇavaḥ |
8,082.02 pibā dadhṛgyathociṣe ||
8,082.03  iṣā mandasvādu te'raṃ varāya manyave |
8,082.03 bhuvatta indra śaṃ hṛde ||
8,082.04  ā tvaśatravā gahi nyukthāni ca hūyase |
8,082.04 upame rocane divaḥ ||
8,082.05  tubhyāyamadribhiḥ suto gobhiḥ śrīto madāya kam |
8,082.05 pra soma indra hūyate ||
8,082.06  indra śrudhi su me havamasme sutasya gomataḥ |
8,082.06 vi pītiṃ tṛptimaśnuhi ||
8,082.07  ya indra camaseṣvā somaścamūṣu te sutaḥ |
8,082.07 pibedasya tvamīśiṣe ||
8,082.08  yo apsu candramā iva somaścamūṣu dadṛśe |
8,082.08 pibedasya tvamīśiṣe ||
8,082.09  yaṃ te śyenaḥ padābharattiro rajāṃsyaspṛtam |
8,082.09 pibedasya tvamīśiṣe ||

8,083.01  devānāmidavo mahattadā vṛṇīmahe vayam |
8,083.01 vṛṣṇāmasmabhyamūtaye ||
8,083.02  te naḥ santu yujaḥ sadā varuṇo mitro aryamā |
8,083.02 vṛdhāsaśca pracetasaḥ ||
8,083.03  ati no viṣpitā puru naubhirapo na parṣatha |
8,083.03 yūyamṛtasya rathyaḥ ||
8,083.04  vāmaṃ no astvaryamanvāmaṃ varuṇa śaṃsyam |
8,083.04 vāmaṃ hyāvṛṇīmahe ||
8,083.05  vāmasya hi pracetasa īśānāśo riśādasaḥ |
8,083.05 nemādityā aghasya yat ||
8,083.06  vayamidvaḥ sudānavaḥ kṣiyanto yānto adhvannā |
8,083.06 devā vṛdhāya hūmahe ||
8,083.07  adhi na indraiṣāṃ viṣṇo sajātyānām |
8,083.07 itā maruto aśvinā ||
8,083.08  pra bhrātṛtvaṃ sudānavo'dha dvitā samānyā |
8,083.08 māturgarbhe bharāmahe ||
8,083.09  yūyaṃ hi ṣṭhā sudānava indrajyeṣṭhā abhidyavaḥ |
8,083.09 adhā cidva uta bruve ||

8,084.01  preṣṭhaṃ vo atithiṃ stuṣe mitramiva priyam |
8,084.01 agniṃ rathaṃ na vedyam ||
8,084.02  kavimiva pracetasaṃ yaṃ devāso adha dvitā |
8,084.02 ni martyeṣvādadhuḥ ||
8,084.03  tvaṃ yaviṣṭha dāśuṣo nṝṃḥ pāhi śṛṇudhī giraḥ |
8,084.03 rakṣā tokamuta tmanā ||
8,084.04  kayā te agne aṅgira ūrjo napādupastutim |
8,084.04 varāya deva manyave ||
8,084.05  dāśema kasya manasā yajñasya sahaso yaho |
8,084.05 kadu voca idaṃ namaḥ ||
8,084.06  adhā tvaṃ hi naskaro viśvā asmabhyaṃ sukṣitīḥ |
8,084.06 vājadraviṇaso giraḥ ||
8,084.07  kasya nūnaṃ parīṇaso dhiyo jinvasi dampate |
8,084.07 goṣātā yasya te giraḥ ||
8,084.08  taṃ marjayanta sukratuṃ puroyāvānamājiṣu |
8,084.08 sveṣu kṣayeṣu vājinam ||
8,084.09  kṣeti kṣemebhiḥ sādhubhirnakiryaṃ ghnanti hanti yaḥ |
8,084.09 agne suvīra edhate ||

8,085.01  ā me havaṃ nāsatyāśvinā gacchataṃ yuvam |
8,085.01 madhvaḥ somasya pītaye ||
8,085.02  imaṃ me stomamaśvinemaṃ me śṛṇutaṃ havam |
8,085.02 madhvaḥ somasya pītaye ||
8,085.03  ayaṃ vāṃ kṛṣṇo aśvinā havate vājinīvasū |
8,085.03 madhvaḥ somasya pītaye ||
8,085.04  śṛṇutaṃ jariturhavaṃ kṛṣṇasya stuvato narā |
8,085.04 madhvaḥ somasya pītaye ||
8,085.05  chardiryantamadābhyaṃ viprāya stuvate narā |
8,085.05 madhvaḥ somasya pītaye ||
8,085.06  gacchataṃ dāśuṣo gṛhamitthā stuvato aśvinā |
8,085.06 madhvaḥ somasya pītaye ||
8,085.07  yuñjāthāṃ rāsabhaṃ rathe vīḍvaṅge vṛṣaṇvasū |
8,085.07 madhvaḥ somasya pītaye ||
8,085.08  trivandhureṇa trivṛtā rathenā yātamaśvinā |
8,085.08 madhvaḥ somasya pītaye ||
8,085.09  nū me giro nāsatyāśvinā prāvataṃ yuvam |
8,085.09 madhvaḥ somasya pītaye ||

8,086.01  ubhā hi dasrā bhiṣajā mayobhuvobhā dakṣasya vacaso babhūvathuḥ |
8,086.01 tā vāṃ viśvako havate tanūkṛthe mā no vi yauṣṭaṃ sakhyā mumocatam ||
8,086.02  kathā nūnaṃ vāṃ vimanā upa stavadyuvaṃ dhiyaṃ dadathurvasyaiṣṭaye |
8,086.02 tā vāṃ viśvako havate tanūkṛthe mā no vi yauṣṭaṃ sakhyā mumocatam ||
8,086.03  yuvaṃ hi ṣmā purubhujemamedhatuṃ viṣṇāpve dadathurvasyaiṣṭaye |
8,086.03 tā vāṃ viśvako havate tanūkṛthe mā no vi yauṣṭaṃ sakhyā mumocatam ||
8,086.04  uta tyaṃ vīraṃ dhanasāmṛjīṣiṇaṃ dūre citsantamavase havāmahe |
8,086.04 yasya svādiṣṭhā sumatiḥ pituryathā mā no vi yauṣṭaṃ sakhyā mumocatam ||
8,086.05  ṛtena devaḥ savitā śamāyata ṛtasya śṛṅgamurviyā vi paprathe |
8,086.05 ṛtaṃ sāsāha mahi citpṛtanyato mā no vi yauṣṭaṃ sakhyā mumocatam ||

8,087.01  dyumnī vāṃ stomo aśvinā krivirna seka ā gatam |
8,087.01 madhvaḥ sutasya sa divi priyo narā pātaṃ gaurāviveriṇe ||
8,087.02  pibataṃ gharmaṃ madhumantamaśvinā barhiḥ sīdataṃ narā |
8,087.02 tā mandasānā manuṣo duroṇa ā ni pātaṃ vedasā vayaḥ ||
8,087.03  ā vāṃ viśvābhirūtibhiḥ priyamedhā ahūṣata |
8,087.03 tā vartiryātamupa vṛktabarhiṣo juṣṭaṃ yajñaṃ diviṣṭiṣu ||
8,087.04  pibataṃ somaṃ madhumantamaśvinā barhiḥ sīdataṃ sumat |
8,087.04 tā vāvṛdhānā upa suṣṭutiṃ divo gantaṃ gaurāviveriṇam ||
8,087.05  ā nūnaṃ yātamaśvināśvebhiḥ pruṣitapsubhiḥ |
8,087.05 dasrā hiraṇyavartanī śubhaspatī pātaṃ somamṛtāvṛdhā ||
8,087.06  vayaṃ hi vāṃ havāmahe vipanyavo viprāso vājasātaye |
8,087.06 tā valgū dasrā purudaṃsasā dhiyāśvinā śruṣṭyā gatam ||

8,088.01  taṃ vo dasmamṛtīṣahaṃ vasormandānamandhasaḥ |
8,088.01 abhi vatsaṃ na svasareṣu dhenava indraṃ gīrbhirnavāmahe ||
8,088.02  dyukṣaṃ sudānuṃ taviṣībhirāvṛtaṃ giriṃ na purubhojasam |
8,088.02 kṣumantaṃ vājaṃ śatinaṃ sahasriṇaṃ makṣū gomantamīmahe ||
8,088.03  na tvā bṛhanto adrayo varanta indra vīḻavaḥ |
8,088.03 yadditsasi stuvate māvate vasu nakiṣṭadā mināti te ||
8,088.04  yoddhāsi kratvā śavasota daṃsanā viśvā jātābhi majmanā |
8,088.04 ā tvāyamarka ūtaye vavartati yaṃ gotamā ajījanan ||
8,088.05  pra hi ririkṣa ojasā divo antebhyaspari |
8,088.05 na tvā vivyāca raja indra pārthivamanu svadhāṃ vavakṣitha ||
8,088.06  nakiḥ pariṣṭirmaghavanmaghasya te yaddāśuṣe daśasyasi |
8,088.06 asmākaṃ bodhyucathasya coditā maṃhiṣṭho vājasātaye ||

8,089.01  bṛhadindrāya gāyata maruto vṛtrahantamam |
8,089.01 yena jyotirajanayannṛtāvṛdho devaṃ devāya jāgṛvi ||
8,089.02  apādhamadabhiśastīraśastihāthendro dyumnyābhavat |
8,089.02 devāsta indra sakhyāya yemire bṛhadbhāno marudgaṇa ||
8,089.03  pra va indrāya bṛhate maruto brahmārcata |
8,089.03 vṛtraṃ hanati vṛtrahā śatakraturvajreṇa śataparvaṇā ||
8,089.04  abhi pra bhara dhṛṣatā dhṛṣanmanaḥ śravaścitte asadbṛhat |
8,089.04 arṣantvāpo javasā vi mātaro hano vṛtraṃ jayā svaḥ ||
8,089.05  yajjāyathā apūrvya maghavanvṛtrahatyāya |
8,089.05 tatpṛthivīmaprathayastadastabhnā uta dyām ||
8,089.06  tatte yajño ajāyata tadarka uta haskṛtiḥ |
8,089.06 tadviśvamabhibhūrasi yajjātaṃ yacca jantvam ||
8,089.07  āmāsu pakvamairaya ā sūryaṃ rohayo divi |
8,089.07 gharmaṃ na sāmantapatā suvṛktibhirjuṣṭaṃ girvaṇase bṛhat ||

8,090.01  ā no viśvāsu havya indraḥ samatsu bhūṣatu |
8,090.01 upa brahmāṇi savanāni vṛtrahā paramajyā ṛcīṣamaḥ ||
8,090.02  tvaṃ dātā prathamo rādhasāmasyasi satya īśānakṛt |
8,090.02 tuvidyumnasya yujyā vṛṇīmahe putrasya śavaso mahaḥ ||
8,090.03  brahmā ta indra girvaṇaḥ kriyante anatidbhutā |
8,090.03 imā juṣasva haryaśva yojanendra yā te amanmahi ||
8,090.04  tvaṃ hi satyo maghavannanānato vṛtrā bhūri nyṛñjase |
8,090.04 sa tvaṃ śaviṣṭha vajrahasta dāśuṣe'rvāñcaṃ rayimā kṛdhi ||
8,090.05  tvamindra yaśā asyṛjīṣī śavasaspate |
8,090.05 tvaṃ vṛtrāṇi haṃsyapratīnyeka idanuttā carṣaṇīdhṛtā ||
8,090.06  tamu tvā nūnamasura pracetasaṃ rādho bhāgamivemahe |
8,090.06 mahīva kṛttiḥ śaraṇā ta indra pra te sumnā no aśnavan ||

8,091.01  kanyā vāravāyatī somamapi srutāvidat |
8,091.01 astaṃ bharantyabravīdindrāya sunavai tvā śakrāya sunavai tvā ||
8,091.02  asau ya eṣi vīrako gṛhaṃgṛhaṃ vicākaśad |
8,091.02 imaṃ jambhasutaṃ piba dhānāvantaṃ karambhiṇamapūpavantamukthinam ||
8,091.03  ā cana tvā cikitsāmo'dhi cana tvā nemasi |
8,091.03 śanairiva śanakairivendrāyendo pari srava ||
8,091.04  kuvicchakatkuvitkaratkuvinno vasyasaskarat |
8,091.04 kuvitpatidviṣo yatīrindreṇa saṃgamāmahai ||
8,091.05  imāni trīṇi viṣṭapā tānīndra vi rohaya |
8,091.05 śirastatasyorvarāmādidaṃ ma upodare ||
8,091.06  asau ca yā na urvarādimāṃ tanvaṃ mama |
8,091.06 atho tatasya yacchiraḥ sarvā tā romaśā kṛdhi ||
8,091.07  khe rathasya khe'nasaḥ khe yugasya śatakrato |
8,091.07 apālāmindra triṣpūtvyakṛṇoḥ sūryatvacam ||

8,092.01  pāntamā vo andhasa indramabhi pra gāyata |
8,092.01 viśvāsāhaṃ śatakratuṃ maṃhiṣṭhaṃ carṣaṇīnām ||
8,092.02  puruhūtaṃ puruṣṭutaṃ gāthānyaṃ sanaśrutam |
8,092.02 indra iti bravītana ||
8,092.03  indra inno mahānāṃ dātā vājānāṃ nṛtuḥ |
8,092.03 mahāṃ abhijñvā yamat ||
8,092.04  apādu śipryandhasaḥ sudakṣasya prahoṣiṇaḥ |
8,092.04 indorindro yavāśiraḥ ||
8,092.05  taṃ vabhi prārcatendraṃ somasya pītaye |
8,092.05 tadiddhyasya vardhanam ||
8,092.06  asya pītvā madānāṃ devo devasyaujasā |
8,092.06 viśvābhi bhuvanā bhuvat ||
8,092.07  tyamu vaḥ satrāsāhaṃ viśvāsu gīrṣvāyatam |
8,092.07 ā cyāvayasyūtaye ||
8,092.08  yudhmaṃ santamanarvāṇaṃ somapāmanapacyutam |
8,092.08 naramavāryakratum ||
8,092.09  śikṣā ṇa indra rāya ā puru vidvāṃ ṛcīṣama |
8,092.09 avā naḥ pārye dhane ||
8,092.10  ataścidindra ṇa upā yāhi śatavājayā |
8,092.10 iṣā sahasravājayā ||
8,092.11  ayāma dhīvato dhiyo'rvadbhiḥ śakra godare |
8,092.11 jayema pṛtsu vajrivaḥ ||
8,092.12  vayamu tvā śatakrato gāvo na yavaseṣvā |
8,092.12 uktheṣu raṇayāmasi ||
8,092.13  viśvā hi martyatvanānukāmā śatakrato |
8,092.13 aganma vajrinnāśasaḥ ||
8,092.14  tve su putra śavaso'vṛtrankāmakātayaḥ |
8,092.14 na tvāmindrāti ricyate ||
8,092.15  sa no vṛṣansaniṣṭhayā saṃ ghorayā dravitnvā |
8,092.15 dhiyāviḍḍhi purandhyā ||
8,092.16  yaste nūnaṃ śatakratavindra dyumnitamo madaḥ |
8,092.16 tena nūnaṃ made madeḥ ||
8,092.17  yaste citraśravastamo ya indra vṛtrahantamaḥ |
8,092.17 ya ojodātamo madaḥ ||
8,092.18  vidmā hi yaste adrivastvādattaḥ satya somapāḥ |
8,092.18 viśvāsu dasma kṛṣṭiṣu ||
8,092.19  indrāya madvane sutaṃ pari ṣṭobhantu no giraḥ |
8,092.19 arkamarcantu kāravaḥ ||
8,092.20  yasminviśvā adhi śriyo raṇanti sapta saṃsadaḥ |
8,092.20 indraṃ sute havāmahe ||
8,092.21  trikadrukeṣu cetanaṃ devāso yajñamatnata |
8,092.21 tamidvardhantu no giraḥ ||
8,092.22  ā tvā viśantvindavaḥ samudramiva sindhavaḥ |
8,092.22 na tvāmindrāti ricyate ||
8,092.23  vivyaktha mahinā vṛṣanbhakṣaṃ somasya jāgṛve |
8,092.23 ya indra jaṭhareṣu te ||
8,092.24  araṃ ta indra kukṣaye somo bhavatu vṛtrahan |
8,092.24 araṃ dhāmabhya indavaḥ ||
8,092.25  aramaśvāya gāyati śrutakakṣo araṃ gave |
8,092.25 aramindrasya dhāmne ||
8,092.26  araṃ hi ṣma suteṣu ṇaḥ someṣvindra bhūṣasi |
8,092.26 araṃ te śakra dāvane ||
8,092.27  parākāttāccidadrivastvāṃ nakṣanta no giraḥ |
8,092.27 araṃ gamāma te vayam ||
8,092.28  evā hyasi vīrayurevā śūra uta sthiraḥ |
8,092.28 evā te rādhyaṃ manaḥ ||
8,092.29  evā rātistuvīmagha viśvebhirdhāyi dhātṛbhiḥ |
8,092.29 adhā cidindra me sacā ||
8,092.30  mo ṣu brahmeva tandrayurbhuvo vājānāṃ pate |
8,092.30 matsvā sutasya gomataḥ ||
8,092.31  mā na indrābhyādiśaḥ sūro aktuṣvā yaman |
8,092.31 tvā yujā vanema tat ||
8,092.32  tvayedindra yujā vayaṃ prati bruvīmahi spṛdhaḥ |
8,092.32 tvamasmākaṃ tava smasi ||
8,092.33  tvāmiddhi tvāyavo'nunonuvataścarān |
8,092.33 sakhāya indra kāravaḥ ||

8,093.01  udghedabhi śrutāmaghaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ naryāpasam |
8,093.01 astārameṣi sūrya ||
8,093.02  nava yo navatiṃ puro bibheda bāhvojasā |
8,093.02 ahiṃ ca vṛtrahāvadhīt ||
8,093.03  sa na indraḥ śivaḥ sakhāśvāvadgomadyavamat |
8,093.03 urudhāreva dohate ||
8,093.04  yadadya kacca vṛtrahannudagā abhi sūrya |
8,093.04 sarvaṃ tadindra te vaśe ||
8,093.05  yadvā pravṛddha satpate na marā iti manyase |
8,093.05 uto tatsatyamittava ||
8,093.06  ye somāsaḥ parāvati ye arvāvati sunvire |
8,093.06 sarvāṃstāṃ indra gacchasi ||
8,093.07  tamindraṃ vājayāmasi mahe vṛtrāya hantave |
8,093.07 sa vṛṣā vṛṣabho bhuvat ||
8,093.08  indraḥ sa dāmane kṛta ojiṣṭhaḥ sa made hitaḥ |
8,093.08 dyumnī ślokī sa somyaḥ ||
8,093.09  girā vajro na sambhṛtaḥ sabalo anapacyutaḥ |
8,093.09 vavakṣa ṛṣvo astṛtaḥ ||
8,093.10  durge cinnaḥ sugaṃ kṛdhi gṛṇāna indra girvaṇaḥ |
8,093.10 tvaṃ ca maghavanvaśaḥ ||
8,093.11  yasya te nū cidādiśaṃ na minanti svarājyam |
8,093.11 na devo nādhrigurjanaḥ ||
8,093.12  adhā te apratiṣkutaṃ devī śuṣmaṃ saparyataḥ |
8,093.12 ubhe suśipra rodasī ||
8,093.13  tvametadadhārayaḥ kṛṣṇāsu rohiṇīṣu ca |
8,093.13 paruṣṇīṣu ruśatpayaḥ ||
8,093.14  vi yadaheradha tviṣo viśve devāso akramuḥ |
8,093.14 vidanmṛgasya tāṃ amaḥ ||
8,093.15  ādu me nivaro bhuvadvṛtrahādiṣṭa pauṃsyam |
8,093.15 ajātaśatrurastṛtaḥ ||
8,093.16  śrutaṃ vo vṛtrahantamaṃ pra śardhaṃ carṣaṇīnām |
8,093.16 ā śuṣe rādhase mahe ||
8,093.17  ayā dhiyā ca gavyayā puruṇāmanpuruṣṭuta |
8,093.17 yatsomesoma ābhavaḥ ||
8,093.18  bodhinmanā idastu no vṛtrahā bhūryāsutiḥ |
8,093.18 śṛṇotu śakra āśiṣam ||
8,093.19  kayā tvaṃ na ūtyābhi pra mandase vṛṣan |
8,093.19 kayā stotṛbhya ā bhara ||
8,093.20  kasya vṛṣā sute sacā niyutvānvṛṣabho raṇat |
8,093.20 vṛtrahā somapītaye ||
8,093.21  abhī ṣu ṇastvaṃ rayiṃ mandasānaḥ sahasriṇam |
8,093.21 prayantā bodhi dāśuṣe ||
8,093.22  patnīvantaḥ sutā ima uśanto yanti vītaye |
8,093.22 apāṃ jagmirnicumpuṇaḥ ||
8,093.23  iṣṭā hotrā asṛkṣatendraṃ vṛdhāso adhvare |
8,093.23 acchāvabhṛthamojasā ||
8,093.24  iha tyā sadhamādyā harī hiraṇyakeśyā |
8,093.24 voḻhāmabhi prayo hitam ||
8,093.25  tubhyaṃ somāḥ sutā ime stīrṇaṃ barhirvibhāvaso |
8,093.25 stotṛbhya indramā vaha ||
8,093.26  ā te dakṣaṃ vi rocanā dadhadratnā vi dāśuṣe |
8,093.26 stotṛbhya indramarcata ||
8,093.27  ā te dadhāmīndriyamukthā viśvā śatakrato |
8,093.27 stotṛbhya indra mṛḻaya ||
8,093.28  bhadrambhadraṃ na ā bhareṣamūrjaṃ śatakrato |
8,093.28 yadindra mṛḻayāsi naḥ ||
8,093.29  sa no viśvānyā bhara suvitāni śatakrato |
8,093.29 yadindra mṛḻayāsi naḥ ||
8,093.30  tvāmidvṛtrahantama sutāvanto havāmahe |
8,093.30 yadindra mṛḻayāsi naḥ ||
8,093.31  upa no haribhiḥ sutaṃ yāhi madānāṃ pate |
8,093.31 upa no haribhiḥ sutam ||
8,093.32  dvitā yo vṛtrahantamo vida indraḥ śatakratuḥ |
8,093.32 upa no haribhiḥ sutam ||
8,093.33  tvaṃ hi vṛtrahanneṣāṃ pātā somānāmasi |
8,093.33 upa no haribhiḥ sutam ||
8,093.34  indra iṣe dadātu na ṛbhukṣaṇamṛbhuṃ rayim |
8,093.34 vājī dadātu vājinam ||

8,094.01  gaurdhayati marutāṃ śravasyurmātā maghonām |
8,094.01 yuktā vahnī rathānām ||
8,094.02  yasyā devā upasthe vratā viśve dhārayante |
8,094.02 sūryāmāsā dṛśe kam ||
8,094.03  tatsu no viśve arya ā sadā gṛṇanti kāravaḥ |
8,094.03 marutaḥ somapītaye ||
8,094.04  asti somo ayaṃ sutaḥ pibantyasya marutaḥ |
8,094.04 uta svarājo aśvinā ||
8,094.05  pibanti mitro aryamā tanā pūtasya varuṇaḥ |
8,094.05 triṣadhasthasya jāvataḥ ||
8,094.06  uto nvasya joṣamāṃ indraḥ sutasya gomataḥ |
8,094.06 prātarhoteva matsati ||
8,094.07  kadatviṣanta sūrayastira āpa iva sridhaḥ |
8,094.07 arṣanti pūtadakṣasaḥ ||
8,094.08  kadvo adya mahānāṃ devānāmavo vṛṇe |
8,094.08 tmanā ca dasmavarcasām ||
8,094.09  ā ye viśvā pārthivāni paprathanrocanā divaḥ |
8,094.09 marutaḥ somapītaye ||
8,094.10  tyānnu pūtadakṣaso divo vo maruto huve |
8,094.10 asya somasya pītaye ||
8,094.11  tyānnu ye vi rodasī tastabhurmaruto huve |
8,094.11 asya somasya pītaye ||
8,094.12  tyaṃ nu mārutaṃ gaṇaṃ giriṣṭhāṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ huve |
8,094.12 asya somasya pītaye ||

8,095.01  ā tvā giro rathīrivāsthuḥ suteṣu girvaṇaḥ |
8,095.01 abhi tvā samanūṣatendra vatsaṃ na mātaraḥ ||
8,095.02  ā tvā śukrā acucyavuḥ sutāsa indra girvaṇaḥ |
8,095.02 pibā tvasyāndhasa indra viśvāsu te hitam ||
8,095.03  pibā somaṃ madāya kamindra śyenābhṛtaṃ sutam |
8,095.03 tvaṃ hi śaśvatīnāṃ patī rājā viśāmasi ||
8,095.04  śrudhī havaṃ tiraścyā indra yastvā saparyati |
8,095.04 suvīryasya gomato rāyaspūrdhi mahāṃ asi ||
8,095.05  indra yaste navīyasīṃ giraṃ mandrāmajījanat |
8,095.05 cikitvinmanasaṃ dhiyaṃ pratnāmṛtasya pipyuṣīm ||
8,095.06  tamu ṣṭavāma yaṃ gira indramukthāni vāvṛdhuḥ |
8,095.06 purūṇyasya pauṃsyā siṣāsanto vanāmahe ||
8,095.07  eto nvindraṃ stavāma śuddhaṃ śuddhena sāmnā |
8,095.07 śuddhairukthairvāvṛdhvāṃsaṃ śuddha āśīrvānmamattu ||
8,095.08  indra śuddho na ā gahi śuddhaḥ śuddhābhirūtibhiḥ |
8,095.08 śuddho rayiṃ ni dhāraya śuddho mamaddhi somyaḥ ||
8,095.09  indra śuddho hi no rayiṃ śuddho ratnāni dāśuṣe |
8,095.09 śuddho vṛtrāṇi jighnase śuddho vājaṃ siṣāsasi ||

8,096.01  asmā uṣāsa ātiranta yāmamindrāya naktamūrmyāḥ suvācaḥ |
8,096.01 asmā āpo mātaraḥ sapta tasthurnṛbhyastarāya sindhavaḥ supārāḥ ||
8,096.02  atividdhā vithureṇā cidastrā triḥ sapta sānu saṃhitā girīṇām |
8,096.02 na taddevo na martyastuturyādyāni pravṛddho vṛṣabhaścakāra ||
8,096.03  indrasya vajra āyaso nimiśla indrasya bāhvorbhūyiṣṭhamojaḥ |
8,096.03 śīrṣannindrasya kratavo nireka āsanneṣanta śrutyā upāke ||
8,096.04  manye tvā yajñiyaṃ yajñiyānāṃ manye tvā cyavanamacyutānām |
8,096.04 manye tvā satvanāmindra ketuṃ manye tvā vṛṣabhaṃ carṣaṇīnām ||
8,096.05  ā yadvajraṃ bāhvorindra dhatse madacyutamahaye hantavā u |
8,096.05 pra parvatā anavanta pra gāvaḥ pra brahmāṇo abhinakṣanta indram ||
8,096.06  tamu ṣṭavāma ya imā jajāna viśvā jātānyavarāṇyasmāt |
8,096.06 indreṇa mitraṃ didhiṣema gīrbhirupo namobhirvṛṣabhaṃ viśema ||
8,096.07  vṛtrasya tvā śvasathādīṣamāṇā viśve devā ajahurye sakhāyaḥ |
8,096.07 marudbhirindra sakhyaṃ te astvathemā viśvāḥ pṛtanā jayāsi ||
8,096.08  triḥ ṣaṣṭistvā maruto vāvṛdhānā usrā iva rāśayo yajñiyāsaḥ |
8,096.08 upa tvemaḥ kṛdhi no bhāgadheyaṃ śuṣmaṃ ta enā haviṣā vidhema ||
8,096.09  tigmamāyudhaṃ marutāmanīkaṃ kasta indra prati vajraṃ dadharṣa |
8,096.09 anāyudhāso asurā adevāścakreṇa tāṃ apa vapa ṛjīṣin ||
8,096.10  maha ugrāya tavase suvṛktiṃ preraya śivatamāya paśvaḥ |
8,096.10 girvāhase gira indrāya pūrvīrdhehi tanve kuvidaṅga vedat ||
8,096.11  ukthavāhase vibhve manīṣāṃ druṇā na pāramīrayā nadīnām |
8,096.11 ni spṛśa dhiyā tanvi śrutasya juṣṭatarasya kuvidaṅga vedat ||
8,096.12  tadviviḍḍhi yatta indro jujoṣatstuhi suṣṭutiṃ namasā vivāsa |
8,096.12 upa bhūṣa jaritarmā ruvaṇyaḥ śrāvayā vācaṃ kuvidaṅga vedat ||
8,096.13  ava drapso aṃśumatīmatiṣṭhadiyānaḥ kṛṣṇo daśabhiḥ sahasraiḥ |
8,096.13 āvattamindraḥ śacyā dhamantamapa snehitīrnṛmaṇā adhatta ||
8,096.14  drapsamapaśyaṃ viṣuṇe carantamupahvare nadyo aṃśumatyāḥ |
8,096.14 nabho na kṛṣṇamavatasthivāṃsamiṣyāmi vo vṛṣaṇo yudhyatājau ||
8,096.15  adha drapso aṃśumatyā upasthe'dhārayattanvaṃ titviṣāṇaḥ |
8,096.15 viśo adevīrabhyācarantīrbṛhaspatinā yujendraḥ sasāhe ||
8,096.16  tvaṃ ha tyatsaptabhyo jāyamāno'śatrubhyo abhavaḥ śatrurindra |
8,096.16 gūḻhe dyāvāpṛthivī anvavindo vibhumadbhyo bhuvanebhyo raṇaṃ dhāḥ ||
8,096.17  tvaṃ ha tyadapratimānamojo vajreṇa vajrindhṛṣito jaghantha |
8,096.17 tvaṃ śuṣṇasyāvātiro vadhatraistvaṃ gā indra śacyedavindaḥ ||
8,096.18  tvaṃ ha tyadvṛṣabha carṣaṇīnāṃ ghano vṛtrāṇāṃ taviṣo babhūtha |
8,096.18 tvaṃ sindhūṃrasṛjastastabhānāntvamapo ajayo dāsapatnīḥ ||
8,096.19  sa sukratū raṇitā yaḥ suteṣvanuttamanyuryo aheva revān |
8,096.19 ya eka innaryapāṃsi kartā sa vṛtrahā pratīdanyamāhuḥ ||
8,096.20  sa vṛtrahendraścarṣaṇīdhṛttaṃ suṣṭutyā havyaṃ huvema |
8,096.20 sa prāvitā maghavā no'dhivaktā sa vājasya śravasyasya dātā ||
8,096.21  sa vṛtrahendra ṛbhukṣāḥ sadyo jajñāno havyo babhūva |
8,096.21 kṛṇvannapāṃsi naryā purūṇi somo na pīto havyaḥ sakhibhyaḥ ||

8,097.01  yā indra bhuja ābharaḥ svarvāṃ asurebhyaḥ |
8,097.01 stotāraminmaghavannasya vardhaya ye ca tve vṛktabarhiṣaḥ ||
8,097.02  yamindra dadhiṣe tvamaśvaṃ gāṃ bhāgamavyayam |
8,097.02 yajamāne sunvati dakṣiṇāvati tasmintaṃ dhehi mā paṇau ||
8,097.03  ya indra sastyavrato'nuṣvāpamadevayuḥ |
8,097.03 svaiḥ ṣa evairmumuratpoṣyaṃ rayiṃ sanutardhehi taṃ tataḥ ||
8,097.04  yacchakrāsi parāvati yadarvāvati vṛtrahan |
8,097.04 atastvā gīrbhirdyugadindra keśibhiḥ sutāvāṃ ā vivāsati ||
8,097.05  yadvāsi rocane divaḥ samudrasyādhi viṣṭapi |
8,097.05 yatpārthive sadane vṛtrahantama yadantarikṣa ā gahi ||
8,097.06  sa naḥ someṣu somapāḥ suteṣu śavasaspate |
8,097.06 mādayasva rādhasā sūnṛtāvatendra rāyā parīṇasā ||
8,097.07  mā na indra parā vṛṇagbhavā naḥ sadhamādyaḥ |
8,097.07 tvaṃ na ūtī tvaminna āpyaṃ mā na indra parā vṛṇak ||
8,097.08  asme indra sacā sute ni ṣadā pītaye madhu |
8,097.08 kṛdhī jaritre maghavannavo mahadasme indra sacā sute ||
8,097.09  na tvā devāsa āśata na martyāso adrivaḥ |
8,097.09 viśvā jātāni śavasābhibhūrasi na tvā devāsa āśata ||
8,097.10  viśvāḥ pṛtanā abhibhūtaraṃ naraṃ sajūstatakṣurindraṃ jajanuśca rājase |
8,097.10 kratvā variṣṭhaṃ vara āmurimutogramojiṣṭhaṃ tavasaṃ tarasvinam ||
8,097.11  samīṃ rebhāso asvarannindraṃ somasya pītaye |
8,097.11 svarpatiṃ yadīṃ vṛdhe dhṛtavrato hyojasā samūtibhiḥ ||
8,097.12  nemiṃ namanti cakṣasā meṣaṃ viprā abhisvarā |
8,097.12 sudītayo vo adruho'pi karṇe tarasvinaḥ samṛkvabhiḥ ||
8,097.13  tamindraṃ johavīmi maghavānamugraṃ satrā dadhānamapratiṣkutaṃ śavāṃsi |
8,097.13 maṃhiṣṭho gīrbhirā ca yajñiyo vavartadrāye no viśvā supathā kṛṇotu vajrī ||
8,097.14  tvaṃ pura indra cikidenā vyojasā śaviṣṭha śakra nāśayadhyai |
8,097.14 tvadviśvāni bhuvanāni vajrindyāvā rejete pṛthivī ca bhīṣā ||
8,097.15  tanma ṛtamindra śūra citra pātvapo na vajrinduritāti parṣi bhūri |
8,097.15 kadā na indra rāya ā daśasyerviśvapsnyasya spṛhayāyyasya rājan ||

8,098.01  indrāya sāma gāyata viprāya bṛhate bṛhat |
8,098.01 dharmakṛte vipaścite panasyave ||
8,098.02  tvamindrābhibhūrasi tvaṃ sūryamarocayaḥ |
8,098.02 viśvakarmā viśvadevo mahāṃ asi ||
8,098.03  vibhrājañjyotiṣā svaragaccho rocanaṃ divaḥ |
8,098.03 devāsta indra sakhyāya yemire ||
8,098.04  endra no gadhi priyaḥ satrājidagohyaḥ |
8,098.04 girirna viśvataspṛthuḥ patirdivaḥ ||
8,098.05  abhi hi satya somapā ubhe babhūtha rodasī |
8,098.05 indrāsi sunvato vṛdhaḥ patirdivaḥ ||
8,098.06  tvaṃ hi śaśvatīnāmindra dartā purāmasi |
8,098.06 hantā dasyormanorvṛdhaḥ patirdivaḥ ||
8,098.07  adhā hīndra girvaṇa upa tvā kāmānmahaḥ sasṛjmahe |
8,098.07 udeva yanta udabhiḥ ||
8,098.08  vārṇa tvā yavyābhirvardhanti śūra brahmāṇi |
8,098.08 vāvṛdhvāṃsaṃ cidadrivo divedive ||
8,098.09  yuñjanti harī iṣirasya gāthayorau ratha uruyuge |
8,098.09 indravāhā vacoyujā ||
8,098.10  tvaṃ na indrā bharaṃ ojo nṛmṇaṃ śatakrato vicarṣaṇe |
8,098.10 ā vīraṃ pṛtanāṣaham ||
8,098.11  tvaṃ hi naḥ pitā vaso tvaṃ mātā śatakrato babhūvitha |
8,098.11 adhā te sumnamīmahe ||
8,098.12  tvāṃ śuṣminpuruhūta vājayantamupa bruve śatakrato |
8,098.12 sa no rāsva suvīryam ||

8,099.01  tvāmidā hyo naro'pīpyanvajrinbhūrṇayaḥ |
8,099.01 sa indra stomavāhasāmiha śrudhyupa svasaramā gahi ||
8,099.02  matsvā suśipra harivastadīmahe tve ā bhūṣanti vedhasaḥ |
8,099.02 tava śravāṃsyupamānyukthyā suteṣvindra girvaṇaḥ ||
8,099.03  śrāyanta iva sūryaṃ viśvedindrasya bhakṣata |
8,099.03 vasūni jāte janamāna ojasā prati bhāgaṃ na dīdhima ||
8,099.04  anarśarātiṃ vasudāmupa stuhi bhadrā indrasya rātayaḥ |
8,099.04 so asya kāmaṃ vidhato na roṣati mano dānāya codayan ||
8,099.05  tvamindra pratūrtiṣvabhi viśvā asi spṛdhaḥ |
8,099.05 aśastihā janitā viśvatūrasi tvaṃ tūrya taruṣyataḥ ||
8,099.06  anu te śuṣmaṃ turayantamīyatuḥ kṣoṇī śiśuṃ na mātarā |
8,099.06 viśvāste spṛdhaḥ śnathayanta manyave vṛtraṃ yadindra tūrvasi ||
8,099.07  ita ūtī vo ajaraṃ prahetāramaprahitam |
8,099.07 āśuṃ jetāraṃ hetāraṃ rathītamamatūrtaṃ tugryāvṛdham ||
8,099.08  iṣkartāramaniṣkṛtaṃ sahaskṛtaṃ śatamūtiṃ śatakratum |
8,099.08 samānamindramavase havāmahe vasavānaṃ vasūjuvam ||

8,100.01  ayaṃ ta emi tanvā purastādviśve devā abhi mā yanti paścāt |
8,100.01 yadā mahyaṃ dīdharo bhāgamindrādinmayā kṛṇavo vīryāṇi ||
8,100.02  dadhāmi te madhuno bhakṣamagre hitaste bhāgaḥ suto astu somaḥ |
8,100.02 asaśca tvaṃ dakṣiṇataḥ sakhā me'dhā vṛtrāṇi jaṅghanāva bhūri ||
8,100.03  pra su stomaṃ bharata vājayanta indrāya satyaṃ yadi satyamasti |
8,100.03 nendro astīti nema u tva āha ka īṃ dadarśa kamabhi ṣṭavāma ||
8,100.04  ayamasmi jaritaḥ paśya meha viśvā jātānyabhyasmi mahnā |
8,100.04 ṛtasya mā pradiśo vardhayantyādardiro bhuvanā dardarīmi ||
8,100.05  ā yanmā venā aruhannṛtasyaṃ ekamāsīnaṃ haryatasya pṛṣṭhe |
8,100.05 manaścinme hṛda ā pratyavocadacikradañchiśumantaḥ sakhāyaḥ ||
8,100.06  viśvettā te savaneṣu pravācyā yā cakartha maghavannindra sunvate |
8,100.06 pārāvataṃ yatpurusambhṛtaṃ vasvapāvṛṇoḥ śarabhāya ṛṣibandhave ||
8,100.07  pra nūnaṃ dhāvatā pṛthaṅneha yo vo avāvarīt |
8,100.07 ni ṣīṃ vṛtrasya marmaṇi vajramindro apīpatat ||
8,100.08  manojavā ayamāna āyasīmataratpuram |
8,100.08 divaṃ suparṇo gatvāya somaṃ vajriṇa ābharat ||
8,100.09  samudre antaḥ śayata udnā vajro abhīvṛtaḥ |
8,100.09 bharantyasmai saṃyataḥ puraḥprasravaṇā balim ||
8,100.10  yadvāgvadantyavicetanāni rāṣṭrī devānāṃ niṣasāda mandrā |
8,100.10 catasra ūrjaṃ duduhe payāṃsi kva svidasyāḥ paramaṃ jagāma ||
8,100.11  devīṃ vācamajanayanta devāstāṃ viśvarūpāḥ paśavo vadanti |
8,100.11 sā no mandreṣamūrjaṃ duhānā dhenurvāgasmānupa suṣṭutaitu ||
8,100.12  sakhe viṣṇo vitaraṃ vi kramasva dyaurdehi lokaṃ vajrāya viṣkabhe |
8,100.12 hanāva vṛtraṃ riṇacāva sindhūnindrasya yantu prasave visṛṣṭāḥ ||

8,101.01  ṛdhagitthā sa martyaḥ śaśame devatātaye |
8,101.01 yo nūnaṃ mitrāvaruṇāvabhiṣṭaya ācakre havyadātaye ||
8,101.02  varṣiṣṭhakṣatrā urucakṣasā narā rājānā dīrghaśruttamā |
8,101.02 tā bāhutā na daṃsanā ratharyataḥ sākaṃ sūryasya raśmibhiḥ ||
8,101.03  pra yo vāṃ mitrāvaruṇājiro dūto adravat |
8,101.03 ayaḥśīrṣā maderaghuḥ ||
8,101.04  na yaḥ sampṛcche na punarhavītave na saṃvādāya ramate |
8,101.04 tasmānno adya samṛteruruṣyataṃ bāhubhyāṃ na uruṣyatam ||
8,101.05  pra mitrāya prāryamṇe sacathyamṛtāvaso |
8,101.05 varūthyaṃ varuṇe chandyaṃ vaca stotraṃ rājasu gāyata ||
8,101.06  te hinvire aruṇaṃ jenyaṃ vasvekaṃ putraṃ tisṝṇām |
8,101.06 te dhāmānyamṛtā martyānāmadabdhā abhi cakṣate ||
8,101.07  ā me vacāṃsyudyatā dyumattamāni kartvā |
8,101.07 ubhā yātaṃ nāsatyā sajoṣasā prati havyāni vītaye ||
8,101.08  rātiṃ yadvāmarakṣasaṃ havāmahe yuvābhyāṃ vājinīvasū |
8,101.08 prācīṃ hotrāṃ pratirantāvitaṃ narā gṛṇānā jamadagninā ||
8,101.09  ā no yajñaṃ divispṛśaṃ vāyo yāhi sumanmabhiḥ |
8,101.09 antaḥ pavitra upari śrīṇāno'yaṃ śukro ayāmi te ||
8,101.10  vetyadhvaryuḥ pathibhī rajiṣṭhaiḥ prati havyāni vītaye |
8,101.10 adhā niyutva ubhayasya naḥ piba śuciṃ somaṃ gavāśiram ||
8,101.11  baṇmahāṃ asi sūrya baḻ āditya mahāṃ asi |
8,101.11 mahaste sato mahimā panasyate'ddhā deva mahāṃ asi ||
8,101.12  baṭsūrya śravasā mahāṃ asi satrā deva mahāṃ asi |
8,101.12 mahnā devānāmasuryaḥ purohito vibhu jyotiradābhyam ||
8,101.13  iyaṃ yā nīcyarkiṇī rūpā rohiṇyā kṛtā |
8,101.13 citreva pratyadarśyāyatyantardaśasu bāhuṣu ||
8,101.14  prajā ha tisro atyāyamīyurnyanyā arkamabhito viviśre |
8,101.14 bṛhaddha tasthau bhuvaneṣvantaḥ pavamāno harita ā viveśa ||
8,101.15  mātā rudrāṇāṃ duhitā vasūnāṃ svasādityānāmamṛtasya nābhiḥ |
8,101.15 pra nu vocaṃ cikituṣe janāya mā gāmanāgāmaditiṃ vadhiṣṭa ||
8,101.16  vacovidaṃ vācamudīrayantīṃ viśvābhirdhībhirupatiṣṭhamānām |
8,101.16 devīṃ devebhyaḥ paryeyuṣīṃ gāmā māvṛkta martyo dabhracetāḥ ||

8,102.01  tvamagne bṛhadvayo dadhāsi deva dāśuṣe |
8,102.01 kavirgṛhapatiryuvā ||
8,102.02  sa na īḻānayā saha devāṃ agne duvasyuvā |
8,102.02 cikidvibhānavā vaha ||
8,102.03  tvayā ha svidyujā vayaṃ codiṣṭhena yaviṣṭhya |
8,102.03 abhi ṣmo vājasātaye ||
8,102.04  aurvabhṛguvacchucimapnavānavadā huve |
8,102.04 agniṃ samudravāsasam ||
8,102.05  huve vātasvanaṃ kaviṃ parjanyakrandyaṃ sahaḥ |
8,102.05 agniṃ samudravāsasam ||
8,102.06  ā savaṃ savituryathā bhagasyeva bhujiṃ huve |
8,102.06 agniṃ samudravāsasam ||
8,102.07  agniṃ vo vṛdhantamadhvarāṇāṃ purūtamam |
8,102.07 acchā naptre sahasvate ||
8,102.08  ayaṃ yathā na ābhuvattvaṣṭā rūpeva takṣyā |
8,102.08 asya kratvā yaśasvataḥ ||
8,102.09  ayaṃ viśvā abhi śriyo'gnirdeveṣu patyate |
8,102.09 ā vājairupa no gamat ||
8,102.10  viśveṣāmiha stuhi hotṝṇāṃ yaśastamam |
8,102.10 agniṃ yajñeṣu pūrvyam ||
8,102.11  śīraṃ pāvakaśociṣaṃ jyeṣṭho yo dameṣvā |
8,102.11 dīdāya dīrghaśruttamaḥ ||
8,102.12  tamarvantaṃ na sānasiṃ gṛṇīhi vipra śuṣmiṇam |
8,102.12 mitraṃ na yātayajjanam ||
8,102.13  upa tvā jāmayo giro dediśatīrhaviṣkṛtaḥ |
8,102.13 vāyoranīke asthiran ||
8,102.14  yasya tridhātvavṛtaṃ barhistasthāvasaṃdinam |
8,102.14 āpaścinni dadhā padam ||
8,102.15  padaṃ devasya mīḻhuṣo'nādhṛṣṭābhirūtibhiḥ |
8,102.15 bhadrā sūrya ivopadṛk ||
8,102.16  agne ghṛtasya dhītibhistepāno deva śociṣā |
8,102.16 ā devānvakṣi yakṣi ca ||
8,102.17  taṃ tvājananta mātaraḥ kaviṃ devāso aṅgiraḥ |
8,102.17 havyavāhamamartyam ||
8,102.18  pracetasaṃ tvā kave'gne dūtaṃ vareṇyam |
8,102.18 havyavāhaṃ ni ṣedire ||
8,102.19  nahi me astyaghnyā na svadhitirvananvati |
8,102.19 athaitādṛgbharāmi te ||
8,102.20  yadagne kāni kāni cidā te dārūṇi dadhmasi |
8,102.20 tā juṣasva yaviṣṭhya ||
8,102.21  yadattyupajihvikā yadvamro atisarpati |
8,102.21 sarvaṃ tadastu te ghṛtam ||
8,102.22  agnimindhāno manasā dhiyaṃ saceta martyaḥ |
8,102.22 agnimīdhe vivasvabhiḥ ||

8,103.01  adarśi gātuvittamo yasminvratānyādadhuḥ |
8,103.01 upo ṣu jātamāryasya vardhanamagniṃ nakṣanta no giraḥ ||
8,103.02  pra daivodāso agnirdevāṃ acchā na majmanā |
8,103.02 anu mātaraṃ pṛthivīṃ vi vāvṛte tasthau nākasya sānavi ||
8,103.03  yasmādrejanta kṛṣṭayaścarkṛtyāni kṛṇvataḥ |
8,103.03 sahasrasāṃ medhasātāviva tmanāgniṃ dhībhiḥ saparyata ||
8,103.04  pra yaṃ rāye ninīṣasi marto yaste vaso dāśat |
8,103.04 sa vīraṃ dhatte agna ukthaśaṃsinaṃ tmanā sahasrapoṣiṇam ||
8,103.05  sa dṛḻhe cidabhi tṛṇatti vājamarvatā sa dhatte akṣiti śravaḥ |
8,103.05 tve devatrā sadā purūvaso viśvā vāmāni dhīmahi ||
8,103.06  yo viśvā dayate vasu hotā mandro janānām |
8,103.06 madhorna pātrā prathamānyasmai pra stomā yantyagnaye ||
8,103.07  aśvaṃ na gīrbhī rathyaṃ sudānavo marmṛjyante devayavaḥ |
8,103.07 ubhe toke tanaye dasma viśpate parṣi rādho maghonām ||
8,103.08  pra maṃhiṣṭhāya gāyata ṛtāvne bṛhate śukraśociṣe |
8,103.08 upastutāso agnaye ||
8,103.09  ā vaṃsate maghavā vīravadyaśaḥ samiddho dyumnyāhutaḥ |
8,103.09 kuvinno asya sumatirnavīyasyacchā vājebhirāgamat ||
8,103.10  preṣṭhamu priyāṇāṃ stuhyāsāvātithim |
8,103.10 agniṃ rathānāṃ yamam ||
8,103.11  uditā yo niditā veditā vasvā yajñiyo vavartati |
8,103.11 duṣṭarā yasya pravaṇe normayo dhiyā vājaṃ siṣāsataḥ ||
8,103.12  mā no hṛṇītāmatithirvasuragniḥ purupraśasta eṣaḥ |
8,103.12 yaḥ suhotā svadhvaraḥ ||
8,103.13  mo te riṣanye acchoktibhirvaso'gne kebhiścidevaiḥ |
8,103.13 kīriściddhi tvāmīṭṭe dūtyāya rātahavyaḥ svadhvaraḥ ||
8,103.14  āgne yāhi marutsakhā rudrebhiḥ somapītaye |
8,103.14 sobharyā upa suṣṭutiṃ mādayasva svarṇare ||








ṛgveda 9



9,001.01  svādiṣṭhayā madiṣṭhayā pavasva soma dhārayā |
9,001.01 indrāya pātave sutaḥ ||
9,001.02  rakṣohā viśvacarṣaṇirabhi yonimayohatam |
9,001.02 druṇā sadhasthamāsadat ||
9,001.03  varivodhātamo bhava maṃhiṣṭho vṛtrahantamaḥ |
9,001.03 parṣi rādho maghonām ||
9,001.04  abhyarṣa mahānāṃ devānāṃ vītimandhasā |
9,001.04 abhi vājamuta śravaḥ ||
9,001.05  tvāmacchā carāmasi tadidarthaṃ divedive |
9,001.05 indo tve na āśasaḥ ||
9,001.06  punāti te parisrutaṃ somaṃ sūryasya duhitā |
9,001.06 vāreṇa śaśvatā tanā ||
9,001.07  tamīmaṇvīḥ samarya ā gṛbhṇanti yoṣaṇo daśa |
9,001.07 svasāraḥ pārye divi ||
9,001.08  tamīṃ hinvantyagruvo dhamanti bākuraṃ dṛtim |
9,001.08 tridhātu vāraṇaṃ madhu ||
9,001.09  abhīmamaghnyā uta śrīṇanti dhenavaḥ śiśum |
9,001.09 somamindrāya pātave ||
9,001.10  asyedindro madeṣvā viśvā vṛtrāṇi jighnate |
9,001.10 śūro maghā ca maṃhate ||

9,002.01  pavasva devavīrati pavitraṃ soma raṃhyā |
9,002.01 indramindo vṛṣā viśa ||
9,002.02  ā vacyasva mahi psaro vṛṣendo dyumnavattamaḥ |
9,002.02 ā yoniṃ dharṇasiḥ sadaḥ ||
9,002.03  adhukṣata priyaṃ madhu dhārā sutasya vedhasaḥ |
9,002.03 apo vasiṣṭa sukratuḥ ||
9,002.04  mahāntaṃ tvā mahīranvāpo arṣanti sindhavaḥ |
9,002.04 yadgobhirvāsayiṣyase ||
9,002.05  samudro apsu māmṛje viṣṭambho dharuṇo divaḥ |
9,002.05 somaḥ pavitre asmayuḥ ||
9,002.06  acikradadvṛṣā harirmahānmitro na darśataḥ |
9,002.06 saṃ sūryeṇa rocate ||
9,002.07  girasta inda ojasā marmṛjyante apasyuvaḥ |
9,002.07 yābhirmadāya śumbhase ||
9,002.08  taṃ tvā madāya ghṛṣvaya u lokakṛtnumīmahe |
9,002.08 tava praśastayo mahīḥ ||
9,002.09  asmabhyamindavindrayurmadhvaḥ pavasva dhārayā |
9,002.09 parjanyo vṛṣṭimāṃ iva ||
9,002.10  goṣā indo nṛṣā asyaśvasā vājasā uta |
9,002.10 ātmā yajñasya pūrvyaḥ ||

9,003.01  eṣa devo amartyaḥ parṇavīriva dīyati |
9,003.01 abhi droṇānyāsadam ||
9,003.02  eṣa devo vipā kṛto'ti hvarāṃsi dhāvati |
9,003.02 pavamāno adābhyaḥ ||
9,003.03  eṣa devo vipanyubhiḥ pavamāna ṛtāyubhiḥ |
9,003.03 harirvājāya mṛjyate ||
9,003.04  eṣa viśvāni vāryā śūro yanniva satvabhiḥ |
9,003.04 pavamānaḥ siṣāsati ||
9,003.05  eṣa devo ratharyati pavamāno daśasyati |
9,003.05 āviṣkṛṇoti vagvanum ||
9,003.06  eṣa viprairabhiṣṭuto'po devo vi gāhate |
9,003.06 dadhadratnāni dāśuṣe ||
9,003.07  eṣa divaṃ vi dhāvati tiro rajāṃsi dhārayā |
9,003.07 pavamānaḥ kanikradat ||
9,003.08  eṣa divaṃ vyāsarattiro rajāṃsyaspṛtaḥ |
9,003.08 pavamānaḥ svadhvaraḥ ||
9,003.09  eṣa pratnena janmanā devo devebhyaḥ sutaḥ |
9,003.09 hariḥ pavitre arṣati ||
9,003.10  eṣa u sya puruvrato jajñāno janayanniṣaḥ |
9,003.10 dhārayā pavate sutaḥ ||

9,004.01  sanā ca soma jeṣi ca pavamāna mahi śravaḥ |
9,004.01 athā no vasyasaskṛdhi ||
9,004.02  sanā jyotiḥ sanā svarviśvā ca soma saubhagā |
9,004.02 athā no vasyasaskṛdhi ||
9,004.03  sanā dakṣamuta kratumapa soma mṛdho jahi |
9,004.03 athā no vasyasaskṛdhi ||
9,004.04  pavītāraḥ punītana somamindrāya pātave |
9,004.04 athā no vasyasaskṛdhi ||
9,004.05  tvaṃ sūrye na ā bhaja tava kratvā tavotibhiḥ |
9,004.05 athā no vasyasaskṛdhi ||
9,004.06  tava kratvā tavotibhirjyokpaśyema sūryam |
9,004.06 athā no vasyasaskṛdhi ||
9,004.07  abhyarṣa svāyudha soma dvibarhasaṃ rayim |
9,004.07 athā no vasyasaskṛdhi ||
9,004.08  abhyarṣānapacyuto rayiṃ samatsu sāsahiḥ |
9,004.08 athā no vasyasaskṛdhi ||
9,004.09  tvāṃ yajñairavīvṛdhanpavamāna vidharmaṇi |
9,004.09 athā no vasyasaskṛdhi ||
9,004.10  rayiṃ naścitramaśvinamindo viśvāyumā bhara |
9,004.10 athā no vasyasaskṛdhi ||

9,005.01  samiddho viśvataspatiḥ pavamāno vi rājati |
9,005.01 prīṇanvṛṣā kanikradat ||
9,005.02  tanūnapātpavamānaḥ śṛṅge śiśāno arṣati |
9,005.02 antarikṣeṇa rārajat ||
9,005.03  īḻenyaḥ pavamāno rayirvi rājati dyumān |
9,005.03 madhordhārābhirojasā ||
9,005.04  barhiḥ prācīnamojasā pavamāna stṛṇanhariḥ |
9,005.04 deveṣu deva īyate ||
9,005.05  udātairjihate bṛhaddvāro devīrhiraṇyayīḥ |
9,005.05 pavamānena suṣṭutāḥ ||
9,005.06  suśilpe bṛhatī mahī pavamāno vṛṣaṇyati |
9,005.06 naktoṣāsā na darśate ||
9,005.07  ubhā devā nṛcakṣasā hotārā daivyā huve |
9,005.07 pavamāna indro vṛṣā ||
9,005.08  bhāratī pavamānasya sarasvatīḻā mahī |
9,005.08 imaṃ no yajñamā gamantisro devīḥ supeśasaḥ ||
9,005.09  tvaṣṭāramagrajāṃ gopāṃ puroyāvānamā huve |
9,005.09 indurindro vṛṣā hariḥ pavamānaḥ prajāpatiḥ ||
9,005.10  vanaspatiṃ pavamāna madhvā samaṅgdhi dhārayā |
9,005.10 sahasravalśaṃ haritaṃ bhrājamānaṃ hiraṇyayam ||
9,005.11  viśve devāḥ svāhākṛtiṃ pavamānasyā gata |
9,005.11 vāyurbṛhaspatiḥ sūryo'gnirindraḥ sajoṣasaḥ ||

9,006.01  mandrayā soma dhārayā vṛṣā pavasva devayuḥ |
9,006.01 avyo vāreṣvasmayuḥ ||
9,006.02  abhi tyaṃ madyaṃ madamindavindra iti kṣara |
9,006.02 abhi vājino arvataḥ ||
9,006.03  abhi tyaṃ pūrvyaṃ madaṃ suvāno arṣa pavitra ā |
9,006.03 abhi vājamuta śravaḥ ||
9,006.04  anu drapsāsa indava āpo na pravatāsaran |
9,006.04 punānā indramāśata ||
9,006.05  yamatyamiva vājinaṃ mṛjanti yoṣaṇo daśa |
9,006.05 vane krīḻantamatyavim ||
9,006.06  taṃ gobhirvṛṣaṇaṃ rasaṃ madāya devavītaye |
9,006.06 sutaṃ bharāya saṃ sṛja ||
9,006.07  devo devāya dhārayendrāya pavate sutaḥ |
9,006.07 payo yadasya pīpayat ||
9,006.08  ātmā yajñasya raṃhyā suṣvāṇaḥ pavate sutaḥ |
9,006.08 pratnaṃ ni pāti kāvyam ||
9,006.09  evā punāna indrayurmadaṃ madiṣṭha vītaye |
9,006.09 guhā ciddadhiṣe giraḥ ||

9,007.01  asṛgramindavaḥ pathā dharmannṛtasya suśriyaḥ |
9,007.01 vidānā asya yojanam ||
9,007.02  pra dhārā madhvo agriyo mahīrapo vi gāhate |
9,007.02 havirhaviṣṣu vandyaḥ ||
9,007.03  pra yujo vāco agriyo vṛṣāva cakradadvane |
9,007.03 sadmābhi satyo adhvaraḥ ||
9,007.04  pari yatkāvyā kavirnṛmṇā vasāno arṣati |
9,007.04 svarvājī siṣāsati ||
9,007.05  pavamāno abhi spṛdho viśo rājeva sīdati |
9,007.05 yadīmṛṇvanti vedhasaḥ ||
9,007.06  avyo vāre pari priyo harirvaneṣu sīdati |
9,007.06 rebho vanuṣyate matī ||
9,007.07  sa vāyumindramaśvinā sākaṃ madena gacchati |
9,007.07 raṇā yo asya dharmabhiḥ ||
9,007.08  ā mitrāvaruṇā bhagaṃ madhvaḥ pavanta ūrmayaḥ |
9,007.08 vidānā asya śakmabhiḥ ||
9,007.09  asmabhyaṃ rodasī rayiṃ madhvo vājasya sātaye |
9,007.09 śravo vasūni saṃ jitam ||

9,008.01  ete somā abhi priyamindrasya kāmamakṣaran |
9,008.01 vardhanto asya vīryam ||
9,008.02  punānāsaścamūṣado gacchanto vāyumaśvinā |
9,008.02 te no dhāntu suvīryam ||
9,008.03  indrasya soma rādhase punāno hārdi codaya |
9,008.03 ṛtasya yonimāsadam ||
9,008.04  mṛjanti tvā daśa kṣipo hinvanti sapta dhītayaḥ |
9,008.04 anu viprā amādiṣuḥ ||
9,008.05  devebhyastvā madāya kaṃ sṛjānamati meṣyaḥ |
9,008.05 saṃ gobhirvāsayāmasi ||
9,008.06  punānaḥ kalaśeṣvā vastrāṇyaruṣo hariḥ |
9,008.06 pari gavyānyavyata ||
9,008.07  maghona ā pavasva no jahi viśvā apa dviṣaḥ |
9,008.07 indo sakhāyamā viśa ||
9,008.08  vṛṣṭiṃ divaḥ pari srava dyumnaṃ pṛthivyā adhi |
9,008.08 saho naḥ soma pṛtsu dhāḥ ||
9,008.09  nṛcakṣasaṃ tvā vayamindrapītaṃ svarvidam |
9,008.09 bhakṣīmahi prajāmiṣam ||

9,009.01  pari priyā divaḥ kavirvayāṃsi naptyorhitaḥ |
9,009.01 suvāno yāti kavikratuḥ ||
9,009.02  prapra kṣayāya panyase janāya juṣṭo adruhe |
9,009.02 vītyarṣa caniṣṭhayā ||
9,009.03  sa sūnurmātarā śucirjāto jāte arocayat |
9,009.03 mahānmahī ṛtāvṛdhā ||
9,009.04  sa sapta dhītibhirhito nadyo ajinvadadruhaḥ |
9,009.04 yā ekamakṣi vāvṛdhuḥ ||
9,009.05  tā abhi santamastṛtaṃ mahe yuvānamā dadhuḥ |
9,009.05 indumindra tava vrate ||
9,009.06  abhi vahniramartyaḥ sapta paśyati vāvahiḥ |
9,009.06 krivirdevīratarpayat ||
9,009.07  avā kalpeṣu naḥ pumastamāṃsi soma yodhyā |
9,009.07 tāni punāna jaṅghanaḥ ||
9,009.08  nū navyase navīyase sūktāya sādhayā pathaḥ |
9,009.08 pratnavadrocayā rucaḥ ||
9,009.09  pavamāna mahi śravo gāmaśvaṃ rāsi vīravat |
9,009.09 sanā medhāṃ sanā svaḥ ||

9,010.01  pra svānāso rathā ivārvanto na śravasyavaḥ |
9,010.01 somāso rāye akramuḥ ||
9,010.02  hinvānāso rathā iva dadhanvire gabhastyoḥ |
9,010.02 bharāsaḥ kāriṇāmiva ||
9,010.03  rājāno na praśastibhiḥ somāso gobhirañjate |
9,010.03 yajño na sapta dhātṛbhiḥ ||
9,010.04  pari suvānāsa indavo madāya barhaṇā girā |
9,010.04 sutā arṣanti dhārayā ||
9,010.05  āpānāso vivasvato jananta uṣaso bhagam |
9,010.05 sūrā aṇvaṃ vi tanvate ||
9,010.06  apa dvārā matīnāṃ pratnā ṛṇvanti kāravaḥ |
9,010.06 vṛṣṇo harasa āyavaḥ ||
9,010.07  samīcīnāsa āsate hotāraḥ saptajāmayaḥ |
9,010.07 padamekasya piprataḥ ||
9,010.08  nābhā nābhiṃ na ā dade cakṣuścitsūrye sacā |
9,010.08 kaverapatyamā duhe ||
9,010.09  abhi priyā divaspadamadhvaryubhirguhā hitam |
9,010.09 sūraḥ paśyati cakṣasā ||

9,011.01  upāsmai gāyatā naraḥ pavamānāyendave |
9,011.01 abhi devāṃ iyakṣate ||
9,011.02  abhi te madhunā payo'tharvāṇo aśiśrayuḥ |
9,011.02 devaṃ devāya devayu ||
9,011.03  sa naḥ pavasva śaṃ gave śaṃ janāya śamarvate |
9,011.03 śaṃ rājannoṣadhībhyaḥ ||
9,011.04  babhrave nu svatavase'ruṇāya divispṛśe |
9,011.04 somāya gāthamarcata ||
9,011.05  hastacyutebhiradribhiḥ sutaṃ somaṃ punītana |
9,011.05 madhāvā dhāvatā madhu ||
9,011.06  namasedupa sīdata dadhnedabhi śrīṇītana |
9,011.06 indumindre dadhātana ||
9,011.07  amitrahā vicarṣaṇiḥ pavasva soma śaṃ gave |
9,011.07 devebhyo anukāmakṛt ||
9,011.08  indrāya soma pātave madāya pari ṣicyase |
9,011.08 manaścinmanasaspatiḥ ||
9,011.09  pavamāna suvīryaṃ rayiṃ soma rirīhi naḥ |
9,011.09 indavindreṇa no yujā ||

9,012.01  somā asṛgramindavaḥ sutā ṛtasya sādane |
9,012.01 indrāya madhumattamāḥ ||
9,012.02  abhi viprā anūṣata gāvo vatsaṃ na mātaraḥ |
9,012.02 indraṃ somasya pītaye ||
9,012.03  madacyutkṣeti sādane sindhorūrmā vipaścit |
9,012.03 somo gaurī adhi śritaḥ ||
9,012.04  divo nābhā vicakṣaṇo'vyo vāre mahīyate |
9,012.04 somo yaḥ sukratuḥ kaviḥ ||
9,012.05  yaḥ somaḥ kalaśeṣvāṃ antaḥ pavitra āhitaḥ |
9,012.05 taminduḥ pari ṣasvaje ||
9,012.06  pra vācaminduriṣyati samudrasyādhi viṣṭapi |
9,012.06 jinvankośaṃ madhuścutam ||
9,012.07  nityastotro vanaspatirdhīnāmantaḥ sabardughaḥ |
9,012.07 hinvāno mānuṣā yugā ||
9,012.08  abhi priyā divaspadā somo hinvāno arṣati |
9,012.08 viprasya dhārayā kaviḥ ||
9,012.09  ā pavamāna dhāraya rayiṃ sahasravarcasam |
9,012.09 asme indo svābhuvam ||

9,013.01  somaḥ punāno arṣati sahasradhāro atyaviḥ |
9,013.01 vāyorindrasya niṣkṛtam ||
9,013.02  pavamānamavasyavo vipramabhi pra gāyata |
9,013.02 suṣvāṇaṃ devavītaye ||
9,013.03  pavante vājasātaye somāḥ sahasrapājasaḥ |
9,013.03 gṛṇānā devavītaye ||
9,013.04  uta no vājasātaye pavasva bṛhatīriṣaḥ |
9,013.04 dyumadindo suvīryam ||
9,013.05  te naḥ sahasriṇaṃ rayiṃ pavantāmā suvīryam |
9,013.05 suvānā devāsa indavaḥ ||
9,013.06  atyā hiyānā na hetṛbhirasṛgraṃ vājasātaye |
9,013.06 vi vāramavyamāśavaḥ ||
9,013.07  vāśrā arṣantīndavo'bhi vatsaṃ na dhenavaḥ |
9,013.07 dadhanvire gabhastyoḥ ||
9,013.08  juṣṭa indrāya matsaraḥ pavamāna kanikradat |
9,013.08 viśvā apa dviṣo jahi ||
9,013.09  apaghnanto arāvṇaḥ pavamānāḥ svardṛśaḥ |
9,013.09 yonāvṛtasya sīdata ||

9,014.01  pari prāsiṣyadatkaviḥ sindhorūrmāvadhi śritaḥ |
9,014.01 kāraṃ bibhratpuruspṛham ||
9,014.02  girā yadī sabandhavaḥ pañca vrātā apasyavaḥ |
9,014.02 pariṣkṛṇvanti dharṇasim ||
9,014.03  ādasya śuṣmiṇo rase viśve devā amatsata |
9,014.03 yadī gobhirvasāyate ||
9,014.04  niriṇāno vi dhāvati jahaccharyāṇi tānvā |
9,014.04 atrā saṃ jighnate yujā ||
9,014.05  naptībhiryo vivasvataḥ śubhro na māmṛje yuvā |
9,014.05 gāḥ kṛṇvāno na nirṇijam ||
9,014.06  ati śritī tiraścatā gavyā jigātyaṇvyā |
9,014.06 vagnumiyarti yaṃ vide ||
9,014.07  abhi kṣipaḥ samagmata marjayantīriṣaspatim |
9,014.07 pṛṣṭhā gṛbhṇata vājinaḥ ||
9,014.08  pari divyāni marmṛśadviśvāni soma pārthivā |
9,014.08 vasūni yāhyasmayuḥ ||

9,015.01  eṣa dhiyā yātyaṇvyā śūro rathebhirāśubhiḥ |
9,015.01 gacchannindrasya niṣkṛtam ||
9,015.02  eṣa purū dhiyāyate bṛhate devatātaye |
9,015.02 yatrāmṛtāsa āsate ||
9,015.03  eṣa hito vi nīyate'ntaḥ śubhrāvatā pathā |
9,015.03 yadī tuñjanti bhūrṇayaḥ ||
9,015.04  eṣa śṛṅgāṇi dodhuvacchiśīte yūthyo vṛṣā |
9,015.04 nṛmṇā dadhāna ojasā ||
9,015.05  eṣa rukmibhirīyate vājī śubhrebhiraṃśubhiḥ |
9,015.05 patiḥ sindhūnāṃ bhavan ||
9,015.06  eṣa vasūni pibdanā paruṣā yayivāṃ ati |
9,015.06 ava śādeṣu gacchati ||
9,015.07  etaṃ mṛjanti marjyamupa droṇeṣvāyavaḥ |
9,015.07 pracakrāṇaṃ mahīriṣaḥ ||
9,015.08  etamu tyaṃ daśa kṣipo mṛjanti sapta dhītayaḥ |
9,015.08 svāyudhaṃ madintamam ||

9,016.01  pra te sotāra oṇyo rasaṃ madāya ghṛṣvaye |
9,016.01 sargo na taktyetaśaḥ ||
9,016.02  kratvā dakṣasya rathyamapo vasānamandhasā |
9,016.02 goṣāmaṇveṣu saścima ||
9,016.03  anaptamapsu duṣṭaraṃ somaṃ pavitra ā sṛja |
9,016.03 punīhīndrāya pātave ||
9,016.04  pra punānasya cetasā somaḥ pavitre arṣati |
9,016.04 kratvā sadhasthamāsadat ||
9,016.05  pra tvā namobhirindava indra somā asṛkṣata |
9,016.05 mahe bharāya kāriṇaḥ ||
9,016.06  punāno rūpe avyaye viśvā arṣannabhi śriyaḥ |
9,016.06 śūro na goṣu tiṣṭhati ||
9,016.07  divo na sānu pipyuṣī dhārā sutasya vedhasaḥ |
