9,016.07 vṛthā pavitre arṣati ||
9,016.08  tvaṃ soma vipaścitaṃ tanā punāna āyuṣu |
9,016.08 avyo vāraṃ vi dhāvasi ||

9,017.01  pra nimneneva sindhavo ghnanto vṛtrāṇi bhūrṇayaḥ |
9,017.01 somā asṛgramāśavaḥ ||
9,017.02  abhi suvānāsa indavo vṛṣṭayaḥ pṛthivīmiva |
9,017.02 indraṃ somāso akṣaran ||
9,017.03  atyūrmirmatsaro madaḥ somaḥ pavitre arṣati |
9,017.03 vighnanrakṣāṃsi devayuḥ ||
9,017.04  ā kalaśeṣu dhāvati pavitre pari ṣicyate |
9,017.04 ukthairyajñeṣu vardhate ||
9,017.05  ati trī soma rocanā rohanna bhrājase divam |
9,017.05 iṣṇansūryaṃ na codayaḥ ||
9,017.06  abhi viprā anūṣata mūrdhanyajñasya kāravaḥ |
9,017.06 dadhānāścakṣasi priyam ||
9,017.07  tamu tvā vājinaṃ naro dhībhirviprā avasyavaḥ |
9,017.07 mṛjanti devatātaye ||
9,017.08  madhordhārāmanu kṣara tīvraḥ sadhasthamāsadaḥ |
9,017.08 cārurṛtāya pītaye ||

9,018.01  pari suvāno giriṣṭhāḥ pavitre somo akṣāḥ |
9,018.01 madeṣu sarvadhā asi ||
9,018.02  tvaṃ viprastvaṃ kavirmadhu pra jātamandhasaḥ |
9,018.02 madeṣu sarvadhā asi ||
9,018.03  tava viśve sajoṣaso devāsaḥ pītimāśata |
9,018.03 madeṣu sarvadhā asi ||
9,018.04  ā yo viśvāni vāryā vasūni hastayordadhe |
9,018.04 madeṣu sarvadhā asi ||
9,018.05  ya ime rodasī mahī saṃ mātareva dohate |
9,018.05 madeṣu sarvadhā asi ||
9,018.06  pari yo rodasī ubhe sadyo vājebhirarṣati |
9,018.06 madeṣu sarvadhā asi ||
9,018.07  sa śuṣmī kalaśeṣvā punāno acikradat |
9,018.07 madeṣu sarvadhā asi ||

9,019.01  yatsoma citramukthyaṃ divyaṃ pārthivaṃ vasu |
9,019.01 tannaḥ punāna ā bhara ||
9,019.02  yuvaṃ hi sthaḥ svarpatī indraśca soma gopatī |
9,019.02 īśānā pipyataṃ dhiyaḥ ||
9,019.03  vṛṣā punāna āyuṣu stanayannadhi barhiṣi |
9,019.03 hariḥ sanyonimāsadat ||
9,019.04  avāvaśanta dhītayo vṛṣabhasyādhi retasi |
9,019.04 sūnorvatsasya mātaraḥ ||
9,019.05  kuvidvṛṣaṇyantībhyaḥ punāno garbhamādadhat |
9,019.05 yāḥ śukraṃ duhate payaḥ ||
9,019.06  upa śikṣāpatasthuṣo bhiyasamā dhehi śatruṣu |
9,019.06 pavamāna vidā rayim ||
9,019.07  ni śatroḥ soma vṛṣṇyaṃ ni śuṣmaṃ ni vayastira |
9,019.07 dūre vā sato anti vā ||

9,020.01  pra kavirdevavītaye'vyo vārebhirarṣati |
9,020.01 sāhvānviśvā abhi spṛdhaḥ ||
9,020.02  sa hi ṣmā jaritṛbhya ā vājaṃ gomantaminvati |
9,020.02 pavamānaḥ sahasriṇam ||
9,020.03  pari viśvāni cetasā mṛśase pavase matī |
9,020.03 sa naḥ soma śravo vidaḥ ||
9,020.04  abhyarṣa bṛhadyaśo maghavadbhyo dhruvaṃ rayim |
9,020.04 iṣaṃ stotṛbhya ā bhara ||
9,020.05  tvaṃ rājeva suvrato giraḥ somā viveśitha |
9,020.05 punāno vahne adbhuta ||
9,020.06  sa vahnirapsu duṣṭaro mṛjyamāno gabhastyoḥ |
9,020.06 somaścamūṣu sīdati ||
9,020.07  krīḻurmakho na maṃhayuḥ pavitraṃ soma gacchasi |
9,020.07 dadhatstotre suvīryam ||

9,021.01  ete dhāvantīndavaḥ somā indrāya ghṛṣvayaḥ |
9,021.01 matsarāsaḥ svarvidaḥ ||
9,021.02  pravṛṇvanto abhiyujaḥ suṣvaye varivovidaḥ |
9,021.02 svayaṃ stotre vayaskṛtaḥ ||
9,021.03  vṛthā krīḻanta indavaḥ sadhasthamabhyekamit |
9,021.03 sindhorūrmā vyakṣaran ||
9,021.04  ete viśvāni vāryā pavamānāsa āśata |
9,021.04 hitā na saptayo rathe ||
9,021.05  āsminpiśaṅgamindavo dadhātā venamādiśe |
9,021.05 yo asmabhyamarāvā ||
9,021.06  ṛbhurna rathyaṃ navaṃ dadhātā ketamādiśe |
9,021.06 śukrāḥ pavadhvamarṇasā ||
9,021.07  eta u tye avīvaśankāṣṭhāṃ vājino akrata |
9,021.07 sataḥ prāsāviṣurmatim ||

9,022.01  ete somāsa āśavo rathā iva pra vājinaḥ |
9,022.01 sargāḥ sṛṣṭā aheṣata ||
9,022.02  ete vātā ivoravaḥ parjanyasyeva vṛṣṭayaḥ |
9,022.02 agneriva bhramā vṛthā ||
9,022.03  ete pūtā vipaścitaḥ somāso dadhyāśiraḥ |
9,022.03 vipā vyānaśurdhiyaḥ ||
9,022.04  ete mṛṣṭā amartyāḥ sasṛvāṃso na śaśramuḥ |
9,022.04 iyakṣantaḥ patho rajaḥ ||
9,022.05  ete pṛṣṭhāni rodasorviprayanto vyānaśuḥ |
9,022.05 utedamuttamaṃ rajaḥ ||
9,022.06  tantuṃ tanvānamuttamamanu pravata āśata |
9,022.06 utedamuttamāyyam ||
9,022.07  tvaṃ soma paṇibhya ā vasu gavyāni dhārayaḥ |
9,022.07 tataṃ tantumacikradaḥ ||

9,023.01  somā asṛgramāśavo madhormadasya dhārayā |
9,023.01 abhi viśvāni kāvyā ||
9,023.02  anu pratnāsa āyavaḥ padaṃ navīyo akramuḥ |
9,023.02 ruce jananta sūryam ||
9,023.03  ā pavamāna no bharāryo adāśuṣo gayam |
9,023.03 kṛdhi prajāvatīriṣaḥ ||
9,023.04  abhi somāsa āyavaḥ pavante madyaṃ madam |
9,023.04 abhi kośaṃ madhuścutam ||
9,023.05  somo arṣati dharṇasirdadhāna indriyaṃ rasam |
9,023.05 suvīro abhiśastipāḥ ||
9,023.06  indrāya soma pavase devebhyaḥ sadhamādyaḥ |
9,023.06 indo vājaṃ siṣāsasi ||
9,023.07  asya pītvā madānāmindro vṛtrāṇyaprati |
9,023.07 jaghāna jaghanacca nu ||

9,024.01  pra somāso adhanviṣuḥ pavamānāsa indavaḥ |
9,024.01 śrīṇānā apsu mṛñjata ||
9,024.02  abhi gāvo adhanviṣurāpo na pravatā yatīḥ |
9,024.02 punānā indramāśata ||
9,024.03  pra pavamāna dhanvasi somendrāya pātave |
9,024.03 nṛbhiryato vi nīyase ||
9,024.04  tvaṃ soma nṛmādanaḥ pavasva carṣaṇīsahe |
9,024.04 sasniryo anumādyaḥ ||
9,024.05  indo yadadribhiḥ sutaḥ pavitraṃ paridhāvasi |
9,024.05 aramindrasya dhāmne ||
9,024.06  pavasva vṛtrahantamokthebhiranumādyaḥ |
9,024.06 śuciḥ pāvako adbhutaḥ ||
9,024.07  śuciḥ pāvaka ucyate somaḥ sutasya madhvaḥ |
9,024.07 devāvīraghaśaṃsahā ||

9,025.01  pavasva dakṣasādhano devebhyaḥ pītaye hare |
9,025.01 marudbhyo vāyave madaḥ ||
9,025.02  pavamāna dhiyā hito'bhi yoniṃ kanikradat |
9,025.02 dharmaṇā vāyumā viśa ||
9,025.03  saṃ devaiḥ śobhate vṛṣā kaviryonāvadhi priyaḥ |
9,025.03 vṛtrahā devavītamaḥ ||
9,025.04  viśvā rūpāṇyāviśanpunāno yāti haryataḥ |
9,025.04 yatrāmṛtāsa āsate ||
9,025.05  aruṣo janayangiraḥ somaḥ pavata āyuṣak |
9,025.05 indraṃ gacchankavikratuḥ ||
9,025.06  ā pavasva madintama pavitraṃ dhārayā kave |
9,025.06 arkasya yonimāsadam ||

9,026.01  tamamṛkṣanta vājinamupasthe aditeradhi |
9,026.01 viprāso aṇvyā dhiyā ||
9,026.02  taṃ gāvo abhyanūṣata sahasradhāramakṣitam |
9,026.02 induṃ dhartāramā divaḥ ||
9,026.03  taṃ vedhāṃ medhayāhyanpavamānamadhi dyavi |
9,026.03 dharṇasiṃ bhūridhāyasam ||
9,026.04  tamahyanbhurijordhiyā saṃvasānaṃ vivasvataḥ |
9,026.04 patiṃ vāco adābhyam ||
9,026.05  taṃ sānāvadhi jāmayo hariṃ hinvantyadribhiḥ |
9,026.05 haryataṃ bhūricakṣasam ||
9,026.06  taṃ tvā hinvanti vedhasaḥ pavamāna girāvṛdham |
9,026.06 indavindrāya matsaram ||

9,027.01  eṣa kavirabhiṣṭutaḥ pavitre adhi tośate |
9,027.01 punāno ghnannapa sridhaḥ ||
9,027.02  eṣa indrāya vāyave svarjitpari ṣicyate |
9,027.02 pavitre dakṣasādhanaḥ ||
9,027.03  eṣa nṛbhirvi nīyate divo mūrdhā vṛṣā sutaḥ |
9,027.03 somo vaneṣu viśvavit ||
9,027.04  eṣa gavyuracikradatpavamāno hiraṇyayuḥ |
9,027.04 induḥ satrājidastṛtaḥ ||
9,027.05  eṣa sūryeṇa hāsate pavamāno adhi dyavi |
9,027.05 pavitre matsaro madaḥ ||
9,027.06  eṣa śuṣmyasiṣyadadantarikṣe vṛṣā hariḥ |
9,027.06 punāna indurindramā ||

9,028.01  eṣa vājī hito nṛbhirviśvavinmanasaspatiḥ |
9,028.01 avyo vāraṃ vi dhāvati ||
9,028.02  eṣa pavitre akṣaratsomo devebhyaḥ sutaḥ |
9,028.02 viśvā dhāmānyāviśan ||
9,028.03  eṣa devaḥ śubhāyate'dhi yonāvamartyaḥ |
9,028.03 vṛtrahā devavītamaḥ ||
9,028.04  eṣa vṛṣā kanikradaddaśabhirjāmibhiryataḥ |
9,028.04 abhi droṇāni dhāvati ||
9,028.05  eṣa sūryamarocayatpavamāno vicarṣaṇiḥ |
9,028.05 viśvā dhāmāni viśvavit ||
9,028.06  eṣa śuṣmyadābhyaḥ somaḥ punāno arṣati |
9,028.06 devāvīraghaśaṃsahā ||

9,029.01  prāsya dhārā akṣaranvṛṣṇaḥ sutasyaujasā |
9,029.01 devāṃ anu prabhūṣataḥ ||
9,029.02  saptiṃ mṛjanti vedhaso gṛṇantaḥ kāravo girā |
9,029.02 jyotirjajñānamukthyam ||
9,029.03  suṣahā soma tāni te punānāya prabhūvaso |
9,029.03 vardhā samudramukthyam ||
9,029.04  viśvā vasūni saṃjayanpavasva soma dhārayā |
9,029.04 inu dveṣāṃsi sadhryak ||
9,029.05  rakṣā su no araruṣaḥ svanātsamasya kasya cit |
9,029.05 nido yatra mumucmahe ||
9,029.06  endo pārthivaṃ rayiṃ divyaṃ pavasva dhārayā |
9,029.06 dyumantaṃ śuṣmamā bhara ||

9,030.01  pra dhārā asya śuṣmiṇo vṛthā pavitre akṣaran |
9,030.01 punāno vācamiṣyati ||
9,030.02  indurhiyānaḥ sotṛbhirmṛjyamānaḥ kanikradat |
9,030.02 iyarti vagnumindriyam ||
9,030.03  ā naḥ śuṣmaṃ nṛṣāhyaṃ vīravantaṃ puruspṛham |
9,030.03 pavasva soma dhārayā ||
9,030.04  pra somo ati dhārayā pavamāno asiṣyadat |
9,030.04 abhi droṇānyāsadam ||
9,030.05  apsu tvā madhumattamaṃ hariṃ hinvantyadribhiḥ |
9,030.05 indavindrāya pītaye ||
9,030.06  sunotā madhumattamaṃ somamindrāya vajriṇe |
9,030.06 cāruṃ śardhāya matsaram ||

9,031.01  pra somāsaḥ svādhyaḥ pavamānāso akramuḥ |
9,031.01 rayiṃ kṛṇvanti cetanam ||
9,031.02  divaspṛthivyā adhi bhavendo dyumnavardhanaḥ |
9,031.02 bhavā vājānāṃ patiḥ ||
9,031.03  tubhyaṃ vātā abhipriyastubhyamarṣanti sindhavaḥ |
9,031.03 soma vardhanti te mahaḥ ||
9,031.04  ā pyāyasva sametu te viśvataḥ soma vṛṣṇyam |
9,031.04 bhavā vājasya saṃgathe ||
9,031.05  tubhyaṃ gāvo ghṛtaṃ payo babhro duduhre akṣitam |
9,031.05 varṣiṣṭhe adhi sānavi ||
9,031.06  svāyudhasya te sato bhuvanasya pate vayam |
9,031.06 indo sakhitvamuśmasi ||

9,032.01  pra somāso madacyutaḥ śravase no maghonaḥ |
9,032.01 sutā vidathe akramuḥ ||
9,032.02  ādīṃ tritasya yoṣaṇo hariṃ hinvantyadribhiḥ |
9,032.02 indumindrāya pītaye ||
9,032.03  ādīṃ haṃso yathā gaṇaṃ viśvasyāvīvaśanmatim |
9,032.03 atyo na gobhirajyate ||
9,032.04  ubhe somāvacākaśanmṛgo na takto arṣasi |
9,032.04 sīdannṛtasya yonimā ||
9,032.05  abhi gāvo anūṣata yoṣā jāramiva priyam |
9,032.05 agannājiṃ yathā hitam ||
9,032.06  asme dhehi dyumadyaśo maghavadbhyaśca mahyaṃ ca |
9,032.06 saniṃ medhāmuta śravaḥ ||

9,033.01  pra somāso vipaścito'pāṃ na yantyūrmayaḥ |
9,033.01 vanāni mahiṣā iva ||
9,033.02  abhi droṇāni babhravaḥ śukrā ṛtasya dhārayā |
9,033.02 vājaṃ gomantamakṣaran ||
9,033.03  sutā indrāya vāyave varuṇāya marudbhyaḥ |
9,033.03 somā arṣanti viṣṇave ||
9,033.04  tisro vāca udīrate gāvo mimanti dhenavaḥ |
9,033.04 harireti kanikradat ||
9,033.05  abhi brahmīranūṣata yahvīrṛtasya mātaraḥ |
9,033.05 marmṛjyante divaḥ śiśum ||
9,033.06  rāyaḥ samudrāṃścaturo'smabhyaṃ soma viśvataḥ |
9,033.06 ā pavasva sahasriṇaḥ ||

9,034.01  pra suvāno dhārayā tanendurhinvāno arṣati |
9,034.01 rujaddṛḻhā vyojasā ||
9,034.02  suta indrāya vāyave varuṇāya marudbhyaḥ |
9,034.02 somo arṣati viṣṇave ||
9,034.03  vṛṣāṇaṃ vṛṣabhiryataṃ sunvanti somamadribhiḥ |
9,034.03 duhanti śakmanā payaḥ ||
9,034.04  bhuvattritasya marjyo bhuvadindrāya matsaraḥ |
9,034.04 saṃ rūpairajyate hariḥ ||
9,034.05  abhīmṛtasya viṣṭapaṃ duhate pṛśnimātaraḥ |
9,034.05 cāru priyatamaṃ haviḥ ||
9,034.06  samenamahrutā imā giro arṣanti sasrutaḥ |
9,034.06 dhenūrvāśro avīvaśat ||

9,035.01  ā naḥ pavasva dhārayā pavamāna rayiṃ pṛthum |
9,035.01 yayā jyotirvidāsi naḥ ||
9,035.02  indo samudramīṅkhaya pavasva viśvamejaya |
9,035.02 rāyo dhartā na ojasā ||
9,035.03  tvayā vīreṇa vīravo'bhi ṣyāma pṛtanyataḥ |
9,035.03 kṣarā ṇo abhi vāryam ||
9,035.04  pra vājaminduriṣyati siṣāsanvājasā ṛṣiḥ |
9,035.04 vratā vidāna āyudhā ||
9,035.05  taṃ gīrbhirvācamīṅkhayaṃ punānaṃ vāsayāmasi |
9,035.05 somaṃ janasya gopatim ||
9,035.06  viśvo yasya vrate jano dādhāra dharmaṇaspateḥ |
9,035.06 punānasya prabhūvasoḥ ||

9,036.01  asarji rathyo yathā pavitre camvoḥ sutaḥ |
9,036.01 kārṣmanvājī nyakramīt ||
9,036.02  sa vahniḥ soma jāgṛviḥ pavasva devavīrati |
9,036.02 abhi kośaṃ madhuścutam ||
9,036.03  sa no jyotīṃṣi pūrvya pavamāna vi rocaya |
9,036.03 kratve dakṣāya no hinu ||
9,036.04  śumbhamāna ṛtāyubhirmṛjyamāno gabhastyoḥ |
9,036.04 pavate vāre avyaye ||
9,036.05  sa viśvā dāśuṣe vasu somo divyāni pārthivā |
9,036.05 pavatāmāntarikṣyā ||
9,036.06  ā divaspṛṣṭhamaśvayurgavyayuḥ soma rohasi |
9,036.06 vīrayuḥ śavasaspate ||

9,037.01  sa sutaḥ pītaye vṛṣā somaḥ pavitre arṣati |
9,037.01 vighnanrakṣāṃsi devayuḥ ||
9,037.02  sa pavitre vicakṣaṇo harirarṣati dharṇasiḥ |
9,037.02 abhi yoniṃ kanikradat ||
9,037.03  sa vājī rocanā divaḥ pavamāno vi dhāvati |
9,037.03 rakṣohā vāramavyayam ||
9,037.04  sa tritasyādhi sānavi pavamāno arocayat |
9,037.04 jāmibhiḥ sūryaṃ saha ||
9,037.05  sa vṛtrahā vṛṣā suto varivovidadābhyaḥ |
9,037.05 somo vājamivāsarat ||
9,037.06  sa devaḥ kavineṣito'bhi droṇāni dhāvati |
9,037.06 indurindrāya maṃhanā ||

9,038.01  eṣa u sya vṛṣā ratho'vyo vārebhirarṣati |
9,038.01 gacchanvājaṃ sahasriṇam ||
9,038.02  etaṃ tritasya yoṣaṇo hariṃ hinvantyadribhiḥ |
9,038.02 indumindrāya pītaye ||
9,038.03  etaṃ tyaṃ harito daśa marmṛjyante apasyuvaḥ |
9,038.03 yābhirmadāya śumbhate ||
9,038.04  eṣa sya mānuṣīṣvā śyeno na vikṣu sīdati |
9,038.04 gacchañjāro na yoṣitam ||
9,038.05  eṣa sya madyo raso'va caṣṭe divaḥ śiśuḥ |
9,038.05 ya indurvāramāviśat ||
9,038.06  eṣa sya pītaye suto harirarṣati dharṇasiḥ |
9,038.06 krandanyonimabhi priyam ||

9,039.01  āśurarṣa bṛhanmate pari priyeṇa dhāmnā |
9,039.01 yatra devā iti bravan ||
9,039.02  pariṣkṛṇvannaniṣkṛtaṃ janāya yātayanniṣaḥ |
9,039.02 vṛṣṭiṃ divaḥ pari srava ||
9,039.03  suta eti pavitra ā tviṣiṃ dadhāna ojasā |
9,039.03 vicakṣāṇo virocayan ||
9,039.04  ayaṃ sa yo divaspari raghuyāmā pavitra ā |
9,039.04 sindhorūrmā vyakṣarat ||
9,039.05  āvivāsanparāvato atho arvāvataḥ sutaḥ |
9,039.05 indrāya sicyate madhu ||
9,039.06  samīcīnā anūṣata hariṃ hinvantyadribhiḥ |
9,039.06 yonāvṛtasya sīdata ||

9,040.01  punāno akramīdabhi viśvā mṛdho vicarṣaṇiḥ |
9,040.01 śumbhanti vipraṃ dhītibhiḥ ||
9,040.02  ā yonimaruṇo ruhadgamadindraṃ vṛṣā sutaḥ |
9,040.02 dhruve sadasi sīdati ||
9,040.03  nū no rayiṃ mahāmindo'smabhyaṃ soma viśvataḥ |
9,040.03 ā pavasva sahasriṇam ||
9,040.04  viśvā soma pavamāna dyumnānīndavā bhara |
9,040.04 vidāḥ sahasriṇīriṣaḥ ||
9,040.05  sa naḥ punāna ā bhara rayiṃ stotre suvīryam |
9,040.05 jariturvardhayā giraḥ ||
9,040.06  punāna indavā bhara soma dvibarhasaṃ rayim |
9,040.06 vṛṣannindo na ukthyam ||

9,041.01  pra ye gāvo na bhūrṇayastveṣā ayāso akramuḥ |
9,041.01 ghnantaḥ kṛṣṇāmapa tvacam ||
9,041.02  suvitasya manāmahe'ti setuṃ durāvyam |
9,041.02 sāhvāṃso dasyumavratam ||
9,041.03  śṛṇve vṛṣṭeriva svanaḥ pavamānasya śuṣmiṇaḥ |
9,041.03 caranti vidyuto divi ||
9,041.04  ā pavasva mahīmiṣaṃ gomadindo hiraṇyavat |
9,041.04 aśvāvadvājavatsutaḥ ||
9,041.05  sa pavasva vicarṣaṇa ā mahī rodasī pṛṇa |
9,041.05 uṣāḥ sūryo na raśmibhiḥ ||
9,041.06  pari ṇaḥ śarmayantyā dhārayā soma viśvataḥ |
9,041.06 sarā raseva viṣṭapam ||

9,042.01  janayanrocanā divo janayannapsu sūryam |
9,042.01 vasāno gā apo hariḥ ||
9,042.02  eṣa pratnena manmanā devo devebhyaspari |
9,042.02 dhārayā pavate sutaḥ ||
9,042.03  vāvṛdhānāya tūrvaye pavante vājasātaye |
9,042.03 somāḥ sahasrapājasaḥ ||
9,042.04  duhānaḥ pratnamitpayaḥ pavitre pari ṣicyate |
9,042.04 krandandevāṃ ajījanat ||
9,042.05  abhi viśvāni vāryābhi devāṃ ṛtāvṛdhaḥ |
9,042.05 somaḥ punāno arṣati ||
9,042.06  gomannaḥ soma vīravadaśvāvadvājavatsutaḥ |
9,042.06 pavasva bṛhatīriṣaḥ ||

9,043.01  yo atya iva mṛjyate gobhirmadāya haryataḥ |
9,043.01 taṃ gīrbhirvāsayāmasi ||
9,043.02  taṃ no viśvā avasyuvo giraḥ śumbhanti pūrvathā |
9,043.02 indumindrāya pītaye ||
9,043.03  punāno yāti haryataḥ somo gīrbhiḥ pariṣkṛtaḥ |
9,043.03 viprasya medhyātitheḥ ||
9,043.04  pavamāna vidā rayimasmabhyaṃ soma suśriyam |
9,043.04 indo sahasravarcasam ||
9,043.05  induratyo na vājasṛtkanikranti pavitra ā |
9,043.05 yadakṣārati devayuḥ ||
9,043.06  pavasva vājasātaye viprasya gṛṇato vṛdhe |
9,043.06 soma rāsva suvīryam ||

9,044.01  pra ṇa indo mahe tana ūrmiṃ na bibhradarṣasi |
9,044.01 abhi devāṃ ayāsyaḥ ||
9,044.02  matī juṣṭo dhiyā hitaḥ somo hinve parāvati |
9,044.02 viprasya dhārayā kaviḥ ||
9,044.03  ayaṃ deveṣu jāgṛviḥ suta eti pavitra ā |
9,044.03 somo yāti vicarṣaṇiḥ ||
9,044.04  sa naḥ pavasva vājayuścakrāṇaścārumadhvaram |
9,044.04 barhiṣmāṃ ā vivāsati ||
9,044.05  sa no bhagāya vāyave vipravīraḥ sadāvṛdhaḥ |
9,044.05 somo deveṣvā yamat ||
9,044.06  sa no adya vasuttaye kratuvidgātuvittamaḥ |
9,044.06 vājaṃ jeṣi śravo bṛhat ||

9,045.01  sa pavasva madāya kaṃ nṛcakṣā devavītaye |
9,045.01 indavindrāya pītaye ||
9,045.02  sa no arṣābhi dūtyaṃ tvamindrāya tośase |
9,045.02 devānsakhibhya ā varam ||
9,045.03  uta tvāmaruṇaṃ vayaṃ gobhirañjmo madāya kam |
9,045.03 vi no rāye duro vṛdhi ||
9,045.04  atyū pavitramakramīdvājī dhuraṃ na yāmani |
9,045.04 indurdeveṣu patyate ||
9,045.05  samī sakhāyo asvaranvane krīḻantamatyavim |
9,045.05 induṃ nāvā anūṣata ||
9,045.06  tayā pavasva dhārayā yayā pīto vicakṣase |
9,045.06 indo stotre suvīryam ||

9,046.01  asṛgrandevavītaye'tyāsaḥ kṛtvyā iva |
9,046.01 kṣarantaḥ parvatāvṛdhaḥ ||
9,046.02  pariṣkṛtāsa indavo yoṣeva pitryāvatī |
9,046.02 vāyuṃ somā asṛkṣata ||
9,046.03  ete somāsa indavaḥ prayasvantaścamū sutāḥ |
9,046.03 indraṃ vardhanti karmabhiḥ ||
9,046.04  ā dhāvatā suhastyaḥ śukrā gṛbhṇīta manthinā |
9,046.04 gobhiḥ śrīṇīta matsaram ||
9,046.05  sa pavasva dhanañjaya prayantā rādhaso mahaḥ |
9,046.05 asmabhyaṃ soma gātuvit ||
9,046.06  etaṃ mṛjanti marjyaṃ pavamānaṃ daśa kṣipaḥ |
9,046.06 indrāya matsaraṃ madam ||

9,047.01  ayā somaḥ sukṛtyayā mahaścidabhyavardhata |
9,047.01 mandāna udvṛṣāyate ||
9,047.02  kṛtānīdasya kartvā cetante dasyutarhaṇā |
9,047.02 ṛṇā ca dhṛṣṇuścayate ||
9,047.03  ātsoma indriyo raso vajraḥ sahasrasā bhuvat |
9,047.03 ukthaṃ yadasya jāyate ||
9,047.04  svayaṃ kavirvidhartari viprāya ratnamicchati |
9,047.04 yadī marmṛjyate dhiyaḥ ||
9,047.05  siṣāsatū rayīṇāṃ vājeṣvarvatāmiva |
9,047.05 bhareṣu jigyuṣāmasi ||

9,048.01  taṃ tvā nṛmṇāni bibhrataṃ sadhastheṣu maho divaḥ |
9,048.01 cāruṃ sukṛtyayemahe ||
9,048.02  saṃvṛktadhṛṣṇumukthyaṃ mahāmahivrataṃ madam |
9,048.02 śataṃ puro rurukṣaṇim ||
9,048.03  atastvā rayimabhi rājānaṃ sukrato divaḥ |
9,048.03 suparṇo avyathirbharat ||
9,048.04  viśvasmā itsvardṛśe sādhāraṇaṃ rajasturam |
9,048.04 gopāmṛtasya virbharat ||
9,048.05  adhā hinvāna indriyaṃ jyāyo mahitvamānaśe |
9,048.05 abhiṣṭikṛdvicarṣaṇiḥ ||

9,049.01  pavasva vṛṣṭimā su no'pāmūrmiṃ divaspari |
9,049.01 ayakṣmā bṛhatīriṣaḥ ||
9,049.02  tayā pavasva dhārayā yayā gāva ihāgaman |
9,049.02 janyāsa upa no gṛham ||
9,049.03  ghṛtaṃ pavasva dhārayā yajñeṣu devavītamaḥ |
9,049.03 asmabhyaṃ vṛṣṭimā pava ||
9,049.04  sa na ūrje vyavyayaṃ pavitraṃ dhāva dhārayā |
9,049.04 devāsaḥ śṛṇavanhi kam ||
9,049.05  pavamāno asiṣyadadrakṣāṃsyapajaṅghanat |
9,049.05 pratnavadrocayanrucaḥ ||

9,050.01  utte śuṣmāsa īrate sindhorūrmeriva svanaḥ |
9,050.01 vāṇasya codayā pavim ||
9,050.02  prasave ta udīrate tisro vāco makhasyuvaḥ |
9,050.02 yadavya eṣi sānavi ||
9,050.03  avyo vāre pari priyaṃ hariṃ hinvantyadribhiḥ |
9,050.03 pavamānaṃ madhuścutam ||
9,050.04  ā pavasva madintama pavitraṃ dhārayā kave |
9,050.04 arkasya yonimāsadam ||
9,050.05  sa pavasva madintama gobhirañjāno aktubhiḥ |
9,050.05 indavindrāya pītaye ||

9,051.01  adhvaryo adribhiḥ sutaṃ somaṃ pavitra ā sṛja |
9,051.01 punīhīndrāya pātave ||
9,051.02  divaḥ pīyūṣamuttamaṃ somamindrāya vajriṇe |
9,051.02 sunotā madhumattamam ||
9,051.03  tava tya indo andhaso devā madhorvyaśnate |
9,051.03 pavamānasya marutaḥ ||
9,051.04  tvaṃ hi soma vardhayansuto madāya bhūrṇaye |
9,051.04 vṛṣanstotāramūtaye ||
9,051.05  abhyarṣa vicakṣaṇa pavitraṃ dhārayā sutaḥ |
9,051.05 abhi vājamuta śravaḥ ||

9,052.01  pari dyukṣaḥ sanadrayirbharadvājaṃ no andhasā |
9,052.01 suvāno arṣa pavitra ā ||
9,052.02  tava pratnebhiradhvabhiravyo vāre pari priyaḥ |
9,052.02 sahasradhāro yāttanā ||
9,052.03  carurna yastamīṅkhayendo na dānamīṅkhaya |
9,052.03 vadhairvadhasnavīṅkhaya ||
9,052.04  ni śuṣmamindaveṣāṃ puruhūta janānām |
9,052.04 yo asmāṃ ādideśati ||
9,052.05  śataṃ na inda ūtibhiḥ sahasraṃ vā śucīnām |
9,052.05 pavasva maṃhayadrayiḥ ||

9,053.01  utte śuṣmāso asthū rakṣo bhindanto adrivaḥ |
9,053.01 nudasva yāḥ parispṛdhaḥ ||
9,053.02  ayā nijaghnirojasā rathasaṃge dhane hite |
9,053.02 stavā abibhyuṣā hṛdā ||
9,053.03  asya vratāni nādhṛṣe pavamānasya dūḍhyā |
9,053.03 ruja yastvā pṛtanyati ||
9,053.04  taṃ hinvanti madacyutaṃ hariṃ nadīṣu vājinam |
9,053.04 indumindrāya matsaram ||

9,054.01  asya pratnāmanu dyutaṃ śukraṃ duduhre ahrayaḥ |
9,054.01 payaḥ sahasrasāmṛṣim ||
9,054.02  ayaṃ sūrya ivopadṛgayaṃ sarāṃsi dhāvati |
9,054.02 sapta pravata ā divam ||
9,054.03  ayaṃ viśvāni tiṣṭhati punāno bhuvanopari |
9,054.03 somo devo na sūryaḥ ||
9,054.04  pari ṇo devavītaye vājāṃ arṣasi gomataḥ |
9,054.04 punāna indavindrayuḥ ||

9,055.01  yavaṃyavaṃ no andhasā puṣṭampuṣṭaṃ pari srava |
9,055.01 soma viśvā ca saubhagā ||
9,055.02  indo yathā tava stavo yathā te jātamandhasaḥ |
9,055.02 ni barhiṣi priye sadaḥ ||
9,055.03  uta no govidaśvavitpavasva somāndhasā |
9,055.03 makṣūtamebhirahabhiḥ ||
9,055.04  yo jināti na jīyate hanti śatrumabhītya |
9,055.04 sa pavasva sahasrajit ||

9,056.01  pari soma ṛtaṃ bṛhadāśuḥ pavitre arṣati |
9,056.01 vighnanrakṣāṃsi devayuḥ ||
9,056.02  yatsomo vājamarṣati śataṃ dhārā apasyuvaḥ |
9,056.02 indrasya sakhyamāviśan ||
9,056.03  abhi tvā yoṣaṇo daśa jāraṃ na kanyānūṣata |
9,056.03 mṛjyase soma sātaye ||
9,056.04  tvamindrāya viṣṇave svādurindo pari srava |
9,056.04 nṝnstotṝnpāhyaṃhasaḥ ||

9,057.01  pra te dhārā asaścato divo na yanti vṛṣṭayaḥ |
9,057.01 acchā vājaṃ sahasriṇam ||
9,057.02  abhi priyāṇi kāvyā viśvā cakṣāṇo arṣati |
9,057.02 haristuñjāna āyudhā ||
9,057.03  sa marmṛjāna āyubhiribho rājeva suvrataḥ |
9,057.03 śyeno na vaṃsu ṣīdati ||
9,057.04  sa no viśvā divo vasūto pṛthivyā adhi |
9,057.04 punāna indavā bhara ||

9,058.01  taratsa mandī dhāvati dhārā sutasyāndhasaḥ |
9,058.01 taratsa mandī dhāvati ||
9,058.02  usrā veda vasūnāṃ martasya devyavasaḥ |
9,058.02 taratsa mandī dhāvati ||
9,058.03  dhvasrayoḥ puruṣantyorā sahasrāṇi dadmahe |
9,058.03 taratsa mandī dhāvati ||
9,058.04  ā yayostriṃśataṃ tanā sahasrāṇi ca dadmahe |
9,058.04 taratsa mandī dhāvati ||

9,059.01  pavasva gojidaśvajidviśvajitsoma raṇyajit |
9,059.01 prajāvadratnamā bhara ||
9,059.02  pavasvādbhyo adābhyaḥ pavasvauṣadhībhyaḥ |
9,059.02 pavasva dhiṣaṇābhyaḥ ||
9,059.03  tvaṃ soma pavamāno viśvāni duritā tara |
9,059.03 kaviḥ sīda ni barhiṣi ||
9,059.04  pavamāna svarvido jāyamāno'bhavo mahān |
9,059.04 indo viśvāṃ abhīdasi ||
9,060.01  pra gāyatreṇa gāyata pavamānaṃ vicarṣaṇim |
9,060.01 induṃ sahasracakṣasam ||
9,060.02  taṃ tvā sahasracakṣasamatho sahasrabharṇasam |
9,060.02 ati vāramapāviṣuḥ ||
9,060.03  ati vārānpavamāno asiṣyadatkalaśāṃ abhi dhāvati |
9,060.03 indrasya hārdyāviśan ||
9,060.04  indrasya soma rādhase śaṃ pavasva vicarṣaṇe |
9,060.04 prajāvadreta ā bhara ||

9,061.01  ayā vītī pari srava yasta indo madeṣvā |
9,061.01 avāhannavatīrnava ||
9,061.02  puraḥ sadya itthādhiye divodāsāya śambaram |
9,061.02 adha tyaṃ turvaśaṃ yadum ||
9,061.03  pari ṇo aśvamaśvavidgomadindo hiraṇyavat |
9,061.03 kṣarā sahasriṇīriṣaḥ ||
9,061.04  pavamānasya te vayaṃ pavitramabhyundataḥ |
9,061.04 sakhitvamā vṛṇīmahe ||
9,061.05  ye te pavitramūrmayo'bhikṣaranti dhārayā |
9,061.05 tebhirnaḥ soma mṛḻaya ||
9,061.06  sa naḥ punāna ā bhara rayiṃ vīravatīmiṣam |
9,061.06 īśānaḥ soma viśvataḥ ||
9,061.07  etamu tyaṃ daśa kṣipo mṛjanti sindhumātaram |
9,061.07 samādityebhirakhyata ||
9,061.08  samindreṇota vāyunā suta eti pavitra ā |
9,061.08 saṃ sūryasya raśmibhiḥ ||
9,061.09  sa no bhagāya vāyave pūṣṇe pavasva madhumān |
9,061.09 cārurmitre varuṇe ca ||
9,061.10  uccā te jātamandhaso divi ṣadbhūmyā dade |
9,061.10 ugraṃ śarma mahi śravaḥ ||
9,061.11  enā viśvānyarya ā dyumnāni mānuṣāṇām |
9,061.11 siṣāsanto vanāmahe ||
9,061.12  sa na indrāya yajyave varuṇāya marudbhyaḥ |
9,061.12 varivovitpari srava ||
9,061.13  upo ṣu jātamapturaṃ gobhirbhaṅgaṃ pariṣkṛtam |
9,061.13 induṃ devā ayāsiṣuḥ ||
9,061.14  tamidvardhantu no giro vatsaṃ saṃśiśvarīriva |
9,061.14 ya indrasya hṛdaṃsaniḥ ||
9,061.15  arṣā ṇaḥ soma śaṃ gave dhukṣasva pipyuṣīmiṣam |
9,061.15 vardhā samudramukthyam ||
9,061.16  pavamāno ajījanaddivaścitraṃ na tanyatum |
9,061.16 jyotirvaiśvānaraṃ bṛhat ||
9,061.17  pavamānasya te raso mado rājannaducchunaḥ |
9,061.17 vi vāramavyamarṣati ||
9,061.18  pavamāna rasastava dakṣo vi rājati dyumān |
9,061.18 jyotirviśvaṃ svardṛśe ||
9,061.19  yaste mado vareṇyastenā pavasvāndhasā |
9,061.19 devāvīraghaśaṃsahā ||
9,061.20  jaghnirvṛtramamitriyaṃ sasnirvājaṃ divedive |
9,061.20 goṣā u aśvasā asi ||
9,061.21  sammiślo aruṣo bhava sūpasthābhirna dhenubhiḥ |
9,061.21 sīdañchyeno na yonimā ||
9,061.22  sa pavasva ya āvithendraṃ vṛtrāya hantave |
9,061.22 vavrivāṃsaṃ mahīrapaḥ ||
9,061.23  suvīrāso vayaṃ dhanā jayema soma mīḍhvaḥ |
9,061.23 punāno vardha no giraḥ ||
9,061.24  tvotāsastavāvasā syāma vanvanta āmuraḥ |
9,061.24 soma vrateṣu jāgṛhi ||
9,061.25  apaghnanpavate mṛdho'pa somo arāvṇaḥ |
9,061.25 gacchannindrasya niṣkṛtam ||
9,061.26  maho no rāya ā bhara pavamāna jahī mṛdhaḥ |
9,061.26 rāsvendo vīravadyaśaḥ ||
9,061.27  na tvā śataṃ cana hruto rādho ditsantamā minan |
9,061.27 yatpunāno makhasyase ||
9,061.28  pavasvendo vṛṣā sutaḥ kṛdhī no yaśaso jane |
9,061.28 viśvā apa dviṣo jahi ||
9,061.29  asya te sakhye vayaṃ tavendo dyumna uttame |
9,061.29 sāsahyāma pṛtanyataḥ ||
9,061.30  yā te bhīmānyāyudhā tigmāni santi dhūrvaṇe |
9,061.30 rakṣā samasya no nidaḥ ||

9,062.01  ete asṛgramindavastiraḥ pavitramāśavaḥ |
9,062.01 viśvānyabhi saubhagā ||
9,062.02  vighnanto duritā puru sugā tokāya vājinaḥ |
9,062.02 tanā kṛṇvanto arvate ||
9,062.03  kṛṇvanto varivo gave'bhyarṣanti suṣṭutim |
9,062.03 iḻāmasmabhyaṃ saṃyatam ||
9,062.04  asāvyaṃśurmadāyāpsu dakṣo giriṣṭhāḥ |
9,062.04 śyeno na yonimāsadat ||
9,062.05  śubhramandho devavātamapsu dhūto nṛbhiḥ sutaḥ |
9,062.05 svadanti gāvaḥ payobhiḥ ||
9,062.06  ādīmaśvaṃ na hetāro'śūśubhannamṛtāya |
9,062.06 madhvo rasaṃ sadhamāde ||
9,062.07  yāste dhārā madhuścuto'sṛgraminda ūtaye |
9,062.07 tābhiḥ pavitramāsadaḥ ||
9,062.08  so arṣendrāya pītaye tiro romāṇyavyayā |
9,062.08 sīdanyonā vaneṣvā ||
9,062.09  tvamindo pari srava svādiṣṭho aṅgirobhyaḥ |
9,062.09 varivovidghṛtaṃ payaḥ ||
9,062.10  ayaṃ vicarṣaṇirhitaḥ pavamānaḥ sa cetati |
9,062.10 hinvāna āpyaṃ bṛhat ||
9,062.11  eṣa vṛṣā vṛṣavrataḥ pavamāno aśastihā |
9,062.11 karadvasūni dāśuṣe ||
9,062.12  ā pavasva sahasriṇaṃ rayiṃ gomantamaśvinam |
9,062.12 puruścandraṃ puruspṛham ||
9,062.13  eṣa sya pari ṣicyate marmṛjyamāna āyubhiḥ |
9,062.13 urugāyaḥ kavikratuḥ ||
9,062.14  sahasrotiḥ śatāmagho vimāno rajasaḥ kaviḥ |
9,062.14 indrāya pavate madaḥ ||
9,062.15  girā jāta iha stuta indurindrāya dhīyate |
9,062.15 viryonā vasatāviva ||
9,062.16  pavamānaḥ suto nṛbhiḥ somo vājamivāsarat |
9,062.16 camūṣu śakmanāsadam ||
9,062.17  taṃ tripṛṣṭhe trivandhure rathe yuñjanti yātave |
9,062.17 ṛṣīṇāṃ sapta dhītibhiḥ ||
9,062.18  taṃ sotāro dhanaspṛtamāśuṃ vājāya yātave |
9,062.18 hariṃ hinota vājinam ||
9,062.19  āviśankalaśaṃ suto viśvā arṣannabhi śriyaḥ |
9,062.19 śūro na goṣu tiṣṭhati ||
9,062.20  ā ta indo madāya kaṃ payo duhantyāyavaḥ |
9,062.20 devā devebhyo madhu ||
9,062.21  ā naḥ somaṃ pavitra ā sṛjatā madhumattamam |
9,062.21 devebhyo devaśruttamam ||
9,062.22  ete somā asṛkṣata gṛṇānāḥ śravase mahe |
9,062.22 madintamasya dhārayā ||
9,062.23  abhi gavyāni vītaye nṛmṇā punāno arṣasi |
9,062.23 sanadvājaḥ pari srava ||
9,062.24  uta no gomatīriṣo viśvā arṣa pariṣṭubhaḥ |
9,062.24 gṛṇāno jamadagninā ||
9,062.25  pavasva vāco agriyaḥ soma citrābhirūtibhiḥ |
9,062.25 abhi viśvāni kāvyā ||
9,062.26  tvaṃ samudriyā apo'griyo vāca īrayan |
9,062.26 pavasva viśvamejaya ||
9,062.27  tubhyemā bhuvanā kave mahimne soma tasthire |
9,062.27 tubhyamarṣanti sindhavaḥ ||
9,062.28  pra te divo na vṛṣṭayo dhārā yantyasaścataḥ |
9,062.28 abhi śukrāmupastiram ||
9,062.29  indrāyenduṃ punītanograṃ dakṣāya sādhanam |
9,062.29 īśānaṃ vītirādhasam ||
9,062.30  pavamāna ṛtaḥ kaviḥ somaḥ pavitramāsadat |
9,062.30 dadhatstotre suvīryam ||

9,063.01  ā pavasva sahasriṇaṃ rayiṃ soma suvīryam |
9,063.01 asme śravāṃsi dhāraya ||
9,063.02  iṣamūrjaṃ ca pinvasa indrāya matsarintamaḥ |
9,063.02 camūṣvā ni ṣīdasi ||
9,063.03  suta indrāya viṣṇave somaḥ kalaśe akṣarat |
9,063.03 madhumāṃ astu vāyave ||
9,063.04  ete asṛgramāśavo'ti hvarāṃsi babhravaḥ |
9,063.04 somā ṛtasya dhārayā ||
9,063.05  indraṃ vardhanto apturaḥ kṛṇvanto viśvamāryam |
9,063.05 apaghnanto arāvṇaḥ ||
9,063.06  sutā anu svamā rajo'bhyarṣanti babhravaḥ |
9,063.06 indraṃ gacchanta indavaḥ ||
9,063.07  ayā pavasva dhārayā yayā sūryamarocayaḥ |
9,063.07 hinvāno mānuṣīrapaḥ ||
9,063.08  ayukta sūra etaśaṃ pavamāno manāvadhi |
9,063.08 antarikṣeṇa yātave ||
9,063.09  uta tyā harito daśa sūro ayukta yātave |
9,063.09 indurindra iti bruvan ||
9,063.10  parīto vāyave sutaṃ gira indrāya matsaram |
9,063.10 avyo vāreṣu siñcata ||
9,063.11  pavamāna vidā rayimasmabhyaṃ soma duṣṭaram |
9,063.11 yo dūṇāśo vanuṣyatā ||
9,063.12  abhyarṣa sahasriṇaṃ rayiṃ gomantamaśvinam |
9,063.12 abhi vājamuta śravaḥ ||
9,063.13  somo devo na sūryo'dribhiḥ pavate sutaḥ |
9,063.13 dadhānaḥ kalaśe rasam ||
9,063.14  ete dhāmānyāryā śukrā ṛtasya dhārayā |
9,063.14 vājaṃ gomantamakṣaran ||
9,063.15  sutā indrāya vajriṇe somāso dadhyāśiraḥ |
9,063.15 pavitramatyakṣaran ||
9,063.16  pra soma madhumattamo rāye arṣa pavitra ā |
9,063.16 mado yo devavītamaḥ ||
9,063.17  tamī mṛjantyāyavo hariṃ nadīṣu vājinam |
9,063.17 indumindrāya matsaram ||
9,063.18  ā pavasva hiraṇyavadaśvāvatsoma vīravat |
9,063.18 vājaṃ gomantamā bhara ||
9,063.19  pari vāje na vājayumavyo vāreṣu siñcata |
9,063.19 indrāya madhumattamam ||
9,063.20  kaviṃ mṛjanti marjyaṃ dhībhirviprā avasyavaḥ |
9,063.20 vṛṣā kanikradarṣati ||
9,063.21  vṛṣaṇaṃ dhībhirapturaṃ somamṛtasya dhārayā |
9,063.21 matī viprāḥ samasvaran ||
9,063.22  pavasva devāyuṣagindraṃ gacchatu te madaḥ |
9,063.22 vāyumā roha dharmaṇā ||
9,063.23  pavamāna ni tośase rayiṃ soma śravāyyam |
9,063.23 priyaḥ samudramā viśa ||
9,063.24  apaghnanpavase mṛdhaḥ kratuvitsoma matsaraḥ |
9,063.24 nudasvādevayuṃ janam ||
9,063.25  pavamānā asṛkṣata somāḥ śukrāsa indavaḥ |
9,063.25 abhi viśvāni kāvyā ||
9,063.26  pavamānāsa āśavaḥ śubhrā asṛgramindavaḥ |
9,063.26 ghnanto viśvā apa dviṣaḥ ||
9,063.27  pavamānā divasparyantarikṣādasṛkṣata |
9,063.27 pṛthivyā adhi sānavi ||
9,063.28  punānaḥ soma dhārayendo viśvā apa sridhaḥ |
9,063.28 jahi rakṣāṃsi sukrato ||
9,063.29  apaghnansoma rakṣaso'bhyarṣa kanikradat |
9,063.29 dyumantaṃ śuṣmamuttamam ||
9,063.30  asme vasūni dhāraya soma divyāni pārthivā |
9,063.30 indo viśvāni vāryā ||

9,064.01  vṛṣā soma dyumāṃ asi vṛṣā deva vṛṣavrataḥ |
9,064.01 vṛṣā dharmāṇi dadhiṣe ||
9,064.02  vṛṣṇaste vṛṣṇyaṃ śavo vṛṣā vanaṃ vṛṣā madaḥ |
9,064.02 satyaṃ vṛṣanvṛṣedasi ||
9,064.03  aśvo na cakrado vṛṣā saṃ gā indo samarvataḥ |
9,064.03 vi no rāye duro vṛdhi ||
9,064.04  asṛkṣata pra vājino gavyā somāso aśvayā |
9,064.04 śukrāso vīrayāśavaḥ ||
9,064.05  śumbhamānā ṛtāyubhirmṛjyamānā gabhastyoḥ |
9,064.05 pavante vāre avyaye ||
9,064.06  te viśvā dāśuṣe vasu somā divyāni pārthivā |
9,064.06 pavantāmāntarikṣyā ||
9,064.07  pavamānasya viśvavitpra te sargā asṛkṣata |
9,064.07 sūryasyeva na raśmayaḥ ||
9,064.08  ketuṃ kṛṇvandivaspari viśvā rūpābhyarṣasi |
9,064.08 samudraḥ soma pinvase ||
9,064.09  hinvāno vācamiṣyasi pavamāna vidharmaṇi |
9,064.09 akrāndevo na sūryaḥ ||
9,064.10  induḥ paviṣṭa cetanaḥ priyaḥ kavīnāṃ matī |
9,064.10 sṛjadaśvaṃ rathīriva ||
9,064.11  ūrmiryaste pavitra ā devāvīḥ paryakṣarat |
9,064.11 sīdannṛtasya yonimā ||
9,064.12  sa no arṣa pavitra ā mado yo devavītamaḥ |
9,064.12 indavindrāya pītaye ||
9,064.13  iṣe pavasva dhārayā mṛjyamāno manīṣibhiḥ |
9,064.13 indo rucābhi gā ihi ||
9,064.14  punāno varivaskṛdhyūrjaṃ janāya girvaṇaḥ |
9,064.14 hare sṛjāna āśiram ||
9,064.15  punāno devavītaya indrasya yāhi niṣkṛtam |
9,064.15 dyutāno vājibhiryataḥ ||
9,064.16  pra hinvānāsa indavo'cchā samudramāśavaḥ |
9,064.16 dhiyā jūtā asṛkṣata ||
9,064.17  marmṛjānāsa āyavo vṛthā samudramindavaḥ |
9,064.17 agmannṛtasya yonimā ||
9,064.18  pari ṇo yāhyasmayurviśvā vasūnyojasā |
9,064.18 pāhi naḥ śarma vīravat ||
9,064.19  mimāti vahniretaśaḥ padaṃ yujāna ṛkvabhiḥ |
9,064.19 pra yatsamudra āhitaḥ ||
9,064.20  ā yadyoniṃ hiraṇyayamāśurṛtasya sīdati |
9,064.20 jahātyapracetasaḥ ||
9,064.21  abhi venā anūṣateyakṣanti pracetasaḥ |
9,064.21 majjantyavicetasaḥ ||
9,064.22  indrāyendo marutvate pavasva madhumattamaḥ |
9,064.22 ṛtasya yonimāsadam ||
9,064.23  taṃ tvā viprā vacovidaḥ pari ṣkṛṇvanti vedhasaḥ |
9,064.23 saṃ tvā mṛjantyāyavaḥ ||
9,064.24  rasaṃ te mitro aryamā pibanti varuṇaḥ kave |
9,064.24 pavamānasya marutaḥ ||
9,064.25  tvaṃ soma vipaścitaṃ punāno vācamiṣyasi |
9,064.25 indo sahasrabharṇasam ||
9,064.26  uto sahasrabharṇasaṃ vācaṃ soma makhasyuvam |
9,064.26 punāna indavā bhara ||
9,064.27  punāna indaveṣāṃ puruhūta janānām |
9,064.27 priyaḥ samudramā viśa ||
9,064.28  davidyutatyā rucā pariṣṭobhantyā kṛpā |
9,064.28 somāḥ śukrā gavāśiraḥ ||
9,064.29  hinvāno hetṛbhiryata ā vājaṃ vājyakramīt |
9,064.29 sīdanto vanuṣo yathā ||
9,064.30  ṛdhaksoma svastaye saṃjagmāno divaḥ kaviḥ |
9,064.30 pavasva sūryo dṛśe ||

9,065.01  hinvanti sūramusrayaḥ svasāro jāmayaspatim |
9,065.01 mahāminduṃ mahīyuvaḥ ||
9,065.02  pavamāna rucārucā devo devebhyaspari |
9,065.02 viśvā vasūnyā viśa ||
9,065.03  ā pavamāna suṣṭutiṃ vṛṣṭiṃ devebhyo duvaḥ |
9,065.03 iṣe pavasva saṃyatam ||
9,065.04  vṛṣā hyasi bhānunā dyumantaṃ tvā havāmahe |
9,065.04 pavamāna svādhyaḥ ||
9,065.05  ā pavasva suvīryaṃ mandamānaḥ svāyudha |
9,065.05 iho ṣvindavā gahi ||
9,065.06  yadadbhiḥ pariṣicyase mṛjyamāno gabhastyoḥ |
9,065.06 druṇā sadhasthamaśnuṣe ||
9,065.07  pra somāya vyaśvavatpavamānāya gāyata |
9,065.07 mahe sahasracakṣase ||
9,065.08  yasya varṇaṃ madhuścutaṃ hariṃ hinvantyadribhiḥ |
9,065.08 indumindrāya pītaye ||
9,065.09  tasya te vājino vayaṃ viśvā dhanāni jigyuṣaḥ |
9,065.09 sakhitvamā vṛṇīmahe ||
9,065.10  vṛṣā pavasva dhārayā marutvate ca matsaraḥ |
9,065.10 viśvā dadhāna ojasā ||
9,065.11  taṃ tvā dhartāramoṇyoḥ pavamāna svardṛśam |
9,065.11 hinve vājeṣu vājinam ||
9,065.12  ayā citto vipānayā hariḥ pavasva dhārayā |
9,065.12 yujaṃ vājeṣu codaya ||
9,065.13  ā na indo mahīmiṣaṃ pavasva viśvadarśataḥ |
9,065.13 asmabhyaṃ soma gātuvit ||
9,065.14  ā kalaśā anūṣatendo dhārābhirojasā |
9,065.14 endrasya pītaye viśa ||
9,065.15  yasya te madyaṃ rasaṃ tīvraṃ duhantyadribhiḥ |
9,065.15 sa pavasvābhimātihā ||
9,065.16  rājā medhābhirīyate pavamāno manāvadhi |
9,065.16 antarikṣeṇa yātave ||
9,065.17  ā na indo śatagvinaṃ gavāṃ poṣaṃ svaśvyam |
9,065.17 vahā bhagattimūtaye ||
9,065.18  ā naḥ soma saho juvo rūpaṃ na varcase bhara |
9,065.18 suṣvāṇo devavītaye ||
9,065.19  arṣā soma dyumattamo'bhi droṇāni roruvat |
9,065.19 sīdañchyeno na yonimā ||
9,065.20  apsā indrāya vāyave varuṇāya marudbhyaḥ |
9,065.20 somo arṣati viṣṇave ||
9,065.21  iṣaṃ tokāya no dadhadasmabhyaṃ soma viśvataḥ |
9,065.21 ā pavasva sahasriṇam ||
9,065.22  ye somāsaḥ parāvati ye arvāvati sunvire |
9,065.22 ye vādaḥ śaryaṇāvati ||
9,065.23  ya ārjīkeṣu kṛtvasu ye madhye pastyānām |
9,065.23 ye vā janeṣu pañcasu ||
9,065.24  te no vṛṣṭiṃ divaspari pavantāmā suvīryam |
9,065.24 suvānā devāsa indavaḥ ||
9,065.25  pavate haryato harirgṛṇāno jamadagninā |
9,065.25 hinvāno goradhi tvaci ||
9,065.26  pra śukrāso vayojuvo hinvānāso na saptayaḥ |
9,065.26 śrīṇānā apsu mṛñjata ||
9,065.27  taṃ tvā suteṣvābhuvo hinvire devatātaye |
9,065.27 sa pavasvānayā rucā ||
9,065.28  ā te dakṣaṃ mayobhuvaṃ vahnimadyā vṛṇīmahe |
9,065.28 pāntamā puruspṛham ||
9,065.29  ā mandramā vareṇyamā vipramā manīṣiṇam |
9,065.29 pāntamā puruspṛham ||
9,065.30  ā rayimā sucetunamā sukrato tanūṣvā |
9,065.30 pāntamā puruspṛham ||

9,066.01  pavasva viśvacarṣaṇe'bhi viśvāni kāvyā |
9,066.01 sakhā sakhibhya īḍyaḥ ||
9,066.02  tābhyāṃ viśvasya rājasi ye pavamāna dhāmanī |
9,066.02 pratīcī soma tasthatuḥ ||
9,066.03  pari dhāmāni yāni te tvaṃ somāsi viśvataḥ |
9,066.03 pavamāna ṛtubhiḥ kave ||
9,066.04  pavasva janayanniṣo'bhi viśvāni vāryā |
9,066.04 sakhā sakhibhya ūtaye ||
9,066.05  tava śukrāso arcayo divaspṛṣṭhe vi tanvate |
9,066.05 pavitraṃ soma dhāmabhiḥ ||
9,066.06  taveme sapta sindhavaḥ praśiṣaṃ soma sisrate |
9,066.06 tubhyaṃ dhāvanti dhenavaḥ ||
9,066.07  pra soma yāhi dhārayā suta indrāya matsaraḥ |
9,066.07 dadhāno akṣiti śravaḥ ||
9,066.08  samu tvā dhībhirasvaranhinvatīḥ sapta jāmayaḥ |
9,066.08 vipramājā vivasvataḥ ||
9,066.09  mṛjanti tvā samagruvo'vye jīrāvadhi ṣvaṇi |
9,066.09 rebho yadajyase vane ||
9,066.10  pavamānasya te kave vājinsargā asṛkṣata |
9,066.10 arvanto na śravasyavaḥ ||
9,066.11  acchā kośaṃ madhuścutamasṛgraṃ vāre avyaye |
9,066.11 avāvaśanta dhītayaḥ ||
9,066.12  acchā samudramindavo'staṃ gāvo na dhenavaḥ |
9,066.12 agmannṛtasya yonimā ||
9,066.13  pra ṇa indo mahe raṇa āpo arṣanti sindhavaḥ |
9,066.13 yadgobhirvāsayiṣyase ||
9,066.14  asya te sakhye vayamiyakṣantastvotayaḥ |
9,066.14 indo sakhitvamuśmasi ||
9,066.15  ā pavasva gaviṣṭaye mahe soma nṛcakṣase |
9,066.15 endrasya jaṭhare viśa ||
9,066.16  mahāṃ asi soma jyeṣṭha ugrāṇāminda ojiṣṭhaḥ |
9,066.16 yudhvā sañchaśvajjigetha ||
9,066.17  ya ugrebhyaścidojīyāñchūrebhyaścicchūrataraḥ |
9,066.17 bhūridābhyaścinmaṃhīyān ||
9,066.18  tvaṃ soma sūra eṣastokasya sātā tanūnām |
9,066.18 vṛṇīmahe sakhyāya vṛṇīmahe yujyāya ||
9,066.19  agna āyūṃṣi pavasa ā suvorjamiṣaṃ ca naḥ |
9,066.19 āre bādhasva ducchunām ||
9,066.20  agnirṛṣiḥ pavamānaḥ pāñcajanyaḥ purohitaḥ |
9,066.20 tamīmahe mahāgayam ||
9,066.21  agne pavasva svapā asme varcaḥ suvīryam |
9,066.21 dadhadrayiṃ mayi poṣam ||
9,066.22  pavamāno ati sridho'bhyarṣati suṣṭutim |
9,066.22 sūro na viśvadarśataḥ ||
9,066.23  sa marmṛjāna āyubhiḥ prayasvānprayase hitaḥ |
9,066.23 induratyo vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
9,066.24  pavamāna ṛtaṃ bṛhacchukraṃ jyotirajījanat |
9,066.24 kṛṣṇā tamāṃsi jaṅghanat ||
9,066.25  pavamānasya jaṅghnato hareścandrā asṛkṣata |
9,066.25 jīrā ajiraśociṣaḥ ||
9,066.26  pavamāno rathītamaḥ śubhrebhiḥ śubhraśastamaḥ |
9,066.26 hariścandro marudgaṇaḥ ||
9,066.27  pavamāno vyaśnavadraśmibhirvājasātamaḥ |
9,066.27 dadhatstotre suvīryam ||
9,066.28  pra suvāna indurakṣāḥ pavitramatyavyayam |
9,066.28 punāna indurindramā ||
9,066.29  eṣa somo adhi tvaci gavāṃ krīḻatyadribhiḥ |
9,066.29 indraṃ madāya johuvat ||
9,066.30  yasya te dyumnavatpayaḥ pavamānābhṛtaṃ divaḥ |
9,066.30 tena no mṛḻa jīvase ||

9,067.01  tvaṃ somāsi dhārayurmandra ojiṣṭho adhvare |
9,067.01 pavasva maṃhayadrayiḥ ||
9,067.02  tvaṃ suto nṛmādano dadhanvānmatsarintamaḥ |
9,067.02 indrāya sūrirandhasā ||
9,067.03  tvaṃ suṣvāṇo adribhirabhyarṣa kanikradat |
9,067.03 dyumantaṃ śuṣmamuttamam ||
9,067.04  indurhinvāno arṣati tiro vārāṇyavyayā |
9,067.04 harirvājamacikradat ||
9,067.05  indo vyavyamarṣasi vi śravāṃsi vi saubhagā |
9,067.05 vi vājānsoma gomataḥ ||
9,067.06  ā na indo śatagvinaṃ rayiṃ gomantamaśvinam |
9,067.06 bharā soma sahasriṇam ||
9,067.07  pavamānāsa indavastiraḥ pavitramāśavaḥ |
9,067.07 indraṃ yāmebhirāśata ||
9,067.08  kakuhaḥ somyo rasa indurindrāya pūrvyaḥ |
9,067.08 āyuḥ pavata āyave ||
9,067.09  hinvanti sūramusrayaḥ pavamānaṃ madhuścutam |
9,067.09 abhi girā samasvaran ||
9,067.10  avitā no ajāśvaḥ pūṣā yāmaniyāmani |
9,067.10 ā bhakṣatkanyāsu naḥ ||
9,067.11  ayaṃ somaḥ kapardine ghṛtaṃ na pavate madhu |
9,067.11 ā bhakṣatkanyāsu naḥ ||
9,067.12  ayaṃ ta āghṛṇe suto ghṛtaṃ na pavate śuci |
9,067.12 ā bhakṣatkanyāsu naḥ ||
9,067.13  vāco jantuḥ kavīnāṃ pavasva soma dhārayā |
9,067.13 deveṣu ratnadhā asi ||
9,067.14  ā kalaśeṣu dhāvati śyeno varma vi gāhate |
9,067.14 abhi droṇā kanikradat ||
9,067.15  pari pra soma te raso'sarji kalaśe sutaḥ |
9,067.15 śyeno na takto arṣati ||
9,067.16  pavasva soma mandayannindrāya madhumattamaḥ ||
9,067.17  asṛgrandevavītaye vājayanto rathā iva ||
9,067.18  te sutāso madintamāḥ śukrā vāyumasṛkṣata ||
9,067.19  grāvṇā tunno abhiṣṭutaḥ pavitraṃ soma gacchasi |
9,067.19 dadhatstotre suvīryam ||
9,067.20  eṣa tunno abhiṣṭutaḥ pavitramati gāhate |
9,067.20 rakṣohā vāramavyayam ||
9,067.21  yadanti yacca dūrake bhayaṃ vindati māmiha |
9,067.21 pavamāna vi tajjahi ||
9,067.22  pavamānaḥ so adya naḥ pavitreṇa vicarṣaṇiḥ |
9,067.22 yaḥ potā sa punātu naḥ ||
9,067.23  yatte pavitramarciṣyagne vitatamantarā |
9,067.23 brahma tena punīhi naḥ ||
9,067.24  yatte pavitramarcivadagne tena punīhi naḥ |
9,067.24 brahmasavaiḥ punīhi naḥ ||
9,067.25  ubhābhyāṃ deva savitaḥ pavitreṇa savena ca |
9,067.25 māṃ punīhi viśvataḥ ||
9,067.26  tribhiṣṭvaṃ deva savitarvarṣiṣṭhaiḥ soma dhāmabhiḥ |
9,067.26 agne dakṣaiḥ punīhi naḥ ||
9,067.27  punantu māṃ devajanāḥ punantu vasavo dhiyā |
9,067.27 viśve devāḥ punīta mā jātavedaḥ punīhi mā ||
9,067.28  pra pyāyasva pra syandasva soma viśvebhiraṃśubhiḥ |
9,067.28 devebhya uttamaṃ haviḥ ||
9,067.29  upa priyaṃ panipnataṃ yuvānamāhutīvṛdham |
9,067.29 aganma bibhrato namaḥ ||
9,067.30  alāyyasya paraśurnanāśa tamā pavasva deva soma |
9,067.30 ākhuṃ cideva deva soma ||
9,067.31  yaḥ pāvamānīradhyetyṛṣibhiḥ sambhṛtaṃ rasam |
9,067.31 sarvaṃ sa pūtamaśnāti svaditaṃ mātariśvanā ||
9,067.32  pāvamānīryo adhyetyṛṣibhiḥ sambhṛtaṃ rasam |
9,067.32 tasmai sarasvatī duhe kṣīraṃ sarpirmadhūdakam ||

9,068.01  pra devamacchā madhumanta indavo'siṣyadanta gāva ā na dhenavaḥ |
9,068.01 barhiṣado vacanāvanta ūdhabhiḥ parisrutamusriyā nirṇijaṃ dhire ||
9,068.02  sa roruvadabhi pūrvā acikradadupāruhaḥ śrathayansvādate hariḥ |
9,068.02 tiraḥ pavitraṃ pariyannuru jrayo ni śaryāṇi dadhate deva ā varam ||
9,068.03  vi yo mame yamyā saṃyatī madaḥ sākaṃvṛdhā payasā pinvadakṣitā |
9,068.03 mahī apāre rajasī vivevidadabhivrajannakṣitaṃ pāja ā dade ||
9,068.04  sa mātarā vicaranvājayannapaḥ pra medhiraḥ svadhayā pinvate padam |
9,068.04 aṃśuryavena pipiśe yato nṛbhiḥ saṃ jāmibhirnasate rakṣate śiraḥ ||
9,068.05  saṃ dakṣeṇa manasā jāyate kavirṛtasya garbho nihito yamā paraḥ |
9,068.05 yūnā ha santā prathamaṃ vi jajñaturguhā hitaṃ janima nemamudyatam ||
9,068.06  mandrasya rūpaṃ vividurmanīṣiṇaḥ śyeno yadandho abharatparāvataḥ |
9,068.06 taṃ marjayanta suvṛdhaṃ nadīṣvāṃ uśantamaṃśuṃ pariyantamṛgmiyam ||
9,068.07  tvāṃ mṛjanti daśa yoṣaṇaḥ sutaṃ soma ṛṣibhirmatibhirdhītibhirhitam |
9,068.07 avyo vārebhiruta devahūtibhirnṛbhiryato vājamā darṣi sātaye ||
9,068.08  pariprayantaṃ vayyaṃ suṣaṃsadaṃ somaṃ manīṣā abhyanūṣata stubhaḥ |
9,068.08 yo dhārayā madhumāṃ ūrmiṇā diva iyarti vācaṃ rayiṣāḻ amartyaḥ ||
9,068.09  ayaṃ diva iyarti viśvamā rajaḥ somaḥ punānaḥ kalaśeṣu sīdati |
9,068.09 adbhirgobhirmṛjyate adribhiḥ sutaḥ punāna indurvarivo vidatpriyam ||
9,068.10  evā naḥ soma pariṣicyamāno vayo dadhaccitratamaṃ pavasva |
9,068.10 adveṣe dyāvāpṛthivī huvema devā dhatta rayimasme suvīram ||

9,069.01  iṣurna dhanvanprati dhīyate matirvatso na māturupa sarjyūdhani |
9,069.01 urudhāreva duhe agra āyatyasya vrateṣvapi soma iṣyate ||
9,069.02  upo matiḥ pṛcyate sicyate madhu mandrājanī codate antarāsani |
9,069.02 pavamānaḥ saṃtaniḥ praghnatāmiva madhumāndrapsaḥ pari vāramarṣati ||
9,069.03  avye vadhūyuḥ pavate pari tvaci śrathnīte naptīraditerṛtaṃ yate |
9,069.03 harirakrānyajataḥ saṃyato mado nṛmṇā śiśāno mahiṣo na śobhate ||
9,069.04  ukṣā mimāti prati yanti dhenavo devasya devīrupa yanti niṣkṛtam |
9,069.04 atyakramīdarjunaṃ vāramavyayamatkaṃ na niktaṃ pari somo avyata ||
9,069.05  amṛktena ruśatā vāsasā hariramartyo nirṇijānaḥ pari vyata |
9,069.05 divaspṛṣṭhaṃ barhaṇā nirṇije kṛtopastaraṇaṃ camvornabhasmayam ||
9,069.06  sūryasyeva raśmayo drāvayitnavo matsarāsaḥ prasupaḥ sākamīrate |
9,069.06 tantuṃ tataṃ pari sargāsa āśavo nendrādṛte pavate dhāma kiṃ cana ||
9,069.07  sindhoriva pravaṇe nimna āśavo vṛṣacyutā madāso gātumāśata |
9,069.07 śaṃ no niveśe dvipade catuṣpade'sme vājāḥ soma tiṣṭhantu kṛṣṭayaḥ ||
9,069.08  ā naḥ pavasva vasumaddhiraṇyavadaśvāvadgomadyavamatsuvīryam |
9,069.08 yūyaṃ hi soma pitaro mama sthana divo mūrdhānaḥ prasthitā vayaskṛtaḥ ||
9,069.09  ete somāḥ pavamānāsa indraṃ rathā iva pra yayuḥ sātimaccha |
9,069.09 sutāḥ pavitramati yantyavyaṃ hitvī vavriṃ harito vṛṣṭimaccha ||
9,069.10  indavindrāya bṛhate pavasva sumṛḻīko anavadyo riśādāḥ |
9,069.10 bharā candrāṇi gṛṇate vasūni devairdyāvāpṛthivī prāvataṃ naḥ ||

9,070.01  trirasmai sapta dhenavo duduhre satyāmāśiraṃ pūrvye vyomani |
9,070.01 catvāryanyā bhuvanāni nirṇije cārūṇi cakre yadṛtairavardhata ||
9,070.02  sa bhikṣamāṇo amṛtasya cāruṇa ubhe dyāvā kāvyenā vi śaśrathe |
9,070.02 tejiṣṭhā apo maṃhanā pari vyata yadī devasya śravasā sado viduḥ ||
9,070.03  te asya santu ketavo'mṛtyavo'dābhyāso januṣī ubhe anu |
9,070.03 yebhirnṛmṇā ca devyā ca punata ādidrājānaṃ mananā agṛbhṇata ||
9,070.04  sa mṛjyamāno daśabhiḥ sukarmabhiḥ pra madhyamāsu mātṛṣu prame sacā |
9,070.04 vratāni pāno amṛtasya cāruṇa ubhe nṛcakṣā anu paśyate viśau ||
9,070.05  sa marmṛjāna indriyāya dhāyasa obhe antā rodasī harṣate hitaḥ |
9,070.05 vṛṣā śuṣmeṇa bādhate vi durmatīrādediśānaḥ śaryaheva śurudhaḥ ||
9,070.06  sa mātarā na dadṛśāna usriyo nānadadeti marutāmiva svanaḥ |
9,070.06 jānannṛtaṃ prathamaṃ yatsvarṇaraṃ praśastaye kamavṛṇīta sukratuḥ ||
9,070.07  ruvati bhīmo vṛṣabhastaviṣyayā śṛṅge śiśāno hariṇī vicakṣaṇaḥ |
9,070.07 ā yoniṃ somaḥ sukṛtaṃ ni ṣīdati gavyayī tvagbhavati nirṇigavyayī ||
9,070.08  śuciḥ punānastanvamarepasamavye harirnyadhāviṣṭa sānavi |
9,070.08 juṣṭo mitrāya varuṇāya vāyave tridhātu madhu kriyate sukarmabhiḥ ||
9,070.09  pavasva soma devavītaye vṛṣendrasya hārdi somadhānamā viśa |
9,070.09 purā no bādhādduritāti pāraya kṣetraviddhi diśa āhā vipṛcchate ||
9,070.10  hito na saptirabhi vājamarṣendrasyendo jaṭharamā pavasva |
9,070.10 nāvā na sindhumati parṣi vidvāñchūro na yudhyannava no nida spaḥ ||

9,071.01  ā dakṣiṇā sṛjyate śuṣmyāsadaṃ veti druho rakṣasaḥ pāti jāgṛviḥ |
9,071.01 hariropaśaṃ kṛṇute nabhaspaya upastire camvorbrahma nirṇije ||
9,071.02  pra kṛṣṭiheva śūṣa eti roruvadasuryaṃ varṇaṃ ni riṇīte asya tam |
9,071.02 jahāti vavriṃ pitureti niṣkṛtamupaprutaṃ kṛṇute nirṇijaṃ tanā ||
9,071.03  adribhiḥ sutaḥ pavate gabhastyorvṛṣāyate nabhasā vepate matī |
9,071.03 sa modate nasate sādhate girā nenikte apsu yajate parīmaṇi ||
9,071.04  pari dyukṣaṃ sahasaḥ parvatāvṛdhaṃ madhvaḥ siñcanti harmyasya sakṣaṇim |
9,071.04 ā yasmingāvaḥ suhutāda ūdhani mūrdhañchrīṇantyagriyaṃ varīmabhiḥ ||
9,071.05  samī rathaṃ na bhurijoraheṣata daśa svasāro aditerupastha ā |
9,071.05 jigādupa jrayati gorapīcyaṃ padaṃ yadasya matuthā ajījanan ||
9,071.06  śyeno na yoniṃ sadanaṃ dhiyā kṛtaṃ hiraṇyayamāsadaṃ deva eṣati |
9,071.06 e riṇanti barhiṣi priyaṃ girāśvo na devāṃ apyeti yajñiyaḥ ||
9,071.07  parā vyakto aruṣo divaḥ kavirvṛṣā tripṛṣṭho anaviṣṭa gā abhi |
9,071.07 sahasraṇītiryatiḥ parāyatī rebho na pūrvīruṣaso vi rājati ||
9,071.08  tveṣaṃ rūpaṃ kṛṇute varṇo asya sa yatrāśayatsamṛtā sedhati sridhaḥ |
9,071.08 apsā yāti svadhayā daivyaṃ janaṃ saṃ suṣṭutī nasate saṃ goagrayā ||
9,071.09  ukṣeva yūthā pariyannarāvīdadhi tviṣīradhita sūryasya |
9,071.09 divyaḥ suparṇo'va cakṣata kṣāṃ somaḥ pari kratunā paśyate jāḥ ||

9,072.01  hariṃ mṛjantyaruṣo na yujyate saṃ dhenubhiḥ kalaśe somo ajyate |
9,072.01 udvācamīrayati hinvate matī puruṣṭutasya kati citparipriyaḥ ||
9,072.02  sākaṃ vadanti bahavo manīṣiṇa indrasya somaṃ jaṭhare yadāduhuḥ |
9,072.02 yadī mṛjanti sugabhastayo naraḥ sanīḻābhirdaśabhiḥ kāmyaṃ madhu ||
9,072.03  aramamāṇo atyeti gā abhi sūryasya priyaṃ duhitustiro ravam |
9,072.03 anvasmai joṣamabharadvinaṅgṛsaḥ saṃ dvayībhiḥ svasṛbhiḥ kṣeti jāmibhiḥ ||
9,072.04  nṛdhūto adriṣuto barhiṣi priyaḥ patirgavāṃ pradiva indurṛtviyaḥ |
9,072.04 purandhivānmanuṣo yajñasādhanaḥ śucirdhiyā pavate soma indra te ||
9,072.05  nṛbāhubhyāṃ codito dhārayā suto'nuṣvadhaṃ pavate soma indra te |
9,072.05 āprāḥ kratūnsamajairadhvare matīrverna druṣaccamvorāsadaddhariḥ ||
9,072.06  aṃśuṃ duhanti stanayantamakṣitaṃ kaviṃ kavayo'paso manīṣiṇaḥ |
9,072.06 samī gāvo matayo yanti saṃyata ṛtasya yonā sadane punarbhuvaḥ ||
9,072.07  nābhā pṛthivyā dharuṇo maho divo'pāmūrmau sindhuṣvantarukṣitaḥ |
9,072.07 indrasya vajro vṛṣabho vibhūvasuḥ somo hṛde pavate cāru matsaraḥ ||
9,072.08  sa tū pavasva pari pārthivaṃ raja stotre śikṣannādhūnvate ca sukrato |
9,072.08 mā no nirbhāgvasunaḥ sādanaspṛśo rayiṃ piśaṅgaṃ bahulaṃ vasīmahi ||
9,072.09  ā tū na indo śatadātvaśvyaṃ sahasradātu paśumaddhiraṇyavat |
9,072.09 upa māsva bṛhatī revatīriṣo'dhi stotrasya pavamāna no gahi ||

9,073.01  srakve drapsasya dhamataḥ samasvarannṛtasya yonā samaranta nābhayaḥ |
9,073.01 trīnsa mūrdhno asuraścakra ārabhe satyasya nāvaḥ sukṛtamapīparan ||
9,073.02  samyaksamyañco mahiṣā aheṣata sindhorūrmāvadhi venā avīvipan |
9,073.02 madhordhārābhirjanayanto arkamitpriyāmindrasya tanvamavīvṛdhan ||
9,073.03  pavitravantaḥ pari vācamāsate pitaiṣāṃ pratno abhi rakṣati vratam |
9,073.03 mahaḥ samudraṃ varuṇastiro dadhe dhīrā icchekurdharuṇeṣvārabham ||
9,073.04  sahasradhāre'va te samasvarandivo nāke madhujihvā asaścataḥ |
9,073.04 asya spaśo na ni miṣanti bhūrṇayaḥ padepade pāśinaḥ santi setavaḥ ||
9,073.05  piturmāturadhyā ye samasvarannṛcā śocantaḥ saṃdahanto avratān |
9,073.05 indradviṣṭāmapa dhamanti māyayā tvacamasiknīṃ bhūmano divaspari ||
9,073.06  pratnānmānādadhyā ye samasvarañchlokayantrāso rabhasasya mantavaḥ |
9,073.06 apānakṣāso badhirā ahāsata ṛtasya panthāṃ na taranti duṣkṛtaḥ ||
9,073.07  sahasradhāre vitate pavitra ā vācaṃ punanti kavayo manīṣiṇaḥ |
9,073.07 rudrāsa eṣāmiṣirāso adruha spaśaḥ svañcaḥ sudṛśo nṛcakṣasaḥ ||
9,073.08  ṛtasya gopā na dabhāya sukratustrī ṣa pavitrā hṛdyantarā dadhe |
9,073.08 vidvānsa viśvā bhuvanābhi paśyatyavājuṣṭānvidhyati karte avratān ||
9,073.09  ṛtasya tanturvitataḥ pavitra ā jihvāyā agre varuṇasya māyayā |
9,073.09 dhīrāścittatsaminakṣanta āśatātrā kartamava padātyaprabhuḥ ||

9,074.01  śiśurna jāto'va cakradadvane svaryadvājyaruṣaḥ siṣāsati |
9,074.01 divo retasā sacate payovṛdhā tamīmahe sumatī śarma saprathaḥ ||
9,074.02  divo ya skambho dharuṇaḥ svātata āpūrṇo aṃśuḥ paryeti viśvataḥ |
9,074.02 seme mahī rodasī yakṣadāvṛtā samīcīne dādhāra samiṣaḥ kaviḥ ||
9,074.03  mahi psaraḥ sukṛtaṃ somyaṃ madhūrvī gavyūtiraditerṛtaṃ yate |
9,074.03 īśe yo vṛṣṭerita usriyo vṛṣāpāṃ netā ya itaūtirṛgmiyaḥ ||
9,074.04  ātmanvannabho duhyate ghṛtaṃ paya ṛtasya nābhiramṛtaṃ vi jāyate |
9,074.04 samīcīnāḥ sudānavaḥ prīṇanti taṃ naro hitamava mehanti peravaḥ ||
9,074.05  arāvīdaṃśuḥ sacamāna ūrmiṇā devāvyaṃ manuṣe pinvati tvacam |
9,074.05 dadhāti garbhamaditerupastha ā yena tokaṃ ca tanayaṃ ca dhāmahe ||
9,074.06  sahasradhāre'va tā asaścatastṛtīye santu rajasi prajāvatīḥ |
9,074.06 catasro nābho nihitā avo divo havirbharantyamṛtaṃ ghṛtaścutaḥ ||
9,074.07  śvetaṃ rūpaṃ kṛṇute yatsiṣāsati somo mīḍhvāṃ asuro veda bhūmanaḥ |
9,074.07 dhiyā śamī sacate semabhi pravaddivaskavandhamava darṣadudriṇam ||
9,074.08  adha śvetaṃ kalaśaṃ gobhiraktaṃ kārṣmannā vājyakramītsasavān |
9,074.08 ā hinvire manasā devayantaḥ kakṣīvate śatahimāya gonām ||
9,074.09  adbhiḥ soma papṛcānasya te raso'vyo vāraṃ vi pavamāna dhāvati |
9,074.09 sa mṛjyamānaḥ kavibhirmadintama svadasvendrāya pavamāna pītaye ||

9,075.01  abhi priyāṇi pavate canohito nāmāni yahvo adhi yeṣu vardhate |
9,075.01 ā sūryasya bṛhato bṛhannadhi rathaṃ viṣvañcamaruhadvicakṣaṇaḥ ||
9,075.02  ṛtasya jihvā pavate madhu priyaṃ vaktā patirdhiyo asyā adābhyaḥ |
9,075.02 dadhāti putraḥ pitrorapīcyaṃ nāma tṛtīyamadhi rocane divaḥ ||
9,075.03  ava dyutānaḥ kalaśāṃ acikradannṛbhiryemānaḥ kośa ā hiraṇyaye |
9,075.03 abhīmṛtasya dohanā anūṣatādhi tripṛṣṭha uṣaso vi rājati ||
9,075.04  adribhiḥ suto matibhiścanohitaḥ prarocayanrodasī mātarā śuciḥ |
9,075.04 romāṇyavyā samayā vi dhāvati madhordhārā pinvamānā divedive ||
9,075.05  pari soma pra dhanvā svastaye nṛbhiḥ punāno abhi vāsayāśiram |
9,075.05 ye te madā āhanaso vihāyasastebhirindraṃ codaya dātave magham ||

9,076.01  dhartā divaḥ pavate kṛtvyo raso dakṣo devānāmanumādyo nṛbhiḥ |
9,076.01 hariḥ sṛjāno atyo na satvabhirvṛthā pājāṃsi kṛṇute nadīṣvā ||
9,076.02  śūro na dhatta āyudhā gabhastyoḥ svaḥ siṣāsanrathiro gaviṣṭiṣu |
9,076.02 indrasya śuṣmamīrayannapasyubhirindurhinvāno ajyate manīṣibhiḥ ||
9,076.03  indrasya soma pavamāna ūrmiṇā taviṣyamāṇo jaṭhareṣvā viśa |
9,076.03 pra ṇaḥ pinva vidyudabhreva rodasī dhiyā na vājāṃ upa māsi śaśvataḥ ||
9,076.04  viśvasya rājā pavate svardṛśa ṛtasya dhītimṛṣiṣāḻ avīvaśat |
9,076.04 yaḥ sūryasyāsireṇa mṛjyate pitā matīnāmasamaṣṭakāvyaḥ ||
9,076.05  vṛṣeva yūthā pari kośamarṣasyapāmupasthe vṛṣabhaḥ kanikradat |
9,076.05 sa indrāya pavase matsarintamo yathā jeṣāma samithe tvotayaḥ ||

9,077.01  eṣa pra kośe madhumāṃ acikradadindrasya vajro vapuṣo vapuṣṭaraḥ |
9,077.01 abhīmṛtasya sudughā ghṛtaścuto vāśrā arṣanti payaseva dhenavaḥ ||
9,077.02  sa pūrvyaḥ pavate yaṃ divaspari śyeno mathāyadiṣitastiro rajaḥ |
9,077.02 sa madhva ā yuvate vevijāna itkṛśānorasturmanasāha bibhyuṣā ||
9,077.03  te naḥ pūrvāsa uparāsa indavo mahe vājāya dhanvantu gomate |
9,077.03 īkṣeṇyāso ahyo na cāravo brahmabrahma ye jujuṣurhavirhaviḥ ||
9,077.04  ayaṃ no vidvānvanavadvanuṣyata induḥ satrācā manasā puruṣṭutaḥ |
9,077.04 inasya yaḥ sadane garbhamādadhe gavāmurubjamabhyarṣati vrajam ||
9,077.05  cakrirdivaḥ pavate kṛtvyo raso mahāṃ adabdho varuṇo hurugyate |
9,077.05 asāvi mitro vṛjaneṣu yajñiyo'tyo na yūthe vṛṣayuḥ kanikradat ||

9,078.01  pra rājā vācaṃ janayannasiṣyadadapo vasāno abhi gā iyakṣati |
9,078.01 gṛbhṇāti ripramavirasya tānvā śuddho devānāmupa yāti niṣkṛtam ||
9,078.02  indrāya soma pari ṣicyase nṛbhirnṛcakṣā ūrmiḥ kavirajyase vane |
9,078.02 pūrvīrhi te srutayaḥ santi yātave sahasramaśvā harayaścamūṣadaḥ ||
9,078.03  samudriyā apsaraso manīṣiṇamāsīnā antarabhi somamakṣaran |
9,078.03 tā īṃ hinvanti harmyasya sakṣaṇiṃ yācante sumnaṃ pavamānamakṣitam ||
9,078.04  gojinnaḥ somo rathajiddhiraṇyajitsvarjidabjitpavate sahasrajit |
9,078.04 yaṃ devāsaścakrire pītaye madaṃ svādiṣṭhaṃ drapsamaruṇaṃ mayobhuvam ||
9,078.05  etāni soma pavamāno asmayuḥ satyāni kṛṇvandraviṇānyarṣasi |
9,078.05 jahi śatrumantike dūrake ca ya urvīṃ gavyūtimabhayaṃ ca naskṛdhi ||

9,079.01  acodaso no dhanvantvindavaḥ pra suvānāso bṛhaddiveṣu harayaḥ |
9,079.01 vi ca naśanna iṣo arātayo'ryo naśanta saniṣanta no dhiyaḥ ||
9,079.02  pra ṇo dhanvantvindavo madacyuto dhanā vā yebhirarvato junīmasi |
9,079.02 tiro martasya kasya citparihvṛtiṃ vayaṃ dhanāni viśvadhā bharemahi ||
9,079.03  uta svasyā arātyā arirhi ṣa utānyasyā arātyā vṛko hi ṣaḥ |
9,079.03 dhanvanna tṛṣṇā samarīta tāṃ abhi soma jahi pavamāna durādhyaḥ ||
9,079.04  divi te nābhā paramo ya ādade pṛthivyāste ruruhuḥ sānavi kṣipaḥ |
9,079.04 adrayastvā bapsati goradhi tvacyapsu tvā hastairduduhurmanīṣiṇaḥ ||
9,079.05  evā ta indo subhvaṃ supeśasaṃ rasaṃ tuñjanti prathamā abhiśriyaḥ |
9,079.05 nidaṃnidaṃ pavamāna ni tāriṣa āviste śuṣmo bhavatu priyo madaḥ ||

9,080.01  somasya dhārā pavate nṛcakṣasa ṛtena devānhavate divaspari |
9,080.01 bṛhaspate ravathenā vi didyute samudrāso na savanāni vivyacuḥ ||
9,080.02  yaṃ tvā vājinnaghnyā abhyanūṣatāyohataṃ yonimā rohasi dyumān |
9,080.02 maghonāmāyuḥ pratiranmahi śrava indrāya soma pavase vṛṣā madaḥ ||
9,080.03  endrasya kukṣā pavate madintama ūrjaṃ vasānaḥ śravase sumaṅgalaḥ |
9,080.03 pratyaṅsa viśvā bhuvanābhi paprathe krīḻanhariratyaḥ syandate vṛṣā ||
9,080.04  taṃ tvā devebhyo madhumattamaṃ naraḥ sahasradhāraṃ duhate daśa kṣipaḥ |
9,080.04 nṛbhiḥ soma pracyuto grāvabhiḥ suto viśvāndevāṃ ā pavasvā sahasrajit ||
9,080.05  taṃ tvā hastino madhumantamadribhirduhantyapsu vṛṣabhaṃ daśa kṣipaḥ |
9,080.05 indraṃ soma mādayandaivyaṃ janaṃ sindhorivormiḥ pavamāno arṣasi ||

9,081.01  pra somasya pavamānasyormaya indrasya yanti jaṭharaṃ supeśasaḥ |
9,081.01 dadhnā yadīmunnītā yaśasā gavāṃ dānāya śūramudamandiṣuḥ sutāḥ ||
9,081.02  acchā hi somaḥ kalaśāṃ asiṣyadadatyo na voḻhā raghuvartanirvṛṣā |
9,081.02 athā devānāmubhayasya janmano vidvāṃ aśnotyamuta itaśca yat ||
9,081.03  ā naḥ soma pavamānaḥ kirā vasvindo bhava maghavā rādhaso mahaḥ |
9,081.03 śikṣā vayodho vasave su cetunā mā no gayamāre asmatparā sicaḥ ||
9,081.04  ā naḥ pūṣā pavamānaḥ surātayo mitro gacchantu varuṇaḥ sajoṣasaḥ |
9,081.04 bṛhaspatirmaruto vāyuraśvinā tvaṣṭā savitā suyamā sarasvatī ||
9,081.05  ubhe dyāvāpṛthivī viśvaminve aryamā devo aditirvidhātā |
9,081.05 bhago nṛśaṃsa urvantarikṣaṃ viśve devāḥ pavamānaṃ juṣanta ||

9,082.01  asāvi somo aruṣo vṛṣā harī rājeva dasmo abhi gā acikradat |
9,082.01 punāno vāraṃ paryetyavyayaṃ śyeno na yoniṃ ghṛtavantamāsadam ||
9,082.02  kavirvedhasyā paryeṣi māhinamatyo na mṛṣṭo abhi vājamarṣasi |
9,082.02 apasedhanduritā soma mṛḻaya ghṛtaṃ vasānaḥ pari yāsi nirṇijam ||
9,082.03  parjanyaḥ pitā mahiṣasya parṇino nābhā pṛthivyā giriṣu kṣayaṃ dadhe |
9,082.03 svasāra āpo abhi gā utāsaransaṃ grāvabhirnasate vīte adhvare ||
9,082.04  jāyeva patyāvadhi śeva maṃhase pajrāyā garbha śṛṇuhi bravīmi te |
9,082.04 antarvāṇīṣu pra carā su jīvase'nindyo vṛjane soma jāgṛhi ||
9,082.05  yathā pūrvebhyaḥ śatasā amṛdhraḥ sahasrasāḥ paryayā vājamindo |
9,082.05 evā pavasva suvitāya navyase tava vratamanvāpaḥ sacante ||

9,083.01  pavitraṃ te vitataṃ brahmaṇaspate prabhurgātrāṇi paryeṣi viśvataḥ |
9,083.01 ataptatanūrna tadāmo aśnute śṛtāsa idvahantastatsamāśata ||
9,083.02  tapoṣpavitraṃ vitataṃ divaspade śocanto asya tantavo vyasthiran |
9,083.02 avantyasya pavītāramāśavo divaspṛṣṭhamadhi tiṣṭhanti cetasā ||
9,083.03  arūrucaduṣasaḥ pṛśniragriya ukṣā bibharti bhuvanāni vājayuḥ |
9,083.03 māyāvino mamire asya māyayā nṛcakṣasaḥ pitaro garbhamā dadhuḥ ||
9,083.04  gandharva itthā padamasya rakṣati pāti devānāṃ janimānyadbhutaḥ |
9,083.04 gṛbhṇāti ripuṃ nidhayā nidhāpatiḥ sukṛttamā madhuno bhakṣamāśata ||
9,083.05  havirhaviṣmo mahi sadma daivyaṃ nabho vasānaḥ pari yāsyadhvaram |
9,083.05 rājā pavitraratho vājamāruhaḥ sahasrabhṛṣṭirjayasi śravo bṛhat ||

9,084.01  pavasva devamādano vicarṣaṇirapsā indrāya varuṇāya vāyave |
9,084.01 kṛdhī no adya varivaḥ svastimadurukṣitau gṛṇīhi daivyaṃ janam ||
9,084.02  ā yastasthau bhuvanānyamartyo viśvāni somaḥ pari tānyarṣati |
9,084.02 kṛṇvansaṃcṛtaṃ vicṛtamabhiṣṭaya induḥ siṣaktyuṣasaṃ na sūryaḥ ||
9,084.03  ā yo gobhiḥ sṛjyata oṣadhīṣvā devānāṃ sumna iṣayannupāvasuḥ |
9,084.03 ā vidyutā pavate dhārayā suta indraṃ somo mādayandaivyaṃ janam ||
9,084.04  eṣa sya somaḥ pavate sahasrajiddhinvāno vācamiṣirāmuṣarbudham |
9,084.04 induḥ samudramudiyarti vāyubhirendrasya hārdi kalaśeṣu sīdati ||
9,084.05  abhi tyaṃ gāvaḥ payasā payovṛdhaṃ somaṃ śrīṇanti matibhiḥ svarvidam |
9,084.05 dhanañjayaḥ pavate kṛtvyo raso vipraḥ kaviḥ kāvyenā svarcanāḥ ||

9,085.01  indrāya soma suṣutaḥ pari sravāpāmīvā bhavatu rakṣasā saha |
9,085.01 mā te rasasya matsata dvayāvino draviṇasvanta iha santvindavaḥ ||
9,085.02  asmānsamarye pavamāna codaya dakṣo devānāmasi hi priyo madaḥ |
9,085.02 jahi śatrūṃrabhyā bhandanāyataḥ pibendra somamava no mṛdho jahi ||
9,085.03  adabdha indo pavase madintama ātmendrasya bhavasi dhāsiruttamaḥ |
9,085.03 abhi svaranti bahavo manīṣiṇo rājānamasya bhuvanasya niṃsate ||
9,085.04  sahasraṇīthaḥ śatadhāro adbhuta indrāyenduḥ pavate kāmyaṃ madhu |
9,085.04 jayankṣetramabhyarṣā jayannapa uruṃ no gātuṃ kṛṇu soma mīḍhvaḥ ||
9,085.05  kanikradatkalaśe gobhirajyase vyavyayaṃ samayā vāramarṣasi |
9,085.05 marmṛjyamāno atyo na sānasirindrasya soma jaṭhare samakṣaraḥ ||
9,085.06  svāduḥ pavasva divyāya janmane svādurindrāya suhavītunāmne |
9,085.06 svādurmitrāya varuṇāya vāyave bṛhaspataye madhumāṃ adābhyaḥ ||
9,085.07  atyaṃ mṛjanti kalaśe daśa kṣipaḥ pra viprāṇāṃ matayo vāca īrate |
9,085.07 pavamānā abhyarṣanti suṣṭutimendraṃ viśanti madirāsa indavaḥ ||
9,085.08  pavamāno abhyarṣā suvīryamurvīṃ gavyūtiṃ mahi śarma saprathaḥ |
9,085.08 mākirno asya pariṣūtirīśatendo jayema tvayā dhanaṃdhanam ||
9,085.09  adhi dyāmasthādvṛṣabho vicakṣaṇo'rūrucadvi divo rocanā kaviḥ |
9,085.09 rājā pavitramatyeti roruvaddivaḥ pīyūṣaṃ duhate nṛcakṣasaḥ ||
9,085.10  divo nāke madhujihvā asaścato venā duhantyukṣaṇaṃ giriṣṭhām |
9,085.10 apsu drapsaṃ vāvṛdhānaṃ samudra ā sindhorūrmā madhumantaṃ pavitra ā ||
9,085.11  nāke suparṇamupapaptivāṃsaṃ giro venānāmakṛpanta pūrvīḥ |
9,085.11 śiśuṃ rihanti matayaḥ panipnataṃ hiraṇyayaṃ śakunaṃ kṣāmaṇi sthām ||
9,085.12  ūrdhvo gandharvo adhi nāke asthādviśvā rūpā praticakṣāṇo asya |
9,085.12 bhānuḥ śukreṇa śociṣā vyadyautprārūrucadrodasī mātarā śuciḥ ||

9,086.01  pra ta āśavaḥ pavamāna dhījavo madā arṣanti raghujā iva tmanā |
9,086.01 divyāḥ suparṇā madhumanta indavo madintamāsaḥ pari kośamāsate ||
9,086.02  pra te madāso madirāsa āśavo'sṛkṣata rathyāso yathā pṛthak |
9,086.02 dhenurna vatsaṃ payasābhi vajriṇamindramindavo madhumanta ūrmayaḥ ||
9,086.03  atyo na hiyāno abhi vājamarṣa svarvitkośaṃ divo adrimātaram |
9,086.03 vṛṣā pavitre adhi sāno avyaye somaḥ punāna indriyāya dhāyase ||
9,086.04  pra ta āśvinīḥ pavamāna dhījuvo divyā asṛgranpayasā dharīmaṇi |
9,086.04 prāntarṛṣaya sthāvirīrasṛkṣata ye tvā mṛjantyṛṣiṣāṇa vedhasaḥ ||
9,086.05  viśvā dhāmāni viśvacakṣa ṛbhvasaḥ prabhoste sataḥ pari yanti ketavaḥ |
9,086.05 vyānaśiḥ pavase soma dharmabhiḥ patirviśvasya bhuvanasya rājasi ||
9,086.06  ubhayataḥ pavamānasya raśmayo dhruvasya sataḥ pari yanti ketavaḥ |
9,086.06 yadī pavitre adhi mṛjyate hariḥ sattā ni yonā kalaśeṣu sīdati ||
9,086.07  yajñasya ketuḥ pavate svadhvaraḥ somo devānāmupa yāti niṣkṛtam |
9,086.07 sahasradhāraḥ pari kośamarṣati vṛṣā pavitramatyeti roruvat ||
9,086.08  rājā samudraṃ nadyo vi gāhate'pāmūrmiṃ sacate sindhuṣu śritaḥ |
9,086.08 adhyasthātsānu pavamāno avyayaṃ nābhā pṛthivyā dharuṇo maho divaḥ ||
9,086.09  divo na sānu stanayannacikradaddyauśca yasya pṛthivī ca dharmabhiḥ |
9,086.09 indrasya sakhyaṃ pavate vivevidatsomaḥ punānaḥ kalaśeṣu sīdati ||
9,086.10  jyotiryajñasya pavate madhu priyaṃ pitā devānāṃ janitā vibhūvasuḥ |
9,086.10 dadhāti ratnaṃ svadhayorapīcyaṃ madintamo matsara indriyo rasaḥ ||
9,086.11  abhikrandankalaśaṃ vājyarṣati patirdivaḥ śatadhāro vicakṣaṇaḥ |
9,086.11 harirmitrasya sadaneṣu sīdati marmṛjāno'vibhiḥ sindhubhirvṛṣā ||
9,086.12  agre sindhūnāṃ pavamāno arṣatyagre vāco agriyo goṣu gacchati |
9,086.12 agre vājasya bhajate mahādhanaṃ svāyudhaḥ sotṛbhiḥ pūyate vṛṣā ||
9,086.13  ayaṃ matavāñchakuno yathā hito'vye sasāra pavamāna ūrmiṇā |
9,086.13 tava kratvā rodasī antarā kave śucirdhiyā pavate soma indra te ||
9,086.14  drāpiṃ vasāno yajato divispṛśamantarikṣaprā bhuvaneṣvarpitaḥ |
9,086.14 svarjajñāno nabhasābhyakramītpratnamasya pitaramā vivāsati ||
9,086.15  so asya viśe mahi śarma yacchati yo asya dhāma prathamaṃ vyānaśe |
9,086.15 padaṃ yadasya parame vyomanyato viśvā abhi saṃ yāti saṃyataḥ ||
9,086.16  pro ayāsīdindurindrasya niṣkṛtaṃ sakhā sakhyurna pra mināti saṃgiram |
9,086.16 marya iva yuvatibhiḥ samarṣati somaḥ kalaśe śatayāmnā pathā ||
9,086.17  pra vo dhiyo mandrayuvo vipanyuvaḥ panasyuvaḥ saṃvasaneṣvakramuḥ |
9,086.17 somaṃ manīṣā abhyanūṣata stubho'bhi dhenavaḥ payasemaśiśrayuḥ ||
9,086.18  ā naḥ soma saṃyataṃ pipyuṣīmiṣamindo pavasva pavamāno asridham |
9,086.18 yā no dohate trirahannasaścuṣī kṣumadvājavanmadhumatsuvīryam ||
9,086.19  vṛṣā matīnāṃ pavate vicakṣaṇaḥ somo ahnaḥ pratarītoṣaso divaḥ |
9,086.19 krāṇā sindhūnāṃ kalaśāṃ avīvaśadindrasya hārdyāviśanmanīṣibhiḥ ||
9,086.20  manīṣibhiḥ pavate pūrvyaḥ kavirnṛbhiryataḥ pari kośāṃ acikradat |
9,086.20 tritasya nāma janayanmadhu kṣaradindrasya vāyoḥ sakhyāya kartave ||
9,086.21  ayaṃ punāna uṣaso vi rocayadayaṃ sindhubhyo abhavadu lokakṛt |
9,086.21 ayaṃ triḥ sapta duduhāna āśiraṃ somo hṛde pavate cāru matsaraḥ ||
9,086.22  pavasva soma divyeṣu dhāmasu sṛjāna indo kalaśe pavitra ā |
9,086.22 sīdannindrasya jaṭhare kanikradannṛbhiryataḥ sūryamārohayo divi ||
9,086.23  adribhiḥ sutaḥ pavase pavitra āṃ indavindrasya jaṭhareṣvāviśan |
9,086.23 tvaṃ nṛcakṣā abhavo vicakṣaṇa soma gotramaṅgirobhyo'vṛṇorapa ||
9,086.24  tvāṃ soma pavamānaṃ svādhyo'nu viprāso amadannavasyavaḥ |
9,086.24 tvāṃ suparṇa ābharaddivasparīndo viśvābhirmatibhiḥ pariṣkṛtam ||
9,086.25  avye punānaṃ pari vāra ūrmiṇā hariṃ navante abhi sapta dhenavaḥ |
9,086.25 apāmupasthe adhyāyavaḥ kavimṛtasya yonā mahiṣā aheṣata ||
9,086.26  induḥ punāno ati gāhate mṛdho viśvāni kṛṇvansupathāni yajyave |
9,086.26 gāḥ kṛṇvāno nirṇijaṃ haryataḥ kaviratyo na krīḻanpari vāramarṣati ||
9,086.27  asaścataḥ śatadhārā abhiśriyo hariṃ navante'va tā udanyuvaḥ |
9,086.27 kṣipo mṛjanti pari gobhirāvṛtaṃ tṛtīye pṛṣṭhe adhi rocane divaḥ ||
9,086.28  tavemāḥ prajā divyasya retasastvaṃ viśvasya bhuvanasya rājasi |
9,086.28 athedaṃ viśvaṃ pavamāna te vaśe tvamindo prathamo dhāmadhā asi ||
9,086.29  tvaṃ samudro asi viśvavitkave tavemāḥ pañca pradiśo vidharmaṇi |
9,086.29 tvaṃ dyāṃ ca pṛthivīṃ cāti jabhriṣe tava jyotīṃṣi pavamāna sūryaḥ ||
9,086.30  tvaṃ pavitre rajaso vidharmaṇi devebhyaḥ soma pavamāna pūyase |
9,086.30 tvāmuśijaḥ prathamā agṛbhṇata tubhyemā viśvā bhuvanāni yemire ||
9,086.31  pra rebha etyati vāramavyayaṃ vṛṣā vaneṣvava cakradaddhariḥ |
9,086.31 saṃ dhītayo vāvaśānā anūṣata śiśuṃ rihanti matayaḥ panipnatam ||
9,086.32  sa sūryasya raśmibhiḥ pari vyata tantuṃ tanvānastrivṛtaṃ yathā vide |
9,086.32 nayannṛtasya praśiṣo navīyasīḥ patirjanīnāmupa yāti niṣkṛtam ||
9,086.33  rājā sindhūnāṃ pavate patirdiva ṛtasya yāti pathibhiḥ kanikradat |
9,086.33 sahasradhāraḥ pari ṣicyate hariḥ punāno vācaṃ janayannupāvasuḥ ||
9,086.34  pavamāna mahyarṇo vi dhāvasi sūro na citro avyayāni pavyayā |
9,086.34 gabhastipūto nṛbhiradribhiḥ suto mahe vājāya dhanyāya dhanvasi ||
9,086.35  iṣamūrjaṃ pavamānābhyarṣasi śyeno na vaṃsu kalaśeṣu sīdasi |
9,086.35 indrāya madvā madyo madaḥ suto divo viṣṭambha upamo vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
9,086.36  sapta svasāro abhi mātaraḥ śiśuṃ navaṃ jajñānaṃ jenyaṃ vipaścitam |
9,086.36 apāṃ gandharvaṃ divyaṃ nṛcakṣasaṃ somaṃ viśvasya bhuvanasya rājase ||
9,086.37  īśāna imā bhuvanāni vīyase yujāna indo haritaḥ suparṇyaḥ |
9,086.37 tāste kṣarantu madhumadghṛtaṃ payastava vrate soma tiṣṭhantu kṛṣṭayaḥ ||
9,086.38  tvaṃ nṛcakṣā asi soma viśvataḥ pavamāna vṛṣabha tā vi dhāvasi |
9,086.38 sa naḥ pavasva vasumaddhiraṇyavadvayaṃ syāma bhuvaneṣu jīvase ||
9,086.39  govitpavasva vasuviddhiraṇyavidretodhā indo bhuvaneṣvarpitaḥ |
9,086.39 tvaṃ suvīro asi soma viśvavittaṃ tvā viprā upa girema āsate ||
9,086.40  unmadhva ūrmirvananā atiṣṭhipadapo vasāno mahiṣo vi gāhate |
9,086.40 rājā pavitraratho vājamāruhatsahasrabhṛṣṭirjayati śravo bṛhat ||
9,086.41  sa bhandanā udiyarti prajāvatīrviśvāyurviśvāḥ subharā ahardivi |
9,086.41 brahma prajāvadrayimaśvapastyaṃ pīta indavindramasmabhyaṃ yācatāt ||
9,086.42  so agre ahnāṃ harirharyato madaḥ pra cetasā cetayate anu dyubhiḥ |
9,086.42 dvā janā yātayannantarīyate narā ca śaṃsaṃ daivyaṃ ca dhartari ||
9,086.43  añjate vyañjate samañjate kratuṃ rihanti madhunābhyañjate |
9,086.43 sindhorucchvāse patayantamukṣaṇaṃ hiraṇyapāvāḥ paśumāsu gṛbhṇate ||
9,086.44  vipaścite pavamānāya gāyata mahī na dhārātyandho arṣati |
9,086.44 ahirna jūrṇāmati sarpati tvacamatyo na krīḻannasaradvṛṣā hariḥ ||
9,086.45  agrego rājāpyastaviṣyate vimāno ahnāṃ bhuvaneṣvarpitaḥ |
9,086.45 harirghṛtasnuḥ sudṛśīko arṇavo jyotīrathaḥ pavate rāya okyaḥ ||
9,086.46  asarji skambho diva udyato madaḥ pari tridhāturbhuvanānyarṣati |
9,086.46 aṃśuṃ rihanti matayaḥ panipnataṃ girā yadi nirṇijamṛgmiṇo yayuḥ ||
9,086.47  pra te dhārā atyaṇvāni meṣyaḥ punānasya saṃyato yanti raṃhayaḥ |
9,086.47 yadgobhirindo camvoḥ samajyasa ā suvānaḥ soma kalaśeṣu sīdasi ||
9,086.48  pavasva soma kratuvinna ukthyo'vyo vāre pari dhāva madhu priyam |
9,086.48 jahi viśvānrakṣasa indo atriṇo bṛhadvadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||

9,087.01  pra tu drava pari kośaṃ ni ṣīda nṛbhiḥ punāno abhi vājamarṣa |
9,087.01 aśvaṃ na tvā vājinaṃ marjayanto'cchā barhī raśanābhirnayanti ||
9,087.02  svāyudhaḥ pavate deva induraśastihā vṛjanaṃ rakṣamāṇaḥ |
9,087.02 pitā devānāṃ janitā sudakṣo viṣṭambho divo dharuṇaḥ pṛthivyāḥ ||
9,087.03  ṛṣirvipraḥ puraetā janānāmṛbhurdhīra uśanā kāvyena |
9,087.03 sa cidviveda nihitaṃ yadāsāmapīcyaṃ guhyaṃ nāma gonām ||
9,087.04  eṣa sya te madhumāṃ indra somo vṛṣā vṛṣṇe pari pavitre akṣāḥ |
9,087.04 sahasrasāḥ śatasā bhūridāvā śaśvattamaṃ barhirā vājyasthāt ||
9,087.05  ete somā abhi gavyā sahasrā mahe vājāyāmṛtāya śravāṃsi |
9,087.05 pavitrebhiḥ pavamānā asṛgrañchravasyavo na pṛtanājo atyāḥ ||
9,087.06  pari hi ṣmā puruhūto janānāṃ viśvāsaradbhojanā pūyamānaḥ |
9,087.06 athā bhara śyenabhṛta prayāṃsi rayiṃ tuñjāno abhi vājamarṣa ||
9,087.07  eṣa suvānaḥ pari somaḥ pavitre sargo na sṛṣṭo adadhāvadarvā |
9,087.07 tigme śiśāno mahiṣo na śṛṅge gā gavyannabhi śūro na satvā ||
9,087.08  eṣā yayau paramādantaradreḥ kūcitsatīrūrve gā viveda |
9,087.08 divo na vidyutstanayantyabhraiḥ somasya te pavata indra dhārā ||
9,087.09  uta sma rāśiṃ pari yāsi gonāmindreṇa soma sarathaṃ punānaḥ |
9,087.09 pūrvīriṣo bṛhatīrjīradāno śikṣā śacīvastava tā upaṣṭut ||

9,088.01  ayaṃ soma indra tubhyaṃ sunve tubhyaṃ pavate tvamasya pāhi |
9,088.01 tvaṃ ha yaṃ cakṛṣe tvaṃ vavṛṣa induṃ madāya yujyāya somam ||
9,088.02  sa īṃ ratho na bhuriṣāḻ ayoji mahaḥ purūṇi sātaye vasūni |
9,088.02 ādīṃ viśvā nahuṣyāṇi jātā svarṣātā vana ūrdhvā navanta ||
9,088.03  vāyurna yo niyutvāṃ iṣṭayāmā nāsatyeva hava ā śambhaviṣṭhaḥ |
9,088.03 viśvavāro draviṇodā iva tmanpūṣeva dhījavano'si soma ||
9,088.04  indro na yo mahā karmāṇi cakrirhantā vṛtrāṇāmasi soma pūrbhit |
9,088.04 paidvo na hi tvamahināmnāṃ hantā viśvasyāsi soma dasyoḥ ||
9,088.05  agnirna yo vana ā sṛjyamāno vṛthā pājāṃsi kṛṇute nadīṣu |
9,088.05 jano na yudhvā mahata upabdiriyarti somaḥ pavamāna ūrmim ||
9,088.06  ete somā ati vārāṇyavyā divyā na kośāso abhravarṣāḥ |
9,088.06 vṛthā samudraṃ sindhavo na nīcīḥ sutāso abhi kalaśāṃ asṛgran ||
9,088.07  śuṣmī śardho na mārutaṃ pavasvānabhiśastā divyā yathā viṭ |
9,088.07 āpo na makṣū sumatirbhavā naḥ sahasrāpsāḥ pṛtanāṣāṇna yajñaḥ ||
9,088.08  rājño nu te varuṇasya vratāni bṛhadgabhīraṃ tava soma dhāma |
9,088.08 śuciṣṭvamasi priyo na mitro dakṣāyyo aryamevāsi soma ||

9,089.01  pro sya vahniḥ pathyābhirasyāndivo na vṛṣṭiḥ pavamāno akṣāḥ |
9,089.01 sahasradhāro asadannyasme māturupasthe vana ā ca somaḥ ||
9,089.02  rājā sindhūnāmavasiṣṭa vāsa ṛtasya nāvamāruhadrajiṣṭhām |
9,089.02 apsu drapso vāvṛdhe śyenajūto duha īṃ pitā duha īṃ piturjām ||
9,089.03  siṃhaṃ nasanta madhvo ayāsaṃ harimaruṣaṃ divo asya patim |
9,089.03 śūro yutsu prathamaḥ pṛcchate gā asya cakṣasā pari pātyukṣā ||
9,089.04  madhupṛṣṭhaṃ ghoramayāsamaśvaṃ rathe yuñjantyurucakra ṛṣvam |
9,089.04 svasāra īṃ jāmayo marjayanti sanābhayo vājinamūrjayanti ||
9,089.05  catasra īṃ ghṛtaduhaḥ sacante samāne antardharuṇe niṣattāḥ |
9,089.05 tā īmarṣanti namasā punānāstā īṃ viśvataḥ pari ṣanti pūrvīḥ ||
9,089.06  viṣṭambho divo dharuṇaḥ pṛthivyā viśvā uta kṣitayo haste asya |
9,089.06 asatta utso gṛṇate niyutvānmadhvo aṃśuḥ pavata indriyāya ||
9,089.07  vanvannavāto abhi devavītimindrāya soma vṛtrahā pavasva |
9,089.07 śagdhi mahaḥ puruścandrasya rāyaḥ suvīryasya patayaḥ syāma ||

9,090.01  pra hinvāno janitā rodasyo ratho na vājaṃ saniṣyannayāsīt |
9,090.01 indraṃ gacchannāyudhā saṃśiśāno viśvā vasu hastayorādadhānaḥ ||
9,090.02  abhi tripṛṣṭhaṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ vayodhāmāṅgūṣāṇāmavāvaśanta vāṇīḥ |
9,090.02 vanā vasāno varuṇo na sindhūnvi ratnadhā dayate vāryāṇi ||
9,090.03  śūragrāmaḥ sarvavīraḥ sahāvāñjetā pavasva sanitā dhanāni |
9,090.03 tigmāyudhaḥ kṣipradhanvā samatsvaṣāḻhaḥ sāhvānpṛtanāsu śatrūn ||
9,090.04  urugavyūtirabhayāni kṛṇvansamīcīne ā pavasvā purandhī |
9,090.04 apaḥ siṣāsannuṣasaḥ svargāḥ saṃ cikrado maho asmabhyaṃ vājān ||
9,090.05  matsi soma varuṇaṃ matsi mitraṃ matsīndramindo pavamāna viṣṇum |
9,090.05 matsi śardho mārutaṃ matsi devānmatsi mahāmindramindo madāya ||
9,090.06  evā rājeva kratumāṃ amena viśvā ghanighnadduritā pavasva |
9,090.06 indo sūktāya vacase vayo dhā yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

9,091.01  asarji vakvā rathye yathājau dhiyā manotā prathamo manīṣī |
9,091.01 daśa svasāro adhi sāno avye'janti vahniṃ sadanānyaccha ||
9,091.02  vītī janasya divyasya kavyairadhi suvāno nahuṣyebhirinduḥ |
9,091.02 pra yo nṛbhiramṛto martyebhirmarmṛjāno'vibhirgobhiradbhiḥ ||
9,091.03  vṛṣā vṛṣṇe roruvadaṃśurasmai pavamāno ruśadīrte payo goḥ |
9,091.03 sahasramṛkvā pathibhirvacovidadhvasmabhiḥ sūro aṇvaṃ vi yāti ||
9,091.04  rujā dṛḻhā cidrakṣasaḥ sadāṃsi punāna inda ūrṇuhi vi vājān |
9,091.04 vṛścopariṣṭāttujatā vadhena ye anti dūrādupanāyameṣām ||
9,091.05  sa pratnavannavyase viśvavāra sūktāya pathaḥ kṛṇuhi prācaḥ |
9,091.05 ye duḥṣahāso vanuṣā bṛhantastāṃste aśyāma purukṛtpurukṣo ||
9,091.06  evā punāno apaḥ svargā asmabhyaṃ tokā tanayāni bhūri |
9,091.06 śaṃ naḥ kṣetramuru jyotīṃṣi soma jyoṅnaḥ sūryaṃ dṛśaye rirīhi ||

9,092.01  pari suvāno hariraṃśuḥ pavitre ratho na sarji sanaye hiyānaḥ |
9,092.01 āpacchlokamindriyaṃ pūyamānaḥ prati devāṃ ajuṣata prayobhiḥ ||
9,092.02  acchā nṛcakṣā asaratpavitre nāma dadhānaḥ kavirasya yonau |
9,092.02 sīdanhoteva sadane camūṣūpemagmannṛṣayaḥ sapta viprāḥ ||
9,092.03  pra sumedhā gātuvidviśvadevaḥ somaḥ punānaḥ sada eti nityam |
9,092.03 bhuvadviśveṣu kāvyeṣu rantānu janānyatate pañca dhīraḥ ||
9,092.04  tava tye soma pavamāna niṇye viśve devāstraya ekādaśāsaḥ |
9,092.04 daśa svadhābhiradhi sāno avye mṛjanti tvā nadyaḥ sapta yahvīḥ ||
9,092.05  tannu satyaṃ pavamānasyāstu yatra viśve kāravaḥ saṃnasanta |
9,092.05 jyotiryadahne akṛṇodu lokaṃ prāvanmanuṃ dasyave karabhīkam ||
9,092.06  pari sadmeva paśumānti hotā rājā na satyaḥ samitīriyānaḥ |
9,092.06 somaḥ punānaḥ kalaśāṃ ayāsītsīdanmṛgo na mahiṣo vaneṣu ||

9,093.01  sākamukṣo marjayanta svasāro daśa dhīrasya dhītayo dhanutrīḥ |
9,093.01 hariḥ paryadravajjāḥ sūryasya droṇaṃ nanakṣe atyo na vājī ||
9,093.02  saṃ mātṛbhirna śiśurvāvaśāno vṛṣā dadhanve puruvāro adbhiḥ |
9,093.02 maryo na yoṣāmabhi niṣkṛtaṃ yansaṃ gacchate kalaśa usriyābhiḥ ||
9,093.03  uta pra pipya ūdharaghnyāyā indurdhārābhiḥ sacate sumedhāḥ |
9,093.03 mūrdhānaṃ gāvaḥ payasā camūṣvabhi śrīṇanti vasubhirna niktaiḥ ||
9,093.04  sa no devebhiḥ pavamāna radendo rayimaśvinaṃ vāvaśānaḥ |
9,093.04 rathirāyatāmuśatī purandhirasmadryagā dāvane vasūnām ||
9,093.05  nū no rayimupa māsva nṛvantaṃ punāno vātāpyaṃ viśvaścandram |
9,093.05 pra vanditurindo tāryāyuḥ prātarmakṣū dhiyāvasurjagamyāt ||

9,094.01  adhi yadasminvājinīva śubha spardhante dhiyaḥ sūrye na viśaḥ |
9,094.01 apo vṛṇānaḥ pavate kavīyanvrajaṃ na paśuvardhanāya manma ||
9,094.02  dvitā vyūrṇvannamṛtasya dhāma svarvide bhuvanāni prathanta |
9,094.02 dhiyaḥ pinvānāḥ svasare na gāva ṛtāyantīrabhi vāvaśra indum ||
9,094.03  pari yatkaviḥ kāvyā bharate śūro na ratho bhuvanāni viśvā |
9,094.03 deveṣu yaśo martāya bhūṣandakṣāya rāyaḥ purubhūṣu navyaḥ ||
9,094.04  śriye jātaḥ śriya ā niriyāya śriyaṃ vayo jaritṛbhyo dadhāti |
9,094.04 śriyaṃ vasānā amṛtatvamāyanbhavanti satyā samithā mitadrau ||
9,094.05  iṣamūrjamabhyarṣāśvaṃ gāmuru jyotiḥ kṛṇuhi matsi devān |
9,094.05 viśvāni hi suṣahā tāni tubhyaṃ pavamāna bādhase soma śatrūn ||

9,095.01  kanikranti harirā sṛjyamānaḥ sīdanvanasya jaṭhare punānaḥ |
9,095.01 nṛbhiryataḥ kṛṇute nirṇijaṃ gā ato matīrjanayata svadhābhiḥ ||
9,095.02  hariḥ sṛjānaḥ pathyāmṛtasyeyarti vācamariteva nāvam |
9,095.02 devo devānāṃ guhyāni nāmāviṣkṛṇoti barhiṣi pravāce ||
9,095.03  apāmivedūrmayastarturāṇāḥ pra manīṣā īrate somamaccha |
9,095.03 namasyantīrupa ca yanti saṃ cā ca viśantyuśatīruśantam ||
9,095.04  taṃ marmṛjānaṃ mahiṣaṃ na sānāvaṃśuṃ duhantyukṣaṇaṃ giriṣṭhām |
9,095.04 taṃ vāvaśānaṃ matayaḥ sacante trito bibharti varuṇaṃ samudre ||
9,095.05  iṣyanvācamupavakteva hotuḥ punāna indo vi ṣyā manīṣām |
9,095.05 indraśca yatkṣayathaḥ saubhagāya suvīryasya patayaḥ syāma ||

9,096.01  pra senānīḥ śūro agre rathānāṃ gavyanneti harṣate asya senā |
9,096.01 bhadrānkṛṇvannindrahavānsakhibhya ā somo vastrā rabhasāni datte ||
9,096.02  samasya hariṃ harayo mṛjantyaśvahayairaniśitaṃ namobhiḥ |
9,096.02 ā tiṣṭhati rathamindrasya sakhā vidvāṃ enā sumatiṃ yātyaccha ||
9,096.03  sa no deva devatāte pavasva mahe soma psarasa indrapānaḥ |
9,096.03 kṛṇvannapo varṣayandyāmutemāmurorā no varivasyā punānaḥ ||
9,096.04  ajītaye'hataye pavasva svastaye sarvatātaye bṛhate |
9,096.04 taduśanti viśva ime sakhāyastadahaṃ vaśmi pavamāna soma ||
9,096.05  somaḥ pavate janitā matīnāṃ janitā divo janitā pṛthivyāḥ |
9,096.05 janitāgnerjanitā sūryasya janitendrasya janitota viṣṇoḥ ||
9,096.06  brahmā devānāṃ padavīḥ kavīnāmṛṣirviprāṇāṃ mahiṣo mṛgāṇām |
9,096.06 śyeno gṛdhrāṇāṃ svadhitirvanānāṃ somaḥ pavitramatyeti rebhan ||
9,096.07  prāvīvipadvāca ūrmiṃ na sindhurgiraḥ somaḥ pavamāno manīṣāḥ |
9,096.07 antaḥ paśyanvṛjanemāvarāṇyā tiṣṭhati vṛṣabho goṣu jānan ||
9,096.08  sa matsaraḥ pṛtsu vanvannavātaḥ sahasraretā abhi vājamarṣa |
9,096.08 indrāyendo pavamāno manīṣyaṃśorūrmimīraya gā iṣaṇyan ||
9,096.09  pari priyaḥ kalaśe devavāta indrāya somo raṇyo madāya |
9,096.09 sahasradhāraḥ śatavāja indurvājī na saptiḥ samanā jigāti ||
9,096.10  sa pūrvyo vasuvijjāyamāno mṛjāno apsu duduhāno adrau |
9,096.10 abhiśastipā bhuvanasya rājā vidadgātuṃ brahmaṇe pūyamānaḥ ||
9,096.11  tvayā hi naḥ pitaraḥ soma pūrve karmāṇi cakruḥ pavamāna dhīrāḥ |
9,096.11 vanvannavātaḥ paridhīṃraporṇu vīrebhiraśvairmaghavā bhavā naḥ ||
9,096.12  yathāpavathā manave vayodhā amitrahā varivoviddhaviṣmān |
9,096.12 evā pavasva draviṇaṃ dadhāna indre saṃ tiṣṭha janayāyudhāni ||
9,096.13  pavasva soma madhumāṃ ṛtāvāpo vasāno adhi sāno avye |
9,096.13 ava droṇāni ghṛtavānti sīda madintamo matsara indrapānaḥ ||
9,096.14  vṛṣṭiṃ divaḥ śatadhāraḥ pavasva sahasrasā vājayurdevavītau |
9,096.14 saṃ sindhubhiḥ kalaśe vāvaśānaḥ samusriyābhiḥ pratiranna āyuḥ ||
9,096.15  eṣa sya somo matibhiḥ punāno'tyo na vājī taratīdarātīḥ |
9,096.15 payo na dugdhamaditeriṣiramurviva gātuḥ suyamo na voḻhā ||
9,096.16  svāyudhaḥ sotṛbhiḥ pūyamāno'bhyarṣa guhyaṃ cāru nāma |
9,096.16 abhi vājaṃ saptiriva śravasyābhi vāyumabhi gā deva soma ||
9,096.17  śiśuṃ jajñānaṃ haryataṃ mṛjanti śumbhanti vahniṃ maruto gaṇena |
9,096.17 kavirgīrbhiḥ kāvyenā kaviḥ sansomaḥ pavitramatyeti rebhan ||
9,096.18  ṛṣimanā ya ṛṣikṛtsvarṣāḥ sahasraṇīthaḥ padavīḥ kavīnām |
9,096.18 tṛtīyaṃ dhāma mahiṣaḥ siṣāsansomo virājamanu rājati ṣṭup ||
9,096.19  camūṣacchyenaḥ śakuno vibhṛtvā govindurdrapsa āyudhāni bibhrat |
9,096.19 apāmūrmiṃ sacamānaḥ samudraṃ turīyaṃ dhāma mahiṣo vivakti ||
9,096.20  maryo na śubhrastanvaṃ mṛjāno'tyo na sṛtvā sanaye dhanānām |
9,096.20 vṛṣeva yūthā pari kośamarṣankanikradaccamvorā viveśa ||
9,096.21  pavasvendo pavamāno mahobhiḥ kanikradatpari vārāṇyarṣa |
9,096.21 krīḻañcamvorā viśa pūyamāna indraṃ te raso madiro mamattu ||
9,096.22  prāsya dhārā bṛhatīrasṛgrannakto gobhiḥ kalaśāṃ ā viveśa |
9,096.22 sāma kṛṇvansāmanyo vipaścitkrandannetyabhi sakhyurna jāmim ||
9,096.23  apaghnanneṣi pavamāna śatrūnpriyāṃ na jāro abhigīta induḥ |
9,096.23 sīdanvaneṣu śakuno na patvā somaḥ punānaḥ kalaśeṣu sattā ||
9,096.24  ā te rucaḥ pavamānasya soma yoṣeva yanti sudughāḥ sudhārāḥ |
9,096.24 harirānītaḥ puruvāro apsvacikradatkalaśe devayūnām ||

9,097.01  asya preṣā hemanā pūyamāno devo devebhiḥ samapṛkta rasam |
9,097.01 sutaḥ pavitraṃ paryeti rebhanmiteva sadma paśumānti hotā ||
9,097.02  bhadrā vastrā samanyā vasāno mahānkavirnivacanāni śaṃsan |
9,097.02 ā vacyasva camvoḥ pūyamāno vicakṣaṇo jāgṛvirdevavītau ||
9,097.03  samu priyo mṛjyate sāno avye yaśastaro yaśasāṃ kṣaito asme |
9,097.03 abhi svara dhanvā pūyamāno yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
9,097.04  pra gāyatābhyarcāma devānsomaṃ hinota mahate dhanāya |
9,097.04 svāduḥ pavāte ati vāramavyamā sīdāti kalaśaṃ devayurnaḥ ||
9,097.05  indurdevānāmupa sakhyamāyansahasradhāraḥ pavate madāya |
9,097.05 nṛbhi stavāno anu dhāma pūrvamagannindraṃ mahate saubhagāya ||
9,097.06  stotre rāye harirarṣā punāna indraṃ mado gacchatu te bharāya |
9,097.06 devairyāhi sarathaṃ rādho acchā yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
9,097.07  pra kāvyamuśaneva bruvāṇo devo devānāṃ janimā vivakti |
9,097.07 mahivrataḥ śucibandhuḥ pāvakaḥ padā varāho abhyeti rebhan ||
9,097.08  pra haṃsāsastṛpalaṃ manyumacchāmādastaṃ vṛṣagaṇā ayāsuḥ |
9,097.08 āṅgūṣyaṃ pavamānaṃ sakhāyo durmarṣaṃ sākaṃ pra vadanti vāṇam ||
9,097.09  sa raṃhata urugāyasya jūtiṃ vṛthā krīḻantaṃ mimate na gāvaḥ |
9,097.09 parīṇasaṃ kṛṇute tigmaśṛṅgo divā harirdadṛśe naktamṛjraḥ ||
9,097.10  indurvājī pavate gonyoghā indre somaḥ saha invanmadāya |
9,097.10 hanti rakṣo bādhate paryarātīrvarivaḥ kṛṇvanvṛjanasya rājā ||
9,097.11  adha dhārayā madhvā pṛcānastiro roma pavate adridugdhaḥ |
9,097.11 indurindrasya sakhyaṃ juṣāṇo devo devasya matsaro madāya ||
9,097.12  abhi priyāṇi pavate punāno devo devānsvena rasena pṛñcan |
9,097.12 indurdharmāṇyṛtuthā vasāno daśa kṣipo avyata sāno avye ||
9,097.13  vṛṣā śoṇo abhikanikradadgā nadayanneti pṛthivīmuta dyām |
9,097.13 indrasyeva vagnurā śṛṇva ājau pracetayannarṣati vācamemām ||
9,097.14  rasāyyaḥ payasā pinvamāna īrayanneṣi madhumantamaṃśum |
9,097.14 pavamānaḥ saṃtanimeṣi kṛṇvannindrāya soma pariṣicyamānaḥ ||
9,097.15  evā pavasva madiro madāyodagrābhasya namayanvadhasnaiḥ |
9,097.15 pari varṇaṃ bharamāṇo ruśantaṃ gavyurno arṣa pari soma siktaḥ ||
