9,097.16  juṣṭvī na indo supathā sugānyurau pavasva varivāṃsi kṛṇvan |
9,097.16 ghaneva viṣvagduritāni vighnannadhi ṣṇunā dhanva sāno avye ||
9,097.17  vṛṣṭiṃ no arṣa divyāṃ jigatnumiḻāvatīṃ śaṅgayīṃ jīradānum |
9,097.17 stukeva vītā dhanvā vicinvanbandhūṃrimāṃ avarāṃ indo vāyūn ||
9,097.18  granthiṃ na vi ṣya grathitaṃ punāna ṛjuṃ ca gātuṃ vṛjinaṃ ca soma |
9,097.18 atyo na krado harirā sṛjāno maryo deva dhanva pastyāvān ||
9,097.19  juṣṭo madāya devatāta indo pari ṣṇunā dhanva sāno avye |
9,097.19 sahasradhāraḥ surabhiradabdhaḥ pari srava vājasātau nṛṣahye ||
9,097.20  araśmāno ye'rathā ayuktā atyāso na sasṛjānāsa ājau |
9,097.20 ete śukrāso dhanvanti somā devāsastāṃ upa yātā pibadhyai ||
9,097.21  evā na indo abhi devavītiṃ pari srava nabho arṇaścamūṣu |
9,097.21 somo asmabhyaṃ kāmyaṃ bṛhantaṃ rayiṃ dadātu vīravantamugram ||
9,097.22  takṣadyadī manaso venato vāgjyeṣṭhasya vā dharmaṇi kṣoranīke |
9,097.22 ādīmāyanvaramā vāvaśānā juṣṭaṃ patiṃ kalaśe gāva indum ||
9,097.23  pra dānudo divyo dānupinva ṛtamṛtāya pavate sumedhāḥ |
9,097.23 dharmā bhuvadvṛjanyasya rājā pra raśmibhirdaśabhirbhāri bhūma ||
9,097.24  pavitrebhiḥ pavamāno nṛcakṣā rājā devānāmuta martyānām |
9,097.24 dvitā bhuvadrayipatī rayīṇāmṛtaṃ bharatsubhṛtaṃ cārvinduḥ ||
9,097.25  arvāṃ iva śravase sātimacchendrasya vāyorabhi vītimarṣa |
9,097.25 sa naḥ sahasrā bṛhatīriṣo dā bhavā soma draviṇovitpunānaḥ ||
9,097.26  devāvyo naḥ pariṣicyamānāḥ kṣayaṃ suvīraṃ dhanvantu somāḥ |
9,097.26 āyajyavaḥ sumatiṃ viśvavārā hotāro na diviyajo mandratamāḥ ||
9,097.27  evā deva devatāte pavasva mahe soma psarase devapānaḥ |
9,097.27 mahaściddhi ṣmasi hitāḥ samarye kṛdhi suṣṭhāne rodasī punānaḥ ||
9,097.28  aśvo no krado vṛṣabhiryujānaḥ siṃho na bhīmo manaso javīyān |
9,097.28 arvācīnaiḥ pathibhirye rajiṣṭhā ā pavasva saumanasaṃ na indo ||
9,097.29  śataṃ dhārā devajātā asṛgransahasramenāḥ kavayo mṛjanti |
9,097.29 indo sanitraṃ diva ā pavasva puraetāsi mahato dhanasya ||
9,097.30  divo na sargā asasṛgramahnāṃ rājā na mitraṃ pra mināti dhīraḥ |
9,097.30 piturna putraḥ kratubhiryatāna ā pavasva viśe asyā ajītim ||
9,097.31  pra te dhārā madhumatīrasṛgranvārānyatpūto atyeṣyavyān |
9,097.31 pavamāna pavase dhāma gonāṃ jajñānaḥ sūryamapinvo arkaiḥ ||
9,097.32  kanikradadanu panthāmṛtasya śukro vi bhāsyamṛtasya dhāma |
9,097.32 sa indrāya pavase matsaravānhinvāno vācaṃ matibhiḥ kavīnām ||
9,097.33  divyaḥ suparṇo'va cakṣi soma pinvandhārāḥ karmaṇā devavītau |
9,097.33 endo viśa kalaśaṃ somadhānaṃ krandannihi sūryasyopa raśmim ||
9,097.34  tisro vāca īrayati pra vahnirṛtasya dhītiṃ brahmaṇo manīṣām |
9,097.34 gāvo yanti gopatiṃ pṛcchamānāḥ somaṃ yanti matayo vāvaśānāḥ ||
9,097.35  somaṃ gāvo dhenavo vāvaśānāḥ somaṃ viprā matibhiḥ pṛcchamānāḥ |
9,097.35 somaḥ sutaḥ pūyate ajyamānaḥ some arkāstriṣṭubhaḥ saṃ navante ||
9,097.36  evā naḥ soma pariṣicyamāna ā pavasva pūyamānaḥ svasti |
9,097.36 indramā viśa bṛhatā raveṇa vardhayā vācaṃ janayā purandhim ||
9,097.37  ā jāgṛvirvipra ṛtā matīnāṃ somaḥ punāno asadaccamūṣu |
9,097.37 sapanti yaṃ mithunāso nikāmā adhvaryavo rathirāsaḥ suhastāḥ ||
9,097.38  sa punāna upa sūre na dhātobhe aprā rodasī vi ṣa āvaḥ |
9,097.38 priyā cidyasya priyasāsa ūtī sa tū dhanaṃ kāriṇe na pra yaṃsat ||
9,097.39  sa vardhitā vardhanaḥ pūyamānaḥ somo mīḍhvāṃ abhi no jyotiṣāvīt |
9,097.39 yenā naḥ pūrve pitaraḥ padajñāḥ svarvido abhi gā adrimuṣṇan ||
9,097.40  akrānsamudraḥ prathame vidharmañjanayanprajā bhuvanasya rājā |
9,097.40 vṛṣā pavitre adhi sāno avye bṛhatsomo vāvṛdhe suvāna induḥ ||
9,097.41  mahattatsomo mahiṣaścakārāpāṃ yadgarbho'vṛṇīta devān |
9,097.41 adadhādindre pavamāna ojo'janayatsūrye jyotirinduḥ ||
9,097.42  matsi vāyumiṣṭaye rādhase ca matsi mitrāvaruṇā pūyamānaḥ |
9,097.42 matsi śardho mārutaṃ matsi devānmatsi dyāvāpṛthivī deva soma ||
9,097.43  ṛjuḥ pavasva vṛjinasya hantāpāmīvāṃ bādhamāno mṛdhaśca |
9,097.43 abhiśrīṇanpayaḥ payasābhi gonāmindrasya tvaṃ tava vayaṃ sakhāyaḥ ||
9,097.44  madhvaḥ sūdaṃ pavasva vasva utsaṃ vīraṃ ca na ā pavasvā bhagaṃ ca |
9,097.44 svadasvendrāya pavamāna indo rayiṃ ca na ā pavasvā samudrāt ||
9,097.45  somaḥ suto dhārayātyo na hitvā sindhurna nimnamabhi vājyakṣāḥ |
9,097.45 ā yoniṃ vanyamasadatpunānaḥ samindurgobhirasaratsamadbhiḥ ||
9,097.46  eṣa sya te pavata indra somaścamūṣu dhīra uśate tavasvān |
9,097.46 svarcakṣā rathiraḥ satyaśuṣmaḥ kāmo na yo devayatāmasarji ||
9,097.47  eṣa pratnena vayasā punānastiro varpāṃsi duhiturdadhānaḥ |
9,097.47 vasānaḥ śarma trivarūthamapsu hoteva yāti samaneṣu rebhan ||
9,097.48  nū nastvaṃ rathiro deva soma pari srava camvoḥ pūyamānaḥ |
9,097.48 apsu svādiṣṭho madhumāṃ ṛtāvā devo na yaḥ savitā satyamanmā ||
9,097.49  abhi vāyuṃ vītyarṣā gṛṇāno'bhi mitrāvaruṇā pūyamānaḥ |
9,097.49 abhī naraṃ dhījavanaṃ ratheṣṭhāmabhīndraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ vajrabāhum ||
9,097.50  abhi vastrā suvasanānyarṣābhi dhenūḥ sudughāḥ pūyamānaḥ |
9,097.50 abhi candrā bhartave no hiraṇyābhyaśvānrathino deva soma ||
9,097.51  abhī no arṣa divyā vasūnyabhi viśvā pārthivā pūyamānaḥ |
9,097.51 abhi yena draviṇamaśnavāmābhyārṣeyaṃ jamadagnivannaḥ ||
9,097.52  ayā pavā pavasvainā vasūni māṃścatva indo sarasi pra dhanva |
9,097.52 bradhnaścidatra vāto na jūtaḥ purumedhaścittakave naraṃ dāt ||
9,097.53  uta na enā pavayā pavasvādhi śrute śravāyyasya tīrthe |
9,097.53 ṣaṣṭiṃ sahasrā naiguto vasūni vṛkṣaṃ na pakvaṃ dhūnavadraṇāya ||
9,097.54  mahīme asya vṛṣanāma śūṣe māṃścatve vā pṛśane vā vadhatre |
9,097.54 asvāpayannigutaḥ snehayaccāpāmitrāṃ apācito acetaḥ ||
9,097.55  saṃ trī pavitrā vitatānyeṣyanvekaṃ dhāvasi pūyamānaḥ |
9,097.55 asi bhago asi dātrasya dātāsi maghavā maghavadbhya indo ||
9,097.56  eṣa viśvavitpavate manīṣī somo viśvasya bhuvanasya rājā |
9,097.56 drapsāṃ īrayanvidatheṣvindurvi vāramavyaṃ samayāti yāti ||
9,097.57  induṃ rihanti mahiṣā adabdhāḥ pade rebhanti kavayo na gṛdhrāḥ |
9,097.57 hinvanti dhīrā daśabhiḥ kṣipābhiḥ samañjate rūpamapāṃ rasena ||
9,097.58  tvayā vayaṃ pavamānena soma bhare kṛtaṃ vi cinuyāma śaśvat |
9,097.58 tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||

9,098.01  abhi no vājasātamaṃ rayimarṣa puruspṛham |
9,098.01 indo sahasrabharṇasaṃ tuvidyumnaṃ vibhvāsaham ||
9,098.02  pari ṣya suvāno avyayaṃ rathe na varmāvyata |
9,098.02 indurabhi druṇā hito hiyāno dhārābhirakṣāḥ ||
9,098.03  pari ṣya suvāno akṣā induravye madacyutaḥ |
9,098.03 dhārā ya ūrdhvo adhvare bhrājā naiti gavyayuḥ ||
9,098.04  sa hi tvaṃ deva śaśvate vasu martāya dāśuṣe |
9,098.04 indo sahasriṇaṃ rayiṃ śatātmānaṃ vivāsasi ||
9,098.05  vayaṃ te asya vṛtrahanvaso vasvaḥ puruspṛhaḥ |
9,098.05 ni nediṣṭhatamā iṣaḥ syāma sumnasyādhrigo ||
9,098.06  dviryaṃ pañca svayaśasaṃ svasāro adrisaṃhatam |
9,098.06 priyamindrasya kāmyaṃ prasnāpayantyūrmiṇam ||
9,098.07  pari tyaṃ haryataṃ hariṃ babhruṃ punanti vāreṇa |
9,098.07 yo devānviśvāṃ itpari madena saha gacchati ||
9,098.08  asya vo hyavasā pānto dakṣasādhanam |
9,098.08 yaḥ sūriṣu śravo bṛhaddadhe svarṇa haryataḥ ||
9,098.09  sa vāṃ yajñeṣu mānavī indurjaniṣṭa rodasī |
9,098.09 devo devī giriṣṭhā asredhantaṃ tuviṣvaṇi ||
9,098.10  indrāya soma pātave vṛtraghne pari ṣicyase |
9,098.10 nare ca dakṣiṇāvate devāya sadanāsade ||
9,098.11  te pratnāso vyuṣṭiṣu somāḥ pavitre akṣaran |
9,098.11 apaprothantaḥ sanutarhuraścitaḥ prātastāṃ apracetasaḥ ||
9,098.12  taṃ sakhāyaḥ purorucaṃ yūyaṃ vayaṃ ca sūrayaḥ |
9,098.12 aśyāma vājagandhyaṃ sanema vājapastyam ||

9,099.01  ā haryatāya dhṛṣṇave dhanustanvanti pauṃsyam |
9,099.01 śukrāṃ vayantyasurāya nirṇijaṃ vipāmagre mahīyuvaḥ ||
9,099.02  adha kṣapā pariṣkṛto vājāṃ abhi pra gāhate |
9,099.02 yadī vivasvato dhiyo hariṃ hinvanti yātave ||
9,099.03  tamasya marjayāmasi mado ya indrapātamaḥ |
9,099.03 yaṃ gāva āsabhirdadhuḥ purā nūnaṃ ca sūrayaḥ ||
9,099.04  taṃ gāthayā purāṇyā punānamabhyanūṣata |
9,099.04 uto kṛpanta dhītayo devānāṃ nāma bibhratīḥ ||
9,099.05  tamukṣamāṇamavyaye vāre punanti dharṇasim |
9,099.05 dūtaṃ na pūrvacittaya ā śāsate manīṣiṇaḥ ||
9,099.06  sa punāno madintamaḥ somaścamūṣu sīdati |
9,099.06 paśau na reta ādadhatpatirvacasyate dhiyaḥ ||
9,099.07  sa mṛjyate sukarmabhirdevo devebhyaḥ sutaḥ |
9,099.07 vide yadāsu saṃdadirmahīrapo vi gāhate ||
9,099.08  suta indo pavitra ā nṛbhiryato vi nīyase |
9,099.08 indrāya matsarintamaścamūṣvā ni ṣīdasi ||

9,100.01  abhī navante adruhaḥ priyamindrasya kāmyam |
9,100.01 vatsaṃ na pūrva āyuni jātaṃ rihanti mātaraḥ ||
9,100.02  punāna indavā bhara soma dvibarhasaṃ rayim |
9,100.02 tvaṃ vasūni puṣyasi viśvāni dāśuṣo gṛhe ||
9,100.03  tvaṃ dhiyaṃ manoyujaṃ sṛjā vṛṣṭiṃ na tanyatuḥ |
9,100.03 tvaṃ vasūni pārthivā divyā ca soma puṣyasi ||
9,100.04  pari te jigyuṣo yathā dhārā sutasya dhāvati |
9,100.04 raṃhamāṇā vyavyayaṃ vāraṃ vājīva sānasiḥ ||
9,100.05  kratve dakṣāya naḥ kave pavasva soma dhārayā |
9,100.05 indrāya pātave suto mitrāya varuṇāya ca ||
9,100.06  pavasva vājasātamaḥ pavitre dhārayā sutaḥ |
9,100.06 indrāya soma viṣṇave devebhyo madhumattamaḥ ||
9,100.07  tvāṃ rihanti mātaro hariṃ pavitre adruhaḥ |
9,100.07 vatsaṃ jātaṃ na dhenavaḥ pavamāna vidharmaṇi ||
9,100.08  pavamāna mahi śravaścitrebhiryāsi raśmibhiḥ |
9,100.08 śardhantamāṃsi jighnase viśvāni dāśuṣo gṛhe ||
9,100.09  tvaṃ dyāṃ ca mahivrata pṛthivīṃ cāti jabhriṣe |
9,100.09 prati drāpimamuñcathāḥ pavamāna mahitvanā ||

9,101.01  purojitī vo andhasaḥ sutāya mādayitnave |
9,101.01 apa śvānaṃ śnathiṣṭana sakhāyo dīrghajihvyam ||
9,101.02  yo dhārayā pāvakayā pariprasyandate sutaḥ |
9,101.02 induraśvo na kṛtvyaḥ ||
9,101.03  taṃ duroṣamabhī naraḥ somaṃ viśvācyā dhiyā |
9,101.03 yajñaṃ hinvantyadribhiḥ ||
9,101.04  sutāso madhumattamāḥ somā indrāya mandinaḥ |
9,101.04 pavitravanto akṣarandevāngacchantu vo madāḥ ||
9,101.05  indurindrāya pavata iti devāso abruvan |
9,101.05 vācaspatirmakhasyate viśvasyeśāna ojasā ||
9,101.06  sahasradhāraḥ pavate samudro vācamīṅkhayaḥ |
9,101.06 somaḥ patī rayīṇāṃ sakhendrasya divedive ||
9,101.07  ayaṃ pūṣā rayirbhagaḥ somaḥ punāno arṣati |
9,101.07 patirviśvasya bhūmano vyakhyadrodasī ubhe ||
9,101.08  samu priyā anūṣata gāvo madāya ghṛṣvayaḥ |
9,101.08 somāsaḥ kṛṇvate pathaḥ pavamānāsa indavaḥ ||
9,101.09  ya ojiṣṭhastamā bhara pavamāna śravāyyam |
9,101.09 yaḥ pañca carṣaṇīrabhi rayiṃ yena vanāmahai ||
9,101.10  somāḥ pavanta indavo'smabhyaṃ gātuvittamāḥ |
9,101.10 mitrāḥ suvānā arepasaḥ svādhyaḥ svarvidaḥ ||
9,101.11  suṣvāṇāso vyadribhiścitānā goradhi tvaci |
9,101.11 iṣamasmabhyamabhitaḥ samasvaranvasuvidaḥ ||
9,101.12  ete pūtā vipaścitaḥ somāso dadhyāśiraḥ |
9,101.12 sūryāso na darśatāso jigatnavo dhruvā ghṛte ||
9,101.13  pra sunvānasyāndhaso marto na vṛta tadvacaḥ |
9,101.13 apa śvānamarādhasaṃ hatā makhaṃ na bhṛgavaḥ ||
9,101.14  ā jāmiratke avyata bhuje na putra oṇyoḥ |
9,101.14 sarajjāro na yoṣaṇāṃ varo na yonimāsadam ||
9,101.15  sa vīro dakṣasādhano vi yastastambha rodasī |
9,101.15 hariḥ pavitre avyata vedhā na yonimāsadam ||
9,101.16  avyo vārebhiḥ pavate somo gavye adhi tvaci |
9,101.16 kanikradadvṛṣā haririndrasyābhyeti niṣkṛtam ||

9,102.01  krāṇā śiśurmahīnāṃ hinvannṛtasya dīdhitim |
9,102.01 viśvā pari priyā bhuvadadha dvitā ||
9,102.02  upa tritasya pāṣyorabhakta yadguhā padam |
9,102.02 yajñasya sapta dhāmabhiradha priyam ||
9,102.03  trīṇi tritasya dhārayā pṛṣṭheṣverayā rayim |
9,102.03 mimīte asya yojanā vi sukratuḥ ||
9,102.04  jajñānaṃ sapta mātaro vedhāmaśāsata śriye |
9,102.04 ayaṃ dhruvo rayīṇāṃ ciketa yat ||
9,102.05  asya vrate sajoṣaso viśve devāso adruhaḥ |
9,102.05 spārhā bhavanti rantayo juṣanta yat ||
9,102.06  yamī garbhamṛtāvṛdho dṛśe cārumajījanan |
9,102.06 kaviṃ maṃhiṣṭhamadhvare puruspṛham ||
9,102.07  samīcīne abhi tmanā yahvī ṛtasya mātarā |
9,102.07 tanvānā yajñamānuṣagyadañjate ||
9,102.08  kratvā śukrebhirakṣabhirṛṇorapa vrajaṃ divaḥ |
9,102.08 hinvannṛtasya dīdhitiṃ prādhvare ||

9,103.01  pra punānāya vedhase somāya vaca udyatam |
9,103.01 bhṛtiṃ na bharā matibhirjujoṣate ||
9,103.02  pari vārāṇyavyayā gobhirañjāno arṣati |
9,103.02 trī ṣadhasthā punānaḥ kṛṇute hariḥ ||
9,103.03  pari kośaṃ madhuścutamavyaye vāre arṣati |
9,103.03 abhi vāṇīrṛṣīṇāṃ sapta nūṣata ||
9,103.04  pari ṇetā matīnāṃ viśvadevo adābhyaḥ |
9,103.04 somaḥ punānaścamvorviśaddhariḥ ||
9,103.05  pari daivīranu svadhā indreṇa yāhi saratham |
9,103.05 punāno vāghadvāghadbhiramartyaḥ ||
9,103.06  pari saptirna vājayurdevo devebhyaḥ sutaḥ |
9,103.06 vyānaśiḥ pavamāno vi dhāvati ||

9,104.01  sakhāya ā ni ṣīdata punānāya pra gāyata |
9,104.01 śiśuṃ na yajñaiḥ pari bhūṣata śriye ||
9,104.02  samī vatsaṃ na mātṛbhiḥ sṛjatā gayasādhanam |
9,104.02 devāvyaṃ madamabhi dviśavasam ||
9,104.03  punātā dakṣasādhanaṃ yathā śardhāya vītaye |
9,104.03 yathā mitrāya varuṇāya śantamaḥ ||
9,104.04  asmabhyaṃ tvā vasuvidamabhi vāṇīranūṣata |
9,104.04 gobhiṣṭe varṇamabhi vāsayāmasi ||
9,104.05  sa no madānāṃ pata indo devapsarā asi |
9,104.05 sakheva sakhye gātuvittamo bhava ||
9,104.06  sanemi kṛdhyasmadā rakṣasaṃ kaṃ cidatriṇam |
9,104.06 apādevaṃ dvayumaṃho yuyodhi naḥ ||

9,105.01  taṃ vaḥ sakhāyo madāya punānamabhi gāyata |
9,105.01 śiśuṃ na yajñaiḥ svadayanta gūrtibhiḥ ||
9,105.02  saṃ vatsa iva mātṛbhirindurhinvāno ajyate |
9,105.02 devāvīrmado matibhiḥ pariṣkṛtaḥ ||
9,105.03  ayaṃ dakṣāya sādhano'yaṃ śardhāya vītaye |
9,105.03 ayaṃ devebhyo madhumattamaḥ sutaḥ ||
9,105.04  gomanna indo aśvavatsutaḥ sudakṣa dhanva |
9,105.04 śuciṃ te varṇamadhi goṣu dīdharam ||
9,105.05  sa no harīṇāṃ pata indo devapsarastamaḥ |
9,105.05 sakheva sakhye naryo ruce bhava ||
9,105.06  sanemi tvamasmadāṃ adevaṃ kaṃ cidatriṇam |
9,105.06 sāhvāṃ indo pari bādho apa dvayum ||

9,106.01  indramaccha sutā ime vṛṣaṇaṃ yantu harayaḥ |
9,106.01 śruṣṭī jātāsa indavaḥ svarvidaḥ ||
9,106.02  ayaṃ bharāya sānasirindrāya pavate sutaḥ |
9,106.02 somo jaitrasya cetati yathā vide ||
9,106.03  asyedindro madeṣvā grābhaṃ gṛbhṇīta sānasim |
9,106.03 vajraṃ ca vṛṣaṇaṃ bharatsamapsujit ||
9,106.04  pra dhanvā soma jāgṛvirindrāyendo pari srava |
9,106.04 dyumantaṃ śuṣmamā bharā svarvidam ||
9,106.05  indrāya vṛṣaṇaṃ madaṃ pavasva viśvadarśataḥ |
9,106.05 sahasrayāmā pathikṛdvicakṣaṇaḥ ||
9,106.06  asmabhyaṃ gātuvittamo devebhyo madhumattamaḥ |
9,106.06 sahasraṃ yāhi pathibhiḥ kanikradat ||
9,106.07  pavasva devavītaya indo dhārābhirojasā |
9,106.07 ā kalaśaṃ madhumānsoma naḥ sadaḥ ||
9,106.08  tava drapsā udapruta indraṃ madāya vāvṛdhuḥ |
9,106.08 tvāṃ devāso amṛtāya kaṃ papuḥ ||
9,106.09  ā naḥ sutāsa indavaḥ punānā dhāvatā rayim |
9,106.09 vṛṣṭidyāvo rītyāpaḥ svarvidaḥ ||
9,106.10  somaḥ punāna ūrmiṇāvyo vāraṃ vi dhāvati |
9,106.10 agre vācaḥ pavamānaḥ kanikradat ||
9,106.11  dhībhirhinvanti vājinaṃ vane krīḻantamatyavim |
9,106.11 abhi tripṛṣṭhaṃ matayaḥ samasvaran ||
9,106.12  asarji kalaśāṃ abhi mīḻhe saptirna vājayuḥ |
9,106.12 punāno vācaṃ janayannasiṣyadat ||
9,106.13  pavate haryato harirati hvarāṃsi raṃhyā |
9,106.13 abhyarṣanstotṛbhyo vīravadyaśaḥ ||
9,106.14  ayā pavasva devayurmadhordhārā asṛkṣata |
9,106.14 rebhanpavitraṃ paryeṣi viśvataḥ ||

9,107.01  parīto ṣiñcatā sutaṃ somo ya uttamaṃ haviḥ |
9,107.01 dadhanvāṃ yo naryo apsvantarā suṣāva somamadribhiḥ ||
9,107.02  nūnaṃ punāno'vibhiḥ pari sravādabdhaḥ surabhintaraḥ |
9,107.02 sute cittvāpsu madāmo andhasā śrīṇanto gobhiruttaram ||
9,107.03  pari suvānaścakṣase devamādanaḥ kraturindurvicakṣaṇaḥ ||
9,107.04  punānaḥ soma dhārayāpo vasāno arṣasi |
9,107.04 ā ratnadhā yonimṛtasya sīdasyutso deva hiraṇyayaḥ ||
9,107.05  duhāna ūdhardivyaṃ madhu priyaṃ pratnaṃ sadhasthamāsadat |
9,107.05 āpṛcchyaṃ dharuṇaṃ vājyarṣati nṛbhirdhūto vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
9,107.06  punānaḥ soma jāgṛviravyo vāre pari priyaḥ |
9,107.06 tvaṃ vipro abhavo'ṅgirastamo madhvā yajñaṃ mimikṣa naḥ ||
9,107.07  somo mīḍhvānpavate gātuvittama ṛṣirvipro vicakṣaṇaḥ |
9,107.07 tvaṃ kavirabhavo devavītama ā sūryaṃ rohayo divi ||
9,107.08  soma u ṣuvāṇaḥ sotṛbhiradhi ṣṇubhiravīnām |
9,107.08 aśvayeva haritā yāti dhārayā mandrayā yāti dhārayā ||
9,107.09  anūpe gomāngobhirakṣāḥ somo dugdhābhirakṣāḥ |
9,107.09 samudraṃ na saṃvaraṇānyagmanmandī madāya tośate ||
9,107.10  ā soma suvāno adribhistiro vārāṇyavyayā |
9,107.10 jano na puri camvorviśaddhariḥ sado vaneṣu dadhiṣe ||
9,107.11  sa māmṛje tiro aṇvāni meṣyo mīḻhe saptirna vājayuḥ |
9,107.11 anumādyaḥ pavamāno manīṣibhiḥ somo viprebhirṛkvabhiḥ ||
9,107.12  pra soma devavītaye sindhurna pipye arṇasā |
9,107.12 aṃśoḥ payasā madiro na jāgṛviracchā kośaṃ madhuścutam ||
9,107.13  ā haryato arjune atke avyata priyaḥ sūnurna marjyaḥ |
9,107.13 tamīṃ hinvantyapaso yathā rathaṃ nadīṣvā gabhastyoḥ ||
9,107.14  abhi somāsa āyavaḥ pavante madyaṃ madam |
9,107.14 samudrasyādhi viṣṭapi manīṣiṇo matsarāsaḥ svarvidaḥ ||
9,107.15  taratsamudraṃ pavamāna ūrmiṇā rājā deva ṛtaṃ bṛhat |
9,107.15 arṣanmitrasya varuṇasya dharmaṇā pra hinvāna ṛtaṃ bṛhat ||
9,107.16  nṛbhiryemāno haryato vicakṣaṇo rājā devaḥ samudriyaḥ ||
9,107.17  indrāya pavate madaḥ somo marutvate sutaḥ |
9,107.17 sahasradhāro atyavyamarṣati tamī mṛjantyāyavaḥ ||
9,107.18  punānaścamū janayanmatiṃ kaviḥ somo deveṣu raṇyati |
9,107.18 apo vasānaḥ pari gobhiruttaraḥ sīdanvaneṣvavyata ||
9,107.19  tavāhaṃ soma rāraṇa sakhya indo divedive |
9,107.19 purūṇi babhro ni caranti māmava paridhīṃrati tāṃ ihi ||
9,107.20  utāhaṃ naktamuta soma te divā sakhyāya babhra ūdhani |
9,107.20 ghṛṇā tapantamati sūryaṃ paraḥ śakunā iva paptima ||
9,107.21  mṛjyamānaḥ suhastya samudre vācaminvasi |
9,107.21 rayiṃ piśaṅgaṃ bahulaṃ puruspṛhaṃ pavamānābhyarṣasi ||
9,107.22  mṛjāno vāre pavamāno avyaye vṛṣāva cakrado vane |
9,107.22 devānāṃ soma pavamāna niṣkṛtaṃ gobhirañjāno arṣasi ||
9,107.23  pavasva vājasātaye'bhi viśvāni kāvyā |
9,107.23 tvaṃ samudraṃ prathamo vi dhārayo devebhyaḥ soma matsaraḥ ||
9,107.24  sa tū pavasva pari pārthivaṃ rajo divyā ca soma dharmabhiḥ |
9,107.24 tvāṃ viprāso matibhirvicakṣaṇa śubhraṃ hinvanti dhītibhiḥ ||
9,107.25  pavamānā asṛkṣata pavitramati dhārayā |
9,107.25 marutvanto matsarā indriyā hayā medhāmabhi prayāṃsi ca ||
9,107.26  apo vasānaḥ pari kośamarṣatīndurhiyānaḥ sotṛbhiḥ |
9,107.26 janayañjyotirmandanā avīvaśadgāḥ kṛṇvāno na nirṇijam ||

9,108.01  pavasva madhumattama indrāya soma kratuvittamo madaḥ |
9,108.01 mahi dyukṣatamo madaḥ ||
9,108.02  yasya te pītvā vṛṣabho vṛṣāyate'sya pītā svarvidaḥ |
9,108.02 sa supraketo abhyakramīdiṣo'cchā vājaṃ naitaśaḥ ||
9,108.03  tvaṃ hyaṅga daivyā pavamāna janimāni dyumattamaḥ |
9,108.03 amṛtatvāya ghoṣayaḥ ||
9,108.04  yenā navagvo dadhyaṅṅaporṇute yena viprāsa āpire |
9,108.04 devānāṃ sumne amṛtasya cāruṇo yena śravāṃsyānaśuḥ ||
9,108.05  eṣa sya dhārayā suto'vyo vārebhiḥ pavate madintamaḥ |
9,108.05 krīḻannūrmirapāmiva ||
9,108.06  ya usriyā apyā antaraśmano nirgā akṛntadojasā |
9,108.06 abhi vrajaṃ tatniṣe gavyamaśvyaṃ varmīva dhṛṣṇavā ruja ||
9,108.07  ā sotā pari ṣiñcatāśvaṃ na stomamapturaṃ rajasturam |
9,108.07 vanakrakṣamudaprutam ||
9,108.08  sahasradhāraṃ vṛṣabhaṃ payovṛdhaṃ priyaṃ devāya janmane |
9,108.08 ṛtena ya ṛtajāto vivāvṛdhe rājā deva ṛtaṃ bṛhat ||
9,108.09  abhi dyumnaṃ bṛhadyaśa iṣaspate didīhi deva devayuḥ |
9,108.09 vi kośaṃ madhyamaṃ yuva ||
9,108.10  ā vacyasva sudakṣa camvoḥ suto viśāṃ vahnirna viśpatiḥ |
9,108.10 vṛṣṭiṃ divaḥ pavasva rītimapāṃ jinvā gaviṣṭaye dhiyaḥ ||
9,108.11  etamu tyaṃ madacyutaṃ sahasradhāraṃ vṛṣabhaṃ divo duhuḥ |
9,108.11 viśvā vasūni bibhratam ||
9,108.12  vṛṣā vi jajñe janayannamartyaḥ pratapañjyotiṣā tamaḥ |
9,108.12 sa suṣṭutaḥ kavibhirnirṇijaṃ dadhe tridhātvasya daṃsasā ||
9,108.13  sa sunve yo vasūnāṃ yo rāyāmānetā ya iḻānām |
9,108.13 somo yaḥ sukṣitīnām ||
9,108.14  yasya na indraḥ pibādyasya maruto yasya vāryamaṇā bhagaḥ |
9,108.14 ā yena mitrāvaruṇā karāmaha endramavase mahe ||
9,108.15  indrāya soma pātave nṛbhiryataḥ svāyudho madintamaḥ |
9,108.15 pavasva madhumattamaḥ ||
9,108.16  indrasya hārdi somadhānamā viśa samudramiva sindhavaḥ |
9,108.16 juṣṭo mitrāya varuṇāya vāyave divo viṣṭambha uttamaḥ ||

9,109.01  pari pra dhanvendrāya soma svādurmitrāya pūṣṇe bhagāya ||
9,109.02  indraste soma sutasya peyāḥ kratve dakṣāya viśve ca devāḥ ||
9,109.03  evāmṛtāya mahe kṣayāya sa śukro arṣa divyaḥ pīyūṣaḥ ||
9,109.04  pavasva soma mahānsamudraḥ pitā devānāṃ viśvābhi dhāma ||
9,109.05  śukraḥ pavasva devebhyaḥ soma dive pṛthivyai śaṃ ca prajāyai ||
9,109.06  divo dhartāsi śukraḥ pīyūṣaḥ satye vidharmanvājī pavasva ||
9,109.07  pavasva soma dyumnī sudhāro mahāmavīnāmanu pūrvyaḥ ||
9,109.08  nṛbhiryemāno jajñānaḥ pūtaḥ kṣaradviśvāni mandraḥ svarvit ||
9,109.09  induḥ punānaḥ prajāmurāṇaḥ karadviśvāni draviṇāni naḥ ||
9,109.10  pavasva soma kratve dakṣāyāśvo na nikto vājī dhanāya ||
9,109.11  taṃ te sotāro rasaṃ madāya punanti somaṃ mahe dyumnāya ||
9,109.12  śiśuṃ jajñānaṃ hariṃ mṛjanti pavitre somaṃ devebhya indum ||
9,109.13  induḥ paviṣṭa cārurmadāyāpāmupasthe kavirbhagāya ||
9,109.14  bibharti cārvindrasya nāma yena viśvāni vṛtrā jaghāna ||
9,109.15  pibantyasya viśve devāso gobhiḥ śrītasya nṛbhiḥ sutasya ||
9,109.16  pra suvāno akṣāḥ sahasradhārastiraḥ pavitraṃ vi vāramavyam ||
9,109.17  sa vājyakṣāḥ sahasraretā adbhirmṛjāno gobhiḥ śrīṇānaḥ ||
9,109.18  pra soma yāhīndrasya kukṣā nṛbhiryemāno adribhiḥ sutaḥ ||
9,109.19  asarji vājī tiraḥ pavitramindrāya somaḥ sahasradhāraḥ ||
9,109.20  añjantyenaṃ madhvo rasenendrāya vṛṣṇa induṃ madāya ||
9,109.21  devebhyastvā vṛthā pājase'po vasānaṃ hariṃ mṛjanti ||
9,109.22  indurindrāya tośate ni tośate śrīṇannugro riṇannapaḥ ||

9,110.01  paryū ṣu pra dhanva vājasātaye pari vṛtrāṇi sakṣaṇiḥ |
9,110.01 dviṣastaradhyā ṛṇayā na īyase ||
9,110.02  anu hi tvā sutaṃ soma madāmasi mahe samaryarājye |
9,110.02 vājāṃ abhi pavamāna pra gāhase ||
9,110.03  ajījano hi pavamāna sūryaṃ vidhāre śakmanā payaḥ |
9,110.03 gojīrayā raṃhamāṇaḥ purandhyā ||
9,110.04  ajījano amṛta martyeṣvāṃ ṛtasya dharmannamṛtasya cāruṇaḥ |
9,110.04 sadāsaro vājamacchā saniṣyadat ||
9,110.05  abhyabhi hi śravasā tatardithotsaṃ na kaṃ cijjanapānamakṣitam |
9,110.05 śaryābhirna bharamāṇo gabhastyoḥ ||
9,110.06  ādīṃ ke citpaśyamānāsa āpyaṃ vasuruco divyā abhyanūṣata |
9,110.06 vāraṃ na devaḥ savitā vyūrṇute ||
9,110.07  tve soma prathamā vṛktabarhiṣo mahe vājāya śravase dhiyaṃ dadhuḥ |
9,110.07 sa tvaṃ no vīra vīryāya codaya ||
9,110.08  divaḥ pīyūṣaṃ pūrvyaṃ yadukthyaṃ maho gāhāddiva ā niradhukṣata |
9,110.08 indramabhi jāyamānaṃ samasvaran ||
9,110.09  adha yadime pavamāna rodasī imā ca viśvā bhuvanābhi majmanā |
9,110.09 yūthe na niṣṭhā vṛṣabho vi tiṣṭhase ||
9,110.10  somaḥ punāno avyaye vāre śiśurna krīḻanpavamāno akṣāḥ |
9,110.10 sahasradhāraḥ śatavāja induḥ ||
9,110.11  eṣa punāno madhumāṃ ṛtāvendrāyenduḥ pavate svādurūrmiḥ |
9,110.11 vājasanirvarivovidvayodhāḥ ||
9,110.12  sa pavasva sahamānaḥ pṛtanyūnsedhanrakṣāṃsyapa durgahāṇi |
9,110.12 svāyudhaḥ sāsahvānsoma śatrūn ||

9,111.01  ayā rucā hariṇyā punāno viśvā dveṣāṃsi tarati svayugvabhiḥ sūro na svayugvabhiḥ |
9,111.01 dhārā sutasya rocate punāno aruṣo hariḥ |
9,111.01  viśvā yadrūpā pariyātyṛkvabhiḥ saptāsyebhirṛkvabhiḥ ||
9,111.02  tvaṃ tyatpaṇīnāṃ vido vasu saṃ mātṛbhirmarjayasi sva ā dama ṛtasya dhītibhirdame |
9,111.02 parāvato na sāma tadyatrā raṇanti dhītayaḥ |
9,111.02  tridhātubhiraruṣībhirvayo dadhe rocamāno vayo dadhe ||
9,111.03  pūrvāmanu pradiśaṃ yāti cekitatsaṃ raśmibhiryatate darśato ratho daivyo darśato rathaḥ |
9,111.03 agmannukthāni pauṃsyendraṃ jaitrāya harṣayan |
9,111.03  vajraśca yadbhavatho anapacyutā samatsvanapacyutā ||

9,112.01  nānānaṃ vā u no dhiyo vi vratāni janānām |
9,112.01 takṣā riṣṭaṃ rutaṃ bhiṣagbrahmā sunvantamicchatīndrāyendo pari srava ||
9,112.02  jaratībhiroṣadhībhiḥ parṇebhiḥ śakunānām |
9,112.02 kārmāro aśmabhirdyubhirhiraṇyavantamicchatīndrāyendo pari srava ||
9,112.03  kārurahaṃ tato bhiṣagupalaprakṣiṇī nanā |
9,112.03 nānādhiyo vasūyavo'nu gā iva tasthimendrāyendo pari srava ||
9,112.04  aśvo voḻhā sukhaṃ rathaṃ hasanāmupamantriṇaḥ |
9,112.04 śepo romaṇvantau bhedau vārinmaṇḍūka icchatīndrāyendo pari srava ||

9,113.01  śaryaṇāvati somamindraḥ pibatu vṛtrahā |
9,113.01 balaṃ dadhāna ātmani kariṣyanvīryaṃ mahadindrāyendo pari srava ||
9,113.02  ā pavasva diśāṃ pata ārjīkātsoma mīḍhvaḥ |
9,113.02 ṛtavākena satyena śraddhayā tapasā suta indrāyendo pari srava ||
9,113.03  parjanyavṛddhaṃ mahiṣaṃ taṃ sūryasya duhitābharat |
9,113.03 taṃ gandharvāḥ pratyagṛbhṇantaṃ some rasamādadhurindrāyendo pari srava ||
9,113.04  ṛtaṃ vadannṛtadyumna satyaṃ vadansatyakarman |
9,113.04 śraddhāṃ vadansoma rājandhātrā soma pariṣkṛta indrāyendo pari srava ||
9,113.05  satyamugrasya bṛhataḥ saṃ sravanti saṃsravāḥ |
9,113.05 saṃ yanti rasino rasāḥ punāno brahmaṇā hara indrāyendo pari srava ||
9,113.06  yatra brahmā pavamāna chandasyāṃ vācaṃ vadan |
9,113.06 grāvṇā some mahīyate somenānandaṃ janayannindrāyendo pari srava ||
9,113.07  yatra jyotirajasraṃ yasmiṃlloke svarhitam |
9,113.07 tasminmāṃ dhehi pavamānāmṛte loke akṣita indrāyendo pari srava ||
9,113.08  yatra rājā vaivasvato yatrāvarodhanaṃ divaḥ |
9,113.08 yatrāmūryahvatīrāpastatra māmamṛtaṃ kṛdhīndrāyendo pari srava ||
9,113.09  yatrānukāmaṃ caraṇaṃ trināke tridive divaḥ |
9,113.09 lokā yatra jyotiṣmantastatra māmamṛtaṃ kṛdhīndrāyendo pari srava ||
9,113.10  yatra kāmā nikāmāśca yatra bradhnasya viṣṭapam |
9,113.10 svadhā ca yatra tṛptiśca tatra māmamṛtaṃ kṛdhīndrāyendo pari srava ||
9,113.11  yatrānandāśca modāśca mudaḥ pramuda āsate |
9,113.11 kāmasya yatrāptāḥ kāmāstatra māmamṛtaṃ kṛdhīndrāyendo pari srava ||

9,114.01  ya indoḥ pavamānasyānu dhāmānyakramīt |
9,114.01 tamāhuḥ suprajā iti yaste somāvidhanmana indrāyendo pari srava ||
9,114.02  ṛṣe mantrakṛtāṃ stomaiḥ kaśyapodvardhayangiraḥ |
9,114.02 somaṃ namasya rājānaṃ yo jajñe vīrudhāṃ patirindrāyendo pari srava ||
9,114.03  sapta diśo nānāsūryāḥ sapta hotāra ṛtvijaḥ |
9,114.03 devā ādityā ye sapta tebhiḥ somābhi rakṣa na indrāyendo pari srava ||
9,114.04  yatte rājañchṛtaṃ havistena somābhi rakṣa naḥ |
9,114.04 arātīvā mā nastārīnmo ca naḥ kiṃ canāmamadindrāyendo pari srava ||








ṛgveda 10





10,001.01  agre bṛhannuṣasāmūrdhvo asthānnirjaganvāntamaso jyotiṣāgāt |
10,001.01 agnirbhānunā ruśatā svaṅga ā jāto viśvā sadmānyaprāḥ ||
10,001.02  sa jāto garbho asi rodasyoragne cārurvibhṛta oṣadhīṣu |
10,001.02 citraḥ śiśuḥ pari tamāṃsyaktūnpra mātṛbhyo adhi kanikradadgāḥ ||
10,001.03  viṣṇuritthā paramamasya vidvāñjāto bṛhannabhi pāti tṛtīyam |
10,001.03 āsā yadasya payo akrata svaṃ sacetaso abhyarcantyatra ||
10,001.04  ata u tvā pitubhṛto janitrīrannāvṛdhaṃ prati carantyannaiḥ |
10,001.04 tā īṃ pratyeṣi punaranyarūpā asi tvaṃ vikṣu mānuṣīṣu hotā ||
10,001.05  hotāraṃ citrarathamadhvarasya yajñasyayajñasya ketuṃ ruśantam |
10,001.05 pratyardhiṃ devasyadevasya mahnā śriyā tvagnimatithiṃ janānām ||
10,001.06  sa tu vastrāṇyadha peśanāni vasāno agnirnābhā pṛthivyāḥ |
10,001.06 aruṣo jātaḥ pada iḻāyāḥ purohito rājanyakṣīha devān ||
10,001.07  ā hi dyāvāpṛthivī agna ubhe sadā putro na mātarā tatantha |
10,001.07 pra yāhyacchośato yaviṣṭhāthā vaha sahasyeha devān ||

10,002.01  piprīhi devāṃ uśato yaviṣṭha vidvāṃ ṛtūṃrṛtupate yajeha |
10,002.01 ye daivyā ṛtvijastebhiragne tvaṃ hotṝṇāmasyāyajiṣṭhaḥ ||
10,002.02  veṣi hotramuta potraṃ janānāṃ mandhātāsi draviṇodā ṛtāvā |
10,002.02 svāhā vayaṃ kṛṇavāmā havīṃṣi devo devānyajatvagnirarhan ||
10,002.03  ā devānāmapi panthāmaganma yacchaknavāma tadanu pravoḻhum |
10,002.03 agnirvidvānsa yajātsedu hotā so adhvarānsa ṛtūnkalpayāti ||
10,002.04  yadvo vayaṃ pramināma vratāni viduṣāṃ devā aviduṣṭarāsaḥ |
10,002.04 agniṣṭadviśvamā pṛṇāti vidvānyebhirdevāṃ ṛtubhiḥ kalpayāti ||
10,002.05  yatpākatrā manasā dīnadakṣā na yajñasya manvate martyāsaḥ |
10,002.05 agniṣṭaddhotā kratuvidvijānanyajiṣṭho devāṃ ṛtuśo yajāti ||
10,002.06  viśveṣāṃ hyadhvarāṇāmanīkaṃ citraṃ ketuṃ janitā tvā jajāna |
10,002.06 sa ā yajasva nṛvatīranu kṣā spārhā iṣaḥ kṣumatīrviśvajanyāḥ ||
10,002.07  yaṃ tvā dyāvāpṛthivī yaṃ tvāpastvaṣṭā yaṃ tvā sujanimā jajāna |
10,002.07 panthāmanu pravidvānpitṛyāṇaṃ dyumadagne samidhāno vi bhāhi ||

10,003.01  ino rājannaratiḥ samiddho raudro dakṣāya suṣumāṃ adarśi |
10,003.01 cikidvi bhāti bhāsā bṛhatāsiknīmeti ruśatīmapājan ||
10,003.02  kṛṣṇāṃ yadenīmabhi varpasā bhūjjanayanyoṣāṃ bṛhataḥ piturjām |
10,003.02 ūrdhvaṃ bhānuṃ sūryasya stabhāyandivo vasubhiraratirvi bhāti ||
10,003.03  bhadro bhadrayā sacamāna āgātsvasāraṃ jāro abhyeti paścāt |
10,003.03 supraketairdyubhiragnirvitiṣṭhanruśadbhirvarṇairabhi rāmamasthāt ||
10,003.04  asya yāmāso bṛhato na vagnūnindhānā agneḥ sakhyuḥ śivasya |
10,003.04 īḍyasya vṛṣṇo bṛhataḥ svāso bhāmāso yāmannaktavaścikitre ||
10,003.05  svanā na yasya bhāmāsaḥ pavante rocamānasya bṛhataḥ sudivaḥ |
10,003.05 jyeṣṭhebhiryastejiṣṭhaiḥ krīḻumadbhirvarṣiṣṭhebhirbhānubhirnakṣati dyām ||
10,003.06  asya śuṣmāso dadṛśānapaverjehamānasya svanayanniyudbhiḥ |
10,003.06 pratnebhiryo ruśadbhirdevatamo vi rebhadbhiraratirbhāti vibhvā ||
10,003.07  sa ā vakṣi mahi na ā ca satsi divaspṛthivyoraratiryuvatyoḥ |
10,003.07 agniḥ sutukaḥ sutukebhiraśvai rabhasvadbhī rabhasvāṃ eha gamyāḥ ||

10,004.01  pra te yakṣi pra ta iyarmi manma bhuvo yathā vandyo no haveṣu |
10,004.01 dhanvanniva prapā asi tvamagna iyakṣave pūrave pratna rājan ||
10,004.02  yaṃ tvā janāso abhi saṃcaranti gāva uṣṇamiva vrajaṃ yaviṣṭha |
10,004.02 dūto devānāmasi martyānāmantarmahāṃścarasi rocanena ||
10,004.03  śiśuṃ na tvā jenyaṃ vardhayantī mātā bibharti sacanasyamānā |
10,004.03 dhanoradhi pravatā yāsi haryañjigīṣase paśurivāvasṛṣṭaḥ ||
10,004.04  mūrā amūra na vayaṃ cikitvo mahitvamagne tvamaṅga vitse |
10,004.04 śaye vavriścarati jihvayādanrerihyate yuvatiṃ viśpatiḥ san ||
10,004.05  kūcijjāyate sanayāsu navyo vane tasthau palito dhūmaketuḥ |
10,004.05 asnātāpo vṛṣabho na pra veti sacetaso yaṃ praṇayanta martāḥ ||
10,004.06  tanūtyajeva taskarā vanargū raśanābhirdaśabhirabhyadhītām |
10,004.06 iyaṃ te agne navyasī manīṣā yukṣvā rathaṃ na śucayadbhiraṅgaiḥ ||
10,004.07  brahma ca te jātavedo namaśceyaṃ ca gīḥ sadamidvardhanī bhūt |
10,004.07 rakṣā ṇo agne tanayāni tokā rakṣota nastanvo aprayucchan ||

10,005.01  ekaḥ samudro dharuṇo rayīṇāmasmaddhṛdo bhūrijanmā vi caṣṭe |
10,005.01 siṣaktyūdharniṇyorupastha utsasya madhye nihitaṃ padaṃ veḥ ||
10,005.02  samānaṃ nīḻaṃ vṛṣaṇo vasānāḥ saṃ jagmire mahiṣā arvatībhiḥ |
10,005.02 ṛtasya padaṃ kavayo ni pānti guhā nāmāni dadhire parāṇi ||
10,005.03  ṛtāyinī māyinī saṃ dadhāte mitvā śiśuṃ jajñaturvardhayantī |
10,005.03 viśvasya nābhiṃ carato dhruvasya kaveścittantuṃ manasā viyantaḥ ||
10,005.04  ṛtasya hi vartanayaḥ sujātamiṣo vājāya pradivaḥ sacante |
10,005.04 adhīvāsaṃ rodasī vāvasāne ghṛtairannairvāvṛdhāte madhūnām ||
10,005.05  sapta svasṝraruṣīrvāvaśāno vidvānmadhva ujjabhārā dṛśe kam |
10,005.05 antaryeme antarikṣe purājā icchanvavrimavidatpūṣaṇasya ||
10,005.06  sapta maryādāḥ kavayastatakṣustāsāmekāmidabhyaṃhuro gāt |
10,005.06 āyorha skambha upamasya nīḻe pathāṃ visarge dharuṇeṣu tasthau ||
10,005.07  asacca sacca parame vyomandakṣasya janmannaditerupasthe |
10,005.07 agnirha naḥ prathamajā ṛtasya pūrva āyuni vṛṣabhaśca dhenuḥ ||

10,006.01  ayaṃ sa yasya śarmannavobhiragneredhate jaritābhiṣṭau |
10,006.01 jyeṣṭhebhiryo bhānubhirṛṣūṇāṃ paryeti parivīto vibhāvā ||
10,006.02  yo bhānubhirvibhāvā vibhātyagnirdevebhirṛtāvājasraḥ |
10,006.02 ā yo vivāya sakhyā sakhibhyo'parihvṛto atyo na saptiḥ ||
10,006.03  īśe yo viśvasyā devavīterīśe viśvāyuruṣaso vyuṣṭau |
10,006.03 ā yasminmanā havīṃṣyagnāvariṣṭaratha skabhnāti śūṣaiḥ ||
10,006.04  śūṣebhirvṛdho juṣāṇo arkairdevāṃ acchā raghupatvā jigāti |
10,006.04 mandro hotā sa juhvā yajiṣṭhaḥ sammiślo agnirā jigharti devān ||
10,006.05  tamusrāmindraṃ na rejamānamagniṃ gīrbhirnamobhirā kṛṇudhvam |
10,006.05 ā yaṃ viprāso matibhirgṛṇanti jātavedasaṃ juhvaṃ sahānām ||
10,006.06  saṃ yasminviśvā vasūni jagmurvāje nāśvāḥ saptīvanta evaiḥ |
10,006.06 asme ūtīrindravātatamā arvācīnā agna ā kṛṇuṣva ||
10,006.07  adhā hyagne mahnā niṣadyā sadyo jajñāno havyo babhūtha |
10,006.07 taṃ te devāso anu ketamāyannadhāvardhanta prathamāsa ūmāḥ ||

10,007.01  svasti no divo agne pṛthivyā viśvāyurdhehi yajathāya deva |
10,007.01 sacemahi tava dasma praketairuruṣyā ṇa urubhirdeva śaṃsaiḥ ||
10,007.02  imā agne matayastubhyaṃ jātā gobhiraśvairabhi gṛṇanti rādhaḥ |
10,007.02 yadā te marto anu bhogamānaḍvaso dadhāno matibhiḥ sujāta ||
10,007.03  agniṃ manye pitaramagnimāpimagniṃ bhrātaraṃ sadamitsakhāyam |
10,007.03 agneranīkaṃ bṛhataḥ saparyaṃ divi śukraṃ yajataṃ sūryasya ||
10,007.04  sidhrā agne dhiyo asme sanutrīryaṃ trāyase dama ā nityahotā |
10,007.04 ṛtāvā sa rohidaśvaḥ purukṣurdyubhirasmā ahabhirvāmamastu ||
10,007.05  dyubhirhitaṃ mitramiva prayogaṃ pratnamṛtvijamadhvarasya jāram |
10,007.05 bāhubhyāmagnimāyavo'jananta vikṣu hotāraṃ nyasādayanta ||
10,007.06  svayaṃ yajasva divi deva devānkiṃ te pākaḥ kṛṇavadapracetāḥ |
10,007.06 yathāyaja ṛtubhirdeva devānevā yajasva tanvaṃ sujāta ||
10,007.07  bhavā no agne'vitota gopā bhavā vayaskṛduta no vayodhāḥ |
10,007.07 rāsvā ca naḥ sumaho havyadātiṃ trāsvota nastanvo aprayucchan ||

10,008.01  pra ketunā bṛhatā yātyagnirā rodasī vṛṣabho roravīti |
10,008.01 divaścidantāṃ upamāṃ udānaḻ apāmupasthe mahiṣo vavardha ||
10,008.02  mumoda garbho vṛṣabhaḥ kakudmānasremā vatsaḥ śimīvāṃ arāvīt |
10,008.02 sa devatātyudyatāni kṛṇvansveṣu kṣayeṣu prathamo jigāti ||
10,008.03  ā yo mūrdhānaṃ pitrorarabdha nyadhvare dadhire sūro arṇaḥ |
10,008.03 asya patmannaruṣīraśvabudhnā ṛtasya yonau tanvo juṣanta ||
10,008.04  uṣauṣo hi vaso agrameṣi tvaṃ yamayorabhavo vibhāvā |
10,008.04 ṛtāya sapta dadhiṣe padāni janayanmitraṃ tanve svāyai ||
10,008.05  bhuvaścakṣurmaha ṛtasya gopā bhuvo varuṇo yadṛtāya veṣi |
10,008.05 bhuvo apāṃ napājjātavedo bhuvo dūto yasya havyaṃ jujoṣaḥ ||
10,008.06  bhuvo yajñasya rajasaśca netā yatrā niyudbhiḥ sacase śivābhiḥ |
10,008.06 divi mūrdhānaṃ dadhiṣe svarṣāṃ jihvāmagne cakṛṣe havyavāham ||
10,008.07  asya tritaḥ kratunā vavre antaricchandhītiṃ piturevaiḥ parasya |
10,008.07 sacasyamānaḥ pitrorupasthe jāmi bruvāṇa āyudhāni veti ||
10,008.08  sa pitryāṇyāyudhāni vidvānindreṣita āptyo abhyayudhyat |
10,008.08 triśīrṣāṇaṃ saptaraśmiṃ jaghanvāntvāṣṭrasya cinniḥ sasṛje trito gāḥ ||
10,008.09  bhūrīdindra udinakṣantamojo'vābhinatsatpatirmanyamānam |
10,008.09 tvāṣṭrasya cidviśvarūpasya gonāmācakrāṇastrīṇi śīrṣā parā vark ||

10,009.01  āpo hi ṣṭhā mayobhuvastā na ūrje dadhātana |
10,009.01 mahe raṇāya cakṣase ||
10,009.02  yo vaḥ śivatamo rasastasya bhājayateha naḥ |
10,009.02 uśatīriva mātaraḥ ||
10,009.03  tasmā araṃ gamāma vo yasya kṣayāya jinvatha |
10,009.03 āpo janayathā ca naḥ ||
10,009.04  śaṃ no devīrabhiṣṭaya āpo bhavantu pītaye |
10,009.04 śaṃ yorabhi sravantu naḥ ||
10,009.05  īśānā vāryāṇāṃ kṣayantīścarṣaṇīnām |
10,009.05 apo yācāmi bheṣajam ||
10,009.06  apsu me somo abravīdantarviśvāni bheṣajā |
10,009.06 agniṃ ca viśvaśambhuvam ||
10,009.07  āpaḥ pṛṇīta bheṣajaṃ varūthaṃ tanve mama |
10,009.07 jyokca sūryaṃ dṛśe ||
10,009.08  idamāpaḥ pra vahata yatkiṃ ca duritaṃ mayi |
10,009.08 yadvāhamabhidudroha yadvā śepa utānṛtam ||
10,009.09  āpo adyānvacāriṣaṃ rasena samagasmahi |
10,009.09 payasvānagna ā gahi taṃ mā saṃ sṛja varcasā ||

10,010.01  o citsakhāyaṃ sakhyā vavṛtyāṃ tiraḥ purū cidarṇavaṃ jaganvān |
10,010.01 piturnapātamā dadhīta vedhā adhi kṣami prataraṃ dīdhyānaḥ ||
10,010.02  na te sakhā sakhyaṃ vaṣṭyetatsalakṣmā yadviṣurūpā bhavāti |
10,010.02 mahasputrāso asurasya vīrā divo dhartāra urviyā pari khyan ||
10,010.03  uśanti ghā te amṛtāsa etadekasya cittyajasaṃ martyasya |
10,010.03 ni te mano manasi dhāyyasme janyuḥ patistanvamā viviśyāḥ ||
10,010.04  na yatpurā cakṛmā kaddha nūnamṛtā vadanto anṛtaṃ rapema |
10,010.04 gandharvo apsvapyā ca yoṣā sā no nābhiḥ paramaṃ jāmi tannau ||
10,010.05  garbhe nu nau janitā dampatī kardevastvaṣṭā savitā viśvarūpaḥ |
10,010.05 nakirasya pra minanti vratāni veda nāvasya pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||
10,010.06  ko asya veda prathamasyāhnaḥ ka īṃ dadarśa ka iha pra vocat |
10,010.06 bṛhanmitrasya varuṇasya dhāma kadu brava āhano vīcyā nṝn ||
10,010.07  yamasya mā yamyaṃ kāma āgansamāne yonau sahaśeyyāya |
10,010.07 jāyeva patye tanvaṃ riricyāṃ vi cidvṛheva rathyeva cakrā ||
10,010.08  na tiṣṭhanti na ni miṣantyete devānāṃ spaśa iha ye caranti |
10,010.08 anyena madāhano yāhi tūyaṃ tena vi vṛha rathyeva cakrā ||
10,010.09  rātrībhirasmā ahabhirdaśasyetsūryasya cakṣurmuhurunmimīyāt |
10,010.09 divā pṛthivyā mithunā sabandhū yamīryamasya bibhṛyādajāmi ||
10,010.10  ā ghā tā gacchānuttarā yugāni yatra jāmayaḥ kṛṇavannajāmi |
10,010.10 upa barbṛhi vṛṣabhāya bāhumanyamicchasva subhage patiṃ mat ||
10,010.11  kiṃ bhrātāsadyadanāthaṃ bhavāti kimu svasā yannirṛtirnigacchāt |
10,010.11 kāmamūtā bahvetadrapāmi tanvā me tanvaṃ saṃ pipṛgdhi ||
10,010.12  na vā u te tanvā tanvaṃ saṃ papṛcyāṃ pāpamāhuryaḥ svasāraṃ nigacchāt |
10,010.12 anyena matpramudaḥ kalpayasva na te bhrātā subhage vaṣṭyetat ||
10,010.13  bato batāsi yama naiva te mano hṛdayaṃ cāvidāma |
10,010.13 anyā kila tvāṃ kakṣyeva yuktaṃ pari ṣvajāte libujeva vṛkṣam ||
10,010.14  anyamū ṣu tvaṃ yamyanya u tvāṃ pari ṣvajāte libujeva vṛkṣam |
10,010.14 tasya vā tvaṃ mana icchā sa vā tavādhā kṛṇuṣva saṃvidaṃ subhadrām ||

10,011.01  vṛṣā vṛṣṇe duduhe dohasā divaḥ payāṃsi yahvo aditeradābhyaḥ |
10,011.01 viśvaṃ sa veda varuṇo yathā dhiyā sa yajñiyo yajatu yajñiyāṃ ṛtūn ||
10,011.02  rapadgandharvīrapyā ca yoṣaṇā nadasya nāde pari pātu me manaḥ |
10,011.02 iṣṭasya madhye aditirni dhātu no bhrātā no jyeṣṭhaḥ prathamo vi vocati ||
10,011.03  so cinnu bhadrā kṣumatī yaśasvatyuṣā uvāsa manave svarvatī |
10,011.03 yadīmuśantamuśatāmanu kratumagniṃ hotāraṃ vidathāya jījanan ||
10,011.04  adha tyaṃ drapsaṃ vibhvaṃ vicakṣaṇaṃ virābharadiṣitaḥ śyeno adhvare |
10,011.04 yadī viśo vṛṇate dasmamāryā agniṃ hotāramadha dhīrajāyata ||
10,011.05  sadāsi raṇvo yavaseva puṣyate hotrābhiragne manuṣaḥ svadhvaraḥ |
10,011.05 viprasya vā yacchaśamāna ukthyaṃ vājaṃ sasavāṃ upayāsi bhūribhiḥ ||
10,011.06  udīraya pitarā jāra ā bhagamiyakṣati haryato hṛtta iṣyati |
10,011.06 vivakti vahniḥ svapasyate makhastaviṣyate asuro vepate matī ||
10,011.07  yaste agne sumatiṃ marto akṣatsahasaḥ sūno ati sa pra śṛṇve |
10,011.07 iṣaṃ dadhāno vahamāno aśvairā sa dyumāṃ amavānbhūṣati dyūn ||
10,011.08  yadagna eṣā samitirbhavāti devī deveṣu yajatā yajatra |
10,011.08 ratnā ca yadvibhajāsi svadhāvo bhāgaṃ no atra vasumantaṃ vītāt ||
10,011.09  śrudhī no agne sadane sadhasthe yukṣvā rathamamṛtasya dravitnum |
10,011.09 ā no vaha rodasī devaputre mākirdevānāmapa bhūriha syāḥ ||

10,012.01  dyāvā ha kṣāmā prathame ṛtenābhiśrāve bhavataḥ satyavācā |
10,012.01 devo yanmartānyajathāya kṛṇvansīdaddhotā pratyaṅsvamasuṃ yan ||
10,012.02  devo devānparibhūrṛtena vahā no havyaṃ prathamaścikitvān |
10,012.02 dhūmaketuḥ samidhā bhāṛjīko mandro hotā nityo vācā yajīyān ||
10,012.03  svāvṛgdevasyāmṛtaṃ yadī gorato jātāso dhārayanta urvī |
10,012.03 viśve devā anu tatte yajurgurduhe yadenī divyaṃ ghṛtaṃ vāḥ ||
10,012.04  arcāmi vāṃ vardhāyāpo ghṛtasnū dyāvābhūmī śṛṇutaṃ rodasī me |
10,012.04 ahā yaddyāvo'sunītimayanmadhvā no atra pitarā śiśītām ||
10,012.05  kiṃ svinno rājā jagṛhe kadasyāti vrataṃ cakṛmā ko vi veda |
10,012.05 mitraściddhi ṣmā juhurāṇo devāñchloko na yātāmapi vājo asti ||
10,012.06  durmantvatrāmṛtasya nāma salakṣmā yadviṣurūpā bhavāti |
10,012.06 yamasya yo manavate sumantvagne tamṛṣva pāhyaprayucchan ||
10,012.07  yasmindevā vidathe mādayante vivasvataḥ sadane dhārayante |
10,012.07 sūrye jyotiradadhurmāsyaktūnpari dyotaniṃ carato ajasrā ||
10,012.08  yasmindevā manmani saṃcarantyapīcye na vayamasya vidma |
10,012.08 mitro no atrāditiranāgānsavitā devo varuṇāya vocat ||
10,012.09  śrudhī no agne sadane sadhasthe yukṣvā rathamamṛtasya dravitnum |
10,012.09 ā no vaha rodasī devaputre mākirdevānāmapa bhūriha syāḥ ||

10,013.01  yuje vāṃ brahma pūrvyaṃ namobhirvi śloka etu pathyeva sūreḥ |
10,013.01 śṛṇvantu viśve amṛtasya putrā ā ye dhāmāni divyāni tasthuḥ ||
10,013.02  yame iva yatamāne yadaitaṃ pra vāṃ bharanmānuṣā devayantaḥ |
10,013.02 ā sīdataṃ svamu lokaṃ vidāne svāsasthe bhavatamindave naḥ ||
10,013.03  pañca padāni rupo anvarohaṃ catuṣpadīmanvemi vratena |
10,013.03 akṣareṇa prati mima etāmṛtasya nābhāvadhi saṃ punāmi ||
10,013.04  devebhyaḥ kamavṛṇīta mṛtyuṃ prajāyai kamamṛtaṃ nāvṛṇīta |
10,013.04 bṛhaspatiṃ yajñamakṛṇvata ṛṣiṃ priyāṃ yamastanvaṃ prārirecīt ||
10,013.05  sapta kṣaranti śiśave marutvate pitre putrāso apyavīvatannṛtam |
10,013.05 ubhe idasyobhayasya rājata ubhe yatete ubhayasya puṣyataḥ ||

10,014.01  pareyivāṃsaṃ pravato mahīranu bahubhyaḥ panthāmanupaspaśānam |
10,014.01 vaivasvataṃ saṃgamanaṃ janānāṃ yamaṃ rājānaṃ haviṣā duvasya ||
10,014.02  yamo no gātuṃ prathamo viveda naiṣā gavyūtirapabhartavā u |
10,014.02 yatrā naḥ pūrve pitaraḥ pareyurenā jajñānāḥ pathyā anu svāḥ ||
10,014.03  mātalī kavyairyamo aṅgirobhirbṛhaspatirṛkvabhirvāvṛdhānaḥ |
10,014.03 yāṃśca devā vāvṛdhurye ca devānsvāhānye svadhayānye madanti ||
10,014.04  imaṃ yama prastaramā hi sīdāṅgirobhiḥ pitṛbhiḥ saṃvidānaḥ |
10,014.04 ā tvā mantrāḥ kaviśastā vahantvenā rājanhaviṣā mādayasva ||
10,014.05  aṅgirobhirā gahi yajñiyebhiryama vairūpairiha mādayasva |
10,014.05 vivasvantaṃ huve yaḥ pitā te'sminyajñe barhiṣyā niṣadya ||
10,014.06  aṅgiraso naḥ pitaro navagvā atharvāṇo bhṛgavaḥ somyāsaḥ |
10,014.06 teṣāṃ vayaṃ sumatau yajñiyānāmapi bhadre saumanase syāma ||
10,014.07  prehi prehi pathibhiḥ pūrvyebhiryatrā naḥ pūrve pitaraḥ pareyuḥ |
10,014.07 ubhā rājānā svadhayā madantā yamaṃ paśyāsi varuṇaṃ ca devam ||
10,014.08  saṃ gacchasva pitṛbhiḥ saṃ yameneṣṭāpūrtena parame vyoman |
10,014.08 hitvāyāvadyaṃ punarastamehi saṃ gacchasva tanvā suvarcāḥ ||
10,014.09  apeta vīta vi ca sarpatāto'smā etaṃ pitaro lokamakran |
10,014.09 ahobhiradbhiraktubhirvyaktaṃ yamo dadātyavasānamasmai ||
10,014.10  ati drava sārameyau śvānau caturakṣau śabalau sādhunā pathā |
10,014.10 athā pitṝnsuvidatrāṃ upehi yamena ye sadhamādaṃ madanti ||
10,014.11  yau te śvānau yama rakṣitārau caturakṣau pathirakṣī nṛcakṣasau |
10,014.11 tābhyāmenaṃ pari dehi rājansvasti cāsmā anamīvaṃ ca dhehi ||
10,014.12  urūṇasāvasutṛpā udumbalau yamasya dūtau carato janāṃ anu |
10,014.12 tāvasmabhyaṃ dṛśaye sūryāya punardātāmasumadyeha bhadram ||
10,014.13  yamāya somaṃ sunuta yamāya juhutā haviḥ |
10,014.13 yamaṃ ha yajño gacchatyagnidūto araṅkṛtaḥ ||
10,014.14  yamāya ghṛtavaddhavirjuhota pra ca tiṣṭhata |
10,014.14 sa no deveṣvā yamaddīrghamāyuḥ pra jīvase ||
10,014.15  yamāya madhumattamaṃ rājñe havyaṃ juhotana |
10,014.15 idaṃ nama ṛṣibhyaḥ pūrvajebhyaḥ pūrvebhyaḥ pathikṛdbhyaḥ ||
10,014.16  trikadrukebhiḥ patati ṣaḻ urvīrekamidbṛhat |
10,014.16 triṣṭubgāyatrī chandāṃsi sarvā tā yama āhitā ||

10,015.01  udīratāmavara utparāsa unmadhyamāḥ pitaraḥ somyāsaḥ |
10,015.01 asuṃ ya īyuravṛkā ṛtajñāste no'vantu pitaro haveṣu ||
10,015.02  idaṃ pitṛbhyo namo astvadya ye pūrvāso ya uparāsa īyuḥ |
10,015.02 ye pārthive rajasyā niṣattā ye vā nūnaṃ suvṛjanāsu vikṣu ||
10,015.03  āhaṃ pitṝnsuvidatrāṃ avitsi napātaṃ ca vikramaṇaṃ ca viṣṇoḥ |
10,015.03 barhiṣado ye svadhayā sutasya bhajanta pitvasta ihāgamiṣṭhāḥ ||
10,015.04  barhiṣadaḥ pitara ūtyarvāgimā vo havyā cakṛmā juṣadhvam |
10,015.04 ta ā gatāvasā śantamenāthā naḥ śaṃ yorarapo dadhāta ||
10,015.05  upahūtāḥ pitaraḥ somyāso barhiṣyeṣu nidhiṣu priyeṣu |
10,015.05 ta ā gamantu ta iha śruvantvadhi bruvantu te'vantvasmān ||
10,015.06  ācyā jānu dakṣiṇato niṣadyemaṃ yajñamabhi gṛṇīta viśve |
10,015.06 mā hiṃsiṣṭa pitaraḥ kena cinno yadva āgaḥ puruṣatā karāma ||
10,015.07  āsīnāso aruṇīnāmupasthe rayiṃ dhatta dāśuṣe martyāya |
10,015.07 putrebhyaḥ pitarastasya vasvaḥ pra yacchata ta ihorjaṃ dadhāta ||
10,015.08  ye naḥ pūrve pitaraḥ somyāso'nūhire somapīthaṃ vasiṣṭhāḥ |
10,015.08 tebhiryamaḥ saṃrarāṇo havīṃṣyuśannuśadbhiḥ pratikāmamattu ||
10,015.09  ye tātṛṣurdevatrā jehamānā hotrāvida stomataṣṭāso arkaiḥ |
10,015.09 āgne yāhi suvidatrebhirarvāṅsatyaiḥ kavyaiḥ pitṛbhirgharmasadbhiḥ ||
10,015.10  ye satyāso havirado haviṣpā indreṇa devaiḥ sarathaṃ dadhānāḥ |
10,015.10 āgne yāhi sahasraṃ devavandaiḥ paraiḥ pūrvaiḥ pitṛbhirgharmasadbhiḥ ||
10,015.11  agniṣvāttāḥ pitara eha gacchata sadaḥsadaḥ sadata supraṇītayaḥ |
10,015.11 attā havīṃṣi prayatāni barhiṣyathā rayiṃ sarvavīraṃ dadhātana ||
10,015.12  tvamagna īḻito jātavedo'vāḍḍhavyāni surabhīṇi kṛtvī |
10,015.12 prādāḥ pitṛbhyaḥ svadhayā te akṣannaddhi tvaṃ deva prayatā havīṃṣi ||
10,015.13  ye ceha pitaro ye ca neha yāṃśca vidma yāṃ u ca na pravidma |
10,015.13 tvaṃ vettha yati te jātavedaḥ svadhābhiryajñaṃ sukṛtaṃ juṣasva ||
10,015.14  ye agnidagdhā ye anagnidagdhā madhye divaḥ svadhayā mādayante |
10,015.14 tebhiḥ svarāḻ asunītimetāṃ yathāvaśaṃ tanvaṃ kalpayasva ||

10,016.01  mainamagne vi daho mābhi śoco māsya tvacaṃ cikṣipo mā śarīram |
10,016.01 yadā śṛtaṃ kṛṇavo jātavedo'themenaṃ pra hiṇutātpitṛbhyaḥ ||
10,016.02  śṛtaṃ yadā karasi jātavedo'themenaṃ pari dattātpitṛbhyaḥ |
10,016.02 yadā gacchātyasunītimetāmathā devānāṃ vaśanīrbhavāti ||
10,016.03  sūryaṃ cakṣurgacchatu vātamātmā dyāṃ ca gaccha pṛthivīṃ ca dharmaṇā |
10,016.03 apo vā gaccha yadi tatra te hitamoṣadhīṣu prati tiṣṭhā śarīraiḥ ||
10,016.04  ajo bhāgastapasā taṃ tapasva taṃ te śocistapatu taṃ te arciḥ |
10,016.04 yāste śivāstanvo jātavedastābhirvahainaṃ sukṛtāmu lokam ||
10,016.05  ava sṛja punaragne pitṛbhyo yasta āhutaścarati svadhābhiḥ |
10,016.05 āyurvasāna upa vetu śeṣaḥ saṃ gacchatāṃ tanvā jātavedaḥ ||
10,016.06  yatte kṛṣṇaḥ śakuna ātutoda pipīlaḥ sarpa uta vā śvāpadaḥ |
10,016.06 agniṣṭadviśvādagadaṃ kṛṇotu somaśca yo brāhmaṇāṃ āviveśa ||
10,016.07  agnervarma pari gobhirvyayasva saṃ prorṇuṣva pīvasā medasā ca |
10,016.07 nettvā dhṛṣṇurharasā jarhṛṣāṇo dadhṛgvidhakṣyanparyaṅkhayāte ||
10,016.08  imamagne camasaṃ mā vi jihvaraḥ priyo devānāmuta somyānām |
10,016.08 eṣa yaścamaso devapānastasmindevā amṛtā mādayante ||
10,016.09  kravyādamagniṃ pra hiṇomi dūraṃ yamarājño gacchatu ripravāhaḥ |
10,016.09 ihaivāyamitaro jātavedā devebhyo havyaṃ vahatu prajānan ||
10,016.10  yo agniḥ kravyātpraviveśa vo gṛhamimaṃ paśyannitaraṃ jātavedasam |
10,016.10 taṃ harāmi pitṛyajñāya devaṃ sa gharmaminvātparame sadhasthe ||
10,016.11  yo agniḥ kravyavāhanaḥ pitṝnyakṣadṛtāvṛdhaḥ |
10,016.11 predu havyāni vocati devebhyaśca pitṛbhya ā ||
10,016.12  uśantastvā ni dhīmahyuśantaḥ samidhīmahi |
10,016.12 uśannuśata ā vaha pitṝnhaviṣe attave ||
10,016.13  yaṃ tvamagne samadahastamu nirvāpayā punaḥ |
10,016.13 kiyāmbvatra rohatu pākadūrvā vyalkaśā ||
10,016.14  śītike śītikāvati hlādike hlādikāvati |
10,016.14 maṇḍūkyā su saṃ gama imaṃ svagniṃ harṣaya ||

10,017.01  tvaṣṭā duhitre vahatuṃ kṛṇotītīdaṃ viśvaṃ bhuvanaṃ sameti |
10,017.01 yamasya mātā paryuhyamānā maho jāyā vivasvato nanāśa ||
10,017.02  apāgūhannamṛtāṃ martyebhyaḥ kṛtvī savarṇāmadadurvivasvate |
10,017.02 utāśvināvabharadyattadāsīdajahādu dvā mithunā saraṇyūḥ ||
10,017.03  pūṣā tvetaścyāvayatu pra vidvānanaṣṭapaśurbhuvanasya gopāḥ |
10,017.03 sa tvaitebhyaḥ pari dadatpitṛbhyo'gnirdevebhyaḥ suvidatriyebhyaḥ ||
10,017.04  āyurviśvāyuḥ pari pāsati tvā pūṣā tvā pātu prapathe purastāt |
10,017.04 yatrāsate sukṛto yatra te yayustatra tvā devaḥ savitā dadhātu ||
10,017.05  pūṣemā āśā anu veda sarvāḥ so asmāṃ abhayatamena neṣat |
10,017.05 svastidā āghṛṇiḥ sarvavīro'prayucchanpura etu prajānan ||
10,017.06  prapathe pathāmajaniṣṭa pūṣā prapathe divaḥ prapathe pṛthivyāḥ |
10,017.06 ubhe abhi priyatame sadhasthe ā ca parā ca carati prajānan ||
10,017.07  sarasvatīṃ devayanto havante sarasvatīmadhvare tāyamāne |
10,017.07 sarasvatīṃ sukṛto ahvayanta sarasvatī dāśuṣe vāryaṃ dāt ||
10,017.08  sarasvati yā sarathaṃ yayātha svadhābhirdevi pitṛbhirmadantī |
10,017.08 āsadyāsminbarhiṣi mādayasvānamīvā iṣa ā dhehyasme ||
10,017.09  sarasvatīṃ yāṃ pitaro havante dakṣiṇā yajñamabhinakṣamāṇāḥ |
10,017.09 sahasrārghamiḻo atra bhāgaṃ rāyaspoṣaṃ yajamāneṣu dhehi ||
10,017.10  āpo asmānmātaraḥ śundhayantu ghṛtena no ghṛtapvaḥ punantu |
10,017.10 viśvaṃ hi ripraṃ pravahanti devīrudidābhyaḥ śucirā pūta emi ||
10,017.11  drapsaścaskanda prathamāṃ anu dyūnimaṃ ca yonimanu yaśca pūrvaḥ |
10,017.11 samānaṃ yonimanu saṃcarantaṃ drapsaṃ juhomyanu sapta hotrāḥ ||
10,017.12  yaste drapsa skandati yaste aṃśurbāhucyuto dhiṣaṇāyā upasthāt |
10,017.12 adhvaryorvā pari vā yaḥ pavitrāttaṃ te juhomi manasā vaṣaṭkṛtam ||
10,017.13  yaste drapsa skanno yaste aṃśuravaśca yaḥ paraḥ srucā |
10,017.13 ayaṃ devo bṛhaspatiḥ saṃ taṃ siñcatu rādhase ||
10,017.14  payasvatīroṣadhayaḥ payasvanmāmakaṃ vacaḥ |
10,017.14 apāṃ payasvaditpayastena mā saha śundhata ||

10,018.01  paraṃ mṛtyo anu parehi panthāṃ yaste sva itaro devayānāt |
10,018.01 cakṣuṣmate śṛṇvate te bravīmi mā naḥ prajāṃ rīriṣo mota vīrān ||
10,018.02  mṛtyoḥ padaṃ yopayanto yadaita drāghīya āyuḥ prataraṃ dadhānāḥ |
10,018.02 āpyāyamānāḥ prajayā dhanena śuddhāḥ pūtā bhavata yajñiyāsaḥ ||
10,018.03  ime jīvā vi mṛtairāvavṛtrannabhūdbhadrā devahūtirno adya |
10,018.03 prāñco agāma nṛtaye hasāya drāghīya āyuḥ prataraṃ dadhānāḥ ||
10,018.04  imaṃ jīvebhyaḥ paridhiṃ dadhāmi maiṣāṃ nu gādaparo arthametam |
10,018.04 śataṃ jīvantu śaradaḥ purūcīrantarmṛtyuṃ dadhatāṃ parvatena ||
10,018.05  yathāhānyanupūrvaṃ bhavanti yatha ṛtava ṛtubhiryanti sādhu |
10,018.05 yathā na pūrvamaparo jahātyevā dhātarāyūṃṣi kalpayaiṣām ||
10,018.06  ā rohatāyurjarasaṃ vṛṇānā anupūrvaṃ yatamānā yati ṣṭha |
10,018.06 iha tvaṣṭā sujanimā sajoṣā dīrghamāyuḥ karati jīvase vaḥ ||
10,018.07  imā nārīravidhavāḥ supatnīrāñjanena sarpiṣā saṃ viśantu |
10,018.07 anaśravo'namīvāḥ suratnā ā rohantu janayo yonimagre ||
10,018.08  udīrṣva nāryabhi jīvalokaṃ gatāsumetamupa śeṣa ehi |
10,018.08 hastagrābhasya didhiṣostavedaṃ patyurjanitvamabhi saṃ babhūtha ||
10,018.09  dhanurhastādādadāno mṛtasyāsme kṣatrāya varcase balāya |
10,018.09 atraiva tvamiha vayaṃ suvīrā viśvā spṛdho abhimātīrjayema ||
10,018.10  upa sarpa mātaraṃ bhūmimetāmuruvyacasaṃ pṛthivīṃ suśevām |
10,018.10 ūrṇamradā yuvatirdakṣiṇāvata eṣā tvā pātu nirṛterupasthāt ||
10,018.11  ucchvañcasva pṛthivi mā ni bādhathāḥ sūpāyanāsmai bhava sūpavañcanā |
10,018.11 mātā putraṃ yathā sicābhyenaṃ bhūma ūrṇuhi ||
10,018.12  ucchvañcamānā pṛthivī su tiṣṭhatu sahasraṃ mita upa hi śrayantām |
10,018.12 te gṛhāso ghṛtaścuto bhavantu viśvāhāsmai śaraṇāḥ santvatra ||
10,018.13  utte stabhnāmi pṛthivīṃ tvatparīmaṃ logaṃ nidadhanmo ahaṃ riṣam |
10,018.13 etāṃ sthūṇāṃ pitaro dhārayantu te'trā yamaḥ sādanā te minotu ||
10,018.14  pratīcīne māmahanīṣvāḥ parṇamivā dadhuḥ |
10,018.14 pratīcīṃ jagrabhā vācamaśvaṃ raśanayā yathā ||

10,019.01  ni vartadhvaṃ mānu gātāsmānsiṣakta revatīḥ |
10,019.01 agnīṣomā punarvasū asme dhārayataṃ rayim ||
10,019.02  punarenā ni vartaya punarenā nyā kuru |
10,019.02 indra eṇā ni yacchatvagnirenā upājatu ||
10,019.03  punaretā ni vartantāmasminpuṣyantu gopatau |
10,019.03 ihaivāgne ni dhārayeha tiṣṭhatu yā rayiḥ ||
10,019.04  yanniyānaṃ nyayanaṃ saṃjñānaṃ yatparāyaṇam |
10,019.04 āvartanaṃ nivartanaṃ yo gopā api taṃ huve ||
10,019.05  ya udānaḍvyayanaṃ ya udānaṭparāyaṇam |
10,019.05 āvartanaṃ nivartanamapi gopā ni vartatām ||
10,019.06  ā nivarta ni vartaya punarna indra gā dehi |
10,019.06 jīvābhirbhunajāmahai ||
10,019.07  pari vo viśvato dadha ūrjā ghṛtena payasā |
10,019.07 ye devāḥ ke ca yajñiyāste rayyā saṃ sṛjantu naḥ ||
10,019.08  ā nivartana vartaya ni nivartana vartaya |
10,019.08 bhūmyāścatasraḥ pradiśastābhya enā ni vartaya ||

10,020.01  bhadraṃ no api vātaya manaḥ ||
10,020.02  agnimīḻe bhujāṃ yaviṣṭhaṃ śāsā mitraṃ durdharītum |
10,020.02 yasya dharmansvarenīḥ saparyanti māturūdhaḥ ||
10,020.03  yamāsā kṛpanīḻaṃ bhāsāketuṃ vardhayanti |
10,020.03 bhrājate śreṇidan ||
10,020.04  aryo viśāṃ gātureti pra yadānaḍdivo antān |
10,020.04 kavirabhraṃ dīdyānaḥ ||
10,020.05  juṣaddhavyā mānuṣasyordhvastasthāvṛbhvā yajñe |
10,020.05 minvansadma pura eti ||
10,020.06  sa hi kṣemo haviryajñaḥ śruṣṭīdasya gātureti |
10,020.06 agniṃ devā vāśīmantam ||
10,020.07  yajñāsāhaṃ duva iṣe'gniṃ pūrvasya śevasya |
10,020.07 adreḥ sūnumāyumāhuḥ ||
10,020.08  naro ye ke cāsmadā viśvette vāma ā syuḥ |
10,020.08 agniṃ haviṣā vardhantaḥ ||
10,020.09  kṛṣṇaḥ śveto'ruṣo yāmo asya bradhna ṛjra uta śoṇo yaśasvān |
10,020.09 hiraṇyarūpaṃ janitā jajāna ||
10,020.10  evā te agne vimado manīṣāmūrjo napādamṛtebhiḥ sajoṣāḥ |
10,020.10 gira ā vakṣatsumatīriyāna iṣamūrjaṃ sukṣitiṃ viśvamābhāḥ ||

10,021.01  āgniṃ na svavṛktibhirhotāraṃ tvā vṛṇīmahe |
10,021.01 yajñāya stīrṇabarhiṣe vi vo made śīraṃ pāvakaśociṣaṃ vivakṣase ||
10,021.02  tvāmu te svābhuvaḥ śumbhantyaśvarādhasaḥ |
10,021.02 veti tvāmupasecanī vi vo mada ṛjītiragna āhutirvivakṣase ||
10,021.03  tve dharmāṇa āsate juhūbhiḥ siñcatīriva |
10,021.03 kṛṣṇā rūpāṇyarjunā vi vo made viśvā adhi śriyo dhiṣe vivakṣase ||
10,021.04  yamagne manyase rayiṃ sahasāvannamartya |
10,021.04 tamā no vājasātaye vi vo made yajñeṣu citramā bharā vivakṣase ||
10,021.05  agnirjāto atharvaṇā vidadviśvāni kāvyā |
10,021.05 bhuvaddūto vivasvato vi vo made priyo yamasya kāmyo vivakṣase ||
10,021.06  tvāṃ yajñeṣvīḻate'gne prayatyadhvare |
10,021.06 tvaṃ vasūni kāmyā vi vo made viśvā dadhāsi dāśuṣe vivakṣase ||
10,021.07  tvāṃ yajñeṣvṛtvijaṃ cārumagne ni ṣedire |
10,021.07 ghṛtapratīkaṃ manuṣo vi vo made śukraṃ cetiṣṭhamakṣabhirvivakṣase ||
10,021.08  agne śukreṇa śociṣoru prathayase bṛhat |
10,021.08 abhikrandanvṛṣāyase vi vo made garbhaṃ dadhāsi jāmiṣu vivakṣase ||

10,022.01  kuha śruta indraḥ kasminnadya jane mitro na śrūyate |
10,022.01 ṛṣīṇāṃ vā yaḥ kṣaye guhā vā carkṛṣe girā ||
10,022.02  iha śruta indro asme adya stave vajryṛcīṣamaḥ |
10,022.02 mitro na yo janeṣvā yaśaścakre asāmyā ||
10,022.03  maho yaspatiḥ śavaso asāmyā maho nṛmṇasya tūtujiḥ |
10,022.03 bhartā vajrasya dhṛṣṇoḥ pitā putramiva priyam ||
10,022.04  yujāno aśvā vātasya dhunī devo devasya vajrivaḥ |
10,022.04 syantā pathā virukmatā sṛjāna stoṣyadhvanaḥ ||
10,022.05  tvaṃ tyā cidvātasyāśvāgā ṛjrā tmanā vahadhyai |
10,022.05 yayordevo na martyo yantā nakirvidāyyaḥ ||
10,022.06  adha gmantośanā pṛcchate vāṃ kadarthā na ā gṛham |
10,022.06 ā jagmathuḥ parākāddivaśca gmaśca martyam ||
10,022.07  ā na indra pṛkṣase'smākaṃ brahmodyatam |
10,022.07 tattvā yācāmahe'vaḥ śuṣṇaṃ yaddhannamānuṣam ||
10,022.08  akarmā dasyurabhi no amanturanyavrato amānuṣaḥ |
10,022.08 tvaṃ tasyāmitrahanvadhardāsasya dambhaya ||
10,022.09  tvaṃ na indra śūra śūrairuta tvotāso barhaṇā |
10,022.09 purutrā te vi pūrtayo navanta kṣoṇayo yathā ||
10,022.10  tvaṃ tānvṛtrahatye codayo nṝnkārpāṇe śūra vajrivaḥ |
10,022.10 guhā yadī kavīnāṃ viśāṃ nakṣatraśavasām ||
10,022.11  makṣū tā ta indra dānāpnasa ākṣāṇe śūra vajrivaḥ |
10,022.11 yaddha śuṣṇasya dambhayo jātaṃ viśvaṃ sayāvabhiḥ ||
10,022.12  mākudhryagindra śūra vasvīrasme bhūvannabhiṣṭayaḥ |
10,022.12 vayaṃvayaṃ ta āsāṃ sumne syāma vajrivaḥ ||
10,022.13  asme tā ta indra santu satyāhiṃsantīrupaspṛśaḥ |
10,022.13 vidyāma yāsāṃ bhujo dhenūnāṃ na vajrivaḥ ||
10,022.14  ahastā yadapadī vardhata kṣāḥ śacībhirvedyānām |
10,022.14 śuṣṇaṃ pari pradakṣiṇidviśvāyave ni śiśnathaḥ ||
10,022.15  pibāpibedindra śūra somaṃ mā riṣaṇyo vasavāna vasuḥ san |
10,022.15 uta trāyasva gṛṇato maghono mahaśca rāyo revataskṛdhī naḥ ||

10,023.01  yajāmaha indraṃ vajradakṣiṇaṃ harīṇāṃ rathyaṃ vivratānām |
10,023.01 pra śmaśru dodhuvadūrdhvathā bhūdvi senābhirdayamāno vi rādhasā ||
10,023.02  harī nvasya yā vane vide vasvindro maghairmaghavā vṛtrahā bhuvat |
10,023.02 ṛbhurvāja ṛbhukṣāḥ patyate śavo'va kṣṇaumi dāsasya nāma cit ||
10,023.03  yadā vajraṃ hiraṇyamidathā rathaṃ harī yamasya vahato vi sūribhiḥ |
10,023.03 ā tiṣṭhati maghavā sanaśruta indro vājasya dīrghaśravasaspatiḥ ||
10,023.04  so cinnu vṛṣṭiryūthyā svā sacāṃ indraḥ śmaśrūṇi haritābhi pruṣṇute |
10,023.04 ava veti sukṣayaṃ sute madhūdiddhūnoti vāto yathā vanam ||
10,023.05  yo vācā vivāco mṛdhravācaḥ purū sahasrāśivā jaghāna |
10,023.05 tattadidasya pauṃsyaṃ gṛṇīmasi piteva yastaviṣīṃ vāvṛdhe śavaḥ ||
10,023.06  stomaṃ ta indra vimadā ajījanannapūrvyaṃ purutamaṃ sudānave |
10,023.06 vidmā hyasya bhojanaminasya yadā paśuṃ na gopāḥ karāmahe ||
10,023.07  mākirna enā sakhyā vi yauṣustava cendra vimadasya ca ṛṣeḥ |
10,023.07 vidmā hi te pramatiṃ deva jāmivadasme te santu sakhyā śivāni ||

10,024.01  indra somamimaṃ piba madhumantaṃ camū sutam |
10,024.01 asme rayiṃ ni dhāraya vi vo made sahasriṇaṃ purūvaso vivakṣase ||
10,024.02  tvāṃ yajñebhirukthairupa havyebhirīmahe |
10,024.02 śacīpate śacīnāṃ vi vo made śreṣṭhaṃ no dhehi vāryaṃ vivakṣase ||
10,024.03  yaspatirvāryāṇāmasi radhrasya coditā |
10,024.03 indra stotṝṇāmavitā vi vo made dviṣo naḥ pāhyaṃhaso vivakṣase ||
10,024.04  yuvaṃ śakrā māyāvinā samīcī niramanthatam |
10,024.04 vimadena yadīḻitā nāsatyā niramanthatam ||
10,024.05  viśve devā akṛpanta samīcyorniṣpatantyoḥ |
10,024.05 nāsatyāvabruvandevāḥ punarā vahatāditi ||
10,024.06  madhumanme parāyaṇaṃ madhumatpunarāyanam |
10,024.06 tā no devā devatayā yuvaṃ madhumataskṛtam ||

10,025.01  bhadraṃ no api vātaya mano dakṣamuta kratum |
10,025.01 adhā te sakhye andhaso vi vo made raṇangāvo na yavase vivakṣase ||
10,025.02  hṛdispṛśasta āsate viśveṣu soma dhāmasu |
10,025.02 adhā kāmā ime mama vi vo made vi tiṣṭhante vasūyavo vivakṣase ||
10,025.03  uta vratāni soma te prāhaṃ mināmi pākyā |
10,025.03 adhā piteva sūnave vi vo made mṛḻā no abhi cidvadhādvivakṣase ||
10,025.04  samu pra yanti dhītayaḥ sargāso'vatāṃ iva |
10,025.04 kratuṃ naḥ soma jīvase vi vo made dhārayā camasāṃ iva vivakṣase ||
10,025.05  tava tye soma śaktibhirnikāmāso vyṛṇvire |
10,025.05 gṛtsasya dhīrāstavaso vi vo made vrajaṃ gomantamaśvinaṃ vivakṣase ||
10,025.06  paśuṃ naḥ soma rakṣasi purutrā viṣṭhitaṃ jagat |
10,025.06 samākṛṇoṣi jīvase vi vo made viśvā sampaśyanbhuvanā vivakṣase ||
10,025.07  tvaṃ naḥ soma viśvato gopā adābhyo bhava |
10,025.07 sedha rājannapa sridho vi vo made mā no duḥśaṃsa īśatā vivakṣase ||
10,025.08  tvaṃ naḥ soma sukraturvayodheyāya jāgṛhi |
10,025.08 kṣetravittaro manuṣo vi vo made druho naḥ pāhyaṃhaso vivakṣase ||
10,025.09  tvaṃ no vṛtrahantamendrasyendo śivaḥ sakhā |
10,025.09 yatsīṃ havante samithe vi vo made yudhyamānāstokasātau vivakṣase ||
10,025.10  ayaṃ gha sa turo mada indrasya vardhata priyaḥ |
10,025.10 ayaṃ kakṣīvato maho vi vo made matiṃ viprasya vardhayadvivakṣase ||
10,025.11  ayaṃ viprāya dāśuṣe vājāṃ iyarti gomataḥ |
10,025.11 ayaṃ saptabhya ā varaṃ vi vo made prāndhaṃ śroṇaṃ ca tāriṣadvivakṣase ||

10,026.01  pra hyacchā manīṣā spārhā yanti niyutaḥ |
10,026.01 pra dasrā niyudrathaḥ pūṣā aviṣṭu māhinaḥ ||
10,026.02  yasya tyanmahitvaṃ vātāpyamayaṃ janaḥ |
10,026.02 vipra ā vaṃsaddhītibhiściketa suṣṭutīnām ||
10,026.03  sa veda suṣṭutīnāmindurna pūṣā vṛṣā |
10,026.03 abhi psuraḥ pruṣāyati vrajaṃ na ā pruṣāyati ||
10,026.04  maṃsīmahi tvā vayamasmākaṃ deva pūṣan |
10,026.04 matīnāṃ ca sādhanaṃ viprāṇāṃ cādhavam ||
10,026.05  pratyardhiryajñānāmaśvahayo rathānām |
10,026.05 ṛṣiḥ sa yo manurhito viprasya yāvayatsakhaḥ ||
10,026.06  ādhīṣamāṇāyāḥ patiḥ śucāyāśca śucasya ca |
10,026.06 vāsovāyo'vīnāmā vāsāṃsi marmṛjat ||
10,026.07  ino vājānāṃ patirinaḥ puṣṭīnāṃ sakhā |
10,026.07 pra śmaśru haryato dūdhodvi vṛthā yo adābhyaḥ ||
10,026.08  ā te rathasya pūṣannajā dhuraṃ vavṛtyuḥ |
10,026.08 viśvasyārthinaḥ sakhā sanojā anapacyutaḥ ||
10,026.09  asmākamūrjā rathaṃ pūṣā aviṣṭu māhinaḥ |
10,026.09 bhuvadvājānāṃ vṛdha imaṃ naḥ śṛṇavaddhavam ||

10,027.01  asatsu me jaritaḥ sābhivego yatsunvate yajamānāya śikṣam |
10,027.01 anāśīrdāmahamasmi prahantā satyadhvṛtaṃ vṛjināyantamābhum ||
10,027.02  yadīdahaṃ yudhaye saṃnayānyadevayūntanvā śūśujānān |
10,027.02 amā te tumraṃ vṛṣabhaṃ pacāni tīvraṃ sutaṃ pañcadaśaṃ ni ṣiñcam ||
10,027.03  nāhaṃ taṃ veda ya iti bravītyadevayūnsamaraṇe jaghanvān |
10,027.03 yadāvākhyatsamaraṇamṛghāvadādiddha me vṛṣabhā pra bruvanti ||
10,027.04  yadajñāteṣu vṛjaneṣvāsaṃ viśve sato maghavāno ma āsan |
10,027.04 jināmi vetkṣema ā santamābhuṃ pra taṃ kṣiṇāṃ parvate pādagṛhya ||
10,027.05  na vā u māṃ vṛjane vārayante na parvatāso yadahaṃ manasye |
10,027.05 mama svanātkṛdhukarṇo bhayāta evedanu dyūnkiraṇaḥ samejāt ||
10,027.06  darśannvatra śṛtapāṃ anindrānbāhukṣadaḥ śarave patyamānān |
10,027.06 ghṛṣuṃ vā ye niniduḥ sakhāyamadhyū nveṣu pavayo vavṛtyuḥ ||
10,027.07  abhūrvaukṣīrvyu āyurānaḍdarṣannu pūrvo aparo nu darṣat |
10,027.07 dve pavaste pari taṃ na bhūto yo asya pāre rajaso viveṣa ||
10,027.08  gāvo yavaṃ prayutā aryo akṣantā apaśyaṃ sahagopāścarantīḥ |
10,027.08 havā idaryo abhitaḥ samāyankiyadāsu svapatiśchandayāte ||
10,027.09  saṃ yadvayaṃ yavasādo janānāmahaṃ yavāda urvajre antaḥ |
10,027.09 atrā yukto'vasātāramicchādatho ayuktaṃ yunajadvavanvān ||
10,027.10  atredu me maṃsase satyamuktaṃ dvipācca yaccatuṣpātsaṃsṛjāni |
10,027.10 strībhiryo atra vṛṣaṇaṃ pṛtanyādayuddho asya vi bhajāni vedaḥ ||
10,027.11  yasyānakṣā duhitā jātvāsa kastāṃ vidvāṃ abhi manyāte andhām |
10,027.11 kataro meniṃ prati taṃ mucāte ya īṃ vahāte ya īṃ vā vareyāt ||
10,027.12  kiyatī yoṣā maryato vadhūyoḥ pariprītā panyasā vāryeṇa |
10,027.12 bhadrā vadhūrbhavati yatsupeśāḥ svayaṃ sā mitraṃ vanute jane cit ||
10,027.13  patto jagāra pratyañcamatti śīrṣṇā śiraḥ prati dadhau varūtham |
10,027.13 āsīna ūrdhvāmupasi kṣiṇāti nyaṅṅuttānāmanveti bhūmim ||
10,027.14  bṛhannacchāyo apalāśo arvā tasthau mātā viṣito atti garbhaḥ |
10,027.14 anyasyā vatsaṃ rihatī mimāya kayā bhuvā ni dadhe dhenurūdhaḥ ||
10,027.15  sapta vīrāso adharādudāyannaṣṭottarāttātsamajagmirante |
10,027.15 nava paścātātsthivimanta āyandaśa prāksānu vi tirantyaśnaḥ ||
10,027.16  daśānāmekaṃ kapilaṃ samānaṃ taṃ hinvanti kratave pāryāya |
10,027.16 garbhaṃ mātā sudhitaṃ vakṣaṇāsvavenantaṃ tuṣayantī bibharti ||
10,027.17  pīvānaṃ meṣamapacanta vīrā nyuptā akṣā anu dīva āsan |
10,027.17 dvā dhanuṃ bṛhatīmapsvantaḥ pavitravantā carataḥ punantā ||
10,027.18  vi krośanāso viṣvañca āyanpacāti nemo nahi pakṣadardhaḥ |
10,027.18 ayaṃ me devaḥ savitā tadāha drvanna idvanavatsarpirannaḥ ||
10,027.19  apaśyaṃ grāmaṃ vahamānamārādacakrayā svadhayā vartamānam |
10,027.19 siṣaktyaryaḥ pra yugā janānāṃ sadyaḥ śiśnā pramināno navīyān ||
10,027.20  etau me gāvau pramarasya yuktau mo ṣu pra sedhīrmuhurinmamandhi |
10,027.20 āpaścidasya vi naśantyarthaṃ sūraśca marka uparo babhūvān ||
10,027.21  ayaṃ yo vajraḥ purudhā vivṛtto'vaḥ sūryasya bṛhataḥ purīṣāt |
10,027.21 śrava idenā paro anyadasti tadavyathī jarimāṇastaranti ||
10,027.22  vṛkṣevṛkṣe niyatā mīmayadgaustato vayaḥ pra patānpūruṣādaḥ |
10,027.22 athedaṃ viśvaṃ bhuvanaṃ bhayāta indrāya sunvadṛṣaye ca śikṣat ||
10,027.23  devānāṃ māne prathamā atiṣṭhankṛntatrādeṣāmuparā udāyan |
10,027.23 trayastapanti pṛthivīmanūpā dvā bṛbūkaṃ vahataḥ purīṣam ||
10,027.24  sā te jīvāturuta tasya viddhi mā smaitādṛgapa gūhaḥ samarye |
10,027.24 āviḥ svaḥ kṛṇute gūhate busaṃ sa pādurasya nirṇijo na mucyate ||

10,028.01  viśvo hyanyo arirājagāma mamedaha śvaśuro nā jagāma |
10,028.01 jakṣīyāddhānā uta somaṃ papīyātsvāśitaḥ punarastaṃ jagāyāt ||
10,028.02  sa roruvadvṛṣabhastigmaśṛṅgo varṣmantasthau varimannā pṛthivyāḥ |
10,028.02 viśveṣvenaṃ vṛjaneṣu pāmi yo me kukṣī sutasomaḥ pṛṇāti ||
10,028.03  adriṇā te mandina indra tūyānsunvanti somānpibasi tvameṣām |
10,028.03 pacanti te vṛṣabhāṃ atsi teṣāṃ pṛkṣeṇa yanmaghavanhūyamānaḥ ||
10,028.04  idaṃ su me jaritarā cikiddhi pratīpaṃ śāpaṃ nadyo vahanti |
10,028.04 lopāśaḥ siṃhaṃ pratyañcamatsāḥ kroṣṭā varāhaṃ niratakta kakṣāt ||
10,028.05  kathā ta etadahamā ciketaṃ gṛtsasya pākastavaso manīṣām |
10,028.05 tvaṃ no vidvāṃ ṛtuthā vi voco yamardhaṃ te maghavankṣemyā dhūḥ ||
10,028.06  evā hi māṃ tavasaṃ vardhayanti divaścinme bṛhata uttarā dhūḥ |
10,028.06 purū sahasrā ni śiśāmi sākamaśatruṃ hi mā janitā jajāna ||
10,028.07  evā hi māṃ tavasaṃ jajñurugraṃ karmankarmanvṛṣaṇamindra devāḥ |
10,028.07 vadhīṃ vṛtraṃ vajreṇa mandasāno'pa vrajaṃ mahinā dāśuṣe vam ||
10,028.08  devāsa āyanparaśūṃrabibhranvanā vṛścanto abhi viḍbhirāyan |
10,028.08 ni sudrvaṃ dadhato vakṣaṇāsu yatrā kṛpīṭamanu taddahanti ||
10,028.09  śaśaḥ kṣuraṃ pratyañcaṃ jagārādriṃ logena vyabhedamārāt |
10,028.09 bṛhantaṃ cidṛhate randhayāni vayadvatso vṛṣabhaṃ śūśuvānaḥ ||
10,028.10  suparṇa itthā nakhamā siṣāyāvaruddhaḥ paripadaṃ na siṃhaḥ |
10,028.10 niruddhaścinmahiṣastarṣyāvāngodhā tasmā ayathaṃ karṣadetat ||
10,028.11  tebhyo godhā ayathaṃ karṣadetadye brahmaṇaḥ pratipīyantyannaiḥ |
10,028.11 sima ukṣṇo'vasṛṣṭāṃ adanti svayaṃ balāni tanvaḥ śṛṇānāḥ ||
10,028.12  ete śamībhiḥ suśamī abhūvanye hinvire tanvaḥ soma ukthaiḥ |
10,028.12 nṛvadvadannupa no māhi vājāndivi śravo dadhiṣe nāma vīraḥ ||

10,029.01  vane na vā yo nyadhāyi cākañchucirvāṃ stomo bhuraṇāvajīgaḥ |
10,029.01 yasyedindraḥ purudineṣu hotā nṛṇāṃ naryo nṛtamaḥ kṣapāvān ||
10,029.02  pra te asyā uṣasaḥ prāparasyā nṛtau syāma nṛtamasya nṛṇām |
10,029.02 anu triśokaḥ śatamāvahannṝnkutsena ratho yo asatsasavān ||
10,029.03  kaste mada indra rantyo bhūdduro giro abhyugro vi dhāva |
10,029.03 kadvāho arvāgupa mā manīṣā ā tvā śakyāmupamaṃ rādho annaiḥ ||
10,029.04  kadu dyumnamindra tvāvato nṝnkayā dhiyā karase kanna āgan |
10,029.04 mitro na satya urugāya bhṛtyā anne samasya yadasanmanīṣāḥ ||
10,029.05  preraya sūro arthaṃ na pāraṃ ye asya kāmaṃ janidhā iva gman |
10,029.05 giraśca ye te tuvijāta pūrvīrnara indra pratiśikṣantyannaiḥ ||
10,029.06  mātre nu te sumite indra pūrvī dyaurmajmanā pṛthivī kāvyena |
10,029.06 varāya te ghṛtavantaḥ sutāsaḥ svādmanbhavantu pītaye madhūni ||
10,029.07  ā madhvo asmā asicannamatramindrāya pūrṇaṃ sa hi satyarādhāḥ |
10,029.07 sa vāvṛdhe varimannā pṛthivyā abhi kratvā naryaḥ pauṃsyaiśca ||
10,029.08  vyānaḻ indraḥ pṛtanāḥ svojā āsmai yatante sakhyāya pūrvīḥ |
10,029.08 ā smā rathaṃ na pṛtanāsu tiṣṭha yaṃ bhadrayā sumatyā codayāse ||

10,030.01  pra devatrā brahmaṇe gāturetvapo acchā manaso na prayukti |
10,030.01 mahīṃ mitrasya varuṇasya dhāsiṃ pṛthujrayase rīradhā suvṛktim ||
10,030.02  adhvaryavo haviṣmanto hi bhūtācchāpa itośatīruśantaḥ |
10,030.02 ava yāścaṣṭe aruṇaḥ suparṇastamāsyadhvamūrmimadyā suhastāḥ ||
10,030.03  adhvaryavo'pa itā samudramapāṃ napātaṃ haviṣā yajadhvam |
10,030.03 sa vo dadadūrmimadyā supūtaṃ tasmai somaṃ madhumantaṃ sunota ||
10,030.04  yo anidhmo dīdayadapsvantaryaṃ viprāsa īḻate adhvareṣu |
10,030.04 apāṃ napānmadhumatīrapo dā yābhirindro vāvṛdhe vīryāya ||
10,030.05  yābhiḥ somo modate harṣate ca kalyāṇībhiryuvatibhirna maryaḥ |
10,030.05 tā adhvaryo apo acchā parehi yadāsiñcā oṣadhībhiḥ punītāt ||
10,030.06  evedyūne yuvatayo namanta yadīmuśannuśatīretyaccha |
10,030.06 saṃ jānate manasā saṃ cikitre'dhvaryavo dhiṣaṇāpaśca devīḥ ||
10,030.07  yo vo vṛtābhyo akṛṇodu lokaṃ yo vo mahyā abhiśasteramuñcat |
10,030.07 tasmā indrāya madhumantamūrmiṃ devamādanaṃ pra hiṇotanāpaḥ ||
10,030.08  prāsmai hinota madhumantamūrmiṃ garbho yo vaḥ sindhavo madhva utsaḥ |
10,030.08 ghṛtapṛṣṭhamīḍyamadhvareṣvāpo revatīḥ śṛṇutā havaṃ me ||
10,030.09  taṃ sindhavo matsaramindrapānamūrmiṃ pra heta ya ubhe iyarti |
10,030.09 madacyutamauśānaṃ nabhojāṃ pari tritantuṃ vicarantamutsam ||
10,030.10  āvarvṛtatīradha nu dvidhārā goṣuyudho na niyavaṃ carantīḥ |
10,030.10 ṛṣe janitrīrbhuvanasya patnīrapo vandasva savṛdhaḥ sayonīḥ ||
10,030.11  hinotā no adhvaraṃ devayajyā hinota brahma sanaye dhanānām |
10,030.11 ṛtasya yoge vi ṣyadhvamūdhaḥ śruṣṭīvarīrbhūtanāsmabhyamāpaḥ ||
10,030.12  āpo revatīḥ kṣayathā hi vasvaḥ kratuṃ ca bhadraṃ bibhṛthāmṛtaṃ ca |
10,030.12 rāyaśca stha svapatyasya patnīḥ sarasvatī tadgṛṇate vayo dhāt ||
10,030.13  prati yadāpo adṛśramāyatīrghṛtaṃ payāṃsi bibhratīrmadhūni |
10,030.13 adhvaryubhirmanasā saṃvidānā indrāya somaṃ suṣutaṃ bharantīḥ ||
10,030.14  emā agmanrevatīrjīvadhanyā adhvaryavaḥ sādayatā sakhāyaḥ |
10,030.14 ni barhiṣi dhattana somyāso'pāṃ naptrā saṃvidānāsa enāḥ ||
10,030.15  āgmannāpa uśatīrbarhiredaṃ nyadhvare asadandevayantīḥ |
10,030.15 adhvaryavaḥ sunutendrāya somamabhūdu vaḥ suśakā devayajyā ||

10,031.01  ā no devānāmupa vetu śaṃso viśvebhisturairavase yajatraḥ |
10,031.01 tebhirvayaṃ suṣakhāyo bhavema taranto viśvā duritā syāma ||
10,031.02  pari cinmarto draviṇaṃ mamanyādṛtasya pathā namasā vivāset |
10,031.02 uta svena kratunā saṃ vadeta śreyāṃsaṃ dakṣaṃ manasā jagṛbhyāt ||
10,031.03  adhāyi dhītirasasṛgramaṃśāstīrthe na dasmamupa yantyūmāḥ |
10,031.03 abhyānaśma suvitasya śūṣaṃ navedaso amṛtānāmabhūma ||
10,031.04  nityaścākanyātsvapatirdamūnā yasmā u devaḥ savitā jajāna |
10,031.04 bhago vā gobhiraryamemanajyātso asmai cāruśchadayaduta syāt ||
10,031.05  iyaṃ sā bhūyā uṣasāmiva kṣā yaddha kṣumantaḥ śavasā samāyan |
10,031.05 asya stutiṃ jariturbhikṣamāṇā ā naḥ śagmāsa upa yantu vājāḥ ||
10,031.06  asyedeṣā sumatiḥ paprathānābhavatpūrvyā bhūmanā gauḥ |
10,031.06 asya sanīḻā asurasya yonau samāna ā bharaṇe bibhramāṇāḥ ||
10,031.07  kiṃ svidvanaṃ ka u sa vṛkṣa āsa yato dyāvāpṛthivī niṣṭatakṣuḥ |
10,031.07 saṃtasthāne ajare itaūtī ahāni pūrvīruṣaso jaranta ||
10,031.08  naitāvadenā paro anyadastyukṣā sa dyāvāpṛthivī bibharti |
10,031.08 tvacaṃ pavitraṃ kṛṇuta svadhāvānyadīṃ sūryaṃ na harito vahanti ||
10,031.09  stego na kṣāmatyeti pṛthvīṃ mihaṃ na vāto vi ha vāti bhūma |
10,031.09 mitro yatra varuṇo ajyamāno'gnirvane na vyasṛṣṭa śokam ||
10,031.10  starīryatsūta sadyo ajyamānā vyathiravyathīḥ kṛṇuta svagopā |
10,031.10 putro yatpūrvaḥ pitrorjaniṣṭa śamyāṃ gaurjagāra yaddha pṛcchān ||
10,031.11  uta kaṇvaṃ nṛṣadaḥ putramāhuruta śyāvo dhanamādatta vājī |
10,031.11 pra kṛṣṇāya ruśadapinvatodharṛtamatra nakirasmā apīpet ||

10,032.01  pra su gmantā dhiyasānasya sakṣaṇi varebhirvarāṃ abhi ṣu prasīdataḥ |
10,032.01 asmākamindra ubhayaṃ jujoṣati yatsomyasyāndhaso bubodhati ||
10,032.02  vīndra yāsi divyāni rocanā vi pārthivāni rajasā puruṣṭuta |
10,032.02 ye tvā vahanti muhuradhvarāṃ upa te su vanvantu vagvanāṃ arādhasaḥ ||
10,032.03  tadinme chantsadvapuṣo vapuṣṭaraṃ putro yajjānaṃ pitroradhīyati |
10,032.03 jāyā patiṃ vahati vagnunā sumatpuṃsa idbhadro vahatuḥ pariṣkṛtaḥ ||
10,032.04  taditsadhasthamabhi cāru dīdhaya gāvo yacchāsanvahatuṃ na dhenavaḥ |
10,032.04 mātā yanmanturyūthasya pūrvyābhi vāṇasya saptadhāturijjanaḥ ||
10,032.05  pra vo'cchā ririce devayuṣpadameko rudrebhiryāti turvaṇiḥ |
10,032.05 jarā vā yeṣvamṛteṣu dāvane pari va ūmebhyaḥ siñcatā madhu ||
10,032.06  nidhīyamānamapagūḻhamapsu pra me devānāṃ vratapā uvāca |
10,032.06 indro vidvāṃ anu hi tvā cacakṣa tenāhamagne anuśiṣṭa āgām ||
10,032.07  akṣetravitkṣetravidaṃ hyaprāṭsa praiti kṣetravidānuśiṣṭaḥ |
10,032.07 etadvai bhadramanuśāsanasyota srutiṃ vindatyañjasīnām ||
10,032.08  adyedu prāṇīdamamannimāhāpīvṛto adhayanmāturūdhaḥ |
10,032.08 emenamāpa jarimā yuvānamaheḻanvasuḥ sumanā babhūva ||
10,032.09  etāni bhadrā kalaśa kriyāma kuruśravaṇa dadato maghāni |
10,032.09 dāna idvo maghavānaḥ so astvayaṃ ca somo hṛdi yaṃ bibharmi ||

10,033.01  pra mā yuyujre prayujo janānāṃ vahāmi sma pūṣaṇamantareṇa |
10,033.01 viśve devāso adha māmarakṣanduḥśāsurāgāditi ghoṣa āsīt ||
10,033.02  saṃ mā tapantyabhitaḥ sapatnīriva parśavaḥ |
10,033.02 ni bādhate amatirnagnatā jasurverna vevīyate matiḥ ||
10,033.03  mūṣo na śiśnā vyadanti mādhya stotāraṃ te śatakrato |
10,033.03 sakṛtsu no maghavannindra mṛḻayādhā piteva no bhava ||
10,033.04  kuruśravaṇamāvṛṇi rājānaṃ trāsadasyavam |
10,033.04 maṃhiṣṭhaṃ vāghatāmṛṣiḥ ||
10,033.05  yasya mā harito rathe tisro vahanti sādhuyā |
10,033.05 stavai sahasradakṣiṇe ||
10,033.06  yasya prasvādaso gira upamaśravasaḥ pituḥ |
10,033.06 kṣetraṃ na raṇvamūcuṣe ||
10,033.07  adhi putropamaśravo napānmitrātitherihi |
10,033.07 pituṣṭe asmi vanditā ||
10,033.08  yadīśīyāmṛtānāmuta vā martyānām |
10,033.08 jīvedinmaghavā mama ||
10,033.09  na devānāmati vrataṃ śatātmā cana jīvati |
10,033.09 tathā yujā vi vāvṛte ||

10,034.01  prāvepā mā bṛhato mādayanti pravātejā iriṇe varvṛtānāḥ |
10,034.01 somasyeva maujavatasya bhakṣo vibhīdako jāgṛvirmahyamacchān ||
10,034.02  na mā mimetha na jihīḻa eṣā śivā sakhibhya uta mahyamāsīt |
10,034.02 akṣasyāhamekaparasya hetoranuvratāmapa jāyāmarodham ||
10,034.03  dveṣṭi śvaśrūrapa jāyā ruṇaddhi na nāthito vindate marḍitāram |
10,034.03 aśvasyeva jarato vasnyasya nāhaṃ vindāmi kitavasya bhogam ||
10,034.04  anye jāyāṃ pari mṛśantyasya yasyāgṛdhadvedane vājyakṣaḥ |
10,034.04 pitā mātā bhrātara enamāhurna jānīmo nayatā baddhametam ||
10,034.05  yadādīdhye na daviṣāṇyebhiḥ parāyadbhyo'va hīye sakhibhyaḥ |
10,034.05 nyuptāśca babhravo vācamakrataṃ emīdeṣāṃ niṣkṛtaṃ jāriṇīva ||
10,034.06  sabhāmeti kitavaḥ pṛcchamāno jeṣyāmīti tanvā śūśujānaḥ |
10,034.06 akṣāso asya vi tiranti kāmaṃ pratidīvne dadhata ā kṛtāni ||
10,034.07  akṣāsa idaṅkuśino nitodino nikṛtvānastapanāstāpayiṣṇavaḥ |
10,034.07 kumāradeṣṇā jayataḥ punarhaṇo madhvā sampṛktāḥ kitavasya barhaṇā ||
10,034.08  tripañcāśaḥ krīḻati vrāta eṣāṃ deva iva savitā satyadharmā |
10,034.08 ugrasya cinmanyave nā namante rājā cidebhyo nama itkṛṇoti ||
10,034.09  nīcā vartanta upari sphurantyahastāso hastavantaṃ sahante |
10,034.09 divyā aṅgārā iriṇe nyuptāḥ śītāḥ santo hṛdayaṃ nirdahanti ||
10,034.10  jāyā tapyate kitavasya hīnā mātā putrasya carataḥ kva svit |
10,034.10 ṛṇāvā bibhyaddhanamicchamāno'nyeṣāmastamupa naktameti ||
10,034.11  striyaṃ dṛṣṭvāya kitavaṃ tatāpānyeṣāṃ jāyāṃ sukṛtaṃ ca yonim |
10,034.11 pūrvāhṇe aśvānyuyuje hi babhrūnso agnerante vṛṣalaḥ papāda ||
10,034.12  yo vaḥ senānīrmahato gaṇasya rājā vrātasya prathamo babhūva |
10,034.12 tasmai kṛṇomi na dhanā ruṇadhmi daśāhaṃ prācīstadṛtaṃ vadāmi ||
10,034.13  akṣairmā dīvyaḥ kṛṣimitkṛṣasva vitte ramasva bahu manyamānaḥ |
10,034.13 tatra gāvaḥ kitava tatra jāyā tanme vi caṣṭe savitāyamaryaḥ ||
10,034.14  mitraṃ kṛṇudhvaṃ khalu mṛḻatā no mā no ghoreṇa caratābhi dhṛṣṇu |
10,034.14 ni vo nu manyurviśatāmarātiranyo babhrūṇāṃ prasitau nvastu ||

10,035.01  abudhramu tya indravanto agnayo jyotirbharanta uṣaso vyuṣṭiṣu |
10,035.01 mahī dyāvāpṛthivī cetatāmapo'dyā devānāmava ā vṛṇīmahe ||
10,035.02  divaspṛthivyorava ā vṛṇīmahe mātṝnsindhūnparvatāñcharyaṇāvataḥ |
10,035.02 anāgāstvaṃ sūryamuṣāsamīmahe bhadraṃ somaḥ suvāno adyā kṛṇotu naḥ ||
10,035.03  dyāvā no adya pṛthivī anāgaso mahī trāyetāṃ suvitāya mātarā |
10,035.03 uṣā ucchantyapa bādhatāmaghaṃ svastyagniṃ samidhānamīmahe ||
10,035.04  iyaṃ na usrā prathamā sudevyaṃ revatsanibhyo revatī vyucchatu |
10,035.04 āre manyuṃ durvidatrasya dhīmahi svastyagniṃ samidhānamīmahe ||
10,035.05  pra yāḥ sisrate sūryasya raśmibhirjyotirbharantīruṣaso vyuṣṭiṣu |
10,035.05 bhadrā no adya śravase vyucchata svastyagniṃ samidhānamīmahe ||
10,035.06  anamīvā uṣasa ā carantu na udagnayo jihatāṃ jyotiṣā bṛhat |
10,035.06 āyukṣātāmaśvinā tūtujiṃ rathaṃ svastyagniṃ samidhānamīmahe ||
10,035.07  śreṣṭhaṃ no adya savitarvareṇyaṃ bhāgamā suva sa hi ratnadhā asi |
10,035.07 rāyo janitrīṃ dhiṣaṇāmupa bruve svastyagniṃ samidhānamīmahe ||
10,035.08  pipartu mā tadṛtasya pravācanaṃ devānāṃ yanmanuṣyā amanmahi |
10,035.08 viśvā idusrā spaḻ udeti sūryaḥ svastyagniṃ samidhānamīmahe ||
10,035.09  adveṣo adya barhiṣa starīmaṇi grāvṇāṃ yoge manmanaḥ sādha īmahe |
10,035.09 ādityānāṃ śarmaṇi sthā bhuraṇyasi svastyagniṃ samidhānamīmahe ||
10,035.10  ā no barhiḥ sadhamāde bṛhaddivi devāṃ īḻe sādayā sapta hotṝn |
10,035.10 indraṃ mitraṃ varuṇaṃ sātaye bhagaṃ svastyagniṃ samidhānamīmahe ||
10,035.11  ta ādityā ā gatā sarvatātaye vṛdhe no yajñamavatā sajoṣasaḥ |
10,035.11 bṛhaspatiṃ pūṣaṇamaśvinā bhagaṃ svastyagniṃ samidhānamīmahe ||
10,035.12  tanno devā yacchata supravācanaṃ chardirādityāḥ subharaṃ nṛpāyyam |
10,035.12 paśve tokāya tanayāya jīvase svastyagniṃ samidhānamīmahe ||
10,035.13  viśve adya maruto viśva ūtī viśve bhavantvagnayaḥ samiddhāḥ |
10,035.13 viśve no devā avasā gamantu viśvamastu draviṇaṃ vājo asme ||
10,035.14  yaṃ devāso'vatha vājasātau yaṃ trāyadhve yaṃ pipṛthātyaṃhaḥ |
10,035.14 yo vo gopīthe na bhayasya veda te syāma devavītaye turāsaḥ ||

10,036.01  uṣāsānaktā bṛhatī supeśasā dyāvākṣāmā varuṇo mitro aryamā |
10,036.01 indraṃ huve marutaḥ parvatāṃ apa ādityāndyāvāpṛthivī apaḥ svaḥ ||
10,036.02  dyauśca naḥ pṛthivī ca pracetasa ṛtāvarī rakṣatāmaṃhaso riṣaḥ |
10,036.02 mā durvidatrā nirṛtirna īśata taddevānāmavo adyā vṛṇīmahe ||
10,036.03  viśvasmānno aditiḥ pātvaṃhaso mātā mitrasya varuṇasya revataḥ |
10,036.03 svarvajjyotiravṛkaṃ naśīmahi taddevānāmavo adyā vṛṇīmahe ||
10,036.04  grāvā vadannapa rakṣāṃsi sedhatu duṣṣvapnyaṃ nirṛtiṃ viśvamatriṇam |
10,036.04 ādityaṃ śarma marutāmaśīmahi taddevānāmavo adyā vṛṇīmahe ||
10,036.05  endro barhiḥ sīdatu pinvatāmiḻā bṛhaspatiḥ sāmabhirṛkvo arcatu |
10,036.05 supraketaṃ jīvase manma dhīmahi taddevānāmavo adyā vṛṇīmahe ||
10,036.06  divispṛśaṃ yajñamasmākamaśvinā jīrādhvaraṃ kṛṇutaṃ sumnamiṣṭaye |
10,036.06 prācīnaraśmimāhutaṃ ghṛtena taddevānāmavo adyā vṛṇīmahe ||
10,036.07  upa hvaye suhavaṃ mārutaṃ gaṇaṃ pāvakamṛṣvaṃ sakhyāya śambhuvam |
10,036.07 rāyaspoṣaṃ sauśravasāya dhīmahi taddevānāmavo adyā vṛṇīmahe ||
10,036.08  apāṃ peruṃ jīvadhanyaṃ bharāmahe devāvyaṃ suhavamadhvaraśriyam |
10,036.08 suraśmiṃ somamindriyaṃ yamīmahi taddevānāmavo adyā vṛṇīmahe ||
10,036.09  sanema tatsusanitā sanitvabhirvayaṃ jīvā jīvaputrā anāgasaḥ |
10,036.09 brahmadviṣo viṣvageno bharerata taddevānāmavo adyā vṛṇīmahe ||
10,036.10  ye sthā manoryajñiyāste śṛṇotana yadvo devā īmahe taddadātana |
10,036.10 jaitraṃ kratuṃ rayimadvīravadyaśastaddevānāmavo adyā vṛṇīmahe ||
10,036.11  mahadadya mahatāmā vṛṇīmahe'vo devānāṃ bṛhatāmanarvaṇām |
10,036.11 yathā vasu vīrajātaṃ naśāmahai taddevānāmavo adyā vṛṇīmahe ||
10,036.12  maho agneḥ samidhānasya śarmaṇyanāgā mitre varuṇe svastaye |
10,036.12 śreṣṭhe syāma savituḥ savīmani taddevānāmavo adyā vṛṇīmahe ||
10,036.13  ye savituḥ satyasavasya viśve mitrasya vrate varuṇasya devāḥ |
10,036.13 te saubhagaṃ vīravadgomadapno dadhātana draviṇaṃ citramasme ||
10,036.14  savitā paścātātsavitā purastātsavitottarāttātsavitādharāttāt |
10,036.14 savitā naḥ suvatu sarvatātiṃ savitā no rāsatāṃ dīrghamāyuḥ ||

10,037.01  namo mitrasya varuṇasya cakṣase maho devāya tadṛtaṃ saparyata |
10,037.01 dūredṛśe devajātāya ketave divasputrāya sūryāya śaṃsata ||
10,037.02  sā mā satyoktiḥ pari pātu viśvato dyāvā ca yatra tatanannahāni ca |
10,037.02 viśvamanyanni viśate yadejati viśvāhāpo viśvāhodeti sūryaḥ ||
10,037.03  na te adevaḥ pradivo ni vāsate yadetaśebhiḥ patarai ratharyasi |
10,037.03 prācīnamanyadanu vartate raja udanyena jyotiṣā yāsi sūrya ||
10,037.04  yena sūrya jyotiṣā bādhase tamo jagacca viśvamudiyarṣi bhānunā |
10,037.04 tenāsmadviśvāmanirāmanāhutimapāmīvāmapa duṣṣvapnyaṃ suva ||
10,037.05  viśvasya hi preṣito rakṣasi vratamaheḻayannuccarasi svadhā anu |
10,037.05 yadadya tvā sūryopabravāmahai taṃ no devā anu maṃsīrata kratum ||
10,037.06  taṃ no dyāvāpṛthivī tanna āpa indraḥ śṛṇvantu maruto havaṃ vacaḥ |
10,037.06 mā śūne bhūma sūryasya saṃdṛśi bhadraṃ jīvanto jaraṇāmaśīmahi ||
10,037.07  viśvāhā tvā sumanasaḥ sucakṣasaḥ prajāvanto anamīvā anāgasaḥ |
10,037.07 udyantaṃ tvā mitramaho divedive jyogjīvāḥ prati paśyema sūrya ||
10,037.08  mahi jyotirbibhrataṃ tvā vicakṣaṇa bhāsvantaṃ cakṣuṣecakṣuṣe mayaḥ |
10,037.08 ārohantaṃ bṛhataḥ pājasaspari vayaṃ jīvāḥ prati paśyema sūrya ||
10,037.09  yasya te viśvā bhuvanāni ketunā pra cerate ni ca viśante aktubhiḥ |
10,037.09 anāgāstvena harikeśa sūryāhnāhnā no vasyasāvasyasodihi ||
10,037.10  śaṃ no bhava cakṣasā śaṃ no ahnā śaṃ bhānunā śaṃ himā śaṃ ghṛṇena |
10,037.10 yathā śamadhvañchamasadduroṇe tatsūrya draviṇaṃ dhehi citram ||
10,037.11  asmākaṃ devā ubhayāya janmane śarma yacchata dvipade catuṣpade |
10,037.11 adatpibadūrjayamānamāśitaṃ tadasme śaṃ yorarapo dadhātana ||
10,037.12  yadvo devāścakṛma jihvayā guru manaso vā prayutī devaheḻanam |
10,037.12 arāvā yo no abhi ducchunāyate tasmintadeno vasavo ni dhetana ||

10,038.01  asminna indra pṛtsutau yaśasvati śimīvati krandasi prāva sātaye |
10,038.01 yatra goṣātā dhṛṣiteṣu khādiṣu viṣvakpatanti didyavo nṛṣāhye ||
10,038.02  sa naḥ kṣumantaṃ sadane vyūrṇuhi goarṇasaṃ rayimindra śravāyyam |
10,038.02 syāma te jayataḥ śakra medino yathā vayamuśmasi tadvaso kṛdhi ||
10,038.03  yo no dāsa āryo vā puruṣṭutādeva indra yudhaye ciketati |
10,038.03 asmābhiṣṭe suṣahāḥ santu śatravastvayā vayaṃ tānvanuyāma saṃgame ||
10,038.04  yo dabhrebhirhavyo yaśca bhūribhiryo abhīke varivovinnṛṣāhye |
10,038.04 taṃ vikhāde sasnimadya śrutaṃ naramarvāñcamindramavase karāmahe ||
10,038.05  svavṛjaṃ hi tvāmahamindra śuśravānānudaṃ vṛṣabha radhracodanam |
10,038.05 pra muñcasva pari kutsādihā gahi kimu tvāvānmuṣkayorbaddha āsate ||

10,039.01  yo vāṃ parijmā suvṛdaśvinā ratho doṣāmuṣāso havyo haviṣmatā |
10,039.01 śaśvattamāsastamu vāmidaṃ vayaṃ piturna nāma suhavaṃ havāmahe ||
10,039.02  codayataṃ sūnṛtāḥ pinvataṃ dhiya utpurandhīrīrayataṃ taduśmasi |
