10,039.02 yaśasaṃ bhāgaṃ kṛṇutaṃ no aśvinā somaṃ na cāruṃ maghavatsu naskṛtam ||
10,039.03  amājuraścidbhavatho yuvaṃ bhago'nāśościdavitārāpamasya cit |
10,039.03 andhasya cinnāsatyā kṛśasya cidyuvāmidāhurbhiṣajā rutasya cit ||
10,039.04  yuvaṃ cyavānaṃ sanayaṃ yathā rathaṃ punaryuvānaṃ carathāya takṣathuḥ |
10,039.04 niṣṭaugryamūhathuradbhyaspari viśvettā vāṃ savaneṣu pravācyā ||
10,039.05  purāṇā vāṃ vīryā pra bravā jane'tho hāsathurbhiṣajā mayobhuvā |
10,039.05 tā vāṃ nu navyāvavase karāmahe'yaṃ nāsatyā śradariryathā dadhat ||
10,039.06  iyaṃ vāmahve śṛṇutaṃ me aśvinā putrāyeva pitarā mahyaṃ śikṣatam |
10,039.06 anāpirajñā asajātyāmatiḥ purā tasyā abhiśasterava spṛtam ||
10,039.07  yuvaṃ rathena vimadāya śundhyuvaṃ nyūhathuḥ purumitrasya yoṣaṇām |
10,039.07 yuvaṃ havaṃ vadhrimatyā agacchataṃ yuvaṃ suṣutiṃ cakrathuḥ purandhaye ||
10,039.08  yuvaṃ viprasya jaraṇāmupeyuṣaḥ punaḥ kalerakṛṇutaṃ yuvadvayaḥ |
10,039.08 yuvaṃ vandanamṛśyadādudūpathuryuvaṃ sadyo viśpalāmetave kṛthaḥ ||
10,039.09  yuvaṃ ha rebhaṃ vṛṣaṇā guhā hitamudairayataṃ mamṛvāṃsamaśvinā |
10,039.09 yuvamṛbīsamuta taptamatraya omanvantaṃ cakrathuḥ saptavadhraye ||
10,039.10  yuvaṃ śvetaṃ pedave'śvināśvaṃ navabhirvājairnavatī ca vājinam |
10,039.10 carkṛtyaṃ dadathurdrāvayatsakhaṃ bhagaṃ na nṛbhyo havyaṃ mayobhuvam ||
10,039.11  na taṃ rājānāvadite kutaścana nāṃho aśnoti duritaṃ nakirbhayam |
10,039.11 yamaśvinā suhavā rudravartanī purorathaṃ kṛṇuthaḥ patnyā saha ||
10,039.12  ā tena yātaṃ manaso javīyasā rathaṃ yaṃ vāmṛbhavaścakruraśvinā |
10,039.12 yasya yoge duhitā jāyate diva ubhe ahanī sudine vivasvataḥ ||
10,039.13  tā vartiryātaṃ jayuṣā vi parvatamapinvataṃ śayave dhenumaśvinā |
10,039.13 vṛkasya cidvartikāmantarāsyādyuvaṃ śacībhirgrasitāmamuñcatam ||
10,039.14  etaṃ vāṃ stomamaśvināvakarmātakṣāma bhṛgavo na ratham |
10,039.14 nyamṛkṣāma yoṣaṇāṃ na marye nityaṃ na sūnuṃ tanayaṃ dadhānāḥ ||

10,040.01  rathaṃ yāntaṃ kuha ko ha vāṃ narā prati dyumantaṃ suvitāya bhūṣati |
10,040.01 prātaryāvāṇaṃ vibhvaṃ viśeviśe vastorvastorvahamānaṃ dhiyā śami ||
10,040.02  kuha sviddoṣā kuha vastoraśvinā kuhābhipitvaṃ karataḥ kuhoṣatuḥ |
10,040.02 ko vāṃ śayutrā vidhaveva devaraṃ maryaṃ na yoṣā kṛṇute sadhastha ā ||
10,040.03  prātarjarethe jaraṇeva kāpayā vastorvastoryajatā gacchatho gṛham |
10,040.03 kasya dhvasrā bhavathaḥ kasya vā narā rājaputreva savanāva gacchathaḥ ||
10,040.04  yuvāṃ mṛgeva vāraṇā mṛgaṇyavo doṣā vastorhaviṣā ni hvayāmahe |
10,040.04 yuvaṃ hotrāmṛtuthā juhvate nareṣaṃ janāya vahathaḥ śubhaspatī ||
10,040.05  yuvāṃ ha ghoṣā paryaśvinā yatī rājña ūce duhitā pṛcche vāṃ narā |
10,040.05 bhūtaṃ me ahna uta bhūtamaktave'śvāvate rathine śaktamarvate ||
10,040.06  yuvaṃ kavī ṣṭhaḥ paryaśvinā rathaṃ viśo na kutso jariturnaśāyathaḥ |
10,040.06 yuvorha makṣā paryaśvinā madhvāsā bharata niṣkṛtaṃ na yoṣaṇā ||
10,040.07  yuvaṃ ha bhujyuṃ yuvamaśvinā vaśaṃ yuvaṃ śiñjāramuśanāmupārathuḥ |
10,040.07 yuvo rarāvā pari sakhyamāsate yuvorahamavasā sumnamā cake ||
10,040.08  yuvaṃ ha kṛśaṃ yuvamaśvinā śayuṃ yuvaṃ vidhantaṃ vidhavāmuruṣyathaḥ |
10,040.08 yuvaṃ sanibhya stanayantamaśvināpa vrajamūrṇuthaḥ saptāsyam ||
10,040.09  janiṣṭa yoṣā patayatkanīnako vi cāruhanvīrudho daṃsanā anu |
10,040.09 āsmai rīyante nivaneva sindhavo'smā ahne bhavati tatpatitvanam ||
10,040.10  jīvaṃ rudanti vi mayante adhvare dīrghāmanu prasitiṃ dīdhiyurnaraḥ |
10,040.10 vāmaṃ pitṛbhyo ya idaṃ samerire mayaḥ patibhyo janayaḥ pariṣvaje ||
10,040.11  na tasya vidma tadu ṣu pra vocata yuvā ha yadyuvatyāḥ kṣeti yoniṣu |
10,040.11 priyosriyasya vṛṣabhasya retino gṛhaṃ gamemāśvinā taduśmasi ||
10,040.12  ā vāmagansumatirvājinīvasū nyaśvinā hṛtsu kāmā ayaṃsata |
10,040.12 abhūtaṃ gopā mithunā śubhaspatī priyā aryamṇo duryāṃ aśīmahi ||
10,040.13  tā mandasānā manuṣo duroṇa ā dhattaṃ rayiṃ sahavīraṃ vacasyave |
10,040.13 kṛtaṃ tīrthaṃ suprapāṇaṃ śubhaspatī sthāṇuṃ patheṣṭhāmapa durmatiṃ hatam ||
10,040.14  kva svidadya katamāsvaśvinā vikṣu dasrā mādayete śubhaspatī |
10,040.14 ka īṃ ni yeme katamasya jagmaturviprasya vā yajamānasya vā gṛham ||

10,041.01  samānamu tyaṃ puruhūtamukthyaṃ rathaṃ tricakraṃ savanā ganigmatam |
10,041.01 parijmānaṃ vidathyaṃ suvṛktibhirvayaṃ vyuṣṭā uṣaso havāmahe ||
10,041.02  prātaryujaṃ nāsatyādhi tiṣṭhathaḥ prātaryāvāṇaṃ madhuvāhanaṃ ratham |
10,041.02 viśo yena gacchatho yajvarīrnarā kīreścidyajñaṃ hotṛmantamaśvinā ||
10,041.03  adhvaryuṃ vā madhupāṇiṃ suhastyamagnidhaṃ vā dhṛtadakṣaṃ damūnasam |
10,041.03 viprasya vā yatsavanāni gacchatho'ta ā yātaṃ madhupeyamaśvinā ||

10,042.01  asteva su prataraṃ lāyamasyanbhūṣanniva pra bharā stomamasmai |
10,042.01 vācā viprāstarata vācamaryo ni rāmaya jaritaḥ soma indram ||
10,042.02  dohena gāmupa śikṣā sakhāyaṃ pra bodhaya jaritarjāramindram |
10,042.02 kośaṃ na pūrṇaṃ vasunā nyṛṣṭamā cyāvaya maghadeyāya śūram ||
10,042.03  kimaṅga tvā maghavanbhojamāhuḥ śiśīhi mā śiśayaṃ tvā śṛṇomi |
10,042.03 apnasvatī mama dhīrastu śakra vasuvidaṃ bhagamindrā bharā naḥ ||
10,042.04  tvāṃ janā mamasatyeṣvindra saṃtasthānā vi hvayante samīke |
10,042.04 atrā yujaṃ kṛṇute yo haviṣmānnāsunvatā sakhyaṃ vaṣṭi śūraḥ ||
10,042.05  dhanaṃ na syandraṃ bahulaṃ yo asmai tīvrānsomāṃ āsunoti prayasvān |
10,042.05 tasmai śatrūnsutukānprātarahno ni svaṣṭrānyuvati hanti vṛtram ||
10,042.06  yasminvayaṃ dadhimā śaṃsamindre yaḥ śiśrāya maghavā kāmamasme |
10,042.06 ārāccitsanbhayatāmasya śatrurnyasmai dyumnā janyā namantām ||
10,042.07  ārācchatrumapa bādhasva dūramugro yaḥ śambaḥ puruhūta tena |
10,042.07 asme dhehi yavamadgomadindra kṛdhī dhiyaṃ jaritre vājaratnām ||
10,042.08  pra yamantarvṛṣasavāso agmantīvrāḥ somā bahulāntāsa indram |
10,042.08 nāha dāmānaṃ maghavā ni yaṃsanni sunvate vahati bhūri vāmam ||
10,042.09  uta prahāmatidīvyā jayāti kṛtaṃ yacchvaghnī vicinoti kāle |
10,042.09 yo devakāmo na dhanā ruṇaddhi samittaṃ rāyā sṛjati svadhāvān ||
10,042.10  gobhiṣṭaremāmatiṃ durevāṃ yavena kṣudhaṃ puruhūta viśvām |
10,042.10 vayaṃ rājabhiḥ prathamā dhanānyasmākena vṛjanenā jayema ||
10,042.11  bṛhaspatirnaḥ pari pātu paścādutottarasmādadharādaghāyoḥ |
10,042.11 indraḥ purastāduta madhyato naḥ sakhā sakhibhyo varivaḥ kṛṇotu ||

10,043.01  acchā ma indraṃ matayaḥ svarvidaḥ sadhrīcīrviśvā uśatīranūṣata |
10,043.01 pari ṣvajante janayo yathā patiṃ maryaṃ na śundhyuṃ maghavānamūtaye ||
10,043.02  na ghā tvadrigapa veti me manastve itkāmaṃ puruhūta śiśraya |
10,043.02 rājeva dasma ni ṣado'dhi barhiṣyasminsu some'vapānamastu te ||
10,043.03  viṣūvṛdindro amateruta kṣudhaḥ sa idrāyo maghavā vasva īśate |
10,043.03 tasyedime pravaṇe sapta sindhavo vayo vardhanti vṛṣabhasya śuṣmiṇaḥ ||
10,043.04  vayo na vṛkṣaṃ supalāśamāsadansomāsa indraṃ mandinaścamūṣadaḥ |
10,043.04 praiṣāmanīkaṃ śavasā davidyutadvidatsvarmanave jyotirāryam ||
10,043.05  kṛtaṃ na śvaghnī vi cinoti devane saṃvargaṃ yanmaghavā sūryaṃ jayat |
10,043.05 na tatte anyo anu vīryaṃ śakanna purāṇo maghavannota nūtanaḥ ||
10,043.06  viśaṃviśaṃ maghavā paryaśāyata janānāṃ dhenā avacākaśadvṛṣā |
10,043.06 yasyāha śakraḥ savaneṣu raṇyati sa tīvraiḥ somaiḥ sahate pṛtanyataḥ ||
10,043.07  āpo na sindhumabhi yatsamakṣaransomāsa indraṃ kulyā iva hradam |
10,043.07 vardhanti viprā maho asya sādane yavaṃ na vṛṣṭirdivyena dānunā ||
10,043.08  vṛṣā na kruddhaḥ patayadrajassvā yo aryapatnīrakṛṇodimā apaḥ |
10,043.08 sa sunvate maghavā jīradānave'vindajjyotirmanave haviṣmate ||
10,043.09  ujjāyatāṃ paraśurjyotiṣā saha bhūyā ṛtasya sudughā purāṇavat |
10,043.09 vi rocatāmaruṣo bhānunā śuciḥ svarṇa śukraṃ śuśucīta satpatiḥ ||
10,043.10  gobhiṣṭaremāmatiṃ durevāṃ yavena kṣudhaṃ puruhūta viśvām |
10,043.10 vayaṃ rājabhiḥ prathamā dhanānyasmākena vṛjanenā jayema ||
10,043.11  bṛhaspatirnaḥ pari pātu paścādutottarasmādadharādaghāyoḥ |
10,043.11 indraḥ purastāduta madhyato naḥ sakhā sakhibhyo varivaḥ kṛṇotu ||

10,044.01  ā yātvindraḥ svapatirmadāya yo dharmaṇā tūtujānastuviṣmān |
10,044.01 pratvakṣāṇo ati viśvā sahāṃsyapāreṇa mahatā vṛṣṇyena ||
10,044.02  suṣṭhāmā rathaḥ suyamā harī te mimyakṣa vajro nṛpate gabhastau |
10,044.02 śībhaṃ rājansupathā yāhyarvāṅvardhāma te papuṣo vṛṣṇyāni ||
10,044.03  endravāho nṛpatiṃ vajrabāhumugramugrāsastaviṣāsa enam |
10,044.03 pratvakṣasaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ satyaśuṣmamemasmatrā sadhamādo vahantu ||
10,044.04  evā patiṃ droṇasācaṃ sacetasamūrja skambhaṃ dharuṇa ā vṛṣāyase |
10,044.04 ojaḥ kṛṣva saṃ gṛbhāya tve apyaso yathā kenipānāmino vṛdhe ||
10,044.05  gamannasme vasūnyā hi śaṃsiṣaṃ svāśiṣaṃ bharamā yāhi sominaḥ |
10,044.05 tvamīśiṣe sāsminnā satsi barhiṣyanādhṛṣyā tava pātrāṇi dharmaṇā ||
10,044.06  pṛthakprāyanprathamā devahūtayo'kṛṇvata śravasyāni duṣṭarā |
10,044.06 na ye śekuryajñiyāṃ nāvamāruhamīrmaiva te nyaviśanta kepayaḥ ||
10,044.07  evaivāpāgapare santu dūḍhyo'śvā yeṣāṃ duryuja āyuyujre |
10,044.07 itthā ye prāgupare santi dāvane purūṇi yatra vayunāni bhojanā ||
10,044.08  girīṃrajrānrejamānāṃ adhārayaddyauḥ krandadantarikṣāṇi kopayat |
10,044.08 samīcīne dhiṣaṇe vi ṣkabhāyati vṛṣṇaḥ pītvā mada ukthāni śaṃsati ||
10,044.09  imaṃ bibharmi sukṛtaṃ te aṅkuśaṃ yenārujāsi maghavañchaphārujaḥ |
10,044.09 asminsu te savane astvokyaṃ suta iṣṭau maghavanbodhyābhagaḥ ||
10,044.10  gobhiṣṭaremāmatiṃ durevāṃ yavena kṣudhaṃ puruhūta viśvām |
10,044.10 vayaṃ rājabhiḥ prathamā dhanānyasmākena vṛjanenā jayema ||
10,044.11  bṛhaspatirnaḥ pari pātu paścādutottarasmādadharādaghāyoḥ |
10,044.11 indraḥ purastāduta madhyato naḥ sakhā sakhibhyo varivaḥ kṛṇotu ||

10,045.01  divaspari prathamaṃ jajñe agnirasmaddvitīyaṃ pari jātavedāḥ |
10,045.01 tṛtīyamapsu nṛmaṇā ajasramindhāna enaṃ jarate svādhīḥ ||
10,045.02  vidmā te agne tredhā trayāṇi vidmā te dhāma vibhṛtā purutrā |
10,045.02 vidmā te nāma paramaṃ guhā yadvidmā tamutsaṃ yata ājagantha ||
10,045.03  samudre tvā nṛmaṇā apsvantarnṛcakṣā īdhe divo agna ūdhan |
10,045.03 tṛtīye tvā rajasi tasthivāṃsamapāmupasthe mahiṣā avardhan ||
10,045.04  akrandadagni stanayanniva dyauḥ kṣāmā rerihadvīrudhaḥ samañjan |
10,045.04 sadyo jajñāno vi hīmiddho akhyadā rodasī bhānunā bhātyantaḥ ||
10,045.05  śrīṇāmudāro dharuṇo rayīṇāṃ manīṣāṇāṃ prārpaṇaḥ somagopāḥ |
10,045.05 vasuḥ sūnuḥ sahaso apsu rājā vi bhātyagra uṣasāmidhānaḥ ||
10,045.06  viśvasya keturbhuvanasya garbha ā rodasī apṛṇājjāyamānaḥ |
10,045.06 vīḻuṃ cidadrimabhinatparāyañjanā yadagnimayajanta pañca ||
10,045.07  uśikpāvako aratiḥ sumedhā marteṣvagniramṛto ni dhāyi |
10,045.07 iyarti dhūmamaruṣaṃ bharibhraducchukreṇa śociṣā dyāminakṣan ||
10,045.08  dṛśāno rukma urviyā vyadyauddurmarṣamāyuḥ śriye rucānaḥ |
10,045.08 agniramṛto abhavadvayobhiryadenaṃ dyaurjanayatsuretāḥ ||
10,045.09  yaste adya kṛṇavadbhadraśoce'pūpaṃ deva ghṛtavantamagne |
10,045.09 pra taṃ naya prataraṃ vasyo acchābhi sumnaṃ devabhaktaṃ yaviṣṭha ||
10,045.10  ā taṃ bhaja sauśravaseṣvagna ukthauktha ā bhaja śasyamāne |
10,045.10 priyaḥ sūrye priyo agnā bhavātyujjātena bhinadadujjanitvaiḥ ||
10,045.11  tvāmagne yajamānā anu dyūnviśvā vasu dadhire vāryāṇi |
10,045.11 tvayā saha draviṇamicchamānā vrajaṃ gomantamuśijo vi vavruḥ ||
10,045.12  astāvyagnirnarāṃ suśevo vaiśvānara ṛṣibhiḥ somagopāḥ |
10,045.12 adveṣe dyāvāpṛthivī huvema devā dhatta rayimasme suvīram ||

10,046.01  pra hotā jāto mahānnabhovinnṛṣadvā sīdadapāmupasthe |
10,046.01 dadhiryo dhāyi sa te vayāṃsi yantā vasūni vidhate tanūpāḥ ||
10,046.02  imaṃ vidhanto apāṃ sadhasthe paśuṃ na naṣṭaṃ padairanu gman |
10,046.02 guhā catantamuśijo namobhiricchanto dhīrā bhṛgavo'vindan ||
10,046.03  imaṃ trito bhūryavindadicchanvaibhūvaso mūrdhanyaghnyāyāḥ |
10,046.03 sa śevṛdho jāta ā harmyeṣu nābhiryuvā bhavati rocanasya ||
10,046.04  mandraṃ hotāramuśijo namobhiḥ prāñcaṃ yajñaṃ netāramadhvarāṇām |
10,046.04 viśāmakṛṇvannaratiṃ pāvakaṃ havyavāhaṃ dadhato mānuṣeṣu ||
10,046.05  pra bhūrjayantaṃ mahāṃ vipodhāṃ mūrā amūraṃ purāṃ darmāṇam |
10,046.05 nayanto garbhaṃ vanāṃ dhiyaṃ dhurhiriśmaśruṃ nārvāṇaṃ dhanarcam ||
10,046.06  ni pastyāsu trita stabhūyanparivīto yonau sīdadantaḥ |
10,046.06 ataḥ saṃgṛbhyā viśāṃ damūnā vidharmaṇāyantrairīyate nṝn ||
10,046.07  asyājarāso damāmaritrā arcaddhūmāso agnayaḥ pāvakāḥ |
10,046.07 śvitīcayaḥ śvātrāso bhuraṇyavo vanarṣado vāyavo na somāḥ ||
10,046.08  pra jihvayā bharate vepo agniḥ pra vayunāni cetasā pṛthivyāḥ |
10,046.08 tamāyavaḥ śucayantaṃ pāvakaṃ mandraṃ hotāraṃ dadhire yajiṣṭham ||
10,046.09  dyāvā yamagniṃ pṛthivī janiṣṭāmāpastvaṣṭā bhṛgavo yaṃ sahobhiḥ |
10,046.09 īḻenyaṃ prathamaṃ mātariśvā devāstatakṣurmanave yajatram ||
10,046.10  yaṃ tvā devā dadhire havyavāhaṃ puruspṛho mānuṣāso yajatram |
10,046.10 sa yāmannagne stuvate vayo dhāḥ pra devayanyaśasaḥ saṃ hi pūrvīḥ ||

10,047.01  jagṛbhmā te dakṣiṇamindra hastaṃ vasūyavo vasupate vasūnām |
10,047.01 vidmā hi tvā gopatiṃ śūra gonāmasmabhyaṃ citraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ rayiṃ dāḥ ||
10,047.02  svāyudhaṃ svavasaṃ sunīthaṃ catuḥsamudraṃ dharuṇaṃ rayīṇām |
10,047.02 carkṛtyaṃ śaṃsyaṃ bhūrivāramasmabhyaṃ citraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ rayiṃ dāḥ ||
10,047.03  subrahmāṇaṃ devavantaṃ bṛhantamuruṃ gabhīraṃ pṛthubudhnamindra |
10,047.03 śrutaṛṣimugramabhimātiṣāhamasmabhyaṃ citraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ rayiṃ dāḥ ||
10,047.04  sanadvājaṃ vipravīraṃ tarutraṃ dhanaspṛtaṃ śūśuvāṃsaṃ sudakṣam |
10,047.04 dasyuhanaṃ pūrbhidamindra satyamasmabhyaṃ citraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ rayiṃ dāḥ ||
10,047.05  aśvāvantaṃ rathinaṃ vīravantaṃ sahasriṇaṃ śatinaṃ vājamindra |
10,047.05 bhadravrātaṃ vipravīraṃ svarṣāmasmabhyaṃ citraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ rayiṃ dāḥ ||
10,047.06  pra saptagumṛtadhītiṃ sumedhāṃ bṛhaspatiṃ matiracchā jigāti |
10,047.06 ya āṅgiraso namasopasadyo'smabhyaṃ citraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ rayiṃ dāḥ ||
10,047.07  vanīvāno mama dūtāsa indraṃ stomāścaranti sumatīriyānāḥ |
10,047.07 hṛdispṛśo manasā vacyamānā asmabhyaṃ citraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ rayiṃ dāḥ ||
10,047.08  yattvā yāmi daddhi tanna indra bṛhantaṃ kṣayamasamaṃ janānām |
10,047.08 abhi taddyāvāpṛthivī gṛṇītāmasmabhyaṃ citraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ rayiṃ dāḥ ||

10,048.01  ahaṃ bhuvaṃ vasunaḥ pūrvyaspatirahaṃ dhanāni saṃ jayāmi śaśvataḥ |
10,048.01 māṃ havante pitaraṃ na jantavo'haṃ dāśuṣe vi bhajāmi bhojanam ||
10,048.02  ahamindro rodho vakṣo atharvaṇastritāya gā ajanayamaheradhi |
10,048.02 ahaṃ dasyubhyaḥ pari nṛmṇamā dade gotrā śikṣandadhīce mātariśvane ||
10,048.03  mahyaṃ tvaṣṭā vajramatakṣadāyasaṃ mayi devāso'vṛjannapi kratum |
10,048.03 mamānīkaṃ sūryasyeva duṣṭaraṃ māmāryanti kṛtena kartvena ca ||
10,048.04  ahametaṃ gavyayamaśvyaṃ paśuṃ purīṣiṇaṃ sāyakenā hiraṇyayam |
10,048.04 purū sahasrā ni śiśāmi dāśuṣe yanmā somāsa ukthino amandiṣuḥ ||
10,048.05  ahamindro na parā jigya iddhanaṃ na mṛtyave'va tasthe kadā cana |
10,048.05 somaminmā sunvanto yācatā vasu na me pūravaḥ sakhye riṣāthana ||
10,048.06  ahametāñchāśvasato dvādvendraṃ ye vajraṃ yudhaye'kṛṇvata |
10,048.06 āhvayamānāṃ ava hanmanāhanaṃ dṛḻhā vadannanamasyurnamasvinaḥ ||
10,048.07  abhīdamekameko asmi niṣṣāḻ abhī dvā kimu trayaḥ karanti |
10,048.07 khale na parṣānprati hanmi bhūri kiṃ mā nindanti śatravo'nindrāḥ ||
10,048.08  ahaṃ guṅgubhyo atithigvamiṣkaramiṣaṃ na vṛtraturaṃ vikṣu dhārayam |
10,048.08 yatparṇayaghna uta vā karañjahe prāhaṃ mahe vṛtrahatye aśuśravi ||
10,048.09  pra me namī sāpya iṣe bhuje bhūdgavāmeṣe sakhyā kṛṇuta dvitā |
10,048.09 didyuṃ yadasya samitheṣu maṃhayamādidenaṃ śaṃsyamukthyaṃ karam ||
10,048.10  pra nemasmindadṛśe somo antargopā nemamāvirasthā kṛṇoti |
10,048.10 sa tigmaśṛṅgaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ yuyutsandruhastasthau bahule baddho antaḥ ||
10,048.11  ādityānāṃ vasūnāṃ rudriyāṇāṃ devo devānāṃ na mināmi dhāma |
10,048.11 te mā bhadrāya śavase tatakṣuraparājitamastṛtamaṣāḻham ||

10,049.01  ahaṃ dāṃ gṛṇate pūrvyaṃ vasvahaṃ brahma kṛṇavaṃ mahyaṃ vardhanam |
10,049.01 ahaṃ bhuvaṃ yajamānasya coditāyajvanaḥ sākṣi viśvasminbhare ||
10,049.02  māṃ dhurindraṃ nāma devatā divaśca gmaścāpāṃ ca jantavaḥ |
10,049.02 ahaṃ harī vṛṣaṇā vivratā raghū ahaṃ vajraṃ śavase dhṛṣṇvā dade ||
10,049.03  ahamatkaṃ kavaye śiśnathaṃ hathairahaṃ kutsamāvamābhirūtibhiḥ |
10,049.03 ahaṃ śuṣṇasya śnathitā vadharyamaṃ na yo rara āryaṃ nāma dasyave ||
10,049.04  ahaṃ piteva vetasūṃrabhiṣṭaye tugraṃ kutsāya smadibhaṃ ca randhayam |
10,049.04 ahaṃ bhuvaṃ yajamānasya rājani pra yadbhare tujaye na priyādhṛṣe ||
10,049.05  ahaṃ randhayaṃ mṛgayaṃ śrutarvaṇe yanmājihīta vayunā canānuṣak |
10,049.05 ahaṃ veśaṃ namramāyave'karamahaṃ savyāya paḍgṛbhimarandhayam ||
10,049.06  ahaṃ sa yo navavāstvaṃ bṛhadrathaṃ saṃ vṛtreva dāsaṃ vṛtrahārujam |
10,049.06 yadvardhayantaṃ prathayantamānuṣagdūre pāre rajaso rocanākaram ||
10,049.07  ahaṃ sūryasya pari yāmyāśubhiḥ praitaśebhirvahamāna ojasā |
10,049.07 yanmā sāvo manuṣa āha nirṇija ṛdhakkṛṣe dāsaṃ kṛtvyaṃ hathaiḥ ||
10,049.08  ahaṃ saptahā nahuṣo nahuṣṭaraḥ prāśrāvayaṃ śavasā turvaśaṃ yadum |
10,049.08 ahaṃ nyanyaṃ sahasā sahaskaraṃ nava vrādhato navatiṃ ca vakṣayam ||
10,049.09  ahaṃ sapta sravato dhārayaṃ vṛṣā dravitnvaḥ pṛthivyāṃ sīrā adhi |
10,049.09 ahamarṇāṃsi vi tirāmi sukraturyudhā vidaṃ manave gātumiṣṭaye ||
10,049.10  ahaṃ tadāsu dhārayaṃ yadāsu na devaścana tvaṣṭādhārayadruśat |
10,049.10 spārhaṃ gavāmūdhassu vakṣaṇāsvā madhormadhu śvātryaṃ somamāśiram ||
10,049.11  evā devāṃ indro vivye nṝnpra cyautnena maghavā satyarādhāḥ |
10,049.11 viśvettā te harivaḥ śacīvo'bhi turāsaḥ svayaśo gṛṇanti ||

10,050.01  pra vo mahe mandamānāyāndhaso'rcā viśvānarāya viśvābhuve |
10,050.01 indrasya yasya sumakhaṃ saho mahi śravo nṛmṇaṃ ca rodasī saparyataḥ ||
10,050.02  so cinnu sakhyā narya ina stutaścarkṛtya indro māvate nare |
10,050.02 viśvāsu dhūrṣu vājakṛtyeṣu satpate vṛtre vāpsvabhi śūra mandase ||
10,050.03  ke te nara indra ye ta iṣe ye te sumnaṃ sadhanyamiyakṣān |
10,050.03 ke te vājāyāsuryāya hinvire ke apsu svāsūrvarāsu pauṃsye ||
10,050.04  bhuvastvamindra brahmaṇā mahānbhuvo viśveṣu savaneṣu yajñiyaḥ |
10,050.04 bhuvo nṝṃścyautno viśvasminbhare jyeṣṭhaśca mantro viśvacarṣaṇe ||
10,050.05  avā nu kaṃ jyāyānyajñavanaso mahīṃ ta omātrāṃ kṛṣṭayo viduḥ |
10,050.05 aso nu kamajaro vardhāśca viśvedetā savanā tūtumā kṛṣe ||
10,050.06  etā viśvā savanā tūtumā kṛṣe svayaṃ sūno sahaso yāni dadhiṣe |
10,050.06 varāya te pātraṃ dharmaṇe tanā yajño mantro brahmodyataṃ vacaḥ ||
10,050.07  ye te vipra brahmakṛtaḥ sute sacā vasūnāṃ ca vasunaśca dāvane |
10,050.07 pra te sumnasya manasā pathā bhuvanmade sutasya somyasyāndhasaḥ ||

10,051.01  mahattadulbaṃ sthaviraṃ tadāsīdyenāviṣṭitaḥ praviveśithāpaḥ |
10,051.01 viśvā apaśyadbahudhā te agne jātavedastanvo deva ekaḥ ||
10,051.02  ko mā dadarśa katamaḥ sa devo yo me tanvo bahudhā paryapaśyat |
10,051.02 kvāha mitrāvaruṇā kṣiyantyagnerviśvāḥ samidho devayānīḥ ||
10,051.03  aicchāma tvā bahudhā jātavedaḥ praviṣṭamagne apsvoṣadhīṣu |
10,051.03 taṃ tvā yamo acikeccitrabhāno daśāntaruṣyādatirocamānam ||
10,051.04  hotrādahaṃ varuṇa bibhyadāyaṃ nedeva mā yunajannatra devāḥ |
10,051.04 tasya me tanvo bahudhā niviṣṭā etamarthaṃ na ciketāhamagniḥ ||
10,051.05  ehi manurdevayuryajñakāmo'raṅkṛtyā tamasi kṣeṣyagne |
10,051.05 sugānpathaḥ kṛṇuhi devayānānvaha havyāni sumanasyamānaḥ ||
10,051.06  agneḥ pūrve bhrātaro arthametaṃ rathīvādhvānamanvāvarīvuḥ |
10,051.06 tasmādbhiyā varuṇa dūramāyaṃ gauro na kṣepnoravije jyāyāḥ ||
10,051.07  kurmasta āyurajaraṃ yadagne yathā yukto jātavedo na riṣyāḥ |
10,051.07 athā vahāsi sumanasyamāno bhāgaṃ devebhyo haviṣaḥ sujāta ||
10,051.08  prayājānme anuyājāṃśca kevalānūrjasvantaṃ haviṣo datta bhāgam |
10,051.08 ghṛtaṃ cāpāṃ puruṣaṃ cauṣadhīnāmagneśca dīrghamāyurastu devāḥ ||
10,051.09  tava prayājā anuyājāśca kevala ūrjasvanto haviṣaḥ santu bhāgāḥ |
10,051.09 tavāgne yajño'yamastu sarvastubhyaṃ namantāṃ pradiśaścatasraḥ ||

10,052.01  viśve devāḥ śāstana mā yatheha hotā vṛto manavai yanniṣadya |
10,052.01 pra me brūta bhāgadheyaṃ yathā vo yena pathā havyamā vo vahāni ||
10,052.02  ahaṃ hotā nyasīdaṃ yajīyānviśve devā maruto mā junanti |
10,052.02 aharaharaśvinādhvaryavaṃ vāṃ brahmā samidbhavati sāhutirvām ||
10,052.03  ayaṃ yo hotā kiru sa yamasya kamapyūhe yatsamañjanti devāḥ |
10,052.03 aharaharjāyate māsimāsyathā devā dadhire havyavāham ||
10,052.04  māṃ devā dadhire havyavāhamapamluktaṃ bahu kṛcchrā carantam |
10,052.04 agnirvidvānyajñaṃ naḥ kalpayāti pañcayāmaṃ trivṛtaṃ saptatantum ||
10,052.05  ā vo yakṣyamṛtatvaṃ suvīraṃ yathā vo devā varivaḥ karāṇi |
10,052.05 ā bāhvorvajramindrasya dheyāmathemā viśvāḥ pṛtanā jayāti ||
10,052.06  trīṇi śatā trī sahasrāṇyagniṃ triṃśacca devā nava cāsaparyan |
10,052.06 aukṣanghṛtairastṛṇanbarhirasmā ādiddhotāraṃ nyasādayanta ||

10,053.01  yamaicchāma manasā so'yamāgādyajñasya vidvānparuṣaścikitvān |
10,053.01 sa no yakṣaddevatātā yajīyānni hi ṣatsadantaraḥ pūrvo asmat ||
10,053.02  arādhi hotā niṣadā yajīyānabhi prayāṃsi sudhitāni hi khyat |
10,053.02 yajāmahai yajñiyānhanta devāṃ īḻāmahā īḍyāṃ ājyena ||
10,053.03  sādhvīmakardevavītiṃ no adya yajñasya jihvāmavidāma guhyām |
10,053.03 sa āyurāgātsurabhirvasāno bhadrāmakardevahūtiṃ no adya ||
10,053.04  tadadya vācaḥ prathamaṃ masīya yenāsurāṃ abhi devā asāma |
10,053.04 ūrjāda uta yajñiyāsaḥ pañca janā mama hotraṃ juṣadhvam ||
10,053.05  pañca janā mama hotraṃ juṣantāṃ gojātā uta ye yajñiyāsaḥ |
10,053.05 pṛthivī naḥ pārthivātpātvaṃhaso'ntarikṣaṃ divyātpātvasmān ||
10,053.06  tantuṃ tanvanrajaso bhānumanvihi jyotiṣmataḥ patho rakṣa dhiyā kṛtān |
10,053.06 anulbaṇaṃ vayata joguvāmapo manurbhava janayā daivyaṃ janam ||
10,053.07  akṣānaho nahyatanota somyā iṣkṛṇudhvaṃ raśanā ota piṃśata |
10,053.07 aṣṭāvandhuraṃ vahatābhito rathaṃ yena devāso anayannabhi priyam ||
10,053.08  aśmanvatī rīyate saṃ rabhadhvamuttiṣṭhata pra taratā sakhāyaḥ |
10,053.08 atrā jahāma ye asannaśevāḥ śivānvayamuttaremābhi vājān ||
10,053.09  tvaṣṭā māyā vedapasāmapastamo bibhratpātrā devapānāni śantamā |
10,053.09 śiśīte nūnaṃ paraśuṃ svāyasaṃ yena vṛścādetaśo brahmaṇaspatiḥ ||
10,053.10  sato nūnaṃ kavayaḥ saṃ śiśīta vāśībhiryābhiramṛtāya takṣatha |
10,053.10 vidvāṃsaḥ padā guhyāni kartana yena devāso amṛtatvamānaśuḥ ||
10,053.11  garbhe yoṣāmadadhurvatsamāsanyapīcyena manasota jihvayā |
10,053.11 sa viśvāhā sumanā yogyā abhi siṣāsanirvanate kāra ijjitim ||

10,054.01  tāṃ su te kīrtiṃ maghavanmahitvā yattvā bhīte rodasī ahvayetām |
10,054.01 prāvo devāṃ ātiro dāsamojaḥ prajāyai tvasyai yadaśikṣa indra ||
10,054.02  yadacarastanvā vāvṛdhāno balānīndra prabruvāṇo janeṣu |
10,054.02 māyetsā te yāni yuddhānyāhurnādya śatruṃ nanu purā vivitse ||
10,054.03  ka u nu te mahimanaḥ samasyāsmatpūrva ṛṣayo'ntamāpuḥ |
10,054.03 yanmātaraṃ ca pitaraṃ ca sākamajanayathāstanvaḥ svāyāḥ ||
10,054.04  catvāri te asuryāṇi nāmādābhyāni mahiṣasya santi |
10,054.04 tvamaṅga tāni viśvāni vitse yebhiḥ karmāṇi maghavañcakartha ||
10,054.05  tvaṃ viśvā dadhiṣe kevalāni yānyāviryā ca guhā vasūni |
10,054.05 kāmaminme maghavanmā vi tārīstvamājñātā tvamindrāsi dātā ||
10,054.06  yo adadhājjyotiṣi jyotirantaryo asṛjanmadhunā saṃ madhūni |
10,054.06 adha priyaṃ śūṣamindrāya manma brahmakṛto bṛhadukthādavāci ||

10,055.01  dūre tannāma guhyaṃ parācairyattvā bhīte ahvayetāṃ vayodhai |
10,055.01 udastabhnāḥ pṛthivīṃ dyāmabhīke bhrātuḥ putrānmaghavantitviṣāṇaḥ ||
10,055.02  mahattannāma guhyaṃ puruspṛgyena bhūtaṃ janayo yena bhavyam |
10,055.02 pratnaṃ jātaṃ jyotiryadasya priyaṃ priyāḥ samaviśanta pañca ||
10,055.03  ā rodasī apṛṇādota madhyaṃ pañca devāṃ ṛtuśaḥ saptasapta |
10,055.03 catustriṃśatā purudhā vi caṣṭe sarūpeṇa jyotiṣā vivratena ||
10,055.04  yaduṣa aucchaḥ prathamā vibhānāmajanayo yena puṣṭasya puṣṭam |
10,055.04 yatte jāmitvamavaraṃ parasyā mahanmahatyā asuratvamekam ||
10,055.05  vidhuṃ dadrāṇaṃ samane bahūnāṃ yuvānaṃ santaṃ palito jagāra |
10,055.05 devasya paśya kāvyaṃ mahitvādyā mamāra sa hyaḥ samāna ||
10,055.06  śākmanā śāko aruṇaḥ suparṇa ā yo mahaḥ śūraḥ sanādanīḻaḥ |
10,055.06 yacciketa satyamittanna moghaṃ vasu spārhamuta jetota dātā ||
10,055.07  aibhirdade vṛṣṇyā pauṃsyāni yebhiraukṣadvṛtrahatyāya vajrī |
10,055.07 ye karmaṇaḥ kriyamāṇasya mahna ṛtekarmamudajāyanta devāḥ ||
10,055.08  yujā karmāṇi janayanviśvaujā aśastihā viśvamanāsturāṣāṭ |
10,055.08 pītvī somasya diva ā vṛdhānaḥ śūro niryudhādhamaddasyūn ||

10,056.01  idaṃ ta ekaṃ para ū ta ekaṃ tṛtīyena jyotiṣā saṃ viśasva |
10,056.01 saṃveśane tanvaścāruredhi priyo devānāṃ parame janitre ||
10,056.02  tanūṣṭe vājintanvaṃ nayantī vāmamasmabhyaṃ dhātu śarma tubhyam |
10,056.02 ahruto maho dharuṇāya devāndivīva jyotiḥ svamā mimīyāḥ ||
10,056.03  vājyasi vājinenā suvenīḥ suvita stomaṃ suvito divaṃ gāḥ |
10,056.03 suvito dharma prathamānu satyā suvito devānsuvito'nu patma ||
10,056.04  mahimna eṣāṃ pitaraścaneśire devā deveṣvadadhurapi kratum |
10,056.04 samavivyacuruta yānyatviṣuraiṣāṃ tanūṣu ni viviśuḥ punaḥ ||
10,056.05  sahobhirviśvaṃ pari cakramū rajaḥ pūrvā dhāmānyamitā mimānāḥ |
10,056.05 tanūṣu viśvā bhuvanā ni yemire prāsārayanta purudha prajā anu ||
10,056.06  dvidhā sūnavo'suraṃ svarvidamāsthāpayanta tṛtīyena karmaṇā |
10,056.06 svāṃ prajāṃ pitaraḥ pitryaṃ saha āvareṣvadadhustantumātatam ||
10,056.07  nāvā na kṣodaḥ pradiśaḥ pṛthivyāḥ svastibhirati durgāṇi viśvā |
10,056.07 svāṃ prajāṃ bṛhaduktho mahitvāvareṣvadadhādā pareṣu ||
10,057.01  mā pra gāma patho vayaṃ mā yajñādindra sominaḥ |
10,057.01 mānta sthurno arātayaḥ ||
10,057.02  yo yajñasya prasādhanastanturdeveṣvātataḥ |
10,057.02 tamāhutaṃ naśīmahi ||
10,057.03  mano nvā huvāmahe nārāśaṃsena somena |
10,057.03 pitṝṇāṃ ca manmabhiḥ ||
10,057.04  ā ta etu manaḥ punaḥ kratve dakṣāya jīvase |
10,057.04 jyokca sūryaṃ dṛśe ||
10,057.05  punarnaḥ pitaro mano dadātu daivyo janaḥ |
10,057.05 jīvaṃ vrātaṃ sacemahi ||
10,057.06  vayaṃ soma vrate tava manastanūṣu bibhrataḥ |
10,057.06 prajāvantaḥ sacemahi ||

10,058.01  yatte yamaṃ vaivasvataṃ mano jagāma dūrakam |
10,058.01 tatta ā vartayāmasīha kṣayāya jīvase ||
10,058.02  yatte divaṃ yatpṛthivīṃ mano jagāma dūrakam |
10,058.02 tatta ā vartayāmasīha kṣayāya jīvase ||
10,058.03  yatte bhūmiṃ caturbhṛṣṭiṃ mano jagāma dūrakam |
10,058.03 tatta ā vartayāmasīha kṣayāya jīvase ||
10,058.04  yatte catasraḥ pradiśo mano jagāma dūrakam |
10,058.04 tatta ā vartayāmasīha kṣayāya jīvase ||
10,058.05  yatte samudramarṇavaṃ mano jagāma dūrakam |
10,058.05 tatta ā vartayāmasīha kṣayāya jīvase ||
10,058.06  yatte marīcīḥ pravato mano jagāma dūrakam |
10,058.06 tatta ā vartayāmasīha kṣayāya jīvase ||
10,058.07  yatte apo yadoṣadhīrmano jagāma dūrakam |
10,058.07 tatta ā vartayāmasīha kṣayāya jīvase ||
10,058.08  yatte sūryaṃ yaduṣasaṃ mano jagāma dūrakam |
10,058.08 tatta ā vartayāmasīha kṣayāya jīvase ||
10,058.09  yatte parvatānbṛhato mano jagāma dūrakam |
10,058.09 tatta ā vartayāmasīha kṣayāya jīvase ||
10,058.10  yatte viśvamidaṃ jaganmano jagāma dūrakam |
10,058.10 tatta ā vartayāmasīha kṣayāya jīvase ||
10,058.11  yatte parāḥ parāvato mano jagāma dūrakam |
10,058.11 tatta ā vartayāmasīha kṣayāya jīvase ||
10,058.12  yatte bhūtaṃ ca bhavyaṃ ca mano jagāma dūrakam |
10,058.12 tatta ā vartayāmasīha kṣayāya jīvase ||

10,059.01  pra tāryāyuḥ prataraṃ navīya sthātāreva kratumatā rathasya |
10,059.01 adha cyavāna uttavītyarthaṃ parātaraṃ su nirṛtirjihītām ||
10,059.02  sāmannu rāye nidhimannvannaṃ karāmahe su purudha śravāṃsi |
10,059.02 tā no viśvāni jaritā mamattu parātaraṃ su nirṛtirjihītām ||
10,059.03  abhī ṣvaryaḥ pauṃsyairbhavema dyaurna bhūmiṃ girayo nājrān |
10,059.03 tā no viśvāni jaritā ciketa parātaraṃ su nirṛtirjihītām ||
10,059.04  mo ṣu ṇaḥ soma mṛtyave parā dāḥ paśyema nu sūryamuccarantam |
10,059.04 dyubhirhito jarimā sū no astu parātaraṃ su nirṛtirjihītām ||
10,059.05  asunīte mano asmāsu dhāraya jīvātave su pra tirā na āyuḥ |
10,059.05 rārandhi naḥ sūryasya saṃdṛśi ghṛtena tvaṃ tanvaṃ vardhayasva ||
10,059.06  asunīte punarasmāsu cakṣuḥ punaḥ prāṇamiha no dhehi bhogam |
10,059.06 jyokpaśyema sūryamuccarantamanumate mṛḻayā naḥ svasti ||
10,059.07  punarno asuṃ pṛthivī dadātu punardyaurdevī punarantarikṣam |
10,059.07 punarnaḥ somastanvaṃ dadātu punaḥ pūṣā pathyāṃ yā svastiḥ ||
10,059.08  śaṃ rodasī subandhave yahvī ṛtasya mātarā |
10,059.08 bharatāmapa yadrapo dyauḥ pṛthivi kṣamā rapo mo ṣu te kiṃ canāmamat ||
10,059.09  ava dvake ava trikā divaścaranti bheṣajā |
10,059.09 kṣamā cariṣṇvekakaṃ bharatāmapa yadrapo dyauḥ pṛthivi kṣamā rapo mo ṣu te kiṃ canāmamat ||
10,059.10  samindreraya gāmanaḍvāhaṃ ya āvahaduśīnarāṇyā anaḥ |
10,059.10 bharatāmapa yadrapo dyauḥ pṛthivi kṣamā rapo mo ṣu te kiṃ canāmamat ||

10,060.01  ā janaṃ tveṣasaṃdṛśaṃ māhīnānāmupastutam |
10,060.01 aganma bibhrato namaḥ ||
10,060.02  asamātiṃ nitośanaṃ tveṣaṃ niyayinaṃ ratham |
10,060.02 bhajerathasya satpatim ||
10,060.03  yo janānmahiṣāṃ ivātitasthau pavīravān |
10,060.03 utāpavīravānyudhā ||
10,060.04  yasyekṣvākurupa vrate revānmarāyyedhate |
10,060.04 divīva pañca kṛṣṭayaḥ ||
10,060.05  indra kṣatrāsamātiṣu rathaproṣṭheṣu dhāraya |
10,060.05 divīva sūryaṃ dṛśe ||
10,060.06  agastyasya nadbhyaḥ saptī yunakṣi rohitā |
10,060.06 paṇīnnyakramīrabhi viśvānrājannarādhasaḥ ||
10,060.07  ayaṃ mātāyaṃ pitāyaṃ jīvāturāgamat |
10,060.07 idaṃ tava prasarpaṇaṃ subandhavehi nirihi ||
10,060.08  yathā yugaṃ varatrayā nahyanti dharuṇāya kam |
10,060.08 evā dādhāra te mano jīvātave na mṛtyave'tho ariṣṭatātaye ||
10,060.09  yatheyaṃ pṛthivī mahī dādhāremānvanaspatīn |
10,060.09 evā dādhāra te mano jīvātave na mṛtyave'tho ariṣṭatātaye ||
10,060.10  yamādahaṃ vaivasvatātsubandhormana ābharam |
10,060.10 jīvātave na mṛtyave'tho ariṣṭatātaye ||
10,060.11  nyagvāto'va vāti nyaktapati sūryaḥ |
10,060.11 nīcīnamaghnyā duhe nyagbhavatu te rapaḥ ||
10,060.12  ayaṃ me hasto bhagavānayaṃ me bhagavattaraḥ |
10,060.12 ayaṃ me viśvabheṣajo'yaṃ śivābhimarśanaḥ ||

10,061.01  idamitthā raudraṃ gūrtavacā brahma kratvā śacyāmantarājau |
10,061.01 krāṇā yadasya pitarā maṃhaneṣṭhāḥ parṣatpakthe ahannā sapta hotṝn ||
10,061.02  sa iddānāya dabhyāya vanvañcyavānaḥ sūdairamimīta vedim |
10,061.02 tūrvayāṇo gūrtavacastamaḥ kṣodo na reta itaūti siñcat ||
10,061.03  mano na yeṣu havaneṣu tigmaṃ vipaḥ śacyā vanutho dravantā |
10,061.03 ā yaḥ śaryābhistuvinṛmṇo asyāśrīṇītādiśaṃ gabhastau ||
10,061.04  kṛṣṇā yadgoṣvaruṇīṣu sīdaddivo napātāśvinā huve vām |
10,061.04 vītaṃ me yajñamā gataṃ me annaṃ vavanvāṃsā neṣamasmṛtadhrū ||
10,061.05  prathiṣṭa yasya vīrakarmamiṣṇadanuṣṭhitaṃ nu naryo apauhat |
10,061.05 punastadā vṛhati yatkanāyā duhiturā anubhṛtamanarvā ||
10,061.06  madhyā yatkartvamabhavadabhīke kāmaṃ kṛṇvāne pitari yuvatyām |
10,061.06 manānagreto jahaturviyantā sānau niṣiktaṃ sukṛtasya yonau ||
10,061.07  pitā yatsvāṃ duhitaramadhiṣkankṣmayā retaḥ saṃjagmāno ni ṣiñcat |
10,061.07 svādhyo'janayanbrahma devā vāstoṣpatiṃ vratapāṃ niratakṣan ||
10,061.08  sa īṃ vṛṣā na phenamasyadājau smadā paraidapa dabhracetāḥ |
10,061.08 saratpadā na dakṣiṇā parāvṛṅna tā nu me pṛśanyo jagṛbhre ||
10,061.09  makṣū na vahniḥ prajāyā upabdiragniṃ na nagna upa sīdadūdhaḥ |
10,061.09 sanitedhmaṃ sanitota vājaṃ sa dhartā jajñe sahasā yavīyut ||
10,061.10  makṣū kanāyāḥ sakhyaṃ navagvā ṛtaṃ vadanta ṛtayuktimagman |
10,061.10 dvibarhaso ya upa gopamāguradakṣiṇāso acyutā dudukṣan ||
10,061.11  makṣū kanāyāḥ sakhyaṃ navīyo rādho na reta ṛtamitturaṇyan |
10,061.11 śuci yatte rekṇa āyajanta sabardughāyāḥ paya usriyāyāḥ ||
10,061.12  paśvā yatpaścā viyutā budhanteti bravīti vaktarī rarāṇaḥ |
10,061.12 vasorvasutvā kāravo'nehā viśvaṃ viveṣṭi draviṇamupa kṣu ||
10,061.13  tadinnvasya pariṣadvāno agmanpurū sadanto nārṣadaṃ bibhitsan |
10,061.13 vi śuṣṇasya saṃgrathitamanarvā vidatpuruprajātasya guhā yat ||
10,061.14  bhargo ha nāmota yasya devāḥ svarṇa ye triṣadhasthe niṣeduḥ |
10,061.14 agnirha nāmota jātavedāḥ śrudhī no hotarṛtasya hotādhruk ||
10,061.15  uta tyā me raudrāvarcimantā nāsatyāvindra gūrtaye yajadhyai |
10,061.15 manuṣvadvṛktabarhiṣe rarāṇā mandū hitaprayasā vikṣu yajyū ||
10,061.16  ayaṃ stuto rājā vandi vedhā apaśca viprastarati svasetuḥ |
10,061.16 sa kakṣīvantaṃ rejayatso agniṃ nemiṃ na cakramarvato raghudru ||
10,061.17  sa dvibandhurvaitaraṇo yaṣṭā sabardhuṃ dhenumasvaṃ duhadhyai |
10,061.17 saṃ yanmitrāvaruṇā vṛñja ukthairjyeṣṭhebhiraryamaṇaṃ varūthaiḥ ||
10,061.18  tadbandhuḥ sūrirdivi te dhiyandhā nābhānediṣṭho rapati pra venan |
10,061.18 sā no nābhiḥ paramāsya vā ghāhaṃ tatpaścā katithaścidāsa ||
10,061.19  iyaṃ me nābhiriha me sadhasthamime me devā ayamasmi sarvaḥ |
10,061.19 dvijā aha prathamajā ṛtasyedaṃ dhenuraduhajjāyamānā ||
10,061.20  adhāsu mandro aratirvibhāvāva syati dvivartanirvaneṣāṭ |
10,061.20 ūrdhvā yacchreṇirna śiśurdanmakṣū sthiraṃ śevṛdhaṃ sūta mātā ||
10,061.21  adhā gāva upamātiṃ kanāyā anu śvāntasya kasya citpareyuḥ |
10,061.21 śrudhi tvaṃ sudraviṇo nastvaṃ yāḻ āśvaghnasya vāvṛdhe sūnṛtābhiḥ ||
10,061.22  adha tvamindra viddhyasmānmaho rāye nṛpate vajrabāhuḥ |
10,061.22 rakṣā ca no maghonaḥ pāhi sūrīnanehasaste harivo abhiṣṭau ||
10,061.23  adha yadrājānā gaviṣṭau saratsaraṇyuḥ kārave jaraṇyuḥ |
10,061.23 vipraḥ preṣṭhaḥ sa hyeṣāṃ babhūva parā ca vakṣaduta parṣadenān ||
10,061.24  adhā nvasya jenyasya puṣṭau vṛthā rebhanta īmahe tadū nu |
10,061.24 saraṇyurasya sūnuraśvo vipraścāsi śravasaśca sātau ||
10,061.25  yuvoryadi sakhyāyāsme śardhāya stomaṃ jujuṣe namasvān |
10,061.25 viśvatra yasminnā giraḥ samīcīḥ pūrvīva gāturdāśatsūnṛtāyai ||
10,061.26  sa gṛṇāno adbhirdevavāniti subandhurnamasā sūktaiḥ |
10,061.26 vardhadukthairvacobhirā hi nūnaṃ vyadhvaiti payasa usriyāyāḥ ||
10,061.27  ta ū ṣu ṇo maho yajatrā bhūta devāsa ūtaye sajoṣāḥ |
10,061.27 ye vājāṃ anayatā viyanto ye sthā nicetāro amūrāḥ ||

10,062.01  ye yajñena dakṣiṇayā samaktā indrasya sakhyamamṛtatvamānaśa |
10,062.01 tebhyo bhadramaṅgiraso vo astu prati gṛbhṇīta mānavaṃ sumedhasaḥ ||
10,062.02  ya udājanpitaro gomayaṃ vasvṛtenābhindanparivatsare valam |
10,062.02 dīrghāyutvamaṅgiraso vo astu prati gṛbhṇīta mānavaṃ sumedhasaḥ ||
10,062.03  ya ṛtena sūryamārohayandivyaprathayanpṛthivīṃ mātaraṃ vi |
10,062.03 suprajāstvamaṅgiraso vo astu prati gṛbhṇīta mānavaṃ sumedhasaḥ ||
10,062.04  ayaṃ nābhā vadati valgu vo gṛhe devaputrā ṛṣayastacchṛṇotana |
10,062.04 subrahmaṇyamaṅgiraso vo astu prati gṛbhṇīta mānavaṃ sumedhasaḥ ||
10,062.05  virūpāsa idṛṣayasta idgambhīravepasaḥ |
10,062.05 te aṅgirasaḥ sūnavaste agneḥ pari jajñire ||
10,062.06  ye agneḥ pari jajñire virūpāso divaspari |
10,062.06 navagvo nu daśagvo aṅgirastamo sacā deveṣu maṃhate ||
10,062.07  indreṇa yujā niḥ sṛjanta vāghato vrajaṃ gomantamaśvinam |
10,062.07 sahasraṃ me dadato aṣṭakarṇyaḥ śravo deveṣvakrata ||
10,062.08  pra nūnaṃ jāyatāmayaṃ manustokmeva rohatu |
10,062.08 yaḥ sahasraṃ śatāśvaṃ sadyo dānāya maṃhate ||
10,062.09  na tamaśnoti kaścana diva iva sānvārabham |
10,062.09 sāvarṇyasya dakṣiṇā vi sindhuriva paprathe ||
10,062.10  uta dāsā pariviṣe smaddiṣṭī goparīṇasā |
10,062.10 yadusturvaśca māmahe ||
10,062.11  sahasradā grāmaṇīrmā riṣanmanuḥ sūryeṇāsya yatamānaitu dakṣiṇā |
10,062.11 sāvarṇerdevāḥ pra tirantvāyuryasminnaśrāntā asanāma vājam ||

10,063.01  parāvato ye didhiṣanta āpyaṃ manuprītāso janimā vivasvataḥ |
10,063.01 yayāterye nahuṣyasya barhiṣi devā āsate te adhi bruvantu naḥ ||
10,063.02  viśvā hi vo namasyāni vandyā nāmāni devā uta yajñiyāni vaḥ |
10,063.02 ye stha jātā aditeradbhyaspari ye pṛthivyāste ma iha śrutā havam ||
10,063.03  yebhyo mātā madhumatpinvate payaḥ pīyūṣaṃ dyauraditiradribarhāḥ |
10,063.03 ukthaśuṣmānvṛṣabharānsvapnasastāṃ ādityāṃ anu madā svastaye ||
10,063.04  nṛcakṣaso animiṣanto arhaṇā bṛhaddevāso amṛtatvamānaśuḥ |
10,063.04 jyotīrathā ahimāyā anāgaso divo varṣmāṇaṃ vasate svastaye ||
10,063.05  samrājo ye suvṛdho yajñamāyayuraparihvṛtā dadhire divi kṣayam |
10,063.05 tāṃ ā vivāsa namasā suvṛktibhirmaho ādityāṃ aditiṃ svastaye ||
10,063.06  ko va stomaṃ rādhati yaṃ jujoṣatha viśve devāso manuṣo yati ṣṭhana |
10,063.06 ko vo'dhvaraṃ tuvijātā araṃ karadyo naḥ parṣadatyaṃhaḥ svastaye ||
10,063.07  yebhyo hotrāṃ prathamāmāyeje manuḥ samiddhāgnirmanasā sapta hotṛbhiḥ |
10,063.07 ta ādityā abhayaṃ śarma yacchata sugā naḥ karta supathā svastaye ||
10,063.08  ya īśire bhuvanasya pracetaso viśvasya sthāturjagataśca mantavaḥ |
10,063.08 te naḥ kṛtādakṛtādenasasparyadyā devāsaḥ pipṛtā svastaye ||
10,063.09  bhareṣvindraṃ suhavaṃ havāmahe'ṃhomucaṃ sukṛtaṃ daivyaṃ janam |
10,063.09 agniṃ mitraṃ varuṇaṃ sātaye bhagaṃ dyāvāpṛthivī marutaḥ svastaye ||
10,063.10  sutrāmāṇaṃ pṛthivīṃ dyāmanehasaṃ suśarmāṇamaditiṃ supraṇītim |
10,063.10 daivīṃ nāvaṃ svaritrāmanāgasamasravantīmā ruhemā svastaye ||
10,063.11  viśve yajatrā adhi vocatotaye trāyadhvaṃ no durevāyā abhihrutaḥ |
10,063.11 satyayā vo devahūtyā huvema śṛṇvato devā avase svastaye ||
10,063.12  apāmīvāmapa viśvāmanāhutimapārātiṃ durvidatrāmaghāyataḥ |
10,063.12 āre devā dveṣo asmadyuyotanoru ṇaḥ śarma yacchatā svastaye ||
10,063.13  ariṣṭaḥ sa marto viśva edhate pra prajābhirjāyate dharmaṇaspari |
10,063.13 yamādityāso nayathā sunītibhirati viśvāni duritā svastaye ||
10,063.14  yaṃ devāso'vatha vājasātau yaṃ śūrasātā maruto hite dhane |
10,063.14 prātaryāvāṇaṃ rathamindra sānasimariṣyantamā ruhemā svastaye ||
10,063.15  svasti naḥ pathyāsu dhanvasu svastyapsu vṛjane svarvati |
10,063.15 svasti naḥ putrakṛtheṣu yoniṣu svasti rāye maruto dadhātana ||
10,063.16  svastiriddhi prapathe śreṣṭhā rekṇasvatyabhi yā vāmameti |
10,063.16 sā no amā so araṇe ni pātu svāveśā bhavatu devagopā ||
10,063.17  evā plateḥ sūnuravīvṛdhadvo viśva ādityā adite manīṣī |
10,063.17 īśānāso naro amartyenāstāvi jano divyo gayena ||

10,064.01  kathā devānāṃ katamasya yāmani sumantu nāma śṛṇvatāṃ manāmahe |
10,064.01 ko mṛḻāti katamo no mayaskaratkatama ūtī abhyā vavartati ||
10,064.02  kratūyanti kratavo hṛtsu dhītayo venanti venāḥ patayantyā diśaḥ |
10,064.02 na marḍitā vidyate anya ebhyo deveṣu me adhi kāmā ayaṃsata ||
10,064.03  narā vā śaṃsaṃ pūṣaṇamagohyamagniṃ deveddhamabhyarcase girā |
10,064.03 sūryāmāsā candramasā yamaṃ divi tritaṃ vātamuṣasamaktumaśvinā ||
10,064.04  kathā kavistuvīravānkayā girā bṛhaspatirvāvṛdhate suvṛktibhiḥ |
10,064.04 aja ekapātsuhavebhirṛkvabhirahiḥ śṛṇotu budhnyo havīmani ||
10,064.05  dakṣasya vādite janmani vrate rājānā mitrāvaruṇā vivāsasi |
10,064.05 atūrtapanthāḥ pururatho aryamā saptahotā viṣurūpeṣu janmasu ||
10,064.06  te no arvanto havanaśruto havaṃ viśve śṛṇvantu vājino mitadravaḥ |
10,064.06 sahasrasā medhasātāviva tmanā maho ye dhanaṃ samitheṣu jabhrire ||
10,064.07  pra vo vāyuṃ rathayujaṃ purandhiṃ stomaiḥ kṛṇudhvaṃ sakhyāya pūṣaṇam |
10,064.07 te hi devasya savituḥ savīmani kratuṃ sacante sacitaḥ sacetasaḥ ||
10,064.08  triḥ sapta sasrā nadyo mahīrapo vanaspatīnparvatāṃ agnimūtaye |
10,064.08 kṛśānumastṝntiṣyaṃ sadhastha ā rudraṃ rudreṣu rudriyaṃ havāmahe ||
10,064.09  sarasvatī sarayuḥ sindhurūrmibhirmaho mahīravasā yantu vakṣaṇīḥ |
10,064.09 devīrāpo mātaraḥ sūdayitnvo ghṛtavatpayo madhumanno arcata ||
10,064.10  uta mātā bṛhaddivā śṛṇotu nastvaṣṭā devebhirjanibhiḥ pitā vacaḥ |
10,064.10 ṛbhukṣā vājo rathaspatirbhago raṇvaḥ śaṃsaḥ śaśamānasya pātu naḥ ||
10,064.11  raṇvaḥ saṃdṛṣṭau pitumāṃ iva kṣayo bhadrā rudrāṇāṃ marutāmupastutiḥ |
10,064.11 gobhiḥ ṣyāma yaśaso janeṣvā sadā devāsa iḻayā sacemahi ||
10,064.12  yāṃ me dhiyaṃ maruta indra devā adadāta varuṇa mitra yūyam |
10,064.12 tāṃ pīpayata payaseva dhenuṃ kuvidgiro adhi rathe vahātha ||
10,064.13  kuvidaṅga prati yathā cidasya naḥ sajātyasya maruto bubodhatha |
10,064.13 nābhā yatra prathamaṃ saṃnasāmahe tatra jāmitvamaditirdadhātu naḥ ||
10,064.14  te hi dyāvāpṛthivī mātarā mahī devī devāñjanmanā yajñiye itaḥ |
10,064.14 ubhe bibhṛta ubhayaṃ bharīmabhiḥ purū retāṃsi pitṛbhiśca siñcataḥ ||
10,064.15  vi ṣā hotrā viśvamaśnoti vāryaṃ bṛhaspatiraramatiḥ panīyasī |
10,064.15 grāvā yatra madhuṣuducyate bṛhadavīvaśanta matibhirmanīṣiṇaḥ ||
10,064.16  evā kavistuvīravāṃ ṛtajñā draviṇasyurdraviṇasaścakānaḥ |
10,064.16 ukthebhiratra matibhiśca vipro'pīpayadgayo divyāni janma ||
10,064.17  evā plateḥ sūnuravīvṛdhadvo viśva ādityā adite manīṣī |
10,064.17 īśānāso naro amartyenāstāvi jano divyo gayena ||

10,065.01  agnirindro varuṇo mitro aryamā vāyuḥ pūṣā sarasvatī sajoṣasaḥ |
10,065.01 ādityā viṣṇurmarutaḥ svarbṛhatsomo rudro aditirbrahmaṇaspatiḥ ||
10,065.02  indrāgnī vṛtrahatyeṣu satpatī mitho hinvānā tanvā samokasā |
10,065.02 antarikṣaṃ mahyā paprurojasā somo ghṛtaśrīrmahimānamīrayan ||
10,065.03  teṣāṃ hi mahnā mahatāmanarvaṇāṃ stomāṃ iyarmyṛtajñā ṛtāvṛdhām |
10,065.03 ye apsavamarṇavaṃ citrarādhasaste no rāsantāṃ mahaye sumitryāḥ ||
10,065.04  svarṇaramantarikṣāṇi rocanā dyāvābhūmī pṛthivīṃ skambhurojasā |
10,065.04 pṛkṣā iva mahayantaḥ surātayo devā stavante manuṣāya sūrayaḥ ||
10,065.05  mitrāya śikṣa varuṇāya dāśuṣe yā samrājā manasā na prayucchataḥ |
10,065.05 yayordhāma dharmaṇā rocate bṛhadyayorubhe rodasī nādhasī vṛtau ||
10,065.06  yā gaurvartaniṃ paryeti niṣkṛtaṃ payo duhānā vratanīravārataḥ |
10,065.06 sā prabruvāṇā varuṇāya dāśuṣe devebhyo dāśaddhaviṣā vivasvate ||
10,065.07  divakṣaso agnijihvā ṛtāvṛdha ṛtasya yoniṃ vimṛśanta āsate |
10,065.07 dyāṃ skabhitvyapa ā cakrurojasā yajñaṃ janitvī tanvī ni māmṛjuḥ ||
10,065.08  parikṣitā pitarā pūrvajāvarī ṛtasya yonā kṣayataḥ samokasā |
10,065.08 dyāvāpṛthivī varuṇāya savrate ghṛtavatpayo mahiṣāya pinvataḥ ||
10,065.09  parjanyāvātā vṛṣabhā purīṣiṇendravāyū varuṇo mitro aryamā |
10,065.09 devāṃ ādityāṃ aditiṃ havāmahe ye pārthivāso divyāso apsu ye ||
10,065.10  tvaṣṭāraṃ vāyumṛbhavo ya ohate daivyā hotārā uṣasaṃ svastaye |
10,065.10 bṛhaspatiṃ vṛtrakhādaṃ sumedhasamindriyaṃ somaṃ dhanasā u īmahe ||
10,065.11  brahma gāmaśvaṃ janayanta oṣadhīrvanaspatīnpṛthivīṃ parvatāṃ apaḥ |
10,065.11 sūryaṃ divi rohayantaḥ sudānava āryā vratā visṛjanto adhi kṣami ||
10,065.12  bhujyumaṃhasaḥ pipṛtho niraśvinā śyāvaṃ putraṃ vadhrimatyā ajinvatam |
10,065.12 kamadyuvaṃ vimadāyohathuryuvaṃ viṣṇāpvaṃ viśvakāyāva sṛjathaḥ ||
10,065.13  pāvīravī tanyaturekapādajo divo dhartā sindhurāpaḥ samudriyaḥ |
10,065.13 viśve devāsaḥ śṛṇavanvacāṃsi me sarasvatī saha dhībhiḥ purandhyā ||
10,065.14  viśve devāḥ saha dhībhiḥ purandhyā manoryajatrā amṛtā ṛtajñāḥ |
10,065.14 rātiṣāco abhiṣācaḥ svarvidaḥ svargiro brahma sūktaṃ juṣerata ||
10,065.15  devānvasiṣṭho amṛtānvavande ye viśvā bhuvanābhi pratasthuḥ |
10,065.15 te no rāsantāmurugāyamadya yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

10,066.01  devānhuve bṛhacchravasaḥ svastaye jyotiṣkṛto adhvarasya pracetasaḥ |
10,066.01 ye vāvṛdhuḥ prataraṃ viśvavedasa indrajyeṣṭhāso amṛtā ṛtāvṛdhaḥ ||
10,066.02  indraprasūtā varuṇapraśiṣṭā ye sūryasya jyotiṣo bhāgamānaśuḥ |
10,066.02 marudgaṇe vṛjane manma dhīmahi māghone yajñaṃ janayanta sūrayaḥ ||
10,066.03  indro vasubhiḥ pari pātu no gayamādityairno aditiḥ śarma yacchatu |
10,066.03 rudro rudrebhirdevo mṛḻayāti nastvaṣṭā no gnābhiḥ suvitāya jinvatu ||
10,066.04  aditirdyāvāpṛthivī ṛtaṃ mahadindrāviṣṇū marutaḥ svarbṛhat |
10,066.04 devāṃ ādityāṃ avase havāmahe vasūnrudrānsavitāraṃ sudaṃsasam ||
10,066.05  sarasvāndhībhirvaruṇo dhṛtavrataḥ pūṣā viṣṇurmahimā vāyuraśvinā |
10,066.05 brahmakṛto amṛtā viśvavedasaḥ śarma no yaṃsantrivarūthamaṃhasaḥ ||
10,066.06  vṛṣā yajño vṛṣaṇaḥ santu yajñiyā vṛṣaṇo devā vṛṣaṇo haviṣkṛtaḥ |
10,066.06 vṛṣaṇā dyāvāpṛthivī ṛtāvarī vṛṣā parjanyo vṛṣaṇo vṛṣastubhaḥ ||
10,066.07  agnīṣomā vṛṣaṇā vājasātaye purupraśastā vṛṣaṇā upa bruve |
10,066.07 yāvījire vṛṣaṇo devayajyayā tā naḥ śarma trivarūthaṃ vi yaṃsataḥ ||
10,066.08  dhṛtavratāḥ kṣatriyā yajñaniṣkṛto bṛhaddivā adhvarāṇāmabhiśriyaḥ |
10,066.08 agnihotāra ṛtasāpo adruho'po asṛjannanu vṛtratūrye ||
10,066.09  dyāvāpṛthivī janayannabhi vratāpa oṣadhīrvanināni yajñiyā |
10,066.09 antarikṣaṃ svarā paprurūtaye vaśaṃ devāsastanvī ni māmṛjuḥ ||
10,066.10  dhartāro diva ṛbhavaḥ suhastā vātāparjanyā mahiṣasya tanyatoḥ |
10,066.10 āpa oṣadhīḥ pra tirantu no giro bhago rātirvājino yantu me havam ||
10,066.11  samudraḥ sindhū rajo antarikṣamaja ekapāttanayitnurarṇavaḥ |
10,066.11 ahirbudhnyaḥ śṛṇavadvacāṃsi me viśve devāsa uta sūrayo mama ||
10,066.12  syāma vo manavo devavītaye prāñcaṃ no yajñaṃ pra ṇayata sādhuyā |
10,066.12 ādityā rudrā vasavaḥ sudānava imā brahma śasyamānāni jinvata ||
10,066.13  daivyā hotārā prathamā purohita ṛtasya panthāmanvemi sādhuyā |
10,066.13 kṣetrasya patiṃ prativeśamīmahe viśvāndevāṃ amṛtāṃ aprayucchataḥ ||
10,066.14  vasiṣṭhāsaḥ pitṛvadvācamakrata devāṃ īḻānā ṛṣivatsvastaye |
10,066.14 prītā iva jñātayaḥ kāmametyāsme devāso'va dhūnutā vasu ||
10,066.15  devānvasiṣṭho amṛtānvavande ye viśvā bhuvanābhi pratasthuḥ |
10,066.15 te no rāsantāmurugāyamadya yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

10,067.01  imāṃ dhiyaṃ saptaśīrṣṇīṃ pitā na ṛtaprajātāṃ bṛhatīmavindat |
10,067.01 turīyaṃ svijjanayadviśvajanyo'yāsya ukthamindrāya śaṃsan ||
10,067.02  ṛtaṃ śaṃsanta ṛju dīdhyānā divasputrāso asurasya vīrāḥ |
10,067.02 vipraṃ padamaṅgiraso dadhānā yajñasya dhāma prathamaṃ mananta ||
10,067.03  haṃsairiva sakhibhirvāvadadbhiraśmanmayāni nahanā vyasyan |
10,067.03 bṛhaspatirabhikanikradadgā uta prāstauducca vidvāṃ agāyat ||
10,067.04  avo dvābhyāṃ para ekayā gā guhā tiṣṭhantīranṛtasya setau |
10,067.04 bṛhaspatistamasi jyotiricchannudusrā ākarvi hi tisra āvaḥ ||
10,067.05  vibhidyā puraṃ śayathemapācīṃ nistrīṇi sākamudadherakṛntat |
10,067.05 bṛhaspatiruṣasaṃ sūryaṃ gāmarkaṃ viveda stanayanniva dyauḥ ||
10,067.06  indro valaṃ rakṣitāraṃ dughānāṃ kareṇeva vi cakartā raveṇa |
10,067.06 svedāñjibhirāśiramicchamāno'rodayatpaṇimā gā amuṣṇāt ||
10,067.07  sa īṃ satyebhiḥ sakhibhiḥ śucadbhirgodhāyasaṃ vi dhanasairadardaḥ |
10,067.07 brahmaṇaspatirvṛṣabhirvarāhairgharmasvedebhirdraviṇaṃ vyānaṭ ||
10,067.08  te satyena manasā gopatiṃ gā iyānāsa iṣaṇayanta dhībhiḥ |
10,067.08 bṛhaspatirmithoavadyapebhirudusriyā asṛjata svayugbhiḥ ||
10,067.09  taṃ vardhayanto matibhiḥ śivābhiḥ siṃhamiva nānadataṃ sadhasthe |
10,067.09 bṛhaspatiṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ śūrasātau bharebhare anu madema jiṣṇum ||
10,067.10  yadā vājamasanadviśvarūpamā dyāmarukṣaduttarāṇi sadma |
10,067.10 bṛhaspatiṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ vardhayanto nānā santo bibhrato jyotirāsā ||
10,067.11  satyāmāśiṣaṃ kṛṇutā vayodhai kīriṃ ciddhyavatha svebhirevaiḥ |
10,067.11 paścā mṛdho apa bhavantu viśvāstadrodasī śṛṇutaṃ viśvaminve ||
10,067.12  indro mahnā mahato arṇavasya vi mūrdhānamabhinadarbudasya |
10,067.12 ahannahimariṇātsapta sindhūndevairdyāvāpṛthivī prāvataṃ naḥ ||

10,068.01  udapruto na vayo rakṣamāṇā vāvadato abhriyasyeva ghoṣāḥ |
10,068.01 giribhrajo normayo madanto bṛhaspatimabhyarkā anāvan ||
10,068.02  saṃ gobhirāṅgiraso nakṣamāṇo bhaga ivedaryamaṇaṃ nināya |
10,068.02 jane mitro na dampatī anakti bṛhaspate vājayāśūṃrivājau ||
10,068.03  sādhvaryā atithinīriṣirā spārhāḥ suvarṇā anavadyarūpāḥ |
10,068.03 bṛhaspatiḥ parvatebhyo vitūryā nirgā ūpe yavamiva sthivibhyaḥ ||
10,068.04  āpruṣāyanmadhuna ṛtasya yonimavakṣipannarka ulkāmiva dyoḥ |
10,068.04 bṛhaspatiruddharannaśmano gā bhūmyā udneva vi tvacaṃ bibheda ||
10,068.05  apa jyotiṣā tamo antarikṣādudnaḥ śīpālamiva vāta ājat |
10,068.05 bṛhaspatiranumṛśyā valasyābhramiva vāta ā cakra ā gāḥ ||
10,068.06  yadā valasya pīyato jasuṃ bhedbṛhaspatiragnitapobhirarkaiḥ |
10,068.06 dadbhirna jihvā pariviṣṭamādadāvirnidhīṃrakṛṇodusriyāṇām ||
10,068.07  bṛhaspatiramata hi tyadāsāṃ nāma svarīṇāṃ sadane guhā yat |
10,068.07 āṇḍeva bhittvā śakunasya garbhamudusriyāḥ parvatasya tmanājat ||
10,068.08  aśnāpinaddhaṃ madhu paryapaśyanmatsyaṃ na dīna udani kṣiyantam |
10,068.08 niṣṭajjabhāra camasaṃ na vṛkṣādbṛhaspatirviraveṇā vikṛtya ||
10,068.09  soṣāmavindatsa svaḥ so agniṃ so arkeṇa vi babādhe tamāṃsi |
10,068.09 bṛhaspatirgovapuṣo valasya nirmajjānaṃ na parvaṇo jabhāra ||
10,068.10  himeva parṇā muṣitā vanāni bṛhaspatinākṛpayadvalo gāḥ |
10,068.10 anānukṛtyamapunaścakāra yātsūryāmāsā mitha uccarātaḥ ||
10,068.11  abhi śyāvaṃ na kṛśanebhiraśvaṃ nakṣatrebhiḥ pitaro dyāmapiṃśan |
10,068.11 rātryāṃ tamo adadhurjyotirahanbṛhaspatirbhinadadriṃ vidadgāḥ ||
10,068.12  idamakarma namo abhriyāya yaḥ pūrvīranvānonavīti |
10,068.12 bṛhaspatiḥ sa hi gobhiḥ so aśvaiḥ sa vīrebhiḥ sa nṛbhirno vayo dhāt ||

10,069.01  bhadrā agnervadhryaśvasya saṃdṛśo vāmī praṇītiḥ suraṇā upetayaḥ |
10,069.01 yadīṃ sumitrā viśo agra indhate ghṛtenāhuto jarate davidyutat ||
10,069.02  ghṛtamagnervadhryaśvasya vardhanaṃ ghṛtamannaṃ ghṛtaṃ vasya medanam |
10,069.02 ghṛtenāhuta urviyā vi paprathe sūrya iva rocate sarpirāsutiḥ ||
10,069.03  yatte manuryadanīkaṃ sumitraḥ samīdhe agne tadidaṃ navīyaḥ |
10,069.03 sa revacchoca sa giro juṣasva sa vājaṃ darṣi sa iha śravo dhāḥ ||
10,069.04  yaṃ tvā pūrvamīḻito vadhryaśvaḥ samīdhe agne sa idaṃ juṣasva |
10,069.04 sa na stipā uta bhavā tanūpā dātraṃ rakṣasva yadidaṃ te asme ||
10,069.05  bhavā dyumnī vādhryaśvota gopā mā tvā tārīdabhimātirjanānām |
10,069.05 śūra iva dhṛṣṇuścyavanaḥ sumitraḥ pra nu vocaṃ vādhryaśvasya nāma ||
10,069.06  samajryā parvatyā vasūni dāsā vṛtrāṇyāryā jigetha |
10,069.06 śūra iva dhṛṣṇuścyavano janānāṃ tvamagne pṛtanāyūṃrabhi ṣyāḥ ||
10,069.07  dīrghatanturbṛhadukṣāyamagniḥ sahasrastarīḥ śatanītha ṛbhvā |
10,069.07 dyumāndyumatsu nṛbhirmṛjyamānaḥ sumitreṣu dīdayo devayatsu ||
10,069.08  tve dhenuḥ sudughā jātavedo'saścateva samanā sabardhuk |
10,069.08 tvaṃ nṛbhirdakṣiṇāvadbhiragne sumitrebhiridhyase devayadbhiḥ ||
10,069.09  devāścitte amṛtā jātavedo mahimānaṃ vādhryaśva pra vocan |
10,069.09 yatsampṛcchaṃ mānuṣīrviśa āyantvaṃ nṛbhirajayastvāvṛdhebhiḥ ||
10,069.10  piteva putramabibharupasthe tvāmagne vadhryaśvaḥ saparyan |
10,069.10 juṣāṇo asya samidhaṃ yaviṣṭhota pūrvāṃ avanorvrādhataścit ||
10,069.11  śaśvadagnirvadhryaśvasya śatrūnnṛbhirjigāya sutasomavadbhiḥ |
10,069.11 samanaṃ cidadahaścitrabhāno'va vrādhantamabhinadvṛdhaścit ||
10,069.12  ayamagnirvadhryaśvasya vṛtrahā sanakātpreddho namasopavākyaḥ |
10,069.12 sa no ajāmīṃruta vā vijāmīnabhi tiṣṭha śardhato vādhryaśva ||

10,070.01  imāṃ me agne samidhaṃ juṣasveḻaspade prati haryā ghṛtācīm |
10,070.01 varṣmanpṛthivyāḥ sudinatve ahnāmūrdhvo bhava sukrato devayajyā ||
10,070.02  ā devānāmagrayāveha yātu narāśaṃso viśvarūpebhiraśvaiḥ |
10,070.02 ṛtasya pathā namasā miyedho devebhyo devatamaḥ suṣūdat ||
10,070.03  śaśvattamamīḻate dūtyāya haviṣmanto manuṣyāso agnim |
10,070.03 vahiṣṭhairaśvaiḥ suvṛtā rathenā devānvakṣi ni ṣadeha hotā ||
10,070.04  vi prathatāṃ devajuṣṭaṃ tiraścā dīrghaṃ drāghmā surabhi bhūtvasme |
10,070.04 aheḻatā manasā deva barhirindrajyeṣṭhāṃ uśato yakṣi devān ||
10,070.05  divo vā sānu spṛśatā varīyaḥ pṛthivyā vā mātrayā vi śrayadhvam |
10,070.05 uśatīrdvāro mahinā mahadbhirdevaṃ rathaṃ rathayurdhārayadhvam ||
10,070.06  devī divo duhitarā suśilpe uṣāsānaktā sadatāṃ ni yonau |
10,070.06 ā vāṃ devāsa uśatī uśanta urau sīdantu subhage upasthe ||
10,070.07  ūrdhvo grāvā bṛhadagniḥ samiddhaḥ priyā dhāmānyaditerupasthe |
10,070.07 purohitāvṛtvijā yajñe asminviduṣṭarā draviṇamā yajethām ||
10,070.08  tisro devīrbarhiridaṃ varīya ā sīdata cakṛmā vaḥ syonam |
10,070.08 manuṣvadyajñaṃ sudhitā havīṃṣīḻā devī ghṛtapadī juṣanta ||
10,070.09  deva tvaṣṭaryaddha cārutvamānaḍyadaṅgirasāmabhavaḥ sacābhūḥ |
10,070.09 sa devānāṃ pātha upa pra vidvāṃ uśanyakṣi draviṇodaḥ suratnaḥ ||
10,070.10  vanaspate raśanayā niyūyā devānāṃ pātha upa vakṣi vidvān |
10,070.10 svadāti devaḥ kṛṇavaddhavīṃṣyavatāṃ dyāvāpṛthivī havaṃ me ||
10,070.11  āgne vaha varuṇamiṣṭaye na indraṃ divo maruto antarikṣāt |
10,070.11 sīdantu barhirviśva ā yajatrāḥ svāhā devā amṛtā mādayantām ||

10,071.01  bṛhaspate prathamaṃ vāco agraṃ yatprairata nāmadheyaṃ dadhānāḥ |
10,071.01 yadeṣāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ yadaripramāsītpreṇā tadeṣāṃ nihitaṃ guhāviḥ ||
10,071.02  saktumiva titaunā punanto yatra dhīrā manasā vācamakrata |
10,071.02 atrā sakhāyaḥ sakhyāni jānate bhadraiṣāṃ lakṣmīrnihitādhi vāci ||
10,071.03  yajñena vācaḥ padavīyamāyantāmanvavindannṛṣiṣu praviṣṭām |
10,071.03 tāmābhṛtyā vyadadhuḥ purutrā tāṃ sapta rebhā abhi saṃ navante ||
10,071.04  uta tvaḥ paśyanna dadarśa vācamuta tvaḥ śṛṇvanna śṛṇotyenām |
10,071.04 uto tvasmai tanvaṃ vi sasre jāyeva patya uśatī suvāsāḥ ||
10,071.05  uta tvaṃ sakhye sthirapītamāhurnainaṃ hinvantyapi vājineṣu |
10,071.05 adhenvā carati māyayaiṣa vācaṃ śuśruvāṃ aphalāmapuṣpām ||
10,071.06  yastityāja sacividaṃ sakhāyaṃ na tasya vācyapi bhāgo asti |
10,071.06 yadīṃ śṛṇotyalakaṃ śṛṇoti nahi praveda sukṛtasya panthām ||
10,071.07  akṣaṇvantaḥ karṇavantaḥ sakhāyo manojaveṣvasamā babhūvuḥ |
10,071.07 ādaghnāsa upakakṣāsa u tve hradā iva snātvā u tve dadṛśre ||
10,071.08  hṛdā taṣṭeṣu manaso javeṣu yadbrāhmaṇāḥ saṃyajante sakhāyaḥ |
10,071.08 atrāha tvaṃ vi jahurvedyābhirohabrahmāṇo vi carantyu tve ||
10,071.09  ime ye nārvāṅna paraścaranti na brāhmaṇāso na sutekarāsaḥ |
10,071.09 ta ete vācamabhipadya pāpayā sirīstantraṃ tanvate aprajajñayaḥ ||
10,071.10  sarve nandanti yaśasāgatena sabhāsāhena sakhyā sakhāyaḥ |
10,071.10 kilbiṣaspṛtpituṣaṇirhyeṣāmaraṃ hito bhavati vājināya ||
10,071.11  ṛcāṃ tvaḥ poṣamāste pupuṣvāngāyatraṃ tvo gāyati śakvarīṣu |
10,071.11 brahmā tvo vadati jātavidyāṃ yajñasya mātrāṃ vi mimīta u tvaḥ ||

10,072.01  devānāṃ nu vayaṃ jānā pra vocāma vipanyayā |
10,072.01 uktheṣu śasyamāneṣu yaḥ paśyāduttare yuge ||
10,072.02  brahmaṇaspatiretā saṃ karmāra ivādhamat |
10,072.02 devānāṃ pūrvye yuge'sataḥ sadajāyata ||
10,072.03  devānāṃ yuge prathame'sataḥ sadajāyata |
10,072.03 tadāśā anvajāyanta taduttānapadaspari ||
10,072.04  bhūrjajña uttānapado bhuva āśā ajāyanta |
10,072.04 aditerdakṣo ajāyata dakṣādvaditiḥ pari ||
10,072.05  aditirhyajaniṣṭa dakṣa yā duhitā tava |
10,072.05 tāṃ devā anvajāyanta bhadrā amṛtabandhavaḥ ||
10,072.06  yaddevā adaḥ salile susaṃrabdhā atiṣṭhata |
10,072.06 atrā vo nṛtyatāmiva tīvro reṇurapāyata ||
10,072.07  yaddevā yatayo yathā bhuvanānyapinvata |
10,072.07 atrā samudra ā gūḻhamā sūryamajabhartana ||
10,072.08  aṣṭau putrāso aditerye jātāstanvaspari |
10,072.08 devāṃ upa praitsaptabhiḥ parā mārtāṇḍamāsyat ||
10,072.09  saptabhiḥ putrairaditirupa praitpūrvyaṃ yugam |
10,072.09 prajāyai mṛtyave tvatpunarmārtāṇḍamābharat ||

10,073.01  janiṣṭhā ugraḥ sahase turāya mandra ojiṣṭho bahulābhimānaḥ |
10,073.01 avardhannindraṃ marutaścidatra mātā yadvīraṃ dadhanaddhaniṣṭhā ||
10,073.02  druho niṣattā pṛśanī cidevaiḥ purū śaṃsena vāvṛdhuṣṭa indram |
10,073.02 abhīvṛteva tā mahāpadena dhvāntātprapitvādudaranta garbhāḥ ||
10,073.03  ṛṣvā te pādā pra yajjigāsyavardhanvājā uta ye cidatra |
10,073.03 tvamindra sālāvṛkānsahasramāsandadhiṣe aśvinā vavṛtyāḥ ||
10,073.04  samanā tūrṇirupa yāsi yajñamā nāsatyā sakhyāya vakṣi |
10,073.04 vasāvyāmindra dhārayaḥ sahasrāśvinā śūra dadaturmaghāni ||
10,073.05  mandamāna ṛtādadhi prajāyai sakhibhirindra iṣirebhirartham |
10,073.05 ābhirhi māyā upa dasyumāgānmihaḥ pra tamrā avapattamāṃsi ||
10,073.06  sanāmānā ciddhvasayo nyasmā avāhannindra uṣaso yathānaḥ |
10,073.06 ṛṣvairagacchaḥ sakhibhirnikāmaiḥ sākaṃ pratiṣṭhā hṛdyā jaghantha ||
10,073.07  tvaṃ jaghantha namuciṃ makhasyuṃ dāsaṃ kṛṇvāna ṛṣaye vimāyam |
10,073.07 tvaṃ cakartha manave syonānpatho devatrāñjaseva yānān ||
10,073.08  tvametāni papriṣe vi nāmeśāna indra dadhiṣe gabhastau |
10,073.08 anu tvā devāḥ śavasā madantyuparibudhnānvaninaścakartha ||
10,073.09  cakraṃ yadasyāpsvā niṣattamuto tadasmai madhviccacchadyāt |
10,073.09 pṛthivyāmatiṣitaṃ yadūdhaḥ payo goṣvadadhā oṣadhīṣu ||
10,073.10  aśvādiyāyeti yadvadantyojaso jātamuta manya enam |
10,073.10 manyoriyāya harmyeṣu tasthau yataḥ prajajña indro asya veda ||
10,073.11  vayaḥ suparṇā upa sedurindraṃ priyamedhā ṛṣayo nādhamānāḥ |
10,073.11 apa dhvāntamūrṇuhi pūrdhi cakṣurmumugdhyasmānnidhayeva baddhān ||

10,074.01  vasūnāṃ vā carkṛṣa iyakṣandhiyā vā yajñairvā rodasyoḥ |
10,074.01 arvanto vā ye rayimantaḥ sātau vanuṃ vā ye suśruṇaṃ suśruto dhuḥ ||
10,074.02  hava eṣāmasuro nakṣata dyāṃ śravasyatā manasā niṃsata kṣām |
10,074.02 cakṣāṇā yatra suvitāya devā dyaurna vārebhiḥ kṛṇavanta svaiḥ ||
10,074.03  iyameṣāmamṛtānāṃ gīḥ sarvatātā ye kṛpaṇanta ratnam |
10,074.03 dhiyaṃ ca yajñaṃ ca sādhantaste no dhāntu vasavyamasāmi ||
10,074.04  ā tatta indrāyavaḥ panantābhi ya ūrvaṃ gomantaṃ titṛtsān |
10,074.04 sakṛtsvaṃ ye puruputrāṃ mahīṃ sahasradhārāṃ bṛhatīṃ dudukṣan ||
10,074.05  śacīva indramavase kṛṇudhvamanānataṃ damayantaṃ pṛtanyūn |
10,074.05 ṛbhukṣaṇaṃ maghavānaṃ suvṛktiṃ bhartā yo vajraṃ naryaṃ purukṣuḥ ||
10,074.06  yadvāvāna purutamaṃ purāṣāḻ ā vṛtrahendro nāmānyaprāḥ |
10,074.06 aceti prāsahaspatistuviṣmānyadīmuśmasi kartave karattat ||

10,075.01  pra su va āpo mahimānamuttamaṃ kārurvocāti sadane vivasvataḥ |
10,075.01 pra saptasapta tredhā hi cakramuḥ pra sṛtvarīṇāmati sindhurojasā ||
10,075.02  pra te'radadvaruṇo yātave pathaḥ sindho yadvājāṃ abhyadravastvam |
10,075.02 bhūmyā adhi pravatā yāsi sānunā yadeṣāmagraṃ jagatāmirajyasi ||
10,075.03  divi svano yatate bhūmyoparyanantaṃ śuṣmamudiyarti bhānunā |
10,075.03 abhrādiva pra stanayanti vṛṣṭayaḥ sindhuryadeti vṛṣabho na roruvat ||
10,075.04  abhi tvā sindho śiśuminna mātaro vāśrā arṣanti payaseva dhenavaḥ |
10,075.04 rājeva yudhvā nayasi tvamitsicau yadāsāmagraṃ pravatāminakṣasi ||
10,075.05  imaṃ me gaṅge yamune sarasvati śutudri stomaṃ sacatā paruṣṇyā |
10,075.05 asiknyā marudvṛdhe vitastayārjīkīye śṛṇuhyā suṣomayā ||
10,075.06  tṛṣṭāmayā prathamaṃ yātave sajūḥ susartvā rasayā śvetyā tyā |
10,075.06 tvaṃ sindho kubhayā gomatīṃ krumuṃ mehatnvā sarathaṃ yābhirīyase ||
10,075.07  ṛjītyenī ruśatī mahitvā pari jrayāṃsi bharate rajāṃsi |
10,075.07 adabdhā sindhurapasāmapastamāśvā na citrā vapuṣīva darśatā ||
10,075.08  svaśvā sindhuḥ surathā suvāsā hiraṇyayī sukṛtā vājinīvatī |
10,075.08 ūrṇāvatī yuvatiḥ sīlamāvatyutādhi vaste subhagā madhuvṛdham ||
10,075.09  sukhaṃ rathaṃ yuyuje sindhuraśvinaṃ tena vājaṃ saniṣadasminnājau |
10,075.09 mahānhyasya mahimā panasyate'dabdhasya svayaśaso virapśinaḥ ||

10,076.01  ā va ṛñjasa ūrjāṃ vyuṣṭiṣvindraṃ maruto rodasī anaktana |
10,076.01 ubhe yathā no ahanī sacābhuvā sadaḥsado varivasyāta udbhidā ||
10,076.02  tadu śreṣṭhaṃ savanaṃ sunotanātyo na hastayato adriḥ sotari |
10,076.02 vidaddhyaryo abhibhūti pauṃsyaṃ maho rāye cittarute yadarvataḥ ||
10,076.03  tadiddhyasya savanaṃ viverapo yathā purā manave gātumaśret |
10,076.03 goarṇasi tvāṣṭre aśvanirṇiji premadhvareṣvadhvarāṃ aśiśrayuḥ ||
10,076.04  apa hata rakṣaso bhaṅgurāvata skabhāyata nirṛtiṃ sedhatāmatim |
10,076.04 ā no rayiṃ sarvavīraṃ sunotana devāvyaṃ bharata ślokamadrayaḥ ||
10,076.05  divaścidā vo'mavattarebhyo vibhvanā cidāśvapastarebhyaḥ |
10,076.05 vāyościdā somarabhastarebhyo'gneścidarca pitukṛttarebhyaḥ ||
10,076.06  bhurantu no yaśasaḥ sotvandhaso grāvāṇo vācā divitā divitmatā |
10,076.06 naro yatra duhate kāmyaṃ madhvāghoṣayanto abhito mithasturaḥ ||
10,076.07  sunvanti somaṃ rathirāso adrayo nirasya rasaṃ gaviṣo duhanti te |
10,076.07 duhantyūdharupasecanāya kaṃ naro havyā na marjayanta āsabhiḥ ||
10,076.08  ete naraḥ svapaso abhūtana ya indrāya sunutha somamadrayaḥ |
10,076.08 vāmaṃvāmaṃ vo divyāya dhāmne vasuvasu vaḥ pārthivāya sunvate ||

10,077.01  abhrapruṣo na vācā pruṣā vasu haviṣmanto na yajñā vijānuṣaḥ |
10,077.01 sumārutaṃ na brahmāṇamarhase gaṇamastoṣyeṣāṃ na śobhase ||
10,077.02  śriye maryāso añjīṃrakṛṇvata sumārutaṃ na pūrvīrati kṣapaḥ |
10,077.02 divasputrāsa etā na yetira ādityāsaste akrā na vāvṛdhuḥ ||
10,077.03  pra ye divaḥ pṛthivyā na barhaṇā tmanā riricre abhrānna sūryaḥ |
10,077.03 pājasvanto na vīrāḥ panasyavo riśādaso na maryā abhidyavaḥ ||
10,077.04  yuṣmākaṃ budhne apāṃ na yāmani vithuryati na mahī śratharyati |
10,077.04 viśvapsuryajño arvāgayaṃ su vaḥ prayasvanto na satrāca ā gata ||
10,077.05  yūyaṃ dhūrṣu prayujo na raśmibhirjyotiṣmanto na bhāsā vyuṣṭiṣu |
10,077.05 śyenāso na svayaśaso riśādasaḥ pravāso na prasitāsaḥ paripruṣaḥ ||
10,077.06  pra yadvahadhve marutaḥ parākādyūyaṃ mahaḥ saṃvaraṇasya vasvaḥ |
10,077.06 vidānāso vasavo rādhyasyārācciddveṣaḥ sanutaryuyota ||
10,077.07  ya udṛci yajñe adhvareṣṭhā marudbhyo na mānuṣo dadāśat |
10,077.07 revatsa vayo dadhate suvīraṃ sa devānāmapi gopīthe astu ||
10,077.08  te hi yajñeṣu yajñiyāsa ūmā ādityena nāmnā śambhaviṣṭhāḥ |
10,077.08 te no'vantu rathatūrmanīṣāṃ mahaśca yāmannadhvare cakānāḥ ||

10,078.01  viprāso na manmabhiḥ svādhyo devāvyo na yajñaiḥ svapnasaḥ |
10,078.01 rājāno na citrāḥ susaṃdṛśaḥ kṣitīnāṃ na maryā arepasaḥ ||
10,078.02  agnirna ye bhrājasā rukmavakṣaso vātāso na svayujaḥ sadyaūtayaḥ |
10,078.02 prajñātāro na jyeṣṭhāḥ sunītayaḥ suśarmāṇo na somā ṛtaṃ yate ||
10,078.03  vātāso na ye dhunayo jigatnavo'gnīnāṃ na jihvā virokiṇaḥ |
10,078.03 varmaṇvanto na yodhāḥ śimīvantaḥ pitṝṇāṃ na śaṃsāḥ surātayaḥ ||
10,078.04  rathānāṃ na ye'rāḥ sanābhayo jigīvāṃso na śūrā abhidyavaḥ |
10,078.04 vareyavo na maryā ghṛtapruṣo'bhisvartāro arkaṃ na suṣṭubhaḥ ||
10,078.05  aśvāso na ye jyeṣṭhāsa āśavo didhiṣavo na rathyaḥ sudānavaḥ |
10,078.05 āpo na nimnairudabhirjigatnavo viśvarūpā aṅgiraso na sāmabhiḥ ||
10,078.06  grāvāṇo na sūrayaḥ sindhumātara ādardirāso adrayo na viśvahā |
10,078.06 śiśūlā na krīḻayaḥ sumātaro mahāgrāmo na yāmannuta tviṣā ||
10,078.07  uṣasāṃ na ketavo'dhvaraśriyaḥ śubhaṃyavo nāñjibhirvyaśvitan |
10,078.07 sindhavo na yayiyo bhrājadṛṣṭayaḥ parāvato na yojanāni mamire ||
10,078.08  subhāgānno devāḥ kṛṇutā suratnānasmānstotṝnmaruto vāvṛdhānāḥ |
10,078.08 adhi stotrasya sakhyasya gāta sanāddhi vo ratnadheyāni santi ||

10,079.01  apaśyamasya mahato mahitvamamartyasya martyāsu vikṣu |
10,079.01 nānā hanū vibhṛte saṃ bharete asinvatī bapsatī bhūryattaḥ ||
10,079.02  guhā śiro nihitamṛdhagakṣī asinvannatti jihvayā vanāni |
10,079.02 atrāṇyasmai paḍbhiḥ saṃ bharantyuttānahastā namasādhi vikṣu ||
10,079.03  pra mātuḥ prataraṃ guhyamicchankumāro na vīrudhaḥ sarpadurvīḥ |
10,079.03 sasaṃ na pakvamavidacchucantaṃ ririhvāṃsaṃ ripa upasthe antaḥ ||
10,079.04  tadvāmṛtaṃ rodasī pra bravīmi jāyamāno mātarā garbho atti |
10,079.04 nāhaṃ devasya martyaściketāgniraṅga vicetāḥ sa pracetāḥ ||
10,079.05  yo asmā annaṃ tṛṣvādadhātyājyairghṛtairjuhoti puṣyati |
10,079.05 tasmai sahasramakṣabhirvi cakṣe'gne viśvataḥ pratyaṅṅasi tvam ||
10,079.06  kiṃ deveṣu tyaja enaścakarthāgne pṛcchāmi nu tvāmavidvān |
10,079.06 akrīḻankrīḻanharirattave'danvi parvaśaścakarta gāmivāsiḥ ||
10,079.07  viṣūco aśvānyuyuje vanejā ṛjītibhī raśanābhirgṛbhītān |
10,079.07 cakṣade mitro vasubhiḥ sujātaḥ samānṛdhe parvabhirvāvṛdhānaḥ ||

10,080.01  agniḥ saptiṃ vājambharaṃ dadātyagnirvīraṃ śrutyaṃ karmaniṣṭhām |
10,080.01 agnī rodasī vi caratsamañjannagnirnārīṃ vīrakukṣiṃ purandhim ||
10,080.02  agnerapnasaḥ samidastu bhadrāgnirmahī rodasī ā viveśa |
10,080.02 agnirekaṃ codayatsamatsvagnirvṛtrāṇi dayate purūṇi ||
10,080.03  agnirha tyaṃ jarataḥ karṇamāvāgniradbhyo niradahajjarūtham |
10,080.03 agniratriṃ gharma uruṣyadantaragnirnṛmedhaṃ prajayāsṛjatsam ||
10,080.04  agnirdāddraviṇaṃ vīrapeśā agnirṛṣiṃ yaḥ sahasrā sanoti |
10,080.04 agnirdivi havyamā tatānāgnerdhāmāni vibhṛtā purutrā ||
10,080.05  agnimukthairṛṣayo vi hvayante'gniṃ naro yāmani bādhitāsaḥ |
10,080.05 agniṃ vayo antarikṣe patanto'gniḥ sahasrā pari yāti gonām ||
10,080.06  agniṃ viśa īḻate mānuṣīryā agniṃ manuṣo nahuṣo vi jātāḥ |
10,080.06 agnirgāndharvīṃ pathyāmṛtasyāgnergavyūtirghṛta ā niṣattā ||
10,080.07  agnaye brahma ṛbhavastatakṣuragniṃ mahāmavocāmā suvṛktim |
10,080.07 agne prāva jaritāraṃ yaviṣṭhāgne mahi draviṇamā yajasva ||

10,081.01  ya imā viśvā bhuvanāni juhvadṛṣirhotā nyasīdatpitā naḥ |
10,081.01 sa āśiṣā draviṇamicchamānaḥ prathamacchadavarāṃ ā viveśa ||
10,081.02  kiṃ svidāsīdadhiṣṭhānamārambhaṇaṃ katamatsvitkathāsīt |
10,081.02 yato bhūmiṃ janayanviśvakarmā vi dyāmaurṇonmahinā viśvacakṣāḥ ||
10,081.03  viśvataścakṣuruta viśvatomukho viśvatobāhuruta viśvataspāt |
10,081.03 saṃ bāhubhyāṃ dhamati saṃ patatrairdyāvābhūmī janayandeva ekaḥ ||
10,081.04  kiṃ svidvanaṃ ka u sa vṛkṣa āsa yato dyāvāpṛthivī niṣṭatakṣuḥ |
10,081.04 manīṣiṇo manasā pṛcchatedu tadyadadhyatiṣṭhadbhuvanāni dhārayan ||
10,081.05  yā te dhāmāni paramāṇi yāvamā yā madhyamā viśvakarmannutemā |
10,081.05 śikṣā sakhibhyo haviṣi svadhāvaḥ svayaṃ yajasva tanvaṃ vṛdhānaḥ ||
10,081.06  viśvakarmanhaviṣā vāvṛdhānaḥ svayaṃ yajasva pṛthivīmuta dyām |
10,081.06 muhyantvanye abhito janāsa ihāsmākaṃ maghavā sūrirastu ||
10,081.07  vācaspatiṃ viśvakarmāṇamūtaye manojuvaṃ vāje adyā huvema |
10,081.07 sa no viśvāni havanāni joṣadviśvaśambhūravase sādhukarmā ||

10,082.01  cakṣuṣaḥ pitā manasā hi dhīro ghṛtamene ajanannannamāne |
10,082.01 yadedantā adadṛhanta pūrva ādiddyāvāpṛthivī aprathetām ||
10,082.02  viśvakarmā vimanā ādvihāyā dhātā vidhātā paramota saṃdṛk |
10,082.02 teṣāmiṣṭāni samiṣā madanti yatrā saptaṛṣīnpara ekamāhuḥ ||
10,082.03  yo naḥ pitā janitā yo vidhātā dhāmāni veda bhuvanāni viśvā |
10,082.03 yo devānāṃ nāmadhā eka eva taṃ sampraśnaṃ bhuvanā yantyanyā ||
10,082.04  ta āyajanta draviṇaṃ samasmā ṛṣayaḥ pūrve jaritāro na bhūnā |
10,082.04 asūrte sūrte rajasi niṣatte ye bhūtāni samakṛṇvannimāni ||
10,082.05  paro divā para enā pṛthivyā paro devebhirasurairyadasti |
10,082.05 kaṃ svidgarbhaṃ prathamaṃ dadhra āpo yatra devāḥ samapaśyanta viśve ||
10,082.06  tamidgarbhaṃ prathamaṃ dadhra āpo yatra devāḥ samagacchanta viśve |
10,082.06 ajasya nābhāvadhyekamarpitaṃ yasminviśvāni bhuvanāni tasthuḥ ||
10,082.07  na taṃ vidātha ya imā jajānānyadyuṣmākamantaraṃ babhūva |
10,082.07 nīhāreṇa prāvṛtā jalpyā cāsutṛpa ukthaśāsaścaranti ||

10,083.01  yaste manyo'vidhadvajra sāyaka saha ojaḥ puṣyati viśvamānuṣak |
10,083.01 sāhyāma dāsamāryaṃ tvayā yujā sahaskṛtena sahasā sahasvatā ||
10,083.02  manyurindro manyurevāsa devo manyurhotā varuṇo jātavedāḥ |
10,083.02 manyuṃ viśa īḻate mānuṣīryāḥ pāhi no manyo tapasā sajoṣāḥ ||
10,083.03  abhīhi manyo tavasastavīyāntapasā yujā vi jahi śatrūn |
10,083.03 amitrahā vṛtrahā dasyuhā ca viśvā vasūnyā bharā tvaṃ naḥ ||
10,083.04  tvaṃ hi manyo abhibhūtyojāḥ svayambhūrbhāmo abhimātiṣāhaḥ |
10,083.04 viśvacarṣaṇiḥ sahuriḥ sahāvānasmāsvojaḥ pṛtanāsu dhehi ||
10,083.05  abhāgaḥ sannapa pareto asmi tava kratvā taviṣasya pracetaḥ |
10,083.05 taṃ tvā manyo akraturjihīḻāhaṃ svā tanūrbaladeyāya mehi ||
10,083.06  ayaṃ te asmyupa mehyarvāṅpratīcīnaḥ sahure viśvadhāyaḥ |
10,083.06 manyo vajrinnabhi māmā vavṛtsva hanāva dasyūṃruta bodhyāpeḥ ||
10,083.07  abhi prehi dakṣiṇato bhavā me'dhā vṛtrāṇi jaṅghanāva bhūri |
10,083.07 juhomi te dharuṇaṃ madhvo agramubhā upāṃśu prathamā pibāva ||

10,084.01  tvayā manyo sarathamārujanto harṣamāṇāso dhṛṣitā marutvaḥ |
10,084.01 tigmeṣava āyudhā saṃśiśānā abhi pra yantu naro agnirūpāḥ ||
10,084.02  agniriva manyo tviṣitaḥ sahasva senānīrnaḥ sahure hūta edhi |
10,084.02 hatvāya śatrūnvi bhajasva veda ojo mimāno vi mṛdho nudasva ||
10,084.03  sahasva manyo abhimātimasme rujanmṛṇanpramṛṇanprehi śatrūn |
10,084.03 ugraṃ te pājo nanvā rurudhre vaśī vaśaṃ nayasa ekaja tvam ||
10,084.04  eko bahūnāmasi manyavīḻito viśaṃviśaṃ yudhaye saṃ śiśādhi |
10,084.04 akṛttaruktvayā yujā vayaṃ dyumantaṃ ghoṣaṃ vijayāya kṛṇmahe ||
10,084.05  vijeṣakṛdindra ivānavabravo'smākaṃ manyo adhipā bhaveha |
10,084.05 priyaṃ te nāma sahure gṛṇīmasi vidmā tamutsaṃ yata ābabhūtha ||
10,084.06  ābhūtyā sahajā vajra sāyaka saho bibharṣyabhibhūta uttaram |
10,084.06 kratvā no manyo saha medyedhi mahādhanasya puruhūta saṃsṛji ||
10,084.07  saṃsṛṣṭaṃ dhanamubhayaṃ samākṛtamasmabhyaṃ dattāṃ varuṇaśca manyuḥ |
10,084.07 bhiyaṃ dadhānā hṛdayeṣu śatravaḥ parājitāso apa ni layantām ||

10,085.01  satyenottabhitā bhūmiḥ sūryeṇottabhitā dyauḥ |
10,085.01 ṛtenādityāstiṣṭhanti divi somo adhi śritaḥ ||
10,085.02  somenādityā balinaḥ somena pṛthivī mahī |
10,085.02 atho nakṣatrāṇāmeṣāmupasthe soma āhitaḥ ||
10,085.03  somaṃ manyate papivānyatsampiṃṣantyoṣadhim |
10,085.03 somaṃ yaṃ brahmāṇo vidurna tasyāśnāti kaścana ||
10,085.04  ācchadvidhānairgupito bārhataiḥ soma rakṣitaḥ |
10,085.04 grāvṇāmicchṛṇvantiṣṭhasi na te aśnāti pārthivaḥ ||
10,085.05  yattvā deva prapibanti tata ā pyāyase punaḥ |
10,085.05 vāyuḥ somasya rakṣitā samānāṃ māsa ākṛtiḥ ||
10,085.06  raibhyāsīdanudeyī nārāśaṃsī nyocanī |
10,085.06 sūryāyā bhadramidvāso gāthayaiti pariṣkṛtam ||
10,085.07  cittirā upabarhaṇaṃ cakṣurā abhyañjanam |
10,085.07 dyaurbhūmiḥ kośa āsīdyadayātsūryā patim ||
10,085.08  stomā āsanpratidhayaḥ kurīraṃ chanda opaśaḥ |
10,085.08 sūryāyā aśvinā varāgnirāsītpurogavaḥ ||
10,085.09  somo vadhūyurabhavadaśvināstāmubhā varā |
10,085.09 sūryāṃ yatpatye śaṃsantīṃ manasā savitādadāt ||
10,085.10  mano asyā ana āsīddyaurāsīduta cchadiḥ |
10,085.10 śukrāvanaḍvāhāvāstāṃ yadayātsūryā gṛham ||
10,085.11  ṛksāmābhyāmabhihitau gāvau te sāmanāvitaḥ |
10,085.11 śrotraṃ te cakre āstāṃ divi panthāścarācāraḥ ||
10,085.12  śucī te cakre yātyā vyāno akṣa āhataḥ |
10,085.12 ano manasmayaṃ sūryārohatprayatī patim ||
10,085.13  sūryāyā vahatuḥ prāgātsavitā yamavāsṛjat |
10,085.13 aghāsu hanyante gāvo'rjunyoḥ paryuhyate ||
10,085.14  yadaśvinā pṛcchamānāvayātaṃ tricakreṇa vahatuṃ sūryāyāḥ |
10,085.14 viśve devā anu tadvāmajānanputraḥ pitarāvavṛṇīta pūṣā ||
10,085.15  yadayātaṃ śubhaspatī vareyaṃ sūryāmupa |
10,085.15 kvaikaṃ cakraṃ vāmāsītkva deṣṭrāya tasthathuḥ ||
10,085.16  dve te cakre sūrye brahmāṇa ṛtuthā viduḥ |
10,085.16 athaikaṃ cakraṃ yadguhā tadaddhātaya idviduḥ ||
10,085.17  sūryāyai devebhyo mitrāya varuṇāya ca |
10,085.17 ye bhūtasya pracetasa idaṃ tebhyo'karaṃ namaḥ ||
10,085.18  pūrvāparaṃ carato māyayaitau śiśū krīḻantau pari yāto adhvaram |
10,085.18 viśvānyanyo bhuvanābhicaṣṭa ṛtūṃranyo vidadhajjāyate punaḥ ||
10,085.19  navonavo bhavati jāyamāno'hnāṃ keturuṣasāmetyagram |
10,085.19 bhāgaṃ devebhyo vi dadhātyāyanpra candramāstirate dīrghamāyuḥ ||
10,085.20  sukiṃśukaṃ śalmaliṃ viśvarūpaṃ hiraṇyavarṇaṃ suvṛtaṃ sucakram |
10,085.20 ā roha sūrye amṛtasya lokaṃ syonaṃ patye vahatuṃ kṛṇuṣva ||
10,085.21  udīrṣvātaḥ pativatī hyeṣā viśvāvasuṃ namasā gīrbhirīḻe |
10,085.21 anyāmiccha pitṛṣadaṃ vyaktāṃ sa te bhāgo januṣā tasya viddhi ||
10,085.22  udīrṣvāto viśvāvaso namaseḻā mahe tvā |
10,085.22 anyāmiccha prapharvyaṃ saṃ jāyāṃ patyā sṛja ||
10,085.23  anṛkṣarā ṛjavaḥ santu panthā yebhiḥ sakhāyo yanti no vareyam |
10,085.23 samaryamā saṃ bhago no ninīyātsaṃ jāspatyaṃ suyamamastu devāḥ ||
10,085.24  pra tvā muñcāmi varuṇasya pāśādyena tvābadhnātsavitā suśevaḥ |
10,085.24 ṛtasya yonau sukṛtasya loke'riṣṭāṃ tvā saha patyā dadhāmi ||
10,085.25  preto muñcāmi nāmutaḥ subaddhāmamutaskaram |
10,085.25 yatheyamindra mīḍhvaḥ suputrā subhagāsati ||
10,085.26  pūṣā tveto nayatu hastagṛhyāśvinā tvā pra vahatāṃ rathena |
10,085.26 gṛhāngaccha gṛhapatnī yathāso vaśinī tvaṃ vidathamā vadāsi ||
10,085.27  iha priyaṃ prajayā te samṛdhyatāmasmingṛhe gārhapatyāya jāgṛhi |
10,085.27 enā patyā tanvaṃ saṃ sṛjasvādhā jivrī vidathamā vadāthaḥ ||
10,085.28  nīlalohitaṃ bhavati kṛtyāsaktirvyajyate |
10,085.28 edhante asyā jñātayaḥ patirbandheṣu badhyate ||
10,085.29  parā dehi śāmulyaṃ brahmabhyo vi bhajā vasu |
10,085.29 kṛtyaiṣā padvatī bhūtvyā jāyā viśate patim ||
10,085.30  aśrīrā tanūrbhavati ruśatī pāpayāmuyā |
10,085.30 patiryadvadhvo vāsasā svamaṅgamabhidhitsate ||
10,085.31  ye vadhvaścandraṃ vahatuṃ yakṣmā yanti janādanu |
10,085.31 punastānyajñiyā devā nayantu yata āgatāḥ ||
10,085.32  mā vidanparipanthino ya āsīdanti dampatī |
10,085.32 sugebhirdurgamatītāmapa drāntvarātayaḥ ||
10,085.33  sumaṅgalīriyaṃ vadhūrimāṃ sameta paśyata |
10,085.33 saubhāgyamasyai dattvāyāthāstaṃ vi paretana ||
10,085.34  tṛṣṭametatkaṭukametadapāṣṭhavadviṣavannaitadattave |
10,085.34 sūryāṃ yo brahmā vidyātsa idvādhūyamarhati ||
10,085.35  āśasanaṃ viśasanamatho adhivikartanam |
10,085.35 sūryāyāḥ paśya rūpāṇi tāni brahmā tu śundhati ||
10,085.36  gṛbhṇāmi te saubhagatvāya hastaṃ mayā patyā jaradaṣṭiryathāsaḥ |
10,085.36 bhago aryamā savitā purandhirmahyaṃ tvādurgārhapatyāya devāḥ ||
10,085.37  tāṃ pūṣañchivatamāmerayasva yasyāṃ bījaṃ manuṣyā vapanti |
10,085.37 yā na ūrū uśatī viśrayāte yasyāmuśantaḥ praharāma śepam ||
10,085.38  tubhyamagre paryavahansūryāṃ vahatunā saha |
10,085.38 punaḥ patibhyo jāyāṃ dā agne prajayā saha ||
10,085.39  punaḥ patnīmagniradādāyuṣā saha varcasā |
10,085.39 dīrghāyurasyā yaḥ patirjīvāti śaradaḥ śatam ||
10,085.40  somaḥ prathamo vivide gandharvo vivida uttaraḥ |
10,085.40 tṛtīyo agniṣṭe patisturīyaste manuṣyajāḥ ||
10,085.41  somo dadadgandharvāya gandharvo dadadagnaye |
10,085.41 rayiṃ ca putrāṃścādādagnirmahyamatho imām ||
10,085.42  ihaiva staṃ mā vi yauṣṭaṃ viśvamāyurvyaśnutam |
10,085.42 krīḻantau putrairnaptṛbhirmodamānau sve gṛhe ||
10,085.43  ā naḥ prajāṃ janayatu prajāpatirājarasāya samanaktvaryamā |
10,085.43 adurmaṅgalīḥ patilokamā viśa śaṃ no bhava dvipade śaṃ catuṣpade ||
10,085.44  aghoracakṣurapatighnyedhi śivā paśubhyaḥ sumanāḥ suvarcāḥ |
10,085.44 vīrasūrdevakāmā syonā śaṃ no bhava dvipade śaṃ catuṣpade ||
10,085.45  imāṃ tvamindra mīḍhvaḥ suputrāṃ subhagāṃ kṛṇu |
10,085.45 daśāsyāṃ putrānā dhehi patimekādaśaṃ kṛdhi ||
10,085.46  samrājñī śvaśure bhava samrājñī śvaśrvāṃ bhava |
10,085.46 nanāndari samrājñī bhava samrājñī adhi devṛṣu ||
10,085.47  samañjantu viśve devāḥ samāpo hṛdayāni nau |
10,085.47 saṃ mātariśvā saṃ dhātā samu deṣṭrī dadhātu nau ||

10,086.01  vi hi sotorasṛkṣata nendraṃ devamamaṃsata |
10,086.01 yatrāmadadvṛṣākapiraryaḥ puṣṭeṣu matsakhā viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ ||
10,086.02  parā hīndra dhāvasi vṛṣākaperati vyathiḥ |
10,086.02 no aha pra vindasyanyatra somapītaye viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ ||
10,086.03  kimayaṃ tvāṃ vṛṣākapiścakāra harito mṛgaḥ |
10,086.03 yasmā irasyasīdu nvaryo vā puṣṭimadvasu viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ ||
10,086.04  yamimaṃ tvaṃ vṛṣākapiṃ priyamindrābhirakṣasi |
10,086.04 śvā nvasya jambhiṣadapi karṇe varāhayurviśvasmādindra uttaraḥ ||
10,086.05  priyā taṣṭāni me kapirvyaktā vyadūduṣat |
10,086.05 śiro nvasya rāviṣaṃ na sugaṃ duṣkṛte bhuvaṃ viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ ||
10,086.06  na matstrī subhasattarā na suyāśutarā bhuvat |
10,086.06 na matpraticyavīyasī na sakthyudyamīyasī viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ ||
10,086.07  uve amba sulābhike yathevāṅga bhaviṣyati |
10,086.07 bhasanme amba sakthi me śiro me vīva hṛṣyati viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ ||
10,086.08  kiṃ subāho svaṅgure pṛthuṣṭo pṛthujāghane |
10,086.08 kiṃ śūrapatni nastvamabhyamīṣi vṛṣākapiṃ viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ ||
10,086.09  avīrāmiva māmayaṃ śarārurabhi manyate |
10,086.09 utāhamasmi vīriṇīndrapatnī marutsakhā viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ ||
10,086.10  saṃhotraṃ sma purā nārī samanaṃ vāva gacchati |
10,086.10 vedhā ṛtasya vīriṇīndrapatnī mahīyate viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ ||
10,086.11  indrāṇīmāsu nāriṣu subhagāmahamaśravam |
10,086.11 nahyasyā aparaṃ cana jarasā marate patirviśvasmādindra uttaraḥ ||
10,086.12  nāhamindrāṇi rāraṇa sakhyurvṛṣākaperṛte |
10,086.12 yasyedamapyaṃ haviḥ priyaṃ deveṣu gacchati viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ ||
10,086.13  vṛṣākapāyi revati suputra ādu susnuṣe |
10,086.13 ghasatta indra ukṣaṇaḥ priyaṃ kācitkaraṃ havirviśvasmādindra uttaraḥ ||
10,086.14  ukṣṇo hi me pañcadaśa sākaṃ pacanti viṃśatim |
10,086.14 utāhamadmi pīva idubhā kukṣī pṛṇanti me viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ ||
10,086.15  vṛṣabho na tigmaśṛṅgo'ntaryūtheṣu roruvat |
10,086.15 manthasta indra śaṃ hṛde yaṃ te sunoti bhāvayurviśvasmādindra uttaraḥ ||
10,086.16  na seśe yasya rambate'ntarā sakthyā kapṛt |
10,086.16 sedīśe yasya romaśaṃ niṣeduṣo vijṛmbhate viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ ||
10,086.17  na seśe yasya romaśaṃ niṣeduṣo vijṛmbhate |
10,086.17 sedīśe yasya rambate'ntarā sakthyā kapṛdviśvasmādindra uttaraḥ ||
10,086.18  ayamindra vṛṣākapiḥ parasvantaṃ hataṃ vidat |
10,086.18 asiṃ sūnāṃ navaṃ carumādedhasyāna ācitaṃ viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ ||
10,086.19  ayamemi vicākaśadvicinvandāsamāryam |
10,086.19 pibāmi pākasutvano'bhi dhīramacākaśaṃ viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ ||
10,086.20  dhanva ca yatkṛntatraṃ ca kati svittā vi yojanā |
10,086.20 nedīyaso vṛṣākape'stamehi gṛhāṃ upa viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ ||
10,086.21  punarehi vṛṣākape suvitā kalpayāvahai |
10,086.21 ya eṣa svapnanaṃśano'stameṣi pathā punarviśvasmādindra uttaraḥ ||
10,086.22  yadudañco vṛṣākape gṛhamindrājagantana |
10,086.22 kva sya pulvagho mṛgaḥ kamagañjanayopano viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ ||
10,086.23  parśurha nāma mānavī sākaṃ sasūva viṃśatim |
10,086.23 bhadraṃ bhala tyasyā abhūdyasyā udaramāmayadviśvasmādindra uttaraḥ ||

10,087.01  rakṣohaṇaṃ vājinamā jigharmi mitraṃ prathiṣṭhamupa yāmi śarma |
10,087.01 śiśāno agniḥ kratubhiḥ samiddhaḥ sa no divā sa riṣaḥ pātu naktam ||
10,087.02  ayodaṃṣṭro arciṣā yātudhānānupa spṛśa jātavedaḥ samiddhaḥ |
10,087.02 ā jihvayā mūradevānrabhasva kravyādo vṛktvyapi dhatsvāsan ||
10,087.03  ubhobhayāvinnupa dhehi daṃṣṭrā hiṃsraḥ śiśāno'varaṃ paraṃ ca |
10,087.03 utāntarikṣe pari yāhi rājañjambhaiḥ saṃ dhehyabhi yātudhānān ||
10,087.04  yajñairiṣūḥ saṃnamamāno agne vācā śalyāṃ aśanibhirdihānaḥ |
10,087.04 tābhirvidhya hṛdaye yātudhānānpratīco bāhūnprati bhaṅdhyeṣām ||
10,087.05  agne tvacaṃ yātudhānasya bhindhi hiṃsrāśanirharasā hantvenam |
10,087.05 pra parvāṇi jātavedaḥ śṛṇīhi kravyātkraviṣṇurvi cinotu vṛkṇam ||
10,087.06  yatredānīṃ paśyasi jātavedastiṣṭhantamagna uta vā carantam |
10,087.06 yadvāntarikṣe pathibhiḥ patantaṃ tamastā vidhya śarvā śiśānaḥ ||
10,087.07  utālabdhaṃ spṛṇuhi jātaveda ālebhānādṛṣṭibhiryātudhānāt |
10,087.07 agne pūrvo ni jahi śośucāna āmādaḥ kṣviṅkāstamadantvenīḥ ||
10,087.08  iha pra brūhi yatamaḥ so agne yo yātudhāno ya idaṃ kṛṇoti |
10,087.08 tamā rabhasva samidhā yaviṣṭha nṛcakṣasaścakṣuṣe randhayainam ||
10,087.09  tīkṣṇenāgne cakṣuṣā rakṣa yajñaṃ prāñcaṃ vasubhyaḥ pra ṇaya pracetaḥ |
10,087.09 hiṃsraṃ rakṣāṃsyabhi śośucānaṃ mā tvā dabhanyātudhānā nṛcakṣaḥ ||
10,087.10  nṛcakṣā rakṣaḥ pari paśya vikṣu tasya trīṇi prati śṛṇīhyagrā |
10,087.10 tasyāgne pṛṣṭīrharasā śṛṇīhi tredhā mūlaṃ yātudhānasya vṛśca ||
10,087.11  triryātudhānaḥ prasitiṃ ta etvṛtaṃ yo agne anṛtena hanti |
10,087.11 tamarciṣā sphūrjayañjātavedaḥ samakṣamenaṃ gṛṇate ni vṛṅdhi ||
10,087.12  tadagne cakṣuḥ prati dhehi rebhe śaphārujaṃ yena paśyasi yātudhānam |
10,087.12 atharvavajjyotiṣā daivyena satyaṃ dhūrvantamacitaṃ nyoṣa ||
10,087.13  yadagne adya mithunā śapāto yadvācastṛṣṭaṃ janayanta rebhāḥ |
10,087.13 manyormanasaḥ śaravyā jāyate yā tayā vidhya hṛdaye yātudhānān ||
10,087.14  parā śṛṇīhi tapasā yātudhānānparāgne rakṣo harasā śṛṇīhi |
10,087.14 parārciṣā mūradevāñchṛṇīhi parāsutṛpo abhi śośucānaḥ ||
10,087.15  parādya devā vṛjinaṃ śṛṇantu pratyagenaṃ śapathā yantu tṛṣṭāḥ |
10,087.15 vācāstenaṃ śarava ṛcchantu marmanviśvasyaitu prasitiṃ yātudhānaḥ ||
10,087.16  yaḥ pauruṣeyeṇa kraviṣā samaṅkte yo aśvyena paśunā yātudhānaḥ |
10,087.16 yo aghnyāyā bharati kṣīramagne teṣāṃ śīrṣāṇi harasāpi vṛśca ||
10,087.17  saṃvatsarīṇaṃ paya usriyāyāstasya māśīdyātudhāno nṛcakṣaḥ |
10,087.17 pīyūṣamagne yatamastitṛpsāttaṃ pratyañcamarciṣā vidhya marman ||
10,087.18  viṣaṃ gavāṃ yātudhānāḥ pibantvā vṛścyantāmaditaye durevāḥ |
10,087.18 paraināndevaḥ savitā dadātu parā bhāgamoṣadhīnāṃ jayantām ||
10,087.19  sanādagne mṛṇasi yātudhānānna tvā rakṣāṃsi pṛtanāsu jigyuḥ |
10,087.19 anu daha sahamūrānkravyādo mā te hetyā mukṣata daivyāyāḥ ||
10,087.20  tvaṃ no agne adharādudaktāttvaṃ paścāduta rakṣā purastāt |
10,087.20 prati te te ajarāsastapiṣṭhā aghaśaṃsaṃ śośucato dahantu ||
10,087.21  paścātpurastādadharādudaktātkaviḥ kāvyena pari pāhi rājan |
10,087.21 sakhe sakhāyamajaro jarimṇe'gne martāṃ amartyastvaṃ naḥ ||
10,087.22  pari tvāgne puraṃ vayaṃ vipraṃ sahasya dhīmahi |
10,087.22 dhṛṣadvarṇaṃ divedive hantāraṃ bhaṅgurāvatām ||
10,087.23  viṣeṇa bhaṅgurāvataḥ prati ṣma rakṣaso daha |
10,087.23 agne tigmena śociṣā tapuragrābhirṛṣṭibhiḥ ||
10,087.24  pratyagne mithunā daha yātudhānā kimīdinā |
10,087.24 saṃ tvā śiśāmi jāgṛhyadabdhaṃ vipra manmabhiḥ ||
10,087.25  pratyagne harasā haraḥ śṛṇīhi viśvataḥ prati |
10,087.25 yātudhānasya rakṣaso balaṃ vi ruja vīryam ||

10,088.01  haviṣpāntamajaraṃ svarvidi divispṛśyāhutaṃ juṣṭamagnau |
10,088.01 tasya bharmaṇe bhuvanāya devā dharmaṇe kaṃ svadhayā paprathanta ||
10,088.02  gīrṇaṃ bhuvanaṃ tamasāpagūḻhamāviḥ svarabhavajjāte agnau |
10,088.02 tasya devāḥ pṛthivī dyaurutāpo'raṇayannoṣadhīḥ sakhye asya ||
10,088.03  devebhirnviṣito yajñiyebhiragniṃ stoṣāṇyajaraṃ bṛhantam |
10,088.03 yo bhānunā pṛthivīṃ dyāmutemāmātatāna rodasī antarikṣam ||
10,088.04  yo hotāsītprathamo devajuṣṭo yaṃ samāñjannājyenā vṛṇānāḥ |
10,088.04 sa patatrītvaraṃ sthā jagadyacchvātramagnirakṛṇojjātavedāḥ ||
10,088.05  yajjātavedo bhuvanasya mūrdhannatiṣṭho agne saha rocanena |
10,088.05 taṃ tvāhema matibhirgīrbhirukthaiḥ sa yajñiyo abhavo rodasiprāḥ ||
10,088.06  mūrdhā bhuvo bhavati naktamagnistataḥ sūryo jāyate prātarudyan |
10,088.06 māyāmū tu yajñiyānāmetāmapo yattūrṇiścarati prajānan ||
10,088.07  dṛśenyo yo mahinā samiddho'rocata diviyonirvibhāvā |
10,088.07 tasminnagnau sūktavākena devā havirviśva ājuhavustanūpāḥ ||
10,088.08  sūktavākaṃ prathamamādidagnimādiddhavirajanayanta devāḥ |
10,088.08 sa eṣāṃ yajño abhavattanūpāstaṃ dyaurveda taṃ pṛthivī tamāpaḥ ||
10,088.09  yaṃ devāso'janayantāgniṃ yasminnājuhavurbhuvanāni viśvā |
10,088.09 so arciṣā pṛthivīṃ dyāmutemāmṛjūyamāno atapanmahitvā ||
10,088.10  stomena hi divi devāso agnimajījanañchaktibhī rodasiprām |
