10,088.10 tamū akṛṇvantredhā bhuve kaṃ sa oṣadhīḥ pacati viśvarūpāḥ ||
10,088.11  yadedenamadadhuryajñiyāso divi devāḥ sūryamāditeyam |
10,088.11 yadā cariṣṇū mithunāvabhūtāmāditprāpaśyanbhuvanāni viśvā ||
10,088.12  viśvasmā agniṃ bhuvanāya devā vaiśvānaraṃ ketumahnāmakṛṇvan |
10,088.12 ā yastatānoṣaso vibhātīrapo ūrṇoti tamo arciṣā yan ||
10,088.13  vaiśvānaraṃ kavayo yajñiyāso'gniṃ devā ajanayannajuryam |
10,088.13 nakṣatraṃ pratnamaminaccariṣṇu yakṣasyādhyakṣaṃ taviṣaṃ bṛhantam ||
10,088.14  vaiśvānaraṃ viśvahā dīdivāṃsaṃ mantrairagniṃ kavimacchā vadāmaḥ |
10,088.14 yo mahimnā paribabhūvorvī utāvastāduta devaḥ parastāt ||
10,088.15  dve srutī aśṛṇavaṃ pitṝṇāmahaṃ devānāmuta martyānām |
10,088.15 tābhyāmidaṃ viśvamejatsameti yadantarā pitaraṃ mātaraṃ ca ||
10,088.16  dve samīcī bibhṛtaścarantaṃ śīrṣato jātaṃ manasā vimṛṣṭam |
10,088.16 sa pratyaṅviśvā bhuvanāni tasthāvaprayucchantaraṇirbhrājamānaḥ ||
10,088.17  yatrā vadete avaraḥ paraśca yajñanyoḥ kataro nau vi veda |
10,088.17 ā śekuritsadhamādaṃ sakhāyo nakṣanta yajñaṃ ka idaṃ vi vocat ||
10,088.18  katyagnayaḥ kati sūryāsaḥ katyuṣāsaḥ katyu svidāpaḥ |
10,088.18 nopaspijaṃ vaḥ pitaro vadāmi pṛcchāmi vaḥ kavayo vidmane kam ||
10,088.19  yāvanmātramuṣaso na pratīkaṃ suparṇyo vasate mātariśvaḥ |
10,088.19 tāvaddadhātyupa yajñamāyanbrāhmaṇo hoturavaro niṣīdan ||

10,089.01  indraṃ stavā nṛtamaṃ yasya mahnā vibabādhe rocanā vi jmo antān |
10,089.01 ā yaḥ paprau carṣaṇīdhṛdvarobhiḥ pra sindhubhyo riricāno mahitvā ||
10,089.02  sa sūryaḥ paryurū varāṃsyendro vavṛtyādrathyeva cakrā |
10,089.02 atiṣṭhantamapasyaṃ na sargaṃ kṛṣṇā tamāṃsi tviṣyā jaghāna ||
10,089.03  samānamasmā anapāvṛdarca kṣmayā divo asamaṃ brahma navyam |
10,089.03 vi yaḥ pṛṣṭheva janimānyarya indraścikāya na sakhāyamīṣe ||
10,089.04  indrāya giro aniśitasargā apaḥ prerayaṃ sagarasya budhnāt |
10,089.04 yo akṣeṇeva cakriyā śacībhirviṣvaktastambha pṛthivīmuta dyām ||
10,089.05  āpāntamanyustṛpalaprabharmā dhuniḥ śimīvāñcharumāṃ ṛjīṣī |
10,089.05 somo viśvānyatasā vanāni nārvāgindraṃ pratimānāni debhuḥ ||
10,089.06  na yasya dyāvāpṛthivī na dhanva nāntarikṣaṃ nādrayaḥ somo akṣāḥ |
10,089.06 yadasya manyuradhinīyamānaḥ śṛṇāti vīḻu rujati sthirāṇi ||
10,089.07  jaghāna vṛtraṃ svadhitirvaneva ruroja puro aradanna sindhūn |
10,089.07 bibheda giriṃ navaminna kumbhamā gā indro akṛṇuta svayugbhiḥ ||
10,089.08  tvaṃ ha tyadṛṇayā indra dhīro'sirna parva vṛjinā śṛṇāsi |
10,089.08 pra ye mitrasya varuṇasya dhāma yujaṃ na janā minanti mitram ||
10,089.09  pra ye mitraṃ prāryamaṇaṃ durevāḥ pra saṃgiraḥ pra varuṇaṃ minanti |
10,089.09 nyamitreṣu vadhamindra tumraṃ vṛṣanvṛṣāṇamaruṣaṃ śiśīhi ||
10,089.10  indro diva indra īśe pṛthivyā indro apāmindra itparvatānām |
10,089.10 indro vṛdhāmindra inmedhirāṇāmindraḥ kṣeme yoge havya indraḥ ||
10,089.11  prāktubhya indraḥ pra vṛdho ahabhyaḥ prāntarikṣātpra samudrasya dhāseḥ |
10,089.11 pra vātasya prathasaḥ pra jmo antātpra sindhubhyo ririce pra kṣitibhyaḥ ||
10,089.12  pra śośucatyā uṣaso na keturasinvā te vartatāmindra hetiḥ |
10,089.12 aśmeva vidhya diva ā sṛjānastapiṣṭhena heṣasā droghamitrān ||
10,089.13  anvaha māsā anvidvanānyanvoṣadhīranu parvatāsaḥ |
10,089.13 anvindraṃ rodasī vāvaśāne anvāpo ajihata jāyamānam ||
10,089.14  karhi svitsā ta indra cetyāsadaghasya yadbhinado rakṣa eṣat |
10,089.14 mitrakruvo yacchasane na gāvaḥ pṛthivyā āpṛgamuyā śayante ||
10,089.15  śatrūyanto abhi ye nastatasre mahi vrādhanta ogaṇāsa indra |
10,089.15 andhenāmitrāstamasā sacantāṃ sujyotiṣo aktavastāṃ abhi ṣyuḥ ||
10,089.16  purūṇi hi tvā savanā janānāṃ brahmāṇi mandangṛṇatāmṛṣīṇām |
10,089.16 imāmāghoṣannavasā sahūtiṃ tiro viśvāṃ arcato yāhyarvāṅ ||
10,089.17  evā te vayamindra bhuñjatīnāṃ vidyāma sumatīnāṃ navānām |
10,089.17 vidyāma vastoravasā gṛṇanto viśvāmitrā uta ta indra nūnam ||
10,089.18  śunaṃ huvema maghavānamindramasminbhare nṛtamaṃ vājasātau |
10,089.18 śṛṇvantamugramūtaye samatsu ghnantaṃ vṛtrāṇi saṃjitaṃ dhanānām ||

10,090.01  sahasraśīrṣā puruṣaḥ sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt |
10,090.01 sa bhūmiṃ viśvato vṛtvātyatiṣṭhaddaśāṅgulam ||
10,090.02  puruṣa evedaṃ sarvaṃ yadbhūtaṃ yacca bhavyam |
10,090.02 utāmṛtatvasyeśāno yadannenātirohati ||
10,090.03  etāvānasya mahimāto jyāyāṃśca pūruṣaḥ |
10,090.03 pādo'sya viśvā bhūtāni tripādasyāmṛtaṃ divi ||
10,090.04  tripādūrdhva udaitpuruṣaḥ pādo'syehābhavatpunaḥ |
10,090.04 tato viṣvaṅvyakrāmatsāśanānaśane abhi ||
10,090.05  tasmādvirāḻ ajāyata virājo adhi pūruṣaḥ |
10,090.05 sa jāto atyaricyata paścādbhūmimatho puraḥ ||
10,090.06  yatpuruṣeṇa haviṣā devā yajñamatanvata |
10,090.06 vasanto asyāsīdājyaṃ grīṣma idhmaḥ śaraddhaviḥ ||
10,090.07  taṃ yajñaṃ barhiṣi praukṣanpuruṣaṃ jātamagrataḥ |
10,090.07 tena devā ayajanta sādhyā ṛṣayaśca ye ||
10,090.08  tasmādyajñātsarvahutaḥ sambhṛtaṃ pṛṣadājyam |
10,090.08 paśūntāṃścakre vāyavyānāraṇyāngrāmyāśca ye ||
10,090.09  tasmādyajñātsarvahuta ṛcaḥ sāmāni jajñire |
10,090.09 chandāṃsi jajñire tasmādyajustasmādajāyata ||
10,090.10  tasmādaśvā ajāyanta ye ke cobhayādataḥ |
10,090.10 gāvo ha jajñire tasmāttasmājjātā ajāvayaḥ ||
10,090.11  yatpuruṣaṃ vyadadhuḥ katidhā vyakalpayan |
10,090.11 mukhaṃ kimasya kau bāhū kā ūrū pādā ucyete ||
10,090.12  brāhmaṇo'sya mukhamāsīdbāhū rājanyaḥ kṛtaḥ |
10,090.12 ūrū tadasya yadvaiśyaḥ padbhyāṃ śūdro ajāyata ||
10,090.13  candramā manaso jātaścakṣoḥ sūryo ajāyata |
10,090.13 mukhādindraścāgniśca prāṇādvāyurajāyata ||
10,090.14  nābhyā āsīdantarikṣaṃ śīrṣṇo dyauḥ samavartata |
10,090.14 padbhyāṃ bhūmirdiśaḥ śrotrāttathā lokāṃ akalpayan ||
10,090.15  saptāsyāsanparidhayastriḥ sapta samidhaḥ kṛtāḥ |
10,090.15 devā yadyajñaṃ tanvānā abadhnanpuruṣaṃ paśum ||
10,090.16  yajñena yajñamayajanta devāstāni dharmāṇi prathamānyāsan |
10,090.16 te ha nākaṃ mahimānaḥ sacanta yatra pūrve sādhyāḥ santi devāḥ ||

10,091.01  saṃ jāgṛvadbhirjaramāṇa idhyate dame damūnā iṣayanniḻaspade |
10,091.01 viśvasya hotā haviṣo vareṇyo vibhurvibhāvā suṣakhā sakhīyate ||
10,091.02  sa darśataśrīratithirgṛhegṛhe vanevane śiśriye takvavīriva |
10,091.02 janaṃjanaṃ janyo nāti manyate viśa ā kṣeti viśyo viśaṃviśam ||
10,091.03  sudakṣo dakṣaiḥ kratunāsi sukraturagne kaviḥ kāvyenāsi viśvavit |
10,091.03 vasurvasūnāṃ kṣayasi tvameka iddyāvā ca yāni pṛthivī ca puṣyataḥ ||
10,091.04  prajānannagne tava yonimṛtviyamiḻāyāspade ghṛtavantamāsadaḥ |
10,091.04 ā te cikitra uṣasāmivetayo'repasaḥ sūryasyeva raśmayaḥ ||
10,091.05  tava śriyo varṣyasyeva vidyutaścitrāścikitra uṣasāṃ na ketavaḥ |
10,091.05 yadoṣadhīrabhisṛṣṭo vanāni ca pari svayaṃ cinuṣe annamāsye ||
10,091.06  tamoṣadhīrdadhire garbhamṛtviyaṃ tamāpo agniṃ janayanta mātaraḥ |
10,091.06 tamitsamānaṃ vaninaśca vīrudho'ntarvatīśca suvate ca viśvahā ||
10,091.07  vātopadhūta iṣito vaśāṃ anu tṛṣu yadannā veviṣadvitiṣṭhase |
10,091.07 ā te yatante rathyo yathā pṛthakchardhāṃsyagne ajarāṇi dhakṣataḥ ||
10,091.08  medhākāraṃ vidathasya prasādhanamagniṃ hotāraṃ paribhūtamaṃ matim |
10,091.08 tamidarbhe haviṣyā samānamittaminmahe vṛṇate nānyaṃ tvat ||
10,091.09  tvāmidatra vṛṇate tvāyavo hotāramagne vidatheṣu vedhasaḥ |
10,091.09 yaddevayanto dadhati prayāṃsi te haviṣmanto manavo vṛktabarhiṣaḥ ||
10,091.10  tavāgne hotraṃ tava potramṛtviyaṃ tava neṣṭraṃ tvamagnidṛtāyataḥ |
10,091.10 tava praśāstraṃ tvamadhvarīyasi brahmā cāsi gṛhapatiśca no dame ||
10,091.11  yastubhyamagne amṛtāya martyaḥ samidhā dāśaduta vā haviṣkṛti |
10,091.11 tasya hotā bhavasi yāsi dūtyamupa brūṣe yajasyadhvarīyasi ||
10,091.12  imā asmai matayo vāco asmadāṃ ṛco giraḥ suṣṭutayaḥ samagmata |
10,091.12 vasūyavo vasave jātavedase vṛddhāsu cidvardhano yāsu cākanat ||
10,091.13  imāṃ pratnāya suṣṭutiṃ navīyasīṃ voceyamasmā uśate śṛṇotu naḥ |
10,091.13 bhūyā antarā hṛdyasya nispṛśe jāyeva patya uśatī suvāsāḥ ||
10,091.14  yasminnaśvāsa ṛṣabhāsa ukṣaṇo vaśā meṣā avasṛṣṭāsa āhutāḥ |
10,091.14 kīlālape somapṛṣṭhāya vedhase hṛdā matiṃ janaye cārumagnaye ||
10,091.15  ahāvyagne havirāsye te srucīva ghṛtaṃ camvīva somaḥ |
10,091.15 vājasaniṃ rayimasme suvīraṃ praśastaṃ dhehi yaśasaṃ bṛhantam ||

10,092.01  yajñasya vo rathyaṃ viśpatiṃ viśāṃ hotāramaktoratithiṃ vibhāvasum |
10,092.01 śocañchuṣkāsu hariṇīṣu jarbhuradvṛṣā keturyajato dyāmaśāyata ||
10,092.02  imamañjaspāmubhaye akṛṇvata dharmāṇamagniṃ vidathasya sādhanam |
10,092.02 aktuṃ na yahvamuṣasaḥ purohitaṃ tanūnapātamaruṣasya niṃsate ||
10,092.03  baḻ asya nīthā vi paṇeśca manmahe vayā asya prahutā āsurattave |
10,092.03 yadā ghorāso amṛtatvamāśatādijjanasya daivyasya carkiran ||
10,092.04  ṛtasya hi prasitirdyaururu vyaco namo mahyaramatiḥ panīyasī |
10,092.04 indro mitro varuṇaḥ saṃ cikitrire'tho bhagaḥ savitā pūtadakṣasaḥ ||
10,092.05  pra rudreṇa yayinā yanti sindhavastiro mahīmaramatiṃ dadhanvire |
10,092.05 yebhiḥ parijmā pariyannuru jrayo vi roruvajjaṭhare viśvamukṣate ||
10,092.06  krāṇā rudrā maruto viśvakṛṣṭayo divaḥ śyenāso asurasya nīḻayaḥ |
10,092.06 tebhiścaṣṭe varuṇo mitro aryamendro devebhirarvaśebhirarvaśaḥ ||
10,092.07  indre bhujaṃ śaśamānāsa āśata sūro dṛśīke vṛṣaṇaśca pauṃsye |
10,092.07 pra ye nvasyārhaṇā tatakṣire yujaṃ vajraṃ nṛṣadaneṣu kāravaḥ ||
10,092.08  sūraścidā harito asya rīramadindrādā kaścidbhayate tavīyasaḥ |
10,092.08 bhīmasya vṛṣṇo jaṭharādabhiśvaso divedive sahuri stannabādhitaḥ ||
10,092.09  stomaṃ vo adya rudrāya śikvase kṣayadvīrāya namasā didiṣṭana |
10,092.09 yebhiḥ śivaḥ svavāṃ evayāvabhirdivaḥ siṣakti svayaśā nikāmabhiḥ ||
10,092.10  te hi prajāyā abharanta vi śravo bṛhaspatirvṛṣabhaḥ somajāmayaḥ |
10,092.10 yajñairatharvā prathamo vi dhārayaddevā dakṣairbhṛgavaḥ saṃ cikitrire ||
10,092.11  te hi dyāvāpṛthivī bhūriretasā narāśaṃsaścaturaṅgo yamo'ditiḥ |
10,092.11 devastvaṣṭā draviṇodā ṛbhukṣaṇaḥ pra rodasī maruto viṣṇurarhire ||
10,092.12  uta sya na uśijāmurviyā kavirahiḥ śṛṇotu budhnyo havīmani |
10,092.12 sūryāmāsā vicarantā divikṣitā dhiyā śamīnahuṣī asya bodhatam ||
10,092.13  pra naḥ pūṣā carathaṃ viśvadevyo'pāṃ napādavatu vāyuriṣṭaye |
10,092.13 ātmānaṃ vasyo abhi vātamarcata tadaśvinā suhavā yāmani śrutam ||
10,092.14  viśāmāsāmabhayānāmadhikṣitaṃ gīrbhiru svayaśasaṃ gṛṇīmasi |
10,092.14 gnābhirviśvābhiraditimanarvaṇamaktoryuvānaṃ nṛmaṇā adhā patim ||
10,092.15  rebhadatra januṣā pūrvo aṅgirā grāvāṇa ūrdhvā abhi cakṣuradhvaram |
10,092.15 yebhirvihāyā abhavadvicakṣaṇaḥ pāthaḥ sumekaṃ svadhitirvananvati ||

10,093.01  mahi dyāvāpṛthivī bhūtamurvī nārī yahvī na rodasī sadaṃ naḥ |
10,093.01 tebhirnaḥ pātaṃ sahyasa ebhirnaḥ pātaṃ śūṣaṇi ||
10,093.02  yajñeyajñe sa martyo devānsaparyati |
10,093.02 yaḥ sumnairdīrghaśruttama āvivāsatyenān ||
10,093.03  viśveṣāmirajyavo devānāṃ vārmahaḥ |
10,093.03 viśve hi viśvamahaso viśve yajñeṣu yajñiyāḥ ||
10,093.04  te ghā rājāno amṛtasya mandrā aryamā mitro varuṇaḥ parijmā |
10,093.04 kadrudro nṛṇāṃ stuto marutaḥ pūṣaṇo bhagaḥ ||
10,093.05  uta no naktamapāṃ vṛṣaṇvasū sūryāmāsā sadanāya sadhanyā |
10,093.05 sacā yatsādyeṣāmahirbudhneṣu budhnyaḥ ||
10,093.06  uta no devāvaśvinā śubhaspatī dhāmabhirmitrāvaruṇā uruṣyatām |
10,093.06 mahaḥ sa rāya eṣate'ti dhanveva duritā ||
10,093.07  uta no rudrā cinmṛḻatāmaśvinā viśve devāso rathaspatirbhagaḥ |
10,093.07 ṛbhurvāja ṛbhukṣaṇaḥ parijmā viśvavedasaḥ ||
10,093.08  ṛbhurṛbhukṣā ṛbhurvidhato mada ā te harī jūjuvānasya vājinā |
10,093.08 duṣṭaraṃ yasya sāma cidṛdhagyajño na mānuṣaḥ ||
10,093.09  kṛdhī no ahrayo deva savitaḥ sa ca stuṣe maghonām |
10,093.09 saho na indro vahnibhirnyeṣāṃ carṣaṇīnāṃ cakraṃ raśmiṃ na yoyuve ||
10,093.10  aiṣu dyāvāpṛthivī dhātaṃ mahadasme vīreṣu viśvacarṣaṇi śravaḥ |
10,093.10 pṛkṣaṃ vājasya sātaye pṛkṣaṃ rāyota turvaṇe ||
10,093.11  etaṃ śaṃsamindrāsmayuṣṭvaṃ kūcitsantaṃ sahasāvannabhiṣṭaye |
10,093.11 sadā pāhyabhiṣṭaye medatāṃ vedatā vaso ||
10,093.12  etaṃ me stomaṃ tanā na sūrye dyutadyāmānaṃ vāvṛdhanta nṛṇām |
10,093.12 saṃvananaṃ nāśvyaṃ taṣṭevānapacyutam ||
10,093.13  vāvarta yeṣāṃ rāyā yuktaiṣāṃ hiraṇyayī |
10,093.13 nemadhitā na pauṃsyā vṛtheva viṣṭāntā ||
10,093.14  pra tadduḥśīme pṛthavāne vene pra rāme vocamasure maghavatsu |
10,093.14 ye yuktvāya pañca śatāsmayu pathā viśrāvyeṣām ||
10,093.15  adhīnnvatra saptatiṃ ca sapta ca |
10,093.15 sadyo didiṣṭa tānvaḥ sadyo didiṣṭa pārthyaḥ sadyo didiṣṭa māyavaḥ ||

10,094.01  praite vadantu pra vayaṃ vadāma grāvabhyo vācaṃ vadatā vadadbhyaḥ |
10,094.01 yadadrayaḥ parvatāḥ sākamāśavaḥ ślokaṃ ghoṣaṃ bharathendrāya sominaḥ ||
10,094.02  ete vadanti śatavatsahasravadabhi krandanti haritebhirāsabhiḥ |
10,094.02 viṣṭvī grāvāṇaḥ sukṛtaḥ sukṛtyayā hotuścitpūrve haviradyamāśata ||
10,094.03  ete vadantyavidannanā madhu nyūṅkhayante adhi pakva āmiṣi |
10,094.03 vṛkṣasya śākhāmaruṇasya bapsataste sūbharvā vṛṣabhāḥ premarāviṣuḥ ||
10,094.04  bṛhadvadanti madireṇa mandinendraṃ krośanto'vidannanā madhu |
10,094.04 saṃrabhyā dhīrāḥ svasṛbhiranartiṣurāghoṣayantaḥ pṛthivīmupabdibhiḥ ||
10,094.05  suparṇā vācamakratopa dyavyākhare kṛṣṇā iṣirā anartiṣuḥ |
10,094.05 nyaṅni yantyuparasya niṣkṛtaṃ purū reto dadhire sūryaśvitaḥ ||
10,094.06  ugrā iva pravahantaḥ samāyamuḥ sākaṃ yuktā vṛṣaṇo bibhrato dhuraḥ |
10,094.06 yacchvasanto jagrasānā arāviṣuḥ śṛṇva eṣāṃ prothatho arvatāmiva ||
10,094.07  daśāvanibhyo daśakakṣyebhyo daśayoktrebhyo daśayojanebhyaḥ |
10,094.07 daśābhīśubhyo arcatājarebhyo daśa dhuro daśa yuktā vahadbhyaḥ ||
10,094.08  te adrayo daśayantrāsa āśavasteṣāmādhānaṃ paryeti haryatam |
10,094.08 ta ū sutasya somyasyāndhaso'ṃśoḥ pīyūṣaṃ prathamasya bhejire ||
10,094.09  te somādo harī indrasya niṃsate'ṃśuṃ duhanto adhyāsate gavi |
10,094.09 tebhirdugdhaṃ papivānsomyaṃ madhvindro vardhate prathate vṛṣāyate ||
10,094.10  vṛṣā vo aṃśurna kilā riṣāthaneḻāvantaḥ sadamitsthanāśitāḥ |
10,094.10 raivatyeva mahasā cārava sthana yasya grāvāṇo ajuṣadhvamadhvaram ||
10,094.11  tṛdilā atṛdilāso adrayo'śramaṇā aśṛthitā amṛtyavaḥ |
10,094.11 anāturā ajarā sthāmaviṣṇavaḥ supīvaso atṛṣitā atṛṣṇajaḥ ||
10,094.12  dhruvā eva vaḥ pitaro yugeyuge kṣemakāmāsaḥ sadaso na yuñjate |
10,094.12 ajuryāso hariṣāco haridrava ā dyāṃ raveṇa pṛthivīmaśuśravuḥ ||
10,094.13  tadidvadantyadrayo vimocane yāmannañjaspā iva ghedupabdibhiḥ |
10,094.13 vapanto bījamiva dhānyākṛtaḥ pṛñcanti somaṃ na minanti bapsataḥ ||
10,094.14  sute adhvare adhi vācamakratā krīḻayo na mātaraṃ tudantaḥ |
10,094.14 vi ṣū muñcā suṣuvuṣo manīṣāṃ vi vartantāmadrayaścāyamānāḥ ||

10,095.01  haye jāye manasā tiṣṭha ghore vacāṃsi miśrā kṛṇavāvahai nu |
10,095.01 na nau mantrā anuditāsa ete mayaskaranparatare canāhan ||
10,095.02  kimetā vācā kṛṇavā tavāhaṃ prākramiṣamuṣasāmagriyeva |
10,095.02 purūravaḥ punarastaṃ parehi durāpanā vāta ivāhamasmi ||
10,095.03  iṣurna śriya iṣudherasanā goṣāḥ śatasā na raṃhiḥ |
10,095.03 avīre kratau vi davidyutannorā na māyuṃ citayanta dhunayaḥ ||
10,095.04  sā vasu dadhatī śvaśurāya vaya uṣo yadi vaṣṭyantigṛhāt |
10,095.04 astaṃ nanakṣe yasmiñcākandivā naktaṃ śnathitā vaitasena ||
10,095.05  triḥ sma māhnaḥ śnathayo vaitasenota sma me'vyatyai pṛṇāsi |
10,095.05 purūravo'nu te ketamāyaṃ rājā me vīra tanvastadāsīḥ ||
10,095.06  yā sujūrṇiḥ śreṇiḥ sumnaāpirhradecakṣurna granthinī caraṇyuḥ |
10,095.06 tā añjayo'ruṇayo na sasruḥ śriye gāvo na dhenavo'navanta ||
10,095.07  samasmiñjāyamāna āsata gnā utemavardhannadyaḥ svagūrtāḥ |
10,095.07 mahe yattvā purūravo raṇāyāvardhayandasyuhatyāya devāḥ ||
10,095.08  sacā yadāsu jahatīṣvatkamamānuṣīṣu mānuṣo niṣeve |
10,095.08 apa sma mattarasantī na bhujyustā atrasanrathaspṛśo nāśvāḥ ||
10,095.09  yadāsu marto amṛtāsu nispṛksaṃ kṣoṇībhiḥ kratubhirna pṛṅkte |
10,095.09 tā ātayo na tanvaḥ śumbhata svā aśvāso na krīḻayo dandaśānāḥ ||
10,095.10  vidyunna yā patantī davidyodbharantī me apyā kāmyāni |
10,095.10 janiṣṭo apo naryaḥ sujātaḥ prorvaśī tirata dīrghamāyuḥ ||
10,095.11  jajñiṣa itthā gopīthyāya hi dadhātha tatpurūravo ma ojaḥ |
10,095.11 aśāsaṃ tvā viduṣī sasminnahanna ma āśṛṇoḥ kimabhugvadāsi ||
10,095.12  kadā sūnuḥ pitaraṃ jāta icchāccakrannāśru vartayadvijānan |
10,095.12 ko dampatī samanasā vi yūyodadha yadagniḥ śvaśureṣu dīdayat ||
10,095.13  prati bravāṇi vartayate aśru cakranna krandadādhye śivāyai |
10,095.13 pra tatte hinavā yatte asme parehyastaṃ nahi mūra māpaḥ ||
10,095.14  sudevo adya prapatedanāvṛtparāvataṃ paramāṃ gantavā u |
10,095.14 adhā śayīta nirṛterupasthe'dhainaṃ vṛkā rabhasāso adyuḥ ||
10,095.15  purūravo mā mṛthā mā pra papto mā tvā vṛkāso aśivāsa u kṣan |
10,095.15 na vai straiṇāni sakhyāni santi sālāvṛkāṇāṃ hṛdayānyetā ||
10,095.16  yadvirūpācaraṃ martyeṣvavasaṃ rātrīḥ śaradaścatasraḥ |
10,095.16 ghṛtasya stokaṃ sakṛdahna āśnāṃ tādevedaṃ tātṛpāṇā carāmi ||
10,095.17  antarikṣaprāṃ rajaso vimānīmupa śikṣāmyurvaśīṃ vasiṣṭhaḥ |
10,095.17 upa tvā rātiḥ sukṛtasya tiṣṭhānni vartasva hṛdayaṃ tapyate me ||
10,095.18  iti tvā devā ima āhuraiḻa yathemetadbhavasi mṛtyubandhuḥ |
10,095.18 prajā te devānhaviṣā yajāti svarga u tvamapi mādayāse ||

10,096.01  pra te mahe vidathe śaṃsiṣaṃ harī pra te vanve vanuṣo haryataṃ madam |
10,096.01 ghṛtaṃ na yo haribhiścāru secata ā tvā viśantu harivarpasaṃ giraḥ ||
10,096.02  hariṃ hi yonimabhi ye samasvaranhinvanto harī divyaṃ yathā sadaḥ |
10,096.02 ā yaṃ pṛṇanti haribhirna dhenava indrāya śūṣaṃ harivantamarcata ||
10,096.03  so asya vajro harito ya āyaso harirnikāmo harirā gabhastyoḥ |
10,096.03 dyumnī suśipro harimanyusāyaka indre ni rūpā haritā mimikṣire ||
10,096.04  divi na keturadhi dhāyi haryato vivyacadvajro harito na raṃhyā |
10,096.04 tudadahiṃ hariśipro ya āyasaḥ sahasraśokā abhavaddharimbharaḥ ||
10,096.05  tvaṃtvamaharyathā upastutaḥ pūrvebhirindra harikeśa yajvabhiḥ |
10,096.05 tvaṃ haryasi tava viśvamukthyamasāmi rādho harijāta haryatam ||
10,096.06  tā vajriṇaṃ mandinaṃ stomyaṃ mada indraṃ rathe vahato haryatā harī |
10,096.06 purūṇyasmai savanāni haryata indrāya somā harayo dadhanvire ||
10,096.07  araṃ kāmāya harayo dadhanvire sthirāya hinvanharayo harī turā |
10,096.07 arvadbhiryo haribhirjoṣamīyate so asya kāmaṃ harivantamānaśe ||
10,096.08  hariśmaśārurharikeśa āyasasturaspeye yo haripā avardhata |
10,096.08 arvadbhiryo haribhirvājinīvasurati viśvā duritā pāriṣaddharī ||
10,096.09  sruveva yasya hariṇī vipetatuḥ śipre vājāya hariṇī davidhvataḥ |
10,096.09 pra yatkṛte camase marmṛjaddharī pītvā madasya haryatasyāndhasaḥ ||
10,096.10  uta sma sadma haryatasya pastyoratyo na vājaṃ harivāṃ acikradat |
10,096.10 mahī ciddhi dhiṣaṇāharyadojasā bṛhadvayo dadhiṣe haryataścidā ||
10,096.11  ā rodasī haryamāṇo mahitvā navyaṃnavyaṃ haryasi manma nu priyam |
10,096.11 pra pastyamasura haryataṃ gorāviṣkṛdhi haraye sūryāya ||
10,096.12  ā tvā haryantaṃ prayujo janānāṃ rathe vahantu hariśipramindra |
10,096.12 pibā yathā pratibhṛtasya madhvo haryanyajñaṃ sadhamāde daśoṇim ||
10,096.13  apāḥ pūrveṣāṃ harivaḥ sutānāmatho idaṃ savanaṃ kevalaṃ te |
10,096.13 mamaddhi somaṃ madhumantamindra satrā vṛṣañjaṭhara ā vṛṣasva ||

10,097.01  yā oṣadhīḥ pūrvā jātā devebhyastriyugaṃ purā |
10,097.01 manai nu babhrūṇāmahaṃ śataṃ dhāmāni sapta ca ||
10,097.02  śataṃ vo amba dhāmāni sahasramuta vo ruhaḥ |
10,097.02 adhā śatakratvo yūyamimaṃ me agadaṃ kṛta ||
10,097.03  oṣadhīḥ prati modadhvaṃ puṣpavatīḥ prasūvarīḥ |
10,097.03 aśvā iva sajitvarīrvīrudhaḥ pārayiṣṇvaḥ ||
10,097.04  oṣadhīriti mātarastadvo devīrupa bruve |
10,097.04 saneyamaśvaṃ gāṃ vāsa ātmānaṃ tava pūruṣa ||
10,097.05  aśvatthe vo niṣadanaṃ parṇe vo vasatiṣkṛtā |
10,097.05 gobhāja itkilāsatha yatsanavatha pūruṣam ||
10,097.06  yatrauṣadhīḥ samagmata rājānaḥ samitāviva |
10,097.06 vipraḥ sa ucyate bhiṣagrakṣohāmīvacātanaḥ ||
10,097.07  aśvāvatīṃ somāvatīmūrjayantīmudojasam |
10,097.07 āvitsi sarvā oṣadhīrasmā ariṣṭatātaye ||
10,097.08  ucchuṣmā oṣadhīnāṃ gāvo goṣṭhādiverate |
10,097.08 dhanaṃ saniṣyantīnāmātmānaṃ tava pūruṣa ||
10,097.09  iṣkṛtirnāma vo mātātho yūyaṃ stha niṣkṛtīḥ |
10,097.09 sīrāḥ patatriṇī sthana yadāmayati niṣkṛtha ||
10,097.10  ati viśvāḥ pariṣṭhā stena iva vrajamakramuḥ |
10,097.10 oṣadhīḥ prācucyavuryatkiṃ ca tanvo rapaḥ ||
10,097.11  yadimā vājayannahamoṣadhīrhasta ādadhe |
10,097.11 ātmā yakṣmasya naśyati purā jīvagṛbho yathā ||
10,097.12  yasyauṣadhīḥ prasarpathāṅgamaṅgaṃ paruṣparuḥ |
10,097.12 tato yakṣmaṃ vi bādhadhva ugro madhyamaśīriva ||
10,097.13  sākaṃ yakṣma pra pata cāṣeṇa kikidīvinā |
10,097.13 sākaṃ vātasya dhrājyā sākaṃ naśya nihākayā ||
10,097.14  anyā vo anyāmavatvanyānyasyā upāvata |
10,097.14 tāḥ sarvāḥ saṃvidānā idaṃ me prāvatā vacaḥ ||
10,097.15  yāḥ phalinīryā aphalā apuṣpā yāśca puṣpiṇīḥ |
10,097.15 bṛhaspatiprasūtāstā no muñcantvaṃhasaḥ ||
10,097.16  muñcantu mā śapathyādatho varuṇyāduta |
10,097.16 atho yamasya paḍbīśātsarvasmāddevakilbiṣāt ||
10,097.17  avapatantīravadandiva oṣadhayaspari |
10,097.17 yaṃ jīvamaśnavāmahai na sa riṣyāti pūruṣaḥ ||
10,097.18  yā oṣadhīḥ somarājñīrbahvīḥ śatavicakṣaṇāḥ |
10,097.18 tāsāṃ tvamasyuttamāraṃ kāmāya śaṃ hṛde ||
10,097.19  yā oṣadhīḥ somarājñīrviṣṭhitāḥ pṛthivīmanu |
10,097.19 bṛhaspatiprasūtā asyai saṃ datta vīryam ||
10,097.20  mā vo riṣatkhanitā yasmai cāhaṃ khanāmi vaḥ |
10,097.20 dvipaccatuṣpadasmākaṃ sarvamastvanāturam ||
10,097.21  yāścedamupaśṛṇvanti yāśca dūraṃ parāgatāḥ |
10,097.21 sarvāḥ saṃgatya vīrudho'syai saṃ datta vīryam ||
10,097.22  oṣadhayaḥ saṃ vadante somena saha rājñā |
10,097.22 yasmai kṛṇoti brāhmaṇastaṃ rājanpārayāmasi ||
10,097.23  tvamuttamāsyoṣadhe tava vṛkṣā upastayaḥ |
10,097.23 upastirastu so'smākaṃ yo asmāṃ abhidāsati ||

10,098.01  bṛhaspate prati me devatāmihi mitro vā yadvaruṇo vāsi pūṣā |
10,098.01 ādityairvā yadvasubhirmarutvānsa parjanyaṃ śantanave vṛṣāya ||
10,098.02  ā devo dūto ajiraścikitvāntvaddevāpe abhi māmagacchat |
10,098.02 pratīcīnaḥ prati māmā vavṛtsva dadhāmi te dyumatīṃ vācamāsan ||
10,098.03  asme dhehi dyumatīṃ vācamāsanbṛhaspate anamīvāmiṣirām |
10,098.03 yayā vṛṣṭiṃ śantanave vanāva divo drapso madhumāṃ ā viveśa ||
10,098.04  ā no drapsā madhumanto viśantvindra dehyadhirathaṃ sahasram |
10,098.04 ni ṣīda hotramṛtuthā yajasva devāndevāpe haviṣā saparya ||
10,098.05  ārṣṭiṣeṇo hotramṛṣirniṣīdandevāpirdevasumatiṃ cikitvān |
10,098.05 sa uttarasmādadharaṃ samudramapo divyā asṛjadvarṣyā abhi ||
10,098.06  asminsamudre adhyuttarasminnāpo devebhirnivṛtā atiṣṭhan |
10,098.06 tā adravannārṣṭiṣeṇena sṛṣṭā devāpinā preṣitā mṛkṣiṇīṣu ||
10,098.07  yaddevāpiḥ śantanave purohito hotrāya vṛtaḥ kṛpayannadīdhet |
10,098.07 devaśrutaṃ vṛṣṭivaniṃ rarāṇo bṛhaspatirvācamasmā ayacchat ||
10,098.08  yaṃ tvā devāpiḥ śuśucāno agna ārṣṭiṣeṇo manuṣyaḥ samīdhe |
10,098.08 viśvebhirdevairanumadyamānaḥ pra parjanyamīrayā vṛṣṭimantam ||
10,098.09  tvāṃ pūrva ṛṣayo gīrbhirāyantvāmadhvareṣu puruhūta viśve |
10,098.09 sahasrāṇyadhirathānyasme ā no yajñaṃ rohidaśvopa yāhi ||
10,098.10  etānyagne navatirnava tve āhutānyadhirathā sahasrā |
10,098.10 tebhirvardhasva tanvaḥ śūra pūrvīrdivo no vṛṣṭimiṣito rirīhi ||
10,098.11  etānyagne navatiṃ sahasrā saṃ pra yaccha vṛṣṇa indrāya bhāgam |
10,098.11 vidvānpatha ṛtuśo devayānānapyaulānaṃ divi deveṣu dhehi ||
10,098.12  agne bādhasva vi mṛdho vi durgahāpāmīvāmapa rakṣāṃsi sedha |
10,098.12 asmātsamudrādbṛhato divo no'pāṃ bhūmānamupa naḥ sṛjeha ||

10,099.01  kaṃ naścitramiṣaṇyasi cikitvānpṛthugmānaṃ vāśraṃ vāvṛdhadhyai |
10,099.01 kattasya dātu śavaso vyuṣṭau takṣadvajraṃ vṛtraturamapinvat ||
10,099.02  sa hi dyutā vidyutā veti sāma pṛthuṃ yonimasuratvā sasāda |
10,099.02 sa sanīḻebhiḥ prasahāno asya bhrāturna ṛte saptathasya māyāḥ ||
10,099.03  sa vājaṃ yātāpaduṣpadā yansvarṣātā pari ṣadatsaniṣyan |
10,099.03 anarvā yacchatadurasya vedo ghnañchiśnadevāṃ abhi varpasā bhūt ||
10,099.04  sa yahvyo'vanīrgoṣvarvā juhoti pradhanyāsu sasriḥ |
10,099.04 apādo yatra yujyāso'rathā droṇyaśvāsa īrate ghṛtaṃ vāḥ ||
10,099.05  sa rudrebhiraśastavāra ṛbhvā hitvī gayamāreavadya āgāt |
10,099.05 vamrasya manye mithunā vivavrī annamabhītyārodayanmuṣāyan ||
10,099.06  sa iddāsaṃ tuvīravaṃ patirdanṣaḻakṣaṃ triśīrṣāṇaṃ damanyat |
10,099.06 asya trito nvojasā vṛdhāno vipā varāhamayoagrayā han ||
10,099.07  sa druhvaṇe manuṣa ūrdhvasāna ā sāviṣadarśasānāya śarum |
10,099.07 sa nṛtamo nahuṣo'smatsujātaḥ puro'bhinadarhandasyuhatye ||
10,099.08  so abhriyo na yavasa udanyankṣayāya gātuṃ vidanno asme |
10,099.08 upa yatsīdadinduṃ śarīraiḥ śyeno'yopāṣṭirhanti dasyūn ||
10,099.09  sa vrādhataḥ śavasānebhirasya kutsāya śuṣṇaṃ kṛpaṇe parādāt |
10,099.09 ayaṃ kavimanayacchasyamānamatkaṃ yo asya sanitota nṛṇām ||
10,099.10  ayaṃ daśasyannaryebhirasya dasmo devebhirvaruṇo na māyī |
10,099.10 ayaṃ kanīna ṛtupā avedyamimītāraruṃ yaścatuṣpāt ||
10,099.11  asya stomebhirauśija ṛjiśvā vrajaṃ darayadvṛṣabheṇa piproḥ |
10,099.11 sutvā yadyajato dīdayadgīḥ pura iyāno abhi varpasā bhūt ||
10,099.12  evā maho asura vakṣathāya vamrakaḥ paḍbhirupa sarpadindram |
10,099.12 sa iyānaḥ karati svastimasmā iṣamūrjaṃ sukṣitiṃ viśvamābhāḥ ||

10,100.01  indra dṛhya maghavantvāvadidbhuja iha stutaḥ sutapā bodhi no vṛdhe |
10,100.01 devebhirnaḥ savitā prāvatu śrutamā sarvatātimaditiṃ vṛṇīmahe ||
10,100.02  bharāya su bharata bhāgamṛtviyaṃ pra vāyave śucipe krandadiṣṭaye |
10,100.02 gaurasya yaḥ payasaḥ pītimānaśa ā sarvatātimaditiṃ vṛṇīmahe ||
10,100.03  ā no devaḥ savitā sāviṣadvaya ṛjūyate yajamānāya sunvate |
10,100.03 yathā devānpratibhūṣema pākavadā sarvatātimaditiṃ vṛṇīmahe ||
10,100.04  indro asme sumanā astu viśvahā rājā somaḥ suvitasyādhyetu naḥ |
10,100.04 yathāyathā mitradhitāni saṃdadhurā sarvatātimaditiṃ vṛṇīmahe ||
10,100.05  indra ukthena śavasā parurdadhe bṛhaspate pratarītāsyāyuṣaḥ |
10,100.05 yajño manuḥ pramatirnaḥ pitā hi kamā sarvatātimaditiṃ vṛṇīmahe ||
10,100.06  indrasya nu sukṛtaṃ daivyaṃ saho'gnirgṛhe jaritā medhiraḥ kaviḥ |
10,100.06 yajñaśca bhūdvidathe cārurantama ā sarvatātimaditiṃ vṛṇīmahe ||
10,100.07  na vo guhā cakṛma bhūri duṣkṛtaṃ nāviṣṭyaṃ vasavo devaheḻanam |
10,100.07 mākirno devā anṛtasya varpasa ā sarvatātimaditiṃ vṛṇīmahe ||
10,100.08  apāmīvāṃ savitā sāviṣannyagvarīya idapa sedhantvadrayaḥ |
10,100.08 grāvā yatra madhuṣuducyate bṛhadā sarvatātimaditiṃ vṛṇīmahe ||
10,100.09  ūrdhvo grāvā vasavo'stu sotari viśvā dveṣāṃsi sanutaryuyota |
10,100.09 sa no devaḥ savitā pāyurīḍya ā sarvatātimaditiṃ vṛṇīmahe ||
10,100.10  ūrjaṃ gāvo yavase pīvo attana ṛtasya yāḥ sadane kośe aṅgdhve |
10,100.10 tanūreva tanvo astu bheṣajamā sarvatātimaditiṃ vṛṇīmahe ||
10,100.11  kratuprāvā jaritā śaśvatāmava indra idbhadrā pramatiḥ sutāvatām |
10,100.11 pūrṇamūdhardivyaṃ yasya siktaya ā sarvatātimaditiṃ vṛṇīmahe ||
10,100.12  citraste bhānuḥ kratuprā abhiṣṭiḥ santi spṛdho jaraṇiprā adhṛṣṭāḥ |
10,100.12 rajiṣṭhayā rajyā paśva ā gostūtūrṣati paryagraṃ duvasyuḥ ||

10,101.01  udbudhyadhvaṃ samanasaḥ sakhāyaḥ samagnimindhvaṃ bahavaḥ sanīḻāḥ |
10,101.01 dadhikrāmagnimuṣasaṃ ca devīmindrāvato'vase ni hvaye vaḥ ||
10,101.02  mandrā kṛṇudhvaṃ dhiya ā tanudhvaṃ nāvamaritraparaṇīṃ kṛṇudhvam |
10,101.02 iṣkṛṇudhvamāyudhāraṃ kṛṇudhvaṃ prāñcaṃ yajñaṃ pra ṇayatā sakhāyaḥ ||
10,101.03  yunakta sīrā vi yugā tanudhvaṃ kṛte yonau vapateha bījam |
10,101.03 girā ca śruṣṭiḥ sabharā asanno nedīya itsṛṇyaḥ pakvameyāt ||
10,101.04  sīrā yuñjanti kavayo yugā vi tanvate pṛthak |
10,101.04 dhīrā deveṣu sumnayā ||
10,101.05  nirāhāvānkṛṇotana saṃ varatrā dadhātana |
10,101.05 siñcāmahā avatamudriṇaṃ vayaṃ suṣekamanupakṣitam ||
10,101.06  iṣkṛtāhāvamavataṃ suvaratraṃ suṣecanam |
10,101.06 udriṇaṃ siñce akṣitam ||
10,101.07  prīṇītāśvānhitaṃ jayātha svastivāhaṃ rathamitkṛṇudhvam |
10,101.07 droṇāhāvamavatamaśmacakramaṃsatrakośaṃ siñcatā nṛpāṇam ||
10,101.08  vrajaṃ kṛṇudhvaṃ sa hi vo nṛpāṇo varma sīvyadhvaṃ bahulā pṛthūni |
10,101.08 puraḥ kṛṇudhvamāyasīradhṛṣṭā mā vaḥ susroccamaso dṛṃhatā tam ||
10,101.09  ā vo dhiyaṃ yajñiyāṃ varta ūtaye devā devīṃ yajatāṃ yajñiyāmiha |
10,101.09 sā no duhīyadyavaseva gatvī sahasradhārā payasā mahī gauḥ ||
10,101.10  ā tū ṣiñca harimīṃ drorupasthe vāśībhistakṣatāśmanmayībhiḥ |
10,101.10 pari ṣvajadhvaṃ daśa kakṣyābhirubhe dhurau prati vahniṃ yunakta ||
10,101.11  ubhe dhurau vahnirāpibdamāno'ntaryoneva carati dvijāniḥ |
10,101.11 vanaspatiṃ vana āsthāpayadhvaṃ ni ṣū dadhidhvamakhananta utsam ||
10,101.12  kapṛnnaraḥ kapṛthamuddadhātana codayata khudata vājasātaye |
10,101.12 niṣṭigryaḥ putramā cyāvayotaya indraṃ sabādha iha somapītaye ||

10,102.01  pra te rathaṃ mithūkṛtamindro'vatu dhṛṣṇuyā |
10,102.01 asminnājau puruhūta śravāyye dhanabhakṣeṣu no'va ||
10,102.02  utsma vāto vahati vāso'syā adhirathaṃ yadajayatsahasram |
10,102.02 rathīrabhūnmudgalānī gaviṣṭau bhare kṛtaṃ vyacedindrasenā ||
10,102.03  antaryaccha jighāṃsato vajramindrābhidāsataḥ |
10,102.03 dāsasya vā maghavannāryasya vā sanutaryavayā vadham ||
10,102.04  udno hradamapibajjarhṛṣāṇaḥ kūṭaṃ sma tṛṃhadabhimātimeti |
10,102.04 pra muṣkabhāraḥ śrava icchamāno'jiraṃ bāhū abharatsiṣāsan ||
10,102.05  nyakrandayannupayanta enamamehayanvṛṣabhaṃ madhya ājeḥ |
10,102.05 tena sūbharvaṃ śatavatsahasraṃ gavāṃ mudgalaḥ pradhane jigāya ||
10,102.06  kakardave vṛṣabho yukta āsīdavāvacītsārathirasya keśī |
10,102.06 dudheryuktasya dravataḥ sahānasa ṛcchanti ṣmā niṣpado mudgalānīm ||
10,102.07  uta pradhimudahannasya vidvānupāyunagvaṃsagamatra śikṣan |
10,102.07 indra udāvatpatimaghnyānāmaraṃhata padyābhiḥ kakudmān ||
10,102.08  śunamaṣṭrāvyacaratkapardī varatrāyāṃ dārvānahyamānaḥ |
10,102.08 nṛmṇāni kṛṇvanbahave janāya gāḥ paspaśānastaviṣīradhatta ||
10,102.09  imaṃ taṃ paśya vṛṣabhasya yuñjaṃ kāṣṭhāyā madhye drughaṇaṃ śayānam |
10,102.09 yena jigāya śatavatsahasraṃ gavāṃ mudgalaḥ pṛtanājyeṣu ||
10,102.10  āre aghā ko nvitthā dadarśa yaṃ yuñjanti taṃ vā sthāpayanti |
10,102.10 nāsmai tṛṇaṃ nodakamā bharantyuttaro dhuro vahati pradediśat ||
10,102.11  parivṛkteva patividyamānaṭpīpyānā kūcakreṇeva siñcan |
10,102.11 eṣaiṣyā cidrathyā jayema sumaṅgalaṃ sinavadastu sātam ||
10,102.12  tvaṃ viśvasya jagataścakṣurindrāsi cakṣuṣaḥ |
10,102.12 vṛṣā yadājiṃ vṛṣaṇā siṣāsasi codayanvadhriṇā yujā ||

10,103.01  āśuḥ śiśāno vṛṣabho na bhīmo ghanāghanaḥ kṣobhaṇaścarṣaṇīnām |
10,103.01 saṃkrandano'nimiṣa ekavīraḥ śataṃ senā ajayatsākamindraḥ ||
10,103.02  saṃkrandanenānimiṣeṇa jiṣṇunā yutkāreṇa duścyavanena dhṛṣṇunā |
10,103.02 tadindreṇa jayata tatsahadhvaṃ yudho nara iṣuhastena vṛṣṇā ||
10,103.03  sa iṣuhastaiḥ sa niṣaṅgibhirvaśī saṃsraṣṭā sa yudha indro gaṇena |
10,103.03 saṃsṛṣṭajitsomapā bāhuśardhyugradhanvā pratihitābhirastā ||
10,103.04  bṛhaspate pari dīyā rathena rakṣohāmitrāṃ apabādhamānaḥ |
10,103.04 prabhañjansenāḥ pramṛṇo yudhā jayannasmākamedhyavitā rathānām ||
10,103.05  balavijñāya sthaviraḥ pravīraḥ sahasvānvājī sahamāna ugraḥ |
10,103.05 abhivīro abhisatvā sahojā jaitramindra rathamā tiṣṭha govit ||
10,103.06  gotrabhidaṃ govidaṃ vajrabāhuṃ jayantamajma pramṛṇantamojasā |
10,103.06 imaṃ sajātā anu vīrayadhvamindraṃ sakhāyo anu saṃ rabhadhvam ||
10,103.07  abhi gotrāṇi sahasā gāhamāno'dayo vīraḥ śatamanyurindraḥ |
10,103.07 duścyavanaḥ pṛtanāṣāḻ ayudhyo'smākaṃ senā avatu pra yutsu ||
10,103.08  indra āsāṃ netā bṛhaspatirdakṣiṇā yajñaḥ pura etu somaḥ |
10,103.08 devasenānāmabhibhañjatīnāṃ jayantīnāṃ maruto yantvagram ||
10,103.09  indrasya vṛṣṇo varuṇasya rājña ādityānāṃ marutāṃ śardha ugram |
10,103.09 mahāmanasāṃ bhuvanacyavānāṃ ghoṣo devānāṃ jayatāmudasthāt ||
10,103.10  uddharṣaya maghavannāyudhānyutsatvanāṃ māmakānāṃ manāṃsi |
10,103.10 udvṛtrahanvājināṃ vājinānyudrathānāṃ jayatāṃ yantu ghoṣāḥ ||
10,103.11  asmākamindraḥ samṛteṣu dhvajeṣvasmākaṃ yā iṣavastā jayantu |
10,103.11 asmākaṃ vīrā uttare bhavantvasmāṃ u devā avatā haveṣu ||
10,103.12  amīṣāṃ cittaṃ pratilobhayantī gṛhāṇāṅgānyapve parehi |
10,103.12 abhi prehi nirdaha hṛtsu śokairandhenāmitrāstamasā sacantām ||
10,103.13  pretā jayatā nara indro vaḥ śarma yacchatu |
10,103.13 ugrā vaḥ santu bāhavo'nādhṛṣyā yathāsatha ||

10,104.01  asāvi somaḥ puruhūta tubhyaṃ haribhyāṃ yajñamupa yāhi tūyam |
10,104.01 tubhyaṃ giro vipravīrā iyānā dadhanvira indra pibā sutasya ||
10,104.02  apsu dhūtasya harivaḥ pibeha nṛbhiḥ sutasya jaṭharaṃ pṛṇasva |
10,104.02 mimikṣuryamadraya indra tubhyaṃ tebhirvardhasva madamukthavāhaḥ ||
10,104.03  progrāṃ pītiṃ vṛṣṇa iyarmi satyāṃ prayai sutasya haryaśva tubhyam |
10,104.03 indra dhenābhiriha mādayasva dhībhirviśvābhiḥ śacyā gṛṇānaḥ ||
10,104.04  ūtī śacīvastava vīryeṇa vayo dadhānā uśija ṛtajñāḥ |
10,104.04 prajāvadindra manuṣo duroṇe tasthurgṛṇantaḥ sadhamādyāsaḥ ||
10,104.05  praṇītibhiṣṭe haryaśva suṣṭoḥ suṣumnasya pururuco janāsaḥ |
10,104.05 maṃhiṣṭhāmūtiṃ vitire dadhānā stotāra indra tava sūnṛtābhiḥ ||
10,104.06  upa brahmāṇi harivo haribhyāṃ somasya yāhi pītaye sutasya |
10,104.06 indra tvā yajñaḥ kṣamamāṇamānaḍdāśvāṃ asyadhvarasya praketaḥ ||
10,104.07  sahasravājamabhimātiṣāhaṃ suteraṇaṃ maghavānaṃ suvṛktim |
10,104.07 upa bhūṣanti giro apratītamindraṃ namasyā jarituḥ pananta ||
10,104.08  saptāpo devīḥ suraṇā amṛktā yābhiḥ sindhumatara indra pūrbhit |
10,104.08 navatiṃ srotyā nava ca sravantīrdevebhyo gātuṃ manuṣe ca vindaḥ ||
10,104.09  apo mahīrabhiśasteramuñco'jāgarāsvadhi deva ekaḥ |
10,104.09 indra yāstvaṃ vṛtratūrye cakartha tābhirviśvāyustanvaṃ pupuṣyāḥ ||
10,104.10  vīreṇyaḥ kraturindraḥ suśastirutāpi dhenā puruhūtamīṭṭe |
10,104.10 ārdayadvṛtramakṛṇodu lokaṃ sasāhe śakraḥ pṛtanā abhiṣṭiḥ ||
10,104.11  śunaṃ huvema maghavānamindramasminbhare nṛtamaṃ vājasātau |
10,104.11 śṛṇvantamugramūtaye samatsu ghnantaṃ vṛtrāṇi saṃjitaṃ dhanānām ||

10,105.01  kadā vaso stotraṃ haryata āva śmaśā rudhadvāḥ |
10,105.01 dīrghaṃ sutaṃ vātāpyāya ||
10,105.02  harī yasya suyujā vivratā verarvantānu śepā |
10,105.02 ubhā rajī na keśinā patirdan ||
10,105.03  apa yorindraḥ pāpaja ā marto na śaśramāṇo bibhīvān |
10,105.03 śubhe yadyuyuje taviṣīvān ||
10,105.04  sacāyorindraścarkṛṣa āṃ upānasaḥ saparyan |
10,105.04 nadayorvivratayoḥ śūra indraḥ ||
10,105.05  adhi yastasthau keśavantā vyacasvantā na puṣṭyai |
10,105.05 vanoti śiprābhyāṃ śipriṇīvān ||
10,105.06  prāstaudṛṣvaujā ṛṣvebhistatakṣa śūraḥ śavasā |
10,105.06 ṛbhurna kratubhirmātariśvā ||
10,105.07  vajraṃ yaścakre suhanāya dasyave hirīmaśo hirīmān |
10,105.07 arutahanuradbhutaṃ na rajaḥ ||
10,105.08  ava no vṛjinā śiśīhyṛcā vanemānṛcaḥ |
10,105.08 nābrahmā yajña ṛdhagjoṣati tve ||
10,105.09  ūrdhvā yatte tretinī bhūdyajñasya dhūrṣu sadman |
10,105.09 sajūrnāvaṃ svayaśasaṃ sacāyoḥ ||
10,105.10  śriye te pṛśnirupasecanī bhūcchriye darvirarepāḥ |
10,105.10 yayā sve pātre siñcasa ut ||
10,105.11  śataṃ vā yadasurya prati tvā sumitra itthāstauddurmitra itthāstaut |
10,105.11 āvo yaddasyuhatye kutsaputraṃ prāvo yaddasyuhatye kutsavatsam ||

10,106.01  ubhā u nūnaṃ tadidarthayethe vi tanvāthe dhiyo vastrāpaseva |
10,106.01 sadhrīcīnā yātave premajīgaḥ sudineva pṛkṣa ā taṃsayethe ||
10,106.02  uṣṭāreva pharvareṣu śrayethe prāyogeva śvātryā śāsurethaḥ |
10,106.02 dūteva hi ṣṭho yaśasā janeṣu māpa sthātaṃ mahiṣevāvapānāt ||
10,106.03  sākaṃyujā śakunasyeva pakṣā paśveva citrā yajurā gamiṣṭam |
10,106.03 agniriva devayordīdivāṃsā parijmāneva yajathaḥ purutrā ||
10,106.04  āpī vo asme pitareva putrogreva rucā nṛpatīva turyai |
10,106.04 iryeva puṣṭyai kiraṇeva bhujyai śruṣṭīvāneva havamā gamiṣṭam ||
10,106.05  vaṃsageva pūṣaryā śimbātā mitreva ṛtā śatarā śātapantā |
10,106.05 vājevoccā vayasā gharmyeṣṭhā meṣeveṣā saparyā purīṣā ||
10,106.06  sṛṇyeva jarbharī turpharītū naitośeva turpharī parpharīkā |
10,106.06 udanyajeva jemanā maderū tā me jarāyvajaraṃ marāyu ||
10,106.07  pajreva carcaraṃ jāraṃ marāyu kṣadmevārtheṣu tartarītha ugrā |
10,106.07 ṛbhū nāpatkharamajrā kharajrurvāyurna parpharatkṣayadrayīṇām ||
10,106.08  gharmeva madhu jaṭhare sanerū bhagevitā turpharī phārivāram |
10,106.08 patareva cacarā candranirṇiṅmanaṛṅgā mananyā na jagmī ||
10,106.09  bṛhanteva gambhareṣu pratiṣṭhāṃ pādeva gādhaṃ tarate vidāthaḥ |
10,106.09 karṇeva śāsuranu hi smarātho'ṃśeva no bhajataṃ citramapnaḥ ||
10,106.10  āraṅgareva madhverayethe sāragheva gavi nīcīnabāre |
10,106.10 kīnāreva svedamāsiṣvidānā kṣāmevorjā sūyavasātsacethe ||
10,106.11  ṛdhyāma stomaṃ sanuyāma vājamā no mantraṃ sarathehopa yātam |
10,106.11 yaśo na pakvaṃ madhu goṣvantarā bhūtāṃśo aśvinoḥ kāmamaprāḥ ||

10,107.01  āvirabhūnmahi māghonameṣāṃ viśvaṃ jīvaṃ tamaso niramoci |
10,107.01 mahi jyotiḥ pitṛbhirdattamāgāduruḥ panthā dakṣiṇāyā adarśi ||
10,107.02  uccā divi dakṣiṇāvanto asthurye aśvadāḥ saha te sūryeṇa |
10,107.02 hiraṇyadā amṛtatvaṃ bhajante vāsodāḥ soma pra tiranta āyuḥ ||
10,107.03  daivī pūrtirdakṣiṇā devayajyā na kavāribhyo nahi te pṛṇanti |
10,107.03 athā naraḥ prayatadakṣiṇāso'vadyabhiyā bahavaḥ pṛṇanti ||
10,107.04  śatadhāraṃ vāyumarkaṃ svarvidaṃ nṛcakṣasaste abhi cakṣate haviḥ |
10,107.04 ye pṛṇanti pra ca yacchanti saṃgame te dakṣiṇāṃ duhate saptamātaram ||
10,107.05  dakṣiṇāvānprathamo hūta eti dakṣiṇāvāngrāmaṇīragrameti |
10,107.05 tameva manye nṛpatiṃ janānāṃ yaḥ prathamo dakṣiṇāmāvivāya ||
10,107.06  tameva ṛṣiṃ tamu brahmāṇamāhuryajñanyaṃ sāmagāmukthaśāsam |
10,107.06 sa śukrasya tanvo veda tisro yaḥ prathamo dakṣiṇayā rarādha ||
10,107.07  dakṣiṇāśvaṃ dakṣiṇā gāṃ dadāti dakṣiṇā candramuta yaddhiraṇyam |
10,107.07 dakṣiṇānnaṃ vanute yo na ātmā dakṣiṇāṃ varma kṛṇute vijānan ||
10,107.08  na bhojā mamrurna nyarthamīyurna riṣyanti na vyathante ha bhojāḥ |
10,107.08 idaṃ yadviśvaṃ bhuvanaṃ svaścaitatsarvaṃ dakṣiṇaibhyo dadāti ||
10,107.09  bhojā jigyuḥ surabhiṃ yonimagre bhojā jigyurvadhvaṃ yā suvāsāḥ |
10,107.09 bhojā jigyurantaḥpeyaṃ surāyā bhojā jigyurye ahūtāḥ prayanti ||
10,107.10  bhojāyāśvaṃ saṃ mṛjantyāśuṃ bhojāyāste kanyā śumbhamānā |
10,107.10 bhojasyedaṃ puṣkariṇīva veśma pariṣkṛtaṃ devamāneva citram ||
10,107.11  bhojamaśvāḥ suṣṭhuvāho vahanti suvṛdratho vartate dakṣiṇāyāḥ |
10,107.11 bhojaṃ devāso'vatā bhareṣu bhojaḥ śatrūnsamanīkeṣu jetā ||

10,108.01  kimicchantī saramā predamānaḍdūre hyadhvā jaguriḥ parācaiḥ |
10,108.01 kāsmehitiḥ kā paritakmyāsītkathaṃ rasāyā ataraḥ payāṃsi ||
10,108.02  indrasya dūtīriṣitā carāmi maha icchantī paṇayo nidhīnvaḥ |
10,108.02 atiṣkado bhiyasā tanna āvattathā rasāyā ataraṃ payāṃsi ||
10,108.03  kīdṛṅṅindraḥ sarame kā dṛśīkā yasyedaṃ dūtīrasaraḥ parākāt |
10,108.03 ā ca gacchānmitramenā dadhāmāthā gavāṃ gopatirno bhavāti ||
10,108.04  nāhaṃ taṃ veda dabhyaṃ dabhatsa yasyedaṃ dūtīrasaraṃ parākāt |
10,108.04 na taṃ gūhanti sravato gabhīrā hatā indreṇa paṇayaḥ śayadhve ||
10,108.05  imā gāvaḥ sarame yā aicchaḥ pari divo antānsubhage patantī |
10,108.05 kasta enā ava sṛjādayudhvyutāsmākamāyudhā santi tigmā ||
10,108.06  asenyā vaḥ paṇayo vacāṃsyaniṣavyāstanvaḥ santu pāpīḥ |
10,108.06 adhṛṣṭo va etavā astu panthā bṛhaspatirva ubhayā na mṛḻāt ||
10,108.07  ayaṃ nidhiḥ sarame adribudhno gobhiraśvebhirvasubhirnyṛṣṭaḥ |
10,108.07 rakṣanti taṃ paṇayo ye sugopā reku padamalakamā jagantha ||
10,108.08  eha gamannṛṣayaḥ somaśitā ayāsyo aṅgiraso navagvāḥ |
10,108.08 ta etamūrvaṃ vi bhajanta gonāmathaitadvacaḥ paṇayo vamannit ||
10,108.09  evā ca tvaṃ sarama ājagantha prabādhitā sahasā daivyena |
10,108.09 svasāraṃ tvā kṛṇavai mā punargā apa te gavāṃ subhage bhajāma ||
10,108.10  nāhaṃ veda bhrātṛtvaṃ no svasṛtvamindro viduraṅgirasaśca ghorāḥ |
10,108.10 gokāmā me acchadayanyadāyamapāta ita paṇayo varīyaḥ ||
10,108.11  dūramita paṇayo varīya udgāvo yantu minatīrṛtena |
10,108.11 bṛhaspatiryā avindannigūḻhāḥ somo grāvāṇa ṛṣayaśca viprāḥ ||

10,109.01  te'vadanprathamā brahmakilbiṣe'kūpāraḥ salilo mātariśvā |
10,109.01 vīḻuharāstapa ugro mayobhūrāpo devīḥ prathamajā ṛtena ||
10,109.02  somo rājā prathamo brahmajāyāṃ punaḥ prāyacchadahṛṇīyamānaḥ |
10,109.02 anvartitā varuṇo mitra āsīdagnirhotā hastagṛhyā nināya ||
10,109.03  hastenaiva grāhya ādhirasyā brahmajāyeyamiti cedavocan |
10,109.03 na dūtāya prahye tastha eṣā tathā rāṣṭraṃ gupitaṃ kṣatriyasya ||
10,109.04  devā etasyāmavadanta pūrve saptaṛṣayastapase ye niṣeduḥ |
10,109.04 bhīmā jāyā brāhmaṇasyopanītā durdhāṃ dadhāti parame vyoman ||
10,109.05  brahmacārī carati veviṣadviṣaḥ sa devānāṃ bhavatyekamaṅgam |
10,109.05 tena jāyāmanvavindadbṛhaspatiḥ somena nītāṃ juhvaṃ na devāḥ ||
10,109.06  punarvai devā adaduḥ punarmanuṣyā uta |
10,109.06 rājānaḥ satyaṃ kṛṇvānā brahmajāyāṃ punardaduḥ ||
10,109.07  punardāya brahmajāyāṃ kṛtvī devairnikilbiṣam |
10,109.07 ūrjaṃ pṛthivyā bhaktvāyorugāyamupāsate ||

10,110.01  samiddho adya manuṣo duroṇe devo devānyajasi jātavedaḥ |
10,110.01 ā ca vaha mitramahaścikitvāntvaṃ dūtaḥ kavirasi pracetāḥ ||
10,110.02  tanūnapātpatha ṛtasya yānānmadhvā samañjansvadayā sujihva |
10,110.02 manmāni dhībhiruta yajñamṛndhandevatrā ca kṛṇuhyadhvaraṃ naḥ ||
10,110.03  ājuhvāna īḍyo vandyaścā yāhyagne vasubhiḥ sajoṣāḥ |
10,110.03 tvaṃ devānāmasi yahva hotā sa enānyakṣīṣito yajīyān ||
10,110.04  prācīnaṃ barhiḥ pradiśā pṛthivyā vastorasyā vṛjyate agre ahnām |
10,110.04 vyu prathate vitaraṃ varīyo devebhyo aditaye syonam ||
10,110.05  vyacasvatīrurviyā vi śrayantāṃ patibhyo na janayaḥ śumbhamānāḥ |
10,110.05 devīrdvāro bṛhatīrviśvaminvā devebhyo bhavata suprāyaṇāḥ ||
10,110.06  ā suṣvayantī yajate upāke uṣāsānaktā sadatāṃ ni yonau |
10,110.06 divye yoṣaṇe bṛhatī surukme adhi śriyaṃ śukrapiśaṃ dadhāne ||
10,110.07  daivyā hotārā prathamā suvācā mimānā yajñaṃ manuṣo yajadhyai |
10,110.07 pracodayantā vidatheṣu kārū prācīnaṃ jyotiḥ pradiśā diśantā ||
10,110.08  ā no yajñaṃ bhāratī tūyametviḻā manuṣvadiha cetayantī |
10,110.08 tisro devīrbarhiredaṃ syonaṃ sarasvatī svapasaḥ sadantu ||
10,110.09  ya ime dyāvāpṛthivī janitrī rūpairapiṃśadbhuvanāni viśvā |
10,110.09 tamadya hotariṣito yajīyāndevaṃ tvaṣṭāramiha yakṣi vidvān ||
10,110.10  upāvasṛja tmanyā samañjandevānāṃ pātha ṛtuthā havīṃṣi |
10,110.10 vanaspatiḥ śamitā devo agniḥ svadantu havyaṃ madhunā ghṛtena ||
10,110.11  sadyo jāto vyamimīta yajñamagnirdevānāmabhavatpurogāḥ |
10,110.11 asya hotuḥ pradiśyṛtasya vāci svāhākṛtaṃ haviradantu devāḥ ||

10,111.01  manīṣiṇaḥ pra bharadhvaṃ manīṣāṃ yathāyathā matayaḥ santi nṛṇām |
10,111.01 indraṃ satyairerayāmā kṛtebhiḥ sa hi vīro girvaṇasyurvidānaḥ ||
10,111.02  ṛtasya hi sadaso dhītiradyautsaṃ gārṣṭeyo vṛṣabho gobhirānaṭ |
10,111.02 udatiṣṭhattaviṣeṇā raveṇa mahānti citsaṃ vivyācā rajāṃsi ||
10,111.03  indraḥ kila śrutyā asya veda sa hi jiṣṇuḥ pathikṛtsūryāya |
10,111.03 ānmenāṃ kṛṇvannacyuto bhuvadgoḥ patirdivaḥ sanajā apratītaḥ ||
10,111.04  indro mahnā mahato arṇavasya vratāminādaṅgirobhirgṛṇānaḥ |
10,111.04 purūṇi cinni tatānā rajāṃsi dādhāra yo dharuṇaṃ satyatātā ||
10,111.05  indro divaḥ pratimānaṃ pṛthivyā viśvā veda savanā hanti śuṣṇam |
10,111.05 mahīṃ ciddyāmātanotsūryeṇa cāskambha citkambhanena skabhīyān ||
10,111.06  vajreṇa hi vṛtrahā vṛtramastaradevasya śūśuvānasya māyāḥ |
10,111.06 vi dhṛṣṇo atra dhṛṣatā jaghanthāthābhavo maghavanbāhvojāḥ ||
10,111.07  sacanta yaduṣasaḥ sūryeṇa citrāmasya ketavo rāmavindan |
10,111.07 ā yannakṣatraṃ dadṛśe divo na punaryato nakiraddhā nu veda ||
10,111.08  dūraṃ kila prathamā jagmurāsāmindrasya yāḥ prasave sasrurāpaḥ |
10,111.08 kva svidagraṃ kva budhna āsāmāpo madhyaṃ kva vo nūnamantaḥ ||
10,111.09  sṛjaḥ sindhūṃrahinā jagrasānāṃ ādidetāḥ pra vivijre javena |
10,111.09 mumukṣamāṇā uta yā mumucre'dhedetā na ramante nitiktāḥ ||
10,111.10  sadhrīcīḥ sindhumuśatīrivāyansanājjāra āritaḥ pūrbhidāsām |
10,111.10 astamā te pārthivā vasūnyasme jagmuḥ sūnṛtā indra pūrvīḥ ||

10,112.01  indra piba pratikāmaṃ sutasya prātaḥsāvastava hi pūrvapītiḥ |
10,112.01 harṣasva hantave śūra śatrūnukthebhiṣṭe vīryā pra bravāma ||
10,112.02  yaste ratho manaso javīyānendra tena somapeyāya yāhi |
10,112.02 tūyamā te harayaḥ pra dravantu yebhiryāsi vṛṣabhirmandamānaḥ ||
10,112.03  haritvatā varcasā sūryasya śreṣṭhai rūpaistanvaṃ sparśayasva |
10,112.03 asmābhirindra sakhibhirhuvānaḥ sadhrīcīno mādayasvā niṣadya ||
10,112.04  yasya tyatte mahimānaṃ madeṣvime mahī rodasī nāviviktām |
10,112.04 tadoka ā haribhirindra yuktaiḥ priyebhiryāhi priyamannamaccha ||
10,112.05  yasya śaśvatpapivāṃ indra śatrūnanānukṛtyā raṇyā cakartha |
10,112.05 sa te purandhiṃ taviṣīmiyarti sa te madāya suta indra somaḥ ||
10,112.06  idaṃ te pātraṃ sanavittamindra pibā somamenā śatakrato |
10,112.06 pūrṇa āhāvo madirasya madhvo yaṃ viśva idabhiharyanti devāḥ ||
10,112.07  vi hi tvāmindra purudhā janāso hitaprayaso vṛṣabha hvayante |
10,112.07 asmākaṃ te madhumattamānīmā bhuvansavanā teṣu harya ||
10,112.08  pra ta indra pūrvyāṇi pra nūnaṃ vīryā vocaṃ prathamā kṛtāni |
10,112.08 satīnamanyuraśrathāyo adriṃ suvedanāmakṛṇorbrahmaṇe gām ||
10,112.09  ni ṣu sīda gaṇapate gaṇeṣu tvāmāhurvipratamaṃ kavīnām |
10,112.09 na ṛte tvatkriyate kiṃ canāre mahāmarkaṃ maghavañcitramarca ||
10,112.10  abhikhyā no maghavannādhamānānsakhe bodhi vasupate sakhīnām |
10,112.10 raṇaṃ kṛdhi raṇakṛtsatyaśuṣmābhakte cidā bhajā rāye asmān ||

10,113.01  tamasya dyāvāpṛthivī sacetasā viśvebhirdevairanu śuṣmamāvatām |
10,113.01 yadaitkṛṇvāno mahimānamindriyaṃ pītvī somasya kratumāṃ avardhata ||
10,113.02  tamasya viṣṇurmahimānamojasāṃśuṃ dadhanvānmadhuno vi rapśate |
10,113.02 devebhirindro maghavā sayāvabhirvṛtraṃ jaghanvāṃ abhavadvareṇyaḥ ||
10,113.03  vṛtreṇa yadahinā bibhradāyudhā samasthithā yudhaye śaṃsamāvide |
10,113.03 viśve te atra marutaḥ saha tmanāvardhannugra mahimānamindriyam ||
10,113.04  jajñāna eva vyabādhata spṛdhaḥ prāpaśyadvīro abhi pauṃsyaṃ raṇam |
10,113.04 avṛścadadrimava sasyadaḥ sṛjadastabhnānnākaṃ svapasyayā pṛthum ||
10,113.05  ādindraḥ satrā taviṣīrapatyata varīyo dyāvāpṛthivī abādhata |
10,113.05 avābharaddhṛṣito vajramāyasaṃ śevaṃ mitrāya varuṇāya dāśuṣe ||
10,113.06  indrasyātra taviṣībhyo virapśina ṛghāyato araṃhayanta manyave |
10,113.06 vṛtraṃ yadugro vyavṛścadojasāpo bibhrataṃ tamasā parīvṛtam ||
10,113.07  yā vīryāṇi prathamāni kartvā mahitvebhiryatamānau samīyatuḥ |
10,113.07 dhvāntaṃ tamo'va dadhvase hata indro mahnā pūrvahūtāvapatyata ||
10,113.08  viśve devāso adha vṛṣṇyāni te'vardhayansomavatyā vacasyayā |
10,113.08 raddhaṃ vṛtramahimindrasya hanmanāgnirna jambhaistṛṣvannamāvayat ||
10,113.09  bhūri dakṣebhirvacanebhirṛkvabhiḥ sakhyebhiḥ sakhyāni pra vocata |
10,113.09 indro dhuniṃ ca cumuriṃ ca dambhayañchraddhāmanasyā śṛṇute dabhītaye ||
10,113.10  tvaṃ purūṇyā bharā svaśvyā yebhirmaṃsai nivacanāni śaṃsan |
10,113.10 sugebhirviśvā duritā tarema vido ṣu ṇa urviyā gādhamadya ||

10,114.01  gharmā samantā trivṛtaṃ vyāpatustayorjuṣṭiṃ mātariśvā jagāma |
10,114.01 divaspayo didhiṣāṇā aveṣanvidurdevāḥ sahasāmānamarkam ||
10,114.02  tisro deṣṭrāya nirṛtīrupāsate dīrghaśruto vi hi jānanti vahnayaḥ |
10,114.02 tāsāṃ ni cikyuḥ kavayo nidānaṃ pareṣu yā guhyeṣu vrateṣu ||
10,114.03  catuṣkapardā yuvatiḥ supeśā ghṛtapratīkā vayunāni vaste |
10,114.03 tasyāṃ suparṇā vṛṣaṇā ni ṣedaturyatra devā dadhire bhāgadheyam ||
10,114.04  ekaḥ suparṇaḥ sa samudramā viveśa sa idaṃ viśvaṃ bhuvanaṃ vi caṣṭe |
10,114.04 taṃ pākena manasāpaśyamantitastaṃ mātā reḻhi sa u reḻhi mātaram ||
10,114.05  suparṇaṃ viprāḥ kavayo vacobhirekaṃ santaṃ bahudhā kalpayanti |
10,114.05 chandāṃsi ca dadhato adhvareṣu grahānsomasya mimate dvādaśa ||
10,114.06  ṣaṭtriṃśāṃśca caturaḥ kalpayantaśchandāṃsi ca dadhata ādvādaśam |
10,114.06 yajñaṃ vimāya kavayo manīṣa ṛksāmābhyāṃ pra rathaṃ vartayanti ||
10,114.07  caturdaśānye mahimāno asya taṃ dhīrā vācā pra ṇayanti sapta |
10,114.07 āpnānaṃ tīrthaṃ ka iha pra vocadyena pathā prapibante sutasya ||
10,114.08  sahasradhā pañcadaśānyukthā yāvaddyāvāpṛthivī tāvadittat |
10,114.08 sahasradhā mahimānaḥ sahasraṃ yāvadbrahma viṣṭhitaṃ tāvatī vāk ||
10,114.09  kaśchandasāṃ yogamā veda dhīraḥ ko dhiṣṇyāṃ prati vācaṃ papāda |
10,114.09 kamṛtvijāmaṣṭamaṃ śūramāhurharī indrasya ni cikāya kaḥ svit ||
10,114.10  bhūmyā antaṃ paryeke caranti rathasya dhūrṣu yuktāso asthuḥ |
10,114.10 śramasya dāyaṃ vi bhajantyebhyo yadā yamo bhavati harmye hitaḥ ||

10,115.01  citra icchiśostaruṇasya vakṣatho na yo mātarāvapyeti dhātave |
10,115.01 anūdhā yadi jījanadadhā ca nu vavakṣa sadyo mahi dūtyaṃ caran ||
10,115.02  agnirha nāma dhāyi dannapastamaḥ saṃ yo vanā yuvate bhasmanā datā |
10,115.02 abhipramurā juhvā svadhvara ino na prothamāno yavase vṛṣā ||
10,115.03  taṃ vo viṃ na druṣadaṃ devamandhasa induṃ prothantaṃ pravapantamarṇavam |
10,115.03 āsā vahniṃ na śociṣā virapśinaṃ mahivrataṃ na sarajantamadhvanaḥ ||
10,115.04  vi yasya te jrayasānasyājara dhakṣorna vātāḥ pari santyacyutāḥ |
10,115.04 ā raṇvāso yuyudhayo na satvanaṃ tritaṃ naśanta pra śiṣanta iṣṭaye ||
10,115.05  sa idagniḥ kaṇvatamaḥ kaṇvasakhāryaḥ parasyāntarasya taruṣaḥ |
10,115.05 agniḥ pātu gṛṇato agniḥ sūrīnagnirdadātu teṣāmavo naḥ ||
10,115.06  vājintamāya sahyase supitrya tṛṣu cyavāno anu jātavedase |
10,115.06 anudre cidyo dhṛṣatā varaṃ sate mahintamāya dhanvanedaviṣyate ||
10,115.07  evāgnirmartaiḥ saha sūribhirvasu ṣṭave sahasaḥ sūnaro nṛbhiḥ |
10,115.07 mitrāso na ye sudhitā ṛtāyavo dyāvo na dyumnairabhi santi mānuṣān ||
10,115.08  ūrjo napātsahasāvanniti tvopastutasya vandate vṛṣā vāk |
10,115.08 tvāṃ stoṣāma tvayā suvīrā drāghīya āyuḥ prataraṃ dadhānāḥ ||
10,115.09  iti tvāgne vṛṣṭihavyasya putrā upastutāsa ṛṣayo'vocan |
10,115.09 tāṃśca pāhi gṛṇataśca sūrīnvaṣaḍvaṣaḻ ityūrdhvāso anakṣannamo nama ityūrdhvāso anakṣan ||

10,116.01  pibā somaṃ mahata indriyāya pibā vṛtrāya hantave śaviṣṭha |
10,116.01 piba rāye śavase hūyamānaḥ piba madhvastṛpadindrā vṛṣasva ||
10,116.02  asya piba kṣumataḥ prasthitasyendra somasya varamā sutasya |
10,116.02 svastidā manasā mādayasvārvācīno revate saubhagāya ||
10,116.03  mamattu tvā divyaḥ soma indra mamattu yaḥ sūyate pārthiveṣu |
10,116.03 mamattu yena varivaścakartha mamattu yena niriṇāsi śatrūn ||
10,116.04  ā dvibarhā amino yātvindro vṛṣā haribhyāṃ pariṣiktamandhaḥ |
10,116.04 gavyā sutasya prabhṛtasya madhvaḥ satrā khedāmaruśahā vṛṣasva ||
10,116.05  ni tigmāni bhrāśayanbhrāśyānyava sthirā tanuhi yātujūnām |
10,116.05 ugrāya te saho balaṃ dadāmi pratītyā śatrūnvigadeṣu vṛśca ||
10,116.06  vyarya indra tanuhi śravāṃsyoja sthireva dhanvano'bhimātīḥ |
10,116.06 asmadryagvāvṛdhānaḥ sahobhiranibhṛṣṭastanvaṃ vāvṛdhasva ||
10,116.07  idaṃ havirmaghavantubhyaṃ rātaṃ prati samrāḻ ahṛṇāno gṛbhāya |
10,116.07 tubhyaṃ suto maghavantubhyaṃ pakvo'ddhīndra piba ca prasthitasya ||
10,116.08  addhīdindra prasthitemā havīṃṣi cano dadhiṣva pacatota somam |
10,116.08 prayasvantaḥ prati haryāmasi tvā satyāḥ santu yajamānasya kāmāḥ ||
10,116.09  prendrāgnibhyāṃ suvacasyāmiyarmi sindhāviva prerayaṃ nāvamarkaiḥ |
10,116.09 ayā iva pari caranti devā ye asmabhyaṃ dhanadā udbhidaśca ||

10,117.01  na vā u devāḥ kṣudhamidvadhaṃ dadurutāśitamupa gacchanti mṛtyavaḥ |
10,117.01 uto rayiḥ pṛṇato nopa dasyatyutāpṛṇanmarḍitāraṃ na vindate ||
10,117.02  ya ādhrāya cakamānāya pitvo'nnavānsanraphitāyopajagmuṣe |
10,117.02 sthiraṃ manaḥ kṛṇute sevate puroto citsa marḍitāraṃ na vindate ||
10,117.03  sa idbhojo yo gṛhave dadātyannakāmāya carate kṛśāya |
10,117.03 aramasmai bhavati yāmahūtā utāparīṣu kṛṇute sakhāyam ||
10,117.04  na sa sakhā yo na dadāti sakhye sacābhuve sacamānāya pitvaḥ |
10,117.04 apāsmātpreyānna tadoko asti pṛṇantamanyamaraṇaṃ cidicchet ||
10,117.05  pṛṇīyādinnādhamānāya tavyāndrāghīyāṃsamanu paśyeta panthām |
10,117.05 o hi vartante rathyeva cakrānyamanyamupa tiṣṭhanta rāyaḥ ||
10,117.06  moghamannaṃ vindate apracetāḥ satyaṃ bravīmi vadha itsa tasya |
10,117.06 nāryamaṇaṃ puṣyati no sakhāyaṃ kevalāgho bhavati kevalādī ||
10,117.07  kṛṣannitphāla āśitaṃ kṛṇoti yannadhvānamapa vṛṅkte caritraiḥ |
10,117.07 vadanbrahmāvadato vanīyānpṛṇannāpirapṛṇantamabhi ṣyāt ||
10,117.08  ekapādbhūyo dvipado vi cakrame dvipāttripādamabhyeti paścāt |
10,117.08 catuṣpādeti dvipadāmabhisvare sampaśyanpaṅktīrupatiṣṭhamānaḥ ||
10,117.09  samau ciddhastau na samaṃ viviṣṭaḥ sammātarā cinna samaṃ duhāte |
10,117.09 yamayościnna samā vīryāṇi jñātī citsantau na samaṃ pṛṇītaḥ ||

10,118.01  agne haṃsi nyatriṇaṃ dīdyanmartyeṣvā |
10,118.01 sve kṣaye śucivrata ||
10,118.02  uttiṣṭhasi svāhuto ghṛtāni prati modase |
10,118.02 yattvā srucaḥ samasthiran ||
10,118.03  sa āhuto vi rocate'gnirīḻenyo girā |
10,118.03 srucā pratīkamajyate ||
10,118.04  ghṛtenāgniḥ samajyate madhupratīka āhutaḥ |
10,118.04 rocamāno vibhāvasuḥ ||
10,118.05  jaramāṇaḥ samidhyase devebhyo havyavāhana |
10,118.05 taṃ tvā havanta martyāḥ ||
10,118.06  taṃ martā amartyaṃ ghṛtenāgniṃ saparyata |
10,118.06 adābhyaṃ gṛhapatim ||
10,118.07  adābhyena śociṣāgne rakṣastvaṃ daha |
10,118.07 gopā ṛtasya dīdihi ||
10,118.08  sa tvamagne pratīkena pratyoṣa yātudhānyaḥ |
10,118.08 urukṣayeṣu dīdyat ||
10,118.09  taṃ tvā gīrbhirurukṣayā havyavāhaṃ samīdhire |
10,118.09 yajiṣṭhaṃ mānuṣe jane ||

10,119.01  iti vā iti me mano gāmaśvaṃ sanuyāmiti |
10,119.01 kuvitsomasyāpāmiti ||
10,119.02  pra vātā iva dodhata unmā pītā ayaṃsata |
10,119.02 kuvitsomasyāpāmiti ||
10,119.03  unmā pītā ayaṃsata rathamaśvā ivāśavaḥ |
10,119.03 kuvitsomasyāpāmiti ||
10,119.04  upa mā matirasthita vāśrā putramiva priyam |
10,119.04 kuvitsomasyāpāmiti ||
10,119.05  ahaṃ taṣṭeva vandhuraṃ paryacāmi hṛdā matim |
10,119.05 kuvitsomasyāpāmiti ||
10,119.06  nahi me akṣipaccanācchāntsuḥ pañca kṛṣṭayaḥ |
10,119.06 kuvitsomasyāpāmiti ||
10,119.07  nahi me rodasī ubhe anyaṃ pakṣaṃ cana prati |
10,119.07 kuvitsomasyāpāmiti ||
10,119.08  abhi dyāṃ mahinā bhuvamabhīmāṃ pṛthivīṃ mahīm |
10,119.08 kuvitsomasyāpāmiti ||
10,119.09  hantāhaṃ pṛthivīmimāṃ ni dadhānīha veha vā |
10,119.09 kuvitsomasyāpāmiti ||
10,119.10  oṣamitpṛthivīmahaṃ jaṅghanānīha veha vā |
10,119.10 kuvitsomasyāpāmiti ||
10,119.11  divi me anyaḥ pakṣo'dho anyamacīkṛṣam |
10,119.11 kuvitsomasyāpāmiti ||
10,119.12  ahamasmi mahāmaho'bhinabhyamudīṣitaḥ |
10,119.12 kuvitsomasyāpāmiti ||
10,119.13  gṛho yāmyaraṅkṛto devebhyo havyavāhanaḥ |
10,119.13 kuvitsomasyāpāmiti ||

10,120.01  tadidāsa bhuvaneṣu jyeṣṭhaṃ yato jajña ugrastveṣanṛmṇaḥ |
10,120.01 sadyo jajñāno ni riṇāti śatrūnanu yaṃ viśve madantyūmāḥ ||
10,120.02  vāvṛdhānaḥ śavasā bhūryojāḥ śatrurdāsāya bhiyasaṃ dadhāti |
10,120.02 avyanacca vyanacca sasni saṃ te navanta prabhṛtā madeṣu ||
10,120.03  tve kratumapi vṛñjanti viśve dviryadete trirbhavantyūmāḥ |
10,120.03 svādoḥ svādīyaḥ svādunā sṛjā samadaḥ su madhu madhunābhi yodhīḥ ||
10,120.04  iti ciddhi tvā dhanā jayantaṃ mademade anumadanti viprāḥ |
10,120.04 ojīyo dhṛṣṇo sthiramā tanuṣva mā tvā dabhanyātudhānā durevāḥ ||
10,120.05  tvayā vayaṃ śāśadmahe raṇeṣu prapaśyanto yudhenyāni bhūri |
10,120.05 codayāmi ta āyudhā vacobhiḥ saṃ te śiśāmi brahmaṇā vayāṃsi ||
10,120.06  stuṣeyyaṃ puruvarpasamṛbhvaminatamamāptyamāptyānām |
10,120.06 ā darṣate śavasā sapta dānūnpra sākṣate pratimānāni bhūri ||
10,120.07  ni taddadhiṣe'varaṃ paraṃ ca yasminnāvithāvasā duroṇe |
10,120.07 ā mātarā sthāpayase jigatnū ata inoṣi karvarā purūṇi ||
10,120.08  imā brahma bṛhaddivo vivaktīndrāya śūṣamagriyaḥ svarṣāḥ |
10,120.08 maho gotrasya kṣayati svarājo duraśca viśvā avṛṇodapa svāḥ ||
10,120.09  evā mahānbṛhaddivo atharvāvocatsvāṃ tanvamindrameva |
10,120.09 svasāro mātaribhvarīrariprā hinvanti ca śavasā vardhayanti ca ||

10,121.01  hiraṇyagarbhaḥ samavartatāgre bhūtasya jātaḥ patireka āsīt |
10,121.01 sa dādhāra pṛthivīṃ dyāmutemāṃ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema ||
10,121.02  ya ātmadā baladā yasya viśva upāsate praśiṣaṃ yasya devāḥ |
10,121.02 yasya chāyāmṛtaṃ yasya mṛtyuḥ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema ||
10,121.03  yaḥ prāṇato nimiṣato mahitvaika idrājā jagato babhūva |
10,121.03 ya īśe asya dvipadaścatuṣpadaḥ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema ||
10,121.04  yasyeme himavanto mahitvā yasya samudraṃ rasayā sahāhuḥ |
10,121.04 yasyemāḥ pradiśo yasya bāhū kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema ||
10,121.05  yena dyaurugrā pṛthivī ca dṛḻhā yena sva stabhitaṃ yena nākaḥ |
10,121.05 yo antarikṣe rajaso vimānaḥ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema ||
10,121.06  yaṃ krandasī avasā tastabhāne abhyaikṣetāṃ manasā rejamāne |
10,121.06 yatrādhi sūra udito vibhāti kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema ||
10,121.07  āpo ha yadbṛhatīrviśvamāyangarbhaṃ dadhānā janayantīragnim |
10,121.07 tato devānāṃ samavartatāsurekaḥ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema ||
10,121.08  yaścidāpo mahinā paryapaśyaddakṣaṃ dadhānā janayantīryajñam |
10,121.08 yo deveṣvadhi deva eka āsītkasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema ||
10,121.09  mā no hiṃsījjanitā yaḥ pṛthivyā yo vā divaṃ satyadharmā jajāna |
10,121.09 yaścāpaścandrā bṛhatīrjajāna kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema ||
10,121.10  prajāpate na tvadetānyanyo viśvā jātāni pari tā babhūva |
10,121.10 yatkāmāste juhumastanno astu vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām ||

10,122.01  vasuṃ na citramahasaṃ gṛṇīṣe vāmaṃ śevamatithimadviṣeṇyam |
10,122.01 sa rāsate śurudho viśvadhāyaso'gnirhotā gṛhapatiḥ suvīryam ||
10,122.02  juṣāṇo agne prati harya me vaco viśvāni vidvānvayunāni sukrato |
10,122.02 ghṛtanirṇigbrahmaṇe gātumeraya tava devā ajanayannanu vratam ||
10,122.03  sapta dhāmāni pariyannamartyo dāśaddāśuṣe sukṛte māmahasva |
10,122.03 suvīreṇa rayiṇāgne svābhuvā yasta ānaṭsamidhā taṃ juṣasva ||
10,122.04  yajñasya ketuṃ prathamaṃ purohitaṃ haviṣmanta īḻate sapta vājinam |
10,122.04 śṛṇvantamagniṃ ghṛtapṛṣṭhamukṣaṇaṃ pṛṇantaṃ devaṃ pṛṇate suvīryam ||
10,122.05  tvaṃ dūtaḥ prathamo vareṇyaḥ sa hūyamāno amṛtāya matsva |
10,122.05 tvāṃ marjayanmaruto dāśuṣo gṛhe tvāṃ stomebhirbhṛgavo vi rurucuḥ ||
10,122.06  iṣaṃ duhansudughāṃ viśvadhāyasaṃ yajñapriye yajamānāya sukrato |
10,122.06 agne ghṛtasnustrirṛtāni dīdyadvartiryajñaṃ pariyansukratūyase ||
10,122.07  tvāmidasyā uṣaso vyuṣṭiṣu dūtaṃ kṛṇvānā ayajanta mānuṣāḥ |
10,122.07 tvāṃ devā mahayāyyāya vāvṛdhurājyamagne nimṛjanto adhvare ||
10,122.08  ni tvā vasiṣṭhā ahvanta vājinaṃ gṛṇanto agne vidatheṣu vedhasaḥ |
10,122.08 rāyaspoṣaṃ yajamāneṣu dhāraya yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||

10,123.01  ayaṃ venaścodayatpṛśnigarbhā jyotirjarāyū rajaso vimāne |
10,123.01 imamapāṃ saṃgame sūryasya śiśuṃ na viprā matibhī rihanti ||
10,123.02  samudrādūrmimudiyarti veno nabhojāḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ haryatasya darśi |
10,123.02 ṛtasya sānāvadhi viṣṭapi bhrāṭsamānaṃ yonimabhyanūṣata vrāḥ ||
10,123.03  samānaṃ pūrvīrabhi vāvaśānāstiṣṭhanvatsasya mātaraḥ sanīḻāḥ |
10,123.03 ṛtasya sānāvadhi cakramāṇā rihanti madhvo amṛtasya vāṇīḥ ||
10,123.04  jānanto rūpamakṛpanta viprā mṛgasya ghoṣaṃ mahiṣasya hi gman |
10,123.04 ṛtena yanto adhi sindhumasthurvidadgandharvo amṛtāni nāma ||
10,123.05  apsarā jāramupasiṣmiyāṇā yoṣā bibharti parame vyoman |
10,123.05 caratpriyasya yoniṣu priyaḥ sansīdatpakṣe hiraṇyaye sa venaḥ ||
10,123.06  nāke suparṇamupa yatpatantaṃ hṛdā venanto abhyacakṣata tvā |
10,123.06 hiraṇyapakṣaṃ varuṇasya dūtaṃ yamasya yonau śakunaṃ bhuraṇyum ||
10,123.07  ūrdhvo gandharvo adhi nāke asthātpratyaṅcitrā bibhradasyāyudhāni |
10,123.07 vasāno atkaṃ surabhiṃ dṛśe kaṃ svarṇa nāma janata priyāṇi ||
10,123.08  drapsaḥ samudramabhi yajjigāti paśyangṛdhrasya cakṣasā vidharman |
10,123.08 bhānuḥ śukreṇa śociṣā cakānastṛtīye cakre rajasi priyāṇi ||

10,124.01  imaṃ no agna upa yajñamehi pañcayāmaṃ trivṛtaṃ saptatantum |
10,124.01 aso havyavāḻ uta naḥ purogā jyogeva dīrghaṃ tama āśayiṣṭhāḥ ||
10,124.02  adevāddevaḥ pracatā guhā yanprapaśyamāno amṛtatvamemi |
10,124.02 śivaṃ yatsantamaśivo jahāmi svātsakhyādaraṇīṃ nābhimemi ||
10,124.03  paśyannanyasyā atithiṃ vayāyā ṛtasya dhāma vi mime purūṇi |
10,124.03 śaṃsāmi pitre asurāya śevamayajñiyādyajñiyaṃ bhāgamemi ||
10,124.04  bahvīḥ samā akaramantarasminnindraṃ vṛṇānaḥ pitaraṃ jahāmi |
10,124.04 agniḥ somo varuṇaste cyavante paryāvardrāṣṭraṃ tadavāmyāyan ||
10,124.05  nirmāyā u tye asurā abhūvantvaṃ ca mā varuṇa kāmayāse |
10,124.05 ṛtena rājannanṛtaṃ viviñcanmama rāṣṭrasyādhipatyamehi ||
10,124.06  idaṃ svaridamidāsa vāmamayaṃ prakāśa urvantarikṣam |
10,124.06 hanāva vṛtraṃ nirehi soma haviṣṭvā santaṃ haviṣā yajāma ||
10,124.07  kaviḥ kavitvā divi rūpamāsajadaprabhūtī varuṇo nirapaḥ sṛjat |
10,124.07 kṣemaṃ kṛṇvānā janayo na sindhavastā asya varṇaṃ śucayo bharibhrati ||
10,124.08  tā asya jyeṣṭhamindriyaṃ sacante tā īmā kṣeti svadhayā madantīḥ |
10,124.08 tā īṃ viśo na rājānaṃ vṛṇānā bībhatsuvo apa vṛtrādatiṣṭhan ||
10,124.09  bībhatsūnāṃ sayujaṃ haṃsamāhurapāṃ divyānāṃ sakhye carantam |
10,124.09 anuṣṭubhamanu carcūryamāṇamindraṃ ni cikyuḥ kavayo manīṣā ||

10,125.01  ahaṃ rudrebhirvasubhiścarāmyahamādityairuta viśvadevaiḥ |
10,125.01 ahaṃ mitrāvaruṇobhā bibharmyahamindrāgnī ahamaśvinobhā ||
10,125.02  ahaṃ somamāhanasaṃ bibharmyahaṃ tvaṣṭāramuta pūṣaṇaṃ bhagam |
10,125.02 ahaṃ dadhāmi draviṇaṃ haviṣmate suprāvye yajamānāya sunvate ||
10,125.03  ahaṃ rāṣṭrī saṃgamanī vasūnāṃ cikituṣī prathamā yajñiyānām |
10,125.03 tāṃ mā devā vyadadhuḥ purutrā bhūristhātrāṃ bhūryāveśayantīm ||
10,125.04  mayā so annamatti yo vipaśyati yaḥ prāṇiti ya īṃ śṛṇotyuktam |
10,125.04 amantavo māṃ ta upa kṣiyanti śrudhi śruta śraddhivaṃ te vadāmi ||
10,125.05  ahameva svayamidaṃ vadāmi juṣṭaṃ devebhiruta mānuṣebhiḥ |
10,125.05 yaṃ kāmaye taṃtamugraṃ kṛṇomi taṃ brahmāṇaṃ tamṛṣiṃ taṃ sumedhām ||
10,125.06  ahaṃ rudrāya dhanurā tanomi brahmadviṣe śarave hantavā u |
10,125.06 ahaṃ janāya samadaṃ kṛṇomyahaṃ dyāvāpṛthivī ā viveśa ||
10,125.07  ahaṃ suve pitaramasya mūrdhanmama yonirapsvantaḥ samudre |
10,125.07 tato vi tiṣṭhe bhuvanānu viśvotāmūṃ dyāṃ varṣmaṇopa spṛśāmi ||
10,125.08  ahameva vāta iva pra vāmyārabhamāṇā bhuvanāni viśvā |
10,125.08 paro divā para enā pṛthivyaitāvatī mahinā saṃ babhūva ||

10,126.01  na tamaṃho na duritaṃ devāso aṣṭa martyam |
10,126.01 sajoṣaso yamaryamā mitro nayanti varuṇo ati dviṣaḥ ||
10,126.02  taddhi vayaṃ vṛṇīmahe varuṇa mitrāryaman |
10,126.02 yenā niraṃhaso yūyaṃ pātha nethā ca martyamati dviṣaḥ ||
10,126.03  te nūnaṃ no'yamūtaye varuṇo mitro aryamā |
10,126.03 nayiṣṭhā u no neṣaṇi parṣiṣṭhā u naḥ parṣaṇyati dviṣaḥ ||
10,126.04  yūyaṃ viśvaṃ pari pātha varuṇo mitro aryamā |
10,126.04 yuṣmākaṃ śarmaṇi priye syāma supraṇītayo'ti dviṣaḥ ||
10,126.05  ādityāso ati sridho varuṇo mitro aryamā |
10,126.05 ugraṃ marudbhī rudraṃ huvemendramagniṃ svastaye'ti dviṣaḥ ||
10,126.06  netāra ū ṣu ṇastiro varuṇo mitro aryamā |
10,126.06 ati viśvāni duritā rājānaścarṣaṇīnāmati dviṣaḥ ||
10,126.07  śunamasmabhyamūtaye varuṇo mitro aryamā |
10,126.07 śarma yacchantu sapratha ādityāso yadīmahe ati dviṣaḥ ||
10,126.08  yathā ha tyadvasavo gauryaṃ citpadi ṣitāmamuñcatā yajatrāḥ |
10,126.08 evo ṣvasmanmuñcatā vyaṃhaḥ pra tāryagne prataraṃ na āyuḥ ||

10,127.01  rātrī vyakhyadāyatī purutrā devyakṣabhiḥ |
10,127.01 viśvā adhi śriyo'dhita ||
10,127.02  orvaprā amartyā nivato devyudvataḥ |
10,127.02 jyotiṣā bādhate tamaḥ ||
10,127.03  niru svasāramaskṛtoṣasaṃ devyāyatī |
10,127.03 apedu hāsate tamaḥ ||
10,127.04  sā no adya yasyā vayaṃ ni te yāmannavikṣmahi |
10,127.04 vṛkṣe na vasatiṃ vayaḥ ||
10,127.05  ni grāmāso avikṣata ni padvanto ni pakṣiṇaḥ |
10,127.05 ni śyenāsaścidarthinaḥ ||
10,127.06  yāvayā vṛkyaṃ vṛkaṃ yavaya stenamūrmye |
10,127.06 athā naḥ sutarā bhava ||
10,127.07  upa mā pepiśattamaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ vyaktamasthita |
10,127.07 uṣa ṛṇeva yātaya ||
10,127.08  upa te gā ivākaraṃ vṛṇīṣva duhitardivaḥ |
10,127.08 rātri stomaṃ na jigyuṣe ||

10,128.01  mamāgne varco vihaveṣvastu vayaṃ tvendhānāstanvaṃ puṣema |
10,128.01 mahyaṃ namantāṃ pradiśaścatasrastvayādhyakṣeṇa pṛtanā jayema ||
10,128.02  mama devā vihave santu sarva indravanto maruto viṣṇuragniḥ |
10,128.02 mamāntarikṣamurulokamastu mahyaṃ vātaḥ pavatāṃ kāme asmin ||
10,128.03  mayi devā draviṇamā yajantāṃ mayyāśīrastu mayi devahūtiḥ |
10,128.03 daivyā hotāro vanuṣanta pūrve'riṣṭāḥ syāma tanvā suvīrāḥ ||
10,128.04  mahyaṃ yajantu mama yāni havyākūtiḥ satyā manaso me astu |
10,128.04 eno mā ni gāṃ katamaccanāhaṃ viśve devāso adhi vocatā naḥ ||
10,128.05  devīḥ ṣaḻ urvīruru naḥ kṛṇota viśve devāsa iha vīrayadhvam |
10,128.05 mā hāsmahi prajayā mā tanūbhirmā radhāma dviṣate soma rājan ||
10,128.06  agne manyuṃ pratinudanpareṣāmadabdho gopāḥ pari pāhi nastvam |
10,128.06 pratyañco yantu nigutaḥ punaste'maiṣāṃ cittaṃ prabudhāṃ vi neśat ||
10,128.07  dhātā dhātṝṇāṃ bhuvanasya yaspatirdevaṃ trātāramabhimātiṣāham |
10,128.07 imaṃ yajñamaśvinobhā bṛhaspatirdevāḥ pāntu yajamānaṃ nyarthāt ||
10,128.08  uruvyacā no mahiṣaḥ śarma yaṃsadasminhave puruhūtaḥ purukṣuḥ |
10,128.08 sa naḥ prajāyai haryaśva mṛḻayendra mā no rīriṣo mā parā dāḥ ||
10,128.09  ye naḥ sapatnā apa te bhavantvindrāgnibhyāmava bādhāmahe tān |
10,128.09 vasavo rudrā ādityā uparispṛśaṃ mograṃ cettāramadhirājamakran ||

10,129.01  nāsadāsīnno sadāsīttadānīṃ nāsīdrajo no vyomā paro yat |
10,129.01 kimāvarīvaḥ kuha kasya śarmannambhaḥ kimāsīdgahanaṃ gabhīram ||
10,129.02  na mṛtyurāsīdamṛtaṃ na tarhi na rātryā ahna āsītpraketaḥ |
10,129.02 ānīdavātaṃ svadhayā tadekaṃ tasmāddhānyanna paraḥ kiṃ canāsa ||
10,129.03  tama āsīttamasā gūḻhamagre'praketaṃ salilaṃ sarvamā idam |
10,129.03 tucchyenābhvapihitaṃ yadāsīttapasastanmahinājāyataikam ||
10,129.04  kāmastadagre samavartatādhi manaso retaḥ prathamaṃ yadāsīt |
10,129.04 sato bandhumasati niravindanhṛdi pratīṣyā kavayo manīṣā ||
10,129.05  tiraścīno vitato raśmireṣāmadhaḥ svidāsī3 upari svidāsī3  |
10,129.05 retodhā āsanmahimāna āsansvadhā avastātprayatiḥ parastāt ||
10,129.06  ko addhā veda ka iha pra vocatkuta ājātā kuta iyaṃ visṛṣṭiḥ |
10,129.06 arvāgdevā asya visarjanenāthā ko veda yata ābabhūva ||
10,129.07  iyaṃ visṛṣṭiryata ābabhūva yadi vā dadhe yadi vā na |
10,129.07 yo asyādhyakṣaḥ parame vyomanso aṅga veda yadi vā na veda ||

10,130.01  yo yajño viśvatastantubhistata ekaśataṃ devakarmebhirāyataḥ |
10,130.01 ime vayanti pitaro ya āyayuḥ pra vayāpa vayetyāsate tate ||
10,130.02  pumāṃ enaṃ tanuta utkṛṇatti pumānvi tatne adhi nāke asmin |
10,130.02 ime mayūkhā upa sedurū sadaḥ sāmāni cakrustasarāṇyotave ||
10,130.03  kāsītpramā pratimā kiṃ nidānamājyaṃ kimāsītparidhiḥ ka āsīt |
10,130.03 chandaḥ kimāsītpraugaṃ kimukthaṃ yaddevā devamayajanta viśve ||
10,130.04  agnergāyatryabhavatsayugvoṣṇihayā savitā saṃ babhūva |
10,130.04 anuṣṭubhā soma ukthairmahasvānbṛhaspaterbṛhatī vācamāvat ||
10,130.05  virāṇmitrāvaruṇayorabhiśrīrindrasya triṣṭubiha bhāgo ahnaḥ |
10,130.05 viśvāndevāñjagatyā viveśa tena cākḷpra ṛṣayo manuṣyāḥ ||
10,130.06  cākḷpre tena ṛṣayo manuṣyā yajñe jāte pitaro naḥ purāṇe |
10,130.06 paśyanmanye manasā cakṣasā tānya imaṃ yajñamayajanta pūrve ||
10,130.07  sahastomāḥ sahachandasa āvṛtaḥ sahapramā ṛṣayaḥ sapta daivyāḥ |
10,130.07 pūrveṣāṃ panthāmanudṛśya dhīrā anvālebhire rathyo na raśmīn ||

10,131.01  apa prāca indra viśvāṃ amitrānapāpāco abhibhūte nudasva |
10,131.01 apodīco apa śūrādharāca urau yathā tava śarmanmadema ||
10,131.02  kuvidaṅga yavamanto yavaṃ cidyathā dāntyanupūrvaṃ viyūya |
10,131.02 ihehaiṣāṃ kṛṇuhi bhojanāni ye barhiṣo namovṛktiṃ na jagmuḥ ||
10,131.03  nahi sthūryṛtuthā yātamasti nota śravo vivide saṃgameṣu |
10,131.03 gavyanta indraṃ sakhyāya viprā aśvāyanto vṛṣaṇaṃ vājayantaḥ ||
10,131.04  yuvaṃ surāmamaśvinā namucāvāsure sacā |
10,131.04 vipipānā śubhaspatī indraṃ karmasvāvatam ||
10,131.05  putramiva pitarāvaśvinobhendrāvathuḥ kāvyairdaṃsanābhiḥ |
10,131.05 yatsurāmaṃ vyapibaḥ śacībhiḥ sarasvatī tvā maghavannabhiṣṇak ||
10,131.06  indraḥ sutrāmā svavāṃ avobhiḥ sumṛḻīko bhavatu viśvavedāḥ |
10,131.06 bādhatāṃ dveṣo abhayaṃ kṛṇotu suvīryasya patayaḥ syāma ||
10,131.07  tasya vayaṃ sumatau yajñiyasyāpi bhadre saumanase syāma |
10,131.07 sa sutrāmā svavāṃ indro asme ārācciddveṣaḥ sanutaryuyotu ||

10,132.01  ījānamiddyaurgūrtāvasurījānaṃ bhūmirabhi prabhūṣaṇi |
10,132.01 ījānaṃ devāvaśvināvabhi sumnairavardhatām ||
10,132.02  tā vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā dhārayatkṣitī suṣumneṣitatvatā yajāmasi |
10,132.02 yuvoḥ krāṇāya sakhyairabhi ṣyāma rakṣasaḥ ||
10,132.03  adhā cinnu yaddidhiṣāmahe vāmabhi priyaṃ rekṇaḥ patyamānāḥ |
10,132.03 dadvāṃ vā yatpuṣyati rekṇaḥ saṃ vārannakirasya maghāni ||
10,132.04  asāvanyo asura sūyata dyaustvaṃ viśveṣāṃ varuṇāsi rājā |
10,132.04 mūrdhā rathasya cākannaitāvatainasāntakadhruk ||
10,132.05  asminsvetacchakapūta eno hite mitre nigatānhanti vīrān |
10,132.05 avorvā yaddhāttanūṣvavaḥ priyāsu yajñiyāsvarvā ||
10,132.06  yuvorhi mātāditirvicetasā dyaurna bhūmiḥ payasā pupūtani |
10,132.06 ava priyā didiṣṭana sūro ninikta raśmibhiḥ ||
10,132.07  yuvaṃ hyapnarājāvasīdataṃ tiṣṭhadrathaṃ na dhūrṣadaṃ vanarṣadam |
10,132.07 tā naḥ kaṇūkayantīrnṛmedhastatre aṃhasaḥ sumedhastatre aṃhasaḥ ||

10,133.01  pro ṣvasmai purorathamindrāya śūṣamarcata |
10,133.01 abhīke cidu lokakṛtsaṃge samatsu vṛtrahāsmākaṃ bodhi coditā nabhantāmanyakeṣāṃ jyākā adhi dhanvasu ||
10,133.02  tvaṃ sindhūṃravāsṛjo'dharāco ahannahim |
10,133.02 aśatrurindra jajñiṣe viśvaṃ puṣyasi vāryaṃ taṃ tvā pari ṣvajāmahe nabhantāmanyakeṣāṃ jyākā adhi dhanvasu ||
10,133.03  vi ṣu viśvā arātayo'ryo naśanta no dhiyaḥ |
10,133.03 astāsi śatrave vadhaṃ yo na indra jighāṃsati yā te rātirdadirvasu nabhantāmanyakeṣāṃ jyākā adhi dhanvasu ||
10,133.04  yo na indrābhito jano vṛkāyurādideśati |
10,133.04 adhaspadaṃ tamīṃ kṛdhi vibādho asi sāsahirnabhantāmanyakeṣāṃ jyākā adhi dhanvasu ||
10,133.05  yo na indrābhidāsati sanābhiryaśca niṣṭyaḥ |
10,133.05 ava tasya balaṃ tira mahīva dyauradha tmanā nabhantāmanyakeṣāṃ jyākā adhi dhanvasu ||
10,133.06  vayamindra tvāyavaḥ sakhitvamā rabhāmahe |
10,133.06 ṛtasya naḥ pathā nayāti viśvāni duritā nabhantāmanyakeṣāṃ jyākā adhi dhanvasu ||
10,133.07  asmabhyaṃ su tvamindra tāṃ śikṣa yā dohate prati varaṃ jaritre |
10,133.07 acchidrodhnī pīpayadyathā naḥ sahasradhārā payasā mahī gauḥ ||

10,134.01  ubhe yadindra rodasī āpaprāthoṣā iva |
10,134.01 mahāntaṃ tvā mahīnāṃ samrājaṃ carṣaṇīnāṃ devī janitryajījanadbhadrā janitryajījanat ||
10,134.02  ava sma durhaṇāyato martasya tanuhi sthiram |
10,134.02 adhaspadaṃ tamīṃ kṛdhi yo asmāṃ ādideśati devī janitryajījanadbhadrā janitryajījanat ||
10,134.03  ava tyā bṛhatīriṣo viśvaścandrā amitrahan |
10,134.03 śacībhiḥ śakra dhūnuhīndra viśvābhirūtibhirdevī janitryajījanadbhadrā janitryajījanat ||
10,134.04  ava yattvaṃ śatakratavindra viśvāni dhūnuṣe |
10,134.04 rayiṃ na sunvate sacā sahasriṇībhirūtibhirdevī janitryajījanadbhadrā janitryajījanat ||
10,134.05  ava svedā ivābhito viṣvakpatantu didyavaḥ |
10,134.05 dūrvāyā iva tantavo vyasmadetu durmatirdevī janitryajījanadbhadrā janitryajījanat ||
10,134.06  dīrghaṃ hyaṅkuśaṃ yathā śaktiṃ bibharṣi mantumaḥ |
10,134.06 pūrveṇa maghavanpadājo vayāṃ yathā yamo devī janitryajījanadbhadrā janitryajījanat ||
10,134.07  nakirdevā minīmasi nakirā yopayāmasi mantraśrutyaṃ carāmasi |
10,134.07 pakṣebhirapikakṣebhiratrābhi saṃ rabhāmahe ||

10,135.01  yasminvṛkṣe supalāśe devaiḥ sampibate yamaḥ |
10,135.01 atrā no viśpatiḥ pitā purāṇāṃ anu venati ||
10,135.02  purāṇāṃ anuvenantaṃ carantaṃ pāpayāmuyā |
10,135.02 asūyannabhyacākaśaṃ tasmā aspṛhayaṃ punaḥ ||
10,135.03  yaṃ kumāra navaṃ rathamacakraṃ manasākṛṇoḥ |
10,135.03 ekeṣaṃ viśvataḥ prāñcamapaśyannadhi tiṣṭhasi ||
10,135.04  yaṃ kumāra prāvartayo rathaṃ viprebhyaspari |
10,135.04 taṃ sāmānu prāvartata samito nāvyāhitam ||
10,135.05  kaḥ kumāramajanayadrathaṃ ko niravartayat |
10,135.05 kaḥ svittadadya no brūyādanudeyī yathābhavat ||
10,135.06  yathābhavadanudeyī tato agramajāyata |
10,135.06 purastādbudhna ātataḥ paścānnirayaṇaṃ kṛtam ||
10,135.07  idaṃ yamasya sādanaṃ devamānaṃ yaducyate |
10,135.07 iyamasya dhamyate nāḻīrayaṃ gīrbhiḥ pariṣkṛtaḥ ||

10,136.01  keśyagniṃ keśī viṣaṃ keśī bibharti rodasī |
10,136.01 keśī viśvaṃ svardṛśe keśīdaṃ jyotirucyate ||
10,136.02  munayo vātaraśanāḥ piśaṅgā vasate malā |
10,136.02 vātasyānu dhrājiṃ yanti yaddevāso avikṣata ||
10,136.03  unmaditā mauneyena vātāṃ ā tasthimā vayam |
10,136.03 śarīredasmākaṃ yūyaṃ martāso abhi paśyatha ||
10,136.04  antarikṣeṇa patati viśvā rūpāvacākaśat |
10,136.04 munirdevasyadevasya saukṛtyāya sakhā hitaḥ ||
10,136.05  vātasyāśvo vāyoḥ sakhātho deveṣito muniḥ |
10,136.05 ubhau samudrāvā kṣeti yaśca pūrva utāparaḥ ||
10,136.06  apsarasāṃ gandharvāṇāṃ mṛgāṇāṃ caraṇe caran |
10,136.06 keśī ketasya vidvānsakhā svādurmadintamaḥ ||
10,136.07  vāyurasmā upāmanthatpinaṣṭi smā kunannamā |
10,136.07 keśī viṣasya pātreṇa yadrudreṇāpibatsaha ||

10,137.01  uta devā avahitaṃ devā unnayathā punaḥ |
10,137.01 utāgaścakruṣaṃ devā devā jīvayathā punaḥ ||
10,137.02  dvāvimau vātau vāta ā sindhorā parāvataḥ |
10,137.02 dakṣaṃ te anya ā vātu parānyo vātu yadrapaḥ ||
10,137.03  ā vāta vāhi bheṣajaṃ vi vāta vāhi yadrapaḥ |
10,137.03 tvaṃ hi viśvabheṣajo devānāṃ dūta īyase ||
10,137.04  ā tvāgamaṃ śantātibhiratho ariṣṭatātibhiḥ |
10,137.04 dakṣaṃ te bhadramābhārṣaṃ parā yakṣmaṃ suvāmi te ||
10,137.05  trāyantāmiha devāstrāyatāṃ marutāṃ gaṇaḥ |
10,137.05 trāyantāṃ viśvā bhūtāni yathāyamarapā asat ||
10,137.06  āpa idvā u bheṣajīrāpo amīvacātanīḥ |
10,137.06 āpaḥ sarvasya bheṣajīstāste kṛṇvantu bheṣajam ||
10,137.07  hastābhyāṃ daśaśākhābhyāṃ jihvā vācaḥ purogavī |
10,137.07 anāmayitnubhyāṃ tvā tābhyāṃ tvopa spṛśāmasi ||

10,138.01  tava tya indra sakhyeṣu vahnaya ṛtaṃ manvānā vyadardirurvalam |
10,138.01 yatrā daśasyannuṣaso riṇannapaḥ kutsāya manmannahyaśca daṃsayaḥ ||
10,138.02  avāsṛjaḥ prasvaḥ śvañcayo girīnudāja usrā apibo madhu priyam |
10,138.02 avardhayo vanino asya daṃsasā śuśoca sūrya ṛtajātayā girā ||
10,138.03  vi sūryo madhye amucadrathaṃ divo vidaddāsāya pratimānamāryaḥ |
10,138.03 dṛḻhāni piprorasurasya māyina indro vyāsyaccakṛvāṃ ṛjiśvanā ||
10,138.04  anādhṛṣṭāni dhṛṣito vyāsyannidhīṃradevāṃ amṛṇadayāsyaḥ |
10,138.04 māseva sūryo vasu puryamā dade gṛṇānaḥ śatrūṃraśṛṇādvirukmatā ||
10,138.05  ayuddhaseno vibhvā vibhindatā dāśadvṛtrahā tujyāni tejate |
10,138.05 indrasya vajrādabibhedabhiśnathaḥ prākrāmacchundhyūrajahāduṣā anaḥ ||
10,138.06  etā tyā te śrutyāni kevalā yadeka ekamakṛṇorayajñam |
10,138.06 māsāṃ vidhānamadadhā adhi dyavi tvayā vibhinnaṃ bharati pradhiṃ pitā ||

10,139.01  sūryaraśmirharikeśaḥ purastātsavitā jyotirudayāṃ ajasram |
10,139.01 tasya pūṣā prasave yāti vidvānsampaśyanviśvā bhuvanāni gopāḥ ||
10,139.02  nṛcakṣā eṣa divo madhya āsta āpaprivānrodasī antarikṣam |
10,139.02 sa viśvācīrabhi caṣṭe ghṛtācīrantarā pūrvamaparaṃ ca ketum ||
10,139.03  rāyo budhnaḥ saṃgamano vasūnāṃ viśvā rūpābhi caṣṭe śacībhiḥ |
10,139.03 deva iva savitā satyadharmendro na tasthau samare dhanānām ||
10,139.04  viśvāvasuṃ soma gandharvamāpo dadṛśuṣīstadṛtenā vyāyan |
10,139.04 tadanvavaidindro rārahāṇa āsāṃ pari sūryasya paridhīṃrapaśyat ||
10,139.05  viśvāvasurabhi tanno gṛṇātu divyo gandharvo rajaso vimānaḥ |
10,139.05 yadvā ghā satyamuta yanna vidma dhiyo hinvāno dhiya inno avyāḥ ||
10,139.06  sasnimavindaccaraṇe nadīnāmapāvṛṇodduro aśmavrajānām |
10,139.06 prāsāṃ gandharvo amṛtāni vocadindro dakṣaṃ pari jānādahīnām ||

10,140.01  agne tava śravo vayo mahi bhrājante arcayo vibhāvaso |
10,140.01 bṛhadbhāno śavasā vājamukthyaṃ dadhāsi dāśuṣe kave ||
10,140.02  pāvakavarcāḥ śukravarcā anūnavarcā udiyarṣi bhānunā |
10,140.02 putro mātarā vicarannupāvasi pṛṇakṣi rodasī ubhe ||
10,140.03  ūrjo napājjātavedaḥ suśastibhirmandasva dhītibhirhitaḥ |
10,140.03 tve iṣaḥ saṃ dadhurbhūrivarpasaścitrotayo vāmajātāḥ ||
10,140.04  irajyannagne prathayasva jantubhirasme rāyo amartya |
10,140.04 sa darśatasya vapuṣo vi rājasi pṛṇakṣi sānasiṃ kratum ||
10,140.05  iṣkartāramadhvarasya pracetasaṃ kṣayantaṃ rādhaso mahaḥ |
10,140.05 rātiṃ vāmasya subhagāṃ mahīmiṣaṃ dadhāsi sānasiṃ rayim ||
10,140.06  ṛtāvānaṃ mahiṣaṃ viśvadarśatamagniṃ sumnāya dadhire puro janāḥ |
10,140.06 śrutkarṇaṃ saprathastamaṃ tvā girā daivyaṃ mānuṣā yugā ||

10,141.01  agne acchā vadeha naḥ pratyaṅnaḥ sumanā bhava |
10,141.01 pra no yaccha viśaspate dhanadā asi nastvam ||
10,141.02  pra no yacchatvaryamā pra bhagaḥ pra bṛhaspatiḥ |
10,141.02 pra devāḥ prota sūnṛtā rāyo devī dadātu naḥ ||
10,141.03  somaṃ rājānamavase'gniṃ gīrbhirhavāmahe |
10,141.03 ādityānviṣṇuṃ sūryaṃ brahmāṇaṃ ca bṛhaspatim ||
10,141.04  indravāyū bṛhaspatiṃ suhaveha havāmahe |
10,141.04 yathā naḥ sarva ijjanaḥ saṃgatyāṃ sumanā asat ||
10,141.05  aryamaṇaṃ bṛhaspatimindraṃ dānāya codaya |
10,141.05 vātaṃ viṣṇuṃ sarasvatīṃ savitāraṃ ca vājinam ||
10,141.06  tvaṃ no agne agnibhirbrahma yajñaṃ ca vardhaya |
10,141.06 tvaṃ no devatātaye rāyo dānāya codaya ||

10,142.01  ayamagne jaritā tve abhūdapi sahasaḥ sūno nahyanyadastyāpyam |
10,142.01 bhadraṃ hi śarma trivarūthamasti ta āre hiṃsānāmapa didyumā kṛdhi ||
10,142.02  pravatte agne janimā pitūyataḥ sācīva viśvā bhuvanā nyṛñjase |
10,142.02 pra saptayaḥ pra saniṣanta no dhiyaḥ puraścaranti paśupā iva tmanā ||
10,142.03  uta vā u pari vṛṇakṣi bapsadbahoragna ulapasya svadhāvaḥ |
10,142.03 uta khilyā urvarāṇāṃ bhavanti mā te hetiṃ taviṣīṃ cukrudhāma ||
10,142.04  yadudvato nivato yāsi bapsatpṛthageṣi pragardhinīva senā |
10,142.04 yadā te vāto anuvāti śocirvapteva śmaśru vapasi pra bhūma ||
10,142.05  pratyasya śreṇayo dadṛśra ekaṃ niyānaṃ bahavo rathāsaḥ |
10,142.05 bāhū yadagne anumarmṛjāno nyaṅṅuttānāmanveṣi bhūmim ||
10,142.06  utte śuṣmā jihatāmutte arcirutte agne śaśamānasya vājāḥ |
10,142.06 ucchvañcasva ni nama vardhamāna ā tvādya viśve vasavaḥ sadantu ||
10,142.07  apāmidaṃ nyayanaṃ samudrasya niveśanam |
10,142.07 anyaṃ kṛṇuṣvetaḥ panthāṃ tena yāhi vaśāṃ anu ||
10,142.08  āyane te parāyaṇe dūrvā rohantu puṣpiṇīḥ |
10,142.08 hradāśca puṇḍarīkāṇi samudrasya gṛhā ime ||

10,143.01  tyaṃ cidatrimṛtajuramarthamaśvaṃ na yātave |
10,143.01 kakṣīvantaṃ yadī punā rathaṃ na kṛṇutho navam ||
10,143.02  tyaṃ cidaśvaṃ na vājinamareṇavo yamatnata |
10,143.02 dṛḻhaṃ granthiṃ na vi ṣyatamatriṃ yaviṣṭhamā rajaḥ ||
10,143.03  narā daṃsiṣṭhāvatraye śubhrā siṣāsataṃ dhiyaḥ |
10,143.03 athā hi vāṃ divo narā puna stomo na viśase ||
10,143.04  cite tadvāṃ surādhasā rātiḥ sumatiraśvinā |
10,143.04 ā yannaḥ sadane pṛthau samane parṣatho narā ||
10,143.05  yuvaṃ bhujyuṃ samudra ā rajasaḥ pāra īṅkhitam |
10,143.05 yātamacchā patatribhirnāsatyā sātaye kṛtam ||
10,143.06  ā vāṃ sumnaiḥ śaṃyū iva maṃhiṣṭhā viśvavedasā |
10,143.06 samasme bhūṣataṃ narotsaṃ na pipyuṣīriṣaḥ ||

10,144.01  ayaṃ hi te amartya induratyo na patyate |
10,144.01 dakṣo viśvāyurvedhase ||
10,144.02  ayamasmāsu kāvya ṛbhurvajro dāsvate |
10,144.02 ayaṃ bibhartyūrdhvakṛśanaṃ madamṛbhurna kṛtvyaṃ madam ||
10,144.03  ghṛṣuḥ śyenāya kṛtvana āsu svāsu vaṃsagaḥ |
10,144.03 ava dīdhedahīśuvaḥ ||
10,144.04  yaṃ suparṇaḥ parāvataḥ śyenasya putra ābharat |
10,144.04 śatacakraṃ yo'hyo vartaniḥ ||
10,144.05  yaṃ te śyenaścārumavṛkaṃ padābharadaruṇaṃ mānamandhasaḥ |
10,144.05 enā vayo vi tāryāyurjīvasa enā jāgāra bandhutā ||
10,144.06  evā tadindra indunā deveṣu ciddhārayāte mahi tyajaḥ |
10,144.06 kratvā vayo vi tāryāyuḥ sukrato kratvāyamasmadā sutaḥ ||

10,145.01  imāṃ khanāmyoṣadhiṃ vīrudhaṃ balavattamām |
10,145.01 yayā sapatnīṃ bādhate yayā saṃvindate patim ||
10,145.02  uttānaparṇe subhage devajūte sahasvati |
10,145.02 sapatnīṃ me parā dhama patiṃ me kevalaṃ kuru ||
10,145.03  uttarāhamuttara uttareduttarābhyaḥ |
10,145.03 athā sapatnī yā mamādharā sādharābhyaḥ ||
10,145.04  nahyasyā nāma gṛbhṇāmi no asminramate jane |
10,145.04 parāmeva parāvataṃ sapatnīṃ gamayāmasi ||
10,145.05  ahamasmi sahamānātha tvamasi sāsahiḥ |
10,145.05 ubhe sahasvatī bhūtvī sapatnīṃ me sahāvahai ||
10,145.06  upa te'dhāṃ sahamānāmabhi tvādhāṃ sahīyasā |
10,145.06 māmanu pra te mano vatsaṃ gauriva dhāvatu pathā vāriva dhāvatu ||

10,146.01  araṇyānyaraṇyānyasau yā preva naśyasi |
10,146.01 kathā grāmaṃ na pṛcchasi na tvā bhīriva vindatī3  ||
10,146.02  vṛṣāravāya vadate yadupāvati ciccikaḥ |
10,146.02 āghāṭibhiriva dhāvayannaraṇyānirmahīyate ||
10,146.03  uta gāva ivādantyuta veśmeva dṛśyate |
10,146.03 uto araṇyāniḥ sāyaṃ śakaṭīriva sarjati ||
10,146.04  gāmaṅgaiṣa ā hvayati dārvaṅgaiṣo apāvadhīt |
10,146.04 vasannaraṇyānyāṃ sāyamakrukṣaditi manyate ||
10,146.05  na vā araṇyānirhantyanyaścennābhigacchati |
10,146.05 svādoḥ phalasya jagdhvāya yathākāmaṃ ni padyate ||
10,146.06  āñjanagandhiṃ surabhiṃ bahvannāmakṛṣīvalām |
10,146.06 prāhaṃ mṛgāṇāṃ mātaramaraṇyānimaśaṃsiṣam ||

10,147.01  śratte dadhāmi prathamāya manyave'hanyadvṛtraṃ naryaṃ viverapaḥ |
10,147.01 ubhe yattvā bhavato rodasī anu rejate śuṣmātpṛthivī cidadrivaḥ ||
10,147.02  tvaṃ māyābhiranavadya māyinaṃ śravasyatā manasā vṛtramardayaḥ |
10,147.02 tvāminnaro vṛṇate gaviṣṭiṣu tvāṃ viśvāsu havyāsviṣṭiṣu ||
10,147.03  aiṣu cākandhi puruhūta sūriṣu vṛdhāso ye maghavannānaśurmagham |
10,147.03 arcanti toke tanaye pariṣṭiṣu medhasātā vājinamahraye dhane ||
10,147.04  sa innu rāyaḥ subhṛtasya cākananmadaṃ yo asya raṃhyaṃ ciketati |
10,147.04 tvāvṛdho maghavandāśvadhvaro makṣū sa vājaṃ bharate dhanā nṛbhiḥ ||
10,147.05  tvaṃ śardhāya mahinā gṛṇāna uru kṛdhi maghavañchagdhi rāyaḥ |
10,147.05 tvaṃ no mitro varuṇo na māyī pitvo na dasma dayase vibhaktā ||

10,148.01  suṣvāṇāsa indra stumasi tvā sasavāṃsaśca tuvinṛmṇa vājam |
10,148.01 ā no bhara suvitaṃ yasya cākantmanā tanā sanuyāma tvotāḥ ||
10,148.02  ṛṣvastvamindra śūra jāto dāsīrviśaḥ sūryeṇa sahyāḥ |
10,148.02 guhā hitaṃ guhyaṃ gūḻhamapsu bibhṛmasi prasravaṇe na somam ||
10,148.03  aryo vā giro abhyarca vidvānṛṣīṇāṃ vipraḥ sumatiṃ cakānaḥ |
10,148.03 te syāma ye raṇayanta somairenota tubhyaṃ rathoḻha bhakṣaiḥ ||
10,148.04  imā brahmendra tubhyaṃ śaṃsi dā nṛbhyo nṛṇāṃ śūra śavaḥ |
