10,148.04 tebhirbhava sakraturyeṣu cākannuta trāyasva gṛṇata uta stīn ||
10,148.05  śrudhī havamindra śūra pṛthyā uta stavase venyasyārkaiḥ |
10,148.05 ā yaste yoniṃ ghṛtavantamasvārūrmirna nimnairdravayanta vakvāḥ ||

10,149.01  savitā yantraiḥ pṛthivīmaramṇādaskambhane savitā dyāmadṛṃhat |
10,149.01 aśvamivādhukṣaddhunimantarikṣamatūrte baddhaṃ savitā samudram ||
10,149.02  yatrā samudra skabhito vyaunadapāṃ napātsavitā tasya veda |
10,149.02 ato bhūrata ā utthitaṃ rajo'to dyāvāpṛthivī aprathetām ||
10,149.03  paścedamanyadabhavadyajatramamartyasya bhuvanasya bhūnā |
10,149.03 suparṇo aṅga saviturgarutmānpūrvo jātaḥ sa u asyānu dharma ||
10,149.04  gāva iva grāmaṃ yūyudhirivāśvānvāśreva vatsaṃ sumanā duhānā |
10,149.04 patiriva jāyāmabhi no nyetu dhartā divaḥ savitā viśvavāraḥ ||
10,149.05  hiraṇyastūpaḥ savitaryathā tvāṅgiraso juhve vāje asmin |
10,149.05 evā tvārcannavase vandamānaḥ somasyevāṃśuṃ prati jāgarāham ||

10,150.01  samiddhaścitsamidhyase devebhyo havyavāhana |
10,150.01 ādityai rudrairvasubhirna ā gahi mṛḻīkāya na ā gahi ||
10,150.02  imaṃ yajñamidaṃ vaco jujuṣāṇa upāgahi |
10,150.02 martāsastvā samidhāna havāmahe mṛḻīkāya havāmahe ||
10,150.03  tvāmu jātavedasaṃ viśvavāraṃ gṛṇe dhiyā |
10,150.03 agne devāṃ ā vaha naḥ priyavratānmṛḻīkāya priyavratān ||
10,150.04  agnirdevo devānāmabhavatpurohito'gniṃ manuṣyā ṛṣayaḥ samīdhire |
10,150.04 agniṃ maho dhanasātāvahaṃ huve mṛḻīkaṃ dhanasātaye ||
10,150.05  agniratriṃ bharadvājaṃ gaviṣṭhiraṃ prāvannaḥ kaṇvaṃ trasadasyumāhave |
10,150.05 agniṃ vasiṣṭho havate purohito mṛḻīkāya purohitaḥ ||

10,151.01  śraddhayāgniḥ samidhyate śraddhayā hūyate haviḥ |
10,151.01 śraddhāṃ bhagasya mūrdhani vacasā vedayāmasi ||
10,151.02  priyaṃ śraddhe dadataḥ priyaṃ śraddhe didāsataḥ |
10,151.02 priyaṃ bhojeṣu yajvasvidaṃ ma uditaṃ kṛdhi ||
10,151.03  yathā devā asureṣu śraddhāmugreṣu cakrire |
10,151.03 evaṃ bhojeṣu yajvasvasmākamuditaṃ kṛdhi ||
10,151.04  śraddhāṃ devā yajamānā vāyugopā upāsate |
10,151.04 śraddhāṃ hṛdayyayākūtyā śraddhayā vindate vasu ||
10,151.05  śraddhāṃ prātarhavāmahe śraddhāṃ madhyandinaṃ pari |
10,151.05 śraddhāṃ sūryasya nimruci śraddhe śraddhāpayeha naḥ ||

10,152.01  śāsa itthā mahāṃ asyamitrakhādo adbhutaḥ |
10,152.01 na yasya hanyate sakhā na jīyate kadā cana ||
10,152.02  svastidā viśaspatirvṛtrahā vimṛdho vaśī |
10,152.02 vṛṣendraḥ pura etu naḥ somapā abhayaṅkaraḥ ||
10,152.03  vi rakṣo vi mṛdho jahi vi vṛtrasya hanū ruja |
10,152.03 vi manyumindra vṛtrahannamitrasyābhidāsataḥ ||
10,152.04  vi na indra mṛdho jahi nīcā yaccha pṛtanyataḥ |
10,152.04 yo asmāṃ abhidāsatyadharaṃ gamayā tamaḥ ||
10,152.05  apendra dviṣato mano'pa jijyāsato vadham |
10,152.05 vi manyoḥ śarma yaccha varīyo yavayā vadham ||

10,153.01  īṅkhayantīrapasyuva indraṃ jātamupāsate |
10,153.01 bhejānāsaḥ suvīryam ||
10,153.02  tvamindra balādadhi sahaso jāta ojasaḥ |
10,153.02 tvaṃ vṛṣanvṛṣedasi ||
10,153.03  tvamindrāsi vṛtrahā vyantarikṣamatiraḥ |
10,153.03 uddyāmastabhnā ojasā ||
10,153.04  tvamindra sajoṣasamarkaṃ bibharṣi bāhvoḥ |
10,153.04 vajraṃ śiśāna ojasā ||
10,153.05  tvamindrābhibhūrasi viśvā jātānyojasā |
10,153.05 sa viśvā bhuva ābhavaḥ ||

10,154.01  soma ekebhyaḥ pavate ghṛtameka upāsate |
10,154.01 yebhyo madhu pradhāvati tāṃścidevāpi gacchatāt ||
10,154.02  tapasā ye anādhṛṣyāstapasā ye svaryayuḥ |
10,154.02 tapo ye cakrire mahastāṃścidevāpi gacchatāt ||
10,154.03  ye yudhyante pradhaneṣu śūrāso ye tanūtyajaḥ |
10,154.03 ye vā sahasradakṣiṇāstāṃścidevāpi gacchatāt ||
10,154.04  ye citpūrva ṛtasāpa ṛtāvāna ṛtāvṛdhaḥ |
10,154.04 pitṝntapasvato yama tāṃścidevāpi gacchatāt ||
10,154.05  sahasraṇīthāḥ kavayo ye gopāyanti sūryam |
10,154.05 ṛṣīntapasvato yama tapojāṃ api gacchatāt ||

10,155.01  arāyi kāṇe vikaṭe giriṃ gaccha sadānve |
10,155.01 śirimbiṭhasya satvabhistebhiṣṭvā cātayāmasi ||
10,155.02  catto itaścattāmutaḥ sarvā bhrūṇānyāruṣī |
10,155.02 arāyyaṃ brahmaṇaspate tīkṣṇaśṛṇgodṛṣannihi ||
10,155.03  ado yaddāru plavate sindhoḥ pāre apūruṣam |
10,155.03 tadā rabhasva durhaṇo tena gaccha parastaram ||
10,155.04  yaddha prācīrajagantoro maṇḍūradhāṇikīḥ |
10,155.04 hatā indrasya śatravaḥ sarve budbudayāśavaḥ ||
10,155.05  parīme gāmaneṣata paryagnimahṛṣata |
10,155.05 deveṣvakrata śravaḥ ka imāṃ ā dadharṣati ||

10,156.01  agniṃ hinvantu no dhiyaḥ saptimāśumivājiṣu |
10,156.01 tena jeṣma dhanaṃdhanam ||
10,156.02  yayā gā ākarāmahe senayāgne tavotyā |
10,156.02 tāṃ no hinva maghattaye ||
10,156.03  āgne sthūraṃ rayiṃ bhara pṛthuṃ gomantamaśvinam |
10,156.03 aṅdhi khaṃ vartayā paṇim ||
10,156.04  agne nakṣatramajaramā sūryaṃ rohayo divi |
10,156.04 dadhajjyotirjanebhyaḥ ||
10,156.05  agne keturviśāmasi preṣṭhaḥ śreṣṭha upasthasat |
10,156.05 bodhā stotre vayo dadhat ||

10,157.01  imā nu kaṃ bhuvanā sīṣadhāmendraśca viśve ca devāḥ ||
10,157.02  yajñaṃ ca nastanvaṃ ca prajāṃ cādityairindraḥ saha cīkḷpāti ||
10,157.03  ādityairindraḥ sagaṇo marudbhirasmākaṃ bhūtvavitā tanūnām ||
10,157.04  hatvāya devā asurānyadāyandevā devatvamabhirakṣamāṇāḥ ||
10,157.05  pratyañcamarkamanayañchacībhirāditsvadhāmiṣirāṃ paryapaśyan ||

10,158.01  sūryo no divaspātu vāto antarikṣāt |
10,158.01 agnirnaḥ pārthivebhyaḥ ||
10,158.02  joṣā savitaryasya te haraḥ śataṃ savāṃ arhati |
10,158.02 pāhi no didyutaḥ patantyāḥ ||
10,158.03  cakṣurno devaḥ savitā cakṣurna uta parvataḥ |
10,158.03 cakṣurdhātā dadhātu naḥ ||
10,158.04  cakṣurno dhehi cakṣuṣe cakṣurvikhyai tanūbhyaḥ |
10,158.04 saṃ cedaṃ vi ca paśyema ||
10,158.05  susaṃdṛśaṃ tvā vayaṃ prati paśyema sūrya |
10,158.05 vi paśyema nṛcakṣasaḥ ||

10,159.01  udasau sūryo agādudayaṃ māmako bhagaḥ |
10,159.01 ahaṃ tadvidvalā patimabhyasākṣi viṣāsahiḥ ||
10,159.02  ahaṃ keturahaṃ mūrdhāhamugrā vivācanī |
10,159.02 mamedanu kratuṃ patiḥ sehānāyā upācaret ||
10,159.03  mama putrāḥ śatruhaṇo'tho me duhitā virāṭ |
10,159.03 utāhamasmi saṃjayā patyau me śloka uttamaḥ ||
10,159.04  yenendro haviṣā kṛtvyabhavaddyumnyuttamaḥ |
10,159.04 idaṃ tadakri devā asapatnā kilābhuvam ||
10,159.05  asapatnā sapatnaghnī jayantyabhibhūvarī |
10,159.05 āvṛkṣamanyāsāṃ varco rādho astheyasāmiva ||
10,159.06  samajaiṣamimā ahaṃ sapatnīrabhibhūvarī |
10,159.06 yathāhamasya vīrasya virājāni janasya ca ||

10,160.01  tīvrasyābhivayaso asya pāhi sarvarathā vi harī iha muñca |
10,160.01 indra mā tvā yajamānāso anye ni rīramantubhyamime sutāsaḥ ||
10,160.02  tubhyaṃ sutāstubhyamu sotvāsastvāṃ giraḥ śvātryā ā hvayanti |
10,160.02 indredamadya savanaṃ juṣāṇo viśvasya vidvāṃ iha pāhi somam ||
10,160.03  ya uśatā manasā somamasmai sarvahṛdā devakāmaḥ sunoti |
10,160.03 na gā indrastasya parā dadāti praśastamiccārumasmai kṛṇoti ||
10,160.04  anuspaṣṭo bhavatyeṣo asya yo asmai revānna sunoti somam |
10,160.04 niraratnau maghavā taṃ dadhāti brahmadviṣo hantyanānudiṣṭaḥ ||
10,160.05  aśvāyanto gavyanto vājayanto havāmahe tvopagantavā u |
10,160.05 ābhūṣantaste sumatau navāyāṃ vayamindra tvā śunaṃ huvema ||

10,161.01  muñcāmi tvā haviṣā jīvanāya kamajñātayakṣmāduta rājayakṣmāt |
10,161.01 grāhirjagrāha yadi vaitadenaṃ tasyā indrāgnī pra mumuktamenam ||
10,161.02  yadi kṣitāyuryadi vā pareto yadi mṛtyorantikaṃ nīta eva |
10,161.02 tamā harāmi nirṛterupasthādaspārṣamenaṃ śataśāradāya ||
10,161.03  sahasrākṣeṇa śataśāradena śatāyuṣā haviṣāhārṣamenam |
10,161.03 śataṃ yathemaṃ śarado nayātīndro viśvasya duritasya pāram ||
10,161.04  śataṃ jīva śarado vardhamānaḥ śataṃ hemantāñchatamu vasantān |
10,161.04 śatamindrāgnī savitā bṛhaspatiḥ śatāyuṣā haviṣemaṃ punarduḥ ||
10,161.05  āhārṣaṃ tvāvidaṃ tvā punarāgāḥ punarnava |
10,161.05 sarvāṅga sarvaṃ te cakṣuḥ sarvamāyuśca te'vidam ||

10,162.01  brahmaṇāgniḥ saṃvidāno rakṣohā bādhatāmitaḥ |
10,162.01 amīvā yaste garbhaṃ durṇāmā yonimāśaye ||
10,162.02  yaste garbhamamīvā durṇāmā yonimāśaye |
10,162.02 agniṣṭaṃ brahmaṇā saha niṣkravyādamanīnaśat ||
10,162.03  yaste hanti patayantaṃ niṣatsnuṃ yaḥ sarīsṛpam |
10,162.03 jātaṃ yaste jighāṃsati tamito nāśayāmasi ||
10,162.04  yasta ūrū viharatyantarā dampatī śaye |
10,162.04 yoniṃ yo antarāreḻhi tamito nāśayāmasi ||
10,162.05  yastvā bhrātā patirbhūtvā jāro bhūtvā nipadyate |
10,162.05 prajāṃ yaste jighāṃsati tamito nāśayāmasi ||
10,162.06  yastvā svapnena tamasā mohayitvā nipadyate |
10,162.06 prajāṃ yaste jighāṃsati tamito nāśayāmasi ||

10,163.01  akṣībhyāṃ te nāsikābhyāṃ karṇābhyāṃ chubukādadhi |
10,163.01 yakṣmaṃ śīrṣaṇyaṃ mastiṣkājjihvāyā vi vṛhāmi te ||
10,163.02  grīvābhyasta uṣṇihābhyaḥ kīkasābhyo anūkyāt |
10,163.02 yakṣmaṃ doṣaṇyamaṃsābhyāṃ bāhubhyāṃ vi vṛhāmi te ||
10,163.03  āntrebhyaste gudābhyo vaniṣṭhorhṛdayādadhi |
10,163.03 yakṣmaṃ matasnābhyāṃ yaknaḥ plāśibhyo vi vṛhāmi te ||
10,163.04  ūrubhyāṃ te aṣṭhīvadbhyāṃ pārṣṇibhyāṃ prapadābhyām |
10,163.04 yakṣmaṃ śroṇibhyāṃ bhāsadādbhaṃsaso vi vṛhāmi te ||
10,163.05  mehanādvanaṅkaraṇāllomabhyaste nakhebhyaḥ |
10,163.05 yakṣmaṃ sarvasmādātmanastamidaṃ vi vṛhāmi te ||
10,163.06  aṅgādaṅgāllomnolomno jātaṃ parvaṇiparvaṇi |
10,163.06 yakṣmaṃ sarvasmādātmanastamidaṃ vi vṛhāmi te ||

10,164.01  apehi manasaspate'pa krāma paraścara |
10,164.01 paro nirṛtyā ā cakṣva bahudhā jīvato manaḥ ||
10,164.02  bhadraṃ vai varaṃ vṛṇate bhadraṃ yuñjanti dakṣiṇam |
10,164.02 bhadraṃ vaivasvate cakṣurbahutrā jīvato manaḥ ||
10,164.03  yadāśasā niḥśasābhiśasopārima jāgrato yatsvapantaḥ |
10,164.03 agnirviśvānyapa duṣkṛtānyajuṣṭānyāre asmaddadhātu ||
10,164.04  yadindra brahmaṇaspate'bhidrohaṃ carāmasi |
10,164.04 pracetā na āṅgiraso dviṣatāṃ pātvaṃhasaḥ ||
10,164.05  ajaiṣmādyāsanāma cābhūmānāgaso vayam |
10,164.05 jāgratsvapnaḥ saṃkalpaḥ pāpo yaṃ dviṣmastaṃ sa ṛcchatu yo no dveṣṭi tamṛcchatu ||

10,165.01  devāḥ kapota iṣito yadicchandūto nirṛtyā idamājagāma |
10,165.01 tasmā arcāma kṛṇavāma niṣkṛtiṃ śaṃ no astu dvipade śaṃ catuṣpade ||
10,165.02  śivaḥ kapota iṣito no astvanāgā devāḥ śakuno gṛheṣu |
10,165.02 agnirhi vipro juṣatāṃ havirnaḥ pari hetiḥ pakṣiṇī no vṛṇaktu ||
10,165.03  hetiḥ pakṣiṇī na dabhātyasmānāṣṭryāṃ padaṃ kṛṇute agnidhāne |
10,165.03 śaṃ no gobhyaśca puruṣebhyaścāstu mā no hiṃsīdiha devāḥ kapotaḥ ||
10,165.04  yadulūko vadati moghametadyatkapotaḥ padamagnau kṛṇoti |
10,165.04 yasya dūtaḥ prahita eṣa etattasmai yamāya namo astu mṛtyave ||
10,165.05  ṛcā kapotaṃ nudata praṇodamiṣaṃ madantaḥ pari gāṃ nayadhvam |
10,165.05 saṃyopayanto duritāni viśvā hitvā na ūrjaṃ pra patātpatiṣṭhaḥ ||

10,166.01  ṛṣabhaṃ mā samānānāṃ sapatnānāṃ viṣāsahim |
10,166.01 hantāraṃ śatrūṇāṃ kṛdhi virājaṃ gopatiṃ gavām ||
10,166.02  ahamasmi sapatnahendra ivāriṣṭo akṣataḥ |
10,166.02 adhaḥ sapatnā me padorime sarve abhiṣṭhitāḥ ||
10,166.03  atraiva vo'pi nahyāmyubhe ārtnī iva jyayā |
10,166.03 vācaspate ni ṣedhemānyathā madadharaṃ vadān ||
10,166.04  abhibhūrahamāgamaṃ viśvakarmeṇa dhāmnā |
10,166.04 ā vaścittamā vo vratamā vo'haṃ samitiṃ dade ||
10,166.05  yogakṣemaṃ va ādāyāhaṃ bhūyāsamuttama ā vo mūrdhānamakramīm |
10,166.05 adhaspadānma udvadata maṇḍūkā ivodakānmaṇḍūkā udakādiva ||

10,167.01  tubhyedamindra pari ṣicyate madhu tvaṃ sutasya kalaśasya rājasi |
10,167.01 tvaṃ rayiṃ puruvīrāmu naskṛdhi tvaṃ tapaḥ paritapyājayaḥ svaḥ ||
10,167.02  svarjitaṃ mahi mandānamandhaso havāmahe pari śakraṃ sutāṃ upa |
10,167.02 imaṃ no yajñamiha bodhyā gahi spṛdho jayantaṃ maghavānamīmahe ||
10,167.03  somasya rājño varuṇasya dharmaṇi bṛhaspateranumatyā u śarmaṇi |
10,167.03 tavāhamadya maghavannupastutau dhātarvidhātaḥ kalaśāṃ abhakṣayam ||
10,167.04  prasūto bhakṣamakaraṃ carāvapi stomaṃ cemaṃ prathamaḥ sūrirunmṛje |
10,167.04 sute sātena yadyāgamaṃ vāṃ prati viśvāmitrajamadagnī dame ||

10,168.01  vātasya nu mahimānaṃ rathasya rujanneti stanayannasya ghoṣaḥ |
10,168.01 divispṛgyātyaruṇāni kṛṇvannuto eti pṛthivyā reṇumasyan ||
10,168.02  saṃ prerate anu vātasya viṣṭhā ainaṃ gacchanti samanaṃ na yoṣāḥ |
10,168.02 tābhiḥ sayuksarathaṃ deva īyate'sya viśvasya bhuvanasya rājā ||
10,168.03  antarikṣe pathibhirīyamāno na ni viśate katamaccanāhaḥ |
10,168.03 apāṃ sakhā prathamajā ṛtāvā kva svijjātaḥ kuta ā babhūva ||
10,168.04  ātmā devānāṃ bhuvanasya garbho yathāvaśaṃ carati deva eṣaḥ |
10,168.04 ghoṣā idasya śṛṇvire na rūpaṃ tasmai vātāya haviṣā vidhema ||

10,169.01  mayobhūrvāto abhi vātūsrā ūrjasvatīroṣadhīrā riśantām |
10,169.01 pīvasvatīrjīvadhanyāḥ pibantvavasāya padvate rudra mṛḻa ||
10,169.02  yāḥ sarūpā virūpā ekarūpā yāsāmagniriṣṭyā nāmāni veda |
10,169.02 yā aṅgirasastapaseha cakrustābhyaḥ parjanya mahi śarma yaccha ||
10,169.03  yā deveṣu tanvamairayanta yāsāṃ somo viśvā rūpāṇi veda |
10,169.03 tā asmabhyaṃ payasā pinvamānāḥ prajāvatīrindra goṣṭhe rirīhi ||
10,169.04  prajāpatirmahyametā rarāṇo viśvairdevaiḥ pitṛbhiḥ saṃvidānaḥ |
10,169.04 śivāḥ satīrupa no goṣṭhamākastāsāṃ vayaṃ prajayā saṃ sadema ||

10,170.01  vibhrāḍbṛhatpibatu somyaṃ madhvāyurdadhadyajñapatāvavihrutam |
10,170.01 vātajūto yo abhirakṣati tmanā prajāḥ pupoṣa purudhā vi rājati ||
10,170.02  vibhrāḍbṛhatsubhṛtaṃ vājasātamaṃ dharmandivo dharuṇe satyamarpitam |
10,170.02 amitrahā vṛtrahā dasyuhantamaṃ jyotirjajñe asurahā sapatnahā ||
10,170.03  idaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ jyotiṣāṃ jyotiruttamaṃ viśvajiddhanajiducyate bṛhat |
10,170.03 viśvabhrāḍbhrājo mahi sūryo dṛśa uru paprathe saha ojo acyutam ||
10,170.04  vibhrājañjyotiṣā svaragaccho rocanaṃ divaḥ |
10,170.04 yenemā viśvā bhuvanānyābhṛtā viśvakarmaṇā viśvadevyāvatā ||

10,171.01  tvaṃ tyamiṭato rathamindra prāvaḥ sutāvataḥ |
10,171.01 aśṛṇoḥ somino havam ||
10,171.02  tvaṃ makhasya dodhataḥ śiro'va tvaco bharaḥ |
10,171.02 agacchaḥ somino gṛham ||
10,171.03  tvaṃ tyamindra martyamāstrabudhnāya venyam |
10,171.03 muhuḥ śrathnā manasyave ||
10,171.04  tvaṃ tyamindra sūryaṃ paścā santaṃ puraskṛdhi |
10,171.04 devānāṃ cittiro vaśam ||

10,172.01  ā yāhi vanasā saha gāvaḥ sacanta vartaniṃ yadūdhabhiḥ ||
10,172.02  ā yāhi vasvyā dhiyā maṃhiṣṭho jārayanmakhaḥ sudānubhiḥ ||
10,172.03  pitubhṛto na tantumitsudānavaḥ prati dadhmo yajāmasi ||
10,172.04  uṣā apa svasustamaḥ saṃ vartayati vartaniṃ sujātatā ||

10,173.01  ā tvāhārṣamantaredhi dhruvastiṣṭhāvicācaliḥ |
10,173.01 viśastvā sarvā vāñchantu mā tvadrāṣṭramadhi bhraśat ||
10,173.02  ihaivaidhi māpa cyoṣṭhāḥ parvata ivāvicācaliḥ |
10,173.02 indra iveha dhruvastiṣṭheha rāṣṭramu dhāraya ||
10,173.03  imamindro adīdharaddhruvaṃ dhruveṇa haviṣā |
10,173.03 tasmai somo adhi bravattasmā u brahmaṇaspatiḥ ||
10,173.04  dhruvā dyaurdhruvā pṛthivī dhruvāsaḥ parvatā ime |
10,173.04 dhruvaṃ viśvamidaṃ jagaddhruvo rājā viśāmayam ||
10,173.05  dhruvaṃ te rājā varuṇo dhruvaṃ devo bṛhaspatiḥ |
10,173.05 dhruvaṃ ta indraścāgniśca rāṣṭraṃ dhārayatāṃ dhruvam ||
10,173.06  dhruvaṃ dhruveṇa haviṣābhi somaṃ mṛśāmasi |
10,173.06 atho ta indraḥ kevalīrviśo balihṛtaskarat ||

10,174.01  abhīvartena haviṣā yenendro abhivāvṛte |
10,174.01 tenāsmānbrahmaṇaspate'bhi rāṣṭrāya vartaya ||
10,174.02  abhivṛtya sapatnānabhi yā no arātayaḥ |
10,174.02 abhi pṛtanyantaṃ tiṣṭhābhi yo na irasyati ||
10,174.03  abhi tvā devaḥ savitābhi somo avīvṛtat |
10,174.03 abhi tvā viśvā bhūtānyabhīvarto yathāsasi ||
10,174.04  yenendro haviṣā kṛtvyabhavaddyumnyuttamaḥ |
10,174.04 idaṃ tadakri devā asapatnaḥ kilābhuvam ||
10,174.05  asapatnaḥ sapatnahābhirāṣṭro viṣāsahiḥ |
10,174.05 yathāhameṣāṃ bhūtānāṃ virājāni janasya ca ||

10,175.01  pra vo grāvāṇaḥ savitā devaḥ suvatu dharmaṇā |
10,175.01 dhūrṣu yujyadhvaṃ sunuta ||
10,175.02  grāvāṇo apa ducchunāmapa sedhata durmatim |
10,175.02 usrāḥ kartana bheṣajam ||
10,175.03  grāvāṇa upareṣvā mahīyante sajoṣasaḥ |
10,175.03 vṛṣṇe dadhato vṛṣṇyam ||
10,175.04  grāvāṇaḥ savitā nu vo devaḥ suvatu dharmaṇā |
10,175.04 yajamānāya sunvate ||

10,176.01  pra sūnava ṛbhūṇāṃ bṛhannavanta vṛjanā |
10,176.01 kṣāmā ye viśvadhāyaso'śnandhenuṃ na mātaram ||
10,176.02  pra devaṃ devyā dhiyā bharatā jātavedasam |
10,176.02 havyā no vakṣadānuṣak ||
10,176.03  ayamu ṣya pra devayurhotā yajñāya nīyate |
10,176.03 ratho na yorabhīvṛto ghṛṇīvāñcetati tmanā ||
10,176.04  ayamagniruruṣyatyamṛtādiva janmanaḥ |
10,176.04 sahasaścitsahīyāndevo jīvātave kṛtaḥ ||

10,177.01  pataṅgamaktamasurasya māyayā hṛdā paśyanti manasā vipaścitaḥ |
10,177.01 samudre antaḥ kavayo vi cakṣate marīcīnāṃ padamicchanti vedhasaḥ ||
10,177.02  pataṅgo vācaṃ manasā bibharti tāṃ gandharvo'vadadgarbhe antaḥ |
10,177.02 tāṃ dyotamānāṃ svaryaṃ manīṣāmṛtasya pade kavayo ni pānti ||
10,177.03  apaśyaṃ gopāmanipadyamānamā ca parā ca pathibhiścarantam |
10,177.03 sa sadhrīcīḥ sa viṣūcīrvasāna ā varīvarti bhuvaneṣvantaḥ ||

10,178.01  tyamū ṣu vājinaṃ devajūtaṃ sahāvānaṃ tarutāraṃ rathānām |
10,178.01 ariṣṭanemiṃ pṛtanājamāśuṃ svastaye tārkṣyamihā huvema ||
10,178.02  indrasyeva rātimājohuvānāḥ svastaye nāvamivā ruhema |
10,178.02 urvī na pṛthvī bahule gabhīre mā vāmetau mā paretau riṣāma ||
10,178.03  sadyaścidyaḥ śavasā pañca kṛṣṭīḥ sūrya iva jyotiṣāpastatāna |
10,178.03 sahasrasāḥ śatasā asya raṃhirna smā varante yuvatiṃ na śaryām ||

10,179.01  uttiṣṭhatāva paśyatendrasya bhāgamṛtviyam |
10,179.01 yadi śrāto juhotana yadyaśrāto mamattana ||
10,179.02  śrātaṃ haviro ṣvindra pra yāhi jagāma sūro adhvano vimadhyam |
10,179.02 pari tvāsate nidhibhiḥ sakhāyaḥ kulapā na vrājapatiṃ carantam ||
10,179.03  śrātaṃ manya ūdhani śrātamagnau suśrātaṃ manye tadṛtaṃ navīyaḥ |
10,179.03 mādhyandinasya savanasya dadhnaḥ pibendra vajrinpurukṛjjuṣāṇaḥ ||

10,180.01  pra sasāhiṣe puruhūta śatrūñjyeṣṭhaste śuṣma iha rātirastu |
10,180.01 indrā bhara dakṣiṇenā vasūni patiḥ sindhūnāmasi revatīnām ||
10,180.02  mṛgo na bhīmaḥ kucaro giriṣṭhāḥ parāvata ā jaganthā parasyāḥ |
10,180.02 sṛkaṃ saṃśāya pavimindra tigmaṃ vi śatrūntāḻhi vi mṛdho nudasva ||
10,180.03  indra kṣatramabhi vāmamojo'jāyathā vṛṣabha carṣaṇīnām |
10,180.03 apānudo janamamitrayantamuruṃ devebhyo akṛṇoru lokam ||

10,181.01  prathaśca yasya saprathaśca nāmānuṣṭubhasya haviṣo haviryat |
10,181.01 dhāturdyutānātsavituśca viṣṇo rathantaramā jabhārā vasiṣṭhaḥ ||
10,181.02  avindante atihitaṃ yadāsīdyajñasya dhāma paramaṃ guhā yat |
10,181.02 dhāturdyutānātsavituśca viṣṇorbharadvājo bṛhadā cakre agneḥ ||
10,181.03  te'vindanmanasā dīdhyānā yaju ṣkannaṃ prathamaṃ devayānam |
10,181.03 dhāturdyutānātsavituśca viṣṇorā sūryādabharangharmamete ||

10,182.01  bṛhaspatirnayatu durgahā tiraḥ punarneṣadaghaśaṃsāya manma |
10,182.01 kṣipadaśastimapa durmatiṃ hannathā karadyajamānāya śaṃ yoḥ ||
10,182.02  narāśaṃso no'vatu prayāje śaṃ no astvanuyājo haveṣu |
10,182.02 kṣipadaśastimapa durmatiṃ hannathā karadyajamānāya śaṃ yoḥ ||
10,182.03  tapurmūrdhā tapatu rakṣaso ye brahmadviṣaḥ śarave hantavā u |
10,182.03 kṣipadaśastimapa durmatiṃ hannathā karadyajamānāya śaṃ yoḥ ||

10,183.01  apaśyaṃ tvā manasā cekitānaṃ tapaso jātaṃ tapaso vibhūtam |
10,183.01 iha prajāmiha rayiṃ rarāṇaḥ pra jāyasva prajayā putrakāma ||
10,183.02  apaśyaṃ tvā manasā dīdhyānāṃ svāyāṃ tanū ṛtvye nādhamānām |
10,183.02 upa māmuccā yuvatirbabhūyāḥ pra jāyasva prajayā putrakāme ||
10,183.03  ahaṃ garbhamadadhāmoṣadhīṣvahaṃ viśveṣu bhuvaneṣvantaḥ |
10,183.03 ahaṃ prajā ajanayaṃ pṛthivyāmahaṃ janibhyo aparīṣu putrān ||

10,184.01  viṣṇuryoniṃ kalpayatu tvaṣṭā rūpāṇi piṃśatu |
10,184.01 ā siñcatu prajāpatirdhātā garbhaṃ dadhātu te ||
10,184.02  garbhaṃ dhehi sinīvāli garbhaṃ dhehi sarasvati |
10,184.02 garbhaṃ te aśvinau devāvā dhattāṃ puṣkarasrajā ||
10,184.03  hiraṇyayī araṇī yaṃ nirmanthato aśvinā |
10,184.03 taṃ te garbhaṃ havāmahe daśame māsi sūtave ||

10,185.01  mahi trīṇāmavo'stu dyukṣaṃ mitrasyāryamṇaḥ |
10,185.01 durādharṣaṃ varuṇasya ||
10,185.02  nahi teṣāmamā cana nādhvasu vāraṇeṣu |
10,185.02 īśe ripuraghaśaṃsaḥ ||
10,185.03  yasmai putrāso aditeḥ pra jīvase martyāya |
10,185.03 jyotiryacchantyajasram ||

10,186.01  vāta ā vātu bheṣajaṃ śambhu mayobhu no hṛde |
10,186.01 pra ṇa āyūṃṣi tāriṣat ||
10,186.02  uta vāta pitāsi na uta bhrātota naḥ sakhā |
10,186.02 sa no jīvātave kṛdhi ||
10,186.03  yadado vāta te gṛhe'mṛtasya nidhirhitaḥ |
10,186.03 tato no dehi jīvase ||

10,187.01  prāgnaye vācamīraya vṛṣabhāya kṣitīnām |
10,187.01 sa naḥ parṣadati dviṣaḥ ||
10,187.02  yaḥ parasyāḥ parāvatastiro dhanvātirocate |
10,187.02 sa naḥ parṣadati dviṣaḥ ||
10,187.03  yo rakṣāṃsi nijūrvati vṛṣā śukreṇa śociṣā |
10,187.03 sa naḥ parṣadati dviṣaḥ ||
10,187.04  yo viśvābhi vipaśyati bhuvanā saṃ ca paśyati |
10,187.04 sa naḥ parṣadati dviṣaḥ ||
10,187.05  yo asya pāre rajasaḥ śukro agnirajāyata |
10,187.05 sa naḥ parṣadati dviṣaḥ ||

10,188.01  pra nūnaṃ jātavedasamaśvaṃ hinota vājinam |
10,188.01 idaṃ no barhirāsade ||
10,188.02  asya pra jātavedaso vipravīrasya mīḻhuṣaḥ |
10,188.02 mahīmiyarmi suṣṭutim ||
10,188.03  yā ruco jātavedaso devatrā havyavāhanīḥ |
10,188.03 tābhirno yajñaminvatu ||

10,189.01  āyaṃ gauḥ pṛśnirakramīdasadanmātaraṃ puraḥ |
10,189.01 pitaraṃ ca prayansvaḥ ||
10,189.02  antaścarati rocanāsya prāṇādapānatī |
10,189.02 vyakhyanmahiṣo divam ||
10,189.03  triṃśaddhāma vi rājati vākpataṅgāya dhīyate |
10,189.03 prati vastoraha dyubhiḥ ||

10,190.01  ṛtaṃ ca satyaṃ cābhīddhāttapaso'dhyajāyata |
10,190.01 tato rātryajāyata tataḥ samudro arṇavaḥ ||
10,190.02  samudrādarṇavādadhi saṃvatsaro ajāyata |
10,190.02 ahorātrāṇi vidadhadviśvasya miṣato vaśī ||
10,190.03  sūryācandramasau dhātā yathāpūrvamakalpayat |
10,190.03 divaṃ ca pṛthivīṃ cāntarikṣamatho svaḥ ||

10,191.01  saṃsamidyuvase vṛṣannagne viśvānyarya ā |
10,191.01 iḻaspade samidhyase sa no vasūnyā bhara ||
10,191.02  saṃ gacchadhvaṃ saṃ vadadhvaṃ saṃ vo manāṃsi jānatām |
10,191.02 devā bhāgaṃ yathā pūrve saṃjānānā upāsate ||
10,191.03  samāno mantraḥ samitiḥ samānī samānaṃ manaḥ saha cittameṣām |
10,191.03 samānaṃ mantramabhi mantraye vaḥ samānena vo haviṣā juhomi ||
10,191.04  samānī va ākūtiḥ samānā hṛdayāni vaḥ |
10,191.04 samānamastu vo mano yathā vaḥ susahāsati ||
